// [AI] Rekomendasi proyek: konteks data lengkap -> temuan deterministik -> narasi AI (Gemini, sama seperti m_proyekCRD.php)
//   Temuan (findings) SELALU dihitung oleh sistem dari data, lalu dikirim ke AI sebagai daftar yang wajib dibahas, sehingga
//   tidak ada indikator yang terlewat. Bila AI tidak tersedia, narasi disusun dari temuan yang sama (ai_used = false).
// ============================================================
if (!function_exists('dash_call_gemini')) {
    function dash_call_gemini(string $prompt, int $timeout = 45): string {
        $apiKey = getenv('GOOGLE_API_KEY');
        if (!$apiKey) throw new Exception('GOOGLE_API_KEY belum diset di environment server.');
        $candidateModels = ['gemini-3.6-flash', 'gemini-3.5-flash-lite'];     // sama dengan mpCallGemini()
        $response = null; $httpCode = 0; $lastErrorMsg = '';
        foreach ($candidateModels as $model) {
            $apiUrl = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{$model}:generateContent";
            for ($attempt = 1; $attempt <= 2; $attempt++) {
                $ch = curl_init($apiUrl);
                curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
                curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST, 'POST');
                curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, json_encode([
                    'contents' => [['parts' => [['text' => $prompt]]]],
                    'generationConfig' => ['responseMimeType' => 'application/json', 'temperature' => 0.3]
                ]));
                curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ['Content-Type: application/json', 'x-goog-api-key: ' . $apiKey]);
                curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, $timeout);
                $response = curl_exec($ch);
                $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
                curl_close($ch);
                if ($httpCode === 200) break 2;
                $lastErrorMsg = "Model {$model} (HTTP {$httpCode})";
                if ($httpCode === 503 || $httpCode === 429) sleep(1); else break;
            }
        }
        if ($httpCode !== 200) throw new Exception("Gagal terhubung ke Gemini API: {$lastErrorMsg}");
        $apiResult = json_decode($response, true);
        $raw = $apiResult['candidates'][0]['content']['parts'][0]['text'] ?? '';
        return trim(str_replace(['```json', '```'], '', $raw));
    }
}

/** Kumpulkan seluruh data proyek yang relevan + temuan deterministik. */
function dash_project_context($db, int $pid): ?array {
    $q = function (string $sql, array $p = []) use ($db) { $st = $db->prepare($sql); $st->execute($p); return $st; };
    $proj = $q("SELECT id, name, status, start_date, end_date, contract_value, COALESCE(ppn_rate,0) AS ppn_rate, COALESCE(ppn_inclusive,false) AS ppn_inclusive,
                       COALESCE(progress,0) AS progress,
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(budget * COALESCE(NULLIF(budget_exch_rate, 0), 1), 0), (SELECT SUM(b.qty_plan*b.unit_price_plan) FROM budget_items b WHERE b.project_id = projects.id), 0) AS budget
                  FROM projects WHERE id = :p", [':p' => $pid])->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$proj) return null;
    $progress = (int)$proj['progress']; $budget = (float)$proj['budget'];
    $cv = (float)$proj['contract_value'];
    $inclusive = ($proj['ppn_inclusive'] === true || $proj['ppn_inclusive'] === 't');
    $contractDpp = ($inclusive && (float)$proj['ppn_rate'] > 0) ? $cv / (1 + (float)$proj['ppn_rate'] / 100) : $cv;

    $issueWhere = "h.project_id = :p AND h.status = 'posted' AND h.reversed_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(h.issue_type,'PROJECT') = 'PROJECT'";
    // [F-1.2 2026-11-16] SATU RUMUS realisasi: public.v_project_actual_cost via ProjectActualCost().
    // cost_total WAJIB sama dengan prog_metrics() (menu Progress) dan wr_calc() (modul WIP Release).
    if (function_exists('ProjectActualCost')) {
        $ac = ProjectActualCost($db, $pid);
    } else {
        $ac = null;
    }
    if ($ac !== null) {
        $cm = $ac['cost_material'];
        $ce = $ac['cost_expense'];
        $cs = $ac['cost_subcon'];
        $budget = (float)$ac['budget_base'];
    } else {
        // Fallback defensif bila migration F-1.2 belum dijalankan: rumus lama dipertahankan.
        $cm = (float)$q("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty_out*i.unit_cost),0) FROM material_out_items i JOIN material_out_header h ON h.id = i.material_out_id WHERE {$issueWhere}", [':p' => $pid])->fetchColumn();
        $ce = (float)$q("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM financial_expenses WHERE project_id = :p AND COALESCE(UPPER(status),'') NOT IN ('VOID','CANCELLED','CANCELED','BATAL','DIBATALKAN')", [':p' => $pid])->fetchColumn();
        $cs = 0.0;
    }
    $hasSub = tbl_exists($db, 'subcon_progress') && tbl_exists($db, 'subcon_contracts');
    $sub = ['kontrak_aktif' => 0, 'nilai_kontrak' => 0.0, 'tertagih_dpp' => 0.0, 'sisa_hutang' => 0.0];
    if ($hasSub) {
        // [REVISI 2026-11-13] Biaya Subcon dari subcon_payment_certificates (status APPROVED)
        // Menggunakan gross_amount (bukan amount_certified) sesuai struktur database aktual
        $hasCert = tbl_exists($db, 'subcon_payment_certificates');
        $r = null;
        
        if ($hasCert) {
            try {
                $r = $q("SELECT 
                            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subcon_contracts WHERE project_id = :p AND status IN ('Disetujui','Selesai')) AS n,
                            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(contract_value),0) FROM subcon_contracts WHERE project_id = :p AND status IN ('Disetujui','Selesai')) AS v,
                            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(spc.gross_amount),0) 
                             FROM subcon_payment_certificates spc
                             JOIN subcon_inspections si ON si.id = spc.inspection_id
                             JOIN subcon_progress sp ON sp.id = si.progress_id
                             JOIN subcon_contracts sc ON sc.id = sp.contract_id
                             WHERE sc.project_id = :p AND spc.status = 'APPROVED') AS g,
                            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(spc.net_payable),0) 
                             FROM subcon_payment_certificates spc
                             JOIN subcon_inspections si ON si.id = spc.inspection_id
                             JOIN subcon_progress sp ON sp.id = si.progress_id
                             JOIN subcon_contracts sc ON sc.id = sp.contract_id
                             WHERE sc.project_id = :p AND spc.status = 'APPROVED')
                            - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(y.amount),0) FROM subcon_payments y 
                               JOIN subcon_contracts sc ON sc.id = y.contract_id 
                               WHERE sc.project_id = :p AND y.status = 'Posted' AND y.pay_type = 'PROGRESS') AS h",
                          [':p' => $pid])->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                error_log('[project.analysis] subcon cert query error: ' . $e->getMessage());
                $r = null;
            }
        }
        
        if ($r === null) {
            // Fallback ke logika lama jika query baru gagal
            $r = $q("SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subcon_contracts WHERE project_id = :p AND status IN ('Disetujui','Selesai')) AS n,
                            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(contract_value),0) FROM subcon_contracts WHERE project_id = :p AND status IN ('Disetujui','Selesai')) AS v,
                            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sp.gross_amount),0) FROM subcon_progress sp JOIN subcon_contracts sc ON sc.id = sp.contract_id WHERE sc.project_id = :p AND sp.status = 'Disetujui') AS g,
                            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sp.net_payable),0) FROM subcon_progress sp JOIN subcon_contracts sc ON sc.id = sp.contract_id WHERE sc.project_id = :p AND sp.status = 'Disetujui')
                            - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(y.amount),0) FROM subcon_payments y JOIN subcon_contracts sc ON sc.id = y.contract_id WHERE sc.project_id = :p AND y.status = 'Posted' AND y.pay_type = 'PROGRESS') AS h",
                      [':p' => $pid])->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        }
        $sub = ['kontrak_aktif' => (int)$r['n'], 'nilai_kontrak' => round((float)$r['v'], 2), 'tertagih_dpp' => round((float)$r['g'], 2), 'sisa_hutang' => round((float)$r['h'], 2)];
    }
    // [F-1.2] Bila view sudah dimigrasi, $cs (realisasi subkon) sudah datang dari ProjectActualCost() dan jumlah
    //   sertifikat dihitung dengan sumber yang SAMA (subcon_payment_certificates.gross_amount APPROVED), jadi
    //   memakai $sub['tertagih_dpp'] di sini akan dobel-hitung. Bila view BELUM ada ($ac === null), tetap pakai
    //   logika lama agar dashboard tetap jalan tanpa migrasi.
    // Catatan: $sub (nilai kontrak, sisa hutang, dst.) tetap ditampilkan — hanya sisi BIAYA yang disatukan.
    if ($ac === null) {
        $cs = $sub['tertagih_dpp'];
    }
    $cost = $cm + $ce + $cs;
    $usage = $budget > 0 ? $cost / $budget * 100 : null;
    $gap = $usage !== null ? $usage - $progress : null;

    // waktu terpakai
    $elapsed = null; $daysToEnd = null;
    if ($proj['start_date'] && $proj['end_date']) {
        $sd = new DateTime($proj['start_date']); $ed = new DateTime($proj['end_date']); $today = new DateTime('today');
        $span = (int)$sd->diff($ed)->format('%r%a');
        if ($span > 0) $elapsed = max(0, min(100, ((int)$sd->diff($today)->format('%r%a')) / $span * 100));
        $daysToEnd = (int)$today->diff($ed)->format('%r%a');
    }

    // RAB material: yang paling melampaui (termasuk material di luar RAB)
    $rab = $q("SELECT COALESCE(m.material_name, '(material #' || COALESCE(bx.material_id, ox.material_id) || ')') AS material,
                      COALESCE(bx.plan,0) AS plan_qty, COALESCE(bx.tol,0) AS tol, COALESCE(ox.q,0) AS out_qty,
                      COALESCE(bx.plan_value,0) AS plan_value, COALESCE(ox.v,0) AS out_value, (bx.material_id IS NULL) AS no_rab
                 FROM (SELECT b.material_id, SUM(b.qty_plan) AS plan, MAX(COALESCE(b.tolerance_pct,0)) AS tol, SUM(b.qty_plan*b.unit_price_plan) AS plan_value
                         FROM budget_items b WHERE b.project_id = :p AND b.material_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.material_id) bx
                 FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT i.material_id, SUM(i.qty_out) AS q, SUM(i.qty_out*i.unit_cost) AS v
                                    FROM material_out_items i JOIN material_out_header h ON h.id = i.material_out_id
                                   WHERE {$issueWhere} GROUP BY i.material_id) ox ON ox.material_id = bx.material_id
                 LEFT JOIN materials m ON m.id = COALESCE(bx.material_id, ox.material_id)
                WHERE COALESCE(ox.q,0) > 0
                ORDER BY (COALESCE(ox.v,0) - COALESCE(bx.plan_value,0)) DESC LIMIT 8", [':p' => $pid])->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    $overLines = []; $noRabLines = [];
    foreach ($rab as &$r) {
        $r['plan_qty'] = (float)$r['plan_qty']; $r['out_qty'] = (float)$r['out_qty']; $r['plan_value'] = round((float)$r['plan_value'], 2); $r['out_value'] = round((float)$r['out_value'], 2);
        $r['no_rab'] = ($r['no_rab'] === true || $r['no_rab'] === 't');
        $r['used_pct'] = $r['plan_qty'] > 0 ? round($r['out_qty'] / $r['plan_qty'] * 100, 1) : null;
        if ($r['no_rab']) $noRabLines[] = $r;
        elseif ($r['out_qty'] > $r['plan_qty'] * (1 + (float)$r['tol'] / 100) + 0.0005) $overLines[] = $r;
        unset($r['tol']);
    }
    unset($r);
    $lastIssue = $q("SELECT MAX(h.issue_date) FROM material_out_header h WHERE {$issueWhere}", [':p' => $pid])->fetchColumn();
    $daysSinceIssue = $lastIssue ? (int)(new DateTime($lastIssue))->diff(new DateTime('today'))->format('%r%a') : null;

    // penagihan & piutang
    $bill = $q("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(v.dpp_amount, v.amount)),0) AS billed_dpp,
                       COALESCE(SUM(" . str_replace('pinv.', 'v.', AR_OS) . "),0) AS ar_outstanding,
                       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND " . str_replace('pinv.', 'v.', AR_OS) . " > 0.005 THEN " . str_replace('pinv.', 'v.', AR_OS) . " END),0) AS ar_overdue,
                       COUNT(CASE WHEN v.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND " . str_replace('pinv.', 'v.', AR_OS) . " > 0.005 THEN 1 END) AS overdue_cnt,
                       COUNT(*) AS inv_cnt
                  FROM project_invoices v WHERE v.project_id = :p AND v.release_status = 'released'", [':p' => $pid])->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);   // [RELEASE-LAYER] hanya tagihan resmi
    $billed = (float)$bill['billed_dpp'];
    $collected = (float)$q("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ppi.amount_paid),0) FROM project_payment_items ppi JOIN project_invoices v ON v.id = ppi.invoice_id WHERE v.project_id = :p", [':p' => $pid])->fetchColumn();
    $billedPct = $contractDpp > 0 ? $billed / $contractDpp * 100 : null;
    $margin = $billed > 0 ? ($billed - $cost) / $billed * 100 : null;

    // task
    $taskTotal = 0; $taskDone = 0; $lateTasks = [];
    if (tbl_exists($db, 'project_tasks')) {
        $r = $q("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Selesai','Closed','Done') THEN 1 END) AS d FROM project_tasks WHERE project_id = :p", [':p' => $pid])->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $taskTotal = (int)$r['n']; $taskDone = (int)$r['d'];
        $lateTasks = $q("SELECT task_name, end_date, (CURRENT_DATE - end_date) AS days_late FROM project_tasks
                          WHERE project_id = :p AND end_date < CURRENT_DATE AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Selesai','Closed','Done') ORDER BY end_date ASC LIMIT 5", [':p' => $pid])->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $lateCount = (int)$q("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_tasks WHERE project_id = :p AND end_date < CURRENT_DATE AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Selesai','Closed','Done')", [':p' => $pid])->fetchColumn();
    } else { $lateCount = 0; }
    foreach ($lateTasks as &$t) $t['days_late'] = (int)$t['days_late'];
    unset($t);

    // pembelian
    $po = $q("SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status='Draft' THEN 1 END) AS draft, COUNT(CASE WHEN status='Diajukan' THEN 1 END) AS diajukan, COUNT(CASE WHEN status='Disetujui' THEN 1 END) AS disetujui
                FROM purchase_orders WHERE project_id = :p", [':p' => $pid])->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    $grnUninv = (int)$q("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM grn_hdr g JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id = g.po_id WHERE po.project_id = :p
                           AND COALESCE(LOWER(g.status),'') NOT IN ('cancelled','canceled','dibatalkan','void','reversed')
                           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_invoice_dtl d WHERE d.grn_hdr_id = g.id)", [':p' => $pid])->fetchColumn();
    $returOpen = tbl_exists($db, 'supplier_return_hdr') ? (int)$q("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier_return_hdr WHERE project_id = :p AND status = 'Dikirim'", [':p' => $pid])->fetchColumn() : 0;
    $opnameLoss = ['jumlah' => 0, 'nilai_kurang' => 0.0];
    if (tbl_exists($db, 'stock_opname_hdr')) {
        try {       // bagian opsional: kegagalan di sini tidak boleh menggagalkan seluruh analisis
            $r = $q("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_loss),0) AS l FROM stock_opname_hdr o JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id
                      WHERE w.project_id = :p AND o.status = 'Disetujui'", [':p' => $pid])->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            $opnameLoss = ['jumlah' => (int)$r['n'], 'nilai_kurang' => round((float)$r['l'], 2)];
        } catch (Exception $e) { error_log('[dashboardCRD] ctx opname: ' . $e->getMessage()); }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ temuan deterministik
    $F = [];
    $add = function (string $code, string $sev, string $title, string $evidence, string $action) use (&$F) { $F[] = compact('code', 'sev', 'title', 'evidence', 'action'); };
    $rp = function ($v) { return 'Rp ' . number_format((float)$v, 0, ',', '.'); };
    $pc = function ($v) { return rtrim(rtrim(number_format((float)$v, 1, ',', '.'), '0'), ','); };

    if ($budget <= 0) $add('BUDGET_EMPTY', 'medium', 'Budget proyek belum diisi', 'Budget proyek dan RAB bernilai 0, sehingga pemakaian biaya tidak dapat diukur.', 'Isi budget di Master Proyek atau lengkapi RAB.');
    if ($usage !== null && $usage > 100) $add('BUDGET_OVER', 'high', 'Biaya melampaui budget', "Biaya riil {$rp($cost)} = {$pc($usage)}% dari budget {$rp($budget)}.", 'Tahan pengeluaran baru; ajukan revisi RAB atau addendum kontrak.');
    if ($gap !== null && $gap >= HEALTH_WARN_GAP) {
        $dom = $cost > 0 ? ($cm / $cost >= 0.5 ? 'material' : ($cs / $cost >= 0.5 ? 'prestasi subkon' : 'pengeluaran non-material')) : '-';
        $add('COST_AHEAD', $gap >= HEALTH_CRIT_GAP ? 'high' : 'medium', 'Pemakaian biaya jauh di depan progres',
             "Pemakaian {$pc($usage)}% vs progres {$progress}% (gap +" . round($gap) . "); biaya didominasi {$dom} (material {$rp($cm)}, pengeluaran {$rp($ce)}, subkon {$rp($cs)}).",
             $dom === 'material' ? 'Lakukan stock opname lapangan dan cocokkan issue material dengan progres fisik.' : ($dom === 'prestasi subkon' ? 'Verifikasi prestasi subkon dengan berita acara progres lapangan.' : 'Tinjau bukti dan alokasi pengeluaran proyek.'));
    }
    if ($gap !== null && $gap <= -25 && $progress > 0) $add('COST_UNRECORDED', 'medium', 'Biaya kemungkinan belum tercatat',
             "Pemakaian hanya {$pc($usage)}% sementara progres {$progress}% (gap " . round($gap) . "). Ini bukan otomatis efisiensi: material belum di-issue, tagihan supplier/subkon belum diinput, atau progres terlalu tinggi.",
             'Cocokkan dengan pengeluaran lapangan: issue material, prestasi subkon, invoice supplier, dan pengeluaran yang belum dicatat; verifikasi angka progres.');
    if ($progress === 0 && $elapsed !== null && $elapsed >= 20) $add('PROGRESS_NOT_UPDATED', 'medium', 'Progres belum diperbarui',
             "Progres tercatat 0% padahal waktu terpakai {$pc($elapsed)}%. Gap dan status kesehatan tidak dapat dipercaya sampai progres diisi.", 'Perbarui progres lapangan lewat modul Project Progress.');
    if (count($overLines)) { $n = $overLines[0];
        $add('MATERIAL_OVER_RAB', 'high', count($overLines) . ' material melebihi batas RAB', 'Terbesar: ' . $n['material'] . " keluar {$n['out_qty']} dari rencana {$n['plan_qty']} ({$pc($n['used_pct'])}%).", 'Selidiki pemakaian berlebih (pemborosan, kehilangan, salah catat) dan lakukan stock opname material tersebut.'); }
    if (count($noRabLines)) $add('MATERIAL_NO_RAB', 'medium', count($noRabLines) . ' material keluar tanpa baris RAB', 'Contoh: ' . $noRabLines[0]['material'] . ' senilai ' . $rp($noRabLines[0]['out_value']) . '.', 'Pastikan material tersebut sah untuk proyek ini; tambahkan ke RAB atau koreksi issue.');
    if ($hasSub && $sub['nilai_kontrak'] > 0 && $contractDpp > 0) {
        $subPct = $sub['tertagih_dpp'] / $sub['nilai_kontrak'] * 100;
        if ($subPct - $progress >= 15) $add('SUBCON_AHEAD', 'medium', 'Prestasi subkon mendahului progres proyek', "Prestasi subkon disetujui {$pc($subPct)}% dari nilai SPK sedangkan progres proyek {$progress}%.", 'Verifikasi berita acara prestasi sebelum prestasi berikutnya disetujui.');
    }
    if ($billedPct !== null && $contractDpp > 0 && $progress - $billedPct >= 15 && $billed < $contractDpp) $add('BILLING_LAG', 'medium', 'Penagihan tertinggal dari progres', "Tertagih {$pc($billedPct)}% dari kontrak sedangkan progres {$progress}%.", 'Terbitkan termin berikutnya agar arus kas tidak tertekan.');
    if ((float)$bill['ar_overdue'] > 0.005) $add('AR_OVERDUE', 'high', 'Piutang klien jatuh tempo', "{$bill['overdue_cnt']} tagihan senilai {$rp($bill['ar_overdue'])} sudah lewat jatuh tempo.", 'Lakukan penagihan segera dan eskalasi ke klien.');
    if ($elapsed !== null && $progress > 0 && $elapsed - $progress >= 15) $add('SCHEDULE_LAG', 'medium', 'Progres tertinggal dari jadwal', "Waktu terpakai {$pc($elapsed)}% vs progres {$progress}%" . ($lateCount ? "; {$lateCount} task terlambat" : '') . '.', 'Tinjau jadwal (S-curve) dan tambah sumber daya pada task kritis.');
    if ($daysToEnd !== null && $daysToEnd < 0 && $progress < 100) $add('PAST_DEADLINE', 'high', 'Melewati tanggal selesai', 'Tanggal selesai terlewat ' . abs($daysToEnd) . " hari, progres {$progress}%.", 'Tetapkan jadwal baru atau addendum waktu dan kendalikan denda keterlambatan.');
    if ($lateCount > 0 && !count(array_filter($F, function ($f) { return $f['code'] === 'SCHEDULE_LAG'; }))) $add('TASKS_LATE', 'medium', "{$lateCount} task terlambat", 'Terlama: ' . ($lateTasks[0]['task_name'] ?? '-') . ' (' . ($lateTasks[0]['days_late'] ?? 0) . ' hari).', 'Perbarui status task atau susun rencana pemulihan.');
    if ($margin !== null && $margin < 10) $add('MARGIN_LOW', $margin < 0 ? 'high' : 'medium', 'Margin berjalan rendah', "Margin {$pc($margin)}% (tertagih {$rp($billed)} - biaya {$rp($cost)}).", 'Tinjau biaya terhadap tagihan dan pertimbangkan klaim variation order.');
    if ($returOpen > 0) $add('RETUR_OPEN', 'low', "{$returOpen} retur supplier belum diselesaikan", 'Retur sudah dikirim tetapi belum diganti / dikreditkan.', 'Selesaikan retur (ganti barang atau nota kredit).');
    if ($grnUninv > 0) $add('GRN_UNINVOICED', 'low', "{$grnUninv} GRN belum di-invoice", 'Barang sudah diterima tetapi tagihan supplier belum dicatat.', 'Catat invoice supplier agar hutang dan PPN masukan tercatat.');
    if ($opnameLoss['nilai_kurang'] > 0) $add('OPNAME_LOSS', 'medium', 'Opname gudang proyek mencatat selisih kurang', "{$opnameLoss['jumlah']} opname disetujui dengan nilai kurang {$rp($opnameLoss['nilai_kurang'])}.", 'Telusuri penyebab selisih dan perketat kontrol penerimaan / pengeluaran gudang.');
    if ($progress > 0 && $daysSinceIssue !== null && $daysSinceIssue > 30) $add('NO_RECENT_ISSUE', 'low', 'Tidak ada pengeluaran material baru', "Issue material terakhir {$daysSinceIssue} hari lalu padahal proyek berjalan.", 'Pastikan pemakaian material lapangan dicatat tepat waktu.');

    $rank = ['high' => 0, 'medium' => 1, 'low' => 2];
    usort($F, function ($a, $b) use ($rank) { return $rank[$a['sev']] <=> $rank[$b['sev']]; });
    $risk = 'LOW';
    foreach ($F as $f) { if ($f['sev'] === 'high') { $risk = 'HIGH'; break; } if ($f['sev'] === 'medium') $risk = 'MEDIUM'; }

    return [
        'risk_rule' => $risk, 'findings' => $F,
        'metrics' => ['progress' => $progress, 'usage_pct' => $usage === null ? null : round($usage, 1), 'gap' => $gap === null ? null : round($gap, 1),
                      'budget' => round($budget, 2), 'cost_total' => round($cost, 2), 'cost_material' => round($cm, 2), 'cost_expense' => round($ce, 2), 'cost_subcon' => round($cs, 2),
                      'elapsed_pct' => $elapsed === null ? null : round($elapsed, 1), 'margin_pct' => $margin === null ? null : round($margin, 1)],
        'context' => [
            'proyek' => ['nama' => $proj['name'], 'status' => $proj['status'], 'mulai' => $proj['start_date'], 'selesai' => $proj['end_date'], 'nilai_kontrak_dpp' => round($contractDpp, 2), 'progres_pct' => $progress, 'waktu_terpakai_pct' => $elapsed === null ? null : round($elapsed, 1), 'sisa_hari' => $daysToEnd],
            'biaya' => ['budget' => round($budget, 2), 'total' => round($cost, 2), 'material' => round($cm, 2), 'pengeluaran' => round($ce, 2), 'subkon' => round($cs, 2), 'pemakaian_pct' => $usage === null ? null : round($usage, 1)],
            'material_teratas' => $rab, 'material_terakhir_keluar_hari_lalu' => $daysSinceIssue,
            'subkon' => $sub,
            'penagihan' => ['tertagih_dpp' => round($billed, 2), 'tertagih_pct_kontrak' => $billedPct === null ? null : round($billedPct, 1), 'terbayar_klien' => round($collected, 2),
                            'piutang' => round((float)$bill['ar_outstanding'], 2), 'piutang_jatuh_tempo' => round((float)$bill['ar_overdue'], 2), 'margin_pct' => $margin === null ? null : round($margin, 1)],
            'task' => ['total' => $taskTotal, 'selesai' => $taskDone, 'terlambat' => $lateCount, 'terlambat_teratas' => $lateTasks],
            'pembelian' => ['po_draft' => (int)$po['draft'], 'po_diajukan' => (int)$po['diajukan'], 'po_disetujui' => (int)$po['disetujui'], 'grn_belum_diinvoice' => $grnUninv, 'retur_belum_selesai' => $returOpen],
            'opname_gudang_proyek' => $opnameLoss,
        ],
    ];
}


/** Kolom tambahan ai_variance_logs sudah dimigrasi? */
function avl_has_cols($db): bool {
    static $has = null;
    if ($has === null) {
        try {
            $st = $db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ai_variance_logs'
                                AND column_name IN ('analysis', 'source', 'ai_used', 'headline', 'risk_rule')");
            $has = ((int)$st->fetchColumn() === 5);
        } catch (Exception $e) { $has = false; }
    }
    return $has;
}

/**
 * Jalankan analisis satu proyek dan SIMPAN hasilnya ke ai_variance_logs.
 * $refresh=false : bila ada hasil AI untuk data yang sama dalam AI_LOG_TTL_HOURS jam, kembalikan hasil itu (tanpa panggil AI, tanpa baris baru).
 * $refresh=true  : selalu analisis ulang (panggil AI) dan simpan baris baru.
 */
function dash_run_analysis($db, int $pid, bool $refresh, string $source, ?int $userId): array {
    @set_time_limit(90);
    $ctx = dash_project_context($db, $pid);
    if (!$ctx) throw new Exception('Proyek tidak ditemukan.');
    $hasCols = avl_has_cols($db);
    $hash = md5(json_encode([$ctx['context'], $ctx['findings']], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) . date('Y-m-d'));

    if ($hasCols && !$refresh) {
        $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, analysis, created_at FROM ai_variance_logs
                             WHERE project_id = :p AND ai_used = true AND analysis->>'ctx_hash' = :h AND created_at > NOW() - (:ttl || ' hours')::interval
                             ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1");
        $st->execute([':p' => $pid, ':h' => $hash, ':ttl' => (string)AI_LOG_TTL_HOURS]);
        if ($row = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
            $res = json_decode($row['analysis'], true);
            if (is_array($res)) { $res['cached'] = true; $res['generated_at'] = $row['created_at']; $res['log_id'] = (int)$row['id']; return $res; }
        }
    }

    $F = $ctx['findings']; $risk = $ctx['risk_rule']; $name = $ctx['context']['proyek']['nama'];
    $aiUsed = false; $aiNote = ''; $headline = ''; $summary = ''; $actions = []; $questions = [];
    try {
        $prompt = "Anda adalah Project Controller senior untuk perusahaan kontraktor di Indonesia. Analisis kesehatan satu proyek berdasarkan DATA berikut dan beri rekomendasi.\n" .
            "DATA PROYEK (JSON): " . json_encode($ctx['context'], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) . "\n" .
            "TEMUAN SISTEM (WAJIB dibahas semuanya, jangan ada yang terlewat): " . json_encode($F, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) . "\n" .
            "ATURAN: (1) Bahasa Indonesia, spesifik, sebut angka dari data; jangan mengarang data yang tidak ada. " .
            "(2) Jelaskan hubungan antar temuan (mis. biaya di depan progres + material melebihi RAB = indikasi kebocoran material) dan beri hipotesis penyebab sebagai INDIKASI, bukan kepastian. " .
            "(3) Bila pemakaian biaya jauh DI BAWAH progres, jangan menyebutnya efisiensi tanpa syarat: sebutkan kemungkinan biaya belum tercatat atau progres terlalu tinggi. " .
            "(4) actions: 4-6 tindakan konkret berurutan prioritas yang bisa dilakukan di sistem ERP ini (stock opname, verifikasi prestasi subkon, terbitkan termin, update progres, revisi RAB, selesaikan retur, catat invoice supplier, dan sejenisnya). " .
            "(5) risk hanya salah satu dari LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH; risiko minimal sama dengan hasil sistem: {$risk}. " .
            "(6) questions: 0-3 hal yang perlu dikonfirmasi manusia karena data tidak cukup.\n" .
            "Jawab JSON MURNI: {\"risk\":\"LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH\",\"headline\":\"satu kalimat inti\",\"summary\":\"satu paragraf 3-5 kalimat\",\"actions\":[\"...\"],\"questions\":[\"...\"]}";
        $ai = json_decode(dash_call_gemini($prompt), true);
        if (is_array($ai) && !empty($ai['summary']) && !empty($ai['actions']) && is_array($ai['actions'])) {
            $order = ['LOW' => 0, 'MEDIUM' => 1, 'HIGH' => 2];
            $aiRisk = strtoupper((string)($ai['risk'] ?? 'LOW'));
            if ($aiRisk === 'CRITICAL') $aiRisk = 'HIGH';
            if (isset($order[$aiRisk]) && $order[$aiRisk] > $order[$risk]) $risk = $aiRisk;        // AI boleh menaikkan risiko, tidak menurunkan di bawah hasil aturan
            $headline = trim((string)($ai['headline'] ?? ''));
            $summary = trim((string)$ai['summary']);
            $actions = array_slice(array_values(array_filter(array_map('trim', array_map('strval', $ai['actions'])))), 0, 6);
            $questions = array_slice(array_values(array_filter(array_map('trim', array_map('strval', (array)($ai['questions'] ?? []))))), 0, 3);
            $aiUsed = true;
        } else { $aiNote = 'Respons AI tidak sesuai format; ditampilkan analisis sistem.'; }
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log('[project.analysis] gemini: ' . $e->getMessage());
        $aiNote = 'AI tidak tersedia (' . $e->getMessage() . '); ditampilkan analisis sistem.';
    }
    if (!$aiUsed) {
        $headline = count($F) ? "{$name}: " . $F[0]['title'] : "{$name}: tidak ada temuan yang perlu ditindaklanjuti.";
        $parts = []; foreach (array_slice($F, 0, 4) as $f) $parts[] = $f['evidence'];
        $summary = count($F) ? implode(' ', $parts) : 'Seluruh indikator (biaya, progres, jadwal, penagihan, pembelian) berada dalam batas normal.';
        $seen = [];
        foreach ($F as $f) { if (!isset($seen[$f['action']])) { $seen[$f['action']] = true; $actions[] = $f['action']; } }
        $actions = array_slice($actions, 0, 6);
    }

    $m = $ctx['metrics'];
    $result = ['project_id' => $pid, 'project_name' => $name, 'risk' => $risk, 'risk_rule' => $ctx['risk_rule'], 'headline' => $headline, 'summary' => $summary,
               'actions' => $actions, 'questions' => $questions, 'findings' => $F, 'metrics' => $m, 'ai_used' => $aiUsed, 'ai_note' => $aiNote,
               'cached' => false, 'ctx_hash' => $hash, 'source' => $source, 'generated_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s')];

    // simpan ke ai_variance_logs (setiap analisis baru / ulang)  -> dibaca kartu dashboard & layar Pembayaran Termin
    $budget = (float)$m['budget']; $cost = (float)$m['cost_total'];
    $varAmt = $cost - $budget; $varPct = $budget > 0 ? $varAmt / $budget * 100 : 0;
    try {
        if ($hasCols) {
            $st = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO ai_variance_logs
                    (project_id, total_budget, total_actual, variance_amount, variance_percentage, risk_level, ai_summary, recommendations, created_by,
                     risk_rule, headline, analysis, source, ai_used)
                VALUES (:pid, :tb, :ta, :va, :vp, :rl, :sum, CAST(:rec AS jsonb), :uid, :rr, :hl, CAST(:an AS jsonb), :src, :used)
                RETURNING id, created_at");
            $st->execute([':pid' => $pid, ':tb' => $budget, ':ta' => $cost, ':va' => $varAmt, ':vp' => $varPct, ':rl' => $risk, ':sum' => $summary,
                          ':rec' => json_encode($actions, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), ':uid' => $userId ?: null, ':rr' => $ctx['risk_rule'], ':hl' => $headline,
                          ':an' => json_encode($result, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), ':src' => $source, ':used' => $aiUsed ? 't' : 'f']);
        } else {      // kolom lama saja (migrasi belum dijalankan)
            $st = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO ai_variance_logs (project_id, total_budget, total_actual, variance_amount, variance_percentage, risk_level, ai_summary, recommendations, created_by)
                VALUES (:pid, :tb, :ta, :va, :vp, :rl, :sum, CAST(:rec AS jsonb), :uid) RETURNING id, created_at");
            $st->execute([':pid' => $pid, ':tb' => $budget, ':ta' => $cost, ':va' => $varAmt, ':vp' => $varPct, ':rl' => $risk, ':sum' => $summary,
                          ':rec' => json_encode($actions, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), ':uid' => $userId ?: null]);
        }
        $row = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $result['log_id'] = (int)$row['id']; $result['generated_at'] = $row['created_at'];
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log('[project.analysis] simpan log: ' . $e->getMessage());
        $result['log_id'] = null;
        $result['ai_note'] = trim($result['ai_note'] . ' Hasil belum tersimpan ke ai_variance_logs (' . $e->getMessage() . ').');
    }
    return $result;
}

/**
 * Status kartu kesehatan proyek -- SATU aturan untuk dashboard (selaras indeks biaya modul Project Progress: CPI < 0.80 merah, < 0.90 kuning).
 * Input : progress (%), budget, cost, end_date (Y-m-d|null), ai_risk (LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL|null)
 * Output: ['level' => NORMAL|WASPADA|KRITIS|NA, 'reasons' => [...], 'usage' => %|null, 'gap' => |null, 'cpi' => |null, 'late_days' => int]
 */
function dash_card_level(int $progress, float $budget, float $cost, ?string $endDate, ?string $aiRisk): array {
    $rank = ['NORMAL' => 0, 'NA' => 0, 'WASPADA' => 1, 'KRITIS' => 2];
    $level = 'NORMAL'; $reasons = [];
    $bump = function (string $lv, string $why) use (&$level, &$reasons, $rank) { if ($rank[$lv] > $rank[$level]) $level = $lv; $reasons[] = $why; };
    $usage = $budget > 0 ? $cost / $budget * 100 : null;
    $gap = $usage !== null ? $usage - $progress : null;
    $ev = $budget * $progress / 100;
    $cpi = ($budget > 0 && $cost > 0) ? $ev / $cost : null;
    if ($budget <= 0) { $level = 'NA'; if ($cost > 0) $reasons[] = 'Budget belum diisi'; }
    if ($usage !== null && $usage > 100) $bump('KRITIS', 'Biaya melampaui budget');
    if ($gap !== null && $gap >= HEALTH_CRIT_GAP) $bump('KRITIS', 'Gap biaya >= ' . HEALTH_CRIT_GAP);
    elseif ($gap !== null && $gap >= HEALTH_WARN_GAP) $bump('WASPADA', 'Gap biaya >= ' . HEALTH_WARN_GAP);
    if ($cpi !== null && $cpi < 0.80) $bump('KRITIS', 'Indeks biaya (CPI) ' . round($cpi, 2) . ' < 0,80');
    elseif ($cpi !== null && $cpi < 0.90) $bump('WASPADA', 'Indeks biaya (CPI) ' . round($cpi, 2) . ' < 0,90');
    $late = 0;
    if ($endDate && $progress < 100) {
        $late = -((int)(new DateTime('today'))->diff(new DateTime($endDate))->format('%r%a'));       // hari melewati tanggal selesai
        if ($late > 30) $bump('KRITIS', "Melewati tanggal selesai {$late} hari");
        elseif ($late > 0) $bump('WASPADA', "Melewati tanggal selesai {$late} hari");
    }
    if ($gap !== null && $gap <= -25 && $progress > 0) $bump('WASPADA', 'Biaya kemungkinan belum tercatat (pemakaian jauh di bawah progres)');
    $ai = strtoupper((string)$aiRisk);
    if ($ai === 'HIGH' || $ai === 'CRITICAL') $bump('KRITIS', 'Analisis AI terakhir: risiko ' . $ai);
    elseif ($ai === 'MEDIUM') $bump('WASPADA', 'Analisis AI terakhir: risiko MEDIUM');
    return ['level' => $level, 'reasons' => $reasons, 'usage' => $usage === null ? null : round($usage, 1), 'gap' => $gap === null ? null : round($gap, 1),
            'cpi' => $cpi === null ? null : round($cpi, 2), 'late_days' => max(0, $late)];
}

==================== FILE: ./php-func/fx.func.php ====================
<?php
/**
 * fx.func.php
 * ============================================================
 * Fungsi bantu mata uang & kurs, dipakai bersama oleh RAB, PO, Planning, dashboard, dst.
 *
 *   fx_base_currency($db)                 -> ['id' => int|null, 'code' => 'IDR'|..., 'configured' => bool]
 *   fx_default_rate($db, $currencyId, $date)
 *                                         -> ['rate' => float|null, 'source' => 'BASE'|'periode'|'terakhir'|'none',
 *                                             'kmk_no', 'start_date', 'end_date', 'base_code']
 *
 * Mata uang dasar = Pengaturan Sistem (finance_settings). Belum diatur -> IDR.
 * Kurs default = kurs pajak KMK (tax_exchange_rate_*) pada tanggal transaksi; tanggal belum
 * tercakup -> kurs terakhir; tidak ada data -> rate null (isi manual).
 * Nilai kurs = mata uang dasar per 1 unit mata uang (rate_per_unit; bila kosong rate / unit_multiplier).
 * KMK berbasis IDR, jadi kurs otomatis hanya tersedia bila mata uang dasar = IDR.
 * ============================================================
 */

function fx_base_currency($db): array {
    static $cache = null;
    if ($cache !== null) return $cache;
    $res = ['id' => null, 'code' => null, 'configured' => false];
    try {
        if ($db->query("SELECT to_regclass('public.finance_settings')")->fetchColumn()) {
            $r = $db->query("SELECT c.id, UPPER(TRIM(c.init)) AS code
                               FROM public.finance_settings f
                               JOIN public.m_currency c ON c.id = f.base_currency_id
                              WHERE f.id = 1")->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if ($r) return $cache = ['id' => (int)$r['id'], 'code' => $r['code'], 'configured' => true];
        }
        $r = $db->query("SELECT id FROM public.m_currency WHERE UPPER(TRIM(init)) = 'IDR' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1")->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($r) $res = ['id' => (int)$r['id'], 'code' => 'IDR', 'configured' => false];
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
    }
    return $cache = $res;
}

function fx_default_rate($db, int $currencyId, string $date): array {
    $dt = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $date);
    if (!$dt || $dt->format('Y-m-d') !== $date) $date = date('Y-m-d');

    $base = fx_base_currency($db);
    $out  = ['rate' => null, 'source' => 'none', 'kmk_no' => null, 'start_date' => null, 'end_date' => null,
             'base_code' => $base['code']];

    if ($base['id'] !== null && $currencyId === $base['id']) {
        return ['rate' => 1.0, 'source' => 'BASE'] + $out;
    }
    if ($base['code'] !== null && $base['code'] !== 'IDR') {
        return $out;                                   // KMK = IDR per unit -> tidak bisa dipakai
    }

    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT UPPER(TRIM(init)) FROM public.m_currency WHERE id = :id");
    $st->execute([':id' => $currencyId]);
    $code = $st->fetchColumn();
    if (!$code) return $out;

    $sql = "SELECT COALESCE(d.rate_per_unit, d.rate / NULLIF(d.unit_multiplier, 0)) AS rate,
                   h.kmk_no, h.start_date, h.end_date
              FROM public.tax_exchange_rate_dtl d
              JOIN public.tax_exchange_rate_hdr h ON h.id = d.hdr_id
             WHERE (d.currency_id = :cid OR UPPER(d.currency_code) = :code)";

    $st = $db->prepare($sql . " AND CAST(:d AS date) BETWEEN h.start_date AND h.end_date
                                 ORDER BY h.start_date DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT 1");
    $st->execute([':cid' => $currencyId, ':code' => $code, ':d' => $date]);
    $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    $source = 'periode';

    if (!$r || $r['rate'] === null) {
        $st = $db->prepare($sql . " ORDER BY h.end_date DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT 1");
        $st->execute([':cid' => $currencyId, ':code' => $code]);
        $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $source = 'terakhir';
    }
    if (!$r || $r['rate'] === null) return $out;

    return [
        'rate'       => round((float)$r['rate'], 4),
        'source'     => $source,
        'kmk_no'     => $r['kmk_no'],
        'start_date' => date('d/m/Y', strtotime($r['start_date'])),
        'end_date'   => date('d/m/Y', strtotime($r['end_date'])),
        'base_code'  => $base['code'],
    ];
}
==================== FILE: ./php-func/function.stock.php ====================
<?php
/**
 * function.stock.php
 * Helper stok bersama untuk: Warehouse Issuing, Stock Transfer, Stock Card, Stock Opname.
 *
 * Pemakaian di endpoint (setelah function.all.php yang menyediakan $conn):
 *     require_once '../php-func/function.all.php';
 *     require_once '../php-class/crudClass.php';
 *     require_once '../php-func/function.stock.php';
 *
 * ASUMSI (mohon diverifikasi):
 *   - stock_movements.movement_type berisi 'IN' / 'OUT', qty SELALU positif.
 *   - Saldo = SUM(IN) - SUM(OUT) per (item_id, warehouse_id).
 *   - Costing FIFO: layer = baris 'IN' berurutan (movement_date, id); total OUT historis
 *     "memakan" layer dari yang tertua.
 */

if (!class_exists('WhException')) {
    // Error bisnis (pesan aman ditampilkan ke user). Exception lain -> pesan generik + log.
    class WhException extends Exception {}
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Response & logging                                                  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
if (!function_exists('WhJson')) {
    function WhJson($arr) {
        while (ob_get_level() > 0) { ob_end_clean(); }   // buang output liar agar JSON tetap valid
        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
        echo json_encode($arr);
        exit;
    }
}
function WhFail($msg) { WhJson(array('success' => false, 'message' => $msg)); }
function WhOk($msg, $extra = array()) { WhJson(array_merge(array('success' => true, 'message' => $msg), $extra)); }

function WhLog($msg) {
    $dir = dirname(__FILE__) . '/../logs';              // simpan di file log terpisah
    if (!is_dir($dir)) { @mkdir($dir, 0775, true); }
    @error_log(date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . ' ' . $msg . "\n", 3, $dir . '/stock-error.log');
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Query helpers (semua pakai pg_query_params)                         */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
function WhQ($sql, $params = array()) {
    global $conn;
    $r = @pg_query_params($conn, $sql, $params);
    if ($r === false) { throw new Exception(pg_last_error($conn) . ' | SQL: ' . $sql); }
    return $r;
}
function WhRows($sql, $params = array()) {
    $r = WhQ($sql, $params);
    $o = array();
    while ($x = pg_fetch_assoc($r)) { $o[] = $x; }
    return $o;
}
function WhRow($sql, $params = array()) {
    $rows = WhRows($sql, $params);
    return count($rows) ? $rows[0] : null;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Request helpers                                                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
function WhReq($k, $d = '') { return isset($_REQUEST[$k]) ? trim($_REQUEST[$k]) : $d; }
function WhPost($k, $d = '') { return isset($_POST[$k]) ? trim($_POST[$k]) : $d; }
function WhRequirePost() {
    if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') { throw new WhException('Metode request harus POST.'); }
}
function WhPage() {
    $s = isset($_REQUEST['start']) ? max(0, (int)$_REQUEST['start']) : 0;
    $l = isset($_REQUEST['limit']) ? (int)$_REQUEST['limit'] : 25;
    if ($l < 1 || $l > 500) { $l = 25; }
    return array($s, $l);
}
function WhDate($s, $label = 'Tanggal') {
    if (!preg_match('/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/', $s, $m) || !checkdate((int)$m[2], (int)$m[3], (int)$m[1])) {
        throw new WhException($label . ' tidak valid (format harus YYYY-MM-DD).');
    }
    return $s;
}
function WhDetails() {
    $d = json_decode(isset($_POST['details']) ? $_POST['details'] : '', true);
    if (!is_array($d) || !count($d)) { throw new WhException('Detail item tidak boleh kosong.'); }
    return $d;
}
function WhNum($v) { return (is_numeric($v)) ? round((float)$v, 4) : 0.0; }
function WhFmt($n) { return rtrim(rtrim(number_format((float)$n, 4, '.', ''), '0'), '.'); }
function WhBool($v) { return ($v === 't' || $v === true || $v === 'true' || $v === '1'); }
function WhUserId() {
    if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { @session_start(); }
    foreach (array('user_id', 'userid', 'id') as $k) {
        if (isset($_SESSION[$k]) && is_numeric($_SESSION[$k])) { return (int)$_SESSION[$k]; }
    }
    return null;   // SESUAIKAN dengan key session login Anda
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Stok                                                                */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
// Kunci transaksi per (item, gudang) agar dua posting bersamaan tidak membuat stok minus.
function WhLock($itemId, $whId) {
    WhQ('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock($1,$2)', array((int)$itemId, (int)$whId));
}

function WhOnHand($itemId, $whId) {
    $r = WhRow("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='IN' THEN qty ELSE -qty END),0) AS q
                FROM stock_movements WHERE item_id=$1 AND warehouse_id=$2",
               array((int)$itemId, (int)$whId));
    return round((float)$r['q'], 4);
}

// Alokasi FIFO: kembalikan daftar layer [qty, unit_cost] yang dipakai untuk mengeluarkan $qty.
function WhFifoAllocate($itemId, $whId, $qty) {
    $need = round((float)$qty, 4);
    $r = WhRow("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty),0) AS q FROM stock_movements
                WHERE item_id=$1 AND warehouse_id=$2 AND movement_type='OUT'",
               array((int)$itemId, (int)$whId));
    $skip = (float)$r['q'];                              // layer tertua sudah terpakai sebanyak ini
    $layers = WhRows("SELECT qty, unit_cost FROM stock_movements
                      WHERE item_id=$1 AND warehouse_id=$2 AND movement_type='IN'
                      ORDER BY movement_date, id", array((int)$itemId, (int)$whId));
    $out = array();
    foreach ($layers as $l) {
        $lq = (float)$l['qty'];
        if ($skip >= $lq - 0.00005) { $skip -= $lq; continue; }
        $avail = $lq - $skip;
        $skip = 0;
        $take = min($avail, $need);
        if ($take > 0) {
            $out[] = array('qty' => round($take, 4), 'unit_cost' => (float)$l['unit_cost']);
            $need = round($need - $take, 4);
        }
        if ($need <= 0.00005) { break; }
    }
    if ($need > 0.00005) {
        throw new WhException('Layer FIFO tidak mencukupi (kurang ' . WhFmt($need) . '). Periksa konsistensi stock_movements.');
    }
    return $out;
}

function WhPostMovement($date, $itemId, $whId, $type, $qty, $cost, $refType, $refId, $refNo, $remark, $userId) {
    WhQ("INSERT INTO stock_movements
            (movement_date, item_id, grade_id, warehouse_id, movement_type, qty, unit_cost,
             reference_type, reference_id, reference_no, remark, created_by)
         VALUES ($1,$2,NULL,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,$10,$11)",
        array($date, (int)$itemId, (int)$whId, $type, $qty, $cost, $refType, (int)$refId, $refNo, $remark, $userId));
}

// Reverse = hapus baris ledger milik dokumen (menjaga urutan layer FIFO tetap benar;
// jejak audit tetap ada di data_log_delete). Tolak jika membuat stok minus.
function WhDeleteMovementsByRef($refType, $refId) {
    $pairs = WhRows("SELECT DISTINCT item_id, warehouse_id FROM stock_movements
                     WHERE reference_type=$1 AND reference_id=$2 ORDER BY item_id, warehouse_id",
                    array($refType, (int)$refId));
    foreach ($pairs as $p) { WhLock($p['item_id'], $p['warehouse_id']); }   // urut -> aman dari deadlock
    WhQ("DELETE FROM stock_movements WHERE reference_type=$1 AND reference_id=$2", array($refType, (int)$refId));
    foreach ($pairs as $p) {
        $oh = WhOnHand($p['item_id'], $p['warehouse_id']);
        if ($oh < -0.00005) {
            $m = WhRow('SELECT material_name FROM materials WHERE id=$1', array((int)$p['item_id']));
            throw new WhException('Reverse ditolak: stok ' . ($m ? $m['material_name'] : $p['item_id']) .
                ' akan minus (' . WhFmt($oh) . ') karena sudah dipakai transaksi lain.');
        }
    }
}

// Biaya satuan untuk penambahan stok tanpa layer asal (mis. selisih opname plus).
function WhLastCost($itemId, $whId) {
    $r = WhRow("SELECT unit_cost FROM stock_movements
                WHERE item_id=$1 AND movement_type='IN' AND unit_cost>0
                ORDER BY (warehouse_id=$2) DESC, movement_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1",
               array((int)$itemId, (int)$whId));
    if ($r) { return (float)$r['unit_cost']; }
    $m = WhRow('SELECT COALESCE(estimated_price,0) AS p FROM materials WHERE id=$1', array((int)$itemId));
    return $m ? (float)$m['p'] : 0.0;
}
==================== FILE: ./php-func/function.spk.php ====================
<?php
/**
 * function.spk.php  [NEW 2026-10-21]
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Logika kuota SPK (Surat Perintah Kerja). Dipakai oleh php-crud/spkCRD.php dan php-crud/warehouse.issuingCRD.php.
 * Bergantung pada helper yang sama dengan CRD stok: WhRow(), WhRows(), WhException.
 *
 * Aturan kuota material per proyek:
 *   % dibayar   = SUM(project_invoices.paid_amount) / projects.contract_value x 100        (maks 100)
 *   % diizinkan = % dibayar x SPK_PAID_MULTIPLIER (2), maksimal 100
 *   kuota kumulatif per material = qty RAB x % diizinkan / 100
 *   terpakai kuota = qty semua SPK Diterbitkan (dipesan) + issue proyek posted yang BUKAN dari SPK aktif
 *                    (issue tanpa SPK / dari SPK yang sudah Selesai = pemakaian nyata)
 *   tersedia untuk SPK baru = kuota - terpakai kuota
 * Sisa SPK per material = qty di SPK - issue posted yang memakai SPK itu.
 */

if (!defined('SPK_PAID_MULTIPLIER')) { define('SPK_PAID_MULTIPLIER', 2.0); }

// Pembayaran proyek: nilai kontrak, total diterima, persen, dan persen yang diizinkan untuk material
function SpkProjectPaid($projectId) {
    $r = WhRow("SELECT COALESCE(p.contract_value,0) AS cv,
                       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM project_invoices WHERE project_id=p.id),0) AS paid
                FROM projects p WHERE p.id=$1", array((int)$projectId));
    if (!$r) { throw new WhException('Proyek tidak ditemukan.'); }
    $cv = (float)$r['cv']; $paid = (float)$r['paid'];
    $pct = ($cv > 0) ? min(100.0, $paid / $cv * 100.0) : 0.0;
    $allowed = min(100.0, $pct * SPK_PAID_MULTIPLIER);
    return array('contract_value' => $cv, 'paid_amount' => $paid,
                 'paid_pct' => round($pct, 4), 'allowed_pct' => round($allowed, 4));
}

// Kuota per material untuk proyek. $excludeSpkId = SPK yang sedang diedit (tidak dihitung sebagai pemakai kuota).
function SpkMaterialQuota($projectId, $excludeSpkId = 0) {
    $projectId = (int)$projectId; $excludeSpkId = (int)$excludeSpkId;
    $pay = SpkProjectPaid($projectId);
    $rab = WhRows("SELECT bi.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name,
                          MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(bi.unit,''), m.unit, '')) AS unit, SUM(bi.qty_plan) AS rab_qty
                   FROM budget_items bi JOIN materials m ON m.id=bi.material_id
                   WHERE bi.project_id=$1 AND bi.material_id IS NOT NULL
                   GROUP BY bi.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name
                   ORDER BY m.material_name", array($projectId));

    $act = array();
    foreach (WhRows("SELECT si.material_id, SUM(si.qty) AS q FROM spk_items si JOIN spk s ON s.id=si.spk_id
                     WHERE s.project_id=$1 AND s.status='Diterbitkan' AND s.id<>$2 GROUP BY si.material_id",
                    array($projectId, $excludeSpkId)) as $r) { $act[(int)$r['material_id']] = (float)$r['q']; }

    $oth = array();
    foreach (WhRows("SELECT i.material_id, SUM(i.qty_out) AS q
                     FROM material_out_items i JOIN material_out_header h ON h.id=i.material_out_id
                     LEFT JOIN spk s ON s.id=h.spk_id
                     WHERE h.project_id=$1 AND h.status='posted' AND h.issue_type='PROJECT'
                       AND (h.spk_id IS NULL OR s.status<>'Diterbitkan') AND (h.spk_id IS NULL OR h.spk_id<>$2)
                     GROUP BY i.material_id", array($projectId, $excludeSpkId)) as $r) { $oth[(int)$r['material_id']] = (float)$r['q']; }

    // Stok fisik inventory: saldo IN - OUT pada seluruh gudang aktif.
    // Kurangi sisa qty yang sudah dipesan oleh SPK aktif lain agar satu stok tidak dihitung berulang.
    $stockReserved = array();
    foreach (WhRows("SELECT r.material_id, SUM(GREATEST(r.reserved_qty - COALESCE(u.used_qty,0),0)) AS reserved_qty
                     FROM (SELECT s.id AS spk_id, s.project_id, si.material_id, SUM(si.qty) AS reserved_qty
                           FROM spk_items si JOIN spk s ON s.id=si.spk_id
                           WHERE s.project_id=$1 AND s.status='Diterbitkan' AND s.id<>$2
                           GROUP BY s.id, s.project_id, si.material_id) r
                     LEFT JOIN (SELECT h.spk_id, i.material_id, SUM(i.qty_out) AS used_qty
                                FROM material_out_items i JOIN material_out_header h ON h.id=i.material_out_id
                                WHERE h.status='posted' AND h.spk_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY h.spk_id, i.material_id) u
                       ON u.spk_id=r.spk_id AND u.material_id=r.material_id
                     GROUP BY r.material_id", array($projectId, $excludeSpkId)) as $rr) {
        $stockReserved[(int)$rr['material_id']] = (float)$rr['reserved_qty'];
    }
    $stock = array();
    foreach (WhRows("SELECT bal.item_id AS material_id, SUM(GREATEST(bal.onhand,0)) AS onhand
                     FROM (SELECT sm.item_id, sm.warehouse_id,
                                  SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type='IN' THEN sm.qty ELSE -sm.qty END) AS onhand
                           FROM stock_movements sm
                           JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=sm.warehouse_id
                           WHERE w.active=true
                           GROUP BY sm.item_id, sm.warehouse_id) bal
                     GROUP BY bal.item_id") as $sr) {
        $stock[(int)$sr['material_id']] = max(0, (float)$sr['onhand']);
    }

    $out = array();
    foreach ($rab as $r) {
        $mid = (int)$r['material_id']; $rq = (float)$r['rab_qty'];
        $cap = round($rq * $pay['allowed_pct'] / 100.0, 4);
        $a = isset($act[$mid]) ? $act[$mid] : 0.0; $o = isset($oth[$mid]) ? $oth[$mid] : 0.0;
        $quotaAvailable = max(0, round($cap - $a - $o, 4));
        $stockOnHand = isset($stock[$mid]) ? (float)$stock[$mid] : 0.0;
        $reservedStock = isset($stockReserved[$mid]) ? (float)$stockReserved[$mid] : 0.0;
        $stockAvailable = max(0, round($stockOnHand - $reservedStock, 4));
        $out[$mid] = array('material_id' => $mid, 'material_code' => $r['material_code'], 'material_name' => $r['material_name'],
                           'unit' => $r['unit'], 'rab_qty' => round($rq, 4), 'cap_qty' => $cap,
                           'spk_active' => round($a, 4), 'issued_other' => round($o, 4),
                           'stock_onhand' => round($stockOnHand, 4), 'stock_reserved' => round($reservedStock, 4),
                           'stock_available' => $stockAvailable,
                           'quota_available' => $quotaAvailable,
                           'available' => min($quotaAvailable, $stockAvailable));
    }
    return array('pay' => $pay, 'materials' => $out);
}

// Sisa jatah satu material pada satu SPK = qty SPK - issue posted yang memakai SPK itu
function SpkRemaining($spkId, $materialId) {
    $q = WhRow("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty),0) AS q FROM spk_items WHERE spk_id=$1 AND material_id=$2", array((int)$spkId, (int)$materialId));
    $u = WhRow("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty_out),0) AS q FROM material_out_items i JOIN material_out_header h ON h.id=i.material_out_id
                WHERE h.spk_id=$1 AND i.material_id=$2 AND h.status='posted'", array((int)$spkId, (int)$materialId));
    return array('qty' => round((float)$q['q'], 4), 'used' => round((float)$u['q'], 4),
                 'remaining' => max(0, round((float)$q['q'] - (float)$u['q'], 4)));
}
==================== FILE: ./php-func/app.url.php ====================
<?php
/**
 * Application URL helper.
 * Compatible with PHP 7.x.
 */

if (!function_exists('app_detect_base_url')) {
    function app_detect_base_url()
    {
        $paths = array();

        if (!empty($_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'])) {
            $paths[] = parse_url($_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'], PHP_URL_PATH);
        }

        if (!empty($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'])) {
            $paths[] = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'], PHP_URL_PATH);
        }

        $internalDirs = 'views|php-crud|pdf|includes|php-func|php-class|css|js|js-ext|js-func|tcpdf_new';

        foreach ($paths as $path) {
            if (!$path) {
                continue;
            }

            $path = '/' . ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $path), '/');

            // Contoh: /rab-project/dev/views/router
            if (preg_match('~^(.*?)/(' . $internalDirs . ')(?:/|$)~i', $path, $matches)) {
                $root = rtrim($matches[1], '/');
                return ($root === '' ? '/' : $root . '/');
            }

            // Entry point di application root.
            if (preg_match('~^(.*?)/(?:index|router|login)\.php$~i', $path, $matches)) {
                $root = rtrim($matches[1], '/');
                return ($root === '' ? '/' : $root . '/');
            }
        }

        return '/';
    }
}

if (!defined('BASE_URL')) {
    define('BASE_URL', app_detect_base_url());
}
==================== FILE: ./php-func/function.inventory.recon.php ====================
<?php
/**
 * function.inventory.recon.php  [NEW 2026-10-18]
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Logika rekonsiliasi persediaan: nilai BUKU (saldo akun persediaan di buku besar) vs nilai STOK
 * (ledger stock_movements, IN - OUT bernilai FIFO), sampai tanggal tertentu.
 * Dipakai bersama oleh php-crud/inventory.reconCRD.php (layar) dan pdf/inventoryrecon.php (cetak).
 *
 * Pemeriksaan dokumen: setiap dokumen stok (reference_type + reference_id di stock_movements) dicocokkan dengan jurnalnya:
 *   - MATERIAL_OUT, issue_type PROJECT          -> jurnal 'material_out'     (reference_id = id issue)
 *   - MATERIAL_OUT, issue_type SUPPLIER_RETURN  -> jurnal 'supplier_return'  (reference_id = id retur supplier)
 *   - jenis lain                                -> jurnal dengan reference_type sama (huruf kecil) bila nilai enum-nya ada
 *   Status dokumen: OK | TIDAK ADA JURNAL | NILAI BEDA | N/A (jenis dokumen tidak punya jenis jurnal)
 *
 * Selisih (buku - stok) dijelaskan oleh dokumen bermasalah:
 *   dokumen tanpa jurnal  : buku kurang  nilai_stok_dokumen      -> selisih += -nilai
 *   dokumen nilai beda    : buku beda sign x (jurnal - |nilai|)  -> selisih += sign x (jurnal - |nilai|)
 *   Sisa yang tidak terjelaskan biasanya jurnal manual / penyesuaian langsung di akun persediaan.
 */

const IR_TOL = 1.00;      // toleransi pembulatan nilai dokumen vs jurnal (Rp)

/** Akun persediaan default = akun kredit rule ISSUE_PROJECT di fiscal_config (Persediaan Bahan Baku). */
function ir_default_account($db): int {
    $st = $db->query("SELECT credit_account_id FROM public.fiscal_config WHERE rule_code = 'ISSUE_PROJECT' AND is_active = true ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1");
    return (int)$st->fetchColumn();
}

function ir_accounts($db): array {
    // [AKUN] Hanya akun persediaan utama (akun kredit rule ISSUE_PROJECT, mis. 1500). Akun aset lain (WIP, Barang Jadi, Bank, dst.)
    //        tidak memakai ledger stok sebagai pembanding, jadi tidak ditawarkan agar tidak salah pilih.
    //        Bila rule belum diatur, tampilkan akun yang namanya memuat 'persediaan'.
    $def = ir_default_account($db);
    if ($def > 0) {
        $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, account_code, account_name FROM public.chart_of_accounts WHERE id = :id");
        $st->execute([':id' => $def]);
    } else {
        $st = $db->query("SELECT id, account_code, account_name FROM public.chart_of_accounts
                           WHERE account_name ILIKE '%persediaan%' AND is_active = true ORDER BY account_code");
    }
    $out = [];
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) {
        $out[] = ['id' => (int)$r['id'], 'label' => $r['account_code'] . ' - ' . $r['account_name'], 'is_default' => ((int)$r['id'] === $def || $def <= 0)];
    }
    return $out;
}

/**
 * Hitung rekonsiliasi. Mengembalikan ['summary'=>[], 'items'=>[], 'warehouses'=>[], 'docs'=>[]].
 * Melempar Exception bila tanggal / akun tidak valid.
 */
function ir_reconcile($db, string $asOf, int $accountId): array {
    $d = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $asOf);
    if (!$d || $d->format('Y-m-d') !== $asOf) throw new Exception('Tanggal tidak valid.');
    if ($accountId <= 0) $accountId = ir_default_account($db);
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT account_code, account_name FROM public.chart_of_accounts WHERE id = :id");
    $st->execute([':id' => $accountId]);
    $acc = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$acc) throw new Exception('Akun persediaan tidak ditemukan. Atur rule ISSUE_PROJECT di fiscal_config atau pilih akun.');

    // --- nilai buku: saldo debit - kredit akun persediaan (jurnal posted/reversed) s/d tanggal
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.debit - jl.credit), 0)
          FROM public.journal_lines jl
          JOIN public.journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_id
               AND je.status::text IN ('posted', 'reversed') AND je.journal_date <= CAST(:d AS date)
         WHERE jl.account_id = :a");
    $st->execute([':d' => $asOf, ':a' => $accountId]);
    $book = round((float)$st->fetchColumn(), 2);

    // --- nilai stok: IN - OUT (nilai FIFO per movement)
    $VAL = "CASE WHEN sm.movement_type = 'IN' THEN sm.qty * sm.unit_cost ELSE -sm.qty * sm.unit_cost END";
    $QTY = "CASE WHEN sm.movement_type = 'IN' THEN sm.qty ELSE -sm.qty END";

    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM({$VAL}), 0) FROM public.stock_movements sm WHERE sm.movement_date <= CAST(:d AS date)");
    $st->execute([':d' => $asOf]);
    $stock = round((float)$st->fetchColumn(), 2);

    // --- per item
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT m.id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit, SUM({$QTY}) AS qty, SUM({$VAL}) AS val
          FROM public.stock_movements sm
          JOIN public.materials m ON m.id = sm.item_id
         WHERE sm.movement_date <= CAST(:d AS date)
         GROUP BY m.id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit
        HAVING ABS(SUM({$QTY})) > 0.00005 OR ABS(SUM({$VAL})) > 0.004
         ORDER BY m.material_name");
    $st->execute([':d' => $asOf]);
    $items = [];
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) {
        $q = (float)$r['qty']; $v = (float)$r['val'];
        $items[] = ['material_code' => $r['material_code'], 'material_name' => $r['material_name'], 'unit' => $r['unit'],
                    'qty' => round($q, 4), 'value' => round($v, 2), 'avg_cost' => (abs($q) > 0.00005) ? round($v / $q, 2) : 0.0];
    }

    // --- per gudang (jumlah item bersaldo + nilai)
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT w.id AS wid, w.name AS wname, sm.item_id, SUM({$QTY}) AS qty, SUM({$VAL}) AS val
          FROM public.stock_movements sm
          JOIN public.warehouses w ON w.id = sm.warehouse_id
         WHERE sm.movement_date <= CAST(:d AS date)
         GROUP BY w.id, w.name, sm.item_id");
    $st->execute([':d' => $asOf]);
    $wh = [];
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) {
        $k = (int)$r['wid'];
        if (!isset($wh[$k])) $wh[$k] = ['warehouse_name' => $r['wname'], 'item_count' => 0, 'value' => 0.0];
        if (abs((float)$r['qty']) > 0.00005) $wh[$k]['item_count']++;
        $wh[$k]['value'] += (float)$r['val'];
    }
    $warehouses = [];
    foreach ($wh as $w) { $warehouses[] = ['warehouse_name' => $w['warehouse_name'], 'item_count' => $w['item_count'], 'value' => round($w['value'], 2)]; }
    usort($warehouses, function ($a, $b) { return strcmp($a['warehouse_name'], $b['warehouse_name']); });

    // --- pemeriksaan dokumen vs jurnal
    $labels = $db->query("SELECT e.enumlabel FROM pg_enum e WHERE e.enumtypid =
                           (SELECT atttypid FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = 'public.journal_entries'::regclass AND attname = 'reference_type')")
                 ->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
    $labels = array_map('strtolower', $labels);

    $issueType = [];
    foreach ($db->query("SELECT id, issue_type FROM public.material_out_header")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) { $issueType[(int)$r['id']] = $r['issue_type']; }
    $returByIssue = []; $returRef = [];
    foreach ($db->query("SELECT id, ref_no, material_out_id FROM public.supplier_return_hdr WHERE material_out_id IS NOT NULL")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) {
        $returByIssue[(int)$r['material_out_id']] = (int)$r['id'];
        $returRef[(int)$r['id']] = $r['ref_no'];
    }
    // [PERBAIKAN] aturan posting untuk jurnal yang kurang: jenis jurnal -> rule fiscal_config
    $fixRule = ['wh_receiving' => 'GRN_RCV', 'material_out' => 'ISSUE_PROJECT', 'supplier_return' => 'RETURN_SUPPLIER'];

    // jurnal asli (bukan 'Reverse of ...'), nilai = jumlah debit
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT je.reference_type::text AS rt, je.reference_id AS rid, SUM(jl.debit) AS amt
          FROM public.journal_entries je
          JOIN public.journal_lines jl ON jl.journal_id = je.id
         WHERE je.status::text = 'posted' AND je.description NOT LIKE 'Reverse of %'
           AND je.journal_date <= CAST(:d AS date)
         GROUP BY je.reference_type::text, je.reference_id");
    $st->execute([':d' => $asOf]);
    $jmap = [];
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) { $jmap[$r['rt'] . '|' . $r['rid']] = (float)$r['amt']; }

    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT sm.reference_type, sm.reference_id, MAX(sm.reference_no) AS reference_no, MIN(sm.movement_date) AS doc_date,
               SUM({$VAL}) AS val
          FROM public.stock_movements sm
         WHERE sm.movement_date <= CAST(:d AS date)
         GROUP BY sm.reference_type, sm.reference_id
         ORDER BY MIN(sm.movement_date), sm.reference_id");
    $st->execute([':d' => $asOf]);

    $docs = []; $explained = 0.0; $problemCount = 0;
    $fixes = []; $fixValue = 0.0;     // [PERBAIKAN] dokumen yang jurnalnya bisa dibuat otomatis
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) {
        $val = round((float)$r['val'], 2);
        $rtype = strtolower((string)$r['reference_type']);
        $rid = (int)$r['reference_id'];
        $jt = null; $jid = $rid; $status = 'N/A'; $jamt = null;

        if ($rtype === 'material_out') {
            $it = isset($issueType[$rid]) ? $issueType[$rid] : null;
            if ($it === 'SUPPLIER_RETURN') {
                $jt = 'supplier_return';
                if (isset($returByIssue[$rid])) { $jid = $returByIssue[$rid]; } else { $jt = null; }
            } else {
                $jt = 'material_out';
            }
        } elseif (in_array($rtype, $labels, true)) {
            $jt = $rtype;
        }

        if ($jt !== null) {
            $key = $jt . '|' . $jid;
            if (!isset($jmap[$key])) {
                $status = 'TIDAK ADA JURNAL';
                $explained += -$val;
                // dapat diperbaiki otomatis bila jenisnya dikenal dan arah nilainya sesuai (penerimaan = masuk, issue/retur = keluar)
                if (isset($fixRule[$jt]) && (($jt === 'wh_receiving' && $val > 0) || ($jt !== 'wh_receiving' && $val < 0))) {
                    $refNo = (string)$r['reference_no'];
                    $desc = ($jt === 'wh_receiving') ? ('Penerimaan fisik gudang - ' . $refNo)
                          : (($jt === 'material_out') ? ('Issue material ' . $refNo) : ('Retur supplier ' . (isset($returRef[$jid]) ? $returRef[$jid] : $refNo)));
                    $fixes[] = ['rule' => $fixRule[$jt], 'ref_type' => $jt, 'ref_id' => $jid, 'date' => $r['doc_date'],
                                'amount' => abs($val), 'desc' => $desc, 'label' => $refNo];
                    $fixValue += abs($val);
                }
            } else {
                $jamt = round($jmap[$key], 2);
                if (abs($jamt - abs($val)) <= IR_TOL) {
                    $status = 'OK';
                } else {
                    $status = 'NILAI BEDA';
                    $sign = ($val >= 0) ? 1 : -1;
                    $explained += $sign * ($jamt - abs($val));
                }
            }
        }
        if ($status === 'TIDAK ADA JURNAL' || $status === 'NILAI BEDA') $problemCount++;
        $docs[] = ['reference_type' => $r['reference_type'], 'reference_no' => $r['reference_no'], 'doc_date' => $r['doc_date'],
                   'value' => $val, 'journal_amount' => $jamt, 'status' => $status];
    }

    $diff = round($book - $stock, 2);
    $explained = round($explained, 2);
    $summary = [
        'as_of' => $asOf, 'account_id' => $accountId, 'account_label' => $acc['account_code'] . ' - ' . $acc['account_name'],
        'book_balance' => $book, 'stock_value' => $stock, 'diff' => $diff,
        'explained' => $explained, 'unexplained' => round($diff - $explained, 2),
        'docs_total' => count($docs), 'docs_problem' => $problemCount,
        'fixable_count' => count($fixes), 'fixable_value' => round($fixValue, 2),
        'status' => (abs($diff) <= IR_TOL) ? 'SESUAI' : 'SELISIH',
    ];
    return ['summary' => $summary, 'items' => $items, 'warehouses' => $warehouses, 'docs' => $docs, 'fixes' => $fixes];
}

/**
 * [PERBAIKAN] Posting otomatis jurnal yang kurang (hanya dokumen berstatus TIDAK ADA JURNAL yang jenisnya dikenal):
 *   penerimaan fisik gudang -> rule GRN_RCV | issue proyek -> ISSUE_PROJECT | retur supplier -> RETURN_SUPPLIER
 * Nilai = nilai stok dokumen, tanggal = tanggal dokumen. Satu transaksi: gagal satu (mis. periode ditutup) = batal semua.
 * Idempotent: dokumen yang sudah berjurnal tidak muncul lagi. Tidak menyentuh stok. NILAI BEDA dan selisih lain tidak diubah
 * (butuh pemeriksaan manual agar kesalahan tidak tertutup).
 */
function ir_fix_missing($db, string $asOf, int $accountId): array {
    $def = ir_default_account($db);
    if ($accountId <= 0) $accountId = $def;
    if ($def <= 0 || $accountId !== $def) {
        throw new Exception('Perbaikan otomatis hanya untuk akun persediaan utama (akun kredit rule ISSUE_PROJECT di fiscal_config).');
    }
    $r = ir_reconcile($db, $asOf, $accountId);
    if (!count($r['fixes'])) return ['posted' => [], 'count' => 0];

    $posted = [];
    $db->beginTransaction();
    try {
        foreach ($r['fixes'] as $f) {
            $jr = AutoPostJournal($db, [
                'rule_code' => $f['rule'], 'reference_type' => $f['ref_type'], 'reference_id' => (int)$f['ref_id'],
                'journal_date' => $f['date'], 'amount' => $f['amount'], 'description' => $f['desc'],
            ]);
            if (!$jr['success']) throw new Exception($f['label'] . ': ' . $jr['message']);
            $posted[] = $f['label'];
        }
        $db->commit();
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
        throw $e;
    }
    return ['posted' => $posted, 'count' => count($posted)];
}

/**
 * Defense-in-depth CSRF check for browser POST requests.
 * Mutating endpoints must be same-origin; GET mutations are separately blocked.
 */
if (!function_exists('app_require_same_origin_post')) {
    function app_require_same_origin_post(): void {
        if (strtoupper($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET') !== 'POST') {
            return;
        }
        $expectedHostHeader = trim((string)($_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? ''));
        $source = trim((string)($_SERVER['HTTP_ORIGIN'] ?? $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'] ?? ''));
        if ($expectedHostHeader === '' || $source === '') {
            http_response_code(403);
            error_log('[SECURITY] Blocked POST without Origin/Referer header.');
            exit('Permintaan ditolak: sumber request tidak dapat diverifikasi.');
        }
        $expectedScheme = strtolower(trim((string)($_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO'] ?? '')));
        if (!in_array($expectedScheme, array('http', 'https'), true)) {
            $expectedScheme = (!empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && strtolower((string)$_SERVER['HTTPS']) !== 'off') ? 'https' : 'http';
        }
        $expectedParts = parse_url($expectedScheme . '://' . $expectedHostHeader);
        $sourceParts = parse_url($source);
        $expectedHost = strtolower((string)($expectedParts['host'] ?? ''));
        $sourceHost = strtolower((string)($sourceParts['host'] ?? ''));
        $sourceScheme = strtolower((string)($sourceParts['scheme'] ?? ''));
        $expectedPort = $expectedParts['port'] ?? ($expectedScheme === 'https' ? 443 : 80);
        $sourcePort = $sourceParts['port'] ?? ($sourceScheme === 'https' ? 443 : 80);
        if ($expectedHost === '' || $sourceHost === '' || $expectedHost !== $sourceHost
            || !in_array($sourceScheme, array('http', 'https'), true)
            || $sourceScheme !== $expectedScheme
            || $expectedPort !== $sourcePort
            || strtolower((string)($_SERVER['HTTP_SEC_FETCH_SITE'] ?? '')) === 'cross-site') {
            http_response_code(403);
            error_log('[SECURITY] Blocked cross-origin POST request.');
            exit('Permintaan ditolak: request harus berasal dari origin aplikasi.');
        }
    }
}

if (!function_exists('app_require_active_user')) {
    function app_require_active_user(): void {
        global $conn;
        $userId = (int)($_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($userId <= 0) {
            http_response_code(401);
            exit('Sesi berakhir. Silakan login kembali.');
        }
        $result = @pg_query_params(
            $conn,
            "SELECT 1 FROM m_user_system WHERE id = $1 AND active IS TRUE LIMIT 1",
            array($userId)
        );
        if (!$result) {
            error_log('[SECURITY] Could not verify active user session: user_id=' . $userId . '; ' . pg_last_error($conn));
            http_response_code(503);
            exit('Status akun tidak dapat diverifikasi. Silakan coba kembali.');
        }
        if (pg_num_rows($result) < 1) {
            error_log('[SECURITY] Blocked inactive or missing user session: user_id=' . $userId);
            $_SESSION = array();
            if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE) {
                session_regenerate_id(true);
            }
            http_response_code(401);
            $isJson = (!empty($_SERVER['HTTP_ACCEPT']) && strpos($_SERVER['HTTP_ACCEPT'], 'application/json') !== false)
                || (!empty($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) && strtolower($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) === 'xmlhttprequest');
            if ($isJson) {
                header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
                echo json_encode(array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Akun tidak aktif atau sesi tidak berlaku. Silakan login kembali.'));
            } else {
                echo 'Akun tidak aktif atau sesi tidak berlaku. Silakan login kembali.';
            }
            exit;
        }
    }
}
