function searchData($findThis, $findInFields, $limit = null) {
    global $conn;
    // Keep the caller's pagination limit; searching must not silently load all rows.
    $limit = ($limit === null || (int)$limit <= 0) ? 250 : (int)$limit;
    $searchField = null;
    if (isset($findThis) && $findThis !== '' && $findThis !== null) {
        $searchDtl = explode("|", (string)$findThis);
        $conditions = array();
        foreach ($searchDtl as $term) {
            $fields = array();
            // Field expressions are supplied by trusted application call sites; only values are escaped.
            $pattern = pg_escape_literal($conn, '%' . strtolower($term) . '%');
            foreach ($findInFields as $field) {
                $fields[] = "lower(" . $field . ") ~~ " . $pattern;
            }
            if ($fields) {
                $conditions[] = "(" . implode(" OR ", $fields) . ")";
            }
        }
        if ($conditions) {
            $searchField = " AND " . implode(" AND ", $conditions);
        }
    }
    return array("limit" => $limit, "searchSQL" => $searchField);
}

function srcDataGrid($fields, $find) {
    global $conn;
    $conditions = array();
    foreach (explode("%", (string)$find) as $term) {
        $pattern = pg_escape_literal($conn, '%' . strtolower($term) . '%');
        foreach ($fields as $field) {
            $conditions[] = "lower(" . $field . ") LIKE " . $pattern;
        }
    }
    return $conditions ? "( " . implode(" OR ", $conditions) . " )" : "( 1=1 )";
}

function insertQ($table, $rows) {
    global $conn;
    $command = "INSERT INTO " . $table;
    $row = "";
    $value = "";
    foreach ($rows as $key => $values) {
        $row .= "," . $key;
        $valStr = $values ?? '';
        if (!empty($values) && is_string($valStr) && substr($valStr, 0, 8) === "currval(") {
            $value .= "," . $valStr;
        }
        else if ($values === '0' || $values === 0) {
            $value .= ",'" . $values . "'";
        }
        else if (!empty($values)) {
            $escapedVal = pg_escape_string($conn, (string)$valStr);
            $value .= ",'" . $escapedVal . "'";
        }
        else {
            $value .= ",NULL";
        }
    }
    $command .= "(" . substr($row, 1) . ")";
    $command .= " VALUES (" . substr($value, 1) . ") RETURNING id";
    return $command;
}

function updateQ($table, $data, $where = null) {
    global $conn;
    $command = "UPDATE " . $table . " SET ";
    $set = "";
    foreach ($data as $key => $values) {
        $valStr = $values ?? '';
        if ($values === '0' || $values === 0) {
            $set .= "," . $key . "='" . $values . "'";
        }
        else if (!empty($values)) {
            $escapedVal = pg_escape_string($conn, (string)$valStr);
            $set .= "," . $key . "='" . $escapedVal . "'";
        }
        else {
            $set .= "," . $key . "=NULL";
        }
    }
    $command .= substr(trim($set), 1);
    if ($where != null) {
        $command .= " WHERE " . $where;
    }
    return $command;
}

function CreateRefNo($tableName, $FieldCount, $RefInit) {
    global $conn;
    $sql = "
(
select CASE (count(".$FieldCount.")) WHEN 0
THEN '".$RefInit."-".date('ym')."-00001'
ELSE '".$RefInit."-".date('ym')."-'
||(select (substring('00000'||cast(CAST(max(substring(".$FieldCount." from '.....$'))AS int)+1 as varchar) from '.....$'))
from ".$tableName."
where substring(".$FieldCount.",length(".$FieldCount.")-9,2)='".date('y')."' and substring(".$FieldCount.",length(".$FieldCount.")-7,2)='".date('m')."')
END  AS ref_no
from ".$tableName." where substring(".$FieldCount.",length(".$FieldCount.")-9,2)='".date('y')."' and substring(".$FieldCount.",length(".$FieldCount.")-7,2)='".date('m')."'
)
";
    $output = pg_query($conn, $sql) or die('Connection failed: ' . pg_last_error($conn));
    $AddRefNo = '';
    if (pg_num_rows($output) > 0) {
        while ($objid = pg_fetch_array($output, null, PGSQL_ASSOC)) {
            $AddRefNo = $objid["ref_no"];
        }
    }
    return $AddRefNo;
}

function CreateWHRefNo($tableName, $FieldCount, $RefInit) {
    global $conn;
    $sql = "
(
select CASE (count(".$FieldCount.")) WHEN 0
THEN '".$RefInit."-".date('ym')."-00001'
ELSE '".$RefInit."-".date('ym')."-'
||(select (substring('00000'||cast(CAST(max(substring(".$FieldCount." from '.....$'))AS int)+1 as varchar) from '.....$'))
from ".$tableName."
where substring(".$FieldCount.",0,position('-' in ".$FieldCount."))='".$RefInit."' and substring(".$FieldCount.",length(ref_no)-9,2)='".date('y')."' and substring(".$FieldCount.",length(ref_no)-7,2)='".date('m')."')
END  AS ref_no
from ".$tableName." where substring(".$FieldCount.",0,position('-' in ".$FieldCount."))='".$RefInit."' and substring(".$FieldCount.",length(ref_no)-9,2)='".date('y')."' and substring(".$FieldCount.",length(ref_no)-7,2)='".date('m')."'
)
";
    $output = pg_query($conn, $sql) or die('Connection failed: ' . pg_last_error($conn));
    $AddRefNo = '';
    if (pg_num_rows($output) > 0) {
        while ($objid = pg_fetch_array($output, null, PGSQL_ASSOC)) {
            $AddRefNo = $objid["ref_no"];
        }
    }
    return $AddRefNo;
}

function CreateNikNo($unit, $status, $fromdate) {
    global $conn;
    $year = date('y', strtotime((string)$fromdate));
    $sql = <<<'SQL'
SELECT (
nikunitinit(
(SELECT init FROM m_location WHERE id IN
(SELECT location_id FROM m_department WHERE id = $1)),
(SELECT name FROM m_employee_status WHERE id = $2)
)
|| $3
|| (substring(
'0000' || cast(
(coalesce(cast(max(substring(nik::varchar(8) from '[0-9]{4}$')) AS int), 0) + 1)
AS varchar
)
from '[0-9]{4}$'
))
)::varchar(8) AS ref_no
FROM m_employee
WHERE substring(nik::varchar(8), 3, 2) = $3
SQL;
    $output = pg_query_params($conn, $sql, array((int)$unit, (int)$status, $year));
    if ($output === false) {
        error_log('[CreateNikNo] ' . pg_last_error($conn));
        throw new Exception('Gagal membuat nomor induk karyawan.');
    }
    $row = pg_fetch_assoc($output);
    return $row ? (string)$row['ref_no'] : '';
}

/**
 * Menetapkan variabel sesi PostgreSQL (app.username) untuk audit log / trigger.
 * Gunakan ini tepat setelah pg_query('BEGIN') pada koneksi yang sama.
 * [FIX] Parameter diganti nama menjadi $connOverride agar tidak bentrok dengan
 *       `global $conn` (sebelumnya parameter $conn selalu tertimpa global,
 *       sehingga koneksi yang dikirim pemanggil diabaikan).
 */
function SetPgAppUser($connOverride = null) {
    global $conn;
    $c = $connOverride ?: $conn;
    $u = $_SESSION['username'] ?? $_SESSION['login_name'] ?? $_SESSION['user_name'] ?? 'system';
    $res = pg_query_params($c, "SELECT set_config('app.username', $1, true)", [$u]);
    if ($res === false) throw new Exception('[SetPgAppUser] ' . pg_last_error($c));
}

function json2Array($jsonData) {
    global $conn;
    $jArray = json_decode(stripslashes((string)($jsonData ?? '')), true);
    if (is_array($jArray) && count($jArray) > 0) {
        $escapedItems = array();
        foreach ($jArray as $item) {
            $itemStr = (string)($item ?? '');
            $escapedItems[] = "'" . pg_escape_string($conn, $itemStr) . "'";
        }
        return implode(",", $escapedItems);
    }
    return "";
}

function String_to_float($string_obj) {
    $s = trim((string)$string_obj);
    $neg = (strpos($s, '-') === 0);
    $s = str_replace(['-', ','], '', $s);
    $v = (float)$s;
    return $neg ? -$v : $v;
}

function EncodeData($MyData) { return base64_encode($MyData); }
function DecodeData($MyData) { return base64_decode($MyData); }
function rNum($number, $round) { return floor($number / $round) * $round; }

function rAmountReport($number, $round) {
    if ($number > 0) return number_format(floor($number / $round) * $round, 0, '.', ',');
    if ($number < 0) return number_format(floor(($number * -1) / $round) * $round * -1, 0, '.', ',');
    return '-';
}

function GetFormId($formURl) {
    global $conn;
    $formName = explode("/", $formURl);
    $getFormName = end($formName);
    $sql = "select * from m_form_name where php_url='" . pg_escape_string($conn, $getFormName) . "'";
    $output = pg_query($conn, $sql) or die('Connection failed: ' . pg_last_error($conn));
    $formId = null;
    if (pg_num_rows($output) > 0) {
        while ($objid = pg_fetch_array($output, null, PGSQL_ASSOC)) {
            $formId = $objid["id"];
        }
    }
    return $formId;
}

function CheckCRUD($task, $userId, $formId) {
    global $conn;
    $st = pg_query_params(
        $conn,
        "SELECT access_level FROM m_user_access_menu WHERE user_id = $1 AND form_id = $2",
        [$userId, $formId]
    );
    if ($st === false) {
        throw new Exception('[CheckCRUD] ' . pg_last_error($conn));
    }
    $lv = pg_num_rows($st) ? (int)pg_fetch_result($st, 0, 0) : 0;
    // Skala lama: 1 = baca saja, 2 = boleh create/update, 3 = boleh delete
    $need = ['read' => 1, 'create' => 2, 'update' => 2, 'delete' => 3][$task] ?? 1;
    return $lv >= $need ? $task : 'xxx';
}

function Str2N($StrData) {
    return floatval(preg_replace("/[^-0-9\.]/", "", $StrData));
}

function checksinglequote($txt) {
    global $conn;
    if ($txt === null || is_bool($txt)) {
        return '';
    }
    $quotes = array("'", '"');
    return str_replace($quotes, '', pg_escape_string($conn, (string)$txt));
}

function deleteQ($table, $where = null) {
    global $conn;
    $command = "DELETE FROM " . $table;
    if ($where != null && $where !== '') {
        $command .= " WHERE " . $where;
    }
    return $command;
}

/*
Fungsi   : DbOrFail()
Kenapa   : crud::insert() / crud::update() / crud::delete() (di
           crudClass.php) MENANGKAP PDOException sendiri dan hanya
           `return false` -- pesan errornya tersimpan di $db->getResult(),
           TIDAK pernah dilempar ulang sebagai exception. Akibatnya kalau
           kode pemanggil tidak mengecek return value-nya secara eksplisit,
           kegagalan insert/update jadi senyap: transaksi Postgres sudah
           aborted, tapi PHP tetap lanjut ke statement berikutnya sampai
           akhirnya meledak sebagai "25P02: current transaction is aborted"
           di query lain yang sebenarnya tidak bersalah.
Cara pakai: bungkus SETIAP panggilan $db->insert()/update()/delete() yang
           ada di dalam try/beginTransaction() dengan fungsi ini, supaya kegagalan
           langsung ketahuan & transaksi langsung rollback dengan pesan asli dari
           Postgres -- bukan pesan 25P02 yang membingungkan.
           DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('journal_entries', [...]), 'insert journal_entries');
Throws Exception dengan pesan asli dari $db->getResult() jika $ok === false.
*/
function DbOrFail($db, $ok, $context = '') {
    if ($ok === false) {
        $raw = $db->getResult();
        $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
        $msg = $decoded['message'] ?? $raw ?? 'Operasi database gagal (tanpa pesan detail).';
        throw new Exception(($context ? "[{$context}] " : '') . $msg);
    }
    return $ok;
}

/*
Daftar reference_type jurnal yang dikenal aplikasi.
[PATCH 2026-11-15 F-3.1] journal_entries.reference_type bertipe VARCHAR (bukan enum), sehingga tanpa
daftar ini nilai bebas bisa tersimpan. Tambah 'material_leftover' (retur sisa material proyek,
material.leftoverCRD.php) dan 'subcon_leftover_buyback' (buy-back sisa subkontraktor, rancangan
audit hulu-hilir §9.1) yang sebelumnya belum terdaftar -> posting jurnalnya ditolak/senyap.
*/
if (!defined('JRN_VALID_REF_TYPES')) {
    define('JRN_VALID_REF_TYPES', implode('|', [
        'sales_univoice', 'payment_entry', 'manual_entry', 'closing_entry', 'adjustment',
        'wh_receiving', 'purchase_grn', 'purchase_invoice', 'purchase_return',
        'project_invoice', 'project_payment', 'material_out', 'supplier_return',
        'wip_release', 'stock_transfer', 'sales_proyekoice',
        'material_leftover', 'subcon_leftover_buyback',
        'subcon_progress', 'subcon_payment', 'subcon_invoice', 'subcon_invoice_pay',
    ]));
}

/** Benarkah $refType termasuk reference_type jurnal yang terdaftar (validasi in_array, case-sensitive). */
function AutoPostRefKnown(string $refType): bool {
    return in_array($refType, explode('|', JRN_VALID_REF_TYPES), true);
}

/*
Fungsi      : AutoPostJournal()
Lokasi      : function.all.php (shared, dipakai lintas modul)
Tujuan      : Generate jurnal otomatis dari modul transaksi (Sales Invoice,
              Purchase GRN, Customer Payment, dll) berdasarkan rule yang
              sudah didefinisikan di tabel fiscal_config.
Cara pakai dari modul lain (contoh setelah simpan Sales Invoice baru):
    require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
    $result = AutoPostJournal($db, [
        'rule_code'      => 'SLSCASH',           // cocokkan ke fiscal_config.rule_code
        'reference_type' => 'sales_univoice',    // harus salah satu nilai enum reference_type
        'reference_id'   => $newInvoiceId,       // id record di tabel sumber (sales_univoices dkk)
        'journal_date'   => $univoiceDate,       // tanggal transaksi
        'amount'         => $totalAmount,        // nominal transaksi
        'description'    => 'Invoice ' . $univoiceNo
    ]);
    if (!$result['success']) {
        // tangani error -- misal rule tidak ditemukan, atau periode closed.
        // Modul pemanggil TETAP bisa lanjut simpan transaksinya (jurnal
        // gagal dibuat bukan berarti transaksi sumber harus dibatalkan --
        // itu keputusan bisnis, sesuaikan sesuai kebutuhan Anda).
    }
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
UPGRADE: Override akun per transaksi (mis. Payment Entry dengan combo
pilihan Kas/Bank dinamis dari user, bukan akun tetap dari fiscal_config).
rule_code TETAP WAJIB diisi dan tetap divalidasi ke fiscal_config -- rule
dipakai untuk kontrol/audit bahwa hanya kombinasi posting yang sudah
didaftarkan yang boleh jalan, dan sebagai fallback account bila override
tidak dikirim. Tambahkan parameter opsional:
    'debit_account_id'  => int   // override akun debit rule utk transaksi ini
    'credit_account_id' => int   // override akun kredit rule utk transaksi ini
Contoh Payment Entry (Kas/Bank dipilih user, kredit ikut rule AR/Uang Muka):
    AutoPostJournal($db, [
        'rule_code'         => 'PAY_AR',
        'reference_type'    => 'payment_entry',
        'reference_id'      => $paymentId,
        'journal_date'      => $payDate,
        'amount'            => $allocatedTotal,
        'description'       => 'Pelunasan Invoice ' . $paymentNo,
        'debit_account_id'  => $accountId,   // akun Kas/Bank pilihan user
    ]);
Return: ['success' => bool, 'message' => string, 'journal_id' => int|null]
*/
function AutoPostJournal($db, $params) {
    $ruleCode      = $params['rule_code'] ?? '';
    $referenceType = $params['reference_type'] ?? '';
    $referenceId   = intval($params['reference_id'] ?? 0);
    $journalDate   = $params['journal_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
    $amount        = Str2N($params['amount'] ?? 0);
    $description   = $params['description'] ?? '';

    // Override opsional -- kalau diisi, dipakai menggantikan akun dari rule.
    $debitAccountIdOverride  = intval($params['debit_account_id']  ?? 0);
    $creditAccountIdOverride = intval($params['credit_account_id'] ?? 0);

    if (empty($ruleCode) || empty($referenceType) || $amount <= 0) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Parameter AutoPostJournal tidak lengkap (rule_code/reference_type/amount).', 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    // [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-3.1] reference_type wajib terdaftar di JRN_VALID_REF_TYPES (validasi in_array)
    // agar nilai typo/tak dikenal (mis. 'material_leftover' sebelum patch ini) tidak lolak ke journal_entries.
    if (!AutoPostRefKnown($referenceType)) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "reference_type '{$referenceType}' tidak terdaftar. Daftar valid: " . JRN_VALID_REF_TYPES . '.', 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    // 1. Cari rule di fiscal_config (tetap wajib ada & aktif, sebagai kontrol
    //    posting resmi -- walau akunnya nanti bisa di-override per transaksi)
    $stmtRule = $db->prepare("SELECT debit_account_id, credit_account_id, rule_name FROM fiscal_config WHERE rule_code = :code AND is_active = true");
    $stmtRule->execute(['code' => $ruleCode]);
    $rule = $stmtRule->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$rule) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Rule posting '{$ruleCode}' tidak ditemukan atau tidak aktif di fiscal_config.", 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    $debitAccountId  = $debitAccountIdOverride  > 0 ? $debitAccountIdOverride  : intval($rule['debit_account_id']);
    $creditAccountId = $creditAccountIdOverride > 0 ? $creditAccountIdOverride : intval($rule['credit_account_id']);
    if ($debitAccountId <= 0 || $creditAccountId <= 0) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Akun debit/kredit untuk rule '{$ruleCode}' tidak valid (cek fiscal_config atau override yang dikirim).", 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    // 2. Cari periode akuntansi berdasarkan tanggal transaksi
    $stmtPeriod = $db->prepare("
SELECT id, is_closed FROM accounting_periods
WHERE :jdate BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
LIMIT 1
");
    $stmtPeriod->execute(['jdate' => $journalDate]);
    $period = $stmtPeriod->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$period) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Tidak ada periode akuntansi yang mencakup tanggal {$journalDate}. Buat periode-nya dulu di menu Fiscal Period.", 'journal_id' => null];
    }
    if ($period['is_closed']) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Periode akuntansi untuk tanggal {$journalDate} sudah ditutup. Jurnal otomatis tidak bisa dibuat.", 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    // 3. Buat header jurnal -- langsung status 'posted' (bukan draft), karena
    //    ini auto-generate dari transaksi yang sudah tervalidasi di modul asal.
    // [FIX-REFNO] CreateRefNo() memakai koneksi pg terpisah ($conn) sehingga TIDAK melihat jurnal yang baru di-insert
    //             lewat PDO ($db) dan belum di-commit -> posting >1 jurnal dalam satu transaksi menghasilkan ref_no kembar
    //             (unique violation journal_entries_journal_no_key). Nomor jurnal sekarang dibuat lewat $db (koneksi/transaksi yang sama).
    $refNo = JournalNextRefNo($db); // JV = Journal Voucher (auto)

    try {
        DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('journal_entries', [
            'ref_no'         => $refNo,
            'journal_date'   => $journalDate,
            'period_id'      => $period['id'],
            'reference_type' => $referenceType,
            'reference_id'   => $referenceId,
            'description'    => $description ?: $rule['rule_name'],
            'status'         => 'posted',
            'posted_by'      => $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null,
            'posted_at'      => date('Y-m-d H:i:s')
        ]), 'insert journal_entries');

        $stmtNewId = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM journal_entries WHERE ref_no = :no");
        $stmtNewId->execute(['no' => $refNo]);
        $journalId = $stmtNewId->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['id'] ?? null;
        if (!$journalId) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal membuat header jurnal.', 'journal_id' => null];
        }

        // 4. Insert 2 baris (debit & kredit) -- pakai akun hasil override jika ada
        DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('journal_lines', [
            'journal_id'  => $journalId,
            'account_id'  => $debitAccountId,
            'debit'       => $amount,
            'credit'      => 0,
            'description' => $description
        ]), 'insert journal_lines (debit)');

        DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('journal_lines', [
            'journal_id'  => $journalId,
            'account_id'  => $creditAccountId,
            'debit'       => 0,
            'credit'      => $amount,
            'description' => $description
        ]), 'insert journal_lines (credit)');
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        // Pesan asli dari Postgres (mis. constraint reference_type/status,
        // FK period_id/account_id tidak valid, dsb) dikembalikan ke pemanggil
        // -- bukan dibiarkan jadi 25P02 senyap di query lain.
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage(), 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    return ['success' => true, 'message' => "Jurnal otomatis {$refNo} berhasil dibuat.", 'journal_id' => $journalId];
}

/*
Fungsi   : ensure_period_open()
Tujuan   : Memeriksa apakah suatu tanggal transaksi jatuh pada periode akuntansi
           yang sudah ditutup (is_closed = true). Mengembalikan array [success => bool, message => string]
           atau melempar exception/menghentikan eksekusi bila ditutup.
*/
function ensure_period_open($db, $transactionDate) {
    if (empty($transactionDate)) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Tanggal transaksi tidak boleh kosong untuk validasi periode.'];
    }
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT id, period_name, is_closed
            FROM accounting_periods
            WHERE :tdate BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
            LIMIT 1
        ");
        $stmt->execute(['tdate' => $transactionDate]);
        $period = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$period) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Tidak ada periode akuntansi yang mencakup tanggal {$transactionDate}. Buat periode-nya terlebih dahulu di menu Fiscal Period."];
        }

        if ($period['is_closed'] === true || $period['is_closed'] === 't' || $period['is_closed'] === 1 || $period['is_closed'] === '1') {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Periode akuntansi '{$period['period_name']}' untuk tanggal {$transactionDate} sudah ditutup (Closed). Transaksi penambahan, perubahan, atau penghapusan diblokir."];
        }

        return ['success' => true, 'period_id' => $period['id']];
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal memvalidasi periode akuntansi: ' . $e->getMessage()];
    }
}

/*
Fungsi   : ReverseJournalByReference()
Tujuan   : Hapus semua jurnal (header + lines) yang tercatat untuk sebuah
           reference_type + reference_id tertentu. Dipakai saat modul
           sumber (Payment Entry, Sales Invoice, dll) di-update atau
           dihapus, sebelum AutoPostJournal() dipanggil ulang.
Catatan  : Satu reference_type+reference_id bisa punya LEBIH DARI SATU
           journal_entries (mis. Payment Entry dengan alokasi Piutang +
           Uang Muka = 2 kali panggil AutoPostJournal = 2 journal_entries).
           Fungsi ini menghapus semuanya sekaligus.
Return: int  -> jumlah journal_entries yang dihapus
*/
function ReverseJournalByReference($db, $referenceType, $referenceId) {
    $referenceId = intval($referenceId);
    if (empty($referenceType) || $referenceId <= 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    $stmtFind = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM journal_entries WHERE reference_type = :rtype AND reference_id = :rid");
    $stmtFind->execute(['rtype' => $referenceType, 'rid' => $referenceId]);
    $journalIds = $stmtFind->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
    if (!$journalIds) {
        return 0;
    }
    $stmtDelLines  = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id = :jid");
    $stmtDelHeader = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM journal_entries WHERE id = :jid");
    foreach ($journalIds as $jid) {
        $stmtDelLines->execute(['jid' => $jid]);
        $stmtDelHeader->execute(['jid' => $jid]);
    }
    return count($journalIds);
}

/*
Fungsi   : JournalNextRefNo()   [FIX-REFNO]
Tujuan   : Nomor jurnal berikutnya format JV-YYMM-NNNNN (sama dengan CreateRefNo) tetapi dibaca lewat PDO $db,
           jadi ikut melihat baris yang belum di-commit pada transaksi yang sama.
           Advisory lock transaksi mencegah dua proses mengambil nomor yang sama bersamaan.
*/
function JournalNextRefNo($db) {
    $prefix = 'JV-' . date('ym') . '-';
    $db->query("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(7001)");   // lock dilepas otomatis saat COMMIT/ROLLBACK
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(ref_no, 5) AS int)), 0) + 1
FROM journal_entries
WHERE ref_no ~ :pat");
    $st->execute(['pat' => '^' . $prefix . '[0-9]{5}$']);
    return $prefix . str_pad((string)intval($st->fetchColumn()), 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
}

/*
Fungsi   : PostStockMovement()
Tujuan   : Catat 1 baris pergerakan stok (IN atau OUT) ke ledger
           stock_movements. Dipakai oleh GRN (IN), Sales Delivery (OUT),
           Stock Transfer (IN+OUT sepasang), Purchase/Sales Return, dll.
$params = [
    'movement_date'  => 'YYYY-MM-DD',  (required)
    'item_id'        => int,            (required)
    'grade_id'       => int|null,
    'warehouse_id'   => int,            (required)
    'movement_type'  => 'IN'|'OUT',     (required)
    'qty'            => float,          (required, > 0)
    'unit_cost'      => float,          (optional, default 0)
    'reference_type' => string,         (required)
    'reference_id'   => int,            (required)
    'reference_no'   => string,         (optional, buat tampilan cepat)
    'remark'         => string,
]
Return: int  -> id baris stock_movements yang baru diinsert
Throws Exception kalau parameter wajib kosong / movement_type tidak valid.
*/
function PostStockMovement($db, $params) {
    $movementDate  = $params['movement_date'] ?? null;
    $itemId        = intval($params['item_id'] ?? 0);
    $gradeId       = isset($params['grade_id']) && $params['grade_id'] !== '' ? intval($params['grade_id']) : null;
    $warehouseId   = intval($params['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);
    $movementType  = strtoupper($params['movement_type'] ?? '');
    $qty           = round(floatval($params['qty'] ?? 0), 4);
    $unitCost      = round(floatval($params['unit_cost'] ?? 0), 4);
    $referenceType = $params['reference_type'] ?? '';
    $referenceId   = intval($params['reference_id'] ?? 0);
    $referenceNo   = $params['reference_no'] ?? null;
    $remark        = $params['remark'] ?? null;

    if (empty($movementDate) || $itemId <= 0 || $warehouseId <= 0 || $qty <= 0) {
        throw new Exception("Parameter PostStockMovement tidak lengkap (movement_date/item_id/warehouse_id/qty wajib diisi & valid).");
    }
    if (!in_array($movementType, ['IN', 'OUT'], true)) {
        throw new Exception("movement_type harus 'IN' atau 'OUT', diterima: '{$movementType}'.");
    }
    if (empty($referenceType) || $referenceId <= 0) {
        throw new Exception("Parameter PostStockMovement tidak lengkap (reference_type/reference_id wajib diisi).");
    }

    $ok = $db->insert('stock_movements', [
        'movement_date'  => $movementDate,
        'item_id'        => $itemId,
        'grade_id'       => $gradeId,
        'warehouse_id'   => $warehouseId,
        'movement_type'  => $movementType,
        'qty'            => $qty,
        'unit_cost'      => $unitCost,
        'reference_type' => $referenceType,
        'reference_id'   => $referenceId,
        'reference_no'   => $referenceNo,
        'remark'         => $remark,
        'created_by'     => $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null
    ]);
    if ($ok === false) {
        throw new Exception("Gagal insert stock_movements: " . $db->getResult());
    }
    return $db->lastInsertId();
}

/*
Fungsi   : ReverseStockMovementByReference()
Tujuan   : Hapus semua baris stock_movements untuk reference_type +
           reference_id tertentu. Dipakai saat modul sumber (GRN, Sales
           Delivery, dll) di-update atau dihapus, sebelum
           PostStockMovement() dipanggil ulang.
Return: int -> jumlah baris yang dihapus
*/
function ReverseStockMovementByReference($db, $referenceType, $referenceId) {
    $referenceId = intval($referenceId);
    if (empty($referenceType) || $referenceId <= 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    $stmtCount = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_movements WHERE reference_type = :rtype AND reference_id = :rid");
    $stmtCount->execute(['rtype' => $referenceType, 'rid' => $referenceId]);
    $count = intval($stmtCount->fetchColumn());
    if ($count > 0) {
        $stmtDel = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_movements WHERE reference_type = :rtype AND reference_id = :rid");
        $stmtDel->execute(['rtype' => $referenceType, 'rid' => $referenceId]);
    }
    return $count;
}

/*
Fungsi   : GetStockBalance()
Tujuan   : Ambil saldo stok saat ini untuk 1 item (+grade opsional) di
           1 gudang tertentu, langsung dari view_stock_balance.

           [CLIENT-SUPPLIED 2026-11-15 F-4.1] view_stock_balance TIDAK diubah (view tanpa
           material_source dipakai modul lain, mengganti definition-nya berisiko untuk
           instalasi lama). Saldo dihitung langsung dari stock_movements di sini, sehingga
           aman dan tidak bergantung pada kolom view.
*/
function GetStockBalance($db, $itemId, $gradeId, $warehouseId) {
    $sql = "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'IN' THEN qty ELSE -qty END), 0) AS balance_qty
              FROM stock_movements
             WHERE item_id = :item_id AND warehouse_id = :warehouse_id " . ($gradeId ? "AND grade_id = :grade_id" : "AND grade_id IS NULL");
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    $params = ['item_id' => $itemId, 'warehouse_id' => $warehouseId];
    if ($gradeId) { $params['grade_id'] = $gradeId; }
    $stmt->execute($params);
    $balance = $stmt->fetchColumn();
    return $balance !== false ? round(floatval($balance), 4) : 0.0;
}

/*
Fungsi   : GetProjectStockMap()
Tujuan   : Ambil saldo stok per material yang DAPAT DIPAKAI oleh suatu
           proyek, untuk pengecekan inventory di Purchase Planning / PO.
           "Dapat dipakai" = stok tersimpan di gudang milik proyek itu
           sendiri (warehouses.project_id) ATAU gudang bersama yang tidak
           dibind ke proyek mana pun (warehouses.project_id IS NULL, mis.
           Gudang Pusat). Stok di gudang milik PROYEK LAIN tidak dihitung
           (catatan: material tsb bukan milik proyek ini).
           Item diidentifikasi lewat stock_movements.item_id = materials.id.
$params  : $db (PDO crud), $projectId (int)
Return   : array [material_id => qty_tersedia(float)]
*/
function GetProjectStockMap($db, $projectId) {
    $projectId = (int)$projectId;
    if ($projectId <= 0) return [];
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT sm.item_id AS material_id,
               SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type = 'IN' THEN sm.qty ELSE -sm.qty END) AS balance_qty
          FROM public.stock_movements sm
          JOIN public.warehouses w ON w.id = sm.warehouse_id
         WHERE w.project_id = :pid OR w.project_id IS NULL
         GROUP BY sm.item_id
    ");
    $st->execute([':pid' => $projectId]);
    $map = [];
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) {
        $mid = (int)$r['material_id'];
        $qty = round(floatval($r['balance_qty']), 4);
        $map[$mid] = $qty > 0 ? $qty : 0.0;
    }
    return $map;
}

/*
Fungsi   : RecalcGrnStatus()
Tujuan   : Hitung ulang status GRN (open/partial/closed) berdasarkan
           qty_received di grn_dtl vs total qty yang sudah di-posting
           lewat wh_receiving (status 'posted').
[FIX]    : Semua query memakai koneksi global $conn -- pg_query_params()
           wajib menerima koneksi sebagai argumen pertama. DbOrFail()
           tidak dipakai di sini karena itu untuk wrapper PDO ($db),
           bukan resource hasil pg_query_params().
*/
function RecalcGrnStatus($grn_hdr_id, $db = null) {
    $grn_hdr_id = (int)$grn_hdr_id;
    $sql = "SELECT
COUNT(*) AS total_items,
SUM(CASE WHEN (gd.qty_received - COALESCE(wd.qty_wh_sum,0)) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fully_received,
SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(wd.qty_wh_sum,0) > 0
AND (gd.qty_received - COALESCE(wd.qty_wh_sum,0)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partially_received
FROM grn_dtl gd
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT d.grn_dtl_id, SUM(d.qty_received) AS qty_wh_sum
FROM wh_receiving_dtl d
JOIN wh_receiving_hdr h ON h.id = d.wh_receiving_hdr_id AND h.status = 'posted'
GROUP BY d.grn_dtl_id
) wd ON wd.grn_dtl_id = gd.id
WHERE gd.grn_hdr_id = " . ($db !== null ? ':id' : '$1');
    if ($db !== null) {
        $st = $db->prepare($sql); $st->execute([':id' => $grn_hdr_id]);
        $row = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } else {
        global $conn;
        $res = pg_query_params($conn, $sql, [$grn_hdr_id]);
        if ($res === false) throw new Exception('[RecalcGrnStatus] ' . pg_last_error($conn));
        $row = pg_fetch_assoc($res);
    }
    if ((int)$row['total_items'] === 0) $status = 'open';
    elseif ((int)$row['fully_received'] === (int)$row['total_items']) $status = 'closed';
    elseif ((int)$row['fully_received'] > 0 || (int)$row['partially_received'] > 0) $status = 'partial';
    else $status = 'open';
    if ($db !== null) {
        $st = $db->prepare("UPDATE grn_hdr SET status = :s WHERE id = :id");
        $st->execute([':s' => $status, ':id' => $grn_hdr_id]);
    } else {
        global $conn;
        $res = pg_query_params($conn, "UPDATE grn_hdr SET status = $1 WHERE id = $2", [$status, $grn_hdr_id]);
        if ($res === false) throw new Exception('[RecalcGrnStatus update] ' . pg_last_error($conn));
    }
    return $status;
}

function mpCallChatGPT($prompt, $timeout = 30) {
    // 1. Masukkan API Key OpenAI Anda di sini (atau via Environment Variable)
    $apiKey = getenv('OPENAI_API_KEY') ?: 'sk-proj-Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Morbi quis orci molestie elit scelerisque cursus.';
    // 2. Pilih model ChatGPT (gpt-4o-mini sangat cepat, murah, dan pintar)
    $model = 'gpt-4o-mini';
    // 3. Endpoint Resmi OpenAI
    $apiUrl = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions";
    // 4. Payload dengan System Prompt yang MEMAKSA Bahasa Indonesia
    $payload = [
        'model' => $model,
        'messages' => [
            [
                'role' => 'system',
                'content' => 'Anda adalah asisten AI ahli manajemen proyek konstruksi di Indonesia. ATURAN WAJIB: 1) Berikan SELURUH respons dalam BAHASA INDONESIA yang baik dan benar. 2) Jangan gunakan bahasa Mandarin atau Inggris. 3) Selalu berikan respons dalam format JSON yang valid tanpa teks pembuka/penutup di luar JSON.'
            ],
            [
                'role' => 'user',
                'content' => $prompt
            ]
        ],
        // Memaksa model untuk mengeluarkan output JSON murni
        'response_format' => [
            'type' => 'json_object'
        ],
        'temperature' => 0.3 // Rendah agar hasil analisis lebih konsisten dan faktual
    ];
    $ch = curl_init($apiUrl);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, json_encode($payload));
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
        'Content-Type: application/json',
        'Authorization: Bearer ' . $apiKey
    ]);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, $timeout);
    $response = curl_exec($ch);
    $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    $curlError = curl_error($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
    // 5. Handle Error
    if ($httpCode !== 200) {
        $errorMsg = $curlError ? $curlError : $response;
        throw new Exception("Gagal terhubung ke OpenAI API (HTTP {$httpCode}): {$errorMsg}");
    }
    // 6. Parse Respons
    $apiResult = json_decode($response, true);
    if (isset($apiResult['choices'][0]['message']['content'])) {
        $raw = $apiResult['choices'][0]['message']['content'];
        // Bersihkan tag markdown ```json ... ``` jika model tetap mengeluarkannya
        return trim(str_replace(['```json', '```'], '', $raw));
    }
    // Fallback jika struktur respons berubah atau ada error dari sisi OpenAI
    $errMsg = $apiResult['error']['message'] ?? 'Format respons tidak dikenali';
    throw new Exception("Error dari OpenAI API: {$errMsg}");
}

function CreateRefNoDb($db, $table, $column, $prefix) {
    $allowed = ['wh_receiving_hdr'=>'ref_no', 'supplier_payments'=>'payment_no',
                'purchase_orders'=>'po_number', 'grn_hdr'=>'ref_no', 'purchase_invoice_hdr'=>'inv_no'];
    if (!isset($allowed[$table]) || $allowed[$table] !== $column) throw new Exception('CreateRefNoDb: tabel/kolom tidak diizinkan.');
    $prefix = preg_replace('/[^A-Z0-9]/', '', strtoupper((string)$prefix));
    if ($prefix === '') throw new Exception('CreateRefNoDb: prefix tidak valid.');
    $db->query("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(" . (int)crc32($table . '.' . $column) . ")");
    $p = $prefix . '-' . date('ym') . '-';
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(RIGHT($column, 5) AS int)), 0) + 1 FROM $table WHERE $column ~ :pat");
    $st->execute([':pat' => '^' . $p . '[0-9]{5}$']);
    return $p . str_pad((string)intval($st->fetchColumn()), 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
}

// ============================================================
// [F-1.2 2026-11-16] SATU RUMUS "realisasi biaya proyek" (HPP).
// Sumber kebenaran tunggal: view public.v_project_actual_cost
// (migration sql/2026-11-16.project_actual_cost_view.sql).
// Dipakai oleh: project.analysis.php (dash_project_context), project.progressCRD.php (prog_metrics),
//               project.wipreleaseCRD.php (wr_calc). JANGAN hitung ulang dengan rumus sendiri.
// ============================================================
if (!function_exists('ProjectActualCost')) {
    /**
     * Kembalikan baris v_project_actual_cost untuk satu proyek (null bila view/proyek tidak ada).
     * @param PDO   $db             Koneksi PDO (dalam transaksi apa pun).
     * @param int   $pid            ID proyek.
     * @param float|null $progressOverride Bila diisi, earned value dihitung seolah progress sebesar ini
     *                             (dipakai saat verifikasi klaim). cost_* TIDAK ikut berubah.
     * @return array|null          [project_id, progress, budget_base, rab_budget, cost_material, cost_expense,
     *                              cost_subcon, cost_total, hpp_released, wip_remaining, earned_value, cpi]
     */
    function ProjectActualCost($db, int $pid, ?float $progressOverride = null): ?array {
        try {
            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT project_id, project_name, project_status, progress,
                                       budget_base_raw, rab_budget,
                                       cost_material, cost_expense, cost_subcon, cost_total,
                                       hpp_released, wip_remaining
                                  FROM public.v_project_actual_cost
                                 WHERE project_id = :p");
            $st->execute([':p' => $pid]);
            $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            error_log('[function.all] ProjectActualCost: view tidak tersedia / gagal: ' . $e->getMessage()
                . ' -- jalankan migration sql/2026-11-16.project_actual_cost_view.sql');
            return null;
        }
        if (!$r) return null;
        $progress = $progressOverride !== null ? (float)$progressOverride : (float)$r['progress'];
        $budgetBase = (float)$r['budget_base_raw'] > 0 ? (float)$r['budget_base_raw'] : (float)$r['rab_budget'];
        $cm = (float)$r['cost_material'];
        $ce = (float)$r['cost_expense'];
        $cs = (float)$r['cost_subcon'];
        $total = (float)$r['cost_total'];
        if ($total <= 0.000001) $total = $cm + $ce + $cs;   // jaga konsistensi bila kolom view berubah
        $ev = $budgetBase * $progress / 100.0;
        $cpi = $total > 0 ? round($ev / $total, 4) : null;
        return [
            'project_id'    => (int)$r['project_id'],
            'project_name'  => (string)$r['project_name'],
            'project_status'=> (string)$r['project_status'],
            'progress'      => (int)round($progress),
            'budget_base'   => round($budgetBase, 2),
            'rab_budget'    => round((float)$r['rab_budget'], 2),
            'cost_material' => round($cm, 2),
            'cost_expense'  => round($ce, 2),
            'cost_subcon'   => round($cs, 2),
            'cost_total'    => round($total, 2),
            'hpp_released'  => round((float)$r['hpp_released'], 2),
            'wip_remaining' => round((float)$r['wip_remaining'], 2),
            'earned_value'  => round($ev, 2),
            'cpi'           => $cpi,
        ];
    }
}

<?php
// Block direct HTTP access before loading application dependencies.

/**
 * Cron Task / Scraper: fetch_kurs_pajak.php
 * Mengambil data Kurs Pajak mingguan dari Kemenkeu (https://fiskal.kemenkeu.go.id/informasi-publik/kurs-pajak)
 * dan menyimpannya secara otomatis ke database lokal proyekgmn (tax_exchange_rate_hdr & dtl).
 *
 * Jalankan via CLI / Cron setiap hari Rabu:
 * 0 8 * * 3 php /home/myadmin/proyekgmn/cron/fetch_kurs_pajak.php
 */

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

function parseIndonesianDate($dateStr) {
    $months = [
        'Januari' => '01', 'Februari' => '02', 'Maret' => '03', 'April' => '04',
        'Mei' => '05', 'Juni' => '06', 'Juli' => '07', 'Agustus' => '08',
        'September' => '09', 'Oktober' => '10', 'November' => '11', 'Desember' => '12',
        'Jan' => '01', 'Feb' => '02', 'Mar' => '03', 'Apr' => '04',
        'Mei' => '05', 'Jun' => '06', 'Jul' => '07', 'Agt' => '08',
        'Sep' => '09', 'Okt' => '10', 'Nov' => '11', 'Desember' => '12'
    ];

    $parts = preg_split('/\s+/', trim($dateStr));
    if (count($parts) >= 3) {
        $day = str_pad($parts[0], 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        $month = $months[$parts[1]] ?? '01';
        $year = $parts[2];
        return "$year-$month-$day";
    }
    return date('Y-m-d');
}

function fetchAndStoreTaxExchangeRates($pdo = null) {
    // 1. Resolve PDO Connection if null
    if ($pdo === null) {
        global $pdo, $db_conn, $conn, $db;
        if (isset($GLOBALS['pdo']) && $GLOBALS['pdo'] instanceof PDO) {
            $pdo = $GLOBALS['pdo'];
        } elseif (isset($pdo) && $pdo instanceof PDO) {
            // $pdo exists locally
        } else {
            // Gunakan koneksi standar aplikasi; jangan menyimpan credential database di source.
            require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';
            try {
                $pdo = new crud();
            } catch (PDOException $e) {
                return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Database Connection Error: " . $e->getMessage()];
            }
        }
    }

    $url = "https://fiskal.kemenkeu.go.id/informasi-publik/kurs-pajak";

    $html = false;
    if (function_exists('curl_init')) {
        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_URL => $url,
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_USERAGENT => 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 30,
            CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER => true,
            CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST => 2
        ]);
        $html = curl_exec($ch);
        curl_close($ch);
    }

    if ($html === false || empty($html)) {
        $opts = [
            'http' => [
                'method' => 'GET',
                'header' => "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36\r\n"
            ],
            'ssl' => [
                'verify_peer' => true,
                'verify_peer_name' => true
            ]
        ];
        $context = stream_context_create($opts);
        $html = @file_get_contents($url, false, $context);
    }

    if (empty($html)) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Gagal mengambil HTML dari $url"];
    }

    // 1. Extract KMK No
    $kmkNo = 'KMK Kurs Pajak';
    if (preg_match('/KMK\s+Nomor\s+([^\<]+)/i', $html, $matches)) {
        $kmkNo = trim($matches[1]);
    }

    // 2. Extract Tanggal Berlaku (Start Date & End Date)
    $startDate = date('Y-m-d');
    $endDate = date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+6 days'));
    if (preg_match('/Tanggal\s+berlaku:\s*(\d+\s+[A-Za-z]+\s+\d{4})\s*-\s*(\d+\s+[A-Za-z]+\s+\d{4})/i', $html, $matches)) {
        $startDate = parseIndonesianDate($matches[1]);
        $endDate = parseIndonesianDate($matches[2]);
    }

    // 3. Extract File URL salinan KMK
    $fileUrl = null;
    if (preg_match('/<a[^>]+class=["\']view-pdf["\'][^>]+href=["\']([^"\']+)["\']/i', $html, $matches)) {
        $fileUrl = "https://fiskal.kemenkeu.go.id" . $matches[1];
    }

    // Check existing header
    $stmtCheck = $pdo->prepare("SELECT id FROM tax_exchange_rate_hdr WHERE start_date = :start_date AND end_date = :end_date");
    $stmtCheck->execute(['start_date' => $startDate, 'end_date' => $endDate]);
    $existingHdr = $stmtCheck->fetch();

    if ($existingHdr) {
        $hdrId = $existingHdr['id'];
        $stmtUpdateHdr = $pdo->prepare("UPDATE tax_exchange_rate_hdr SET kmk_no = :kmk_no, file_url = :file_url WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtUpdateHdr->execute(['kmk_no' => $kmkNo, 'file_url' => $fileUrl, 'id' => $hdrId]);

        $pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM tax_exchange_rate_dtl WHERE hdr_id = :hdr_id")->execute(['hdr_id' => $hdrId]);
    } else {
        $stmtInsHdr = $pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO tax_exchange_rate_hdr (kmk_no, start_date, end_date, file_url, remark) VALUES (:kmk_no, :start_date, :end_date, :file_url, 'Auto-synced via Kemenkeu') RETURNING id");
        $stmtInsHdr->execute([
            'kmk_no' => $kmkNo,
            'start_date' => $startDate,
            'end_date' => $endDate,
            'file_url' => $fileUrl
        ]);
        $hdrId = $stmtInsHdr->fetchColumn();
    }

    // Load m_currency map (Code -> ID)
    $currMap = [];
    $stmtCurr = $pdo->query("SELECT id, UPPER(TRIM(init)) AS code FROM m_currency WHERE init IS NOT NULL AND init != ''");
    while ($row = $stmtCurr->fetch()) {
        $currMap[$row['code']] = $row['id'];
    }

    // 4. Parse Table Rows
    preg_match_all('/<tr[^>]*>(.*?)<\/tr>/s', $html, $trMatches);
    $insertedCount = 0;

    $stmtInsDtl = $pdo->prepare("
        INSERT INTO tax_exchange_rate_dtl 
        (hdr_id, currency_id, currency_code, currency_name, unit_multiplier, rate, rate_per_unit, prev_rate, change_amount, change_direction) 
        VALUES 
        (:hdr_id, :currency_id, :currency_code, :currency_name, :unit_multiplier, :rate, :rate_per_unit, :prev_rate, :change_amount, :change_direction)
    ");

    foreach ($trMatches[1] as $trHtml) {
        if (strpos($trHtml, '<th') !== false || strpos($trHtml, 'Mata Uang') !== false) {
            continue;
        }

        $currencyCode = '';
        $currencyName = '';

        if (preg_match('/<span[^>]*class=[\'"]hidden-xs[\'"][^>]*>\s*([^\<\)]+)\s*\(([A-Z]{3})\)\s*<\/span>/i', $trHtml, $mCurr)) {
            $currencyName = trim($mCurr[1]);
            $currencyCode = trim($mCurr[2]);
        } elseif (preg_match('/([A-Z]{3})/', $trHtml, $mCode)) {
            $currencyCode = trim($mCode[1]);
            $currencyName = $currencyCode;
        }

        if (empty($currencyCode)) continue;

        $rate = 0.0;
        if (preg_match('/<div[^>]*class=[\'"][^\'"]*m-l-5[^\'"]*[\'"][^>]*>\s*([\d\.,]+)\s*<\/div>/i', $trHtml, $mRate)) {
            $rateStr = str_replace('.', '', $mRate[1]);
            $rateStr = str_replace(',', '.', $rateStr);
            $rate = floatval($rateStr);
        }

        if ($rate <= 0) continue;

        $changeAmount = 0.0;
        $direction = 'FLAT';

        if (strpos($trHtml, 'curr-up') !== false) {
            $direction = 'UP';
        } elseif (strpos($trHtml, 'curr-down') !== false) {
            $direction = 'DOWN';
        }

        if (preg_match('/td[^>]*curr-change[^>]*>\s*([\d\.,]+)/i', $trHtml, $mChange)) {
            $changeStr = str_replace('.', '', $mChange[1]);
            $changeStr = str_replace(',', '.', $changeStr);
            $changeAmount = floatval($changeStr);
        }

        $multiplier = ($currencyCode === 'JPY') ? 100.0 : 1.0;
        $ratePerUnit = $rate / $multiplier;
        $currencyId = $currMap[$currencyCode] ?? null;

        $prevRate = 0.0;
        if ($direction === 'UP') {
            $prevRate = $rate - $changeAmount;
        } elseif ($direction === 'DOWN') {
            $prevRate = $rate + $changeAmount;
        } else {
            $prevRate = $rate;
        }

        $stmtInsDtl->execute([
            'hdr_id' => $hdrId,
            'currency_id' => $currencyId,
            'currency_code' => $currencyCode,
            'currency_name' => $currencyName,
            'unit_multiplier' => $multiplier,
            'rate' => $rate,
            'rate_per_unit' => $ratePerUnit,
            'prev_rate' => $prevRate,
            'change_amount' => $changeAmount,
            'change_direction' => $direction
        ]);

        $insertedCount++;
    }

    return [
        'success' => true,
        'hdr_id' => $hdrId,
        'kmk_no' => $kmkNo,
        'period' => "$startDate s/d $endDate",
        'items_count' => $insertedCount
    ];
}

    }

<?php
/*
Document : login.php
Description : Login Page - RAB-PROJECT (Dark Theme, selaras dashboard + Show/Hide Password Icon)
*/

require_once __DIR__ . '/php-class/crudClass.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/php-func/function.all.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION)) { session_start(); }

// Jika sudah login, langsung ke dashboard
if (isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) && !is_null($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    header('Location: views/dashboard.php');
    exit;
}

// Protect the login form from cross-origin POST requests.
if (function_exists('app_require_same_origin_post')) {
    app_require_same_origin_post();
}

$error_msg = '';
$username = '';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $username = trim($_POST['username'] ?? '');
    $password = $_POST['password'] ?? '';
    
    if (!empty($username) && !empty($password)) {
        try {
            $db = new crud();
            $stmt = $db->prepare("
                SELECT id, login_name, password, active
                FROM m_user_system
                WHERE LOWER(login_name) = LOWER(:username)
                LIMIT 1
            ");
            $stmt->execute([':username' => $username]);
            $user = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            
            if (!$user) {
                $error_msg = "Username atau Password salah!";
            } else {
                if ((int)$user['active'] !== 1) {
                    $error_msg = "Akun Anda tidak aktif. Hubungi administrator.";
                } else {
                    $isPasswordValid = false;
                    
                    // Cek multiple methods
                    if ($user['password'] === $password) $isPasswordValid = true;
                    if (!$isPasswordValid && function_exists('EncodeData')) {
                        if ($user['password'] === EncodeData($password)) $isPasswordValid = true;
                    }
                    if (!$isPasswordValid && $user['password'] === md5($password)) $isPasswordValid = true;
                    if (!$isPasswordValid && function_exists('password_verify')) {
                        if (password_verify($password, $user['password'])) $isPasswordValid = true;
                    }
                    
                    if ($isPasswordValid) {
                        // Upgrade legacy plaintext / Base64 / MD5 credentials after successful authentication.
                        $passwordInfo = password_get_info((string)$user['password']);
                        $passwordAlgo = $passwordInfo['algo'] ?? 0;
                        if (empty($passwordAlgo) || !password_verify($password, (string)$user['password'])
                            || password_needs_rehash((string)$user['password'], PASSWORD_DEFAULT, ['cost' => 12])) {
                            $upgradeHash = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_DEFAULT, ['cost' => 12]);
                            $upgradeStmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE m_user_system SET password = :password WHERE id = :id");
                            $upgradeStmt->execute([':password' => $upgradeHash, ':id' => (int)$user['id']]);
                        }

                        // Rotasi session saat login; hak modul tidak ditentukan dari kolom user.
                        session_regenerate_id(true);
                        $_SESSION["user_id"] = $user['id'];
                        $_SESSION["username"] = $user['login_name'];
                        unset($_SESSION['FormAccess'], $_SESSION['form_id'], $_SESSION['current_menu_id']);
                        header('Location: views/dashboard.php');
                        exit;
                    } else {
                        $error_msg = "Username atau Password salah!";
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            error_log("[Login Error] " . $e->getMessage());
            $error_msg = "Terjadi kesalahan sistem.";
        }
    } else {
        $error_msg = "Username dan Password wajib diisi!";
    }
}

            var ICON_EYE_CLOSED = '<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M17.94 17.94A10.07 10.07 0 0 1 12 20c-7 0-11-8-11-8a18.45 18.45 0 0 1 5.06-5.94M9.9 4.24A9.12 9.12 0 0 1 12 4c7 0 11 8 11 8a18.5 18.5 0 0 1-2.16 3.19m-6.72-1.07a3 3 0 1 1-4.24-4.24"></path><line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23"></line></svg>';

            toggleBtn.onclick = function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                var isPassword = (passwordInput.type === 'password');
                
                if (isPassword) {
                    passwordInput.type = 'text';
                    toggleBtn.innerHTML = ICON_EYE_OPEN;
                    toggleBtn.title = 'Sembunyikan password';
                } else {
                    passwordInput.type = 'password';
                    toggleBtn.innerHTML = ICON_EYE_CLOSED;
                    toggleBtn.title = 'Tampilkan password';
                }
            };
        });
