/*
  Service Worker Project Progress.
  Base URL mengikuti lokasi file Service Worker.
  API php-crud tidak pernah di-cache.
*/

var APP_BASE = new URL('.', self.location.href).pathname;

// Cache dipisahkan berdasarkan base path.
// Cache dev dan production tidak saling menghapus.
var CACHE_PREFIX = 'prg-v3-' + APP_BASE.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
var VERSION = CACHE_PREFIX;

var SHELL = [
    APP_BASE + 'views/project.progress.m.php',
    APP_BASE + 'js/project.progress.m.js',
    APP_BASE + 'manifest.progress.json'
];

self.addEventListener('install', function (e) {
    e.waitUntil(
        caches.open(VERSION).then(function (cache) {
            return Promise.all(
                SHELL.map(function (url) {
                    return cache.add(url).catch(function (error) {
                        console.warn('Gagal cache shell:', url, error);
                    });
                })
            );
        })
    );

    self.skipWaiting();
});

self.addEventListener('activate', function (e) {
    e.waitUntil(
        caches.keys().then(function (keys) {
            return Promise.all(
                keys.filter(function (key) {
                    return key.indexOf(CACHE_PREFIX) === 0 &&
                           key !== VERSION;
                }).map(function (key) {
                    return caches.delete(key);
                })
            );
        })
    );

    self.clients.claim();
});

self.addEventListener('fetch', function (e) {
    var req = e.request;
    var url = new URL(req.url);

    if (req.method !== 'GET' || url.origin !== location.origin) {
        return;
    }

    // API, CRUD, dan foto selalu langsung ke jaringan.
    if (url.pathname.indexOf(APP_BASE + 'php-crud/') === 0) {
        return;
    }

    // Hanya file shell Project Progress yang dikelola.
    if (SHELL.indexOf(url.pathname) === -1) {
        return;
    }

    e.respondWith(
        fetch(req).then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.ok) {
                var copy = res.clone();

                caches.open(VERSION).then(function (cache) {
                    cache.put(req, copy);
                });
            }

            return res;
        }).catch(function () {
            return caches.open(VERSION).then(function (cache) {
                return cache.match(req);
            });
        })
    );
});

==================== FILE: ./js_project.progress.js ====================
/*
  Document      : project.progress.js
  Description   : Entry Progress Proyek & Verifikasi Auditor Head Office (HO). ExtJS 3.4.1
                  Mengikuti struktur acuan purchase.return.js:
                  - Main Grid (#divMainGrid) + Panel Detail di bawah (#prgDtlContainer)
                  - Modal Editor (#editorWdw bawaan template)
                  - Alur Status: Draft -> Submitted -> Verified (HO) / Rejected (HO)
                  - Pre-check progress vs pemakaian anggaran
  Backend       : ../php-crud/project.progressCRD.php
*/
Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();

    // Styling khusus header grid editor & modal dark theme (Disuntik persis acuan purchase.return.js)
    (function () {
        var old = document.getElementById('gridEditorHdrCss');
        if (old) old.parentNode.removeChild(old);
        var H = 'body .x-grid3-gridEditor ';
        var css = [
            H + '.x-grid3-header,' + H + '.x-grid3-header-offset,' + H + '.x-grid3-header-inner,' + H + '.x-grid3-hd-row,',
            H + '.x-grid3-hd-row td.x-grid3-hd,' + H + '.x-grid3-hd-row td.x-grid3-hd-over,' + H + '.x-grid3-hd-row td.x-grid3-hd-click,',
            H + '.x-grid3-hd-row td.sort-asc,' + H + '.x-grid3-hd-row td.sort-desc,' + H + '.x-grid3-hd-row td.x-grid3-hd-menu-open{',
            '  background:#194a82 !important;background-image:none !important;border-top:none !important;',
            '  border-bottom:2px solid #2b6cb0 !important;border-left:none !important;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12) !important;',
            '  vertical-align:middle !important;}',
            H + '.x-grid3-hd-row td.x-grid3-hd:last-child{border-right:none !important;}',
            H + '.x-grid3-hd-inner,' + H + 'td.x-grid3-hd-over .x-grid3-hd-inner,' + H + 'td.sort-asc .x-grid3-hd-inner,' + H + 'td.sort-desc .x-grid3-hd-inner{',
            '  background:transparent !important;background-image:none !important;border:none !important;',
            '  padding:8px 8px !important;white-space:normal !important;text-overflow:clip !important;',
            '  line-height:14px !important;height:auto !important;color:#ffffff !important;}',
            H + '.x-grid3-hd-btn,' + H + 'img.x-grid3-sort-icon{display:none !important;}',
            '.rtDarkWin .x-form-item label{color:#9fc3d1 !important;}',
            '.rtDarkWin .x-form-display-field{color:#e2e8f0 !important;}',
            '.rtDarkWin .x-form-empty-field{color:#9fb4c7 !important;}',
            '.rtDarkWin .x-btn button{color:#ffffff !important;font-weight:bold !important;opacity:1 !important;}',
            '.rtDarkWin .x-btn-tl,.rtDarkWin .x-btn-tr,.rtDarkWin .x-btn-tc,.rtDarkWin .x-btn-ml,.rtDarkWin .x-btn-mr,',
            '.rtDarkWin .x-btn-bl,.rtDarkWin .x-btn-br,.rtDarkWin .x-btn-bc{background:none !important;background-image:none !important;}',
            '.rtDarkWin .x-btn-mc{background-color:#2e7dd1 !important;background-image:none !important;border-radius:4px;}',
            '.rtDarkWin .x-btn-over .x-btn-mc{background-color:#4695e6 !important;}',
            '.rtDarkWin .x-btn-mc button{padding:2px 8px;}'
        ].join('\n');
        var st = document.createElement('style');
        st.id = 'gridEditorHdrCss';
        st.type = 'text/css';
        st.innerHTML = css;
        document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0].appendChild(st);
    })();

    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Progress <em>Proyek & Verifikasi HO</em>";

    var CRD = '../php-crud/project.progressCRD.php';
    var ACCESS_ADD = 2;   // Hak akses entry/submit progress (Lapangan)
    var ACCESS_EDIT = 3;  // Hak akses verifikasi/reject (Auditor HO)

    var dataRecord = null;
    var editId = 0;
    var hdrForm = null;
    var fProject, fPeriodDate, fBaDoc, fNotes, fProjInfo;

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }
    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function fmtQty(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    function fmtPct(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00') + '%'; }
    function ymd(d) {
        var m = d.getMonth() + 1, dd = d.getDate();
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : m) + '-' + (dd < 10 ? '0' + dd : dd);
    }
    function parseYmd(str) {
        var m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(str || '');
        return m ? new Date(parseInt(m[1], 10), parseInt(m[2], 10) - 1, parseInt(m[3], 10)) : null;
    }
    function showErr(msg) { Ext.Msg.show({ title: 'Peringatan', msg: msg, buttons: Ext.Msg.OK, icon: Ext.Msg.WARNING }); }

    function storeError(proxy, type, action, opt, res) {
        var m = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        if (res && res.message) { m = res.message; }
        else {
            try { var o = Ext.decode(res.responseText); if (o && o.message) { m = o.message; } }
            catch (e) { if (res && res.status) { m += ' (HTTP ' + res.status + ')'; } }
        }
        showErr(m);
    }

    function ajax(params, onOk) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD, method: 'POST', params: params,
            success: function (r) {
                var o;
                try { o = Ext.decode(r.responseText); } catch (e) { showErr('Respon server tidak valid.'); return; }
                onOk(o);
            },
            failure: function (r) { showErr('Koneksi ke server gagal (HTTP ' + r.status + ').'); }
        });
    }

    function statusColor(v) {
        switch (v) {
            case 'DRAFT': return '#e6a817 !important';
            case 'SUBMITTED': return '#4fa3ff !important';
            case 'VERIFIED': return '#00ff4c !important';
            case 'REJECTED': return '#c0392b !important';
        }
        return '#ffffff !important';
    }

    function evidenceLink(v) {
        if (!v) return '-';
        if (!/^(https?:\/\/|\/)/i.test(v)) return enc(v);
        var label = /\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp)(\?.*)?$/i.test(v) ? 'Foto Evidens' : (/\.pdf(\?.*)?$/i.test(v) ? 'PDF Berita Acara' : 'Link Dokumen');
        return '<a href="' + enc(v) + '" target="_blank" onclick="event.stopPropagation();" style="color:#2bc1e2;font-weight:bold;">' + label + '</a>';
    }

    function doAction(params, okTitle) {
        ajax(params, function (res) {
            Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? (okTitle || 'Sukses') : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
            if (res.success) {
                var id = dataRecord ? dataRecord.id : 0;
                dtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                dataRecord = null;
                updateMainButtons();
                mainDs.load({
                    callback: function () {
                        var idx = mainDs.find('id', id);
                        if (idx >= 0) {
                            dataRecord = mainDs.getAt(idx).data;
                            updateMainButtons();
                            loadDetailPanel(dataRecord);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }

    function needAccess(level, msg) {
        if (getFormAccess() < level) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', msg); return false; }
        return true;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 0. Panel Detail (Master-Detail di bawah main grid)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var GridMainHeight = maxGridHeight(gridContainer);
    var DtlHeight = Math.round(GridMainHeight - (GridMainHeight * 0.6) - 30);

    var dtlDiv = document.createElement('div');
    dtlDiv.id = 'prgDtlContainer';
    dtlDiv.className = 'detail-panel-container';
    dtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
    dtlDiv.style.maxHeight = Math.max(DtlHeight, 220) + 'px';
    dtlDiv.style.overflowY = 'auto';
    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(dtlDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling);
    }

    function loadDetailPanel(rec) {
        ajax({ action: 'detail', id: rec.id }, function (res) {
            if (!res.success) {
                dtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow; padding:10px;">' + enc(res.message || 'Gagal memuat detail.') + '</div>';
                dtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            renderDetailPanel(rec, res.data || []);
        });
    }

    function renderDetailPanel(h, items) {
        var actions = [];
        if (h.status === 'DRAFT') {
            actions = [['submit', 'Submit ke HO', '#03615e']];
        } else if (h.status === 'SUBMITTED') {
            actions = [['verify', 'Verifikasi & Approve (HO)', '#03615e'], ['reject', 'Tolak / Reject (HO)', '#8e2b22']];
        }

        var actHtml = '';
        if (actions.length) {
            actHtml = '<div style="float:right; margin:2px 4px 0 0;">';
            Ext.each(actions, function (a) {
                actHtml += '<button type="button" class="rtActionBtn" data-act="' + a[0] + '" style="margin-left:8px; padding:8px 16px; background:' + a[2] +
                           '; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold;">' + enc(a[1]) + '</button>';
            });
            actHtml += '</div>';
        }

        var html = actHtml + '<h3 class="detail-title">Detail Laporan Progress: Proyek ' + enc(h.project_name) +
                   ' <span style="color:' + statusColor(h.status) + ';">(' + enc(h.status) + ')</span></h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<div style="padding:4px 2px 10px 2px;">Tgl Cut-Off: <b>' + enc(h.period_date) + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Cumulative Progress: <b style="color:#2bc1e2;">' + fmtPct(h.progress_pct) +
                   '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Kenaikan (Delta): <b style="color:#00ff4c;">+' + fmtPct(h.progress_delta) +
                   '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Pelapor: <b>' + enc(h.reported_by_name || '-') +
                   '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Dokumen BA: ' + evidenceLink(h.ba_document_url) +
                   (h.verified_by_name ? ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Verifikator HO: <b>' + enc(h.verified_by_name) + '</b> (' + enc(h.verified_at || '-') + ')' : '') +
                   (h.rejection_note ? ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; <span style="color:#f87171;">Catatan Penolakan: ' + enc(h.rejection_note) + '</span>' : '') + '</div>' +
                   '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +
                   '<thead><tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Kode Pekerjaan</th><th align="left">Nama Item Pekerjaan (RAB)</th><th align="right">Qty RAB (Plan)</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Qty Terpasang (Aktual)</th><th align="right">% Terpasang</th><th align="left">Keterangan Field</th>' +
                   '</tr></thead><tbody>';

        if (!items.length) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:15px; text-align:center; color:#557982;">Belum ada item rincian pekerjaan.</td></tr>';
        }

        Ext.each(items, function (i) {
            html += '<tr class="data-row">' +
                    '<td align="left"><span style="color:#668894;">' + enc(i.item_code || '-') + '</span></td>' +
                    '<td align="left"><b>' + enc(i.item_name) + '</b></td>' +
                    '<td align="right">' + fmtQty(i.qty_plan) + ' ' + enc(i.unit || '') + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right" style="color:#2bc1e2;"><b>' + fmtQty(i.qty_installed) + ' ' + enc(i.unit || '') + '</b></td>' +
                    '<td align="right" class="subtotal-val"><b>' + fmtPct(i.installed_pct) + '</b></td>' +
                    '<td align="left">' + enc(i.notes || '-') + '</td></tr>';
        });
        html += '</tbody></table>';

        dtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        dtlDiv.style.display = 'block';

        var btns = dtlDiv.querySelectorAll('.rtActionBtn');
        for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) {
            btns[i].onclick = function () {
                var act = this.getAttribute('data-act');
                runAction(h, act);
            };
        }
    }

    function runAction(rec, act) {
        if (act === 'submit') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_ADD, 'Akses ditolak.')) return;
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Submit Progress', 'Kirim laporan progress ke HO untuk diverifikasi?', function (b) {
                if (b === 'yes') doAction({ action: 'submit', id: rec.id });
            });
        } else if (act === 'verify') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Hanya Auditor HO / Manajemen yang berhak memverifikasi.')) return;
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Verifikasi HO', 'Setujui laporan progress ini? Progress resmi proyek akan diperbarui.', function (b) {
                if (b === 'yes') doAction({ action: 'verify', id: rec.id });
            });
        } else if (act === 'reject') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Hanya Auditor HO / Manajemen yang berhak menolak.')) return;
            Ext.Msg.prompt('Tolak Laporan Progress', 'Masukkan alasan penolakan untuk dikoreksi site engineer:', function (btn, text) {
                if (btn === 'ok') {
                    if (!text || !text.trim()) { showErr('Alasan penolakan wajib diisi.'); return; }
                    doAction({ action: 'reject', id: rec.id, rejection_note: text.trim() });
                }
            }, true);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Stores
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    mainDs = new Ext.data.JsonStore({
        url: CRD, baseParams: { action: 'list', start: 0, limit: 250 },
        root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount', idProperty: 'id',
        fields: ['id', 'project_id', 'project_name', 'period_date', 'progress_pct', 'progress_delta',
                 'ba_document_url', 'status', 'rejection_note', 'reported_by_name', 'verified_by_name', 'verified_at',
                 { name: 'line_count', type: 'int' }],
        listeners: { exception: storeError }
    });
    mainDs.load();

    var projectDs = new Ext.data.JsonStore({
        url: CRD, baseParams: { action: 'lookup_projects' }, root: 'data', idProperty: 'id',
        fields: ['id', 'project_name', 'budget', 'current_progress', 'spent_amount'],
        listeners: { exception: storeError }
    });

    var itemField = ['budget_item_id', 'item_code', 'item_name', 'unit',
                     { name: 'qty_plan', type: 'float' }, { name: 'qty_installed', type: 'float' },
                     { name: 'installed_pct', type: 'float' }, 'notes'];
    var itemDs = new Ext.data.Store({ reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data' }, itemField) });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Main Grid (Daftar Laporan Progress Proyek)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var mainHeight = Math.round(GridMainHeight * 0.6);
    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: mainHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Proyek', dataIndex: 'project_name', width: 200, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Tgl Cut-Off', dataIndex: 'period_date', width: 90, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Cum. Progress (%)', dataIndex: 'progress_pct', width: 110, align: 'right',
              renderer: function (v) { return '<b style="color:#2bc1e2;">' + fmtPct(v) + '</b>'; } },
            { header: 'Delta (+%)', dataIndex: 'progress_delta', width: 90, align: 'right',
              renderer: function (v) { return '<span style="color:#00ff4c;">+' + fmtPct(v) + '</span>'; } },
            { header: 'Pelapor', dataIndex: 'reported_by_name', width: 120 },
            { header: 'Bukti BA / Photo', dataIndex: 'ba_document_url', width: 120, renderer: evidenceLink },
            { header: 'Verifikator HO', dataIndex: 'verified_by_name', width: 120, renderer: function (v) { return v || '-'; } },
            { header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 95, align: 'center',
              renderer: function (v) { return '<span style="color:' + statusColor(v) + ';font-weight:bold;">' + enc(v || '-') + '</span>'; } }
        ],
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        loadMask: true,
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (!rec) return;
                dataRecord = rec.data;
                updateMainButtons();
                loadDetailPanel(dataRecord);
            }
        }
    });

    function updateMainButtons() {
        mainBtnEnable('#addData');
        if (dataRecord && (dataRecord.status === 'DRAFT' || dataRecord.status === 'REJECTED')) {
            mainBtnEnable('#editData');
            mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
        } else {
            mainBtnDisable('#editData');
            mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
        }
    }
    editDataDisable();
    updateMainButtons();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Editor Window & Grid Rincian Progress per RAB Item
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var itemGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: itemDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true, scrollOffset: 0 },
        height: 280,
        enableHdMenu: false,
        enableColumnMove: false,
        columns: [
            { sortable: false, menuDisabled: true, header: 'Kode', dataIndex: 'item_code', width: 70 },
            { sortable: false, menuDisabled: true, header: 'Item RAB Pekerjaan', dataIndex: 'item_name', width: 180 },
            { sortable: false, menuDisabled: true, header: 'Sat', dataIndex: 'unit', width: 45, align: 'center' },
            { sortable: false, menuDisabled: true, header: 'Qty RAB', dataIndex: 'qty_plan', width: 85, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return fmtQty(v); } },
            { sortable: false, menuDisabled: true, header: 'Qty Terpasang (Aktual)', dataIndex: 'qty_installed', width: 120, align: 'right',
              editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }),
              renderer: function (v) { return '<b>' + fmtQty(v) + '</b>'; } },
            { sortable: false, menuDisabled: true, header: '% Terpasang', dataIndex: 'installed_pct', width: 85, align: 'right',
              renderer: function (v) { return '<b style="color:#2bc1e2;">' + fmtPct(v) + '</b>'; } },
            { sortable: false, menuDisabled: true, header: 'Keterangan Field', dataIndex: 'notes', width: 160, editor: new myTextField(), renderer: function (v) { return enc(v); } }
        ],
        listeners: {
            validateedit: function (e) {
                if (e.field === 'qty_installed') {
                    var val = parseFloat(e.value) || 0;
                    var plan = parseFloat(e.record.get('qty_plan')) || 0;
                    if (val < 0) { showErr('Qty terpasang tidak boleh negatif.'); e.cancel = true; return; }
                    var pct = plan > 0 ? (val / plan) * 100 : 0;
                    e.record.set('installed_pct', pct);
                }
            }
        }
    });
    itemGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    (function injectExtraUI() {
        var g = document.getElementById('editorFormGrid');
        if (g && !document.getElementById('prgHdrForm')) {
            var hdr = document.createElement('div');
            hdr.id = 'prgHdrForm';
            hdr.style.cssText = 'margin-bottom:6px;';
            g.parentNode.insertBefore(hdr, g);
        }
    })();

    function openBaUploadWin() {
        var fUrl = new Ext.form.TextField({ fieldLabel: 'Link / URL', anchor: '98%', emptyText: 'http://... atau upload file PDF/Foto' });
        var fileInput = document.createElement('input');
        fileInput.type = 'file';
        fileInput.accept = 'image/*,.pdf';
        fileInput.style.display = 'none';
        document.body.appendChild(fileInput);

        fileInput.onchange = function () {
            var f = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
            if (!f) return;
            if (f.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) { showErr('Ukuran file maksimal 5 MB.'); return; }
            var fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('action', 'upload_ba');
            fd.append('file', f);
            var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
            xhr.open('POST', CRD);
            xhr.onload = function () {
                var o = Ext.decode(xhr.responseText);
                if (o.success) {
                    fBaDoc.setValue(o.url);
                    win.close();
                } else { showErr(o.message || 'Upload gagal.'); }
            };
            xhr.send(fd);
        };

        var win = new Ext.Window({
            title: 'Upload Berita Acara / Evidens', width: 450, height: 160, modal: true, layout: 'fit', cls: 'rtDarkWin',
            items: new Ext.form.FormPanel({
                border: false, labelWidth: 80, bodyStyle: 'padding:12px;',
                items: [fUrl, { xtype: 'button', text: 'Pilih File dari Komputer...', handler: function () { fileInput.click(); } }]
            }),
            buttons: [
                { text: 'Gunakan Link', handler: function () { fBaDoc.setValue(fUrl.getValue()); win.close(); } },
                { text: 'Batal', handler: function () { win.close(); } }
            ]
        });
        win.show();
    }

    function ensureHdrForm() {
        if (hdrForm) { hdrForm.doLayout(); return; }

        fProject = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Proyek', store: projectDs, displayField: 'project_name', valueField: 'id',
            mode: 'remote', queryParam: 'query', minChars: 0, triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false,
            anchor: '98%', emptyText: 'Pilih Proyek...',
            listeners: { select: function (combo, rec) { onProjectSelected(rec); } }
        });
        fPeriodDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tgl Cut-Off', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), allowBlank: false, width: 120 });
        fBaDoc = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Dokumen BA / Photo', anchor: '85%', readOnly: true });
        fProjInfo = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ fieldLabel: 'Info Proyek', value: '-', anchor: '95%' });

        var col = function (w, items) {
            return { columnWidth: w, layout: 'form', border: false, labelWidth: 110, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;', items: items };
        };

        hdrForm = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
            renderTo: 'prgHdrForm',
            border: false,
            layout: 'column',
            bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:4px 2px 0 2px;',
            items: [
                col(0.5, [fProject, fPeriodDate]),
                col(0.5, [
                    {
                        layout: 'column', border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;',
                        items: [
                            { columnWidth: 0.8, layout: 'form', border: false, labelWidth: 110, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;', items: [fBaDoc] },
                            { columnWidth: 0.2, layout: 'form', border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;', items: [
                                { xtype: 'button', text: 'Upload...', handler: openBaUploadWin }
                            ]}
                        ]
                    },
                    fProjInfo
                ])
            ]
        });
    }

    function onProjectSelected(rec) {
        if (!rec) { fProjInfo.setValue('-'); itemDs.removeAll(); return; }
        fProjInfo.setValue('Progress Saat Ini: <b style="color:#2bc1e2;">' + fmtPct(rec.get('current_progress')) + '</b> | Budget: <b>Rp ' + fmtQty(rec.get('budget')) + '</b>');
        loadProjectRabItems(rec.get('id'));
    }

    function loadProjectRabItems(projectId, cb) {
        ajax({ action: 'rab_items', project_id: projectId, progress_id: editId }, function (res) {
            if (!res.success) { itemDs.removeAll(); showErr(res.message || 'Gagal memuat item RAB.'); return; }
            itemDs.loadData(res);
            if (cb) cb();
        });
    }

    function showEditor(title) {
        var addWdw = document.getElementById('addWdw');
        if (addWdw) addWdw.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;' + enc(title);
        ensureHdrForm();
        itemGrid.doLayout();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Action Handlers (Add, Edit, Save, Delete)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (!needAccess(ACCESS_ADD, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses membuat laporan progress.')) return;
        editId = 0;
        showEditor('Input Laporan Progress Proyek Baru');
        fProject.enable();
        fProject.clearValue();
        fProjInfo.setValue('-');
        fPeriodDate.setValue(new Date());
        fBaDoc.setValue('');
        itemDs.removeAll();
        projectDs.load();
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) { showErr('Pilih data laporan dari tabel.'); return; }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'DRAFT' && dataRecord.status !== 'REJECTED') {
            showErr('Hanya laporan berstatus DRAFT atau REJECTED yang dapat diedit.'); return;
        }
        if (!needAccess(ACCESS_ADD, 'Akses ditolak.')) return;

        var rec = dataRecord;
        editId = rec.id;
        showEditor('Edit Laporan Progress Proyek');
        projectDs.load({
            params: { query: rec.project_name || '' },
            callback: function () {
                fProject.setValue(rec.project_id);
                fProject.disable();
                fPeriodDate.setValue(parseYmd(rec.period_date) || new Date());
                fBaDoc.setValue(rec.ba_document_url || '');
                loadProjectRabItems(rec.project_id);
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        if (!fProject.getValue() || !fPeriodDate.getValue()) {
            showErr('Proyek dan Tanggal Cut-Off wajib diisi.'); return;
        }
        var arr = [];
        itemDs.each(function (r) {
            var q = parseFloat(r.get('qty_installed')) || 0;
            if (q >= 0) {
                arr.push({
                    budget_item_id: r.get('budget_item_id'),
                    qty_installed: q,
                    installed_pct: parseFloat(r.get('installed_pct')) || 0,
                    notes: r.get('notes') || ''
                });
            }
        });

        ajax({
            action: 'save',
            id: editId,
            project_id: fProject.getValue(),
            period_date: ymd(fPeriodDate.getValue()),
            ba_document_url: fBaDoc.getValue(),
            details: Ext.util.JSON.encode(arr)
        }, function (res) {
            if (res.success) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message || 'Laporan progress tersimpan.');
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                dataRecord = null;
                dtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                mainDs.load();
                updateMainButtons();
            } else {
                showErr(res.message || 'Gagal menyimpan.');
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord || (dataRecord.status !== 'DRAFT' && dataRecord.status !== 'REJECTED')) {
            showErr('Pilih laporan berstatus DRAFT / REJECTED.'); return;
        }
        Ext.Msg.confirm('Hapus Laporan', 'Hapus draft laporan progress ini?', function (b) {
            if (b === 'yes') doAction({ action: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id });
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
    var addWdwInit = document.getElementById('addWdw');
    if (addWdwInit) addWdwInit.style.display = 'none';
});

==================== FILE: ./pdf/journal.php ====================
<?php
/*
  Document      : pdf/journal.php   [PRINT][NEW]
  Description   : Cetak Journal Entry (header + baris debit/kredit).
  Parameter     : id         = cetak satu jurnal
                  period_id  = cetak semua jurnal satu periode
                  (tanpa parameter = semua jurnal, urut tanggal)
*/
require_once __DIR__ . '/print.common.php';
$db = pr_boot();

$id = intval($_GET['id'] ?? 0);
$periodId = intval($_GET['period_id'] ?? 0);
$where = []; $params = [];
$sub = 'Semua jurnal';
if ($id > 0) { $where[] = 'je.id = :id'; $params['id'] = $id; $sub = 'Satu jurnal'; }
if ($periodId > 0) {
    $p = pr_period($db, $periodId);
    $where[] = 'je.period_id = :pid'; $params['pid'] = $periodId;
    $sub = 'Periode ' . $p['period_name'] . ' (' . pr_date($p['start_date']) . ' s/d ' . pr_date($p['end_date']) . ')';
}

$st = $db->prepare("
    SELECT je.id, je.ref_no, je.journal_date, je.description, je.status::text AS status,
           je.reference_type::text AS reference_type, ap.period_name
      FROM journal_entries je
      LEFT JOIN accounting_periods ap ON ap.id = je.period_id
     " . (count($where) ? 'WHERE ' . implode(' AND ', $where) : '') . "
     ORDER BY je.journal_date ASC, je.id ASC");
$st->execute($params);
$heads = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

$stL = $db->prepare("
    SELECT c.account_code, c.account_name, jl.debit, jl.credit, jl.description
      FROM journal_lines jl
      JOIN chart_of_accounts c ON c.id = jl.account_id
     WHERE jl.journal_id = :jid
     ORDER BY jl.id ASC");

pr_open('Journal Entry', 'JOURNAL ENTRY', [pr_e($sub)]);
$gD = 0.0; $gK = 0.0;
foreach ($heads as $h) {
    $stL->execute(['jid' => $h['id']]);
    $lines = $stL->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    $sd = 0.0; $sk = 0.0;
    echo '<div class="jv"><div class="jvh"><span>' . pr_e($h['ref_no']) . ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; ' . pr_e(pr_date($h['journal_date'])) .
         ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; ' . pr_e($h['period_name'] ?: '-') . '</span><span>' . pr_e(strtoupper($h['status'])) . ' &middot; ' . pr_e($h['reference_type']) . '</span></div>' .
         '<div style="padding:3px 6px;">' . pr_e($h['description']) . '</div>' .
         '<table class="rpt"><tr><th>Kode</th><th>Nama Akun</th><th>Keterangan</th><th class="r">Debit</th><th class="r">Kredit</th></tr>';
    $i = 0;
    foreach ($lines as $l) {
        $d = floatval($l['debit']); $k = floatval($l['credit']); $sd += $d; $sk += $k;
        echo '<tr' . ($i++ % 2 ? ' class="z"' : '') . '><td>' . pr_e($l['account_code']) . '</td><td>' . pr_e($l['account_name']) . '</td><td>' . pr_e($l['description']) .
             '</td><td class="r">' . ($d > 0.004 ? pr_n($d) : '') . '</td><td class="r">' . ($k > 0.004 ? pr_n($k) : '') . '</td></tr>';
    }
    echo '<tr class="tot"><td colspan="3">TOTAL</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($sd) . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($sk) . '</td></tr></table></div>';
    $gD += $sd; $gK += $sk;
}
if (!count($heads)) { echo '<p class="muted">Tidak ada jurnal.</p>'; }
else { echo '<div class="grand"><span>TOTAL ' . count($heads) . ' JURNAL (Debit / Kredit)</span><span>' . pr_n($gD) . ' / ' . pr_n($gK) . '</span></div>'; }
pr_close();
==================== FILE: ./pdf/generalledger.php ====================
<?php
/*
  Document      : pdf/generalledger.php   [PRINT][NEW]
  Description   : Cetak General Ledger (buku besar) per akun, dengan saldo berjalan.
                  Rumus = php-crud/generalledgerCRD.php (jurnal posted/reversed; akun asset/bank/cash/expense debit-normal;
                  saldo awal per akun bila periode difilter).
  Parameter     : account_id = 0/kosong -> semua akun (dikelompokkan per akun)
                  period_id  = 0/kosong -> semua histori (saldo awal 0)
  Catatan       : Sama seperti layar GL, akun yang hanya punya saldo awal tanpa mutasi dalam periode tidak ditampilkan.
*/
require_once __DIR__ . '/print.common.php';
$db = pr_boot();

$accountId = intval($_GET['account_id'] ?? 0);
$periodId  = intval($_GET['period_id'] ?? 0);

$startDate = null; $endDate = null; $periodLabel = 'Semua Periode';
if ($periodId > 0) {
    $period = pr_period($db, $periodId);
    $startDate = $period['start_date']; $endDate = $period['end_date'];
    $periodLabel = $period['period_name'] . ' (' . pr_date($startDate) . ' s/d ' . pr_date($endDate) . ')';
}
$accountLabel = 'Semua Akun';
if ($accountId > 0) {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT account_code, account_name FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE id = :id");
    $st->execute(['id' => $accountId]);
    $acc = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$acc) { echo 'Akun tidak ditemukan.'; exit; }
    $accountLabel = $acc['account_code'] . ' - ' . $acc['account_name'];
}

// Kondisi dinamis (nama parameter dibedakan: PDO pgsql tidak mengizinkan nama yang sama dipakai dua kali)
$conds = ["j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')"]; $params = [];
if ($accountId > 0) { $conds[] = 'l.account_id = :acc'; $params['acc'] = $accountId; }
if ($startDate !== null) {
    $conds[] = 'j.journal_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date';
    $params['start_date'] = $startDate; $params['end_date'] = $endDate;
}
$where = implode(' AND ', $conds);

$opening = '0';
if ($startDate !== null) {
    $oc = "l2.account_id = l.account_id AND j2.status IN ('posted','reversed') AND j2.journal_date < :ob_start_date";
    if ($accountId > 0) { $oc .= ' AND l2.account_id = :ob_acc'; $params['ob_acc'] = $accountId; }
    $opening = "(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c2.account_type IN ('asset','bank','cash','expense') THEN l2.debit - l2.credit ELSE l2.credit - l2.debit END), 0)
                   FROM journal_lines l2
                   JOIN journal_entries j2 ON j2.id = l2.journal_id
                   JOIN chart_of_accounts c2 ON c2.id = l2.account_id
                  WHERE {$oc})";
    $params['ob_start_date'] = $startDate;
}

$st = $db->prepare("
    SELECT j.journal_date, j.ref_no, l.description AS line_desc, j.description AS header_desc,
           l.debit, l.credit, l.account_id, c.account_code, c.account_name,
           {$opening} AS opening_balance,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.account_type IN ('asset','bank','cash','expense') THEN l.debit - l.credit ELSE l.credit - l.debit END)
             OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY j.journal_date, j.id, l.id
                   ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_in_range
      FROM journal_lines l
      JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
      JOIN chart_of_accounts c ON c.id = l.account_id
     WHERE {$where}
     ORDER BY c.account_code ASC, j.journal_date ASC, j.id ASC, l.id ASC");
$st->execute($params);
$rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

// kelompokkan per akun
$groups = [];
foreach ($rows as $r) { $groups[$r['account_id']][] = $r; }

// [LANDSCAPE] GL punya 6 kolom -> A4 landscape agar kolom Keterangan tidak sempit/terbungkus 3 baris
pr_open('General Ledger', 'GENERAL LEDGER',
    ['Akun: ' . pr_e($accountLabel) . ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Periode: ' . pr_e($periodLabel)],
    '', true, '@page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 12mm; }');

$cols = '<colgroup><col style="width:85px"><col style="width:110px"><col><col style="width:125px"><col style="width:125px"><col style="width:135px"></colgroup>';
$grandD = 0.0; $grandK = 0.0;
foreach ($groups as $accRows) {
    $first = $accRows[0];
    $bal0 = floatval($first['opening_balance']);
    $sd = 0.0; $sk = 0.0; $bal = $bal0;
    echo '<h3>Akun: ' . pr_e($first['account_code'] . ' - ' . $first['account_name']) . '</h3>';
    echo '<table class="rpt fx">' . $cols .
         '<tr><th>Tanggal</th><th>No. Jurnal</th><th>Keterangan</th><th class="r">Debit</th><th class="r">Kredit</th><th class="r">Saldo</th></tr>';
    if ($startDate !== null) {
        echo '<tr><td colspan="5"><i>Saldo awal</i></td><td class="r">' . pr_n($bal0) . '</td></tr>';
    }
    $i = 0;
    foreach ($accRows as $r) {
        $d = floatval($r['debit']); $k = floatval($r['credit']); $sd += $d; $sk += $k;
        $bal = $bal0 + floatval($r['cum_in_range']);
        $desc = $r['line_desc'] ?: $r['header_desc'];
        echo '<tr' . ($i++ % 2 ? ' class="z"' : '') . '><td>' . pr_e(pr_date($r['journal_date'])) . '</td><td>' . pr_e($r['ref_no']) . '</td><td>' . pr_e($desc) .
             '</td><td class="r">' . ($d > 0.004 ? pr_n($d) : '') . '</td><td class="r">' . ($k > 0.004 ? pr_n($k) : '') . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($bal) . '</td></tr>';
    }
    echo '<tr class="tot"><td colspan="3">TOTAL / SALDO AKHIR</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($sd) . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($sk) . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($bal) . '</td></tr></table>';
    $grandD += $sd; $grandK += $sk;
}
if (!count($groups)) { echo '<p class="muted">Tidak ada transaksi.</p>'; }
else { echo '<div class="grand"><span>TOTAL ' . count($rows) . ' BARIS (Debit / Kredit)</span><span>' . pr_n($grandD) . ' / ' . pr_n($grandK) . '</span></div>'; }
pr_close();
==================== FILE: ./pdf/profitloss.php ====================
<?php
/*
  Document      : pdf/profitloss.php   [PRINT][NEW]
  Description   : Cetak Laporan Laba Rugi per periode (jurnal posted/reversed). Kolom ganda: "Periode Ini" (mutasi dalam
                  periode) dan "Tahun Berjalan (YTD)" (1 Januari tahun periode s/d akhir periode). Rumus = php-crud/profitlossCRD.php.
                  Akun yang kedua kolomnya nol disembunyikan.
  [ALIGN]       : Seluruh laporan (pendapatan, beban, laba bersih) dirender dalam SATU tabel dengan satu colgroup,
                  sehingga nilai Laba Bersih pasti tepat di bawah kolom Periode Ini dan Tahun Berjalan (YTD).
  Parameter     : period_id (wajib)
*/
require_once __DIR__ . '/print.common.php';
$db = pr_boot();
$period = pr_period($db, intval($_GET['period_id'] ?? 0));

// [YTD] awal tahun berjalan = 1 Januari tahun akhir periode (bila periode mulai sebelum itu, pakai awal periode)
$ytdStart = date('Y', strtotime($period['end_date'])) . '-01-01';
if ($period['start_date'] < $ytdStart) { $ytdStart = $period['start_date']; }

$st = $db->prepare("
    SELECT c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type,
           COALESCE(SUM(
               CASE WHEN j.id IS NOT NULL AND j.journal_date BETWEEN :s AND :e THEN
                   CASE WHEN c.account_type = 'revenue' THEN l.credit - l.debit
                        WHEN c.account_type = 'expense' THEN l.debit - l.credit
                        ELSE 0 END
               ELSE 0 END
           ), 0) AS amount,
           COALESCE(SUM(
               CASE WHEN j.id IS NOT NULL THEN
                   CASE WHEN c.account_type = 'revenue' THEN l.credit - l.debit
                        WHEN c.account_type = 'expense' THEN l.debit - l.credit
                        ELSE 0 END
               ELSE 0 END
           ), 0) AS amount_cum
      FROM chart_of_accounts c
      LEFT JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
      LEFT JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
           AND j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')
           AND j.journal_date BETWEEN :ys AND :ce
     WHERE c.is_active = true AND c.account_type IN ('revenue', 'expense')
     GROUP BY c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type
     ORDER BY c.account_code ASC");
$st->execute(['s' => $period['start_date'], 'e' => $period['end_date'], 'ys' => $ytdStart, 'ce' => $period['end_date']]);

$rev = []; $exp = []; $tRev = 0.0; $tExp = 0.0; $tRevC = 0.0; $tExpC = 0.0;
foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) {
    $a = floatval($r['amount']); $c = floatval($r['amount_cum']);
    $show = (abs($a) > 0.004 || abs($c) > 0.004);
    if ($r['account_type'] === 'revenue') { $tRev += $a; $tRevC += $c; if ($show) $rev[] = [$r['account_code'], $r['account_name'], $a, $c]; }
    else                                  { $tExp += $a; $tExpC += $c; if ($show) $exp[] = [$r['account_code'], $r['account_name'], $a, $c]; }
}
$net = $tRev - $tExp; $netC = $tRevC - $tExpC;

// Baris-baris satu seksi di dalam tabel tunggal (judul seksi, header kolom, item, total)
function pl_rows($title, $items, $totalLabel, $t, $tc) {
    $h = '<tr><td colspan="4" class="sec">' . pr_e($title) . '</td></tr>' .
         '<tr><th>Kode</th><th>Nama Akun</th><th class="r">Periode Ini</th><th class="r">Tahun Berjalan (YTD)</th></tr>';
    $i = 0;
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $h .= '<tr' . ($i++ % 2 ? ' class="z"' : '') . '><td class="c">' . pr_e($it[0]) . '</td><td>' . pr_e($it[1]) . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($it[2]) . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($it[3]) . '</td></tr>';
    }
    if (!count($items)) { $h .= '<tr><td colspan="4" class="muted">Tidak ada saldo.</td></tr>'; }
    return $h . '<tr class="tot"><td colspan="2">' . pr_e($totalLabel) . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($t) . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($tc) . '</td></tr>';
}

pr_open('Laba Rugi - ' . $period['period_name'], 'LAPORAN LABA RUGI',
    ['Periode: ' . pr_e($period['period_name']) . ' (' . pr_e(pr_date($period['start_date'])) . ' s/d ' . pr_e(pr_date($period['end_date'])) . ')',
     'YTD: ' . pr_e(pr_date($ytdStart)) . ' s/d ' . pr_e(pr_date($period['end_date']))]);
?>
<table class="rpt fx">
    <colgroup><col style="width:70px"><col><col style="width:150px"><col style="width:170px"></colgroup>
<?php
echo pl_rows('PENDAPATAN', $rev, 'TOTAL PENDAPATAN', $tRev, $tRevC);
echo pl_rows('BEBAN / BIAYA', $exp, 'TOTAL BEBAN', $tExp, $tExpC);
?>
    <tr class="net">
        <td colspan="2"><?php echo $net >= 0 ? 'LABA BERSIH' : 'RUGI BERSIH'; ?></td>
        <td class="r"><?php echo pr_n($net); ?></td>
        <td class="r"><?php echo pr_n($netC); ?></td>
    </tr>
</table>
<?php pr_close(); ?>
<!-- profitloss print tpl v3: tabel tunggal -->

<?php

==================== FILE: ./pdf/ppn.report.php ====================
<?php
/*

  Description   : Cetak invoice (tagihan termin) ke client: nomor & tanggal, jatuh tempo, client, proyek, rincian DPP / PPN / total,
                  pembayaran yang sudah diterima, sisa tagihan, dan no. faktur pajak. Memakai helper print.common.php

require_once __DIR__ . '/print.common.php';
$db = pr_boot();

$id = intval($_GET['id'] ?? 0);
$st = $db->prepare("
    SELECT v.id, v.inv_no, v.invoice_date, v.due_date, v.termin_name, v.percentage, v.amount, v.paid_amount,
           v.dpp_amount, v.ppn_rate, v.ppn_amount, v.faktur_pajak_no, v.faktur_pajak_date, v.remark,
           v.release_status, v.release_no, v.release_date, v.release_note,       -- [RELEASE-LAYER] dokumen tagihan
           p.name AS project_name, p.location AS project_location, COALESCE(p.contract_value, 0) AS contract_value,
           cl.name AS client_name, cl.address AS client_address, cl.phone AS client_phone, cl.contact_person AS client_pic
      FROM project_invoices v
      JOIN projects p ON p.id = v.project_id
      LEFT JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = p.client_id
     WHERE v.id = :id");
$st->execute(['id' => $id]);
$inv = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
if (!$inv) { http_response_code(404); echo 'Invoice tidak ditemukan.'; exit; }

$st = $db->prepare("
    SELECT pp.payment_no, pp.payment_date, i.amount_paid
      FROM project_payment_items i JOIN project_payments pp ON pp.id = i.payment_id
     WHERE i.invoice_id = :id ORDER BY pp.payment_date, pp.id");
$st->execute(['id' => $id]);
$pays = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

$amount = floatval($inv['amount']); $paid = floatval($inv['paid_amount']);

$ppn    = floatval($inv['ppn_amount']);
$sisa   = round($amount - $paid, 2);

    'Proyek: ' . pr_e($inv['project_name']) . ($inv['project_location'] ? ' (' . pr_e($inv['project_location']) . ')' : ''),
    // [RELEASE-LAYER] nomor dokumen tagihan yang diserahkan ke client; DRAFT = belum diterbitkan
    (strtoupper((string)$inv['release_status']) === 'RELEASED' && $inv['release_no'])
        ? 'No. Dokumen Tagihan: ' . pr_e($inv['release_no']) . ($inv['release_date'] ? ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Tgl Terbit: ' . pr_e(pr_date($inv['release_date'])) : '')
        : '<span style="color:#b3541e;">STATUS: DRAFT - dokumen tagihan belum diterbitkan ke client</span>',
    // [RELEASE-LAYER] catatan penerbitan (opsional) tampil bila ada
    (strtoupper((string)$inv['release_status']) === 'RELEASED' && !empty($inv['release_note']))
        ? 'Catatan Terbit: ' . pr_e($inv['release_note'])
        : '',

$info = array_values(array_filter($info, function ($x) { return $x !== ''; }));   // buang baris kosong

$extraCss = '';

==================== FILE: ./pdf/balancesheet.php ====================
<?php
/*
  Document      : pdf/balancesheet.php   [PRINT-BS][NEW]
  Description   : Halaman cetak Neraca Keuangan (HTML siap cetak, A4). Dibuka dari tombol Printing di Balance Sheet
                  (balancesheet.js -> ../pdf/balancesheet.php?period_id=ID). Dialog cetak browser hanya muncul saat tombol
                  "Cetak / Simpan PDF" diklik (pilih "Save as PDF" bila ingin file PDF).
  Catatan       : - Rumus sama dengan php-crud/balancesheetCRD.php (saldo kumulatif s/d akhir periode, jurnal posted/reversed;
                    laba berjalan = pendapatan - beban).
                  - Baris akun bersaldo nol disembunyikan agar cetakan ringkas.
                  - Sebelumnya file ini membuka halaman Journal Entry (salah isi); file ini menggantikannya.
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

header('Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8');

if (empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login kembali.';
    exit;
}

$periodId = intval($_GET['period_id'] ?? $_REQUEST['period_id'] ?? 0);
if ($periodId <= 0) { echo 'Periode wajib dipilih.'; exit; }

$db = new crud();

$st = $db->prepare("SELECT period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
$st->execute(['id' => $periodId]);
$period = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
if (!$period) { echo 'Periode tidak ditemukan.'; exit; }
$asOf = $period['end_date'];

// Saldo akun neraca s/d akhir periode (sama dengan balancesheetCRD.php)
$st = $db->prepare("
    SELECT c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type,
           COALESCE(SUM(
               CASE WHEN j.id IS NOT NULL THEN
                   CASE WHEN c.account_type IN ('asset', 'bank', 'cash') THEN l.debit - l.credit
                        WHEN c.account_type IN ('liability', 'equity') THEN l.credit - l.debit
                        ELSE 0 END
               ELSE 0 END
           ), 0) AS balance
      FROM chart_of_accounts c
      LEFT JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
      LEFT JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
           AND j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')
           AND j.journal_date <= :as_of
     WHERE c.is_active = true
       AND c.account_type IN ('asset', 'bank', 'cash', 'liability', 'equity')
     GROUP BY c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type
     ORDER BY c.account_code ASC");
$st->execute(['as_of' => $asOf]);
$rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

// Laba berjalan kumulatif = pendapatan (kredit - debit) - beban (debit - kredit)
$st = $db->prepare("
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
               CASE WHEN j.id IS NOT NULL THEN
                   CASE WHEN c.account_type = 'revenue' THEN l.credit - l.debit
                        WHEN c.account_type = 'expense' THEN l.credit - l.debit
                        ELSE 0 END
               ELSE 0 END
           ), 0) AS net_profit
      FROM chart_of_accounts c
      LEFT JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
      LEFT JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
           AND j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')
           AND j.journal_date <= :as_of
     WHERE c.account_type IN ('revenue', 'expense')");
$st->execute(['as_of' => $asOf]);
$earnings = floatval($st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['net_profit'] ?? 0);

$assets = []; $liabs = []; $equities = [];
$tAsset = 0.0; $tLiab = 0.0; $tEquity = 0.0;
foreach ($rows as $r) {
    $bal = floatval($r['balance']);
    $tipe = $r['account_type'];
    if (in_array($tipe, ['asset', 'bank', 'cash'])) { $tAsset += $bal; if (abs($bal) > 0.004) $assets[] = [$r['account_code'], $r['account_name'], $bal]; }
    elseif ($tipe === 'liability')                  { $tLiab  += $bal; if (abs($bal) > 0.004) $liabs[]  = [$r['account_code'], $r['account_name'], $bal]; }
    elseif ($tipe === 'equity')                     { $tEquity += $bal; if (abs($bal) > 0.004) $equities[] = [$r['account_code'], $r['account_name'], $bal]; }
}
if (abs($earnings) > 0.001) { $equities[] = ['-', 'Laba / (Rugi) Periode Berjalan', $earnings]; $tEquity += $earnings; }
$tLE = $tLiab + $tEquity;
$balanced = abs($tAsset - $tLE) < 0.01;

function e($v) { return htmlspecialchars((string)$v, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); }
function n($v) { return number_format((float)$v, 2, '.', ','); }
function section($title, $items, $totalLabel, $total) {
    $h = '<h3>' . e($title) . '</h3><table class="rpt">';
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $h .= '<tr><td class="c">' . e($it[0]) . '</td><td>' . e($it[1]) . '</td><td class="r">' . n($it[2]) . '</td></tr>';
    }
    if (!count($items)) { $h .= '<tr><td colspan="3" class="muted">Tidak ada saldo.</td></tr>'; }
    $h .= '<tr class="tot"><td colspan="2">' . e($totalLabel) . '</td><td class="r">' . n($total) . '</td></tr></table>';
    return $h;
}

    .status { text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin: 6px 0 14px 0; color: <?php echo $balanced ? '#1b7a3a' : '#b00020'; ?>; }
    h3 { font-size: 14px; margin: 16px 0 6px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding-bottom: 3px; }
    table.rpt { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }

echo section('ASET (AKTIVA)', $assets, 'TOTAL ASET', $tAsset);

==================== FILE: ./pdf/financialreport.php ====================
<?php
/*
  Document      : pdf/financialreport.php   [PRINT][NEW]
  Description   : Cetak Financial Report = Neraca (kumulatif s/d akhir periode) + Laba Rugi (kolom "Periode Ini" dan
                  "Tahun Berjalan (YTD)" = 1 Januari tahun periode s/d akhir periode).
                  Rumus = php-crud/financialreportCRD.php. Akun yang semua kolomnya nol disembunyikan.
  Parameter     : period_id (wajib)
*/
require_once __DIR__ . '/print.common.php';
$db = pr_boot();
$period = pr_period($db, intval($_GET['period_id'] ?? 0));
$s = $period['start_date']; $e = $period['end_date'];

// Neraca
$st = $db->prepare("
    SELECT c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type,
           COALESCE(SUM(
               CASE WHEN j.id IS NOT NULL THEN
                   CASE WHEN c.account_type IN ('asset', 'bank', 'cash') THEN l.debit - l.credit
                        ELSE l.credit - l.debit END
               ELSE 0 END
           ), 0) AS balance
      FROM chart_of_accounts c
      LEFT JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
      LEFT JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
           AND j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed') AND j.journal_date <= :e
     WHERE c.is_active = true AND c.account_type IN ('asset', 'bank', 'cash', 'liability', 'equity')
     GROUP BY c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type
     ORDER BY c.account_code ASC");
$st->execute(['e' => $e]);
$A = []; $L = []; $Q = []; $tA = 0.0; $tL = 0.0; $tQ = 0.0;
foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) {
    $b = floatval($r['balance']);
    if (abs($b) < 0.004) continue;
    $it = [$r['account_code'], $r['account_name'], $b];
    if (in_array($r['account_type'], ['asset', 'bank', 'cash'])) { $A[] = $it; $tA += $b; }
    elseif ($r['account_type'] === 'liability')                  { $L[] = $it; $tL += $b; }
    else                                                         { $Q[] = $it; $tQ += $b; }
}
// Laba/rugi kumulatif s/d akhir periode -> ekuitas
$st = $db->prepare("
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
               CASE WHEN j.id IS NOT NULL THEN
                   CASE WHEN c.account_type = 'revenue' THEN l.credit - l.debit
                        ELSE -(l.debit - l.credit) END
               ELSE 0 END
           ), 0) AS ni
      FROM chart_of_accounts c
      LEFT JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
      LEFT JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
           AND j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed') AND j.journal_date <= :e
     WHERE c.account_type IN ('revenue', 'expense')");
$st->execute(['e' => $e]);
$niCum = floatval($st->fetchColumn());
if (abs($niCum) > 0.004) { $Q[] = ['-', 'Laba (Rugi) Kumulatif s/d Periode Ini', $niCum]; }
$tQ += $niCum;
$balanced = abs($tA - ($tL + $tQ)) < 0.01;

// Laba Rugi periode
$st = $db->prepare("
    SELECT c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type,
           COALESCE(SUM(
               CASE WHEN j.id IS NOT NULL AND j.journal_date BETWEEN :s AND :e THEN
                   CASE WHEN c.account_type = 'revenue' THEN l.credit - l.debit
                        ELSE l.debit - l.credit END
               ELSE 0 END
           ), 0) AS amount,
           COALESCE(SUM(
               CASE WHEN j.id IS NOT NULL THEN
                   CASE WHEN c.account_type = 'revenue' THEN l.credit - l.debit
                        ELSE l.debit - l.credit END
               ELSE 0 END
           ), 0) AS amount_cum
      FROM chart_of_accounts c
      LEFT JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
      LEFT JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
           AND j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed') AND j.journal_date BETWEEN :ys AND :ce
           AND j.reference_type::text <> 'closing_entry'   -- [CLOSING] jurnal penutup tidak ikut dihitung di Laba Rugi
     WHERE c.is_active = true AND c.account_type IN ('revenue', 'expense')
     GROUP BY c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type
     ORDER BY c.account_code ASC");
// [YTD] awal tahun berjalan = 1 Januari tahun akhir periode (bila periode mulai sebelum itu, pakai awal periode)
$ytdStart = date('Y', strtotime($e)) . '-01-01';
if ($s < $ytdStart) { $ytdStart = $s; }
$st->execute(['s' => $s, 'e' => $e, 'ys' => $ytdStart, 'ce' => $e]);
$R = []; $X = []; $tR = 0.0; $tX = 0.0; $tRc = 0.0; $tXc = 0.0;
foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) {
    $a = floatval($r['amount']); $c = floatval($r['amount_cum']);
    $show = (abs($a) > 0.004 || abs($c) > 0.004);
    if ($r['account_type'] === 'revenue') { $tR += $a; $tRc += $c; if ($show) $R[] = [$r['account_code'], $r['account_name'], $a, $c]; }
    else                                  { $tX += $a; $tXc += $c; if ($show) $X[] = [$r['account_code'], $r['account_name'], $a, $c]; }
}
$netP = $tR - $tX; $netC = $tRc - $tXc;

// [YTD] seksi laba rugi dua kolom nilai; lebar kolom tetap (colgroup) agar sejajar di semua seksi & baris laba bersih
define('FR_COLS', '<colgroup><col style="width:70px"><col><col style="width:150px"><col style="width:170px"></colgroup>');
function fr_is_section($title, $items, $totalLabel, $t, $tc) {
    $h = '<h3>' . pr_e($title) . '</h3><table class="rpt fx">' . FR_COLS .
         '<tr><th>Kode</th><th>Nama Akun</th><th class="r">Periode Ini</th><th class="r">Tahun Berjalan (YTD)</th></tr>';
    $i = 0;
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $h .= '<tr' . ($i++ % 2 ? ' class="z"' : '') . '><td class="c">' . pr_e($it[0]) . '</td><td>' . pr_e($it[1]) . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($it[2]) . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($it[3]) . '</td></tr>';
    }
    if (!count($items)) { $h .= '<tr><td colspan="4" class="muted">Tidak ada saldo.</td></tr>'; }
    return $h . '<tr class="tot"><td colspan="2">' . pr_e($totalLabel) . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($t) . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($tc) . '</td></tr></table>';
}

pr_open('Financial Report - ' . $period['period_name'], 'FINANCIAL REPORT',
    ['Periode: ' . pr_e($period['period_name']) . ' (' . pr_e(pr_date($s)) . ' s/d ' . pr_e(pr_date($e)) . ')'],
    '[ NERACA: ' . ($balanced ? 'BALANCE' : 'TIDAK BALANCE (selisih ' . pr_n($tA - $tL - $tQ) . ')') . ' ]', $balanced);
?>
<h2 style="font-size:15px; margin:10px 0 0 0;">NERACA (per <?php echo pr_e(pr_date($e)); ?>)</h2>
<?php
echo pr_section('ASET', $A, 'TOTAL ASET', $tA);
echo pr_section('LIABILITAS', $L, 'TOTAL LIABILITAS', $tL);
echo pr_section('EKUITAS', $Q, 'TOTAL EKUITAS', $tQ);
?>
<div class="grand"><span>TOTAL LIABILITAS &amp; EKUITAS</span><span><?php echo pr_n($tL + $tQ); ?></span></div>

<h2 style="font-size:15px; margin:22px 0 0 0;">LAPORAN LABA RUGI (<?php echo pr_e(pr_date($s)); ?> s/d <?php echo pr_e(pr_date($e)); ?> | YTD: <?php echo pr_e(pr_date($ytdStart)); ?> s/d <?php echo pr_e(pr_date($e)); ?>)</h2>
<?php
echo fr_is_section('PENDAPATAN', $R, 'TOTAL PENDAPATAN', $tR, $tRc);
echo fr_is_section('BEBAN / BIAYA', $X, 'TOTAL BEBAN', $tX, $tXc);
?>
<!-- [YTD] Laba bersih sebagai tabel dengan kolom sama (Periode Ini | YTD) -->
<table class="rpt fx" style="margin-top:14px; border-top:2px solid #000; border-bottom:2px solid #000;">
    <?php echo FR_COLS; ?>
    <tr style="font-size:14px; font-weight:bold;">
        <td colspan="2"><?php echo $netP >= 0 ? 'LABA BERSIH' : 'RUGI BERSIH'; ?></td>
        <td class="r"><?php echo pr_n($netP); ?></td>
        <td class="r"><?php echo pr_n($netC); ?></td>
    </tr>
</table>
<?php pr_close(); ?>
==================== FILE: ./pdf/trialbalance.php ====================
<?php
/*
  Document      : pdf/trialbalance.php   [PRINT][NEW]
  Description   : Cetak Trial Balance per periode (saldo kumulatif s/d akhir periode, jurnal posted/reversed).
                  Rumus = php-crud/trialbalanceCRD.php (akun bank & cash debit-normal).
  Parameter     : period_id (wajib), hide_zero=0 untuk menampilkan akun bersaldo nol (default disembunyikan)
*/
require_once __DIR__ . '/print.common.php';
$db = pr_boot();
$period = pr_period($db, intval($_GET['period_id'] ?? 0));
$asOf = $period['end_date'];
$hideZero = (($_GET['hide_zero'] ?? '1') !== '0');

$st = $db->prepare("
    SELECT c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type,
           COALESCE(SUM(
               CASE WHEN c.account_type IN ('asset','bank','cash','expense') THEN l.debit - l.credit
                    ELSE l.credit - l.debit END
           ), 0) AS balance
      FROM chart_of_accounts c
      LEFT JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
      LEFT JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
           AND j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')
           AND j.journal_date <= :as_of
     WHERE c.is_active = true
     GROUP BY c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type
     ORDER BY c.account_code ASC");
$st->execute(['as_of' => $asOf]);
$rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

$data = []; $tD = 0.0; $tK = 0.0;
foreach ($rows as $r) {
    $debitNormal = in_array($r['account_type'], ['asset', 'bank', 'cash', 'expense']);
    $b = floatval($r['balance']);
    $d = 0.0; $k = 0.0;
    if ($debitNormal) { if ($b >= 0) $d = $b; else $k = abs($b); }
    else              { if ($b >= 0) $k = $b; else $d = abs($b); }
    $tD += $d; $tK += $k;
    if ($hideZero && abs($d) < 0.004 && abs($k) < 0.004) continue;
    $data[] = [$r['account_code'], $r['account_name'], ucfirst($r['account_type']), $d, $k];
}
$ok = abs($tD - $tK) < 0.01;

pr_open('Trial Balance - ' . $period['period_name'], 'TRIAL BALANCE',
    ['Per Tanggal: ' . pr_e(pr_date($asOf)) . ' (' . pr_e($period['period_name']) . ')'],
    '[ STATUS: ' . ($ok ? 'BALANCE' : 'TIDAK BALANCE (selisih ' . pr_n($tD - $tK) . ')') . ' ]', $ok);
?>
<table class="rpt">
    <tr><th>Kode</th><th>Nama Akun</th><th>Tipe</th><th class="r">Debit</th><th class="r">Kredit</th></tr>
<?php
$i = 0;
foreach ($data as $r) {
    echo '<tr' . ($i++ % 2 ? ' class="z"' : '') . '><td>' . pr_e($r[0]) . '</td><td>' . pr_e($r[1]) . '</td><td>' . pr_e($r[2]) . '</td>' .
         '<td class="r">' . ($r[3] > 0.004 ? pr_n($r[3]) : '') . '</td><td class="r">' . ($r[4] > 0.004 ? pr_n($r[4]) : '') . '</td></tr>';
}
if (!count($data)) { echo '<tr><td colspan="5" class="muted">Tidak ada saldo.</td></tr>'; }
?>
    <tr class="tot"><td colspan="3">TOTAL</td><td class="r"><?php echo pr_n($tD); ?></td><td class="r"><?php echo pr_n($tK); ?></td></tr>
</table>
<?php pr_close(); ?>
==================== FILE: ./pdf/inventory.recon.php ====================
<?php
/*
  Document      : pdf/inventoryrecon.php   [PRINT][NEW]
  Description   : Cetak Rekonsiliasi Persediaan: ringkasan (buku vs stok), dokumen bermasalah, per item, per gudang.
                  Logika = php-func/function.inventory.recon.php (sama dengan layar).
  Parameter     : as_of (YYYY-MM-DD, default hari ini), account_id (default = akun persediaan rule ISSUE_PROJECT)
*/
require_once __DIR__ . '/print.common.php';
$db = pr_boot();
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.inventory.recon.php';

$asOf = (string)($_GET['as_of'] ?? date('Y-m-d'));
$accId = intval($_GET['account_id'] ?? 0);
try {
    $r = ir_reconcile($db, $asOf, $accId);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo pr_e($e->getMessage());
    exit;
}
$s = $r['summary'];
$ok = ($s['status'] === 'SESUAI');

pr_open('Rekonsiliasi Persediaan - ' . $asOf, 'REKONSILIASI PERSEDIAAN',
    ['Per Tanggal: ' . pr_e(pr_date($asOf)) . ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Akun: ' . pr_e($s['account_label'])],
    '[ STATUS: ' . ($ok ? 'SESUAI' : 'SELISIH ' . pr_n($s['diff'])) . ' ]', $ok);
?>
<table class="rpt fx">
    <colgroup><col><col style="width:170px"></colgroup>
    <tr><td>Nilai Buku (saldo akun persediaan)</td><td class="r"><?php echo pr_n($s['book_balance']); ?></td></tr>
    <tr class="z"><td>Nilai Stok (stock_movements, IN - OUT)</td><td class="r"><?php echo pr_n($s['stock_value']); ?></td></tr>
    <tr class="tot"><td>Selisih (Buku - Stok)</td><td class="r"><?php echo pr_n($s['diff']); ?></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Dijelaskan oleh dokumen bermasalah</td><td class="r"><?php echo pr_n($s['explained']); ?></td></tr>
    <tr class="z"><td>Tidak terjelaskan (jurnal manual / penyesuaian langsung)</td><td class="r"><?php echo pr_n($s['unexplained']); ?></td></tr>
</table>

<?php
// dokumen bermasalah
$prob = array_values(array_filter($r['docs'], function ($d) { return $d['status'] === 'TIDAK ADA JURNAL' || $d['status'] === 'NILAI BEDA'; }));
echo '<h3>DOKUMEN BERMASALAH (' . count($prob) . ' dari ' . $s['docs_total'] . ' dokumen)</h3>';
echo '<table class="rpt fx"><colgroup><col style="width:80px"><col style="width:120px"><col><col style="width:130px"><col style="width:130px"><col style="width:130px"></colgroup>' .
     '<tr><th>Tanggal</th><th>Jenis</th><th>No. Dokumen</th><th class="r">Nilai Stok</th><th class="r">Nilai Jurnal</th><th>Status</th></tr>';
$i = 0;
foreach ($prob as $d) {
    echo '<tr' . ($i++ % 2 ? ' class="z"' : '') . '><td>' . pr_e(pr_date($d['doc_date'])) . '</td><td>' . pr_e($d['reference_type']) . '</td><td>' . pr_e($d['reference_no']) .
         '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($d['value']) . '</td><td class="r">' . ($d['journal_amount'] === null ? '-' : pr_n($d['journal_amount'])) . '</td><td>' . pr_e($d['status']) . '</td></tr>';
}
if (!count($prob)) echo '<tr><td colspan="6" class="muted">Tidak ada dokumen bermasalah.</td></tr>';
echo '</table>';

// per item
echo '<h3>NILAI STOK PER ITEM</h3>';
echo '<table class="rpt fx"><colgroup><col style="width:90px"><col><col style="width:60px"><col style="width:110px"><col style="width:110px"><col style="width:130px"></colgroup>' .
     '<tr><th>Kode</th><th>Material</th><th>Sat</th><th class="r">Qty</th><th class="r">Biaya Rata-rata</th><th class="r">Nilai</th></tr>';
$i = 0; $tot = 0.0;
foreach ($r['items'] as $it) {
    $tot += $it['value'];
    echo '<tr' . ($i++ % 2 ? ' class="z"' : '') . '><td>' . pr_e($it['material_code']) . '</td><td>' . pr_e($it['material_name']) . '</td><td>' . pr_e($it['unit']) .
         '</td><td class="r">' . number_format($it['qty'], 4, '.', ',') . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($it['avg_cost']) . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($it['value']) . '</td></tr>';
}
if (!count($r['items'])) echo '<tr><td colspan="6" class="muted">Tidak ada saldo stok.</td></tr>';
echo '<tr class="tot"><td colspan="5">TOTAL</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($tot) . '</td></tr></table>';

// per gudang
echo '<h3>NILAI STOK PER GUDANG</h3>';
echo '<table class="rpt fx"><colgroup><col><col style="width:150px"><col style="width:150px"></colgroup>' .
     '<tr><th>Gudang</th><th class="r">Item Bersaldo</th><th class="r">Nilai</th></tr>';
$i = 0;
foreach ($r['warehouses'] as $w) {
    echo '<tr' . ($i++ % 2 ? ' class="z"' : '') . '><td>' . pr_e($w['warehouse_name']) . '</td><td class="r">' . (int)$w['item_count'] . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($w['value']) . '</td></tr>';
}
echo '</table>';
pr_close();
==================== FILE: ./pdf/print.common.php ====================
<?php
/*
  Document      : pdf/print.common.php   [PRINT][NEW]
  Description   : Helper bersama halaman cetak laporan keuangan (trialbalance.php, profitloss.php,
                  financialreport.php, journal.php): boot sesi + koneksi, periode, kerangka HTML A4, format angka.
                  Halaman cetak = HTML siap cetak; dialog cetak browser baru muncul saat tombol "Cetak / Simpan PDF" diklik.
*/

function pr_e($v) { return htmlspecialchars((string)$v, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); }
function pr_n($v) { return number_format((float)$v, 2, '.', ','); }

// Sesi + koneksi PDO. Mengembalikan objek crud.
function pr_boot() {
    if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }
    require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
    require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';
    header('Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8');
    // [NOCACHE] halaman cetak jangan di-cache browser/proxy (ngrok) agar selalu memakai versi file terbaru di server
    header('Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0');
    header('Pragma: no-cache');
    if (empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
        http_response_code(401);
        echo 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login kembali.';
        exit;
    }
    return new crud();
}

// Ambil periode akuntansi; keluar dengan pesan bila tidak valid.
function pr_period($db, $periodId) {
    if ($periodId <= 0) { echo 'Periode wajib dipilih.'; exit; }
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
    $st->execute(['id' => $periodId]);
    $p = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$p) { echo 'Periode tidak ditemukan.'; exit; }
    return $p;
}

function pr_date($d) { return $d ? date('d/m/Y', strtotime($d)) : '-'; }

// Buka halaman: $lines = baris sub-judul, $status = teks status (opsional), $ok = warna status
// $extraCss (opsional) = CSS tambahan khusus halaman, mis. '@page { size: A4 landscape; }' untuk laporan lebar seperti General Ledger
function pr_open($docTitle, $heading, $lines = [], $status = '', $ok = true, $extraCss = '') {
    ?>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title><?php echo pr_e($docTitle); ?></title>
<style>
    @page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 15mm; }
    body { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000; background: #fff; font-size: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 16px; }
    h1 { text-align: center; font-size: 18px; margin: 0 0 4px 0; }
    .sub { text-align: center; color: #333; margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .status { text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin: 6px 0 14px 0; }
    h3 { font-size: 14px; margin: 16px 0 6px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding-bottom: 3px; }
    table.rpt { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
    table.rpt th { text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid #000; padding: 4px 6px; }
    table.rpt td { padding: 4px 6px; }
    table.rpt tr.z td { background: #f1f1f1; }                         /* zebra, tetap terlihat saat cetak */
    table.rpt tr.tot td { font-weight: bold; border-top: 1px solid #000; background: #fff; }
    td.c { width: 70px; } td.r, th.r { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
    table.rpt th.r { text-align: right; }                               /* [ALIGN] 'table.rpt th' (rata kiri) lebih spesifik dari 'th.r' -> header kolom angka ikut rata kanan */
    table.fx { table-layout: fixed; }
    table.rpt td.sec { font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding: 16px 6px 3px 6px; background: #fff; }   /* [ALIGN] judul seksi sebagai baris tabel tunggal */
    table.rpt tr.net td { font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; border-top: 2px solid #000; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding: 8px 6px; background: #fff; }                                   /* [ALIGN] lebar kolom tetap agar baris total/laba bersih sejajar dengan kolom di atasnya */
    .muted { color: #777; font-style: italic; }
    .grand { margin-top: 14px; padding: 8px 6px; border-top: 2px solid #000; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
    .jv { margin-top: 14px; page-break-inside: avoid; }
    .jvh { font-weight: bold; background: #e4e4e4; padding: 4px 6px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
    .foot { margin-top: 16px; font-size: 10px; color: #555; }
    .noprint { margin-bottom: 12px; text-align: right; }
    .noprint button { padding: 6px 14px; cursor: pointer; }
    * { -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
    @media print { .noprint { display: none; } body { padding: 0; } }
    <?php echo $extraCss; ?>
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="noprint"><button onclick="window.print()">Cetak / Simpan PDF</button></div>
<h1><?php echo pr_e($heading); ?></h1>
<?php foreach ($lines as $l) { echo '<div class="sub">' . $l . '</div>'; } ?>

function pr_close() {
    echo '<div class="foot">Dicetak: ' . date('d/m/Y H:i') . '</div></body></html>';
}

// Blok seksi: judul + daftar [kode, nama, nilai] + baris total. Baris bernilai ~0 sudah disaring pemanggil.
function pr_section($title, $items, $totalLabel, $total) {
    $h = '<h3>' . pr_e($title) . '</h3><table class="rpt">';
    $i = 0;
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $h .= '<tr' . ($i++ % 2 ? ' class="z"' : '') . '><td class="c">' . pr_e($it[0]) . '</td><td>' . pr_e($it[1]) . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($it[2]) . '</td></tr>';
    }
    if (!count($items)) { $h .= '<tr><td colspan="3" class="muted">Tidak ada saldo.</td></tr>'; }
    $h .= '<tr class="tot"><td colspan="2">' . pr_e($totalLabel) . '</td><td class="r">' . pr_n($total) . '</td></tr></table>';
    return $h;
}

==================== FILE: ./progress.opening.js ====================
-- SALDO AWAL progress (opsional): proyek yang progress-nya diketik manual sebelum modul verifikasi ada
-- dicatat sebagai satu baris 'Diverifikasi' bertanda legacy, supaya riwayat klaim tidak kosong dan klaim berikutnya
-- (harus lebih besar dari angka ini) punya acuan yang jelas.
-- LIHAT DULU proyek mana yang terpengaruh:
SELECT id, name, status, progress FROM projects WHERE COALESCE(progress, 0) > 0 ORDER BY id;

INSERT INTO project_progress_log
       (project_id, report_date, percent_claimed, prev_percent, reported_by, note, evidence_ref, status, verified_at, verify_note)
SELECT p.id, CURRENT_DATE, p.progress, 0, NULL,
       'Saldo awal: progress diinput manual sebelum modul verifikasi', 'LEGACY', 'Diverifikasi', NOW(),
       'Belum diverifikasi lapangan - tinjau ulang bila angka tidak sesuai'
  FROM projects p
 WHERE COALESCE(p.progress, 0) > 0
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_progress_log l WHERE l.project_id = p.id);

-- BILA ANGKA LEGACY TIDAK DIPERCAYA (mis. 92% padahal biaya baru 17%), turunkan ke angka yang benar lewat SQL ini
-- (satu-satunya cara menurunkan progress; klaim di aplikasi hanya bisa menaikkan):
--   UPDATE projects SET progress = <angka_benar> WHERE id = <id_proyek>;

<?php
/**
 * scripts/reaudit_fase3.php

 */
if (PHP_SAPI !== 'cli') { http_response_code(403); exit('CLI only.'); }
error_reporting(E_ALL & ~E_NOTICE);

// Paksa target DB uji (jangan pernah ke DB default aplikasi).
putenv('RAB_DB_NAME=proyekGMN_test');
putenv('DB_NAME=proyekGMN_test');

$pass = 0; $fail = 0;
function check(string $label, bool $ok, string $detail = '') {
    global $pass, $fail;
    if ($ok) { $pass++; echo "PASS  $label\n"; }
    else     { $fail++; echo "FAIL  $label  $detail\n"; }
}
function scalar($db, string $sql, $params = []) {
    $st = $db->prepare($sql); $st->execute($params); return $st->fetchColumn();
}
function colExists($db, string $table, string $col): bool {
    return (int) scalar($db,
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name=? AND column_name=?",
        [$table, $col]) === 1;
}
function trigExists($db, string $trg): bool {
    return (int) scalar($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname=? AND NOT tgisinternal", [$trg]) >= 1;
}
function conExists($db, string $con): bool {
    return (int) scalar($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname=?", [$con]) >= 1;
}
