      (int) scalar($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounting_periods WHERE CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN start_date AND end_date AND is_closed=false") >= 1);

echo "--- Fase 3b (#5): rule PRJ_DEP_APPLY ---\n";
$row = $db->prepare("SELECT f.rule_code, d.account_code dr, c.account_code cr, f.is_active
                       FROM fiscal_config f
                       JOIN chart_of_accounts d ON d.id=f.debit_account_id
                       JOIN chart_of_accounts c ON c.id=f.credit_account_id
                      WHERE f.rule_code='PRJ_DEP_APPLY'");
$row->execute(); $dep = $row->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
check('PRJ_DEP_APPLY Dr 2200 / Cr 1200 & aktif',
      $dep && $dep['dr'] === '2200' && $dep['cr'] === '1200' && ($dep['is_active'] === true || $dep['is_active'] === 't' || $dep['is_active'] === 1),
      json_encode($dep));

echo "--- Fase 3b (#5): uji fungsional AutoPostJournal (transaksi + ROLLBACK) ---\n";
try {
    $db->beginTransaction();
    $today = date('Y-m-d');
    $amount = 1234.56;
    $jr = AutoPostJournal($db, [
        'rule_code'      => 'PRJ_DEP_APPLY',
        'reference_type' => 'project_payment',
        'reference_id'   => 999999001,
        'journal_date'   => $today,
        'amount'         => $amount,
        'description'    => 'REAUDIT-F3 deposit client apply (uji, rollback)',
    ]);
    check('AutoPostJournal PRJ_DEP_APPLY sukses', !empty($jr['success']), $jr['message'] ?? '');
    if (!empty($jr['success'])) {
        $jid = (int) $jr['journal_id'];
        $debitAcc = (int) scalar($db, "SELECT account_id FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id=? AND debit>0", [$jid]);
        $creditAcc = (int) scalar($db, "SELECT account_id FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id=? AND credit>0", [$jid]);
        $drCode = (string) scalar($db, "SELECT account_code FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE id=?", [$debitAcc]);
        $crCode = (string) scalar($db, "SELECT account_code FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE id=?", [$creditAcc]);
        $sumDr = (float) scalar($db, "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debit),0) FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id=?", [$jid]);
        $sumCr = (float) scalar($db, "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(credit),0) FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id=?", [$jid]);
        check('Jurnal Dr 2200 (Uang Muka Penjualan)', $drCode === '2200', "got {$drCode}");
        check('Jurnal Cr 1200 (Piutang Usaha)', $crCode === '1200', "got {$crCode}");
        check('Journal balance Dr==Cr==amount', abs($sumDr - $amount) < 0.005 && abs($sumCr - $amount) < 0.005, "Dr={$sumDr} Cr={$sumCr}");
        check('Debit != kas (bukan akun kas bank)', $drCode !== '1100');
    }
    $db->rollBack();
    echo "(transaksi uji di-ROLLBACK — tidak ada jurnal baru tertinggal)\n";
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
    check('uji fungsional PRJ_DEP_APPLY', false, $e->getMessage());
}

echo "--- Fase 3b (#1): uji trigger guard (transaksi + ROLLBACK) ---\n";
try {
    $db->beginTransaction();
    // cari invoice released dengan saldo, else skip
    $invId = scalar($db, "SELECT id FROM project_invoices WHERE COALESCE(release_status,'draft')='released' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1");
    if (!$invId) { echo "SKIP  uji trigger project_payment (tidak ada invoice released di DB uji)\n"; $db->rollBack(); }
    else {
        // alokasi sengaja di atas saldo: amount_paid sangat besar
        $bal = (float) scalar($db, "SELECT COALESCE(amount,0)-COALESCE(paid_amount,0)-COALESCE(retention_amount,0) FROM project_invoices WHERE id=?", [$invId]);
        $over = $bal + 1000.00;
        // perlu payment buatan; gunakan payment existing bila ada, else skip
        $payId = scalar($db, "SELECT id FROM project_payments ORDER BY id LIMIT 1");
        if (!$payId) { echo "SKIP  uji trigger project_payment (tidak ada project_payments utk FK)\n"; $db->rollBack(); }
        else {
            $threw = false;
            try {
                $st = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO project_payment_items (payment_id, invoice_id, amount_paid) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
                $st->execute([$payId, $invId, $over]);
            } catch (Throwable $e) { $threw = true; }
            check('trigger guard menolak alokasi > saldo invoice', $threw, "over={$over}");
            $db->rollBack();
            echo "(transaksi uji trigger di-ROLLBACK)\n";
        }
    }
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
    check('uji trigger project_payment_items', false, $e->getMessage());
}

echo "--- Fase 3: saldo jurnal historis tetap seimbang ---\n";
$imbalance = (int) scalar($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT journal_id FROM journal_lines GROUP BY journal_id HAVING ABS(SUM(debit)-SUM(credit)) >= 0.01) x");
check('semua jurnal historis Debit==Kredit', $imbalance === 0, "imbalance={$imbalance}");
$orphan = (int) scalar($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM journal_entries je WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_lines jl WHERE jl.journal_id=je.id)");
check('tidak ada journal_entries tanpa baris journal_lines', $orphan === 0, "orphan={$orphan}");

echo "=== HASIL: PASS={$pass} FAIL={$fail} ===\n";
exit($fail > 0 ? 1 : 0);

function dbconn()
{
    $c = @pg_connect('host=' . DB_HOST . ' port=' . DB_PORT . ' dbname=' . DB_NAME
        . ' user=' . DB_USER . ' password=' . DB_PASS);
    if (!$c) { fwrite(STDERR, "CONNECT-FAIL: " . pg_last_error() . "\n"); exit(1); }
    return $c;
}

$c = dbconn();
echo "TARGET DB: " . DB_NAME . "\n";

// --- 0. Snapshot baseline -------------------------------------------------
function snap($c, $sql, $label)
{
    $r = @pg_query($c, $sql);
    if (!$r) { echo "$label = QUERY-ERROR: " . pg_last_error($c) . "\n"; return; }
    $n = pg_num_rows($r);
    echo "$label = $n\n";
}
echo "--- BASELINE ---\n";
snap($c, "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='project_invoices' AND column_name LIKE 'retention%'", 'baseline: inv retention cols');
snap($c, "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='project_payments' AND column_name='total_amount_base'", 'baseline: pay total_amount_base');
snap($c, "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='grn_hdr' AND column_name='approval_status'", 'baseline: grn approval_status');
snap($c, "SELECT 1 FROM fiscal_config WHERE rule_code='PRJ_DEP_APPLY'", 'baseline: PRJ_DEP_APPLY rule');
snap($c, "SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='trg_check_project_payment_within_invoice'", 'baseline: trg project payment guard');
snap($c, "SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='trg_check_supplier_payment_within_invoice'", 'baseline: trg supplier payment guard');
snap($c, "SELECT id,title FROM m_form_name WHERE id=156 AND title='TAGIHAN KLIEN'", 'baseline: menu 156 rename');
pg_free_result(pg_query($c, "SELECT 1")); // noop

// --- 1. Jalankan migrasi --------------------------------------------------
echo "--- APPLY MIGRATIONS ---\n";
$fail = 0;
foreach ($files as $f) {
    $path = __DIR__ . '/../' . $f;
    if (!is_file($path)) { echo "SKIP (file tidak ada): $f\n"; continue; }
    $sql = file_get_contents($path);
    // Hapus baris \set psql (bulk_release tidak ada di daftar, tapi jaga-jaga)
    $sql = preg_replace('/^\\s*\\set\s.*$/m', '', $sql);
    $res = @pg_query($c, $sql);
    if (!$res) {
        $fail++;
        echo "FAIL  : $f\n       " . trim(pg_last_error($c)) . "\n";
    } else {
        echo "OK    : $f\n";
    }
    // hasil multi-statement sudah habis dikonsumsi pg_query (pg_query hanya eksekusi satu stack;
    // PostgreSQL menjalankan seluruh string sebagai satu rangkaian bila tanpa error).
}
if ($fail > 0) { echo "ABORT: $fail migrasi gagal. Periksa error di atas.\n"; exit(2); }

// --- 2. Pilihan #5: pastikan PRJ_DEP_APPLY + pasangan akun benar ----------
echo "--- FIX #5: PRJ_DEP_APPLY ---\n";
$sql = "INSERT INTO fiscal_config (rule_code, rule_name, debit_account_id, credit_account_id, is_active)
        SELECT 'PRJ_DEP_APPLY', 'Pemakaian deposit client untuk bayar termin', d.id, c.id, true
          FROM chart_of_accounts d, chart_of_accounts c
         WHERE d.account_code = '2200' AND c.account_code = '1200'
        ON CONFLICT (rule_code) DO UPDATE
           SET rule_name = EXCLUDED.rule_name,
               debit_account_id = EXCLUDED.debit_account_id,
               credit_account_id = EXCLUDED.credit_account_id,
               is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active
         WHERE fiscal_config.debit_account_id  <> EXCLUDED.debit_account_id
            OR fiscal_config.credit_account_id <> EXCLUDED.credit_account_id
            OR fiscal_config.is_active        <> EXCLUDED.is_active";
$res = @pg_query($c, $sql);
if (!$res) { echo "FAIL PRJ_DEP_APPLY upsert: " . pg_last_error($c) . "\n"; exit(3); }
echo "OK    : PRJ_DEP_APPLY upsert\n";

// --- 3. Verifikasi pasca-terapkan -----------------------------------------
echo "--- POST-CHECK ---\n";
snap($c, "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='project_invoices' AND column_name LIKE 'retention%'", 'post: inv retention cols (harus 2)');
snap($c, "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='project_payments' AND column_name='total_amount_base'", 'post: pay total_amount_base (harus 1)');
snap($c, "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='grn_hdr' AND column_name='approval_status'", 'post: grn approval_status (harus 1)');
snap($c, "SELECT 1 FROM fiscal_config WHERE rule_code='PRJ_DEP_APPLY'", 'post: PRJ_DEP_APPLY rule (harus 1)');
snap($c, "SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='trg_check_project_payment_within_invoice'", 'post: trg project payment guard');
snap($c, "SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='trg_check_supplier_payment_within_invoice'", 'post: trg supplier payment guard');
snap($c, "SELECT id,title FROM m_form_name WHERE id=156 AND title='TAGIHAN KLIEN'", 'post: menu 156 rename');
$r = pg_query($c, "SELECT f.rule_code, d.account_code AS dr, c.account_code AS cr, f.is_active
                     FROM fiscal_config f
                     JOIN chart_of_accounts d ON d.id=f.debit_account_id
                     JOIN chart_of_accounts c ON c.id=f.credit_account_id
                    WHERE f.rule_code='PRJ_DEP_APPLY'");
$row = pg_fetch_assoc($r);
echo "post: PRJ_DEP_APPLY detail = " . json_encode($row) . "\n";
pg_close($c);
echo "SELESAI.\n";

<?php
// Script untuk mengaudit & menerapkan validasi Tutup Periode pada seluruh file transaksi CRUD.

$dir = '/home/myadmin/proyekgmn-dev/php-crud';
$files = scandir($dir);
$count = 0;

foreach ($files as $file) {

        $path = $dir . '/' . $file;

            echo "Memproses: $file\n";

            // 1. Cari case create/update/delete
            // 2. Tambahkan validasi periode
            // Ini akan memerlukan logika lebih dalam jika mau otomatis.
            // Untuk sekarang, kita lakukan secara manual untuk file krusial.
        }
    }
}

    else     { $fail++; echo "FAIL  $label  $detail\n"; }

function scalar($db, string $sql, $params = []) {
    $st = $db->prepare($sql); $st->execute($params); return $st->fetchColumn();
}
function row($db, string $sql, $params = []) {
    $st = $db->prepare($sql); $st->execute($params); return $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

function viewExists($db, string $view): bool {
    return (int) scalar($db,
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name = ?",
        [$view]) === 1;
}
function viewCol($db, string $view, string $col): bool {
    return (int) scalar($db,
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name = ? AND column_name = ?",
        [$view, $col]) === 1;
}

function http_post(string $path, array $fields, string $jar): array {
    $ch = curl_init(CFG_BASE_URL . $path);
    curl_setopt_array($ch, [
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true, CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 5,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 60, CURLOPT_POST => true, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => http_build_query($fields),
        CURLOPT_COOKIEFILE => $jar, CURLOPT_COOKIEJAR => $jar,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['Origin: ' . CFG_ORIGIN, 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'],
    ]);
    $body = curl_exec($ch); $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE); $err = curl_error($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
    return ['http' => $code, 'body' => (string)$body, 'err' => $err];
}
function http_get(string $path, string $jar): array {
    $ch = curl_init(CFG_BASE_URL . $path);
    curl_setopt_array($ch, [
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true, CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 5,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 60, CURLOPT_COOKIEFILE => $jar, CURLOPT_COOKIEJAR => $jar,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'],
    ]);
    $body = curl_exec($ch); $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE); $err = curl_error($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
    return ['http' => $code, 'body' => (string)$body, 'err' => $err];
}
function api(int $userId, string $crud, string $task, array $fields = []): array {
    $fields['task'] = $task;
    $r = http_post('/php-crud/' . $crud, $fields, '/tmp/e2e_cookie_' . $userId);
    $json = json_decode($r['body'], true);
    return ['http' => $r['http'], 'json' => is_array($json) ? $json : null, 'raw' => $r['body'], 'err' => $r['err']];
}
function login_ar_ap(int $userId, string $loginName, string $password): bool {
    $jar = '/tmp/e2e_cookie_' . $userId;
    if (is_file($jar)) { unlink($jar); }
    $ch = curl_init();
    curl_setopt_array($ch, [
        CURLOPT_URL => CFG_BASE_URL . '/login.php', CURLOPT_POST => true,
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => http_build_query(['username' => $loginName, 'password' => $password]),
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => false, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 60,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEFILE => $jar, CURLOPT_COOKIEJAR => $jar,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['Origin: ' . CFG_ORIGIN, 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'],
    ]);
    $body = curl_exec($ch); $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE); curl_close($ch);
    if ($code !== 302) { fwrite(STDERR, "[LOGIN] user={$loginName} http={$code} body0=" . substr((string)$body, 0, 120) . "\n"); return false; }
    $chk = api($userId, 'ar.agingCRD.php', 'list_clients', []);
    return $chk['http'] === 200 && !empty($chk['json']['success']);
}

    }
    if ($spayId > 0) {
        $db->prepare("INSERT INTO public.supplier_payment_items (supplier_payment_id, invoice_id, amount_paid) VALUES (?, ?, 200000)")
           ->execute([$spayId, $pinvId]);
    }

    // Verifikasi AR: invoice muncul di v_ar_aging dengan outstanding 750.000
    $o = scalar($db, "SELECT outstanding FROM public.v_ar_aging WHERE invoice_id = ?", [$invId]);
    check('fixture AR: outstanding 750.000 di v_ar_aging', $o !== false && abs((float)$o - 750000) < 0.01, "got={$o}");
    $s = scalar($db, "SELECT sisa FROM public.v_ar_card WHERE client_id = ?", [$cid]);
    $expSisa = 750000; // hanya fixture (saldo awal/faktur lain di bulan ini bisa menambah)
    check('fixture AR: sisa kartu >= outstanding fixture', $s !== false && (float)$s >= 750000 - 0.01, "sisa={$s}");
    // Verifikasi AP
    $o = scalar($db, "SELECT outstanding FROM public.v_ap_aging WHERE invoice_id = ?", [$pinvId]);
    check('fixture AP: outstanding 300.000 di v_ap_aging', $o !== false && abs((float)$o - 300000) < 0.01, "got={$o}");
    $s = scalar($db, "SELECT sisa FROM public.v_ap_card WHERE supplier_id = ?", [$sid]);
    check('fixture AP: sisa kartu >= outstanding fixture', $s !== false && (float)$s >= 300000 - 0.01, "sisa={$s}");
    // Aging bucket: invoice hari ini -> bucket 0-30
    $b = scalar($db, "SELECT bucket_0_30 FROM public.v_ar_aging WHERE invoice_id = ?", [$invId]);
    check('fixture AR: bucket 0-30 = outstanding (invoice baru)', abs((float)$b - 750000) < 0.01, "b={$b}");
    $db->rollBack();
    check('fixture ROLLBACK: tidak ada data uji tersisa',
          (int) scalar($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.project_invoices WHERE inv_no LIKE 'E2E-ARAP-%'") === 0 &&
          (int) scalar($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.purchase_invoice_hdr WHERE inv_no = 'E2E-AP-1'") === 0);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
    check('fixture fungsional AR/AP', false, $e->getMessage());
}

// Cleanup user uji (data m_user_system tidak dibungkus transaksi di atas)
if (!empty($uid)) {
    $db->prepare("DELETE FROM public.m_user_access_menu WHERE user_id = ?")->execute([$uid]);
    $db->prepare("DELETE FROM public.m_user_system WHERE id = ?")->execute([$uid]);
}

echo "\nPASS={$pass} FAIL={$fail}\n";
exit($fail > 0 ? 1 : 0);

$error_msg = '';
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $username = trim($_POST['username'] ?? '');
    $password = trim($_POST['password'] ?? '');

    if (!empty($username) && !empty($password)) {
        try {
            $db = new crud();
            $stmt = $db->prepare("
             SELECT id, login_name, password, active 
                FROM m_user_system 
                WHERE login_name = :username AND active IS TRUE 
                LIMIT 1
            ");
            $stmt->execute([':username' => $username]);
            $user = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            $isPasswordValid = false;
            if (function_exists('password_verify')) {
                $isPasswordValid = password_verify($password, $user['password']) || ($user['password'] === $password);
            } else {
                $isPasswordValid = ($user['password'] === $password);
            }

            if ($user && $isPasswordValid) {
                //error_log("Pesan debug: Proses A berhasil dijalankan.");

                if ($user['active'] != 1) {
                    $error_msg = "Akun Anda tidak aktif. Hubungi administrator.";
                } else {

                    $_SESSION["username"] = $user['username'];
                    $_SESSION["user_fullname"] = $user['user_fullname'];
                    $_SESSION["department_id"] = $user['department_id'];
                    $_SESSION["FormAccess"] = (int)$user['form_access'];
                    
                    header('Location: views/dashboard.php');
                    exit;
                }
            } else {
                $error_msg = "Username atau Password salah!";
            }
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            error_log("Login Database Error: " . $e->getMessage());
            $error_msg = "Terjadi kesalahan sistem pada database.";

        $error_msg = "Username dan Password wajib diisi!";

==================== FILE: ./login.php ====================
<?php
/*
Document : login.php
Description : Login Page - RAB-PROJECT (Dark Theme, selaras dashboard + Show/Hide Password Icon)
*/

require_once __DIR__ . '/php-class/crudClass.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/php-func/function.all.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION)) { session_start(); }

// Jika sudah login, langsung ke dashboard
if (isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) && !is_null($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    header('Location: views/dashboard.php');
    exit;
}

$error_msg = '';
$username = '';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $username = trim($_POST['username'] ?? '');
    $password = $_POST['password'] ?? '';
    
    if (!empty($username) && !empty($password)) {
        try {
            $db = new crud();
            $stmt = $db->prepare("
                SELECT id, login_name, password, active
                FROM m_user_system
                WHERE LOWER(login_name) = LOWER(:username)
                LIMIT 1
            ");
            $stmt->execute([':username' => $username]);
            $user = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            
            if (!$user) {
                $error_msg = "Username atau Password salah!";
            } else {
                if ((int)$user['active'] !== 1) {
                    $error_msg = "Akun Anda tidak aktif. Hubungi administrator.";
                } else {
                    $isPasswordValid = false;
                    
                    // Cek multiple methods
                    if ($user['password'] === $password) $isPasswordValid = true;
                    if (!$isPasswordValid && function_exists('EncodeData')) {
                        if ($user['password'] === EncodeData($password)) $isPasswordValid = true;
                    }
                    if (!$isPasswordValid && $user['password'] === md5($password)) $isPasswordValid = true;
                    if (!$isPasswordValid && function_exists('password_verify')) {
                        if (password_verify($password, $user['password'])) $isPasswordValid = true;
                    }
                    
                    if ($isPasswordValid) {
                        $_SESSION["user_id"] = $user['id'];
                        $_SESSION["username"] = $user['login_name'];
                        $_SESSION["FormAccess"] = isset($user['form_access']) ? (int)$user['form_access'] : 0;
                        session_regenerate_id(true);
                        header('Location: views/dashboard.php');
                        exit;
                    } else {
                        $error_msg = "Username atau Password salah!";
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            error_log("[Login Error] " . $e->getMessage());
            $error_msg = "Terjadi kesalahan sistem.";
        }
    } else {
        $error_msg = "Username dan Password wajib diisi!";
    }
}

==================== FILE: ./warehouse.issuingCRD.php ====================
<?php
/**
 * warehouse.issuingCRD.php — Warehouse Issuing (material out ke proyek)
 *
 * Aturan issue per material:
 *   1. Material harus sudah di-RCV di gudang (stok W/H > 0).
 *   2. qty issue <= stok di W/H.
 *   3. Total issue proyek (posted) + qty ini <= RAB qty_plan x (1 + 5%).
 *      Bila melewati qty RAB tapi masih dalam +5% -> is_overbudget = true (allowance terpakai).
 *   4. [UPGRADE PROGRESS-GATED BUDGET] Total kumulatif actual cost tidak boleh melebihi plafon
 *      anggaran berjalan berdasarkan progress fisik proyek di lapangan (projects.progress) + 5% toleransi.
 *   Nilai issue = FIFO dari layer RCV (stock_movements IN).
 */
ob_start();
ini_set('display_errors', '0');
require_once '../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once '../php-class/crudClass.php';
require_once '../php-func/function.stock.php';
require_once '../php-func/journal.stock.php';
require_once '../php-func/function.spk.php';        // [SPK][NEW] kuota & sisa jatah SPK

define('ISSUE_REQUIRE_SPK', true);           // [SPK][NEW] issue ke proyek WAJIB memilih SPK berstatus Diterbitkan (false = tidak wajib)
define('ISSUE_ALLOWANCE_PCT', 5.0);          
define('ISSUE_REF_TYPE', 'MATERIAL_OUT');    
define('ISSUE_TYPE_RETURN', 'SUPPLIER_RETURN');   

$action = WhReq('action', 'list');

try {
    switch ($action) {
        case 'list':              IssList(); break;
        case 'detail':            IssDetail(); break;
        case 'lookup_projects':   IssLookupProjects(); break;
        case 'lookup_spk':        IssLookupSpk(); break;        // [SPK][NEW]
        case 'lookup_warehouses': IssLookupWarehouses(); break;
        case 'lookup_materials':  IssLookupMaterials(); break;
        case 'save':              IssSave(); break;
        case 'reverse':           IssReverse(); break;
        case 'prepare':           IssPrepare(); break;   
        case 'deliver':           IssDeliver(); break;   
        case 'upload_proof':      IssUploadProof(); break;   
        case 'backfill_return_journal': IssBackfillReturnJournal(); break;   // [BACKFILL-RETUR][NEW] sekali jalan: jurnal retur lama yang belum berjurnal
        default: throw new WhException('Action tidak dikenali.');
    }
} catch (WhException $e) {
    @pg_query($conn, 'ROLLBACK');
    WhFail($e->getMessage());
} catch (Exception $e) {
    @pg_query($conn, 'ROLLBACK');
    WhLog('warehouse.issuingCRD: ' . $e->getMessage());
    WhFail('Terjadi kesalahan pada server. Hubungi administrator.');
}

function IssRabInfo($projectId, $materialId) {
    $rab = WhRow("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_plan),0) AS q FROM budget_items
                  WHERE project_id=$1 AND material_id=$2", array((int)$projectId, (int)$materialId));
    $iss = WhRow("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty_out),0) AS q
                  FROM material_out_items i JOIN material_out_header h ON h.id=i.material_out_id
                  WHERE h.project_id=$1 AND i.material_id=$2 AND h.status='posted'
                    AND h.issue_type='PROJECT'", 
                 array((int)$projectId, (int)$materialId));
    return array('rab_qty' => round((float)$rab['q'], 4), 'issued' => round((float)$iss['q'], 4));
}

/**
 * [NEW PROGRESS-GATED VALIDATION] Validasi pengeluaran material terhadap progress fisik proyek
 */
function validateMaterialOutAgainstProgress($projectId, $newMaterialCost) {
    $proj = WhRow("SELECT budget, COALESCE(progress, 0) AS progress FROM public.projects WHERE id = $1", array((int)$projectId));
    if (!$proj) {
        throw new WhException('Proyek tidak ditemukan.');
    }

    $totalBudget = floatval($proj['budget']);
    $currentProgress = intval($proj['progress']); 
    $tolerancePct = 5.0; 

    if ($totalBudget <= 0) {
        return;
    }

    $allowedBudgetLimit = ($totalBudget * ($currentProgress / 100.0)) * (1 + ($tolerancePct / 100.0));

    $spentData = WhRow("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty_out * i.unit_cost), 0) AS total_spent 
                        FROM material_out_header h 
                        JOIN material_out_items i ON i.material_out_id = h.id 
                        WHERE h.project_id = $1 AND h.status = 'posted' AND h.issue_type = 'PROJECT'", 
                       array((int)$projectId));
    $currentSpent = floatval($spentData['total_spent']);
    $projectedSpent = $currentSpent + $newMaterialCost;

    if ($projectedSpent > $allowedBudgetLimit) {
        throw new WhException(sprintf(
            "TRANSAKSI DITOLAK: Pemakaian anggaran melampaui batas progress fisik saat ini! Progress fisik: %%d%%%. Plafon diizinkan: Rp %%s. Total pengajuan: Rp %%s.",
            $currentProgress,
            number_format($allowedBudgetLimit, 2, ',', '.'),
            number_format($projectedSpent, 2, ',', '.')
        ));
    }
}

function IssNextSjNo($date) {
    $ts = strtotime($date);
    $prefix = 'SJ-' . date('ym', $ts ? $ts : time()) . '-';
    WhRow('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext($1)) AS l', array('material_out_sj_no'));
    $r = WhRow('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(delivery_note_no, 5) AS integer)), 0) AS n
                FROM material_out_header WHERE delivery_note_no ~ $1', array('^' . $prefix . '[0-9]{5}$'));
    return $prefix . str_pad((string)((int)$r['n'] + 1), 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
}

function IssList() {
    list($start, $limit) = WhPage();
    $q = WhReq('query');
    $params = array();
    $where = '1=1';
    if ($q !== '') {
        $params[] = '%' . $q . '%';
        $where .= ' AND (h.ref_no ILIKE $1 OR p.name ILIKE $1 OR h.received_by_mandor ILIKE $1 OR rt.ref_no ILIKE $1
                   OR h.delivery_note_no ILIKE $1 OR h.delivery_receiver ILIKE $1 OR sp.spk_no ILIKE $1)';     // [SPK] cari juga nomor SPK
    }
    $c = WhRow("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM material_out_header h
                JOIN projects p ON p.id=h.project_id
                LEFT JOIN supplier_return_hdr rt ON rt.material_out_id=h.id
                LEFT JOIN spk sp ON sp.id=h.spk_id
                WHERE $where", $params);

    $params[] = $limit;  $pl = '$' . count($params);
    $params[] = $start;  $ps = '$' . count($params);
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT h.id, h.ref_no, h.project_id, p.name AS project_name,
                           h.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, h.issue_date,
                           h.received_by_mandor, h.status, h.remark, h.issue_type, h.spk_id, sp.spk_no,
                           h.prepared_at, h.delivery_date, h.delivery_note_no, h.delivery_receiver, h.delivery_proof,
                           rt.ref_no AS return_ref_no, rt.status AS return_status,
                           rt.sent_date, rt.carrier, rs.name AS return_supplier_name,
                           COALESCE(t.total_amount,0) AS total_amount,
                           COALESCE(t.line_count,0)   AS line_count,
                           COALESCE(t.has_over,false) AS has_overbudget
                    FROM material_out_header h
                    JOIN projects   p ON p.id=h.project_id
                    JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=h.warehouse_id
                    LEFT JOIN supplier_return_hdr rt ON rt.material_out_id=h.id
                    LEFT JOIN m_suppliers rs ON rs.id=rt.supplier_id
                    LEFT JOIN spk sp ON sp.id=h.spk_id
                    LEFT JOIN (SELECT material_out_id, SUM(qty_out*unit_cost) AS total_amount,
                                      COUNT(*) AS line_count, BOOL_OR(is_overbudget) AS has_over
                               FROM material_out_items GROUP BY material_out_id) t ON t.material_out_id=h.id
                    WHERE $where
                    ORDER BY h.issue_date DESC, h.id DESC
                    LIMIT $pl OFFSET $ps", $params);
    foreach ($rows as &$r) { $r['has_overbudget'] = WhBool($r['has_overbudget']); }
    unset($r);
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => (int)$c['n'], 'data' => $rows));
}

function IssDetail() {
    $id = (int)WhReq('id');
    if ($id < 1) { throw new WhException('ID dokumen tidak valid.'); }
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT i.id, i.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit,
                           i.qty_out, i.unit_cost, (i.qty_out*i.unit_cost) AS amount,
                           i.is_overbudget, i.overbudget_reason, i.notes
                    FROM material_out_items i JOIN materials m ON m.id=i.material_id
                    WHERE i.material_out_id=$1 ORDER BY i.id", array($id));
    foreach ($rows as &$r) { $r['is_overbudget'] = WhBool($r['is_overbudget']); }
    unset($r);
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($rows), 'data' => $rows));
}

function IssLookupProjects() {
    $q = WhReq('query');
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT id, name FROM projects WHERE name ILIKE $1 ORDER BY name LIMIT 100",
                   array('%' . $q . '%'));
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($rows), 'data' => $rows));
}

function IssLookupWarehouses() {
    $pid = (int)WhReq('project_id');
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT w.id, w.code,
                           (w.name || ' (' || oh.item_count || ' material)') AS name
                    FROM warehouses w
                    JOIN (SELECT warehouse_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count
                          FROM (SELECT warehouse_id, item_id
                                FROM stock_movements
                                GROUP BY warehouse_id, item_id
                                HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='IN' THEN qty ELSE -qty END) > 0) x
                          GROUP BY warehouse_id) oh ON oh.warehouse_id = w.id
                    WHERE w.active = true
                    ORDER BY (w.project_id = $1) DESC NULLS LAST, w.name", array($pid));
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($rows), 'data' => $rows));
}

// [SPK][NEW] SPK berstatus Diterbitkan milik proyek (untuk dipilih di editor issue)
function IssLookupSpk() {
    $pid = (int)WhReq('project_id');
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT s.id, s.spk_no, s.spk_date, s.foreman, s.description,
                           s.spk_no || COALESCE(' - ' || NULLIF(s.foreman,''), '') AS label
                    FROM spk s WHERE s.project_id=$1 AND s.status='Diterbitkan' ORDER BY s.spk_date DESC, s.id DESC", array($pid));
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($rows), 'data' => $rows));
}

function IssLookupMaterials() {
    $pid = (int)WhReq('project_id');
    $wid = (int)WhReq('warehouse_id');
    $q   = WhReq('query');
    $spk = (int)WhReq('spk_id');         // [SPK] bila ada: hanya material SPK itu, batas issue = sisa jatah SPK
    $extra = ''; $params = array($pid, $wid, '%' . $q . '%');
    if ($spk > 0) { $extra = ' AND m.id IN (SELECT material_id FROM spk_items WHERE spk_id=$4)'; $params[] = $spk; }
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit,
                           oh.onhand,
                           COALESCE(rab.rab_qty,0) AS rab_qty,
                           COALESCE(iss.issued,0)  AS issued
                    FROM materials m
                    JOIN (SELECT item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='IN' THEN qty ELSE -qty END) AS onhand
                          FROM stock_movements WHERE warehouse_id=$2 GROUP BY item_id) oh ON oh.item_id=m.id
                    LEFT JOIN (SELECT material_id, SUM(qty_plan) AS rab_qty FROM budget_items
                               WHERE project_id=$1 AND material_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY material_id) rab
                           ON rab.material_id=m.id
                    LEFT JOIN (SELECT i.material_id, SUM(i.qty_out) AS issued
                               FROM material_out_items i JOIN material_out_header h ON h.id=i.material_out_id
                               WHERE h.project_id=$1 AND h.status='posted' AND h.issue_type='PROJECT'
                               GROUP BY i.material_id) iss
                           ON iss.material_id=m.id
                    WHERE oh.onhand > 0 AND (m.material_name ILIKE $3 OR m.material_code ILIKE $3)" . $extra . "
                    ORDER BY m.material_name LIMIT 50", $params);
    foreach ($rows as &$r) {
        $rab = (float)$r['rab_qty'];
        $limit = round($rab * (1 + ISSUE_ALLOWANCE_PCT / 100), 4);
        $remain = max(0, round($limit - (float)$r['issued'], 4));
        $r['limit_qty'] = $limit;                                   
        $r['max_issue'] = ($rab > 0) ? min((float)$r['onhand'], $remain) : 0;   
        if ($spk > 0) {                                              // [SPK] batasi dengan sisa jatah SPK
            $sr = SpkRemaining($spk, (int)$r['material_id']);
            $r['spk_remaining'] = $sr['remaining'];
            $r['max_issue'] = min((float)$r['max_issue'], $sr['remaining']);
        } else { $r['spk_remaining'] = null; }
    }
    unset($r);
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($rows), 'data' => $rows));
}

function IssSave() {
    WhRequirePost();
    $projectId = (int)WhPost('project_id');
    $whId      = (int)WhPost('warehouse_id');
    $date      = WhDate(WhPost('issue_date'), 'Tanggal issue');
    $mandor    = WhPost('received_by_mandor');
    $remark    = WhPost('remark');
    $spkId     = (int)WhPost('spk_id');       // [SPK][NEW]
    $details   = WhDetails();
    $userId    = WhUserId();

    if ($projectId < 1) { throw new WhException('Proyek wajib dipilih.'); }
    if ($whId < 1)      { throw new WhException('Gudang wajib dipilih.'); }
    if (ISSUE_REQUIRE_SPK && $spkId < 1) { throw new WhException('SPK wajib dipilih untuk issue material ke proyek.'); }

    $wh = WhRow('SELECT id, project_id, active FROM warehouses WHERE id=$1', array($whId));
    if (!$wh || !WhBool($wh['active'])) { throw new WhException('Gudang tidak ditemukan / tidak aktif.'); }

    $lines = array();
    foreach ($details as $d) {
        $mid = isset($d['material_id']) ? (int)$d['material_id'] : 0;
        $qty = isset($d['qty_out']) ? WhNum($d['qty_out']) : 0;
        if ($mid < 1) { throw new WhException('Material pada detail tidak valid.'); }
        if ($qty <= 0) { throw new WhException('Qty issue harus lebih besar dari 0.'); }
        if (!isset($lines[$mid])) { $lines[$mid] = array('qty' => 0, 'notes' => ''); }
        $lines[$mid]['qty'] = round($lines[$mid]['qty'] + $qty, 4);
        if (!empty($d['notes'])) { $lines[$mid]['notes'] = trim($d['notes']); }
    }

    WhQ('BEGIN');

    // [SPK][NEW] SPK harus milik proyek ini & berstatus Diterbitkan; baris SPK dikunci agar dua issue tidak melampaui sisa jatah bersamaan
    $spkNo = '';
    if ($spkId > 0) {
        $sp = WhRow('SELECT id, spk_no, project_id, status FROM spk WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE', array($spkId));
        if (!$sp) { throw new WhException('SPK tidak ditemukan.'); }
        if ((int)$sp['project_id'] !== $projectId) { throw new WhException('SPK ' . $sp['spk_no'] . ' bukan milik proyek yang dipilih.'); }
        if ($sp['status'] !== 'Diterbitkan') { throw new WhException('SPK ' . $sp['spk_no'] . ' berstatus ' . $sp['status'] . '; hanya SPK Diterbitkan yang dapat dipakai issue.'); }
        $spkNo = $sp['spk_no'];
    }

    $estimatedTotalValue = 0.0;
    foreach ($lines as $mid => $ln) {
        $qty = $ln['qty'];
        $lyEst = WhFifoAllocate($mid, $whId, $qty);
        foreach ($lyEst as $ly) {
            $estimatedTotalValue += ($ly['qty'] * $ly['unit_cost']);
        }
    }

    validateMaterialOutAgainstProgress($projectId, $estimatedTotalValue);

    $refNo = CreateRefNo('material_out_header', 'ref_no', 'GI');
    $h = WhRow("INSERT INTO material_out_header
                    (ref_no, project_id, warehouse_id, issue_date, issued_by, received_by_mandor, status, remark, spk_id)
                VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,'posted',$7,$8) RETURNING id",
               array($refNo, $projectId, $whId, $date, $userId, $mandor, $remark, $spkId > 0 ? $spkId : null));
    $hdrId = (int)$h['id'];
    $issueValue = 0.0;                              

    foreach ($lines as $mid => $ln) {
        $qty = $ln['qty'];
        WhLock($mid, $whId);          
        WhLock($mid, 0);              
        $mat = WhRow('SELECT material_name FROM materials WHERE id=$1', array($mid));
        if (!$mat) { throw new WhException('Material ID ' . $mid . ' tidak ditemukan.'); }
        $name = $mat['material_name'];

        $onhand = WhOnHand($mid, $whId);
        if ($onhand <= 0) { throw new WhException("Material {$name} belum di-RCV / stok di gudang kosong."); }
        if ($qty > $onhand + 0.00005) {
            throw new WhException("Qty issue {$name} (" . WhFmt($qty) . ") melebihi stok di gudang (" . WhFmt($onhand) . ").");
        }
        // [SPK][NEW] material harus ada di SPK dan qty tidak melebihi sisa jatah SPK
        if ($spkId > 0) {
            $sr = SpkRemaining($spkId, $mid);
            if ($sr['qty'] <= 0) { throw new WhException("Material {$name} tidak ada di SPK {$spkNo}."); }
            if ($qty > $sr['remaining'] + 0.00005) {
                throw new WhException("Qty issue {$name} (" . WhFmt($qty) . ") melebihi sisa jatah SPK {$spkNo} (" . WhFmt($sr['remaining']) .
                    " dari " . WhFmt($sr['qty']) . ", sudah terpakai " . WhFmt($sr['used']) . ").");
            }
        }
        
        $info = IssRabInfo($projectId, $mid);
        if ($info['rab_qty'] <= 0) { throw new WhException("Material {$name} tidak ada di RAB proyek ini."); }
        $limit = round($info['rab_qty'] * (1 + ISSUE_ALLOWANCE_PCT / 100), 4);
        $after = round($info['issued'] + $qty, 4);
        if ($after > $limit + 0.00005) {
            throw new WhException("Issue {$name} melebihi batas RAB +" . ISSUE_ALLOWANCE_PCT . "% (RAB " .
                WhFmt($info['rab_qty']) . ", batas " . WhFmt($limit) . ", sudah di-issue " . WhFmt($info['issued']) . ").");
        }
        $over   = ($after > $info['rab_qty'] + 0.00005);
        $reason = $over ? ('Allowance +' . ISSUE_ALLOWANCE_PCT . '% dari RAB') : null;

        $layers = WhFifoAllocate($mid, $whId, $qty);
        foreach ($layers as $ly) {
            WhQ("INSERT INTO material_out_items
                    (material_out_id, material_id, qty_out, unit_cost, is_overbudget, overbudget_reason, notes)
                 VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7)",
                array($hdrId, $mid, $ly['qty'], round($ly['unit_cost'], 2), $over ? 't' : 'f', $reason, $ln['notes']));
            WhPostMovement($date, $mid, $whId, 'OUT', $ly['qty'], $ly['unit_cost'],
                           ISSUE_REF_TYPE, $hdrId, $refNo, 'Issue ke proyek', $userId);
            $issueValue += $ly['qty'] * $ly['unit_cost'];   
        }
    }
    
    JrnPost('ISSUE_PROJECT', JRN_REF_ISSUE, $hdrId, $date, $issueValue,
            'Issue material ke proyek - ' . $refNo, $userId);
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    WhOk('Issuing berhasil diposting. No: ' . $refNo, array('id' => $hdrId, 'ref_no' => $refNo));
}

function IssReverse() {
    WhRequirePost();
    $id = (int)WhPost('id');
    if ($id < 1) { throw new WhException('ID dokumen tidak valid.'); }
    WhQ('BEGIN');
    $h = WhRow('SELECT id, status, issue_type FROM material_out_header WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE', array($id));
    if (!$h) { throw new WhException('Dokumen tidak ditemukan.'); }
    if ($h['status'] !== 'posted') { throw new WhException('Hanya dokumen berstatus posted yang dapat di-reverse.'); }
    if ($h['issue_type'] !== 'PROJECT') { throw new WhException('Dokumen ini adalah issue Retur Supplier. Gunakan Batal Kirim di modul Retur Supplier.'); }
    WhQ("UPDATE material_out_header SET status='reversed', reversed_at=now(), reversed_by=$2 WHERE id=$1",
        array($id, WhUserId()));
    JrnReverseByRef(JRN_REF_ISSUE, $id, date('Y-m-d'), WhUserId(), 'Reverse issue');
    WhDeleteMovementsByRef(ISSUE_REF_TYPE, $id);   
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    WhOk('Dokumen issuing berhasil di-reverse.');
}

function IssPrepare() {
    WhRequirePost();
    $id = (int)WhPost('id');
    if ($id < 1) { throw new WhException('ID dokumen tidak valid.'); }
    WhQ('BEGIN');
    $h = WhRow('SELECT id, status, issue_type FROM material_out_header WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE', array($id));
    if (!$h) { throw new WhException('Dokumen tidak ditemukan.'); }
    if ($h['issue_type'] !== ISSUE_TYPE_RETURN) { throw new WhException('Siap Kirim hanya untuk issue Retur Supplier.'); }
    if ($h['status'] !== 'pending') { throw new WhException('Hanya dokumen berstatus pending yang dapat ditandai Siap Kirim.'); }
    $sjNo = IssNextSjNo(date('Y-m-d'));       
    WhQ("UPDATE material_out_header SET status='prepared', prepared_at=now(), prepared_by=$2, delivery_note_no=$3 WHERE id=$1",
        array($id, WhUserId(), $sjNo));
    WhQ("UPDATE supplier_return_hdr SET status='Disiapkan', updated_at=now() WHERE material_out_id=$1 AND status='Diperintahkan'",
        array($id));
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    WhOk('Barang ditandai sudah disiapkan (Siap Kirim). No. Surat Jalan: ' . $sjNo . '. Menunggu konfirmasi pengiriman.', array('delivery_note_no' => $sjNo));   
}

function IssDeliver() {
    WhRequirePost();
    $id       = (int)WhPost('id');
    $date     = WhDate(WhPost('delivery_date'), 'Tanggal kirim');
    $carrier  = trim(WhPost('carrier'));
    $receiver = trim(WhPost('receiver'));
    $proof    = trim(WhPost('delivery_proof'));
    $userId   = WhUserId();
    if ($id < 1) { throw new WhException('ID dokumen tidak valid.'); }
    if ($carrier === '')  { throw new WhException('Kurir / kendaraan pengiriman wajib diisi.'); }
    if ($receiver === '') { throw new WhException('Nama penerima wajib diisi.'); }
    
    $proofs = array();
    foreach (preg_split('/\r\n|\r|\n/', $proof) as $u) {
        $u = trim($u);
        if ($u === '') { continue; }
        if (!preg_match('#^(https?://|/)#i', $u)) { throw new WhException('Bukti harus berupa file yang diunggah atau link http(s).'); }
        $proofs[] = $u;
    }
    if (count($proofs) > 5) { throw new WhException('Bukti maksimal 5 file.'); }
    $proof = implode("\n", $proofs);

    WhQ('BEGIN');
    $h = WhRow('SELECT id, ref_no, status, issue_type, warehouse_id, delivery_note_no FROM material_out_header WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE', array($id));
    if (!$h) { throw new WhException('Dokumen tidak ditemukan.'); }
    if ($h['issue_type'] !== ISSUE_TYPE_RETURN) { throw new WhException('Konfirmasi dikirim hanya untuk issue Retur Supplier.'); }
    if ($h['status'] === 'pending') { throw new WhException('Tandai Siap Kirim terlebih dahulu sebelum konfirmasi dikirim.'); }
    if ($h['status'] !== 'prepared') { throw new WhException('Hanya dokumen berstatus prepared yang dapat dikonfirmasi dikirim.'); }
    $rt = WhRow('SELECT id, ref_no FROM supplier_return_hdr WHERE material_out_id=$1 FOR UPDATE', array($id));
    if (!$rt) { throw new WhException('Dokumen retur asal tidak ditemukan.'); }
    $whId  = (int)$h['warehouse_id'];
    $refNo = $h['ref_no'];
    
    $sjNo = trim((string)$h['delivery_note_no']);
    if ($sjNo === '') { $sjNo = IssNextSjNo($date); }
    $dtl = WhRows('SELECT id, material_id, qty_claim, defect_type FROM supplier_return_dtl WHERE return_hdr_id=$1 ORDER BY material_id, id',
                  array((int)$rt['id']));
    if (!count($dtl)) { throw new WhException('Retur belum memiliki item.'); }

    WhQ('DELETE FROM material_out_items WHERE material_out_id=$1', array($id));   
    $value = 0.0;
    foreach ($dtl as $d) {
        $mid = (int)$d['material_id'];
        $qty = round((float)$d['qty_claim'], 4);
        WhLock($mid, $whId);
        $m = WhRow('SELECT material_name FROM materials WHERE id=$1', array($mid));
        $onhand = WhOnHand($mid, $whId);
        if ($qty > $onhand + 0.00005) {
            throw new WhException('Stok ' . $m['material_name'] . ' di gudang (' . WhFmt($onhand) .
                ') tidak cukup untuk dikirim (' . WhFmt($qty) . ').');
        }
        $tot = 0.0;
        foreach (WhFifoAllocate($mid, $whId, $qty) as $ly) {
            WhQ("INSERT INTO material_out_items (material_out_id, material_id, qty_out, unit_cost, is_overbudget, notes)
                 VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'f',$5)",
                array($id, $mid, $ly['qty'], round($ly['unit_cost'], 2), 'Retur cacat: ' . $d['defect_type']));
            WhPostMovement($date, $mid, $whId, 'OUT', $ly['qty'], $ly['unit_cost'], ISSUE_REF_TYPE, $id, $refNo,
                           'Retur supplier ' . $rt['ref_no'], $userId);
            $tot += $ly['qty'] * $ly['unit_cost'];
        }
        WhQ('UPDATE supplier_return_dtl SET unit_cost=$2 WHERE id=$1', array((int)$d['id'], round($tot / $qty, 4)));
        $value += $tot;
    }
    
    JrnPost('RETURN_SUPPLIER', JRN_REF_RETURN, (int)$rt['id'], $date, $value, 'Retur supplier ' . $rt['ref_no'], $userId);

    WhQ("UPDATE material_out_header SET status='posted', issue_date=$2, received_by_mandor=$3, delivery_date=$2,
                delivery_note_no=$4, delivery_receiver=$5, delivery_proof=$6 WHERE id=$1",
        array($id, $date, $carrier, $sjNo, $receiver, $proof !== '' ? $proof : null));      
    WhQ("UPDATE supplier_return_hdr SET status='Dikirim', sent_date=$2, carrier=$3, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1",
        array((int)$rt['id'], $date, $carrier));
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    WhOk('Pengiriman dikonfirmasi. No. Surat Jalan: ' . $sjNo . '. Stok keluar dari gudang dan retur ' . $rt['ref_no'] . ' berstatus Dikirim.', array('delivery_note_no' => $sjNo));   
}

function IssUploadProof() {
    WhRequirePost();
    WhUserId();                                              
    if (empty($_FILES['file']) || $_FILES['file']['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
        $code = isset($_FILES['file']['error']) ? (int)$_FILES['file']['error'] : -1;
        throw new WhException('File gagal diunggah (kode ' . $code . '). Cek batas upload_max_filesize / post_max_size di php.ini.');
    }
    $f = $_FILES['file'];
    if ($f['size'] > 5 * 1024 * 1024) { throw new WhException('Ukuran file maksimal 5 MB.'); }
    $allowed = array('jpg' => 'image/jpeg', 'jpeg' => 'image/jpeg', 'png' => 'image/png',
                     'webp' => 'image/webp', 'gif' => 'image/gif', 'pdf' => 'application/pdf');
    $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($f['name'], PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
    if (!isset($allowed[$ext])) { throw new WhException('Tipe file tidak diizinkan. Gunakan JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF atau PDF.'); }
    if (function_exists('finfo_open')) {                     
        $fi = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
        $mime = finfo_file($fi, $f['tmp_name']);
        finfo_close($fi);
        if ($mime !== $allowed[$ext]) { throw new WhException('Isi file tidak sesuai dengan ekstensinya.'); }
    }
    $dir = dirname(__DIR__) . '/uploads/delivery';
    if (!is_dir($dir) && !@mkdir($dir, 0755, true)) {
        throw new WhException('Folder uploads/delivery tidak bisa dibuat. Buat manual dan beri izin tulis untuk user web server.');
    }
    $ht = $dir . '/.htaccess';                               
    if (!file_exists($ht)) {
        @file_put_contents($ht, "<FilesMatch \"\\.(php|phtml|phar|pl|cgi)$\">\n    Require all denied\n</FilesMatch>\n");   // [FIX-HTACCESS] tanda kutip penutup pola FilesMatch sebelumnya hilang ($\>)
    }
    $name = 'dlv_' . date('Ymd_His') . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4)) . '.' . $ext;
    if (!move_uploaded_file($f['tmp_name'], $dir . '/' . $name)) {
        throw new WhException('Gagal menyimpan file. Cek izin tulis folder uploads/delivery.');
    }
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'url' => '/proyek/uploads/delivery/' . $name, 'name' => $name));
}

// [BACKFILL-RETUR][NEW] Backfill sekali jalan: jurnal retur supplier (Dr GRN Clearing / Cr Persediaan, rule RETURN_SUPPLIER)
// untuk retur yang sudah dikirim (issue posted) tetapi belum punya jurnal -- yaitu retur yang dikirim sebelum fitur jurnal ada.
// Idempotent (retur yang sudah berjurnal dilewati). Satu transaksi: gagal satu (mis. periode ditutup) = batal semua.
// Tanggal jurnal = tanggal kirim (delivery_date, bila kosong issue_date).
function IssBackfillReturnJournal() {
    $userId = WhUserId();       // tanpa WhRequirePost: dibuka lewat URL (GET); aman karena idempotent + wajib FormAccess >= 3
    if (intval(isset($_SESSION['FormAccess']) ? $_SESSION['FormAccess'] : 0) < 3) { throw new WhException('Akses ditolak.'); }
    WhQ('BEGIN');
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT r.id, r.ref_no, COALESCE(mo.delivery_date, mo.issue_date, r.sent_date) AS jdate,
                           COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.qty_out*i.unit_cost) FROM material_out_items i WHERE i.material_out_id=mo.id),0) AS total
                    FROM supplier_return_hdr r
                    JOIN material_out_header mo ON mo.id=r.material_out_id AND mo.status='posted'
                    WHERE r.status IN ('Dikirim','Diganti','Kredit')
                      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries je
                                       WHERE je.reference_type::text=$1 AND je.reference_id=r.id)
                    ORDER BY jdate ASC, r.id ASC", array(JRN_REF_RETURN));
    $done = array(); $skipped = array();
    foreach ($rows as $r) {
        $jid = JrnPost('RETURN_SUPPLIER', JRN_REF_RETURN, (int)$r['id'], $r['jdate'], $r['total'],
                       'Retur supplier ' . $r['ref_no'], $userId);
        if ($jid) { $done[] = $r['ref_no']; } else { $skipped[] = $r['ref_no']; }     // nilai 0 -> tidak dijurnal
    }
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    $msg = count($done) . ' jurnal retur diposting' . (count($done) ? ': ' . implode(', ', $done) : '.');
    if (count($skipped)) { $msg .= ' | dilewati (nilai 0): ' . implode(', ', $skipped); }
    WhOk($msg, array('posted' => $done, 'skipped' => $skipped));
}

==================== FILE: ./router.php ====================
<?php
/**
 * Security patch for legacy ProyekGMN router.
 * Compatible with PHP 7.x.
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/php-func/app.url.php';

ini_set('pcre.jit', '0');

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

function router_is_ajax_request()
{
    $requestedWith = isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH'])
        ? strtolower($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) : '';
    $accept = isset($_SERVER['HTTP_ACCEPT']) ? $_SERVER['HTTP_ACCEPT'] : '';

    return ($requestedWith === 'xmlhttprequest')
        || (strpos($accept, 'application/json') !== false);
}

function router_respond_denied($status, $message)
{
    http_response_code($status);
    if (router_is_ajax_request()) {
        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
        echo json_encode(array('success' => false, 'message' => $message));
    } else {
        echo htmlspecialchars($message, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
    }
    exit;
}

function router_require_login()
{
    if (empty($_SESSION['user_id']) || !is_numeric($_SESSION['user_id'])
        || intval($_SESSION['user_id']) <= 0) {
        if (router_is_ajax_request()) {
            router_respond_denied(401, 'Session telah berakhir. Silakan login kembali.');
        }
        header('Location: ' . rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') . '/index.php');
        exit;
    }
}

function router_normalize_menu_path($value)
{
    $value = trim((string)$value);
    if ($value === '') {
        return '';
    }
    $value = str_replace('\\', '/', $value);
    return strtolower(basename($value));
}

/**
 * Map a direct CRUD/PDF endpoint to its parent view menu.
 * A successful match means the user has access to the menu, not necessarily
 * permission for every operation. CRUD handlers must still enforce operation
 * permissions (read/create/update/delete/post/reverse) server-side.
 */
function router_authorize_endpoint($db, $userId, $endpointType, $fileName)
{
    $candidates = array();
    $base = basename($fileName);

    if ($endpointType === 'crud') {
        if (preg_match('/CRD\.php$/i', $base)) {
            $candidates[] = preg_replace('/CRD\.php$/i', '.php', $base);
        }
        // Explicit aliases for legacy endpoints whose parent menu filename differs.
        $legacyAliases = array(
            'project.invoiceCRD.php' => array('project.invoice.php', 'projectinvoice.php'),
            'projectprogressCRD.php' => array('project.progress.php', 'project.progress.m.php'),
            'ppn.backfillCRD.php'    => array('ppn.report.php'),
            'm.taxexchangerate.pdf.php' => array('m.taxexchangerate.php'),
        );
        if (isset($legacyAliases[$base])) {
            $candidates = array_merge($candidates, $legacyAliases[$base]);
        }
    } elseif ($endpointType === 'pdf') {
        $candidates[] = $base; // wrapper file inside /pdf
        if (preg_match('/\.pdf\.php$/i', $base)) {
            $candidates[] = preg_replace('/\.pdf\.php$/i', '.php', $base);
        }
    }

    $candidates = array_values(array_unique(array_filter($candidates)));
    if (!$candidates) {
        return false;
    }

    $sql = "
        SELECT f.id, f.title, f.php_url, u.access_level
        FROM m_form_name f
        INNER JOIN m_user_access_menu u ON u.form_id = f.id
        WHERE u.user_id = :user_id
          AND COALESCE(u.access_level, 0) > 0
        ORDER BY u.access_level ASC, f.id ASC
    ";
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    $stmt->execute(array('user_id' => $userId));

    while ($row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
        $menuFile = router_normalize_menu_path($row['php_url']);
        if ($menuFile !== '' && in_array($menuFile, array_map('strtolower', $candidates), true)) {
            $_SESSION['FormAccess'] = $row['access_level'];
            $_SESSION['form_id'] = intval($row['id']);
            $_SESSION['current_menu_id'] = intval($row['id']);
            return $row;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

router_require_login();

$requestPath = parse_url(isset($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI']) ? $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] : '/', PHP_URL_PATH);
$requestMethod = isset($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD']) ? strtoupper($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD']) : 'GET';
$userId = intval($_SESSION['user_id']);

require_once __DIR__ . '/php-class/crudClass.php';
if (function_exists('app_require_active_user')) {
    app_require_active_user();
}
if (function_exists('app_require_same_origin_post')) {
    app_require_same_origin_post();
}

try {
    $db = new crud();

    // Direct PDF/report endpoint: authenticate AND authorize against parent menu.
    if (preg_match('~(?:^|/)pdf/([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.php)$~i', $requestPath, $matches)) {
        $pdfName = $matches[1];
        $pdfPath = realpath(__DIR__ . '/pdf/' . $pdfName);
        $pdfRoot = realpath(__DIR__ . '/pdf');

        if (!$pdfPath || !$pdfRoot || strpos($pdfPath, $pdfRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) !== 0
            || !is_file($pdfPath)) {
            router_respond_denied(404, 'File laporan tidak ditemukan.');
        }

        if (!router_authorize_endpoint($db, $userId, 'pdf', $pdfName)) {
            router_respond_denied(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk laporan ini.');
        }

        chdir(dirname($pdfPath));
        require $pdfPath;
        exit;
    }

    // Direct CRUD endpoint: authenticate AND authorize against parent menu.
    if (preg_match('~(?:^|/)php-crud/([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.php)$~i', $requestPath, $matches)) {
        $crudName = $matches[1];
        $crudPath = realpath(__DIR__ . '/php-crud/' . $crudName);
        $crudRoot = realpath(__DIR__ . '/php-crud');

        if (!$crudPath || !$crudRoot || strpos($crudPath, $crudRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) !== 0
            || !is_file($crudPath)) {
            router_respond_denied(404, 'Endpoint tidak ditemukan.');
        }

        
        $isDashboardApi = (strcasecmp($crudName, 'dashboardCRD.php') === 0);

        if (
            !$isDashboardApi &&
            !router_authorize_endpoint($db, $userId, 'crud', $crudName)
        ) {
            router_respond_denied(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke modul ini.');
        }

        chdir(dirname($crudPath));
        require $crudPath;
        exit;
    }

    // Normal view routing. Do not use stale session menu id as authorization
    // when the request explicitly supplies a different or invalid menu id.
    $formId = 0;
    if (isset($_REQUEST['menu_id']) && is_numeric($_REQUEST['menu_id'])) {
        $formId = intval($_REQUEST['menu_id']);
    } elseif (isset($_REQUEST['form_id']) && is_numeric($_REQUEST['form_id'])) {
        $formId = intval($_REQUEST['form_id']);
    } elseif (isset($_GET['id']) && is_numeric($_GET['id'])) {
        $formId = intval($_GET['id']);
    } elseif (isset($_GET['menu']) && is_numeric($_GET['menu'])) {
        $formId = intval($_GET['menu']);
    } elseif (isset($_SESSION['current_menu_id'])) {
        $formId = intval($_SESSION['current_menu_id']);
    }

    if ($formId <= 0) {
        router_respond_denied(400, 'Parameter menu ID tidak valid.');
    }

    $sql = "
        SELECT f.id, f.title, f.php_url, u.access_level
        FROM m_form_name f
        INNER JOIN m_user_access_menu u ON u.form_id = f.id
        WHERE f.id = :form_id
          AND u.user_id = :user_id
          AND COALESCE(u.access_level, 0) > 0
        LIMIT 1
    ";
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    $stmt->execute(array('form_id' => $formId, 'user_id' => $userId));
    $formData = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    if (!$formData) {
        router_respond_denied(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki izin untuk membuka halaman ini.');
    }

    $targetFile = trim((string)$formData['php_url']);
    if ($targetFile === '' || strpos($targetFile, "\0") !== false) {
        router_respond_denied(404, 'File tujuan belum dikonfigurasi.');
    }

    // Resolve only inside /views; reject traversal and symlink escape.
    $viewRoot = realpath(__DIR__ . '/views');
    $relative = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $targetFile), '/');
    $relative = preg_replace('~^(?:\.\./|php/)+~i', '', $relative);
    $viewPath = realpath(__DIR__ . '/views/' . $relative);

    if (!$viewRoot || !$viewPath || strpos($viewPath, $viewRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) !== 0
        || !is_file($viewPath) || strtolower(pathinfo($viewPath, PATHINFO_EXTENSION)) !== 'php') {
        router_respond_denied(404, 'File halaman tidak ditemukan pada lokasi yang diizinkan.');
    }

    $_SESSION['FormAccess'] = $formData['access_level'];
    $_SESSION['form_id'] = intval($formData['id']);
    $_SESSION['current_menu_id'] = intval($formData['id']);

    chdir($viewRoot);
    ob_start();
    include $viewPath;
    $htmlOutput = ob_get_clean();

    $appBase = rtrim(BASE_URL, '/');

    $patterns = array(
        '="../css/'       => '="' . $appBase . '/css/',
        '="../js/'        => '="' . $appBase . '/js/',
        '="../js-ext/'    => '="' . $appBase . '/js-ext/',
        '="../pdf/'       => '="' . $appBase . '/pdf/',
        '="../tcpdf_new/' => '="' . $appBase . '/tcpdf_new/',
        '="../js-func/'   => '="' . $appBase . '/js-func/',
        '="../php-crud/'  => '="' . $appBase . '/php-crud/'
    );

    echo strtr($htmlOutput, $patterns);
    exit;

} catch (Exception $e) {
    error_log('Router security patch error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    router_respond_denied(500, 'Terjadi kesalahan server saat memproses permintaan.');
}

// Smooth scroll
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
anchor.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
if (target) {
e.preventDefault();
target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
}
});
});
// Fade-in animation
const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
entries.forEach(entry => {
if (entry.isIntersecting) {
entry.target.style.opacity = '1';
entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
}
});
}, { threshold: 0.1 });
document.querySelectorAll('.feature-card, .glass').forEach(el => {
el.style.opacity = '0';
el.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease';
observer.observe(el);
});
</script>

<?php
// Include file fungsi dasar dan class database yang digunakan sistem
require_once __DIR__ . '/php-class/crudClass.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/php-func/function.all.php';

// Inisialisasi koneksi database
$db = new crud();

try {
    // 1. PASTIKAN USERNAME INI SESUAI DENGAN YANG ANDA KETIK DI HALAMAN LOGIN
    $username = 'demo'; 
    $new_password = 'xyz789';

    // 2. Cek enkripsi yang dipakai aplikasi Anda
    // Jika sistem login Anda memakai md5 murni, langsung gunakan md5($new_password)
    $encrypted_password = function_exists('EncodeData') ? EncodeData($new_password) : md5($new_password);

    // Cek apakah user tersedia di tabel m_user_system
    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id, login_name FROM m_user_system WHERE login_name = :username");
    $stmt->execute(['username' => $username]);
    $user = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    if ($user) {
        $user_id = $user['id'];
        $actual_username = $user['login_name'];

        // Update password user di database
        $updateQuery = "UPDATE m_user_system SET password = :password WHERE id = :id";
        $updateStmt = $db->prepare($updateQuery);
        $updateResult = $updateStmt->execute([
            'password' => $encrypted_password,
            'id' => $user_id
        ]);

        // Cek apakah ada baris data di database yang benar-benar berubah
        if ($updateStmt->rowCount() > 0) {
            echo "<h3>Berhasil! Password untuk user <b>'" . htmlspecialchars($actual_username) . "'</b> telah diperbarui menjadi <b>" . htmlspecialchars($new_password) . "</b>.</h3>";
            echo "<p>Hasil enkripsi yang masuk ke database: <code>" . htmlspecialchars($encrypted_password) . "</code></p>";
            echo "<p style='color:red;'><b>PENTING:</b> Silakan hapus file ini demi keamanan setelah selesai digunakan.</p>";
        } else {
            echo "<h3>Informasi: Query berhasil dijalankan, namun password tidak berubah.</h3>";
            echo "<p>Hal ini terjadi kemungkinan karena password baru yang Anda input (setelah dienkripsi) <b>sama persis</b> dengan password lama yang sudah ada di database.</p>";
        }
    } else {
        echo "<h3>Gagal: User dengan nama login <b>'" . htmlspecialchars($username) . "'</b> tidak ditemukan di dalam tabel m_user_system.</h3>";
        
        // Menampilkan list user yang tersedia di database untuk mempermudah pengecekan Anda
        echo "<p><b>Daftar user yang ada di database Anda:</b></p><ul>";
        $list = $db->query("SELECT login_name FROM m_user_system LIMIT 10")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        foreach ($list as $row) {
            echo "<li>" . htmlspecialchars($row['login_name']) . "</li>";
        }
        echo "</ul>";
    }

} catch (Exception $e) {
    echo "<h3>Terjadi kesalahan sistem saat memperbarui password:</h3> " . $e->getMessage();
}
?>

==================== FILE: ./rab_project_security_patch_review/php-func/app.url.php ====================
<?php
/**
 * Application URL helper.
 * Compatible with PHP 7.x.
 */

if (!function_exists('app_detect_base_url')) {
    function app_detect_base_url()
    {
        $paths = array();

        if (!empty($_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'])) {
            $paths[] = parse_url($_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'], PHP_URL_PATH);
        }

        if (!empty($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'])) {
            $paths[] = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'], PHP_URL_PATH);
        }

        $internalDirs = 'views|php-crud|pdf|includes|php-func|php-class|css|js|js-ext|js-func|tcpdf_new';

        foreach ($paths as $path) {
            if (!$path) {
                continue;
            }

            $path = '/' . ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $path), '/');

            // Contoh: /rab-project/dev/views/router
            if (preg_match('~^(.*?)/(' . $internalDirs . ')(?:/|$)~i', $path, $matches)) {
                $root = rtrim($matches[1], '/');
                return ($root === '' ? '/' : $root . '/');
            }

            // Entry point di application root.
            if (preg_match('~^(.*?)/(?:index|router)\.php$~i', $path, $matches)) {
                $root = rtrim($matches[1], '/');
                return ($root === '' ? '/' : $root . '/');
            }
        }

        return '/';
    }
}

if (!defined('BASE_URL')) {
    define('BASE_URL', app_detect_base_url());
}

<?php
/**
 * Hardened legacy menu validation.
 * Keeps the existing PostgreSQL access lookup and sidebar generation.
 */
if (!defined('BASE_PATH')) {
    define('BASE_PATH', dirname(__DIR__));
}
require_once __DIR__ . '/app.url.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

include_once __DIR__ . '/function.all.php';
include_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

$requestPath = parse_url(isset($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI']) ? $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] : '/', PHP_URL_PATH);
$urlFile = basename($requestPath);

global $conn, $dbconn;
if (empty($conn)) {
    if (!empty($dbconn)) {
        $conn = $dbconn;
    } elseif (!empty($GLOBALS['dbconn'])) {
        $conn = $GLOBALS['dbconn'];
    } elseif (!empty($GLOBALS['conn'])) {
        $conn = $GLOBALS['conn'];
    }
}

$isAjax = (
    (!empty($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) &&
     strtolower($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) === 'xmlhttprequest')
    || (!empty($_SERVER['HTTP_ACCEPT']) &&
        strpos($_SERVER['HTTP_ACCEPT'], 'application/json') !== false)
);

if (empty($_SESSION['user_id']) || !is_numeric($_SESSION['user_id'])
    || intval($_SESSION['user_id']) <= 0) {
    if ($isAjax) {
        http_response_code(401);
        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
        echo json_encode(array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Session telah berakhir. Silakan login kembali.'));
        exit;
    }
    header('Location: ' . rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') . '/index.php');
    exit;
}

if (!$conn) {
    error_log('user.valid.php: PostgreSQL connection is unavailable.');
    http_response_code(500);
    exit('Terjadi kesalahan koneksi server. Silakan hubungi administrator.');
}

$userId = intval($_SESSION['user_id']);
$formId = 0;

if (isset($_REQUEST['menu_id']) && is_numeric($_REQUEST['menu_id'])) {
    $formId = intval($_REQUEST['menu_id']);
} elseif (isset($_REQUEST['form_id']) && is_numeric($_REQUEST['form_id'])) {
    $formId = intval($_REQUEST['form_id']);
} elseif (
    preg_match('~(?:^|/)views/router/?$~i', $requestPath)
    && isset($_GET['id']) && ctype_digit((string)$_GET['id'])
) {
    // Legacy /views/router?id=<form_id>; do not confuse record ids with menu ids.
    $formId = intval($_GET['id']);
} elseif (isset($_SESSION['form_id']) && is_numeric($_SESSION['form_id'])) {
    $formId = intval($_SESSION['form_id']);
} elseif (isset($_SESSION['current_menu_id']) && is_numeric($_SESSION['current_menu_id'])) {
    $formId = intval($_SESSION['current_menu_id']);
}

$formAccess = null;

if ($formId > 0) {
    $sql = 'SELECT access_level FROM m_user_access_menu WHERE user_id = $1 AND form_id = $2 LIMIT 1';
    $result = pg_query_params($conn, $sql, array($userId, $formId));
    if ($result && pg_num_rows($result) > 0) {
        $row = pg_fetch_assoc($result);
        $formAccess = $row['access_level'];
    }
}

// Fallback untuk halaman lama yang dibuka berdasarkan nama file.
// CRUD direct request tetap harus divalidasi oleh router/endpoint; jangan
// mengandalkan fallback nama file ini sebagai otorisasi operasi.
if ($formAccess === null) {
    $cleanUrlFile = preg_replace('/CRD\.php$/i', '.php', $urlFile);
    $cleanUrlFile = preg_replace('/\.pdf\.php$/i', '.php', $cleanUrlFile);

    $sql = "
        SELECT a.access_level, b.id AS real_form_id
        FROM m_user_access_menu a
        INNER JOIN m_form_name b ON a.form_id = b.id
        WHERE a.user_id = $1
          AND (LOWER(BTRIM(b.php_url)) = LOWER($2)
               OR LOWER(BTRIM(b.php_url)) = LOWER($3))
          AND COALESCE(a.access_level, 0) > 0
        LIMIT 1
    ";
    $result = pg_query_params($conn, $sql, array($userId, $urlFile, $cleanUrlFile));

    if ($result && pg_num_rows($result) > 0) {
        $row = pg_fetch_assoc($result);
        $formAccess = $row['access_level'];
        if ($formId <= 0) {
            $formId = intval($row['real_form_id']);
        }
    }
}

if ($formAccess === null || intval($formAccess) <= 0 || $formId <= 0) {
    if ($isAjax) {
        http_response_code(403);
        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
        echo json_encode(array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak: Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke modul ini.'));
        exit;
    }
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Akses ditolak: Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke modul ini.');
}

$_SESSION['FormAccess'] = $formAccess;
$_SESSION['form_id'] = $formId;
$_SESSION['current_menu_id'] = $formId;

// Build sidebar links only for the active page request.
if (isset($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD']) && $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'GET') {
    $linkMenu = '';
    $sql = "
      SELECT g.seq, g.name, f.title, f.php_url
      FROM m_form_links l
      LEFT JOIN m_form_name f ON f.id = l.link_form_id
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id, name, COALESCE(remark, '') AS remark, seq
        FROM (
          (SELECT d.id, h.name || ' -- ' || d.name AS name, d.remark, d.seq
           FROM m_form_group d
           LEFT JOIN (
             SELECT name, seq FROM m_form_group WHERE SUBSTRING(seq, 3, 2) = '00'
           ) h ON SUBSTRING(h.seq, 1, 2) = SUBSTRING(d.seq, 1, 2)
           WHERE SUBSTRING(d.seq, 3, 2) <> '00' AND SUBSTRING(d.seq, 1, 2) <> '00')
          UNION
          (SELECT h.id, h.name, h.remark, seq
           FROM m_form_group h
           WHERE SUBSTRING(seq, 3, 2) = '00' AND SUBSTRING(seq, 1, 2) <> '00')
        ) data
        ORDER BY seq
      ) g ON g.id = f.group_id
      WHERE l.form_id = $1
      ORDER BY g.seq, f.title
    ";

    $result = pg_query_params($conn, $sql, array($formId));
    if ($result && pg_num_rows($result) > 0) {
        $currentGroup = null;
        while ($row = pg_fetch_assoc($result)) {
            $groupName = isset($row['name']) ? $row['name'] : '';
            $seq = isset($row['seq']) ? $row['seq'] : '';

            if ($seq !== $currentGroup) {
                if ($groupName !== '') {
                    $linkMenu .= '<div id="groupMenu">' . htmlspecialchars($groupName, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '</div>';
                    $linkMenu .= '<div class="Hline-separatorMid"></div>';
                }
                $currentGroup = $seq;
            }

            $targetUrl = !empty($row['php_url']) ? $row['php_url'] : '#';
            $title = isset($row['title']) ? $row['title'] : '';
            $linkMenu .= '<a href="' . htmlspecialchars($targetUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8')
                . '" target="_blank">' . htmlspecialchars($title, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '</a>';
        }
    }
    $_SESSION['linkMenu'] = $linkMenu;
}

==================== FILE: ./rab_project_security_patch_review/views/logout.php ====================
<?php
// views/logout.php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/app.url.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

// Ambil user_id dari session
$user_id = $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null;

if ($user_id) {
    // Pastikan path ke crudClass.php sesuai dengan struktur folder Anda
    require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';
    $db = new crud();
    
    try {
        // Update status login berdasarkan user_id (bukan id primary key tabel login_status)
        // Sesuai schema: m_user_login_status memiliki kolom user_id sebagai FK
        $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE m_user_login_status SET login_status = false, login_terminal = NULL WHERE user_id = :user_id");
        $stmt->execute(['user_id' => $user_id]);
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        // Jika gagal update (misal user tidak ada di tabel status), abaikan dan tetap lanjut logout
        error_log("Logout DB Error: " . $e->getMessage());
    }
}

// Hapus semua data session
$_SESSION = array();

// Hapus cookie session jika ada
if (ini_get("session.use_cookies")) {
    $params = session_get_cookie_params();
    setcookie(session_name(), '', time() - 42000,
        $params["path"], $params["domain"],
        $params["secure"] ?? false, $params["httponly"] ?? true
    );
}

// Destroy session
session_destroy();

// Redirect to the application root without trusting the Host header.
header('Location: ' . rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') . '/index.php');
exit;

    function pickDefaultPeriod(store) {
        var d = new Date(), m = d.getMonth() + 1, day = d.getDate();
        var today = d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : m) + '-' + (day < 10 ? '0' + day : day);
        var idx = store.findBy(function (r) { return r.get('start_date') <= today && today <= r.get('end_date'); });
        return store.getAt(idx >= 0 ? idx : 0).get('id');
    }

            load: function (store) {
                if (store.getCount() > 0 && !fldPeriod.getValue()) {

    function renderBSView(res) {

==================== FILE: ./js/project.payment.list.print.js ====================
(function () {
    'use strict';
    var endpoint = window.PAYMENT_LIST_CRD_URL || '../php-crud/project.paymentCRD.php';
    var status = document.getElementById('listStatus');
    var table = document.getElementById('paymentTable');
    var rowsEl = document.getElementById('paymentRows');

    function esc(v) {
        return String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v)
            .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
            .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }
    function num(v) { var n = parseFloat(v); return isFinite(n) ? n : 0; }
    function money(v) {
        return num(v).toLocaleString('id-ID', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
    }
    function dateId(v) {
        if (!v) return '-';
        var s = String(v).substring(0, 10), p = s.split('-');
        return p.length === 3 ? p[2] + '/' + p[1] + '/' + p[0] : esc(v);
    }
    function methodLabel(v) {
        var labels = { BANK_TRANSFER: 'Transfer Bank', CASH: 'Tunai', GIRO: 'Giro', CEK: 'Cek' };
        return labels[String(v || '').toUpperCase()] || v || '-';
    }
    function loadPage(start, all, total) {
        var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        var body = 'task=list_payments&start=' + encodeURIComponent(start) + '&limit=250';
        xhr.open('POST', endpoint, true);
        xhr.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8');
        xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Requested-With', 'XMLHttpRequest');
        xhr.onreadystatechange = function () {
            if (xhr.readyState !== 4) return;
            var res;
            try { res = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText); }
            catch (e) { fail('Respons server tidak valid.'); return; }
            if (xhr.status < 200 || xhr.status >= 300 || !res.success || !Array.isArray(res.data)) {
                fail((res && res.message) || 'Gagal memuat daftar pembayaran.');
                return;
            }
            Array.prototype.push.apply(all, res.data);
            total = parseInt(res.totalCount, 10) || all.length;
            if (all.length < total && res.data.length) {
                loadPage(all.length, all, total);
                return;
            }
            render(all);
        };
        xhr.onerror = function () { fail('Tidak dapat terhubung ke server.'); };
        xhr.send(body);
    }
    function fail(message) {
        status.textContent = message;
        status.style.color = '#b42318';
    }
    function render(data) {
        if (!data.length) {
            status.textContent = 'Belum ada data pembayaran.';
            return;
        }
        var totalIdr = 0;
        rowsEl.innerHTML = data.map(function (r) {
            totalIdr += num(r.total_amount);
            return '<tr><td>' + esc(r.payment_no || '-') + '</td><td>' + dateId(r.payment_date) +
                '</td><td>' + esc(r.client_name || '-') + '</td><td>' + esc(r.project_names || '-') +
                '</td><td>' + esc(methodLabel(r.payment_method)) + '</td><td>' + esc(r.currency_code || 'IDR') +
                '</td><td class="num">' + money(r.total_amount_cur !== undefined ? r.total_amount_cur : r.total_amount) +
                '</td><td class="num">' + money(r.allocated_amount) + '</td><td class="num">' + money(r.excess_amount) +
                '</td><td>' + esc(r.reference_no || '-') + '</td></tr>';
        }).join('');
        document.getElementById('grandTotal').textContent = money(totalIdr);
        status.hidden = true;
        table.hidden = false;
    }
    document.getElementById('btnPrintList').addEventListener('click', function () { window.print(); });
    document.getElementById('btnCloseList').addEventListener('click', function () { window.close(); });
    loadPage(0, [], 0);
})();
