    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        if (!fClient || !fClient.getValue()) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Client wajib dipilih.'); return; }
        if (!fDate.getValue()) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Tanggal bayar wajib diisi.'); return; }
        if (!fAccount.getValue() && !(depIdr() > 0 && numVal(fTotal) <= 0)) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Akun Kas/Bank wajib dipilih.'); return; }   // [DEPOSIT] lunas penuh dari deposit tanpa kas
        var cid = fClient.getValue();
        if (!isBaseCur(curId()) && !(curRate() > 0)) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Kurs wajib diisi.'); return; }

        var arr = [], alloc = 0, err = '';
        outDs.each(function (r) {
            var pay = round2(r.get('pay'));
            if (pay <= 0) return;
            if (pay > maxPay(round2(r.get('remaining'))) + VEPS) {
                err = err || ('Termin ' + r.get('inv_no') + ': bayar melebihi sisa tagihan.');
                return;
            }
            arr.push({ invoice_id: r.get('invoice_id'), amount_paid: pay });
            alloc += pay;
        });
        if (err) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', err); return; }
        alloc = round2(alloc);
        if (!arr.length) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Isi "Bayar Sekarang" minimal pada satu termin.'); return; }

        var total = round2(fTotal.getValue());
        if (total <= 0 && depIdr() <= 0) total = alloc;                                          // [DEPOSIT]
        if (total + depCur() + VEPS < alloc) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Kas diterima + deposit lebih kecil dari total alokasi.'); return; }
        var excess = round2(total + depCur() - alloc);

        var doSave = function () {
            ajax({
                task: 'save_payment',
                client_id: cid,
                currency_id: curId() || 0,
                exch_rate: curRate(),
                payment_date: fDate.getValue().dateFormat('Y-m-d'),
                account_id: fAccount.getValue() || 0,
                payment_method: fMethod.getValue() || 'BANK_TRANSFER',
                total_amount: total,
                deposit_apply: depIdr(),                                                           // [DEPOSIT]
                reference_no: fRef.getValue(),
                notes: fNotes.getValue(),
                items: Ext.util.JSON.encode(arr)
            }, function (res) {
                if (res.success) {
                    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    mainDs.load();
                    var newId = res.data && res.data.id;
                    if (newId) {
                        dataRecord = { id: newId };
                        updateMainButtons();
                        loadDetailPanel(newId);
                        Ext.Msg.confirm('Sukses', (res.message || 'Berhasil disimpan.') + '<br/><br/>Cetak tanda terima sekarang?', function (btn) {
                            if (btn === 'yes') printReceipt(newId);
                        });
                    } else {
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message || 'Berhasil disimpan.');
                    }
                } else {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
                    loadOutstanding(cid);
                }
            });
        };

        if (excess > VEPS) {
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi Lebih Bayar',
                'Jumlah diterima melebihi alokasi sebesar <b>' + fmtAmt(excess) + ' ' + curCode() + '</b>. Lanjutkan simpan?',
                function (btn) { if (btn === 'yes') doSave(); });
        } else {
            doSave();
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih pembayaran terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_EDIT) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Tidak memiliki hak akses.');
            return;
        }
        Ext.Msg.confirm('Hapus Pembayaran',
            'Hapus pembayaran <b>' + enc(dataRecord.payment_no || '') + '</b>? Saldo termin akan dikembalikan.',
            function (btn) {
                if (btn !== 'yes') return;
                ajax({ task: 'delete_payment', id: dataRecord.id }, function (res) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) {
                        dataRecord = null;
                        dtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                        mainDs.load();
                        updateMainButtons();
                    }
                });
            });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        if (document.getElementById('popCancel')) {
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';

    projectDs.load();
    clientDs.load();
    currencyDs.load();
    accountDs.load();
});
==================== FILE: ./js/stock.transfer.js ====================
/*
  Document    : stock.transfer.js
  Description : Stock Transfer antar gudang. ExtJS 3.4.1
  Backend     : php-crud/stock.transferCRD.php
  CATATAN     : container render diasumsikan div #main-content (fallback ke body).
*/
Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();

    var URL = 'php-crud/stock.transferCRD.php';
    var RENDER_TO = Ext.get('main-content') ? 'main-content' : Ext.getBody();
    var dataRecord = null;

    function showErr(msg) { Ext.Msg.show({ title: 'Peringatan', msg: msg, buttons: Ext.Msg.OK, icon: Ext.Msg.WARNING }); }
    function fmtQty(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
    function fmtAmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function storeError(proxy, type, action, opt, res) {
        var m = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        if (res && res.message) { m = res.message; } else if (res && res.status) { m += ' (HTTP ' + res.status + ')'; }
        showErr(m);
    }
    function ajaxPost(params, okCb) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: URL, method: 'POST', params: params,
            success: function (r) {
                var o;
                try { o = Ext.decode(r.responseText); } catch (e) { showErr('Respon server tidak valid.'); return; }
                if (!o.success) { showErr(o.message || 'Proses gagal.'); return; }
                okCb(o);
            },
            failure: function (r) { showErr('Koneksi ke server gagal (HTTP ' + r.status + ').'); }
        });
    }
    function statusRenderer(v) {
        return '<span style="color:' + (v === 'posted' ? '#2e9e4f' : '#c0392b') + ';font-weight:bold;">' + enc(v) + '</span>';
    }

    // ---------------- grid utama ----------------
    mainDs = new Ext.data.JsonStore({      // assignment polos (konvensi template)
        url: URL, baseParams: { action: 'list' }, root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount', idProperty: 'id',
        fields: ['id', 'ref_no', 'transfer_date', 'from_warehouse_id', 'from_warehouse_name',
                 'to_warehouse_id', 'to_warehouse_name', 'status', 'remark',
                 { name: 'total_qty', type: 'float' }, { name: 'total_amount', type: 'float' }],
        listeners: { exception: storeError }
    });
    var searchField = new Ext.form.TextField({
        emptyText: 'Cari No / Gudang...', width: 200, enableKeyEvents: true,
        listeners: { specialkey: function (f, e) { if (e.getKey() === e.ENTER) { doSearch(); } } }
    });
    function doSearch() { mainDs.baseParams.query = searchField.getValue(); mainDs.load({ params: { start: 0, limit: 25 } }); }

    new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs, renderTo: RENDER_TO, title: 'Stock Transfer',
        height: Math.max(420, Ext.getBody().getViewSize().height - 140), loadMask: true, stripeRows: true,
        sm: new Ext.grid.RowSelectionModel({ singleSelect: true }), viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. Transfer', dataIndex: 'ref_no', width: 110 },
            { header: 'Tanggal', dataIndex: 'transfer_date', width: 85, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Gudang Asal', dataIndex: 'from_warehouse_name', width: 160 },
            { header: 'Gudang Tujuan', dataIndex: 'to_warehouse_name', width: 160 },
            { header: 'Total Qty', dataIndex: 'total_qty', width: 100, align: 'right', renderer: fmtQty },
            { header: 'Nilai', dataIndex: 'total_amount', width: 110, align: 'right', renderer: fmtAmt },
            { header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 80, align: 'center', renderer: statusRenderer }
        ],
        tbar: [
            { text: 'Tambah Transfer', handler: function () { openEditor(); } },
            { text: 'Detail', handler: function () {
                if (!dataRecord) { showErr('Pilih dokumen terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
                openDetail(dataRecord);
            } },
            { text: 'Reverse', handler: function () {
                if (!dataRecord) { showErr('Pilih dokumen terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
                if (dataRecord.status !== 'posted') { showErr('Hanya dokumen posted yang dapat di-reverse.'); return; }
                Ext.Msg.confirm('Reverse Transfer', 'Reverse <b>' + enc(dataRecord.ref_no) + '</b>? Stok dikembalikan ke gudang asal.',
                    function (b) {
                        if (b !== 'yes') { return; }
                        ajaxPost({ action: 'reverse', id: dataRecord.id }, function (o) {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', o.message); dataRecord = null; mainDs.reload();
                        });
                    });
            } },
            '->', searchField, { text: 'Cari', handler: doSearch }
        ],
        bbar: new Ext.PagingToolbar({ store: mainDs, pageSize: 25, displayInfo: true }),
        listeners: { rowclick: function (g, i) { var r = g.getStore().getAt(i); dataRecord = r ? r.data : null; } }
    });
    mainDs.load({ params: { start: 0, limit: 25 } });

    // ---------------- detail ----------------
    function openDetail(rec) {
        var ds = new Ext.data.JsonStore({
            url: URL, baseParams: { action: 'detail', id: rec.id }, root: 'data',
            fields: ['material_code', 'material_name', 'unit', { name: 'qty', type: 'float' },
                     { name: 'unit_cost', type: 'float' }, { name: 'amount', type: 'float' }],
            listeners: { exception: storeError }
        });
        new Ext.Window({
            title: 'Detail Transfer ' + rec.ref_no, width: 760, height: 360, modal: true, layout: 'fit',
            items: new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
                store: ds, stripeRows: true, viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
                columns: [
                    { header: 'Kode', dataIndex: 'material_code', width: 90 },
                    { header: 'Material', dataIndex: 'material_name', width: 220 },
                    { header: 'Sat', dataIndex: 'unit', width: 50, align: 'center' },
                    { header: 'Qty', dataIndex: 'qty', width: 100, align: 'right', renderer: fmtQty },
                    { header: 'Biaya Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit_cost', width: 100, align: 'right', renderer: fmtAmt },
                    { header: 'Nilai', dataIndex: 'amount', width: 110, align: 'right', renderer: fmtAmt }
                ]
            })
        }).show();
        ds.load();
    }

    // ---------------- editor ----------------
    var whDs = new Ext.data.JsonStore({
        url: URL, baseParams: { action: 'lookup_warehouses' }, root: 'data', fields: ['id', 'code', 'name', 'project_name'],
        listeners: { exception: storeError }
    });
    var itemDs = new Ext.data.JsonStore({
        url: URL, baseParams: { action: 'lookup_items' }, root: 'data',
        fields: ['item_id', 'material_code', 'material_name', 'unit', { name: 'onhand', type: 'float' }],
        listeners: { exception: storeError }
    });
    gridAddEditorDs = new Ext.data.JsonStore({      // store detail editor
        root: 'data', fields: ['item_id', 'material_code', 'material_name', 'unit',
            { name: 'qty', type: 'float' }, { name: 'onhand', type: 'float' }]
    });

    function openEditor() {
        gridAddEditorDs.removeAll();
        var wtpl = '<tpl for="."><div class="x-combo-list-item">{name} <span style="color:#888;">[{project_name}]</span></div></tpl>';
        var fFrom = new Ext.form.ComboBox({ fieldLabel: 'Gudang Asal', store: whDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id',
            mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, anchor: '95%', tpl: wtpl });
        var fTo = new Ext.form.ComboBox({ fieldLabel: 'Gudang Tujuan', store: whDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id',
            mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, anchor: '95%', tpl: wtpl });
        var fDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), allowBlank: false, width: 120 });
        var fRemark = new Ext.form.TextField({ fieldLabel: 'Catatan', anchor: '95%' });

        fFrom.on('select', function () { gridAddEditorDs.removeAll(); fItem.clearValue(); });

        var fItem = new Ext.form.ComboBox({
            store: itemDs, displayField: 'material_name', valueField: 'item_id', mode: 'remote', queryParam: 'query',
            minChars: 0, triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, width: 380, listWidth: 480,
            emptyText: 'Cari item yang berstok di gudang asal...',
            tpl: '<tpl for="."><div class="x-combo-list-item">{material_code} - {material_name} <b>(stok {onhand} {unit})</b></div></tpl>',
            listeners: {
                beforequery: function () {
                    if (!fFrom.getValue()) { showErr('Pilih gudang asal terlebih dahulu.'); return false; }
                    itemDs.baseParams.warehouse_id = fFrom.getValue();
                }
            }
        });
        function addItem() {
            var rec = fItem.findRecord('item_id', fItem.getValue());
            if (!rec) { showErr('Pilih item terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
            if (gridAddEditorDs.find('item_id', rec.get('item_id')) >= 0) { showErr('Item sudah ada di daftar.'); return; }
            var R = gridAddEditorDs.recordType;
            gridAddEditorDs.add(new R({
                item_id: rec.get('item_id'), material_code: rec.get('material_code'), material_name: rec.get('material_name'),
                unit: rec.get('unit'), qty: rec.get('onhand'), onhand: rec.get('onhand')
            }));
            fItem.clearValue();
        }

        var detailGrid = new Ext.grid.EditorGridPanel({
            region: 'center', store: gridAddEditorDs, clicksToEdit: 1, stripeRows: true, viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
            tbar: [fItem, { text: 'Tambah', handler: addItem }],
            columns: [
                { header: 'Kode', dataIndex: 'material_code', width: 90 },
                { header: 'Material', dataIndex: 'material_name', width: 230 },
                { header: 'Sat', dataIndex: 'unit', width: 50, align: 'center' },
                { header: 'Stok Asal', dataIndex: 'onhand', width: 100, align: 'right', renderer: fmtQty },
                { header: 'Qty Transfer', dataIndex: 'qty', width: 100, align: 'right', renderer: fmtQty,
                  editor: new Ext.form.NumberField({ allowNegative: false, decimalPrecision: 4 }) },
                { header: '', dataIndex: 'item_id', width: 30, align: 'center', fixed: true,
                  renderer: function () { return '<span style="color:#e05353;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;">&#10005;</span>'; } }
            ],
            listeners: {
                validateedit: function (e) {
                    if (e.field === 'qty' && parseFloat(e.value) > e.record.get('onhand') + 0.00005) {
                        showErr('Qty melebihi stok gudang asal (' + fmtQty(e.record.get('onhand')) + ').');
                        e.cancel = true;
                    }
                },
                cellclick: function (g, row, col) { if (col === g.getColumnModel().getColumnCount() - 1) { g.getStore().removeAt(row); } }
            }
        });

        var form = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
            region: 'north', height: 110, border: false, layout: 'column', bodyStyle: 'padding:8px 6px 0 6px;',
            items: [
                { columnWidth: 0.5, layout: 'form', border: false, labelWidth: 110, items: [fFrom, fTo] },
                { columnWidth: 0.5, layout: 'form', border: false, labelWidth: 90, items: [fDate, fRemark] }
            ]
        });

        var win = new Ext.Window({
            title: 'Stock Transfer Baru', width: 900, height: 560, modal: true, layout: 'border',
            items: [form, detailGrid],
            buttons: [
                { text: 'Simpan & Posting', handler: function () {
                    if (!fFrom.getValue() || !fTo.getValue() || !fDate.getValue()) { showErr('Gudang asal, tujuan, dan tanggal wajib diisi.'); return; }
                    if (fFrom.getValue() === fTo.getValue()) { showErr('Gudang asal dan tujuan tidak boleh sama.'); return; }
                    var arr = [], err = '';
                    gridAddEditorDs.each(function (r) {
                        var q = parseFloat(r.get('qty')) || 0;
                        if (q <= 0) { err = 'Qty transfer ' + r.get('material_name') + ' harus lebih besar dari 0.'; return false; }
                        arr.push({ item_id: r.get('item_id'), qty: q });
                    });
                    if (err) { showErr(err); return; }
                    if (!arr.length) { showErr('Tambahkan minimal satu item.'); return; }
                    ajaxPost({
                        action: 'save', from_warehouse_id: fFrom.getValue(), to_warehouse_id: fTo.getValue(),
                        transfer_date: fDate.getValue().format('Y-m-d'), remark: fRemark.getValue(),
                        details: Ext.util.JSON.encode(arr)
                    }, function (o) { win.close(); Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', o.message); mainDs.reload(); });
                } },
                { text: 'Batal', handler: function () { win.close(); } }
            ]
        });
        win.show();
        whDs.load();
    }
});

/*
  Document      : projectinvoice.js
  Description   : Tagihan Klien (invoice termin proyek).  [MENU-RENAME 2026-11-15] label "Tagihan ke Klien" -> "Tagihan Klien"; id menu 156 & rute lama tidak berubah.
                   Alur: SIMPAN invoice (DRAFT, internal) -> RELEASE tagihan
                   (terbit dokumen TAG-... yang diserahkan ke client; jurnal penagihan posting; invoice baru muncul di
                   modul Project Payment) -> client membayar -> kelebihan bayar jadi deposit client.
                   Grid utama = daftar invoice (status dokumen DRAFT/TERBIT + status Belum Bayar / Sebagian / Lunas,
                   jatuh tempo); klik baris -> panel detail (pembayaran yang masuk, faktur pajak, cetak).
                   Add/Edit membuka editor standar template (editorWdw, seperti PO).
                   Nilai yang diinput = DPP; PPN Keluaran default 11% (0 = tanpa PPN); total tagihan = DPP + PPN.
                   Ubah / hapus hanya untuk invoice DRAFT yang belum ada pembayaran. Ringkasan di atas grid = dasar
                   proyeksi arus kas penerimaan (hanya tagihan yang sudah diterbitkan).
  Backend       : php-crud/project.invoiceCRD.php
  [CHANGED]     : form Terbitkan/Ubah Invoice dipindah dari Ext.Window (tombol Ext tak terbaca di tema gelap) ke editorWdw template
                   dengan tombol SAVE/DISCARD standar, tata letak seperti header PO. Checkbox 'Kenakan PPN' (tak terlihat di tema gelap)
                   diganti pilihan Ya/Tidak. Tombol jendela Faktur Pajak memakai tombol HTML gaya standar (teal / burgundy).
  [RELEASE-LAYER 2026-11-14] : tambah satu layer monitor & release tagihan ke client. Invoice baru = DRAFT (tidak muncul di
                   Pembayaran Termin). Tombol Release Tagihan / Batalkan Release / Release Semua (filter) di filter bar;
                   kolom grid "Dokumen Tagihan" menampilkan nomor TAG + tanggal terbit atau DRAFT; kartu "Belum Diterbitkan"
                   memantau nilai draft. Hanya invoice TERBIT yang dapat dibayar klien.
*/

    var TOP_DEFAULT_DAYS = 30;           // termin pembayaran default (hari) untuk jatuh tempo; bisa diubah per invoice
    var VEPS = 0.01;

    var dataRecord = null;               // baris invoice terpilih

    function getFormAccess() { return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0); }
    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function fmtAmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    function round2(v) { return Math.round((parseFloat(v) || 0) * 100) / 100; }
    function showErr(msg) { Ext.Msg.show({ title: 'Peringatan', msg: msg, buttons: Ext.Msg.OK, icon: Ext.Msg.WARNING }); }
    function ymd(d) { return d ? d.dateFormat('Y-m-d') : ''; }
    // [CHANGED] tombol HTML gaya standar UI (putih tebal, padding 8px 20px, radius 4px); primer teal #066b78, batal burgundy #800020
    function uiBtn(id, label, bg) {
        return '<button type="button" id="' + id + '" style="margin-left:8px;padding:8px 20px;background:' + bg +
               ';color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;">' + label + '</button>';
    }

    function ajax(params, onOk, onFail) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD, method: 'POST', params: params,
            success: function (response) {
                var res;
                try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); }
                catch (e) { showErr('Respons server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).'); return; }
                onOk(res);
            },
            failure: function () { if (onFail) onFail(); else showErr('Gagal menghubungi server.'); }
        });
    }
    function storeError(proxy, type, action, opt, res) {
        var m = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        if (res && res.message) { m = res.message; }
        else if (res && res.status) { m += ' (HTTP ' + res.status + ')'; }
        showErr(m);
    }

    function statusColor(v) {
        return { 'Lunas': '#00ff4c', 'Sebagian': '#e6a817', 'Belum Bayar': '#2bc1e2' }[v] || '#ffffff';
    }
    // [RELEASE-LAYER] warna status dokumen: DRAFT = kuning (internal), TERBIT = hijau (resmi ke client)
    function relColor(s) { return s === 'released' ? '#2e9e4f' : '#e6a817'; }

    function renderCards(s) {
        s = s || {};
        var card = function (cls, lb, v) { return '<div class="ti-card ' + cls + '"><div class="lb">' + lb + '</div><div class="vl">' + fmtAmt(v) + '</div></div>'; };
        document.getElementById('tiCards').innerHTML =
            // [RELEASE-LAYER] kartu DRAFT memantau tagihan yang belum diterbitkan ke client
            card('warn', 'Belum Diterbitkan (' + (s.draft_count || 0) + ' dok)', s.draft_value) +

            card('warn', 'Lewat Jatuh Tempo', s.overdue) + card('soon', 'Jatuh Tempo 30 Hari', s.due_30) + card('', 'Tanpa Jatuh Tempo', s.no_due);
    }

        columns: [

                header: 'Dokumen Tagihan', dataIndex: 'release_no', width: 145,                       // [GRID-WRAP] 150 -> 145 (sudah muat TAG-... + tgl 2 baris)

            {

                renderer: function (v, meta, r) {
                    if (!v) return '<span style="color:#668894;">-</span>';
                    return r.get('is_overdue') ? '<span style="color:#ff6b5e;font-weight:bold;">' + enc(v) + ' (+' + r.get('days_overdue') + ' hr)</span>' : enc(v);
                }
            },
            { header: 'Client', dataIndex: 'client_name', width: 160, renderer: function (v) { return CellWrap(v || '-'); } },  // [GRID-WRAP] 150 -> 160
            { header: 'Proyek', dataIndex: 'project_name', width: 190, renderer: CellWrap },          // [GRID-WRAP] 180 -> 190
            { header: 'Termin', dataIndex: 'termin_name', width: 130, renderer: CellWrap },           // [GRID-WRAP] 110 -> 130
            { header: 'DPP', dataIndex: 'dpp_amount', width: 130, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return fmtAmt(v); } },        // [GRID-WRAP] 105 -> 130 (nominal panjang)
            { header: 'PPN', dataIndex: 'ppn_amount', width: 110, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return v > 0 ? fmtAmt(v) : '-'; } },  // [GRID-WRAP] 90 -> 110
            { header: 'Total Tagihan', dataIndex: 'amount', width: 140, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return '<b>' + fmtAmt(v) + '</b>'; } },  // [GRID-WRAP] 115 -> 140
            { header: 'Terbayar', dataIndex: 'paid_amount', width: 130, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return fmtAmt(v); } },   // [GRID-WRAP] 105 -> 130
            { header: 'Sisa', dataIndex: 'remaining', width: 130, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return v > VEPS ? '<b>' + fmtAmt(v) + '</b>' : '-'; } },  // [GRID-WRAP] 105 -> 130
            {
                header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 105, align: 'center',                   // [GRID-WRAP] 90 -> 105 (Belum Bayar / Sebagian)
                renderer: function (v) { return '<span style="color:' + statusColor(v) + ' !important;font-weight:bold;">' + enc(v) + '</span>'; }
            }
        ],
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (!rec) return;
                dataRecord = rec.data;
                updateMainButtons();
                loadDetailPanel(dataRecord.id);
            }
        }
    });

    function updateMainButtons() {
        mainBtnEnable('#addData');
        var rel = dataRecord ? String(dataRecord.release_status || 'draft') : '';                 // [RELEASE-LAYER]
        if (dataRecord && rel === 'draft' && !(dataRecord.paid_amount > VEPS)) {       // hanya DRAFT tanpa pembayaran yang boleh diubah / dihapus
            mainBtnEnable('#editData');
            mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
        } else {
            mainBtnDisable('#editData');
            mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
        }
        // [RELEASE-LAYER] tombol release aktif sesuai status dokumen baris terpilih
        var canRel = getFormAccess() >= ACCESS_EDIT;
        if (canRel && dataRecord && rel === 'draft') mainBtnEnable('#tiRelease'); else mainBtnDisable('#tiRelease');
        if (canRel && dataRecord && rel === 'released' && !(dataRecord.paid_amount > VEPS)) mainBtnEnable('#tiUnrelease'); else mainBtnDisable('#tiUnrelease');
        if (canRel) mainBtnEnable('#tiReleaseAll'); else mainBtnDisable('#tiReleaseAll');
    }
    editDataDisable();
    updateMainButtons();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Panel detail (pembayaran yang masuk + aksi)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function loadDetailPanel(id) {
        ajax({ task: 'load_invoice', id: id }, function (res) {
            if (!res.success) {
                dtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow; padding:10px;">' + enc(res.message || 'Gagal memuat detail invoice.') + '</div>';
                dtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            renderDetailPanel(res.data);
        }, function () {
            dtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red; padding:10px;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
            dtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
        });
    }

    function renderDetailPanel(d) {
        var h = d.header, pays = d.payments || [];
        var st = h.remaining <= VEPS ? 'Lunas' : (h.paid_amount > VEPS ? 'Sebagian' : 'Belum Bayar');
        // [RELEASE-LAYER] informasi dokumen tagihan di panel detail
        var relLine = (h.release_status === 'released')
            ? 'Dokumen tagihan: <b>' + enc(h.release_no || '-') + '</b> (' + enc(h.release_date || '-') + ')' + (h.released_by_name ? ' oleh ' + enc(h.released_by_name) : '')
            : '<span style="color:#e6a817;font-weight:bold;">DRAFT</span> <span style="color:#6b869a;">- belum diterbitkan ke client (tidak muncul di Pembayaran Termin)</span>';
        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Invoice: ' + enc(h.inv_no) + ' <span style="color:' + statusColor(st) + ';">(' + st + ')</span></h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<div style="padding:4px 2px 10px 2px;">Client: <b>' + enc(h.client_name || '-') + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Proyek: <b>' + enc(h.project_name) +
                   '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Termin: <b>' + enc(h.termin_name) + '</b>' + (h.percentage > 0 ? ' (' + h.percentage + '% kontrak)' : '') +
                   ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Tanggal: <b>' + enc(h.invoice_date) + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Jatuh tempo: <b>' + enc(h.due_date || '-') + '</b>' +
                   ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Faktur pajak: <b>' + (h.ppn_amount > 0 ? (h.faktur_pajak_no ? enc(h.faktur_pajak_no) : '<span style="color:#e6a817;">belum diisi</span>') : 'tanpa PPN') + '</b>' +
                   ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; ' + relLine +
                   (h.release_note ? ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Catatan terbit: <b>' + enc(h.release_note) + '</b>' : '') +
                   (h.remark ? ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Catatan: ' + enc(h.remark) : '') + '</div>' +
                   '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0"><thead><tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Keterangan</th><th align="right">Jumlah (IDR)</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
                   '<tr class="data-row"><td>DPP</td><td align="right">' + fmtAmt(h.dpp_amount) + '</td></tr>';
        if (h.ppn_amount > 0) html += '<tr class="data-row"><td>PPN Keluaran ' + h.ppn_rate + '%</td><td align="right">' + fmtAmt(h.ppn_amount) + '</td></tr>';
        html += '<tr class="data-row"><td><b>Total Tagihan</b></td><td align="right" class="subtotal-val"><b>' + fmtAmt(h.amount) + '</b></td></tr>';
        Ext.each(pays, function (p) {
            html += '<tr class="data-row"><td style="color:#2e9e4f;">Pembayaran ' + enc(p.payment_no) + ' (' + enc(p.payment_date) + ')</td><td align="right" style="color:#2e9e4f;">- ' + fmtAmt(p.amount_paid) + '</td></tr>';
        });
        html += '<tr class="data-row"><td><b>Sisa Tagihan</b></td><td align="right" class="subtotal-val"><b>' + fmtAmt(h.remaining) + '</b></td></tr></tbody></table>';

        html += '<div style="margin-top:15px; text-align:right;">';
        // [RELEASE-LAYER] aksi release / batal release juga tersedia di panel detail
        if (h.release_status === 'released' && !(h.paid_amount > VEPS)) {
            html += '<button type="button" class="tiActBtn" data-act="unrelease" style="margin-left:8px; padding:8px 16px; background:#800020; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold;">Batalkan Release</button>';
        } else if (h.release_status !== 'released') {
            html += '<button type="button" class="tiActBtn" data-act="release" style="margin-left:8px; padding:8px 16px; background:#03615e; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold;">Release Tagihan</button>';
        }
        if (h.ppn_amount > 0) html += '<button type="button" class="tiActBtn" data-act="faktur" style="margin-left:8px; padding:8px 16px; background:#8e6b22; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold;">Faktur Pajak</button>';
        html += '<button type="button" class="tiActBtn" data-act="print" style="margin-left:8px; padding:8px 16px; background:#03615e; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold;">Cetak Invoice</button></div>';
        dtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        dtlDiv.style.display = 'block';

        var btns = dtlDiv.querySelectorAll('.tiActBtn');
        for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) {
            btns[i].onclick = function () {
                var act = this.getAttribute('data-act');
                if (act === 'print') printInvoice(h.id);
                else if (act === 'release') doRelease(h.id);
                else if (act === 'unrelease') doUnrelease(h.id);
                else editFaktur(h);
            };
        }
    }

    function printInvoice(id) {
        window.open('../dev/pdf/project.invoice.php?id=' + id, '_blank', 'width=900,height=800,scrollbars=yes,resizable=yes');
    }

    // [RELEASE-LAYER] terbitkan / batalkan dokumen tagihan satu invoice
    function doRelease(id) {
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_EDIT) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses.'); return; }
        // [RELEASE-LAYER] catatan penerbitan opsional (maks 200 karakter)
        Ext.Msg.prompt('Release Tagihan', 'Catatan penerbitan (opsional, maks 200 karakter):', function (btn, note) {
            if (btn !== 'ok') return;
            note = String(note || '').trim();
            if (note.length > 200) { showErr('Catatan penerbitan terlalu panjang (maksimal 200 karakter).'); return; }
            ajax({ task: 'release_invoice', id: id, release_note: note }, function (res) {
                Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                if (res.success) {
                    mainDs.load();
                    if (dataRecord && dataRecord.id === id) loadDetailPanel(id);
                }
            });
        });
    }
    function doUnrelease(id) {
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_EDIT) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses.'); return; }
        Ext.Msg.confirm('Batalkan Release', 'Kembalikan invoice ini ke DRAFT? Dokumen tagihan ' + enc(dataRecord && dataRecord.release_no || '') +
            ' tidak lagi berlaku dan tagihan hilang dari Pembayaran Termin.', function (btn) {
            if (btn !== 'yes') return;
            ajax({ task: 'unrelease_invoice', id: id }, function (res) {
                Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                if (res.success) { mainDs.load(); loadDetailPanel(id); }
            });
        });
    }

    // Isi / ubah faktur pajak keluaran
    function editFaktur(h) {
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_EDIT) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses.'); return; }
        var fNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Faktur Pajak', anchor: '95%', maxLength: 30, value: h.faktur_pajak_no || '' });
        var fDt = new Ext.form.DateField({
            fieldLabel: 'Tgl Faktur Pajak', format: 'd/m/Y', width: 130, allowBlank: true,
            value: h.faktur_pajak_date ? Date.parseDate(h.faktur_pajak_date, 'Y-m-d') : ''
        });
        // [CHANGED] tombol HTML gaya standar (Ext.Button bawaan tak terlihat di tema gelap)
        var win = new Ext.Window({
            title: 'Faktur Pajak - ' + h.inv_no, width: 420, height: 250, modal: true, layout: 'fit',
            items: new Ext.form.FormPanel({
                border: false, labelWidth: 120, bodyStyle: 'padding:12px;',
                items: [{ xtype: 'displayfield', hideLabel: true,
                          value: 'PPN Keluaran <b>' + fmtAmt(h.ppn_amount) + '</b> (DPP ' + fmtAmt(h.dpp_amount) +
                                 '). Tanggal faktur menentukan masa pajak di Laporan PPN. Kosongkan nomor untuk menghapus.' }, fNo, fDt]
            }),
            bbar: ['->', { xtype: 'tbtext', text: uiBtn('tiFpSave', 'Simpan', '#066b78') + uiBtn('tiFpCancel', 'Batal', '#800020') }]
        });
        win.show();
        document.getElementById('tiFpCancel').onclick = function () { win.close(); };
        document.getElementById('tiFpSave').onclick = function () {
            var no = fNo.getValue(), dt = fDt.getValue();        // baca nilai sebelum win.close()
            ajax({ task: 'update_faktur_pajak', id: h.id, faktur_pajak_no: no, faktur_pajak_date: ymd(dt) }, function (res) {
                Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                if (res.success) { win.close(); mainDs.load(); loadDetailPanel(h.id); }
            });
        };
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Editor invoice (editorWdw template, seperti PO): form header 2 baris + bar ringkasan
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var editing = false;                 // true = ubah invoice, false = invoice baru
    var curRec = null;                   // invoice yang sedang diubah
    var dueManual = false;               // jatuh tempo diubah manual / dimuat dari invoice -> jangan ditimpa TOP
    var hdrForm = null, hdrForm2 = null;
    var fClient, fProject, fName, fDate, fTop, fDue, fPct, fAmt, fPpnOn, fPpnRate, fFpNo, fFpDate, fRemark;

    // Tempat form header + bar ringkasan; grid template (editorFormGrid) tidak dipakai -> disembunyikan
    (function injectExtraUI() {
        var g = document.getElementById('editorFormGrid');
        var host = g ? g.parentNode : document.getElementById('editorWdw');
        if (!host || document.getElementById('tiHdrForm')) return;

        var hdr = document.createElement('div');
        hdr.id = 'tiHdrForm';
        hdr.style.cssText = 'margin-bottom:2px;';
        var hdr2 = document.createElement('div');
        hdr2.id = 'tiHdrForm2';
        hdr2.style.cssText = 'margin-bottom:8px;';
        var bar = document.createElement('div');
        bar.id = 'tiInfoBar';
        bar.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px; margin-top:8px; font-size:13px; text-align:right; background:#1f2d3a; color:#ffffff !important; border-radius:4px;';

        if (g) {
            host.insertBefore(hdr, g); host.insertBefore(hdr2, g); host.insertBefore(bar, g);
            g.style.display = 'none';
        } else {
            host.appendChild(hdr); host.appendChild(hdr2); host.appendChild(bar);
        }
    })();

    function curProject() { return fProject && fProject.getValue() ? projectDs.getById(fProject.getValue()) : null; }
    function taxed() { return fPpnOn.getValue() === '1'; }
    function curRate() { return taxed() ? (parseFloat(fPpnRate.getValue()) || 0) : 0; }
    function syncDue() {
        if (dueManual) return;
        var d = fDate.getValue(), n = parseInt(fTop.getValue(), 10);
        if (d && n >= 0) fDue.setValue(d.add(Date.DAY, n)); else fDue.setValue('');
    }
    function recalcFromPct() {                    // nilai kontrak x persen -> DPP
        var p = curProject(), pct = parseFloat(fPct.getValue()) || 0;
        if (p && p.get('contract_value') > 0 && pct > 0) fAmt.setValue(round2(p.get('contract_value') * pct / 100));
    }
    function refresh() {
        var bar = document.getElementById('tiInfoBar');
        if (!bar) return;
        var p = curProject(), dpp = round2(parseFloat(fAmt.getValue()) || 0), r = curRate(), ppn = round2(dpp * r / 100);
        var msg = '';
        if (p) {
            var cv = p.get('contract_value'), billed = p.get('billed_dpp') - (editing ? (curRec.dpp_amount || 0) : 0);
            msg += '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#9fc3d1;">Nilai kontrak <b>' + fmtAmt(cv) + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; sudah ditagih (DPP) <b>' + fmtAmt(billed) +
                   '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; sisa kontrak <b>' + fmtAmt(Math.max(cv - billed - dpp, 0)) + '</b>';
            if (cv > 0 && billed + dpp > cv + VEPS) msg += ' <span style="color:#ff6b5e;">(melebihi nilai kontrak)</span>';
            msg += '</div>';
        }
        msg += '<div style="margin-top:4px;"><b>Total Tagihan: ' + fmtAmt(round2(dpp + ppn)) + '</b> ' +
               '<span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:normal;color:#9fc3d1;">&nbsp;(DPP ' + fmtAmt(dpp) + ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; PPN ' + r + '% ' + fmtAmt(ppn) + ')</span></div>';
        bar.innerHTML = msg;
    }

    // Form dibuat saat editor dibuka pertama kali (container hidden -> lebar kolom 0 bila dirender lebih awal)
    function ensureForm() {
        if (hdrForm) { hdrForm.doLayout(); hdrForm2.doLayout(); return; }

        fClient = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Client', store: clientDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all',
            forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, anchor: '95%',
            listeners: { select: function () {                          // proyek hanya milik client terpilih (filterBy: cocok persis, bukan awalan)
                var cid = String(fClient.getValue());
                projectDs.clearFilter();
                projectDs.filterBy(function (r) { return String(r.get('client_id')) === cid; });
                fProject.clearValue(); refresh();
            } }
        });
        fProject = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Proyek', store: projectDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all',
            forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, anchor: '95%',
            listeners: { select: function () { recalcFromPct(); refresh(); } }
        });
        fName = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Nama Termin', anchor: '95%', allowBlank: false });
        fDate = new Ext.form.DateField({
            fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Invoice', format: 'd/m/Y', width: 130, allowBlank: false, value: new Date(),
            listeners: { select: function () { syncDue(); }, change: function () { syncDue(); } }
        });
        fTop = new myNumberField({
            fieldLabel: 'TOP (hari)', decimalPrecision: 0, allowNegative: false, width: 70, value: TOP_DEFAULT_DAYS,
            listeners: { change: function () { dueManual = false; syncDue(); } }
        });
        fDue = new Ext.form.DateField({
            fieldLabel: 'Jatuh Tempo', format: 'd/m/Y', width: 130, allowBlank: true,
            listeners: { select: function () { dueManual = true; }, change: function () { dueManual = !!fDue.getValue(); } }
        });
        fPct = new myNumberField({
            fieldLabel: '% dari Kontrak', decimalPrecision: 2, allowNegative: false, width: 90,
            listeners: { change: function () { recalcFromPct(); refresh(); } }
        });
        fAmt = new myNumberField({
            fieldLabel: 'Nilai Invoice (DPP)', decimalPrecision: 2, allowNegative: false, width: 160, value: 0,
            listeners: { change: function () { refresh(); } }
        });
        // [CHANGED] pilihan Ya/Tidak (bukan checkbox: checkbox bawaan tak terlihat di tema gelap)
        fPpnOn = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Kenakan PPN', store: new Ext.data.ArrayStore({ fields: ['v', 't'], data: [['1', 'Ya'], ['0', 'Tidak']] }),
            displayField: 't', valueField: 'v', mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, editable: false,
            value: '1', width: 90,
            listeners: { select: function () { fPpnRate.setDisabled(!taxed()); refresh(); } }
        });
        fPpnRate = new myNumberField({
            fieldLabel: 'Tarif PPN (%)', decimalPrecision: 2, width: 90, allowNegative: false, value: PPN_DEFAULT_RATE,
            listeners: { change: function () { refresh(); } }
        });
        fFpNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Faktur Pajak', anchor: '95%', emptyText: 'opsional, bisa diisi setelah terbit' });
        fFpDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tgl Faktur Pajak', format: 'd/m/Y', width: 130, allowBlank: true });
        fRemark = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Catatan', anchor: '95%' });

        var col = function (w, items) {
            return { columnWidth: w, layout: 'form', border: false, labelWidth: 110, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;', items: items };
        };
        hdrForm = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
            renderTo: 'tiHdrForm', border: false, layout: 'column',
            bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:4px 2px 0 2px;',
            items: [col(0.34, [fClient, fProject, fName]), col(0.33, [fDate, fTop, fDue]), col(0.33, [fPct, fAmt, fPpnOn, fPpnRate])]
        });
        hdrForm2 = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
            renderTo: 'tiHdrForm2', border: false, layout: 'column',
            bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:0 2px 4px 2px;',
            items: [col(0.34, [fFpNo]), col(0.33, [fFpDate]), col(0.33, [fRemark])]
        });
    }

    function showEditor(title) {
        var addWdw = document.getElementById('addWdw');      // jaga-jaga: window Add bawaan template jangan ikut terbuka
        if (addWdw) addWdw.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;' + enc(title);
        ensureForm();
    }

    // Isi form (setelah master client & proyek termuat)
    function fillForm(rec) {
        editing = !!rec;
        curRec = rec || null;
        dueManual = editing && !!rec.due_date;
        projectDs.clearFilter();

        fClient.setDisabled(editing);
        fProject.setDisabled(editing);
        if (editing) { fClient.setValue(rec.client_id); fProject.setValue(rec.project_id); }
        else { fClient.clearValue(); fProject.clearValue(); }

        fName.setValue(editing ? rec.termin_name : '');
        fDate.setValue(editing ? Date.parseDate(rec.invoice_date, 'Y-m-d') : new Date());
        fTop.setValue((editing && rec.due_date)
            ? Math.round((Date.parseDate(rec.due_date, 'Y-m-d') - Date.parseDate(rec.invoice_date, 'Y-m-d')) / 86400000) : TOP_DEFAULT_DAYS);
        fDue.setValue(editing && rec.due_date ? Date.parseDate(rec.due_date, 'Y-m-d') : '');
        fPct.setValue(editing && rec.percentage > 0 ? rec.percentage : '');
        fAmt.setValue(editing ? rec.dpp_amount : 0);

        var isTaxed = editing ? rec.ppn_amount > 0 : true;      // invoice baru: default kena PPN
        fPpnOn.setValue(isTaxed ? '1' : '0');
        fPpnRate.setValue(editing && rec.ppn_rate > 0 ? rec.ppn_rate : PPN_DEFAULT_RATE);
        fPpnRate.setDisabled(!isTaxed);

        fFpNo.setValue(editing ? (rec.faktur_pajak_no || '') : '');
        fFpDate.setValue(editing && rec.faktur_pajak_date ? Date.parseDate(rec.faktur_pajak_date, 'Y-m-d') : '');
        fRemark.setValue(editing ? (rec.remark || '') : '');

        if (!editing) syncDue();
        refresh();
    }

    function openEditor(rec) {                        // rec null = invoice baru
        showEditor(rec ? 'Ubah Invoice ' + rec.inv_no : 'Terbitkan Invoice ke Client');
        clientDs.load({ callback: function () { projectDs.load({ callback: function () { fillForm(rec); } }); } });
    }

    // SAVE (tombol template)
    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        if (!fProject || !fProject.getValue()) { showErr('Proyek wajib dipilih.'); return; }
        if (!fName.getValue()) { showErr('Nama termin wajib diisi.'); return; }
        if (!fDate.getValue()) { showErr('Tanggal invoice wajib diisi.'); return; }
        if (!(parseFloat(fAmt.getValue()) > 0)) { showErr('Nilai invoice (DPP) harus lebih dari 0.'); return; }
        if (fDue.getValue() && fDue.getValue() < fDate.getValue()) { showErr('Jatuh tempo tidak boleh lebih awal dari tanggal invoice.'); return; }
        if (taxed() && !(curRate() > 0 && curRate() <= 100)) { showErr('Tarif PPN harus lebih dari 0 dan maksimal 100%.'); return; }
        var p = {
            task: 'save_invoice', id: editing ? curRec.id : 0, project_id: fProject.getValue(), client_id: fClient.getValue() || (editing ? curRec.client_id : 0),
            termin_name: fName.getValue(), invoice_date: ymd(fDate.getValue()), due_date: ymd(fDue.getValue()),
            percentage: fPct.getValue(), amount: fAmt.getValue(), ppn_rate: curRate(),
            faktur_pajak_no: fFpNo.getValue(), faktur_pajak_date: ymd(fFpDate.getValue()), remark: fRemark.getValue()
        };
        ajax(p, function (res) {
            if (res.success) {
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message || 'Invoice tersimpan.');
                projectDs.load();            // total DPP yang sudah ditagih berubah
                mainDs.load();
                if (res.data && res.data.id) { dataRecord = { id: res.data.id, paid_amount: 0, release_status: 'draft' }; updateMainButtons(); loadDetailPanel(res.data.id); }
            } else {
                showErr(res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
            }
        });
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Handler tombol template
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_ADD) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menerbitkan invoice.'); return; }
        openEditor(null);
    };
    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih invoice terlebih dahulu dari tabel.'); return; }
        if (dataRecord.paid_amount > VEPS) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Invoice yang sudah ada pembayaran tidak dapat diubah.'); return; }
        if (String(dataRecord.release_status || 'draft') !== 'draft') { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Invoice sudah diterbitkan; batalkan release terlebih dahulu untuk mengubah.'); return; }
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_EDIT) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengubah invoice.'); return; }
        openEditor(dataRecord);
    };
    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih invoice terlebih dahulu dari tabel.'); return; }
        if (dataRecord.paid_amount > VEPS) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Invoice yang sudah ada pembayaran tidak dapat dihapus.'); return; }
        if (String(dataRecord.release_status || 'draft') !== 'draft') { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Invoice sudah diterbitkan; batalkan release terlebih dahulu sebelum menghapus.'); return; }
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_EDIT) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus invoice.'); return; }
        Ext.Msg.confirm('Hapus Invoice', 'Hapus invoice <b>' + enc(dataRecord.inv_no) + '</b>? Jurnal penagihannya ikut dibatalkan.', function (btn) {
            if (btn !== 'yes') return;
            ajax({ task: 'delete_invoice', id: dataRecord.id }, function (res) {
                Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                if (res.success) {
                    dataRecord = null;
                    dtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                    projectDs.load();
                    mainDs.load();
                    updateMainButtons();
                }
            });
        });
    };
    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih invoice terlebih dahulu dari tabel.'); return; }
        printInvoice(dataRecord.id);
    };
    if (document.getElementById('popOK')) {
        document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () { document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none'; };
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5b. [RELEASE-LAYER] Tombol release / batal release / release bulk di filter bar
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('tiRelease').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih invoice terlebih dahulu dari tabel.'); return; }
        if (String(dataRecord.release_status || 'draft') === 'released') { showErr('Invoice sudah diterbitkan (' + enc(dataRecord.release_no || '') + ').'); return; }
        if (dataRecord.paid_amount > VEPS) { showErr('Invoice sudah ada pembayaran.'); return; }
        Ext.Msg.confirm('Release Tagihan', 'Terbitkan dokumen tagihan untuk invoice <b>' + enc(dataRecord.inv_no) + '</b>? ' +
            'Jurnal penagihan diposting dan invoice masuk daftar tagihan di Pembayaran Termin.', function (btn) {
            if (btn === 'yes') doRelease(dataRecord.id);
        });
    };
    document.getElementById('tiUnrelease').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih invoice terlebih dahulu dari tabel.'); return; }
        if (String(dataRecord.release_status || 'draft') !== 'released') { showErr('Invoice belum diterbitkan.'); return; }
        if (dataRecord.paid_amount > VEPS) { showErr('Invoice sudah ada pembayaran; penerbitannya tidak dapat dibatalkan.'); return; }
        doUnrelease(dataRecord.id);
    };
    document.getElementById('tiReleaseAll').onclick = function () {
        var ids = [];
        mainDs.each(function (r) { if (String(r.get('release_status') || 'draft') === 'draft') ids.push(r.get('id')); });
        if (!ids.length) { showErr('Tidak ada invoice DRAFT pada filter aktif.'); return; }
        // [RELEASE-LAYER] catatan penerbitan opsional (maks 200 karakter), diterapkan ke semua invoice yang di-release
        Ext.Msg.prompt('Release Semua (filter aktif)', 'Catatan penerbitan (opsional, maks 200 karakter):', function (btn, note) {
            if (btn !== 'ok') return;
            note = String(note || '').trim();
            if (note.length > 200) { showErr('Catatan penerbitan terlalu panjang (maksimal 200 karakter).'); return; }
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Release Semua (filter aktif)', 'Terbitkan <b>' + ids.length + ' invoice DRAFT</b> yang sesuai filter Client/Status di layar ini? ' +
                'Dokumen tagihan (TAG-...) diterbitkan untuk semuanya dan jurnal penagihan diposting.', function (btn2) {
                if (btn2 !== 'yes') return;
                ajax({ task: 'release_invoices', ids: Ext.util.JSON.encode(ids), release_note: note }, function (res) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) mainDs.load();
                });
            });
        });
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. Data awal
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    clientDs.load({ callback: function () {
        var sel = document.getElementById('tiClient');
        clientDs.each(function (r) {
            var o = document.createElement('option');
            o.value = r.get('id'); o.text = r.get('name');
            sel.appendChild(o);
        });
    } });
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';

    loadMain();
});

/*
  Document      : settings.js
  Description   : Pengaturan Sistem. Empat tab:
                   1. Profil Perusahaan : nama, alamat, kontak, NPWP
                   2. Logo              : logo dokumen (kop cetak) & logo aplikasi (upload PNG/JPEG/WEBP, maks 1 MB)
                   3. Keuangan          : mata uang dasar (pembukuan) & mata uang laporan keuangan final,
                                          jenis kurs default, dasar kurs laba rugi, awal tahun fiskal, desimal
                   4. Dokumen           : footer & penandatangan + pratinjau kop dokumen
                  Transaksi (RAB, PO, dst) boleh multi currency; laporan keuangan final mengacu ke tab Keuangan.
  Backend       : /rab-project/dev/php-crud/settingsCRD.php
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Pengaturan <em>Sistem</em>";

    var CRD = '../php-crud/settingsCRD.php';
    var ACCESS_WRITE = 3;                       // harus sama dengan SET_ACCESS_WRITE di settingsCRD.php

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }
    var canWrite = getFormAccess() >= ACCESS_WRITE;

    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }

    function ajax(params, onOk) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: params,
            success: function (response) {
                var res;
                try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); }
                catch (e) { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Respons server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).'); return; }
                onOk(res);
            },
            failure: function () { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.'); }
        });
    }

    var settingsState = { company: {}, finance: null, lockReason: null };

    // Gaya ringan agar label & teks bantuan terbaca di tema gelap

        document.head.appendChild(st);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Stores lokal untuk combo
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var currencyDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, [
            { name: 'id' }, { name: 'init' }, { name: 'name' },
            { name: 'label', convert: function (v, r) { return r.init + ' - ' + r.name; } }
        ])
    });
    var rateTypeDs = new Ext.data.ArrayStore({
        fields: ['v', 't'],
        data: [['KMK', 'KMK - Kurs pajak (Kemenkeu)'], ['BI', 'BI - Kurs Bank Indonesia'], ['MANUAL', 'Manual']]
    });
    var basisDs = new Ext.data.ArrayStore({
        fields: ['v', 't'],
        data: [['TRANSACTION', 'Kurs saat transaksi'], ['AVERAGE', 'Kurs rata-rata periode'], ['PERIOD_END', 'Kurs akhir periode']]
    });
    var monthDs = new Ext.data.ArrayStore({
        fields: ['v', 't'],
        data: [[1, 'Januari'], [2, 'Februari'], [3, 'Maret'], [4, 'April'], [5, 'Mei'], [6, 'Juni'],
               [7, 'Juli'], [8, 'Agustus'], [9, 'September'], [10, 'Oktober'], [11, 'November'], [12, 'Desember']]
    });
    var decDs = new Ext.data.ArrayStore({ fields: ['v', 't'], data: [[0, '0'], [1, '1'], [2, '2'], [3, '3'], [4, '4']] });

    function combo(cfg, store, display, value) {
        return new myComboField(Ext.apply({
            store: store, displayField: display, valueField: value,
            mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, editable: false, anchor: '60%'
        }, cfg));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Tab 1: Profil Perusahaan
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fCompany  = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Nama Perusahaan *', maxLength: 150, allowBlank: false });
    var fLegal    = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Nama Legal (PT/CV)', maxLength: 200 });
    var fAddress  = new Ext.form.TextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Alamat', maxLength: 1000, height: 90, grow: false, emptyText: 'Alamat lengkap (boleh lebih dari satu baris)' });
    var fCity     = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Kota', maxLength: 100, anchor: '40%' });
    var fProvince = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Provinsi', maxLength: 100, anchor: '40%' });
    var fPostal   = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Kode Pos', maxLength: 20, anchor: '20%' });
    var fCountry  = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Negara', maxLength: 100, anchor: '40%' });
    var fPhone    = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Telepon', maxLength: 50, anchor: '40%' });
    var fEmail    = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Email', maxLength: 150, vtype: 'email', anchor: '50%' });
    var fWebsite  = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Website', maxLength: 150, anchor: '50%' });
    var fTax      = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'NPWP', maxLength: 50, anchor: '40%' });

    var companyForm = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
        labelWidth: 150, border: false, autoScroll: true,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:16px;',
        defaults: { anchor: '60%' },
        items: [
            { xtype: 'box', html: '<div class="set-note">Data ini dipakai sebagai <b>kop dokumen</b> (PO, invoice, laporan) dan header laporan keuangan.</div>' },
            fCompany, fLegal, fAddress, fCity, fProvince, fPostal, fCountry, fPhone, fEmail, fWebsite, fTax
        ],
        buttons: [{
            text: 'Simpan Profil', disabled: !canWrite,

                ajax({

                    city: fCity.getValue(), province: fProvince.getValue(), postal_code: fPostal.getValue(),
                    country: fCountry.getValue(), phone: fPhone.getValue(), email: fEmail.getValue(),
                    website: fWebsite.getValue(), tax_id: fTax.getValue()
                }, function (res) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) { reloadSettings(); }
                });

    function logoCard(type, title, hint) {
        return '<div class="logo-card">' +
               '<h4>' + title + '</h4><div class="hint">' + hint + '</div>' +
               '<div class="logo-box"><img id="logoImg_' + type + '" style="display:none" alt="" />' +
               '<span class="none" id="logoNone_' + type + '">Belum ada logo</span></div>' +
               '<input type="file" id="logoFile_' + type + '" accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp" ' + (canWrite ? '' : 'disabled') + ' style="color:#9fc3d1;margin-bottom:10px;" /><br />' +
               '<button type="button" class="btn-up" id="logoUp_' + type + '"' + (canWrite ? '' : ' disabled') + '>Unggah</button>' +
               '<button type="button" class="btn-del" id="logoDel_' + type + '"' + (canWrite ? '' : ' disabled') + '>Hapus</button>' +
               '</div>';
    }

    function showLogo(type) {
        var img = document.getElementById('logoImg_' + type), none = document.getElementById('logoNone_' + type);
        if (!img) return;
        var has = !!settingsState.company['has_logo_' + (type === 'document' ? 'document' : 'app')];
        if (!has) { img.style.display = 'none'; none.style.display = ''; return; }
        var v = settingsState.company['logo_' + (type === 'document' ? 'document' : 'app') + '_v'] || 0;
        img.onload = function () { img.style.display = ''; none.style.display = 'none'; };
        img.onerror = function () { img.style.display = 'none'; none.style.display = ''; };
        img.src = CRD + '?task=logo&type=' + type + '&v=' + v + '&_=' + new Date().getTime();
    }

    function wireLogo(type) {
        var file = document.getElementById('logoFile_' + type);
        document.getElementById('logoUp_' + type).onclick = function () {
            if (!file.files.length) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih file logo terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
            var f = file.files[0];
            if (['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'].indexOf(f.type) < 0) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Format logo harus PNG, JPEG, atau WEBP.'); return; }
            if (f.size > 1048576) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Ukuran logo maksimal 1 MB.'); return; }
            var fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('type', type);
            fd.append('file', f);
            fetch(CRD + '?task=upload_logo', { method: 'POST', body: fd, credentials: 'same-origin' })
                .then(function (r) { return r.text(); })
                .then(function (t) {
                    var res;
                    try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(t); } catch (e) { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Respons server tidak valid.'); return; }
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) { file.value = ''; reloadSettings(); }
                })
                .catch(function () { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.'); });
        };
        document.getElementById('logoDel_' + type).onclick = function () {
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Hapus Logo', 'Hapus logo ini?', function (btn) {
                if (btn !== 'yes') return;
                ajax({ task: 'delete_logo', type: type }, function (res) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) reloadSettings();
                });
            });
        };
    }

    var logoPanel = new Ext.Panel({
        border: false, autoScroll: true,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:16px;',
        html: '<div class="set-note">Format <b>PNG / JPEG / WEBP</b>, maksimal <b>1 MB</b> dan 4000 x 4000 piksel. PNG berlatar transparan paling cocok. SVG tidak didukung.</div>' +
              logoCard('document', 'Logo Dokumen', 'Tampil di kop PO, invoice, dan laporan cetak. Disarankan landscape / persegi, lebar minimal 400 px.') +
              logoCard('app', 'Logo Aplikasi', 'Dipakai di header aplikasi / halaman login. Disarankan persegi.'),
        listeners: {
            afterrender: function () { wireLogo('document'); wireLogo('app'); showLogo('document'); showLogo('app'); }
        }
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Tab 3: Keuangan
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fBase     = combo({ fieldLabel: 'Mata Uang Dasar (Pembukuan) *', allowBlank: false }, currencyDs, 'label', 'id');
    var fReport   = combo({ fieldLabel: 'Mata Uang Laporan Keuangan *', allowBlank: false }, currencyDs, 'label', 'id');
    var fRateType = combo({ fieldLabel: 'Jenis Kurs Default' }, rateTypeDs, 't', 'v');
    var fBasisPl  = combo({ fieldLabel: 'Kurs Laporan Laba Rugi' }, basisDs, 't', 'v');
    var fMonth    = combo({ fieldLabel: 'Awal Tahun Fiskal', anchor: '30%' }, monthDs, 't', 'v');
    var fDecimals = combo({ fieldLabel: 'Desimal Nilai Uang', anchor: '15%' }, decDs, 't', 'v');
    var fLockInfo = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ hideLabel: true, value: '' });

    var financeForm = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
        labelWidth: 230, border: false, autoScroll: true,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:16px;',
        defaults: { anchor: '60%' },
        items: [
            { xtype: 'box', html: '<div class="set-note">Transaksi (RAB, PO, penerimaan, dst) <b>boleh memakai banyak mata uang</b>. ' +
                'Semua nilai dikonversi ke <b>mata uang dasar</b> untuk pembukuan (jurnal, stok FIFO), dan ' +
                '<b>laporan keuangan final mengacu ke pengaturan ini</b>: ditampilkan dalam <b>mata uang laporan</b> memakai jenis dan dasar kurs di bawah. ' +
                'Bila mata uang laporan sama dengan mata uang dasar, tidak ada penjabaran kurs.</div>' },
            fBase, fLockInfo, fReport, fRateType, fBasisPl,
            { xtype: 'box', html: '<div class="set-note" style="margin-top:2px;">Neraca selalu memakai <b>kurs akhir periode</b>. ' +
                'Pilihan kurs untuk pembukuan (KMK atau BI) sebaiknya dipastikan dengan akuntan / konsultan pajak. ' +
                'Kurs otomatis di PO saat ini bersumber dari kurs pajak KMK dan mengasumsikan mata uang dasar IDR.</div>' },
            fMonth, fDecimals
        ],
        buttons: [{
            text: 'Simpan Pengaturan Keuangan', disabled: !canWrite,
            handler: function () {
                if (!financeForm.getForm().isValid()) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Mata uang dasar dan mata uang laporan wajib dipilih.'); return; }
                ajax({
                    task: 'save_finance',
                    base_currency_id: fBase.getValue(), report_currency_id: fReport.getValue(),
                    default_rate_type: fRateType.getValue(), rate_basis_pl: fBasisPl.getValue(),
                    fiscal_year_start_month: fMonth.getValue(), amount_decimals: fDecimals.getValue()
                }, function (res) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) reloadSettings();
                });
            }
        }]
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Tab 4: Dokumen (footer, penandatangan, pratinjau kop)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fFooter    = new Ext.form.TextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Footer Dokumen', maxLength: 1000, height: 90, grow: false, emptyText: 'Catatan kaki dokumen, mis. syarat pembayaran atau info rekening' });
    var fSignName  = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Nama Penandatangan', maxLength: 150, anchor: '40%' });
    var fSignTitle = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Jabatan Penandatangan', maxLength: 100, anchor: '40%' });
    var previewBox = new Ext.BoxComponent({ html: '' });

    function nl2br(v) { return enc(v).replace(/\r?\n/g, '<br />'); }

    function updateDocPreview() {
        var c = settingsState.company || {};
        var name = fCompany.getValue() || c.company_name || '(Nama perusahaan belum diisi)';
        var addr = [fAddress.getValue(), [fCity.getValue(), fProvince.getValue(), fPostal.getValue()].filter(Boolean).join(', '), fCountry.getValue()]
                       .filter(Boolean).map(nl2br).join('<br />');
        var contact = [fPhone.getValue() ? 'Telp: ' + enc(fPhone.getValue()) : '', fEmail.getValue() ? 'Email: ' + enc(fEmail.getValue()) : '',
                       fWebsite.getValue() ? enc(fWebsite.getValue()) : '', fTax.getValue() ? 'NPWP: ' + enc(fTax.getValue()) : '']
                       .filter(Boolean).join(' &nbsp;|&nbsp; ');
        var logo = c.has_logo_document
            ? '<img src="' + CRD + '?task=logo&type=document&v=' + (c.logo_document_v || 0) + '" alt="" />' : '';
        var html =
            '<div class="doc-preview">' +
            '<div class="head">' + logo + '<div><div class="co">' + enc(name) + '</div><div class="ad">' + addr +
            (contact ? '<br />' + contact : '') + '</div></div></div>' +
            '<div class="body">( isi dokumen )</div>' +
            ((fSignName.getValue() || fSignTitle.getValue())
                ? '<div class="sign">' + enc(fSignTitle.getValue()) + '<br /><br /><br /><b>' + enc(fSignName.getValue()) + '</b></div>' : '') +
            (fFooter.getValue() ? '<div class="foot">' + nl2br(fFooter.getValue()) + '</div>' : '') +
            '</div>';
        if (previewBox.rendered) previewBox.getEl().update(html); else previewBox.html = html;
    }

    var docForm = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
        labelWidth: 170, border: false, autoScroll: true,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:16px;',
        defaults: { anchor: '60%' },
        items: [
            { xtype: 'box', html: '<div class="set-note">Pelengkap dokumen cetak. Pratinjau kop di bawah memakai profil perusahaan dan logo dokumen.</div>' },
            fFooter, fSignName, fSignTitle,
            { xtype: 'box', html: '<div style="margin:14px 0 6px 0;color:#38bdf8;font-weight:bold;">Pratinjau Kop Dokumen</div>' },
            previewBox
        ],
        buttons: [{
            text: 'Simpan Pengaturan Dokumen', disabled: !canWrite,
            handler: function () {
                ajax({
                    task: 'save_document',
                    doc_footer: fFooter.getValue(), doc_signer_name: fSignName.getValue(), doc_signer_title: fSignTitle.getValue()
                }, function (res) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) reloadSettings();
                });
            }
        }],
        listeners: { activate: updateDocPreview }
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // TabPanel utama
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var host = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var totalH = maxGridHeight(host);

    var TAB_DEFS = [
        { title: 'Profil Perusahaan', sub: 'Nama, alamat, kontak',
          icon: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 21V5l9-3 9 3v16"/><path d="M9 21v-5h6v5"/><path d="M8 9h2M14 9h2M8 13h2M14 13h2"/></svg>' },
        { title: 'Logo', sub: 'Dokumen & aplikasi',
          icon: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><circle cx="9" cy="10" r="1.6"/><path d="M21 16l-5-5-8 8"/></svg>' },
        { title: 'Keuangan & Mata Uang', sub: 'Mata uang dasar & laporan',
          icon: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M14.5 9.2c-.4-.8-1.4-1.2-2.5-1.2-1.4 0-2.5.7-2.5 1.8 0 2.6 5 1.2 5 3.8 0 1.1-1.1 1.8-2.5 1.8-1.2 0-2.2-.5-2.6-1.4"/><path d="M12 6v2M12 16v2"/></svg>' },
        { title: 'Dokumen', sub: 'Footer & penandatangan',
          icon: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 2h8l4 4v16H6z"/><path d="M14 2v4h4M9 12h6M9 16h6"/></svg>' }
    ];

    var navDiv = document.createElement('div');
    navDiv.className = 'st-nav';
    navDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="st-bar" id="stBar"></div>' + TAB_DEFS.map(function (t, i) {
        return '<button type="button" class="st-tab" data-i="' + i + '"><span class="st-ico">' + t.icon + '</span>' +
               '<span class="st-txt"><b>' + t.title + '</b><small>' + t.sub + '</small></span></button>';
    }).join('');
    var bodyDiv = document.createElement('div');
    host.appendChild(navDiv);
    host.appendChild(bodyDiv);

    var cardPanel = new Ext.Panel({
        renderTo: bodyDiv,
        border: false,
        layout: 'card',
        activeItem: 0,
        layoutConfig: { deferredRender: false, layoutOnCardChange: true },
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;',
        height: Math.max(320, totalH - 78),
        items: [companyForm, logoPanel, financeForm, docForm]
    });

    var currentTab = 0;
    function setTab(i) {
        currentTab = i;
        cardPanel.getLayout().setActiveItem(i);
        var btns = navDiv.querySelectorAll('.st-tab');
        for (var k = 0; k < btns.length; k++) {
            if (k === i) btns[k].classList.add('on'); else btns[k].classList.remove('on');
        }
        var bar = document.getElementById('stBar'), b = btns[i];
        bar.style.width = b.offsetWidth + 'px';
        bar.style.transform = 'translateX(' + b.offsetLeft + 'px)';
        var el = cardPanel.items.itemAt(i).getEl();
        el.removeClass('st-in');
        void el.dom.offsetWidth;                 // restart animasi
        el.addClass('st-in');
    }
    Ext.each(navDiv.querySelectorAll('.st-tab'), function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = function () { setTab(parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-i'), 10)); };
    });
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () { setTab(currentTab); });
    setTimeout(function () { setTab(0); }, 0);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Muat & terapkan pengaturan
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function applySettings(d) {
        var c = d.company || {}, f = d.finance;
        settingsState.company = c;
        settingsState.finance = f;
        settingsState.lockReason = d.base_lock_reason || null;

        fCompany.setValue(c.company_name || '');
        fLegal.setValue(c.legal_name || '');
        fAddress.setValue(c.address || '');
        fCity.setValue(c.city || '');
        fProvince.setValue(c.province || '');
        fPostal.setValue(c.postal_code || '');
        fCountry.setValue(c.country || '');
        fPhone.setValue(c.phone || '');
        fEmail.setValue(c.email || '');
        fWebsite.setValue(c.website || '');
        fTax.setValue(c.tax_id || '');
        fFooter.setValue(c.doc_footer || '');
        fSignName.setValue(c.doc_signer_name || '');
        fSignTitle.setValue(c.doc_signer_title || '');

        currencyDs.loadData({ data: d.currencies || [] });
        if (f) {
            fBase.setValue(f.base_currency_id);
            fReport.setValue(f.report_currency_id);
            fRateType.setValue(f.default_rate_type);
            fBasisPl.setValue(f.rate_basis_pl);
            fMonth.setValue(f.fiscal_year_start_month);
            fDecimals.setValue(f.amount_decimals);
        } else {
            fBase.clearValue();
            fReport.clearValue();
            fRateType.setValue('KMK');
            fBasisPl.setValue('AVERAGE');
            fMonth.setValue(1);
            fDecimals.setValue(2);
        }

        var locked = !!settingsState.lockReason;
        fBase.setDisabled(locked || !canWrite);
        fLockInfo.setValue(locked
            ? '<div class="set-note set-warn">&#128274; Mata uang dasar terkunci. ' + enc(settingsState.lockReason) +
              ' Mata uang laporan keuangan tetap dapat diubah kapan saja.</div>'
            : (f ? '' : '<div class="set-note set-warn">Pengaturan keuangan belum diatur. Pilih mata uang dasar (umumnya IDR) lalu simpan.</div>'));

        if (!canWrite) {
            [fRateType, fReport, fBasisPl, fMonth, fDecimals].forEach(function (x) { x.setDisabled(true); });
            [fCompany, fLegal, fAddress, fCity, fProvince, fPostal, fCountry, fPhone, fEmail, fWebsite, fTax,
             fFooter, fSignName, fSignTitle].forEach(function (x) { x.setReadOnly(true); });
        }

        showLogo('document');
        showLogo('app');
        updateDocPreview();
    }

    function reloadSettings() {
        ajax({ task: 'load_settings' }, function (res) {
            if (!res.success) { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Gagal memuat pengaturan.'); return; }
            applySettings(res.data);
        });
    }

    mainBtnDisable('#addData');
    mainBtnDisable('#editData');
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';

    reloadSettings();
});

    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function fmtAmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    function showErr(msg) { Ext.Msg.show({ title: 'Peringatan', msg: msg, buttons: Ext.Msg.OK, icon: Ext.Msg.WARNING }); }

    // Exception store: pesan backend / HTTP ditampilkan eksplisit
    function storeError(proxy, type, action, opt, res) {
        var m = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        if (res && res.message) { m = res.message; }
        else if (res && res.status) { m += ' (HTTP ' + res.status + ')'; }
        showErr(m);
    }
    function jsonStore(task, fields, extra) {
        var cfg = {
            url: CRD, baseParams: { task: task }, root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount', fields: fields,
            listeners: { exception: storeError }
        };
        return new Ext.data.JsonStore(Ext.apply(cfg, extra || {}));
    }

    var floatF = function (n) { return { name: n, type: 'float' }; };

    // assignment polos (bukan var/let) -- konvensi search box global. Store kartu = mainDs.
    mainDs = jsonStore('list_cards', ['supplier_id', 'supplier_name', 'period_start', 'period_end', floatF('saldo_awal'),
                                       floatF('faktur'), floatF('pembayaran'), floatF('alokasi'), floatF('sisa'),
                                       'invoice_count', 'first_invoice_date', 'last_invoice_date',
                                       floatF('bucket_0_30'), floatF('bucket_31_60'), floatF('bucket_61_90'),
                                       floatF('bucket_90_plus'), floatF('outstanding_all')]);
    var detDs = jsonStore('list_details', ['supplier_id', 'supplier_name', 'invoice_id', 'inv_no',
                                           'supplier_invoice_no', 'status', 'invoice_date', 'aging_date',

    function ymd(d) {
        var m = d.getMonth() + 1, day = d.getDate();
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + '-' + (day < 10 ? '0' : '') + day;
    }
    function filterParams() {
        return { year: parseInt(inYear.value, 10) || now.getFullYear(), month: parseInt(selMonth.value, 10) || 1,
                 date_from: document.getElementById('apFrom').value, date_to: document.getElementById('apTo').value,
