                    { header: 'Umur (hari)', dataIndex: 'age_days', width: 75, align: 'center' },
                    amtCol('0-30', 'bucket_0_30', 100),
                    amtCol('31-60', 'bucket_31_60', 100),
                    amtCol('61-90', 'bucket_61_90', 100),
                    amtCol('>90', 'bucket_90_plus', 100)
                ]
            });
        }
    };
    var grids = {}, activeKey = 'cards';

    // Grid dibuat saat tab pertama kali tampil (container sudah visible -> lebar kolom benar)
    function showTab(key) {
        activeKey = key;
        Ext.each(TABS, function (t) {
            document.getElementById('apTab_' + t.key).className = 'ap-tab' + (t.key === key ? ' active' : '');
            document.getElementById('apPanel_' + t.key).style.display = (t.key === key) ? 'block' : 'none';
        });
        if (!grids[key]) grids[key] = builders[key]();
    }
    Ext.each(TABS, function (t) {
        document.getElementById('apTab_' + t.key).onclick = function () { showTab(t.key); };
    });

    var inLoadAll = false;      // true saat tombol Tampilkan memuat kedua store (cegah muat ganda dari hook pencarian)
    function loadAll() {
        var p = filterParams();
        inLoadAll = true;
        Ext.apply(mainDs.baseParams, { year: p.year, month: p.month, query: p.query || '' });
        mainDs.load();
        Ext.apply(detDs.baseParams, { date_from: p.date_from, date_to: p.date_to, supplier_id: p.supplier_id, query: p.query || '' });
        detDs.load();
        inLoadAll = false;
    }
    document.getElementById('apGo').onclick = loadAll;
    document.getElementById('apExport').onclick = function () {
        var p = filterParams();
        var type = (activeKey === 'details') ? 'details' : 'cards';
        var q = (mainDs.baseParams && mainDs.baseParams.query) || '';
        var url = CRD + '?task=export_csv&type=' + type + '&year=' + p.year + '&month=' + p.month +
                  '&supplier_id=' + p.supplier_id + '&date_from=' + encodeURIComponent(p.date_from || '') +
                  '&date_to=' + encodeURIComponent(p.date_to || '') + '&query=' + encodeURIComponent(q);
        window.open(url);
    };

    // Ringkasan periode dari respons list_cards (total saldo awal/faktur/bayar/alokasi/sisa & bucket)
    mainDs.on('load', function (store) {
        var el = document.getElementById('apTotals');
        var t = (store.reader.jsonData || {}).totals;
        if (!el) return;
        if (!t) { el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
        el.innerHTML = 'Saldo awal: <b style="color:#e6f1f8;">' + fmtAmt(t.saldo_awal) + '</b>' +
                       ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Faktur: <b style="color:#e6f1f8;">' + fmtAmt(t.faktur) + '</b>' +
                       ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Pembayaran: <b style="color:#e6f1f8;">' + fmtAmt(t.pembayaran) + '</b>' +
                       ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Alokasi: <b style="color:#e6f1f8;">' + fmtAmt(t.alokasi) + '</b>' +
                       ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b>Sisa: ' + fmtAmt(t.sisa) + '</b>' +
                       ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; >90 hari: <span style="color:' + (t.bucket_90_plus > 0 ? '#ff6b5e' : '#7fe0a0') + ';font-weight:bold;">' + fmtAmt(t.bucket_90_plus) + '</span>';
    });

    // Pencarian global template memuat ulang mainDs saja -> samakan query ke store detail
    mainDs.on('beforeload', function (store) {
        var q = store.baseParams.query || '';
        detDs.baseParams.query = q;
        if (inLoadAll) return;                       // sudah dimuat oleh loadAll()
        if (detDs.lastOptions) detDs.load();         // pencarian dari search box template -> muat ulang detail
    });

    // Template: laporan hanya-baca, tombol tambah/ubah/hapus dinonaktifkan
    if (typeof editDataDisable === 'function') { editDataDisable(); }
    if (typeof mainBtnDisable === 'function') { mainBtnDisable('#addData'); mainBtnDisable('#deleteData'); }

    calcHeight();
    showTab('cards');
    supplierDs.load({ callback: function () {
        supplierDs.each(function (r) {
            if (r.get('id') === 0) return;               // opsi "(Semua supplier)" sudah ada di select
            var o = document.createElement('option');
            o.value = r.get('id'); o.text = r.get('name');
            selClient.appendChild(o);
        });
        loadAll();
    } });
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

==================== FILE: ./js/project.payment.print.js ====================
/*
 * project.payment.print.js
 * Memuat data tanda terima melalui project.paymentCRD.php (task=load_payment),
 * lalu menampilkan hasil analisis AI terbaru untuk setiap proyek terkait.
 * PHP cetak hanya berisi kerangka HTML/CSS.
 */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    var paymentId = parseInt(window.PAYMENT_ID, 10) || 0;
    var endpoint = window.PAYMENT_CRD_URL || '/rab-project/dev/php-crud/project.paymentCRD.php';
    var root = document.getElementById('receipt');

    function esc(value) {
        return String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value)
            .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
            .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }
    function num(value) {
        var n = parseFloat(value);
        return isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
    }
    function money(value) {
        return num(value).toLocaleString('id-ID', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
    }
    function dateId(value) {
        if (!value) return '-';
        var s = String(value).substring(0, 10);
        var p = s.split('-');
        return p.length === 3 ? p[2] + '/' + p[1] + '/' + p[0] : esc(value);
    }
    function methodLabel(value) {
        var map = { BANK_TRANSFER: 'Transfer Bank', CASH: 'Tunai', GIRO: 'Giro', CEK: 'Cek' };
        return map[String(value || '').toUpperCase()] || value || '-';
    }
    function request(params, callback) {
        var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        var body = Object.keys(params).map(function (k) {
            return encodeURIComponent(k) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(params[k] === undefined ? '' : params[k]);
        }).join('&');
        xhr.open('POST', endpoint, true);
        xhr.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8');
        xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Requested-With', 'XMLHttpRequest');
        xhr.onreadystatechange = function () {
            if (xhr.readyState !== 4) return;
            var response;
            try { response = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText); }
            catch (e) { callback(new Error('Respons server bukan JSON yang valid.')); return; }
            if (xhr.status < 200 || xhr.status >= 300) {
                callback(new Error(response.message || 'Permintaan ke server gagal.'));
                return;
            }
            callback(null, response);
        };
        xhr.onerror = function () { callback(new Error('Tidak dapat terhubung ke server.')); };
        xhr.send(body);
    }
    function fail(message) {
        root.innerHTML = '<div class="err">' + esc(message) + '</div>';
    }
    // Gaya cetak mengikuti hierarki panel AI pada layar detail pembayaran.
    (function injectAiPrintStyles() {
        var style = document.createElement('style');
        style.textContent =
            '.ai-project-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px;color:#075e58;font-size:14px}' +
            '.ai-risk{font-weight:bold;border:1px solid currentColor;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:3px;white-space:nowrap}' +
            '.ai-summary{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:12px}' +
            '.ai-summary p{margin:5px 0 0;white-space:pre-wrap}' +
            '.ai-mitigations{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}' +
            '.ai-recommendations{margin:6px 0 0 18px;padding:0}' +
            '.ai-recommendations li{margin-bottom:6px}' +
            '.ai-project{margin:12px 0;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d8e0e3}';
        document.head.appendChild(style);
    })();

    function renderAiPlaceholder(projects) {
        if (!projects.length) {
            return '<section class="ai-section"><h3>Hasil Analisis AI — Varian Anggaran & Risiko</h3>' +
                '<p>Tidak ditemukan proyek yang terkait dengan pembayaran ini.</p></section>';
        }
        return '<section class="ai-section" id="aiSection"><h3>Hasil Analisis AI — Varian Anggaran & Risiko Proyek</h3>' +
            '<p id="aiLoading">Memuat hasil analisis AI terbaru...</p><div id="aiResults"></div>' +
            '<p class="muted">Hasil AI merupakan informasi pendukung dan perlu ditinjau bersama data proyek aktual.</p></section>';
    }
    function renderReceipt(payload) {
        var h = payload.header || {};
        var items = payload.items || [];
        var currency = h.currency_code || 'IDR';
        var foreign = currency !== 'IDR';
        var rows = '';
        var projectMap = {};
        items.forEach(function (item) {
            projectMap[String(item.project_id)] = item.project_name || ('Proyek #' + item.project_id);
            rows += '<tr><td>' + esc(item.project_name) + '</td><td>' + esc(item.termin_name) +
                (item.percentage !== null && item.percentage !== undefined ? ' (' + money(item.percentage) + '%)' : '') +
                '</td><td>' + esc(item.inv_no) + '</td><td class="r-al">' + money(item.invoice_amount) +
                '</td><td class="r-al">' + money(item.amount_paid) + '</td>' +
                (foreign ? '<td class="r-al">' + money(item.amount_cur) + '</td>' : '') + '</tr>';
        });
        if (!items.length) {
            rows = '<tr><td colspan="' + (foreign ? 6 : 5) + '" style="text-align:center">Tidak ada rincian alokasi termin.</td></tr>';
        }
        var projectIds = Object.keys(projectMap);
        var totalRows = '<tr><td colspan="' + (foreign ? 4 : 3) + '" class="r-al"><b>Total Dialokasikan (IDR)</b></td>' +
            '<td class="r-al"><b>' + money(h.allocated_amount) + '</b></td>' +
            (foreign ? '<td></td>' : '') + '</tr>';
        if (num(h.excess_amount) > 0.01) {
            totalRows += '<tr><td colspan="' + (foreign ? 4 : 3) + '" class="r-al"><b>Lebih Bayar (IDR)</b></td>' +
                '<td class="r-al">' + money(h.excess_amount) + '</td>' + (foreign ? '<td></td>' : '') + '</tr>';
        }
        totalRows += '<tr><td colspan="' + (foreign ? 4 : 3) + '" class="r-al"><b>Total Diterima (' + esc(currency) + ')</b></td>' +
            '<td class="r-al"><b>' + money(h.total_amount_cur !== undefined ? h.total_amount_cur : h.total_amount) + '</b></td>' +
            (foreign ? '<td></td>' : '') + '</tr>';
        if (foreign) {
            totalRows += '<tr><td colspan="4" class="r-al"><b>Nilai setara IDR</b></td><td class="r-al">' + money(h.total_amount) + '</td><td></td></tr>';
        }

        root.innerHTML =
            '<header class="hdr"><div class="l"><div class="co-name">RAB-Project</div><div class="co-addr">Sistem Monitoring Proyek</div></div>' +
            '<div class="r"><b>TANDA TERIMA PEMBAYARAN</b><div>No. ' + esc(h.payment_no) + '</div></div></header>' +
            '<h1 class="title">TANDA TERIMA</h1>' +
            '<p>Telah diterima pembayaran dari:</p>' +
            '<table class="meta"><tr><td class="k">Nama Client</td><td><b>' + esc(h.client_name) + '</b></td>' +
            '<td class="k">Tanggal Pembayaran</td><td><b>' + dateId(h.payment_date) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td class="k">Metode Pembayaran</td><td><b>' + esc(methodLabel(h.payment_method)) + '</b></td>' +
            '<td class="k">Mata Uang</td><td><b>' + esc(currency) + (foreign ? ' (kurs ' + money(h.exch_rate) + ')' : '') + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td class="k">Akun Penerimaan</td><td><b>' + esc([h.account_code, h.account_name].filter(Boolean).join(' - ') || '-') + '</b></td>' +
            '<td class="k">Referensi</td><td><b>' + esc(h.reference_no || '-') + '</b></td></tr></table>' +
            '<table class="items"><thead><tr><th>Proyek</th><th>Termin</th><th>No. Invoice</th><th class="r-al">Tagihan (IDR)</th><th class="r-al">Dibayar (IDR)</th>' +
            (foreign ? '<th class="r-al">Dibayar (' + esc(currency) + ')</th>' : '') +
            '</tr></thead><tbody>' + rows + '</tbody><tfoot>' + totalRows + '</tfoot></table>' +
            (h.notes ? '<p><b>Catatan:</b> ' + esc(h.notes) + '</p>' : '') +
            renderAiPlaceholder(projectIds) +
            '<div class="sign"><div><p>Diterima oleh,</p><div class="space"></div><div class="line">' + esc(h.client_name) + '</div></div>' +
            '<div><p>Diterima dari / Petugas,</p><div class="space"></div><div class="line">' + esc(h.created_by_name || 'Petugas Penerima') + '</div></div></div>' +
            '<div class="footer">Dokumen dihasilkan oleh RAB-Monitor · ' + esc(h.payment_no) + '</div>';

        loadAiResults(projectIds, projectMap);
    }
    function loadAiResults(projectIds, projectMap) {
        var loading = document.getElementById('aiLoading');
        var results = document.getElementById('aiResults');
        var printButton = document.getElementById('btnPrintReceipt');
        if (printButton) { printButton.disabled = true; printButton.textContent = 'Memuat hasil AI...'; }
        if (!projectIds.length) {
            if (loading) loading.textContent = 'Tidak ada proyek yang terhubung dengan pembayaran ini.';
            if (printButton) { printButton.disabled = false; printButton.textContent = 'Cetak'; }
            return;
        }

        var completed = 0;
        var htmlByProject = {};
        projectIds.forEach(function (projectId) {
            // Ambil hasil analisis tersimpan yang sama dengan yang ditampilkan di panel.
            // Jangan memanggil analyze_project_variance saat mencetak karena itu membuat
            // analisis baru dan hasil cetak bisa berbeda dari hasil yang sedang dilihat.
            request({ task: 'latest_project_variance', project_id: projectId }, function (err, res) {
                completed++;
                var projectName = projectMap[projectId];
                if (err || !res || !res.success || !res.data) {
                    var msg = (res && res.message) ? res.message :
                        (err ? err.message : 'Hasil analisis AI belum tersedia.');
                    htmlByProject[projectId] = '<div class="ai-project"><b>' + esc(projectName) +
                        '</b><p>' + esc(msg) + '</p></div>';
                } else {
                    var d = res.data;
                    var risk = String(d.risk_level || 'BELUM DIKETAHUI').toUpperCase();
                    var color = (risk === 'HIGH' || risk === 'CRITICAL') ? '#e05353' :
                                (risk === 'MEDIUM' ? '#e6a817' : '#2e9e4f');
                    var recs = Array.isArray(d.recommendations) ? d.recommendations : [];
                    var recHtml = recs.length ? '<ul class="ai-recommendations">' + recs.map(function (rec) {
                        return '<li>' + esc(rec) + '</li>';
                    }).join('') + '</ul>' : '<ul class="ai-recommendations"><li>Tidak ada rekomendasi khusus.</li></ul>';

                    htmlByProject[projectId] = '<div class="ai-project">' +
                        '<div class="ai-project-heading"><b>AI Cost &amp; Schedule Variance Analysis</b>' +
                        '<span class="ai-risk" style="color:' + color + '">RISK: ' + esc(risk) + '</span></div>' +
                        '<div class="ai-summary"><b>Ringkasan Eksekutif:</b><p>' + esc(d.ai_summary || '-') + '</p></div>' +
                        '<div class="ai-mitigations"><b>Rekomendasi Mitigasi:</b>' + recHtml + '</div>' +
                        '<div class="muted">Analisis terakhir: ' + esc(dateId(d.created_at)) + '</div>' +
                        '</div>';
                }
                if (completed === projectIds.length) {
                    if (loading) loading.remove();
                    results.innerHTML = projectIds.map(function (id) { return htmlByProject[id]; }).join('');
                    if (printButton) { printButton.disabled = false; printButton.textContent = 'Cetak'; }
                }
            });
        });
    }

    // Ukur ruang cetak A4 sebelum mencetak. Jika analisis berikut tanda tangan/footer
    // melewati halaman pertama, mulai bagian analisis pada halaman kedua.
    function fitAiSectionForPrint() {
        var section = document.getElementById('aiSection');
        var sign = root.querySelector('.sign');
        var footer = root.querySelector('.footer');
        if (!section) return;
        section.classList.remove('force-page-break');

        var measure = document.createElement('div');
        measure.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:-10000px;top:0;width:1px;height:267mm;visibility:hidden;';
        document.body.appendChild(measure);
        var printableHeight = measure.getBoundingClientRect().height;
        document.body.removeChild(measure);

        var contentEnd = section.offsetTop + section.offsetHeight;
        if (sign) contentEnd = Math.max(contentEnd, sign.offsetTop + sign.offsetHeight);
        if (footer) contentEnd = Math.max(contentEnd, footer.offsetTop + footer.offsetHeight);
        if (contentEnd > printableHeight) section.classList.add('force-page-break');
    }

    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', fitAiSectionForPrint);

    // Assign direct handlers so toolbar controls remain functional even if other
    // page scripts register delegated click handlers.
    var printButton = document.getElementById('btnPrintReceipt');
    var closeButton = document.getElementById('btnCloseReceipt');
    if (printButton) {
        printButton.onclick = function () {
            if (printButton.disabled) return;
            fitAiSectionForPrint();
            window.focus();
            window.print();
        };
    }
    if (closeButton) {
        closeButton.onclick = function () {
            window.close();
            window.setTimeout(function () {
                // Browsers may block window.close() when the page was not opened
                // by script; provide a usable fallback instead of a dead button.
                if (!window.closed) {
                    if (window.history.length > 1) window.history.back();
                    else window.location.href = '/rab-project/';
                }
            }, 120);
        };
    }

    if (!paymentId) {
        fail('ID pembayaran tidak valid.');
        return;
    }
    request({ task: 'load_payment', id: paymentId }, function (err, res) {
        if (err) {
            fail('Gagal memuat tanda terima: ' + err.message);
            return;
        }
        if (!res || !res.success || !res.data || !res.data.header) {
            fail((res && res.message) || 'Data pembayaran tidak ditemukan.');
            return;
        }
        renderReceipt(res.data);
    });
})();

==================== FILE: ./js/whrcv.js ====================
/*
  Document      : whrcv.js
  Description   : WH Rcv (Penerimaan Fisik Gudang) - Frontend Controller ExtJS 3.x
  Backend       : /php-crud/whrcvCRD.php
  Split bin     : satu baris GRN boleh dipecah ke beberapa Bin Location (mis. item X: 60 di A1-01 dan 40 di A1-02).
                  Klik "Split" di baris item -> isi qty yang dipindah -> baris baru muncul untuk memilih bin lain.
                  Total qty semua bin per item <= sisa GRN; bin tidak boleh sama dua kali; tiap baris hasil split wajib punya bin.
                  Tiap baris disimpan sebagai baris wh_receiving_dtl sendiri (satu layer FIFO per bin).
  Multi currency: nilai penerimaan dicatat dalam MATA UANG DASAR (diambil server dari GRN = harga GRN x kurs PO);
                  harga mata uang asal ikut ditampilkan sebagai jejak. Dasar FIFO, stok, dan jurnal = mata uang dasar.
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    // [FIX-DATE] Date.format('Y-m-d') Ext menghasilkan 'Y-10-13' di browser ini -> susun YYYY-MM-DD manual
    function ymd(d) {
        var m = d.getMonth() + 1, dd = d.getDate();
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : m) + '-' + (dd < 10 ? '0' + dd : dd);
    }
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Penerimaan <em>Fisik Gudang</em>";

    // [GRID-WRAP 2026-11-17] Override SCOPED untuk grid halaman W/H Rcv:
    // #divMainGrid (daftar WH Rcv) & #editorFormGrid (item) — tidak menyentuh CSS global.
    // ExtJS 3.4.1 (css/ext-all.css) memasang
    //   .x-grid3-cell-inner,.x-grid3-hd-inner{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
    // sehingga header & sel panjang (Supplier, Gudang, Item, No. DO) terpotong "...".
    // Paksa wrap + clip + tinggi baris dinamis; angka tetap rata kanan (align ColumnModel dihormati).
    (function injectGridWrapCss() {
        var st = document.createElement('style');
        st.type = 'text/css';
        st.appendChild(document.createTextNode(
            '#divMainGrid .x-grid3-hd-inner, #editorFormGrid .x-grid3-hd-inner {' +
            ' white-space:normal !important; overflow:visible !important; text-overflow:clip !important;' +
            ' word-wrap:break-word !important; overflow-wrap:break-word !important; word-break:break-word !important;' +
            ' line-height:1.3 !important; height:auto !important; min-height:34px !important;' +

            // Baris & header tinggi dinamis (tidak dikunci): teks membungkus ke 2 baris bila perlu.
            '#divMainGrid .x-grid3-hd, #editorFormGrid .x-grid3-hd { padding:0 !important; vertical-align:middle !important; height:auto !important; }' +
            '#divMainGrid .x-grid3-row td, #editorFormGrid .x-grid3-row td { height:auto !important; vertical-align:middle !important; }' +
            '#divMainGrid .x-grid3-header-offset, #editorFormGrid .x-grid3-header-offset { height:auto !important; }'));
        document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0].appendChild(st);
    })();

    var task = '';

                    applyCurrencyHeaders();

                store.each(function (r) {

    var GridDtlHeight = (maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));

            },

                    // dokumennya sudah berstatus 'reversed'.
                    if (dataRecord.status === 'reversed' || getFormAccess() < 4) {
                        mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
                    } else {
                        mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');

                }

        }
    });
    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Detail View Renderer (Disamakan dengan PO / GRN)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function loadWhrcvDetail(id, refNo) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_edit', id: id },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    whrcvDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">Gagal memuat detail.</div>';
                    whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderWhrcvDetailView(res.data.items || [], refNo, res.data.currency_code);
            },
            failure: function () {
                whrcvDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderWhrcvDetailView(rows, refNo, curCode) {
        var fmtQty = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); };
        var fmtAmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };

        var code = curCode || '';
        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Detail Item WH Rcv: ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(refNo || '') + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Nama Item</th>' +
                   '<th style="text-align:right;">Qty Diterima</th>' +
                   '<th align="left">Lot No</th>' +
                   '<th align="left">Bin</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Harga Asal' + (code ? ' (' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(code) + ')' : '') + '</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Harga Dasar</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Subtotal Dasar</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        var grandTotal = 0;

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="7" class="empty-msg">Tidak ada item detail.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var qty = parseFloat(r.qty_received) || 0;
                var cost = parseFloat(r.unit_cost) || 0;                       // mata uang dasar
                var costTxn = (r.unit_cost_txn !== null && r.unit_cost_txn !== undefined) ? parseFloat(r.unit_cost_txn) : cost;
                var subtotal = qty * cost;
                grandTotal += subtotal;

                html += '<tr class="data-row">' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.item_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtQty(qty) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.lot_no || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.bin_code || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:#9fc3d1;">' + fmtAmt(costTxn) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(cost) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" class="subtotal-val">' + fmtAmt(subtotal) + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });
        }

        html += '</tbody>' +
                '<tfoot>' +
                '<tr class="total-row">' +
                '<td colspan="6" align="right" class="total-label">Total Nilai Diterima (dasar):</td>' +
                '<td align="right" class="total-val">' + fmtAmt(grandTotal) + '</td>' +
                '</tr>' +
                '</tfoot>' +
                '</table>';

        whrcvDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Item Grid Editor (Form Grid)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var itemGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: itemGridDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        // [GRID-WRAP 2026-11-17] forceFit:true -> false agar Item/nama panjang wrap, bukan terpotong "...".
        viewConfig: { forceFit: false, scrollOffset: 0 },
        height: 220,
        columns: [
            {
                header: 'Item', dataIndex: 'item_name', width: 180,
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    if (record && record.get('is_split')) {
                        return '<span style="color:#9fc3d1; padding-left:14px;">&#8627; ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v || '') + '</span>';
                    }
                    return CellWrap.apply(this, arguments);
                }
            },
            {
                header: 'Qty GRN', dataIndex: 'qty_grn', width: 90, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    if (record && record.get('is_split')) return '';
                    return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000');
                }
            },
            {
                header: 'Sisa Belum Diterima', dataIndex: 'qty_remaining', width: 110, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    if (record && record.get('is_split')) return '';
                    return '<b style="color:#38bdf8;">' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000') + '</b>';
                }
            },
            {
                header: 'Qty Diterima Skrg', dataIndex: 'qty_input', width: 120, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 4 }),
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b style="color:#2e9e4f;">' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000') + '</b>'; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Lot No', dataIndex: 'lot_no', width: 100,
                editor: new myTextField({})
            },
            {
                header: 'Bin Location', dataIndex: 'bin_location_id', width: 130,
                editor: new myComboField({
                    store: binLocationDs, displayField: 'code', valueField: 'id',
                    mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true
                }),
                renderer: function (v) {
                    if (!v) return '-';
                    var rec = binLocationDs.getById(v);
                    return rec ? rec.get('code') : v;
                }
            },
            {
                header: 'Harga Asal', dataIndex: 'unit_cost', width: 100, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return '<span style="color:#9fc3d1;">' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00') + '</span>'; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Harga Dasar', dataIndex: 'unit_cost_base', width: 100, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Subtotal Dasar', dataIndex: 'qty_input', width: 120, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    var subtotal = (parseFloat(record.get('qty_input')) || 0) * (parseFloat(record.get('unit_cost_base')) || 0);
                    return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(subtotal, '0,000.00') + '</b>';
                }
            },
            {
                id: 'whSplitCol', header: 'Split Bin', dataIndex: 'is_split', width: 90, align: 'center', fixed: true,
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    var html = '<span class="whSplitBtn" title="Pecah qty item ini ke bin lain" style="cursor:pointer; color:#38bdf8; font-weight:bold;">&#10697; Split</span>';
                    if (record && record.get('is_split')) {
                        html += ' <span class="whSplitDel" title="Hapus baris ini (qty kembali ke baris induk)" style="cursor:pointer; color:#e05353; font-weight:bold; margin-left:6px;">&#10005;</span>';
                    }
                    return html;
                }
            }
        ],
        listeners: {
            afteredit: function (e) {
                var rec = e.record;
                if (e.field === 'qty_input') {
                    var q = parseFloat(e.value) || 0;
                    if (q < 0) { rec.set('qty_input', 0); q = 0; }
                    var maxQty = splitGroupMax(rec);            // sisa GRN dikurangi qty baris lain di item yang sama
                    if (q > maxQty + 0.00005) {
                        rec.set('qty_input', Math.max(maxQty, 0));
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Qty melebihi sisa GRN' + (splitGroupRows(rec).length > 1 ? ' (total semua bin untuk item ini)' : '') +
                                      '. Otomatis dibatasi ke ' + Ext.util.Format.number(Math.max(maxQty, 0), '0,000.0000') + '.');
                    }
                } else if (e.field === 'bin_location_id' && rec.get('bin_location_id')) {
                    var dup = false;
                    Ext.each(splitGroupRows(rec), function (r) {
                        if (r !== rec && String(r.get('bin_location_id')) === String(rec.get('bin_location_id'))) dup = true;
                    });
                    if (dup) {
                        rec.set('bin_location_id', e.originalValue || null);
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Bin tersebut sudah dipakai baris lain untuk item yang sama. Gabungkan qty-nya ke satu baris.');
                    }
                }
                updateWhrcvTotalLabel();
            },
            cellclick: function (grid, rowIndex, colIndex, e) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (!rec) return;
                if (e.getTarget('.whSplitDel')) { removeSplitRow(rec); return; }
                if (e.getTarget('.whSplitBtn')) { splitRow(rec); }
            }
        }
    });
    itemGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Split bin: satu baris GRN -> beberapa baris dengan bin berbeda
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function round4(v) { return Math.round((parseFloat(v) || 0) * 10000) / 10000; }

    // Semua baris (induk + hasil split) milik baris GRN yang sama, urut seperti di grid
    function splitGroupRows(rec) {
        var rows = [], id = String(rec.get('grn_dtl_id'));
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) { if (String(r.get('grn_dtl_id')) === id) rows.push(r); });
        return rows;
    }

    // Qty maksimum untuk baris ini = sisa GRN - qty baris lain pada item yang sama
    function splitGroupMax(rec) {
        var others = 0;
        Ext.each(splitGroupRows(rec), function (r) { if (r !== rec) others += parseFloat(r.get('qty_input')) || 0; });
        return round4((parseFloat(rec.get('qty_remaining')) || 0) - others);
    }

    function splitRow(rec) {
        var cur = parseFloat(rec.get('qty_input')) || 0;
        if (cur <= 0.0001) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Isi Qty Diterima baris ini dulu sebelum dipecah.');
            return;
        }
        Ext.Msg.prompt('Split Bin Location',
            'Item: <b>' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(rec.get('item_name') || '') + '</b><br />' +
            'Qty yang dipindah ke baris baru (bin lain), kurang dari ' + Ext.util.Format.number(cur, '0,000.0000') + ':',
            function (btn, text) {
                if (btn !== 'ok') return;
                var t = String(text || '').trim();
                if (t.indexOf(',') >= 0 && t.indexOf('.') < 0) t = t.replace(',', '.');
                var q = round4(t);
                if (!(q > 0) || q >= cur - 0.00005) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Qty split harus lebih dari 0 dan kurang dari ' + Ext.util.Format.number(cur, '0,000.0000') + '.');
                    return;
                }
                var child = new itemGridDs.recordType({
                    grn_dtl_id: rec.get('grn_dtl_id'), item_id: rec.get('item_id'), item_name: rec.get('item_name'),
                    grade_id: rec.get('grade_id'), qty_grn: rec.get('qty_grn'), unit_cost: rec.get('unit_cost'),
                    unit_cost_base: rec.get('unit_cost_base'), qty_wh_received: rec.get('qty_wh_received'),
                    qty_remaining: rec.get('qty_remaining'), qty_input: q,
                    lot_no: rec.get('lot_no') || '', bin_location_id: null, is_split: true
                });
                rec.set('qty_input', round4(cur - q));
                var rows = splitGroupRows(rec);
                var at = itemGridDs.indexOf(rows[rows.length - 1]) + 1;         // tepat setelah baris terakhir item ini
                itemGridDs.insert(at, child);
                updateWhrcvTotalLabel();
                try { itemGrid.startEditing(at, itemGrid.getColumnModel().findColumnIndex('bin_location_id')); } catch (e) {}
            }, this, false, String(round4(cur / 2)));
    }

    // Hapus baris hasil split: qty dikembalikan ke baris induk (baris pertama item tsb)
    function removeSplitRow(rec) {
        if (!rec.get('is_split')) return;
        var rows = splitGroupRows(rec), parent = rows[0];
        if (!parent || parent === rec) return;
        parent.set('qty_input', round4((parseFloat(parent.get('qty_input')) || 0) + (parseFloat(rec.get('qty_input')) || 0)));
        itemGridDs.remove(rec);
        updateWhrcvTotalLabel();
    }

    // Kolom "Harga Asal" disembunyikan bila mata uang GRN = mata uang dasar; judul kolom memuat kode mata uang
    function applyCurrencyHeaders() {
        var cm = itemGrid.getColumnModel();
        var diff = whCur.code !== whCur.base;
        cm.setColumnHeader(6, 'Harga Asal (' + whCur.code + ')');
        cm.setColumnHeader(7, 'Harga Dasar (' + whCur.base + ')');
        cm.setColumnHeader(8, 'Subtotal Dasar (' + whCur.base + ')');
        cm.setHidden(6, !diff);
        itemGrid.getView().refresh();
    }

    function updateWhrcvTotalLabel() {
        var total = 0, totalTxn = 0;
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('qty_input')) || 0;
            total += qty * (parseFloat(r.get('unit_cost_base')) || 0);          // mata uang dasar
            totalTxn += qty * (parseFloat(r.get('unit_cost')) || 0);            // mata uang asal
        });
        var el = document.getElementById('lblWhrcvTotal');
        if (el) {
            var html = Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.00') + ' ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(whCur.base);
            if (whCur.code !== whCur.base) {
                html += ' <span style="color:#9fc3d1; font-weight:normal;">(asal ' + Ext.util.Format.number(totalTxn, '0,000.00') + ' ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(whCur.code) + ')</span>';
            }
            el.innerHTML = html;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Form Header & Input Controls
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fldRefNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. WH Rcv', id: 'ref_no', name: 'ref_no', readOnly: true, emptyText: 'Auto-generate' });
    var fldGrnHdr = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'GRN yang Diterima', id: 'grn_hdr_id', name: 'grn_hdr_id', hiddenName: 'grn_hdr_id',
        store: grnDs, displayField: 'ref_no', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false,
        listeners: {
            select: function (combo, record) {
                if (record.get('warehouse_id')) {
                    fldWarehouse.setValue(record.get('warehouse_id'));
                    binLocationDs.load({ params: { warehouse_id: record.get('warehouse_id') } });
                }
                itemGridDs.load({ params: { grn_hdr_id: record.get('id') } });
            }
        }
    });

                binLocationDs.load({ params: { warehouse_id: record.get('id') } });
            }
        }
    });
    var fldReceivedDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tgl Terima', id: 'received_date', name: 'received_date', allowBlank: false, value: new Date() });
    var fldRemark = new myTextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Keterangan', id: 'remark', name: 'remark' });

        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 130,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldRefNo },
            { items: fldReceivedDate },
            { items: fldGrnHdr },
            { items: fldWarehouse },
            { columnWidth: 1, items: fldRemark }
        ]
    });

    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        // [FIX] Aksi "Delete" untuk modul ini sebenarnya adalah Reverse
        // (pembatalan dengan jejak audit tetap ada) -- dokumen WH Rcv yang
        // sudah posted TIDAK di-hard-delete, karena sudah memengaruhi stok
        // dan jurnal. Sebelumnya aksi ini keliru dipasang di tombol Edit.
        if (!dataRecord) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data WH Rcv yang akan di-reverse.');
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status === 'reversed') {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'WH Rcv ini sudah di-reverse sebelumnya.');
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() >= 4) {
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi Reverse', 'Reverse WH Rcv \'' + dataRecord.ref_no + '\'? Stok & jurnal akan dibatalkan.', function (btn) {
                if (btn === 'yes') {
                    Ext.Ajax.request({
                        url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',
                        method: 'POST',
                        params: { task: 'reverse', id: dataRecord.id },
                        success: function (response) {
                            var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                            if (res.success) {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Informasi', res.message || 'WH Rcv berhasil di-reverse.');
                                whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                                mainDs.load();
                                grnDs.load();
                                dataRecord = null;
                                mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
                            } else {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message);
                            }
                        },
                        failure: function () {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        } else {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk reverse.');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        var grnHdrId = fldGrnHdr.getValue();
        if (!grnHdrId) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih GRN yang mau diterima terlebih dahulu.');
            return;
        }
        if (!fldWarehouse.getValue()) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih gudang terlebih dahulu.');
            return;
        }

        // Validasi split bin per item: total <= sisa GRN, bin wajib & tidak boleh sama bila item dipecah
        var groups = {}, splitErr = '';
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
            if ((parseFloat(r.get('qty_input')) || 0) <= 0) return;
            var k = String(r.get('grn_dtl_id'));
            (groups[k] = groups[k] || []).push(r);
        });
        Ext.iterate(groups, function (k, rows) {
            var sum = 0, name = rows[0].get('item_name'), rem = parseFloat(rows[0].get('qty_remaining')) || 0;
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) { sum += parseFloat(r.get('qty_input')) || 0; });
            if (sum > rem + 0.0001) splitErr = splitErr || ('Total qty ' + name + ' (' + round4(sum) + ') melebihi sisa GRN (' + round4(rem) + ').');
            if (rows.length > 1) {
                var seen = {};
                Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                    var b = r.get('bin_location_id');
                    if (!b) splitErr = splitErr || ('Item ' + name + ' dipecah ke beberapa baris: Bin Location wajib diisi di setiap baris.');
                    else if (seen[b]) splitErr = splitErr || ('Item ' + name + ': bin yang sama dipakai dua kali. Gabungkan qty-nya.');
                    else seen[b] = true;
                });
            }
        });
        if (splitErr) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', splitErr);
            return;
        }

        var arrItems = [];
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('qty_input')) || 0;
            if (qty > 0) {
                arrItems.push({
                    grn_dtl_id: r.get('grn_dtl_id'),
                    item_id: r.get('item_id'),
                    item_name: r.get('item_name'),
                    grade_id: r.get('grade_id'),
                    qty_received: qty,
                    unit_cost: parseFloat(r.get('unit_cost')) || 0,
                    lot_no: r.get('lot_no') || null,
                    bin_location_id: r.get('bin_location_id') || null
                });
            }
        });

        if (arrItems.length === 0) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Minimal 1 item dengan qty diterima > 0.');
            return;
        }

        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: 'create',
                grn_hdr_id: grnHdrId,
                warehouse_id: fldWarehouse.getValue(),
                received_date: ymd(fldReceivedDate.getValue()),      // [FIX-DATE]
                items: JSON.stringify(arrItems)
            },
            waitTitle: 'Menyimpan',
            waitMsg: 'Memproses penerimaan & posting stok/jurnal...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message || ('WH Rcv ' + res.ref_no + ' berhasil disimpan.'));
                whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                mainDs.load();
                grnDs.load();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('whrcvDtlContainer').style.display = 'none';

});

    }

    function loadKursDetailPanel(hdrId, kmkNo) {

        kursDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';

        Ext.Ajax.request({

            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_detail', hdr_id: hdrId },
            success: function(response) {

                if (!res.success) {
                    kursDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#ef4444; padding:15px; text-align:center;">Gagal memuat rincian kurs.</div>';
                    kursDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderKursDetailPanel(res.data || [], kmkNo);
            },
            failure: function() {
                kursDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#ef4444; padding:15px; text-align:center;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                kursDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderKursDetailPanel(rows, kmkNo) {
        var fmtUnit = function(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000'); };

        var html = '<div class="detail-title">Rincian Nilai Kurs Pajak Mingguan (Terhadap Rupiah / IDR) — KMK No: ' +
                   Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(kmkNo || '') + '</div>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<table id="kursDtlTable" class="detail-table" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +

                   '<th align="right">Kurs Murni / Unit (IDR)</th>' +
                   '<th align="center">Perubahan</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:20px; text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">Belum ada rincian kurs untuk periode ini.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function(r) {
                var chgHtml;
                if (r.change_direction === 'UP') {
                    chgHtml = '<span style="color:#22c55e;font-weight:bold;">&#9650; +' + renderMoneyVal(r.change_amount) + '</span>';
                } else if (r.change_direction === 'DOWN') {
                    chgHtml = '<span style="color:#ef4444;font-weight:bold;">&#9660; -' + renderMoneyVal(r.change_amount) + '</span>';
                } else {
                    chgHtml = '<span style="color:#94a3b8;">&#9644; Tetap</span>';
                }

                html += '<tr class="data-row">' +
                        '<td align="center"><b>' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.currency_code || '') + '</b></td>' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.currency_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="center">' + fmtUnit(r.unit_multiplier) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right"><b>' + renderMoneyVal(r.rate_kmk) + '</b></td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + renderMoneyVal(r.rate_effective) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="center">' + chgHtml + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });
        }
        html += '</tbody></table>';

        kursDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        kursDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

    });

    if (document.getElementById('addWdw')) document.getElementById('addWdw').style.display = 'none';

/*
Document    : stock.card.js
Description : Stock Card (kartu stok) per item, per gudang / semua gudang. ExtJS 3.4.1
Backend     : ../php-crud/stock.cardCRD.php

[REVISI 2026-11-02]
- Dropdown gudang: HANYA gudang yang punya stok (ada di stock_movements)
- Dropdown material: SEMUA material aktif (tidak difilter by gudang)
- warehouse_id tetap dikirim untuk info qty_on_hand di dropdown
- Auto-load item saat gudang dipilih
- Auto-clear material saat gudang berubah
*/
Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    
    if (document.getElementById('mainHeaderText')) {
        document.getElementById('mainHeaderText').innerHTML = 'Kartu <em>Stok</em>';
    }

    // [GRID-WRAP 2026-11-17] Override SCOPED untuk grid Kartu Stok (#divMainGrid) — tidak menyentuh CSS global.
    // ExtJS 3.4.1 (css/ext-all.css) memasang
    //   .x-grid3-cell-inner,.x-grid3-hd-inner{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
    // sehingga header & sel panjang (Gudang, Keterangan, No. Dokumen) terpotong "...".
    // Paksa wrap + clip + tinggi baris dinamis; angka tetap rata kanan (align ColumnModel dihormati).
    (function injectGridWrapCss() {
        var st = document.createElement('style');
        st.type = 'text/css';
        st.appendChild(document.createTextNode(
            '#divMainGrid .x-grid3-hd-inner {' +
            ' white-space:normal !important; overflow:visible !important; text-overflow:clip !important;' +
            ' word-wrap:break-word !important; overflow-wrap:break-word !important; word-break:break-word !important;' +
            ' line-height:1.3 !important; height:auto !important; min-height:34px !important;' +
            ' padding:4px 6px !important; box-sizing:border-box; vertical-align:middle !important;' +

                 (t ? '<pre style="white-space:pre-wrap;">' + enc(t.substr(0, 300)) + '</pre>' : '<i>(kosong - cek error_log PHP)</i>') + '</span>';

    function loadCard() {

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Trial <em>Balance</em>";
    var CRD = main_url + '/php-crud/trialbalanceCRD.php';

    ['addData', 'editData', 'deleteData'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 0. Buat elemen filter bar & summary secara dinamis
    // ============================================================
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var filterBarDiv = document.createElement('div');
    filterBarDiv.id = 'tbFilterBar';
    filterBarDiv.style.padding = '0 10px';
    var summaryDiv = document.createElement('div');
    summaryDiv.id = 'tbSummary';
    summaryDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:8px 12px; font-size:13px; margin:0 10px 10px 10px; border-radius:4px;';
    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(filterBarDiv, gridContainer);
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(summaryDiv, gridContainer);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 1. Field definitions & stores
    // ============================================================
    var tbField = [
        { name: 'account_code' }, { name: 'account_name' }, { name: 'account_type' },
        { name: 'debit', type: 'float' }, { name: 'credit', type: 'float' }
    ];

    // [DEFAULT-PERIOD][NEW] Periode default = periode yang memuat tanggal hari ini; bila tidak ada -> periode terbaru (baris pertama)
    function pickDefaultPeriod(store) {
        var d = new Date(), m = d.getMonth() + 1, day = d.getDate();
        var today = d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : m) + '-' + (day < 10 ? '0' + day : day);
        var idx = store.findBy(function (r) { return r.get('start_date') <= today && today <= r.get('end_date'); });
        return store.getAt(idx >= 0 ? idx : 0).get('id');
    }

    var periodField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'period_name' }, { name: 'start_date' }, { name: 'end_date' }];
    var periodDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        baseParams: { task: 'read_periods' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, periodField),
        listeners: {
            load: function (store) {
                // [DEFAULT-PERIOD] Auto-pilih periode yang memuat hari ini (bila tidak ada: periode terbaru)
                if (store.getCount() > 0 && !fldPeriod.getValue()) {
                    fldPeriod.setValue(pickDefaultPeriod(store));
                    loadTrialBalance();
                }
            }
        }
    });
    periodDs.load();

    var tbDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, tbField)
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 2. Filter bar
    // ============================================================
    var fldPeriod = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Periode', width: 200, store: periodDs, displayField: 'period_name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldHideZero = new Ext.form.Checkbox({ boxLabel: 'Sembunyikan saldo nol', checked: true });
    var btnShow = new Ext.Button({ text: 'Tampilkan', cls: 'field-button grey-field-button' });

    var filterPanel = new Ext.Panel({
        renderTo: 'tbFilterBar',
        layout: 'column',
        border: false,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:8px 0;',
        defaults: { border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;' },
        items: [
            { columnWidth: 0.25, layout: 'form', labelWidth: 60, items: fldPeriod },
            { columnWidth: 0.25, style: 'padding-top:6px;', items: fldHideZero },
            { columnWidth: 0.15, style: 'padding-top:2px;', items: btnShow }
        ]
    });

    // [FIT-GRID][NEW] Tinggi grid = sisa tinggi layar di bawah posisi grid (setelah filter bar & summary), sisakan ruang
    //                 untuk toolbar paging di bawah agar tidak terpotong. gridMain dibuat di bawah (dipakai setelah ada).
    function fitGrid() {
        if (typeof gridMain === 'undefined' || !gridMain || !gridMain.rendered) return;
        var top = gridContainer.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        var h = (window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight) - top - 24;
        gridMain.setHeight(Math.max(h, 220));
    }
    window.onresize = fitGrid;

    function loadTrialBalance() {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) return;

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_trial_balance', period_id: perId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    summaryDiv.innerHTML = res.message || 'Gagal memuat data.';
                    return;
                }

                var rows = res.data;
                if (fldHideZero.getValue()) {
                    rows = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.debit != 0 || r.credit != 0; });
                }
                var reader = tbDs.reader;
                tbDs.loadData({ data: rows, totalCount: rows.length }, false);

                var balanceColor = res.is_balance ? '#2e9e4f' : '#c0392b';
                var balanceText = res.is_balance ? 'BALANCE ✓' : 'TIDAK BALANCE ✗';
                summaryDiv.style.background = res.is_balance ? 'rgba(255, 0, 255, 0.29)' : 'rgb(255, 255, 0)';
                 summaryDiv.style.color ='yellow'; 
                summaryDiv.innerHTML =
                    '<b>Periode:</b> ' + res.period_name + ' (per ' + res.as_of_date + ')' +
                    ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b>Total Debit:</b> ' + Ext.util.Format.number(res.total_debit, '0,000.00') +
                    ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b>Total Kredit:</b> ' + Ext.util.Format.number(res.total_credit, '0,000.00') +
                    ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b style="color:' + balanceColor + ';">' + balanceText + '</b>';
                fitGrid();     // [FIT-GRID] summary mengubah posisi grid -> sesuaikan tinggi
            }
        });
    }

    btnShow.on('click', loadTrialBalance);
    fldHideZero.on('check', loadTrialBalance);

    // ============================================================
    // 3. Grid Trial Balance
    // ============================================================
    let mainHeight=(maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));

    var gridMain = new stdGridPaging({
        store: tbDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height : mainHeight,

        columns: [
            { header: 'Kode Akun', dataIndex: 'account_code', width: 100, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Nama Akun', dataIndex: 'account_name', width: 260, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Tipe', dataIndex: 'account_type', width: 100, renderer: function (v) { return v ? v.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + v.slice(1) : ''; } },
            {
                header: 'Debit', dataIndex: 'debit', width: 140, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return v ? Ext.util.Format.number(v, '0,000.00') : ''; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Kredit', dataIndex: 'credit', width: 140, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return v ? Ext.util.Format.number(v, '0,000.00') : ''; }
            }
        ],
        pageSize: 500,
        pageStore: tbDs
    });
    fitGrid();     // [FIT-GRID] tinggi awal sesuai layar

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        window.open('../pdf/trialbalance.php?period_id=' + perId, 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
    };
       document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';

    }
});

Ext.onReady(function() {
  Ext.QuickTips.init();

  // Scoped state variables
  let task = '';
  let deleteRow = 0;
  let deleteRecord = null;
  let gridEditorCheck = 0;

  // DOM Helper
  const setDisplay = (id, displayStyle) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.style.display = displayStyle;
  };

  const setHtml = (id, html) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.innerHTML = html;
  };

  setDisplay('addWdw', 'block');

  // Event Handlers
  document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function() {
    const saveBtn = document.getElementById("saveEdit");
    saveBtn.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
    saveBtn.style.backgroundColor = '#1D6788';
    saveBtn.style.color = '#fff';
    
    if (formAccess==2 || formAccess==3 || formAccess==4){
      task = 'create';
      gridEditorDs.load({ params: { id: 0 } });
      setDisplay('editorWdw', 'block');
      setHtml("editorFormHeaderText", "&nbsp;&nbsp;New Supplier");
      frmEditor.getForm().reset();
      Ext.getCmp('init').focus('', 10);
    } else {
      task = '';
      setHtml("popWdwTxt", 'not enough permission to access this window');
      setDisplay('popWdw', 'block');
    }
  };

  document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function() {
    if ( formAccess==3 || formAccess==4){
      task = 'update';
      frmEditor.getForm().reset();
      Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().load({
        url: '../php-crud/m.supplierCRD.php',
        params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'readedit' },
        success: function(form, action) {
          let dt = action.result.data;
        }
      });
      setDisplay('editorWdw', 'block');
      setHtml("editorFormHeaderText", "&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Supplier");
    } else {
      task = '';
      setHtml("popWdwTxt", 'not enough permission to access this window');
      setDisplay('popWdw', 'block');
    }
  };

  document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function() {
    if (formAccess === 4) {
      task = 'delete';
      let supplierName = dataRecord.name;
      setDisplay('popWdw', 'block');
      setDisplay('popCancel', 'block');
      setHtml("popWdwTxt", `delete '${supplierName}' ?`);
    } else {
      task = '';
      setHtml("popWdwTxt", 'not enough permission to delete this data');
      setDisplay('popWdw', 'block');
    }
  };

  document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function() {
    window.open(
      "../pdf/m.supplier.php", 
      'sub', 
      'toolbar=no,location=no,status=no,directories=no,menubar=no'
    );
  };

  document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function() {
    let arrContact = new Ext.data.ArrayStore({ fields: contactField });
    let records = gridEditorDs.getRange();

    records.forEach(rec => {
      arrContact.add(new addRow({
        cont_id         : rec.get('cont_id'),
        name            : rec.get('name'),
        position        : rec.get('position'),
        cont_phone_id   : rec.get('cont_phone_id'),
        phone           : rec.get('phone'),
        cont_mobile_id  : rec.get('cont_mobile_id'),
        mobile          : rec.get('mobile'),
        cont_email_id   : rec.get('cont_email_id'),
        email           : rec.get('email'),
        cont_address_id : rec.get('cont_address_id'),
        address         : rec.get('address'),
        remark          : rec.get('remark')
      }));
    });

    frmEditor.getForm().submit({
      method: 'POST',
      params: { 
        task: task, 
        logActive: Ext.getCmp('logActive').getValue(), 
        arrContact: DsArray2Json(arrContact)
      },
      waitTitle: 'Connecting',
      waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
      success: function(form, action) {
        let objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
        setHtml("popWdwTxt", objResponse.message);
        setDisplay('popWdw', 'block');

        mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
        setDisplay('editorWdw', 'none');
      },
      failure: function(form, action) {
        let objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
        setHtml("popWdwTxt", objResponse ? objResponse.message : 'Save failed');
        setDisplay('popWdw', 'block');
      }
    });
  };

  document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function() {
    if (deleteRow > 0 && deleteRecord) {
      gridEditor.getStore().remove(deleteRecord);
      gridEditor.getView().refresh();
      deleteRow = 0;
      deleteRecord = null;
    }

    if (task === 'delete') {
      deleteDs.load({
        params: { task: "delete", id: dataRecord.id },
        callback: function(records, operation, success) {
          setDisplay('popWdw', 'none');
          setDisplay('popCancel', 'none');
          
          let responseText = operation.response ? operation.response.responseText : '{}';
          let textMessages = Ext.util.JSON.decode(responseText);
          
          setHtml("popWdwTxt", textMessages.message || 'Action completed');
          setDisplay('popWdw', 'block');
          
          mainDs.load({
            callback: function() {
              gridMain.getView().refresh(true);
            }
          });
        }
      });
    } else {
      setDisplay('popWdw', 'none');
      setDisplay('popCancel', 'none');
    }
    
    task = '';
  };

  document.getElementById('logData').onclick = function() {
    setDisplay('logWdw', 'block');
    setHtml("logFormHeaderText", dataRecord.name);
    GridHistoryDs.load({ params: { id: dataRecord.id } });
  };

  let myMask = new Ext.LoadMask(Ext.getBody(), { msg: "Please wait..." });

document.getElementById('addSaveEdit').onclick = function(event) {
  let phone = Ext.getCmp('cont_phone').getValue();
  let mobile = Ext.getCmp('cont_mobile').getValue();
  let email = Ext.getCmp('cont_email').getValue();

  let cont_contact = (phone == null || phone === '') ? '' : ' Phone : ' + phone;
  cont_contact += (mobile == null || mobile === '') ? '' : '<br> Mobile : ' + mobile;
  cont_contact += (email == null || email === '') ? '' : ' <br> Email : ' + email;

  let formattedAddress = (Ext.getCmp('cont_addr').getValue() || '').replace(/\n/gi, '<br>');

  if (gridEditorCheck === 1) {
    let sm = gridEditor.getSelectionModel();
    let rec = null;

    // Safely retrieve selected record regardless of SelectionModel type
    if (typeof sm.getSelected === 'function') {
      rec = sm.getSelected();
    } else if (typeof sm.getSelections === 'function') {
      rec = sm.getSelections()[0];
    } else if (typeof sm.getSelectedCell === 'function') {
      let cell = sm.getSelectedCell();
      if (cell) {
        rec = gridEditor.getStore().getAt(cell[0]);
      }
    }

    if (rec) {
      rec.set('name', Ext.getCmp('cont_name').getValue());
      rec.set('position', Ext.getCmp('cont_position').getValue());
      rec.set('address', formattedAddress);
      rec.set('contact', cont_contact);
      rec.set('phone', phone);
      rec.set('mobile', mobile);
      rec.set('email', email);
      rec.set('remark', Ext.getCmp('cont_remark').getValue());
      gridEditor.getView().refresh();
    } else {
      Ext.Msg.alert('Warning', 'Please select a row in the contact grid first.');
      return;
    }
  } else {
    gridEditor.store.add(new addRow({
      cont_id          : Ext.getCmp('cont_id').getValue(),
      cont_address_id : Ext.getCmp('cont_address_id').getValue(),
      cont_email_id   : Ext.getCmp('cont_email_id').getValue(),
      cont_mobile_id  : Ext.getCmp('cont_mobile_id').getValue(),
      cont_phone_id   : Ext.getCmp('cont_phone_id').getValue(),
      name            : Ext.getCmp('cont_name').getValue(),
      position        : Ext.getCmp('cont_position').getValue(),
      address         : formattedAddress,
      contact         : cont_contact,
      phone           : phone,
      mobile          : mobile,
      email           : email,
      remark          : Ext.getCmp('cont_remark').getValue()
    }));
  }
  document.getElementById('addWdw').style.display = 'none';
};

    function togglePasswordVisibility(fieldId, btnElement) {
        var field = Ext.getCmp(fieldId);
        if (!field || !field.el || !field.el.dom) return;
        var inputEl = field.el.dom;
        if (inputEl.tagName !== 'INPUT') { inputEl = inputEl.querySelector('input') || inputEl; }
        var isCurrentlyHidden = (inputEl.type === 'password');
        if (isCurrentlyHidden) {
            inputEl.type = 'text';
            btnElement.innerHTML = ICON_EYE_OPEN;
            btnElement.title = 'Sembunyikan password';
        } else {
            inputEl.type = 'password';
            btnElement.innerHTML = ICON_EYE_CLOSED;
            btnElement.title = 'Tampilkan password';
        }
    }
    function addToggleToField(fieldId) {
        setTimeout(function() {
            var field = Ext.getCmp(fieldId);
            if (!field || !field.el || !field.el.dom) return;
            var inputEl = field.el.dom;
            if (inputEl.tagName !== 'INPUT') { inputEl = inputEl.querySelector('input') || inputEl; }
            var wrapper = inputEl;
            while (wrapper && wrapper !== document.body && !wrapper.classList.contains('x-form-field-wrap')) { wrapper = wrapper.parentNode; }
            if (!wrapper || wrapper === document.body) { wrapper = inputEl.parentNode; }
            wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
            if (document.getElementById('toggle-' + fieldId)) return;
            var toggleBtn = document.createElement('div');
            toggleBtn.id = 'toggle-' + fieldId;
            toggleBtn.style.cssText = 'position:absolute; right:8px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); cursor:pointer; padding:4px; z-index:99; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:transparent; border:none;';
            toggleBtn.innerHTML = ICON_EYE_CLOSED;
            toggleBtn.title = 'Tampilkan password';
            toggleBtn.onclick = function(e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); togglePasswordVisibility(fieldId, this); };
            wrapper.appendChild(toggleBtn);
            inputEl.style.paddingRight = '32px';
        }, 400);
    }

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function(event) {
        var arrForm = new Ext.data.ArrayStore({ fields: formField });
        arrForm.loadData(EmptyArr);
        for (i = 0; i < gridEditorDs.data.length; i++) {
            var dataFormGrid = gridEditorDs.data.items[i];
            arrForm.add(new addRow({
                id: dataFormGrid.data.id,
                form_id: dataFormGrid.data.form_id,
                access_level: dataFormGrid.data.access_level
            }));
        }
        Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().submit({
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: task,
                u_active: Ext.getCmp('AddActive').getValue(),
                apply_role: (roleAppliedId > 0 && !roleGridDirty
                             && roleAppliedId === parseInt(Ext.getCmp('role_id_combo').getValue(), 10)) ? 1 : 0,
                form_access: DsArray2Json(arrForm)
            },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function(form, action) {
                var objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                var messages = objResponse.message;
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = messages;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function(form, action) {
                var objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                var messages = objResponse.message;
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = messages;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };
    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function(event) {
        if (deleteRow > 0) {
            if (deleteRecord && Ext.getCmp('gridEditor')) {
                Ext.getCmp('gridEditor').getStore().remove(deleteRecord);
                Ext.getCmp('gridEditor').getView().refresh();
            }
            deleteRow = 0;
            deleteRecord = null;
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
            return;
        }
        if (task == 'delete') {
            deleteDs.load({
                params: { task: "delete", id: dataRecord.id },
                callback: function(records, operation, success) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
                    task = '';
                    var textMessages = Ext.util.JSON.decode(operation.callback.caller.caller.arguments[2].responseText);
                    var messages = textMessages.message;
                    document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = messages;
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    mainDs.load();
                    gridMain.getView().refresh(true);
                }
            });
            task = '';
            return;
        }
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
    };

    // ---- Form Access otomatis dari matriks role --------------------------------
    var roleAppliedId = 0;
    var roleGridDirty = false;
    var applyingRole  = false;
    function markRoleGridDirty() { if (!applyingRole) { roleGridDirty = true; } }
    gridEditorDs.on('beforeload', function() { roleAppliedId = 0; roleGridDirty = false; });
    gridEditorDs.on('update', markRoleGridDirty);
    gridEditorDs.on('add', markRoleGridDirty);
    gridEditorDs.on('remove', markRoleGridDirty);

    function fetchRoleMatrix(rid, onDone) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: ROLE_CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_role_matrix', role_id: rid },
            success: function(response) {
                var obj = null;
                try { obj = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); } catch (e) {}
                if (!obj || obj.success === false || !obj.data) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('User Role', (obj && obj.message) || 'Gagal memuat form dari role.');
                    return;
                }
                var rows = [];
                for (var i = 0; i < obj.data.length; i++) {
                    if (parseInt(obj.data[i].access_level, 10) > 0) { rows.push(obj.data[i]); }
                }
                onDone(rows);
            },
            failure: function(response) {
                var msg = 'Gagal memuat form dari role.';
                try { msg = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText).message || msg; } catch (e) {}
                Ext.Msg.alert('User Role', msg);
            }
        });
    }
    function applyRoleReplaceAll(rid, rows) {
        var existing = {};
        gridEditorDs.each(function(r) {
            var rowId = parseInt(r.get('id'), 10);
            if (rowId > 0) { existing[r.get('form_id')] = rowId; }
        });
        for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
            rows[i].id = existing[rows[i].form_id] || '';
        }
        applyingRole = true;
        gridEditorDs.loadData({ data: rows, totalRecord: rows.length });
        applyingRole = false;
        roleAppliedId = rid;
        roleGridDirty = false;
    }
    function applyRoleAccessOnly(rid, rows) {
        var levelByForm = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
            levelByForm[rows[i].form_id] = parseInt(rows[i].access_level, 10);
        }
        var changed = 0, notInRole = 0;
        gridEditorDs.each(function(r) {
            var lvl = levelByForm[r.get('form_id')];
            if (lvl > 0) {
                if (parseInt(r.get('access_level'), 10) !== lvl) {
                    r.set('access_level', lvl);
                    changed++;
                }
            } else {
                notInRole++;
            }
        });
        roleAppliedId = 0;
        roleGridDirty = true;
        gridEditor.getView().refresh();
        Ext.Msg.alert('User Role',
            changed + ' form diperbarui levelnya.' +
            (notInRole > 0 ? '<br>' + notInRole + ' form di daftar tidak ada di role ini dan tidak diubah.' : ''));
    }
    function applyRoleToGrid(rid, askMode) {
        rid = parseInt(rid, 10);
        if (!rid) { return; }
        fetchRoleMatrix(rid, function(rows) {
            var current = gridEditorDs.getCount();
            if (askMode && current > 0) {
                Ext.Msg.show({
                    title: 'Apply Role',
                    msg: 'Form Access user ini sudah berisi ' + current + ' form.<br><br>' +
                         '<b>Update All</b>: ganti daftar form dan level sesuai role (' + rows.length + ' form).<br>' +
                         '<b>Access Only</b>: pertahankan daftar form, hanya ubah level form yang ada di role.',
                    width: 440,
                    icon: Ext.Msg.QUESTION,
                    buttons: { yes: 'Update All', no: 'Access Only', cancel: 'Cancel' },
                    fn: function(btn) {
                        if (btn === 'yes') { applyRoleReplaceAll(rid, rows); }
                        else if (btn === 'no') { applyRoleAccessOnly(rid, rows); }
                    }
                });
            } else {
                applyRoleReplaceAll(rid, rows);
            }
        });
    }

                        meta.attr = 'style= "padding:4px 0px !important;"'; return '<div class="grid-ribbon ribbon-purple-strip">Read/Create/Update</div>';
                    } else if (parseInt(value) == 4) {
                        meta.attr = 'style= "padding:4px 0px !important;"'; return '<div class="grid-ribbon ribbon-red-strip">Read/Create/Update/Delete</div>';
                    }
                }
            },
            { header: "Remark", dataIndex: 'remark', width: 300, align: 'left', renderer: CellWrap },
            { dataIndex: 'form_id', hidden: true },
            { dataIndex: 'id', hidden: true }
        ]
    });

    // ==========================================
    // 8. LOG HISTORY
    // ==========================================
    var GridHistoryDs = new historyDs({ url: CRD });
    var GridHistory = new historyGrid({ store: GridHistoryDs, renderTo: 'logFormMain' });
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

            }
        };

    // NONAKTIFKAN DATA
    if (document.getElementById('deleteData')) {
        document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data expense yang akan dinonaktifkan.');
                return;
            }
            if (getFormAccess() >= 4 || getFormAccess() === 0) {
                Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi', 'Nonaktifkan expense \'' + dataRecord.expense_name + '\'?', function (btn) {

                            params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },

                            }

        };
    }

    if (document.getElementById('saveEdit')) {

            var code = fldCode.getValue();
            var name = fldName.getValue();
            var category = fldCategory.getValue();
            var unit = fldUnit.getValue();
            if (!code) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Kode Expense wajib diisi.'); return; }

            if (!category) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Kategori wajib dipilih.'); return; }
            if (!unit) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Satuan wajib diisi.'); return; }

            var isChecked = fldActive.getValue();
            var activeVal = (isChecked === true || isChecked === 'true' || isChecked === '1') ? 'true' : 'false';

            frmEditor.getForm().submit({
                url: CRD,
                method: 'POST',
                params: {
                    task: task,
                    id: (dataRecord && dataRecord.id) ? dataRecord.id : 0,
                    is_active: activeVal

                failure: function (form, action) {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
                }
            });
        };
    }

    // Sembunyikan editor window saat pertama load
    if (document.getElementById('editorWdw')) {
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
    }
});
