/*
  Document      : m.fiscalperiod.js
  Description   : Fiscal Period - Grid + Add Form + Close/Reopen action
  Backend       : /rab-project/dev/php-crud/m.fiscalperiodCRD.php (tabel accounting_periods)
  [FIX 2026-10-08]:
   - safeDecode(): respons non-JSON (mis. PHP fatal error) tidak lagi menampilkan "undefined".
   - Aksi close/reopen/delete memakai Ext.Ajax.request (cara lama via Store.load + operation.response
     tidak valid di ExtJS 3.4.1 sehingga pesan selalu "Selesai").
   - Store utama diberi listener 'exception'.
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Fiscal <em>Period</em>";

    var CRD = '../php-crud/m.fiscalperiodCRD.php';
    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    // [FIX] decode JSON aman: kembalikan objek {success:false,message} bila respons bukan JSON
    function safeDecode(response) {
        try {
            return Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
        } catch (e) {
            return { success: false, message: 'Respons server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).' };
        }
    }

    // [FIX 3] Date -> 'YYYY-MM-DD' tanpa bergantung pada Date.prototype.format
    function toYmd(d) {
        if (!(d instanceof Date) || isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
        var m = d.getMonth() + 1, day = d.getDate();
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + '-' + (day < 10 ? '0' : '') + day;
    }

    // [FIX] helper popup pesan
    function showPop(msg) {
        document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = msg || '';
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 1. Field definitions
    // ============================================================
    var periodField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'period_name' },
        { name: 'start_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'end_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'is_closed', type: 'boolean' }
    ];

    // ============================================================
    // 2. Main store & grid
    // ============================================================
    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, periodField),
        listeners: {
            // [FIX] wajib: tampilkan pesan bila muat data gagal
            exception: function () {
                showPop('Gagal memuat data periode dari server.');
            }
        }
    });
    mainDs.load();
    let mainHeight = (maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));

    var gridMain = new stdGridPaging({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: mainHeight,

        columns: [
            { header: 'Periode', dataIndex: 'period_name', width: 150, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Mulai', dataIndex: 'start_date', width: 100, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            { header: 'Selesai', dataIndex: 'end_date', width: 100, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            {
                header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'is_closed', width: 100, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) { return v ? '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-weight:bold;">Closed</span>' : '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;">Open</span>'; }
            }
        ],
        listeners: {
            cellclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                dataRecord = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex).data;
                mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                toggleCloseReopenButton();
            }
        },
        pageSize: 250,
        pageStore: mainDs
    });
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // Fiscal Period tidak diedit isinya -- cuma bisa Add & Close/Reopen
    document.getElementById('editData').style.display = 'none';

    function toggleCloseReopenButton() {
        var btn = document.getElementById('closePeriod');
        if (!btn || !dataRecord) return;
        btn.style.display = 'block';
        btn.innerHTML = dataRecord.is_closed
            ? '<t>Reopen</t><i class="material-icons md-22 white">lock_open</i>'
            : '<t>Close</t><i class="material-icons md-22 white">lock</i>';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 3. Editor Form (Add periode baru)
    // ============================================================
    var fldName = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Nama Periode', id: 'period_name', name: 'period_name', allowBlank: false, emptyText: 'ex: 2026-08 atau Agustus 2026' });
    var fldStart = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Mulai', id: 'start_date', name: 'start_date', allowBlank: false });
    var fldEnd = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Selesai', id: 'end_date', name: 'end_date', allowBlank: false });
    var fldId = new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 120,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 1, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldName },
            { columnWidth: 0.5, items: fldStart },
            { columnWidth: 0.5, items: fldEnd },
            { items: fldId },
            { columnWidth: 1, items: FieldSpaceTopLabel }
        ]
    });
    frmEditor.on('clientvalidation', function (f, valid) { if (!valid) { saveEditDisable(); } else { saveEditEnable(); } });

    // ============================================================
    // 4. Toolbar
    // ============================================================
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
        if (getFormAccess() == 2 || getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'create';
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Tambah Periode';
        } else {
            showPop('Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.');
        }
    };

    var closeReopenBtn = document.getElementById('closePeriod');
    if (closeReopenBtn) {
        closeReopenBtn.onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                showPop('Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.');
                return;
            }
            if (getFormAccess() < 4) {
                showPop('Hanya akses tertinggi yang boleh menutup/membuka periode.');
                return;
            }
            var actionTask = dataRecord.is_closed ? 'reopen' : 'close';
            var confirmMsg = dataRecord.is_closed
                ? 'Buka kembali periode \'' + dataRecord.period_name + '\'?'
                : 'Tutup periode \'' + dataRecord.period_name + '\'? Setelah ditutup, jurnal baru tidak bisa masuk ke periode ini.';

            task = actionTask;
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            showPop(confirmMsg);
        };
    }

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            showPop('Pilih data terlebih dahulu.');
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.is_closed) {
            showPop('Periode yang sudah ditutup tidak boleh dihapus.');
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'delete';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            showPop('Hapus periode \'' + dataRecord.period_name + '\' ?');
        } else {
            showPop('Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus data.');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function (event) {
        window.open("../pdf/fiscalperiod.php", 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            // [FIX 2] kirim tanggal eksplisit Y-m-d (field menampilkan 'd M y', bukan format DB)
            params: {
                task: task,
                start_ymd: toYmd(fldStart.getValue()),    // [FIX 3] jangan pakai Date.format (ditimpa library lain)
                end_ymd: toYmd(fldEnd.getValue())
            },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = safeDecode(action.response);          // [FIX]
                // [FIX] server bisa membalas success:false dengan HTTP 200 -> tangani di sini
                if (res.success === false) {
                    showPop(res.message);
                    return;
                }
                showPop(res.message);
                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                // [FIX] action.response bisa undefined (client invalid / koneksi gagal)
                var res = action && action.response ? safeDecode(action.response)
                                                    : { message: 'Gagal menghubungi server atau form belum valid.' };
                showPop(res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        if ((task == 'delete' || task == 'close' || task == 'reopen') && dataRecord) {
            var doTask = task;
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
            task = '';

            // [FIX] Ext.Ajax.request menggantikan Store.load + operation.response
            Ext.Ajax.request({
                url: CRD,
                method: 'POST',
                params: { task: doTask, id: dataRecord.id },
                success: function (response) {
                    var res = safeDecode(response);
                    showPop(res.message || 'Selesai');
                    if (res.success) {
                        dataRecord = null;
                        mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
                        var btn = document.getElementById('closePeriod');
                        if (btn) btn.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                    mainDs.load();
                },
                failure: function () {
                    showPop('Gagal menghubungi server.');
                }
            });
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

/*
  Document      : m.invoice.js
  Description   : Sales Invoice - Header Grid + Editor Form dengan item
                   grid inline-editable. Status draft -> final (final
                   dipicu otomatis oleh tombol Print).
  Backend       : /inv/php-crud/invoiceCRD.php
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Sales <em>Invoice</em>";

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 0. Buat elemen tambahan (Add Line & Total) secara dinamis
    // ============================================================
    (function injectExtraUI() {
        var gridContainer = document.getElementById('editorFormGrid');
        if (gridContainer && !document.getElementById('btnAddItem')) {
            var soItemPanel = document.createElement('div');
            soItemPanel.id = 'soItemPickerPanel';
            soItemPanel.style.cssText = 'padding:6px; margin-bottom:6px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius:4px; display:none;';
            gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(soItemPanel, gridContainer);

            var toolbar = document.createElement('div');
            toolbar.style.padding = '5px 0';
            //toolbar.innerHTML = '<button id="btnAddItem" type="button" class="field-button grey-field-button">+ Tambah Item Manual</button>';
            gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(toolbar, gridContainer);

            var totalsDiv = document.createElement('div');
            totalsDiv.className = 'invoice-totals';
            totalsDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:8px 0; font-weight:bold; font-size:14px; color:#fff;';
            totalsDiv.innerHTML = 'Total: <span id="lblInvoiceTotal">0.00</span>';
            gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(totalsDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling);
        }
    })();

    function renderSoItemPicker() {
        var panel = document.getElementById('soItemPickerPanel');
        if (!panel) return;

        if (soItemDs.getCount() === 0) {
            panel.style.display = 'none';
            return;
        }

        // Otomatis masukkan SEMUA item SO yang belum di-invoice ke grid invoice
        soItemDs.each(function (r) {
            var soItemId = r.get('so_item_id');
            var soqty = r.get('qty');
            var sounitprice = r.get('unit_price');
            var sosubtotal = r.get('subtotal');

            var exists = itemGridDs.findExact('so_item_id', soItemId) >= 0;
            if (!exists) {
                itemGridDs.add(new addItemRow({
                    so_item_id: soItemId,
                    description: r.get('description') || r.get('product_name') || '(tanpa deskripsi)',
                    qty: soqty, unit_price: sounitprice, subtotal: sosubtotal
                }));
            }
        });
        updateInvoiceTotal();

        panel.style.display = 'block';
        panel.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px; color:#2e9e4f;">✓ ' + soItemDs.getCount() + ' item dari Sales Order ini sudah otomatis ditambahkan ke daftar item invoice di bawah.</div>';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 1. Field definitions & stores
    // ============================================================
    var invoiceField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'invoice_no' }, { name: 'so_id' }, { name: 'so_ref_no' },
        { name: 'customer_id' }, { name: 'customer_name' },
        { name: 'invoice_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'due_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'total_amount', type: 'float' }, { name: 'paid_amount', type: 'float' }, { name: 'status' }
    ];

    var itemField = [
        { name: 'line_id' }, 
        { name: 'so_item_id' }, 
        { name: 'description' }, 
        { name: 'qty', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'unit_price', type: 'float' }, 
        { name: 'subtotal', type: 'float' }
    ];
    var addItemRow = Ext.data.Record.create(itemField);

    var soItemField = [
        { name: 'so_item_id' }, 
        { name: 'description' },
        { name: 'qty' }, 
        { name: 'unit_price' }, 
        { name: 'subtotal' },  
        { name: 'product_name' }
    ];
    var soItemDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_so_items' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data' }, soItemField)
    });
    soItemDs.on('load', renderSoItemPicker);

    var soField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'ref_no' }, { name: 'tx_date' }, { name: 'legacy_customer_name' }];
    var soDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_so' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, soField)
    });
    soDs.load();

    var customerField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }];
    var customerDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_customer' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, customerField)
    });
    customerDs.load();

    var itemGridDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_items' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, itemField)
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 2. Main grid
    // ============================================================
    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, invoiceField)
    });
    mainDs.load();

    function statusRenderer(v) {
        return v === 'final'
            ? '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">Final</span>'
            : '<span style="color:#e08e0b;">Draft</span>';
    }
    let mainHeight=(maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));

    var gridMain = new stdGridPaging({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height : mainHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. Invoice', dataIndex: 'invoice_no', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'No. SO', dataIndex: 'so_ref_no', width: 100, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Customer', dataIndex: 'customer_name', width: 160, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Tanggal', dataIndex: 'invoice_date', width: 90, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            { header: 'Jatuh Tempo', dataIndex: 'due_date', width: 90, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            {
                header: 'Total', dataIndex: 'total_amount', width: 120, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Terbayar', dataIndex: 'paid_amount', width: 110, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            { header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 80, align: 'center', renderer: statusRenderer }
        ],
        listeners: {
            cellclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                dataRecord = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex).data;
                mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                editDataEnable();
            }
        },
        pageSize: 250,
        pageStore: mainDs
    });
    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ============================================================
    // 3. Item grid (inline editable)
    // ============================================================
    var itemDeleter = new Extensive.grid.ItemDeleter();

    var itemGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: itemGridDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true, scrollOffset: 0 },
        height: 200,
        selModel: itemDeleter,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Deskripsi', dataIndex: 'description', width: 220, editor: new myTextField({}), renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Qty', dataIndex: 'qty', width: 70, align: 'right', editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }), renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); } },
            { header: 'Harga Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit_price', width: 120, align: 'right', editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }), renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); } },
            { header: 'Subtotal', dataIndex: 'subtotal', width: 130, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00') + '</b>'; } },
            itemDeleter
        ],
        listeners: {
            afteredit: function (e) {
                if (e.field === 'qty' || e.field === 'unit_price') {
                    var qty = parseFloat(e.record.get('qty')) || 0;
                    var price = parseFloat(e.record.get('unit_price')) || 0;
                    e.record.set('subtotal', qty * price);
                }
                updateInvoiceTotal();
            }
        }
    });
    itemGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    document.getElementById('btnAddItem') && (document.getElementById('btnAddItem').onclick = function () {
        itemGridDs.add(new addItemRow({ description: '', qty: 1, unit_price: 0, subtotal: 0 }));
    });

    function updateInvoiceTotal() {
        var total = 0;
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) { total += parseFloat(r.get('subtotal')) || 0; });
        var el = document.getElementById('lblInvoiceTotal');
        if (el) el.innerHTML = Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.00');
    }
    itemGridDs.on('update', updateInvoiceTotal);
    itemGridDs.on('add', updateInvoiceTotal);
    itemGridDs.on('remove', updateInvoiceTotal);
    itemGridDs.on('load', updateInvoiceTotal);

    // ============================================================
    // 4. Editor Form
    // ============================================================
    var fldInvoiceNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Invoice', id: 'invoice_no', name: 'invoice_no', readOnly: true, emptyText: 'Auto-generate' });
    var fldSo = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Sales Order', id: 'so_id', name: 'so_id', hiddenName: 'so_id',
        store: soDs, displayField: 'ref_no', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false,
        listeners: {
            select: function (combo, record) {
                soItemDs.load({ params: { so_id: record.get('id') } });

                // Coba cocokkan Customer berdasarkan NAMA (bukan ID -- SO lama
                // pakai tabel m_customer yang terpisah dari tabel customers
                // baru, ID-nya tidak sebanding).
                var legacyName = (record.get('legacy_customer_name') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                fldCustomer.clearValue();
                if (legacyName) {
                    var matchIdx = customerDs.findBy(function (rec) {
                        return (rec.get('name') || '').trim().toLowerCase() === legacyName;
                    });
                    if (matchIdx >= 0) {
                        fldCustomer.setValue(customerDs.getAt(matchIdx).get('id'));
                    } else {
                        document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Customer SO ("' + record.get('legacy_customer_name') + '") tidak ditemukan otomatis di data Customer baru. Silakan pilih Customer secara manual.';
                        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    });
    var fldCustomer = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Customer', id: 'customer_id', name: 'customer_id', hiddenName: 'customer_id',
        store: customerDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldInvDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Invoice', id: 'invoice_date', name: 'invoice_date', allowBlank: false, value: new Date() });
    var fldDueDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Jatuh Tempo', id: 'due_date', name: 'due_date' });
    var fldId = new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 110,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldInvoiceNo },
            { items: fldSo },
            { items: fldCustomer },
            { items: fldInvDate },
            { items: fldDueDate },
            { items: fldId }
        ]
    });
    frmEditor.on('clientvalidation', function (f, valid) { if (!valid) { saveEditDisable(); } else { saveEditEnable(); } });

    // ============================================================
    // 5. Toolbar
    // ============================================================
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
        if (getFormAccess() == 2 || getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'create';
            itemGridDs.removeAll();
            soItemDs.removeAll();
            var panel = document.getElementById('soItemPickerPanel');
            if (panel) panel.style.display = 'none';
            updateInvoiceTotal();
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Tambah Invoice';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'draft') {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hanya invoice berstatus Draft yang boleh diedit.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            task = 'update';
            frmEditor.getForm().load({ url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php', params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' } });
            itemGridDs.load({ params: { id: dataRecord.id } });
            if (dataRecord.so_id) soItemDs.load({ params: { so_id: dataRecord.so_id } });
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Invoice';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'draft') {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hanya invoice berstatus Draft yang boleh dihapus.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'delete';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hapus invoice \'' + dataRecord.invoice_no + '\' ?';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus data.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    // Print -- finalisasi otomatis dulu (draft -> final + jurnal), baru buka PDF
    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih invoice terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'finalize', id: dataRecord.id },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                if (!res.already_final) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                }
                window.open('../pdf/invoice.php?id=' + dataRecord.id, 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
            },
            failure: function () {
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Gagal menghubungi server untuk finalisasi invoice.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        var arrItems = [];
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
            arrItems.push({
                so_item_id: r.get('so_item_id'),
                description: r.get('description'), qty: r.get('qty'),
                unit_price: r.get('unit_price'), subtotal: r.get('subtotal')
            });
        });

        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: task, arrItems: JSON.stringify(arrItems) },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                itemGridDs.removeAll();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message || 'Gagal menyimpan invoice.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        if (task == 'delete') {
            var deleteDs = new Ext.data.Store({ url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php' });
            deleteDs.load({
                params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                callback: function (records, operation) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(operation.response ? operation.response.responseText : '{}');
                    document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message || 'Selesai';
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    task = '';
                    mainDs.load();
                }
            });
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});
==================== FILE: ./js/m.materials.js ====================
/*
  Document      : m.materials.js
  Description   : Client-side Controller CRUD Master Material (m_materials)
                  menggunakan ExtJS 3.x dan layout stdForm.
  Backend       : ../php-crud/m.materialsCRD.php
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    var CRD = main_url + '/php-crud/m.materialsCRD.php';

    // Header halaman
    if (document.getElementById("mainHeaderText")) {
        document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Master <em>Material</em>";
    }

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 1. DATA STORE & FIELDS
    // ============================================================
    var materialField = [
        { name: 'id' }, 
        { name: 'material_code' }, 
        { name: 'material_name' }, 
        { name: 'unit' },
        { name: 'estimated_price', type: 'float' }, 
        { name: 'active', type: 'boolean' },
        { name: 'created_at', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' }
    ];

    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'list' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, materialField)
    });
    mainDs.load();

    // ============================================================
    // 2. GRID PANEL UTAMA
    // ============================================================
    var GridDtlHeight = (typeof maxGridHeight === 'function') 
        ? maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')) 
        : 400;

    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: GridDtlHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Kode Material', dataIndex: 'material_code', width: 120, renderer: typeof CellWrap !== 'undefined' ? CellWrap : null },
            { header: 'Nama Material', dataIndex: 'material_name', width: 260, renderer: typeof CellWrap !== 'undefined' ? CellWrap : null },
            { header: 'Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit', width: 90, align: 'center', renderer: typeof CellWrap !== 'undefined' ? CellWrap : null },
            {
                header: 'Estimasi Harga', dataIndex: 'estimated_price', width: 140, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'active', width: 100, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) {
                    return (v === true || v === 'true' || v === 't' || v === 1)
                        ? '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">Aktif</span>'
                        : '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-weight:bold;">Nonaktif</span>';
                }
            }
        ],
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        loadMask: true,
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) {
                    dataRecord = rec.data;
                    if (typeof mainBtnEnable === 'function') {
                        mainBtnEnable('#editData');
                        mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    });

    if (typeof editDataDisable === 'function') editDataDisable();
    if (typeof mainBtnDisable === 'function') mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ============================================================
    // 3. KOMPONEN FORM EDITOR (Menggunakan stdForm & myTextField)
    // ============================================================
    var fldMaterialCode = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Kode Material', id: 'material_code', name: 'material_code', allowBlank: false, maxLength: 30 });
    var fldMaterialName = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Nama Material', id: 'material_name', name: 'material_name', allowBlank: false, maxLength: 150 });
    var fldUnit = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Satuan', id: 'unit', name: 'unit', allowBlank: false, maxLength: 20, emptyText: 'sak, m3, kg, btg, pcs, dll' });
    var fldEstimatedPrice = new myNumberField({ fieldLabel: 'Estimasi Harga', id: 'estimated_price', name: 'estimated_price', decimalPrecision: 2, allowBlank: false, value: 0 });
    
    var fldActive = new Ext.form.Checkbox({
        fieldLabel: 'Status Aktif', 
        labelSeparator: '&nbsp;&nbsp;-&nbsp;&nbsp;',
        id: 'is_active', 
        name: 'active', 
        cls: 'fieldCheckClass regular-checkbox',
        inputValue: 'true',
        uncheckedValue: 'false',
        checked: true
    });
    
    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 130,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldMaterialCode },
            { items: fldUnit },
            { items: fldMaterialName },
            { items: fldEstimatedPrice },
            { columnWidth: 0.5, labelAlign: 'right', labelWidth: 130, items: fldActive },
            { items: [new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true })] }
        ]
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 4. ACTION HANDLERS (Tambah, Edit, Hapus, Simpan)
    // ============================================================

    // TAMBAH DATA
    if (document.getElementById('addData')) {
        document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
            if (getFormAccess() >= 2 || getFormAccess() === 0) {
                task = 'create';
                dataRecord = null;
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                fldActive.setValue(true);
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
                if (document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText')) {
                    document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Material Baru';
                }
                fldMaterialCode.focus('', 10);
            } else {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menambah material.');
            }
        };
    }

    // EDIT DATA
    if (document.getElementById('editData')) {
        document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data material terlebih dahulu dari tabel.');
                return;
            }
            if (getFormAccess() >= 3 || getFormAccess() === 0) {
                task = 'update';
                frmEditor.getForm().load({
                    url: CRD,
                    params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' },
                    success: function (form, action) {
                        var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                        var val = res.data.active;
                        
                        // Parameter konversi boolean presisi
                        var isChecked = (val === true || val === 'true' || val === 't' || val === 1 || val === '1');
                        fldActive.setValue(isChecked);
                    },
                    failure: function () {
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal memuat data material.');
                    }
                });
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
                if (document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText')) {
                    document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Material';
                }
            } else {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk edit material.');
            }
        };
    }

    // NONAKTIFKAN / HAPUS DATA
    if (document.getElementById('deleteData')) {
        document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data material yang akan dinonaktifkan.');
                return;
            }
            if (getFormAccess() >= 4 || getFormAccess() === 0) {
                Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi', 'Nonaktifkan material \'' + dataRecord.material_name + '\'?', function (btn) {
                    if (btn === 'yes') {
                        Ext.Ajax.request({
                            url: CRD,
                            method: 'POST',
                            params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                            success: function (response) {
                                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                                if (res.success) {
                                    Ext.Msg.alert('Informasi', 'Material berhasil dinonaktifkan.');
                                    dataRecord = null;
                                    if (typeof editDataDisable === 'function') editDataDisable();
                                    if (typeof mainBtnDisable === 'function') mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
                                    mainDs.load();
                                } else {
                                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message);
                                }
                            },
                            failure: function () {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });
            } else {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menonaktifkan material.');
            }
        };
    }

    // SIMPAN DATA (CREATE / UPDATE)
        document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
            var code = fldMaterialCode.getValue();
            var name = fldMaterialName.getValue();
            var unit = fldUnit.getValue();

            if (!code) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Kode Material wajib diisi.'); return; }
            if (!name) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Nama Material wajib diisi.'); return; }
            if (!unit) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Satuan wajib diisi.'); return; }

            // Evaluasi eksplisit kondisi Checkbox agar dikirim akurat
            var isChecked = fldActive.getValue();
            var activeVal = (isChecked === true || isChecked === 'true' || isChecked === '1') ? 'true' : 'false';

            frmEditor.getForm().submit({
                url: CRD,
                method: 'POST',
                params: {
                    task: task,
                    id: (dataRecord && dataRecord.id) ? dataRecord.id : 0,
                    is_active: activeVal
                },
                waitTitle: 'Menyimpan',
                waitMsg: 'Menyimpan data material...',
                success: function (form, action) {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', 'Material ' + (res.material_code || code) + ' berhasil disimpan.');
                    mainDs.load();
                    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                },
                failure: function (form, action) {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
                }
            });
        };

    if (document.getElementById('editorWdw')) {
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
    }
});

/*
  Document      : m.fiscalconfig.js
  Description   : Fiscal Config - Grid + Detail View + Editor Form
  Backend       : /rab-project/dev/php-crud/fiscalconfigCRD.php

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Fiscal <em>Config</em>";

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    // 0. Container Detail Fiscal Rule (Samakan class dengan PO Detail)
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');

    var fiscalDtlDiv = document.createElement('div');
    fiscalDtlDiv.id = 'fiscalDtlContainer';
    fiscalDtlDiv.className = 'detail-panel-container';
    fiscalDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';

    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(fiscalDtlDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Field definitions & stores
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var configField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'rule_code' }, { name: 'rule_name' },
        { name: 'debit_account_id' }, { name: 'debit_code' }, { name: 'debit_name' },
        { name: 'credit_account_id' }, { name: 'credit_code' }, { name: 'credit_name' },
        { name: 'is_active', type: 'boolean' }
    ];

    var coaField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'account_code' }, { name: 'account_name' }];
    var coaDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/m.coaCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_parent' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, coaField)
    });
    coaDs.load();

    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/fiscalconfigCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, configField)
    });
    mainDs.load();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Main Grid
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var GridDtlHeight = (maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));
    var mainHeight = Math.round(GridDtlHeight - (GridDtlHeight * 0.45));
    var detailHeight = (GridDtlHeight - mainHeight);
    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: mainHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Rule Code', dataIndex: 'rule_code', width: 100, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Nama Rule', dataIndex: 'rule_name', width: 200, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Akun Debit', dataIndex: 'debit_code', width: 180, renderer: function (v, m, r) { return r.get('debit_code') + ' - ' + r.get('debit_name'); } },
            { header: 'Akun Kredit', dataIndex: 'credit_code', width: 180, renderer: function (v, m, r) { return r.get('credit_code') + ' - ' + r.get('credit_name'); } },
            {
                header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'is_active', width: 80, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) { return v ? '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">Aktif</span>' : '<span style="color:#c0392b !important;font-weight:bold;">Nonaktif</span>'; }
            }
        ],
        stripeRows: true,
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        loadMask: true,
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) {
                    dataRecord = rec.data;
                    editDataEnable();
                    mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                    document.getElementById('fiscalDtlContainer').style.display = 'block';
                    loadFiscalDetail(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.rule_code);
                }
            }
        }
    });
    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Detail View Renderer (Diperbarui dengan CSS PO Detail)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function loadFiscalDetail(id, ruleCode) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/fiscalconfigCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_detail', id: id },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    fiscalDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">Gagal memuat detail rule.</div>';
                    fiscalDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderFiscalDetailView(res.data || {}, ruleCode);
            },
            failure: function () {
                fiscalDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                fiscalDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderFiscalDetailView(data, ruleCode) {
        var statusText = data.is_active ? '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">Aktif</span>' : '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-weight:bold;">Nonaktif</span>';

        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Detail Posting Rule: ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(ruleCode || '') + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left" width="200">Parameter</th>' +
                   '<th align="left">Informasi Akun / Sistem</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   'tbody' +
                   '<tr class="data-row">' +
                   '<td align="left">Nama Rule</td>' +
                   '<td align="left" style="font-weight:bold;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(data.rule_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '<tr class="data-row">' +
                   '<td align="left">Posisi Debit (DR)</td>' +
                   '<td align="left" style="color:#2e9e4f !important; font-weight:bold;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(data.debit_code ? (data.debit_code + ' - ' + data.debit_name) : '-') + '</td>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '<tr class="data-row">' +
                   '<td align="left">Posisi Kredit (CR)</td>' +
                   '<td align="left" style="color:#c0392b !important; font-weight:bold;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(data.credit_code ? (data.credit_code + ' - ' + data.credit_name) : '-') + '</td>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '<tr class="data-row">' +
                   '<td align="left">Status Rule</td>' +
                   '<td align="left">' + statusText + '</td>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</tbody>' +
                   '</table>';

        fiscalDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        fiscalDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Editor Form
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fldCode = new myTextField({
        fieldLabel: 'Rule Code', id: 'rule_code', name: 'rule_code', allowBlank: false,
        autoCreate: { tag: "input", maxlength: 15, type: "text", size: "15", autocomplete: "off" },
        listeners: { change: function (f) { f.setValue(f.getValue().toUpperCase()); } }
    });
    var fldName = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Nama Rule', id: 'rule_name', name: 'rule_name', allowBlank: false });
    var fldDebit = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Akun Debit', id: 'debit_account_id', name: 'debit_account_id', hiddenName: 'debit_account_id',
        store: coaDs, displayField: 'account_name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldCredit = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Akun Kredit', id: 'credit_account_id', name: 'credit_account_id', hiddenName: 'credit_account_id',
        store: coaDs, displayField: 'account_name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldActive = new Ext.form.Checkbox({
        fieldLabel: 'Status Aktif', labelSeparator: '&nbsp;&nbsp;-&nbsp;&nbsp;',
        id: 'is_active', name: 'is_active', cls: 'fieldCheckClass regular-checkbox',
        inputValue: 'true', checked: true
    });
    var fldId = new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 130,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },

        ]
    });
    frmEditor.on('clientvalidation', function (f, valid) { if (!valid) { saveEditDisable(); } else { saveEditEnable(); } });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Toolbar Actions
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';

        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;

            frmEditor.getForm().reset();

            frmEditor.getForm().load({ url: '../php-crud/fiscalconfigCRD.php', params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' } });
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Rule';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'delete';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hapus rule \'' + dataRecord.rule_code + '\' ?';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus data.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function (event) {
        window.open("../pdf/fiscalconfig.php", 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/fiscalconfigCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: task },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                fiscalDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        if (task == 'delete') {
            var deleteDs = new Ext.data.Store({ url: '../php-crud/fiscalconfigCRD.php' });
            deleteDs.load({
                params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                callback: function () {
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
                    task = '';
                    fiscalDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                    mainDs.load();
                }
            });
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('fiscalDtlContainer').style.display = 'none';
});
==================== FILE: ./js/project.wiprelease.js ====================
/*
  Document      : project.wiprelease.js
  Description   : Pelepasan WIP -> HPP per proyek. Grid utama = daftar pelepasan; Add membuka editor
                  (proyek, tanggal, mode, progress %) dengan pratinjau hitungan dari server.
                  Mode: 'Per Progress (%)' = HPP kumulatif = WIP kumulatif x progress %;
                        'Proyek Selesai'   = 100% (seluruh WIP dilepas).
                  Simpan memposting jurnal Dr HPP / Cr WIP (rule WIP_RELEASE).
                  Delete = reverse pelepasan TERAKHIR per proyek (jurnal dihapus). Edit tidak tersedia.
                  Pola mengikuti po.js (template many-template-icn.php).
  Backend       : /rab-project/dev/php-crud/project.wipreleaseCRD.php
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Pelepasan <em>WIP</em>";

    var CRD = '../php-crud/project.wipreleaseCRD.php';
    var ACCESS_ADD = 2;      // level akses minimal: buat pelepasan
    var ACCESS_DEL = 3;      // level akses minimal: hapus (reverse)

    var dataRecord = null;   // baris pelepasan terpilih di grid utama
    var frm = null;          // form editor (dibuat saat editor pertama kali dibuka)
    var fDate, fProject, fMode, fPct, fRemark, fInfo;
    var previewReq = 0;      // penanda request pratinjau terbaru (abaikan respons usang)
    var previewOk = false;   // pratinjau terakhir valid & nilai dilepas > 0

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }
    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function fmtAmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    function fmtPct(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00') + ' %'; }
    // Workaround: Date.format('Y-m-d') pernah mengembalikan 'Y-10-10' di sebagian browser -> format manual
    function ymd(d) {
        var m = d.getMonth() + 1, day = d.getDate();
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : m) + '-' + (day < 10 ? '0' + day : day);
    }

    function showMsg(title, msg) { Ext.Msg.alert(title, msg); }

    function storeError(proxy, type, action, opt, res) {      // standar: setiap store punya handler exception
        var m = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        if (res && res.message) { m = res.message; } else if (res && res.status) { m += ' (HTTP ' + res.status + ')'; }
        showMsg('Gagal', m);
    }

    function ajax(params, onOk, onFail) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: params,
            success: function (response) {
                var res;
                try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); }
                catch (e) { showMsg('Gagal', 'Respons server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).'); return; }
                onOk(res);
            },
            failure: function () {
                if (onFail) onFail(); else showMsg('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
            }
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Stores
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var releaseField = [
        { name: 'id', type: 'int' }, { name: 'ref_no' }, { name: 'release_date' },
        { name: 'project_id', type: 'int' }, { name: 'project_name' }, { name: 'mode' },
        { name: 'progress_pct', type: 'float' }, { name: 'cumulative_cost', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'released_before', type: 'float' }, { name: 'amount', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'remark' }, { name: 'journal_no' }, { name: 'is_latest' }
    ];

    var projectDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD, baseParams: { task: 'list_project_options' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' },
            [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }, { name: 'progress', type: 'float' }, { name: 'status' }]),
        listeners: { exception: storeError }
    });

    var modeDs = new Ext.data.ArrayStore({
        fields: ['code', 'label'],
        data: [['progress', 'Per Progress (%)'], ['complete', 'Proyek Selesai (100%)']]
    });

    // PENTING: assignment polos (bukan var/let) -- konvensi search box global.
    mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'list_releases' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, releaseField),
        listeners: { exception: storeError }
    });
    mainDs.load();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Main Grid (daftar pelepasan)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')),
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. Pelepasan', dataIndex: 'ref_no', width: 120 },
            { header: 'Tanggal', dataIndex: 'release_date', width: 90, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Proyek', dataIndex: 'project_name', width: 230, renderer: CellWrap },
            {
                header: 'Mode', dataIndex: 'mode', width: 110, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) { return v === 'complete' ? 'Proyek Selesai' : 'Per Progress'; }
            },
            { header: 'Progress', dataIndex: 'progress_pct', width: 80, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return fmtPct(v); } },
            { header: 'WIP Kumulatif', dataIndex: 'cumulative_cost', width: 130, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return fmtAmt(v); } },
            { header: 'Dilepas Sebelumnya', dataIndex: 'released_before', width: 130, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return fmtAmt(v); } },
            {
                header: 'Nilai Dilepas (HPP)', dataIndex: 'amount', width: 140, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b>' + fmtAmt(v) + '</b>'; }
            },
            { header: 'Jurnal', dataIndex: 'journal_no', width: 110, align: 'center', renderer: function (v) { return v || '-'; } },
            { header: 'Catatan', dataIndex: 'remark', width: 180, renderer: function (v) { return CellWrap(v || ''); } }
        ],
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        loadMask: true,
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (!rec) return;
                dataRecord = rec.data;
                updateMainButtons();
            }
        }
    });

    function updateMainButtons() {
        mainBtnEnable('#addData');
        // hapus hanya untuk pelepasan terakhir proyek (server juga memvalidasi)
        if (dataRecord && dataRecord.is_latest) { mainBtnEnable('#deleteData'); } else { mainBtnDisable('#deleteData'); }
    }
    editDataDisable();          // Edit tidak tersedia: koreksi = hapus (reverse) lalu buat ulang
    updateMainButtons();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Editor: form + pratinjau
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function ensureForm() {
        if (frm) { frm.doLayout(); return; }

        fDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), allowBlank: false, width: 130 });
        fProject = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Proyek', store: projectDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id',
            mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, anchor: '95%',
            listeners: {
                select: function (combo, rec) {
                    // progress default = progress proyek saat ini (masih bisa diubah)
                    if (fMode.getValue() === 'progress') fPct.setValue(rec.get('progress'));
                    doPreview();
                }
            }
        });
        fMode = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Dasar Pelepasan', store: modeDs, displayField: 'label', valueField: 'code',
            mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, editable: false, width: 220,
            value: 'progress',
            listeners: { select: function () { onModeChange(); } }
        });
        fPct = new myNumberField({
            fieldLabel: 'Progress (%)', decimalPrecision: 2, minValue: 0, maxValue: 100, value: 0, width: 110,
            listeners: { change: function () { doPreview(); } }
        });
        fRemark = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Catatan', anchor: '95%' });
        fInfo = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ hideLabel: true, value: '', anchor: '98%' });

        var col = function (w, items) {
            return { columnWidth: w, layout: 'form', border: false, labelWidth: 110, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;', items: items };
        };
        frm = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
            renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
            border: false,
            layout: 'column',
            bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:6px 4px 0 4px;',
            items: [col(0.5, [fDate, fProject, fRemark]), col(0.5, [fMode, fPct]),
                    { columnWidth: 1, layout: 'form', border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;', items: [fInfo] }]
        });
    }

    function onModeChange() {
        var complete = (fMode.getValue() === 'complete');
        fPct.setDisabled(complete);
        if (complete) { fPct.setValue(100); }
        else {
            var pid = fProject.getValue(), rec = pid ? projectDs.getById(pid) : null;
            fPct.setValue(rec ? rec.get('progress') : 0);
        }
        doPreview();
    }

    function resetForm() {
        fDate.setValue(new Date());
        fProject.clearValue();
        fMode.setValue('progress');
        fPct.setDisabled(false);
        fPct.setValue(0);
        fRemark.setValue('');
        fInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#668894;">Pilih proyek untuk melihat perhitungan pelepasan WIP.</span>');
        previewOk = false;
    }

    // Pratinjau dihitung server (rumus yang sama dengan saat simpan)
    function doPreview() {
        var pid = fProject.getValue();
        previewOk = false;
        if (!pid) { fInfo.setValue(''); return; }
        var token = ++previewReq;
        fInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#668894;">menghitung...</span>');
        ajax({
            task: 'preview', project_id: pid, mode: fMode.getValue(),
            progress_pct: fMode.getValue() === 'complete' ? 100 : (parseFloat(fPct.getValue()) || 0)
        }, function (res) {
            if (token !== previewReq) return;               // sudah ada permintaan yang lebih baru
            if (!res.success) {
                fInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#e6a817;">' + enc(res.message || 'Gagal menghitung.') + '</span>');
                return;
            }
            var d = res.data, ok = d.amount > 0.005;
            previewOk = ok;
            var html = '<div style="padding:8px 10px; background:#1f2d3a; border-radius:4px; line-height:1.7;">' +
                'Proyek: <b>' + enc(d.project_name) + '</b> (status ' + enc(d.project_status || '-') + ', progress sistem ' + fmtPct(d.project_progress) + ')<br/>' +
                'WIP kumulatif (jurnal issue): <b>' + fmtAmt(d.wip_cumulative) + '</b><br/>' +
                'Target dilepas @ ' + fmtPct(d.progress_pct) + ': <b>' + fmtAmt(d.target_released) + '</b>' +
                ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; sudah dilepas sebelumnya: <b>' + fmtAmt(d.released_before) + '</b><br/>' +
                '<span style="color:' + (ok ? '#7fe0a0' : '#ff6b5e') + ';">Nilai dilepas ke HPP sekarang: <b>' + fmtAmt(d.amount) + '</b>' +
                (ok ? '' : ' (tidak ada yang perlu dilepas)') + '</span>';
            if (d.unjournaled > 0.005) {
                html += '<br/><span style="color:#e6a817;">Perhatian: ada issue material senilai ' + fmtAmt(d.unjournaled) +
                        ' yang belum berjurnal; jalankan backfill jurnal issue agar WIP lengkap.</span>';
            }
            html += '</div>';
            fInfo.setValue(html);
        });
    }

    function showEditor(title) {
        var addWdw = document.getElementById('addWdw');      // jaga-jaga: window Add bawaan template jangan ikut terbuka
        if (addWdw) addWdw.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;' + enc(title);
        ensureForm();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Action Handlers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // ADD = pelepasan baru
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_ADD) {
            showMsg('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membuat pelepasan WIP.');
            return;
        }
        projectDs.load({
            callback: function () {          // combo harus terisi sebelum form dipakai
                showEditor('Pelepasan WIP Baru');
                resetForm();
            }
        });
    };

    // SAVE
    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        if (!fProject || !fProject.getValue()) { showMsg('Peringatan', 'Proyek wajib dipilih.'); return; }
        if (!fDate.getValue()) { showMsg('Peringatan', 'Tanggal wajib diisi.'); return; }
        var complete = (fMode.getValue() === 'complete');
        var pct = complete ? 100 : (parseFloat(fPct.getValue()) || 0);
        if (pct < 0 || pct > 100) { showMsg('Peringatan', 'Progress harus antara 0 - 100.'); return; }
        if (!previewOk) { showMsg('Peringatan', 'Tidak ada WIP yang perlu dilepas dengan pengaturan ini. Periksa pratinjau di form.'); return; }

        ajax({
            task: 'save_release',
            project_id: fProject.getValue(),
            release_date: ymd(fDate.getValue()),
            mode: fMode.getValue(),
            progress_pct: pct,
            remark: fRemark.getValue()
        }, function (res) {
            showMsg(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
            if (res.success) {
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                dataRecord = null;
                mainDs.load();
                updateMainButtons();
            } else {
                doPreview();                 // data WIP / pelepasan mungkin berubah -> hitung ulang
            }
        });
    };

    // DELETE = reverse pelepasan terakhir proyek
    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) { showMsg('Peringatan', 'Pilih pelepasan terlebih dahulu dari tabel.'); return; }
        if (!dataRecord.is_latest) { showMsg('Peringatan', 'Hanya pelepasan terakhir per proyek yang dapat dihapus.'); return; }
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_DEL) {
            showMsg('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus pelepasan WIP.');
            return;
        }
        Ext.Msg.confirm('Hapus Pelepasan WIP',
            'Hapus pelepasan <b>' + enc(dataRecord.ref_no) + '</b> (' + fmtAmt(dataRecord.amount) + ')? Jurnalnya ikut dibatalkan.',
            function (btn) {
                if (btn !== 'yes') return;
                ajax({ task: 'delete_release', id: dataRecord.id }, function (res) {
                    showMsg(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) {
                        dataRecord = null;
                        mainDs.load();
                        updateMainButtons();
                    }
                });
            });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        if (document.getElementById('popCancel')) {
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});
==================== FILE: ./js/warehouse.issuing.js ====================
/*
  Document      : warehouse.issuing.js
  Description   : Warehouse Issuing (material out ke proyek). ExtJS 3.4.1
                  Pola template (sama dengan po.js / purchase.return.js):
                  grid utama = daftar issue (#divMainGrid); klik baris -> panel detail di bawah grid;
                  Add membuka editor (#editorWdw: header form + grid item).
  Aturan        : material harus sudah RCV di W/H; qty <= stok W/H dan
                  total issue proyek <= RAB +5% (kuota dihitung server, 'max_issue').
                  Gudang = semua gudang yang MASIH ADA material (gudang utama dipakai bersama).
                  Issue jenis SUPPLIER_RETURN dibuat dari modul Retur Pembelian (Perintahkan W/H) dan hanya bisa
                  dibatalkan lewat Batal Kirim / Batalkan Perintah di modul itu.
                  [NEW 2026-10-11] Alur gudang untuk issue retur: pending -> Siap Kirim (prepared) -> Konfirmasi Dikirim (posted).
                  Stok keluar + jurnal baru dibuat saat Konfirmasi Dikirim (gudang yang menyatakan barang benar-benar keluar).
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/warehouse.issuingCRD.php
  PERUBAHAN     : [REBUILD] disusun ulang mengikuti pola template (versi standalone Ext.Window sebelumnya salah)
                  [FIX-DATE] tanggal dikirim lewat ymd() (Date.format('Y-m-d') Ext menghasilkan 'Y-10-10' di browser ini)
                  [CHANGED] gudang = gudang yang masih ada material (bukan lagi per-proyek)
                  [NEW 2026-10-11 #2] No. Surat Jalan otomatis dari sistem (dialog Konfirmasi Dikirim tidak lagi punya isian SJ);
                  kolom Pengiriman di grid utama menampilkan tgl kirim, no. SJ, kurir -> penerima.
                  [NEW 2026-10-12] Cetak Surat Jalan: setelah Konfirmasi Dikirim sukses, sistem menawarkan cetak -> hasil cetak berwatermark ORIGINAL.
                  Setelah status posted, tombol 'Cetak Ulang (COPY)' di panel detail -> hasil cetak berwatermark COPY.
                  Tidak ada lagi tombol cetak saat status prepared (surat jalan dicetak setelah barang dikonfirmasi dikirim).
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    // [NEW] gaya dialog konfirmasi pengiriman agar terbaca di tema gelap
    (function () {
        if (document.getElementById('whDarkWinCss')) { return; }
        var st = document.createElement('style');
        st.id = 'whDarkWinCss';
        st.innerHTML = '.whDarkWin .x-window-body, .whDarkWin .x-panel-body { background:#0d2233 !important; color:#e6f1f5 !important; }' +
                       '.whDarkWin .x-form-item label { color:#9fc3d1 !important; }' +
                       '.whDarkWin .x-form-field { background:#14324a !important; color:#ffffff !important; border-color:#2b5d7a !important; }' +
                       '.whDarkWin .x-form-display-field{color:#e2e8f0 !important;}' +
                       '.whDarkWin .x-btn button{color:#ffffff !important;font-weight:bold !important;opacity:1 !important;}' +
                       '.whDarkWin .x-btn-tl,.whDarkWin .x-btn-tr,.whDarkWin .x-btn-tc,.whDarkWin .x-btn-ml,.whDarkWin .x-btn-mr,' +
                       '.whDarkWin .x-btn-bl,.whDarkWin .x-btn-br,.whDarkWin .x-btn-bc{background:none !important;background-image:none !important;}' +
                       '.whDarkWin .x-btn-mc{background-color:#2e7dd1 !important;background-image:none !important;border-radius:4px;}' +
                       '.whDarkWin .x-btn-over .x-btn-mc{background-color:#4695e6 !important;}' +
                       '.whDarkWin .x-btn-mc button{padding:7px 18px !important;height:auto !important;line-height:18px !important;font-size:13px !important;}';      // [CHANGED] tombol lebih tebal
        document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0].appendChild(st);
    })();
    if (document.getElementById("mainHeaderText")) {
        document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Warehouse <em>Issuing</em>";
    }

    var CRD =  main_url + '/php-crud/warehouse.issuingCRD.php';     // relatif dari /proyek/views/

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }
    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function fmtQty(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
    function fmtAmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    // [FIX-DATE] format('Y-m-d') Ext menghasilkan 'Y-10-10' di browser ini -> susun YYYY-MM-DD manual
    function ymd(d) {
        var m = d.getMonth() + 1, dd = d.getDate();
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : m) + '-' + (dd < 10 ? '0' + dd : dd);
    }
    function showErr(msg) { Ext.Msg.show({ title: 'Peringatan', msg: msg, buttons: Ext.Msg.OK, icon: Ext.Msg.WARNING }); }
    function needAccess(level, msg) {
        if (getFormAccess() < level) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', msg); return false; }
        return true;
    }

    // Exception store: tampilkan pesan backend / HTTP
    function storeError(proxy, type, action, opt, res) {
        var m = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        if (res && res.message) { m = res.message; }
        else {
            try { var o = Ext.decode(res.responseText); if (o && o.message) { m = o.message; } }
            catch (e) { if (res && res.status) { m += ' (HTTP ' + res.status + ')'; } }
        }
        showErr(m);
    }

    function ajax(params, onOk) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD, method: 'POST', params: params,
            success: function (r) {
                var o;
                try { o = Ext.decode(r.responseText); } catch (e) { showErr('Respon server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).'); return; }
                onOk(o);
            },
            failure: function (r) { showErr('Koneksi ke server gagal (HTTP ' + r.status + ').'); }
        });
    }

    // [CHANGED] tambah status alur retur: pending (kuning), prepared (biru)
    function statusColor(v) {
        if (v === 'posted') { return '#2e9e4f !important'; }
        if (v === 'pending') { return '#e6a817 !important'; }
        if (v === 'prepared') { return '#2bc1e2 !important'; }
        return '#c0392b !important';
    }
