    // Form header dibuat saat editor dibuka pertama kali (container hidden -> lebar kolom 0 bila dirender lebih awal)
    function ensureHdrForm() {
        if (hdrForm) { hdrForm.doLayout(); ppnForm.doLayout(); budForm.doLayout(); return; }   // [PPN] ppnForm ikut di-layout

        fDate = new Ext.form.DateField({
            fieldLabel: 'Tanggal PO', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), allowBlank: false, width: 130,
            listeners: {
                select: function () { onDateChange(); },
                change: function () { onDateChange(); }
            }
        });
        fProject = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Proyek', store: projectDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id',
            mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, anchor: '95%',
            listeners: { select: function () { onProjectChange(); } }
        });
        fSupplier = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Supplier', store: supplierDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id',
            mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, anchor: '95%',
            listeners: { select: function () { onSupplierChange(); } }      // [PPN] default mode PPN dari status PKP supplier
        });
        fCurrency = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Mata Uang PO', store: currencyDs, displayField: 'init', valueField: 'id',
            mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, width: 100,
            listeners: { select: function () { onCurrencyChange(); } }
        });
        fRate = new myNumberField({
            fieldLabel: 'Kurs PO', decimalPrecision: 4, value: 1, width: 110,
            listeners: { change: function () { rateManual = true; onRatesChanged(); } }      // diubah user -> jangan ditimpa lagi
        });
        fRateInfo = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ fieldLabel: 'Sumber Kurs', value: '-', anchor: '95%' });
        fNotes = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Catatan', anchor: '95%' });

        var col = function (w, items) {
            return { columnWidth: w, layout: 'form', border: false, labelWidth: 100, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;', items: items };
        };
        hdrForm = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
            renderTo: 'poHdrForm',
            border: false,
            layout: 'column',
            bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:4px 2px 0 2px;',
            items: [col(0.34, [fDate, fProject]), col(0.34, [fSupplier, fCurrency]), col(0.32, [fRate, fRateInfo, fNotes])]
        });

        // Baris anggaran: kurs mata uang anggaran (hanya bila diperlukan) + keterangan konversi
        fBudRate = new myNumberField({
            fieldLabel: 'Kurs Anggaran', decimalPrecision: 4, value: 1, width: 110,
            listeners: { change: function () { budRateManual = true; onRatesChanged(); } }
        });
        fBudInfo = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ hideLabel: true, value: '', anchor: '98%' });
        budForm = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
            renderTo: 'poBudForm',
            border: false,
            layout: 'column',
            bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:0 2px 4px 2px;',
            items: [col(0.34, [fBudRate]), col(0.66, [fBudInfo])]
        });
        setBudRateVisible(false);

        // [PPN] baris form PPN: mode, tarif, keterangan
        fPpnMode = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'PPN', store: new Ext.data.ArrayStore({ fields: ['v', 't'], data: PPN_MODE_DATA }),
            displayField: 't', valueField: 'v', mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true,
            editable: false, value: 'EXCL', anchor: '95%',          // [CHANGED] default EXCL = kena PPN (pilih 'Tanpa PPN' bila tidak kena)
            listeners: { select: function () { ppnManual = true; onPpnModeChange(); } }
        });
        fPpnRate = new myNumberField({
            fieldLabel: 'Tarif PPN (%)', decimalPrecision: 2, value: PPN_DEFAULT_RATE, width: 80, disabled: false,   // [CHANGED] default tarif aktif
            listeners: { change: function () { onRatesChanged(); } }
        });
        fPpnInfo = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ hideLabel: true, value: '', anchor: '98%' });
        ppnForm = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
            renderTo: 'poPpnForm',
            border: false,
            layout: 'column',
            bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:0 2px 0 2px;',
            items: [col(0.34, [fPpnMode]), col(0.22, [fPpnRate]), col(0.44, [fPpnInfo])]
        });
    }

    function setBudRateVisible(v) {
        if (!fBudRate || !fBudRate.getEl()) return;
        var item = fBudRate.getEl().up('.x-form-item');
        if (item) item.setDisplayed(v);
    }

    // ---- Mata uang & kurs --------------------------------------------------
    // Mata uang dasar dari Pengaturan Sistem (is_base)
    function baseCurrencyId() {
        var id = null;
        currencyDs.each(function (r) { if (id === null && r.get('is_base') === true) id = r.get('id'); });
        return id;
    }
    function baseCurrencyCode() {
        var c = 'IDR';
        currencyDs.each(function (r) { if (r.get('is_base') === true) c = r.get('init'); });
        return c;
    }
    function currencyCode(id) {
        var r = id ? currencyDs.getById(id) : null;
        return r ? r.get('init') : baseCurrencyCode();
    }
    // Mata uang PO yang berlaku (kosong = mata uang dasar)
    function poCurId() { return Number((fCurrency && fCurrency.getValue()) || baseCurrencyId()) || null; }
    function isBaseCurrency(id) {
        var r = id ? currencyDs.getById(id) : null;
        return !!r && r.get('is_base') === true;
    }
    function poRate() { return isBaseCurrency(poCurId()) ? 1 : (parseFloat(fRate.getValue()) || 1); }
    function needBudRate() {
        return !!budgetInfo.id && poCurId() !== budgetInfo.id && !budgetInfo.isBase;
    }
    function budRate() {
        if (!budgetInfo.id) return 1;
        if (poCurId() === budgetInfo.id) return poRate();
        if (budgetInfo.isBase) return 1;
        return parseFloat(fBudRate.getValue()) || 0;
    }
    // Faktor konversi nilai PO -> mata uang anggaran (0 = belum bisa dihitung)
    function factor() {
        if (!budgetInfo.id) return 1;
        if (poCurId() === budgetInfo.id) return 1;
        var rb = budRate();
        return rb > 0 ? poRate() / rb : 0;
    }

    function applyHeaders() {
        var cm = itemGrid.getColumnModel();
        var poCode = currencyCode(poCurId()), budCode = budgetInfo.code || poCode;
        cm.setColumnHeader(3, 'Sisa Nilai RAB (' + budCode + ')');
        cm.setColumnHeader(5, 'Harga Satuan (' + poCode + (ppnMode() === 'INCL' ? ', incl. PPN' : '') + ')');   // [PPN]
        cm.setColumnHeader(6, 'Subtotal (' + poCode + ')');
        cm.setColumnHeader(7, 'Setara ' + budCode);
        if (fBudRate && fBudRate.label) fBudRate.label.update('Kurs ' + budCode + ' *');
    }

    function describeConversion() {
        if (!budgetInfo.id) { fBudInfo.setValue(''); return; }
        var poCode = currencyCode(poCurId()), budCode = budgetInfo.code;
        if (poCurId() === budgetInfo.id) {
            fBudInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#668894;">Anggaran proyek dalam <b>' + enc(budCode) + '</b> - sama dengan mata uang PO, tanpa konversi.</span>');
        } else {
            var f = factor();
            fBudInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#9fc3d1;">Anggaran proyek dalam <b>' + enc(budCode) + '</b>. Nilai PO dikonversi: 1 ' + enc(poCode) + ' = ' +
                              (f > 0 ? Ext.util.Format.number(f, '0,000.000000') : '?') + ' ' + enc(budCode) + '</span>');
        }
    }

    // Kurs PO default = KMK pada tanggal PO; belum ada -> kurs terakhir. Tetap bisa diedit.
    function refreshRate() {
        var cur = poCurId(), dt = fDate.getValue();
        if (!cur || !dt) return;
        var token = ++rateReq;
        fRateInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#668894;">memuat kurs...</span>');
        ajax({ task: 'get_exchange_rate', currency_id: cur, date: dt.format('Y-m-d') }, function (res) {
            if (token !== rateReq) return;                       // sudah ada permintaan yang lebih baru
            if (!res.success) {
                fRateInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#c0392b;">' + enc(res.message || 'Gagal memuat kurs.') + '</span>');
                return;
            }
            var d = res.data || {};
            fRate.setReadOnly(d.source === 'BASE');
            if (d.rate) fRate.setValue(d.rate);
            if (d.source === 'BASE') {
                fRateInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#668894;">Mata uang dasar (' + enc(d.base_code || '') + ', kurs 1)</span>');
            } else if (d.source === 'periode') {
                fRateInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#2e9e4f;">KMK ' + enc(d.kmk_no) + ' (' + enc(d.start_date) + ' - ' + enc(d.end_date) + ')</span>');
            } else if (d.source === 'terakhir') {
                fRateInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#e6a817;">Belum ada kurs untuk tanggal PO, memakai kurs terakhir: KMK ' +
                                   enc(d.kmk_no) + ' (' + enc(d.start_date) + ' - ' + enc(d.end_date) + ')</span>');
            } else {
                fRateInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#e6a817;">Data kurs mata uang ini belum tersedia, isi manual.</span>');
            }
            onRatesChanged();
        });
    }

    // Kurs mata uang anggaran (hanya bila PO berbeda mata uang dengan anggaran dan anggaran bukan mata uang dasar)
    function refreshBudRate() {
        var need = needBudRate();
        setBudRateVisible(need);
        applyHeaders();
        if (!need) { describeConversion(); onRatesChanged(); return; }
        if (budRateManual) { describeConversion(); onRatesChanged(); return; }
        var dt = fDate.getValue();
        if (!dt) return;
        var token = ++budRateReq;
        fBudInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#668894;">memuat kurs ' + enc(budgetInfo.code) + '...</span>');
        ajax({ task: 'get_exchange_rate', currency_id: budgetInfo.id, date: dt.format('Y-m-d') }, function (res) {
            if (token !== budRateReq) return;
            var d = (res && res.data) || {};
            if (res.success && d.rate) fBudRate.setValue(d.rate);
            describeConversion();
            if (res.success && d.source === 'terakhir') {
                fBudInfo.setValue(fBudInfo.getValue() + ' <span style="color:#e6a817;">(kurs terakhir KMK ' + enc(d.kmk_no) + ')</span>');
            } else if (!res.success || !d.rate) {
                fBudInfo.setValue(fBudInfo.getValue() + ' <span style="color:#e6a817;">Kurs ' + enc(budgetInfo.code) + ' belum tersedia, isi manual.</span>');
            }
            onRatesChanged();
        });
    }

    function onDateChange() {
        if (!rateManual) refreshRate();
        if (!budRateManual) refreshBudRate();
    }

    function onCurrencyChange() {
        rateManual = false;
        budRateManual = false;
        refreshRate();
        refreshBudRate();
    }

    // Kurs / mata uang / material berubah: harga default (RAB dikonversi) dan semua nilai dihitung ulang
    function onRatesChanged() {
        describeConversion();
        repriceDefaults();
        recalcAll();
    }

    // Harga satuan default = harga RAB (mata uang anggaran) dikonversi ke mata uang PO; baris yang harganya
    // sudah diubah manual tidak disentuh.
    function repriceDefaults() {
        var f = factor();
        if (!(f > 0)) return;
        itemDs.each(function (r) {
            if (r.get('budget_item_id') && r.get('price_manual') !== true) {
                // [PPN] mode INCL: harga default = harga RAB (tanpa PPN) dikonversi lalu ditambah PPN
                r.set('unit_price', round2(((parseFloat(r.get('rab_price')) || 0) / f) * (ppnMode() === 'INCL' ? (1 + ppnRate() / 100) : 1)));
            }
        });
    }

    // [PPN] mode berubah: aktif/nonaktifkan tarif, isi tarif default 11%, hitung ulang
    function onPpnModeChange() {
        var m = ppnMode();
        fPpnRate.setDisabled(m === 'NONE');
        if (m === 'NONE') fPpnRate.setValue(0);
        else if (!(parseFloat(fPpnRate.getValue()) > 0)) fPpnRate.setValue(PPN_DEFAULT_RATE);
        refreshPpnInfo();
        applyHeaders();
        onRatesChanged();          // harga default (mode INCL) & seluruh nilai dihitung ulang
    }

    // [PPN][CHANGED] pilih supplier: default tetap kena PPN (tidak lagi dibedakan PKP / non-PKP); status PKP hanya jadi peringatan
    function onSupplierChange() {
        refreshPpnInfo();
    }

    function refreshPpnInfo() {
        if (!fPpnInfo) return;
        var sid = fSupplier && fSupplier.getValue(), m = ppnMode(), msg = '';
        if (m !== 'NONE' && sid && !supplierIsPkp(sid)) {
            msg = '<span style="color:#e6a817;">Supplier belum berstatus PKP di master supplier - pastikan PPN memang dikenakan.</span>';
        } else if (m === 'NONE' && sid && supplierIsPkp(sid)) {
            msg = '<span style="color:#668894;">Supplier berstatus PKP. Pilih mode PPN bila transaksi ini kena PPN.</span>';
        } else if (m === 'INCL') {
            msg = '<span style="color:#668894;">Harga satuan sudah termasuk PPN; kontrol anggaran RAB memakai DPP.</span>';
        }
        fPpnInfo.setValue(msg);
    }

    function defaultCurrencyId() { return baseCurrencyId(); }

    function resetHdrForm() {
        fDate.setValue(new Date());
        fProject.clearValue();
        fSupplier.clearValue();
        fNotes.setValue('');
        var base = defaultCurrencyId();
        if (base !== null) fCurrency.setValue(base); else fCurrency.clearValue();
        fRate.setValue(1);
        fBudRate.setValue(1);
        ppnManual = false;                                   // [PPN] PO baru
        fPpnMode.setValue('EXCL');                           // [CHANGED] default: kena PPN (Exclude), tarif default
        fPpnRate.setValue(PPN_DEFAULT_RATE);
        fPpnRate.setDisabled(false);
        refreshPpnInfo();
        rateManual = false;
        budRateManual = false;
        budgetInfo = { id: null, code: '', isBase: true, baseCode: baseCurrencyCode(), totalLimit: 0, totalCommitted: 0, ceiling: null };
        setBudRateVisible(false);
        applyHeaders();
        describeConversion();
        refreshRate();
    }

    // Muat baris RAB proyek (komitmen PO yang sedang diedit tidak dihitung) + ringkasan anggaran, lalu panggil cb
    function loadRab(projectId, cb) {
        if (!projectId) {
            rabDs.removeAll();
            budgetInfo = { id: null, code: '', isBase: true, baseCode: baseCurrencyCode(), totalLimit: 0, totalCommitted: 0, ceiling: null };
            applyHeaders();
            if (cb) cb();
            return;
        }
        rabDs.load({
            params: { project_id: projectId, po_id: editingId || 0 },
            callback: function () {
                var sm = (rabDs.reader.jsonData || {}).summary;
                if (sm) {
                    budgetInfo = {
                        id: Number(sm.budget_currency_id) || null, code: sm.budget_code, isBase: !!sm.budget_is_base, baseCode: sm.base_code || baseCurrencyCode(),
                        totalLimit: parseFloat(sm.total_limit) || 0, totalCommitted: parseFloat(sm.total_committed) || 0,
                        ceiling: sm.ceiling !== null && sm.ceiling !== undefined ? parseFloat(sm.ceiling) : null
                    };
                }
                applyHeaders();
                if (cb) cb();
            }
        });
    }

    function onProjectChange() {
        budRateManual = false;
        loadRab(fProject.getValue(), function () {
            itemDs.each(function (r) {      // material yang tidak ada di RAB proyek baru dikosongkan
                var b = r.get('budget_item_id');
                if (b && !rabDs.getById(b)) {
                    r.set('budget_item_id', null); r.set('material_id', null); r.set('material_code', '');
                    r.set('material_name', ''); r.set('unit', ''); r.set('qty', 0); r.set('unit_price', 0);
                    r.set('rab_price', 0); r.set('price_manual', false);
                } else if (b) {
                    r.set('rab_price', rabDs.getById(b).get('unit_price_plan'));
                }
            });
            refreshBudRate();
        });
    }

    // Subtotal, nilai setara anggaran, sisa kuota, flag per baris, dan ringkasan anggaran proyek
    function recalcAll() {
        var f = factor();
        var sumsQty = {}, sumsAmt = {};
        itemDs.each(function (r) {
            var b = r.get('budget_item_id');
            if (!b) return;
            var q = parseFloat(r.get('qty')) || 0;
            var amt = round2(ppnRowDpp(round2(q * (parseFloat(r.get('unit_price')) || 0))) * f);   // [PPN] basis DPP
            sumsQty[b] = (sumsQty[b] || 0) + q;
            sumsAmt[b] = (sumsAmt[b] || 0) + amt;
        });

        var total = 0, totalBud = 0;
        itemDs.each(function (r) {
            var b = r.get('budget_item_id'), s = b ? rabDs.getById(b) : null;
            var q = parseFloat(r.get('qty')) || 0;
            var sub = round2(q * (parseFloat(r.get('unit_price')) || 0));
            var amt = round2(ppnRowDpp(sub) * f);                 // [PPN] nilai setara anggaran = DPP x faktor
            r.set('subtotal', sub);
            r.set('amount_budget', amt);
            total += sub;
            totalBud += amt;
            if (s) {
                r.set('quota', s.get('qty_quota'));
                r.set('value_remaining', s.get('value_remaining'));
                var flag = 'OK';
                if (sumsQty[b] > s.get('qty_quota') + EPS) flag = 'OVER QTY';
                else if (sumsAmt[b] > s.get('value_remaining') + VEPS) flag = 'OVER NILAI';
                r.set('flag', flag);
            } else {
                r.set('flag', '');
            }
        });

        var poCode = currencyCode(poCurId());
        var pc = ppnCalc(total, ppnMode(), ppnRate());           // [PPN] DPP / PPN / total
        var el = document.getElementById('lblPoTotal');
        if (el) {
            var html = fmtAmt(pc.total) + ' ' + enc(poCode);      // [PPN] total sudah termasuk PPN
            if (budgetInfo.id && poCurId() !== budgetInfo.id) {
                html += ' <span style="color:#9fc3d1; font-weight:normal;">&asymp; ' + fmtAmt(totalBud) + ' ' + enc(budgetInfo.code) + '</span>';
            }
            el.innerHTML = html;
        }
        var elp = document.getElementById('lblPoPpn');           // [PPN] rincian DPP / PPN
        if (elp) {
            if (ppnMode() === 'NONE') {
                elp.innerHTML = '';
            } else {
                var sp = 'Jumlah item ' + fmtAmt(pc.subtotal) + ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; DPP ' + fmtAmt(pc.dpp) +
                         ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; PPN ' + ppnRate() + '% ' + fmtAmt(pc.ppn) + ' ' + enc(poCode);
                if (!isBaseCurrency(poCurId())) sp += ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; PPN setara ' + enc(baseCurrencyCode()) + ' ' + fmtAmt(round2(pc.ppn * poRate()));
                elp.innerHTML = sp;
            }
        }
        updateBudgetBar(totalBud);
    }

    // Ringkasan anggaran proyek (mata uang anggaran): batas RAB, terpakai PO lain, PO ini, sisa
    function updateBudgetBar(totalBud) {
        var el = document.getElementById('lblPoBudget');
        if (!el) return;
        if (!budgetInfo.id || !fProject || !fProject.getValue()) { el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
        if (!(factor() > 0)) {
            el.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#e6a817;">Isi kurs ' + enc(budgetInfo.code) + ' agar nilai PO dapat dibandingkan dengan anggaran.</span>';
            return;
        }
        var code = enc(budgetInfo.code);
        var after = budgetInfo.totalCommitted + totalBud;
        var remain = budgetInfo.totalLimit - after;
        var overRab = remain < -VEPS;
        var overCeil = budgetInfo.ceiling !== null && after > budgetInfo.ceiling + VEPS;
        var color = (overRab || overCeil) ? '#ff6b5e' : '#7fe0a0';
        el.innerHTML = '<span style="color:' + color + ';">Anggaran RAB (' + code + '): batas ' + fmtAmt(budgetInfo.totalLimit) +
                       ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; PO lain ' + fmtAmt(budgetInfo.totalCommitted) +
                       ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; PO ini ' + fmtAmt(totalBud) +
                       ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; sisa ' + fmtAmt(remain) + (overRab ? ' (MELEBIHI RAB)' : '') +
                       (budgetInfo.ceiling !== null ? ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; budget proyek ' + fmtAmt(budgetInfo.ceiling) + (overCeil ? ' (MELEBIHI)' : '') : '') +
                       '</span>';
    }

    function newItemRecord(cfg) {
        var Rec = itemDs.recordType || Ext.data.Record.create(itemField);
        return new Rec(Ext.apply({
            budget_item_id: null, material_id: null, material_code: '', material_name: '', unit: '',
            qty: 0, unit_price: 0, subtotal: 0, amount_budget: 0, quota: 0, value_remaining: 0,
            rab_price: 0, price_manual: false, flag: ''
        }, cfg || {}));
    }

    function addBlankRow() {
        itemDs.add(newItemRecord());
        recalcAll();
    }

    function showEditor(title) {
        var addWdw = document.getElementById('addWdw');      // jaga-jaga: window Add bawaan template jangan ikut terbuka
        if (addWdw) addWdw.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;' + enc(title);
        ensureHdrForm();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Action Handlers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // ADD = PO baru
    function openNewPo(draft) {
        editingId = 0;
        showEditor('Purchase Order Baru');
        resetHdrForm();
        itemDs.removeAll();
        rabDs.removeAll();

        if (draft && draft.project_id) {
            fProject.setValue(draft.project_id);
            loadRab(draft.project_id, function () {
                Ext.each(draft.items || [], function (d) {
                    var s = rabDs.getById(d.budget_item_id);
                    if (!s) return;                                   // baris RAB sudah tidak ada
                    itemDs.add(newItemRecord({
                        budget_item_id: s.get('budget_item_id'), material_id: s.get('material_id'),
                        material_code: s.get('material_code'), material_name: s.get('material_name'),
                        unit: s.get('unit'), qty: parseFloat(d.qty) || 0,
                        rab_price: s.get('unit_price_plan'), price_manual: false,   // harga = harga RAB dikonversi ke mata uang PO
                        quota: s.get('qty_quota'), value_remaining: s.get('value_remaining')
                    }));
                });
                if (!itemDs.getCount()) addBlankRow();
                refreshBudRate();
            });
        } else {
            addBlankRow();
        }
    }

    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_ADD) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membuat PO.');
            return;
        }
        openNewPo(null);
    };

    // EDIT = ubah PO Draft
    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih PO terlebih dahulu dari tabel.'); return; }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'Draft') { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Hanya PO berstatus Draft yang dapat diubah.'); return; }
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_EDIT) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengedit PO.');
            return;
        }
        ajax({ task: 'load_po', id: dataRecord.id }, function (res) {
            if (!res.success) { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Gagal memuat PO.'); return; }
            var h = res.data.header;
            editingId = h.id;
            showEditor('Edit PO ' + h.po_number);

            fDate.setValue(Date.parseDate(h.po_date, 'Y-m-d') || new Date());
            fProject.setValue(h.project_id);
            if (h.supplier_id) fSupplier.setValue(h.supplier_id); else fSupplier.clearValue();
            if (h.currency_id) fCurrency.setValue(h.currency_id); else fCurrency.clearValue();
            fRate.setValue(h.exch_rate || 1);
            fRate.setReadOnly(isBaseCurrency(poCurId()));
            fBudRate.setValue(h.budget_exch_rate || 1);
            rateManual = true;                                   // kurs tersimpan di PO tidak ditimpa otomatis
            budRateManual = true;
            fRateInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#668894;">Kurs tersimpan pada PO (ganti mata uang untuk ambil ulang)</span>');
            fNotes.setValue(h.notes || '');
            ppnManual = true;                                    // [PPN] mode tersimpan tidak ditimpa default supplier
            fPpnMode.setValue(h.ppn_mode || 'NONE');
            fPpnRate.setValue(parseFloat(h.ppn_rate) || 0);
            fPpnRate.setDisabled(ppnMode() === 'NONE');
            refreshPpnInfo();

            itemDs.removeAll();
            loadRab(h.project_id, function () {
                Ext.each(res.data.items, function (i) {
                    var s = i.budget_item_id ? rabDs.getById(i.budget_item_id) : null;
                    itemDs.add(newItemRecord({
                        budget_item_id: i.budget_item_id, material_id: i.material_id,
                        material_code: i.material_code || '', material_name: i.description, unit: i.unit || '',
                        qty: i.qty, unit_price: i.unit_price,
                        rab_price: s ? s.get('unit_price_plan') : 0, price_manual: true,    // harga tersimpan tidak ditimpa
                        quota: s ? s.get('qty_quota') : 0, value_remaining: s ? s.get('value_remaining') : 0
                    }));
                });
                if (!itemDs.getCount()) addBlankRow();
                setBudRateVisible(needBudRate());
                applyHeaders();
                describeConversion();
                recalcAll();
            });
        });
    };

    // SAVE
    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        if (!fProject || !fProject.getValue()) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Proyek wajib dipilih.'); return; }
        if (!fDate.getValue()) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Tanggal PO wajib diisi.'); return; }
        if (ppnMode() !== 'NONE' && !(ppnRate() > 0 && ppnRate() <= 100)) {          // [PPN]
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Tarif PPN harus lebih dari 0 dan maksimal 100%.');
            return;
        }
        if (needBudRate() && !(parseFloat(fBudRate.getValue()) > 0)) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Kurs ' + budgetInfo.code + ' (mata uang anggaran) wajib diisi.');
            return;
        }

        var arr = [], err = '';
        itemDs.each(function (r) {
            var b = r.get('budget_item_id'), q = parseFloat(r.get('qty')) || 0, n = 'Baris ' + (itemDs.indexOf(r) + 1);
            if (!b && q <= 0) return;                               // baris kosong diabaikan
            if (!b || q <= 0) { err = err || (n + ': material dan qty (> 0) wajib diisi.'); return; }
            if (r.get('flag') === 'OVER QTY') { err = err || (n + ': qty melebihi sisa kuota RAB.'); return; }
            if (r.get('flag') === 'OVER NILAI') { err = err || (n + ': nilai melebihi sisa anggaran RAB baris ini.'); return; }
            arr.push({ budget_item_id: b, qty: q, unit_price: parseFloat(r.get('unit_price')) || 0 });
        });
        if (err) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', err); return; }
        if (!arr.length) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Isi minimal satu material.'); return; }

        // Total proyek (anggaran RAB & budget proyek)
        var totalBud = 0;
        itemDs.each(function (r) { totalBud += parseFloat(r.get('amount_budget')) || 0; });
        var after = budgetInfo.totalCommitted + totalBud;
        if (after > budgetInfo.totalLimit + VEPS) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Total PO proyek setara ' + fmtAmt(after) + ' ' + budgetInfo.code + ' melebihi total RAB (' + fmtAmt(budgetInfo.totalLimit) + ' ' + budgetInfo.code + ').');
            return;
        }
        if (budgetInfo.ceiling !== null && after > budgetInfo.ceiling + VEPS) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Total PO proyek setara ' + fmtAmt(after) + ' ' + budgetInfo.code + ' melebihi budget proyek (' + fmtAmt(budgetInfo.ceiling) + ' ' + budgetInfo.code + ').');
            return;
        }

        ajax({
            task: 'save_po',
            id: editingId,
            project_id: fProject.getValue(),
            supplier_id: fSupplier.getValue() || 0,
            currency_id: fCurrency.getValue() || 0,
            exch_rate: poRate(),
            budget_exch_rate: needBudRate() ? (parseFloat(fBudRate.getValue()) || 0) : 0,
            po_date: fDate.getValue().format('Y-m-d'),
            notes: fNotes.getValue(),
            ppn_mode: ppnMode(),                                    // [PPN]
            ppn_rate: ppnRate(),                                    // [PPN]
            items: Ext.util.JSON.encode(arr)
        }, function (res) {
            if (res.success) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message || 'PO berhasil disimpan.');
                mainDs.load();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                if (res.data && res.data.id) {
                    dataRecord = { id: res.data.id, status: 'Draft' };
                    updateMainButtons();
                    loadDetailPanel(res.data.id);
                }
            } else {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
                loadRab(fProject.getValue(), recalcAll);     // kuota & komitmen anggaran mungkin berubah -> muat ulang
            }
        });
    };

    // DELETE = hapus PO Draft
    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord || dataRecord.status !== 'Draft') {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih PO berstatus Draft terlebih dahulu. PO lain dapat dibatalkan dari panel detail.');
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_EDIT) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus PO.');
            return;
        }
        Ext.Msg.confirm('Hapus PO', 'Hapus PO <b>' + enc(dataRecord.po_number) + '</b>? Tindakan ini tidak dapat dibatalkan.', function (btn) {
            if (btn !== 'yes') return;
            ajax({ task: 'delete_po', id: dataRecord.id }, function (res) {
                Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                if (res.success) {
                    dataRecord = null;
                    dtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                    mainDs.load();
                    updateMainButtons();
                }
            });
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        if (document.getElementById('popCancel')) {
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Draft dari Purchase Planning (sessionStorage) -> langsung buka editor PO baru
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function checkDraftFromPlanning() {
        var raw = null;
        try { raw = sessionStorage.getItem('po_draft_from_planning'); } catch (e) {}
        if (!raw) return;
        try { sessionStorage.removeItem('po_draft_from_planning'); } catch (e) {}     // sekali pakai
        var draft = null;
        try { draft = Ext.util.JSON.decode(raw); } catch (e) { return; }
        if (!draft || !draft.project_id || !draft.items || !draft.items.length) return;
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_ADD) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membuat PO.');
            return;
        }
        openNewPo(draft);
    }

    // Combo harus sudah terisi sebelum draft dipasang
    var pendingStores = 3;
    function storeReady() { if (--pendingStores === 0) checkDraftFromPlanning(); }
    projectDs.load({ callback: storeReady });
    supplierDs.load({ callback: storeReady });
    currencyDs.load({ callback: storeReady });
});

    clientDs.load({ callback: function () {
        clientDs.each(function (r) {
            if (r.get('id') === 0) return;               // opsi "(Semua klien)" sudah ada di select
            var o = document.createElement('option');
            o.value = r.get('id'); o.text = r.get('name');
            selClient.appendChild(o);
        });
        loadAll();
    } });
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

/*
  Document      : stock.opname.js
  Description   : Stock Opname. Grid utama = daftar opname; klik baris -> panel detail di bawah grid (lembar hitung, selisih,
                   jejak audit, pergerakan stok & jurnal hasil posting, tombol aksi status).
                   Add/Edit membuka editor (header + grid hitung). Edit hanya untuk status Draft; dokumen tidak pernah dihapus.
                   Alur status: Draft -> Diajukan -> Disetujui (posting stok + jurnal). Dibatalkan dari Draft / Diajukan / Disetujui
                   (alasan wajib; Disetujui = reverse). Stok sistem = snapshot saat disimpan / di-refresh.
  Backend       : ../php-crud/stock.opnameCRD.php
*/
Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Stock <em>Opname</em>";

    // [GRID-WRAP 2026-11-17] Override SCOPED untuk grid halaman Stock Opname (#divMainGrid & #editorFormGrid) — tidak menyentuh CSS global.
    // ExtJS 3.4.1 (css/ext-all.css) memasang
    //   .x-grid3-cell-inner,.x-grid3-hd-inner{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
    // sehingga header & sel panjang terpotong "...". Paksa wrap + clip + tinggi baris dinamis.
    // Angka tetap rata kanan (align ColumnModel dihormati — hanya white-space yang berubah).
    (function injectGridWrapCss() {
        var st = document.createElement('style');
        st.type = 'text/css';
        st.appendChild(document.createTextNode(
            '#divMainGrid .x-grid3-hd-inner, #editorFormGrid .x-grid3-hd-inner {' +
            ' white-space:normal !important; overflow:visible !important; text-overflow:clip !important;' +

            ' line-height:1.3 !important; height:auto !important; min-height:34px !important;' +
            ' padding:4px 6px !important; box-sizing:border-box; vertical-align:middle !important;' +
            ' display:flex !important; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; }' +
            '#divMainGrid .x-grid3-cell-inner, #editorFormGrid .x-grid3-cell-inner {' +
            ' white-space:normal !important; overflow:visible !important; text-overflow:clip !important;' +
            ' word-wrap:break-word !important; overflow-wrap:break-word !important; word-break:break-word !important;' +
            ' line-height:1.35 !important; height:auto !important; padding:3px 6px !important; box-sizing:border-box; }' +
            // Baris & header tinggi dinamis (tidak dikunci): teks membungkus ke 2 baris bila perlu.
            '#divMainGrid .x-grid3-hd, #editorFormGrid .x-grid3-hd { padding:0 !important; vertical-align:middle !important; height:auto !important; }' +

        document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0].appendChild(st);
    })();

    var CRD = '../php-crud/stock.opnameCRD.php';
    var ACCESS_ADD = 2;          // level akses minimal: buat / ubah lembar hitung
    var ACCESS_EDIT = 3;         // level akses minimal: ajukan / setujui / batalkan
    var EPS = 0.00005;
    var REASONS = ['Salah Hitung / Salah Catat', 'Rusak', 'Hilang / Susut', 'Kelebihan Penerimaan', 'Salah Pengeluaran', 'Lainnya'];

    var dataRecord = null;       // baris opname terpilih di grid utama
    var editingId = 0;           // 0 = baru, >0 = edit Draft
    var hdrForm = null, fWh, fDate, fRemark;

    function getFormAccess() { return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0); }
    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function fmtQty(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
    function fmtAmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    function round4(v) { return Math.round((parseFloat(v) || 0) * 10000) / 10000; }
    function showErr(msg) { Ext.Msg.show({ title: 'Peringatan', msg: msg, buttons: Ext.Msg.OK, icon: Ext.Msg.WARNING }); }
    function storeError(proxy, type, action, opt, res) {
        var m = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        if (res && res.message) { m = res.message; } else if (res && res.status) { m += ' (HTTP ' + res.status + ')'; }
        showErr(m);
    }
    function ymd(d) { return d ? d.dateFormat('Y-m-d') : ''; }
    function uiBtn(cls, label, bg, attrs) {      // tombol HTML gaya standar UI
        return '<button type="button" class="' + cls + '" ' + (attrs || '') + ' style="margin-left:8px;padding:8px 20px;background:' + bg +
               ';color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;">' + label + '</button>';
    }
    function statusColor(v) {
        switch (v) {
            case 'Draft': return '#999999 !important';
            case 'Diajukan': return '#e6a817 !important';
            case 'Disetujui': return '#00ff4c !important';
            case 'Dibatalkan': return '#c0392b !important';
        }
        return '#ffffff !important';
    }
    function ajax(params, onOk) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD, method: 'POST', params: params,
            success: function (r) {
                var o;
                try { o = Ext.decode(r.responseText); } catch (e) { showErr('Respons server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).'); return; }
                onOk(o);
            },
            failure: function (r) { showErr('Koneksi ke server gagal (HTTP ' + r.status + ').'); }
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 0. Panel detail (di bawah grid utama)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var GridMainHeight = maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid'));
    var dtlDiv = document.createElement('div');
    dtlDiv.id = 'soDtlContainer';
    dtlDiv.className = 'detail-panel-container';
    dtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
    dtlDiv.style.maxHeight = Math.round(GridMainHeight - (GridMainHeight * 0.6) - 30);
    dtlDiv.style.overflowY = 'auto';
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) { gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(dtlDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling); }

    function loadDetailPanel(id) {
        ajax({ action: 'detail', id: id }, function (res) {
            if (!res.success) { dtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;padding:10px;">' + enc(res.message || 'Gagal memuat detail.') + '</div>'; dtlDiv.style.display = 'block'; return; }
            renderDetail(res);
        });
    }

    function renderDetail(res) {
        var h = res.header, lines = res.data || [], mov = res.movements || [], jr = res.journals || [];
        var counted = 0, withDiff = 0;
        Ext.each(lines, function (l) { if (l.counted_qty !== null && l.counted_qty !== undefined) { counted++; if (Math.abs(parseFloat(l.diff_qty)) > EPS) withDiff++; } });

        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Detail Opname: ' + enc(h.ref_no) + ' <span style="color:' + statusColor(h.status) + ';">(' + enc(h.status) + ')</span></h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" /><div style="padding:4px 2px 10px 2px;">Gudang: <b>' + enc(h.warehouse_name) + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Tanggal: <b>' + enc(h.opname_date) +
                   '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Item: <b>' + lines.length + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Dihitung: <b>' + counted + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Ada selisih: <b>' + withDiff + '</b>' +
                   (h.remark ? ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Catatan: ' + enc(h.remark) : '') + '</div>' +
                   '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0"><thead><tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Material</th><th align="right">Stok Sistem</th><th align="right">Qty Hitung</th><th align="right">Selisih</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Biaya Satuan</th><th align="right">Nilai Selisih</th><th align="left">Alasan</th><th align="left">Catatan</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
        if (!lines.length) { html += '<tr><td colspan="8" style="padding:15px;text-align:center;color:#557982;">Belum ada baris.</td></tr>'; }
        Ext.each(lines, function (l) {
            var has = (l.counted_qty !== null && l.counted_qty !== undefined);
            var diff = parseFloat(l.diff_qty) || 0;
            var col = !has ? '#668894' : (diff > EPS ? '#2e9e4f' : (diff < -EPS ? '#e05353' : '#9fc3d1'));
            html += '<tr class="data-row"><td align="left">' + enc(l.material_name) + ' <span style="color:#668894;">(' + enc(l.material_code) + ')</span></td>' +
                    '<td align="right">' + fmtQty(l.system_qty) + ' ' + enc(l.unit || '') + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right">' + (has ? fmtQty(l.counted_qty) : '<i style="color:#668894;">tidak dihitung</i>') + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right" style="color:' + col + ';font-weight:bold;">' + (has ? fmtQty(diff) : '-') + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(l.unit_cost) + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right" style="color:' + col + ';">' + (parseFloat(l.diff_value) ? fmtAmt(l.diff_value) : '-') + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="left">' + enc(l.reason || '') + '</td><td align="left">' + enc(l.note || '') + '</td></tr>';
        });
        html += '</tbody></table>';

        // Jejak audit
        var trail = [];
        trail.push('Dibuat: <b>' + enc(h.created_by_name || '-') + '</b> (' + enc(h.created_at) + ')');
        if (h.submitted_at) trail.push('Diajukan: <b>' + enc(h.submitted_by_name || '-') + '</b> (' + enc(h.submitted_at) + ')');
        if (h.approved_at) trail.push('Disetujui: <b>' + enc(h.approved_by_name || '-') + '</b> (' + enc(h.approved_at) + ')');
        if (h.cancelled_at) trail.push('Dibatalkan: <b>' + enc(h.cancelled_by_name || '-') + '</b> (' + enc(h.cancelled_at) + ') - ' + enc(h.cancel_reason || ''));
        html += '<div style="margin-top:12px;color:#9fc3d1;">' + trail.join(' &nbsp;|&nbsp; ') + '</div>';
        if (h.status === 'Disetujui') {
            html += '<div style="margin-top:6px;color:#9fc3d1;">Nilai lebih diposting: <b>' + fmtAmt(h.total_gain) + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Nilai kurang diposting: <b>' + fmtAmt(h.total_loss) + '</b>';
            if (jr.length) { html += ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Jurnal: ' + Ext.pluck(jr, 'ref_no').join(', '); }
            html += ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Pergerakan stok: ' + mov.length + ' baris (lihat Kartu Stok, ref ' + enc(h.ref_no) + ')</div>';
        }

        // Tombol aksi menurut status
        var btns = '';
        if (h.status === 'Draft') btns += uiBtn('soAct', 'Ajukan', '#066b78', 'data-act="submit"') + uiBtn('soAct', 'Refresh Stok Sistem', '#555555', 'data-act="refresh"');
        if (h.status === 'Diajukan') btns += uiBtn('soAct', 'Setujui &amp; Posting', '#066b78', 'data-act="approve"') + uiBtn('soAct', 'Refresh / Kembali ke Draft', '#555555', 'data-act="refresh"');
        if (h.status !== 'Dibatalkan') btns += uiBtn('soAct', h.status === 'Disetujui' ? 'Batalkan (Reverse)' : 'Batalkan', '#800020', 'data-act="cancel"');
        if (btns) html += '<div style="margin-top:15px;text-align:right;">' + btns + '</div>';

        dtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        dtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
        var els = dtlDiv.querySelectorAll('.soAct');
        for (var i = 0; i < els.length; i++) { els[i].onclick = function () { doAction(h, this.getAttribute('data-act')); }; }
    }

    function doAction(h, act) {
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_EDIT) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk aksi ini.'); return; }
        var done = function (res) {
            Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
            if (res.success) { mainDs.load(); loadDetailPanel(h.id); if (dataRecord && dataRecord.id == h.id) { dataRecord.status = res.status || dataRecord.status; } updateMainButtons(); }
        };
        var texts = { submit: 'Ajukan opname <b>' + enc(h.ref_no) + '</b> untuk persetujuan?',
                      refresh: 'Ambil ulang stok sistem untuk semua baris? Status kembali ke Draft.',
                      approve: 'Setujui &amp; posting opname <b>' + enc(h.ref_no) + '</b>? Stok dan jurnal akan disesuaikan.' };
        if (act === 'cancel') {
            Ext.Msg.prompt('Batalkan Opname', 'Alasan pembatalan (wajib, min. 5 karakter):', function (btn, txt) {
                if (btn !== 'ok') return;
                ajax({ action: 'cancel', id: h.id, reason: txt }, done);
            }, this, true);
            return;
        }
        Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi', texts[act], function (btn) {
            if (btn !== 'yes') return;
            ajax({ action: act, id: h.id }, done);
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Stores & grid utama
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({       // assignment polos (konvensi search box template)
        url: CRD, baseParams: { action: 'list' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, [
            { name: 'id' }, { name: 'ref_no' }, { name: 'warehouse_id' }, { name: 'warehouse_name' }, { name: 'opname_date' },
            { name: 'status' }, { name: 'remark' }, { name: 'created_by_name' },
            { name: 'line_count', type: 'int' }, { name: 'counted_count', type: 'int' }, { name: 'diff_count', type: 'int' },
            { name: 'total_gain', type: 'float' }, { name: 'total_loss', type: 'float' }
        ]),
        listeners: { exception: storeError }
    });
    mainDs.load();

    var whDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD, baseParams: { action: 'lookup_warehouses' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'code' }, { name: 'name' }]),
        listeners: { exception: storeError }
    });
    var matDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD, baseParams: { action: 'lookup_materials' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'material_id' }, [
            { name: 'material_id' }, { name: 'material_code' }, { name: 'material_name' }, { name: 'unit' },
            { name: 'system_qty', type: 'float' }, { name: 'unit_cost', type: 'float' }]),
        listeners: { exception: storeError }
    });

    var mainHeight = Math.round(GridMainHeight * 0.6);
    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs, renderTo: 'divMainGrid', height: mainHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. Opname', dataIndex: 'ref_no', width: 120 },
            { header: 'Tanggal', dataIndex: 'opname_date', width: 90, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Gudang', dataIndex: 'warehouse_name', width: 190, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Item', dataIndex: 'line_count', width: 55, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Dihitung', dataIndex: 'counted_count', width: 70, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Ada Selisih', dataIndex: 'diff_count', width: 80, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Nilai Lebih', dataIndex: 'total_gain', width: 110, align: 'right', renderer: fmtAmt },
            { header: 'Nilai Kurang', dataIndex: 'total_loss', width: 110, align: 'right', renderer: fmtAmt },
            { header: 'Dibuat Oleh', dataIndex: 'created_by_name', width: 110 },
            { header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 90, align: 'center',
              renderer: function (v) { return '<span style="color:' + statusColor(v) + ';font-weight:bold;">' + enc(v || '-') + '</span>'; } }
        ],
        // [GRID-WRAP 2026-11-17] forceFit:true -> false agar Gudang/Dibuat Oleh wrap, bukan terpotong "...".
        viewConfig: { forceFit: false, scrollOffset: 0 }, loadMask: true,
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (!rec) return;
                dataRecord = rec.data;
                updateMainButtons();
                loadDetailPanel(dataRecord.id);
            }
        }
    });

    function updateMainButtons() {
        mainBtnEnable('#addData');
        mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');          // dokumen opname tidak dihapus, hanya Dibatalkan (jejak audit)
        if (dataRecord && dataRecord.status === 'Draft') { mainBtnEnable('#editData'); } else { mainBtnDisable('#editData'); }
    }
    editDataDisable();
    updateMainButtons();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Editor: header + grid hitung
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var itemField = [
        { name: 'material_id' }, { name: 'material_code' }, { name: 'material_name' }, { name: 'unit' },
        { name: 'system_qty', type: 'float' }, { name: 'counted_qty' }, { name: 'diff_qty', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'unit_cost', type: 'float' }, { name: 'reason' }, { name: 'note' }
    ];
    var itemDs = new Ext.data.Store({ reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data' }, itemField) });

    var editorDeleter = new Extensive.grid.ItemDeleter({ header: '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#e05353" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="vertical-align:middle;"><polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/><path d="M19 6l-1 14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H8a2 2 0 0 1-2-2L5 6"/><path d="M10 11v6M14 11v6"/><path d="M9 6V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h4a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v2"/></svg>' });
    itemDs.on('remove', function () { updateSummary(); });

    function hasCount(r) { var v = r.get('counted_qty'); return !(v === null || v === undefined || v === ''); }
    function recalcRow(r) {
        r.set('diff_qty', hasCount(r) ? round4((parseFloat(r.get('counted_qty')) || 0) - (parseFloat(r.get('system_qty')) || 0)) : 0);
    }
    function updateSummary() {
        var n = 0, c = 0, d = 0, gain = 0, loss = 0;
        itemDs.each(function (r) {
            n++;
            if (!hasCount(r)) return;
            c++;
            var diff = parseFloat(r.get('diff_qty')) || 0;
            if (Math.abs(diff) > EPS) { d++; var v = diff * (parseFloat(r.get('unit_cost')) || 0); if (diff > 0) gain += v; else loss += -v; }
        });
        var el = document.getElementById('soSummary');
        if (el) el.innerHTML = 'Item: <b>' + n + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Dihitung: <b>' + c + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Ada selisih: <b>' + d +
            '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Perkiraan nilai lebih: <b style="color:#2e9e4f;">' + fmtAmt(gain) + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Perkiraan nilai kurang (FIFO bisa berbeda): <b style="color:#e05353;">' + fmtAmt(loss) + '</b>';
    }

    var itemGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        selModel: editorDeleter, store: itemDs, renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        // [GRID-WRAP 2026-11-17] forceFit:true -> false agar Material wrap, bukan terpotong "...".
        viewConfig: { forceFit: false, scrollOffset: 0 }, height: 300,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Kode', dataIndex: 'material_code', width: 80 },
            { header: 'Material', dataIndex: 'material_name', width: 200 },
            { header: 'Sat', dataIndex: 'unit', width: 45, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Stok Sistem', dataIndex: 'system_qty', width: 90, align: 'right', renderer: fmtQty },
            { header: 'Qty Hitung', dataIndex: 'counted_qty', width: 90, align: 'right',
              editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 4, allowNegative: false }),
              renderer: function (v) { return (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') ? '<i style="color:#668894;">isi</i>' : fmtQty(v); } },
            { header: 'Selisih', dataIndex: 'diff_qty', width: 90, align: 'right',
              renderer: function (v, m, r) {
                  if (!hasCount(r)) return '';
                  var c = v > EPS ? '#2e9e4f' : (v < -EPS ? '#e05353' : '#9fc3d1');
                  return '<span style="color:' + c + ';font-weight:bold;">' + fmtQty(v) + '</span>';
              } },
            { header: 'Biaya Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit_cost', width: 100, align: 'right',
              editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 4, allowNegative: false }), renderer: fmtAmt },
            { header: 'Alasan Selisih', dataIndex: 'reason', width: 150,
              editor: new Ext.form.ComboBox({ store: REASONS, triggerAction: 'all', editable: false, forceSelection: true }) },
            { header: 'Catatan', dataIndex: 'note', width: 150, editor: new myTextField() },
            editorDeleter
        ],
        listeners: {
            afteredit: function (e) {
                if (e.field === 'counted_qty') {
                    if (e.value === '' || e.value === null) { e.record.set('counted_qty', null); }
                    recalcRow(e.record);
                }
                updateSummary();
            }
        }
    });
    itemGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    (function injectExtraUI() {      // form header + pemilih material + ringkasan
        var g = document.getElementById('editorFormGrid');
        if (!g || document.getElementById('soHdrForm')) return;
        var hdr = document.createElement('div'); hdr.id = 'soHdrForm'; hdr.style.cssText = 'margin-bottom:2px;';
        g.parentNode.insertBefore(hdr, g);
        var bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.id = 'soAddBar'; bar.style.cssText = 'margin:6px 0;';
        g.parentNode.insertBefore(bar, g);
        var sum = document.createElement('div'); sum.id = 'soSummary';
        sum.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px;margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;text-align:right;background:#1f2d3a;color:#ffffff !important;border-radius:4px;';
        g.parentNode.insertBefore(sum, g.nextSibling);
    })();

    var fMat = null;
    function ensureForm() {
        if (hdrForm) { hdrForm.doLayout(); return; }
        fWh = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Gudang', store: whDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all',
            forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, anchor: '95%',
            listeners: { select: function () { itemDs.removeAll(); updateSummary(); } }
        });
        fDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Opname', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), allowBlank: false, width: 130 });
        fRemark = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Catatan', anchor: '95%' });
        var col = function (w, items) { return { columnWidth: w, layout: 'form', border: false, labelWidth: 110, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;', items: items }; };
        hdrForm = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
            renderTo: 'soHdrForm', border: false, layout: 'column', bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;padding:4px 2px 0 2px;',
            items: [col(0.34, [fWh]), col(0.22, [fDate]), col(0.44, [fRemark])]
        });

        // baris tambah material + ambil semua stok gudang
        fMat = new Ext.form.ComboBox({
            store: matDs, displayField: 'material_name', valueField: 'material_id', mode: 'remote', queryParam: 'query', minChars: 0,
            triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, width: 380, listWidth: 520, emptyText: 'Tambah material (termasuk yang stok sistemnya 0)...',
            tpl: '<tpl for="."><div class="x-combo-list-item">{material_code} - {material_name} <b>(stok {system_qty} {unit})</b></div></tpl>',
            renderTo: 'soAddBar',
            listeners: { beforequery: function () {
                if (!fWh.getValue()) { showErr('Pilih gudang terlebih dahulu.'); return false; }
                matDs.baseParams.warehouse_id = fWh.getValue();
            } }
        });
        var b1 = document.createElement('span');
        b1.innerHTML = uiBtn('soBtnAdd', 'Tambah', '#066b78') + uiBtn('soBtnSnap', 'Ambil Semua Stok Gudang', '#555555');
        document.getElementById('soAddBar').appendChild(b1);
        document.getElementById('soAddBar').getElementsByClassName('soBtnAdd')[0].onclick = addMaterial;
        document.getElementById('soAddBar').getElementsByClassName('soBtnSnap')[0].onclick = loadSnapshot;
    }

    function newRec(cfg) {
        var Rec = itemDs.recordType || Ext.data.Record.create(itemField);
        return new Rec(Ext.apply({ material_id: null, material_code: '', material_name: '', unit: '', system_qty: 0, counted_qty: null, diff_qty: 0, unit_cost: 0, reason: '', note: '' }, cfg || {}));
    }
    function addMaterial() {
        var rec = fMat.findRecord('material_id', fMat.getValue());
        if (!rec) { showErr('Pilih material terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
        if (itemDs.find('material_id', rec.get('material_id')) >= 0) { showErr('Material sudah ada di daftar.'); return; }
        itemDs.add(newRec({ material_id: rec.get('material_id'), material_code: rec.get('material_code'), material_name: rec.get('material_name'),
                            unit: rec.get('unit'), system_qty: rec.get('system_qty'), unit_cost: rec.get('unit_cost') }));
        fMat.clearValue();
        updateSummary();
    }
    function loadSnapshot() {
        if (!fWh.getValue()) { showErr('Pilih gudang terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
        ajax({ action: 'snapshot', warehouse_id: fWh.getValue() }, function (res) {
            if (!res.success) { showErr(res.message || 'Gagal mengambil stok.'); return; }
            var added = 0;
            Ext.each(res.data, function (d) {
                if (itemDs.find('material_id', d.material_id) >= 0) return;
                itemDs.add(newRec({ material_id: d.material_id, material_code: d.material_code, material_name: d.material_name, unit: d.unit,
                                    system_qty: parseFloat(d.system_qty), unit_cost: parseFloat(d.unit_cost) }));
                added++;
            });
            updateSummary();
            Ext.Msg.alert('Stok Gudang', added + ' material ditambahkan dari stok sistem.');
        });
    }

    function showEditor(title) {
        var addWdw = document.getElementById('addWdw'); if (addWdw) addWdw.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;' + enc(title);
        ensureForm();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Handler tombol template
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_ADD) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membuat opname.'); return; }
        editingId = 0;
        showEditor('Stock Opname Baru');
        whDs.load({ callback: function () {
            fWh.clearValue(); fWh.setDisabled(false); fDate.setValue(new Date()); fRemark.setValue('');
            itemDs.removeAll(); updateSummary();
        } });
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) { showErr('Pilih opname terlebih dahulu dari tabel.'); return; }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'Draft') { showErr('Hanya opname berstatus Draft yang dapat diubah.'); return; }
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_ADD) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengubah opname.'); return; }
        ajax({ action: 'detail', id: dataRecord.id }, function (res) {
            if (!res.success) { showErr(res.message || 'Gagal memuat opname.'); return; }
            var h = res.header;
            editingId = parseInt(h.id, 10);
            showEditor('Edit Opname ' + h.ref_no);
            whDs.load({ callback: function () {
                fWh.setValue(parseInt(h.warehouse_id, 10)); fWh.setDisabled(true);       // gudang tidak dapat diganti
                fDate.setValue(Date.parseDate(h.opname_date, 'Y-m-d') || new Date());
                fRemark.setValue(h.remark || '');
                itemDs.removeAll();
                Ext.each(res.data, function (d) {
                    itemDs.add(newRec({
                        material_id: d.material_id, material_code: d.material_code, material_name: d.material_name, unit: d.unit,
                        system_qty: parseFloat(d.system_qty), counted_qty: (d.counted_qty === null ? null : parseFloat(d.counted_qty)),
                        diff_qty: parseFloat(d.diff_qty), unit_cost: parseFloat(d.unit_cost), reason: d.reason || '', note: d.note || ''
                    }));
                });
                updateSummary();
            } });
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        if (!fWh.getValue()) { showErr('Gudang wajib dipilih.'); return; }
        if (!fDate.getValue()) { showErr('Tanggal opname wajib diisi.'); return; }
        if (!itemDs.getCount()) { showErr('Tambahkan minimal satu material.'); return; }
        var arr = [], err = '';
        itemDs.each(function (r) {
            var c = hasCount(r) ? parseFloat(r.get('counted_qty')) : null;
            if (c !== null && c < 0) { err = err || ('Qty hitung ' + r.get('material_name') + ' tidak boleh negatif.'); return; }
            arr.push({ material_id: r.get('material_id'), counted_qty: c, unit_cost: parseFloat(r.get('unit_cost')) || 0,
                       reason: r.get('reason') || '', note: r.get('note') || '' });
        });
        if (err) { showErr(err); return; }
        ajax({
            action: 'save', id: editingId, warehouse_id: fWh.getValue(), opname_date: ymd(fDate.getValue()), remark: fRemark.getValue(),
            details: Ext.util.JSON.encode(arr)          // detail bertingkat -> JSON via POST
        }, function (res) {
            if (res.success) {
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message || 'Opname tersimpan.');
                mainDs.load();
                var newId = res.id || (res.data && res.data.id);        // WhOk: id di top-level atau di dalam data
                if (newId) { dataRecord = { id: newId, status: 'Draft' }; updateMainButtons(); loadDetailPanel(newId); }
            } else {
                showErr(res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        if (document.getElementById('popCancel')) { document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none'; }
    };
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

/*
  Document      : m.proyek.js
  Description   : ExtJS Controller untuk pengelolaan Master Proyek dengan Integrasi AI Task Breakdown
                   - Panel Detail Sub-Task AI di Layar Utama (Main Screen)
                   - Editor Form Responsif & Tinggi Maksimal
  Backend       : /rab-project/php-crud/m.proyekCRD.php
  [AI-BOQ]      : analisis AI -> BoQ lengkap (material + biaya/expense, satuan, qty, harga MIN/MAX); review bisa diedit (task, material, biaya);
                  simpan = buat material master -> RAB -> task. Butuh migrasi sql/2026-11-06.budget_items_price_range.sql
  [AUTO-INV]    : + tagihan otomatis (DP/Termin 1-3 = 30-20-20-30) dari breakdown task; tabel tagihan di panel detail
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    if (document.getElementById("mainHeaderText")) {
        document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = " Data <em>Proyek & Kontrak</em>";
    }

    var CRD = main_url + '/php-crud/m.proyekCRD.php';
    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;
    var curRate = 1;
    var fmtRp = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };
    // [AI-BOQ] qty tanpa nol di belakang (Ext 3 tidak mendukung pola '#'): 150 -> "150", 1.5 -> "1.5", 1000 -> "1,000"
    function fmtQty3(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(parseFloat(v) || 0, '0,000.000').replace(/\.?0+$/, ''); }
    // [AI-BOQ] penanda plafon: hasil analisis / RAB lebih besar dari budget atau nilai kontrak (aturan sama dengan modul RAB)
    function plafonBanner() {
        var sm = (mainTaskStore && mainTaskStore.reader && mainTaskStore.reader.jsonData) ? mainTaskStore.reader.jsonData.summary : null;
        if (!sm) return '';
        var nf = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000'); }, en = Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode;
        var col = { danger: ['#3b1212', '#ff6b5e', '#ffb4ab'], warning: ['#3a2c08', '#e6a817', '#ffe08a'], ok: ['#0f2f22', '#2e9e4f', '#a5e8bd'] }[sm.severity] || ['#132330', '#1c3648', '#ffffff'];
        var title = sm.severity === 'ok' ? '&#10003; Anggaran aman' : ('&#9888; ' + (sm.severity === 'danger' ? 'PERINGATAN ANGGARAN' : 'PERHATIAN ANGGARAN'));
        var h = '<div style="background:' + col[0] + ';border:2px solid ' + col[1] + ';border-radius:5px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;">' +
            '<b style="color:' + col[1] + ';">' + title + '</b><br><span style="color:#d5e3ec;">Total RAB Rp <b>' + nf(sm.rab_after_idr) + '</b> | Estimasi seluruh task (max) Rp <b>' + nf(sm.task_total_max_idr) + '</b>' +
            (sm.budget_idr > 0 ? ' | Budget Rp <b>' + nf(sm.budget_idr) + '</b>' : '') + (sm.contract_idr > 0 ? ' | Nilai kontrak Rp <b>' + nf(sm.contract_idr) + '</b>' : '') + '</span>';
        Ext.each(sm.warnings || [], function (w) {
            h += '<div style="color:' + (w.level === 'danger' ? '#ffb4ab' : '#ffe08a') + ';margin-top:3px;">&bull; ' + en(w.text) + '</div>';
        });
        return h + '</div>';
    }
    // [AI-BOQ] rincian item task (M = material, E = biaya) dengan harga satuan MIN - MAX (mata uang anggaran proyek)
    function fmtTaskItems(items, kind) {
        var out = [], nf = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000'); };
        Ext.each(items || [], function (it) {
            if (it.kind !== kind) return;
            var pr = (parseFloat(it.pmin) === parseFloat(it.pmax)) ? nf(it.pmax) : nf(it.pmin) + ' - ' + nf(it.pmax);
            out.push('<div style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(it.name) + '</b>: ' + fmtQty3(it.qty) + ' ' +
                     Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(it.unit) + '<div style="color:#8fb3c0;font-size:13px;">@ ' + pr + ' / ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(it.unit) + (parseFloat(it.pmin) === parseFloat(it.pmax) ? ' (rentang master belum diisi)' : ' (min - max)') + '</div></div>');
        });
        return out.length ? out.join('') : '-';
    }

    // [AUTO-INV][NEW] tabel rencana / hasil tagihan (dipakai dialog preview & hasil breakdown)
    var ACTION_LBL = { 'new': 'Akan diterbitkan', 'sync': 'Sesuaikan tanggal', 'exists': 'Sudah ada', 'skip': 'Dilewati' };
    function planHtml(rows, analysis) {
        var td = 'padding:7px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid #2a485d; vertical-align:top;';
        var nw = td + 'white-space:nowrap;';
        var h = '';
        if (analysis) h += '<div style="margin-bottom:12px; text-align:left; line-height:20px;"><b>Analisis AI:</b> ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(analysis) + '</div>';
        h += '<table style="border-collapse:collapse; font-size:15px; width:100%; text-align:left; table-layout:auto;">' +
             '<tr style="font-weight:bold; color:#00bcd4;">' +
             '<td style="' + nw + '">Tagihan</td><td align="right" style="' + nw + '">%</td><td align="right" style="' + nw + '">Total (DPP+PPN)</td>' +
             '<td style="' + nw + '">Tgl Invoice</td><td style="' + nw + '">Jatuh Tempo</td><td style="' + td + '">Task Pemicu</td><td style="' + nw + '">Aksi</td></tr>';
        Ext.each(rows || [], function (r) {
            h += '<tr><td style="' + nw + '">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.termin_name) + '</td>' +
                 '<td align="right" style="' + nw + '">' + (r.pct || 0) + '</td>' +
                 '<td align="right" style="' + nw + '">' + fmtRp(r.amount) + '</td>' +
                 '<td style="' + nw + '">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.invoice_date || '-') + '</td>' +
                 '<td style="' + nw + '">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.due_date || '-') + '</td>' +
                 '<td style="' + td + '">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.task_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                 '<td style="' + nw + '">' + (ACTION_LBL[r.action] || '') + '</td></tr>';
        });
        return h + '</table>';
    }

    // [AUTO-INV][NEW] window lebar + scroll (Ext.Msg terlalu sempit untuk tabel). onYes kosong -> hanya tombol Tutup.
    // Tombol footer memakai <button> HTML bergaya sama dengan "Print Task" (tombol Ext bawaan tidak terbaca di tema gelap).
    var planWinSeq = 0;
    // [DEDUP] penjaga klik ganda: analisis sedang jalan / jendela hasil analisis masih terbuka / simpan sedang jalan
    var aiBusy = false, aiPlanOpen = false, aiSaving = false;
    // [FORM-LIVE] Isian form proyek yang SEDANG diedit (belum disimpan) ikut dikirim di setiap permintaan analisis / hitung ulang / simpan rencana,
    // sehingga user tidak perlu menyimpan proyek dulu hanya agar budget / nilai kontrak / tanggal terbaru dipakai.
    function formOv() {
        var o = {}, g = function (id) { var c = Ext.getCmp(id); return c ? c.getValue() : undefined; };
        var d = function (id) { var v = g(id); return (v && v.format) ? v.format('Y-m-d') : ''; };
        var nm = g('name'); if (nm) o.ovr_name = nm;
        var sc = g('project_scope'); if (sc !== undefined) o.ovr_project_scope = sc;
        var st = g('status'); if (st) o.ovr_status = st;
        var sd = d('start_date'); if (sd) o.ovr_start_date = sd;
        var ed = d('end_date'); if (ed) o.ovr_end_date = ed;
        var b = g('budget'); if (b !== undefined && b !== '' && b !== null) o.ovr_budget = b;
        var c = g('contract_value'); if (c !== undefined && c !== '' && c !== null) o.ovr_contract_value = c;
        return o;
    }
    function setAiBtn(disabled) {
        var ids = ['customAiBtn', 'customEditBtn'];                  // [EDIT-SAVED] kedua tombol dikunci bersama
        for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            var b = document.getElementById(ids[i]);
            if (!b) continue;
            b.disabled = !!disabled;
            b.style.opacity = disabled ? '0.45' : '1';
            b.style.cursor = disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer';
        }
    }
    function showPlanWin(title, html, yesText, onYes, onReady, keepOpen) {      // [AI-BOQ] keepOpen: jangan tutup saat Simpan (draft tetap ada bila gagal)
        var w = Math.min(1500, Math.round((window.innerWidth || 1200) * 0.97));      // [UI-READABLE] jendela lebih lebar & tinggi agar kartu tidak sempit
        var h = Math.min(950, Math.round((window.innerHeight || 800) * 0.94));
        var uid = 'planWin' + (++planWinSeq);
        var btnBase = 'padding:11px 28px; color:#fff; border:0; border-radius:5px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold; font-size:15px; margin-left:12px;';   // [UI-READABLE] tombol lebih besar
        var btnHtml = '<div style="text-align:right; padding:6px 4px;">' +
            (onYes ? '<button type="button" id="' + uid + 'No" style="' + btnBase + 'background:#800020;">Batal</button>' +        // burgundy
                     '<button type="button" id="' + uid + 'Yes" style="' + btnBase + 'background:#066b78;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(yesText || 'Ya') + '</button>'   // deep teal
                   : '<button type="button" id="' + uid + 'No" style="' + btnBase + 'background:#066b78;">Tutup</button>') +
            '</div>';
        if (!document.getElementById('aiPlanWinCss')) {      // [UI-READABLE] judul jendela 20px (default Ext 11px terlalu kecil)
            Ext.util.CSS.createStyleSheet('.aiPlanWin .x-window-header-text{font-size:20px !important;font-weight:bold;line-height:30px;} ' +
                                          '.aiPlanWin .x-window-header{padding-top:8px;padding-bottom:6px;} ' +
                                          '.aiPlanWin .x-tool{margin-top:6px;}', 'aiPlanWinCss');
        }
        var win = new Ext.Window({
            cls: 'aiPlanWin', title: title, width: w, height: h, modal: true, layout: 'auto', autoScroll: true, closeAction: 'close',
            bodyStyle: 'padding:14px;', html: html,
            bbar: new Ext.Toolbar({
                style: 'background:transparent; border:0; padding:6px 10px;',
                items: ['->', { xtype: 'box', autoEl: { tag: 'div', html: btnHtml } }]
            })
        });
        win.show();
        if (onReady) onReady(win, uid);
        var no = document.getElementById(uid + 'No'), yes = document.getElementById(uid + 'Yes');
        if (no) no.onclick = function () { win.close(); };
        if (yes) yes.onclick = function () { if (keepOpen) { onYes(win); } else { win.close(); onYes(); } };
    }

    function storeException(proxy, type, action, options, response) {
        var msg = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        try {
            var r = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
            if (r && r.message) msg = r.message;
        } catch (e) { msg += ' (respons bukan JSON, cek error_log PHP)'; }
        Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', msg);
    }

    function loadMainDetailPanel(projectId) {
        mainTaskStore.load({
            params: { project_id: projectId },
            callback: function (records) {
                // [AUTO-INV] muat tagihan proyek, lalu render task + tagihan sekaligus
                Ext.Ajax.request({
                    url: CRD, method: 'POST', params: { task: 'read_invoices', project_id: projectId },
                    success: function (resp) {
                        var o = {}; try { o = Ext.util.JSON.decode(resp.responseText); } catch (e) {}
                        renderMainDetailPanel(records, o.data || []);
                    },
                    failure: function () { renderMainDetailPanel(records, []); }
                });
            }
        });
    }

    var btnAiPanel = new Ext.Panel({
        border: false,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:10px 0;',
        html: '<div style="text-align: left;"><button type="button" id="customAiBtn" style="background:transparent; border:1px solid #00bcd4; color:#00bcd4; padding:8px 24px; border-radius:20px; font-weight:bold; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:1px; transition:all 0.3s;">ANALISIS & BAGI TASK (AI)</button>' +
