  Description   : Laporan Keuangan - Neraca & Laba Rugi, render sebagai
                   HTML table (bukan Ext Grid, supaya mudah bikin format
                   laporan keuangan konvensional: indentasi, subtotal, dll).
  Backend       : /rab-project/dev/php-crud/financialreportCRD.php
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    var CRD = main_url + '/php-crud/financialreportCRD.php';

    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Financial <em>Report</em>";

    ['addData', 'editData', 'deleteData'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 0. Buat elemen filter bar & area laporan secara dinamis
    // ============================================================
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    if (gridContainer) gridContainer.style.display = 'none'; // tidak pakai Ext grid di modul ini

    var wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.style.padding = '0 10px';
    wrapper.innerHTML =
        '<div id="frFilterBar" style="padding:8px 0;"></div>' +
        '<div style="display:flex; gap:20px; flex-wrap:wrap;">' +
        '  <div id="frBalanceSheet" style="flex:1; min-width:400px;"></div>' +
        '  <div id="frIncomeStatement" style="flex:1; min-width:400px;"></div>' +
        '</div>';
    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(wrapper, gridContainer);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 1. Filter periode
    // ============================================================
    // [DEFAULT-PERIOD][NEW] Periode default = periode yang memuat tanggal hari ini; bila tidak ada -> periode terbaru (baris pertama)
    function pickDefaultPeriod(store) {
        var d = new Date(), m = d.getMonth() + 1, day = d.getDate();
        var today = d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : m) + '-' + (day < 10 ? '0' + day : day);
        var idx = store.findBy(function (r) { return r.get('start_date') <= today && today <= r.get('end_date'); });
        return store.getAt(idx >= 0 ? idx : 0).get('id');
    }

    var periodField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'period_name' }, { name: 'start_date' }, { name: 'end_date' }];     // [DEFAULT-PERIOD] + tanggal
    var periodDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        baseParams: { task: 'read_periods' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, periodField),
        listeners: {
            load: function (store) {
                if (store.getCount() > 0 && !fldPeriod.getValue()) {
                    fldPeriod.setValue(pickDefaultPeriod(store));     // [DEFAULT-PERIOD]
                    loadReport();
                }
            }
        }
    });
    periodDs.load();

    var fldPeriod = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Periode', width: 200, store: periodDs, displayField: 'period_name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var btnShow = new Ext.Button({ text: 'Tampilkan', cls: 'field-button grey-field-button' });

    new Ext.Panel({
        renderTo: 'frFilterBar',
        layout: 'column',
        border: false,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;',
        defaults: { border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;' },
        items: [
            { columnWidth: 0.3, layout: 'form', labelWidth: 60, items: fldPeriod },
            { columnWidth: 0.15, style: 'padding-top:2px;', items: btnShow }
        ]
    });
    btnShow.on('click', loadReport);

    // ============================================================
    // 2. Helper render tabel HTML
    // ============================================================
    function fmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }

    function renderAccountRows(items) {
        return items.map(function (it) {
            return '<tr style="color:#e5e5e5;"><td style="padding-left:20px;">' + it.account_code + ' - ' + it.account_name + '</td>' +
                   '<td style="text-align:right;">' + fmt(it.balance !== undefined ? it.balance : it.amount) + '</td></tr>';
        }).join('');
    }

    function renderBalanceSheet(bs) {
        var balColor = bs.is_balance ? '#2e9e4f' : '#c0392b';
        var balText = bs.is_balance ? 'BALANCE ✓' : 'TIDAK BALANCE ✗';
        var html = '<h3 style="margin-bottom:6px; color:#fff;">NERACA</h3>' +
            '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; color:#e5e5e5;" class="fr-table">' +
            '<tr style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff;"><td colspan="2"><b>ASET</b></td></tr>' +
            renderAccountRows(bs.asset) +
            '<tr style="border-top:1px solid #888; color:#fff;"><td><b>Total Aset</b></td><td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + fmt(bs.asset_total) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td colspan="2">&nbsp;</td></tr>' +
            '<tr style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff;"><td colspan="2"><b>LIABILITAS</b></td></tr>' +
            renderAccountRows(bs.liability) +
            '<tr style="border-top:1px solid #888; color:#fff;"><td><b>Total Liabilitas</b></td><td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + fmt(bs.liability_total) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td colspan="2">&nbsp;</td></tr>' +
            '<tr style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff;"><td colspan="2"><b>EKUITAS</b></td></tr>' +
            renderAccountRows(bs.equity) +
            '<tr><td style="padding-left:20px;">Laba (Rugi) Kumulatif s/d Periode Ini</td><td style="text-align:right;">' + fmt(bs.net_income_cumulative) + '</td></tr>' +
            '<tr style="border-top:1px solid #888; color:#fff;"><td><b>Total Ekuitas</b></td><td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + fmt(bs.equity_total) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td colspan="2">&nbsp;</td></tr>' +
            '<tr style="border-top:2px solid #888; color:#fff;"><td><b>Total Liabilitas + Ekuitas</b></td><td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + fmt(bs.liability_total + bs.equity_total) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '</table>' +
            '<p style="color:' + balColor + '; font-weight:bold; margin-top:8px;">' + balText + '</p>';
        document.getElementById('frBalanceSheet').innerHTML = html;
    }

    // [YTD] Laba Rugi dua kolom: "Periode Ini" (mutasi dalam periode) dan "Tahun Berjalan (YTD)" (1 Januari s/d akhir periode)
    function renderIsRows(items) {
        return items.map(function (it) {
            return '<tr style="color:#e5e5e5;"><td style="padding-left:20px;">' + it.account_code + ' - ' + it.account_name + '</td>' +
                   '<td style="text-align:right;">' + fmt(it.amount) + '</td>' +
                   '<td style="text-align:right;">' + fmt(it.amount_ytd) + '</td></tr>';
        }).join('');
    }

    function renderIncomeStatement(is) {
        var niColor = function (v) { return v >= 0 ? '#2e9e4f' : '#c0392b'; };
        var niLabel = is.net_income_period >= 0 ? 'LABA BERSIH' : 'RUGI BERSIH';
        var hdr = '<td style="text-align:right; width:130px;"><b>Periode Ini</b></td><td style="text-align:right; width:150px;"><b>Tahun Berjalan (YTD)</b></td>';
        var html = '<h3 style="margin-bottom:6px; color:#fff;">LAPORAN LABA RUGI</h3>' +
            '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; table-layout:fixed; color:#e5e5e5;" class="fr-table">' +
            '<colgroup><col/><col style="width:130px"/><col style="width:150px"/></colgroup>' +
            '<tr style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff;"><td><b>PENDAPATAN</b></td>' + hdr + '</tr>' +
            renderIsRows(is.revenue) +
            '<tr style="border-top:1px solid #888; color:#fff;"><td><b>Total Pendapatan</b></td><td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + fmt(is.revenue_total) + '</b></td><td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + fmt(is.revenue_total_ytd) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td colspan="3">&nbsp;</td></tr>' +
            '<tr style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff;"><td><b>BEBAN</b></td>' + hdr + '</tr>' +
            renderIsRows(is.expense) +
            '<tr style="border-top:1px solid #888; color:#fff;"><td><b>Total Beban</b></td><td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + fmt(is.expense_total) + '</b></td><td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + fmt(is.expense_total_ytd) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td colspan="3">&nbsp;</td></tr>' +
            '<tr style="border-top:2px solid #888;"><td style="color:#fff;"><b>' + niLabel + '</b></td>' +
            '<td style="text-align:right; color:' + niColor(is.net_income_period) + ';"><b>' + fmt(Math.abs(is.net_income_period)) + '</b></td>' +
            '<td style="text-align:right; color:' + niColor(is.net_income_ytd) + ';"><b>' + fmt(Math.abs(is.net_income_ytd)) + '</b></td></tr>' +
            '</table>';
        if (is.revenue_total_ytd === undefined) {      // backend lama (tanpa field YTD)
            html += '<p style="color:#ffeb3b;">Kolom YTD belum tersedia: php-crud/financialreportCRD.php di server belum versi terbaru.</p>';
        }
        document.getElementById('frIncomeStatement').innerHTML = html;
    }

    function loadReport() {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) return;
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_report', period_id: perId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Error', res.message || 'Gagal memuat laporan.');
                    return;
                }
                renderBalanceSheet(res.balance_sheet);
                renderIncomeStatement(res.income_statement);
            }
        });
    }

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        window.open('../pdf/financialreport.php?period_id=' + perId, '_blank', 'width=900,height=800,scrollbars=yes,resizable=yes');     // [PRINT] argumen fitur dijadikan satu string
    };
});
==================== FILE: ./js/m.employee.js ====================
Ext.onReady(function() {
	Ext.QuickTips.init();
  document.getElementById('dataPicture').style.display='block';
  document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Employee <em>List</em> ";
	document.getElementById('dataPicPrev').src='../img/no_image.png';

	document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function(event) {
		document.getElementById('dataPicPrev').src='../img/no_image.png';
		task='';
		if (formAccess==2 || formAccess==3 || formAccess==4){
			task = 'create';
			document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display='block';
			document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "&nbsp;&nbsp;New Employee";

      var frmEditorHeight=(document.getElementById('editorForm').clientHeight - document.getElementById('editorFormHeader').clientHeight);
      Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').setHeight(frmEditorHeight);
      Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').doLayout(); // recalc column widths now that the panel is actually visible

			frmEditor.getForm().reset();

      Ext.getCmp('department_id').allowBlank = false;
      Ext.getCmp('department_id').validateValue(Ext.getCmp('department_id').getValue()); //force update
      Ext.getCmp('status_id').allowBlank = false;
      Ext.getCmp('status_id').validateValue(Ext.getCmp('status_id').getValue()); //force update

			Ext.getCmp('employee_name').focus('', 10);
			Ext.getCmp('fSetDepart').hide();
			Ext.getCmp('btnTransferDept').disable();
			Ext.getCmp('fSetStatus').hide();
			Ext.getCmp('btnChangeSts').disable();

      comboEnable('department_id');
      comboEnable('status_id');
      comboEnable('section_id');

		}else{
			document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to access this window';
			document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';
		}
	};
	document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function(event) {
		task='';
    sectionDs.load({params: {department_id: dataRecord.department_id}});
		if (formAccess==3 || formAccess==4){
			frmEditor.getForm().reset();
			task = 'update';
      Ext.getCmp('department_id').allowBlank = true;
      Ext.getCmp('department_id').validateValue(Ext.getCmp('department_id').getValue()); //force update
      Ext.getCmp('status_id').allowBlank = true;
      Ext.getCmp('status_id').validateValue(Ext.getCmp('status_id').getValue()); //force update
			Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().load({
				url:'../php-crud/m.employeeCRD.php',
				params:{id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit'},
				success:function(form, action) {
					var dt = action.result.data;
          sectionDs.load({params: {department_id: dt.department_id}});
					document.getElementById('dataPicPrev').src=(dt.photo_url==null)? '../img/no_image.png' : dt.photo_url;
					Ext.getCmp('transferDepartFrom').setValue(dt.department_name);
					Ext.getCmp('transferDepartTo').setValue(dt.department_id);
          Ext.getCmp('transferSectionFrom').setValue(dt.section_name);
          Ext.getCmp('transferSectionTo').setValue(dt.section_id);
					Ext.getCmp('transferDepartStart').setValue(transferDate);
					Ext.getCmp('changeStatusFrom').setValue(dt.status_name);
					Ext.getCmp('changeStatusTo').setValue(dt.status_id);
					Ext.getCmp('changeStatusStart').setValue(transferDate);
					statusId=dt.status_id;
					departmentId=dt.department_id;
          sectionId=dt.section_id;
				}
			});

			document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display='block';
			document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Employee";

      var frmEditorHeight=(document.getElementById('editorForm').clientHeight - document.getElementById('editorFormHeader').clientHeight);
      Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').setHeight(frmEditorHeight);
      Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').doLayout(); // recalc column widths now that the panel is actually visible

			Ext.getCmp('fSetDepart').hide();
			Ext.getCmp('btnTransferDept').enable();
			Ext.getCmp('fSetStatus').hide();
			Ext.getCmp('btnChangeSts').enable();

      comboDisable('department_id');
      comboDisable('status_id');
      comboDisable('section_id');

		}else{
			document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML ='not enough permission to access this window';
			document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';
		}
		task='update';
	};
	document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function(event) {
		if (formAccess==4){
			task='delete';
			var employeeName=dataRecord.employee_name;
			document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';
			document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display='block';
			document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'delete \'' + employeeName + '\'  ?';
		}else{
			document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML ='not enough permission to delete this data';
			document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';
		}
	};
	document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function(event) {window.open("../pdf/m.employee.list.php", 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');};

	document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function(event) {
    var genderValue = getRadioGroupValue(Ext.getCmp('gender'));
    var martialValue = getRadioGroupValue(Ext.getCmp('martial_status'));
		var pFile = document.getElementById('dataPicPrev').src;
		var pFileName = document.getElementById('imgfile').value==''? pFile.split('/')[pFile.split('/').length-1]:document.getElementById('imgfile').value.split('\\')[document.getElementById('imgfile').value.split('\\').length-1];
		frmEditor.getForm().submit({
			method:'POST',
			params: {task: task, photo: pFile, photoname: pFileName, martialValue: martialValue, genderValue: genderValue},
			waitTitle:'Connecting',
			waitMsg:'Sending data...',
			success:function(form,action){
				var objResponse=Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
				var messagesStatus=objResponse.status;
				var messages=objResponse.message;
				/*document.getElementById("popWdwMainHeaderText").innerHTML=messagesStatus;*/
				document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML=messages;
			  document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';

				mainDs.load({params:{task: 'read'}});
			  frmEditor.getForm().reset();
				document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display='none';
			},
			failure:function(form, action){
				var objResponse=Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
				var messagesStatus=objResponse.status;
				var messages=objResponse.message;
				/*document.getElementById("popWdwMainHeaderText").innerHTML=messagesStatus;*/
				document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML=messages;
				document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';
			}
		});
	};
	document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function(event) {
	  if (task=='delete') {
      deleteDs.load({
        params:{task: "delete", id: dataRecord.id },
				callback:function(records, operation, success){
          document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='none';
          document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display='none';
          task='';

					var textMessages=Ext.util.JSON.decode(operation.callback.caller.caller.arguments[2].responseText);
					var messagesStatus=textMessages.status;
					var messages=textMessages.message;
					/*document.getElementById("popWdwMainHeaderText").innerHTML=messagesStatus;*/
					document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML=messages;
					document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';
				}
			});
			mainDs.load();
			gridMain.getView().refresh(true);
		}
    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='none';
    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display='none';
    task='';
	};
  document.getElementById('logData').onclick = function(event) {
    document.getElementById('logWdw').style.display='block';
    var employeeName=dataRecord.employee_name;
    document.getElementById("logFormHeaderText").innerHTML = employeeName + '  [' + dataRecord.department_name + ']';
    GridHistory.setHeight(calculateDivHeight(['logForm','logFormHeader']));
    GridHistoryDs.load({params:{id:dataRecord.id}});
  };

	var myMask = new Ext.LoadMask(Ext.getBody(), {msg:"Please wait..."});
	var statusId=0, departmentId=0; sectionId=0;
  var xDate = new Date();
  var transferDate = xDate.addDays(-2);

	var deleteDs = new Ext.data.Store({url: '../php-crud/m.employeeCRD.php'});
	var departmentDs = new Ext.data.Store({
    url: '../php-crud/m.departmentCRD.php',
    baseParams:{task: 'read'},
    reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({
      root: 'data',
      totalProperty: 'totalCount',
      fields:[
        {name: 'id', type:'numeric'},
        {name: 'name', type:'string', convert : function(v, rec) {return rec.location_init + ' ~ ' + capitalizeEachWord(rec.name);}}
      ]
    })
  });
  departmentDs.load();
  var sectionDs = new Ext.data.Store({
    url: '../php-crud/m.departmentCRD.php',
    baseParams:{task: 'read_detail'},
    reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({
      root: 'data',
      totalProperty: 'totalCount',
      fields:[
        {name: 'id', type:'numeric'},
        {name: 'seq_no', type:'numeric'},
        {name: 'name', type:'string', convert : function(v, rec) {return capitalizeEachWord(rec.section_name);}}
      ]
    })
  });
  sectionDs.load();
  var statusDs = new Ext.data.Store({
    url: '../php-crud/m.employee.status.php',
    baseParams:{task: 'read'},
    reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount', fields:[{name: 'id', type:'numeric'},{name: 'name', type:'string'}]})
  });
  statusDs.load();

  var employeeField = [
    {name:'id'},
    {name:'nik'},
    {name:'employee_name'},
    {name:'address'},
    {name:'id_number'},
    {name:'id_address'},
    {name:'npwp_no'},
    {name:'bank_account_no'},
    {name:'phone_number'},
    {name:'birth_date', type:'date', dateFormat:'Y-m-d'},
    {name:'place_birth'},
    {name:'gender'},
    {name:'martial_status'},
    {name:'emergency_name'},
    {name:'emergency_phone'},
    {name:'emergency_relation'},
    {name:'emergency_address'},
    {name:'from_date', type:'date', dateFormat:'Y-m-d'},
    {name:'remark'},
    {name:'employee_department_id'},
    {name:'department_id'},
    {name:'department_name', type:'string', convert : function(v, rec) {
      //return rec.location_init + (rec.department_name==null)? '' : ' ~ ' + capitalizeEachWord(rec.department_name);
      depatName=(!rec.department_name || !rec.department_name.length)? '' : (' - ' + capitalizeEachWord(rec.department_name));
      return rec.location_init + depatName;
    }},
    {name:'employee_status_id'},
    {name:'status_id'},
    {name:'status_name'},
    {name:'employee_section_id'},
    {name:'section_id'},
    {name:'section_name'},
    {name:'photo'},
    {name:'photo_url'},
    {name:'email'}
  ];
	mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
		url: '../php-crud/m.employeeCRD.php',
		baseParams:{task: 'read'},
		reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalRecord', fields :employeeField})
	});
	mainDs.load();

  var frmEditor = new stdForm({
    url: '../php-crud/m.employeeCRD.php',
    id: 'frmEditor',
    reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({root : 'data',fields: employeeField}),
    renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
    labelAlign: 'right',
    autoScroll: 'true',
    items: [
      {items: new myTextField({name: 'id',id:'id', hidden: true})},
      {items: new myTextField({name: 'employee_department_id',id:'employee_department_id', hidden: true})},
      {items: new myTextField({name: 'employee_status_id',id:'employee_status_id', hidden: true})},
      {items: new myTextField({name: 'employee_section_id',id:'employee_section_id', hidden: true})},
      //{columnWidth: 1, xtype:'label', text:'* Personal Info', cls:'x-form-item my-label-styleBl'},
			{ columnWidth: .3, labelAlign: 'top', xtype: 'label', text: 'Personal Info', cls: 'x-form-item my-label-GroupLbl', style: 'clear:both;' },
			{ columnWidth: .7, labelAlign: 'top', items: {xtype:'label', text:'-', cls:'x-form-item my-label-styleW'} },
      {columnWidth: .15,labelAlign: 'top', style: 'clear:both;', items: new myTextField({fieldLabel:'NIK', id:'nik', name:'nik', readOnly:true})},
      {columnWidth: .35, labelAlign: 'top', items: new myTextField({fieldLabel:'Name', id:'employee_name', name:'employee_name',allowBlank: false,autoCreate:{tag: "input", maxlength : 100, type: "text", size: "100", autocomplete: "off"},listeners :{change:function(field){field.setValue(field.getValue().toUpperCase());}}})},
      {columnWidth: .5, labelAlign: 'top', items: new myTextArea({fieldLabel:'Address', height: '55', id:'address', name:'address', allowBlank: false, autoCreate : {tag: "textarea", autocomplete: "off"}})},
      {columnWidth: .16, labelAlign: 'top', style: 'clear:both;', items: {xtype:'radiogroup', labelSeparator:'&nbsp;', cls:'fieldRadioClass', fieldLabel:'Gender ', id: 'gender',items : [{cls: 'regular-radio', boxLabel: 'Male', name: 'gender',inputValue: 'M',checked: true}, {cls: 'regular-radio', boxLabel: 'Female', name: 'gender',inputValue: 'F'}]}},
      {columnWidth: .34, labelAlign: 'top', items: {
        xtype:'radiogroup', labelSeparator:'&nbsp;', cls:'fieldRadioClass', fieldLabel:'Marital',  id: 'martial_status', allowBlank: true,
        items : [
          {cls: 'regular-radio', boxLabel: 'TK',name: 'martial_status',inputValue: 'TK',checked: true},
          {cls: 'regular-radio', boxLabel: 'K0',name: 'martial_status',inputValue: 'K0'},

==================== FILE: ./js/stock.card.m.js ====================
/*
Document      : stock.card.m.js   (v2.0)
Description   : Stock Card Mobile - monitoring stok per gudang/item/periode, BISA OFFLINE.
                Vanilla JS (tanpa ExtJS). Dimuat oleh views/stock.card.m.php.
Backend       : php-crud/stock.cardCRD.php  (action: lookup_warehouses | lookup_items | card | snapshot)
Service Worker: sw.stockcard.js (root aplikasi)

Semua URL (backend, service worker, scope, versi) datang dari window.SC_CFG yang ditulis
oleh view PHP, jadi tidak ada path yang ditebak di sisi browser.

Alur offline:
  - Saat online : data selalu dari server (live).
  - Tombol "Sinkron": unduh snapshot gudang (material, saldo awal, mutasi N hari) ke IndexedDB.
  - Tanpa sinyal / timeout: kartu stok dihitung lokal dari snapshot, diberi label "DATA OFFLINE".
  - Service Worker menyimpan halaman + JS agar aplikasi terbuka tanpa sinyal (butuh HTTPS).
*/
(function () {
'use strict';

var CFG = window.SC_CFG || {};
function absUrl(u, fallback) {
    try { return new URL(u || fallback, location.href).href; } catch (e) { return new URL(fallback, location.href).href; }
}
var CRD = absUrl(CFG.crd, '../php-crud/stock.cardCRD.php');
var SW_URL = absUrl(CFG.sw, '../sw.stockcard.js');
var SW_SCOPE = absUrl(CFG.scope, '../');
var SHELL_VER = String(CFG.ver || '1');

var LS_LAST_RESULT = 'scm_last_result_cache';
var DB_NAME = 'stockCardMobile';
var DB_VERSION = 1;
var STORE_NAME = 'cache';

var warehouses = [];
var items = [];
var db = null;
var syncing = false;
var lastDiag = { url: '-', status: '-', body: '' };

// ============================================================
// 0. Helpers
// ============================================================
function noop() {}
function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
function setVal(id, val) { var el = $(id); if (el) el.value = val; }
function esc(v) { var d = document.createElement('div'); d.textContent = v == null ? '' : v; return d.innerHTML; }
function z2(n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; }
function ymd(d) { return d.getFullYear() + '-' + z2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + z2(d.getDate()); }
function todayStr() { return ymd(new Date()); }
function monthStartStr() { var d = new Date(); return d.getFullYear() + '-' + z2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-01'; }
function daysAgoStr(n) { var d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() - n); return ymd(d); }
function r4(x) { return Math.round(x * 10000) / 10000; }

function fmtQty(v) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return '-';
    return Number(v || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID', { minimumFractionDigits: 4, maximumFractionDigits: 4 });
}
function fmtShort(v) { return Number(v || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID', { maximumFractionDigits: 4 }); }
function fmtAmt(v) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return '-';
    return 'Rp ' + Number(v || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
}
function fmtDate(s) {
    if (!s) return '-';
    var m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(String(s));
    return m ? (m[3] + '/' + m[2] + '/' + m[1]) : s;
}
function fmtStamp(s) {
    var d = new Date(s);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '-';
    return z2(d.getDate()) + '/' + z2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '/' + d.getFullYear() + ' ' + z2(d.getHours()) + ':' + z2(d.getMinutes());
}
function ageHours(s) { var d = new Date(s); return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? 9999 : (Date.now() - d.getTime()) / 36e5; }
function ageText(s) {
    var h = ageHours(s);
    if (h < 1) return 'baru saja';
    if (h < 48) return Math.floor(h) + ' jam lalu';
    return Math.floor(h / 24) + ' hari lalu';
}

console.info('[StockCard.m] Backend:', CRD);

// ============================================================
// 2. IndexedDB
// ============================================================
function openDb() {
    if (db) return Promise.resolve(db);
    return new Promise(function (res, rej) {
        if (!window.indexedDB) { rej(new Error('IndexedDB tidak tersedia')); return; }
        var rq = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
        rq.onupgradeneeded = function () {
            if (!rq.result.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) rq.result.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: 'key' });
        };
        rq.onsuccess = function () { db = rq.result; res(db); };
        rq.onerror = function () { rej(rq.error); };
    });
}
function cacheGet(key) {
    return openDb().then(function (d) {
        return new Promise(function (res) {
            var rq = d.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly').objectStore(STORE_NAME).get(key);
            rq.onsuccess = function () { res(rq.result ? rq.result.value : null); };
            rq.onerror = function () { res(null); };
        });
    }).catch(function () { return null; });
}
// hapus semua key berawalan prefixes, lalu tulis records - satu transaksi (atomik)
function cacheReplace(prefixes, records) {
    return openDb().then(function (d) {
        return new Promise(function (res, rej) {
            var tx = d.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite'), os = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
            prefixes.forEach(function (p) { os.delete(IDBKeyRange.bound(p, p + '\uffff')); });
            records.forEach(function (r) { os.put({ key: r.key, value: r.value, ts: Date.now() }); });
            tx.oncomplete = function () { res(); };
            tx.onerror = tx.onabort = function () { rej(tx.error || new Error('Gagal menyimpan ke penyimpanan HP')); };
        });
    });
}
function cachePut(key, value) { return cacheReplace([], [{ key: key, value: value }]); }
function cacheList(prefix) {
    return openDb().then(function (d) {
        return new Promise(function (res) {
            var out = [], rq = d.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly').objectStore(STORE_NAME)
                .openCursor(IDBKeyRange.bound(prefix, prefix + '\uffff'));
            rq.onsuccess = function () {
                var c = rq.result;
                if (c) { out.push(c.value.value); c.continue(); } else res(out);
            };
            rq.onerror = function () { res(out); };
        });
    }).catch(function () { return []; });
}

// ============================================================
// 3. API
// ============================================================
function isNetFail(e) { return !!(e && (e.offline || (e.http && e.http >= 500))); }

function api(params, opt) {
    opt = opt || {};
    var p = {}, k;
    for (k in params) { if (params.hasOwnProperty(k)) p[k] = params[k]; }
    p._ = Date.now(); // anti-cache
    var url = CRD + '?' + Object.keys(p).map(function (key) {
        return encodeURIComponent(key) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(p[key]);
    }).join('&');
    lastDiag = { url: url, status: '(menunggu respons)', body: '' };

    if (navigator.onLine === false) {
        lastDiag.status = 'perangkat offline';
        renderDiag();
        return Promise.reject({ offline: true, message: 'Tidak ada koneksi internet.' });
    }

    var ctl = (typeof AbortController !== 'undefined') ? new AbortController() : null;
    var timedOut = false;
    var timer = setTimeout(function () { timedOut = true; if (ctl) ctl.abort(); }, opt.timeout || 20000);

    return fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store', headers: { 'ngrok-skip-browser-warning': '1' }, signal: ctl ? ctl.signal : undefined })
        .then(function (r) {
            lastDiag.status = r.status + ' ' + r.statusText;
            return r.text().then(function (txt) {
                clearTimeout(timer);
                lastDiag.body = txt.substring(0, 300);
                if (r.status === 401 || r.status === 403) {
                    return Promise.reject({ auth: true, message: 'Sesi berakhir. Buka ulang halaman & login.' });
                }
                var json = null;
                try { json = JSON.parse(txt); } catch (e) {}
                if (json && typeof json === 'object') return json;
                if (!r.ok) return Promise.reject({ http: r.status, message: 'Server error (' + r.status + ').' });
                return Promise.reject({ notJson: true,
                    message: 'Respons server bukan JSON (sesi login habis atau URL backend salah). Lihat "Diagnostik koneksi".' });
            });
        })
        .catch(function (e) {
            clearTimeout(timer);
            if (e && (e.auth || e.http || e.notJson)) return Promise.reject(e);
            lastDiag.status = timedOut ? 'timeout' : 'gagal terhubung (' + ((e && e.message) || e) + ')';
            return Promise.reject({ offline: true, timeout: timedOut,
                message: timedOut ? 'Server tidak merespons (sinyal lemah).' :
                    'Tidak bisa terhubung ke server. Lihat "Diagnostik koneksi".' });
        })
        .then(function (r) { renderDiag(); return r; }, function (e) { renderDiag(); return Promise.reject(e); });
}

function showMsg(t, type) {
    var m = $('msg');
    if (!m) { console.log('[' + type + ']', t); return; }
    m.textContent = t;
    m.className = 'msg ' + (type || '');
    if (type === 'ok') setTimeout(function () { m.className = 'msg hidden'; }, 5000);
}
function hideMsg() { var m = $('msg'); if (m) m.className = 'msg hidden'; }

function updateNet() {
    var p = $('pillNet');
    if (p) { p.textContent = navigator.onLine ? 'online' : 'offline'; p.className = 'pill' + (navigator.onLine ? '' : ' off'); }
}

function renderDiag() {
    var el = $('diagText');
    if (!el) return;
    el.textContent =
        'Halaman      : ' + location.href + '\n' +
        'Backend      : ' + CRD + '\n' +
        'File JS      : ' + (CFG.js || '-') + '\n' +
        'Service Worker: ' + SW_URL + '\n' +
        'HTTPS/aman   : ' + (window.isSecureContext ? 'ya' : 'TIDAK (offline app tidak bisa aktif)') + '\n' +
        'navigator.onLine : ' + navigator.onLine + '\n' +
        'Request akhir: ' + lastDiag.url + '\n' +
        'Status       : ' + lastDiag.status + '\n' +
        'Respons      : ' + (lastDiag.body || '-');
}

// ============================================================
// 4. Gudang & Material
// ============================================================
function offlineWarehouses() {
    return cacheList('snapmeta_').then(function (metas) {
        return metas.map(function (m) { return { id: m.wid, name: m.warehouse_name }; })
            .sort(function (a, b) { return a.name < b.name ? -1 : 1; });
    });
}

function loadWarehouses() {
    return api({ action: 'lookup_warehouses' }, { timeout: 15000 }).then(function (res) {
        if (!res || !res.success) {
            showMsg((res && res.message) || 'Gagal memuat gudang.', 'err');
            warehouses = [];
            renderWarehouses();
            return;
        }
        // "Semua Gudang" (id 0) tidak dipakai di mobile: gudang wajib dipilih
        warehouses = (res.data || []).filter(function (w) { return parseInt(w.id, 10) > 0; });
        renderWarehouses();
    }, function (e) {
        if (isNetFail(e)) {
            return offlineWarehouses().then(function (list) {
                warehouses = list;
                renderWarehouses();
                if (list.length) showMsg('Tidak terhubung ke server. Menampilkan gudang yang sudah disinkronkan untuk offline.', 'ok');
                else showMsg(e.message + ' Belum ada data offline - sinkronkan dulu saat ada sinyal.', 'err');
            });
        }
        warehouses = [];
        renderWarehouses();
        showMsg(e.message || 'Gagal memuat gudang.', 'err');
    });
}

function filterLocal(list, q) {
    q = (q || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return list;
    return list.filter(function (it) {
        return String(it.material_name || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0 ||
               String(it.material_code || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0;
    });
}

function itemsFromSnapshot(wid, q, netErr) {
    return cacheGet('snapmeta_' + wid).then(function (meta) {
        if (!meta) {
            if (!items.length) showMsg((netErr && netErr.message || 'Tidak ada koneksi.') + ' Gudang ini belum disinkronkan untuk offline.', 'err');
            return;
        }
        items = filterLocal(meta.items || [], q);
        renderItems();
        showMsg('Offline: daftar material dari data tersimpan (' + fmtStamp(meta.generated_at) + ').', 'ok');
    });
}

function loadItems(wid, q) {
    q = q || '';
    if (!wid || wid <= 0) { items = []; renderItems(); return Promise.resolve(); }
    var key = 'items_wh_' + wid;
    var pre = q === '' ? cacheGet(key) : Promise.resolve(null);
    return pre.then(function (cached) {
        if (cached && cached.length) { items = cached; renderItems(); }
        return api({ action: 'lookup_items', warehouse_id: wid, query: q }, { timeout: 15000 });
    }).then(function (res) {
        if (!res || !res.success) { showMsg((res && res.message) || 'Gagal memuat material.', 'err'); return; }
        items = res.data || [];
        if (q === '') cachePut(key, items).catch(noop);
        renderItems();
    }, function (e) {
        if (isNetFail(e)) return itemsFromSnapshot(wid, q, e);
        showMsg(e.message || 'Gagal memuat material.', 'err');
    });
}

// ============================================================
// 5. Render
// ============================================================
function renderWarehouses() {
    var sel = $('fWh');
    if (!sel) return;
    var cur = sel.value;
    var h = '<option value="0">' + (warehouses.length ? '-- Pilih Gudang --' : '-- Tidak ada gudang tersedia --') + '</option>';
    warehouses.forEach(function (w) { h += '<option value="' + esc(w.id) + '">' + esc(w.name) + '</option>'; });
    sel.innerHTML = h;
    if (cur && warehouses.some(function (w) { return String(w.id) === cur; })) sel.value = cur;
}

function renderItems() {
    var sel = $('fItem');
    if (!sel) return;
    var cur = sel.value;
    var h = '<option value="">-- Pilih Material' + (items.length ? ' (' + items.length + ')' : '') + ' --</option>';
    items.forEach(function (it) {
        var stock = Number(it.qty_on_hand) > 0 ? ' [Stok: ' + fmtShort(it.qty_on_hand) + ']' : '';
        h += '<option value="' + esc(it.item_id) + '">' +
             esc((it.material_code ? it.material_code + ' - ' : '') + it.material_name) + ' (' + esc(it.unit) + ')' + stock + '</option>';
    });
    sel.innerHTML = h;
    if (cur && items.some(function (it) { return String(it.item_id) === cur; })) sel.value = cur;
}

function renderResult(data, note) {
    var box = $('resultBox');
    if (!box) return;
    if (!data || !data.success) {
        box.innerHTML = '<div class="card err">' + esc((data && data.message) || 'Tidak ada data.') + '</div>';
        return;
    }
    var rows = data.data || [];
    var summary = data.summary || {};
    var html = '';

    if (note) {
        html += '<div class="card" style="border-left:4px solid #d9822b;font-size:13px;">📴 ' + esc(note) + '</div>';
    }

    html += '<div class="summary-grid">';
    html += '<div class="sum-card"><div class="sum-lbl">Saldo Awal</div><div class="sum-val">' + fmtQty(summary.opening) + '</div></div>';
    html += '<div class="sum-card in"><div class="sum-lbl">Total Masuk</div><div class="sum-val">' + fmtQty(summary.total_in) + '</div></div>';
    html += '<div class="sum-card out"><div class="sum-lbl">Total Keluar</div><div class="sum-val">' + fmtQty(summary.total_out) + '</div></div>';
    html += '<div class="sum-card end"><div class="sum-lbl">Saldo Akhir</div><div class="sum-val">' + fmtQty(summary.ending) + '</div></div>';
    html += '</div>';

    var movCount = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.row_type !== 'OPEN'; }).length;
    if (!movCount) html += '<div class="card">Tidak ada mutasi pada periode ini.</div>';
    html += '<div class="section-title">Rincian Mutasi (' + movCount + ' transaksi)</div>';

    rows.forEach(function (r) {
        var isOpen = r.row_type === 'OPEN';
        var isIn = !isOpen && r.qty_in !== null && r.qty_in !== undefined;
        html += '<div class="tx-card ' + (isOpen ? 'open' : (isIn ? 'in' : 'out')) + '">' +
            '<div class="tx-head"><span class="tx-date">' + fmtDate(r.movement_date) + '</span>' +
            '<span class="tx-type">' + (isOpen ? '📋 Saldo Awal' : (isIn ? '📥 Masuk' : '📤 Keluar')) + '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="tx-body">' +
            '<div class="tx-row"><span class="tx-lbl">Jenis:</span><span>' + (r.reference_type ? esc(r.reference_type) : '-') + '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="tx-row"><span class="tx-lbl">No. Dokumen:</span><span>' + (r.reference_no ? esc(r.reference_no) : '-') + '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="tx-row"><span class="tx-lbl">Gudang:</span><span>' + (r.warehouse_name ? esc(r.warehouse_name) : '-') + '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="tx-row"><span class="tx-lbl">Keterangan:</span><span>' + (r.remark ? esc(r.remark) : '-') + '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="tx-row"><span class="tx-lbl">Masuk:</span><span class="tx-in">' + (r.qty_in !== null && r.qty_in !== undefined ? fmtQty(r.qty_in) : '-') + '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="tx-row"><span class="tx-lbl">Keluar:</span><span class="tx-out">' + (r.qty_out !== null && r.qty_out !== undefined ? fmtQty(r.qty_out) : '-') + '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="tx-row"><span class="tx-lbl">Saldo:</span><span class="tx-bal"><b>' + fmtQty(r.balance) + '</b></span></div>' +
            '<div class="tx-row"><span class="tx-lbl">Biaya Satuan:</span><span>' + (r.unit_cost !== null && r.unit_cost !== undefined ? fmtAmt(r.unit_cost) : '-') + '</span></div>' +
            '</div></div>';
    });

    box.innerHTML = html;
}

function saveLast(data) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(LS_LAST_RESULT, JSON.stringify({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), data: data })); } catch (e) {}
}

// ============================================================
// 6. Kartu Stok (online -> server, gagal/timeout -> hitung dari snapshot)
// ============================================================
function buildCard(it, mvs, from, to, whName) {
    var opening = Number(it.opening) || 0, i, m, d, q, isIn;
    for (i = 0; i < mvs.length; i++) {
        m = mvs[i]; d = String(m.movement_date).substr(0, 10);
        if (d >= from) break;
        q = Number(m.qty) || 0;
        opening = r4(opening + (m.movement_type === 'IN' ? q : -q));
    }
    var bal = opening, totIn = 0, totOut = 0;
    var data = [{ row_type: 'OPEN', movement_date: from, reference_type: '', reference_no: '', warehouse_name: '',
                  remark: 'Saldo Awal', qty_in: null, qty_out: null, unit_cost: null, balance: opening }];
    for (; i < mvs.length; i++) {
        m = mvs[i]; d = String(m.movement_date).substr(0, 10);
        if (d > to) break;
        q = Number(m.qty) || 0;
        isIn = m.movement_type === 'IN';
        bal = r4(bal + (isIn ? q : -q));
        if (isIn) totIn += q; else totOut += q;
        data.push({ row_type: 'MOV', movement_date: m.movement_date, reference_type: m.reference_type,
                    reference_no: m.reference_no, warehouse_name: whName, remark: m.remark,
                    qty_in: isIn ? q : null, qty_out: isIn ? null : q, unit_cost: Number(m.unit_cost) || 0, balance: bal });
    }
    return { success: true, totalCount: data.length, data: data,
             summary: { opening: opening, total_in: r4(totIn), total_out: r4(totOut), ending: bal } };
}

function offlineCard(wid, itemId, from, to, netErr) {
    return cacheGet('snapmeta_' + wid).then(function (meta) {
        var why = (netErr && netErr.message) || 'Tidak ada koneksi.';
        if (!meta) {
            showMsg(why + ' Data offline gudang ini belum disinkronkan. Tekan "Sinkron" saat ada sinyal.', 'err');
            return;
        }
        if (from < meta.date_from) {
            showMsg('Data offline gudang ini hanya mulai ' + fmtDate(meta.date_from) +
                    '. Ubah tanggal "Dari" atau sinkron ulang dengan rentang lebih panjang.', 'err');
            return;
        }
        var it = null;
        (meta.items || []).forEach(function (x) { if (parseInt(x.item_id, 10) === itemId) it = x; });
        if (!it) { showMsg('Material ini tidak ada di data offline gudang tersebut.', 'err'); return; }
        return cacheGet('snapitem_' + wid + '_' + itemId).then(function (mvs) {
            var res = buildCard(it, mvs || [], from, to, meta.warehouse_name);
            renderResult(res, 'DATA OFFLINE - disinkronkan ' + fmtStamp(meta.generated_at) + ' (' + ageText(meta.generated_at) +
                '). Transaksi setelah waktu itu belum termasuk.' + (ageHours(meta.generated_at) > 24 ? ' Data sudah lebih dari 1 hari.' : ''));
        });
    });
}

function loadCard() {
    var wid = parseInt($('fWh').value, 10) || 0;
    var itemId = parseInt($('fItem').value, 10) || 0;
    var dateFrom = $('fFrom').value;
    var dateTo = $('fTo').value;

    if (!wid) { showMsg('Pilih gudang terlebih dahulu.', 'err'); return; }
    if (!itemId) { showMsg('Pilih material terlebih dahulu.', 'err'); return; }
    if (!dateFrom || !dateTo) { showMsg('Periode tanggal wajib diisi.', 'err'); return; }
    if (dateFrom > dateTo) { showMsg('Tanggal awal tidak boleh melebihi tanggal akhir.', 'err'); return; }

    var btn = $('btnLoad');
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Memuat...';
    hideMsg();

    api({ action: 'card', item_id: itemId, warehouse_id: wid, date_from: dateFrom, date_to: dateTo }, { timeout: 20000 })
        .then(function (res) {
            renderResult(res, null);
            if (res && res.success) saveLast(res);
        }, function (e) {
            if (isNetFail(e)) return offlineCard(wid, itemId, dateFrom, dateTo, e);
            showMsg((e && e.message) || 'Gagal memuat data.', 'err');
        })
        .then(function () { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Tampilkan'; });
}

// ============================================================
// 7. Sinkron offline
// ============================================================
function syncOne(w, days) {
    return api({ action: 'snapshot', warehouse_id: w.id, date_from: daysAgoStr(days) }, { timeout: 120000 }).then(function (res) {
        if (!res || !res.success) return Promise.reject({ message: (res && res.message) || 'Gagal sinkron.' });
        var byItem = {};
        (res.movements || []).forEach(function (m) {
            (byItem[m.item_id] || (byItem[m.item_id] = [])).push({
                id: m.id, movement_date: m.movement_date, movement_type: m.movement_type, qty: m.qty, unit_cost: m.unit_cost,
                reference_type: m.reference_type, reference_no: m.reference_no, remark: m.remark });
        });
        var recs = [{ key: 'snapmeta_' + w.id, value: {
            wid: parseInt(w.id, 10), warehouse_name: res.warehouse_name, date_from: res.date_from,
            generated_at: res.generated_at, items: res.items || [], rows: (res.movements || []).length } }];
        (res.items || []).forEach(function (it) {
            recs.push({ key: 'snapitem_' + w.id + '_' + it.item_id, value: byItem[it.item_id] || [] });
        });
        return cacheReplace(['snapitem_' + w.id + '_'], recs);
    });
}

function setProgress(t) { var el = $('syncProgress'); if (el) el.textContent = t || ''; }
function setSyncButtons(disabled) {
    ['btnSyncOne', 'btnSyncAll', 'btnClearOffline'].forEach(function (id) {
        var b = $(id); if (b) { b.disabled = disabled; b.style.opacity = disabled ? '.5' : '1'; }
    });
}

function runSync(list) {
    if (syncing) return;
    if (!list.length) { showMsg('Tidak ada gudang untuk disinkronkan.', 'err'); return; }
    if (!navigator.onLine) { showMsg('Sinkron butuh koneksi internet.', 'err'); return; }
    syncing = true; setSyncButtons(true);
    try { if (navigator.storage && navigator.storage.persist) navigator.storage.persist(); } catch (e) {}
    var days = parseInt($('fSyncDays').value, 10) || 90, ok = 0, fail = [];
    var chain = Promise.resolve();
    list.forEach(function (w, i) {
        chain = chain.then(function () {
            setProgress('Sinkron ' + (i + 1) + '/' + list.length + ': ' + w.name + ' ...');
            return syncOne(w, days).then(function () { ok++; }, function (e) {
                var why = (e && e.name === 'QuotaExceededError') ? 'penyimpanan HP penuh' : ((e && e.message) || 'gagal');
                fail.push(w.name + ' (' + why + ')');
            });
        });
    });
    chain.then(function () {
        syncing = false; setSyncButtons(false);
        setProgress('');
        refreshSyncList();
        if (fail.length) showMsg('Sinkron ' + ok + ' gudang berhasil. Gagal: ' + fail.join('; '), 'err');
        else showMsg('Sinkron selesai: ' + ok + ' gudang siap dipakai offline.', 'ok');
        // sesudah sinkron, segarkan daftar material gudang yang sedang dipilih
        var wid = parseInt(($('fWh') || {}).value, 10) || 0;
        if (wid) loadItems(wid, '');
    });
}

function refreshSyncList() {
    var el = $('syncList');
    if (!el) return;
    cacheList('snapmeta_').then(function (metas) {
        if (!metas.length) { el.innerHTML = '<i>Belum ada data offline. Sinkronkan saat ada sinyal.</i>'; return; }
        metas.sort(function (a, b) { return a.warehouse_name < b.warehouse_name ? -1 : 1; });
        el.innerHTML = metas.map(function (m) {
            var stale = ageHours(m.generated_at) > 24;
            return '• <b>' + esc(m.warehouse_name) + '</b>: ' + (m.items || []).length + ' material, ' + m.rows + ' mutasi sejak ' +
                   fmtDate(m.date_from) + '<br/>&nbsp;&nbsp;disinkronkan ' + fmtStamp(m.generated_at) + ' (' + ageText(m.generated_at) + ')' +
                   (stale ? ' <span style="color:#d9822b;">⚠ usang</span>' : '');
        }).join('<br/>');
    });
}

function clearOffline() {
    if (!confirm('Hapus semua data offline di HP ini? Anda harus sinkron lagi untuk memakai mode offline.')) return;
    cacheReplace(['snapmeta_', 'snapitem_', 'items_wh_', 'wh_list'], []).then(function () {
        try { localStorage.removeItem(LS_LAST_RESULT); } catch (e) {}
        var box = $('resultBox'); if (box) box.innerHTML = '';
        refreshSyncList();
        showMsg('Data offline dihapus.', 'ok');
    }, function () { showMsg('Gagal menghapus data offline.', 'err'); });
}

var BTN = 'padding:9px 12px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:#2e6da4;color:#fff;font-weight:bold;';

function buildSearchBox() {
    var sel = $('fItem');
    if (!sel || !sel.parentNode) return;
    var inp = document.createElement('input');
    inp.type = 'search'; inp.id = 'fItemQ'; inp.placeholder = 'Cari kode / nama material...';
    inp.autocomplete = 'off';
    inp.style.cssText = 'width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:9px;margin-bottom:6px;';
    sel.parentNode.insertBefore(inp, sel);
    var t = null;
    inp.addEventListener('input', function () {
        clearTimeout(t);
        t = setTimeout(function () {
            var wid = parseInt($('fWh').value, 10) || 0;
            if (wid) loadItems(wid, inp.value.trim());
        }, 350);
    });
}

function buildOfflinePanel() {
    var box = $('resultBox');
    if (!box || !box.parentNode) return;
    var p = document.createElement('div');
    p.id = 'offlinePanel'; p.className = 'card';
    p.innerHTML =
        '<div style="font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:6px;">📴 Mode Offline</div>' +
        '<div id="swStatus" style="font-size:12px;margin-bottom:8px;">Memeriksa...</div>' +
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;">' +
        '<select id="fSyncDays" style="padding:9px;"><option value="30">30 hari</option><option value="90" selected>90 hari</option><option value="180">180 hari</option></select>' +
        '<button id="btnSyncOne" type="button" style="' + BTN + '">Sinkron gudang ini</button>' +
        '<button id="btnSyncAll" type="button" style="' + BTN + '">Sinkron semua</button>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="syncProgress" style="font-size:12px;margin:6px 0;"></div>' +
        '<div id="syncList" style="font-size:12px;margin:6px 0;"></div>' +
        '<button id="btnClearOffline" type="button" style="' + BTN + 'background:#a33;">Hapus data offline</button>' +
        '<details style="margin-top:8px;font-size:11px;"><summary>Diagnostik koneksi</summary>' +
        '<pre id="diagText" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all;"></pre></details>';
    box.parentNode.insertBefore(p, box);

    $('btnSyncOne').addEventListener('click', function () {
        var wid = parseInt($('fWh').value, 10) || 0;
        var w = null;
        warehouses.forEach(function (x) { if (parseInt(x.id, 10) === wid) w = x; });
        if (!w) { showMsg('Pilih gudang dulu, atau pakai "Sinkron semua".', 'err'); return; }
        runSync([w]);
    });
    $('btnSyncAll').addEventListener('click', function () { runSync(warehouses.slice()); });
    $('btnClearOffline').addEventListener('click', clearOffline);
    refreshSyncList();
    renderDiag();
}

// ============================================================
// 9. Service Worker (aplikasi bisa dibuka tanpa sinyal)
// ============================================================
function setupServiceWorker() {
    var el = $('swStatus');
    function st(t, good) { if (el) { el.textContent = t; el.style.color = good ? '#2e9e4f' : '#d9822b'; } }

    if (!window.isSecureContext) {
        st('Halaman ini belum bisa dibuka tanpa sinyal karena diakses lewat ' + location.protocol + '//' + location.host +
           ' (butuh HTTPS). Data offline tetap bisa disinkronkan & dipakai selama halaman masih terbuka.', false);
        return;
    }
    if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) { st('Browser ini tidak mendukung Service Worker.', false); return; }

    navigator.serviceWorker.register(SW_URL, { scope: SW_SCOPE }).then(function () {
        return navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
    }).then(function (reg) {
        var done = false;
        try { done = localStorage.getItem('sc_shell_ok') === SHELL_VER; } catch (e) {}
        if (done || !navigator.onLine) { st('Aplikasi siap dibuka tanpa sinyal.', true); return; }

        var urls = [location.href];
        try {
            performance.getEntriesByType('resource').forEach(function (r) {
                try {
                    var u = new URL(r.name);
                    if (u.origin === location.origin && u.pathname.indexOf('/php-crud/') < 0 && urls.indexOf(r.name) < 0) urls.push(r.name);
                } catch (e) {}
            });
        } catch (e) {}
        st('Menyimpan halaman untuk mode offline...', false);
        var ch = new MessageChannel();
        ch.port1.onmessage = function (ev) {
            if (ev.data && ev.data.ok) {
                try { localStorage.setItem('sc_shell_ok', SHELL_VER); } catch (e) {}
                st('Aplikasi siap dibuka tanpa sinyal (' + ev.data.cached + ' file tersimpan).', true);
            } else st('Gagal menyimpan halaman untuk offline. Muat ulang saat online.', false);
        };
        reg.active.postMessage({ type: 'precache', urls: urls }, [ch.port2]);
    }).catch(function (e) {
        st('Service Worker gagal aktif: ' + ((e && e.message) || e) +
           ' - pastikan ' + SW_URL + ' bisa dibuka di browser dan bertipe JavaScript.', false);
    });
}

// ============================================================
// 10. Init
// ============================================================
function init() {
    buildSearchBox();
    buildOfflinePanel();
    updateNet();
    window.addEventListener('online', function () { updateNet(); loadWarehouses(); });
    window.addEventListener('offline', updateNet);

    setVal('fFrom', monthStartStr());
    setVal('fTo', todayStr());

    var fWh = $('fWh');
    if (fWh) {
        fWh.addEventListener('change', function () {
            var wid = parseInt(this.value, 10) || 0;
            setVal('fItemQ', '');
            setVal('fItem', '');
            items = [];
            renderItems();
            if (wid > 0) loadItems(wid, '');
        });
        loadWarehouses();
    } else {
        showMsg('Error: dropdown gudang (#fWh) tidak ditemukan. Refresh halaman.', 'err');
    }

    var btnLoad = $('btnLoad');
    if (btnLoad) btnLoad.addEventListener('click', loadCard);

    // hasil terakhir (dari penyimpanan perangkat)
    try {
        var c = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_LAST_RESULT) || 'null');
        if (c && c.success !== undefined) c = { ts: null, data: c }; // format lama
        if (c && c.data) renderResult(c.data, 'Hasil terakhir' + (c.ts ? ' (' + fmtStamp(c.ts) + ')' : '') + ' dari penyimpanan perangkat. Tekan "Tampilkan" untuk data terbaru.');
    } catch (e) {}

    setupServiceWorker();
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
else init();
})();

            '   cursor: pointer !important;' +
            '   transition: all 0.2s ease !important;' +
            '}' +
            '.btn-act-icon svg { display: block; }' +
            '.btn-verify { background-color: #03615e !important; color: #ffffff !important; }' +
            '.btn-verify:hover { background-color: #048a86 !important; transform: scale(1.08); }' +

            '.btn-cancel:hover { background-color: #718096 !important; transform: scale(1.08); }';
        document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0].appendChild(st);
    })();

    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Progress <em>Proyek</em>";

    var APP_BASE_URL = window.APP_BASE_URL || '/';
  var CRD = APP_BASE_URL + 'php-crud/project.progressCRD.php';
    var ACCESS_REPORT = 2;      // lapor / batalkan klaim
    var ACCESS_VERIFY = 3;      // verifikasi / tolak
    var dataRecord = null;      // baris proyek terpilih
    var currentUserId = 0;      // dari list_log (untuk aturan pelapor != pemverifikasi)
    var allowSelfVerify = false; // dari list_log: bila true, pelapor boleh memverifikasi klaimnya sendiri (uji coba)
    var thresholds = { yellow: 0.9, red: 0.8 };

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }
    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function ymd(d) {
        var m = d.getMonth() + 1, dd = d.getDate();
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : m) + '-' + (dd < 10 ? '0' + dd : dd);
    }
    function fmtAmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    function fmtCpi(v) { return (v === null || v === undefined) ? '-' : Ext.util.Format.number(v, '0.00'); }

    function ajax(params, onOk, onFail) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD, method: 'POST', params: params,
            success: function (response) {
                var res;
                try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); }
                catch (e) { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Respons server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).'); return; }
                onOk(res);
            },
            failure: function () { if (onFail) onFail(); else Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.'); }
        });
    }

    function normalizeProofUrl(url) {
        var value = String(url || '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
        if (!value) { return ''; }

        // URL lama dari lokasi aplikasi sebelumnya.
        // Hanya path bukti progress yang dinormalisasi.
        var match = value.match(/^\/(?:proyek|rab-project)\/uploads\/progress\/(.+)$/i)
                 || value.match(/^\/uploads\/progress\/(.+)$/i);

        if (match) {
            var base = String(APP_BASE_URL || '/');
            if (base.charAt(base.length - 1) !== '/') {
                base += '/';
            }
            return base + 'uploads/progress/' + match[1];
        }

        return value;
    }

    function proofLinks(v) {
        if (!v) { return '-'; }
        var out = [], parts = String(v).split(/\r?\n/);
        for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            var u = parts[i].replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
            if (!u) { continue; }

            var href = normalizeProofUrl(u);

            if (!/^(https?:\/\/|\/)/i.test(href)) {
                out.push(enc(href));
                continue;
            }

            var label = /\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp)(\?.*)?$/i.test(href) ? 'Foto' : (/\.pdf(\?.*)?$/i.test(href) ? 'PDF' : 'Link');
            out.push('<a href="' + enc(href) + '" target="_blank" style="color:#7fe0a0;">' + label + ' ' + (out.length + 1) + '</a>');
        }
        return out.length ? out.join(' &nbsp;|&nbsp; ') : '-';
    }

    function cpiColor(st) {
        switch (st) {
            case 'OK': return '#00ff4c !important';
            case 'KUNING': return '#e6a817 !important';
            case 'MERAH': return '#ff4d3d !important';
        }
        return '#999999 !important';
    }
    function claimColor(st) {
        switch (st) {
            case 'Diajukan': return '#e6a817 !important';
            case 'Diverifikasi': return '#00ff4c !important';
            case 'Ditolak': return '#ff4d3d !important';
        }
        return '#999999 !important';
    }

    function loadDetail(projectId) {
        ajax({ task: 'list_log', project_id: projectId }, function (res) {
            if (!res.success) {
                dtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow; padding:10px;">' + enc(res.message || 'Gagal memuat riwayat klaim.') + '</div>';
                dtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            currentUserId = res.user_id || 0;
            allowSelfVerify = !!res.allow_self_verify;
            renderDetail(res.data || []);
        }, function () {
            dtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red; padding:10px;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
            dtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
        });
    }

    function renderDetail(rows) {
        var d = dataRecord;
        if (!d) { dtlDiv.style.display = 'none'; return; }
        var noBudget = !(d.budget_base > 0);
        var canReport = getFormAccess() >= ACCESS_REPORT && (d.status === 'Berjalan' || d.status === 'Tertunda');

            (canReport
                ? '<button type="button" id="pgReportBtn" style="padding:6px 16px; background:#03615e; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold;">+ Lapor Progress</button>'
                : '<span style="color:#668894; font-size:11px;">' + (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_REPORT ? 'Anda tidak memiliki akses melapor progress.' : 'Proyek berstatus ' + enc(d.status) + ': progress tidak dapat dilaporkan.') + '</span>') +
            '</div>';
        
        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Progress: ' + enc(d.name) + ' <span style="color:' + cpiColor(d.cpi_status) + ';">(' + enc(d.cpi_status) + ')</span></h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' + reportBar +
                   '<div style="padding:6px 10px; margin:0 2px 10px 2px; background:#1f2d3a; border-radius:4px; line-height:1.7;">' +
                   (noBudget
                       ? '<span style="color:#ff6b5e;">Budget proyek belum diisi di Master Proyek - indeks biaya tidak dapat dihitung.</span><br>'
                       : 'Budget (setara): <b>' + fmtAmt(d.budget_base) + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Progress terverifikasi: <b>' + d.progress + '%</b>' +
                         ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Nilai hasil: <b>' + fmtAmt(d.earned_value) + '</b><br>') +
                   'Biaya aktual: <b>' + fmtAmt(d.cost_actual) + '</b> (material ' + fmtAmt(d.cost_material) + ' + lain ' + fmtAmt(d.cost_other) + ')' +
                   (d.cost_pct !== null ? ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Biaya / Budget: <b>' + fmtAmt(d.cost_pct) + '%</b>' : '') +
                   ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; <span style="color:' + cpiColor(d.cpi_status) + ';">Indeks biaya: <b>' + fmtCpi(d.cpi) + '</b></span>' +
                   '<br><span style="color:#668894; font-size:11px;">Indeks biaya = nilai hasil / biaya aktual. Di bawah ' + fmtCpi(thresholds.yellow) +
                   ' kuning, di bawah ' + fmtCpi(thresholds.red) + ' merah (biaya melaju lebih cepat dari pekerjaan).</span></div>' +
                   '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0"><thead><tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Tanggal</th><th align="right">Klaim</th><th align="left">Pelapor</th><th align="left">Bukti</th>' +
                   '<th align="left">Catatan</th><th align="center">Status</th><th align="left">Verifikasi</th><th align="center">Aksi</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
        
        if (!rows.length) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="8" style="padding:15px; text-align:center; color:#557982;">Belum ada klaim progress. Klik "+ Lapor Progress" untuk mengajukan; verifikasi dilakukan pengguna lain (akses level 3).</td></tr>';
        }

        // SVG Icons untuk tombol aksi
        var iconCheck = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"></polyline></svg>';
        var iconCross = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line></svg>';
        var iconBan   = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><line x1="4.93" y1="4.93" x2="19.07" y2="19.07"></line></svg>';

        Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
            var acts = '';
            if (r.status === 'Diajukan') {
                var btnList = [];
                if (getFormAccess() >= ACCESS_VERIFY && (allowSelfVerify || r.reported_by !== currentUserId)) {
                    btnList.push('<button type="button" class="pgAct btn-act-icon btn-verify" data-act="verify" data-id="' + r.id + '" title="Verifikasi Progress">' + iconCheck + '</button>');
                    btnList.push('<button type="button" class="pgAct btn-act-icon btn-reject" data-act="reject" data-id="' + r.id + '" title="Tolak Klaim">' + iconCross + '</button>');
                } else if (r.reported_by === currentUserId) {
                    acts += '<span style="color:#e6a817; font-size:11px;">Anda pelapor: verifikasi oleh pengguna lain</span> ';
                } else if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_VERIFY) {
                    acts += '<span style="color:#668894; font-size:11px;">menunggu verifikator</span> ';
                }
                
                if (getFormAccess() >= ACCESS_REPORT && (r.reported_by === currentUserId || getFormAccess() >= ACCESS_VERIFY)) {
                    btnList.push('<button type="button" class="pgAct btn-act-icon btn-cancel" data-act="cancel" data-id="' + r.id + '" title="Batalkan Klaim">' + iconBan + '</button>');
                }

                if (btnList.length > 0) {
                    acts = '<div style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:4px; white-space:nowrap;">' + btnList.join('') + '</div>';
                }
            }

            var ver = r.verified_at ? enc(r.verifier_name || '-') + '<br><span style="color:#668894; font-size:11px;">' + enc(String(r.verified_at).substr(0, 16)) + '</span>' : '-';
            if (r.verify_note) ver += '<br><span style="font-size:11px;">' + enc(r.verify_note) + '</span>';
            if (r.snap_cpi !== null && r.snap_cpi !== undefined) ver += '<br><span style="color:#9fc3d1; font-size:11px;">indeks saat verifikasi ' + fmtCpi(r.snap_cpi) + '</span>';
            
            html += '<tr class="data-row">' +
                    '<td align="left">' + enc(r.report_date) + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right"><b>' + r.percent_claimed + '%</b> <span style="color:#668894;">(dari ' + r.prev_percent + '%)</span></td>' +
                    '<td align="left">' + enc(r.reporter_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="left">' + proofLinks(r.evidence_ref) + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="left">' + enc(r.note || '') + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="center" style="color:' + claimColor(r.status) + ';font-weight:bold;">' + enc(r.status) + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="left">' + ver + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="center" style="white-space:nowrap;">' + acts + '</td></tr>';
        });
        html += '</tbody></table>';
        dtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        dtlDiv.style.display = 'block';

        var rb = document.getElementById('pgReportBtn');
        if (rb) { rb.onclick = function () { openClaimWindow(dataRecord); }; }

        var btns = dtlDiv.querySelectorAll('.pgAct');
        for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) {
            btns[i].onclick = function () {
                var id = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-id'), 10), act = this.getAttribute('data-act');
                var claim = null;
                Ext.each(rows, function (r) { if (r.id === id) { claim = r; } });
                if (claim) doAction(act, claim);
            };
        }
    }

        url: CRD,

        listeners: {
            load: function (store) {

                if (t) { thresholds = t; }
            },
            exception: function (proxy, type, action, options, response) {
                var msg = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
                try { var r = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); if (r && r.message) msg = r.message; }
                catch (e) { msg += ' (respons bukan JSON, cek error_log PHP)'; }
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', msg);
            }
        }
    });
    mainDs.load();

    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({

        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: mainHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Proyek', dataIndex: 'name', width: 210, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 85, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Progress (terverifikasi)', dataIndex: 'progress', width: 110, align: 'center', renderer: function (v) { return '<b>' + (v || 0) + '%</b>'; } },
            { header: 'Budget (setara)', dataIndex: 'budget_base', width: 130, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return fmtAmt(v); } },

    function refreshAll(projectId) {
        mainDs.load({
            callback: function () {
                var idx = mainDs.findBy(function (r) { return r.get('id') === projectId; });
                if (idx >= 0) {
                    dataRecord = mainDs.getAt(idx).data;
                    loadDetail(projectId);
                } else {
                    dataRecord = null;
                    dtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }
        });
    }
