    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_REPORT) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk melaporkan progress.');
            return;
        }
        if (!dataRecord) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih proyek terlebih dahulu dari tabel.'); return; }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'Berjalan' && dataRecord.status !== 'Tertunda') {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Progress hanya bisa dilaporkan untuk proyek berstatus Berjalan / Tertunda (status sekarang: ' + dataRecord.status + ').');
            return;
        }
        openClaimWindow(dataRecord);
    };

    function openClaimWindow(proj) {
        var fDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Laporan', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), maxValue: new Date(), allowBlank: false, width: 130 });
        var fPct = new Ext.form.NumberField({
            fieldLabel: 'Progress Diklaim (%)', allowDecimals: false, allowNegative: false, minValue: proj.progress + 1, maxValue: 100,
            allowBlank: false, width: 90,
            minText: 'Harus lebih besar dari progress terverifikasi (' + proj.progress + '%).'
        });
        var fEvid = new Ext.form.TextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. BAP / keterangan bukti', anchor: '95%' });
        var fNote = new Ext.form.TextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Catatan', anchor: '95%', height: 55 });

        var proofs = [], uploading = 0;
        var fProofList = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ fieldLabel: 'Bukti foto / PDF', anchor: '95%', value: '' });
        function renderProofs() {
            var h = '';
            for (var i = 0; i < proofs.length; i++) {
                h += '<div>' + (i + 1) + '. ' + proofLinks(proofs[i]) + ' &nbsp;<span style="color:#e05353;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;" title="Hapus" onclick="window.pgProofRemove(' + i + ');">&#10005;</span></div>';
            }
            if (uploading > 0) { h += '<div style="color:#9fc3d1;">Mengunggah ' + uploading + ' file...</div>'; }
            fProofList.setValue(h || '<span style="color:#668894;">Belum ada file</span>');
        }
        window.pgProofRemove = function (i) { proofs.splice(i, 1); renderProofs(); };
        var fileInput = document.createElement('input');
        fileInput.type = 'file';
        fileInput.accept = 'image/*,.pdf';
        fileInput.style.display = 'none';
        document.body.appendChild(fileInput);
        fileInput.onchange = function () {
            var f = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
            if (!f) { return; }
            if (proofs.length + uploading >= 5) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Bukti maksimal 5 file.'); fileInput.value = ''; return; }
            if (f.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Ukuran file maksimal 5 MB.'); fileInput.value = ''; return; }
            var fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('task', 'upload_evidence');
            fd.append('file', f);
            fileInput.value = '';
            uploading++; renderProofs();
            var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
            xhr.open('POST', CRD);
            xhr.onload = function () {
                uploading--;
                var o;
                try { o = Ext.decode(xhr.responseText); } catch (e) { renderProofs(); Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Respons server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).'); return; }
                if (!o.success) { renderProofs(); Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', o.message || 'Unggah gagal.'); return; }
                proofs.push(o.data.url); renderProofs();
            };
            xhr.onerror = function () { uploading--; renderProofs(); Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Koneksi ke server gagal saat mengunggah.'); };
            xhr.send(fd);
        };
        var fProofBtn = new Ext.Button({ text: '+ Unggah Foto / PDF Bukti...', minWidth: 220, handler: function () { fileInput.click(); } });
        renderProofs();

        var win = new Ext.Window({
            title: 'Lapor Progress - ' + proj.name, width: 520, height: 470, modal: true, layout: 'fit', cls: 'whDarkWin', minButtonWidth: 150,
            items: new Ext.form.FormPanel({
                border: false, labelWidth: 150, bodyStyle: 'padding:12px; background:transparent;',
                items: [{ xtype: 'displayfield', hideLabel: true, value: 'Progress terverifikasi saat ini: <b>' + proj.progress + '%</b>. Klaim harus lebih besar dan akan diverifikasi oleh orang lain sebelum berlaku. Bukti wajib: unggah foto / PDF dan / atau isi no. BAP.' },
                        fDate, fPct, fProofList, fProofBtn, fEvid, fNote]
            }),
            buttons: [
                { text: 'Ajukan Klaim', handler: function () {
                    if (!fDate.isValid() || !fPct.isValid()) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Lengkapi tanggal dan persen (lebih besar dari ' + proj.progress + '%).'); return; }
                    if (uploading > 0) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Masih ada file yang sedang diunggah, tunggu sampai selesai.'); return; }
                    var lines = proofs.slice(0);
                    if (Ext.util.Format.trim(fEvid.getValue() || '') !== '') { lines.push(Ext.util.Format.trim(fEvid.getValue())); }
                    if (!lines.length) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Bukti wajib: unggah foto / PDF atau isi no. BAP.'); return; }
                    var params = {
                        task: 'submit_claim', project_id: proj.id, report_date: ymd(fDate.getValue()),
                        percent_claimed: fPct.getValue(), evidence_ref: lines.join('\n'), note: fNote.getValue()
                    };
                    ajax(params, function (res) {
                        Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                        if (res.success) { win.close(); refreshAll(proj.id); }
                    });
                } },
                { text: 'Batal', handler: function () { win.close(); } }
            ],
            listeners: { close: function () {
                if (fileInput.parentNode) { fileInput.parentNode.removeChild(fileInput); }
                window.pgProofRemove = null;
            } }
        });
        win.show();
    }

    function doAction(act, claim) {
        var pid = dataRecord.id;
        if (act === 'cancel') {
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Batalkan Klaim', 'Batalkan klaim progress <b>' + claim.percent_claimed + '%</b>?', function (b) {
                if (b !== 'yes') return;
                ajax({ task: 'cancel_claim', id: claim.id }, function (res) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) refreshAll(pid);
                });
            });
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_VERIFY) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk memverifikasi progress.');
            return;
        }
        var approve = (act === 'verify');
        var msg;
        if (approve) {
            var ev = dataRecord.budget_base * claim.percent_claimed / 100;
            var cpi = dataRecord.cost_actual > 0 ? ev / dataRecord.cost_actual : null;
            msg = 'Setujui progress <b>' + claim.percent_claimed + '%</b> (bukti: ' + proofLinks(claim.evidence_ref) + ')?<br>' +
                  'Pada progress ini: nilai hasil <b>' + fmtAmt(ev) + '</b>, biaya aktual <b>' + fmtAmt(dataRecord.cost_actual) + '</b>, indeks biaya <b>' + fmtCpi(cpi) + '</b>.' +
                  (cpi !== null && cpi < thresholds.red ? '<br><span style="color:#ff6b5e;">Indeks MERAH - catatan verifikasi wajib bila tetap disetujui.</span>' : '') +
                  '<br>Catatan verifikasi:';
        } else {
            msg = 'Tolak klaim progress <b>' + claim.percent_claimed + '%</b>?<br>Alasan penolakan (wajib):';
        }
        // [CHANGED] Ext.Msg.prompt -> Ext.Msg.show agar ukuran dialog bisa diatur: lebar 460px, kolom catatan tinggi 90px.
        //           Warna kolom catatan diatur di css/frm.css (.ext-mb-textarea).
        Ext.Msg.show({
            title: approve ? 'Verifikasi Progress' : 'Tolak Klaim', msg: msg,
            width: 520, minWidth: 520,                 // [CHANGED] 460 -> 520: box catatan tidak terpotong
            prompt: true, multiline: 90,               // [CHANGED] textarea 90px (bawaan 75px)
            buttons: Ext.Msg.OKCANCEL, scope: this,
            fn: function (btn, text) {
            if (btn !== 'ok') return;
            text = Ext.util.Format.trim(text || '');
            if (!approve && text === '') { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Alasan penolakan wajib diisi.'); return; }
            ajax({ task: 'verify', id: claim.id, decision: approve ? 'Diverifikasi' : 'Ditolak', verify_note: text }, function (res) {
                Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                if (res.success) refreshAll(pid);
            });
            }
        });
        // [NEW] jaga-jaga: bila ExtJS tidak memakai lebar yang diminta, paksa lebar dialog minimal 520px lalu tengahkan
        var msgDlg = Ext.Msg.getDialog();
        if (msgDlg && msgDlg.getWidth() < 520) { msgDlg.setWidth(520); msgDlg.doLayout(); msgDlg.center(); }
    }

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        if (document.getElementById('popCancel')) {
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

/*

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    function ymd(d) {
        var m = d.getMonth() + 1, dd = d.getDate();
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : m) + '-' + (dd < 10 ? '0' + dd : dd);
    }
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "RAB <i>Material & Biaya</i>";
    var dataRecord = null;
    var rabCur = { id: null, code: 'IDR', baseCode: 'IDR', isBase: true, rate: 1, locked: null };
    var rateManual = false, rateReq = 0;

    var plafon = null;
    var currentCategory = 'Material'; // Default tab
    
    function getFormAccess() { return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0); }
    function statusColor(v) {
        if (v === 'OVERBUDGET') return '#c0392b !important';
        if (v === 'WARNING') return '#e6a817 !important';
        if (v === 'NO BUDGET') return '#888888 !important';
        return '#27ae60 !important';
    }
    
    // Category tabs

    var CATEGORY_ICONS = { 'Material': '📦', 'Upah': '👷', 'Peralatan': '🔧', 'Transport': '🚛', 'Konsumsi': '🍱', 'Lain-lain': '📋' };

    function fitRabDtl() {
        var sc = document.getElementById('rabDtlScroll');
        if (!sc) return;
        var top = sc.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        sc.style.maxHeight = Math.max(160, window.innerHeight - top - 40) + 'px';
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', fitRabDtl);
    
    function loadRabDetailPanel(projectId, projectName) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../dev/php-crud/rabCRD.php', method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'load_rab', project_id: projectId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    rabDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red; padding:10px;">Gagal memuat detail RAB.</div>';
                    rabDtlDiv.style.display = 'block'; return;
                }
                renderRabDetailPanel(res.data.items || [], projectName, res.data.currency, res.data.plafon);
            },
            failure: function () {
                rabDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red; padding:10px;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                rabDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }
    
    function renderRabDetailPanel(rows, projectName, cur, pf) {
        var fmtQty = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); };
        var fmtAmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };
        var fmtPct = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0.00') + '%'; };
        var code = (cur && cur.code) || 'IDR';
        
        // Group by category
        var byCategory = {};
        Ext.each(CATEGORIES, function(c) { byCategory[c] = []; });
        Ext.each(rows, function(r) {
            var cat = r.category || 'Lain-lain';
            if (!byCategory[cat]) byCategory[cat] = [];
            byCategory[cat].push(r);
        });
        
        var curLine = '<div style="padding:0 2px 10px 2px;">Mata uang: <b>' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(code) + '</b></div>';
        var plafonLine = '';
        if (pf) {
            var base = (cur && cur.base_code) || 'IDR';
            var noContract = !(pf.contract_value > 0);
            var low = pf.reserve_total > 0 && pf.reserve_remaining < pf.reserve_total * 0.1;
            var remColor = noContract ? '#ff6b5e' : (pf.reserve_remaining <= 0 ? '#ff6b5e' : (low ? '#e6a817' : '#7fe0a0'));
            plafonLine = '<div style="padding:6px 10px; margin:0 2px 10px 2px; background:#1f2d3a; border-radius:4px; line-height:1.7;">' +
                (noContract ? '<span style="color:#ff6b5e;">Nilai Kontrak belum diisi.</span>' :
                'Nilai Kontrak: <b>' + base + ' ' + fmtAmt(pf.contract_value) + '</b> | Budget: <b>' + fmtAmt(pf.budget_base) + '</b> | Cadangan: <b>' + fmtAmt(pf.reserve_total) + '</b>') +
                '<br>Total RAB: <b>' + fmtAmt(pf.rab_total_base) + '</b> | Terpakai: <b>' + fmtAmt(pf.reserve_used) + '</b> | <span style="color:' + remColor + ';">Sisa: <b>' + fmtAmt(pf.reserve_remaining) + '</b></span></div>';
        }
        
        // Category tabs
        var tabsHtml = '<div style="display:flex; gap:4px; margin-bottom:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;">';
        Ext.each(CATEGORIES, function(cat) {
            var count = byCategory[cat] ? byCategory[cat].length : 0;
            var active = cat === currentCategory ? 'background:#22d3ee; color:#020c1b;' : 'background:#1f2d3a; color:#22d3ee;';
            tabsHtml += '<button onclick="switchRabCategory(\'' + cat + '\')" style="padding:6px 12px; border:1px solid #22d3ee; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold; ' + active + '">' +
                CATEGORY_ICONS[cat] + ' ' + cat + ' (' + count + ')</button>';
        });
        tabsHtml += '</div>';
        
        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">RAB: ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(projectName || '') + '</h3><hr class="detail-hr" />' + curLine + plafonLine + tabsHtml;
        html += '<div id="rabDtlScroll" style="overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: auto;">';
        
        var catRows = byCategory[currentCategory] || [];
        var isMaterial = currentCategory === 'Material';
        
        html += '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0"><thead><tr class="header-row">';
        html += '<th align="left">Item</th>';
        if (isMaterial) {
            html += '<th align="right">Budget Qty</th><th align="right">Harga Satuan</th><th align="right">Total Budget</th><th align="right">Qty Terpakai</th><th align="right">% Terpakai</th>';
        } else {
            html += '<th align="right">Budget Amount</th><th align="right">Terpakai</th><th align="right">Sisa</th><th align="right">% Terpakai</th>';
        }
        html += '<th align="center">Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
        
        if (catRows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="' + (isMaterial ? 7 : 5) + '" style="padding:15px; text-align:center; color:#557982;">Belum ada data ' + currentCategory + '.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            var grandTotal = 0;
            Ext.each(catRows, function (r) {
                var totalBudget = (parseFloat(r.budget_qty) || 0) * (parseFloat(r.unit_price) || 0);
                grandTotal += totalBudget;
                html += '<tr class="data-row"><td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.material_name || r.category || '-') +
                    (r.is_addendum ? ' <span style="color:#e6a817;">[TAMBAHAN]</span>' : '') + '</td>';
                if (isMaterial) {
                    html += '<td align="right">' + fmtQty(r.budget_qty) + ' ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.unit || '') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(r.unit_price) + '</td><td align="right" class="subtotal-val">' + fmtAmt(totalBudget) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtQty(r.total_qty_out) + '</td><td align="right">' + fmtPct(r.usage_pct) + '</td>';
                } else {
                    var actual = r.expense_actual || 0;
                    var pct = totalBudget > 0 ? (actual / totalBudget * 100) : 0;
                    var sisa = totalBudget - actual;
                    html += '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(totalBudget) + '</td><td align="right">' + fmtAmt(actual) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:' + (sisa < 0 ? '#c0392b' : '#27ae60') + ';">' + fmtAmt(sisa) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtPct(pct) + '</td>';
                }
                html += '<td align="center" style="font-weight:bold; color:' + statusColor(r.status) + ';">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.status || '-') + '</td></tr>';
            });
            html += '<tr class="data-row"><td colspan="' + (isMaterial ? 3 : 1) + '" align="right"><b>Total ' + currentCategory + '</b></td>' +
                '<td align="right" class="subtotal-val"><b>' + fmtAmt(grandTotal) + '</b></td>' +
                '<td colspan="' + (isMaterial ? 3 : 3) + '"></td></tr>';
        }
        html += '</tbody></table></div>';
        rabDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        rabDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
        fitRabDtl();
    }

                        if (row) {
                            row.set('category', record.get('v'));
                            row.set('expense_id', null);
                            row.set('master_min', 0); row.set('master_max', 0);      // [AI-BOQ] rentang harga ikut master item terpilih
                            if (record.get('v') !== 'Material') { 
                                row.set('material_id', null); 
                                row.set('material_name', ''); 
                                row.set('material_code', ''); 
                                row.set('item_name', ''); 
                            } else { 
                                row.set('item_name', ''); 
                            }
                            updateRabTotalLabel();
                        }
                    } }
                }),
                renderer: function (v) { return (CATEGORY_ICONS[v] || '') + ' ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v || '-'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Material / Item', dataIndex: 'material_id', width: 200,
                editor: new myComboField({
                    store: materialDs, displayField: 'material_name', valueField: 'id', mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true,
                    listeners: {
                        select: function (combo, record) {
                            var row = itemGrid.getSelectionModel().getSelected();
                            if (row) {
                                row.set('material_id', record.get('id'));
                                row.set('material_code', record.get('material_code'));
                                row.set('material_name', record.get('material_name'));
                                row.set('unit', record.get('unit'));
                                row.set('category', 'Material');
                                // [AI-BOQ] rentang harga = milik master; harga satuan default = harga MAX master (dikonversi ke mata uang anggaran)
                                row.set('master_min', parseFloat(record.get('estimated_price_min')) || 0);
                                row.set('master_max', parseFloat(record.get('estimated_price')) || 0);
                                if ((parseFloat(record.get('estimated_price')) || 0) > 0) row.set('unit_price', Math.round(parseFloat(record.get('estimated_price')) / curRate() * 100) / 100);
                                updateRabTotalLabel();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }),
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    if (record.get('category') !== 'Material') {
                        var cat = record.get('category') || '';
                        var selectedExpense = String(record.get('expense_id') || '');
                        var options = '<option value="">Pilih ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(cat || 'Expense') + '...</option>';
                        expenseDs.each(function (ex) {
                            if (ex.get('category') === cat) {
                                var exId = String(ex.get('id'));
                                options += '<option value="' + exId + '"' + (exId === selectedExpense ? ' selected="selected"' : '') + '>' +
                                    Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(ex.get('expense_code') + ' - ' + ex.get('expense_name')) + '</option>';
                            }
                        });
                        return '<select class="rab-expense-select" data-row="' + record.id + '" style="width:100%;max-width:100%;background:#0d2133;color:#fff;border:1px solid #1a4f5c;border-radius:3px;padding:3px;">' + options + '</select>';
                    }
                    var rec = materialDs.getById(v);
                    if (rec) return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(rec.get('material_name'));
                    if (record && record.get('material_name')) return '<span style="color:#e6a817;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(record.get('material_name')) + '</span>';

            // COMPANY = dibeli perusahaan (default); CLIENT_SUPPLIED = titipan klien -> qty_to_buy 0,
            // harga beli Rp 0, fisik tetap tercatat di gudang tanpa jurnal rupiah.
            {
                header: 'Sumber', dataIndex: 'material_source', width: 150, align: 'center',
                editor: new myComboField({
                    store: srcDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true,
                    listeners: {
                        select: function (combo, record) {
                            var row = itemGrid.getSelectionModel().getSelected();
                            if (row) { row.set('material_source', record.get('id')); updateRabTotalLabel(); }
                        }
                    }
                }),
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    if (record.get('category') !== 'Material') return '<span style="color:#668894;">-</span>';
                    var lbl = srcLabel(v || 'COMPANY');
                    return v === 'CLIENT_SUPPLIED'
                        ? '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(lbl) + '</span>'
                        : Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(lbl);
                }
            },
            { header: 'Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit', width: 60, align: 'center', editor: new myTextField() },
            { header: 'Qty / Amount', dataIndex: 'budget_qty', width: 100, align: 'right', editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 4 }), renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); } },
            // [AI-BOQ] Rentang harga dari MASTER (read-only). Harga Satuan = default MAX; boleh diubah selama di antara Min dan Max.
            { header: 'Harga Min (master)', dataIndex: 'master_min', width: 105, align: 'right', renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                var l = rabLimits(record); return l ? '<span style="color:#9fc3d1;">' + Ext.util.Format.number(l.min / curRate(), '0,000.00') + '</span>' : '<span style="color:#668894;">-</span>';
            } },
            { header: 'Harga Max (master)', dataIndex: 'master_max', width: 105, align: 'right', renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                var l = rabLimits(record); return l ? '<span style="color:#9fc3d1;">' + Ext.util.Format.number(l.max / curRate(), '0,000.00') + '</span>' : '<span style="color:#668894;">-</span>';
            } },
            { header: 'Harga Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit_price', width: 110, align: 'right', editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }), renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); } },
            { header: 'Total', dataIndex: 'budget_qty', width: 120, align: 'right', renderer: function (v, meta, record) { var total = (parseFloat(record.get('budget_qty')) || 0) * (parseFloat(record.get('unit_price')) || 0); return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.00') + '</b>'; } },
            { header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 90, align: 'center', renderer: function (v) { return '<span style="color:' + statusColor(v) + ';font-weight:bold;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v || '-') + '</span>'; } },
           {
                id: 'rabDeleteCol',
                header: '<span title="Hapus Baris" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#e05353" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"></polyline><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6m3 0V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"></path><line x1="10" y1="11" x2="10" y2="17"></line><line x1="14" y1="11" x2="14" y2="17"></line></svg></span>',
                dataIndex: 'material_id',
                width: 42,
                align: 'center',
                fixed: true,
                renderer: function () {
                    return '<span class="rabDeleteBtn" style="cursor:pointer;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;" title="Hapus baris"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"></polyline><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6m3 0V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"></path><line x1="10" y1="11" x2="10" y2="17"></line><line x1="14" y1="11" x2="14" y2="17"></line></svg></span>';
                }
            }
        ],
        listeners: {
            // [AI-BOQ] tolak harga satuan di luar rentang min-max master (server tetap memvalidasi ulang)
            validateedit: function (e) {
                if (e.field !== 'unit_price') return;
                var l = rabLimits(e.record);
                if (!l) return;
                var pBase = (parseFloat(e.value) || 0) * curRate();
                if (pBase < l.min * 0.9999 - 0.5 || pBase > l.max * 1.0001 + 0.5) {
                    var f = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number((v || 0) / curRate(), '0,000.00'); };
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Harga di luar batas master', 'Harga satuan harus di antara <b>' + f(l.min) + '</b> dan <b>' + f(l.max) + '</b> (rentang min-max master). Ubah rentang di master bila memang perlu.');
                    e.cancel = true;
                }
            },
            afteredit: function () { updateRabTotalLabel(); },
            cellclick: function (grid, rowIndex, columnIndex) {
                if (grid.getColumnModel().getColumnId(columnIndex) === 'rabDeleteCol') { grid.getStore().removeAt(rowIndex); updateRabTotalLabel(); }
            }
        }
    });
    itemGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    // Delegated handler for Expense Master selector in non-material RAB rows.
    (function bindExpenseSelector() {
        var el = document.getElementById('editorFormGrid');
        if (!el || el._rabExpenseSelectorBound) return;
        el._rabExpenseSelectorBound = true;
        el.addEventListener('change', function (evt) {
            var target = evt.target || evt.srcElement;
            if (!target || !target.className || String(target.className).indexOf('rab-expense-select') < 0) return;
            var rowKey = target.getAttribute('data-row');
            var row = null;
            rabItemDs.each(function (r) { if (String(r.id) === String(rowKey)) row = r; });
            if (!row) return;
            var idx = expenseDs.findBy(function (rec) { return String(rec.get('id')) === String(target.value); });
            if (idx < 0) return;
            var ex = expenseDs.getAt(idx);
            row.set('expense_id', parseInt(ex.get('id'), 10));
            row.set('item_name', ex.get('expense_name') || '');
            row.set('unit', ex.get('unit') || 'Unit');
            // [AI-BOQ] rentang harga = milik master biaya; harga satuan default = harga MAX (dikonversi ke mata uang anggaran)
            row.set('master_min', parseFloat(ex.get('default_price_min')) || 0);
            row.set('master_max', parseFloat(ex.get('default_price')) || 0);
            if ((parseFloat(ex.get('default_price')) || 0) > 0) row.set('unit_price', Math.round(parseFloat(ex.get('default_price')) / curRate() * 100) / 100);
            itemGrid.getView().refresh();
            updateRabTotalLabel();
        });
    })();
    
    // Inject UI
    (function injectExtraUI() {
        var g = document.getElementById('editorFormGrid');
        if (g && !document.getElementById('lblRabTotal')) {
            var totalsDiv = document.createElement('div');
            totalsDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px; margin-top:8px; font-weight:bold; font-size:14px; text-align:right; background:#1f2d3a; color:#ffffff !important; border-radius:4px;';
            totalsDiv.innerHTML = 'Total RAB: <span id="lblRabTotal" style="color:#ffffff !important;">0.00</span><div id="lblRabPlafon" style="font-size:12px; font-weight:normal; margin-top:4px;"></div>';
            g.parentNode.insertBefore(totalsDiv, g.nextSibling);
            var btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.id = 'btnAddRabRow'; btn.type = 'button'; btn.innerHTML = '+ Tambah Item';
            btn.style.cssText = 'margin-bottom:6px; padding:5px 12px; background:#2e6da4; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer;';
            btn.onclick = addBlankRow;
            g.parentNode.insertBefore(btn, g);
            var hdr = document.createElement('div');
            hdr.id = 'rabHdrForm'; hdr.style.cssText = 'margin-bottom:8px;';
            g.parentNode.insertBefore(hdr, btn);
        }
    })();
    
    function updateRabTotalLabel() {
        var total = 0;
        rabItemDs.each(function (r) { total += (parseFloat(r.get('budget_qty')) || 0) * (parseFloat(r.get('unit_price')) || 0); });
        var el = document.getElementById('lblRabTotal');
        if (el) {
            var html = Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.00') + ' ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(rabCur.code);
            if (!rabCur.isBase) html += ' &asymp; ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(rabCur.baseCode) + ' ' + Ext.util.Format.number(total * (parseFloat(rabCur.rate) || 1), '0,000.00');
            el.innerHTML = html;
        }
        updatePlafonBar(total);
    }
    
    // [AI-BOQ] rentang harga master untuk satu baris (mata uang dasar); null bila master belum punya rentang (min > 0 dan max >= min)
    function rabLimits(record) {
        var mn = parseFloat(record.get('master_min')) || 0, mx = parseFloat(record.get('master_max')) || 0;
        return (mn > 0 && mx >= mn) ? { min: mn, max: mx } : null;
    }
    function curRate() { return parseFloat(fRate ? fRate.getValue() : rabCur.rate) || parseFloat(rabCur.rate) || 1; }
    
    function plafonCheck(total) {
        var res = { block: null, usesReserve: false, promptMsg: '' };
        if (!plafon) return res;
        var f = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };
        var rate = curRate(), totalBase = total * rate, budgetBase = (plafon.budget || 0) * rate, contract = plafon.contract_value || 0;
        if (contract <= 0 && plafon.require_contract) res.block = 'Nilai Kontrak belum diisi.';
        else if (contract > 0 && budgetBase > contract + 0.01) res.block = 'Budget melebihi Nilai Kontrak.';
        else if (contract > 0 && totalBase > contract + 0.01) res.block = 'Total RAB melebihi Nilai Kontrak.';
        else if (plafon.phase === 'planning' && plafon.budget > 0 && totalBase > budgetBase + 0.01) res.block = 'Total RAB melebihi Budget. Cadangan hanya untuk proyek Berjalan.';
        else if (plafon.phase === 'running' && plafon.budget > 0 && totalBase > budgetBase + 0.01) {
            res.usesReserve = true;
            res.promptMsg = 'Memakai cadangan: <b>' + f(totalBase - budgetBase) + '</b> dari <b>' + f(Math.max(contract - budgetBase, 0)) + '</b> (sisa ' + f(Math.max(contract - totalBase, 0)) + ').<br>Alasan:';
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    function updatePlafonBar(total) {
        var el = document.getElementById('lblRabPlafon');
        if (!el || !plafon) { if (el) el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
        var f = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };
        var rate = curRate(), totalBase = total * rate, budgetBase = (plafon.budget || 0) * rate, contract = plafon.contract_value || 0;
        if (contract <= 0) { el.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#ff6b5e;">Nilai Kontrak belum diisi.</span>'; return; }
        var chk = plafonCheck(total);
        var color = chk.block ? '#ff6b5e' : (chk.usesReserve ? '#e6a817' : '#7fe0a0');
        el.innerHTML = '<span style="color:' + color + ';">Kontrak ' + f(contract) + ' | Budget ' + f(budgetBase) + ' | Cadangan ' + f(Math.max(contract - budgetBase, 0)) + ' | RAB ' + f(totalBase) + ' | Sisa ' + f(contract - totalBase) + (chk.block ? ' (MELEBIHI)' : (chk.usesReserve ? ' (PAKAI CADANGAN)' : '')) + '</span>';
    }
    
    function baseCurrencyCode() {
        var code = 'IDR';
        currencyDs.each(function (r) { if (r.get('is_base') === true) code = r.get('init'); });
        return code;
    }
    
    function applyCurrencyHeaders() {
        var cm = itemGrid.getColumnModel();
        cm.setColumnHeader(4, 'Harga Satuan (' + rabCur.code + ')');
        cm.setColumnHeader(5, 'Total (' + rabCur.code + ')');
    }
    
    function ensureHdrForm() {
        if (hdrForm) { hdrForm.doLayout(); return; }
        fCur = new myComboField({ fieldLabel: 'Mata Uang', store: currencyDs, displayField: 'init', valueField: 'id', mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, width: 110, listeners: { select: function () { onCurrencyChange(); } } });
        fRateDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Kurs', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), width: 120, listeners: { select: function () { if (!rateManual) refreshRate(); }, change: function () { if (!rateManual) refreshRate(); } } });
        fRate = new myNumberField({ fieldLabel: 'Kurs', decimalPrecision: 4, value: 1, width: 130, listeners: { change: function () { rateManual = true; rabCur.rate = fRate.getValue() || 1; updateRabTotalLabel(); } } });
        fRateInfo = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ hideLabel: true, value: '', anchor: '98%' });
        var col = function (w, items) { return { columnWidth: w, layout: 'form', border: false, labelWidth: 150, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;', items: items }; };
        hdrForm = new Ext.form.FormPanel({ renderTo: 'rabHdrForm', border: false, layout: 'column', bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:4px 2px;', items: [col(0.30, [fCur, fRateDate]), col(0.30, [fRate]), col(0.40, [fRateInfo])] });
    }
    
    function onCurrencyChange() {
        var rec = currencyDs.getById(fCur.getValue());
        if (!rec) return;
        rabCur.id = rec.get('id'); rabCur.code = rec.get('init'); rabCur.isBase = rec.get('is_base') === true; rabCur.baseCode = baseCurrencyCode();
        rateManual = false; applyCurrencyHeaders(); refreshRate(); itemGrid.getView().refresh(); updateRabTotalLabel();
    }
    
    function refreshRate() {
        var cid = fCur.getValue(), dt = fRateDate.getValue();
        if (!cid || !dt) return;
        var token = ++rateReq;
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../dev/php-crud/rabCRD.php', method: 'POST', params: { task: 'get_exchange_rate', currency_id: cid, date: ymd(dt) },
            success: function (response) {
                if (token !== rateReq) return;
                var res; try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); } catch (e) { return; }
                if (!res.success) { fRateInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#c0392b;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(res.message || 'Gagal.') + '</span>'); return; }
                var d = res.data || {}, enc = Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode;
                rabCur.isBase = (d.source === 'BASE'); fRate.setReadOnly(rabCur.isBase);
                if (d.rate) { fRate.setValue(d.rate); rabCur.rate = d.rate; }
                fRateInfo.setValue(d.source === 'BASE' ? '<span style="color:#668894;">Mata uang dasar (kurs 1)</span>' : '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;">KMK ' + enc(d.kmk_no) + '</span>');
                updateRabTotalLabel();
            }
        });
    }
    
    function applyCurrencyFromServer(c) {
        c = c || {}; ensureHdrForm();
        rabCur = { id: c.id, code: c.code || 'IDR', baseCode: c.base_code || 'IDR', isBase: !!c.is_base, rate: parseFloat(c.exch_rate) || 1, locked: c.locked_reason || null };
        fCur.setValue(c.id); fRate.setValue(rabCur.rate); fRate.setReadOnly(rabCur.isBase);
        fRateDate.setValue((c.rate_date && Date.parseDate(c.rate_date, 'Y-m-d')) || new Date());
        rateManual = true; fCur.setDisabled(!!rabCur.locked);
        fRateInfo.setValue(rabCur.locked ? '<span style="color:#e6a817;">Mata uang terkunci.</span>' : (rabCur.isBase ? '<span style="color:#668894;">Mata uang dasar.</span>' : '<span style="color:#668894;">Kurs tersimpan.</span>'));
        applyCurrencyHeaders(); itemGrid.getView().refresh(); updateRabTotalLabel();
    }
    
    function addBlankRow() {
        var RabRecord = rabItemDs.recordType || Ext.data.Record.create(rabItemField);
        rabItemDs.add(new RabRecord({ id: 0, material_id: null, expense_id: null, material_code: '', material_name: '', unit: 'Unit', category: currentCategory, item_name: '', material_source: 'COMPANY', budget_qty: 0, unit_price: 0, tolerance_pct: 0, total_qty_out: 0, remaining_qty: 0, usage_pct: 0, status: 'ON TRACK', master_min: 0, master_max: 0, orig_qty: 0, orig_price: 0, is_addendum: false, addendum_reason: '' }));
        updateRabTotalLabel();
    }
    
    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih proyek terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
        if (getFormAccess() < 3) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses.'); return; }
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../dev/php-crud/rabCRD.php', method: 'POST', params: { task: 'load_rab', project_id: dataRecord.id },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Gagal memuat RAB.'); return; }
                var loadedItems = res.data.items || [];
                Ext.each(loadedItems, function (i) { i.orig_qty = i.budget_qty; i.orig_price = i.unit_price; if (!i.category) i.category = 'Material'; if (!i.item_name) i.item_name = i.material_name; });
                plafon = res.data.plafon || null;
                rabItemDs.loadData({ data: loadedItems });
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
                applyCurrencyFromServer(res.data.currency);
                document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;RAB -- ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(res.data.name || '');
            },
            failure: function () { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.'); }
        });
    };
    
    function sendSave(arrItems) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../dev/php-crud/rabCRD.php', method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'save_rab', project_id: dataRecord.id, currency_id: fCur ? fCur.getValue() : 0, exch_rate: fRate ? (fRate.getValue() || 1) : 1, rate_date: (fRateDate && fRateDate.getValue()) ? ymd(fRateDate.getValue()) : '', items: Ext.util.JSON.encode(arrItems) },
            success: function (response) {
                var res; try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); } catch (e) { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Respons server tidak valid.'); return; }
                if (res.success) { Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message || 'RAB berhasil disimpan.'); mainDs.load(); document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none'; loadRabDetailPanel(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.name); }
                else Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan.');
            },
            failure: function () { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.'); }
        });
    }
    
    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) return;
        var arrItems = [], flagged = [], total = 0, hasInvalidRow = false, duplicateFound = false, materialSet = {};
        rabItemDs.each(function (r) {
            var cat = r.get('category') || 'Lain-lain';
            var materialId = r.get('material_id');
            var itemName = r.get('item_name') || r.get('material_name') || '';
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('budget_qty')) || 0;
            var price = parseFloat(r.get('unit_price')) || 0;
            if (cat === 'Material' && (!materialId && qty <= 0)) return;
            if (cat !== 'Material' && qty <= 0) return;
            if (cat === 'Material' && (!materialId || qty <= 0)) { hasInvalidRow = true; return; }
            if (cat !== 'Material' && !(parseInt(r.get('expense_id'), 10) > 0)) { hasInvalidRow = true; return; }
            if (cat === 'Material') {
                if (materialSet[materialId]) duplicateFound = true; else materialSet[materialId] = true;
            }
            var origQty = parseFloat(r.get('orig_qty')) || 0;
            var origVal = origQty * (parseFloat(r.get('orig_price')) || 0);
            var isUp = origQty <= 0 || qty > origQty + 0.00005 || qty * price > origVal + 0.005;
            total += Math.round(qty * price * 100) / 100;
            var item = { id: r.get('id') || 0, material_id: cat === 'Material' ? materialId : 0, expense_id: cat === 'Material' ? 0 : (parseInt(r.get('expense_id'), 10) || 0), category: cat, item_name: itemName, unit: r.get('unit') || 'Unit', budget_qty: qty, unit_price: price, tolerance_pct: parseFloat(r.get('tolerance_pct')) || 0, addendum_reason: '', material_source: cat === 'Material' ? (r.get('material_source') || 'COMPANY') : 'COMPANY' };
            if (isUp) flagged.push(item);
            arrItems.push(item);
        });
        if (hasInvalidRow) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Ada baris Material atau Expense yang belum dipilih lengkap. Pilih item dari Master Expense untuk kategori non-Material.'); return; }
        if (duplicateFound) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Terdapat duplikasi material.'); return; }
        var chk = plafonCheck(total);
        if (chk.block) { Ext.Msg.alert('Melebihi Plafon', chk.block); return; }
        if (chk.usesReserve && flagged.length) {
            Ext.Msg.prompt('Alasan Penambahan', chk.promptMsg, function (btn, text) {
                if (btn !== 'ok') return; text = Ext.util.Format.trim(text || '');
                if (!text) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Alasan wajib diisi.'); return; }
                Ext.each(flagged, function (it) { it.addendum_reason = text; });
                sendSave(arrItems);
            }, this, true);
            return;
        }
        sendSave(arrItems);
    };
    
    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () { document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none'; if (document.getElementById('popCancel')) document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none'; };
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

/*
  Document      : m.clients.js
  Description   : Master Klien (public.clients) -- CRUD sederhana tanpa
                   detail grid. Pola sama dengan m.materials.js.
                   mainDs di-assign POLOS (tanpa var/let) supaya search
                   box global di header (lihat many-template-icn.php)
                   bisa mengaksesnya.
  Backend       : /rab-project/dev/php-crud/clientsCRD.php

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Master <em>Klien</em>";

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Fields & Store
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var clientField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }, { name: 'contact_person' }, { name: 'phone' },
        { name: 'email' }, { name: 'address' }, { name: 'project_count', type: 'int' },
        { name: 'created_at', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' }
    ];

    // PENTING: assignment polos (bukan var/let) -- supaya search box
    // global di header (kotak Search, id 'q') bisa mengakses mainDs ini.
    // Lihat many-template-icn.php: `let mainDs = '';` dideklarasikan
    // global, dan keydown listener global manggil mainDs.load(...).
    mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/clientsCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'list' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, clientField)
    });
    mainDs.load();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Main Grid
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var GridDtlHeight = (maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));
    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: GridDtlHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Nama Klien', dataIndex: 'name', width: 200, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Contact Person', dataIndex: 'contact_person', width: 160, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Telepon', dataIndex: 'phone', width: 120, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Email', dataIndex: 'email', width: 180, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Alamat', dataIndex: 'address', width: 220, renderer: CellWrap },
            {
                header: 'Jml Proyek', dataIndex: 'project_count', width: 100, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) {
                    return '<span style="font-weight:bold;">' + (v || 0) + '</span>';
                }
            }
        ],
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        loadMask: true,
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) {
                    dataRecord = rec.data;
                    mainBtnEnable('#editData');
                    mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                }
            }
        }
    });
    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Editor Form Fields
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fldName = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Nama Klien', id: 'name', name: 'name', allowBlank: false, maxLength: 255 });
    var fldContactPerson = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Contact Person', id: 'contact_person', name: 'contact_person', maxLength: 255 });
    var fldPhone = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Telepon', id: 'phone', name: 'phone', maxLength: 50 });
    var fldEmail = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Email', id: 'email', name: 'email', maxLength: 255, vtype: 'email' });
    var fldAddress = new myTextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Alamat', id: 'address', name: 'address' });

        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',

        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldName },
            { items: fldContactPerson },
            { items: fldPhone },
            { items: fldEmail },
            { columnWidth: 1, items: fldAddress },
            { items: [new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true })] }
        ]

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. CRUD Toolbar Action Handlers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (getFormAccess() >= 2) {
            task = 'create';
            dataRecord = null;
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Klien Baru';
            fldName.focus('', 10);
        } else {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menambah klien.');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data klien terlebih dahulu dari tabel.');
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() >= 3) {
            task = 'update';
            frmEditor.getForm().load({
                url: '../php-crud/clientsCRD.php',
                params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' },
                success: function () {},
                failure: function () {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal memuat data klien.');
                }
            });
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Klien';
        } else {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk edit klien.');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data klien yang akan dihapus.');
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() >= 4) {
            var warn = dataRecord.project_count > 0
                ? ('Klien \'' + dataRecord.name + '\' terpakai di ' + dataRecord.project_count + ' proyek. Yakin ingin menghapus?')
                : ('Hapus klien \'' + dataRecord.name + '\'?');
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi Hapus', warn, function (btn) {
                if (btn === 'yes') {
                    Ext.Ajax.request({
                        url: '../php-crud/clientsCRD.php',
                        method: 'POST',
                        params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                        success: function (response) {
                            var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                            if (res.success) {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Informasi', 'Klien berhasil dihapus.');
                                dataRecord = null;
                                editDataDisable();
                                mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
                                mainDs.load();
                            } else {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message);
                            }
                        },
                        failure: function () {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        } else {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus.');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        var name = fldName.getValue();
        if (!name) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Nama Klien wajib diisi.');
            return;
        }

        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/clientsCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: task,
                id: (dataRecord && dataRecord.id) ? dataRecord.id : 0,
                name: name,
                contact_person: fldContactPerson.getValue(),
                phone: fldPhone.getValue(),
                email: fldEmail.getValue(),
                address: fldAddress.getValue()
            },
            waitTitle: 'Menyimpan',
            waitMsg: 'Menyimpan data klien...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', 'Klien ' + (res.name || name) + ' berhasil disimpan.');
                mainDs.load();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

Ext.onReady(function() {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    
    if (document.getElementById("mainHeaderText")) {
        document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Form Group";
    }

    var task = '';
    var pageSizeVal = typeof PageSize !== 'undefined' ? PageSize : 250;

    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function(event) {
        task = '';
        if (formAccess == 2 || formAccess == 3 || formAccess == 4) {
            task = 'create';
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "&nbsp;&nbsp;New Form Group";
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            fldActive.setValue(true);
        } else {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to access this window';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function(event) {
        task = '';
        if (formAccess == 3 || formAccess == 4) {
            if (!dataRecord || !dataRecord.id) {
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'Pilih data group terlebih dahulu.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            task = 'update';
            Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().load({
                url: '../dev/php-crud/m.form.groupCRD.php',
                params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' },
                success: function(form, action) {
                    let res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                    let row = (res && Ext.isArray(res.data)) ? res.data[0] : (res ? res.data : null);
                    let rawActive = row ? row.active : true;
                    let isActive = (rawActive === true || rawActive === 'true' || rawActive === 't' || rawActive === 1 || rawActive === '1');
                    fldActive.setValue(isActive);
                }
            });
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Form Group";
        } else {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to edit this data';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function(event) {
        if (formAccess == 4) {
            if (!dataRecord || !dataRecord.id) {
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'Pilih data group yang akan dihapus.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            task = 'delete';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'delete group \'' + (dataRecord.grp_name || dataRecord.name || '') + '\' ?';
        } else {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to delete this data';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function(event) {
        window.open("../pdf/m.material_type.php", 'sub', 'toolbar=no,location=no,status=no,directories=no,menubar=no');
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function(event) {
        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: task,
                active: fldActive.getValue() ? 'true' : 'false'
            },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function(form, action) {
                let objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = objResponse.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';

                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });

            },
            failure: function(form, action) {
                let objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = objResponse.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function(event) {

                    mainDs.load();

                        gridMain.getView().refresh(true);

            });

        document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        task = '';

    let myMask = new Ext.LoadMask(Ext.getBody(), { msg: "Please wait..." });
    let deleteDs = new Ext.data.Store({ url: '../dev/p/m.form.groupCRD.php' });
    let grpField = [

        { name: 'remark' },
        { name: 'active', type: 'boolean' }
    ];

    mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../dev/php-crud/m.form.groupCRD.php',

    // Checkbox Active -- TANPA name:'active' (supaya tidak ikut auto-submit

==================== FILE: ./js/inventory.recon.js ====================
/*
  Document      : inventory.recon.js
  Description   : Rekonsiliasi Persediaan (read-only). Membandingkan nilai BUKU (saldo akun persediaan di buku besar)
                  dengan nilai STOK (ledger stock_movements, IN - OUT bernilai FIFO) sampai tanggal tertentu.
                  Ringkasan: nilai buku, nilai stok, selisih, bagian selisih yang dijelaskan dokumen bermasalah, sisa.
                  Tab: Per Item | Per Gudang | Dokumen vs Jurnal (status OK / TIDAK ADA JURNAL / NILAI BEDA / N/A).
                  [PERBAIKAN] Tombol "Proses Perbaikan Otomatis" memposting jurnal yang kurang untuk dokumen stok yang belum berjurnal.
                  [TAB BESAR] Tab dibuat sendiri (tombol 18px) agar terbaca; teks ringkasan memakai bahasa sehari-hari.
                  Pola mengikuti trialbalance.js (filter bar + summary + grid) dan po.js.
  Backend       : /rab-project/dev/php-crud/inventory.reconCRD.php  (logika: php-func/function.inventory.recon.php)
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Rekonsiliasi <em>Persediaan</em>";

    ['addData', 'editData', 'deleteData'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // [FIX-EDITOR] Template menampilkan window editor/add secara default; halaman laporan ini tidak memakainya -> sembunyikan,
    //              kalau tidak kerangka kosong "SAVE / DISCARD" menutupi seluruh halaman (filter, ringkasan, tab).
    ['editorWdw', 'addWdw'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    var CRD = '../php-crud/inventory.reconCRD.php';

    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function fmtAmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    function fmtQty(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
    // Workaround: Date.format('Y-m-d') pernah mengembalikan 'Y-10-10' di sebagian browser -> format manual
    function ymd(d) {
        var m = d.getMonth() + 1, day = d.getDate();
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : m) + '-' + (day < 10 ? '0' + day : day);
    }
    function showMsg(title, msg) { Ext.Msg.alert(title, msg); }
    function storeError(proxy, type, action, opt, res) {
        var m = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        if (res && res.message) { m = res.message; } else if (res && res.status) { m += ' (HTTP ' + res.status + ')'; }
        showMsg('Gagal', m);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 0. Elemen filter bar & summary (dibuat dinamis, sama seperti trialbalance.js)
    // ============================================================
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var filterBarDiv = document.createElement('div');
    filterBarDiv.id = 'irFilterBar';
    filterBarDiv.style.padding = '0 10px';
    var summaryDiv = document.createElement('div');
    summaryDiv.id = 'irSummary';
    summaryDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px; font-size:14px; margin:0 10px 10px 10px; border-radius:4px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color:#fff;';
    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(filterBarDiv, gridContainer);
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(summaryDiv, gridContainer);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 1. Stores
    // ============================================================
    var accDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD, baseParams: { task: 'list_accounts' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' },
            [{ name: 'id', type: 'int' }, { name: 'label' }, { name: 'is_default' }]),
        listeners: {
            exception: storeError,
            load: function (store) {
                var defId = null;
                store.each(function (r) {
                    var d = r.get('is_default');
                    if (defId === null && (d === true || d === 'true' || d === 1 || d === '1')) defId = r.get('id');
                });
                if (defId === null && store.getCount()) defId = store.getAt(0).get('id');
                if (defId !== null && !fldAcc.getValue()) fldAcc.setValue(defId);
                loadRecon();
            }
        }
    });

    function jsonStore(fields) {
        return new Ext.data.Store({
            reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, fields),
            listeners: { exception: storeError }
        });
    }
    var itemDs = jsonStore([{ name: 'material_code' }, { name: 'material_name' }, { name: 'unit' },
                            { name: 'qty', type: 'float' }, { name: 'avg_cost', type: 'float' }, { name: 'value', type: 'float' }]);
    var whDs = jsonStore([{ name: 'warehouse_name' }, { name: 'item_count', type: 'int' }, { name: 'value', type: 'float' }]);
    var docDs = jsonStore([{ name: 'doc_date' }, { name: 'reference_type' }, { name: 'reference_no' },
                           { name: 'value', type: 'float' }, { name: 'journal_amount' }, { name: 'status' }]);

    // ============================================================
    // 2. Filter bar
    // ============================================================
    var fldDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Per Tanggal', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), allowBlank: false, width: 120 });
    var fldAcc = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Akun Persediaan', width: 260, store: accDs, displayField: 'label', valueField: 'id',
        mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldOnlyIssue = new Ext.form.Checkbox({ boxLabel: 'Dokumen: hanya yang bermasalah', checked: false });
    var btnShow = new Ext.Button({ text: 'Tampilkan', cls: 'field-button grey-field-button' });
    var btnFix = new Ext.Button({ text: 'Proses Perbaikan Otomatis', cls: 'field-button grey-field-button', hidden: true });    // tampil hanya bila ada yang bisa diperbaiki

    new Ext.Panel({
        renderTo: 'irFilterBar',
        layout: 'column',
        border: false,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:8px 0;',
        defaults: { border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;' },
        items: [
            { columnWidth: 0.19, layout: 'form', labelWidth: 75, items: fldDate },
            { columnWidth: 0.30, layout: 'form', labelWidth: 110, items: fldAcc },
            { columnWidth: 0.17, style: 'padding-top:6px;', items: fldOnlyIssue },
            { columnWidth: 0.11, style: 'padding-top:2px;', items: btnShow },
            { columnWidth: 0.23, style: 'padding-top:2px;', items: btnFix }
        ]
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 3. Grid dalam tab
    // ============================================================
    var statusColor = function (s) {
        return s === 'OK' ? '#2e9e4f' : (s === 'TIDAK ADA JURNAL' ? '#e8554a' : (s === 'NILAI BEDA' ? '#e6a817' : '#999999'));
    };

    var itemGrid = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: itemDs, loadMask: true, viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        columns: [
            { header: 'Kode', dataIndex: 'material_code', width: 100 },
            { header: 'Material', dataIndex: 'material_name', width: 260, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit', width: 70, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Qty', dataIndex: 'qty', width: 110, align: 'right', renderer: fmtQty },
            { header: 'Biaya Rata-rata', dataIndex: 'avg_cost', width: 120, align: 'right', renderer: fmtAmt },
            { header: 'Nilai Stok', dataIndex: 'value', width: 140, align: 'right', renderer: fmtAmt }
        ]
    });
    var whGrid = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: whDs, loadMask: true, viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        columns: [
            { header: 'Gudang', dataIndex: 'warehouse_name', width: 260, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Jumlah Item Bersaldo', dataIndex: 'item_count', width: 140, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Nilai Stok', dataIndex: 'value', width: 160, align: 'right', renderer: fmtAmt }
        ]
    });
    var docGrid = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: docDs, loadMask: true, viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        columns: [
            { header: 'Tanggal', dataIndex: 'doc_date', width: 90, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Jenis Dokumen', dataIndex: 'reference_type', width: 140 },
            { header: 'No. Dokumen', dataIndex: 'reference_no', width: 150 },
            { header: 'Nilai Stok (+masuk / -keluar)', dataIndex: 'value', width: 170, align: 'right', renderer: fmtAmt },
            {
                header: 'Nilai Jurnal', dataIndex: 'journal_amount', width: 140, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') ? '-' : fmtAmt(parseFloat(v)); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 140, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b style="color:' + statusColor(v) + ' !important;">' + enc(v) + '</b>'; }
            }
        ]
    });

    // [TAB BESAR] Tab dibuat sendiri (bukan Ext.TabPanel): tombol 18px, kontras jelas, tidak bergantung sprite gambar tab Ext.
    var tabNames = ['Per Item', 'Per Gudang', 'Dokumen vs Jurnal'];
    var tabBar = document.createElement('div');
    tabBar.id = 'irTabBar';
    tabBar.style.cssText = 'display:flex; gap:8px; margin:0 0 8px 0;';
    var panes = [];
    var tabBtns = [];
    var activeTab = 0;
    var holder = document.createElement('div');
    holder.id = 'irPanes';
    gridContainer.appendChild(tabBar);
    gridContainer.appendChild(holder);

    // ukuran font isi tabel di area ini dinaikkan agar terbaca
    var st = document.createElement('style');

    function styleTabs() {

    function selectTab(i) {

        styleTabs();
        fitTabs();

    // Tinggi grid aktif = sisa tinggi layar di bawah tab (setelah filter bar & ringkasan terisi)
    function fitTabs() {
        if (!gridsReady) return;

        var h = (window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight) - top - 24;
        var g = [itemGrid, whGrid, docGrid][activeTab];
        g.setHeight(Math.max(h, 240));
        g.setWidth(panes[activeTab].clientWidth || 800);
        g.doLayout();
    }
    window.onresize = fitTabs;

    function loadRecon() {

            success: function (response) {

                try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); }
                catch (e) { summaryDiv.innerHTML = 'Respons server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).'; return; }
                if (!res.success) { summaryDiv.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#ffeb3b;">' + enc(res.message || 'Gagal memuat data.') + '</span>'; return; }
                var d = res.data, s = d.summary;

                itemDs.loadData({ data: d.items, totalCount: d.items.length }, false);
                whDs.loadData({ data: d.warehouses, totalCount: d.warehouses.length }, false);
                docDs.loadData({ data: d.docs, totalCount: d.docs.length }, false);
                applyDocFilter();

                var cell = function (label, val, color) {

                           '<div style="font-size:20px; font-weight:bold; color:' + (color || '#ffffff') + ';">' + fmtAmt(val) + '</div></td>';
                };
                var html = '<div style="margin-bottom:6px; font-size:15px;">Per <b>' + enc(s.as_of) + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Akun: <b>' + enc(s.account_label) + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; ' +
                           '<b style="color:' + (ok ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171') + ';">' + (ok ? 'SESUAI ✓' : 'ADA SELISIH ✗') + '</b></div>' +
                           '<table style="border-collapse:collapse;"><tr>' +
                           cell('Nilai Buku (angka di pembukuan)', s.book_balance) +
                           cell('Nilai Stok (barang di gudang)', s.stock_value) +
                           cell('Selisih (Buku - Stok)', s.diff, ok ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171') +
                           '</tr></table>';

                // penjelasan bahasa sehari-hari + langkah yang harus dilakukan
                var fixCount = s.fixable_count || 0, otherProblem = Math.max((s.docs_problem || 0) - fixCount, 0);
                var msg = [];
                if (ok) {
                    msg.push('<span style="color:#4ade80;">Pembukuan dan gudang sudah cocok. <b>Tidak ada yang perlu dilakukan.</b></span> (' + s.docs_total + ' dokumen stok diperiksa)');
                } else {
                    if (fixCount > 0) {
                        msg.push('<b>' + fixCount + ' dokumen</b> (nilai ' + fmtAmt(s.fixable_value) + ') sudah mengubah stok di gudang tetapi <b>belum dicatat di pembukuan</b>. ' +
                                 'Klik tombol <b>"Proses Perbaikan Otomatis"</b> di atas untuk mencatatnya. Stok tidak diubah.');
                    }
                    if (otherProblem > 0) {
                        msg.push('<b>' + otherProblem + ' dokumen</b> nilainya berbeda antara pembukuan dan gudang. Ini tidak diperbaiki otomatis; mohon dicek oleh bagian akuntansi (lihat tab "Dokumen vs Jurnal").');
                    }
                    if (Math.abs(s.unexplained) > 1) {
                        msg.push('Ada selisih <b>' + fmtAmt(s.unexplained) + '</b> yang <b>tidak bisa dijelaskan</b> oleh dokumen stok (kemungkinan catatan manual di pembukuan). ' +
                                 'Ini perlu diperiksa manual oleh bagian akuntansi, jangan disamakan dengan tombol otomatis.');
                    }
                }
                html += '<div style="margin-top:8px; font-size:14px; line-height:1.6;">' + msg.join('<br/>') + '</div>' +
                        '<div style="margin-top:8px; color:#668894; font-size:12px;">Nilai Buku = jumlah persediaan menurut pembukuan. Nilai Stok = nilai barang yang ada di gudang menurut catatan stok. Keduanya seharusnya sama.</div>';
                summaryDiv.innerHTML = html;

                if (fixCount > 0) { btnFix.show(); } else { btnFix.hide(); }
                fixInfo = { count: fixCount, value: s.fixable_value };
                fitTabs();
            },
            failure: function () { summaryDiv.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#ffeb3b;">Gagal menghubungi server.</span>'; }
        });
    }

                        loadRecon();
                    },
                    failure: function () { showMsg('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.'); }
                });
            });
    });

    };
    if (document.getElementById('popOK')) {
        document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () { document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none'; };
    }
});
==================== FILE: ./js/sw.stockcard.js ====================
/*
Document : sw.stockcard.js
Letak    : ROOT aplikasi (mis. /rab-project/dev/sw.stockcard.js), sejajar folder views/ dan php-crud/.
           Harus dibuka lewat HTTPS (atau localhost) agar browser mau mengaktifkannya.

Tugas    : menyimpan halaman Kartu Stok Mobile + JS-nya supaya bisa dibuka tanpa sinyal.
Strategi : NETWORK-FIRST. Online -> selalu ambil terbaru dari server (update otomatis sampai ke HP).
           Offline / server lambat (> 4 detik) -> pakai salinan tersimpan.
Data     : TIDAK disimpan di sini. Data stok ada di IndexedDB (diatur stock.card.m.js).
           Request ke /php-crud/ tidak pernah disentuh service worker.
Aman     : hanya menangani halaman Kartu Stok Mobile dan file-file yang dimintanya.
           Halaman ERP lain tidak di-cache.
*/
var CACHE = 'stockcard-v2';
var PAGE_RE = /stock\.card\.m/i;
var TIMEOUT_MS = 4000;

self.addEventListener('install', function () { self.skipWaiting(); });

self.addEventListener('activate', function (e) {
    e.waitUntil(
        caches.keys().then(function (keys) {
            return Promise.all(keys.filter(function (k) { return k.indexOf('stockcard-') === 0 && k !== CACHE; })
                .map(function (k) { return caches.delete(k); }));
        }).then(function () { return self.clients.claim(); })
    );
});

// Apakah request ini milik halaman Kartu Stok Mobile?
function isStockPage(url) { return PAGE_RE.test(url); }
function fromStockClient(req) {
    var ref = req.referrer || '';
    if (isStockPage(ref)) return Promise.resolve(true);
    if (!ref) return Promise.resolve(false);
    // halaman bisa dibuka lewat router?id=NN: kenali dari daftar halaman yang sudah kita simpan
    return caches.open(CACHE).then(function (c) { return c.match(ref); }).then(function (hit) { return !!hit; });
}

self.addEventListener('fetch', function (e) {
    var req = e.request;
    if (req.method !== 'GET') return;
    var url = new URL(req.url);
    if (url.origin !== self.location.origin) return;
    if (url.pathname.indexOf('/php-crud/') >= 0) return; // data -> IndexedDB, bukan SW

    if (req.mode === 'navigate') {
        e.respondWith(
            caches.open(CACHE).then(function (c) { return c.match(req); }).then(function (exact) {
                // tangani bila URL-nya halaman stok, atau sudah pernah kita simpan persis (mis. router?id=164)
                if (isStockPage(url.pathname) || exact) return networkFirst(req, isStockPage(url.pathname));
                return fetch(req);
            })
        );
        return;
    }

    e.respondWith(fromStockClient(req).then(function (ok) {
        return ok ? networkFirst(req, true) : fetch(req);
    }));
});

// ignoreSearch hanya untuk file halaman stok / aset-nya; URL lain harus cocok persis
function networkFirst(req, allowIgnoreSearch) {
    return caches.open(CACHE).then(function (cache) {
        function fromCache() {
            return cache.match(req).then(function (hit) {
                return hit || (allowIgnoreSearch ? cache.match(req, { ignoreSearch: true }) : undefined);
            });
        }
        return new Promise(function (resolve) {
            var done = false;
            var timer = setTimeout(function () {
                fromCache().then(function (hit) { if (hit && !done) { done = true; resolve(hit); } });
            }, TIMEOUT_MS);

            fetch(req).then(function (res) {
                clearTimeout(timer);
                if (res && res.ok && !res.redirected) cache.put(req, res.clone());
                if (!done) { done = true; resolve(res); }
            }).catch(function () {
                clearTimeout(timer);
                if (done) return;
                fromCache().then(function (hit) { done = true; resolve(hit || Response.error()); });
            });
        });
    });
}

// Halaman mengirim daftar URL (halaman + JS + CSS) untuk disimpan sekali di awal
self.addEventListener('message', function (e) {
    var d = e.data || {};
    if (d.type !== 'precache' || !Array.isArray(d.urls)) return;
    var port = e.ports && e.ports[0];
    e.waitUntil(
        caches.open(CACHE).then(function (cache) {
            var n = 0;
            return Promise.all(d.urls.map(function (u) {
                return fetch(u, { credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'reload' }).then(function (r) {
                    if (r.ok && !r.redirected) { n++; return cache.put(u, r); }
                }).catch(function () {});
            })).then(function () { if (port) port.postMessage({ ok: n > 0, cached: n }); });
        }).catch(function () { if (port) port.postMessage({ ok: false, cached: 0 }); })
    );
});
