==================== FILE: ./js/subcon.invoice.js ====================
/*
Document      : subcon.invoice.js
Description   : Modul Invoice & Pembayaran Subkontraktor (2-Step Payment)
                - Style button disamakan dengan modul Subkon (uiBtn + TEAL/GREY/BURG)
                - Judul window "Invoice Baru" diperbesar 14px
Backend       : ../php-crud/subcon.invoiceCRD.php
*/
Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Invoice & Pembayaran <em>Subkontraktor</em>";
    
    var CRD = main_url + '/php-crud/subcon.invoiceCRD.php';
    var ACCESS_ADD = 2;
    var ACCESS_EDIT = 3;
    var VEPS = 0.01;
    
    // ============================================================
    // [NEW] SAMAKAN STYLE BUTTON DENGAN MODUL SUBKON
    // ============================================================
    var TEAL = '#066b78', GREY = '#555555', BURG = '#800020';
    
    function uiBtn(cls, label, bg, attrs) {
        return '<button type="button" class="' + cls + '" ' + (attrs || '') + ' style="margin-left:8px;padding:8px 20px;background:' + bg +
               ';color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;">' + label + '</button>';
    }
    
    function statusColor(v) {
        switch (v) {
            case 'Draft': return '#999999 !important';
            case 'Diajukan': return '#e6a817 !important';
            case 'Disetujui': return '#2bc1e2 !important';
            case 'Posted': return '#00ff4c !important';
            case 'Dibatalkan': return '#c0392b !important';
        }
        return '#ffffff !important';
    }
    
    // [NEW] CSS override untuk judul window ExtJS 3.4
    if (!document.getElementById('scInvWindowStyle')) {
        var styleEl = document.createElement('style');
        styleEl.id = 'scInvWindowStyle';
        styleEl.innerHTML = 
            '.x-window-header .x-window-header-text { font-size: 16px !important; font-weight: normal !important; color: #22d3ee !important; }' +
            '.x-window-header { background: #0d2137 !important; }' +
            '.scInvActBtn { font-weight: bold !important; }';
        document.head.appendChild(styleEl);
    }
    
    var dataRecord = null;
    var editingId = 0;
    
    function getFormAccess() { return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0); }
    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function fmtAmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    function ymd(d) { return d ? d.dateFormat('Y-m-d') : ''; }
    function showErr(msg) { Ext.Msg.show({ title: 'Peringatan', msg: msg, buttons: Ext.Msg.OK, icon: Ext.Msg.WARNING }); }
    
    function ajax(params, onOk) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD, method: 'POST', params: params,
            success: function (r) {
                var o;
                try { o = Ext.decode(r.responseText); } catch (e) { showErr('Respons server tidak valid.'); return; }
                onOk(o);
            },
            failure: function (r) { showErr('Koneksi ke server gagal (HTTP ' + r.status + ').'); }
        });
    }
    
    function needAccess(level, msg) {
        if (getFormAccess() < level) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', msg); return false; }
        return true;
    }
    
    // ============================================================
    // STORES
    // ============================================================
    var rdr = function (fields, idp) { return new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: idp || 'id' }, fields); };
    
    var contractDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD, baseParams: { task: 'list_contracts' },
        reader: rdr([{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'spk_no' }, { name: 'subcontractor_name' }, { name: 'contract_value', type: 'float' }, { name: 'status' }]),
        listeners: { exception: function() {} }
    });
    
    var progressDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD, baseParams: { task: 'list_progress' },
        reader: rdr([{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'ref_no' }, { name: 'progress_date' }, { name: 'net_payable', type: 'float' },
            { name: 'paid_amount', type: 'float' }, { name: 'unpaid_amount', type: 'float' }, { name: 'status' }]),
        listeners: { exception: function() {} }
    });
    
    var accountDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD, baseParams: { task: 'list_accounts' },
        reader: rdr([{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'label' }]),
        listeners: { exception: function() {} }
    });
    
    var invoiceDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD, baseParams: { task: 'list_invoices' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, [
            { name: 'id' }, { name: 'invoice_no' }, { name: 'contract_id' }, { name: 'spk_no' },
            { name: 'subcontractor_name' }, { name: 'progress_id' }, { name: 'progress_ref_no' },
            { name: 'invoice_date' }, { name: 'due_date' }, { name: 'total_amount', type: 'float' },
            { name: 'paid_amount', type: 'float' }, { name: 'unpaid_amount', type: 'float' },
            { name: 'status' }, { name: 'reference_no' }, { name: 'notes' }, { name: 'created_by_name' }
        ]),
        listeners: { exception: function() {} }
    });
    
    invoiceDs.load();
    
    // ============================================================
    // GRID UTAMA
    // ============================================================
    var GridMainHeight = maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid'));
    var mainHeight = Math.round(GridMainHeight * 0.7);
    
    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: invoiceDs, renderTo: 'divMainGrid', height: mainHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. Invoice', dataIndex: 'invoice_no', width: 120 },
            { header: 'Tanggal', dataIndex: 'invoice_date', width: 90, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'No. SPK', dataIndex: 'spk_no', width: 110 },
            { header: 'Subkontraktor', dataIndex: 'subcontractor_name', width: 180, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'No. Prestasi', dataIndex: 'progress_ref_no', width: 110 },
            { header: 'Total Invoice', dataIndex: 'total_amount', width: 120, align: 'right', renderer: function(v) { return '<b>' + fmtAmt(v) + '</b>'; } },
            { header: 'Sudah Dibayar', dataIndex: 'paid_amount', width: 120, align: 'right', renderer: fmtAmt },
            { header: 'Sisa Hutang', dataIndex: 'unpaid_amount', width: 120, align: 'right', renderer: function(v) { return '<span style="color:' + (v > 0 ? '#e6a817' : '#27ae60') + ';">' + fmtAmt(v) + '</span>'; } },
            { header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 90, align: 'center', renderer: function(v) { return '<span style="color:' + statusColor(v) + ';font-weight:bold;">' + enc(v || '-') + '</span>'; } },
            { header: 'Dibuat Oleh', dataIndex: 'created_by_name', width: 120 }
        ],
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true }, loadMask: true,
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) {
                    dataRecord = rec.data;
                    updateMainButtons();
                    loadDetailPanel(dataRecord.id);
                }
            }
        }
    });
    
    function updateMainButtons() {
        mainBtnEnable('#addData');
        if (dataRecord && dataRecord.status === 'Draft') { mainBtnEnable('#editData'); mainBtnEnable('#deleteData'); }
        else { mainBtnDisable('#editData'); mainBtnDisable('#deleteData'); }
    }
    editDataDisable(); updateMainButtons();
    
    // ============================================================
    // DETAIL PANEL
    // ============================================================
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var dtlDiv = document.createElement('div');
    dtlDiv.id = 'scInvDtlContainer';
    dtlDiv.className = 'detail-panel-container';
    dtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
    dtlDiv.style.maxHeight = Math.round(GridMainHeight - (GridMainHeight * 0.6) - 30);
    dtlDiv.style.overflowY = 'auto';
    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) { gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(dtlDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling); }
    
    function loadDetailPanel(invoiceId) {
        ajax({ task: 'load_invoice', id: invoiceId }, function (res) {
            if (!res.success) {
                dtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;padding:10px;">' + enc(res.message || 'Gagal memuat detail.') + '</div>';
                dtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            renderDetail(res.data.invoice, res.data.payments || []);
        });
    }
    
    function renderDetail(inv, payments) {
        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Invoice: ' + enc(inv.invoice_no) + ' <span style="color:' + statusColor(inv.status) + ';">(' + enc(inv.status) + ')</span></h3>' +
            '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
            '<div style="padding:4px 2px 10px 2px;">SPK: <b>' + enc(inv.spk_no) + '</b> | Subkon: <b>' + enc(inv.subcontractor_name) + '</b>' +
            (inv.npwp_no ? ' (NPWP ' + enc(inv.npwp_no) + ')' : '') + ' | Tanggal: <b>' + enc(inv.invoice_date) + '</b>' +
            (inv.due_date ? ' | Jatuh Tempo: <b>' + enc(inv.due_date) + '</b>' : '') + '</div>' +
            '<div style="padding:0 2px 10px 2px;color:#9fc3d1;">Total: <b>' + fmtAmt(inv.total_amount) + '</b> | Dibayar: <b>' + fmtAmt(inv.paid_amount) + '</b> | Sisa: <b>' + fmtAmt(inv.unpaid_amount) + '</b></div>';
        
        // Detail prestasi (jika ada)
        if (inv.progress_id) {
            html += '<h4 style="margin:14px 0 4px 0;">Detail Prestasi</h4>' +
                '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0"><tbody>' +
                '<tr><td>Nilai (DPP)</td><td align="right">' + fmtAmt(inv.gross_amount) + '</td></tr>' +
                '<tr><td>PPN</td><td align="right">' + fmtAmt(inv.ppn_amount) + '</td></tr>' +
                '<tr><td>PPh</td><td align="right">' + fmtAmt(inv.pph_amount) + '</td></tr>' +
                '<tr><td>Retensi</td><td align="right">' + fmtAmt(inv.retention_amount) + '</td></tr>' +
                '<tr><td>Pot. Uang Muka</td><td align="right">' + fmtAmt(inv.dp_recovery) + '</td></tr>' +
                '<tr><td><b>Nilai Bayar</b></td><td align="right"><b>' + fmtAmt(inv.net_payable) + '</b></td></tr>' +
                '</tbody></table>';
        }
        
        // Pembayaran
        html += '<h4 style="margin:14px 0 4px 0;">Pembayaran</h4>' +
            '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0"><thead><tr class="header-row">' +
            '<th>No. Bayar</th><th>Tanggal</th><th>Akun</th><th>Metode</th><th>Jumlah</th><th>Status</th><th></th>' +
            '</tr></thead><tbody>';
        
        if (!payments.length) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="7" style="padding:12px;text-align:center;color:#557982;">Belum ada pembayaran.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(payments, function (p) {
                // [FIX] Tombol Batal pembayaran pakai uiBtn (sama dengan subcon.js)
                var cancelBtn = p.status === 'Posted' 
                    ? uiBtn('scInvActBtn', 'Batal', BURG, 'data-act="cancel_payment" data-id="' + p.id + '"') 
                    : '';
                html += '<tr class="data-row"><td>' + enc(p.payment_no) + '</td><td>' + enc(p.payment_date) + '</td>' +
                    '<td>' + enc(p.account_code + ' ' + p.account_name) + '</td><td>' + enc(p.payment_method) + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(p.amount) + '</td>' +
                    '<td><span style="color:' + statusColor(p.status) + ';font-weight:bold;">' + enc(p.status) + '</span></td>' +
                    '<td>' + cancelBtn + '</td></tr>';
            });
        }
        html += '</tbody></table>';
        
        // [FIX] Tombol aksi invoice pakai uiBtn (sama dengan subcon.js)
        var btns = '';
        if (inv.status === 'Draft') {
            btns += uiBtn('scInvActBtn', 'Ajukan', TEAL, 'data-act="submit_invoice" data-id="' + inv.id + '"');
            btns += uiBtn('scInvActBtn', 'Edit', GREY, 'data-act="edit_invoice" data-id="' + inv.id + '"');
            btns += uiBtn('scInvActBtn', 'Batalkan', BURG, 'data-act="cancel_invoice" data-id="' + inv.id + '"');
        } else if (inv.status === 'Diajukan') {
            btns += uiBtn('scInvActBtn', 'Setujui', TEAL, 'data-act="approve_invoice" data-id="' + inv.id + '"');
        } else if (inv.status === 'Disetujui' && inv.unpaid_amount > VEPS) {
            btns += uiBtn('scInvActBtn', 'Bayar', GREY, 'data-act="pay_invoice" data-id="' + inv.id + '"');
        }
        
        if (btns) html += '<div style="margin-top:15px;text-align:right;">' + btns + '</div>';
        
        dtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        dtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
        
        // Wire button handlers
        var btns = dtlDiv.querySelectorAll('.scInvActBtn');
        for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) {
            btns[i].onclick = function () { onAction(this.getAttribute('data-act'), parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-id'), 10)); };
        }
    }
    
    function onAction(act, id) {
        if (act === 'submit_invoice') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses.')) return;
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Ajukan Invoice', 'Ajukan invoice ini untuk disetujui?', function (btn) {
                if (btn !== 'yes') return;
                ajax({ task: 'update_invoice_status', id: id, to: 'Diajukan' }, function (res) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) { invoiceDs.load(); loadDetailPanel(id); }
                });
            });
        } else if (act === 'approve_invoice') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses.')) return;
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Setujui Invoice', 'Setujui invoice ini? Jurnal akan diposting.', function (btn) {
                if (btn !== 'yes') return;
                ajax({ task: 'approve_invoice', id: id }, function (res) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) { invoiceDs.load(); loadDetailPanel(id); }
                });
            });
        } else if (act === 'cancel_invoice') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses.')) return;
            Ext.Msg.prompt('Batalkan Invoice', 'Alasan (min. 5 karakter):', function (btn, txt) {
                if (btn !== 'ok') return;
                if (txt.length < 5) { showErr('Alasan minimal 5 karakter.'); return; }
                ajax({ task: 'cancel_invoice', id: id, reason: txt }, function (res) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) { invoiceDs.load(); loadDetailPanel(id); }
                });
            });
        } else if (act === 'edit_invoice') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses.')) return;
            openInvoiceEditor(id);
        } else if (act === 'pay_invoice') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_ADD, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses.')) return;
            openPaymentEditor(id);
        } else if (act === 'cancel_payment') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses.')) return;
            Ext.Msg.prompt('Batalkan Pembayaran', 'Alasan (min. 5 karakter):', function (btn, txt) {
                if (btn !== 'ok') return;
                if (txt.length < 5) { showErr('Alasan minimal 5 karakter.'); return; }
                ajax({ task: 'cancel_payment', id: id, reason: txt }, function (res) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) { invoiceDs.load(); loadDetailPanel(dataRecord.id); }
                });
            });
        }
    }
    
    // ============================================================
    // INVOICE EDITOR (Step 1) - [FIX] Judul 14px + tombol uiBtn
    // ============================================================
    function openInvoiceEditor(invoiceId) {
        var fContract = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Kontrak Subkon', store: contractDs, displayField: 'spk_no', valueField: 'id',
            mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, anchor: '95%',
            listeners: { select: function () { onContractChange(); } }
        });
        var fProgress = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Prestasi', store: progressDs, displayField: 'ref_no', valueField: 'id',
            mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: false, anchor: '95%', value: 0,
            listeners: { select: function (c, rec) { if (rec) fAmount.setValue(rec.get('unpaid_amount')); } }
        });
        var fInvDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Invoice', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), allowBlank: false, width: 130 });
        var fDueDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Jatuh Tempo', format: 'd/m/Y', width: 130 });
        var fAmount = new myNumberField({ fieldLabel: 'Total Invoice', decimalPrecision: 2, allowNegative: false, width: 150 });
        var fRef = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Referensi', anchor: '95%' });
        var fNotes = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Catatan', anchor: '95%' });
        
        var winTitle = (invoiceId ? 'Edit Invoice' : 'Invoice Baru') + ' - Subkontraktor';
        
        var win = new Ext.Window({
            title: winTitle,
            width: 600, height: 450, modal: true, layout: 'fit',
            // [FIX] headerCfg untuk paksa font-size 14px di title window
            headerCfg: { tag: 'div', cls: 'x-window-header', style: 'font-size:16px;font-weight:bold;' },
            items: new Ext.form.FormPanel({
                border: false, labelWidth: 130, bodyStyle: 'padding:12px;',
                items: [fContract, fProgress, fInvDate, fDueDate, fAmount, fRef, fNotes]
            }),
            // [FIX] bbar pakai uiBtn (sama dengan subcon.js)
            bbar: ['->', { xtype: 'tbtext', text: uiBtn('scInvSave', 'Simpan', TEAL) + uiBtn('scInvCancel', 'Batal', BURG) }]
        });
        
        contractDs.load({ callback: function () {
            progressDs.load({ params: { contract_id: 0 } });
            win.show();
            
            if (invoiceId) {
                ajax({ task: 'load_invoice', id: invoiceId }, function (res) {
                    if (res.success) {
                        var inv = res.data.invoice;
                        fContract.setValue(inv.contract_id);
                        onContractChange(function () {
                            fProgress.setValue(inv.progress_id || 0);
                            fInvDate.setValue(Date.parseDate(inv.invoice_date, 'Y-m-d') || new Date());
                            fDueDate.setValue(inv.due_date ? Date.parseDate(inv.due_date, 'Y-m-d') : null);
                            fAmount.setValue(inv.total_amount);
                            fRef.setValue(inv.reference_no || '');
                            fNotes.setValue(inv.notes || '');
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
            
            setTimeout(function () {
                var btnSave = document.querySelector('.scInvSave');
                var btnCancel = document.querySelector('.scInvCancel');
                if (btnSave) {
                    btnSave.onclick = function () {
                        if (!fContract.getValue()) { showErr('Kontrak wajib dipilih.'); return; }
                        if (!fInvDate.getValue()) { showErr('Tanggal invoice wajib diisi.'); return; }
                        if (!(parseFloat(fAmount.getValue()) > 0)) { showErr('Total invoice harus lebih dari 0.'); return; }
                        
                        ajax({
                            task: 'save_invoice', id: invoiceId || 0,
                            contract_id: fContract.getValue(), progress_id: fProgress.getValue() || 0,
                            invoice_date: ymd(fInvDate.getValue()), due_date: fDueDate.getValue() ? ymd(fDueDate.getValue()) : '',
                            total_amount: fAmount.getValue(), reference_no: fRef.getValue(), notes: fNotes.getValue()
                        }, function (res) {
                            if (res.success) {
                                win.close();
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message);
                                invoiceDs.load();
                                if (res.data && res.data.id) loadDetailPanel(res.data.id);
                            } else showErr(res.message || 'Gagal.');
                        });
                    };
                }
                if (btnCancel) {
                    btnCancel.onclick = function () { win.close(); };
                }
            }, 100);
        }});
    }
    
    function onContractChange(cb) {
        var cid = fContract ? fContract.getValue() : 0;
        progressDs.load({ params: { contract_id: cid }, callback: function () { if (cb) cb(); } });
    }
    
    // ============================================================
    // PAYMENT EDITOR (Step 2) - [FIX] Judul 14px + tombol uiBtn
    // ============================================================
    function openPaymentEditor(invoiceId) {
        ajax({ task: 'load_invoice', id: invoiceId }, function (res) {
            if (!res.success) { showErr(res.message || 'Gagal memuat invoice.'); return; }
            var inv = res.data.invoice;
            if (inv.status !== 'Disetujui') { showErr('Hanya invoice Disetujui yang bisa dibayar.'); return; }
            if (inv.unpaid_amount <= 0) { showErr('Invoice sudah lunas.'); return; }
            
            var fPayDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Bayar', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), allowBlank: false, width: 130 });
            var fAccount = new myComboField({ fieldLabel: 'Akun Kas/Bank', store: accountDs, displayField: 'label', valueField: 'id', mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, anchor: '95%' });
            var fMethod = new myComboField({ fieldLabel: 'Metode', store: new Ext.data.ArrayStore({ fields: ['v', 't'], data: [['BANK_TRANSFER', 'Transfer Bank'], ['CASH', 'Tunai'], ['CHEQUE', 'Cek']] }), displayField: 't', valueField: 'v', mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, value: 'BANK_TRANSFER', anchor: '95%' });
            var fAmount = new myNumberField({ fieldLabel: 'Jumlah Bayar', decimalPrecision: 2, allowNegative: false, value: inv.unpaid_amount, width: 150 });
            var fRef = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Referensi', anchor: '95%' });
            var fNotes = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Catatan', anchor: '95%' });
            
            var winTitle = 'Pembayaran Invoice ' + inv.invoice_no;
            
            var win = new Ext.Window({
                title: winTitle,
                width: 500, height: 380, modal: true, layout: 'fit',
                // [FIX] headerCfg untuk paksa font-size 14px
                headerCfg: { tag: 'div', cls: 'x-window-header', style: 'font-size:14px;font-weight:bold;' },
                items: new Ext.form.FormPanel({
                    border: false, labelWidth: 130, bodyStyle: 'padding:12px;',
                    items: [{ xtype: 'displayfield', hideLabel: true, value: 'Sisa hutang: <b>' + fmtAmt(inv.unpaid_amount) + '</b>' },
                        fPayDate, fAccount, fMethod, fAmount, fRef, fNotes]
                }),
                // [FIX] bbar pakai uiBtn
                bbar: ['->', { xtype: 'tbtext', text: uiBtn('scPaySave', 'Simpan & Posting', TEAL) + uiBtn('scPayCancel', 'Batal', BURG) }]
            });
            
            accountDs.load({ callback: function () { win.show(); } });
            
            setTimeout(function () {
                var btnSave = document.querySelector('.scPaySave');
                var btnCancel = document.querySelector('.scPayCancel');
                if (btnSave) {
                    btnSave.onclick = function () {
                        if (!fPayDate.getValue() || !fAccount.getValue()) { showErr('Tanggal dan akun wajib diisi.'); return; }
                        if (!(parseFloat(fAmount.getValue()) > 0)) { showErr('Jumlah harus > 0.'); return; }
                        
                        ajax({
                            task: 'save_payment', invoice_id: invoiceId, contract_id: inv.contract_id,
                            payment_date: ymd(fPayDate.getValue()), account_id: fAccount.getValue(),
                            payment_method: fMethod.getValue(), amount: fAmount.getValue(),
                            reference_no: fRef.getValue(), notes: fNotes.getValue()
                        }, function (res) {
                            if (res.success) {
                                win.close();
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message);
                                invoiceDs.load();
                                loadDetailPanel(invoiceId);
                            } else showErr(res.message || 'Gagal.');
                        });
                    };
                }
                if (btnCancel) {
                    btnCancel.onclick = function () { win.close(); };
                }
            }, 100);
        });
    }
    
    // ============================================================
    // ACTION HANDLERS
    // ============================================================
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (!needAccess(ACCESS_ADD, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses.')) return;
        openInvoiceEditor(0);
    };
    
    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) { showErr('Pilih invoice terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'Draft') { showErr('Hanya invoice Draft yang bisa diubah.'); return; }
        if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses.')) return;
        openInvoiceEditor(dataRecord.id);
    };
    
    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord || dataRecord.status !== 'Draft') { showErr('Pilih invoice Draft.'); return; }
        if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses.')) return;
        Ext.Msg.confirm('Hapus Invoice', 'Hapus invoice ' + enc(dataRecord.invoice_no) + '?', function (btn) {
            if (btn !== 'yes') return;
            ajax({ task: 'cancel_invoice', id: dataRecord.id, reason: 'Dihapus oleh user' }, function (res) {
                Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                if (res.success) { dataRecord = null; invoiceDs.load(); dtlDiv.style.display = 'none'; updateMainButtons(); }
            });
        });
    };
    
    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () { document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none'; if (document.getElementById('popCancel')) document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none'; };
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

Ext.onReady(function() {
	Ext.QuickTips.init();
	document.getElementById('addWdw').style.display='block';
	document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function(event) {
    document.getElementById("cst_type").style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
		document.getElementById("saveEdit").style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
		document.getElementById("saveEdit").style.backgroundColor = '#1D6788';
		document.getElementById("saveEdit").style.color = '#fff';
		task='';
		if (formAccess==2 || formAccess==3 || formAccess==4){
			task = 'create';
      gridEditorDs.load({params:{id: 0}});
			document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display='block';
			document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "New Customer";

      var frmEditorHeight=(document.getElementById('editorForm').clientHeight - document.getElementById('editorFormHeader').clientHeight)+5;
      Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').setHeight(frmEditorHeight);

			frmEditor.getForm().reset();
			Ext.getCmp('init').focus('', 10);
			Ext.getCmp('country').setValue('1');

	document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function(event) {
		task='';
		if (formAccess==3 || formAccess==4){
			frmEditor.getForm().reset();
			task = 'update';
			Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().load({
				url:'../php-crud/m.customerCRD.php',
				params:{id: dataRecord.id, task: 'readedit'},
				success:function(form, action) {
					var dt = action.result.data;
          cityDs.load({params: {province_id: dt.province},callback: function(success , r){if(success){Ext.getCmp('city').setValue(dt.city);}}});
          districtDs.load({params: {city_id: dt.city},callback: function(success , r){if(success){Ext.getCmp('district').setValue(dt.district);}}});
          villageDs.load({params: {district_id: dt.district},callback: function(success , r){if(success){Ext.getCmp('village').setValue(dt.village);}}});
          if (dt.cst_type==1) {Ext.getCmp('fsetnpwp').show();npwpNotAllowBlank();} else {Ext.getCmp('fsetnpwp').hide();npwpAllowBlank();}
				}
			});
			document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display='block';
			document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "Edit Customer";

      var frmEditorHeight=(document.getElementById('editorForm').clientHeight - document.getElementById('editorFormHeader').clientHeight)+5;
      Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').setHeight(frmEditorHeight);
      Ext.getCmp('country').getEl().dom.setAttribute('readOnly', true);
      Ext.getCmp('country').readOnly = true;
      document.getElementById("cst_type").style.pointerEvents = 'none';
		}else{
			document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML ='not enough permission to access this window';
			document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';

		task='update';

	document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function(event) {
		var arrContact = new Ext.data.ArrayStore({fields: contactField});
		arrContact.loadData(EmptyArr);
		for (i=0;i<gridEditorDs.data.length;i++){
			var dataFormGrid=gridEditorDs.data.items[i];
			arrContact.add(new addRow({
        cont_id          : dataFormGrid.data.cont_id
        ,name            : dataFormGrid.data.name
        ,position        : dataFormGrid.data.position
        ,cont_phone_id   : dataFormGrid.data.cont_phone_id
        ,phone           : dataFormGrid.data.phone
        ,cont_mobile_id  : dataFormGrid.data.cont_mobile_id
        ,mobile          : dataFormGrid.data.mobile
        ,cont_email_id   : dataFormGrid.data.cont_email_id
        ,email           : dataFormGrid.data.email
        ,cont_address_id : dataFormGrid.data.cont_address_id
        ,address         : dataFormGrid.data.address
        ,remark          : dataFormGrid.data.remark
			}));
		}

		frmEditor.getForm().submit({
			method:'POST',
			params: {
				task          : task
				,cust_type    : Ext.getCmp('customer_l').getValue() || 0
				,ass_addr_off : Ext.getCmp('as_addr').getValue()
				,arrContact   : DsArray2Json(arrContact)
			},
			waitTitle:'Connecting',
			waitMsg:'Sending data...',
			success:function(form,action){
				var objResponse=Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
				var messagesStatus=objResponse.status;
				var messages=objResponse.message;
				/*document.getElementById("popWdwMainHeaderText").innerHTML=messagesStatus;*/
				document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML=messages;
				document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';

				mainDs.load({params:{task: 'read'}});
				frmEditor.getForm().reset();
				document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display='none';
			},
			failure:function(form, action){
				var objResponse=Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
				var messagesStatus=objResponse.status;
				var messages=objResponse.message;
				/*document.getElementById("popWdwMainHeaderText").innerHTML=messagesStatus;*/
				document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML=messages;
				document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';
			}
		});
	};
	document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function(event) {
		if (deleteRow>0) {
			gridEditor.getStore().remove(deleteRecord);
			gridEditor.getView().refresh();
			deleteRow=0;
		}
		if (task=='delete') {
			deleteDs.load({
				params:{task: "delete", id: dataRecord.id }
				,callback:function(records, operation, success){
					document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='none';
					document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display='none';
					task='';

					var textMessages=Ext.util.JSON.decode(operation.callback.caller.caller.arguments[2].responseText);
					var messagesStatus=textMessages.status;
					var messages=textMessages.message;
					/*document.getElementById("popWdwMainHeaderText").innerHTML=messagesStatus;*/
					document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML=messages;
					document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';
				}
			});
			mainDs.load();
			gridMain.getView().refresh(true);
		}
		document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='none';
		document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display='none';
		task='';
	};

    Ext.getCmp('npwp').allowBlank = true;

    Ext.getCmp('province').allowBlank = false;

	document.getElementById('as_addr').onclick = function(event) {
		if (Ext.getCmp('as_addr').getValue()) {
			var addrnpwp = Ext.getCmp('street').getValue()  || '';
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('block').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('block').getValue()=='') ? '' : ' Blok : ' + Ext.getCmp('block').getValue();
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('street_no').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('street_no').getValue()=='') ? '' : ' No : ' + Ext.getCmp('street_no').getValue();
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('rt').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('rt').getValue()=='') ? '' : ' RT : ' + Ext.getCmp('rt').getValue();
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('rw').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('rw').getValue()=='') ? '' : ' RW : ' + Ext.getCmp('rw').getValue();
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('city').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('city').getValue()=='') ? '' : '\n' + Ext.getCmp('city').getRawValue();
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('district').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('district').getValue()=='') ? '' : ' - ' + Ext.getCmp('district').getRawValue();
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('village').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('village').getValue()=='') ? '' : ' - ' + Ext.getCmp('village').getRawValue();
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('postal_code').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('postal_code').getValue()=='') ? '' : ' (' + Ext.getCmp('postal_code').getRawValue() + ')';
			addrnpwp +=	(Ext.getCmp('province').getValue()==null || Ext.getCmp('province').getValue()=='') ? '' : '\n' + Ext.getCmp('province').getRawValue() + ' - Indonesia';
			Ext.getCmp('address').setValue(addrnpwp);
		} else {
			Ext.getCmp('address').setValue('');
		}

==================== FILE: ./js/material.leftover.js ====================
/*
  Document      : material.leftover.js
  Description   : Material Left Over = RETUR SISA MATERIAL PROYEK ke gudang. Material yang sudah di-issue ke proyek (masuk WIP)
                   tetapi tidak terpakai dikembalikan: stok gudang bertambah (biaya = rata-rata issue bersih proyek, membentuk layer FIFO)
                   dan WIP proyek berkurang (Dr Persediaan Bahan Baku / Cr WIP).
                   Tab 1 "Dokumen Retur Sisa": daftar dokumen (klik baris -> detail; Add = retur sisa baru; Delete = reverse).
                   Tab 2 "Posisi per Proyek": per proyek & material: RAB, di-issue, retur sisa, terpakai bersih (qty, nilai, % RAB).
                   Qty retur dibatasi qty issue bersih proyek; reverse hanya bila stok hasil retur belum terpakai.
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/material.leftoverCRD.php
*/
Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Material <em>Left Over</em>";

    var CRD = main_url + '/php-crud/material.leftoverCRD.php';
    var ACCESS_ADD = 2;                 // buat retur sisa
    var ACCESS_EDIT = 3;                // reverse
    var EPS = 0.00005;
    var BTN_CLS = 'field-button grey-field-button';     // gaya tombol template (tombol Ext bawaan tidak terbaca di tema gelap)
    var dataRecord = null;              // dokumen terpilih (tab 1)
    var activeKey = 'docs';

    function getFormAccess() { return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0); }
    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function fmtQty(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
    function fmtAmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    function showErr(msg) { Ext.Msg.show({ title: 'Peringatan', msg: msg, buttons: Ext.Msg.OK, icon: Ext.Msg.WARNING }); }
    function ymd(d) { return d ? d.dateFormat('Y-m-d') : ''; }      // Date.format('Y-m-d') pernah salah di browser (lihat catatan), pakai dateFormat

    function ajax(params, onOk, onFail) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD, method: 'POST', params: params,
            success: function (r) {
                var o;
                try { o = Ext.decode(r.responseText); } catch (e) { showErr('Respons server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).'); return; }
                onOk(o);
            },
            failure: function () { if (onFail) onFail(); else showErr('Gagal menghubungi server.'); }
        });
    }
    function storeError(proxy, type, action, opt, res) {
        var m = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        if (res && res.message) { m = res.message; } else if (res && res.status) { m += ' (HTTP ' + res.status + ')'; }
        showErr(m);
    }
    function jsonStore(task, fields) {
        return new Ext.data.JsonStore({ url: CRD, baseParams: { task: task }, root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount', fields: fields,
                                         listeners: { exception: storeError } });
    }
    var fl = function (n) { return { name: n, type: 'float' }; };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 0. Gaya & kerangka (tab seperti Pengaturan Sistem, tema gelap)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    (function injectCss() {

            '.lo-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;border-bottom:1px solid #123049;padding:0 4px;background:#020d1f;}',
            '.lo-tab{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 20px 9px 14px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;color:#6b869a;user-select:none;}',

            '.lo-tab svg{width:24px;height:24px;stroke:#6b869a;fill:none;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;}',
            '.lo-tab .tt{display:block;font:bold 13px arial;color:#aebfcc;} .lo-tab .st{display:block;font:11px arial;color:#6b869a;margin-top:1px;}',
            '.lo-tab.active{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(43,193,226,.04),rgba(43,193,226,.16));border-bottom-color:#2bc1e2;}',
            '.lo-tab.active svg{stroke:#2bc1e2;} .lo-tab.active .tt{color:#2bc1e2;} .lo-tab.active .st{color:#7fa3b8;}',
            '.lo-filter{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:10px 8px;color:#9fc3d1;font:13px arial;}',
            '.lo-filter select{background:#031126;border:1px solid #1d4a6b;color:#e6f1f8;height:26px;padding:0 8px;font:13px arial;border-radius:2px;min-width:240px;}',
            '.lo-filter .btn{padding:5px 14px;border:none;border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer;color:#fff;font:bold 12px arial;background:#03615e;}',
            '.lo-panel{padding:0 8px 8px 8px;}'
        ].join('\n');
        var st = document.createElement('style');
        st.type = 'text/css';
        st.appendChild(document.createTextNode(css));
        document.head.appendChild(st);
    })();

    var grids = {};
    function showTab(key) {
        activeKey = key;
        Ext.each(TABS, function (t) {
            document.getElementById('loTab_' + t.key).className = 'lo-tab' + (t.key === key ? ' active' : '');
            document.getElementById('loPanel_' + t.key).style.display = (t.key === key) ? 'block' : 'none';
        });
        if (!grids[key]) grids[key] = builders[key]();          // dibuat saat tab pertama dibuka (container visible -> lebar kolom benar)
        updateButtons();
    }
    Ext.each(TABS, function (t) { document.getElementById('loTab_' + t.key).onclick = function () { showTab(t.key); }; });

    function updateButtons() {
        mainBtnEnable('#addData');
        if (activeKey === 'docs' && dataRecord && dataRecord.status === 'posted') mainBtnEnable('#deleteData'); else mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
        mainBtnDisable('#editData');
    }
    editDataDisable();

    // Detail dokumen
    function loadDetail(rec) {
        var el = document.getElementById('loDtl');
        ajax({ task: 'detail', id: rec.id }, function (res) {
            if (!res.success) { el.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;padding:10px;">' + enc(res.message) + '</div>'; el.style.display = 'block'; return; }
            var tot = 0;
            var t = '<h3 class="detail-title">Dokumen: ' + enc(rec.ref_no) + ' <span style="font-weight:normal;">(' + enc(rec.project_name) + ' &rarr; ' + enc(rec.warehouse_name) + ')</span></h3><hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                    '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0"><thead><tr class="header-row"><th align="left">Material</th>' +
                    '<th align="right">Qty</th><th align="right">Biaya Satuan</th><th align="right">Nilai</th><th align="left">Catatan</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
            Ext.each(res.data, function (r) {
                tot += r.amount;
                t += '<tr class="data-row"><td>' + enc(r.material_name) + ' <span style="color:#668894;">(' + enc(r.material_code) + ')</span></td><td align="right">' + fmtQty(r.qty) + ' ' + enc(r.unit) +
                     '</td><td align="right">' + fmtAmt(r.unit_cost) + '</td><td align="right">' + fmtAmt(r.amount) + '</td><td>' + enc(r.notes || '') + '</td></tr>';
            });
            t += '<tr class="data-row"><td colspan="3" align="right"><b>Total</b></td><td align="right" class="subtotal-val"><b>' + fmtAmt(tot) + '</b></td><td></td></tr></tbody></table>';
            el.innerHTML = t;
            el.style.display = 'block';
        });
    }

    function openEditor() {
        editStore.removeAll();
        var fProject = new Ext.form.ComboBox({
            fieldLabel: 'Proyek', store: projectDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all',
            forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, anchor: '95%',
            listeners: { select: function () { editStore.removeAll(); fMat.clearValue(); } }
        });
        var fWh = new Ext.form.ComboBox({
            fieldLabel: 'Gudang Tujuan', store: warehouseDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all',
            forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, anchor: '95%'
        });
        var fDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), allowBlank: false, width: 120 });
        var fRemark = new Ext.form.TextField({ fieldLabel: 'Catatan', anchor: '95%' });

        var fMat = new Ext.form.ComboBox({
            store: materialDs, displayField: 'material_name', valueField: 'material_id', mode: 'remote', queryParam: 'query', minChars: 0,
            triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, width: 400, listWidth: 540, emptyText: 'Cari material yang pernah di-issue ke proyek...',
            tpl: '<tpl for="."><div class="x-combo-list-item">{material_code} - {material_name} <b>(issue bersih {net_qty} {unit}, biaya rata-rata {avg_cost})</b></div></tpl>',
            listeners: {
                beforequery: function () {
                    if (!fProject.getValue()) { showErr('Pilih proyek terlebih dahulu.'); return false; }
                    materialDs.baseParams.project_id = fProject.getValue();
                }
            }
        });
        function addMaterial() {
            var rec = fMat.findRecord('material_id', fMat.getValue());
            if (!rec) { showErr('Pilih material terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
            if (editStore.find('material_id', rec.get('material_id')) >= 0) { showErr('Material sudah ada di daftar.'); return; }
            var R = editStore.recordType;
            editStore.add(new R({
                material_id: rec.get('material_id'), material_code: rec.get('material_code'), material_name: rec.get('material_name'), unit: rec.get('unit'),
                net_qty: rec.get('net_qty'), avg_cost: rec.get('avg_cost'), qty: rec.get('net_qty'), notes: ''
            }));
            fMat.clearValue();
        }
        var detailGrid = new Ext.grid.EditorGridPanel({
            region: 'center', store: editStore, clicksToEdit: 1, stripeRows: true, viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
            tbar: [fMat, { text: 'Tambah', cls: BTN_CLS, handler: addMaterial }],
            bbar: ['Qty retur dibatasi qty issue bersih proyek. Nilai = biaya rata-rata issue bersih; WIP proyek berkurang sebesar nilai ini.'],
            columns: [
                { header: 'Kode', dataIndex: 'material_code', width: 80 },
                { header: 'Material', dataIndex: 'material_name', width: 200 },
                { header: 'Sat', dataIndex: 'unit', width: 45, align: 'center' },
                { header: 'Issue Bersih', dataIndex: 'net_qty', width: 100, align: 'right', renderer: fmtQty },
                { header: 'Biaya Rata-rata', dataIndex: 'avg_cost', width: 105, align: 'right', renderer: fmtAmt },
                { header: 'Qty Retur Sisa', dataIndex: 'qty', width: 100, align: 'right', renderer: fmtQty, editor: new Ext.form.NumberField({ allowNegative: false, decimalPrecision: 4 }) },
                { header: 'Nilai', dataIndex: 'qty', width: 110, align: 'right', renderer: function (v, m, r) { return fmtAmt(Math.round(v * r.get('avg_cost') * 100) / 100); } },
                { header: 'Catatan', dataIndex: 'notes', width: 150, editor: new Ext.form.TextField() },
                { header: '', dataIndex: 'material_id', width: 30, align: 'center', fixed: true,
                  renderer: function () { return '<span style="color:#e05353;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;">&#10005;</span>'; } }
            ],
            listeners: {
                validateedit: function (e) {
                    if (e.field === 'qty' && parseFloat(e.value) > e.record.get('net_qty') + EPS) {
                        showErr('Qty melebihi issue bersih proyek (' + fmtQty(e.record.get('net_qty')) + ').');
                        e.cancel = true;
                    }
                },
                cellclick: function (g, row, col) { if (col === g.getColumnModel().getColumnCount() - 1) g.getStore().removeAt(row); }
            }
        });
        var form = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
            region: 'north', height: 110, border: false, layout: 'column', bodyStyle: 'padding:8px 6px 0 6px;',
            items: [
                { columnWidth: 0.5, layout: 'form', border: false, labelWidth: 110, items: [fProject, fWh, fDate] },
                { columnWidth: 0.5, layout: 'form', border: false, labelWidth: 110, items: [fRemark] }
            ]
        });
        var win = new Ext.Window({
            title: 'Retur Sisa Material (Left Over) Baru', width: 960, height: 560, modal: true, layout: 'border', items: [form, detailGrid],
            buttons: [
                { text: 'Simpan & Posting', cls: BTN_CLS, handler: function () {
                    if (!fProject.getValue() || !fWh.getValue() || !fDate.getValue()) { showErr('Proyek, gudang tujuan, dan tanggal wajib diisi.'); return; }
                    var arr = [], err = '';
                    editStore.each(function (r) {
                        var q = parseFloat(r.get('qty')) || 0;
                        if (q <= 0) { err = 'Qty retur ' + r.get('material_name') + ' harus lebih besar dari 0.'; return false; }
                        arr.push({ material_id: r.get('material_id'), qty: q, notes: r.get('notes') || '' });
                    });
                    if (err) { showErr(err); return; }
                    if (!arr.length) { showErr('Tambahkan minimal satu material.'); return; }
                    ajax({ task: 'save', project_id: fProject.getValue(), warehouse_id: fWh.getValue(), doc_date: ymd(fDate.getValue()),
                           remark: fRemark.getValue(), details: Ext.util.JSON.encode(arr) }, function (res) {
                        if (res.success) { win.close(); Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message); loadAll(); }
                        else showErr(res.message || 'Proses gagal.');
                    });
                } },
                { text: 'Batal', cls: BTN_CLS, handler: function () { win.close(); } }
            ]
        });
        win.show();
        projectDs.load();
        warehouseDs.load();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Tombol template
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_ADD) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membuat retur sisa material.'); return; }
        openEditor();
    };
    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {      // Delete = Reverse dokumen
        if (!dataRecord) { showErr('Pilih dokumen terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'posted') { showErr('Hanya dokumen posted yang dapat di-reverse.'); return; }
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_EDIT) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk reverse dokumen.'); return; }
        Ext.Msg.confirm('Reverse Retur Sisa', 'Reverse dokumen <b>' + enc(dataRecord.ref_no) + '</b>? Stok hasil retur ditarik kembali dan jurnal dibatalkan.', function (b) {
            if (b !== 'yes') return;
            ajax({ task: 'reverse', id: dataRecord.id }, function (res) {
                Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                if (res.success) { dataRecord = null; document.getElementById('loDtl').style.display = 'none'; loadAll(); updateButtons(); }
            });
        });
    };
    if (document.getElementById('popOK')) document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () { document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none'; };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Data awal
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    showTab('docs');
    projectDs.load({ callback: function () {
        projectDs.each(function (r) {
            var o = document.createElement('option');
            o.value = r.get('id'); o.text = r.get('name');
            selProject.appendChild(o);
        });
    } });
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
    loadAll();
});

==================== FILE: ./js/project.progress.m.js ====================
/*
  Document      : project.progress.m.js
  Description   : Lapor Progress untuk HP (Android/iPhone). TANPA ExtJS (vanilla JS + PWA).
                  Memakai ULANG backend modul desktop (project.progressCRD.php): lapangan mengajukan KLAIM
                  (persen + bukti) -> office memverifikasi di desktop (akses level 3) -> baru projects.progress berubah.
                  - Foto bukti dikompres di HP lalu diunggah (task upload_evidence), URL-nya masuk evidence_ref
                  - OFFLINE: klaim + foto disimpan di IndexedDB, dikirim otomatis saat online / aplikasi dibuka
                  - Aturan server (tetap berlaku): persen > progress terverifikasi, bukti wajib, hanya 1 klaim menunggu per proyek,
                    proyek berstatus Berjalan / Tertunda
  Backend       : /rab-project/dev/php-crud/project.progressCRD.php
*/
(function () {
    'use strict';

    var CRD = window.APP_BASE_URL + 'php-crud/project.progressCRD.php';
    var ACCESS_REPORT = 2;                                  // samakan dengan PROG_ACCESS_REPORT di backend
    var MAX_PHOTOS = 5, MAX_SIDE = 1280, JPEG_Q = 0.75;
    var LS_PROJECTS = 'prg_claim_projects_cache';

    var projects = [];         // daftar proyek terakhir dari server / cache
    var cur = null;            // proyek terpilih
    var photos = [];           // [{blob, url}] foto laporan yang sedang diisi
    var geo = null;            // {lat, lng}
    var syncing = false;

    function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
    function esc(v) { var d = document.createElement('div'); d.textContent = v == null ? '' : v; return d.innerHTML; }
    function escA(v) { return esc(v).replace(/"/g, '&quot;'); }
    function todayStr() { var d = new Date(), m = d.getMonth() + 1, dd = d.getDate(); return d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : m) + '-' + (dd < 10 ? '0' + dd : dd); }
    function uuid() {
        if (window.crypto && crypto.randomUUID) return crypto.randomUUID();
        return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function (c) {
            var r = Math.random() * 16 | 0; return (c === 'x' ? r : (r & 3 | 8)).toString(16);
        });
    }
    function showMsg(t, type) {
        var m = $('msg'); m.textContent = t; m.className = 'msg ' + (type || '');
        if (type === 'ok') setTimeout(function () { m.className = 'msg hidden'; }, 4000);
    }
    function hideMsg() { $('msg').className = 'msg hidden'; }
    function canReportStatus(p) { return p && (p.status === 'Berjalan' || p.status === 'Tertunda'); }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 0. Jaringan
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // GET (params) / POST (formData). Error jaringan -> reject {offline:true}; 401 -> reject {auth:true}
    function api(params, formData) {
        var opt = { credentials: 'same-origin' }, url = CRD;
        if (formData) { opt.method = 'POST'; opt.body = formData; }
        else { url += '?' + Object.keys(params).map(function (k) { return encodeURIComponent(k) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(params[k]); }).join('&'); }
        return fetch(url, opt).then(function (r) {
            if (r.status === 401) return Promise.reject({ auth: true });
            return r.json().catch(function () { return Promise.reject({ message: 'Respons server tidak valid.' }); });
        }, function () { return Promise.reject({ offline: true }); });
    }
    function post(fields) {
        var fd = new FormData();
        Object.keys(fields).forEach(function (k) { fd.append(k, fields[k]); });
        return api(null, fd);
    }
    function updateNet() {
        var p = $('pillNet'); p.textContent = navigator.onLine ? 'online' : 'offline'; p.className = 'pill' + (navigator.onLine ? '' : ' off');
    }
    function netErr(e) {
        if (e && e.auth) return 'Sesi berakhir. Buka ulang halaman & login.';
        if (e && e.offline) return 'Tidak ada koneksi.';
        return (e && e.message) || 'Gagal.';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. IndexedDB (antrean klaim offline)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var dbp = null;
    function openDb() {
        if (dbp) return dbp;
        dbp = new Promise(function (res, rej) {
            var rq = indexedDB.open('prgClaimQueue', 1);
            rq.onupgradeneeded = function () { rq.result.createObjectStore('queue', { keyPath: 'uuid' }); };
            rq.onsuccess = function () { res(rq.result); };
            rq.onerror = function () { rej(rq.error); };
        });
        return dbp;
    }
    function tx(mode, fn) {
        return openDb().then(function (db) {
            return new Promise(function (res, rej) {
                var t = db.transaction('queue', mode), s = t.objectStore('queue'), out = fn(s);
                t.oncomplete = function () { res(out && out.result !== undefined ? out.result : undefined); };
                t.onerror = function () { rej(t.error); };
            });
        });
    }
    function qPut(item) { return tx('readwrite', function (s) { return s.put(item); }); }
    function qDel(id) { return tx('readwrite', function (s) { return s.delete(id); }); }
    function qAll() { return tx('readonly', function (s) { return s.getAll(); }).then(function (r) { return r || []; }); }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Daftar proyek (cache localStorage agar tetap tampil saat offline)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function normalize(list) {
        return (list || []).map(function (p) {
            return { id: p.id, name: p.name, status: p.status, progress: parseInt(p.progress, 10) || 0, pending_count: parseInt(p.pending_count, 10) || 0 };
        });
    }
    function refreshProjects() {
        return api({ task: 'list_projects' }).then(function (res) {
            if (!res.success) { showMsg(res.message || 'Gagal memuat proyek.', 'err'); return; }
            projects = normalize(res.data);
            try { localStorage.setItem(LS_PROJECTS, JSON.stringify(projects)); } catch (e) {}
            renderProjects();
            if (cur) { for (var i = 0; i < projects.length; i++) if (projects[i].id === cur.id) cur = projects[i]; applyProjectState(); }
        }, function (e) {
            if (e.auth) showMsg(netErr(e), 'err');
        });
    }
    function loadProjects() {
        var cached = null;
        try { cached = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_PROJECTS) || 'null'); } catch (e) {}
        if (cached) { projects = cached; renderProjects(); }
        refreshProjects().then(function () {
            if (!projects.length) showMsg('Daftar proyek belum tersedia. Buka sekali saat online.', 'err');
        });
    }
    function renderProjects() {
        var h = '';
        projects.forEach(function (p) {
            h += '<div class="card prj" data-id="' + p.id + '"><div class="nm">' + esc(p.name) +
                 (p.pending_count > 0 ? '<span class="tag">' + p.pending_count + ' menunggu verifikasi</span>' : '') + '</div>' +
                 '<div class="sub">' + esc(p.status || '') + ' &middot; terverifikasi ' + p.progress + '%</div>' +
                 '<div class="bar"><i style="width:' + p.progress + '%"></i></div></div>';
        });
        $('prjList').innerHTML = h || '<div class="card">Belum ada proyek.</div>';
        var cards = $('prjList').querySelectorAll('.prj');
        for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
            cards[i].onclick = (function (el) {
                return function () {
                    var id = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-id'), 10);
                    for (var k = 0; k < projects.length; k++) if (projects[k].id === id) openProject(projects[k]);
                };
            })(cards[i]);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Form klaim
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function openProject(p) {
        cur = p; hideMsg();
        $('vList').className = 'hidden'; $('vForm').className = '';
        $('btnBack').className = 'sec'; $('ttl').textContent = p.name;
        $('fDate').value = todayStr(); $('fNotes').value = ''; $('fEvid').value = '';
        clearPhotos(); geo = null; $('btnGps').textContent = 'Lokasi: -';
        applyProjectState();
        renderQueueBox(); loadHistory();
        if (navigator.onLine) refreshProjects();          // ambil progress terverifikasi & status klaim terbaru
    }
    function backToList() {
        cur = null; $('vForm').className = 'hidden'; $('vList').className = '';
        $('btnBack').className = 'sec hidden'; $('ttl').textContent = 'Lapor Progress'; hideMsg();
        renderProjects();
    }
    // Atur form sesuai kondisi proyek (status, progress terverifikasi, klaim menunggu)
    function applyProjectState() {
        if (!cur) return;
        var info = 'Progress terverifikasi: <b>' + cur.progress + '%</b>. Klaim harus lebih besar dan akan diverifikasi office sebelum berlaku.';
        var blocked = '';
        if (window.formAccess < ACCESS_REPORT) blocked = 'Anda tidak memiliki akses untuk melapor progress.';
        else if (!canReportStatus(cur)) blocked = 'Proyek berstatus ' + esc(cur.status) + ': progress tidak dapat dilaporkan.';
        else if (cur.progress >= 100) blocked = 'Progress sudah 100%.';
        else if (cur.pending_count > 0) blocked = 'Masih ada klaim yang menunggu verifikasi. Tunggu office memverifikasi atau batalkan klaim tersebut.';
        $('projInfo').innerHTML = info + (blocked ? '<br><span style="color:#e6a817;">' + blocked + '</span>' : '');
        $('frmCard').className = (blocked && cur.pending_count === 0) ? 'card hidden' : 'card';
        $('btnSave').disabled = !!blocked;
        if (!blocked) { var cp = parseInt($('fPct').value, 10); if (isNaN(cp) || cp <= cur.progress) setPct(Math.min(100, cur.progress + 1)); }
    }
    function setPct(v) {
        v = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(parseFloat(v) || 0)));
        $('fRange').value = v; $('fPct').value = v; $('lblPct').textContent = v;
    }

    // Kompres foto: sisi terpanjang <= 1280px, JPEG 75%. Gagal (mis. HEIC) -> pakai file asli bila < 5 MB.
    function compress(file) {
        return new Promise(function (res, rej) {
            var img = new Image(), url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
            img.onload = function () {
                var w = img.naturalWidth, h = img.naturalHeight, r = Math.min(1, MAX_SIDE / Math.max(w, h));
                var c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = Math.round(w * r); c.height = Math.round(h * r);
                c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                c.toBlob(function (b) { b ? res(b) : rej(new Error('compress')); }, 'image/jpeg', JPEG_Q);
            };
            img.onerror = function () {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                if (file.size < 5 * 1024 * 1024 && /^image\/(jpeg|png|webp)$/.test(file.type)) res(file); else rej(new Error('format'));
            };
            img.src = url;
        });
    }
    function renderThumbs() {
        var h = '';
        photos.forEach(function (p, i) { h += '<div><img src="' + p.url + '"><b data-i="' + i + '">&times;</b></div>'; });
        $('thumbs').innerHTML = h;
        var xs = $('thumbs').querySelectorAll('b');
        for (var i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) xs[i].onclick = function () {
            var k = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-i'), 10); URL.revokeObjectURL(photos[k].url); photos.splice(k, 1); renderThumbs();
        };
    }
    function clearPhotos() { photos.forEach(function (p) { URL.revokeObjectURL(p.url); }); photos = []; renderThumbs(); }

    function getGps() {
        if (!navigator.geolocation) { showMsg('GPS tidak tersedia di perangkat ini.', 'err'); return; }
        $('btnGps').textContent = 'Lokasi: mencari...';
        navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function (pos) {
            geo = { lat: pos.coords.latitude, lng: pos.coords.longitude };
            $('btnGps').textContent = 'Lokasi: ' + geo.lat.toFixed(5) + ', ' + geo.lng.toFixed(5);
        }, function (err) {
            geo = null; $('btnGps').textContent = 'Lokasi: gagal (ketuk untuk ulangi)';
            var why = 'Lokasi gagal diambil.';
            if (!window.isSecureContext) why = 'Lokasi hanya bisa dipakai lewat HTTPS. Alamat saat ini bukan HTTPS.';
            else if (err && err.code === 1) why = 'Izin lokasi ditolak. Aktifkan izin lokasi untuk situs ini, lalu ulangi.';
            else if (err && err.code === 2) why = 'Posisi tidak tersedia. Nyalakan GPS / Lokasi di HP, lalu coba di tempat terbuka.';
            else if (err && err.code === 3) why = 'Pencarian lokasi terlalu lama (timeout). Coba lagi di tempat terbuka.';
            showMsg(why + ' Klaim tetap bisa diajukan tanpa lokasi.', 'err');
        }, { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 15000, maximumAge: 60000 });
    }

    function saveReport() {
        if (!cur) return;
        if (window.formAccess < ACCESS_REPORT) { showMsg('Anda tidak memiliki akses untuk melapor progress.', 'err'); return; }
        var pct = parseInt($('fPct').value, 10), date = $('fDate').value, evid = $('fEvid').value.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
        if (isNaN(pct) || pct < 0 || pct > 100) { showMsg('Persentase harus 0 - 100.', 'err'); return; }
        if (pct <= cur.progress) { showMsg('Klaim harus lebih besar dari progress terverifikasi (' + cur.progress + '%).', 'err'); return; }
        if (!date) { showMsg('Tanggal wajib diisi.', 'err'); return; }
        if (date > todayStr()) { showMsg('Tanggal laporan tidak boleh di masa depan.', 'err'); return; }
        if (!photos.length && !evid) { showMsg('Bukti wajib: ambil foto atau isi no. BAP.', 'err'); return; }

        $('btnSave').disabled = true;
        qAll().then(function (items) {
            for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                if (items[i].project_id === cur.id) { throw { dup: true }; }    // server hanya mengizinkan 1 klaim menunggu per proyek
            }
            var gpsLine = geo ? ('[GPS: ' + geo.lat.toFixed(6) + ', ' + geo.lng.toFixed(6) + ']') : '';
            var note = $('fNotes').value.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
            return qPut({
                uuid: uuid(), project_id: cur.id, project_name: cur.name, report_date: date, percent: pct,
                note: (note + (note && gpsLine ? ' ' : '') + gpsLine), evid: evid,
                photos: photos.map(function (p) { return p.blob; }), urls: [], submitTried: false, created: Date.now(), error: ''
            });
        }).then(function () {
            clearPhotos(); $('fNotes').value = ''; $('fEvid').value = ''; geo = null; $('btnGps').textContent = 'Lokasi: -';
            return renderQueueBox();
        }).then(function () { return syncQueue(true); }).then(function () {
            applyProjectState();
        }, function (e) {
            applyProjectState();
            if (e && e.dup) showMsg('Sudah ada klaim proyek ini yang antre. Tunggu terkirim dulu.', 'err');
            else showMsg('Gagal menyimpan ke penyimpanan perangkat (ruang penuh / mode privat).', 'err');
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Antrean & sinkronisasi
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function uploadOne(blob) {
        var ext = blob.type === 'image/png' ? 'png' : (blob.type === 'image/webp' ? 'webp' : 'jpg');
        var fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('task', 'upload_evidence');
        fd.append('file', blob, 'foto.' + ext);
        return api(null, fd);
    }
    // Cek apakah klaim yang sama sudah masuk (respons terputus setelah server menyimpan) -> hindari klaim ganda
    function alreadySubmitted(it) {
        if (!it.submitTried) return Promise.resolve(false);
        return api({ task: 'list_log', project_id: it.project_id }).then(function (res) {
            if (!res.success) return false;
            for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
                var r = res.data[i];
                if ((r.status === 'Diajukan' || r.status === 'Diverifikasi') && r.percent_claimed === it.percent &&
                    r.report_date === it.report_date && r.reported_by === res.user_id) return true;
            }
            return false;
        });
    }
    // Hasil: 'sent' | 'rejected' (ditolak server, perlu tindakan user). Error jaringan/sesi -> reject ke pemanggil.
    function sendItem(it) {
        function nextPhoto() {
            if (!it.photos.length) return Promise.resolve(true);
            return uploadOne(it.photos[0]).then(function (res) {
                if (!res.success) { it.error = res.message || 'Unggah foto ditolak.'; return qPut(it).then(function () { return false; }); }
                it.urls.push(res.data.url); it.photos.shift();            // foto yang sudah terunggah tidak diunggah ulang
                return qPut(it).then(nextPhoto);
            });
        }
        return nextPhoto().then(function (ok) {
            if (!ok) return 'rejected';
            return alreadySubmitted(it).then(function (found) {
                if (found) return qDel(it.uuid).then(function () { return 'sent'; });
                var lines = it.urls.slice(0);
                if (it.evid) lines.push(it.evid);                                // format sama dengan modul desktop: satu bukti per baris
                it.submitTried = true;
                return qPut(it).then(function () {
                    return post({ task: 'submit_claim', project_id: it.project_id, report_date: it.report_date,
                                  percent_claimed: it.percent, evidence_ref: lines.join('\n'), note: it.note || '' });
                }).then(function (res) {
                    if (res.success) return qDel(it.uuid).then(function () { return 'sent'; });
                    it.error = res.message || 'Ditolak server.';
                    return qPut(it).then(function () { return 'rejected'; });
                });
            });
        });
    }

    function syncQueue(announce) {
        if (syncing) return Promise.resolve();
        if (!navigator.onLine) {
            return updateQueuePill().then(function () { if (announce) showMsg('Offline: klaim tersimpan di HP dan akan dikirim saat ada sinyal.', 'ok'); });
        }
        syncing = true;
        return qAll().then(function (items) {
            items = items.filter(function (i) { return !i.error; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.created - b.created; });
            var sent = 0, rejected = 0, stopMsg = '';
            return items.reduce(function (chain, it) {
                return chain.then(function () {
                    if (stopMsg) return;
                    return sendItem(it).then(function (r) { if (r === 'sent') sent++; else rejected++; },
                        function (e) { stopMsg = (e && e.auth) ? 'Sesi berakhir. Klaim tetap aman di HP - buka ulang halaman, login, lalu kirim lagi.'
                                                : (e && e.offline) ? 'Sinyal terputus. Klaim tersimpan di HP dan akan dicoba lagi.' : (e.message || 'Gagal mengirim.'); });
                });
            }, Promise.resolve()).then(function () {
                syncing = false;
                if (stopMsg) showMsg(stopMsg, 'err');
                else if (rejected > 0) showMsg(rejected + ' klaim ditolak server. Lihat bagian Antrean.', 'err');
                else if (sent > 0) showMsg(sent + ' klaim terkirim, menunggu verifikasi office.', 'ok');
                return Promise.all([renderQueueBox(), cur ? loadHistory() : null, sent > 0 ? refreshProjects() : null]);
            });
        }).catch(function () { syncing = false; });
    }

    function updateQueuePill() {
        return qAll().then(function (items) {
            var p = $('pillQ');
            if (items.length) { p.textContent = items.length + ' antre'; p.className = 'pill q'; } else { p.className = 'pill q hidden'; }
            return items;
        });
    }
    function renderQueueBox() {
        return updateQueuePill().then(function (items) {
            var h = '';
            items.filter(function (i) { return !cur || i.project_id === cur.id; }).forEach(function (it) {
                var n = (it.photos || []).length + (it.urls || []).length;
                h += '<div class="card"><b>' + esc(it.percent) + '%</b> &middot; ' + esc(it.report_date) + ' &middot; ' + n + ' foto' +
                     (cur ? '' : ' &middot; ' + esc(it.project_name)) +
                     '<div style="color:' + (it.error ? '#ff8a7d' : '#e6a817') + ';font-size:13px;">' +
                     (it.error ? 'DITOLAK: ' + esc(it.error) : 'Menunggu dikirim...') + '</div>' +
                     (it.error ? '<div class="row" style="margin-top:8px"><button class="sec" data-retry="' + escA(it.uuid) + '">Kirim ulang</button>' +
                                 '<button class="danger" data-del="' + escA(it.uuid) + '">Hapus</button></div>' : '') + '</div>';
            });
            $('qBox').innerHTML = h ? '<h2>Antrean (belum terkirim)</h2>' + h : '';
            var ds = $('qBox').querySelectorAll('[data-del]');
            for (var i = 0; i < ds.length; i++) ds[i].onclick = function () {
                if (window.confirm('Hapus klaim dari antrean? Foto di HP ikut terhapus.')) qDel(this.getAttribute('data-del')).then(renderQueueBox);
            };
            var rs = $('qBox').querySelectorAll('[data-retry]');
            for (var j = 0; j < rs.length; j++) rs[j].onclick = function () {
                var id = this.getAttribute('data-retry');
                qAll().then(function (all) {
                    for (var k = 0; k < all.length; k++) if (all[k].uuid === id) { all[k].error = ''; return qPut(all[k]); }
                }).then(function () { return syncQueue(true); });
            };
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Riwayat klaim (online saja) + batalkan klaim sendiri yang masih Diajukan
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function statusColor(s) { return s === 'Diverifikasi' ? '#2e9e4f' : (s === 'Diajukan' ? '#e6a817' : '#c0392b'); }
    function renderEvidence(v) {
        var out = '', texts = [];
        String(v || '').split(/\r?\n/).forEach(function (l) {
            l = l.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
            if (!l) return;

            // Normalisasi URL foto lama agar mengikuti base URL DEV/LIVE.
            var base = String(window.APP_BASE_URL || '/');
            if (base.charAt(base.length - 1) !== '/') base += '/';

            var match = l.match(/^(?:https?:\/\/[^/]+)?\/(?:proyek|rab-project)\/uploads\/progress\/(.+)$/i)
                     || l.match(/^(?:https?:\/\/[^/]+)?\/uploads\/progress\/(.+)$/i);

            if (match) {
                l = base + 'uploads/progress/' + match[1];
            }

            if (!/^(https?:\/\/|\/)/i.test(l)) { texts.push(esc(l)); return; }
            if (/\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp)(\?.*)?$/i.test(l)) out += '<a href="' + escA(l) + '" target="_blank"><img loading="lazy" src="' + escA(l) + '"></a>';
            else texts.push('<a href="' + escA(l) + '" target="_blank" style="color:#7fe0a0;">Berkas</a>');
        });
        return (texts.length ? '<div class="meta">Bukti: ' + texts.join(' | ') + '</div>' : '') + (out ? '<div class="thumbs">' + out + '</div>' : '');
    }
    function loadHistory() {
        if (!cur) return Promise.resolve();
        $('hist').innerHTML = '<div class="card">Memuat...</div>';
        return api({ task: 'list_log', project_id: cur.id }).then(function (res) {
            if (!res.success) { $('hist').innerHTML = '<div class="card">' + esc(res.message || 'Gagal memuat riwayat.') + '</div>'; return; }
            var h = '';
            res.data.forEach(function (r) {
                h += '<div class="card hist"><span class="st" style="color:' + statusColor(r.status) + ';">' + esc(r.status) + '</span>' +
                     '<span class="pct">' + esc(r.percent_claimed) + '%</span> <span class="meta">(dari ' + esc(r.prev_percent) + '%) &middot; ' + esc(r.report_date) +
                     ' &middot; ' + esc(r.reporter_name || '-') + '</span>' +
                     (r.note ? '<div>' + esc(r.note) + '</div>' : '') + renderEvidence(r.evidence_ref) +
                     (r.verified_at ? '<div class="meta" style="margin-top:6px;">' + esc(r.status) + ' oleh ' + esc(r.verifier_name || '-') +
                                      (r.verify_note ? ': ' + esc(r.verify_note) : '') + '</div>' : '');
                if (r.status === 'Diajukan' && r.reported_by === res.user_id && window.formAccess >= ACCESS_REPORT) {
                    h += '<div style="margin-top:8px"><button class="danger" data-cancel="' + r.id + '">Batalkan klaim</button></div>';
                }
                h += '</div>';
            });
            $('hist').innerHTML = h || '<div class="card">Belum ada klaim progress.</div>';
            var cs = $('hist').querySelectorAll('[data-cancel]');
            for (var i = 0; i < cs.length; i++) cs[i].onclick = function () {
                var id = this.getAttribute('data-cancel');
                if (!window.confirm('Batalkan klaim ini?')) return;
                post({ task: 'cancel_claim', id: id }).then(function (r) {
                    showMsg(r.message || (r.success ? 'Klaim dibatalkan.' : 'Gagal.'), r.success ? 'ok' : 'err');
                    loadHistory(); refreshProjects();
                }, function (e) { showMsg(netErr(e), 'err'); });
            };
        }, function (e) {
            $('hist').innerHTML = '<div class="card">' + (e.offline ? 'Offline - riwayat tidak tersedia.' : esc(netErr(e))) + '</div>';
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. Init
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    $('btnBack').onclick = backToList;
    $('btnGps').onclick = getGps;
    $('btnSave').onclick = saveReport;
    $('btnPhoto').onclick = function () {
        if (photos.length >= MAX_PHOTOS) { showMsg('Maksimal ' + MAX_PHOTOS + ' foto.', 'err'); return; }
        $('fPhoto').click();
    };
    $('fPhoto').onchange = function () {
        var files = Array.prototype.slice.call(this.files || []), self = this;
        files.reduce(function (chain, f) {
            return chain.then(function () {
                if (photos.length >= MAX_PHOTOS) return;
                return compress(f).then(function (b) { photos.push({ blob: b, url: URL.createObjectURL(b) }); },
                                        function () { showMsg('Foto ' + f.name + ' tidak dapat diproses (gunakan JPG/PNG).', 'err'); });
            });
        }, Promise.resolve()).then(function () { renderThumbs(); self.value = ''; });
    };
    $('fRange').oninput = function () { setPct(this.value); };
    $('fPct').onchange = function () { setPct(this.value); };

    window.addEventListener('online', function () { updateNet(); syncQueue(false); });
    window.addEventListener('offline', updateNet);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (!document.hidden) syncQueue(false); });   // iOS tanpa Background Sync

    updateNet();
    updateQueuePill();
    loadProjects();
    syncQueue(false);

    // Minta penyimpanan permanen agar antrean (foto) tidak dihapus browser (terutama iOS/Safari)
    if (navigator.storage && navigator.storage.persist) { navigator.storage.persist(); }

    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator && window.APP_BASE_URL) {
        var base = window.APP_BASE_URL;

        navigator.serviceWorker.register(base + 'sw.progress.js', {
            scope: base
        }).catch(function (error) {
            console.error('Service Worker registration gagal:', error);
        });
    }
})();
