    function storeError(proxy, type, action, opt, res) {
        var m = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        if (res && res.message) { m = res.message; }
        else if (res && res.status) { m += ' (HTTP ' + res.status + ')'; }
        showErr(m);
    }
    function jsonStore(task, fields, extra) {
        var cfg = {
            url: CRD, baseParams: { task: task }, root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount', fields: fields,
            listeners: { exception: storeError }
        };
        return new Ext.data.JsonStore(Ext.apply(cfg, extra || {}));
    }

        document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () {
            var p = filterParams();
            window.open('../dev/pdf/ppn.report.php?year=' + p.year + '&month=' + p.month + '&project_id=' + p.project_id,
                        '_blank', 'width=1100,height=800,scrollbars=yes,resizable=yes');
        };
    }

    // Total & status kurang/lebih bayar dari respons list_summary
    mainDs.on('load', function (store) {
        var el = document.getElementById('ppnTotals');
        var t = (store.reader.jsonData || {}).totals;
        if (!el) return;
        if (!t) { el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
        var net = parseFloat(t.net_ppn) || 0;
        var label = net > 0 ? 'PPN KURANG BAYAR' : (net < 0 ? 'PPN LEBIH BAYAR (dapat dikompensasi)' : 'PPN NIHIL');
        var color = net > 0 ? '#ff6b5e' : '#7fe0a0';
        el.innerHTML = 'PPN Keluaran <b style="color:#e6f1f8;">' + fmtAmt(t.keluaran_ppn) + '</b> &nbsp;-&nbsp; PPN Masukan <b style="color:#e6f1f8;">' +
                       fmtAmt(t.masukan_ppn) + '</b> &nbsp;=&nbsp; <span style="color:' + color + ';font-weight:bold;">' +
                       label + ' ' + fmtAmt(Math.abs(net)) + '</span>';
    });

    // Pencarian global template memuat ulang mainDs saja -> samakan query ke store detail
    mainDs.on('beforeload', function (store) {
        var q = store.baseParams.query || '';
        kelDs.baseParams.query = q;
        masDs.baseParams.query = q;
        if (inLoadAll) return;                       // sudah dimuat oleh loadAll()
        if (kelDs.lastOptions) kelDs.load();         // pencarian dari search box template -> muat ulang detail
        if (masDs.lastOptions) masDs.load();
    });

    // Template: laporan hanya-baca, tombol tambah/ubah/hapus dinonaktifkan
    if (typeof editDataDisable === 'function') editDataDisable();
    if (typeof mainBtnDisable === 'function') { mainBtnDisable('#addData'); mainBtnDisable('#deleteData'); }

    calcHeight();
    showTab('summary');
    projectDs.load({ callback: function () {
        projectDs.each(function (r) {
            if (r.get('id') === 0) return;               // opsi "(Semua proyek)" sudah ada di select
            var o = document.createElement('option');
            o.value = r.get('id'); o.text = r.get('name');
            selProject.appendChild(o);
        });
        loadAll();
    } });
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';

});

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();

        document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Supplier <em>Payment</em>";
    }

    // ============================================================
    // CONSTANTS
    // ============================================================
    var CRD = '../php-crud/supplier.paymentCRD.php';
    var PRINT_URL = '../views/supplier.payment.print.php?id=';
    var LIST_PRINT_URL = '../views/supplier.payment.list.print.php';

    // ============================================================
    // VARIABLES
    // ============================================================
    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;
    var origSupplierId = 0;
    var origDeposit = 0;
    var origExcess = 0;
    var depositBalance = 0;

    // ============================================================
    // UTILITY FUNCTIONS
    // ============================================================
    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }
    function num(v) {
        var n = parseFloat(v);
        return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
    }
    function round2(v) {
        return Math.round((num(v) + 0.0000001) * 100) / 100;
    }
    function fmtAmt(v) {
        return Ext.util.Format.number(num(v), '0,000.00');
    }
    function esc(v) {
        return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : String(v));
    }

    function handleStoreException(proxy, type, action, options, response, arg) {
        var msg = 'Terjadi kesalahan saat memuat data dari server.';
        if (response && response.responseText) {
            try {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (res && res.message) msg = res.message;
            } catch (e) {
                msg = 'Format respon server tidak valid.';
            }
        }
        if (window.console) console.error('Store Exception:', type, action, response);
        Ext.Msg.alert('Error Store', msg);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 1. DATA STORES
    // ============================================================
    var paymentField = [
        { name: 'id' },
        { name: 'payment_no' },
        { name: 'payment_date' },
        { name: 'supplier_id' },
        { name: 'supplier_name' },
        { name: 'account_id' },
        { name: 'account_name' },
        { name: 'payment_method' },
        { name: 'total_amount', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'allocated_amount', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'excess_amount', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'deposit_applied', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'reference_no' },
        { name: 'notes' }
    ];

    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, paymentField),
        listeners: { exception: handleStoreException }
    });

    var supplierDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        baseParams: { task: 'read_supplier' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, [
            { name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }
        ])
    });

    var accountDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        baseParams: { task: 'read_account' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, [

    var methodDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        baseParams: { task: 'read_payment_method' },

            { name: 'value' }, { name: 'label' }

    function renderPaymentDetailHeader(paymentNo, paymentId) {
        var safeId = parseInt(paymentId, 10) || 0;
        var html = '<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:4px;">';
        html += '<h3 class="detail-title" style="margin:0; font-size:14px; color:#38bdf8;">Detail Alokasi Invoice: ' + esc(paymentNo || '') + '</h3>';
        html += '<div>';
        html += '<button type="button" class="spBtnPrint" data-payment-id="' + safeId + '" style="margin-left:8px; padding:6px 14px; background:#03615e; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold; font-size:12px; display:inline-block; visibility:visible;">Cetak Bukti Bayar</button>';
        html += '</div>';
        html += '</div>';
        html += '<hr class="detail-hr" style="border:0; border-top:1px solid #334155; margin-bottom:10px;" />';
        return html;
    }

    function renderPaymentDetailPanel(rows, paymentNo, paymentId) {
        var html = renderPaymentDetailHeader(paymentNo, paymentId);
        html += '<table id="payTable" class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="6" style="border-collapse:collapse; color:#f8fafc; font-size:12px;">';
        html += '<thead>';
        html += '<tr class="header-row" style="background-color:#1e293b; color:#94a3b8;">';
        html += '<th align="left">No. Invoice</th>';
        html += '<th align="left">No. Invoice Supplier</th>';
        html += '<th align="center">Tgl Inv</th>';
        html += '<th align="right">Total Tagihan</th>';
        html += '<th align="right">Sisa Tagihan</th>';
        html += '<th align="right">Nominal Dialokasikan</th>';
        html += '</tr>';
        html += '</thead>';
        html += '<tbody>';
        
        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:15px; text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">Belum ada alokasi invoice untuk pembayaran ini.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            var grandTotal = 0;
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var paid = num(r.amount_paid);
                grandTotal += paid;
                html += '<tr class="data-row" style="border-bottom:1px solid #334155;">';
                html += '<td align="left">' + esc(r.invoice_no || '-') + '</td>';
                html += '<td align="left">' + esc(r.supplier_invoice_no || '-') + '</td>';
                html += '<td align="center">' + esc(r.invoice_date || '-') + '</td>';
                html += '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(r.total_amount) + '</td>';
                html += '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(r.unpaid_amount) + '</td>';
                html += '<td align="right" style="color:#38bdf8; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtAmt(paid) + '</td>';
                html += '</tr>';
            });
            html += '<tr class="footer-row" style="background-color:#0f172a; font-weight:bold;">';
            html += '<td colspan="5" align="right" style="padding:8px;">TOTAL ALOKASI:</td>';
            html += '<td align="right" style="color:#22c55e;">' + fmtAmt(grandTotal) + '</td>';
            html += '</tr>';
        }
        html += '</tbody></table>';
        
        payDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        payDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

    // Event Delegation global pada kontainer detail untuk tombol cetak

            var target = e.target;

                }
            }
        };
    }
   

    // ============================================================
    // PRINTING FUNCTIONS
    // ============================================================
    function printReceipt(id) {
        id = parseInt(id, 10);
        if (!id || id < 1) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Pilih Pembayaran', 'Pilih satu pembayaran terlebih dahulu.');
            return;
        }
        var w = window.open(PRINT_URL + encodeURIComponent(id), '_blank',
                            'width=1000,height=800,scrollbars=yes,resizable=yes');
        if (!w) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Popup diblokir', 'Izinkan pop-up untuk situs ini, lalu klik Cetak kembali.');
        }
    }

    function bindMainPrintButton() {
        var el = document.getElementById('printData') ||
                 document.getElementById('printing') ||
                 document.getElementById('printBtn') ||
                 document.getElementById('btnPrinting');
        if (!el || el.getAttribute('data-sp-list-print-bound') === '1') return;
        el.setAttribute('data-sp-list-print-bound', '1');
        el.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
            if (ev && ev.preventDefault) ev.preventDefault();
            if (ev && ev.stopImmediatePropagation) ev.stopImmediatePropagation();
            else if (ev && ev.stopPropagation) ev.stopPropagation();
            var w = window.open(LIST_PRINT_URL, '_blank',
                                'width=1100,height=800,scrollbars=yes,resizable=yes');
            if (!w) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Popup diblokir', 'Izinkan pop-up untuk situs ini, lalu klik Printing kembali.');
            }
        }, true);
    }

    // Ikat tombol Printing di header untuk mencetak daftar pembayaran.
    bindMainPrintButton();

    function setMainButtons() {
        if (typeof mainBtnEnable !== 'function' || typeof mainBtnDisable !== 'function') return;
        if (dataRecord && getFormAccess() >= 3) mainBtnEnable('#editData'); else mainBtnDisable('#editData');
        if (dataRecord && getFormAccess() >= 4) mainBtnEnable('#deleteData'); else mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
    }

    function clearSelection() {
        dataRecord = null;
        payDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
        setMainButtons();
    }

    function loadPaymentDetailPanel(paymentId, paymentNo) {
        payDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
        // Tombol cetak langsung tersedia setelah pembayaran dipilih,
        // tanpa menunggu hasil pemuatan detail alokasi invoice.
        payDtlDiv.innerHTML = renderPaymentDetailHeader(paymentNo, paymentId) +
            '<div style="padding:15px; text-align:center; color:#38bdf8;">Memuat detail alokasi...</div>';

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_detail', payment_id: paymentId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res;
                try {
                    res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                } catch (e) {
                    payDtlDiv.innerHTML = renderPaymentDetailHeader(paymentNo, paymentId) +
                        '<div style="padding:15px; color:#ef4444;">Gagal memparsing respon detail.</div>';
                    return;
                }
                
                if (res && res.success) {
                    renderPaymentDetailPanel(res.data, paymentNo, paymentId);
                } else {
                    payDtlDiv.innerHTML = renderPaymentDetailHeader(paymentNo, paymentId) +
                        '<div style="padding:15px; color:#f59e0b;">' + esc(res.message || 'Tidak ada detail ditemukan.') + '</div>';
                }
            },
            failure: function () {
                payDtlDiv.innerHTML = renderPaymentDetailHeader(paymentNo, paymentId) +
                    '<div style="padding:15px; color:#ef4444;">Gagal terhubung ke server untuk memuat detail.</div>';
            }
        });
    }

        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        store: gridInvoiceDs,
        selModel: editorDeleter || new Ext.grid.RowSelectionModel({ singleSelect: true }),
        columns: allocColumns,
        tbar: [
            '<div id="gridHeaderText" class="alloc-title">Alokasi ke Invoice</div>',
            { xtype: 'tbfill' },
            '<div id="allocSummary" class="alloc-stats"></div>',
            { xtype: 'tbspacer', width: 14 },
            '<a id="btnAutoAlloc" class="alloc-btn" href="javascript:void(0)" title="Bagi dana ke invoice tertua lebih dulu">Alokasi otomatis (FIFO)</a>'
        ]
    });

    var lnkAutoAlloc = Ext.get('btnAutoAlloc');
    if (lnkAutoAlloc) {
        lnkAutoAlloc.on('click', function (e) {
            if (e && e.stopEvent) e.stopEvent();
            if (gridAlloc.stopEditing) gridAlloc.stopEditing();
            autoAllocateCombined();
        });
    }

    gridAlloc.on('cellclick', function (grid, rowIndex, columnIndex) {
        if (grid.getColumnModel().getColumnId(columnIndex) === 'spDeleteCol') {
            grid.getStore().removeAt(rowIndex);
            refreshSummary();
        }
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 7. ALLOCATION & SUMMARY LOGIC
    // ============================================================
    function getAllocatedTotal() {
        var t = 0;
        gridInvoiceDs.each(function (r) {
            t += num(r.get('amount_paid'));
        });
        return round2(t);
    }

    function getAvailableDeposit() {
        var avail = depositBalance;
        if (task === 'update' && String(fldSupplier.getValue()) === String(origSupplierId)) {
            avail = depositBalance + origDeposit - origExcess;
        }
        return round2(Math.max(0, avail));
    }

    function refreshDepositDisplay() {
        fldDepBalance.setValue(fmtAmt(getAvailableDeposit()));
    }

    function statHtml(label, value, cls, hint) {
        return '<div class="alloc-stat ' + (cls || '') + '"' + (hint ? ' title="' + esc(hint) + '"' : '') + '>' +
               '<span class="alloc-lbl">' + label + '</span>' +
               '<span class="alloc-val">' + value + '</span></div>';
    }

    function refreshSummary() {
        var cash = num(fldTotal.getValue());
        var dep = num(fldDeposit.getValue());
        var alloc = getAllocatedTotal();
        var diff = round2(cash + dep - alloc);
        var el = Ext.get('allocSummary');
        if (!el) return;

        var third;
        if (diff < -0.01) {
            third = statHtml('Dana kurang', fmtAmt(-diff), 'pill bad', 'Dana belum cukup menutup alokasi invoice');
        } else if (diff > 0.01) {
            third = statHtml('Uang muka', fmtAmt(diff), 'pill ok', 'Lebih bayar: dicatat sebagai Uang Muka Pembelian (deposit supplier)');
        } else {
            third = statHtml('Selisih', 'Pas', 'pill zero', 'Dana sama dengan total alokasi');
        }

        el.update(
            statHtml('Dialokasikan', fmtAmt(alloc), 'first', 'Total nominal yang dibayarkan ke invoice') +
            statHtml('Dana (kas + deposit)', fmtAmt(cash + dep), '', 'Total dibayar (kas/bank) + saldo deposit yang dipakai') +
            third
        );
    }

    function autoAllocateFIFO(total) {
        var remaining = round2(total);
        gridInvoiceDs.each(function (rec) {
            var unpaid = num(rec.get('unpaid_amount'));
            var alloc = round2(Math.max(0, Math.min(remaining, unpaid)));
            rec.set('amount_paid', alloc);
            remaining = round2(remaining - alloc);
        });
        refreshSummary();
    }

    function autoAllocateCombined() {
        autoAllocateFIFO(num(fldTotal.getValue()) + num(fldDeposit.getValue()));
    }

    gridAlloc.on('afteredit', function (e) {
        if (e.field !== 'amount_paid') return;
        var unpaid = num(e.record.get('unpaid_amount'));
        var v = num(e.value);
        if (v < 0) {
            e.record.set('amount_paid', 0);
        } else if (v > unpaid + 0.01) {
            e.record.set('amount_paid', unpaid);
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Nominal dibayar tidak boleh melebihi sisa hutang invoice (' + fmtAmt(unpaid) + ').');
        }
        refreshSummary();
    });

    gridInvoiceDs.on('load', function () {
        refreshSummary();
    });

    gridInvoiceDs.on('remove', refreshSummary);

    function onFundsChanged() {
        var dep = num(fldDeposit.getValue());
        var avail = getAvailableDeposit();
        if (dep > avail + 0.01) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Saldo deposit yang dipakai tidak boleh melebihi saldo tersedia (' + fmtAmt(avail) + ').');
            fldDeposit.setValue(avail);
        }
        if (task !== 'update') autoAllocateCombined(); else refreshSummary();
    }

    fldTotal.on('change', onFundsChanged);
    fldDeposit.on('change', onFundsChanged);

    // ============================================================
    // 8. DEPOSIT BALANCE LOADER
    // ============================================================
    function loadDepositBalance(supplierId, cb) {
        depositBalance = 0;
        if (!supplierId) {
            refreshDepositDisplay();
            if (cb) cb();
            return;
        }

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_supplier_deposit_balance', supplier_id: supplierId },
            success: function (response) {
                try {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                    if (res && res.success) depositBalance = num(res.balance);
                } catch (e) { }
                refreshDepositDisplay();
                if (cb) cb();
            },
            failure: function () {
                refreshDepositDisplay();
                if (cb) cb();
            }
        });
    }

    function loadInvoicesFor(supplierId) {
        gridInvoiceDs.removeAll();
        refreshSummary();
        if (!supplierId) return;

        gridInvoiceDs.load({
            params: {
                supplier_id: supplierId,
                payment_id: (task === 'update' && dataRecord) ? dataRecord.id : 0
            }
        });
    }

    fldSupplier.on('select', function (combo, record) {
        var sid = record.get('id');
        if (task !== 'update') fldDeposit.setValue(0);
        loadDepositBalance(sid, function () {
            if (num(fldDeposit.getValue()) > getAvailableDeposit() + 0.01) {
                fldDeposit.setValue(getAvailableDeposit());
            }
            loadInvoicesFor(sid);
        });
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 9. WINDOW EDITOR HELPERS
    // ============================================================
    function setEditorGridHeight() {
        if (typeof $ !== 'function') return;
        var editorFormHeight = $('#editorForm').height() || 400;
        var headerHeight = $('#editorFormHeader').height() || 50;
        var mainFormHeight = $('#editorFormMain').height() || 150;
        var computedHeight = editorFormHeight - headerHeight - mainFormHeight - 20;
        if (computedHeight > 150) {
            gridAlloc.setHeight(computedHeight);
        }
    }

    function showWindow(titleText) {
        var wdw = document.getElementById('editorWdw');
        if (wdw) wdw.style.display = 'block';
        if (document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText')) {
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;' + titleText;
        }

        ensureFrmEditorRendered();
        setEditorGridHeight();
        var frmCmp = Ext.getCmp('frmEditor');
        if (frmCmp) frmCmp.doLayout();
        refreshSummary();
    }

    function hideWindow() {
        var wdw = document.getElementById('editorWdw');
        if (wdw) wdw.style.display = 'none';
    }

    function loadCombos(cb) {
        var pending = 3;
        var done = function () {
            pending--;
            if (pending === 0 && cb) cb();
        };
        supplierDs.load({ callback: done });
        accountDs.load({ callback: done });
        methodDs.load({ callback: done });
    }

    function defaultMethod() {
        var idx = methodDs.find('value', 'BANK_TRANSFER');
        if (idx >= 0) return 'BANK_TRANSFER';
        return methodDs.getCount() > 0 ? methodDs.getAt(0).get('value') : 'BANK_TRANSFER';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 10. ACTIONS: ADD, EDIT, DELETE, SAVE, DISCARD
    // ============================================================

    // --- ADD ---
    if (Ext.get('addData')) {
        Ext.get('addData').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            if (getFormAccess() < 2) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak untuk menambah data.');
                return;
            }

            task = 'create';
            origSupplierId = 0;
            origDeposit = 0;
            origExcess = 0;
            depositBalance = 0;

            loadCombos(function () {
                ensureFrmEditorRendered();
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                fldPayDate.setValue(new Date());
                fldMethod.setValue(defaultMethod());
                fldTotal.setValue(0);
                fldDeposit.setValue(0);
                gridInvoiceDs.removeAll();
                refreshDepositDisplay();
                showWindow('Tambah Pembayaran Supplier');
            });
        });
    }

    // --- EDIT ---
    if (Ext.get('editData')) {
        Ext.get('editData').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            if (getFormAccess() < 3) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak untuk mengubah data.');
                return;
            }
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Silakan pilih data pembayaran terlebih dahulu.');
                return;
            }

            task = 'update';
            loadCombos(function () {
                Ext.Ajax.request({
                    url: CRD,
                    method: 'POST',
                    params: { task: 'read_edit', id: dataRecord.id },
                    success: function (response) {
                        var res;
                        try {
                            res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                        } catch (ex) {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Error', 'Format respon server tidak valid.');
                            return;
                        }
                        if (!res.success || !res.data) {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Data pembayaran tidak ditemukan.');
                            return;
                        }

                        var row = res.data;
                        origSupplierId = row.supplier_id;
                        origDeposit = num(row.deposit_applied);
                        origExcess = num(row.excess_amount);

                        ensureFrmEditorRendered();
                        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                        frmEditor.getForm().setValues(row);

                        gridInvoiceDs.removeAll();
                        loadDepositBalance(row.supplier_id, function () {
                            gridInvoiceDs.load({
                                params: {
                                    supplier_id: row.supplier_id,
                                    payment_id: row.id
                                }
                            });
                        });

                        showWindow('Edit Pembayaran Supplier: ' + esc(row.payment_no));
                    },
                    failure: function () {
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Error', 'Gagal terhubung ke server.');
                    }
                });
            });
        });
    }

    // --- DELETE ---
    if (Ext.get('deleteData')) {
        Ext.get('deleteData').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            if (getFormAccess() < 4) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak untuk menghapus data.');
                return;
            }
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Silakan pilih data pembayaran terlebih dahulu.');
                return;
            }

            Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi',
                'Hapus pembayaran ' + esc(dataRecord.payment_no) + '?<br/>Jurnal pembayaran ikut dibatalkan dan sisa hutang invoice dikembalikan.',
                function (btn) {
                    if (btn !== 'yes') return;

                    Ext.Ajax.request({
                        url: CRD,
                        method: 'POST',
                        params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                        success: function (response) {
                            var res;
                            try {
                                res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                            } catch (ex) {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Error', 'Format respon server tidak valid.');
                                return;
                            }
                            if (res.success) {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message || 'Data pembayaran berhasil dihapus.');
                                mainDs.reload();
                                clearSelection();
                            } else {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Gagal menghapus data.');
                            }
                        },
                        failure: function () {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Error', 'Gagal terhubung ke server.');
                        }
                    });
                }
            );
        });
    }


    function submitPayment(arrItems) {
        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: CRD,
            params: {
                task: task,
                arrItems: Ext.encode(arrItems)
            },
            waitMsg: 'Menyimpan data...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var msg = (action && action.result && action.result.message) ? action.result.message : 'Data pembayaran berhasil disimpan.';
                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', msg);
                hideWindow();
                mainDs.reload();
                clearSelection();
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var msg = 'Gagal menyimpan data.';
                if (action && action.result && action.result.message) {
                    msg = action.result.message;
                } else if (action && action.failureType === Ext.form.Action.CONNECT_FAILURE) {
                    msg = 'Gagal terhubung ke server (sesi mungkin berakhir).';
                }
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', msg);
            }
        });
    }

    if (Ext.get('saveEdit')) {
        Ext.get('saveEdit').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();

            if (!frmEditor.getForm().isValid()) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Mohon lengkapi semua field yang wajib diisi.');
                return;
            }
            if (gridAlloc.stopEditing) gridAlloc.stopEditing();

            var cash = num(fldTotal.getValue());
            var dep = num(fldDeposit.getValue());
            var alloc = getAllocatedTotal();
            var avail = getAvailableDeposit();

            if (cash <= 0 && dep <= 0) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Total dibayar atau saldo deposit yang dipakai harus lebih dari 0.');
                return;
            }
            if (cash > 0 && !fldAccount.getValue()) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih akun Kas/Bank sumber dana.');
                return;
            }
            if (dep > avail + 0.01) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Saldo deposit yang dipakai (' + fmtAmt(dep) + ') melebihi saldo tersedia (' + fmtAmt(avail) + ').');
                return;
            }
            if (dep > alloc + 0.01) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Saldo deposit yang dipakai tidak boleh melebihi total alokasi ke invoice.');
                return;
            }
            if (cash + dep + 0.01 < alloc) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Total dibayar + saldo deposit (' + fmtAmt(cash + dep) + ') belum cukup menutupi alokasi invoice (' + fmtAmt(alloc) + ').');
                return;
            }

            var arrItems = [];
            var overRow = null;
            gridInvoiceDs.each(function (rec) {
                var amt = round2(rec.get('amount_paid'));
                if (amt <= 0) return;
                if (amt > num(rec.get('unpaid_amount')) + 0.01) overRow = rec;
                arrItems.push({ invoice_id: rec.get('invoice_id'), amount_paid: amt });
            });
            if (overRow) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Nominal dibayar untuk invoice ' + esc(overRow.get('invoice_no')) + ' melebihi sisa hutangnya.');
                return;
            }

            var excess = round2(cash + dep - alloc);
            if (excess > 0.01) {
                Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi Uang Muka',
                    'Dana melebihi alokasi invoice sebesar <b>' + fmtAmt(excess) + '</b>.<br/>Selisih dicatat sebagai Uang Muka Pembelian (deposit supplier). Lanjutkan?',
                    function (btn) { if (btn === 'yes') submitPayment(arrItems); });
            } else {
                submitPayment(arrItems);
            }
        });
    }

    var btnDiscard = Ext.get('discardEdit') || Ext.select('#editorWdw .x-tool-close');
    if (btnDiscard) {
        btnDiscard.on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            hideWindow();
        });
    }

    var wdwInit = document.getElementById('editorWdw');
    if (wdwInit) wdwInit.style.display = 'none';
});

==================== FILE: ./js/grn.js ====================
/*
  Document      : grn00_5.js
  Description   : Purchase GRN (Goods Receipt Note) - ExtJS 3.x Frontend Controller
  Backend       : /inv/dev/php-crud/grnCRD.php
  Multi currency: GRN membekukan mata uang & kurs PO. Harga satuan GRN dalam mata uang PO (bisa diedit);
                  nilai dalam mata uang dasar (= harga x kurs PO) dihitung server dan dipakai WH Rcv.
                  GRN hanya bisa dibuat dari PO berstatus Disetujui.
  [NEW 2026-10-12] No. DO Supplier (grn_hdr.supplier_do_no): diinput di sini, lalu diturunkan read-only ke W/H RCV dan Retur Pembelian
                  (trace GRN -> W/H RCV -> Retur). Field dikirim lewat form submit (name 'supplier_do_no'); edit memuat via task read_edit.
  [NEW 2026-10-12] Plat No. Kendaraan & Nama Driver (grn_hdr.vehicle_plate_no / driver_name, opsional) di form entry, grid, dan panel detail.
                  Tombol 'Cetak Tanda Terima' di panel detail (task backend: read_grn_print) -> dokumen TANPA harga untuk driver/supplier.
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Goods Receipt Note";

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;
    var grnCur = { code: 'IDR', base: 'IDR', rate: 1 };      // mata uang GRN yang sedang dilihat/diedit

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 0. Container Detail Item GRN
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');

    var grnDtlDiv = document.createElement('div');
    grnDtlDiv.id = 'grnDtlContainer';
    grnDtlDiv.className = 'detail-panel-container';
    grnDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';

    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(grnDtlDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling);
    }

    (function injectExtraUI() {
        var gridEditorContainer = document.getElementById('editorFormGrid');
        if (gridEditorContainer && !document.getElementById('lblGrnTotal')) {
            var totalsDiv = document.createElement('div');

            totalsDiv.innerHTML = 'Total Nilai GRN: <span id="lblGrnTotal">0.00</span>';
            gridEditorContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(totalsDiv, gridEditorContainer.nextSibling);
        }
    })();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    var grnField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'ref_no' }, { name: 'grn_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'po_id' }, { name: 'po_ref_no' }, { name: 'supplier_id' }, { name: 'supplier_name' },
        { name: 'status' }, { name: 'remark' },
        { name: 'total_qty', type: 'float' }, { name: 'total_amount', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'currency_code' }, { name: 'exch_rate', type: 'float' }, { name: 'total_base', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'supplier_do_no' }, { name: 'vehicle_plate_no' }, { name: 'driver_name' },      // [NEW] No. DO Supplier, Plat No., Driver
        { name: 'approval_status' }, { name: 'approved_by' }, { name: 'approved_at' }, { name: 'approved_note' }  // [GAP #7] GRN Approval Gate
    ];

    var itemField = [
        { name: 'po_dtl_id' }, { name: 'item_id' }, { name: 'item_name' },
        { name: 'qty_ordered', type: 'float' }, { name: 'unit_price', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_received', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'sisa_qty_po', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_max_allowed', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_receivable_max', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_received_this_grn', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'unit_cost_this_grn', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_input', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'unit_cost', type: 'float' }
    ];

    var poField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'ref_no' }, { name: 'supplier_id' }, { name: 'supplier_name' },
                   { name: 'currency_code' }, { name: 'exch_rate', type: 'float' }];
    var poDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../dev/php-crud/grnCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'list_po_open' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, poField)
    });
    poDs.load();

    var itemGridDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../dev/php-crud/grnCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_po_items' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, itemField),
        listeners: {
            load: function (store) {
                var cu = store.reader.jsonData && store.reader.jsonData.currency;
                if (cu) {
                    grnCur = { code: cu.code || 'IDR', base: cu.base_code || 'IDR', rate: parseFloat(cu.exch_rate) || 1 };
                    applyCurrencyHeaders();
                }
                store.each(function (r) {
                    var existingQty = parseFloat(r.get('qty_received_this_grn')) || 0;
                    if (existingQty > 0 && task === 'update') {
                        r.set('qty_input', existingQty);
                    } else {
                        var defaultQty = parseFloat(r.get('sisa_qty_po')) || 0;
                        r.set('qty_input', defaultQty);
                    }

                    var existingCost = r.get('unit_cost_this_grn');
                    var poUnitPrice = parseFloat(r.get('unit_price')) || 0;
                    r.set('unit_cost', (existingCost !== null && existingCost !== undefined && existingCost !== '') ? existingCost : poUnitPrice);
                });
                updateGrnTotalLabel();
            }
        }
    });

    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../dev/php-crud/grnCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, grnField)
    });
    mainDs.load();

    var GridDtlHeight = (maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));
    var mainHeight = Math.round(GridDtlHeight - (GridDtlHeight * 0.45));

    var gridMain = new stdGrid({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: mainHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. GRN', dataIndex: 'ref_no', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Tanggal', dataIndex: 'grn_date', width: 90, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            { header: 'No. PO', dataIndex: 'po_ref_no', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Supplier', dataIndex: 'supplier_name', width: 170, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'No. DO Supplier', dataIndex: 'supplier_do_no', width: 130, renderer: function (v) { return CellWrap(v || '-'); } },      // [NEW]
            { header: 'Plat No.', dataIndex: 'vehicle_plate_no', width: 90, align: 'center', renderer: function (v) { return CellWrap(v || '-'); } },      // [NEW]
            { header: 'Driver', dataIndex: 'driver_name', width: 110, renderer: function (v) { return CellWrap(v || '-'); } },      // [NEW]
            {
                header: 'Total Qty', dataIndex: 'total_qty', width: 100, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
            },
            { header: 'Mata Uang', dataIndex: 'currency_code', width: 80, align: 'center', renderer: function (v) { return v || '-'; } },
            {
                header: 'Total Nilai (Mata Uang PO)', dataIndex: 'total_amount', width: 150, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00') + '</b>'; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Total Nilai (Dasar)', dataIndex: 'total_base', width: 140, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 110, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) {
                    if (v === 'draft') return '<span style="color:#e08e0b;font-weight:bold;">Draft</span>';
                    if (v === 'cancelled') return '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-weight:bold;">Cancelled</span>';
                    return '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">Confirmed</span>';
                }
            },
            {
                header: 'Approval', dataIndex: 'approval_status', width: 100, align: 'center',  // [GAP #7] GRN Approval Gate
                renderer: function (v) {
                    if (v === 'APPROVED') return '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">APPROVED</span>';
                    if (v === 'REJECTED') return '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-weight:bold;">REJECTED</span>';
                    return '<span style="color:#e08e0b;font-weight:bold;">PENDING</span>';
                }
            },
            { header: 'Keterangan', dataIndex: 'remark', width: 160, renderer: CellWrap }
        ],
        listeners: {
            cellclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) {
                    dataRecord = rec.data;
                    mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                    editDataEnable();
                    loadGrnDetail(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.ref_no);
                }
            }
        }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Detail View Renderer
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function loadGrnDetail(grnId, grnNo) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../dev/php-crud/grnCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_grn_items', grn_id: grnId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    grnDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">Gagal memuat detail GRN.</div>';
                    grnDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderGrnDetailView(res.data || [], grnNo, res.currency);
            },
            failure: function () {
                grnDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                grnDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderGrnDetailView(rows, grnNo, cur) {
        var fmtQty = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); };
        var fmtAmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };

        var code = (cur && cur.code) || 'IDR', baseCode = (cur && cur.base_code) || 'IDR';
        var diff = code !== baseCode;
        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Detail Item GRN: ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(grnNo || '') + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<div style="padding:4px 2px 10px 2px;">No. DO Supplier: <b>' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode((dataRecord && dataRecord.supplier_do_no) || '-') + '</b>' +
                   ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Plat No.: <b>' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode((dataRecord && dataRecord.vehicle_plate_no) || '-') + '</b>' +
                   ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Driver: <b>' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode((dataRecord && dataRecord.driver_name) || '-') + '</b>' +
                   '<button type="button" id="btnPrintGrn" style="float:right; padding:5px 14px; background:#2e6da4; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold;">Cetak Tanda Terima</button>' +
                   '</div>' +      // [NEW] info DO / kendaraan / driver + tombol cetak
                   '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Nama Item</th>' +
                    '<th style="text-align:right;">Qty Diterima</th>' +
                    '<th style="text-align:right;">Harga Satuan (' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(code) + ')</th>' +
                    '<th style="text-align:right;">Subtotal (' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(code) + ')</th>' +
                    (diff ? '<th style="text-align:right;">Subtotal Dasar (' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(baseCode) + ')</th>' : '') +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        var grandTotal = 0, grandBase = 0;

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty-msg">Tidak ada item detail.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var qty = parseFloat(r.qty) || 0;
                var cost = parseFloat(r.unit_price) || 0;
                var subtotal = qty * cost;
                var subBase = qty * (parseFloat(r.unit_cost_base) || 0);
                grandTotal += subtotal;
                grandBase += subBase;

                html += '<tr class="data-row">' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.item_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtQty(qty) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(cost) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" class="subtotal-val">' + fmtAmt(subtotal) + '</td>' +
                        (diff ? '<td align="right" style="color:#9fc3d1;">' + fmtAmt(subBase) + '</td>' : '') +
                        '</tr>';
            });
        }

        html += '</tbody>' +
                '<tfoot>' +
                '<tr class="total-row">' +
                '<td colspan="3" align="right" class="total-label">Total Nilai GRN:</td>' +
                '<td align="right" class="total-val">' + fmtAmt(grandTotal) + ' ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(code) + '</td>' +
                (diff ? '<td align="right" class="total-val">' + fmtAmt(grandBase) + ' ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(baseCode) + '</td>' : '') +
                '</tr>' +
                '</tfoot>' +
                '</table>';

        grnDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        grnDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
        var pb = document.getElementById('btnPrintGrn'), printId = dataRecord ? dataRecord.id : 0;      // [NEW] tombol Cetak Tanda Terima
        if (pb && printId) { pb.onclick = function () { printGrn(printId); }; }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3b. [NEW] Cetak Tanda Terima GRN (tanpa harga). Jendela dibuka saat klik (lolos popup blocker),
    //     data dari task 'read_grn_print', lalu HTML ditulis ke jendela dan window.print() dipanggil.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var COMPANY_NAME = '';      // isi sama seperti di warehouse.issuing.js / purchase.return.js; kosong = baris tidak dicetak
    var COMPANY_ADDR = '';

    function grnEnc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function grnDmy(str) {
        var m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(str || '');
        return m ? (m[3] + '/' + m[2] + '/' + m[1]) : (str || '-');
    }
    // [FIX-DATE] Date.format('d/m/Y H:i') bermasalah di browser ini (token Y tidak terformat) -> susun manual
    function grnNow() {
        var d = new Date(), p2 = function (n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : n; };
        return p2(d.getDate()) + '/' + p2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '/' + d.getFullYear() + ' ' + p2(d.getHours()) + ':' + p2(d.getMinutes());
    }
    function grnQty(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(parseFloat(v) || 0, '0,000.0000').replace(/\.?0+$/, ''); }

    function printGrn(grnId) {
        var w = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=900,height=700');
        if (!w) { Ext.Msg.alert('Popup Diblokir', 'Izinkan popup untuk situs ini, lalu klik Cetak Tanda Terima lagi.'); return; }
        w.document.open('text/html','replace');
        w.document.write('<html><body style="font-family:Arial,sans-serif;padding:20px;">Memuat Tanda Terima GRN...</body></html>');
        w.document.close();
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../dev/php-crud/grnCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_grn_print', grn_id: grnId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res;
                try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); }
                catch (e) { w.close(); Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Respons server tidak valid.'); return; }
                if (!res.success) { w.close(); Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Gagal memuat data cetak.'); return; }
                w.document.open('text/html','replace');
                w.document.write(buildGrnPrintHtml(res.data.header || {}, res.data.items || []));
                w.document.close();
                w.focus();
                setTimeout(function () { w.print(); }, 400);
            },
            failure: function () { w.close(); Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.'); }
        });
    }

    function buildGrnPrintHtml(h, items) {
        var BLANK = '..............................';
        var rows = '', no = 0;
        Ext.each(items, function (i) {
            no++;
            var po = parseFloat(i.qty_po) || 0, cum = parseFloat(i.qty_cum) || 0;
            rows += '<tr><td class="c">' + no + '</td><td>' + grnEnc(i.material_code || '') + '</td><td>' + grnEnc(i.item_name) + '</td>' +
                    '<td class="r">' + grnQty(po) + '</td><td class="r"><b>' + grnQty(i.qty) + '</b></td><td class="r">' + grnQty(cum) + '</td>' +
                    '<td class="r">' + grnQty(Math.max(po - cum, 0)) + '</td><td class="c">' + grnEnc(i.unit || '') + '</td><td>' + grnEnc(i.remark || '') + '</td></tr>';
        });
        var css = '@page{size:A4;margin:12mm;}body{font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:12px;color:#000;margin:0;}' +
                  'h1{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 2px 0;text-align:center;letter-spacing:1px;}.sub{text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:11px;}' +
                  'table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;}.meta td{padding:2px 4px;vertical-align:top;}' +
                  '.items th,.items td{border:1px solid #000;padding:5px 6px;}.items th{background:#eee;}' +
                  '.c{text-align:center;}.r{text-align:right;}.sign td{width:33%;text-align:center;padding-top:6px;}' +
                  '.sign .box{height:70px;}hr{border:0;border-top:2px solid #000;margin:8px 0;}';
        return '<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Tanda Terima GRN ' + grnEnc(h.ref_no) + '</title><style>' + css + '</style></head><body>' +
               (COMPANY_NAME ? '<div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:bold;text-align:center;">' + grnEnc(COMPANY_NAME) + '</div>' : '') +
               (COMPANY_ADDR ? '<div class="sub">' + grnEnc(COMPANY_ADDR) + '</div>' : '') +
               '<hr/><h1>TANDA TERIMA BARANG (GRN)</h1><div class="sub">Bukti penerimaan barang dari supplier</div>' +
               '<table class="meta"><tr>' +
               '<td width="16%">No. GRN</td><td width="34%">: <b>' + grnEnc(h.ref_no) + '</b></td>' +
               '<td width="16%">Tanggal Terima</td><td width="34%">: ' + grnDmy(h.grn_date) + '</td></tr><tr>' +
               '<td>Supplier</td><td>: <b>' + grnEnc(h.supplier_name || '-') + '</b></td>' +
               '<td>No. DO Supplier</td><td>: <b>' + grnEnc(h.supplier_do_no || '-') + '</b></td></tr><tr>' +
               '<td>No. PO</td><td>: ' + grnEnc(h.po_ref_no || '-') + (h.po_date ? ' (' + grnDmy(h.po_date) + ')' : '') + '</td>' +
               '<td>Proyek</td><td>: ' + grnEnc(h.project_name || '-') + '</td></tr><tr>' +
               '<td>Plat No. Kendaraan</td><td>: ' + (h.vehicle_plate_no ? grnEnc(h.vehicle_plate_no) : BLANK) + '</td>' +
               '<td>Driver</td><td>: ' + (h.driver_name ? grnEnc(h.driver_name) : BLANK) + '</td></tr></table>' +
               '<br/><table class="items"><thead><tr><th width="4%">No</th><th width="11%">Kode</th><th>Material</th><th width="9%">Qty PO</th>' +
               '<th width="10%">Diterima</th><th width="10%">Akumulasi</th><th width="8%">Sisa</th><th width="6%">Sat</th><th width="14%">Keterangan</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + rows +
               '</tbody></table><div style="margin-top:6px;">Total item: <b>' + no + '</b>' +
               (h.remark ? ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Catatan: ' + grnEnc(h.remark) : '') + '</div><br/>' +
               '<table class="sign"><tr><td>Diterima oleh<br/>(Gudang)</td><td>Pengirim / Driver</td><td>Dibuat oleh<br/>(Admin)</td></tr>' +
               '<tr><td class="box"></td><td class="box"></td><td class="box"></td></tr>' +
               '<tr><td>(................................)</td><td>(' + (h.driver_name ? grnEnc(h.driver_name) : '................................') + ')</td>' +
               '<td>(' + (h.created_by_name ? grnEnc(h.created_by_name) : '................................') + ')</td></tr></table>' +
               '<div style="margin-top:14px;font-size:10px;color:#444;">Dicetak: ' + grnNow() + '</div></body></html>';
    }

    // [GAP #7] Toolbar Approval
    var toolbarApp = new Ext.Toolbar({
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        style: 'margin-top:10px; padding:5px;',
        items: [
            { text: 'Approve GRN', iconCls: 'btn-approve', handler: function() { approveGrn(false); } },
            { text: 'Reject GRN', iconCls: 'btn-reject', handler: function() { approveGrn(true); } },
            { text: 'Batalkan Approval', iconCls: 'btn-unapprove', handler: function() { unapproveGrn(); } }
        ]
    });

    function approveGrn(isReject) {
        if (!dataRecord) return;
        Ext.Msg.prompt(isReject ? 'Reject GRN' : 'Approve GRN', 'Masukkan alasan (opsional):', function(btn, text) {
            if (btn == 'ok') {
                Ext.Ajax.request({
                    url: '../dev/php-crud/grnCRD.php',
                    method: 'POST',
                    params: { task: isReject ? 'reject_grn' : 'approve_grn', id: dataRecord.id, note: text },
                    success: function(resp) {
                        var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(resp.responseText);
                        if (res.success) {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Berhasil', res.message);
                            mainDs.reload();
                            // Refresh detail if needed
                        } else {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }

    function unapproveGrn() {
        if (!dataRecord) return;
        Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi', 'Batalkan approval GRN ini?', function(btn) {
            if (btn == 'yes') {
                Ext.Ajax.request({
                    url: '../dev/php-crud/grnCRD.php',
                    method: 'POST',
                    params: { task: 'unapprove_grn', id: dataRecord.id },
                    success: function(resp) {
                        var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(resp.responseText);
                        if (res.success) {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Berhasil', res.message);
                            mainDs.reload();
                        } else {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Item Grid Editor
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function toleranceRenderer(v, meta, record) {
        var qtyOrdered = parseFloat(record.get('qty_ordered')) || 0;
        var qtyMax = parseFloat(record.get('qty_max_allowed')) || (qtyOrdered * 1.10);
        var qtyInput = parseFloat(v) || 0;

        var pctOfOrdered = qtyOrdered > 0 ? (qtyInput / qtyOrdered) * 100 : 0;
        var color = '#2e9e4f';
        if (qtyInput > qtyOrdered && qtyInput <= qtyMax) {
            color = '#e08e0b';
        } else if (qtyInput > qtyMax) {
            color = '#c0392b';
        }
        return '<b style="color:' + color + ';">' + Ext.util.Format.number(qtyInput, '0,000.0000') +
               '</b> <span style="color:#888;font-size:11px;">(' + pctOfOrdered.toFixed(0) + '% dari PO)</span>';
    }

    var itemGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: itemGridDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true, scrollOffset: 0 },
        height: 240,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Item', dataIndex: 'item_name', width: 180, renderer: CellWrap },
            {
                header: 'Qty PO', dataIndex: 'qty_ordered', width: 90, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Sisa Qty PO', dataIndex: 'sisa_qty_po', width: 90, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b style="color:#38bdf8;">' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000') + '</b>'; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Batas +10%', dataIndex: 'qty_max_allowed', width: 90, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Qty Diterima', dataIndex: 'qty_input', width: 150, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 4 }),
                renderer: toleranceRenderer
            },
            {
                header: 'Harga Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit_cost', width: 110, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }),
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Subtotal', dataIndex: 'qty_input', width: 130, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    var subtotal = (parseFloat(record.get('qty_input')) || 0) * (parseFloat(record.get('unit_cost')) || 0);
                    return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(subtotal, '0,000.00') + '</b>';
                }
            },
            {
                header: 'Subtotal Dasar', dataIndex: 'unit_cost', width: 130, align: 'right', hidden: true,
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    var base = (parseFloat(record.get('qty_input')) || 0) * (parseFloat(record.get('unit_cost')) || 0) * grnCur.rate;
                    return '<span style="color:#9fc3d1;">' + Ext.util.Format.number(base, '0,000.00') + '</span>';
                }
            }
        ],
        listeners: {
            afteredit: function (e) {
                if (e.field === 'qty_input') {
                    var qtyMax = parseFloat(e.record.get('qty_max_allowed')) || 0;
                    var qtyInput = parseFloat(e.value) || 0;
                    if (qtyInput > qtyMax) {
                        e.record.set('qty_input', qtyMax);
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Qty diterima melebihi batas toleransi 10% dari PO. Otomatis dibatasi ke ' + Ext.util.Format.number(qtyMax, '0,000.0000') + '.');
                    }
                    if (qtyInput < 0) {
                        e.record.set('qty_input', 0);
                    }
                }
                updateGrnTotalLabel();
            }
        }
    });
    itemGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    // Judul kolom mengikuti mata uang PO; kolom "Subtotal Dasar" hanya tampil bila mata uang PO bukan mata uang dasar
    function applyCurrencyHeaders() {
        var cm = itemGrid.getColumnModel();
        var diff = grnCur.code !== grnCur.base;
        cm.setColumnHeader(5, 'Harga Satuan (' + grnCur.code + ')');
        cm.setColumnHeader(6, 'Subtotal (' + grnCur.code + ')');
        cm.setColumnHeader(7, 'Subtotal Dasar (' + grnCur.base + ')');
        cm.setHidden(7, !diff);
        setCurInfo();
        itemGrid.getView().refresh();
    }

    function setCurInfo() {
        if (!fldCurInfo) return;
        fldCurInfo.setValue('<b>' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(grnCur.code) + '</b>' +
            (grnCur.code !== grnCur.base
                ? ' &nbsp;(kurs PO: 1 ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(grnCur.code) + ' = ' + Ext.util.Format.number(grnCur.rate, '0,000.0000') + ' ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(grnCur.base) + ')'
                : ' &nbsp;(mata uang dasar)'));
    }

    function updateGrnTotalLabel() {
        var total = 0;
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('qty_input')) || 0;
            var cost = parseFloat(r.get('unit_cost')) || 0;
            total += qty * cost;
        });
        var el = document.getElementById('lblGrnTotal');
        if (el) {
            var html = Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.00') + ' ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(grnCur.code);
            if (grnCur.code !== grnCur.base) {
                html += ' <span style="color:#9fc3d1; font-weight:normal;">&asymp; ' + Ext.util.Format.number(total * grnCur.rate, '0,000.00') + ' ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(grnCur.base) + '</span>';
            }
            el.innerHTML = html;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Editor Form
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // [CHANGED 2026-10-30] semua field diberi lebar eksplisit (anchor / width) dan dikelompokkan per kolom seperti form PO / Purchase Invoice;

    var fldRefNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. GRN', id: 'ref_no', name: 'ref_no', readOnly: true, emptyText: 'Auto-generate', anchor: '95%' });
    var fldPoHdr = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Purchase Order', id: 'po_id', name: 'po_id', hiddenName: 'po_id',
        store: poDs, displayField: 'ref_no', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false, anchor: '95%',      // [CHANGED]
        listeners: {
            select: function (combo, record) {
                Ext.getCmp('supplier_id_hidden') && Ext.getCmp('supplier_id_hidden').setValue(record.get('supplier_id'));
                grnCur = { code: record.get('currency_code') || grnCur.base, base: grnCur.base, rate: parseFloat(record.get('exch_rate')) || 1 };
                setCurInfo();
                itemGridDs.load({
                    params: {
                        po_id: record.get('id'),
                        grn_id: (task === 'update' && dataRecord) ? dataRecord.id : 0
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    });
    var fldCurInfo = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ fieldLabel: 'Mata Uang PO', value: '-' });
    var fldGrnDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tgl GRN', id: 'grn_date', name: 'grn_date', allowBlank: false, value: new Date(), width: 130 });   // [CHANGED]
    var fldSupplierIdHidden = new myTextField({ id: 'supplier_id_hidden', name: 'supplier_id', hidden: true });
    var fldRemark = new myTextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Keterangan', id: 'remark', name: 'remark', anchor: '95%', height: 60 });   // [CHANGED]
    // [NEW] No. DO Supplier (nomor surat jalan dari supplier) -> acuan trace ke W/H RCV dan Retur Pembelian

    // [NEW] Plat No. Kendaraan & Nama Driver (opsional; backend merapikan plat jadi huruf besar)

        listeners: { blur: function (f) { f.setValue(String(f.getValue() || '').toUpperCase()); } } });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({

        labelWidth: 120,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },

        ]
    });

    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (getFormAccess() >= 2) {
            task = 'create';
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            itemGridDs.removeAll();

            grnCur.code = grnCur.base;

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        if (!dataRecord) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data GRN yang ingin diedit.');
            return;
        }

        if (getFormAccess() >= 3) {
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            task = 'update';

            if (!poDs.getById(dataRecord.po_id)) {
                var PoRecord = Ext.data.Record.create(poField);
                poDs.add(new PoRecord({
                    id: dataRecord.po_id,
                    ref_no: dataRecord.po_ref_no + ' (sudah selesai diterima)',
                    supplier_id: dataRecord.supplier_id,
                    supplier_name: dataRecord.supplier_name,
                    currency_code: dataRecord.currency_code,
                    exch_rate: dataRecord.exch_rate
                }, dataRecord.po_id));
            }

            frmEditor.getForm().load({
                url: '../dev/php-crud/grnCRD.php',
                params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' },
                success: function (form, action) {
                    fldPoHdr.setDisabled(true);
                    itemGridDs.load({
                        params: {
                            po_id: dataRecord.po_id,
                            grn_id: dataRecord.id
                        },
                        callback: function () {
                            updateGrnTotalLabel();
                        }
                    });
                }
            });

            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit GRN';
        } else {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengedit.');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data GRN yang ingin dihapus.');
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() >= 4) {
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi Hapus', 'Hapus GRN \'' + dataRecord.ref_no + '\'? Jurnal & status outstanding PO akan dibatalkan otomatis.', function (btn) {
                if (btn === 'yes') {
                    Ext.Ajax.request({
                        url: '../dev/php-crud/grnCRD.php',
                        method: 'POST',
                        params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                        success: function (response) {
                            var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Informasi', res.message);
                            grnDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                            mainDs.load();
                        },
                        failure: function () {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        } else {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses menghapus data.');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        var poHdrId = fldPoHdr.getValue();
        if (!poHdrId) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih Purchase Order terlebih dahulu.');
            return;
        }

        var arrItems = [];
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('qty_input')) || 0;
            if (qty > 0) {
                arrItems.push({
                    po_dtl_id: r.get('po_dtl_id'),
                    item_id: r.get('item_id'),
                    item_name: r.get('item_name'),
                    qty_received: qty,
                    unit_cost: parseFloat(r.get('unit_cost')) || 0,
                    remark: ''
                });
            }
        });

        if (arrItems.length === 0) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Minimal 1 item dengan qty diterima > 0.');
            return;
        }

        var currentId = (task === 'update' && dataRecord) ? dataRecord.id : null;
        var supplierId = fldSupplierIdHidden.getValue();
        if (!supplierId && task === 'update' && dataRecord) {
            supplierId = dataRecord.supplier_id;
        }

        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../dev/php-crud/grnCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: task,
                id: currentId,
                supplier_id: supplierId,
                arrItems: JSON.stringify(arrItems)
            },
            waitTitle: 'Menyimpan',
            waitMsg: 'Memproses GRN & auto-jurnal...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message);
                grnDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                mainDs.load();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('grnDtlContainer').style.display = 'none';
});

      ]
    });
    frmAdd.on('clientvalidation', function(f, valid) {if (!valid) {addSaveEditDisable();} else {addSaveEditEnable();}});

    var GridDtlHeight=(maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));
    var mainHeight=Math.round(GridDtlHeight-(GridDtlHeight*0.5));
    var detailHeight=(GridDtlHeight-mainHeight+6);

        {header: "Start Date", dataIndex: 'from_date', width: 150, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y')},
        {header: "End Date", dataIndex: 'to_date', width: 150,renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y')},
        {header: "Remark", dataIndex: 'remark', width: 250, renderer: CellWrap},
        {dataIndex: 'department_id', hidden: true},
        {dataIndex: 'id', hidden: true}
      ]

    /* History */
    var GridHistoryDs = new historyDs({url: '../php-crud/m.employee.php'});
    var GridHistory = new historyGrid({store  : GridHistoryDs, renderTo: 'logFormMain'});
    
    /* end of History */

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display='none';
    document.getElementById('logWdw').style.display='none';
