==================== FILE: ./js/profitloss.js ====================
/*
  Document      : profitloss.js
  Description   : Profit & Loss (Laporan Rugi Laba) - Read-only report.
                  Kolom ganda: "Periode Ini" (mutasi dalam periode) dan "Kumulatif s/d Periode" (dari awal s/d akhir periode).
                  Periode default = periode yang memuat tanggal hari ini.
  Backend       : /rab-project/dev/php-crud/profitlossCRD.php
  CATATAN       : File ini disusun ulang mengikuti pola balancesheet.js dan tampilan layar Profit & Loss sebelumnya.
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    var CRD = main_url + '/php-crud/profitlossCRD.php';

    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Profit &amp; <em>Loss</em>";

    ['addData', 'editData', 'deleteData'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // 0. Container filter & report
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var filterBarDiv = document.createElement('div');
    filterBarDiv.id = 'plFilterBar';
    filterBarDiv.style.padding = '0 10px';

    var reportDiv = document.createElement('div');
    reportDiv.id = 'plReportContainer';
    reportDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:15px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color:#fff; margin:0 10px 10px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); font-size:13px; overflow-y:auto; overflow-x:hidden;';

    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(filterBarDiv, gridContainer);
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(reportDiv, gridContainer);
    }

    // Tinggi kontainer report = sisa tinggi layar (scrollbar muncul bila isi lebih panjang)
    function fitReport() {
        var top = reportDiv.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        var h = (window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight) - top - 20;
        reportDiv.style.maxHeight = Math.max(h, 200) + 'px';
    }
    window.onresize = fitReport;

    // 1. Store Periode
    // [DEFAULT-PERIOD][NEW] Periode default = periode yang memuat tanggal hari ini; bila tidak ada -> periode terbaru (baris pertama)
    function pickDefaultPeriod(store) {
        var d = new Date(), m = d.getMonth() + 1, day = d.getDate();
        var today = d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : m) + '-' + (day < 10 ? '0' + day : day);
        var idx = store.findBy(function (r) { return r.get('start_date') <= today && today <= r.get('end_date'); });
        return store.getAt(idx >= 0 ? idx : 0).get('id');
    }

    var periodField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'period_name' }, { name: 'start_date' }, { name: 'end_date' }];
    var periodDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        baseParams: { task: 'read_periods' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, periodField),
        listeners: {
            load: function (store) {
                if (store.getCount() > 0 && !fldPeriod.getValue()) {
                    fldPeriod.setValue(pickDefaultPeriod(store));     // [DEFAULT-PERIOD]
                    loadProfitLoss();
                }
            },
            exception: function () {
                reportDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">Gagal memuat daftar periode.</div>';
            }
        }
    });
    periodDs.load();

    // 2. Filter Bar
    var fldPeriod = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Periode', width: 220, store: periodDs, displayField: 'period_name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var btnShow = new Ext.Button({ text: 'Tampilkan', cls: 'field-button grey-field-button' });

    var filterPanel = new Ext.Panel({
        renderTo: 'plFilterBar',
        layout: 'column',
        border: false,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:8px 0;',
        defaults: { border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;' },
        items: [
            { columnWidth: 0.35, layout: 'form', labelWidth: 60, items: fldPeriod },
            { columnWidth: 0.15, style: 'padding-top:2px;', items: btnShow }
        ]
    });

    function loadProfitLoss() {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_profit_loss', period_id: perId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res;
                try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); }
                catch (e) { reportDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">Respons server tidak valid.</div>'; return; }
                if (!res.success) {
                    reportDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">' + (res.message || 'Gagal memuat data.') + '</div>';
                    return;
                }
                renderPLView(res);
            },
            failure: function () {
                reportDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">Gagal menghubungi server.</div>';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderPLView(res) {
        var fmt = function (val) { return Ext.util.Format.number(val || 0, '0,000.00'); };
        var enc = Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode;
        var cellPad = 'padding:3px 6px;';
        // [HEADER] gaya sel header kolom ditetapkan di SETIAP sel (CSS template menimpa font-size yang hanya di <tr>): 16px, tebal, putih
        var hdrCell = 'padding:6px 6px; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; color:#ffffff;';
        var zebra = function (i) { return (i % 2 === 0) ? 'background:rgba(255,255,255,0.00);' : 'background:rgba(15, 113, 194, 0.2);'; };

        // satu blok seksi (pendapatan / beban) dengan dua kolom nilai
        function section(title, color, items, totalLabel, total, totalCum) {
            // [HEADER] judul seksi 18px; baris header kolom 14px, tebal, putih, berlatar agar terbaca jelas
            var h = '<h3 style="color:' + color + '; margin:18px 0 8px 0; font-size:18px;">' + title + '</h3>' +
                    '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse; color:' + color + ';">' +
                    '<tr style="color:#ffffff; font-size:14px; font-weight:bold; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35);">' +
                    '<td style="' + hdrCell + '" width="90">Kode</td><td style="' + hdrCell + '">Nama Akun</td>' +
                    '<td align="right" style="' + hdrCell + '" width="170">Periode Ini</td>' +
                    '<td align="right" style="' + hdrCell + '" width="190">Kumulatif s/d Periode</td></tr>';
            Ext.each(items, function (a, i) {
                h += '<tr style="' + zebra(i) + '">' +
                     '<td style="' + cellPad + '">' + enc(a.account_code) + '</td>' +
                     '<td style="' + cellPad + '">' + enc(a.account_name) + '</td>' +
                     '<td align="right" style="' + cellPad + '">' + fmt(a.amount) + '</td>' +
                     '<td align="right" style="' + cellPad + '">' + fmt(a.amount_cum) + '</td></tr>';
            });
            h += '<tr style="font-weight:bold; font-size:15px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);">' +
                 '<td colspan="2" style="padding:8px 6px;">' + totalLabel + '</td>' +
                 '<td align="right" style="padding:8px 6px;">' + fmt(total) + '</td>' +
                 '<td align="right" style="padding:8px 6px;">' + fmt(totalCum) + '</td></tr></table>';
            return h;
        }

        var netColor = function (v) { return v >= 0 ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171'; };

        var html = '<h2 style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:4px; font-weight:normal;">LAPORAN RUGI LABA</h2>' +
                   '<h4 style="text-align:center; color:#bbb; margin-top:0; font-weight:normal;">Periode: ' + enc(res.period_name) +
                   ' (' + enc(res.start_date) + ' s/d ' + enc(res.end_date) + ')</h4>' +
                   '<hr style="border:0; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); margin:15px 0;" />';

        // [CUM-CHECK] Bila server masih memakai profitlossCRD.php lama (tanpa amount_cum), beri tahu -- jangan tampil 0.00 yang menyesatkan
        if (res.total_revenue_cum === undefined) {
            html += '<div style="padding:8px 10px; margin-bottom:8px; background:rgba(255,235,59,0.12); color:#ffeb3b; border-radius:3px;">' +
                    'Kolom kumulatif belum tersedia: file php-crud/profitlossCRD.php di server belum versi terbaru (tanpa field amount_cum).</div>';
        }

        html += section('PENDAPATAN', '#7cdc2f', res.revenues, 'TOTAL PENDAPATAN', res.total_revenue, res.total_revenue_cum);
        html += section('BEBAN / BIAYA', '#e8554a', res.expenses, 'TOTAL BEBAN', res.total_expense, res.total_expense_cum);

        html += '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse; margin-top:20px;">' +
                '<tr style="font-weight:bold; font-size:18px; color:#ffffff; border-top:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);">' +
                '<td style="padding:10px 6px; color:#ffffff;">' + (res.net_profit_loss >= 0 ? 'LABA BERSIH' : 'RUGI BERSIH') + '</td>' +
                '<td align="right" style="padding:10px 6px; color:' + netColor(res.net_profit_loss) + ';" width="170">' + fmt(res.net_profit_loss) + '</td>' +
                '<td align="right" style="padding:10px 6px; color:' + netColor(res.net_profit_loss_cum) + ';" width="190">' + fmt(res.net_profit_loss_cum) + '</td>' +
                '</tr></table>';

        reportDiv.innerHTML = html;
        fitReport();
    }

    btnShow.on('click', loadProfitLoss);

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        window.open('../pdf/profitloss.php?period_id=' + perId, '_blank', 'width=900,height=800,scrollbars=yes,resizable=yes');
    };

    if (document.getElementById('popOK')) {
        document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        };
    }
});

Ext.onReady(function() {
	Ext.QuickTips.init();
  let myMask = new Ext.LoadMask(Ext.getBody(), {msg:'Please wait...'});
  let deleteDs = new Ext.data.Store({url: '../php-crud/purchase.orderCRD.php'});
  ArrayItem=[], editReq=0, costStatus='local';
  let gridEditorHeight=0, gridItemHeight=0;
  // [GRID-WRAP 2026-11-17] Override SCOPED untuk seluruh grid di halaman Purchase Order:
  // #divMainGrid (daftar PO), #editorFormGrid (item PO & costs), #addFormGrid (pilih item),
  // #divDetailGrid (detail PO), #logFormMain (history). Tidak menyentuh CSS global maupun
  // js-func/ExtExtend.js. ExtJS 3.4.1 (css/ext-all.css) memasang
  //   .x-grid3-cell-inner,.x-grid3-hd-inner{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
  // sehingga header & sel panjang terpotong "...". Paksa wrap + clip + tinggi baris dinamis.
  // Angka tetap rata kanan (align ColumnModel dihormati — hanya white-space yang berubah).
  (function injectGridWrapCss() {
    var st = document.createElement('style');
    st.type = 'text/css';
    st.appendChild(document.createTextNode(
      '#divMainGrid .x-grid3-hd-inner, #editorFormGrid .x-grid3-hd-inner, #addFormGrid .x-grid3-hd-inner, #divDetailGrid .x-grid3-hd-inner, #logFormMain .x-grid3-hd-inner {' +
      ' white-space:normal !important; overflow:visible !important; text-overflow:clip !important;' +
      ' word-wrap:break-word !important; overflow-wrap:break-word !important; word-break:break-word !important;' +
      ' line-height:1.3 !important; height:auto !important; min-height:34px !important;' +
      ' padding:4px 6px !important; box-sizing:border-box; vertical-align:middle !important;' +
      ' display:flex !important; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; }' +
      '#divMainGrid .x-grid3-cell-inner, #editorFormGrid .x-grid3-cell-inner, #addFormGrid .x-grid3-cell-inner, #divDetailGrid .x-grid3-cell-inner, #logFormMain .x-grid3-cell-inner {' +
      ' white-space:normal !important; overflow:visible !important; text-overflow:clip !important;' +
      ' word-wrap:break-word !important; overflow-wrap:break-word !important; word-break:break-word !important;' +

  document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function(event) {
		let arrItem = dataStore2Array(gridEditorDs).map(dataItem => {
      return {
				po_hdr_id         : dataItem.po_hdr_id,
        po_dtl_id         : dataItem.po_dtl_id,
        item_id           : dataItem.item_id,
        qty               : parseFloat($N(dataItem.total_qty,0)),
        remark            : $N(dataItem.remark,''),
        unit_price        : parseFloat($N(dataItem.unit_price,0)),
        additional_qty    : parseFloat($N(dataItem.additional_qty,0)),
        disc_item         : parseFloat($N(dataItem.disc_item,0)),
        disc_item_percent : (dataItem.disc_item_percent==undefined || dataItem.disc_item_percent==null || dataItem.disc_item_percent=='') ? 'false' : 'true',
        req_id            : dataItem.req_id
      };
    });
    let arrCost = dataStore2Array(gridCostDs).filter((dataCostDtl) => {return parseInt($N(dataCostDtl.amount,0))>0;}).map((dataCostDtl) => {
      return {
        po_hdr_id  : dataCostDtl.po_id,
        po_cost_id : dataCostDtl.po_cost_id,
        cost_id    : dataCostDtl.cost_id,
        amount     : parseFloat($N(dataCostDtl.amount,0)),
        po_include : (dataCostDtl.po_include==undefined || dataCostDtl.po_include==null || dataCostDtl.po_include=='') ? 'false' : 'true'
      };
    });

    Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().submit({
      method:'POST',
      params : {
        task        : task,
        ppn         : Ext.getCmp('po_ppn').getValue(),
        disc_pcnt   : Ext.getCmp('disc_percent').getValue(),
        allow_pcnt  : Ext.getCmp('allow_percent').getValue(),
        arrItemDtl  : Array2Json(arrItem),
        arrCostDtl  : Array2Json(arrCost)
      },
      waitTitle:'Connecting',
      waitMsg:'Sending data...',
      success:function(form,action){
        var objResponse=Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
        var messagesStatus=objResponse.status; var messages=objResponse.message;
        /*document.getElementById('popWdwMainHeaderText').innerHTML=messagesStatus;*/
        document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML=messages;
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';
        mainDs.load({params:{task: 'read'}});
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display='none';
      },
      failure:function(form, action){
        var objResponse=Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
        var messagesStatus=objResponse.status; var messages=objResponse.message;
        /*document.getElementById('popWdwMainHeaderText').innerHTML=messagesStatus;*/
        document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML=messages;
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';
      }
    });
  };

      deleteDs.load({
        params:{task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
        callback:function(records, operation, success){
          document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='none';
          document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display='none';
          task='';
          var textMessages=Ext.util.JSON.decode(operation.callback.caller.caller.arguments[2].responseText);
          var messagesStatus=textMessages.status;
          var messages=textMessages.message;
          /*document.getElementById('popWdwMainHeaderText').innerHTML=messagesStatus;*/
          document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML=messages;
          document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='block';
        }
      });

      gridMain.getView().refresh(true);
      task='';
    }
    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display='none';
    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display='none';

    listeners: {

        let record=grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex).data;
        poId=record.id; costStatus=record.coststatus;
        gridDetailDs.load({params:{po_hdr_id: record.id}});
        gridEditorDs.load({params:{po_hdr_id: record.id}});

  });

  let gridDetail = new stdGrid({
    store  : gridDetailDs,

    // [GRID-WRAP 2026-11-17] forceFit dimatikan agar header/nominal tidak terpotong "..." (pola js/po.js).
    viewConfig: { forceFit: false, scrollOffset: 0 },
    columns:[
      {header: 'Name',dataIndex: 'item_name',width: 200,align: 'left',renderer: CellWrap},
      {header: 'Size', dataIndex: 'size', width: 100, renderer: CellWrap},
      {header: '', dataIndex: 'um_unit', width: 50, renderer: CellWrap},
      {header: 'Req.<br/>Qty.', dataIndex: 'req_qty', width: 80, align: 'right',renderer: format_number},
      {header: 'Addtn.<br/>P.O. Qty.', dataIndex: 'additional_qty', width: 80, align: 'right',renderer: format_number},
      {header: 'Total<br/>P.O. Qty',dataIndex: 'total_qty',width: 80, align: 'right',renderer: totalQtyPO},
      {header: 'Unit Price.', dataIndex: 'unit_price', width: 100, align: 'right',renderer: format_number},
      {header: 'Disc', dataIndex: 'disc_item', width: 100, align: 'right',renderer: CellWrap},
      detailCheckColumn,
      {header: 'Disc Amnt', dataIndex: 'item_disc', width: 100, align: 'right',renderer: format_number},

==================== FILE: ./js/journal.entry.js ====================

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    var CRD = main_url + '/php-crud/journal.entryCRD.php';

    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Journal <em>Entry</em>";

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    // 0. Container Detail Baris Jurnal (Pola Detail Panel GRN)
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');

    var journalDtlDiv = document.createElement('div');
    journalDtlDiv.id = 'journalDtlContainer';
    journalDtlDiv.className = 'detail-panel-container';
    journalDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';

    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(journalDtlDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling);
    }

    // Buat elemen UI tambahan pada form editor
    (function injectExtraUI() {
        var iconMenu = document.getElementById('iconMenuL');
        if (iconMenu && !document.getElementById('postData')) {
            var postBtn = document.createElement('a');
            postBtn.id = 'postData';
            postBtn.href = 'javascript:void(0);';
            postBtn.style.display = 'none';
            postBtn.innerHTML = '<t>Post</t><i class="material-icons md-22 white">lock</i>';
            iconMenu.appendChild(postBtn);
        }

        var gridEditorContainer = document.getElementById('editorFormGrid');
        if (gridEditorContainer && !document.getElementById('btnAddLine')) {
            var toolbar = document.createElement('div');
            toolbar.style.padding = '5px 0';
            toolbar.innerHTML = '<button id="btnAddLine" type="button" class="field-button grey-field-button">+ Tambah Baris</button>';
            gridEditorContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(toolbar, gridEditorContainer);

            var totalsDiv = document.createElement('div');
            totalsDiv.className = 'journal-totals';
            totalsDiv.innerHTML =
                '<span>Total Debit: <span id="lblTotalDebit">0.00</span></span>' +
                '<span>Total Kredit: <span id="lblTotalCredit">0.00</span></span>' +
                '<span id="lblBalanceStatus"></span>';
            gridEditorContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(totalsDiv, gridEditorContainer.nextSibling);
        }
    })();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Fields & Stores
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var journalField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'ref_no' }, { name: 'journal_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'period_id' }, { name: 'period_name' }, { name: 'description' },
        { name: 'total_debit', type: 'float' }, { name: 'total_credit', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'status' }
    ];

    var lineField = [
        { name: 'line_id' }, { name: 'account_id' }, { name: 'account_code' }, { name: 'account_name' },
        { name: 'debit', type: 'float' }, { name: 'credit', type: 'float' }, { name: 'description' }
    ];
    var addLineRow = Ext.data.Record.create(lineField);

    var coaField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'account_code' }, { name: 'account_name' }];
    var coaDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../dev/php-crud/m.coaCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_parent' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, coaField)
    });
    coaDs.load();

    var periodField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'period_name' }];
    var periodDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../dev/php-crud/m.fiscalperiodCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_open' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, periodField)
    });
    periodDs.load();

    var lineGridDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        baseParams: { task: 'read_lines' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, lineField)
    });

    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, journalField)
    });
    mainDs.load();

    function statusRenderer(v) {
        if (v === 'posted') return '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">Posted</span>';
        if (v === 'reversed') return '<span style="color:#8e44ad;font-weight:bold;">Reversed</span>';
        return '<span style="color:#e08e0b;">Draft</span>';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Main Grid
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var GridDtlHeight = (maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));
    var mainHeight = Math.round(GridDtlHeight - (GridDtlHeight * 0.45));

    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: mainHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. Jurnal', dataIndex: 'ref_no', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Tanggal', dataIndex: 'journal_date', width: 90, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            { header: 'Periode', dataIndex: 'period_name', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Keterangan', dataIndex: 'description', width: 220, renderer: CellWrap },
            {
                header: 'Total Debit', dataIndex: 'total_debit', width: 110, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Total Kredit', dataIndex: 'total_credit', width: 110, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            { header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 90, align: 'center', renderer: statusRenderer }
        ],
        stripeRows: true,
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        loadMask: true,
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) {
                    dataRecord = rec.data;
                    mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                    editDataEnable();
                    togglePostButton();
                    toggleEditViewButtons();
                    loadJournalDetail(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.ref_no);
                }
            }
        }
    });
    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Detail View Renderer (Desain Seragam dengan GRN)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // [PRINT-JV][NEW] Cetak satu jurnal (per id) -- dipanggil dari tombol Print di panel detail
    function printJournal(journalId) {
        if (!journalId) return;
        window.open('../pdf/journal.php?id=' + encodeURIComponent(journalId), '_blank', 'width=900,height=800,scrollbars=yes,resizable=yes');
    }

    function loadJournalDetail(journalId, refNo) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_lines', id: journalId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    journalDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">Gagal memuat detail jurnal.</div>';
                    journalDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderJournalDetailView(res.data || [], refNo, journalId);     // [PRINT-JV] + journalId
            },
            failure: function() {
                journalDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                journalDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderJournalDetailView(rows, refNo, journalId) {     // [PRINT-JV] + journalId
        var fmtAmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };
        var totalDebit = 0, totalCredit = 0;

        // [PRINT-JV][NEW] judul detail + tombol Print (cetak jurnal ini saja)
        var html = '<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">' +
                   '<h3 class="detail-title" style="margin:0;">Detail Baris Jurnal: ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(refNo || '') + '</h3>' +
                   // [PRINT-JV] gaya disamakan dengan tombol toolbar utama: latar transparan, ikon & teks putih (bukan tombol abu-abu terang)
                   '<button id="btnPrintJournalDtl" type="button" ' +
                   'style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:transparent; color:#ffffff; font-family:inherit; font-size:13px; ' +
                   'border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35); border-radius:3px; padding:4px 14px; cursor:pointer;" ' +
                   'onmouseover="this.style.background=\'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)\';" onmouseout="this.style.background=\'transparent\';">' +
                   '<i class="material-icons md-22 white">print</i> Print</button>' +
                   '</div>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Kode Akun</th>' +
                   '<th align="left">Nama Akun</th>' +
                   '<th align="left">Journal </th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Debit</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Kredit</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty-msg">Tidak ada baris jurnal.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var debit = parseFloat(r.debit) || 0;
                var credit = parseFloat(r.credit) || 0;
                totalDebit += debit;
                totalCredit += credit;

                html += '<tr class="data-row">' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.account_code || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.account_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.description || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:bold;">' + (debit ? fmtAmt(debit) : '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:#f87171; font-weight:bold;">' + (credit ? fmtAmt(credit) : '-') + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });
        }

        html += '</tbody>' +
                '<tfoot>' +
                '<tr class="total-row">' +
                '<td colspan="3" align="right" class="total-label">TOTAL:</td>' +
                '<td align="right" style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtAmt(totalDebit) + '</td>' +
                '<td align="right" style="color:#f87171; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtAmt(totalCredit) + '</td>' +
                '</tr>' +
                '</tfoot>' +
                '</table>';

        journalDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        journalDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';

        var btnPrint = document.getElementById('btnPrintJournalDtl');     // [PRINT-JV] dibuat ulang tiap render -> pasang handler di sini
        if (btnPrint) btnPrint.onclick = function () { printJournal(journalId); };
    }

    function toggleEditViewButtons() {
        var editBtn = document.getElementById('editData');
        var viewBtn = document.getElementById('viewData');
        if (!dataRecord) return;
        var isDraft = dataRecord.status === 'draft';
        if (editBtn) editBtn.style.display = isDraft ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (viewBtn) viewBtn.style.display = isDraft ? 'none' : 'block';
    }

    function setLineEditable(editable) {
        var cm = lineGrid.getColumnModel();
        for (var i = 0; i < cm.getColumnCount(); i++) {
            if (cm.isHidden(i)) continue;
            cm.setEditable(i, editable);
        }
        var addBtn = document.getElementById('btnAddLine');
        if (addBtn) addBtn.style.display = editable ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
        var saveBtn = document.getElementById('saveEdit');
        if (saveBtn) saveBtn.style.display = editable ? 'block' : 'none';
        fldDate.setDisabled(!editable);
        fldPeriod.setDisabled(!editable);
        fldDesc.setDisabled(!editable);
    }

    function togglePostButton() {
        var btn = document.getElementById('postData');
        if (!btn || !dataRecord) return;
        if (dataRecord.status === 'draft') {
            btn.style.display = 'block';
            btn.innerHTML = '<t>Post</t><i class="material-icons md-22 white">lock</i>';
        } else if (dataRecord.status === 'posted') {
            btn.style.display = 'block';
            btn.innerHTML = '<t>Reverse</t><i class="material-icons md-22 white">undo</i>';
        } else {
            btn.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Line Grid Editor (Form Dialog)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var lineDeleter = new Extensive.grid.ItemDeleter();

    var lineGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: lineGridDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true, scrollOffset: 0 },
        height: 220,
        selModel: lineDeleter,
        columns: [
            {
                header: 'Akun', dataIndex: 'account_id', width: 220,
                editor: new myComboField({ store: coaDs, displayField: 'account_name', valueField: 'id' }),
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    return record.get('account_code') ? (record.get('account_code') + ' - ' + record.get('account_name')) : '';
                }
            },
            {
                header: 'Debit', dataIndex: 'debit', width: 110, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }),
                renderer: function (v) { return v ? Ext.util.Format.number(v, '0,000.00') : ''; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Kredit', dataIndex: 'credit', width: 110, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }),
                renderer: function (v) { return v ? Ext.util.Format.number(v, '0,000.00') : ''; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Keterangan', dataIndex: 'description', width: 180,
                editor: new myTextField({}), renderer: CellWrap
            },
            lineDeleter
        ],
        listeners: {
            afteredit: function (e) {
                if (e.field === 'account_id') {
                    var rec = coaDs.getById(e.value);
                    if (rec) {
                        e.record.set('account_code', rec.get('account_code'));
                        e.record.set('account_name', rec.get('account_name'));
                    }
                }
                updateTotals();
            }
        }
    });
    lineGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    document.getElementById('btnAddLine') && (document.getElementById('btnAddLine').onclick = function () {
        lineGridDs.add(new addLineRow({ account_id: null, debit: 0, credit: 0, description: '' }));
    });

    function updateTotals() {
        var totalDebit = 0, totalCredit = 0;
        lineGridDs.each(function (r) {
            totalDebit += parseFloat(r.get('debit')) || 0;
            totalCredit += parseFloat(r.get('credit')) || 0;
        });
        var debitEl = document.getElementById('lblTotalDebit');
        var creditEl = document.getElementById('lblTotalCredit');
        var balanceEl = document.getElementById('lblBalanceStatus');
        if (debitEl) debitEl.innerHTML = Ext.util.Format.number(totalDebit, '0,000.00');
        if (creditEl) creditEl.innerHTML = Ext.util.Format.number(totalCredit, '0,000.00');
        if (balanceEl) {
            var isBalance = Math.abs(totalDebit - totalCredit) < 0.01;
            balanceEl.innerHTML = isBalance ? 'BALANCE' : 'TIDAK BALANCE';
            balanceEl.style.color = isBalance ? '#2e9e4f' : '#c0392b';
        }
    }
    lineGridDs.on('update', updateTotals);
    lineGridDs.on('add', updateTotals);
    lineGridDs.on('remove', updateTotals);
    lineGridDs.on('load', updateTotals);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Editor Form
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fldJournalNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Jurnal', id: 'ref_no', name: 'ref_no', readOnly: true, emptyText: 'Auto-generate' });
    var fldDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal', id: 'journal_date', name: 'journal_date', allowBlank: false, value: new Date() });
    var fldPeriod = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Periode', id: 'period_id', name: 'period_id', hiddenName: 'period_id',
        store: periodDs, displayField: 'period_name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldDesc = new myTextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Keterangan', id: 'description', name: 'description' });
    var fldId = new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 100,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldJournalNo },
            { items: fldDate },
            { items: fldPeriod },
            { columnWidth: 1, items: fldDesc },
            { items: fldId }
        ]
    });
    frmEditor.on('clientvalidation', function (f, valid) { if (!valid) { saveEditDisable(); } else { saveEditEnable(); } });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. Action Handlers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
        if (getFormAccess() == 2 || getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'create';
            lineGridDs.removeAll();
            lineGridDs.add(new addLineRow({ account_id: null, debit: 0, credit: 0, description: '' }));
            lineGridDs.add(new addLineRow({ account_id: null, debit: 0, credit: 0, description: '' }));
            updateTotals();
            setLineEditable(true);
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Tambah Jurnal';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'draft') {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hanya jurnal berstatus Draft yang boleh diedit. Gunakan tombol View untuk melihat detail.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            task = 'update';
            frmEditor.getForm().load({ url: CRD, params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' } });
            lineGridDs.load({ params: { id: dataRecord.id } });
            setLineEditable(true);
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Jurnal';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    var viewBtn = document.getElementById('viewData');
    if (viewBtn) {
        viewBtn.onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            task = '';
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            frmEditor.getForm().load({ url: CRD, params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' } });
            lineGridDs.load({ params: { id: dataRecord.id } });
            setLineEditable(false);
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Detail Jurnal (' + dataRecord.status.toUpperCase() + ') - Read Only';
        };
    }

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'draft') {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hanya jurnal berstatus Draft yang boleh dihapus.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'delete';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hapus jurnal \'' + dataRecord.ref_no + '\' ?';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus data.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    var postBtn = document.getElementById('postData');
    if (postBtn) {
        postBtn.onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih jurnal terlebih dahulu.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            if (dataRecord.status === 'draft') {
                task = 'post';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Post jurnal \'' + dataRecord.ref_no + '\'? Setelah di-post, jurnal tidak bisa diedit/dihapus lagi.';
            } else if (dataRecord.status === 'posted') {
                task = 'reverse';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Reverse jurnal \'' + dataRecord.ref_no + '\'? Ini akan membuat jurnal koreksi baru dengan debit/kredit dibalik.';
            }
        };
    }

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function (event) {
        // [PRINT-JV] Tombol Printing utama = cetak SEMUA jurnal (tidak tergantung baris terpilih).
        //            Cetak per jurnal memakai tombol Print di panel Detail Baris Jurnal (printJournal).
        //            Argumen fitur window.open dijadikan satu string (sebelumnya terpisah & diabaikan).
        window.open('../dev/pdf/journal.php', '_blank', 'width=900,height=800,scrollbars=yes,resizable=yes');
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        var totalDebit = 0, totalCredit = 0;
        var arrLines = [];
        lineGridDs.each(function (r) {
            var acc = r.get('account_id');
            var debit = parseFloat(r.get('debit')) || 0;
            var credit = parseFloat(r.get('credit')) || 0;
            if (!acc || (debit === 0 && credit === 0)) return;
            totalDebit += debit;
            totalCredit += credit;
            arrLines.push({ account_id: acc, debit: debit, credit: credit, description: r.get('description') });
        });

        if (arrLines.length < 2) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Jurnal minimal harus punya 2 baris (debit & kredit).';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (Math.abs(totalDebit - totalCredit) > 0.01) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Jurnal tidak balance! Total Debit: ' + totalDebit.toFixed(2) + ', Total Kredit: ' + totalCredit.toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }

        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: task, arrLines: JSON.stringify(arrLines) },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                journalDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                lineGridDs.removeAll();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message || 'Gagal menyimpan jurnal.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});
==================== FILE: ./js/year.closing.js ====================
/*
  Document      : year.closing.js
  Description   : Tutup Buku Tahunan (jurnal penutup). Grid utama = daftar tahun yang sudah ditutup.
                  Add membuka editor: pilih tahun buku + akun Laba Ditahan + opsi kunci periode; pratinjau dari server
                  (saldo pendapatan & beban, laba/rugi, syarat penutupan). Simpan = membuat 1 jurnal penutup (closing_entry)
                  tanggal 31 Desember dan (opsional) mengunci seluruh periode tahun itu.
                  Delete = buka kembali penutupan TERAKHIR (jurnal dihapus, periode dibuka). Edit tidak tersedia.
                  Pola mengikuti po.js / project.wiprelease.js (template many-template-icn.php).
  Backend       : /rab-project/dev/php-crud/year.closingCRD.php
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Tutup Buku <em>Tahunan</em>";

    var CRD = '../php-crud/year.closingCRD.php';
    var ACCESS_ADD = 3;      // tutup buku
    var ACCESS_DEL = 3;      // buka kembali

    var dataRecord = null;   // baris penutupan terpilih
    var frm = null;
    var fYear, fAcc, fLock, fRemark, fInfo;
    var previewReq = 0;
    var previewOk = false;
    var previewNotEnded = false;
    var selected = {};        // [PILIH AKUN] account_id -> true/false (checklist akun yang ikut ditutup)
    var lastPreview = null;   // hasil pratinjau terakhir (data akun)
    var lastYear = null;      // tahun pratinjau terakhir (pilihan direset saat tahun berganti)

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }
    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function fmtAmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    function showMsg(title, msg) { Ext.Msg.alert(title, msg); }

    function storeError(proxy, type, action, opt, res) {      // standar: setiap store punya handler exception
        var m = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        if (res && res.message) { m = res.message; } else if (res && res.status) { m += ' (HTTP ' + res.status + ')'; }
        showMsg('Gagal', m);
    }

    function ajax(params, onOk, onFail) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: params,
            success: function (response) {
                var res;
                try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); }
                catch (e) { showMsg('Gagal', 'Respons server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).'); return; }
                onOk(res);
            },
            failure: function () {
                if (onFail) onFail(); else showMsg('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
            }
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Stores
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var closingField = [
        { name: 'id', type: 'int' }, { name: 'fiscal_year', type: 'int' }, { name: 'closing_date' }, { name: 'journal_no' },
        { name: 'revenue_total', type: 'float' }, { name: 'expense_total', type: 'float' }, { name: 'net_income', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'retained_account' }, { name: 'locked_count', type: 'int' }, { name: 'remark' }, { name: 'is_latest' }
    ];

    var yearDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD, baseParams: { task: 'list_years' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'year' },
            [{ name: 'year', type: 'int' }, { name: 'closed' }, { name: 'label' }]),
        listeners: { exception: storeError }
    });
    var accDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD, baseParams: { task: 'list_accounts' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' },
            [{ name: 'id', type: 'int' }, { name: 'label' }, { name: 'is_default' }]),
        listeners: { exception: storeError }
    });

    // PENTING: assignment polos (bukan var/let) -- konvensi search box global.
    mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'list_closings' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, closingField),
        listeners: { exception: storeError }
    });
    mainDs.load();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Main Grid
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')),
        columns: [
            { header: 'Tahun Buku', dataIndex: 'fiscal_year', width: 90, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Tanggal Tutup', dataIndex: 'closing_date', width: 110, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'No. Jurnal', dataIndex: 'journal_no', width: 120, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Total Pendapatan', dataIndex: 'revenue_total', width: 140, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return fmtAmt(v); } },
            { header: 'Total Beban', dataIndex: 'expense_total', width: 140, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return fmtAmt(v); } },
            {
                header: 'Laba / (Rugi) Bersih', dataIndex: 'net_income', width: 150, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b style="color:' + (v >= 0 ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171') + ' !important;">' + fmtAmt(v) + '</b>'; }
            },
            { header: 'Akun Laba Ditahan', dataIndex: 'retained_account', width: 200, renderer: function (v) { return CellWrap(v || '-'); } },
            { header: 'Periode Dikunci', dataIndex: 'locked_count', width: 100, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Catatan', dataIndex: 'remark', width: 200, renderer: function (v) { return CellWrap(v || ''); } }
        ],
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        loadMask: true,
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (!rec) return;
                dataRecord = rec.data;
                updateMainButtons();
            }
        }
    });

    function updateMainButtons() {
        mainBtnEnable('#addData');
        // buka kembali hanya untuk penutupan terakhir (server juga memvalidasi)
        if (dataRecord && dataRecord.is_latest) { mainBtnEnable('#deleteData'); } else { mainBtnDisable('#deleteData'); }
    }
    editDataDisable();          // Edit tidak tersedia: koreksi = buka kembali lalu tutup ulang
    updateMainButtons();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Editor: form + pratinjau
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function ensureForm() {
        if (frm) { frm.doLayout(); return; }

        fYear = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Tahun Buku', store: yearDs, displayField: 'label', valueField: 'year',
            mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, editable: false, width: 200,
            listeners: { select: function () { doPreview(); } }
        });
        fAcc = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Akun Laba Ditahan', store: accDs, displayField: 'label', valueField: 'id',
            mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, anchor: '95%',
            listeners: { select: function () { doPreview(); } }
        });
        fLock = new Ext.form.Checkbox({ boxLabel: 'Kunci semua periode tahun ini setelah jurnal penutup dibuat', checked: true, hideLabel: true });
        fRemark = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Catatan', anchor: '95%' });
        fInfo = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ hideLabel: true, value: '', anchor: '98%' });

        var col = function (w, items) {
            return { columnWidth: w, layout: 'form', border: false, labelWidth: 130, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;', items: items };
        };
        frm = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
            renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
            border: false,
            layout: 'column',
            bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:6px 4px 0 4px;',
            items: [col(0.45, [fYear, fAcc]), col(0.55, [fRemark, fLock]),
                    { columnWidth: 1, layout: 'form', border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;', items: [fInfo] }]
        });
    }

    function resetForm() {
        fYear.clearValue();
        // akun default: Laba Ditahan (3200)
        var defId = null;
        accDs.each(function (r) {
            var d = r.get('is_default');
            if (defId === null && (d === true || d === 'true' || d === 1 || d === '1')) defId = r.get('id');
        });
        if (defId === null) { accDs.each(function (r) { if (defId === null && /^3200\b/.test(r.get('label'))) defId = r.get('id'); }); }
        if (defId !== null) fAcc.setValue(defId); else fAcc.clearValue();
        selected = {}; lastPreview = null; lastYear = null;      // [PILIH AKUN]
        fLock.setValue(true);
        fRemark.setValue('');
        fInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#668894;">Pilih tahun buku untuk melihat pratinjau jurnal penutup.</span>');
        previewOk = false;
        previewNotEnded = false;
        // tahun default: tahun terlama yang belum ditutup (penutupan harus berurutan)
        var pick = null;
        yearDs.each(function (r) { if (r.get('closed') !== true) pick = r.get('year'); });    // store urut turun -> baris terakhir = terlama
        if (pick !== null) { fYear.setValue(pick); doPreview(); }
    }

    function listHtml(items, color) {
        var h = '<ul style="margin:4px 0 8px 18px; padding:0; color:' + color + ';">';
        Ext.each(items, function (m) { h += '<li>' + enc(m) + '</li>'; });
        return h + '</ul>';
    }

    // [PILIH AKUN] tabel akun dengan checkbox per baris + checkbox "pilih semua" per bagian
    function accTable(title, secKey, items) {
        var allOn = items.length > 0;
        Ext.each(items, function (a) { if (!selected[a.account_id]) allOn = false; });
        var h = '<div style="margin-top:10px; font-weight:bold; font-size:14px;">' + title + '</div>' +
                '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse; font-size:13px;">' +
                '<tr style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.10); font-weight:bold;">' +
                '<td style="padding:3px 6px;" width="34"><input type="checkbox" class="ycSec" data-sec="' + secKey + '"' + (allOn ? ' checked' : '') + (items.length ? '' : ' disabled') + ' title="Pilih semua ' + title.toLowerCase() + '"/></td>' +
                '<td style="padding:3px 6px;" width="90">Kode</td><td style="padding:3px 6px;">Nama Akun</td>' +
                '<td align="right" style="padding:3px 6px;" width="150">Saldo</td><td align="right" style="padding:3px 6px;" width="170">Jurnal Penutup</td></tr>';
        Ext.each(items, function (a, i) {
            h += '<tr style="' + (i % 2 ? 'background:rgba(15,113,194,0.2);' : '') + '">' +
                 '<td style="padding:3px 6px;"><input type="checkbox" class="ycChk" data-id="' + a.account_id + '" data-sec="' + secKey + '"' + (selected[a.account_id] ? ' checked' : '') + '/></td>' +
                 '<td style="padding:3px 6px;">' + enc(a.account_code) + '</td>' +
                 '<td style="padding:3px 6px;">' + enc(a.account_name) + '</td>' +
                 '<td align="right" style="padding:3px 6px;">' + fmtAmt(a.balance) + '</td>' +
                 '<td align="right" style="padding:3px 6px;">' + (a.debit > 0 ? 'Dr ' + fmtAmt(a.debit) : 'Cr ' + fmtAmt(a.credit)) + '</td></tr>';
        });
        if (!items.length) h += '<tr><td colspan="5" style="padding:6px; color:#668894;">Tidak ada saldo.</td></tr>';
        return h + '</table>';
    }

    function selectedIds() {
        var ids = [];
        if (!lastPreview) return ids;
        Ext.each(lastPreview.revenue.concat(lastPreview.expense), function (a) { if (selected[a.account_id]) ids.push(a.account_id); });
        return ids;
    }

    // [PILIH AKUN] hitung ulang total dari akun terpilih (tanpa memuat ulang daftar, supaya posisi scroll tidak hilang)
    function updateSelectionUI() {
        if (!lastPreview) return;
        var rev = 0, exp = 0, cnt = 0, all = 0;
        Ext.each(lastPreview.revenue, function (a) { all++; if (selected[a.account_id]) { rev += a.balance; cnt++; } });
        Ext.each(lastPreview.expense, function (a) { all++; if (selected[a.account_id]) { exp += a.balance; cnt++; } });
        var net = Math.round((rev - exp) * 100) / 100;
        var set = function (id, html, color) {
            var el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el) { el.innerHTML = html; if (color) el.style.color = color; }
        };
        set('ycCnt', cnt + ' dari ' + all + ' akun dipilih', cnt === 0 ? '#ff6b5e' : (cnt < all ? '#e6a817' : '#9fc3d1'));
        set('ycRev', fmtAmt(rev));
        set('ycExp', fmtAmt(exp));
        set('ycNet', (net >= 0 ? 'LABA BERSIH ' : 'RUGI BERSIH ') + fmtAmt(Math.abs(net)) + ' &rarr; ' +
                     (net >= 0 ? 'Cr ' : 'Dr ') + enc(lastPreview.retained_account || 'Laba Ditahan'), net >= 0 ? '#7fe0a0' : '#ff6b5e');
        set('ycPartial', cnt > 0 && cnt < all ? 'Perhatian: akun yang tidak dipilih TIDAK ditutup, saldonya tetap terbawa ke tahun berikutnya.' : '');
        // status checkbox "pilih semua" tiap bagian
        var root = fInfo.getEl() ? fInfo.getEl().dom : null;
        if (!root) return;
        Ext.each(root.querySelectorAll('.ycSec'), function (box) {
            var items = box.getAttribute('data-sec') === 'rev' ? lastPreview.revenue : lastPreview.expense, on = items.length > 0;
            Ext.each(items, function (a) { if (!selected[a.account_id]) on = false; });
            box.checked = on;
        });
    }

    function wireSelection() {
        var root = fInfo.getEl() ? fInfo.getEl().dom : null;
        if (!root) return;
        Ext.each(root.querySelectorAll('.ycChk'), function (box) {
            box.onclick = function () { selected[parseInt(box.getAttribute('data-id'), 10)] = box.checked; updateSelectionUI(); };
        });
        Ext.each(root.querySelectorAll('.ycSec'), function (box) {
            box.onclick = function () {
                var items = box.getAttribute('data-sec') === 'rev' ? lastPreview.revenue : lastPreview.expense;
                Ext.each(items, function (a) { selected[a.account_id] = box.checked; });
                Ext.each(root.querySelectorAll('.ycChk[data-sec="' + box.getAttribute('data-sec') + '"]'), function (c) { c.checked = box.checked; });
                updateSelectionUI();
            };
        });
        var setAll = function (on) {
            Ext.each(lastPreview.revenue.concat(lastPreview.expense), function (a) { selected[a.account_id] = on; });
            Ext.each(root.querySelectorAll('.ycChk'), function (c) { c.checked = on; });
            updateSelectionUI();
        };
        var bAll = root.querySelector('.ycAllBtn'), bNone = root.querySelector('.ycNoneBtn');
        if (bAll) bAll.onclick = function () { setAll(true); };
        if (bNone) bNone.onclick = function () { setAll(false); };
    }

    var btnCss = 'background:transparent; color:#ffffff; font-family:inherit; font-size:12px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35); border-radius:3px; padding:2px 10px; cursor:pointer; margin-right:6px;';

    // Pratinjau dihitung server (rumus yang sama dengan saat simpan); akun dipilih lewat checklist
    function doPreview() {
        var y = fYear.getValue();
        previewOk = false;
        if (!y) { fInfo.setValue(''); return; }
        var token = ++previewReq;
        fInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#668894;">menghitung...</span>');
        ajax({ task: 'preview', year: y, retained_account_id: fAcc.getValue() || 0 }, function (res) {
            if (token !== previewReq) return;
            if (!res.success) { fInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#e6a817;">' + enc(res.message || 'Gagal menghitung.') + '</span>'); return; }
            var d = res.data;
            previewOk = (d.blockers.length === 0);
            previewNotEnded = !!d.not_ended;

            // pilihan: semua tercentang bila tahun berganti / pertama kali; selain itu pertahankan pilihan (akun baru default tercentang)
            var all = d.revenue.concat(d.expense), next = {};
            Ext.each(all, function (a) { next[a.account_id] = (lastYear === y && selected[a.account_id] !== undefined) ? selected[a.account_id] : true; });
            selected = next; lastYear = y; lastPreview = d;

            var html = '<div style="padding:8px 10px; background:#1f2d3a; border-radius:4px; line-height:1.6; max-height:340px; overflow-y:auto;">' +
                       'Jurnal penutup tanggal <b>' + enc(d.closing_date) + '</b>, laba/rugi dipindah ke <b>' + enc(d.retained_account || '-') + '</b>';
            if (d.blockers.length) html += '<div style="color:#ff6b5e; margin-top:6px;"><b>Tidak dapat diproses:</b>' + listHtml(d.blockers, '#ff6b5e') + '</div>';
            if (d.warnings.length) html += '<div style="color:#e6a817; margin-top:6px;">' + listHtml(d.warnings, '#e6a817') + '</div>';
            html += '<div style="margin-top:8px;"><button type="button" class="ycAllBtn" style="' + btnCss + '">Pilih Semua</button>' +
                    '<button type="button" class="ycNoneBtn" style="' + btnCss + '">Kosongkan</button>' +
                    '<span id="ycCnt" style="font-weight:bold;"></span></div>';
            html += accTable('PENDAPATAN', 'rev', d.revenue) + accTable('BEBAN', 'exp', d.expense);
            html += '<div style="margin-top:10px;">Total pendapatan dipilih: <b id="ycRev"></b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Total beban dipilih: <b id="ycExp"></b></div>' +
                    '<div id="ycNet" style="margin-top:4px; font-size:15px; font-weight:bold;"></div>' +
                    '<div id="ycPartial" style="margin-top:4px; color:#e6a817;"></div>';
            var open = 0; Ext.each(d.periods, function (p) { if (!p.is_closed) open++; });
            html += '<div style="margin-top:6px; color:#9fc3d1;">Periode tahun ini: ' + d.periods.length + ' (terbuka ' + open + ').</div></div>';
            fInfo.setValue(html);
            wireSelection();
            updateSelectionUI();
        });
    }

    function showEditor(title) {
        var addWdw = document.getElementById('addWdw');      // jaga-jaga: window Add bawaan template jangan ikut terbuka
        if (addWdw) addWdw.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;' + enc(title);
        ensureForm();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Action Handlers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // ADD = proses tutup buku
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_ADD) {
            showMsg('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk tutup buku.');
            return;
        }
        yearDs.load({
            callback: function () {
                accDs.load({
                    callback: function () {          // combo harus terisi sebelum form dipakai
                        showEditor('Tutup Buku Tahunan');
                        resetForm();
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    };

    // SAVE
    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        if (!fYear || !fYear.getValue()) { showMsg('Peringatan', 'Tahun buku wajib dipilih.'); return; }
        if (!fAcc.getValue()) { showMsg('Peringatan', 'Akun Laba Ditahan wajib dipilih.'); return; }
        if (!previewOk) { showMsg('Peringatan', 'Penutupan belum dapat diproses. Periksa pratinjau di form (bagian "Tidak dapat diproses").'); return; }
        var ids = selectedIds();                                              // [PILIH AKUN]
        if (!ids.length) { showMsg('Peringatan', 'Pilih minimal satu akun yang akan ditutup.'); return; }
        var totalAcc = lastPreview ? (lastPreview.revenue.length + lastPreview.expense.length) : ids.length;

        var year = fYear.getValue();
        var msg = 'Proses tutup buku tahun <b>' + year + '</b>?<br/>Jurnal penutup dibuat tanggal 31 Desember ' + year +
                  (fLock.getValue() ? ' dan <b>seluruh periode tahun ' + year + ' akan dikunci</b>.' : '.') +
                  '<br/>Penutupan dapat dibuka kembali selama belum ada tahun yang lebih baru ditutup.';
        if (ids.length < totalAcc) msg = '<span style="color:#e6a817;">Hanya ' + ids.length + ' dari ' + totalAcc + ' akun yang ditutup; sisanya tetap bersaldo.</span><br/>' + msg;
        if (previewNotEnded) msg = '<span style="color:#e6a817;">Tahun ' + year + ' belum berakhir (uji coba).</span><br/>' + msg;

        Ext.Msg.confirm('Tutup Buku', msg, function (btn) {
            if (btn !== 'yes') return;
            ajax({
                task: 'save_closing',
                year: year,
                retained_account_id: fAcc.getValue(),
                account_ids: Ext.util.JSON.encode(ids),               // [PILIH AKUN] akun yang ikut ditutup
                lock_periods: fLock.getValue() ? 1 : 0,
                force: previewNotEnded ? 1 : 0,
                remark: fRemark.getValue()
            }, function (res) {
                showMsg(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                if (res.success) {
                    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    dataRecord = null;
                    mainDs.load();
                    updateMainButtons();
                } else {
                    doPreview();
                }
            });
        });
    };

    // DELETE = buka kembali penutupan terakhir
    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) { showMsg('Peringatan', 'Pilih tahun yang sudah ditutup dari tabel.'); return; }
        if (!dataRecord.is_latest) { showMsg('Peringatan', 'Hanya penutupan tahun terakhir yang dapat dibuka kembali.'); return; }
        if (getFormAccess() < ACCESS_DEL) {
            showMsg('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membuka kembali tutup buku.');
            return;
        }
        Ext.Msg.confirm('Buka Kembali Tutup Buku',
            'Buka kembali tutup buku tahun <b>' + enc(dataRecord.fiscal_year) + '</b>?<br/>Jurnal penutup <b>' + enc(dataRecord.journal_no) +
            '</b> dihapus dan periode yang dikunci dibuka kembali.',
            function (btn) {
                if (btn !== 'yes') return;
                ajax({ task: 'delete_closing', id: dataRecord.id }, function (res) {
                    showMsg(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) {
                        dataRecord = null;
                        mainDs.load();
                        updateMainButtons();
                    }
                });
            });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        if (document.getElementById('popCancel')) {
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

/*
Document      : subcon.js
Description   : Subkontraktor. Grid utama = daftar SPK; klik baris -> panel detail di bawah grid (ringkasan keuangan, task, prestasi,
pembayaran, jurnal, jejak audit, tombol aksi). Add/Edit membuka editor SPK (header + pembagian nilai ke task proyek).
Prestasi, pembayaran, dan subkon baru memakai dialog (tombol HTML gaya standar).
Alur SPK: Draft -> Diajukan -> Disetujui -> Selesai (Dibatalkan selama belum ada prestasi / pembayaran).
Prestasi : progres kumulatif % per task -> nilai periode - PPh - retensi - potongan uang muka + PPN = nilai bayar.
Edit  & Delete SPK hanya untuk status Draft. Dokumen turunan tidak dihapus, hanya Dibatalkan (alasan wajib).
Backend       : ../php-crud/subconCRD.php
*/
Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Sub<em>kontraktor</em>";
    var CRD = main_url + '/php-crud/subconCRD.php';
    var ACCESS_ADD = 2;
    var ACCESS_EDIT = 3;
    var VEPS = 0.01;
    var PPN_DEFAULT = 11;
    var dataRecord = null, editingId = 0, hdrForm = null, hdrForm2 = null;
    var curDetail = null;

    function getFormAccess() { return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0); }
    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function fmtAmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    function fmtPct(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00') + '%'; }
    function round2(v) { return Math.round((parseFloat(v) || 0) * 100) / 100; }
    function ymd(d) { return d ? d.dateFormat('Y-m-d') : ''; }
    function showErr(msg) { Ext.Msg.show({ title: 'Peringatan', msg: msg, buttons: Ext.Msg.OK, icon: Ext.Msg.WARNING }); }
    
    function storeError(proxy, type, action, opt, res) {
        var m = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        if (res && res.message) { m = res.message; } else if (res && res.status) { m += ' (HTTP ' + res.status + ')'; }
        showErr(m);
    }
    
    function uiBtn(cls, label, bg, attrs) {
        return '<button type="button" class="' + cls + '" ' + (attrs || '') + ' style="margin-left:8px;padding:8px 20px;background:' + bg +
               ';color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;">' + label + '</button>';
    }
    
    var TEAL = '#066b78', GREY = '#555555', BURG = '#800020';
    
    function statusColor(v) {
        switch (v) {
            case 'Draft': return '#999999 !important';
            case 'Diajukan': return '#e6a817 !important';
            case 'Disetujui': return '#2bc1e2 !important';
            case 'Selesai': return '#00ff4c !important';
            case 'Dibatalkan': case 'Dibatalkan ': return '#c0392b !important';
            case 'Posted': return '#00ff4c !important';
        }
        return '#ffffff !important';
    }
    
    var ACTION_LABEL = { Diajukan: 'Ajukan', Disetujui: 'Setujui SPK', Draft: 'Kembalikan ke Draft', Selesai: 'Tutup SPK (Selesai)', Dibatalkan: 'Batalkan SPK' };
    
    function ajax(params, onOk) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD, method: 'POST', params: params,
            success: function (r) {
                var o;
                try { o = Ext.decode(r.responseText); } catch (e) { showErr('Respons server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).'); return; }
                onOk(o);
            },
            failure: function (r) { showErr('Koneksi ke server gagal (HTTP ' + r.status + ').'); }
        });
    }
    
    function needAccess(level, msg) {
        if (getFormAccess() < level) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', msg); return false; }
        return true;
    }
    
    function reasonPrompt(title, fn) {
        Ext.Msg.prompt(title, 'Alasan (wajib, min. 5 karakter):', function (btn, txt) { if (btn === 'ok') fn(txt); }, this, true);
    }

                td(y.status === 'Posted' ? uiBtn('scAct', 'Batal', BURG, 'data-act="cancel_payment" data-id="' + y.id + '"') : '', 'right') + '</tr>';

        var trail = ['Dibuat: <b>' + enc(h.created_by_name || '-') + '</b> (' + enc(h.created_at) + ')'];

        });

        var els = dtlDiv.querySelectorAll('.scAct');
        for (var i = 0; i < els.length; i++) {

        }

    function refreshAll(id) { mainDs.load(); loadDetailPanel(id); updateMainButtons(); }
    
    function onAction(act, id, to) {
        var h = curDetail.header;
        if (act === 'status') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengubah status SPK.')) return;
            var go = function (reason) {
                ajax({ task: 'change_status', id: h.id, to: to, reason: reason || '' }, function (res) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) { if (dataRecord) dataRecord.status = to; refreshAll(h.id); }
                });
            };
            if (to === 'Dibatalkan') { reasonPrompt('Batalkan SPK', go); return; }
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Ubah Status SPK', 'Ubah status SPK <b>' + enc(h.spk_no) + '</b> menjadi <b>' + enc(to) + '</b>?', function (b) { if (b === 'yes') go(); });
        } else if (act === 'new_progress') {
            if (needAccess(ACCESS_ADD, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membuat prestasi.')) openProgress(h.id, 0);
        } else if (act === 'edit_progress') {
            if (needAccess(ACCESS_ADD, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengubah prestasi.')) openProgress(h.id, id);
        } else if (act === 'approve_progress') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menyetujui prestasi.')) return;
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Setujui Prestasi', 'Setujui prestasi ini? Jurnal (WIP, PPN Masukan, hutang, potongan) akan diposting.', function (b) {
                if (b !== 'yes') return;
                ajax({ task: 'approve_progress', id: id }, function (res) { Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || ''); if (res.success) refreshAll(h.id); });
            });
        } else if (act === 'inspect' || act === 'edit_inspection') {
            if (needAccess(ACCESS_ADD, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membuat inspeksi.')) openInspection(id);
        } else if (act === 'approve_inspection') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menyetujui inspeksi.')) return;
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Setujui Inspeksi', 'Setujui inspeksi ini? Nilai prestasi akan dihitung ulang dari qty yang LOLOS.', function (b) {
                if (b !== 'yes') return;
                ajax({ task: 'approve_inspection', id: id }, function (res) { Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || ''); if (res.success) refreshAll(h.id); });
            });
        } else if (act === 'cancel_inspection') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membatalkan inspeksi.')) return;
            reasonPrompt('Batalkan Inspeksi', function (txt) {
                ajax({ task: 'cancel_inspection', id: id, reason: txt }, function (res) { Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || ''); if (res.success) refreshAll(h.id); });
            });
        } else if (act === 'cancel_progress') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membatalkan prestasi.')) return;
            reasonPrompt('Batalkan Prestasi', function (txt) {
                ajax({ task: 'cancel_progress', id: id, reason: txt }, function (res) { Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || ''); if (res.success) refreshAll(h.id); });
            });
        } else if (act === 'cancel_payment') {
            if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membatalkan pembayaran.')) return;
            reasonPrompt('Batalkan Pembayaran', function (txt) {
                ajax({ task: 'cancel_payment', id: id, reason: txt }, function (res) { Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || ''); if (res.success) refreshAll(h.id); });
            });
        } else if (act === 'pay_dp' || act === 'pay_progress' || act === 'pay_retention') {
            if (needAccess(ACCESS_ADD, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membuat pembayaran.')) openPayment(act === 'pay_dp' ? 'DP' : (act === 'pay_progress' ? 'PROGRESS' : 'RETENSI'));
        }
    }

    function updateMainButtons() {
        mainBtnEnable('#addData');
        if (dataRecord && dataRecord.status === 'Draft') { mainBtnEnable('#editData'); mainBtnEnable('#deleteData'); }
        else { mainBtnDisable('#editData'); mainBtnDisable('#deleteData'); }
