    function setInvoiceGridEditorHeight() {
        var editorFormHeight = $('#editorForm').height() || 400;
        var headerHeight = $('#editorFormHeader').height() || 50;
        var mainFormHeight = $('#editorFormMain').height() || 150;
        var computedHeight = editorFormHeight - headerHeight - mainFormHeight - 20;
        
        if (computedHeight > 150) {
            gridEditorInvoice.setHeight(computedHeight);
        }
    }

    function showWindow(titleText) {
        var wdw = document.getElementById('editorWdw');
        if (wdw) wdw.style.display = 'block';
        if (document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText')) {
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;' + titleText;
        }
        setInvoiceGridEditorHeight();
        // [FIX] Typo lama: id komponennya 'frmEditor', bukan 'frmGridEditor'
        // (yang tidak pernah ada) -> Ext.getCmp() balik undefined -> crash di .doLayout()
        var frmCmp = Ext.getCmp('frmEditor');
        if (frmCmp) frmCmp.doLayout();
    }

    function hideWindow() {
        var wdw = document.getElementById('editorWdw');
        if (wdw) wdw.style.display = 'none';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Action Handlers (Add, Edit, Delete, Save, Discard)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    if (Ext.get('addData')) {
        Ext.get('addData').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            task = 'create';
            dataRecord = null;
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            supplierDs.load();
            gridEditorInvoiceDs.load({ params: { invoice_id: 0 } });
            ppnAmtManual = false;                                   // [PPN]
            recalcInvoicePpn();                                     // [CHANGED] tarif / kena PPN ikut PO (grid kosong -> Tidak)
            showWindow('Tambah Purchase Invoice');
        });
    }

    if (Ext.get('editData')) {
        Ext.get('editData').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Silakan pilih data invoice terlebih dahulu.');
                return;
            }
            task = 'update';
            supplierDs.load({
                callback: function() {
                    frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                    frmEditor.getForm().setValues(dataRecord);
                    gridEditorInvoiceDs.load({ params: { invoice_id: dataRecord.id } });
                    ppnAmtManual = (parseFloat(dataRecord.ppn_amount) || 0) > 0;     // [PPN] PPN tersimpan (mis. sesuai faktur) tidak ditimpa
                    showWindow('Edit Purchase Invoice');
                }
            });
        });
    }

    if (Ext.get('deleteData')) {
        Ext.get('deleteData').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Silakan pilih data invoice terlebih dahulu.');
                return;
            }

            Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi', 'Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus invoice ' + dataRecord.inv_no + '?', function (btn) {
                if (btn === 'yes') {
                    Ext.Ajax.request({
                        url: '../dev/php-crud/purchaseinvoiceCRD.php',
                        method: 'POST',
                        params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                        success: function (response) {
                            var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                            if (res.success) {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', 'Data invoice berhasil dihapus.');
                                mainDs.reload();
                                payDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                                dataRecord = null;
                                if (typeof mainBtnDisable === 'function') {
                                    mainBtnDisable('#editData');
                                    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
                                }
                            } else {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Gagal menghapus data.');
                            }
                        },
                        failure: function () {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Error', 'Gagal terhubung ke server.');
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        });
    }

    if (Ext.get('saveEdit')) {
        Ext.get('saveEdit').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            if (!frmEditor.getForm().isValid()) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Mohon lengkapi semua field yang wajib diisi.');
                return;

            // [PERBAIKAN] Menghentikan mode edit aktif pada grid agar nilai sel terakhir ikut tersimpan di store
            if (gridEditorInvoice.stopEditing) {
                gridEditorInvoice.stopEditing();
            }

            // [PERBAIKAN] Menampung seluruh data row grid editor ke dalam array objek JavaScript
            var detailRecords = [];
            gridEditorInvoiceDs.each(function(record) {
                detailRecords.push(record.data);
            });

            // [PERBAIKAN] Kirim data form beserta detail grid yang sudah di-encode ke format JSON
            frmEditor.getForm().submit({
                url: '../dev/php-crud/purchaseinvoiceCRD.php',
                params: { 
                    task: task,

                    hideWindow();
                    mainDs.reload();

                failure: function (form, action) {
                    var msg = action.result ? action.result.message : 'Gagal menyimpan data.';
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', msg);
                }
            });
        });
    }

    var btnDiscard = Ext.get('discardEdit') || Ext.select('#editorWdw .x-tool-close');
    if (btnDiscard) {
        btnDiscard.on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            hideWindow();
        });
    }

    var wdwInit = document.getElementById('editorWdw');
    if (wdwInit) wdwInit.style.display = 'none';
});

/*
  Document      : project.usage.js
  Description   : Perbandingan PEMAKAIAN MATERIAL vs PROGRES proyek (read-only).
                  Grid atas = ringkasan per proyek (urut yang paling menyimpang): % progres, % pemakaian material,
                  selisih (poin), nilai RAB & terpakai, tanda NORMAL / WASPADA / KRITIS. Klik proyek -> rincian per material di bawah.
                  Selisih = % pemakaian - % progres. > 10 poin = WASPADA, > 20 poin = KRITIS (tanda awal pemborosan / kebocoran).
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/project.usageCRD.php   (view: v_project_material_vs_progress, v_project_material_detail_vs_progress)
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Pemakaian Material <em>vs Progres</em>";

    ['addData', 'editData', 'deleteData'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });
    ['editorWdw', 'addWdw'].forEach(function (id) {      // template menampilkan window editor/add secara default; halaman ini tidak memakainya
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });
    var CRD = main_url + '/php-crud/project.usageCRD.php';


    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function fmtAmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    function fmtQty(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
    function fmtPct(v) { return (v === null || v === undefined) ? '-' : Ext.util.Format.number(v, '0,000.0') + ' %'; }
    function showMsg(title, msg) { Ext.Msg.alert(title, msg); }
    function storeError(proxy, type, action, opt, res) {
        var m = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        if (res && res.message) { m = res.message; } else if (res && res.status) { m += ' (HTTP ' + res.status + ')'; }
        showMsg('Gagal', m);
    }
    function flagColor(f) {
        return f === 'KRITIS' ? '#e8554a' : (f === 'WASPADA' ? '#e6a817' : (f === 'NORMAL' ? '#2e9e4f' : '#999999'));
    }
    // batang progres: lebar = persen (maks 100), warna per jenis
    function bar(pct, color) {
        var w = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct || 0));
        return '<div style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); height:12px; border-radius:6px; overflow:hidden;">' +
               '<div style="width:' + w + '%; height:12px; background:' + color + ';"></div></div>';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 0. Elemen filter, ringkasan, dan panel rincian (dibuat dinamis)
    // ============================================================
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var topDiv = document.createElement('div');
    topDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:8px 12px; margin:0 10px 8px 10px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius:4px; color:#fff; font-size:14px;';
    var dtlDiv = document.createElement('div');
    dtlDiv.className = 'detail-panel-container';
    dtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
    dtlDiv.style.overflowY = 'auto';
    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(topDiv, gridContainer);
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(dtlDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling);
    }
    var gh = maxGridHeight(gridContainer);
    dtlDiv.style.maxHeight = Math.round(gh - gh * 0.55 - 30) + 'px';

    var onlyActive = new Ext.form.Checkbox({ boxLabel: 'Sembunyikan proyek Selesai', checked: true });
    var btnShow = new Ext.Button({ text: 'Muat Ulang', cls: 'field-button grey-field-button' });
    var fbar = document.createElement('div');
    fbar.style.padding = '0 10px';
    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) { gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(fbar, topDiv); }
    new Ext.Panel({
        renderTo: fbar, layout: 'column', border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:6px 0;',
        defaults: { border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;' },
        items: [{ columnWidth: 0.3, style: 'padding-top:6px;', items: onlyActive }, { columnWidth: 0.2, items: btnShow }]
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 1. Store & grid ringkasan
    // ============================================================
    var summaryField = [{ name: 'project_id', type: 'int' }, 'project_name', 'client_name', 'project_status',
                        { name: 'progress_pct', type: 'float' }, { name: 'rab_value', type: 'float' }, { name: 'used_value', type: 'float' },
                        { name: 'usage_pct' }, { name: 'gap_pts' }, 'flag'];

    // PENTING: assignment polos (bukan var/let) -- konvensi search box global.
    mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'rows' }, summaryField),
        listeners: { exception: storeError }
    });

    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs, renderTo: 'divMainGrid', height: Math.round(gh * 0.55), loadMask: true, viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        columns: [
            { header: 'Proyek', dataIndex: 'project_name', width: 220, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Klien', dataIndex: 'client_name', width: 150, renderer: function (v) { return CellWrap(v || '-'); } },
            { header: 'Progres', dataIndex: 'progress_pct', width: 150, renderer: function (v) { return fmtPct(v) + bar(v, '#2bc1e2'); } },
            { header: 'Pemakaian Material', dataIndex: 'usage_pct', width: 160,
              renderer: function (v, m, r) { return (v === null ? '-' : fmtPct(parseFloat(v)) + bar(parseFloat(v), flagColor(r.get('flag')))); } },
            { header: 'Selisih (poin)', dataIndex: 'gap_pts', width: 100, align: 'right',
              renderer: function (v, m, r) { return v === null ? '-' : '<b style="color:' + flagColor(r.get('flag')) + ' !important;">' + (parseFloat(v) > 0 ? '+' : '') + Ext.util.Format.number(parseFloat(v), '0,000.0') + '</b>'; } },
            { header: 'Nilai RAB Material', dataIndex: 'rab_value', width: 140, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return fmtAmt(v); } },
            { header: 'Material Terpakai', dataIndex: 'used_value', width: 140, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return fmtAmt(v); } },
            { header: 'Status Proyek', dataIndex: 'project_status', width: 100, align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Tanda', dataIndex: 'flag', width: 90, align: 'center',
              renderer: function (v) { return '<b style="color:' + flagColor(v) + ' !important;">' + enc(v) + '</b>'; } }
        ],
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) { loadDetail(rec.data); }
            }
        }
    });

    function loadSummary() {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD, method: 'POST', params: { task: 'summary', only_active: onlyActive.getValue() ? 1 : 0 },
            success: function (response) {
                var res;
                try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); }
                catch (e) { showMsg('Gagal', 'Respons server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).'); return; }
                if (!res.success) { showMsg('Gagal', res.message || 'Gagal memuat data.'); return; }
                mainDs.loadData(res.data, false);
                var c = res.data.counts;
                topDiv.innerHTML = '<b style="color:#e8554a;">' + c['KRITIS'] + ' kritis</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b style="color:#e6a817;">' + c['WASPADA'] + ' waspada</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; ' +
                    '<b style="color:#2e9e4f;">' + c['NORMAL'] + ' normal</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; <span style="color:#999;">' + c['TANPA RAB'] + ' tanpa RAB</span>' +
                    '<div style="margin-top:4px; color:#9fc3d1; font-size:12px;">Selisih = % pemakaian material (nilai issue / nilai RAB) dikurangi % progres. ' +
                    'Lebih dari 10 poin = waspada, lebih dari 20 poin = kritis: material keluar jauh lebih cepat dari pekerjaan yang selesai (periksa pemborosan, ' +
                    'material tidak terpasang, atau progres yang belum diperbarui).</div>';
                dtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function () { showMsg('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.'); }
        });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 2. Rincian per material untuk proyek terpilih
    // ============================================================
    function loadDetail(p) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD, method: 'POST', params: { task: 'detail', project_id: p.project_id },
            success: function (response) {
                var res;
                try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); }
                catch (e) { showMsg('Gagal', 'Respons server tidak valid.'); return; }
                if (!res.success) { showMsg('Gagal', res.message || 'Gagal memuat rincian.'); return; }
                var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Rincian per material: ' + enc(p.project_name) + ' <span style="color:#9fc3d1;">(progres ' + fmtPct(p.progress_pct) + ')</span></h3>' +
                           '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                           '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0"><thead><tr class="header-row">' +
                           '<th align="left">Material</th><th align="right">Qty RAB</th><th align="right">Qty Terpakai</th><th align="left" width="150">% Pemakaian</th>' +
                           '<th align="right">Selisih (poin)</th><th align="right">Nilai Terpakai</th><th align="center">Tanda</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
                if (!res.data.length) { html += '<tr><td colspan="7" style="padding:15px; text-align:center; color:#557982;">Proyek ini belum punya material di RAB.</td></tr>'; }
                Ext.each(res.data, function (m) {
                    html += '<tr class="data-row"><td align="left">' + enc(m.material_name) + ' <span style="color:#668894;">(' + enc(m.material_code) + ')</span></td>' +
                            '<td align="right">' + fmtQty(m.rab_qty) + ' ' + enc(m.unit) + '</td><td align="right">' + fmtQty(m.used_qty) + '</td>' +
                            '<td align="left">' + fmtPct(m.usage_pct) + bar(m.usage_pct, flagColor(m.flag)) + '</td>' +
                            '<td align="right"><b style="color:' + flagColor(m.flag) + ';">' + (m.gap_pts === null ? '-' : (m.gap_pts > 0 ? '+' : '') + Ext.util.Format.number(m.gap_pts, '0,000.0')) + '</b></td>' +
                            '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(m.used_value) + '</td>' +
                            '<td align="center"><b style="color:' + flagColor(m.flag) + ';">' + enc(m.flag) + '</b></td></tr>';
                });
                html += '</tbody></table>';
                dtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
                dtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            },
            failure: function () { showMsg('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.'); }
        });
    }

    btnShow.on('click', loadSummary);
    onlyActive.on('check', loadSummary);
    loadSummary();

    if (document.getElementById('printData')) {
        document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () { window.print(); };      // cetak halaman ini apa adanya
    }
    if (document.getElementById('popOK')) {
        document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () { document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none'; };
    }
});
==================== FILE: ./js/m.user.role.js ====================
/*
  Document      : m.user.role.js
  Description   : Client-side Dynamic User Role & Access Matrix Management (ExtJS 3.4.1)
  Project       : Universal ERP / Inventory
*/
Ext.onReady(function() {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();

    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "User Role <em>& Access Matrix</em> ";

    var CRD = main_url + '/php-crud/m.user.roleCRD.php';

    var task = '';
    var activeRoleId = 0;
    var activeRoleName = '';
    var pendingNewRoleEdit = true;
    var pendingNewRoleId = 0;     // role yang baru dibuat -> otomatis dipilih & matriksnya dibuka dalam mode edit
    var matrixEditMode = false;   // matriks hanya bisa diubah setelah tombol Edit ditekan
    var deleteRow = 0;
    var deleteRecord = null;

    var myMask = new Ext.LoadMask(Ext.getBody(), { msg: "Please wait..." });

    // ==========================================
    // 1. TOP TOOLBAR BUTTON ACTIONS
    // ==========================================
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function(event) {
        task = 'save_role';
        if (formAccess >= 3) {
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "&nbsp;&nbsp;New User Role";
            Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().reset();
            showRoleFormAccess(true);
            Ext.getCmp('role_code').focus('', 10);
        } else {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to access this window';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function(event) {
        if (formAccess >= 3) {
            if (!dataRecord || !dataRecord.id) {
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'Please select a role to edit first.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            if (activeRoleId !== dataRecord.id) {
                loadRoleMatrix(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.role_name, dataRecord.role_code);
            }
            setMatrixEditMode(true);
        } else {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to access this window';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    // Edit data induk role (kode, nama, deskripsi, status) - dibuka dari tombol "Edit Info" di panel matriks.
    function openRoleInfoEditor() {
        task = 'update_role';
        Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().setValues({
            role_code: dataRecord.role_code,
            role_name: dataRecord.role_name,
            description: dataRecord.description
        });
        Ext.getCmp('AddActive').setValue(!!dataRecord.is_active);
        showRoleFormAccess(false);          // Edit Info hanya data induk; matriks diedit di panel bawah
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit User Role: " + dataRecord.role_name;
    }

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function(event) {
        if (formAccess == 4) {
            if (!dataRecord || !dataRecord.id) {
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'Please select a role to delete first.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            task = 'delete_role';
            deleteRow = 1;
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'Delete role \'' + dataRecord.role_name + '\' (' + dataRecord.role_code + ')?';
        } else {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to delete this data';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function(event) {
        mainDs.load();
        gridMain.getView().refresh(true);
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function(event) {
        Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().submit({
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: task,
                id: (task === 'update_role' && dataRecord) ? dataRecord.id : 0,
                is_active: Ext.getCmp('AddActive').getValue() ? 'true' : 'false'
            },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Saving role data...',
            success: function(form, action) {
                var objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                var okMsg = objResponse.message || 'Saved successfully.';
                var finishSave = function(extraMsg) {
                    document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = okMsg + (extraMsg || '');
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    mainDs.load();
                    frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                    roleAccessStore.removeAll();
                    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                };

                if (task === 'save_role' && objResponse.id) {
                    var newId = parseInt(objResponse.id, 10);
                    var arr = [];
                    roleAccessStore.each(function(rec) {
                        if (parseInt(rec.get('access_level'), 10) > 0) {
                            arr.push({ form_id: rec.get('form_id'), access_level: parseInt(rec.get('access_level'), 10) });
                        }
                    });
                    pendingNewRoleId = newId;
                    if (arr.length === 0) {
                        pendingNewRoleEdit = true;      // belum ada form: langsung buka matriks dalam mode edit
                        finishSave('<br><br>Atur form &amp; level akses role ini pada <b>Access Matrix</b> di bawah (bisa pakai <b>Copy From...</b>), lalu klik <b>Save Matrix</b>.');
                    } else {
                        pendingNewRoleEdit = false;
                        Ext.Ajax.request({
                            url: CRD,
                            method: 'POST',
                            params: { task: 'save_role_matrix', role_id: newId, matrix_data: Ext.util.JSON.encode(arr) },
                            success: function(resp) {
                                var o = null;
                                try { o = Ext.util.JSON.decode(resp.responseText); } catch (e) {}
                                if (o && o.success === false) {
                                    pendingNewRoleEdit = true;
                                    finishSave('<br><br>Namun form access gagal disimpan: ' + (o.message || '') + '<br>Atur ulang pada Access Matrix di bawah.');
                                } else {
                                    finishSave('<br>' + arr.length + ' form access ikut tersimpan.');
                                }
                            },
                            failure: function(resp) {
                                var msg = '';
                                try { msg = Ext.util.JSON.decode(resp.responseText).message || ''; } catch (e) {}
                                pendingNewRoleEdit = true;
                                finishSave('<br><br>Namun form access gagal disimpan: ' + msg + '<br>Atur ulang pada Access Matrix di bawah.');
                            }
                        });
                    }
                } else {
                    finishSave('');
                }
            },
            failure: function(form, action) {
                var objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = objResponse.message || 'Failed to save role.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function(event) {
        if (deleteRow > 0 && dataRecord && dataRecord.id) {
            myMask.show();
            Ext.Ajax.request({
                url: CRD,
                method: 'POST',
                params: { task: 'delete_role', id: dataRecord.id },
                success: function(response) {
                    myMask.hide();
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
                    deleteRow = 0;
                    var obj = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                    document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = obj.message;
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    mainDs.load();
                },
                failure: function(response) {
                    myMask.hide();
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
                    deleteRow = 0;
                    var obj = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                    document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = obj.message || 'Failed to delete role.';
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                }
            });
            return;
        }

        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
    };

    document.getElementById('logData').onclick = function(event) {
        if (!dataRecord || !dataRecord.id) {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'Please select a role first.';

    // Tinggi total area grid; dibagi header (daftar role) ~45% dan detail (access matrix) sisanya.

    var DETAIL_BAR_H = 52;   // tinggi judul + tombol detail
    function splitHeights() {
        var total = totalGridHeight();
        var main = Math.max(180, Math.round(total * 0.45));
        var detail = Math.max(160, total - main - DETAIL_BAR_H - 30);
        return { main: main, detail: detail };

    mainDs.on('load', function() {
        if (pendingNewRoleId) {
            var newId = pendingNewRoleId;
            pendingNewRoleId = 0;
            var ni = mainDs.findBy(function(r) { return parseInt(r.get('id'), 10) === newId; });
            if (ni >= 0) {
                gridMain.getSelectionModel().selectRow(ni);
                gridMain.getView().focusRow(ni);
                dataRecord = mainDs.getAt(ni).data;
                loadRoleMatrix(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.role_name, dataRecord.role_code);
                setMatrixEditMode(pendingNewRoleEdit);
                return;
            }
        }
        if (!activeRoleId) return;
        var idx = mainDs.findBy(function(r) { return r.get('id') === activeRoleId; });
        if (idx >= 0) {
            gridMain.getSelectionModel().selectRow(idx);
        } else {
            clearRoleMatrix();
        }
    });

    // ---- Copy From: salin form + level dari role lain ----
    function copyIntoNewRole(srcId, srcName) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_role_matrix', role_id: srcId },
            success: function(response) {
                try {
                    var obj = null;
                    try { obj = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); } catch (e) {}
                    if (!obj || obj.success === false || !obj.data) {
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Copy From', (obj && obj.message) || 'Gagal memuat matriks role sumber.');
                        return;
                    }
                    var added = 0;
                    roleAccessStore.removeAll();
                    for (var i = 0; i < obj.data.length; i++) {
                        var d = obj.data[i];
                        if (parseInt(d.access_level, 10) > 0) {
                            d.access_level = parseInt(d.access_level, 10);
                            d.form_id = parseInt(d.form_id, 10);
                            d.active = true;
                            roleAccessStore.add(new roleAccessStore.recordType(d, d.form_id));
                            added++;
                        }
                    }
                    roleAccessGrid.getView().refresh();
                    sizeRoleAccessGrid();
                    if (added === 0) {
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Copy From', 'Role "' + srcName + '" belum memiliki form access (kolom Forms = 0), jadi tidak ada yang disalin.');
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Copy From', 'Error saat mengisi grid: ' + err.message);
                }
            },
            failure: function(response) {
                var msg = 'Gagal memuat matriks role sumber (HTTP ' + response.status + ').';
                try { msg = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText).message || msg; } catch (e) {}
                Ext.Msg.alert('Copy From', msg);
            }
        });
    }

    function openCopyMenu(btn) {
        var items = [];
        mainDs.each(function(r) {
            items.push({
                text: r.get('role_name') + ' (' + r.get('role_code') + ')',
                roleId: r.get('id'),
                roleName: r.get('role_name'),
                handler: function(item) {
                    if (roleAccessStore.getCount() > 0) {
                        Ext.Msg.confirm('Copy From', 'Ganti daftar form yang sudah ada dengan milik role ini?', function(b) {
                            if (b === 'yes') { copyIntoNewRole(item.roleId, item.roleName); }
                        });
                    } else {
                        copyIntoNewRole(item.roleId, item.roleName);
                    }
                }
            });
        });
        if (!items.length) { Ext.Msg.alert('Copy From', 'Belum ada role lain untuk disalin.'); return; }
        new Ext.menu.Menu({ items: items }).show(btn.getEl());
    }

    function applyPickFilter() {
        var q = (document.getElementById('roleAddFormSearch').value || '').toLowerCase();
        catalogStore.filterBy(function(r) {
            if (roleAccessStore.findExact('form_id', r.get('form_id')) >= 0) { return false; }   // sudah ada di daftar role
            if (!q) { return true; }
            return (r.get('form_name') + ' ' + r.get('group_name') + ' ' + r.get('php_url')).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0;
        });
    }

                roleAccessGrid.getView().refresh();

        w.style.display = 'block';
        catalogStore.load({

        });

                '<button id="matrixClearAll" class="field-button grey-field-button" style="margin-right:8px;padding:6px 14px;cursor:pointer;">Clear All</button>' +

                '<button id="matrixSync" class="field-button grey-field-button" style="margin-right:8px;background:#0f9d74;color:#fff;padding:6px 16px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;" title="Sync this role matrix to all assigned users">Sync to Users</button>' +
                '<button id="matrixExit" class="field-button grey-field-button" style="background:#64748B;color:#fff;padding:6px 14px;cursor:pointer;">Exit Edit</button>' +
            '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="matrixMainPanel"></div>';

    matrixGrid.setHeight(splitHeights().detail);
    matrixGrid.render('matrixMainPanel');

    var activeRoleCode = '';

    function renderMatrixTitle() {
        var t = document.getElementById('matrixTitle');
        if (!activeRoleId) { t.innerHTML = 'Access Matrix: pilih role di atas'; return; }
        var badge = matrixEditMode
            ? ' <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:normal;color:#F59E0B;border:1px solid #F59E0B;border-radius:10px;padding:1px 9px;margin-left:8px;">EDITING</span>'
            : ' <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:normal;color:#94A3B8;border:1px solid #475569;border-radius:10px;padding:1px 9px;margin-left:8px;">VIEW ONLY</span>';
        t.innerHTML = 'Access Matrix: ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(activeRoleName) + ' (' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(activeRoleCode) + ')' + badge;
    }

    function setMatrixEditMode(on) {
        matrixEditMode = !!on && activeRoleId > 0;
        document.getElementById('matrixButtons').style.display = matrixEditMode ? 'block' : 'none';
        detailHost.style.borderColor = matrixEditMode ? '#F59E0B' : '#1e3a52';
        renderMatrixTitle();
        matrixGrid.getView().refresh();
    }

    function loadRoleMatrix(roleId, roleName, roleCode) {
        activeRoleId = roleId;
        activeRoleName = roleName;
        activeRoleCode = roleCode;
        setMatrixEditMode(false);           // setiap ganti role kembali ke mode lihat
        matrixStore.load({ params: { role_id: roleId } });
    }

    function clearRoleMatrix() {
        activeRoleId = 0;
        activeRoleName = '';
        activeRoleCode = '';
        setMatrixEditMode(false);
        matrixStore.removeAll();
    }

    function matrixIsDirty() {
        return matrixEditMode && matrixStore.getModifiedRecords().length > 0;
    }

    // Pilih role dari grid; kalau ada perubahan matriks yang belum disimpan, minta konfirmasi dulu.
    function selectRoleRow(grid, rowIndex) {
        var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
        var go = function() {
            dataRecord = rec.data;
            loadRoleMatrix(rec.data.id, rec.data.role_name, rec.data.role_code);
        };
        if (rec.data.id === activeRoleId) { dataRecord = rec.data; return; }
        if (matrixIsDirty()) {
            Ext.MessageBox.confirm('Unsaved changes', 'Perubahan matriks belum disimpan. Buang perubahan dan pindah role?', function(btn) {
                if (btn === 'yes') {
                    go();
                } else {
                    var idx = mainDs.findBy(function(r) { return r.get('id') === activeRoleId; });
                    if (idx >= 0) { grid.getSelectionModel().selectRow(idx); }
                }
            });
        } else {
            go();
        }
    }

    function requireActiveRole() {
        if (!activeRoleId) {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'Please select a role first.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    renderMatrixTitle();

    document.getElementById('matrixEditInfo').onclick = function() {
        if (!requireActiveRole()) return;
        var idx = mainDs.findBy(function(r) { return r.get('id') === activeRoleId; });
        if (idx >= 0) { dataRecord = mainDs.getAt(idx).data; }
        openRoleInfoEditor();
    };

    document.getElementById('matrixExit').onclick = function() {
        var leave = function() {
            matrixStore.rejectChanges();
            setMatrixEditMode(false);
        };
        if (matrixIsDirty()) {
            Ext.MessageBox.confirm('Unsaved changes', 'Perubahan matriks belum disimpan. Keluar dari mode edit dan buang perubahan?', function(btn) {
                if (btn === 'yes') { leave(); }
            });
        } else {
            leave();
        }
    };

    // Salin level akses dari role lain ke matriks yang sedang diedit (belum tersimpan sampai Save Matrix)
    function copyMatrixFromRole(srcId, srcName) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_role_matrix', role_id: srcId },
            success: function(response) {
                var obj = null;
                try { obj = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); } catch (e) {}
                if (!obj || obj.success === false || !obj.data) {
                    document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = (obj && obj.message) || 'Gagal memuat matriks role sumber.';
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                var levelByForm = {};
                for (var i = 0; i < obj.data.length; i++) {
                    levelByForm[obj.data[i].form_id] = parseInt(obj.data[i].access_level, 10) || 0;
                }
                matrixStore.each(function(rec) {
                    var lvl = levelByForm[rec.get('form_id')] || 0;
                    if (parseInt(rec.get('access_level'), 10) !== lvl || !!rec.get('active') !== (lvl > 0)) {
                        rec.set('access_level', lvl);
                        rec.set('active', lvl > 0);
                    }
                });
                matrixGrid.getView().refresh();
            },
            failure: function(response) {
                var msg = 'Gagal memuat matriks role sumber.';
                try { msg = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText).message || msg; } catch (e) {}
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = msg;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    document.getElementById('matrixCopy').onclick = function() {
        if (!requireActiveRole()) return;
        var items = [];
        mainDs.each(function(r) {
            if (parseInt(r.get('id'), 10) === activeRoleId) { return; }
            items.push({
                text: r.get('role_name') + ' (' + r.get('role_code') + ')',
                roleId: r.get('id'),
                roleName: r.get('role_name'),
                handler: function(item) {
                    Ext.MessageBox.confirm('Copy From', 'Ganti level akses matriks ini dengan milik role "' + item.roleName + '"? (belum tersimpan sampai Save Matrix)', function(btn) {
                        if (btn === 'yes') { copyMatrixFromRole(item.roleId, item.roleName); }
                    });
                }
            });
        });
        if (!items.length) {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'Belum ada role lain untuk disalin.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        new Ext.menu.Menu({ items: items }).show(document.getElementById('matrixCopy'));
    };

    // Select All dengan pilihan level: semua form dicentang dan diberi level yang dipilih
    function setAllMatrixLevel(level) {
        matrixStore.each(function(rec) {
            rec.set('active', true);
            rec.set('access_level', level);
        });
        matrixGrid.getView().refresh();
    }

    document.getElementById('matrixSelectAll').onclick = function() {
        if (!requireActiveRole()) return;
        new Ext.menu.Menu({
            items: [
                { text: 'All Read',                          handler: function() { setAllMatrixLevel(1); } },
                { text: 'All Read/Create',                   handler: function() { setAllMatrixLevel(2); } },
                { text: 'All Read/Create/Update (no Delete)', handler: function() { setAllMatrixLevel(3); } },
                { text: 'All Full Access (incl. Delete)',    handler: function() { setAllMatrixLevel(4); } }
            ]
        }).show(document.getElementById('matrixSelectAll'));
    };

    document.getElementById('matrixClearAll').onclick = function() {
        if (!requireActiveRole()) return;
        matrixStore.each(function(rec) {
            rec.set('active', false);
            rec.set('access_level', 0);
        });
        matrixGrid.getView().refresh();
    };

    document.getElementById('matrixSave').onclick = function() {
        if (!requireActiveRole()) return;
        var arr = [];
        matrixStore.each(function(rec) {
            arr.push({
                form_id: rec.get('form_id'),
                access_level: rec.get('active') ? (rec.get('access_level') > 0 ? rec.get('access_level') : 1) : 0
            });
        });

        myMask.show();
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: 'save_role_matrix',
                role_id: activeRoleId,
                matrix_data: Ext.util.JSON.encode(arr)
            },
            success: function(response) {
                myMask.hide();
                var obj = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (obj.success !== false) { matrixStore.commitChanges(); }
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = obj.message || 'Matrix saved successfully.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                mainDs.load();
            },
            failure: function(response) {
                myMask.hide();
                var obj = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = obj.message || 'Failed to save matrix.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('matrixSync').onclick = function() {
        if (!requireActiveRole()) return;
        Ext.MessageBox.confirm(
            'Confirm Sync',
            'Are you sure you want to synchronize this role matrix to ALL users assigned to role "' + activeRoleName + '"? This will overwrite individual form permissions for those users.',
            function(btn) {
                if (btn === 'yes') {
                    myMask.show();
                    Ext.Ajax.request({
                        url: CRD,
                        method: 'POST',
                        params: {
                            task: 'sync_role_to_users',
                            role_id: activeRoleId
                        },
                        success: function(response) {
                            myMask.hide();
                            var obj = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = obj.message || 'Synced successfully.';
                            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                            mainDs.load();
                        },
                        failure: function(response) {
                            myMask.hide();
                            var obj = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = obj.message || 'Failed to sync.';
                            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
        );
    };

    // Template menampilkan editorWdw secara default; sembunyikan setelah semua komponen dirender
    // (sama seperti halaman User System).
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';

    window.onresize = function() {
        var h = splitHeights();
        gridMain.setHeight(h.main);
        matrixGrid.setHeight(h.detail);
    };
});
==================== FILE: ./js/m.coa.js ====================
/*
  Document      : m.coa.js
  Description   : Chart of Accounts - List Grid + Add/Edit Form (hierarkis: parent_id)
  Pattern       : mengikuti m.product.js / m.supplier.js
  Backend       : /univ/php-crud/m.coaCRD.php (task: read, read_parent, read_edit, create, update, delete)
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Chart of <em>Accounts</em>";

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    // ============================================================
    // 1. Field definitions
    // ============================================================
    var coaField = [
        { name: 'id' },
        { name: 'account_code' },
        { name: 'account_name' },
        { name: 'account_type' },
        { name: 'parent_id' },
        { name: 'parent_name' },
        { name: 'is_active', type: 'boolean' }
    ];
    var parentField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'account_code' }, { name: 'account_name' }];

    // ============================================================
    // 2. Combo stores
    // ============================================================
    var accountTypeOptions = new Ext.data.SimpleStore({
        fields: ['value', 'label'],
        data: [
            ['asset', 'Asset'],
            ['liability', 'Liability'],
            ['equity', 'Equity'],
            ['revenue', 'Revenue'],
            ['expense', 'Expense']
        ]
    });

    // Combo akun induk -- load dari server (semua akun, dipakai utk pilih parent)
    var parentDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/m.coaCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_parent' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, parentField)
    });
    parentDs.load();

    // ============================================================
    // 3. Main store & grid
    // ============================================================
    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/m.coaCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, coaField)
    });
    mainDs.load();
    let mainHeight=(maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));

    var gridMain = new stdGridPaging({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height : mainHeight,

        columns: [
            { header: 'Kode Akun', dataIndex: 'account_code', width: 100, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Nama Akun', dataIndex: 'account_name', width: 250, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Tipe Akun', dataIndex: 'account_type', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Akun Induk', dataIndex: 'parent_name', width: 200, renderer: CellWrap },
            {
                header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'is_active', width: 80, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) {
                    return v ? '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">Aktif</span>'
                             : '<span style="color:#c0392b;">Nonaktif</span>';
                }
            }
        ],
        listeners: {
            cellclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                dataRecord = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex).data;
                editDataEnable();
                mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
            }
        },
        pageSize: 250,
        pageStore: mainDs
    });

    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ============================================================
    // 4. Editor Form
    // ============================================================
    var fldCode = new myTextField({
        fieldLabel: 'Kode Akun', id: 'account_code', name: 'account_code', allowBlank: false,
        autoCreate: { tag: "input", maxlength: 20, type: "text", size: "20", autocomplete: "off" }
    });
    var fldName = new myTextField({
        fieldLabel: 'Nama Akun', id: 'account_name', name: 'account_name', allowBlank: false,
        autoCreate: { tag: "input", maxlength: 150, type: "text", size: "150", autocomplete: "off" }
    });
    var fldType = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Tipe Akun', id: 'account_type', name: 'account_type', hiddenName: 'account_type',
        store: accountTypeOptions, displayField: 'label', valueField: 'value', allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldParent = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Akun Induk', id: 'parent_id', name: 'parent_id', hiddenName: 'parent_id',
        store: parentDs, displayField: 'account_name', valueField: 'id',
        emptyText: '-- Tidak ada (akun utama) --'
    });
    var fldActive = new Ext.form.Checkbox({
        fieldLabel: 'Status Aktif', labelSeparator: '&nbsp;&nbsp;-&nbsp;&nbsp;',
        id: 'is_active', name: 'is_active_ui', cls: 'fieldCheckClass regular-checkbox',
        inputValue: 'true', checked: true
        // CATATAN: name sengaja BUKAN 'is_active' -- skin custom
        // 'regular-checkbox' merusak atribut value dari <input> aslinya
        // jadi "[object Object]" saat form di-serialize otomatis dari DOM.
        // id tetap 'is_active' (dipakai frmEditor.getForm().load() untuk
        // mengisi nilai saat Edit), tapi nilai yang BENAR-BENAR terkirim
        // ke server datang dari params eksplisit di tombol Save di bawah,
        // bukan dari serialisasi DOM field ini.
    });
    var fldId = new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 150,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldCode },
            { items: fldName },
            { items: fldType },
            { items: fldParent },
            { columnWidth: 0.5, labelAlign: 'right', labelWidth: 150, items: fldActive },
            { items: fldId }
        ]
    });
    frmEditor.on('clientvalidation', function (f, valid) {
        if (!valid) { saveEditDisable(); } else { saveEditEnable(); }
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 5. Icon toolbar global (#addData/#editData/#deleteData/#printData)
    // ============================================================
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function (event) {
        task = '';
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
        if (formAccess == 2 || formAccess == 3 || formAccess == 4) {
            task = 'create';
            parentDs.reload();
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Tambah Akun';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function (event) {
        task = '';
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (formAccess == 3 || formAccess == 4) {
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            task = 'update';
            frmEditor.getForm().load({
                url: '../php-crud/m.coaCRD.php',
                params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' }
            });
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Akun';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function (event) {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (formAccess == 4) {
            task = 'delete';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Nonaktifkan \'' + dataRecord.account_name + '\' ?';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menonaktifkan data.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function (event) {
        window.open("../pdf/m.coa.php", 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function (event) {
        // FIX: field is_active pakai skin custom (cls 'regular-checkbox'),
        // yang ternyata mengubah atribut value dari <input> aslinya jadi
        // bukan string biasa (terkirim sebagai "[object Object]" saat
        // form di-serialize otomatis dari DOM). Kirim nilainya secara
        // eksplisit di sini -- ini akan override value dari DOM karena
        // ExtJS menambahkan 'params' SETELAH data form yang di-serialize.
        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/m.coaCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: task,
                is_active: fldActive.getValue() ? 1 : 0
            },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = objResponse.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';

                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                parentDs.reload();
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = objResponse.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function (event) {
        if (task == 'delete') {
            var deleteDs = new Ext.data.Store({ url: '../php-crud/m.coaCRD.php' });
            deleteDs.load({
                params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                callback: function (records, operation, success) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
                    task = '';
                    mainDs.load();
                    parentDs.reload();
                }
            });
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    // ============================================================
    // 6. Sembunyikan window di baris paling akhir (SETELAH semua
    //    komponen Ext selesai di-render, supaya layout terhitung benar)
    // ============================================================
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

/*
  Document      : purchase.return.js
  Description   : Retur Pembelian / Retur Supplier untuk material cacat / rusak. ExtJS 3.4.1
                  Mengikuti pola po.js: grid utama (#divMainGrid) + panel detail di bawah grid dengan
                  tombol aksi status, editor memakai #editorWdw bawaan template.
                  Alur: Diajukan -> (Perintahkan W/H) Diperintahkan -> (gudang: Siap Kirim) Disiapkan
                        -> (gudang: Konfirmasi Dikirim) Dikirim -> (Selesaikan) Diganti | Kredit
                  [CHANGED 2026-10-11] Pembelian hanya memerintahkan issue; yang menyatakan barang SUDAH DIKIRIM adalah gudang
                  (Warehouse Issuing). Stok keluar + jurnal baru dibuat saat gudang konfirmasi dikirim.
                  Tombol template: Add = retur baru | Edit = ubah retur Diajukan | Delete = Batalkan retur Diajukan
                  Tombol panel detail: Perintahkan W/H / Batalkan (Diajukan), Batalkan Perintah (Diperintahkan/Disiapkan),
                                       Cetak SJ / Batal Kirim / Selesaikan (Dikirim)
  Entry retur    : pilih dokumen W/H RCV -> proyek, gudang, supplier, PO terisi otomatis; item = item RCV (isi qty + jenis cacat)
  Backend       : ../php-crud/purchase.returnCRD.php
  [CHANGED]     : seluruh file ditulis ulang -- sebelumnya membuat grid/toolbar/window sendiri ke body,
                  sehingga #editorWdw template tampil kosong dan grid tidak muncul; URL AJAX juga relatif
                  ke /views/ (kini '../php-crud/').

    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Retur <em>Pembelian</em>";

    var CRD = main_url + '/php-crud/purchase.returnCRD.php';

    var ACCESS_ADD = 2;      // level akses minimal: buat retur
    var ACCESS_EDIT = 3;     // level akses minimal: ubah / batalkan / kirim / selesaikan

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }
    function enc(v) { return Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(v == null ? '' : v); }
    function fmtQty(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
    function fmtAmt(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
    // [FIX-DATE] format('Y-m-d') Ext menghasilkan 'Y-10-10' di browser ini (huruf Y tidak diganti tahun) -> backend menolak.
    //            Susun string YYYY-MM-DD manual, tidak bergantung Date.format / Date.parseDate Ext.
    function ymd(d) {
        var m = d.getMonth() + 1, dd = d.getDate();
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : m) + '-' + (dd < 10 ? '0' + dd : dd);
    }
    function parseYmd(str) {
        var m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(str || '');
        return m ? new Date(parseInt(m[1], 10), parseInt(m[2], 10) - 1, parseInt(m[3], 10)) : null;
    }
    function showErr(msg) { Ext.Msg.show({ title: 'Peringatan', msg: msg, buttons: Ext.Msg.OK, icon: Ext.Msg.WARNING }); }

    // Exception store: tampilkan pesan backend / HTTP
    function storeError(proxy, type, action, opt, res) {
        var m = 'Gagal memuat data dari server.';
        if (res && res.message) { m = res.message; }
        else {
            try { var o = Ext.decode(res.responseText); if (o && o.message) { m = o.message; } }
            catch (e) { if (res && res.status) { m += ' (HTTP ' + res.status + ')'; } }
        }
        showErr(m);
    }

    function ajax(params, onOk) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD, method: 'POST', params: params,
            success: function (r) {
                var o;
                try { o = Ext.decode(r.responseText); } catch (e) { showErr('Respon server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).'); return; }
                onOk(o);
            },
            failure: function (r) { showErr('Koneksi ke server gagal (HTTP ' + r.status + ').'); }
        });
    }

    function statusColor(v) {
        switch (v) {
            case 'Diajukan': return '#e6a817 !important';
            case 'Diperintahkan': return '#b48ef0 !important';      // [NEW]
            case 'Disiapkan': return '#4fa3ff !important';          // [NEW]
            case 'Dikirim': return '#2bc1e2 !important';
            case 'Diganti': return '#00ff4c !important';
            case 'Kredit': return '#00ff4c !important';
            case 'Dibatalkan': return '#c0392b !important';
        }
        return '#ffffff !important';
    }

    // Jalankan aksi status lalu segarkan grid + panel detail
    function doAction(params, okTitle) {
        ajax(params, function (res) {
            Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? (okTitle || 'Sukses') : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
            if (res.success) {
                var id = dataRecord ? dataRecord.id : 0;
                dtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                dataRecord = null;
                updateMainButtons();
                mainDs.load({
                    callback: function () {             // pilih ulang baris yang sama agar panel detail tampil status baru
                        var idx = mainDs.find('id', id);
                        if (idx >= 0) {
                            dataRecord = mainDs.getAt(idx).data;
                            updateMainButtons();
                            loadDetailPanel(dataRecord);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }


    // [CHANGED] bukti retur: link/foto/PDF. Hanya http(s) atau path lokal yang dijadikan link (cegah javascript: URL)
    function evidenceLink(v) {
        if (!v) return '';
        if (!/^(https?:\/\/|\/)/i.test(v)) return enc(v);
        var label = /\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp)(\?.*)?$/i.test(v) ? 'Foto' : (/\.pdf(\?.*)?$/i.test(v) ? 'PDF' : 'Link');
        return '<a href="' + enc(v) + '" target="_blank" onclick="event.stopPropagation();" style="color:#2bc1e2;">' + label + '</a>';
    }
    function evidenceRenderer(v) {
        if (!v) return '<span style="color:#668894;cursor:pointer;">+ Foto / Link</span>';
        return evidenceLink(v) + ' <span style="color:#668894;cursor:pointer;" title="Ubah bukti">&#9998;</span>';
    }

    // Window isi bukti: tempel link ATAU unggah foto/PDF (maks 5 MB) -> URL tersimpan di kolom bukti baris tsb
    function openEvidence(rec) {
        var fUrl = new Ext.form.TextField({ fieldLabel: 'Link', anchor: '98%', value: rec.get('evidence_ref') || '',
            emptyText: 'Tempel link foto / dokumen (https://...) atau unggah file' });
        var info = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ hideLabel: true, value: '' });
        var fileInput = document.createElement('input');
        fileInput.type = 'file';
        fileInput.accept = 'image/*,.pdf';
        fileInput.style.display = 'none';
        document.body.appendChild(fileInput);
        fileInput.onchange = function () {
            var f = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
            if (!f) return;
            if (f.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) { showErr('Ukuran file maksimal 5 MB.'); fileInput.value = ''; return; }
            var fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('action', 'upload_evidence');
            fd.append('file', f);
            info.setValue('Mengunggah ' + enc(f.name) + '...');
            var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
            xhr.open('POST', CRD);
            xhr.onload = function () {
                var o;
                try { o = Ext.decode(xhr.responseText); } catch (e) { info.setValue(''); showErr('Respon server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).'); return; }
                if (!o.success) { info.setValue(''); showErr(o.message || 'Unggah gagal.'); return; }
                fUrl.setValue(o.url);
                info.setValue('<span style="color:#2e9e4f;">Terunggah: ' + enc(o.name) + '</span>');
            };
            xhr.onerror = function () { info.setValue(''); showErr('Koneksi ke server gagal saat mengunggah.'); };
            xhr.send(fd);
        };
        var win = new Ext.Window({
            title: 'Bukti Retur - ' + rec.get('material_name'), width: 520, height: 210, modal: true, layout: 'fit', cls: 'rtDarkWin',      // [FIX-UI] cls
            items: new Ext.form.FormPanel({
                border: false, labelWidth: 50, bodyStyle: 'padding:12px;',
                items: [fUrl,
                        { xtype: 'button', text: 'Pilih Foto / PDF dari komputer...', handler: function () { fileInput.click(); } },
                        { xtype: 'spacer', height: 8 }, info]
            }),
            buttons: [
                { text: 'OK', handler: function () {
                    var v = (fUrl.getValue() || '').trim();
                    if (v && !/^(https?:\/\/|\/)/i.test(v)) { showErr('Link harus diawali http:// atau https://'); return; }
                    rec.set('evidence_ref', v);
                    win.close();
                } },
                { text: 'Hapus Bukti', handler: function () { rec.set('evidence_ref', ''); win.close(); } },
                { text: 'Batal', handler: function () { win.close(); } }
            ],
            listeners: { close: function () { if (fileInput.parentNode) fileInput.parentNode.removeChild(fileInput); } }
        });
        win.show();
    }

    function needAccess(level, msg) {
        if (getFormAccess() < level) { Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', msg); return false; }
        return true;
    }

    function loadDetailPanel(rec) {
