    // [NEW] Cetak Surat Jalan retur (client-side, tanpa ubah backend). Data: header baris grid + item dari action 'detail'.
    //       Isi COMPANY_NAME / COMPANY_ADDR sesuai perusahaan; kosong = baris itu tidak dicetak.
    var COMPANY_NAME = '';      // [NEW] contoh: 'PT. NAMA KONTRAKTOR'
    var COMPANY_ADDR = '';      // [NEW] contoh: 'Jl. ... No. ..., Surabaya'
    function fmtDmy(str) {
        var d = parseYmd(str);
        if (!d) return enc(str || '');
        var m = d.getMonth() + 1, dd = d.getDate();
        return (dd < 10 ? '0' + dd : dd) + '/' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : m) + '/' + d.getFullYear();
    }
    function qtyPrint(v) {
        var n = Math.round((parseFloat(v) || 0) * 10000) / 10000;
        return Ext.util.Format.number(n, '0,000.0000').replace(/\.?0+$/, '');
    }
    function printSuratJalan(h, items) {
        if (!h.issue_ref_no) { showErr('Surat jalan baru tersedia setelah retur dikirim (Issue W/H dibuat).'); return; }
        var w = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=900,height=700');
        if (!w) { showErr('Popup diblokir browser. Izinkan popup untuk situs ini lalu coba lagi.'); return; }
        var rows = '', no = 0, totalLine = 0;
        Ext.each(items, function (i) {
            no++;
            rows += '<tr><td class="c">' + no + '</td><td>' + enc(i.material_code || '') + '</td><td>' + enc(i.material_name) + '</td>' +
                    '<td class="r">' + qtyPrint(i.qty_claim) + '</td><td class="c">' + enc(i.unit || '') + '</td>' +
                    '<td>' + enc(i.defect_type || '') + '</td><td>' + enc(i.defect_note || '') + '</td></tr>';
        });
        totalLine = items.length;
        var css = '@page{size:A4;margin:12mm;}body{font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:12px;color:#000;margin:0;}' +
                  'h1{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 2px 0;text-align:center;letter-spacing:1px;}.sub{text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:11px;}' +
                  'table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;}.meta td{padding:2px 4px;vertical-align:top;}' +
                  '.items th,.items td{border:1px solid #000;padding:5px 6px;}.items th{background:#eee;}' +
                  '.c{text-align:center;}.r{text-align:right;}.sign td{width:33%;text-align:center;padding-top:6px;}' +
                  '.sign .box{height:70px;}hr{border:0;border-top:2px solid #000;margin:8px 0;}';
        var html = '<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Surat Jalan ' + enc(h.issue_ref_no) + '</title><style>' + css + '</style></head><body>' +
                   (COMPANY_NAME ? '<div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:bold;text-align:center;">' + enc(COMPANY_NAME) + '</div>' : '') +
                   (COMPANY_ADDR ? '<div class="sub">' + enc(COMPANY_ADDR) + '</div>' : '') +
                   '<hr/><h1>SURAT JALAN RETUR PEMBELIAN</h1><div class="sub">Pengembalian barang cacat / rusak ke supplier</div>' +
                   '<table class="meta"><tr>' +
                   '<td width="16%">No. Surat Jalan</td><td width="34%">: <b>' + enc(h.issue_ref_no) + '</b></td>' +
                   '<td width="16%">Tanggal Kirim</td><td width="34%">: ' + fmtDmy(h.sent_date) + '</td></tr><tr>' +
                   '<td>Kepada (Supplier)</td><td>: <b>' + enc(h.supplier_name) + '</b></td>' +
                   '<td>No. Retur</td><td>: ' + enc(h.ref_no) + '</td></tr><tr>' +
                   '<td>Proyek</td><td>: ' + enc(h.project_name) + '</td>' +
                   '<td>No. PO</td><td>: ' + enc(h.po_number || '-') + '</td></tr><tr>' +
                   '<td>Gudang Asal</td><td>: ' + enc(h.warehouse_name) + '</td>' +
                   '<td>No. DO Asal</td><td>: ' + enc(h.supplier_do_no || '-') + '</td></tr><tr>' +
                   '<td>Kurir / Penerima</td><td colspan="3">: ' + enc(h.carrier || '-') + '</td></tr></table>' +
                   '<br/><table class="items"><thead><tr><th width="4%">No</th><th width="12%">Kode</th><th>Material</th><th width="10%">Qty</th>' +
                   '<th width="8%">Sat</th><th width="18%">Jenis Cacat</th><th width="20%">Keterangan</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + rows +
                   '</tbody></table><div style="margin-top:6px;">Total item: <b>' + totalLine + '</b>' +
                   (h.remark ? ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Catatan: ' + enc(h.remark) : '') + '</div><br/>' +
                   '<table class="sign"><tr><td>Dibuat oleh<br/>(Gudang)</td><td>Pengirim / Kurir</td><td>Diterima oleh<br/>(Supplier)</td></tr>' +
                   '<tr><td class="box"></td><td class="box"></td><td class="box"></td></tr>' +
                   '<tr><td>(................................)</td><td>(................................)</td><td>(................................)</td></tr></table>' +
                   '<div style="margin-top:14px;font-size:10px;color:#444;">Dicetak: ' + fmtDmy(ymd(new Date())) + '</div></body></html>';
        w.document.open('text/html','replace');
        w.document.write(html);
        w.document.close();
        w.focus();
        setTimeout(function () { w.print(); }, 300);
    }

    // [NEW] bukti pengiriman = satu atau lebih URL (satu per baris). Hanya http(s)/path lokal yang dijadikan link.
    function proofLinks(v) {
        if (!v) { return ''; }
        var out = [], parts = String(v).split(/\r?\n/);
        for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            var u = parts[i].replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
            if (!u) { continue; }
            if (!/^(https?:\/\/|\/)/i.test(u)) { out.push(enc(u)); continue; }
            var label = /\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp)(\?.*)?$/i.test(u) ? 'Foto' : (/\.pdf(\?.*)?$/i.test(u) ? 'PDF' : 'Link');
            out.push('<a href="' + enc(u) + '" target="_blank" style="color:#7fe0a0;">' + label + ' ' + (out.length + 1) + '</a>');
        }
        return out.join(' &nbsp;|&nbsp; ');
    }

    // [NEW] Banner status pengiriman dari W/H di panel detail retur (read-only; aksi gudang ada di Warehouse Issuing)
    function dispatchBanner(h) {
        function box(bg, border, fg, inner) {
            return '<div style="margin:0 2px 8px 2px; padding:8px 12px; background:' + bg + '; border-left:4px solid ' + border + '; color:' + fg + ';">' + inner + '</div>';
        }
        if (h.status === 'Diperintahkan') {
            return box('#4a3a0b', '#e6a817', '#ffe9a8', '<b>Perintah issue W/H sudah dibuat</b> (' + enc(h.issue_ref_no || '-') +
                ') &mdash; menunggu gudang menyiapkan barang. Stok belum keluar.');
        }
        if (h.status === 'Disiapkan') {
            return box('#0b3550', '#2bc1e2', '#cdeefa', '<b>Barang sudah disiapkan gudang</b> (' + enc(h.issue_ref_no || '-') +
                ', ' + enc(h.prepared_at || '-') + ') &mdash; menunggu konfirmasi pengiriman. Stok belum keluar.');
        }
        if (h.issue_ref_no && (h.status === 'Dikirim' || h.status === 'Diganti' || h.status === 'Kredit')) {
            return box('#0f3d2a', '#2e9e4f', '#c9f2d9', '<b style="color:#4be08a;">&#10004; Barang sudah dikirim dari W/H</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Issue W/H: <b>' + enc(h.issue_ref_no) + '</b>' +
                ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Tgl kirim: <b>' + enc(h.sent_date || '-') + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Kurir / Kendaraan: <b>' + enc(h.carrier || '-') + '</b>' +
                ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Penerima: <b>' + enc(h.delivery_receiver || '-') + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; No. Surat Jalan: <b>' + enc(h.delivery_note_no || '-') + '</b>' +
                (h.delivery_proof ? '<br>Bukti pengiriman: ' + proofLinks(h.delivery_proof) : ''));      // [NEW] foto / PDF dari gudang
        }
        return '';
    }

    function renderDetailPanel(h, items) {
        var grand = 0;
        // [FIX-UI] tombol aksi sesuai status dipindah ke baris judul (sebelumnya di dasar panel -> tidak terlihat)
        var actions = [];
        if (h.status === 'Diajukan') { actions = [['order', 'Perintahkan W/H (Issue)', '#03615e'], ['cancel', 'Batalkan Retur', '#8e2b22']]; }      // [CHANGED] send -> order
        else if (h.status === 'Diperintahkan' || h.status === 'Disiapkan') { actions = [['cancel_order', 'Batalkan Perintah W/H', '#8e2b22']]; }      // [NEW]
        else if (h.status === 'Dikirim') { actions = [['print', 'Cetak Surat Jalan', '#2e6da4'], ['unsend', 'Batal Kirim', '#555555'], ['resolve', 'Selesaikan', '#03615e']]; }
        else if (h.issue_ref_no) { actions = [['print', 'Cetak Surat Jalan', '#2e6da4']]; }      // [NEW] Diganti / Kredit: surat jalan tetap bisa dicetak ulang
        var actHtml = '';
        if (actions.length) {
            actHtml = '<div style="float:right; margin:2px 4px 0 0;">';
            Ext.each(actions, function (a) {
                actHtml += '<button type="button" class="rtActionBtn" data-act="' + a[0] + '" style="margin-left:8px; padding:8px 16px; background:' + a[2] +
                           '; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold;">' + enc(a[1]) + '</button>';
            });
            actHtml += '</div>';
        }
        var html = actHtml + '<h3 class="detail-title">Detail Retur: ' + enc(h.ref_no) +
                   ' <span style="color:' + statusColor(h.status) + ';">(' + enc(h.status) + ')</span></h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<div style="padding:4px 2px 10px 2px;">Tanggal: <b>' + enc(h.return_date) + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Proyek: <b>' + enc(h.project_name) +
                   '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Gudang: <b>' + enc(h.warehouse_name) + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Supplier: <b>' + enc(h.supplier_name) +
                   '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; PO: <b>' + enc(h.po_number || '-') + '</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp; DO Asal: <b>' + enc(h.supplier_do_no || '-') + '</b>' +
                   (h.issue_ref_no ? ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Issue W/H: <b>' + enc(h.issue_ref_no) + '</b> (' + enc(h.sent_date) + ', ' + enc(h.carrier || '-') + ')' : '') +
                   (h.resolution_type ? ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Penyelesaian: <b>' + enc(h.resolution_type) + '</b> ' + enc(h.resolution_date) +
                       (h.credit_note_no ? ' (NK ' + enc(h.credit_note_no) + ', ' + fmtAmt(h.credit_amount) + ')' : '') +
                       (h.resolution_note ? ' - ' + enc(h.resolution_note) : '') : '') +
                   (h.remark ? ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Catatan: ' + enc(h.remark) : '') + '</div>' +
                   dispatchBanner(h) +      // [CHANGED] info status pengiriman dari W/H (gudang yang konfirmasi)
                   '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +
                   '<thead><tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Material</th><th align="right">Qty Retur</th><th align="right">Biaya Satuan (FIFO)</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Nilai</th><th align="left">Jenis Cacat</th><th align="left">Keterangan</th><th align="left">Bukti</th>' +
                   '</tr></thead><tbody>';
        if (!items.length) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="7" style="padding:15px; text-align:center; color:#557982;">Belum ada item.</td></tr>';
        }
        Ext.each(items, function (i) {
            var amt = parseFloat(i.amount) || 0;
            grand += amt;
            html += '<tr class="data-row">' +
                    '<td align="left">' + enc(i.material_name) + ' <span style="color:#668894;">(' + enc(i.material_code || '') + ')</span></td>' +
                    '<td align="right">' + fmtQty(i.qty_claim) + ' ' + enc(i.unit || '') + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(i.unit_cost) + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right" class="subtotal-val">' + fmtAmt(amt) + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="left">' + enc(i.defect_type) + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="left">' + enc(i.defect_note || '') + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="left">' + evidenceLink(i.evidence_ref) + '</td></tr>';
        });
        html += '<tr class="data-row"><td colspan="3" align="right"><b>Total</b></td>' +
                '<td align="right" class="subtotal-val"><b>' + fmtAmt(grand) + '</b></td><td colspan="3"></td></tr>';
        html += '</tbody></table>';

        dtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        dtlDiv.style.display = 'block';

        var btns = dtlDiv.querySelectorAll('.rtActionBtn');
        for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) {
            btns[i].onclick = function () {
                var act = this.getAttribute('data-act');
                if (act === 'print') { printSuratJalan(h, items); return; }      // [NEW] cetak tidak butuh hak edit
                runAction(h, act);
            };
        }
    }

    function runAction(rec, act) {
        if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengubah status retur.')) return;
        if (act === 'order') { openOrder(rec); }      // [CHANGED] send -> order
        else if (act === 'resolve') { openResolve(rec); }
        else if (act === 'cancel') {
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Batalkan Retur', 'Batalkan retur <b>' + enc(rec.ref_no) + '</b>?', function (b) {
                if (b === 'yes') doAction({ action: 'cancel', id: rec.id });
            });
        } else if (act === 'cancel_order') {      // [NEW]
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Batalkan Perintah W/H', 'Batalkan perintah issue W/H untuk <b>' + enc(rec.ref_no) + '</b>? Retur kembali berstatus Diajukan.', function (b) {
                if (b === 'yes') doAction({ action: 'cancel_order', id: rec.id });
            });
        } else if (act === 'unsend') {
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Batal Kirim', 'Batalkan pengiriman <b>' + enc(rec.ref_no) + '</b>? Issue W/H di-reverse dan stok kembali ke gudang.', function (b) {
                if (b === 'yes') doAction({ action: 'unsend', id: rec.id });
            });
        }
    }

    // ---- [CHANGED] Perintahkan W/H: buat dokumen issue (pending). Stok belum keluar; gudang yang konfirmasi dikirim ----
    function openOrder(rec) {
        var wDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Perintah', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), allowBlank: false, width: 120 });
        var win = new Ext.Window({
            title: 'Perintahkan W/H untuk Retur ' + rec.ref_no, width: 460, height: 190, modal: true, layout: 'fit', cls: 'rtDarkWin',      // [FIX-UI] cls
            items: new Ext.form.FormPanel({
                border: false, labelWidth: 120, bodyStyle: 'padding:12px;',
                items: [{ xtype: 'displayfield', hideLabel: true,
                          value: 'Dokumen issue W/H dibuat berstatus pending. Stok BELUM keluar sampai gudang menyiapkan barang dan mengonfirmasi pengiriman di Warehouse Issuing.' },
                        wDate]
            }),
            buttons: [
                { text: 'Perintahkan', handler: function () {
                    if (!wDate.getValue()) { showErr('Tanggal perintah wajib diisi.'); return; }
                    // [FIX-CLOSE] ambil nilai field SEBELUM window ditutup (win.close() menghancurkan field -> getValue() error, request tidak terkirim)
                    var params = { action: 'order', id: rec.id, order_date: ymd(wDate.getValue()) };
                    win.close();
                    doAction(params);
                } },
                { text: 'Batal', handler: function () { win.close(); } }
            ]
        });
        win.show();
    }

    // ---- Selesaikan (ganti barang / kredit) ----
    function openResolve(rec) {
        var wType = new Ext.form.ComboBox({
            fieldLabel: 'Penyelesaian', store: ['Ganti Barang', 'Kredit'], triggerAction: 'all', editable: false,
            forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, anchor: '95%', value: 'Ganti Barang'
        });
        var wDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), allowBlank: false, width: 120 });
        var wCnNo = new Ext.form.TextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Nota Kredit', anchor: '95%', disabled: true });
        var wCnAmt = new Ext.form.NumberField({ fieldLabel: 'Nilai Kredit', decimalPrecision: 2, allowNegative: false, width: 160,
            disabled: true, value: Math.round((rec.total_amount || 0) * 100) / 100 });
        var wNote = new Ext.form.TextField({ fieldLabel: 'Catatan', anchor: '95%' });
        wType.on('select', function () {
            var kredit = (wType.getValue() === 'Kredit');
            wCnNo.setDisabled(!kredit);
            wCnAmt.setDisabled(!kredit);
        });
        var win = new Ext.Window({
            title: 'Selesaikan Retur ' + rec.ref_no, width: 460, height: 290, modal: true, layout: 'fit', cls: 'rtDarkWin',      // [FIX-UI] cls
            items: new Ext.form.FormPanel({
                border: false, labelWidth: 110, bodyStyle: 'padding:12px;',
                items: [wType, wDate, wCnNo, wCnAmt, wNote,
                        { xtype: 'displayfield', hideLabel: true,
                          value: '<span style="color:#888;">Ganti Barang: barang pengganti diterima lewat RCV biasa.</span>' }]
            }),
            buttons: [
                { text: 'Simpan', handler: function () {
                    if (!wDate.getValue()) { showErr('Tanggal wajib diisi.'); return; }
                    var kredit = (wType.getValue() === 'Kredit');
                    if (kredit && (!wCnNo.getValue() || !(parseFloat(wCnAmt.getValue()) > 0))) {
                        showErr('Kredit wajib mengisi no. nota kredit dan nilai kredit (> 0).'); return;
                    }
                    // [FIX-CLOSE] ambil nilai field SEBELUM window ditutup
                    var params = {
                        action: 'resolve', id: rec.id, resolution_type: wType.getValue(),
                        resolution_date: ymd(wDate.getValue()),
                        credit_note_no: kredit ? wCnNo.getValue() : '', credit_amount: kredit ? wCnAmt.getValue() : 0,
                        resolution_note: wNote.getValue()
                    };
                    win.close();
                    doAction(params);
                } },
                { text: 'Batal', handler: function () { win.close(); } }
            ]
        });
        win.show();
    }

    function updateMainButtons() {
        mainBtnEnable('#addData');
        if (dataRecord && dataRecord.status === 'Diajukan') {     // Edit & Delete(Batalkan) hanya untuk retur Diajukan
            mainBtnEnable('#editData');
            mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
        } else {
            mainBtnDisable('#editData');
            mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
        }
    }
    editDataDisable();

    // Form dibuat saat editor dibuka pertama kali (container hidden -> lebar kolom 0 bila dirender lebih awal)
    function ensureHdrForm() {
        if (hdrForm) { hdrForm.doLayout(); return; }

        // satu-satunya pilihan: dokumen RCV (cari no. RCV / GRN / PO / proyek / supplier)
        fRcv = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Dokumen RCV', store: rcvDs, displayField: 'label', valueField: 'id',
            mode: 'remote', queryParam: 'query', minChars: 0, triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false,
            anchor: '98%', listWidth: 700, emptyText: 'Pilih / cari RCV (no. RCV, GRN, PO, proyek, supplier)...',
            listeners: { select: function (combo, rec) { onRcvSelected(rec); } }
        });
        // diturunkan otomatis dari RCV (read-only)
        fProjInfo = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ fieldLabel: 'Proyek', value: '-', anchor: '95%' });
        fWhInfo = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ fieldLabel: 'Gudang', value: '-', anchor: '95%' });
        fSupInfo = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ fieldLabel: 'Supplier', value: '-', anchor: '95%' });
        fPoInfo = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ fieldLabel: 'PO / GRN', value: '-', anchor: '95%' });
        fDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), allowBlank: false, width: 120 });
        fDo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. DO Asal', anchor: '95%' });
        fRemark = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Catatan', anchor: '95%' });

        var col = function (w, items) {
            return { columnWidth: w, layout: 'form', border: false, labelWidth: 95, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;', items: items };
        };
        hdrForm = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
            renderTo: 'rtHdrForm',
            border: false,
            layout: 'column',
            bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:4px 2px 0 2px;',
            items: [col(1, [fRcv]),
                    col(0.34, [fProjInfo, fWhInfo, fDate]),
                    col(0.33, [fSupInfo, fPoInfo]),
                    col(0.33, [fDo, fRemark])]
        });
    }

    // Isi info header dari baris RCV terpilih
    function fillRcvInfo(rec) {
        fProjInfo.setValue(rec ? '<b>' + enc(rec.get('project_name')) + '</b>' : '-');
        fWhInfo.setValue(rec ? '<b>' + enc(rec.get('warehouse_name')) + '</b>' : '-');
        fSupInfo.setValue(rec ? '<b>' + enc(rec.get('supplier_name') || '-') + '</b>' : '-');
        fPoInfo.setValue(rec ? '<b style="color:#e2e8f0;">' + enc(rec.get('po_number')) + '</b> / <b style="color:#e2e8f0;">' + enc(rec.get('grn_no') || '-') + '</b>' : '-');      // [FIX-UI] GRN dibuat bold + warna terang
    }

    // Muat item RCV + qty yang masih boleh diretur; cb dipanggil setelah selesai
    function loadRcvItems(rcvId, cb) {
        ajax({ action: 'rcv_items', rcv_id: rcvId, exclude_id: editId }, function (res) {
            if (!res.success) { itemDs.removeAll(); showErr(res.message || 'Gagal memuat item RCV.'); return; }
            itemDs.loadData(res);
            var any = false;
            itemDs.each(function (r) { if (r.get('available') > 0) any = true; });
            if (!any) showErr('Semua item pada RCV ini sudah diretur / stok gudang kosong.');
            if (cb) cb();
        });
    }

    function onRcvSelected(rec) {
        fillRcvInfo(rec);
        itemDs.removeAll();
        if (rec) loadRcvItems(rec.get('id'));
    }

    function showEditor(title) {
        var addWdw = document.getElementById('addWdw');      // jaga-jaga: window Add bawaan template jangan ikut terbuka
        if (addWdw) addWdw.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;' + enc(title);
        ensureHdrForm();
        itemGrid.doLayout();                                 // [FIX-UI] hitung ulang lebar header/body setelah window tampil
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Action Handlers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // ADD = retur baru
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (!needAccess(ACCESS_ADD, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membuat retur.')) return;
        editId = 0;
        showEditor('Retur Pembelian Baru');
        fRcv.enable();
        fRcv.clearValue();
        fillRcvInfo(null);
        fDate.setValue(new Date()); fDo.setValue(''); fRemark.setValue('');
        itemDs.removeAll();
        rcvDs.load();
    };

    // EDIT = ubah retur Diajukan (dokumen RCV tidak bisa diganti)
    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) { showErr('Pilih retur terlebih dahulu dari tabel.'); return; }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'Diajukan') { showErr('Hanya retur berstatus Diajukan yang dapat diedit.'); return; }
        if (!dataRecord.wh_receiving_hdr_id) { showErr('Retur ini tidak terhubung ke dokumen RCV, hanya bisa dibatalkan.'); return; }
        if (!needAccess(ACCESS_EDIT, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengedit retur.')) return;
        var rec = dataRecord;
        editId = rec.id;
        showEditor('Edit Retur ' + rec.ref_no);
        itemDs.removeAll();
        rcvDs.load({ params: { query: rec.rcv_ref_no || '' }, callback: function () {
            var rr = rcvDs.getById(rec.wh_receiving_hdr_id);
            fRcv.setValue(rec.wh_receiving_hdr_id);
            fRcv.disable();
            fillRcvInfo(rr);
            fDate.setValue(parseYmd(rec.return_date) || new Date());      // [FIX-DATE]
            fDo.setValue(rec.supplier_do_no || '');
            fRemark.setValue(rec.remark || '');
            loadRcvItems(rec.wh_receiving_hdr_id, function () {
                // pasang qty / jenis cacat tersimpan ke baris item RCV (baris tambahan bila satu material punya >1 baris)
                ajax({ action: 'detail', id: rec.id }, function (res) {
                    if (!res.success) { showErr(res.message || 'Gagal memuat detail retur.'); return; }
                    var used = {};
                    Ext.each(res.data, function (d) {
                        var idx = itemDs.findBy(function (r) { return String(r.get('material_id')) === String(d.material_id) && !used[r.id]; });
                        var row = idx >= 0 ? itemDs.getAt(idx) : null;
                        if (!row) {
                            var base = itemDs.getAt(itemDs.findBy(function (r) { return String(r.get('material_id')) === String(d.material_id); }));
                            if (!base) return;
                            row = new itemDs.recordType(Ext.apply({}, base.data));
                            itemDs.add(row);
                        }
                        used[row.id] = true;
                        row.set('qty_claim', parseFloat(d.qty_claim));
                        row.set('defect_type', d.defect_type);
                        row.set('defect_note', d.defect_note || '');
                        row.set('evidence_ref', d.evidence_ref || '');
                    });
                });
            });
        } });
    };

    // SAVE
    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        if (!fRcv.getValue() || !fDate.getValue()) { showErr('Dokumen RCV dan tanggal wajib diisi.'); return; }
        var arr = [], err = '';
        itemDs.each(function (r) {
            var q = parseFloat(r.get('qty_claim')) || 0;
            if (q <= 0) return;                                  // baris qty 0 = tidak diretur, diabaikan
            if (!r.get('defect_type')) { err = 'Jenis cacat ' + r.get('material_name') + ' wajib dipilih.'; return false; }
            arr.push({ material_id: r.get('material_id'), qty_claim: q, defect_type: r.get('defect_type'),
                       defect_note: r.get('defect_note') || '', evidence_ref: r.get('evidence_ref') || '' });
        });
        if (err) { showErr(err); return; }
        if (!arr.length) { showErr('Isi qty retur minimal untuk satu material.'); return; }

        ajax({
            action: 'save', id: editId, rcv_id: fRcv.getValue(),
            return_date: ymd(fDate.getValue()), supplier_do_no: fDo.getValue(), remark: fRemark.getValue(),
            details: Ext.util.JSON.encode(arr)      // detail bertingkat -> JSON via POST
        }, function (res) {
            if (res.success) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message || 'Retur tersimpan.');
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                dataRecord = null;
                dtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                mainDs.load();
                updateMainButtons();
            } else {
                showErr(res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
            }
        });
    };

    // DELETE = Batalkan retur Diajukan (status -> Dibatalkan, data tidak dihapus)
    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord || dataRecord.status !== 'Diajukan') {
            showErr('Pilih retur berstatus Diajukan terlebih dahulu. Retur Dikirim dibatalkan lewat Batal Kirim di panel detail.');
            return;
        }
        runAction(dataRecord, 'cancel');
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        if (document.getElementById('popCancel')) {
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    // [CHANGED] window editor template harus disembunyikan saat halaman dibuka (sebelumnya tampil kosong)
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
    var addWdwInit = document.getElementById('addWdw');
    if (addWdwInit) addWdwInit.style.display = 'none';

});

  const ENDPOINT = '../../php-crud/paymentCRD.php';

  async function loadGrid() {
    const res = await apiCall(ENDPOINT, 'read');
    const tbody = $('gridBody');
    if (!res.success || !res.data.length) {
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;">Tidak ada data.</td></tr>';
      return;
    }
    tbody.innerHTML = res.data.map(i => `
      <tr>
        <td style="font-family:var(--font-mono); color:var(--gold);">${i.payment_no}</td>
        <td>${i.payment_date}</td>
        <td>${i.customer_name}</td>
        <td>${UIFormat.currency(i.total_amount)}</td>
        <td>${UIFormat.currency(i.deposit_applied)}</td>
        <td>
          <button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="openEdit(${i.id})">Edit</button>
        </td>
      </tr>
    `).join('');
  }

  function openNewModal() {
    $('mainForm').reset();
    UIModal.hideErr('errBox');
    UIModal.show('formOverlay');
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadGrid);
</script>

  Description   : General Ledger - Laporan read-only, filter Akun & Periode
                   OPSIONAL. Kalau tidak dipilih, tampilkan semua akun /
                   semua periode, dikelompokkan per akun (GroupingView).
  Backend       : /rab-project/dev/php-crud/generalledgerCRD.php

Ext.onReady(function () {
    var CRD = main_url + '/php-crud/generalledgerCRD.php';
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "General <em>Ledger</em>";

    ['addData', 'editData', 'deleteData'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 0. Buat elemen filter bar & summary secara dinamis
    // ============================================================
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var filterBarDiv = document.createElement('div');
    filterBarDiv.id = 'glFilterBar';
    filterBarDiv.style.padding = '0 10px';
    var summaryDiv = document.createElement('div');
    summaryDiv.id = 'glSummary';
    summaryDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:5px 12px; font-size:13px; color:#ddd; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); margin:0 10px 10px 10px; border-radius:4px;';
    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(filterBarDiv, gridContainer);
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(summaryDiv, gridContainer);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 1. Field definitions & stores
    // ============================================================
    var ledgerField = [
        { name: 'account_id' }, { name: 'account_code' }, { name: 'account_name' }, { name: 'account_label' },
        { name: 'journal_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'journal_no' }, { name: 'description' },
        { name: 'debit', type: 'float' }, { name: 'credit', type: 'float' }, { name: 'balance', type: 'float' }
    ];

    var accountField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'account_code' }, { name: 'account_name' }, { name: 'account_type' }];
    var accountDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        baseParams: { task: 'read_accounts' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, accountField)
    });
    accountDs.load();

    var periodField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'period_name' }, { name: 'start_date' }, { name: 'end_date' }];
    var periodDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: CRD,
        baseParams: { task: 'read_periods' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, periodField)
    });
    periodDs.load();

    // GroupingStore supaya laporan "semua akun" tersusun rapi per kelompok
    var ledgerDs = new Ext.data.GroupingStore({
        url: CRD,
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, ledgerField),
        groupField: 'account_label',
        sortInfo: { field: 'journal_date', direction: 'ASC' },
        remoteGroup: false,
        remoteSort: false
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 2. Filter bar (Akun + Periode, keduanya OPSIONAL + tombol Tampilkan)
    // ============================================================
    var fldAccount = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Akun', width: 280, store: accountDs, displayField: 'account_name', valueField: 'id',
        emptyText: '-- Semua Akun --'
    });
    var fldPeriod = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Periode', width: 180, store: periodDs, displayField: 'period_name', valueField: 'id',
        emptyText: '-- Semua Periode --'
    });
    var btnShow = new Ext.Button({ text: 'Tampilkan', cls: 'field-button grey-field-button' });
    var btnClearFilter = new Ext.Button({ text: 'Reset', cls: 'field-button grey-field-button' });

    var filterPanel = new Ext.Panel({
        renderTo: 'glFilterBar',
        layout: 'column',
        border: false,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:8px 0;',
        defaults: { border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;' },
        items: [
            { columnWidth: 0.35, layout: 'form', labelWidth: 60, items: fldAccount },
            { columnWidth: 0.25, layout: 'form', labelWidth: 60, items: fldPeriod },
            { columnWidth: 0.15, style: 'padding-top:2px;', items: btnShow },
            { columnWidth: 0.1, style: 'padding-top:2px;', items: btnClearFilter }
        ]
    });

    function loadLedger() {
        var accId = fldAccount.getValue() || 0;
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue() || 0;

        ledgerDs.load({ params: { task: 'read_ledger', account_id: accId, period_id: perId } });

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: CRD,
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_ledger', account_id: accId, period_id: perId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) { summaryDiv.innerHTML = ''; return; }
                summaryDiv.innerHTML =
                    '<b>Akun:</b> ' + res.account_label +
                    ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b>Periode:</b> ' + res.period_name +
                    ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b>Jumlah baris:</b> ' + res.totalCount;
            }
        });
    }

    btnShow.on('click', loadLedger);
    btnClearFilter.on('click', function () {
        fldAccount.clearValue();
        fldPeriod.clearValue();
        loadLedger();
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 3. Grid mutasi, dikelompokkan per akun
    // ============================================================
    let mainHeight=(maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));

    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: ledgerDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height : mainHeight,

        stripeRows: true,
        loadMask: { msg: 'Loading Data ...' },
        view: new Ext.grid.GroupingView({
            forceFit: true,
            groupTextTpl: '{text}',
            hideGroupedColumn: true,
            startCollapsed: false
        }),
        colModel: new Ext.grid.ColumnModel({
            columnLines: true,
            defaults: { menuDisabled: true, resizable: false, sortable: false },
            columns: [
                { header: 'Akun', dataIndex: 'account_label', hidden: true },
                { header: 'Tanggal', dataIndex: 'journal_date', width: 90, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
                { header: 'No. Jurnal', dataIndex: 'journal_no', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
                { header: 'Keterangan', dataIndex: 'description', width: 250, renderer: CellWrap },
                {
                    header: 'Debit', dataIndex: 'debit', width: 110, align: 'right',
                    renderer: function (v) { return v ? Ext.util.Format.number(v, '0,000.00') : ''; }
                },
                {
                    header: 'Kredit', dataIndex: 'credit', width: 110, align: 'right',
                    renderer: function (v) { return v ? Ext.util.Format.number(v, '0,000.00') : ''; }
                },
                {
                    header: 'Saldo', dataIndex: 'balance', width: 120, align: 'right',
                    renderer: function (v) { return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00') + '</b>'; }
                }
            ]
        })
    });

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () {
        var accId = fldAccount.getValue() || 0;
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue() || 0;
        window.open('../pdf/generalledger.php?account_id=' + accId + '&period_id=' + perId, 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
    };

    // ============================================================
    // 4. Auto-load semua data saat halaman pertama kali dibuka
    //    (tanpa filter -- sesuai permintaan: tampilkan semua)
    // ============================================================
    loadLedger();
    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';

    }
});

/*
  Document      : rab.js
  Description   : Form Pengelolaan RAB Material Proyek
                   Multi currency: satu mata uang anggaran per proyek (mis. USD untuk proyek berdana luar negeri)
                   + kurs ke mata uang dasar. Harga satuan RAB dalam mata uang anggaran; PO boleh IDR atau USD
                   dan dibandingkan terhadap RAB setelah dikonversi.
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "RAB <i>Material</i>";

    var dataRecord = null;
    var rabCur = { id: null, code: 'IDR', baseCode: 'IDR', isBase: true, rate: 1, locked: null };
    var rateManual = false, rateReq = 0;
    var hdrForm = null, fCur, fRate, fRateDate, fRateInfo;

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    function statusColor(v) {
        if (v === 'OVERBUDGET') return '#c0392b !important';
        if (v === 'WARNING') return '#e6a817 !important';
        if (v === 'NO BUDGET') return '#888888 !important';
        return '#27ae60 !important';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 0. Container Panel Detail Material (tampil di bawah grid utama)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var rabDtlDiv = document.createElement('div');
    rabDtlDiv.id = 'rabDtlContainer';
    rabDtlDiv.className = 'detail-panel-container';
    rabDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';

    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(rabDtlDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling);
    }

    // Fungsi menghitung tinggi dinamis scrollbar detail panel
    function fitRabDtl() {
        var sc = document.getElementById('rabDtlScroll');
        if (!sc) return;
        var top = sc.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        var footer = 40;
        sc.style.maxHeight = Math.max(160, window.innerHeight - top - footer) + 'px';
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', fitRabDtl);

    function loadRabDetailPanel(projectId, projectName) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/rabCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'load_rab', project_id: projectId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    rabDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red; padding:10px;">Gagal memuat detail RAB.</div>';
                    rabDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderRabDetailPanel(res.data.items || [], projectName, res.data.currency);
            },
            failure: function () {
                rabDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red; padding:10px;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                rabDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderRabDetailPanel(rows, projectName, cur) {
        var fmtQty = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); };
        var fmtAmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };
        var fmtPct = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0.00') + '%'; };

        var code = (cur && cur.code) || 'IDR';
        var curLine = '<div style="padding:0 2px 10px 2px;">Mata uang anggaran: <b>' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(code) + '</b>' +
                      (cur && !cur.is_base ? ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; Kurs: <b>' + fmtAmt(cur.exch_rate) + '</b> ' +
                          Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(cur.base_code || 'IDR') + ' per 1 ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(code) : '') + '</div>';
        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Daftar Material RAB: ' +
                   Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(projectName || '') + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' + curLine +
                   '<div id="rabDtlScroll" style="overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: auto;">' +
                   '<table id="rabTable" class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Material</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Budget Qty</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Harga Satuan (' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(code) + ')</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Total Budget (' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(code) + ')</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Qty Terpakai</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">% Terpakai</th>' +
                   '<th align="center">Status</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="7" style="padding:15px; text-align:center; color:#557982;">Belum ada baris RAB material untuk proyek ini. Klik Edit untuk menambahkan.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            var grandBudget = 0;
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var totalBudget = (parseFloat(r.budget_qty) || 0) * (parseFloat(r.unit_price) || 0);
                grandBudget += totalBudget;
                html += '<tr class="data-row">' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.material_name || '-') + ' <span style="color:#668894;">(' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.material_code || '') + ')</span></td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtQty(r.budget_qty) + ' ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.unit || '') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(r.unit_price) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" class="subtotal-val">' + fmtAmt(totalBudget) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtQty(r.total_qty_out) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtPct(r.usage_pct) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="center" style="font-weight:bold; color:' + statusColor(r.status) + ';">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.status || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });
            html += '<tr class="data-row"><td colspan="3" align="right"><b>Total Budget RAB (' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(code) + ')</b></td>' +
                    '<td align="right" class="subtotal-val"><b>' + fmtAmt(grandBudget) + '</b></td>' +
                    '<td colspan="3" style="color:#668894;">' +
                    (cur && !cur.is_base ? '&asymp; ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(cur.base_code || 'IDR') + ' ' + fmtAmt(grandBudget * (parseFloat(cur.exch_rate) || 1)) : '') +
                    '</td></tr>';
        }
        html += '</tbody></table></div>';

        rabDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        rabDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
        fitRabDtl();
    }

    function updateRabTotalLabel() {
        var total = 0;
        rabItemDs.each(function (r) {
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('budget_qty')) || 0;
            var price = parseFloat(r.get('unit_price')) || 0;
            total += qty * price;
        });
        var el = document.getElementById('lblRabTotal');
        if (el) {
            var html = Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.00') + ' ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(rabCur.code);
            if (!rabCur.isBase) {
                html += ' <span style="color:#9fc3d1; font-weight:normal;">&asymp; ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(rabCur.baseCode) + ' ' +
                        Ext.util.Format.number(total * (parseFloat(rabCur.rate) || 1), '0,000.00') + '</span>';
            }
            el.innerHTML = html;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Mata uang anggaran (header editor)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function baseCurrencyCode() {
        var code = 'IDR';
        currencyDs.each(function (r) { if (r.get('is_base') === true) code = r.get('init'); });
        return code;
    }

    // Judul kolom harga & total mengikuti mata uang terpilih
    function applyCurrencyHeaders() {
        var cm = itemGrid.getColumnModel();
        cm.setColumnHeader(3, 'Harga Satuan (' + rabCur.code + ')');
        cm.setColumnHeader(5, 'Total Budget (' + rabCur.code + ')');
    }

    function ensureHdrForm() {
        if (hdrForm) { hdrForm.doLayout(); return; }

        fCur = new myComboField({
            fieldLabel: 'Mata Uang Anggaran', store: currencyDs, displayField: 'init', valueField: 'id',
            mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true, allowBlank: false, width: 110,
            listeners: { select: function () { onCurrencyChange(); } }
        });
        fRateDate = new Ext.form.DateField({
            fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Kurs', format: 'd/m/Y', value: new Date(), width: 120,
            listeners: {
                select: function () { if (!rateManual) refreshRate(); },
                change: function () { if (!rateManual) refreshRate(); }
            }
        });
  
    });
        fRate = new myNumberField({
            fieldLabel: 'Kurs ke Mata Uang Dasar', decimalPrecision: 4, value: 1, width: 130,
            listeners: { change: function () { rateManual = true; rabCur.rate = fRate.getValue() || 1; updateRabTotalLabel(); } }
        });
        fRateInfo = new Ext.form.DisplayField({ hideLabel: true, value: '', anchor: '98%' });

        var col = function (w, items) {
            return { columnWidth: w, layout: 'form', border: false, labelWidth: 150, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;', items: items };
        };
        hdrForm = new Ext.form.FormPanel({
            renderTo: 'rabHdrForm',
            border: false,
            layout: 'column',
            bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:4px 2px;',
            items: [col(0.30, [fCur, fRateDate]), col(0.30, [fRate]), col(0.40, [fRateInfo])]
        });
    }

    function onCurrencyChange() {
        var rec = currencyDs.getById(fCur.getValue());
        if (!rec) return;
        rabCur.id = rec.get('id');
        rabCur.code = rec.get('init');
        rabCur.isBase = rec.get('is_base') === true;
        rabCur.baseCode = baseCurrencyCode();
        rateManual = false;
        applyCurrencyHeaders();
        refreshRate();
        itemGrid.getView().refresh();
        updateRabTotalLabel();
    }

    // Kurs default = kurs pajak KMK pada tanggal kurs; belum ada -> kurs terakhir. Tetap bisa diedit.
    function refreshRate() {
        var cid = fCur.getValue(), dt = fRateDate.getValue();
        if (!cid || !dt) return;
        var token = ++rateReq;
        //fRateInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#668894;">memuat kurs...</span>');
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/rabCRD.php', method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'get_exchange_rate', currency_id: cid, date: dt.format('Y-m-d') },
            success: function (response) {
                if (token !== rateReq) return;
                var res;
                try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText); } catch (e) { return; }
                if (!res.success) { fRateInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#c0392b;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(res.message || 'Gagal memuat kurs.') + '</span>'); return; }
                var d = res.data || {}, enc = Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode;
                rabCur.isBase = (d.source === 'BASE');
                fRate.setReadOnly(rabCur.isBase);
                if (d.rate) { fRate.setValue(d.rate); rabCur.rate = d.rate; }
                if (d.source === 'BASE') {
                    fRateInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#668894;">Mata uang dasar (kurs 1)</span>');
                } else if (d.source === 'periode') {
                    fRateInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#2e9e4f;">KMK ' + enc(d.kmk_no) + ' (' + enc(d.start_date) + ' - ' + enc(d.end_date) + ')</span>');
                } else if (d.source === 'terakhir') {
                    fRateInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#e6a817;">Belum ada kurs untuk tanggal ini, memakai kurs terakhir: KMK ' +
                                       enc(d.kmk_no) + ' (' + enc(d.start_date) + ' - ' + enc(d.end_date) + ')</span>');
                } else {
                    fRateInfo.setValue('<span style="color:#e6a817;">Data kurs mata uang ini belum tersedia, isi manual.</span>');
                }
                updateRabTotalLabel();
            }
        });
    }

    // Terapkan info mata uang hasil load_rab ke form header
    function applyCurrencyFromServer(c) {
        c = c || {};
        ensureHdrForm();
        rabCur = { id: c.id, code: c.code || 'IDR', baseCode: c.base_code || 'IDR', isBase: !!c.is_base,
                   rate: parseFloat(c.exch_rate) || 1, locked: c.locked_reason || null };
        fCur.setValue(c.id);
        fRate.setValue(rabCur.rate);
        fRate.setReadOnly(rabCur.isBase);
        fRateDate.setValue((c.rate_date && Date.parseDate(c.rate_date, 'Y-m-d')) || new Date());
        rateManual = true;                                   // kurs tersimpan tidak ditimpa otomatis
        fCur.setDisabled(!!rabCur.locked);
        fRateInfo.setValue(rabCur.locked
            ? '<span style="color:#e6a817;">&#128274; Mata uang anggaran terkunci. ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(rabCur.locked) + ' Kurs tetap bisa diperbarui.</span>'
            : (rabCur.isBase ? '<span style="color:#668894;">Mata uang dasar (kurs 1)</span>'
                             : '<span style="color:#668894;">Kurs tersimpan pada RAB. Ganti mata uang untuk mengambil kurs baru.</span>'));
        applyCurrencyHeaders();
        itemGrid.getView().refresh();
        updateRabTotalLabel();
    }

    function addBlankMaterialRow() {
        var RabRecord = rabItemDs.recordType || Ext.data.Record.create(rabItemField);
        var rec = new RabRecord({
            id: 0, material_id: null, material_code: '', material_name: '', unit: '',
            budget_qty: 0, unit_price: 0, tolerance_pct: 0,
            total_qty_out: 0, remaining_qty: 0, usage_pct: 0, status: 'ON TRACK'
        });
        rabItemDs.add(rec);
        updateRabTotalLabel();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Action Handlers (Edit, Save, Modal Close)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih proyek terlebih dahulu.');
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() < 3) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengedit RAB.');
            return;
        }
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/rabCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'load_rab', project_id: dataRecord.id },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Gagal memuat RAB.');
                    return;
                }
                rabItemDs.loadData({ data: res.data.items || [] });
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
                applyCurrencyFromServer(res.data.currency);
                document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;RAB Material -- ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(res.data.name || '');
            },
            failure: function () {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) return;

        var arrItems = [];
        var hasInvalidRow = false;
        var materialSet = {};
        var duplicateFound = false;

        rabItemDs.each(function (r) {
            var materialId = r.get('material_id');
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('budget_qty')) || 0;
            
            if (!materialId && qty <= 0) return;
            if (!materialId || qty <= 0) { 
                hasInvalidRow = true; 
                return; 
            }

            if (materialSet[materialId]) {
                duplicateFound = true;
            } else {
                materialSet[materialId] = true;
            }

            arrItems.push({
                id: r.get('id') || 0,
                material_id: materialId,
                budget_qty: qty,
                unit_price: parseFloat(r.get('unit_price')) || 0,
                tolerance_pct: parseFloat(r.get('tolerance_pct')) || 0
            });
        });

        if (hasInvalidRow) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Ada baris material yang belum lengkap. Pastikan material dipilih dan Budget Qty > 0.');
            return;
        }

        if (duplicateFound) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Terdapat duplikasi material. Setiap material hanya boleh diinput 1 kali per proyek.');
            return;
        }

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/rabCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: 'save_rab',
                project_id: dataRecord.id,
                currency_id: fCur ? fCur.getValue() : 0,
                exch_rate: fRate ? (fRate.getValue() || 1) : 1,
                rate_date: (fRateDate && fRateDate.getValue()) ? fRateDate.getValue().format('Y-m-d') : '',
                items: Ext.util.JSON.encode(arrItems)
            },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (res.success) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', 'RAB material berhasil disimpan.');
                    mainDs.load();
                    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    loadRabDetailPanel(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.name);
                } else {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
                }
            },
            failure: function () {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        if (document.getElementById('popCancel')) {
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

/* Reusable App Engine Core */
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

// Universal API Fetcher
async function apiCall(endpoint, task, payload = {}) {
  try {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('task', task);
    for (const key in payload) {
      if (payload[key] !== null && payload[key] !== undefined) {
        formData.append(key, typeof payload[key] === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(payload[key]) : payload[key]);
      }
    }
    const response = await fetch(endpoint, { method: 'POST', body: formData });
    return await response.json();
  } catch (e) {
    return { success: false, message: 'Gagal terhubung ke server.' };
  }
}

// Universal Modal Controller
const UIModal = {
  show(modalId) { $(modalId)?.classList.add('show'); },
  hide(modalId) { $(modalId)?.classList.remove('show'); },
  showErr(boxId, msg) {
    const box = $(boxId);
    if (box) { box.textContent = msg; box.style.display = 'block'; }
  },
  hideErr(boxId) {
    const box = $(boxId);
    if (box) { box.style.display = 'none'; }
  }
};

// Formatter Utilitas
const UIFormat = {
  currency(val) {
    return Number(val || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 });
  }
};
// Global ExtJS Grid Cell Word-Wrap Injection
if (typeof Ext !== 'undefined' && Ext.util && Ext.util.CSS) {
    Ext.util.CSS.createStyleSheet('.x-grid3-cell-inner { white-space: normal !important; word-wrap: break-word !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; line-height: 1.35 !important; }', 'grid-wrap-fix');
}

==================== FILE: ./views/login__.php ====================
<?php
ini_set('session.gc_maxlifetime', 86400);
session_set_cookie_params(86400);
if (!isset($_SESSION)) {
    session_start();
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $loginUsername = trim($_POST["loginUsername"] ?? "");
    $loginPassword = $_POST["loginPassword"] ?? "";
    $loginMobile   = isset($_POST["m"]) ? intval($_POST["m"]) : 0;
    $terminalId    = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'];

    if (empty($loginUsername) || empty($loginPassword)) {
        $_SESSION['login_error'] = "Username dan Password wajib diisi!";
        header("Location: ../index.php");
        exit;
    }

    try {
        $db = new crud();

        $sql = "SELECT u.id,login_name as username, password, login_name as user_fullname, department_id, employee_name as department,
	                 department_init, section_id, location_id, location_init,
                   active as is_active, login_terminal, login_status
                FROM m_user_system u
                left join m_user_login_status s on u.id=s.user_id
                left join view_employee_depart_status v on u.employee_id =v.id
                WHERE u.login_name = :username LIMIT 1";

        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([':username' => $loginUsername]);
        $user = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if ($user && password_verify($loginPassword, $user['password'])) {
            if (isset($user['is_active']) && $user['is_active'] == false) {
                $_SESSION['login_error'] = "Akun Anda tidak aktif. Hubungi administrator.";
                header("Location: ../index.php");
                exit;
            }

            // Regenerasi ID sesi untuk mencegah Session Fixation
            session_regenerate_id(true);

            $_SESSION["username"]        = $user["username"];
            $_SESSION["terminal"]        = $terminalId;
            $_SESSION["user_id"]         = $user["id"];
            $_SESSION["user"]            = $user["user_fullname"];
            $_SESSION["department"]      = $user["department"];
            $_SESSION["department_init"] = $user["department_init"];
            $_SESSION["department_id"]   = $user["department_id"];
            $_SESSION["section_id"]      = $user["section_id"];
            $_SESSION["location_id"]     = $user["location_id"];
            $_SESSION["location_init"]   = $user["location_init"];

            $updateSql = "UPDATE m_user_login_status
                          SET login_status = true, login_terminal = :terminal
                          WHERE id = :user_id";
            $updateStmt = $db->prepare($updateSql);
            $updateStmt->execute([
                ':terminal' => $terminalId,
                ':user_id'  => $user["id"]
            ]);

            $periodSql = "SELECT id, from_date, to_date FROM payroll_period WHERE status IS TRUE LIMIT 1";
            $periodStmt = $db->query($periodSql);
            $period = $periodStmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if ($period) {
                $_SESSION["period_id"]         = $period["id"];
                $_SESSION["period_from_date"]  = $period["from_date"];
                $_SESSION["period_to_date"]    = $period["to_date"];
            }

            header("Location: menu.php");
            exit;

        } else {
            $_SESSION['login_error'] = "Username atau Password salah!";
            header("Location: ../index.php");
            exit;
        }

    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Login Database Error: " . $e->getMessage());
        $_SESSION['login_error'] = "Terjadi kesalahan sistem pada database.";
        header("Location: ../index.php");
        exit;
    }
} else {
    header("Location: ../index.php");
    exit;
}
?>

==================== FILE: ./views/dashboardV1.php ====================
<?php
$B = rtrim(dirname($_SERVER["SCRIPT_NAME"]), "/");  

// views/dashboard.php - FINAL VERSION
// [REVISI 2026-11-06] Dashboard dibagi 3 area bertab: Ringkasan Proyek | Keuangan | Material & RAB.
//   Data dimuat per tab (lazy) dan hanya dimuat ulang bila filter proyek berubah. Backend dashboardCRD.php TIDAK berubah.
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }
if (empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) { header('Location: login.php'); exit; }
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
if (function_exists('app_require_active_user')) {
    app_require_active_user();

require_once __DIR__ . '/../dev/php-class/crudClass.php';
$db = new crud();
$user_id = $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0;

if (!function_exists('toRoman')) {
    function toRoman($num) {
        $romans = ['', 'I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII', 'VIII', 'IX', 'X', 'XI', 'XII', 'XIII', 'XIV', 'XV'];
        return isset($romans[intval($num)]) ? $romans[intval($num)] : intval($num);
    }
}

    $stmt = $db->prepare($hsql);
    $stmt->execute(['user_id' => $user_id]);
