<!-- JAVASCRIPT -->
<script>
const API_ENDPOINT = '../php-crud/dashboardCRD.php';
let currentProjectId = 0;
let finChart = null, doughnutChart = null, barMaterialChart = null;
let globalTaxRates = [];
const formatIDR = (num) => 'Rp ' + Number(num || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
const formatNum = (num) => Number(num || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
const fmtRp = (n) => 'Rp ' + Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID', { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 0 });

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { initDashboard(); });

async function initDashboard() {
    await loadProjects();
    await loadTaxRates();
    loadFinancialAging();
    loadInvoicePipeline();
    loadActionCenter();
    loadMilestones();
    loadProfitability();
    loadExtra();
    loadProjectHealth();
    loadFinancialPerformance();
    loadMaterialMonitoring();
    initMegaMenu();
}
document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-menu a').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        // Membuang fokus dari elemen agar dropdown langsung tersembunyi
        document.activeElement.blur();
    });
});
async function loadProjects() {
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_ENDPOINT}?action=get_projects`);
        const json = await res.json();
        const select = document.getElementById('project_select');
        if (json.success && json.data.length > 0) {
            select.innerHTML = '<option value="0">-- Semua Proyek --</option>' + json.data.map(p => `<option value="${p.id}">${p.project_name}</option>`).join('');
        } else { select.innerHTML = '<option value="0">Tidak ada proyek</option>'; }
    } catch (err) { console.error('Error load projects:', err); }
}

function onProjectChange(val) {
    currentProjectId = parseInt(val) || 0;
    loadFinancialAging(); loadInvoicePipeline(); loadActionCenter(); loadMilestones(); loadProfitability(); loadExtra(); loadProjectHealth(); loadFinancialPerformance(); loadMaterialMonitoring();
}

async function loadFinancialAging() {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('aging_tbody');
    const showMsg = (msg, cls) => { tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="6" class="p-3 text-center ${cls} font-sans">${msg}</td></tr>`; };
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_ENDPOINT}?action=read_financial_aging&project_id=${currentProjectId}`);
        const json = await res.json();
        if (!json.success) { showMsg(json.message || 'Gagal memuat data aging.', 'text-rose-400'); return; }
        const ar = json.ar, ap = json.ap;
        const row = (label, labelCls, d, c) => `
            <tr class="hover:bg-[#071d30]/50 transition">
                <td class="py-2.5 font-sans font-semibold ${labelCls}">${label}<span class="block text-[9px] font-normal text-slate-500">${d.count} invoice outstanding</span></td>
                <td class="py-2.5 text-right text-slate-200">${formatNum(d.age_30)}</td>
                <td class="py-2.5 text-right text-amber-400 font-medium">${formatNum(d.age_60)}</td>
                <td class="py-2.5 text-right text-orange-400 font-medium">${formatNum(d.age_90)}</td>
                <td class="py-2.5 text-right text-rose-400 font-semibold">${formatNum(d.age_over_90)}</td>
                <td class="py-2.5 text-right ${c} font-bold">${formatNum(d.total)}</td>
            </tr>`;
        const net = (k) => (ar[k] || 0) - (ap[k] || 0);
        tbody.innerHTML = row('Piutang (AR)', 'text-cyan-400', ar, 'text-emerald-400') + row('Hutang (AP)', 'text-purple-400', ap, 'text-amber-400') + `
            <tr class="border-t border-[#0a2d4a]"><td class="py-2.5 font-sans font-semibold text-slate-300">Netto (AR - AP)</td>
            <td class="py-2.5 text-right text-slate-300">${formatNum(net('age_30'))}</td>
            <td class="py-2.5 text-right text-slate-300">${formatNum(net('age_60'))}</td>
            <td class="py-2.5 text-right text-slate-300">${formatNum(net('age_90'))}</td>
            <td class="py-2.5 text-right text-slate-300">${formatNum(net('age_over_90'))}</td>
            <td class="py-2.5 text-right text-slate-100 font-bold">${formatNum(net('total'))}</td></tr>
            <tr><td colspan="6" class="pt-2 text-right text-[9px] text-slate-500 font-sans">Umur dihitung dari tanggal invoice, per ${json.as_of}</td></tr>`;
    } catch (err) { console.error('Error load financial aging:', err); showMsg('Gagal memuat data aging.', 'text-rose-400'); }
}

async function loadInvoicePipeline() {
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_ENDPOINT}?action=read_invoice_pipeline&project_id=${currentProjectId}`);
        const json = await res.json();
        if (json.success) {
            const d = json.data;
            document.getElementById('pip_overdue_val').innerText = fmtRp(d.values['Jatuh Tempo (Overdue)']);
            document.getElementById('pip_overdue_cnt').innerText = d.counts['Jatuh Tempo (Overdue)'] + ' invoice';
            document.getElementById('pip_unpaid_val').innerText = fmtRp(d.values['Belum Bayar']);
            document.getElementById('pip_unpaid_cnt').innerText = d.counts['Belum Bayar'] + ' invoice';
            document.getElementById('pip_partial_val').innerText = fmtRp(d.values['Sebagian']);
            document.getElementById('pip_partial_cnt').innerText = d.counts['Sebagian'] + ' invoice';
            document.getElementById('pip_paid_cnt').innerText = d.counts['Lunas'] + ' invoice';
        }
    } catch (err) { console.error('Error load invoice pipeline:', err); }
}

// [REVISI] mega menu: sejajarkan dropdown dengan item menunya, tetapi jangan keluar dari lebar layar
function initMegaMenu() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(li => {
        const dd = li.querySelector('.dropdown-menu');
        if (!dd) return;
        li.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            const vw = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
            dd.style.left = '0px';
            const w = dd.offsetWidth, l = li.getBoundingClientRect().left;
            dd.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(l, vw - w - 8)) + 'px';
        });
    });
}

const esc = (v) => String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));

// [REVISI] Action Center dinamis: indikator disusun dari server (sesuai alur PO -> GRN -> Invoice -> Retur -> Termin -> Subkon -> Opname)
const LEVEL_STYLE = {
    danger: 'border-rose-500 text-rose-200',
    warn:   'border-amber-500 text-amber-200',
    info:   'border-cyan-500 text-cyan-200'
};
async function loadActionCenter() {
    const ul = document.getElementById('action_list');
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_ENDPOINT}?action=read_action_center&project_id=${currentProjectId}`);
        const json = await res.json();
        if (!json.success) { ul.innerHTML = `<li class="text-center text-rose-400 text-xs py-3">${esc(json.message || 'Gagal memuat Action Center')}</li>`; return; }
        const order = { danger: 0, warn: 1, info: 2 };
        const active = json.items.filter(i => i.count > 0).sort((a, b) => (order[a.level] - order[b.level]) || (b.count - a.count));
        const calm = json.items.length - active.length;
        let html = active.map(i => `
            <li class="flex justify-between items-center bg-[#071d30] p-2 rounded border-l-4 ${LEVEL_STYLE[i.level] || LEVEL_STYLE.info}" title="${esc(i.hint)}">
                <span>${esc(i.label)}<span class="block text-[10px] opacity-60">${esc(i.hint)}</span></span>
                <span class="font-bold font-mono text-lg">${i.count}</span>
            </li>`).join('');
        if (!active.length) html = '<li class="text-center text-emerald-400 text-sm py-4">✔ Tidak ada yang perlu ditindaklanjuti.</li>';
        else if (calm > 0) html += `<li class="text-center text-slate-500 text-[11px] pt-1">✔ ${calm} indikator lain aman</li>`;
        ul.innerHTML = html;
    } catch (err) { console.error('Error load action center:', err); ul.innerHTML = '<li class="text-center text-rose-400 text-xs py-3">Error memuat Action Center</li>'; }
}

async function loadMilestones() {
    const list = document.getElementById('milestone_list');
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_ENDPOINT}?action=read_upcoming_milestones&project_id=${currentProjectId}`);
        const json = await res.json();
        if (!json.success) { list.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center text-rose-400 text-xs py-4">${esc(json.message || 'Error memuat milestone')}</div>`; return; }
        if (json.data.length > 0) {
            list.innerHTML = json.data.map(t => {
                const late = t.late === true;
                const info = late ? `Terlambat ${Math.abs(t.days_left)} hari` : (t.days_left === 0 ? 'Hari ini' : `${t.days_left} hari lagi`);
                return `
                <div class="flex justify-between items-center bg-[#071d30] p-2 rounded border-l-2 ${late ? 'border-rose-500' : 'border-cyan-500'}">
                    <div><div class="font-bold text-white text-xs">${esc(t.task_name)}</div><div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400">${esc(t.project_name)}</div></div>
                    <div class="text-right"><div class="${late ? 'text-rose-400' : 'text-amber-400'} font-mono text-xs font-bold">${esc(t.deadline)}</div><div class="text-[9px] ${late ? 'text-rose-300' : 'text-slate-500'}">${esc(t.status)} - ${info}</div></div>
                </div>`;
            }).join('');
        } else { list.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center text-slate-500 text-xs py-4">Tidak ada milestone terdekat.</div>'; }
    } catch (err) { list.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center text-rose-400 text-xs py-4">Error memuat milestone</div>'; }
}

// [REVISI] profitabilitas dari biaya riil: material out proyek + pengeluaran + prestasi subkon; margin = (tertagih - biaya) / tertagih
async function loadProfitability() {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('profit_tbody');
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_ENDPOINT}?action=read_project_profitability&project_id=${currentProjectId}`);
        const json = await res.json();
        if (!json.success) { tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" class="py-4 text-center text-rose-400 text-xs">${esc(json.message || 'Error memuat data')}</td></tr>`; return; }
        if (json.data.length > 0) {
            tbody.innerHTML = json.data.map(p => {
                const hasMargin = p.margin_pct !== null && p.margin_pct !== undefined;
                const margin = hasMargin ? parseFloat(p.margin_pct) : 0;
                const mColor = !hasMargin ? 'text-slate-500' : (margin < 10 ? 'text-rose-400' : (margin < 20 ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-emerald-400'));
                const cPct = parseFloat(p.cost_pct) || 0;
                const cColor = cPct > 100 ? 'text-rose-400' : (cPct > 85 ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-slate-300');
                const detail = `Material ${fmtRp(p.cost_material)} | Pengeluaran ${fmtRp(p.cost_expense)} | Subkon ${fmtRp(p.cost_subcon)}`;
                return `<tr class="hover:bg-[#071d30]/50"><td class="py-2 font-sans text-white text-xs">${esc(p.name)}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 text-right text-cyan-300">${p.progress}%</td>
                    <td class="py-2 text-right text-slate-300">${fmtRp(p.contract_dpp)}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 text-right text-slate-300">${fmtRp(p.billed_dpp)}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 text-right text-slate-300" title="${esc(detail)}">${fmtRp(p.cost_total)}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 text-right ${cColor}">${cPct.toFixed(1)}%</td>
                    <td class="py-2 text-right font-bold ${mColor}">${hasMargin ? margin.toFixed(1) + '%' : '-'}</td></tr>`;
            }).join('');
        } else { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7" class="py-4 text-center text-slate-500 text-xs">Tidak ada data profitabilitas.</td></tr>'; }
    } catch (err) { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7" class="py-4 text-center text-rose-400 text-xs">Error memuat data</td></tr>'; }
}

// [BARU] Kesehatan proyek: progres vs pemakaian biaya, status NORMAL / WASPADA / KRITIS.
// Klik kartu -> uraian AI di bawahnya berganti sesuai proyek (endpoint read_project_ai: temuan sistem + narasi Gemini, dengan cache).
const HEALTH_STYLE = {
    KRITIS:  { badge: 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border-rose-800',      icon: '🔴', label: 'KRITIS',  num: 'text-rose-400',    bar: 'bg-rose-500' },
    WASPADA: { badge: 'bg-amber-950 text-amber-300 border-amber-800',   icon: '🟡', label: 'WASPADA', num: 'text-yellow-300',  bar: 'bg-yellow-400' },
    NORMAL:  { badge: 'bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-800', icon: '🟢', label: 'NORMAL', num: 'text-emerald-400', bar: 'bg-emerald-500' },
    NA:      { badge: 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-600',   icon: '⚪', label: 'BUDGET KOSONG', num: 'text-slate-400', bar: 'bg-slate-500' }
};
const HEALTH_ICONS = ['🏗️', '🏢', '🏘️', '🏭', '🏠'];
const RISK_STYLE = {
    HIGH:   { badge: 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border-rose-800',       text: 'text-rose-300' },
    MEDIUM: { badge: 'bg-amber-950 text-amber-300 border-amber-800',    text: 'text-amber-300' },
    LOW:    { badge: 'bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-800', text: 'text-emerald-300' }
};
const SEV_STYLE = { high: 'border-rose-600 text-rose-200', medium: 'border-amber-600 text-amber-200', low: 'border-cyan-700 text-cyan-200' };
let healthSelectedId = 0, aiRequestToken = 0;

// [BARU] Setelah analisis AI (baru / ulang) selesai: status kartu langsung ikut naik bila risiko AI lebih tinggi (server menyimpan hasilnya ke ai_variance_logs,
// sehingga muat ulang dashboard menampilkan status yang sama).
const LEVEL_RANK = { NA: 0, NORMAL: 0, WASPADA: 1, KRITIS: 2 };
function applyAiRiskToCard(id, aiRisk) {
    const card = document.querySelector(`#health_cards [data-pid="${id}"]`);
    if (!card) return;
    const target = (aiRisk === 'HIGH' || aiRisk === 'CRITICAL') ? 'KRITIS' : (aiRisk === 'MEDIUM' ? 'WASPADA' : null);
    const cur = card.getAttribute('data-level') || 'NORMAL';
    if (!target || LEVEL_RANK[target] <= (LEVEL_RANK[cur] || 0)) return;
    const st = HEALTH_STYLE[target], badge = card.querySelector('.health-badge');
    badge.className = `health-badge px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold border rounded-md whitespace-nowrap ${st.badge}`;
    badge.innerHTML = `${st.icon} ${st.label} • AI`;
    card.querySelectorAll('.health-num').forEach(el => { el.className = `health-num ${st.num}`; });
    card.setAttribute('data-level', target);
}

function selectHealthProject(id, refresh) {
    healthSelectedId = id;
    document.querySelectorAll('#health_cards [data-pid]').forEach(el => {
        const on = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-pid'), 10) === id;
        el.classList.toggle('ring-2', on); el.classList.toggle('ring-cyan-400', on);
    });
    loadProjectAI(id, !!refresh);
}

async function loadProjectAI(id, refresh) {
    const box = document.getElementById('health_reco');
    const token = ++aiRequestToken;                 // abaikan respons usang bila user klik kartu lain
    const card = document.querySelector(`#health_cards [data-pid="${id}"]`);
    const pname = card ? card.getAttribute('data-name') : '';
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="bg-purple-950/30 border border-purple-700/40 rounded-lg p-4 text-sm text-purple-200 animate-pulse">🧠 AI sedang menganalisa <b>${esc(pname)}</b> (biaya, material, subkon, jadwal, penagihan)...</div>`;
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_ENDPOINT}?action=read_project_ai&project_id=${id}&refresh=${refresh ? 1 : 0}`);
        const json = await res.json();
        if (token !== aiRequestToken) return;
        if (!json.success) { box.innerHTML = `<div class="bg-rose-950/30 border border-rose-800 rounded-lg p-3 text-sm text-rose-300">${esc(json.message || 'Gagal memuat rekomendasi AI')}</div>`; return; }
        const d = json.data, rs = RISK_STYLE[d.risk] || RISK_STYLE.LOW;
        const li = (arr, cls) => arr.map(t => `<li class="${cls || ''}">${esc(t)}</li>`).join('');
        const findings = (d.findings || []).map(f => `
            <div class="border-l-4 ${SEV_STYLE[f.sev] || SEV_STYLE.low} bg-[#071d30] rounded px-2 py-1 mb-1">
                <div class="text-xs font-bold">${esc(f.title)}</div><div class="text-[11px] opacity-80">${esc(f.evidence)}</div></div>`).join('');
        box.innerHTML = `
        <div class="bg-purple-950/30 border border-purple-700/40 rounded-lg p-4 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar">
            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                <span class="text-purple-300 font-bold text-base">🧠 AI Recommendation</span>
                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold border rounded-md ${rs.badge}">RISK: ${esc(d.risk)}</span>
                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] border rounded-md border-slate-600 text-slate-300">${d.ai_used ? 'Gemini' : 'Analisis sistem'}${d.cached ? ' • cache' : ''}</span>
                <span class="text-[11px] text-slate-500 ml-auto">${esc(d.generated_at || '')}${d.log_id ? ' • log #' + d.log_id : ''}</span>
                <button type="button" class="aiRefresh px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold rounded bg-[#066b78] text-white cursor-pointer border-0">Analisis Ulang</button>
            </div>
            <div class="${rs.text} italic text-base mb-2"><b>${esc(d.project_name)}:</b> ${esc(d.headline)}</div>
            <div class="text-sm text-slate-200 mb-2 leading-relaxed">${esc(d.summary)}</div>
            ${d.actions.length ? `<div class="text-xs font-bold text-cyan-300 mt-2 mb-1">Tindakan yang disarankan</div><ul class="list-disc pl-5 text-sm text-slate-200 space-y-1">${li(d.actions)}</ul>` : ''}
            ${d.questions && d.questions.length ? `<div class="text-xs font-bold text-amber-300 mt-3 mb-1">Perlu dikonfirmasi</div><ul class="list-disc pl-5 text-sm text-amber-100 space-y-1">${li(d.questions)}</ul>` : ''}
            ${findings ? `<div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mt-3 mb-1">Temuan sistem (${d.findings.length})</div>${findings}` : ''}
            ${d.ai_note ? `<div class="text-[11px] text-amber-400 mt-2">${esc(d.ai_note)}</div>` : ''}
        </div>`;
        box.querySelector('.aiRefresh').onclick = () => loadProjectAI(id, true);
        applyAiRiskToCard(id, d.risk);
    } catch (err) { if (token === aiRequestToken) box.innerHTML = '<div class="bg-rose-950/30 border border-rose-800 rounded-lg p-3 text-sm text-rose-300">Error memuat rekomendasi AI</div>'; }
}

async function loadProjectHealth() {
    const box = document.getElementById('health_cards'), reco = document.getElementById('health_reco');
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_ENDPOINT}?action=read_project_health&project_id=${currentProjectId}`);
        const json = await res.json();
        if (!json.success) { box.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center text-rose-400 text-xs py-4 col-span-full">${esc(json.message || 'Gagal memuat kesehatan proyek')}</div>`; reco.innerHTML = ''; return; }
        if (!json.data.length) { box.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center text-slate-500 text-xs py-4 col-span-full">Tidak ada proyek berstatus Berjalan.</div>'; reco.innerHTML = ''; return; }
        const t = json.thresholds || { warn: 10, crit: 25 };
        document.getElementById('health_legend').innerText = `Klik kartu untuk analisis AI | Status = gap biaya (WASPADA >= ${t.warn}, KRITIS >= ${t.crit}), indeks biaya CPI (<${t.cpi_yellow} / <${t.cpi_red}), jadwal, dan hasil AI terakhir`;
        box.innerHTML = json.data.map((p, i) => {
            const st = HEALTH_STYLE[p.level] || HEALTH_STYLE.NA;
            const hasUsage = p.usage_pct !== null && p.usage_pct !== undefined;
            const gap = (p.gap === null || p.gap === undefined) ? null : Math.round(p.gap);
            const gapTxt = gap === null ? '-' : (gap > 0 ? '+' + gap : String(gap));
            const detail = `Budget ${fmtRp(p.budget)} | Biaya ${fmtRp(p.cost_total)} (Material ${fmtRp(p.cost_material)}, Pengeluaran ${fmtRp(p.cost_expense)}, Subkon ${fmtRp(p.cost_subcon)})` +
                (p.cpi !== null && p.cpi !== undefined ? ` | CPI ${p.cpi}` : '') + (p.elapsed_pct !== null ? ` | Waktu terpakai ${p.elapsed_pct}%` : '') +
                (p.late_days ? ` | Lewat jadwal ${p.late_days} hari` : '') + (p.ai_risk ? ` | AI terakhir: ${p.ai_risk} (${p.ai_at})` : '') +
                (p.reasons && p.reasons.length ? ` | Alasan status: ${p.reasons.join('; ')}` : '');
            const w1 = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, p.progress)), w2 = hasUsage ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, p.usage_pct)) : 0;
            return `
            <div class="bg-[#071d30] border border-[#0a2d4a] rounded-xl p-3 cursor-pointer hover:border-cyan-500 transition" data-pid="${p.id}" data-name="${esc(p.name)}" data-level="${p.level}" title="${esc(detail)}">
                <div class="flex justify-between items-start gap-2">
                    <div class="font-bold text-white text-base leading-tight">${HEALTH_ICONS[i % HEALTH_ICONS.length]} ${esc(p.name)}</div>
                    <span class="health-badge px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold border rounded-md whitespace-nowrap ${st.badge}">${st.icon} ${st.label}${p.ai_risk && p.level !== 'NORMAL' ? ' • AI' : ''}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 text-sm mt-2 text-slate-400">
                    <span>Progres: <b class="text-white">${p.progress}%</b></span>
                    <span>Pemakaian: <b class="health-num ${st.num}">${hasUsage ? Number(p.usage_pct).toFixed(0) + '%' : '-'}</b></span>
                    <span>Gap: <b class="health-num ${st.num}">${gapTxt}</b></span>
                </div>
                <div class="mt-2 space-y-1">
                    <div class="h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded"><div class="h-1.5 rounded bg-cyan-500" style="width:${w1}%"></div></div>
                    <div class="h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded"><div class="h-1.5 rounded ${st.bar}" style="width:${w2}%"></div></div>
                </div>
            </div>`;
        }).join('');
        box.querySelectorAll('[data-pid]').forEach(el => { el.onclick = () => selectHealthProject(parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-pid'), 10), false); });
        // pilih otomatis: proyek yang sedang dipilih / sesuai filter / yang paling kritis (kartu pertama)
        const ids = json.data.map(p => p.id);
        const pick = ids.includes(healthSelectedId) ? healthSelectedId : (ids.includes(parseInt(currentProjectId, 10)) ? parseInt(currentProjectId, 10) : ids[0]);
        selectHealthProject(pick, false);
    } catch (err) { console.error('Error load project health:', err); box.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center text-rose-400 text-xs py-4 col-span-full">Error memuat kesehatan proyek</div>'; }
}

// [REVISI] kartu tambahan: saldo kas & bank, PPN bulan berjalan, subkon
async function loadExtra() {
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_ENDPOINT}?action=read_extra&project_id=${currentProjectId}`);
        const json = await res.json();
        if (!json.success) return;
        const d = json.data;
        document.getElementById('extra_cash').innerText = d.cash === null ? '-' : fmtRp(d.cash);
        const ppnEl = document.getElementById('extra_ppn');
        if (d.ppn) {
            document.getElementById('extra_ppn_period').innerText = `(${d.ppn.periode})`;
            ppnEl.innerText = fmtRp(Math.abs(d.ppn.net));
            ppnEl.className = 'text-xl font-bold font-mono mt-2 ' + (d.ppn.net > 0 ? 'text-rose-400' : 'text-emerald-400');
            document.getElementById('extra_ppn_sub').innerText = `${d.ppn.net > 0 ? 'KURANG BAYAR' : (d.ppn.net < 0 ? 'LEBIH BAYAR' : 'NIHIL')} | Keluaran ${fmtRp(d.ppn.keluaran)} - Masukan ${fmtRp(d.ppn.masukan)}`;
        }
        const card = document.getElementById('extra_subcon_card');
        if (d.subcon) {
            card.style.display = '';
            document.getElementById('extra_subcon').innerText = fmtRp(d.subcon.sisa_hutang);
            document.getElementById('extra_subcon_sub').innerText = `${d.subcon.spk_aktif} SPK aktif | Nilai ${fmtRp(d.subcon.nilai_spk)} | Tertagih ${fmtRp(d.subcon.tertagih)} | sisa hutang prestasi`;
        } else { card.style.display = 'none'; }     // modul subkon belum dimigrasi
    } catch (err) { console.error('Error load extra:', err); }
}

async function loadTaxRates() {
    const badge = document.getElementById('kmk_badge');
    const validDateEl = document.getElementById('kmk_valid_date');
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_ENDPOINT}?action=read_tax_rates`);
        const json = await res.json();
        if (json.success) {
            badge.innerText = json.kmk_number !== '-' ? `KMK: ${json.kmk_number}` : 'Kosong';
            if (json.start_date && json.end_date) validDateEl.innerText = `(${json.start_date} s/d ${json.end_date})`;
            else if (json.valid_date) validDateEl.innerText = `(${json.valid_date})`;
            else validDateEl.innerText = '';
            globalTaxRates = json.rates || [];
            filterTaxRates();
        }
    } catch (err) { document.getElementById('tax_rate_tbody').innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="3" class="p-3 text-center text-rose-400">Gagal memuat kurs pajak</td></tr>'; }
}

function filterTaxRates() {
    const query = (document.getElementById('search_tax_currency').value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const filtered = globalTaxRates.filter(r => (r.currency_code && r.currency_code.toLowerCase().includes(query)) || (r.currency_name && r.currency_name.toLowerCase().includes(query)));
    renderTaxRates(filtered);
}

function renderTaxRates(rates) {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('tax_rate_tbody');
    if (!rates || rates.length === 0) { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="3" class="p-3 text-center text-slate-500">Mata uang tidak ditemukan.</td></tr>'; return; }
    tbody.innerHTML = rates.map(r => {
        const dirColor = r.change_direction === 'UP' ? 'text-emerald-400' : (r.change_direction === 'DOWN' ? 'text-rose-400' : 'text-slate-400');
        const prefix = r.change_direction === 'UP' ? '+' : (r.change_direction === 'DOWN' ? '-' : '');
        return `<tr class="hover:bg-[#071d30]/50"><td class="p-1.5 font-bold text-white">${r.currency_code}</td>
            <td class="p-1.5 text-right">${formatIDR(r.rate)}</td>
            <td class="p-1.5 text-center ${dirColor}">${prefix}${formatNum(r.change_amount)}</td></tr>`;
    }).join('');
}

async function syncTaxRates() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn_sync_tax');
    btn.disabled = true; btn.innerText = 'Syncing...';
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_ENDPOINT}?action=sync_tax_rates`, { method: 'POST' });
        const json = await res.json();
        alert(json.message || (json.success ? 'Berhasil update kurs pajak.' : 'Gagal update kurs pajak.'));
        await loadTaxRates();
    } catch (err) { alert('Gagal menghubungi server sync kurs'); }
    finally { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = 'Update Kurs'; }
}

async function loadFinancialPerformance() {
    const year = document.getElementById('fin_year_select').value;
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_ENDPOINT}?action=read_financial_performance&year=${year}&project_id=${currentProjectId}`);
        const json = await res.json();
        if (!json.success) { renderFinChart(['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','Mei','Jun','Jul','Agu','Sep','Okt','Nov','Des'], [], []); setFinMessage(json.message || 'Gagal memuat performa keuangan.', true); return; }
        if (json.available_years) fillYearSelect(json.available_years, json.year);
        renderFinChart(json.labels, json.datasets.pendapatan, json.datasets.pengeluaran);
        const total = [...json.datasets.pendapatan, ...json.datasets.pengeluaran].reduce((a, b) => a + (Number(b) || 0), 0);
        setFinMessage(total === 0 ? `Belum ada transaksi pendapatan/pengeluaran pada ${json.year}` : '', false);
    } catch (err) { console.error('Error load financial performance:', err); setFinMessage('Gagal terhubung ke server.', true); }
}

function fillYearSelect(years, selected) {
    const sel = document.getElementById('fin_year_select');
    if (!years || !years.length) return;
    sel.innerHTML = years.map(y => `<option value="${y}" ${String(y) === String(selected) ? 'selected' : ''}>${y}</option>`).join('');
}

function setFinMessage(msg, isError) {
    const el = document.getElementById('fin_empty');
    if (!msg) { el.classList.add('hidden'); el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    el.className = 'absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-center px-6 text-[11px] font-sans pointer-events-none ' + (isError ? 'text-rose-400' : 'text-slate-400');
    el.textContent = msg;
}

function renderFinChart(labels, incData, expData) {
    const ctx = document.getElementById('finChartCanvas').getContext('2d');
    if (finChart) finChart.destroy();
    const compact = (v) => Number(v).toLocaleString('id-ID', { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 1 });
    finChart = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ label: 'Pendapatan', data: incData, backgroundColor: '#10b981' }, { label: 'Pengeluaran', data: expData, backgroundColor: '#f43f5e' }] },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { labels: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 9 } } }, tooltip: { callbacks: { label: (c) => ` ${c.dataset.label}: ${formatIDR(c.parsed.y)}` } } }, scales: { x: { ticks: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 8 } }, grid: { color: '#0a2d4a' } }, y: { beginAtZero: true, ticks: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 8 }, callback: compact }, grid: { color: '#0a2d4a' } } } }
    });
}

async function loadMaterialMonitoring() {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('material_tbody');
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_ENDPOINT}?action=read_material_monitoring&project_id=${currentProjectId}`);
        const json = await res.json();
        if (json.success) {
            document.getElementById('kpi_total_budget').innerText = formatIDR(json.kpi.budget_rab);
            document.getElementById('kpi_material_out').innerText = formatIDR(json.kpi.material_out);
            document.getElementById('kpi_sisa_budget').innerText = formatIDR(json.kpi.sisa_budget);
            document.getElementById('kpi_usage_pct').innerText = `${json.kpi.persentase.toFixed(2)}%`;
            const itemMap = new Map();
            (json.items || []).forEach(item => {
                const key = (item.item_name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                if (!itemMap.has(key)) itemMap.set(key, { item_name: item.item_name, item_code: item.item_code, unit: item.unit, budget_qty: 0, budget_value: 0, out_qty: 0, out_value: 0 });
                const target = itemMap.get(key);
                target.budget_qty += Number(item.budget_qty || 0); target.budget_value += Number(item.budget_value || 0);
                target.out_qty += Number(item.out_qty || 0); target.out_value += Number(item.out_value || 0);
            });
            const aggregatedItems = Array.from(itemMap.values()).map(item => {
                item.remaining_qty = item.budget_qty - item.out_qty;
                item.usage_pct = item.budget_value > 0 ? ((item.out_value / item.budget_value) * 100).toFixed(2) : (item.budget_qty > 0 ? ((item.out_qty / item.budget_qty) * 100).toFixed(2) : '0.00');
                const pct = Number(item.usage_pct);
                item.status = pct > 100 ? 'OVERBUDGET' : (pct >= 80 ? 'WARNING' : 'ON_TRACK');
                return item;
            });
            const statusCounts = { ON_TRACK: 0, WARNING: 0, OVERBUDGET: 0 };
            aggregatedItems.forEach(i => { if (statusCounts[i.status] !== undefined) statusCounts[i.status]++; });
            renderDoughnutChart(statusCounts);
            renderBarMaterialChart(aggregatedItems.slice(0, 5));
            document.getElementById('table_count_label').innerText = `Total Material: ${aggregatedItems.length} Item`;
            if (aggregatedItems.length === 0) { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" class="p-4 text-center text-slate-500">Tidak ada data penggunaan material untuk proyek ini.</td></tr>'; return; }
            tbody.innerHTML = aggregatedItems.map(item => {
                let statusBg = 'bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-800';
                if (item.status === 'WARNING') statusBg = 'bg-amber-950 text-amber-300 border-amber-800';
                if (item.status === 'OVERBUDGET') statusBg = 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border-rose-800';
                return `<tr class="hover:bg-[#071d30]/50 transition">
                    <td class="p-3 font-sans"><div class="font-bold text-white">${item.item_name}</div><div class="text-sm text-cyan-400/70">${item.item_code || '-'}</div></td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-center">${item.unit || '-'}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-right">${formatNum(item.budget_qty)}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-right font-bold text-white">${formatIDR(item.budget_value)}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-right text-emerald-400">${formatNum(item.out_qty)}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-right text-emerald-300">${formatIDR(item.out_value)}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-right ${item.remaining_qty < 0 ? 'text-rose-400' : ''}">${formatNum(item.remaining_qty)}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-center text-amber-400 font-bold">${item.usage_pct}%</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-center"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] border rounded-full ${statusBg}">${item.status}</span></td>
                </tr>`;
            }).join('');
        } else {      // [REVISI] sebelumnya tidak ada penanganan -> KPI tetap Rp 0 tanpa pesan
            console.error('Monitoring material gagal:', json.message);
            ['kpi_total_budget', 'kpi_material_out', 'kpi_sisa_budget'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).innerText = '-');
            document.getElementById('kpi_usage_pct').innerText = '-';
            tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="9" class="p-4 text-center text-rose-400">${esc(json.message || 'Gagal memuat data monitoring material')}</td></tr>`;
        }
    } catch (err) { console.error('Error load material monitoring:', err); tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" class="p-4 text-center text-rose-400">Gagal memuat data monitoring material</td></tr>'; }
}

function renderDoughnutChart(counts) {
    const ctx = document.getElementById('doughnutChartCanvas').getContext('2d');
    if (doughnutChart) doughnutChart.destroy();
    doughnutChart = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: { labels: ['On Track', 'Warning', 'Overbudget'], datasets: [{ data: [counts.ON_TRACK || 0, counts.WARNING || 0, counts.OVERBUDGET || 0], backgroundColor: ['#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#f43f5e'], borderWidth: 0 }] },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, cutout: '70%', plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 10 } } } } }
    });
}

function renderBarMaterialChart(topItems) {
    const ctx = document.getElementById('barMaterialCanvas').getContext('2d');
    if (barMaterialChart) barMaterialChart.destroy();
    barMaterialChart = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: { labels: topItems.map(i => i.item_name.substring(0, 15) + '...'), datasets: [{ label: 'Budget Qty', data: topItems.map(i => i.budget_qty), backgroundColor: '#0284c7' }, { label: 'Out Qty', data: topItems.map(i => i.out_qty), backgroundColor: '#10b981' }] },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { labels: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 10 } } } }, scales: { x: { ticks: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 9 } }, grid: { color: '#0a2d4a' } }, y: { ticks: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 9 } }, grid: { color: '#0a2d4a' } } } }
    });
}

<!-- JAVASCRIPT -->
<script>
const API_ENDPOINT = '../php-crud/dashboardCRD.php';
let currentProjectId = 0;
let finChart = null, doughnutChart = null, barMaterialChart = null;
let globalTaxRates = [];
let finYearsLoaded = false;

const formatNum = (num) => Number(num || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
const fmtRp = (n) => 'Rp ' + Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID', { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
const setText = (id, v) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = v; };
const fmtDate = (s) => {
    if (!s) return '-';
    const d = new Date(s);
    return isNaN(d) ? esc(s) : d.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
};

// Semua panggilan API lewat sini: error (HTTP 500 / bukan JSON / success:false) selalu dilempar
// sehingga tampil di layar, tidak lagi diam-diam menghasilkan angka 0.
async function api(action, params = {}) {
    const qs = new URLSearchParams({ action, ...params });
    const res = await fetch(`${API_ENDPOINT}?${qs}`, { credentials: 'same-origin' });
    const txt = await res.text();
    let json;
    try { json = JSON.parse(txt); }
    catch (e) { throw new Error(`Respons bukan JSON (HTTP ${res.status}). Cek error_log PHP.`); }
    if (res.status === 401) { location.href = 'login.php'; throw new Error(json.message || 'Sesi berakhir'); }
    if (!json.success) throw new Error(json.message || 'Permintaan gagal');
    return json;
}

function toggleMobileMenu() {
    document.getElementById("mobile_dropdown").classList.toggle("hidden");
}
document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
    const menu = document.getElementById("mobile_dropdown");
    const btn = document.getElementById("hamburger_btn");
    if (menu && btn && !menu.contains(event.target) && !btn.contains(event.target)) {
        menu.classList.add("hidden");
    }
});
// Mobile Hardware Detection
if (navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0 || /Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent)) {
    document.body.classList.add("is-mobile-hw");
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { initDashboard(); });

// Tab engine
const TAB_LOADERS = {
    ringkasan: () => { loadProjectHealth(); loadActionCenter(); loadMilestones(); loadProfitability(); },
    keuangan: () => { if (!globalTaxRates.length) loadTaxRates(); loadFinancialAging(); loadInvoicePipeline(); loadExtra(); loadFinancialPerformance(); },
    material: () => { loadMaterialMonitoring(); }
};
const TAB_CHARTS = { keuangan: () => [finChart], material: () => [doughnutChart, barMaterialChart] };
const tabDirty = { ringkasan: true, keuangan: true, material: true };
let activeTab = 'ringkasan';
function tabFromHash() {
    const h = (location.hash || '').replace('#', '');
    return TAB_LOADERS[h] ? h : 'ringkasan';
}
function switchTab(name, push = true) {
    if (!TAB_LOADERS[name]) name = 'ringkasan';
    activeTab = name;
    if (push) history.replaceState(null, '', '#' + name);
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
        const match = btn.dataset.tab === name;
        btn.classList.toggle('active', match);
        btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', match ? 'true' : 'false');
        btn.setAttribute('tabindex', match ? '0' : '-1');
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(panel => {
        panel.classList.toggle('active', panel.id === 'tab_' + name);
    });
    if (tabDirty[name]) {
        tabDirty[name] = false;
        TAB_LOADERS[name]();
    }
    if (TAB_CHARTS[name]) {
        setTimeout(() => { TAB_CHARTS[name]().forEach(c => { if (c) c.resize(); }); }, 50);
    }
}
document.getElementById('tab_bar').addEventListener('click', e => {
    const btn = e.target.closest('[data-tab]');
    if (btn) switchTab(btn.dataset.tab);
});
window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => {
    const h = tabFromHash();
    if (h !== activeTab) switchTab(h, false);
});

// ---------- Init ----------
async function initDashboard() {
    // Kurs pajak: backend selalu mengirim KMK terbaru, pemilih tahun tidak dipakai.
    const ky = document.getElementById('kmk_year_select');
    if (ky && ky.parentElement) ky.parentElement.classList.add('hidden');

    try {
        const json = await api('get_projects');
        const sel = document.getElementById('project_select');
        sel.innerHTML = '';
        if (json.data && json.data.length > 0) {
            json.data.forEach((p, idx) => {
                const opt = document.createElement('option');
                opt.value = p.id;
                opt.textContent = p.project_name || p.name || ('Proyek #' + p.id);
                if (idx === 0) opt.selected = true;
                sel.appendChild(opt);
            });
            currentProjectId = parseInt(json.data[0].id) || 0;
        } else {
            sel.innerHTML = '<option value="0">Tidak ada proyek tersedia</option>';
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Gagal memuat proyek:', e);
        document.getElementById('project_select').innerHTML = '<option value="0">Gagal memuat proyek</option>';
    }
    const initialTab = tabFromHash();
    Object.keys(tabDirty).forEach(k => { tabDirty[k] = true; });
    switchTab(initialTab, false);
}

function onProjectChange(val) {
    currentProjectId = parseInt(val) || 0;
    Object.keys(tabDirty).forEach(k => { tabDirty[k] = true; });
    tabDirty[activeTab] = false;
    TAB_LOADERS[activeTab]();
}

// ---------- Loader 1: Kesehatan proyek + kartu statistik ----------
const HEALTH_RANK = { KRITIS: 3, WASPADA: 2, NORMAL: 1, NA: 0 };
const BADGE_BASE = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-base font-bold ';
async function loadProjectHealth() {
    const pid = currentProjectId;
    const badge = document.getElementById('health_badge');
    const desc = document.getElementById('health_desc');
    try {
        const [h, c] = await Promise.all([
            api('read_project_health', { project_id: pid }),
            api('read_summary_counts', { project_id: pid }).catch(() => null)
        ]);
        if (pid !== currentProjectId) return;

        const rows = h.data || [];
        const budget = rows.reduce((a, r) => a + Number(r.budget || 0), 0);
        const cost = rows.reduce((a, r) => a + Number(r.cost_total || 0), 0);
        const progress = rows.length ? rows.reduce((a, r) => a + Number(r.progress || 0), 0) / rows.length : 0;

        setText('stat_total_rab', fmtRp(budget));
        setText('stat_total_exp', fmtRp(cost));
        setText('stat_remaining', fmtRp(budget - cost));
        setText('stat_physical_prog', progress.toFixed(1) + '%');
        if (c && c.data) {
            setText('summary_po_count', c.data.po_count || 0);
            setText('summary_grn_count', c.data.grn_count || 0);
            setText('summary_inv_count', c.data.inv_count || 0);
        }
        document.getElementById('health_progress_bar').style.width = Math.min(Math.max(progress, 0), 100) + '%';

        let level = 'NA';
        rows.forEach(r => { if ((HEALTH_RANK[r.level] ?? 0) > (HEALTH_RANK[level] ?? 0) || level === 'NA') level = r.level || level; });
        const reasons = [];
        rows.forEach(r => {
            const rs = Array.isArray(r.reasons) ? r.reasons : (r.reasons ? [String(r.reasons)] : []);
            rs.forEach(x => reasons.push(typeof x === 'string' ? x : JSON.stringify(x)));
        });
        let info = '';
        if (rows.length === 1) {
            const r = rows[0];
            const parts = [];
            if (r.usage_pct != null && isFinite(Number(r.usage_pct))) parts.push(`Pemakaian anggaran ${Number(r.usage_pct).toFixed(1)}% vs progres ${Number(r.progress).toFixed(0)}%`);
            if (r.cpi != null && isFinite(Number(r.cpi))) parts.push(`CPI ${Number(r.cpi).toFixed(2)}`);
            if (Number(r.late_days) > 0) parts.push(`terlambat ${r.late_days} hari`);
            if (r.ai_risk) parts.push(`AI: ${r.ai_risk}`);
            info = parts.join(' · ');
        }
        const tail = reasons.length ? ' ' + reasons.join('; ') + '.' : '';

        if (level === 'NORMAL') {
            badge.className = BADGE_BASE + 'bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-800';
            badge.textContent = 'SEHAT (NORMAL)';
            desc.textContent = (info || 'Proyek berjalan sesuai anggaran dan jadwal.') + tail;
        } else if (level === 'WASPADA') {
            badge.className = BADGE_BASE + 'bg-yellow-950 text-yellow-300 border border-yellow-800';
            badge.textContent = 'WASPADA';
            desc.textContent = (info || 'Ada indikator yang perlu dipantau.') + tail;
        } else if (level === 'KRITIS') {
            badge.className = BADGE_BASE + 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border border-rose-800';
            badge.textContent = 'KRITIS';
            desc.textContent = (info || 'Biaya/jadwal melampaui batas kritis.') + tail;
        } else {
            badge.className = BADGE_BASE + 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300';
            badge.textContent = 'N/A';
            desc.textContent = rows.length ? (info || 'Data belum cukup untuk menilai kesehatan proyek.') + tail
                                           : 'Proyek tidak ditemukan atau belum berstatus Berjalan.';
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Gagal memuat kesehatan proyek:', e);
        badge.className = BADGE_BASE + 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border border-rose-800';
        badge.textContent = 'GAGAL';
        desc.textContent = e.message;
    }
}

// ---------- Loader 2: Action Center ----------
const LEVEL_STYLE = {
    danger: { box: 'border-rose-900/50', title: 'text-rose-300', badge: 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border border-rose-800', icon: '🔴' },
    warn:   { box: 'border-[#0a2d4a]',   title: 'text-yellow-300', badge: 'bg-yellow-950 text-yellow-300 border border-yellow-800', icon: '🟡' },
    info:   { box: 'border-[#0a2d4a]',   title: 'text-cyan-300',   badge: 'bg-cyan-950 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-800', icon: '🔵' }
};
async function loadActionCenter() {
    const pid = currentProjectId;
    const list = document.getElementById('action_center_list');
    const badge = document.getElementById('action_count_badge');
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="text-base text-slate-500 text-center py-4">Memindai isu...</div>';
    try {
        const json = await api('read_action_center', { project_id: pid });
        if (pid !== currentProjectId) return;
        const order = { danger: 0, warn: 1, info: 2 };
        const items = (json.items || []).filter(i => Number(i.count) > 0)
            .sort((a, b) => (order[a.level] ?? 3) - (order[b.level] ?? 3) || b.count - a.count);
        if (!items.length) {
            list.innerHTML = '<div class="text-base text-emerald-400 text-center py-6">🎉 Tidak ada isu kritis. Semua operasional lancar!</div>';
            badge.textContent = '0 Isu';
            badge.className = 'px-2 py-0.5 bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-800 rounded text-base font-bold';
            return;
        }
        const hasDanger = items.some(i => i.level === 'danger');
        badge.textContent = items.length + ' Isu';
        badge.className = 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-base font-bold border ' +
            (hasDanger ? 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border-rose-800' : 'bg-yellow-950 text-yellow-300 border-yellow-800');
        list.innerHTML = '';
        items.forEach(item => {
            const st = LEVEL_STYLE[item.level] || LEVEL_STYLE.info;
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.className = `p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#071d30]/60 border ${st.box} flex items-start space-x-3`;
            div.innerHTML = `
<div class="text-xl">${st.icon}</div>
<div class="flex-1">
<div class="flex justify-between items-center"><strong class="${st.title} text-base">${esc(item.label)}</strong><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-bold ${st.badge}">${Number(item.count)}</span></div>
<p class="text-base text-slate-300 mt-0.5">${esc(item.hint || '')}</p>
</div>`;
            list.appendChild(div);
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Action center:', e);
        list.innerHTML = `<div class="text-base text-rose-400 text-center py-4">Gagal memuat action center: ${esc(e.message)}</div>`;
    }
}

// ---------- Loader 3: Milestone (task proyek) ----------
async function loadMilestones() {
    const pid = currentProjectId;
    const list = document.getElementById('milestone_list');
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="text-base text-slate-500 text-center py-4">Memuat milestone...</div>';
    try {
        const json = await api('read_upcoming_milestones', { project_id: pid });
        if (pid !== currentProjectId) return;
        const rows = json.data || [];
        if (!rows.length) {
            list.innerHTML = '<div class="text-base text-slate-400 text-center py-6">Tidak ada task jatuh tempo dalam 14 hari ke depan.</div>';
            return;
        }
        list.innerHTML = '';
        rows.forEach(m => {
            const late = !!m.late;
            const days = Number(m.days_left);
            const label = late ? `Terlambat ${Math.abs(days)} hr` : (days === 0 ? 'Hari ini' : `${days} hr lagi`);
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.className = 'p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#071d30]/40 border border-[#0a2d4a] flex items-center justify-between';
            div.innerHTML = `
<div class="flex items-center space-x-3">
<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-base ${late ? 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border border-rose-800' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300'}">${late ? '!' : '•'}</div>
<div>
<h4 class="text-base font-semibold text-white">${esc(m.task_name)}</h4>
<span class="text-xs text-slate-400">${pid ? '' : esc(m.project_name) + ' · '}Target: ${fmtDate(m.deadline)} · ${esc(m.status)}</span>
</div>
</div>
<span class="px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-semibold ${late ? 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border border-rose-800' : 'bg-yellow-950 text-yellow-300 border border-yellow-800'}">${label}</span>`;
            list.appendChild(div);
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Milestone:', e);
        list.innerHTML = `<div class="text-base text-rose-400 text-center py-4">Gagal memuat milestone: ${esc(e.message)}</div>`;
    }
}

// ---------- Loader 4: Profitabilitas proyek ----------
async function loadProfitability() {
    const pid = currentProjectId;
    const tbody = document.getElementById('profit_table_body');
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" class="p-4 text-center text-slate-500">Memuat analisis profitabilitas...</td></tr>';
    try {
        const json = await api('read_project_profitability', { project_id: pid });
        if (pid !== currentProjectId) return;
        const rows = json.data || [];
        if (!rows.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" class="p-4 text-center text-slate-500">Tidak ada proyek Berjalan/Selesai dengan nilai kontrak untuk filter ini.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = '';
        rows.forEach(r => {
            const margin = r.margin_pct;
            let cls, txt, mtxt;
            if (margin === null || margin === undefined) { cls = 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border border-slate-700'; txt = 'BELUM DITAGIH'; mtxt = '-'; }
            else if (Number(margin) >= 0) { cls = 'bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-800'; txt = 'SURPLUS'; mtxt = Number(margin).toFixed(1) + '%'; }
            else { cls = 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border border-rose-800'; txt = 'DEFISIT'; mtxt = Number(margin).toFixed(1) + '%'; }
            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
            tr.className = 'hover:bg-[#071d30]/40 transition';
            tr.innerHTML = `
<td class="p-3 font-semibold text-white">${esc(r.name)}<br><span class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-normal">${esc(r.status)} · progres ${Number(r.progress)}%</span></td>
<td class="p-3 text-right text-slate-300">${fmtRp(r.contract_dpp)}<br><span class="text-xs text-slate-400">Ditagih ${fmtRp(r.billed_dpp)}</span></td>
<td class="p-3 text-right text-yellow-300">${fmtRp(r.cost_total)}<br><span class="text-xs text-slate-400">${Number(r.cost_pct)}% dari kontrak</span></td>
<td class="p-3 text-right font-bold ${margin === null || Number(margin) >= 0 ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-400'}">${mtxt}</td>
<td class="p-3 text-center"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold ${cls}">${txt}</span></td>`;
            tbody.appendChild(tr);
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Profitabilitas:', e);
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="5" class="p-4 text-center text-rose-400">Gagal memuat profitabilitas: ${esc(e.message)}</td></tr>`;
    }
}

// ---------- Loader 5: Aging piutang & hutang (bucket) ----------
async function loadFinancialAging() {
    const pid = currentProjectId;
    const tbody = document.getElementById('aging_table_body');
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7" class="p-4 text-center text-slate-500">Memuat data aging piutang &amp; hutang...</td></tr>';
    try {
        const j = await api('read_financial_aging', { project_id: pid });
        if (pid !== currentProjectId) return;
        const defs = [
            { label: 'Piutang Klien (AR)', d: j.ar, badge: 'bg-cyan-950 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-800', tag: 'AR' },
            { label: 'Hutang Supplier & Subkon (AP)', d: j.ap, badge: 'bg-purple-950 text-purple-300 border border-purple-800', tag: 'AP' }
        ];
        tbody.innerHTML = '';
        defs.forEach(x => {
            const d = x.d || {};
            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
            tr.className = 'hover:bg-[#071d30]/40 transition';
            tr.innerHTML = `
<td class="p-2.5 font-semibold text-white"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold ${x.badge}">${x.tag}</span> ${x.label}</td>
<td class="p-2.5 text-right text-slate-300">${fmtRp(d.age_30)}</td>
<td class="p-2.5 text-right text-slate-300">${fmtRp(d.age_60)}</td>
<td class="p-2.5 text-right text-yellow-300">${fmtRp(d.age_90)}</td>
<td class="p-2.5 text-right text-rose-400">${fmtRp(d.age_over_90)}</td>
<td class="p-2.5 text-right font-bold text-white">${fmtRp(d.total)}</td>
<td class="p-2.5 text-center text-slate-400">${Number(d.count || 0)}</td>`;
            tbody.appendChild(tr);
        });
        // kartu ringkasan Keuangan
        setText('extra_ar_total', fmtRp((j.ar || {}).total));
        setText('extra_ap_total', fmtRp((j.ap || {}).total));
        setText('extra_ar_sub', `${Number((j.ar || {}).count || 0)} invoice klien belum lunas`);
        setText('extra_ap_sub', `${Number((j.ap || {}).count || 0)} tagihan supplier/subkon belum lunas`);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Aging:', e);
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" class="p-4 text-center text-rose-400">Gagal memuat aging: ${esc(e.message)}</td></tr>`;
    }
}

// ---------- Loader 5b: Invoice pipeline (tagihan termin klien) ----------
async function loadInvoicePipeline() {
    const pid = currentProjectId;
    const box = document.getElementById('invoice_pipeline');
    if (!box) return;
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="text-base text-slate-500">Memuat pipeline invoice...</div>';
    try {
        const j = await api('read_invoice_pipeline', { project_id: pid });
        if (pid !== currentProjectId) return;
        const c = (j.data && j.data.counts) || {}, v = (j.data && j.data.values) || {};
        const defs = [
            ['Belum Bayar', 'text-white'],
            ['Sebagian', 'text-yellow-300'],
            ['Jatuh Tempo (Overdue)', 'text-rose-400'],
            ['Lunas', 'text-emerald-400']
        ];
        box.innerHTML = defs.map(([k, color]) => `
<div class="bg-[#071d30]/50 p-4 rounded-lg border border-[#0a2d4a] flex flex-col">
<span class="text-base text-slate-400">${esc(k)}</span>
<span class="text-2xl font-bold font-rajdhani ${color} mt-1">${Number(c[k] || 0)} invoice</span>
<span class="text-[11px] text-slate-500">Sisa tagihan ${fmtRp(v[k])}</span>
</div>`).join('');
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Invoice pipeline:', e);
        box.innerHTML = `<div class="text-base text-rose-400">Gagal memuat pipeline invoice: ${esc(e.message)}</div>`;
    }
}

// ---------- Loader 6: Kurs pajak (KMK terbaru) ----------
async function loadTaxRates() {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('tax_rate_body');
    const badge = document.getElementById('kmk_badge');
    const validDate = document.getElementById('kmk_valid_date');
    const countSpan = document.getElementById('tax_rate_count');
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" class="p-3 text-center text-slate-500">Memuat kurs pajak...</td></tr>';
    try {
        const j = await api('read_tax_rates');
        const rates = j.rates || [];
        globalTaxRates = rates;
        if (!rates.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" class="p-3 text-center text-slate-500">Belum ada data kurs pajak. Sinkronkan lewat menu Master Kurs Pajak.</td></tr>';
            badge.textContent = 'TIDAK ADA DATA';
            badge.className = 'text-xs bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border border-rose-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded inline-block';
            validDate.textContent = '';
            countSpan.textContent = '0 Kurs aktif';
            return;
        }
        badge.textContent = 'KMK ' + (j.kmk_number || '-');
        badge.className = 'text-xs bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded inline-block';
        validDate.textContent = `Periode: ${j.start_date} – ${j.end_date}`;
        countSpan.textContent = rates.length + ' Kurs aktif';
        tbody.innerHTML = '';
        rates.forEach(r => {
            const mult = Number(r.unit_multiplier) > 1 ? ` <span class="text-xs text-slate-400">(per ${Number(r.unit_multiplier)})</span>` : '';
            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
            tr.className = 'hover:bg-[#071d30]/40 transition';
            tr.innerHTML = `
<td class="p-2 font-bold text-white">${esc(r.currency_code)}${mult}<br><span class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-normal">${esc(r.currency_name || '')}</span></td>
<td class="p-2 text-cyan-300">${esc(j.kmk_number || '-')}</td>
<td class="p-2 text-center text-slate-400">${esc(j.start_date)}</td>
<td class="p-2 text-center text-slate-400">${esc(j.end_date)}</td>
<td class="p-2 text-right font-bold text-emerald-400">${formatNum(r.rate)}</td>`;
            tbody.appendChild(tr);
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Kurs pajak:', e);
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="5" class="p-3 text-center text-rose-400">Gagal memuat kurs pajak: ${esc(e.message)}</td></tr>`;
    }
}

// ---------- Loader 7: Saldo kas & PPN ----------
async function loadExtra() {
    const pid = currentProjectId;
    try {
        const j = await api('read_extra', { project_id: pid });
        if (pid !== currentProjectId) return;
        const d = j.data || {};
        setText('extra_net_cash', d.cash === null || d.cash === undefined ? '-' : fmtRp(d.cash));
        if (d.ppn) {
            setText('extra_ppn_total', fmtRp(d.ppn.net));
            setText('extra_ppn_sub', `Keluaran ${fmtRp(d.ppn.keluaran)} − Masukan ${fmtRp(d.ppn.masukan)} (${d.ppn.periode})`);
        } else {
            setText('extra_ppn_total', '-');
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Extra:', e);
        setText('extra_net_cash', '-');
        setText('extra_ppn_sub', 'Gagal memuat: ' + e.message);
    }
}

// ---------- Loader 8: Performa keuangan bulanan ----------
async function loadFinancialPerformance() {
    const pid = currentProjectId;
    const sel = document.getElementById('fin_year_select');
    const emptyDiv = document.getElementById('fin_empty');
    const monthLabels = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'Mei', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Agu', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nov', 'Des'];
    try {
        const j = await api('read_financial_performance', { year: sel.value, project_id: pid });
        if (pid !== currentProjectId) return;
        if (!finYearsLoaded && Array.isArray(j.available_years) && j.available_years.length) {
            sel.innerHTML = j.available_years.map(y => `<option value="${y}">${y}</option>`).join('');
            sel.value = String(j.year);
            finYearsLoaded = true;
        }
        const inc = j.datasets.pendapatan || [], exp = j.datasets.pengeluaran || [];
        if (inc.every(v => v === 0) && exp.every(v => v === 0)) {
            emptyDiv.textContent = `Tidak ada transaksi tercatat pada tahun ${j.year}.`;
            emptyDiv.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            emptyDiv.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        renderFinChart(j.labels || monthLabels, inc, exp);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Performa keuangan:', e);
        renderFinChart(monthLabels, [], []);
        emptyDiv.textContent = 'Gagal memuat performa keuangan: ' + e.message;
        emptyDiv.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
}

const compactNum = (v) => new Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID', { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(v);
function renderFinChart(labels, incData, expData) {
    const ctx = document.getElementById('finChartCanvas').getContext('2d');
    if (finChart) finChart.destroy();
    finChart = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
            labels: labels,
            datasets: [
                { label: 'Pendapatan', data: incData, backgroundColor: '#06b6d4', borderRadius: 4 },
                { label: 'Pengeluaran', data: expData, backgroundColor: '#f59e0b', borderRadius: 4 }
            ]
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {
                legend: { position: 'top', labels: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 10 } } },
                tooltip: { callbacks: { label: (c) => `${c.dataset.label}: ${fmtRp(c.parsed.y)}` } }
            },
            scales: {
                x: { ticks: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 9 } }, grid: { color: '#0a2d4a' } },
                y: { ticks: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 9 }, callback: (v) => compactNum(v) }, grid: { color: '#0a2d4a' } }
            }
        }
    });
}

// ---------- Loader 9: Monitoring material (RAB vs material keluar) ----------
const MAT_STATUS = {
    ON_TRACK:   { txt: 'ON TRACK',   badge: 'bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-800', num: 'text-emerald-400' },
    WARNING:    { txt: 'WASPADA',    badge: 'bg-yellow-950 text-yellow-300 border border-yellow-800',   num: 'text-yellow-300' },
    OVERBUDGET: { txt: 'OVERBUDGET', badge: 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border border-rose-800',         num: 'text-rose-400' }
};
async function loadMaterialMonitoring() {
    const pid = currentProjectId;
    const tbody = document.getElementById('material_table_body');
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" class="p-4 text-center text-slate-500">Memuat data material proyek...</td></tr>';
    try {
        const j = await api('read_material_monitoring', { project_id: pid });
        if (pid !== currentProjectId) return;
        const items = j.items || [];
        const k = j.kpi || {};
        setText('material_kpi', `RAB ${fmtRp(k.budget_rab)} · Keluar ${fmtRp(k.material_out)} (${Number(k.persentase || 0).toFixed(1)}%)`);
        renderDoughnutChart(j.status_counts || {});
        renderBarMaterialChart(items.slice(0, 5));
        if (!items.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" class="p-4 text-center text-slate-500">Tidak ada item material (RAB / material keluar) untuk proyek ini.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = '';
        items.forEach(it => {
            const st = MAT_STATUS[it.status] || MAT_STATUS.ON_TRACK;
            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
            tr.className = 'hover:bg-[#071d30]/40 transition';
            tr.innerHTML = `
<td class="p-3 font-semibold text-white">${esc(it.item_code || '-')}<br><span class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-normal">${esc(it.item_name)}</span></td>
<td class="p-3 text-center text-slate-400">${esc(it.unit || '-')}</td>
<td class="p-3 text-right text-slate-300">${it.no_rab ? '<span class="text-xs text-rose-400">Tanpa RAB</span>' : formatNum(it.budget_qty)}</td>
<td class="p-3 text-right text-yellow-300">${formatNum(it.out_qty)}</td>
<td class="p-3 text-right text-emerald-400">${formatNum(it.remaining_qty)}</td>
<td class="p-3 text-right text-slate-300">${fmtRp(it.budget_value)}</td>
<td class="p-3 text-right font-bold text-white">${fmtRp(it.out_value)}</td>
<td class="p-3 text-right font-bold ${st.num}">${Number(it.usage_pct).toFixed(1)}%</td>
<td class="p-3 text-center"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold ${st.badge}">${st.txt}</span></td>`;
            tbody.appendChild(tr);
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Material:', e);
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="9" class="p-4 text-center text-rose-400">Gagal memuat monitoring material: ${esc(e.message)}</td></tr>`;
        renderDoughnutChart({});
        renderBarMaterialChart([]);
    }
}

function renderDoughnutChart(counts) {
    const ctx = document.getElementById('doughnutChartCanvas').getContext('2d');
    if (doughnutChart) doughnutChart.destroy();
    doughnutChart = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: {
            labels: ['On Track', 'Waspada', 'Overbudget'],
            datasets: [{
                data: [counts.ON_TRACK || 0, counts.WARNING || 0, counts.OVERBUDGET || 0],
                backgroundColor: ['#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#f43f5e'],
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: '#04101c'
            }]
        },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, cutout: '70%', plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 10 } } } } }
    });
}

function renderBarMaterialChart(topItems) {
    const ctx = document.getElementById('barMaterialCanvas').getContext('2d');
    if (barMaterialChart) barMaterialChart.destroy();
    barMaterialChart = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
            labels: topItems.map(i => i.item_name),
            datasets: [{
                label: 'Pemakaian vs RAB (%)',
                data: topItems.map(i => Number(i.usage_pct)),
                backgroundColor: topItems.map(i => i.status === 'OVERBUDGET' ? '#f43f5e' : (i.status === 'WARNING' ? '#f59e0b' : '#22d3ee')),
                borderRadius: 4
            }]
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
            scales: {
                x: { ticks: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 9 } }, grid: { color: '#0a2d4a' } },
                y: { ticks: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 9 }, callback: (v) => v + '%' }, grid: { color: '#0a2d4a' } }
            }
        }
    });
}

==================== FILE: ./views/menudata.php ====================
<?php
if (!isset($_SESSION)) { session_start(); }
if (empty($_SESSION['user_id']) || !is_numeric($_SESSION['user_id']) || (int)$_SESSION['user_id'] <= 0) {
    http_response_code(401);
    exit('Sesi berakhir. Silakan login kembali.');
}
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';
if (function_exists('app_require_active_user')) { app_require_active_user(); }

// Instantiate the PDO crud class
$db = new crud();

$menu='';
$user_id=$_SESSION["user_id"];
$href_logout='../php/logout.php';


function toRoman($num) {
    $map = [
        'M' => 1000, 'CM' => 900, 'D' => 500, 'CD' => 400,
        'C' => 100, 'XC' => 90, 'L' => 50, 'XL' => 40,
        'X' => 10, 'IX' => 9, 'V' => 5, 'IV' => 4, 'I' => 1
    ];
    $romans = ['', 'I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII', 'VIII', 'IX', 'X', 'XI', 'XII', 'XIII', 'XIV', 'XV'];
    $num = intval($num);
    return isset($romans[$num]) ? $romans[$num] : $num;

    $res = '';
    foreach ($map as $roman => $value) {
        while ($num >= $value) {
            $res .= $roman;
            $num -= $value;
        }
    }
    return $res;
}

// 1. Fetch main menu groups using PDO
$hsql = "
  select name,seq
  from m_form_group
  where active = true and substring(seq,3,2)='00'
    and substring(seq,1,2) in (
      select distinct substring(g.seq,1,2) seqn
      from m_form_group g
      left join m_form_name f on g.id=f.group_id
      left join m_user_access_menu u on u.form_id=f.id
      where g.active =true and u.user_id = :user_id
      group by substring(g.seq,1,2)
      order by substring(g.seq,1,2)
  )
  order by seq::int
";
$stmt = $db->prepare($hsql);
$stmt->execute(['user_id' => $user_id]);
$hrows_data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
$hrows = count($hrows_data);
$menuWidth = ($hrows + 1);
$i=0;
if ($hrows > 0) {
  foreach ($hrows_data as $hobjid) {
    $i++;
    $romanNum = toRoman($i);
    $displayName = $romanNum . '. ' . $hobjid['name'];
    $menu.='<li><a href="#">'.$displayName.'</a>';
    $menu.='    <div>';

    // 2. Fetch child menu groups
    $csql = "
        select id,name,seq
        from m_form_group
        where active = true and substring(seq,3,2)!='00' and substring(seq,1,2) = :sub_seq
          and id in (
            select distinct g.id
            from m_form_group g
            left join m_form_name f on g.id=f.group_id
            left join m_user_access_menu u on u.form_id=f.id
            where g.active = true and f.active = true and u.user_id = :user_id
        )
        order by seq::int
    ";
    $cStmt = $db->prepare($csql);
    $cStmt->execute([
        'sub_seq' => substr($hobjid["seq"], 0, 2),
        'user_id' => $user_id
    ]);
    $crows_data = $cStmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    if (count($crows_data) > 0) {
      foreach ($crows_data as $cobjid) {
        $menu.='        <div class="nav-column">';
        if (strtolower($cobjid["name"])=='absence') {
            $menu.='<h3 class="orange">'.$cobjid["name"].'</h3>';
        } else {
            $menu.='<h3>'.$cobjid["name"].'</h3>';
        }

        // Get max row count for alignment padding
        $cRowsql = "
            select count(f.*) as rowcount
            from m_form_name f
            left join m_user_access_menu u on u.form_id=f.id
            where f.active= true and u.user_id = :user_id and f.group_id = :group_id
            group by group_id
            order by count(f.*) DESC
            limit 1
        ";
        $cRowStmt = $db->prepare($cRowsql);
        $cRowStmt->execute(['user_id' => $user_id, 'group_id' => $cobjid["id"]]);
        $rowCount = 0;
        if ($rowObj = $cRowStmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
            $rowCount = $rowObj["rowcount"];
        }

        // 3. Fetch submenu items
        $fsql = "
            select f.id,f.group_id,f.seq,f.title,f.php_url
            from m_form_name f
            left join m_user_access_menu u on u.form_id=f.id
            where f.active= true and group_id = :group_id and u.id is not null and u.user_id = :user_id
            order by group_id,seq::int
        ";
        $fStmt = $db->prepare($fsql);
        $fStmt->execute(['group_id' => $cobjid["id"], 'user_id' => $user_id]);
        $frows_data = $fStmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $frows = count($frows_data);

        if ($frows > 0) {
          $menu.='<ul class="submenu">';
          foreach ($frows_data as $fobjid) {
            $dynamicUrl = "router?id=" . $fobjid["id"];
            $menu .= '<li><a href="' . $dynamicUrl . '" target="_blank">' . $fobjid["title"] . '</a></li>';
            //$targetUrl = !empty($fobjid["php_url"]) ? $fobjid["php_url"] : "#";
          //$menu .= '<li><a href="' . $targetUrl . '" target="_blank">' . $fobjid["title"] . '</a></li>';
          }
          if ($frows < $rowCount) {
              for ($x = $frows; $x < $rowCount; $x++) {
                  $menu.='<li><a class="noHover" target="_blank">&nbsp</a></li>';
              }
          }
          $menu.='</ul>';
        }
        $menu.='</div>';
      }
    }
    $menu.='</div>';
    $menu.='</li>';
  }
}
$menu.='<li><a id="LogoutButton" href="../php/logout.php"><i class="material-icons md-30 white vertical-align-middle padding-bottom-12">exit_to_app</i><div class="logoutText">Logout</div></a></li>';
echo $menu;
?>

/*
Document      : supplier.payment.print.php
Description   : Cetak tanda terima / bukti pembayaran supplier (single)
Dipanggil dari: supplier.payment.js via PRINT_URL + id
Backend data  : Query langsung ke DB (tidak via task CRUD)
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

$paymentId = intval($_GET['id'] ?? 0);
if ($paymentId <= 0) {
    echo '<!DOCTYPE html><html><body><h3 style="color:#e05353;padding:20px;">ID pembayaran tidak valid.</h3></body></html>';
    exit;
}

$db = new crud();

// Load header pembayaran
$stmt = $db->prepare("
    SELECT p.id, p.payment_no, p.payment_date, p.supplier_id,
           p.account_id, p.payment_method, p.total_amount,
           p.allocated_amount, p.excess_amount, p.deposit_applied,
           p.reference_no, p.notes, p.created_by, p.created_at,
           s.name AS supplier_name, s.npwp_no AS supplier_npwp,
           (coa.account_code || ' - ' || coa.account_name) AS account_name,
           coa.account_code,
           u.login_name AS created_by_name
    FROM supplier_payments p
    LEFT JOIN m_suppliers s ON s.id = p.supplier_id
    LEFT JOIN chart_of_accounts coa ON coa.id = p.account_id
    LEFT JOIN m_user_system u ON u.id = p.created_by
    WHERE p.id = :id
");
$stmt->execute(['id' => $paymentId]);
$header = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

if (!$header) {
    echo '<!DOCTYPE html><html><body><h3 style="color:#e05353;padding:20px;">Data pembayaran tidak ditemukan.</h3></body></html>';
    exit;
}

// Load items (alokasi invoice)
$stmt2 = $db->prepare("
    SELECT 
        pi.inv_no AS invoice_no,
        pi.supplier_invoice_no,
        TO_CHAR(pi.invoice_date, 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS invoice_date,
        COALESCE(pi.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount,
        COALESCE(pi.total_amount - pi.paid_amount, 0) AS unpaid_amount,
        COALESCE(spi.amount_paid, 0) AS amount_paid
    FROM supplier_payment_items spi
    INNER JOIN purchase_invoice_hdr pi ON spi.invoice_id = pi.id
    WHERE spi.supplier_payment_id = :payment_id
    ORDER BY pi.invoice_date ASC, pi.id ASC
");
$stmt2->execute(['payment_id' => $paymentId]);
$items = $stmt2->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

function esc($v) {
    return htmlspecialchars($v === null ? '' : (string)$v, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
}
function num($v) { $n = floatval($v); return is_finite($n) ? $n : 0; }
function money($v) { return number_format(num($v), 2, ',', '.'); }
function dateId($v) {
    if (!$v) return '-';
    $s = substr($v, 0, 10);
    $p = explode('-', $s);
    return count($p) === 3 ? $p[2] . '/' . $p[1] . '/' . $p[0] : esc($v);
}
function methodLabel($v) {
    $map = ['BANK_TRANSFER' => 'Transfer Bank', 'CASH' => 'Tunai', 'GIRO' => 'Giro', 'CEK' => 'Cek', 'CHEQUE' => 'Cek'];
    return $map[strtoupper($v)] ?? $v ?? '-';
}

==================== FILE: ./views/m.proyek.print.js ====================
(function () {
'use strict';
var path = window.location.pathname || '';
var marker = path.indexOf('/views/');
var appBase = marker >= 0 ? path.substring(0, marker) : '';
if (!appBase) {
    var scriptSrc = (document.currentScript && document.currentScript.src) || '';
    var scriptPath = scriptSrc.replace(window.location.origin, '');
    var scriptMarker = scriptPath.indexOf('/views/');
    appBase = scriptMarker >= 0 ? scriptPath.substring(0, scriptMarker) : '';
}
var endpoint = appBase + '/php-crud/m.proyekCRD.php';
var mode = window.PROJECT_PRINT_MODE || 'projects';
var projectId = parseInt(window.PROJECT_PRINT_ID, 10) || 0;
var content = document.getElementById('content');
function esc(v) { return String(v == null || v === '' ? '-' : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];}); }
function date(v) { if (!v) return '-'; var m=String(v).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/); return m ? m[3]+'/'+m[2]+'/'+m[1] : esc(v); }
function money(v) { var n=Number(v||0); return n.toLocaleString('id-ID',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2}); }
function request(params) {
 return fetch(endpoint,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8'},body:new URLSearchParams(params).toString(),credentials:'same-origin'})
 .then(function(r){if(!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);return r.json();})
 .then(function(r){if(!r || r.success===false) throw new Error(r && r.message ? r.message : 'Gagal membaca data.');return r;});
}
function projectRows(rows) {
 var html='<table><thead><tr><th>No.</th><th>Nama Proyek</th><th>Klien</th><th>PIC / PM</th><th>Lokasi</th><th>Tgl Mulai</th><th>Tgl Selesai</th><th>Budget</th><th>Nilai Kontrak</th><th>Progress</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
 if (!rows.length) return '<p>Tidak ada data proyek.</p>';
 rows.forEach(function(p,i){html+='<tr><td>'+(i+1)+'</td><td>'+esc(p.name)+'</td><td>'+esc(p.client_name)+'</td><td>'+esc(p.pic_name)+'</td><td>'+esc(p.location_name||p.location)+'</td><td>'+date(p.start_date)+'</td><td>'+date(p.end_date)+'</td><td>'+esc(p.budget_currency_code||'IDR')+' '+money(p.budget)+'</td><td>Rp '+money(p.contract_value)+'</td><td>'+esc(p.progress||0)+'%</td><td>'+esc(p.status)+'</td></tr>';});
 return html+'</tbody></table>';
}
function taskRows(rows) {
 var html='<table><thead><tr><th style="width:36px">No.</th><th>Nama Task</th><th>Deskripsi Pekerjaan</th><th>Tgl Mulai</th><th>Tgl Selesai</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
 if (!rows.length) return '<p>Belum ada task untuk proyek ini.</p>';
 rows.forEach(function(t,i){html+='<tr><td>'+(i+1)+'</td><td>'+esc(t.task_name)+'</td><td>'+esc(t.description)+'</td><td>'+date(t.start_date)+'</td><td>'+date(t.end_date)+'</td><td>'+esc(t.status)+'</td></tr>';});
 return html+'</tbody></table>';
}
document.getElementById('btnPrint').onclick=function(){window.print();};
document.getElementById('btnClose').onclick=function(){window.close();};
if (mode === 'tasks') {
 if (!projectId) {content.innerHTML='<p>ID proyek tidak valid.</p>';return;}
 Promise.all([request({task:'read_one',id:projectId}),request({task:'read_tasks',project_id:projectId})]).then(function(res){
  var p=res[0].data||{}, tasks=res[1].data||[];
  document.getElementById('title').textContent='Rincian Task Proyek';
  document.getElementById('subtitle').textContent=p.name||'Proyek';
  content.innerHTML='<h2>'+esc(p.name)+'</h2><div class="meta"><div><b>Klien:</b> '+esc(p.client_name)+'</div><div><b>PIC / PM:</b> '+esc(p.pic_name)+'</div><div><b>Lokasi:</b> '+esc(p.location_name||p.location)+'</div><div><b>Status:</b> '+esc(p.status)+'</div><div><b>Tanggal Mulai:</b> '+date(p.start_date)+'</div><div><b>Tanggal Selesai:</b> '+date(p.end_date)+'</div></div><h2>Daftar Task</h2>'+taskRows(tasks);
 }).catch(function(e){content.innerHTML='<p>Gagal memuat data: '+esc(e.message)+'</p>';});
} else {
 request({task:'read'}).then(function(res){var rows=res.data||[];document.getElementById('title').textContent='Daftar Seluruh Proyek';document.getElementById('subtitle').textContent='Jumlah proyek: '+rows.length;content.innerHTML=projectRows(rows);}).catch(function(e){content.innerHTML='<p>Gagal memuat data: '+esc(e.message)+'</p>';});
}
})();
