    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read':
        $statusFilter = trim($_POST['status_filter'] ?? '');
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                g.id, g.ref_no, g.grn_date, g.po_hdr_id, ph.ref_no AS po_ref_no,
                g.supplier_id, s.name AS supplier_name, g.status, g.remark,
                COALESCE((SELECT SUM(gd.qty_received * gd.unit_cost) FROM grn_dtl gd WHERE gd.grn_hdr_id = g.id), 0) AS total_amount,
                COALESCE((SELECT SUM(gd.qty_received) FROM grn_dtl gd WHERE gd.grn_hdr_id = g.id), 0) AS total_qty
            FROM grn_hdr g
            LEFT JOIN po_hdr ph ON ph.id = g.po_hdr_id
            LEFT JOIN m_suppliers s ON s.id = g.supplier_id
        ";
        $params = [];
        if ($statusFilter !== '') {
            $sql .= " WHERE g.status = :status_filter ";
            $params['status_filter'] = $statusFilter;
        }
        $sql .= " ORDER BY g.grn_date DESC, g.id DESC LIMIT 250 ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. READ SINGLE (Header + Items, untuk Form Edit)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_edit':
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

        $stmtH = $db->prepare("
            SELECT g.*, (g.grn_date)::text AS grn_date
            FROM grn_hdr g
            WHERE g.id = :id
        ");
        $stmtH->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $header = $stmtH->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$header) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'data' => new stdClass()]);
            exit;
        }

        $stmtD = $db->prepare("
            SELECT gd.id, gd.po_dtl_id, gd.item_id, gd.item_name,
                   gd.qty_received, gd.unit_cost, gd.remark,
                   pd.qty AS po_qty_ordered, pd.unit_price AS po_unit_price
            FROM grn_dtl gd
            LEFT JOIN po_dtl pd ON pd.id = gd.po_dtl_id
            WHERE gd.grn_hdr_id = :id
            ORDER BY gd.id ASC
        ");
        $stmtD->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $header['items'] = $stmtD->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $header]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. READ COMBO: PO yang masih outstanding (buat form GRN baru)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_po':
        $sql = "
            SELECT o.id, o.ref_no, o.tx_date, o.supplier_id, s.name AS supplier_name
            FROM view_po_hdr_outstanding o
            LEFT JOIN m_suppliers s ON s.id = o.supplier_id
            ORDER BY o.tx_date ASC, o.ref_no ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
        break;

    case 'read_warehouse':
        $sql = "SELECT id, name FROM m_warehouse WHERE active = true ORDER BY name ASC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. READ ITEM PO yang masih bisa diterima (termasuk jatah toleransi 10%)
    //    grn_id (opsional, dikirim saat EDIT) -- baris yang SUDAH di-input
    //    oleh GRN ini sendiri ditambahkan balik ke qty_receivable_max &
    //    diekspos lewat qty_received_this_grn, supaya baris itu tetap
    //    muncul di grid gabungan dengan nilai aslinya -- persis pola
    //    invoice_id di read_grn_outstanding milik Purchase Invoice.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_po_items':
        $poHdrId = intval($_POST['po_hdr_id'] ?? 0);
        $grnId   = intval($_POST['grn_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($poHdrId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => []]);
            exit;
        }

        $sql = "
            SELECT
                s.po_dtl_id, s.item_id, s.item_name,
                s.qty_ordered, s.unit_price,
                s.qty_received, s.qty_outstanding,
                s.qty_max_allowed,
                (s.qty_receivable_max + COALESCE(gd.qty_received, 0)) AS qty_receivable_max,
                COALESCE(gd.qty_received, 0) AS qty_received_this_grn,
                COALESCE(gd.unit_cost, s.unit_price) AS unit_cost_this_grn
            FROM view_po_dtl_receipt_status s
            LEFT JOIN grn_dtl gd ON gd.po_dtl_id = s.po_dtl_id AND gd.grn_hdr_id = :grn_id
            WHERE s.po_hdr_id = :po_hdr_id
              AND (s.qty_receivable_max > 0 OR gd.id IS NOT NULL)
            ORDER BY s.po_dtl_id ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['po_hdr_id' => $poHdrId, 'grn_id' => $grnId]);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. CREATE
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'create':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 2) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        $poHdrId     = intval($_POST['po_hdr_id'] ?? 0);
        $supplierId  = intval($_POST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
        $warehouseId = intval($_POST['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);
        $grnDate     = trim($_POST['grn_date'] ?? '');
        $remark      = trim($_POST['remark'] ?? '');
        $items       = json_decode($_POST['arrItems'] ?? '[]', true);

        if ($poHdrId <= 0 || $supplierId <= 0 || $warehouseId <= 0 || empty($grnDate) || !is_array($items) || count($items) === 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Lengkapi data GRN (termasuk Gudang Tujuan) dan minimal 1 item.']);
            exit;
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $grnNo = CreateRefNo('grn_hdr', 'ref_no', 'GRN');

            DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('grn_hdr', [
                'ref_no'       => $grnNo,
                'grn_date'     => $grnDate,
                'po_hdr_id'    => $poHdrId,
                'supplier_id'  => $supplierId,
                'warehouse_id' => $warehouseId,
                'status'       => 'draft',  // menunggu konfirmasi fisik dari gudang -- BELUM ada jurnal/stok
                'remark'       => $remark,
                'created_by'   => $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null
            ]), 'insert grn_hdr');

            $grnId = $db->lastInsertId();
            if (!$grnId) {
                $stmtG = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM grn_hdr WHERE ref_no = :no");
                $stmtG->execute(['no' => $grnNo]);
                $grnId = $stmtG->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['id'] ?? 0;
            }

            // Jurnal & stock movement SENGAJA TIDAK diposting di sini --
            // GRN dari purchasing cuma "expected receipt" (draft). Jurnal
            // & stok baru kebentuk saat gudang konfirmasi fisik lewat
            // task 'confirm_receipt'.
            InsertGrnItems($db, $grnId, $items);

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "GRN {$grnNo} (draft) berhasil disimpan. Menunggu konfirmasi fisik dari gudang."]);

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                $db->rollBack();
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal simpan data: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5b. CONFIRM RECEIPT (konfirmasi fisik dari gudang)
    //     Ini yang BENERAN posting jurnal (GRN_RCV) & stock movement (IN).
    //     Hanya bisa dipanggil sekali -- GRN harus masih status 'draft'.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'confirm_receipt':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        $grnId = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($grnId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID GRN tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $stmtG = $db->prepare("SELECT ref_no, grn_date, warehouse_id, status FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
            $stmtG->execute(['id' => $grnId]);
            $grn = $stmtG->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if (!$grn) {
                throw new Exception("GRN tidak ditemukan.");
            }
            if ($grn['status'] !== 'draft') {
                throw new Exception("GRN ini sudah berstatus '{$grn['status']}' -- tidak bisa dikonfirmasi lagi (mungkin sudah pernah dikonfirmasi atau dibatalkan).");
            }

            $stmtItems = $db->prepare("SELECT item_id, qty_received, unit_cost FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = :id");
            $stmtItems->execute(['id' => $grnId]);
            $items = $stmtItems->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if (empty($items)) {
                throw new Exception("GRN ini tidak punya item, tidak ada yang bisa dikonfirmasi.");
            }

            $totalAmount = 0.0;
            foreach ($items as $it) {
                $totalAmount += round(floatval($it['qty_received']) * floatval($it['unit_cost']), 2);
            }

            // --- AUTO POST JOURNAL: Debit Persediaan / Kredit GRN Clearing ---
            $result = AutoPostJournal($db, [
                'rule_code'      => 'GRN_RCV',
                'reference_type' => 'purchase_grn',
                'reference_id'   => $grnId,
                'journal_date'   => $grn['grn_date'],
                'amount'         => round($totalAmount, 2),
                'description'    => 'Penerimaan Barang PO via ' . $grn['ref_no'] . ' (konfirmasi gudang)',
            ]);
            if (!$result['success']) {
                throw new Exception($result['message']);
            }

            // --- AUTO POST STOCK MOVEMENT (IN) ke WMS ---
            PostGrnStockMovements($db, $grnId, $grn['ref_no'], $grn['grn_date'], intval($grn['warehouse_id']), $items);

            DbOrFail($db, $db->update('grn_hdr', [
                'status'        => 'confirmed',
                'confirmed_by'  => $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null,
                'confirmed_at'  => date('Y-m-d H:i:s')
            ], "id = " . intval($grnId)), 'update grn_hdr confirm');

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "GRN {$grn['ref_no']} dikonfirmasi. Jurnal & stok masuk berhasil diposting."]);

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                $db->rollBack();
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal konfirmasi: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. UPDATE
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'update':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        $id          = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $poHdrId     = intval($_POST['po_hdr_id'] ?? 0);
        $supplierId  = intval($_POST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
        $warehouseId = intval($_POST['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);
        $grnDate     = trim($_POST['grn_date'] ?? '');
        $remark      = trim($_POST['remark'] ?? '');
        $items       = json_decode($_POST['arrItems'] ?? '[]', true);

        if ($id <= 0 || $poHdrId <= 0 || $supplierId <= 0 || $warehouseId <= 0 || empty($grnDate) || !is_array($items) || count($items) === 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Data edit GRN tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $stmtOld = $db->prepare("SELECT ref_no, status FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtOld->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $grnOld = $stmtOld->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$grnOld) {
                throw new Exception("Data GRN tidak ditemukan.");
            }
            $grnNo = $grnOld['ref_no'];
            $wasConfirmed = ($grnOld['status'] === 'confirmed');

            // 1. Hapus jurnal & stock movement lama (no-op aman kalau
            //    memang belum pernah diposting / masih draft)
            ReverseJournalByReference($db, 'purchase_grn', $id);
            // Catatan: kalau barang dari GRN ini SUDAH terlanjur keluar
            // lewat Sales Delivery, menghapus/mengurangi qty di sini bisa
            // bikin saldo stok jadi negatif di laporan -- sistem tidak
            // otomatis menolaknya (sama seperti reversal jurnal), jadi
            // pastikan cek dulu di kartu stok sebelum edit GRN yang barangnya
            // sudah bergerak.
            ReverseStockMovementByReference($db, 'grn', $id);

            // 2. Hapus item lama DULU -- supaya view_po_dtl_receipt_status
            //    otomatis tidak menghitung qty GRN ini lagi saat validasi
            //    toleransi 10% dijalankan ulang di InsertGrnItems()
            $stmtDel = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = :id");
            $stmtDel->execute(['id' => $id]);

            // 3. Update header
            DbOrFail($db, $db->update('grn_hdr', [
                'grn_date'     => $grnDate,
                'po_hdr_id'    => $poHdrId,
                'supplier_id'  => $supplierId,
                'warehouse_id' => $warehouseId,
                'remark'       => $remark
            ], "id = " . intval($id)), 'update grn_hdr');

            // 4. Insert item baru (tervalidasi ulang thd toleransi 10%)
            $totalAmount = InsertGrnItems($db, $id, $items);

            // 5. Re-post jurnal & stok HANYA kalau GRN ini SEBELUMNYA sudah
            //    dikonfirmasi gudang -- kalau masih draft, edit tetap
            //    membuatnya draft (menunggu konfirmasi ulang), TIDAK
            //    otomatis posting jurnal/stok.
            if ($wasConfirmed) {
                $result = AutoPostJournal($db, [
                    'rule_code'      => 'GRN_RCV',
                    'reference_type' => 'purchase_grn',
                    'reference_id'   => $id,
                    'journal_date'   => $grnDate,
                    'amount'         => $totalAmount,
                    'description'    => 'Penerimaan Barang PO via ' . $grnNo . ' (revisi setelah konfirmasi)',
                ]);
                if (!$result['success']) {
                    throw new Exception($result['message']);
                }

                // 6. Re-post stock movement (IN) baru
                PostGrnStockMovements($db, $id, $grnNo, $grnDate, $warehouseId, $items);

                // Status TETAP 'confirmed' (sudah di-set sebelumnya, tidak
                // perlu diubah lagi)
                $statusMsg = "GRN {$grnNo} berhasil diperbarui (status tetap confirmed, jurnal & stok sudah di-repost).";
            } else {
                // Masih draft -- pastikan statusnya tetap draft (jaga-jaga
                // kalau sebelumnya sempat ke-set status lain)
                DbOrFail($db, $db->update('grn_hdr', ['status' => 'draft'], "id = " . intval($id)), 'update grn_hdr status');
                $statusMsg = "GRN {$grnNo} (draft) berhasil diperbarui. Masih menunggu konfirmasi fisik dari gudang.";
            }

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => $statusMsg]);

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                $db->rollBack();
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal update data: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 7. DELETE
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'delete':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 4) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID data tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $stmtOld = $db->prepare("SELECT ref_no FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtOld->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $grnNo = $stmtOld->fetchColumn();
            if (!$grnNo) {
                throw new Exception("Data GRN tidak ditemukan.");
            }

            // TODO: kalau modul Purchase Invoice sudah ada, tolak delete
            // di sini kalau GRN ini sudah pernah dipakai/di-matching ke
            // invoice supplier (supaya GRN Clearing tidak jadi tidak balance).

            ReverseJournalByReference($db, 'purchase_grn', $id);
            ReverseStockMovementByReference($db, 'grn', $id);

            $stmtDelD = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = :id");
            $stmtDelD->execute(['id' => $id]);

            $stmtDelH = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtDelH->execute(['id' => $id]);

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "GRN {$grnNo} berhasil dihapus & jurnal/stok dibatalkan."]);

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                $db->rollBack();
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal menghapus data: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
}

// ==================================================================
// HELPER LOKAL: InsertGrnItems
// Validasi tiap item terhadap sisa jatah toleransi 10% (baca ulang
// view_po_dtl_receipt_status di dalam transaksi yang sama), lalu insert
// ke grn_dtl. Return total nilai (qty * unit_cost) untuk posting jurnal.
// ==================================================================
// ==================================================================
// HELPER: PostGrnStockMovements
// Catat 1 baris stock_movements (IN) per item GRN ke WMS, lewat
// PostStockMovement() generic di function.all.php.
// ==================================================================
function PostGrnStockMovements($db, $grnId, $grnNo, $grnDate, $warehouseId, array $items) {
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $itemId = intval($it['item_id'] ?? 0);
        $qty    = round(floatval($it['qty_received'] ?? 0), 4);
        $cost   = round(floatval($it['unit_cost'] ?? 0), 4);

        if ($itemId <= 0 || $qty <= 0) {
            continue;
        }

        PostStockMovement($db, [
            'movement_date'  => $grnDate,
            'item_id'        => $itemId,
            'warehouse_id'   => $warehouseId,
            'movement_type'  => 'IN',
            'qty'            => $qty,
            'unit_cost'      => $cost,
            'reference_type' => 'grn',
            'reference_id'   => $grnId,
            'reference_no'   => $grnNo,
        ]);
    }
}

function InsertGrnItems($db, $grnId, array $items) {
    $totalAmount = 0.0;

    $stmtCheck = $db->prepare("
        SELECT qty_ordered, qty_receivable_max, item_name
        FROM view_po_dtl_receipt_status
        WHERE po_dtl_id = :po_dtl_id
    ");

    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $poDtlId  = intval($it['po_dtl_id'] ?? 0);
        $itemId   = intval($it['item_id'] ?? 0);
        $itemName = trim($it['item_name'] ?? '');
        $qty      = round(floatval($it['qty_received'] ?? 0), 4);
        $cost     = round(floatval($it['unit_cost'] ?? 0), 4);
        $remark   = trim($it['remark'] ?? '');

        if ($poDtlId <= 0 || $itemId <= 0 || $qty <= 0) {
            continue; // baris kosong/tidak valid, skip
        }

        $stmtCheck->execute(['po_dtl_id' => $poDtlId]);
        $status = $stmtCheck->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$status) {
            throw new Exception("Baris PO (po_dtl_id={$poDtlId}) tidak ditemukan.");
        }

        if ($qty > floatval($status['qty_receivable_max']) + 0.0001) {
            throw new Exception(
                "Qty diterima ({$qty}) untuk item id {$itemId} melebihi batas toleransi 10% dari PO. " .
                "Qty PO: {$status['qty_ordered']}, sisa yang masih boleh diterima: {$status['qty_receivable_max']}."
            );
        }

        DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('grn_dtl', [
            'grn_hdr_id'   => $grnId,
            'po_dtl_id'    => $poDtlId,
            'item_id'      => $itemId,
            'item_name'    => $itemName !== '' ? $itemName : ($status['item_name'] ?? null),
            'qty_received' => $qty,
            'unit_cost'    => $cost,
            'remark'       => $remark
        ]), 'insert grn_dtl');

        $totalAmount += round($qty * $cost, 2);
    }

    if ($totalAmount <= 0) {
        throw new Exception('Tidak ada item valid untuk diposting (total nilai GRN = 0).');
    }

    return round($totalAmount, 2);
}
==================== FILE: ./php-crud/stock.opnameCRD.php ====================
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
/**
 * stock.opnameCRD.php -- Stock Opname (hitung fisik per gudang -> penyesuaian stok + jurnal)
 *
 * Alur   : Draft --(Ajukan)--> Diajukan --(Setujui & Posting)--> Disetujui
 *          Draft / Diajukan --(Batalkan)--> Dibatalkan ; Diajukan --(Refresh / Kembali ke Draft)--> Draft
 *          Disetujui --(Batalkan = reverse)--> Dibatalkan (hanya bila stok hasil penyesuaian belum terpakai)
 * Aturan :
 *   1. Satu gudang hanya boleh punya satu opname berjalan (Draft / Diajukan) -- unique index uq_so_open_per_wh.
 *   2. system_qty = snapshot stok sistem saat disimpan / di-refresh. Saat Setujui, stok sistem sekarang HARUS sama dengan
 *      snapshot; bila ada transaksi masuk / keluar sejak itu -> ditolak, minta Refresh Stok lalu hitung ulang.
 *   3. Baris tanpa hasil hitung (counted_qty kosong) tidak disesuaikan. Selisih <> 0 wajib punya alasan; selisih lebih wajib biaya satuan > 0.
 *   4. Selisih lebih  : stok masuk (IN) pada biaya satuan; jurnal STOCK_ADJ_GAIN (Dr Persediaan / Cr Selisih Persediaan).
 *      Selisih kurang : stok keluar (OUT) FIFO; jurnal STOCK_ADJ_LOSS (Dr Selisih Persediaan / Cr Persediaan).
 *   5. Semua pergerakan stok memakai reference_type 'STOCK_OPNAME' (tampil di Kartu Stok); jurnal reference_type 'stock_adjustment'.
 *   6. Jejak: pembuat, pengaju, penyetuju, pembatal + alasan tersimpan di header; dokumen tidak pernah dihapus (hanya Dibatalkan).
 * Migrasi: sql/2026-10-30.stock_opname.sql
 * Action : list | detail | lookup_warehouses | lookup_materials | snapshot | save | submit | refresh | approve | cancel
 */
ob_start();
ini_set('display_errors', '0');
require_once '../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once '../php-class/crudClass.php';
require_once '../php-func/function.stock.php';
require_once '../php-func/journal.stock.php';           // JrnPost / JrnReverseByRef

define('SO_REQUIRE_OTHER_APPROVER', false);             // true = penyetuju harus user lain selain pengaju
define('SO_EPS', 0.00005);

$SO_REASONS = array('Salah Hitung / Salah Catat', 'Rusak', 'Hilang / Susut', 'Kelebihan Penerimaan', 'Salah Pengeluaran', 'Lainnya');
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }
$action = WhReq('action', 'list');

$stockUserId = (int)($_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0);
if (!$stockUserId || $stockUserId <= 0) {
    http_response_code(401);
    WhFail('Sesi berakhir, silakan login kembali.');
}
$stockAccess = (int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
$stockRequired = 1;
if ($action === 'save') $stockRequired = 2;
if ($action === 'submit') $stockRequired = 3;
if ($action === 'refresh') $stockRequired = 3;
if ($action === 'approve') $stockRequired = 3;
if ($action === 'cancel') $stockRequired = 4;
// save melayani pembuatan dan perubahan opname Draft; perubahan wajib level 3.
if ($action === 'save' && (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0) > 0) $stockRequired = 3;
if ($stockAccess < $stockRequired) {
    http_response_code(403);
    WhFail('Hak akses tidak mencukupi untuk operasi persediaan ini.');
}

try {
    switch ($action) {

        default: throw new WhException('Action tidak dikenali.');
    }
} catch (WhException $e) {
    @pg_query($conn, 'ROLLBACK');
    WhFail($e->getMessage());
} catch (Exception $e) {
    @pg_query($conn, 'ROLLBACK');
    WhLog('stock.opnameCRD: ' . $e->getMessage());
    WhFail('Terjadi kesalahan pada server. Hubungi administrator.');

// Biaya satuan rata-rata tertimbang seluruh layer masuk di gudang (dasar penilaian selisih lebih); fallback harga estimasi master
function SoAvgCost($mid, $whId) {
    $r = WhRow("SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(qty) > 0 THEN SUM(qty * unit_cost) / SUM(qty) ELSE 0 END AS c
                FROM stock_movements WHERE item_id = $1 AND warehouse_id = $2 AND movement_type = 'IN'",
               array((int)$mid, (int)$whId));
    $c = round((float)$r['c'], 4);
    if ($c <= 0) {
        $m = WhRow('SELECT COALESCE(estimated_price, 0) AS p FROM materials WHERE id = $1', array((int)$mid));
        $c = $m ? round((float)$m['p'], 4) : 0;
    }
    return $c;
}

function SoHeader($id, $lock = false) {
    $h = WhRow('SELECT h.*, w.name AS warehouse_name FROM stock_opname_hdr h JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = h.warehouse_id
                WHERE h.id = $1' . ($lock ? ' FOR UPDATE OF h' : ''), array((int)$id));
    if (!$h) { throw new WhException('Dokumen opname tidak ditemukan.'); }
    return $h;
}

function SoList() {
    list($start, $limit) = WhPage();
    $q = WhReq('query');
    $params = array();
    $where = '1=1';
    if ($q !== '') {
        $params[] = '%' . $q . '%';
        $where .= ' AND (h.ref_no ILIKE $1 OR w.name ILIKE $1 OR h.remark ILIKE $1)';
    }
    $c = WhRow("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM stock_opname_hdr h JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = h.warehouse_id WHERE $where", $params);
    $params[] = $limit;  $pl = '$' . count($params);
    $params[] = $start;  $ps = '$' . count($params);
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT h.id, h.ref_no, h.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, h.opname_date, h.status, h.remark,
                           h.total_gain, h.total_loss, h.cancel_reason,
                           COALESCE(t.line_count, 0) AS line_count, COALESCE(t.counted_count, 0) AS counted_count,
                           COALESCE(t.diff_count, 0) AS diff_count,
                           cu.login_name AS created_by_name
                    FROM stock_opname_hdr h
                    JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = h.warehouse_id
                    LEFT JOIN (SELECT opname_id, COUNT(*) AS line_count, COUNT(counted_qty) AS counted_count,
                                      SUM(CASE WHEN counted_qty IS NOT NULL AND diff_qty <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_count
                                 FROM stock_opname_dtl GROUP BY opname_id) t ON t.opname_id = h.id
                    LEFT JOIN m_user_system cu ON cu.id = h.created_by
                    WHERE $where
                    ORDER BY h.opname_date DESC, h.id DESC
                    LIMIT $pl OFFSET $ps", $params);
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => (int)$c['n'], 'data' => $rows));
}

// Header + baris + jejak audit + pergerakan stok yang dihasilkan (bila sudah Disetujui)
function SoDetail() {
    $id = (int)WhReq('id');
    if ($id < 1) { throw new WhException('ID dokumen tidak valid.'); }
    $h = WhRow("SELECT h.*, w.name AS warehouse_name,
                       cu.login_name AS created_by_name, su.login_name AS submitted_by_name,
                       au.login_name AS approved_by_name, xu.login_name AS cancelled_by_name
                FROM stock_opname_hdr h
                JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = h.warehouse_id
                LEFT JOIN m_user_system cu ON cu.id = h.created_by
                LEFT JOIN m_user_system su ON su.id = h.submitted_by
                LEFT JOIN m_user_system au ON au.id = h.approved_by
                LEFT JOIN m_user_system xu ON xu.id = h.cancelled_by
                WHERE h.id = $1", array($id));
    if (!$h) { throw new WhException('Dokumen opname tidak ditemukan.'); }
    $lines = WhRows("SELECT d.id, d.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit, d.system_qty, d.counted_qty,
                            d.diff_qty, d.unit_cost, d.diff_value, d.reason, d.note
                     FROM stock_opname_dtl d JOIN materials m ON m.id = d.material_id
                     WHERE d.opname_id = $1 ORDER BY m.material_name", array($id));
    $mov = WhRows("SELECT s.id, s.movement_date, s.movement_type, m.material_code, m.material_name, s.qty, s.unit_cost, s.reference_no
                   FROM stock_movements s JOIN materials m ON m.id = s.item_id
                   WHERE s.reference_type = $1 AND s.reference_id = $2 ORDER BY s.id", array(SO_REF_TYPE, $id));
    $jr = WhRows("SELECT ref_no, journal_date, status::text AS status FROM journal_entries
                  WHERE reference_type::text = $1 AND reference_id = $2 ORDER BY id", array(SO_JRN_REF, $id));
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($lines), 'header' => $h, 'data' => $lines, 'movements' => $mov, 'journals' => $jr));
}

function SoLookupWarehouses() {
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT id, code, name FROM warehouses WHERE active = true ORDER BY name");
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($rows), 'data' => $rows));
}

// Material untuk ditambahkan manual (termasuk yang stok sistemnya 0 -> barang ditemukan di gudang)
function SoLookupMaterials() {
    $wid = (int)WhReq('warehouse_id');
    $q = WhReq('query');
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit,
                           COALESCE(oh.onhand, 0) AS system_qty
                    FROM materials m
                    LEFT JOIN (SELECT item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'IN' THEN qty ELSE -qty END) AS onhand
                               FROM stock_movements WHERE warehouse_id = $1 GROUP BY item_id) oh ON oh.item_id = m.id
                    WHERE m.active IS NOT FALSE AND (m.material_name ILIKE $2 OR m.material_code ILIKE $2)
                    ORDER BY m.material_name LIMIT 50", array($wid, '%' . $q . '%'));
    foreach ($rows as &$r) { $r['unit_cost'] = SoAvgCost($r['material_id'], $wid); }
    unset($r);
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($rows), 'data' => $rows));
}

// Semua material yang punya stok di gudang (stok sistem <> 0) -> baris awal lembar hitung
function SoSnapshot() {
    $wid = (int)WhReq('warehouse_id');
    if ($wid < 1) { throw new WhException('Gudang wajib dipilih.'); }
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit, oh.onhand AS system_qty
                    FROM materials m
                    JOIN (SELECT item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'IN' THEN qty ELSE -qty END) AS onhand
                          FROM stock_movements WHERE warehouse_id = $1 GROUP BY item_id) oh ON oh.item_id = m.id
                    WHERE oh.onhand <> 0 ORDER BY m.material_name", array($wid));
    foreach ($rows as &$r) { $r['unit_cost'] = SoAvgCost($r['material_id'], $wid); }
    unset($r);
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($rows), 'data' => $rows));
}

// Simpan lembar hitung (baru / ubah Draft). system_qty selalu diambil ulang dari stok saat ini (klien tidak menentukan).
function SoSave() {
    global $SO_REASONS;
    WhRequirePost();
    $id      = (int)WhPost('id');
    $whId    = (int)WhPost('warehouse_id');
    $date    = WhDate(WhPost('opname_date'), 'Tanggal opname');
    $remark  = WhPost('remark');
    $details = WhDetails();
    $userId  = WhUserId();

    if ($whId < 1) { throw new WhException('Gudang wajib dipilih.'); }
    $wh = WhRow('SELECT id, active FROM warehouses WHERE id = $1', array($whId));
    if (!$wh || !WhBool($wh['active'])) { throw new WhException('Gudang tidak ditemukan / tidak aktif.'); }
    if (!count($details)) { throw new WhException('Tambahkan minimal satu material.'); }

    $lines = array();
    foreach ($details as $d) {
        $mid = isset($d['material_id']) ? (int)$d['material_id'] : 0;
        if ($mid < 1) { throw new WhException('Material pada detail tidak valid.'); }
        if (isset($lines[$mid])) { throw new WhException('Material yang sama tidak boleh muncul dua kali dalam satu opname.'); }
        $cnt = (isset($d['counted_qty']) && $d['counted_qty'] !== '' && $d['counted_qty'] !== null) ? round(WhNum($d['counted_qty']), 4) : null;
        if ($cnt !== null && $cnt < 0) { throw new WhException('Qty hitung tidak boleh negatif.'); }
        $reason = isset($d['reason']) ? trim($d['reason']) : '';
        if ($reason !== '' && !in_array($reason, $SO_REASONS, true)) { throw new WhException('Alasan selisih tidak valid.'); }
        $lines[$mid] = array('counted' => $cnt, 'reason' => $reason, 'note' => isset($d['note']) ? trim($d['note']) : '',
                             'cost' => isset($d['unit_cost']) ? round(WhNum($d['unit_cost']), 4) : 0);
    }

    WhQ('BEGIN');
    if ($id > 0) {
        $h = SoHeader($id, true);
        if ($h['status'] !== 'Draft') { throw new WhException('Hanya opname berstatus Draft yang dapat diubah.'); }
        if ((int)$h['warehouse_id'] !== $whId) { throw new WhException('Gudang tidak dapat diubah. Batalkan dokumen ini lalu buat opname baru.'); }
        WhQ('UPDATE stock_opname_hdr SET opname_date = $2, remark = $3, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1', array($id, $date, $remark));
        WhQ('DELETE FROM stock_opname_dtl WHERE opname_id = $1', array($id));
        $refNo = $h['ref_no'];
    } else {
        $open = WhRow("SELECT ref_no FROM stock_opname_hdr WHERE warehouse_id = $1 AND status IN ('Draft','Diajukan') LIMIT 1", array($whId));
        if ($open) { throw new WhException('Gudang ini masih punya opname berjalan (' . $open['ref_no'] . '). Selesaikan atau batalkan dulu.'); }
        $refNo = CreateRefNo('stock_opname_hdr', 'ref_no', 'SOP');
        $h = WhRow("INSERT INTO stock_opname_hdr (ref_no, warehouse_id, opname_date, status, remark, created_by)
                    VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'Draft', $4, $5) RETURNING id", array($refNo, $whId, $date, $remark, $userId));
        $id = (int)$h['id'];
    }
    foreach ($lines as $mid => $ln) {
        $m = WhRow('SELECT material_name FROM materials WHERE id = $1', array($mid));
        if (!$m) { throw new WhException('Material ID ' . $mid . ' tidak ditemukan.'); }
        WhLock($mid, $whId);
        $sys  = round(WhOnHand($mid, $whId), 4);
        $diff = ($ln['counted'] === null) ? 0 : round($ln['counted'] - $sys, 4);
        $cost = ($ln['cost'] > 0) ? $ln['cost'] : SoAvgCost($mid, $whId);
        WhQ("INSERT INTO stock_opname_dtl (opname_id, material_id, system_qty, counted_qty, diff_qty, unit_cost, reason, note)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)",
            array($id, $mid, $sys, $ln['counted'], $diff, $cost, $ln['reason'] !== '' ? $ln['reason'] : null, $ln['note'] !== '' ? $ln['note'] : null));
    }
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    WhOk('Lembar opname tersimpan. No: ' . $refNo, array('id' => $id, 'ref_no' => $refNo));
}

// Validasi kelengkapan baris (dipakai saat Ajukan & Setujui)
function SoValidateLines($id) {
    global $SO_REASONS;
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT d.*, m.material_name FROM stock_opname_dtl d JOIN materials m ON m.id = d.material_id
                    WHERE d.opname_id = $1", array((int)$id));
    $counted = 0;
    foreach ($rows as $r) {
        if ($r['counted_qty'] === null) { continue; }
        $counted++;
        $diff = round((float)$r['diff_qty'], 4);
        if (abs($diff) <= SO_EPS) { continue; }
        if (!in_array((string)$r['reason'], $SO_REASONS, true)) {
            throw new WhException('Alasan selisih wajib dipilih untuk ' . $r['material_name'] . '.');
        }
        if ($diff > 0 && (float)$r['unit_cost'] <= 0) {
            throw new WhException('Biaya satuan wajib diisi (> 0) untuk selisih lebih ' . $r['material_name'] . '.');
        }
    }
    if ($counted < 1) { throw new WhException('Belum ada material yang dihitung. Isi qty hitung minimal satu baris.'); }
    return $rows;
}

function SoSubmit() {
    WhRequirePost();
    $id = (int)WhPost('id');
    WhQ('BEGIN');
    $h = SoHeader($id, true);
    if ($h['status'] !== 'Draft') { throw new WhException('Hanya opname berstatus Draft yang dapat diajukan.'); }
    SoValidateLines($id);
    WhQ("UPDATE stock_opname_hdr SET status = 'Diajukan', submitted_by = $2, submitted_at = now() WHERE id = $1", array($id, WhUserId()));
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    WhOk('Opname diajukan untuk persetujuan.');
}

// Ambil ulang stok sistem (snapshot baru) untuk semua baris; status kembali ke Draft agar hasil hitung ditinjau ulang
function SoRefresh() {
    WhRequirePost();
    $id = (int)WhPost('id');
    WhQ('BEGIN');
    $h = SoHeader($id, true);
    if ($h['status'] !== 'Draft' && $h['status'] !== 'Diajukan') { throw new WhException('Refresh hanya untuk opname Draft / Diajukan.'); }
    $rows = WhRows('SELECT id, material_id, counted_qty FROM stock_opname_dtl WHERE opname_id = $1', array($id));
    foreach ($rows as $r) {
        WhLock((int)$r['material_id'], (int)$h['warehouse_id']);
        $sys  = round(WhOnHand((int)$r['material_id'], (int)$h['warehouse_id']), 4);
        $diff = ($r['counted_qty'] === null) ? 0 : round((float)$r['counted_qty'] - $sys, 4);
        WhQ('UPDATE stock_opname_dtl SET system_qty = $2, diff_qty = $3 WHERE id = $1', array((int)$r['id'], $sys, $diff));
    }
    WhQ("UPDATE stock_opname_hdr SET status = 'Draft', submitted_by = NULL, submitted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1", array($id));
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    WhOk('Stok sistem diperbarui. Periksa kembali selisih lalu ajukan ulang.');
}

function SoApprove() {
    WhRequirePost();
    $id = (int)WhPost('id');
    $userId = WhUserId();
    WhQ('BEGIN');
    $h = SoHeader($id, true);
    if ($h['status'] !== 'Diajukan') { throw new WhException('Hanya opname berstatus Diajukan yang dapat disetujui.'); }
    if (SO_REQUIRE_OTHER_APPROVER && (int)$h['submitted_by'] === (int)$userId) {
        throw new WhException('Penyetuju harus user lain selain pengaju opname.');
    }
    $whId = (int)$h['warehouse_id'];
    $date = $h['opname_date'];
    $rows = SoValidateLines($id);

    $gain = 0.0; $loss = 0.0;
    foreach ($rows as $r) {
        if ($r['counted_qty'] === null) { continue; }
        $mid  = (int)$r['material_id'];
        $diff = round((float)$r['diff_qty'], 4);
        if (abs($diff) <= SO_EPS) { continue; }
        WhLock($mid, $whId);
        $onhand = round(WhOnHand($mid, $whId), 4);
        if (abs($onhand - round((float)$r['system_qty'], 4)) > SO_EPS) {
            throw new WhException('Stok ' . $r['material_name'] . ' berubah sejak snapshot (sekarang ' . WhFmt($onhand) . ', snapshot ' . WhFmt($r['system_qty']) .
                '). Klik Refresh Stok, lalu hitung ulang dan ajukan kembali.');
        }
        if ($diff > 0) {
            $cost = round((float)$r['unit_cost'], 4);
            WhPostMovement($date, $mid, $whId, 'IN', $diff, $cost, SO_REF_TYPE, $id, $h['ref_no'], 'Selisih opname (lebih)', $userId);
            $val = round($diff * $cost, 2);
            $gain += $val;
            WhQ('UPDATE stock_opname_dtl SET diff_value = $2 WHERE id = $1', array((int)$r['id'], $val));
        } else {
            $qty = -$diff;
            $val = 0.0;
            foreach (WhFifoAllocate($mid, $whId, $qty) as $ly) {
                WhPostMovement($date, $mid, $whId, 'OUT', $ly['qty'], $ly['unit_cost'], SO_REF_TYPE, $id, $h['ref_no'], 'Selisih opname (kurang)', $userId);
                $val += $ly['qty'] * $ly['unit_cost'];
            }
            $val = round($val, 2);
            $loss += $val;
            WhQ('UPDATE stock_opname_dtl SET diff_value = $2 WHERE id = $1', array((int)$r['id'], -$val));
        }
    }
    $gain = round($gain, 2); $loss = round($loss, 2);
    if ($gain > 0) { JrnPost('STOCK_ADJ_GAIN', SO_JRN_REF, $id, $date, $gain, 'Selisih lebih opname ' . $h['ref_no'], $userId); }
    if ($loss > 0) { JrnPost('STOCK_ADJ_LOSS', SO_JRN_REF, $id, $date, $loss, 'Selisih kurang opname ' . $h['ref_no'], $userId); }
    WhQ("UPDATE stock_opname_hdr SET status = 'Disetujui', approved_by = $2, approved_at = now(), total_gain = $3, total_loss = $4 WHERE id = $1",
        array($id, $userId, $gain, $loss));
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    WhOk('Opname disetujui & diposting. Nilai lebih ' . WhFmt($gain) . ', nilai kurang ' . WhFmt($loss) . '.');
}

function SoCancel() {
    WhRequirePost();
    $id = (int)WhPost('id');
    $reason = trim(WhPost('reason'));
    $userId = WhUserId();
    if (strlen($reason) < 5) { throw new WhException('Alasan pembatalan wajib diisi (minimal 5 karakter).'); }
    WhQ('BEGIN');
    $h = SoHeader($id, true);
    if ($h['status'] === 'Dibatalkan') { throw new WhException('Dokumen sudah dibatalkan.'); }
    if ($h['status'] === 'Disetujui') {
        // Reverse: selisih lebih hanya boleh dibalik bila stok hasil penyesuaian belum terpakai
        $whId = (int)$h['warehouse_id'];
        $rows = WhRows("SELECT d.material_id, d.diff_qty, m.material_name FROM stock_opname_dtl d JOIN materials m ON m.id = d.material_id
                        WHERE d.opname_id = $1 AND d.counted_qty IS NOT NULL AND d.diff_qty > 0", array($id));
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            WhLock((int)$r['material_id'], $whId);
            if (round(WhOnHand((int)$r['material_id'], $whId), 4) + SO_EPS < round((float)$r['diff_qty'], 4)) {
                throw new WhException('Tidak dapat dibatalkan: stok lebih ' . $r['material_name'] . ' hasil opname sudah terpakai. Lakukan opname koreksi.');
            }
        }
        JrnReverseByRef(SO_JRN_REF, $id, date('Y-m-d'), $userId, 'Batal opname: ' . $reason);
        WhDeleteMovementsByRef(SO_REF_TYPE, $id);
        WhQ('UPDATE stock_opname_dtl SET diff_value = 0 WHERE opname_id = $1', array($id));
    }
    WhQ("UPDATE stock_opname_hdr SET status = 'Dibatalkan', cancelled_by = $2, cancelled_at = now(), cancel_reason = $3 WHERE id = $1",
        array($id, $userId, $reason));
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    WhOk('Opname dibatalkan.');
}

                "id" => $newRoleId

        // ==========================================
        // 6. READ ROLE MATRIX (Muat Seluruh Form & Level Akses untuk Role Terpilih)
        // ==========================================
        case 'read_role_matrix':
            $roleId = intval($_POST['role_id'] ?? $_GET['role_id'] ?? 0);

            $sql = "
                SELECT
                    f.id AS form_id,
                    COALESCE(g.id, 0) AS group_id,
                    COALESCE(g.name, 'Uncategorized') AS group_name,

                $row['access_level'] = intval($row['access_level']);
                $row['access_id'] = intval($row['access_id']);
                $row['active'] = ($row['access_level'] > 0);
                $rows[] = $row;
            }

            echo json_encode([
                "success" => true,
                "totalRecord" => count($rows),
                "data" => $rows
            ]);

        // ==========================================
        // 7. SAVE ROLE MATRIX (Simpan Perubahan Matriks Akses Massal)
        // ==========================================
        case 'save_role_matrix':
            $roleId = intval($_POST['role_id'] ?? 0);
            $matrixPayload = $_POST['matrix_data'] ?? $_POST['arrForm'] ?? null;

            if ($roleId <= 0) {
                echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "ID Role tidak valid untuk penyimpanan matriks."]);
                exit;
            }

            if (empty($matrixPayload)) {
                echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Data matriks akses kosong."]);
                exit;
            }

            $cleanJson = stripslashes($matrixPayload);
            $matrixData = json_decode($cleanJson, true);

            if (!is_array($matrixData)) {
                echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Format payload JSON matriks tidak valid."]);
                exit;
            }

            pg_query($conn, "BEGIN");

            foreach ($matrixData as $row) {
                $formId = intval($row['form_id'] ?? 0);
                $accessLevel = intval($row['access_level'] ?? 0);

                if ($accessLevel < 0 || $accessLevel > 4) {
                    $accessLevel = 0;
                }

                if ($formId > 0) {
                    // GAP-USR-03: Validasi eksistensi form_id di tabel m_form_name
                    $chkForm = pg_query_params($conn, "SELECT 1 FROM m_form_name WHERE id = $1 AND active = true", [$formId]);
                    if (!$chkForm || pg_num_rows($chkForm) === 0) {
                        pg_query($conn, "ROLLBACK");
                        echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Form ID {$formId} tidak valid atau tidak terdaftar di sistem."]);
                        exit;
                    }

                    if ($accessLevel > 0) {
                        // Upsert
                        $upd = pg_query_params(
                            $conn,
                            "INSERT INTO m_role_access_menu (role_id, form_id, access_level) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
                             ON CONFLICT (role_id, form_id) DO UPDATE SET access_level = $3",
                            [$roleId, $formId, $accessLevel]
                        );
                        if (!$upd) throw new Exception(pg_last_error($conn));
                    } else {
                        // Delete if level is 0 / unchecked
                        $del = pg_query_params(
                            $conn,
                            "DELETE FROM m_role_access_menu WHERE role_id = $1 AND form_id = $2",
                            [$roleId, $formId]
                        );
                        if (!$del) throw new Exception(pg_last_error($conn));
                    }
                }
            }

            // Update role timestamp
            pg_query_params($conn, "UPDATE m_role SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1", [$roleId]);

            pg_query($conn, "COMMIT");

            echo json_encode([
                "success" => true,
                "message" => "Matriks akses role berhasil disimpan."
            ]);
            break;

        // ==========================================
        // 8. SYNC ROLE TO USERS (Salin Matriks Role ke m_user_access_menu seluruh user dengan role tersebut)
        // ==========================================
        case 'sync_role_to_users':
            $roleId = intval($_POST['role_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($roleId <= 0) {
                echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "ID Role tidak valid untuk sinkronisasi."]);
                exit;
            }

            pg_query($conn, "BEGIN");

            // Find all users assigned to this role
            $usersRes = pg_query_params($conn, "SELECT id FROM m_user_system WHERE role_id = $1 AND active = true", [$roleId]);
            if (!$usersRes) {
                throw new Exception(pg_last_error($conn));
            }

            $userCount = 0;
            while ($u = pg_fetch_assoc($usersRes)) {
                $userId = intval($u['id']);
                $userCount++;

                // Clear existing user access menu for this user and replace with role access menu
                pg_query_params($conn, "DELETE FROM m_user_access_menu WHERE user_id = $1", [$userId]);
                pg_query_params(
                    $conn,
                    "INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level)
                     SELECT $1, form_id, access_level FROM m_role_access_menu WHERE role_id = $2 AND access_level > 0",
                    [$userId, $roleId]
                );
            }

            pg_query($conn, "COMMIT");

            echo json_encode([
                "success" => true,
                "message" => "Sinkronisasi berhasil! Matriks akses role telah diterapkan ke {$userCount} akun user aktif."
            ]);
            break;

        default:
            echo json_encode([
                "success" => false,
                "message" => "Task '{$task}' tidak dikenali di roleCRD.php."
            ]);
            break;
    }
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    if (pg_connection_status($conn) === PGSQL_CONNECTION_OK) {
        @pg_query($conn, "ROLLBACK");
    }
    error_log("Error in roleCRD.php [task: {$task}]: " . $e->getMessage());
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode([
        "success" => false,
        "message" => "Database error: " . $e->getMessage()
    ]);
}

==================== FILE: ./php-crud/stock.cardCRD.php ====================
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
/**
* stock.cardCRD.php — Stock Card (kartu stok per item, per gudang / semua gudang)
* Output: baris "Saldo Awal" + mutasi periode + running balance, plus ringkasan.
* Action: card | lookup_warehouses | lookup_items | snapshot
*
* [FINAL FIX 2026-11-08]
* RULE:
*   - lookup_warehouses: HANYA gudang yang punya stok (ada di stock_movements)
*   - lookup_items: HANYA material yang punya stok di gudang terpilih
*     (pakai EXISTS stock_movements dengan filter warehouse_id)
*   - Posisi parameter: $1, $2, $3, ... (bukan :named) untuk pg_query_params()
*
* [2026-11-10]
*   - lookup_items kini mengirim qty_on_hand (sebelumnya dipakai UI tapi tidak pernah dikirim)
*   - action baru 'snapshot': data mentah 1 gudang untuk dipakai offline di HP
*/
ob_start();
ini_set('display_errors', '0');
require_once '../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once '../php-class/crudClass.php';
require_once '../php-func/function.stock.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }
$stockCardUserId = (int)($_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0);
if ($stockCardUserId <= 0) {
    http_response_code(401);
    WhFail('Sesi berakhir, silakan login kembali.');
}
if ((int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < 1) {
    http_response_code(403);
    WhFail('Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membaca kartu stok.');
}

$action = WhReq('action', 'card');

try {
    switch ($action) {
        case 'card':              CardLoad(); break;
        case 'lookup_warehouses': CardLookupWarehouses(); break;
        case 'lookup_items':      CardLookupItems(); break;
        case 'snapshot':          CardSnapshot(); break;
        default: throw new WhException('Action tidak dikenali.');
    }
} catch (WhException $e) {
    WhFail($e->getMessage());
} catch (Exception $e) {
    WhLog('stockcardCRD: ' . $e->getMessage());
    WhFail('Terjadi kesalahan pada server. Hubungi administrator.');
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------
 * [RULE 1] Hanya gudang yang memiliki stok (pernah ada mutasi)
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
function CardLookupWarehouses() {
    $sql = "SELECT DISTINCT w.id, w.name 
            FROM warehouses w 
            WHERE w.active = true 
            AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM stock_movements s 
                WHERE s.warehouse_id = w.id
            )
            ORDER BY w.name";
    
    $rows = WhRows($sql);
    
    // Tambahkan opsi "-- Semua Gudang --" di awal
    array_unshift($rows, array('id' => 0, 'name' => '-- Semua Gudang --'));
    
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($rows), 'data' => $rows));
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------
 * [RULE 2] Material HANYA yang punya stok di gudang terpilih
 * warehouse_id WAJIB diisi (tidak boleh 0/kosong)
 * Posisi parameter: $1 = query, $2 = warehouse_id
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
function CardLookupItems() {
    $wid = (int)WhReq('warehouse_id');
    $q   = trim(WhReq('query'));
    
    // [RULE] warehouse_id wajib untuk filter material
    if ($wid <= 0) {
        WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => 0, 'data' => array(), 
                     'message' => 'Pilih gudang terlebih dahulu.'));
        return;
    }
    
    // Query: material yang PERNAH ada mutasi di gudang terpilih
    // Posisi parameter: $1 = pattern query, $2 = warehouse_id
    $sql = "SELECT m.id AS item_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit,
                   (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s2.movement_type='IN' THEN s2.qty ELSE -s2.qty END),0)
                      FROM stock_movements s2
                     WHERE s2.item_id = m.id AND s2.warehouse_id = $2) AS qty_on_hand
            FROM materials m
            WHERE (m.material_name ILIKE $1 OR m.material_code ILIKE $1)
            AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM stock_movements s 
                WHERE s.item_id = m.id 
                AND s.warehouse_id = $2
            )
            ORDER BY m.material_name 
            LIMIT 50";
    
    $params = array('%' . $q . '%', $wid);
    $rows = WhRows($sql, $params);
    
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($rows), 'data' => $rows));
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Card Load (tidak berubah)
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
function CardLoad() {
    $itemId = (int)WhReq('item_id');
    $wid    = (int)WhReq('warehouse_id');
    
    if ($itemId < 1) { throw new WhException('Item wajib dipilih.'); }
    
    $from = WhDate(WhReq('date_from'), 'Tanggal awal');
    $to   = WhDate(WhReq('date_to'), 'Tanggal akhir');
    
    if ($from > $to) { throw new WhException('Tanggal awal tidak boleh melebihi tanggal akhir.'); }
    
    $wf1 = ''; $wf2 = '';
    $p1 = array($itemId, $from);
    $p2 = array($itemId, $from, $to);
    
    if ($wid > 0) {
        $p1[] = $wid; $wf1 = ' AND warehouse_id=$3';
        $p2[] = $wid; $wf2 = ' AND s.warehouse_id=$4';
    }
    
    // Saldo awal
    $o = WhRow("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='IN' THEN qty ELSE -qty END),0) AS q
                FROM stock_movements 
                WHERE item_id=$1 AND movement_date < $2 $wf1", $p1);
    $balance = round((float)$o['q'], 4);
    
    // Mutasi periode
    $mv = WhRows("SELECT s.id, s.movement_date, s.movement_type, s.qty, s.unit_cost,
                         s.reference_type, s.reference_no, s.remark, w.name AS warehouse_name
                  FROM stock_movements s 
                  JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=s.warehouse_id
                  WHERE s.item_id=$1 AND s.movement_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3 $wf2
                  ORDER BY s.movement_date, s.id", $p2);
    
    $data = array(array(
        'row_type' => 'OPEN', 'movement_date' => $from, 'reference_type' => '', 'reference_no' => '',
        'warehouse_name' => '', 'remark' => 'Saldo Awal', 'qty_in' => null, 'qty_out' => null,
        'unit_cost' => null, 'balance' => $balance
    ));
    
    $totIn = 0; $totOut = 0;
    foreach ($mv as $r) {
        $q = (float)$r['qty'];
        $isIn = ($r['movement_type'] === 'IN');
        $balance = round($balance + ($isIn ? $q : -$q), 4);
        if ($isIn) { $totIn += $q; } else { $totOut += $q; }
        $data[] = array(
            'row_type' => 'MOV', 'movement_date' => $r['movement_date'],
            'reference_type' => $r['reference_type'], 'reference_no' => $r['reference_no'],
            'warehouse_name' => $r['warehouse_name'], 'remark' => $r['remark'],
            'qty_in' => $isIn ? $q : null, 'qty_out' => $isIn ? null : $q,
            'unit_cost' => (float)$r['unit_cost'], 'balance' => $balance
        );
    }
    
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data,
        'summary' => array('opening' => (float)$o['q'], 'total_in' => round($totIn, 4),
            'total_out' => round($totOut, 4), 'ending' => $balance)));
}


/* ------------------------------------------------------------------
 * [OFFLINE] Snapshot 1 gudang: daftar material + saldo awal per material
 * pada date_from + seluruh mutasi sejak date_from.
 * Client menghitung kartu stok sendiri dari data ini saat tidak ada sinyal.
 * Default date_from = 90 hari lalu. Batas 50.000 baris mutasi.
 * Posisi parameter: $1 = warehouse_id, $2 = date_from
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
function CardSnapshot() {
    $wid = (int)WhReq('warehouse_id');
    if ($wid < 1) { throw new WhException('Gudang wajib dipilih.'); }

    $rawFrom = trim((string)WhReq('date_from'));
    $from = ($rawFrom === '') ? date('Y-m-d', strtotime('-90 days')) : WhDate($rawFrom, 'Tanggal awal');

    $wh = WhRow("SELECT name FROM warehouses WHERE id=$1", array($wid));
    if (!$wh) { throw new WhException('Gudang tidak ditemukan.'); }

    $items = WhRows("SELECT m.id AS item_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit,
                            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.movement_type='IN' THEN s.qty ELSE -s.qty END),0) AS qty_on_hand,
                            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.movement_date < $2
                                              THEN (CASE WHEN s.movement_type='IN' THEN s.qty ELSE -s.qty END)
                                              ELSE 0 END),0) AS opening
                     FROM materials m
                     JOIN stock_movements s ON s.item_id = m.id
                     WHERE s.warehouse_id = $1
                     GROUP BY m.id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit
                     ORDER BY m.material_name", array($wid, $from));

    $mv = WhRows("SELECT s.id, s.item_id, s.movement_date, s.movement_type, s.qty, s.unit_cost,
                         s.reference_type, s.reference_no, s.remark
                  FROM stock_movements s
                  WHERE s.warehouse_id = $1 AND s.movement_date >= $2
                  ORDER BY s.movement_date, s.id
                  LIMIT 50001", array($wid, $from));

    if (count($mv) > 50000) {
        throw new WhException('Data terlalu besar. Pilih rentang sinkron yang lebih pendek (mis. 30 hari).');
    }

    foreach ($items as &$it) {
        $it['item_id']     = (int)$it['item_id'];
        $it['qty_on_hand'] = round((float)$it['qty_on_hand'], 4);
        $it['opening']     = round((float)$it['opening'], 4);
    }
    unset($it);
    foreach ($mv as &$r) {
        $r['id']        = (int)$r['id'];
        $r['item_id']   = (int)$r['item_id'];
        $r['qty']       = (float)$r['qty'];
        $r['unit_cost'] = (float)$r['unit_cost'];
    }
    unset($r);

    WhJson(array(
        'success'        => true,
        'warehouse_id'   => $wid,
        'warehouse_name' => $wh['name'],
        'date_from'      => $from,
        'generated_at'   => date('c'),
        'items'          => $items,
        'movements'      => $mv
    ));
}

        if (!$dtChk || $dtChk->format('Y-m-d') !== $payDate) {

        if ($db->inTransaction()) {
