        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            // Serialisasi per supplier: dua pembayaran bersamaan tidak bisa
            // sama-sama memakai saldo deposit / melunasi invoice yang sama.
            SpLockSupplier($db, $supplierId);
            $before = [$supplierId => GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $supplierId)];

            $alloc = SpNormalizeItems($items);
            $allocatedTotal = round(array_sum($alloc), 2);

            if ($depositApplied > 0) {
                $availableDeposit = $before[$supplierId];
                if ($depositApplied > $availableDeposit + 0.01) {
                    throw new Exception("Saldo deposit yang dipakai (Rp " . number_format($depositApplied, 2) . ") melebihi saldo tersedia (Rp " . number_format($availableDeposit, 2) . ").");
                }
                if ($depositApplied > $allocatedTotal + 0.01) {
                    throw new Exception('Saldo deposit yang dipakai tidak boleh melebihi total alokasi ke invoice.');
                }
            }

            $cashNeeded = round($allocatedTotal - $depositApplied, 2);
            if ($totalPaid + 0.01 < $cashNeeded) {
                throw new Exception("Total dibayar + saldo deposit belum cukup menutupi alokasi invoice.");
            }
            $excessAmount = round($totalPaid - $cashNeeded, 2);

            // invoice ada, milik supplier ini, nominal <= sisa tagihan (baris dikunci)
            SpValidateAllocations($db, $supplierId, $alloc);

            $paymentNo = SpNextRefNo($db, 'supplier_payments', 'payment_no', 'SPAY');

            $createdBy = null;
            $rawUserId = intval($_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($rawUserId > 0) {
                $stmtUser = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM m_user_system WHERE id = :uid LIMIT 1");
                $stmtUser->execute(['uid' => $rawUserId]);
                if ($stmtUser->fetchColumn()) {
                    $createdBy = $rawUserId;
                }
            }

            $okHeader = $db->insert('supplier_payments', [
                'payment_no'       => $paymentNo,
                'payment_date'     => $payDate,
                'supplier_id'      => $supplierId,
                'account_id'       => $totalPaid > 0 ? $accountId : null,
                'payment_method'   => $method,
                'total_amount'     => $totalPaid,
                'allocated_amount' => $allocatedTotal,
                'excess_amount'    => $excessAmount,
                'deposit_applied'  => $depositApplied,
                'reference_no'     => $refNo,
                'notes'            => $notes,
                'created_by'       => $createdBy
            ]);
            if ($okHeader === false) {
                throw new Exception('ERROR ASLI DB HEADER: ' . $db->getResult());
            }

            $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM supplier_payments WHERE payment_no = :no ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1");
            $stmtP->execute(['no' => $paymentNo]);
            $paymentId = intval($stmtP->fetchColumn());
            if ($paymentId <= 0) {
                throw new Exception('ERROR ASLI DB HEADER: id pembayaran tidak terbaca setelah insert.');
            }

            foreach ($alloc as $invId => $amt) {
                $okItem = $db->insert('supplier_payment_items', [
                    'supplier_payment_id' => $paymentId,
                    'invoice_id'          => $invId,
                    'amount_paid'         => $amt
                ]);
                if ($okItem === false) {
                    throw new Exception("ERROR ASLI DB ITEM (Invoice ID {$invId}): " . $db->getResult());
                }
            }

            // paid_amount dihitung dari item (sumber kebenaran), bukan ditambah manual
            SpRecalcInvoicePaid($db, array_keys($alloc));

            try {
                PostSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $paymentId, $paymentNo, $payDate, $accountId, $allocatedTotal, $excessAmount, $depositApplied);
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                throw new Exception('ERROR ASLI POST JURNAL: ' . $e->getMessage());
            }

            SpAssertDepositNotNegative($db, $before);

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'id' => $paymentId, 'payment_no' => $paymentNo, 'message' => "Pembayaran {$paymentNo} berhasil disimpan."]);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
            exit;
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. UPDATE
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'update':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        $id          = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $supplierId  = intval($_POST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
        $accountId   = intval($_POST['account_id'] ?? 0);
        $payDate     = trim($_POST['payment_date'] ?? '');
        $method      = trim($_POST['payment_method'] ?? 'BANK_TRANSFER');
        $refNo       = trim($_POST['reference_no'] ?? '');
        $notes       = trim($_POST['notes'] ?? '');
        $items       = json_decode($_POST['arrItems'] ?? '[]', true);

        $rawTotal  = str_replace(',', '', $_POST['total_amount'] ?? '0');
        $totalPaid = round(floatval($rawTotal), 2);
        $depositApplied = round(floatval($_POST['deposit_applied'] ?? 0), 2);

        if ($id <= 0 || $supplierId <= 0 || empty($payDate) || ($totalPaid <= 0 && $depositApplied <= 0)) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Data edit tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }
        if ($totalPaid > 0 && $accountId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Pilih akun Kas/Bank sumber dana.']);
            exit;
        }
        $dtChk = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $payDate);
        if (!$dtChk || $dtChk->format('Y-m-d') !== $payDate) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Format Tanggal Bayar tidak valid (harus YYYY-MM-DD).']);
            exit;
        }

        if ($db->inTransaction()) {
            try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $stmtOldPay = $db->prepare("SELECT payment_no, supplier_id FROM supplier_payments WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
            $stmtOldPay->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $oldPay = $stmtOldPay->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$oldPay) {
                throw new Exception("Data pembayaran tidak ditemukan.");
            }
            $oldPayNo       = $oldPay['payment_no'];
            $oldSupplierId  = intval($oldPay['supplier_id']);

            // kunci supplier lama & baru (urut id supaya tidak deadlock) + catat saldo deposit awal
            $sids = array_values(array_unique([$oldSupplierId, $supplierId]));
            sort($sids);
            $before = [];
            foreach ($sids as $sid) {
                SpLockSupplier($db, $sid);
                $before[$sid] = GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $sid);
            }

            $stmtOldItems = $db->prepare("SELECT invoice_id FROM supplier_payment_items WHERE supplier_payment_id = :id");
            $stmtOldItems->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $oldInvoiceIds = array_map('intval', $stmtOldItems->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN));

            $alloc = SpNormalizeItems($items);
            SpLockInvoices($db, array_merge($oldInvoiceIds, array_keys($alloc)));

            ReverseSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $id);

            $stmtDelItems = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM supplier_payment_items WHERE supplier_payment_id = :id");
            $stmtDelItems->execute(['id' => $id]);

            $allocatedTotal = round(array_sum($alloc), 2);

            if ($depositApplied > 0) {
                // dihitung SETELAH jurnal lama dibalik -> pemakaian deposit oleh pembayaran ini sendiri sudah kembali
                $availableDeposit = GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $supplierId);
                if ($depositApplied > $availableDeposit + 0.01) {
                    throw new Exception("Saldo deposit yang dipakai melebihi saldo tersedia (Rp " . number_format($availableDeposit, 2) . ").");
                }
                if ($depositApplied > $allocatedTotal + 0.01) {
                    throw new Exception('Saldo deposit yang dipakai tidak boleh melebihi total alokasi ke invoice.');
                }
            }

            $cashNeeded = round($allocatedTotal - $depositApplied, 2);
            if ($totalPaid + 0.01 < $cashNeeded) {
                throw new Exception('Total dibayar + saldo deposit belum cukup menutupi alokasi invoice.');
            }
            $excessAmount = round($totalPaid - $cashNeeded, 2);

            // item lama sudah dihapus -> "pembayaran lain" saja yang dihitung sebagai terbayar
            SpValidateAllocations($db, $supplierId, $alloc);

            $okUpd = $db->update('supplier_payments', [
                'payment_date'     => $payDate,
                'supplier_id'      => $supplierId,
                'account_id'       => $totalPaid > 0 ? $accountId : null,
                'payment_method'   => $method,
                'total_amount'     => $totalPaid,
                'allocated_amount' => $allocatedTotal,
                'excess_amount'    => $excessAmount,
                'deposit_applied'  => $depositApplied,
                'reference_no'     => $refNo,
                'notes'            => $notes
            ], "id = " . intval($id));

            if ($okUpd === false) {
                throw new Exception("GAGAL UPDATE HEADER: " . $db->getResult());
            }

            foreach ($alloc as $invId => $amt) {
                $okInsItem = $db->insert('supplier_payment_items', ['supplier_payment_id' => $id, 'invoice_id' => $invId, 'amount_paid' => $amt]);
                if ($okInsItem === false) {
                    throw new Exception("GAGAL INSERT ITEM UPDATE (Invoice ID {$invId}): " . $db->getResult());
                }
            }

            SpRecalcInvoicePaid($db, array_merge($oldInvoiceIds, array_keys($alloc)));

            PostSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $id, $oldPayNo, $payDate, $accountId, $allocatedTotal, $excessAmount, $depositApplied);

            SpAssertDepositNotNegative($db, $before);

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Pembayaran {$oldPayNo} berhasil diperbarui."]);

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ERROR UPDATE: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
            exit;
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. DELETE
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'delete':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 4) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID data tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        if ($db->inTransaction()) {
            try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $stmtOldPay = $db->prepare("SELECT payment_no, supplier_id FROM supplier_payments WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
            $stmtOldPay->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $oldPay = $stmtOldPay->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$oldPay) {
                throw new Exception("Data pembayaran tidak ditemukan.");
            }
            $oldPayNo = $oldPay['payment_no'];
            $delSupplierId = intval($oldPay['supplier_id']);

            SpLockSupplier($db, $delSupplierId);
            $before = [$delSupplierId => GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $delSupplierId)];

            $stmtOldItems = $db->prepare("SELECT invoice_id FROM supplier_payment_items WHERE supplier_payment_id = :id");
            $stmtOldItems->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $oldInvoiceIds = array_map('intval', $stmtOldItems->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN));
            SpLockInvoices($db, $oldInvoiceIds);

            ReverseSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $id);

            $stmtDelItems = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM supplier_payment_items WHERE supplier_payment_id = :id");
            $stmtDelItems->execute(['id' => $id]);

            $stmtDelHeader = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM supplier_payments WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtDelHeader->execute(['id' => $id]);

            SpRecalcInvoicePaid($db, $oldInvoiceIds);

            // uang muka dari pembayaran ini mungkin sudah dipakai pembayaran lain
            SpAssertDepositNotNegative($db, $before);

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Pembayaran {$oldPayNo} berhasil dihapus & jurnal dibatalkan."]);

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ERROR DELETE: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
            exit;
        }
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
}

// ==================================================================
// HELPER LOKAL
// ==================================================================
function PostSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $paymentId, $paymentNo, $payDate, $cashAccountId, $allocatedTotal, $excessAmount, $depositApplied = 0) {
    $cashPortionAp = round($allocatedTotal - $depositApplied, 2);

    // (0) Porsi yang dilunasi pakai saldo deposit di supplier -> Debit
    //     Hutang Usaha (2100, fixed) / Kredit Uang Muka Pembelian (1400,
    //     fixed). Tidak ada akun yang perlu di-override di sini.
    if ($depositApplied > 0) {
        $resultDep = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code'      => 'SUP_PAY_DEP',
            'reference_type' => 'supplier_payment',
            'reference_id'   => $paymentId,
            'journal_date'   => $payDate,
            'amount'         => $depositApplied,
            'description'    => 'Pelunasan Hutang Pakai Deposit ' . $paymentNo,
        ]);
        if (!$resultDep['success']) {
            throw new Exception($resultDep['message']);
        }
    }

    // (1) Porsi yang mengurangi Hutang Usaha pakai kas/bank -> Debit Hutang Usaha (fixed) / Kredit Kas-Bank (override)
    if ($cashPortionAp > 0) {
        $resultAp = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code'         => 'SUP_PAY_AP',
            'reference_type'    => 'supplier_payment',
            'reference_id'      => $paymentId,
            'journal_date'      => $payDate,
            'amount'            => $cashPortionAp,
            'description'       => 'Pembayaran Hutang ' . $paymentNo,
            'credit_account_id' => $cashAccountId, // akun Kas/Bank pilihan user
        ]);
        if (!$resultAp['success']) {
            throw new Exception($resultAp['message']);
        }
    }

    // (2) Porsi lebih bayar -> Debit Uang Muka Pembelian (fixed) / Kredit Kas-Bank (override)
    if ($excessAmount > 0) {
        $resultAdv = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code'         => 'SUP_PAY_ADV',
            'reference_type'    => 'supplier_payment',
            'reference_id'      => $paymentId,
            'journal_date'      => $payDate,
            'amount'            => $excessAmount,
            'description'       => 'Uang Muka Pembelian dari Pembayaran ' . $paymentNo,
            'credit_account_id' => $cashAccountId, // akun Kas/Bank pilihan user
        ]);
        if (!$resultAdv['success']) {
            throw new Exception($resultAdv['message']);
        }
    }

    if ($allocatedTotal <= 0 && $excessAmount <= 0 && $depositApplied <= 0) {
        throw new Exception('Tidak ada nominal untuk diposting ke jurnal.');
    }
}

function ReverseSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $paymentId) {
    // Kedua rule (AP & Advance) sama-sama pakai reference_type
    // 'supplier_payment' -- satu panggilan ini menghapus keduanya sekaligus.
    ReverseJournalByReference($db, 'supplier_payment', $paymentId);
}

/*
  Hitung saldo deposit tersedia di seorang supplier, langsung dari
  journal_lines (net debit-kredit akun 1400 Uang Muka Pembelian), dilacak
  lewat reference_type='supplier_payment' + reference_id = id di
  supplier_payments milik supplier ini.
*/
function GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $supplierId) {
    $sql = "
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.debit - jl.credit), 0) AS balance
        FROM journal_lines jl
        JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_id
        JOIN chart_of_accounts coa ON coa.id = jl.account_id AND coa.account_code = '1400'
        WHERE je.reference_type = 'supplier_payment'
          AND je.reference_id IN (
              SELECT id FROM supplier_payments WHERE supplier_id = :supplier_id
          )
    ";
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    $stmt->execute(['supplier_id' => $supplierId]);
    $balance = floatval($stmt->fetchColumn());
    return round($balance, 2);
}


// ==================================================================
// HELPER TAMBAHAN (validasi server, penguncian, hitung ulang paid_amount)
// ==================================================================

/** Placeholder :p0,:p1,... untuk klausa IN. */
function SpInList(array $ids, $prefix, array &$params) {
    $ph = [];
    foreach (array_values($ids) as $i => $v) {
        $ph[] = ':' . $prefix . $i;
        $params[$prefix . $i] = (int)$v;
    }
    return implode(',', $ph);
}

/** Nomor referensi satu-transaksi (lihat CreateRefNoDb di function.all.php); fallback ke CreateRefNo. */
function SpNextRefNo($db, $table, $column, $prefix) {
    $no = function_exists('CreateRefNoDb')
        ? CreateRefNoDb($db, $table, $column, $prefix)
        : CreateRefNo($table, $column, $prefix);
    if ($no === '' || $no === null) {
        throw new Exception('Gagal generate nomor dokumen (' . $prefix . ').');
    }
    return $no;
}

/** Kunci per supplier selama transaksi (advisory lock, lepas otomatis saat COMMIT/ROLLBACK). */
function SpLockSupplier($db, $supplierId) {
    $supplierId = intval($supplierId);
    if ($supplierId <= 0) { return; }
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(7101, CAST(:sid AS integer))");
    $st->execute(['sid' => $supplierId]);
}

/** Baris items dari browser -> [invoice_id => nominal]. Baris kosong dilewati; invoice dobel ditolak. */
function SpNormalizeItems($items) {
    $alloc = [];
    if (!is_array($items)) { return $alloc; }
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $invId = intval($it['invoice_id'] ?? 0);
        $amt   = round(floatval($it['amount_paid'] ?? 0), 2);
        if ($invId <= 0 || $amt <= 0) { continue; }
        if (isset($alloc[$invId])) {
            throw new Exception('Invoice yang sama tidak boleh muncul dua kali dalam satu pembayaran.');
        }
        $alloc[$invId] = $amt;
    }
    return $alloc;
}

/** Kunci baris invoice (urut id). */
function SpLockInvoices($db, array $ids) {
    $ids = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map('intval', $ids))));
    if (empty($ids)) { return; }
    sort($ids);
    $params = [];
    $in = SpInList($ids, 'l', $params);
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM purchase_invoice_hdr WHERE id IN ($in) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE");
    $st->execute($params);
}

/**
 * Invoice harus ada, milik supplier yang dipilih, dan nominal <= sisa tagihan.
 * Sisa = total - SUM(item pembayaran yang ada di DB saat ini); pada update, item lama
 * pembayaran ini sudah dihapus lebih dulu, jadi hanya pembayaran LAIN yang dihitung.
 */
function SpValidateAllocations($db, $supplierId, array $alloc) {
    if (empty($alloc)) { return; }
    $ids = array_keys($alloc);
    SpLockInvoices($db, $ids);

    $params = [];
    $in = SpInList($ids, 'v', $params);
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT inv.id, inv.inv_no, inv.supplier_id,
               COALESCE(inv.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount,
               COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.amount_paid) FROM supplier_payment_items i WHERE i.invoice_id = inv.id), 0) AS paid_now
        FROM purchase_invoice_hdr inv
        WHERE inv.id IN ($in)
    ");
    $st->execute($params);
    $map = [];
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) { $map[intval($r['id'])] = $r; }

    foreach ($alloc as $invId => $amt) {
        if (!isset($map[$invId])) {
            throw new Exception("Invoice (id {$invId}) tidak ditemukan.");
        }
        $r = $map[$invId];
        if (intval($r['supplier_id']) !== intval($supplierId)) {
            throw new Exception("Invoice {$r['inv_no']} milik supplier yang berbeda dengan pembayaran ini.");
        }
        $outstanding = round((float)$r['total_amount'] - (float)$r['paid_now'], 2);
        if ($amt > $outstanding + 0.01) {
            throw new Exception("Pembayaran untuk invoice {$r['inv_no']} (Rp " . number_format($amt, 2) . ") melebihi sisa tagihan (Rp " . number_format($outstanding, 2) . ").");
        }
    }
}

/** paid_amount = SUM(item pembayaran). Idempotent, tidak ada GREATEST(0, ...) yang menyembunyikan selisih. */
function SpRecalcInvoicePaid($db, array $ids) {
    $ids = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map('intval', $ids))));
    if (empty($ids)) { return; }
    sort($ids);
    $params = [];
    $in = SpInList($ids, 'r', $params);
    $st = $db->prepare("
        UPDATE purchase_invoice_hdr AS h
           SET paid_amount = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.amount_paid) FROM supplier_payment_items i WHERE i.invoice_id = h.id), 0)
         WHERE h.id IN ($in)
    ");
    $st->execute($params);
}

/**
 * Saldo deposit supplier tidak boleh menjadi negatif akibat operasi ini.
 * $before = [supplier_id => saldo sebelum operasi]. Bila saldo sudah negatif sebelumnya dan
 * tidak bertambah buruk, operasi tetap diizinkan.
 */
function SpAssertDepositNotNegative($db, array $before) {
    foreach ($before as $sid => $b) {
        $after = GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $sid);
        if ($after < -0.01 && $after < $b - 0.01) {
            throw new Exception("Saldo deposit supplier akan menjadi negatif (Rp " . number_format($after, 2) . "). Uang muka dari pembayaran ini sudah dipakai pembayaran lain -- batalkan/ubah pembayaran yang memakainya terlebih dahulu.");
        }
    }
}

                $g = $r['gap_pts'];
                $r['flag'] = ($g === null) ? 'TANPA RAB' : ($g > 20 ? 'KRITIS' : ($g > 10 ? 'WASPADA' : 'NORMAL'));
            }
            unset($r);
            sendJsonResponse(true, $rows);
            break;

        default:
            sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.');
            break;
    }
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[project.usageCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[project.usageCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}

function po_fmt($n): string { return rtrim(rtrim(number_format((float)$n, 3, '.', ''), '0'), '.'); }
function po_ppn_mode($m): string { $m = strtoupper(trim((string)$m)); return in_array($m, PPN_MODES, true) ? $m : 'NONE'; }
function po_ppn_calc(float $subtotal, string $mode, float $rate): array {
    $subtotal = round($subtotal, 2); $mode = po_ppn_mode($mode);
    if ($mode === 'NONE' || $rate <= 0) return ['subtotal'=>$subtotal,'dpp'=>$subtotal,'ppn'=>0.0,'total'=>$subtotal];
    if ($mode === 'INCL') { $dpp = round($subtotal/(1+$rate/100),2); return ['subtotal'=>$subtotal,'dpp'=>$dpp,'ppn'=>round($subtotal-$dpp,2),'total'=>$subtotal]; }
    $ppn = round($subtotal*$rate/100,2); return ['subtotal'=>$subtotal,'dpp'=>$subtotal,'ppn'=>$ppn,'total'=>round($subtotal+$ppn,2)];
}
function po_line_dpp(float $qty, float $price, string $mode, float $rate): float {
    $sub = round($qty*$price,2);
    if ($mode === 'INCL' && $rate > 0) return round($sub/(1+$rate/100),2);
    return $sub;
}
function po_base_currency($db): array {
    $r = $db->query("SELECT fs.base_currency_id AS id, c.init FROM public.finance_settings fs JOIN public.m_currency c ON c.id = fs.base_currency_id ORDER BY fs.id LIMIT 1")->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$r) $r = $db->query("SELECT id, init FROM public.m_currency WHERE UPPER(TRIM(init))='IDR' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1")->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$r) throw new Exception('Mata uang dasar belum dikonfigurasi (finance_settings.base_currency_id).');
    return ['id'=>(int)$r['id'], 'code'=>strtoupper(trim((string)$r['init']))];
}
function po_currency_code($db, int $id): string {
    static $cache = [];
    if (isset($cache[$id])) return $cache[$id];
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT UPPER(TRIM(init)) FROM public.m_currency WHERE id = :id"); $st->execute([':id'=>$id]);
    $c = (string)$st->fetchColumn(); $cache[$id] = $c !== '' ? $c : 'IDR'; return $cache[$id];
}
function po_sql_line_dpp(string $i, string $po): string {
    return "ROUND(CASE WHEN {$po}.ppn_mode='INCL' AND {$po}.ppn_rate>0 THEN ROUND({$i}.qty*{$i}.unit_price,2)/(1+{$po}.ppn_rate/100.0) ELSE ROUND({$i}.qty*{$i}.unit_price,2) END,2)";
}
function po_sql_budget_factor(int $baseId, string $po, string $p): string {
    $effCur = "COALESCE({$po}.currency_id, {$baseId})";
    $effBud = "COALESCE({$po}.budget_currency_id, {$p}.budget_currency_id, {$baseId})";
    $rate = "COALESCE(NULLIF({$po}.exch_rate,0),1)";
    $budR = "COALESCE(NULLIF({$po}.budget_exch_rate,0), NULLIF({$p}.budget_exch_rate,0),1)";
    return "CASE WHEN {$effCur}={$effBud} THEN 1.0 WHEN {$effBud}={$baseId} THEN {$rate} ELSE {$rate}/{$budR} END";
}
function po_ordered_map($db, int $projectId, int $exclPoId = 0): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT poi.budget_item_id, SUM(poi.qty) AS q FROM po_items poi JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id=poi.po_id WHERE po.project_id=:p AND po.status<>'Dibatalkan' AND po.id<>:x AND poi.budget_item_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY poi.budget_item_id");
    $st->execute([':p'=>$projectId, ':x'=>$exclPoId]);
    $map = []; foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) $map[(int)$r['budget_item_id']] = (float)$r['q']; return $map;
}
function po_committed_map($db, int $projectId, int $exclPoId, int $baseId): array {
    $dpp = po_sql_line_dpp('poi','po'); $fac = po_sql_budget_factor($baseId,'po','p');
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT poi.budget_item_id, SUM({$dpp}*{$fac}) AS v FROM po_items poi JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id=poi.po_id JOIN public.projects p ON p.id=po.project_id WHERE po.project_id=:p AND po.status<>'Dibatalkan' AND po.id<>:x GROUP BY poi.budget_item_id");
    $st->execute([':p'=>$projectId, ':x'=>$exclPoId]);
    $map = []; $total = 0.0;
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) { $v = round((float)$r['v'],2); $total += $v; if ($r['budget_item_id'] !== null) $map[(int)$r['budget_item_id']] = $v; }
    return ['map'=>$map, 'total'=>round($total,2)];
}
function po_project_budget($db, int $projectId, array $base): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT p.budget_currency_id, p.budget_exch_rate, p.budget, COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(c.init)),'') AS budget_code FROM public.projects p LEFT JOIN public.m_currency c ON c.id=p.budget_currency_id WHERE p.id=:p");
    $st->execute([':p'=>$projectId]); $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$r) throw new PoBusinessError('Proyek tidak ditemukan.');
    $curId = (int)$r['budget_currency_id'] > 0 ? (int)$r['budget_currency_id'] : $base['id'];
    $code = $curId === $base['id'] ? $base['code'] : ($r['budget_code'] !== '' ? $r['budget_code'] : po_currency_code($db,$curId));
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(ROUND(qty_plan*COALESCE(unit_price_plan,0),2)*(1+COALESCE(tolerance_pct,0)/100.0),2)),0) FROM public.budget_items WHERE project_id=:p AND category='Material' AND COALESCE(qty_plan,0)>0");
    $st->execute([':p'=>$projectId]);
    $ceil = (float)$r['budget'];
    return ['currency_id'=>$curId,'code'=>$code,'is_base'=>$curId===$base['id'],'proj_rate'=>(float)$r['budget_exch_rate'],'ceiling'=>$ceil>0?round($ceil,2):null,'total_limit'=>round((float)$st->fetchColumn(),2)];
}
function po_received_total($db, int $poId): float {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.qty_received),0) FROM grn_dtl d JOIN grn_hdr h ON h.id=d.grn_hdr_id WHERE h.po_id=:id AND COALESCE(LOWER(h.status),'') NOT IN ('cancelled','canceled','dibatalkan','void','reversed')");
    $st->execute([':id'=>$poId]); return (float)$st->fetchColumn();
}
/* [INVENTORY 2026-11-15] Saldo stok per material yang dapat dipakai proyek:
   gudang milik proyek (warehouses.project_id) + gudang bersama (project_id IS NULL).
   Stok di gudang proyek LAIN tidak dihitung. Butuh GetProjectStockMap() di function.all.php. */
function po_project_stock_map($db, int $projectId): array {
    if ($projectId <= 0) return [];
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT sm.item_id AS material_id,
               SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type = 'IN' THEN sm.qty ELSE -sm.qty END) AS balance_qty
          FROM public.stock_movements sm
          JOIN public.warehouses w ON w.id = sm.warehouse_id
         WHERE w.project_id = :pid OR w.project_id IS NULL
         GROUP BY sm.item_id");
    $st->execute([':pid' => $projectId]);
    $map = [];
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) {
        $qty = round((float)$r['balance_qty'], 4);
        $map[(int)$r['material_id']] = $qty > 0 ? $qty : 0.0;
    }
    return $map;
}
/* Kebutuhan bersih (qty yang benar-benar harus dibeli) = sisa kuota RAB - stok tersedia.
   [CLIENT-SUPPLIED 2026-11-15 F-4.1] bila $materialSource = 'CLIENT_SUPPLIED' (titipan klien),
   kebutuhan beli WAJIB 0 (skip total, bukan GREATEST) -- barang datang dari klien, tidak dibeli. */
function po_net_need(float $qtyPlan, float $tolPct, float $ordered, float $onHand, string $materialSource = 'COMPANY'): float {
    if (strtoupper(trim($materialSource)) === 'CLIENT_SUPPLIED') { return 0.0; }
    $quota = $qtyPlan * (1 + $tolPct / 100) - $ordered;
    return max($quota - $onHand, 0.0);
}
/* [PRERELEASE 2026-11-15] Kunci advisory per proyek: serialisasi save_po & change_status
   supaya dua sesi tidak bisa sama-sama lolos validasi kuota/stok (race condition). */
function po_lock_project($db, int $projectId): void {
    if ($projectId <= 0) return;
    $db->query("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(" . (int)crc32('po_project:' . $projectId) . ")");
}
/* [PRERELEASE] Periode akuntansi yang memuat tanggal PO harus ada & masih terbuka. */
function po_period_open($db, string $date): bool {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.accounting_periods ap WHERE CAST(:d AS date) BETWEEN ap.start_date AND ap.end_date AND ap.is_closed = false");
    $st->execute([':d' => $date]);
    return (bool)$st->fetchColumn();
}
function po_supplier_active($db, int $supId): bool {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.m_suppliers WHERE id = :id AND COALESCE(active, true)");
    $st->execute([':id' => $supId]);
    return (bool)$st->fetchColumn();
}
/* [PRERELEASE] Validasi real-time sebelum PO dilepas (Diajukan / Disetujui).
   Dipanggil DI DALAM transaksi ACID (header PO sudah FOR UPDATE) sehingga stok & kuota
   dibaca ulang persis sebelum status diubah. Melempar PoBusinessError bila ada yang gagal. */
function po_release_validate($db, array $po, array $base): void {
    $id  = (int)$po['id'];
    $prj = (int)$po['project_id'];
    $pno = $po['po_number'];

    // 1. Supplier wajib ada & aktif (release tidak boleh untuk supplier non-aktif)
    if ((int)$po['supplier_id'] > 0 && !po_supplier_active($db, (int)$po['supplier_id'])) {
        throw new PoBusinessError("PO {$pno}: supplier tidak aktif; release ditolak. Pilih supplier aktif.");
    }

    // 2. Tanggal PO valid & berada pada periode akuntansi yang terbuka
    $d = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', (string)$po['po_date']);
    if (!$d || $d->format('Y-m-d') !== (string)$po['po_date']) {
        throw new PoBusinessError("PO {$pno}: tanggal PO tidak valid.");
    }
    if (!po_period_open($db, (string)$po['po_date'])) {
        throw new PoBusinessError("PO {$pno}: periode akuntansi untuk tanggal " . date('d/m/Y', strtotime($po['po_date'])) . " sudah ditutup; release PO dibatalkan.");
    }

    // 3. Integrity header & item: minimal 1 baris po_items, qty > 0, harga valid
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM po_items WHERE po_id = :id");
    $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
    if ((int)$st->fetchColumn() === 0) {
        throw new PoBusinessError("PO {$pno}: tidak memiliki item; release ditolak.");
    }

    // 4. Validasi stok & kuota REAL-TIME: stok proyek/gudang bersama dibaca ulang,
    //    PO lain yang baru masuk ikut mengurangi sisa kuota. Stok milik proyek LAIN
    //    (warehouses.project_id <> proyek ini, bukan NULL) tidak pernah dihitung.
    $ordered  = po_ordered_map($db, $prj, $id);            // PO lain (PO ini dikecualikan)
    $stockMap = po_project_stock_map($db, $prj);           // GetProjectStockMap-equivalent via poCRD
    $stIt = $db->prepare("
        SELECT i.id, i.budget_item_id, i.material_id, i.qty, i.unit_price, i.amount_budget,
               bi.qty_plan, COALESCE(bi.tolerance_pct,0) AS tol,
               COALESCE(bi.unit_price_plan,0) AS price_plan,
               m.material_name,
               COALESCE(NULLIF(bi.unit,''), m.unit, '') AS unit
          FROM po_items i
          JOIN public.budget_items bi ON bi.id = i.budget_item_id AND bi.project_id = :p AND bi.category = 'Material'
          JOIN public.materials m    ON m.id = i.material_id
         WHERE i.po_id = :id
         ORDER BY i.id");
    $stIt->execute([':id' => $id, ':p' => $prj]);
    $rows = $stIt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$rows) {
        throw new PoBusinessError("PO {$pno}: item tidak terikat ke RAB proyek ini; release ditolak.");
    }
    $tallyQty = []; $tallyVal = [];
    $pb = po_project_budget($db, $prj, $base);
    foreach ($rows as $row) {
        $bid = (int)$row['budget_item_id'];
        $qty = round((float)$row['qty'], 3);
        $price = round((float)$row['unit_price'], 2);
        $name = $row['material_name'];
        if ($qty <= 0) throw new PoBusinessError("PO {$pno}: {$name} qty harus > 0.");
        if ($price < 0) throw new PoBusinessError("PO {$pno}: {$name} harga satuan tidak valid.");
        $qtyLimit = (float)$row['qty_plan'] * (1 + (float)$row['tol'] / 100);
        $ordQty = $ordered[$bid] ?? 0.0;
        $tallyQty[$bid] = ($tallyQty[$bid] ?? 0) + $qty;
        if ($ordQty + $tallyQty[$bid] > $qtyLimit + PO_EPS) {
            throw new PoBusinessError("PO {$pno}: {$name} qty PO " . po_fmt($tallyQty[$bid]) . " melebihi sisa kuota RAB (" . po_fmt(max($qtyLimit - $ordQty, 0)) . " {$row['unit']}).");
        }
        $onHand = $stockMap[(int)$row['material_id']] ?? 0.0;
        $tallyBefore = $tallyQty[$bid] - $qty;
        $netNeed = max($qtyLimit - $ordQty - $tallyBefore - $onHand, 0.0);
        if ($qty > $netNeed + PO_EPS) {
            throw new PoBusinessError("PO {$pno}: {$name} qty PO " . po_fmt($qty) . " melebihi kebutuhan bersih " . po_fmt($netNeed) . " {$row['unit']} (sisa kuota RAB " . po_fmt(max($qtyLimit - $ordQty - $tallyBefore, 0)) . " - stok tersedia " . po_fmt($onHand) . ").");
        }
        // kontrol nilai (konsisten dengan save_po): nilai PO baris ini vs batas anggaran baris RAB.
        // amount_budget tersimpan di po_items saat save (sudah dikonversi ke mata uang anggaran).
        $valLimit = round(round((float)$row['qty_plan'] * (float)$row['price_plan'], 2) * (1 + (float)$row['tol'] / 100), 2);
        $lineVal = round((float)$row['amount_budget'], 2);
        $tallyVal[$bid] = round(($tallyVal[$bid] ?? 0) + $lineVal, 2);
        if ($tallyVal[$bid] > $valLimit + PO_VEPS) {
            throw new PoBusinessError("PO {$pno}: {$name} nilai PO " . po_fmt($tallyVal[$bid]) . " melebihi sisa anggaran RAB baris ini (" . po_fmt($valLimit) . ").");
        }
    }
}
if (empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) { http_response_code(401); sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login ulang.'); }
$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';
$poAccess = (int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
$poRequired = 1;
if ($task === 'save_po') $poRequired = 2;
if ($task === 'change_status') $poRequired = 3;
if ($task === 'delete_po') $poRequired = 4;
if ($poAccess < $poRequired) { http_response_code(403); sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Hak akses tidak mencukupi untuk operasi purchase order ini.'); }
if (in_array($task, ['save_po','change_status','delete_po'], true) && ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== 'POST') { http_response_code(405); sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Metode harus POST untuk perubahan purchase order.'); }

            $st = $db->prepare($baseSql." AND CAST(:d AS date) BETWEEN h.start_date AND h.end_date ORDER BY h.start_date DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT 1");
            $st->execute([':cid'=>$cid, ':code'=>$code, ':d'=>$date]); $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC); $source='periode';

            if (!$r || $r['rate'] === null) sendJsonResponse(true, ['rate'=>null,'source'=>'none']);

        case 'list_rab_items':
            $prj = (int)($_REQUEST['project_id'] ?? 0); $excl = (int)($_REQUEST['po_id'] ?? 0);

            $base = po_base_currency($db); $pb = po_project_budget($db, $prj, $base);
            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT bi.id AS budget_item_id, bi.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(bi.unit,''),m.unit,'') AS unit, bi.qty_plan, COALESCE(bi.tolerance_pct,0) AS tolerance_pct, COALESCE(bi.unit_price_plan,0) AS unit_price_plan, COALESCE(bi.material_source,'COMPANY') AS material_source FROM public.budget_items bi JOIN public.materials m ON m.id=bi.material_id WHERE bi.project_id=:p AND bi.category='Material' AND COALESCE(bi.qty_plan,0)>0 ORDER BY m.material_name ASC");
            $st->execute([':p'=>$prj]);

            $stockMap = po_project_stock_map($db, $prj);   // [INVENTORY] stok yg dapat dipakai proyek ini
            $data = [];

                $vPlan=round($plan*(float)$r['unit_price_plan'],2); $vLimit=round($vPlan*(1+$tol/100),2); $vComm=$committed['map'][$bid]??0.0;
                $onHand = $stockMap[(int)$r['material_id']] ?? 0.0;   // [INVENTORY]

            }
            $summary = ['budget_currency_id'=>$pb['currency_id'],'budget_code'=>$pb['code'],'budget_is_base'=>$pb['is_base'],'base_code'=>$base['code'],'total_limit'=>$pb['total_limit'],'total_committed'=>$committed['total'],'ceiling'=>$pb['ceiling']];
            sendJsonResponse(true, $data, '', ['summary'=>$summary]); break;
        case 'list_pos':
            $base = po_base_currency($db);
            $start=(int)($_REQUEST['start']??0); $limit=(int)($_REQUEST['limit']??250); $query=trim($_REQUEST['query']??'');
            $where=''; $params=[];
            if ($query !== '') { $where="WHERE (po.po_number ILIKE :query OR p.name ILIKE :query OR s.name ILIKE :query)"; $params[':query']='%'.$query.'%'; }
            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders po JOIN public.projects p ON p.id=po.project_id LEFT JOIN public.m_suppliers s ON s.id=po.supplier_id {$where}"); $st->execute($params); $totalCount=(int)$st->fetchColumn();
            $dpp2 = po_sql_line_dpp('i2','po'); $fac2 = po_sql_budget_factor($base['id'],'po','p');
            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT po.id, po.po_number, po.po_date, po.project_id, p.name AS project_name, po.supplier_id, s.name AS supplier_name, po.status, po.notes, po.currency_id, c.init AS currency_code, po.exch_rate, po.ppn_mode, po.ppn_rate, COALESCE(po.budget_currency_id,p.budget_currency_id,{$base['id']}) AS budget_currency_id, bc.init AS budget_code, COUNT(i.id) AS item_count, COALESCE(SUM(i.qty*i.unit_price),0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(i.qty*i.unit_price,2)),0) AS subtotal_r, COALESCE((SELECT SUM({$dpp2}*{$fac2}) FROM po_items i2 WHERE i2.po_id=po.id),0) AS total_budget FROM purchase_orders po JOIN public.projects p ON p.id=po.project_id LEFT JOIN public.m_suppliers s ON s.id=po.supplier_id LEFT JOIN public.m_currency c ON c.id=po.currency_id LEFT JOIN public.m_currency bc ON bc.id=COALESCE(po.budget_currency_id,p.budget_currency_id,{$base['id']}) LEFT JOIN po_items i ON i.po_id=po.id {$where} GROUP BY po.id, p.name, s.name, c.init, bc.init, p.budget_currency_id, p.budget_exch_rate ORDER BY po.po_date DESC, po.id DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :start");
            foreach ($params as $k=>$v) $st->bindValue($k,$v);
            $st->bindValue(':limit',$limit,PDO::PARAM_INT); $st->bindValue(':start',$start,PDO::PARAM_INT); $st->execute();
            $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        case 'change_status':
            $id=(int)($_POST['id']??0); $to=(string)($_POST['to']??'');
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $st=$db->prepare("SELECT id, po_number, status, supplier_id, project_id, po_date, currency_id, budget_currency_id, budget_exch_rate, exch_rate FROM purchase_orders WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE"); $st->execute([':id'=>$id]); $po=$st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

                if (!in_array($to, PO_TRANSITIONS[$po['status']]??[], true)) throw new PoBusinessError("Status {$po['status']} tidak dapat diubah ke {$to}.");
                if (in_array($to,['Dibatalkan','Draft'],true) && po_received_total($db,$id)>PO_EPS) throw new PoBusinessError('PO ini sudah ada barang yang diterima (GRN), tidak dapat dibatalkan / dikembalikan ke Draft.');
                if (in_array($to,['Diajukan','Disetujui'],true)) {
                    // [PRERELEASE] validasi real-time di dalam transaksi ACID (header sudah FOR UPDATE):
                    // supplier aktif, periode akuntansi terbuka, integrity item, stok & kuota RAB dibaca ulang.
                    if (!$po['supplier_id']) throw new PoBusinessError('Supplier wajib diisi sebelum PO diajukan / disetujui.');
                    po_lock_project($db, (int)$po['project_id']);
                    po_release_validate($db, $po, po_base_currency($db));
                }
                $st=$db->prepare("UPDATE purchase_orders SET status=:s, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=:id"); $st->execute([':s'=>$to,':id'=>$id]);
                $db->commit(); sendJsonResponse(true, [], "PO {$po['po_number']} sekarang berstatus {$to}.");
            } catch (PoBusinessError $e) { if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack(); sendJsonResponse(false,[],$e->getMessage()); }
            catch (Throwable $e) { if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack(); throw $e; }

        case 'delete_po':
            $id=(int)($_POST['id']??0);
            $db->beginTransaction();

                $st=$db->prepare("SELECT po_number, status FROM purchase_orders WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE"); $st->execute([':id'=>$id]); $po=$st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$po) throw new PoBusinessError('PO tidak ditemukan.');
                if ($po['status']!=='Draft') throw new PoBusinessError('Hanya PO berstatus Draft yang dapat dihapus. Gunakan Batalkan untuk PO lain.');
                // Check for active GRN documents
                $grnCheck = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS grn_count
                                FROM grn_hdr
                                WHERE po_id = :id AND status IN ('posted', 'approved', 'released')");
                $grnCheck->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $grnCount = $grnCheck->fetchColumn();

                if ($grnCount > 0) {
                    throw new PoBusinessError('PO tidak dapat dibatalkan: sudah memiliki dokumen GRN aktif');
                }

                $st=$db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM grn_hdr WHERE po_id=:id"); $st->execute([':id'=>$id]);
                if ((int)$st->fetchColumn()>0) throw new PoBusinessError('PO sudah memiliki GRN, tidak dapat dihapus.');
                $db->prepare("DELETE FROM po_items WHERE po_id=:id")->execute([':id'=>$id]);
                $db->prepare("DELETE FROM purchase_orders WHERE id=:id")->execute([':id'=>$id]);
                $db->commit(); sendJsonResponse(true, [], "PO {$po['po_number']} dihapus.");
            } catch (PoBusinessError $e) { if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack(); sendJsonResponse(false,[],$e->getMessage()); }
            catch (Throwable $e) { if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack(); throw $e; }
            break;
        default: sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.'); break;
    }
} catch (PoBusinessError $e) { sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage()); }
catch (PDOException $e) { error_log('[poCRD] '.$e->getMessage()); sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Database Error: '.$e->getMessage()); }
catch (Throwable $e) { error_log('[poCRD] '.$e->getMessage()); sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'System Error: '.$e->getMessage()); }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.inventory.recon.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$db = new crud();

function sendJsonResponse($success, $data = [], $message = '') {
    $response = ['success' => $success, 'message' => $message];
    if ($success) { $response['data'] = $data; }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($response, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

if (empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login ulang.');
}

$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';
if ((int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < 1) { http_response_code(403); sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Hak baca rekonsiliasi persediaan tidak tersedia.'); }
if ($task === 'fix_missing_journals' && ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== 'POST') {
    http_response_code(405);
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Perbaikan jurnal wajib menggunakan POST.');
}

try {
    switch ($task) {
        case 'list_accounts':
            sendJsonResponse(true, ir_accounts($db));
            break;

        case 'reconcile':
            $asOf = (string)($_REQUEST['as_of'] ?? date('Y-m-d'));
            $accId = (int)($_REQUEST['account_id'] ?? 0);
            $res = ir_reconcile($db, $asOf, $accId);
            unset($res['fixes']);          // daftar internal untuk perbaikan, tidak perlu dikirim ke klien
            sendJsonResponse(true, $res);
            break;

        /* [PERBAIKAN] satu tombol: posting jurnal yang kurang untuk dokumen stok yang belum berjurnal */
        case 'fix_missing_journals':

            $accId = (int)($_POST['account_id'] ?? 0);
            $fx = ir_fix_missing($db, $asOf, $accId);
            sendJsonResponse(true, $fx, $fx['count'] > 0
                ? ($fx['count'] . ' jurnal diposting untuk: ' . implode(', ', $fx['posted']) . '.')
                : 'Tidak ada jurnal yang perlu diposting.');
            break;

        default:
            sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.');
            break;
    }
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[inventory.reconCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[inventory.reconCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());

        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Isi file bukan gambar yang sesuai.']);
        exit;
    }

  break;

    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Task tidak dikenali."]);

}

<?php
/**
 * subconCRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Backend Modul Subkontraktor (js/subcon.js, views/subcon.php). Pola sama dengan poCRD.php: PDO (class crud),
 * dispatch lewat $_REQUEST['task'], respons JSON {success, message, data, totalCount}. Migrasi: sql/2026-10-30.subcon.sql
 *
 * Rantai dokumen (semua bisa ditelusuri, tidak ada yang dihapus -- hanya Dibatalkan dengan alasan):
 *   Proyek -> (Task proyek) -> SPK (subcon_contracts) -> Prestasi (subcon_progress) -> Pembayaran (subcon_payments) -> Jurnal
 *
 * SPK     : Draft -> Diajukan -> Disetujui -> Selesai ; Dibatalkan dari Draft/Diajukan/Disetujui selama belum ada prestasi/pembayaran.
 *           Nilai SPK (DPP) dibagi ke task proyek (project_tasks); total pembagian wajib = nilai kontrak. Opsional terikat satu baris RAB:
 *           total SPK pada baris RAB itu tidak boleh melebihi nilai anggaran baris (qty_plan x unit_price_plan).
 * Prestasi: per periode, progres kumulatif % per task (tidak boleh turun, maks 100). Nilai periode = nilai task x (kum - sebelumnya)/100.
 *           PPN = nilai x tarif SPK ; PPh final dipotong = nilai x tarif ; retensi = nilai x % ; potongan uang muka proporsional
 *           (nilai x dp% , maks sisa uang muka; di progres 100% sisa uang muka dipotong semua) ;
 *           bayar = nilai + PPN - PPh - retensi - potongan uang muka.
 *           Hanya satu prestasi Draft per SPK. Disetujui = jurnal (Dr WIP 1700 / PPN Masukan 2400 ; Cr Hutang Subkon 2110 ;
 *           potongan: Dr 2110 / Cr Hutang PPh 2130, Hutang Retensi 2120, Uang Muka Subkon 1410). Batal hanya prestasi Disetujui TERAKHIR
 *           dan belum ada pembayaran.
 * Bayar   : DP (Dr 1410 / Cr kas-bank, <= uang muka SPK), PROGRESS (Dr 2110 / Cr kas-bank, <= sisa prestasi), RETENSI
 *           (Dr 2120 / Cr kas-bank, <= retensi ditahan, hanya setelah SPK Selesai). Batal = reverse jurnal.
 * Kontrol : SC_REQUIRE_OTHER_APPROVER=true -> penyetuju SPK / prestasi harus user lain selain pembuatnya.
 * Task    : list_project_options | list_subcontractors | save_subcontractor | list_project_tasks | list_budget_items | list_accounts |
 *           list_contracts | load_contract | save_contract | change_status | delete_contract | progress_prepare | save_progress |
 *           approve_progress | cancel_progress | save_payment | cancel_payment
 * ============================================================
 */

const SC_EPS = 0.01;
const SC_REQUIRE_OTHER_APPROVER = false;
const SC_REF_PROGRESS = 'subcon_progress';
const SC_REF_PAYMENT  = 'subcon_payment';
const SC_TRANSITIONS = [
    'Draft'      => ['Diajukan', 'Dibatalkan'],
    'Diajukan'   => ['Disetujui', 'Draft', 'Dibatalkan'],
    'Disetujui'  => ['Selesai', 'Dibatalkan'],
    'Selesai'    => [],
    'Dibatalkan' => [],
];

class ScError extends Exception {}

function sc_send($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $resp = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        $resp['data'] = $data;
        if (!isset($resp['totalCount'])) $resp['totalCount'] = is_array($data) ? count($data) : 0;    // totalCount dari $extra (paging) diutamakan
    }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($resp, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

function sc_f($v): float { return round((float)$v, 2); }
function sc_uid() { return isset($_SESSION['user_id']) ? (int)$_SESSION['user_id'] : null; }
function sc_date(string $d, string $label): string {
    $x = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $d);
    if (!$x || $x->format('Y-m-d') !== $d) throw new ScError($label . ' tidak valid (YYYY-MM-DD).');
    return $d;
}
function sc_pct($v, string $label): float {
    $p = round((float)$v, 2);
    if ($p < 0 || $p > 100) throw new ScError($label . ' harus antara 0 - 100.');
    return $p;
}

/** Pastikan enum reference_type jurnal memuat 'subcon_progress' & 'subcon_payment' (bila kolom berupa enum). */
function sc_assert_ref_types($db): void {
    $st = $db->query("SELECT t.typtype, t.oid FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = a.atttypid
                       WHERE c.relname = 'journal_entries' AND a.attname = 'reference_type' AND NOT a.attisdropped LIMIT 1");
    $r = $st ? $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) : false;
    if (!$r || $r['typtype'] !== 'e') return;
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT enumlabel FROM pg_enum WHERE enumtypid = :o");
    $st->execute([':o' => $r['oid']]);
    $have = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
    foreach ([SC_REF_PROGRESS, SC_REF_PAYMENT] as $need) {
        if (!in_array($need, $have, true)) {
            throw new ScError("Tipe jurnal '{$need}' belum terdaftar di database. Jalankan ALTER TYPE public.reference_type ADD VALUE untuk nilai itu (lihat spk.subcon.step1.sql) terlebih dahulu.");
        }
    }
}
/** Apakah kolom subcon_contracts.spk_id (tautan ke SPK subkon) sudah ada di database ini? */
function sc_has_spk_link($db): bool {
    static $ok = null;
    if ($ok === null) {
        $ok = (bool)$db->query("SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
                                 WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'subcon_contracts' AND column_name = 'spk_id' LIMIT 1")->fetchColumn();
    }
    return $ok;
}
function sc_has_journal($db, string $ref, int $id): bool {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries WHERE reference_type::text = :t AND reference_id = :id LIMIT 1");
    $st->execute([':t' => $ref, ':id' => $id]);
    return (bool)$st->fetchColumn();
}
function sc_post($db, string $rule, string $ref, int $id, string $date, float $amount, string $desc, ?int $creditAccountId = null): void {
    if ($amount <= 0.004) return;
    $p = ['rule_code' => $rule, 'reference_type' => $ref, 'reference_id' => $id, 'journal_date' => $date, 'amount' => $amount, 'description' => $desc];
    if ($creditAccountId) $p['credit_account_id'] = $creditAccountId;
    $r = AutoPostJournal($db, $p);
    if (!$r['success']) throw new ScError('Gagal posting jurnal ' . $rule . ': ' . $r['message']);
}

function sc_contract($db, int $id, bool $lock = false): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM subcon_contracts WHERE id = :id" . ($lock ? ' FOR UPDATE' : ''));
    $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
    $c = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$c) throw new ScError('SPK tidak ditemukan.');
    foreach (['contract_value', 'ppn_rate', 'pph_rate', 'retention_pct', 'dp_pct'] as $k) $c[$k] = (float)$c[$k];
    return $c;
}

/** Total prestasi disetujui & pembayaran posted untuk satu SPK (dasar sisa uang muka, retensi, hutang). */
function sc_totals($db, int $cid): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gross_amount),0) g, COALESCE(SUM(ppn_amount),0) ppn, COALESCE(SUM(pph_amount),0) pph,
                               COALESCE(SUM(retention_amount),0) ret, COALESCE(SUM(dp_recovery),0) dprec, COALESCE(SUM(net_payable),0) net
                          FROM subcon_progress WHERE contract_id = :c AND status = 'Disetujui'");
    $st->execute([':c' => $cid]);
    $t = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_type='DP' THEN amount END),0) dp, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_type='PROGRESS' THEN amount END),0) pr,
                               COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_type='RETENSI' THEN amount END),0) rt
                          FROM subcon_payments WHERE contract_id = :c AND status = 'Posted'");
    $st->execute([':c' => $cid]);
    $p = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    $o = ['gross' => sc_f($t['g']), 'ppn' => sc_f($t['ppn']), 'pph' => sc_f($t['pph']), 'retention' => sc_f($t['ret']),
          'dp_recovered' => sc_f($t['dprec']), 'net' => sc_f($t['net']),
          'dp_paid' => sc_f($p['dp']), 'progress_paid' => sc_f($p['pr']), 'retention_paid' => sc_f($p['rt'])];
    $o['dp_balance']        = sc_f($o['dp_paid'] - $o['dp_recovered']);        // uang muka yang belum dipotong
    $o['retention_balance'] = sc_f($o['retention'] - $o['retention_paid']);    // retensi ditahan, belum dilepas
    $o['payable_balance']   = sc_f($o['net'] - $o['progress_paid']);           // hutang prestasi belum dibayar
    return $o;
}

/** Progres kumulatif sebelumnya (disetujui) per baris task SPK. */
function sc_prev_map($db, int $cid, int $exclProgressId = 0): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT d.contract_task_id, MAX(d.cum_pct) AS m FROM subcon_progress_dtl d JOIN subcon_progress p ON p.id = d.progress_id
                         WHERE p.contract_id = :c AND p.status = 'Disetujui' AND p.id <> :x GROUP BY d.contract_task_id");
    $st->execute([':c' => $cid, ':x' => $exclProgressId]);
    $m = [];
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) $m[(int)$r['contract_task_id']] = (float)$r['m'];
    return $m;
}

/** Hitung PPN, PPh, retensi, potongan uang muka dan nilai bayar satu prestasi. */
function sc_calc(array $c, float $gross, float $cumPct, float $dpBalance): array {
    $ppn = round($gross * $c['ppn_rate'] / 100, 2);
    $pph = round($gross * $c['pph_rate'] / 100, 2);
    $ret = round($gross * $c['retention_pct'] / 100, 2);
    $plan = round($gross * $c['dp_pct'] / 100, 2);
    $dpRec = ($cumPct >= 99.999) ? $dpBalance : min($dpBalance, $plan);       // progres 100% -> sisa uang muka dipotong semua
    $dpRec = max(0.0, round($dpRec, 2));
    $net = round($gross + $ppn - $pph - $ret - $dpRec, 2);
    if ($net < 0) { $dpRec = max(0.0, round($dpRec + $net, 2)); $net = round($gross + $ppn - $pph - $ret - $dpRec, 2); }
    return ['ppn' => $ppn, 'pph' => $pph, 'retention' => $ret, 'dp_recovery' => $dpRec, 'net' => $net];
}

/* =====================================================================================================
 * [2026-11-11] Klaim berbasis KUANTITAS + INSPEKSI  (Langkah 2, docs/SUBCONTRACT_MANAGEMENT_DESIGN.md)
 *   Task kontrak dipetakan 1:1 ke item lingkup SPK (spk_work_items). Untuk task terpetakan, prestasi diisi dengan
 *   QTY klaim (bukan persen). Inspeksi meloloskan / menolak / meminta perbaikan per baris; hanya qty LOLOS yang
 *   membentuk progres, nilai prestasi, jurnal dan hutang. Task tanpa pemetaan tetap memakai persen seperti sebelumnya.
 * ===================================================================================================== */
function sc_has_qty($db): bool {
    static $ok = null;
    if ($ok === null) {
        $v = $db->query("SELECT to_regclass('public.subcon_inspections') IS NOT NULL
                            AND to_regclass('public.subcon_progress_qty_items') IS NOT NULL
                            AND to_regclass('public.spk_work_items') IS NOT NULL
                            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public'
                                         AND table_name = 'subcon_contract_tasks' AND column_name = 'work_item_id')")->fetchColumn();
        $ok = ($v === true || $v === 't' || $v === 1 || $v === '1');
    }
    return $ok;
}

/** Qty yang sudah DITERIMA (lolos inspeksi, prestasi Disetujui) per item lingkup pada satu kontrak. */
function sc_accepted_map($db, int $cid, int $exclProgressId = 0): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT q.work_item_id, COALESCE(SUM(ii.qty_passed), 0) AS passed
                          FROM subcon_inspection_items ii
                          JOIN subcon_inspections i ON i.id = ii.inspection_id AND i.status = 'APPROVED'
                          JOIN subcon_progress_qty_items q ON q.id = ii.progress_qty_item_id
                          JOIN subcon_progress p ON p.id = q.progress_id AND p.contract_id = :c AND p.status = 'Disetujui' AND p.id <> :x
                         GROUP BY q.work_item_id");
    $st->execute([':c' => $cid, ':x' => $exclProgressId]);
    $m = [];
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) $m[(int)$r['work_item_id']] = (float)$r['passed'];
    return $m;
}

/** Task kontrak yang terpetakan ke item lingkup: contract_task_id => info item. */
function sc_task_work_map($db, int $cid): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT t.id AS tid, t.task_name, t.work_item_id, w.work_code, w.description, w.unit, w.contract_qty, w.unit_price
                          FROM subcon_contract_tasks t JOIN spk_work_items w ON w.id = t.work_item_id WHERE t.contract_id = :c");
    $st->execute([':c' => $cid]);
    $m = [];
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) {
        $r['work_item_id'] = (int)$r['work_item_id']; $r['contract_qty'] = (float)$r['contract_qty']; $r['unit_price'] = (float)$r['unit_price'];
        $m[(int)$r['tid']] = $r;
    }
    return $m;
}

function sc_insp_result(float $claimed, float $inspected, float $passed, float $rejected, float $rework): string {
    $e = 0.00005;
    if ($inspected <= $e) return 'PENDING';
    if ($passed >= $claimed - $e) return 'PASS';
    if ($passed > $e) return 'PARTIAL';
    return ($rework > $e) ? 'REWORK' : 'REJECT';
}

/** Hitung ulang baris task terpetakan + header satu prestasi Draft. $usePassed=true -> dasar qty LOLOS inspeksi; false -> qty KLAIM. */
function sc_recompute_progress($db, array $c, int $pid, bool $usePassed): array {
    $cid  = (int)$c['id'];
    $acc  = sc_accepted_map($db, $cid, $pid);
    $prev = sc_prev_map($db, $cid, $pid);
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT q.contract_task_id, q.work_item_id, q.qty_claimed, q.unit_price_snapshot, w.contract_qty,
                               COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ii.qty_passed) FROM subcon_inspection_items ii
                                           JOIN subcon_inspections i ON i.id = ii.inspection_id AND i.status = 'APPROVED'
                                          WHERE ii.progress_qty_item_id = q.id), 0) AS passed
                          FROM subcon_progress_qty_items q JOIN spk_work_items w ON w.id = q.work_item_id WHERE q.progress_id = :p");
    $st->execute([':p' => $pid]);
    $upd = $db->prepare("UPDATE subcon_progress_dtl SET cum_pct = :c, amount = :a WHERE progress_id = :p AND contract_task_id = :t");
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $q) {
        $tid = (int)$q['contract_task_id']; $wi = (int)$q['work_item_id'];
        $qty = $usePassed ? (float)$q['passed'] : (float)$q['qty_claimed'];
        $cq  = (float)$q['contract_qty'];
        $pv  = isset($prev[$tid]) ? $prev[$tid] : 0.0;
        $prior = isset($acc[$wi]) ? $acc[$wi] : 0.0;
        $cum = ($qty > 0 && $cq > 0) ? min(100.0, round(($prior + $qty) / $cq * 100, 3)) : $pv;
        $amt = round($qty * (float)$q['unit_price_snapshot'], 2);
        $upd->execute([':c' => $cum, ':a' => $amt, ':p' => $pid, ':t' => $tid]);
    }
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS g, COALESCE(SUM(t.task_value * d.cum_pct / 100), 0) AS w
                          FROM subcon_progress_dtl d JOIN subcon_contract_tasks t ON t.id = d.contract_task_id WHERE d.progress_id = :p");
    $st->execute([':p' => $pid]);
    $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    $gross  = sc_f($r['g']);
    $cumPct = $c['contract_value'] > 0 ? round((float)$r['w'] / $c['contract_value'] * 100, 3) : 0;
    $tot  = sc_totals($db, $cid);
    $calc = sc_calc($c, $gross, $cumPct, $tot['dp_balance']);
    $db->prepare("UPDATE subcon_progress SET gross_amount = :g, ppn_amount = :ppn, pph_amount = :pph, retention_amount = :ret,
                         dp_recovery = :dp, net_payable = :net, cum_pct = :cp, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = :id")
       ->execute([':g' => $gross, ':ppn' => $calc['ppn'], ':pph' => $calc['pph'], ':ret' => $calc['retention'], ':dp' => $calc['dp_recovery'],
                  ':net' => $calc['net'], ':cp' => $cumPct, ':id' => $pid]);
    return ['gross' => $gross, 'cum_pct' => $cumPct, 'calc' => $calc];
}

} elseif ($task === 'cancel_payment') {
    $scRequired = 4;
} elseif ($task === 'delete_contract') {
    $scRequired = 4;
}
if ($scAccess < $scRequired) {
    http_response_code(403);
    sc_send(false, [], 'Hak akses tidak mencukupi untuk operasi subkontraktor ini.');
}

try {
    switch ($task) {

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ master untuk combo */
        case 'list_project_options':
            $rows = $db->query("SELECT id, name FROM public.projects ORDER BY name ASC")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) $r['id'] = (int)$r['id'];
            unset($r);
            sc_send(true, $rows);
            break;

        case 'list_subcontractors':
            $rows = $db->query("SELECT id, name, npwp_no, is_pkp, pph_rate FROM public.subcontractors WHERE active ORDER BY name ASC")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) { $r['id'] = (int)$r['id']; $r['pph_rate'] = (float)$r['pph_rate']; }
            unset($r);
            sc_send(true, $rows);
            break;

        case 'save_subcontractor':
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $name = trim((string)($_POST['name'] ?? ''));
            if ($name === '') throw new ScError('Nama subkontraktor wajib diisi.');
            $pph = sc_pct($_POST['pph_rate'] ?? 0, 'Tarif PPh');
            $v = [':name' => $name, ':npwp' => trim((string)($_POST['npwp_no'] ?? '')) ?: null,
                  ':pkp' => (($_POST['is_pkp'] ?? '') === '1' || ($_POST['is_pkp'] ?? '') === 'true') ? 't' : 'f',
                  ':cp' => trim((string)($_POST['contact_person'] ?? '')) ?: null, ':ph' => trim((string)($_POST['phone'] ?? '')) ?: null,
                  ':ad' => trim((string)($_POST['address'] ?? '')) ?: null, ':bn' => trim((string)($_POST['bank_name'] ?? '')) ?: null,
                  ':ba' => trim((string)($_POST['bank_account_no'] ?? '')) ?: null, ':bh' => trim((string)($_POST['bank_account_name'] ?? '')) ?: null,
                  ':pph' => $pph];
            if ($id > 0) {
                $v[':id'] = $id;
                $db->prepare("UPDATE subcontractors SET name=:name, npwp_no=:npwp, is_pkp=:pkp, contact_person=:cp, phone=:ph, address=:ad,
                                     bank_name=:bn, bank_account_no=:ba, bank_account_name=:bh, pph_rate=:pph WHERE id=:id")->execute($v);
            } else {
                $st = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO subcontractors (name, npwp_no, is_pkp, contact_person, phone, address, bank_name, bank_account_no, bank_account_name, pph_rate)
                                    VALUES (:name,:npwp,:pkp,:cp,:ph,:ad,:bn,:ba,:bh,:pph) RETURNING id");
                $st->execute($v);
                $id = (int)$st->fetchColumn();
            }
            sc_send(true, ['id' => $id], 'Subkontraktor tersimpan.');
            break;

        case 'list_project_tasks':
            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, task_name, start_date, end_date FROM public.project_tasks WHERE project_id = :p ORDER BY start_date ASC, id ASC");
            $st->execute([':p' => (int)($_REQUEST['project_id'] ?? 0)]);
            $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) $r['id'] = (int)$r['id'];
            unset($r);
            sc_send(true, $rows);
            break;

        // Baris RAB non-material proyek (upah / subkon / lainnya) + sisa anggarannya
        case 'list_budget_items':
            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT bi.id, bi.item_name, bi.category, COALESCE(bi.qty_plan,0) * COALESCE(bi.unit_price_plan,0) AS budget_value,
                                       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.contract_value) FROM subcon_contracts c WHERE c.budget_item_id = bi.id
                                                  AND c.status <> 'Dibatalkan' AND c.id <> :x), 0) AS committed
                                  FROM public.budget_items bi WHERE bi.project_id = :p AND bi.category <> 'Material' ORDER BY bi.item_name");
            $st->execute([':p' => (int)($_REQUEST['project_id'] ?? 0), ':x' => (int)($_REQUEST['contract_id'] ?? 0)]);
            $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                $r['id'] = (int)$r['id']; $r['budget_value'] = sc_f($r['budget_value']); $r['committed'] = sc_f($r['committed']);
                $r['remaining'] = sc_f($r['budget_value'] - $r['committed']);
                $r['label'] = $r['item_name'] . ' (' . $r['category'] . ') - sisa ' . number_format($r['remaining'], 2);
            }
            unset($r);
            array_unshift($rows, ['id' => 0, 'item_name' => '', 'category' => '', 'budget_value' => 0, 'committed' => 0, 'remaining' => 0, 'label' => '(tanpa baris RAB)']);
            sc_send(true, $rows);
            break;

        case 'list_accounts':
            $rows = $db->query("SELECT id, account_code, account_name FROM public.chart_of_accounts
                                 WHERE account_type::text IN ('cash','bank') AND is_active ORDER BY account_code")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) { $r['id'] = (int)$r['id']; $r['label'] = $r['account_code'] . ' - ' . $r['account_name']; }
            unset($r);
            sc_send(true, $rows);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ daftar SPK (grid utama) */
        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ SPK subkon yang bisa ditautkan ke kontrak */
        case 'list_spk_options':
            $oPrj = (int)($_REQUEST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            $oSub = (int)($_REQUEST['subcontractor_id'] ?? 0);
            $oCur = (int)($_REQUEST['contract_id'] ?? 0);
            if (!sc_has_spk_link($db) || $oPrj <= 0 || $oSub <= 0) { sc_send(true, []); break; }
            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT s.id, s.spk_no, s.spk_date, s.status, COALESCE(s.description, '') AS description
                                  FROM spk s
                                 WHERE s.spk_type = 'SUBCON' AND s.project_id = :p AND s.execution_subcontractor_id = :s
                                   AND s.status IN ('Draft', 'Diterbitkan')
                                   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subcon_contracts c WHERE c.spk_id = s.id AND c.id <> :c)
                                 ORDER BY s.spk_date DESC, s.id DESC");
            $st->execute([':p' => $oPrj, ':s' => $oSub, ':c' => $oCur]);
            $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) { $r['id'] = (int)$r['id']; }
            unset($r);
            sc_send(true, $rows);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ item lingkup SPK untuk pemetaan task kontrak */
        case 'list_work_items':
            $wSpk = (int)($_REQUEST['spk_id'] ?? 0);
            if (!sc_has_qty($db) || $wSpk <= 0) { sc_send(true, []); break; }
            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT w.id, w.work_code, w.description, w.unit, w.contract_qty, w.unit_price, w.line_amount, w.project_task_id
                                  FROM spk_work_items w WHERE w.spk_id = :s AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY w.sort_order, w.id");
            $st->execute([':s' => $wSpk]);
            $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                $r['id'] = (int)$r['id']; $r['contract_qty'] = (float)$r['contract_qty']; $r['unit_price'] = (float)$r['unit_price'];
                $r['line_amount'] = (float)$r['line_amount']; $r['project_task_id'] = $r['project_task_id'] !== null ? (int)$r['project_task_id'] : null;
            }
            unset($r);
            sc_send(true, $rows);
            break;

        case 'list_contracts':
            $start = (int)($_REQUEST['start'] ?? 0);
            $limit = (int)($_REQUEST['limit'] ?? 250);
            $query = trim($_REQUEST['query'] ?? '');
            $where = ''; $params = [];
            if ($query !== '') {
                $where = "WHERE (c.spk_no ILIKE :q OR c.title ILIKE :q OR p.name ILIKE :q OR s.name ILIKE :q)";
                $params[':q'] = '%' . $query . '%';
            }
            $hasLink = sc_has_spk_link($db);
            $lx = $hasLink ? "c.spk_id, ls.spk_no AS linked_spk_no, ls.status AS linked_spk_status,"
                           : "NULL::int AS spk_id, NULL::text AS linked_spk_no, NULL::text AS linked_spk_status,";
            $jx = $hasLink ? "LEFT JOIN spk ls ON ls.id = c.spk_id" : "";
            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subcon_contracts c JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = c.project_id
                                  JOIN subcontractors s ON s.id = c.subcontractor_id {$where}");
            $st->execute($params);
            $total = (int)$st->fetchColumn();

            $st = $db->prepare("
                SELECT c.id, c.spk_no, c.project_id, p.name AS project_name, c.subcontractor_id, s.name AS subcontractor_name, c.title,
                       c.contract_value, c.ppn_rate, c.pph_rate, c.retention_pct, c.dp_pct, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.status,
                       {$lx}
                       COALESCE(pr.gross,0) AS billed_gross, COALESCE(pr.net,0) AS billed_net, COALESCE(pr.ret,0) AS retention_held,
                       COALESCE(pay.dp,0) AS dp_paid, COALESCE(pay.pr,0) AS progress_paid, COALESCE(pay.rt,0) AS retention_paid
                  FROM subcon_contracts c
                  JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = c.project_id
                  JOIN subcontractors s ON s.id = c.subcontractor_id
                  {$jx}
                  LEFT JOIN (SELECT contract_id, SUM(gross_amount) gross, SUM(net_payable) net, SUM(retention_amount) ret
                               FROM subcon_progress WHERE status = 'Disetujui' GROUP BY contract_id) pr ON pr.contract_id = c.id
                  LEFT JOIN (SELECT contract_id, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_type='DP' THEN amount END) dp, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_type='PROGRESS' THEN amount END) pr,
                                    SUM(CASE WHEN pay_type='RETENSI' THEN amount END) rt
                               FROM subcon_payments WHERE status = 'Posted' GROUP BY contract_id) pay ON pay.contract_id = c.id
                  {$where}
                 ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :start");
            foreach ($params as $k => $v) $st->bindValue($k, $v);
            $st->bindValue(':limit', $limit, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $st->bindValue(':start', $start, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $st->execute();
            $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                $r['id'] = (int)$r['id']; $r['project_id'] = (int)$r['project_id']; $r['subcontractor_id'] = (int)$r['subcontractor_id'];
                foreach (['contract_value', 'ppn_rate', 'pph_rate', 'retention_pct', 'dp_pct', 'billed_gross', 'billed_net', 'retention_held', 'dp_paid', 'progress_paid', 'retention_paid'] as $k) $r[$k] = (float)$r[$k];
                $r['progress_pct'] = $r['contract_value'] > 0 ? round($r['billed_gross'] / $r['contract_value'] * 100, 2) : 0;
                $r['payable_balance'] = sc_f($r['billed_net'] - $r['progress_paid']);
            }
            unset($r);
            sc_send(true, $rows, '', ['totalCount' => $total]);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ detail SPK (panel detail) */
        case 'load_contract':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $c = sc_contract($db, $id);
            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT c.*, p.name AS project_name, s.name AS subcontractor_name, s.npwp_no, s.is_pkp,
                                       bi.item_name AS budget_item_name, cu.login_name AS created_by_name, au.login_name AS approved_by_name,
                                       xu.login_name AS cancelled_by_name, zu.login_name AS closed_by_name
                                  FROM subcon_contracts c JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = c.project_id JOIN subcontractors s ON s.id = c.subcontractor_id
                                  LEFT JOIN public.budget_items bi ON bi.id = c.budget_item_id
                                  LEFT JOIN public.m_user_system cu ON cu.id = c.created_by LEFT JOIN public.m_user_system au ON au.id = c.approved_by
                                  LEFT JOIN public.m_user_system xu ON xu.id = c.cancelled_by LEFT JOIN public.m_user_system zu ON zu.id = c.closed_by
                                 WHERE c.id = :id");
            $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $hdr = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            $hdr['linked_spk_no'] = null; $hdr['linked_spk_status'] = null;
            if (!empty($hdr['spk_id'])) {
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT spk_no, status FROM spk WHERE id = :i");
                $st->execute([':i' => (int)$hdr['spk_id']]);
                $ls = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if ($ls) { $hdr['linked_spk_no'] = $ls['spk_no']; $hdr['linked_spk_status'] = $ls['status']; }
            }

            $prev = sc_prev_map($db, $id);
            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT t.id, t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_value, t.notes, pt.start_date, pt.end_date
                                  FROM subcon_contract_tasks t LEFT JOIN public.project_tasks pt ON pt.id = t.task_id
                                 WHERE t.contract_id = :id ORDER BY pt.start_date NULLS LAST, t.id");
            $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $tasks = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($tasks as &$t) {
                $t['id'] = (int)$t['id']; $t['task_id'] = $t['task_id'] !== null ? (int)$t['task_id'] : null; $t['task_value'] = (float)$t['task_value'];
                $t['cum_pct'] = isset($prev[$t['id']]) ? $prev[$t['id']] : 0.0;
                $t['billed_amount'] = sc_f($t['task_value'] * $t['cum_pct'] / 100);
            }
            unset($t);
            $hasQty = sc_has_qty($db);
            if ($hasQty) {
                $wm = sc_task_work_map($db, $id);
                foreach ($tasks as &$t) {
                    $t['work_item_id'] = null; $t['work_code'] = null; $t['unit'] = null; $t['contract_qty'] = null; $t['unit_price'] = null; $t['accepted_qty'] = null;
                    if (isset($wm[$t['id']])) {
                        $w = $wm[$t['id']];
                        $t['work_item_id'] = $w['work_item_id']; $t['work_code'] = $w['work_code']; $t['unit'] = $w['unit'];
                        $t['contract_qty'] = $w['contract_qty']; $t['unit_price'] = $w['unit_price'];
                    }
                }
                unset($t);
                $accAll = sc_accepted_map($db, $id);
                foreach ($tasks as &$t) { if ($t['work_item_id']) $t['accepted_qty'] = isset($accAll[$t['work_item_id']]) ? $accAll[$t['work_item_id']] : 0.0; }
                unset($t);
            }

            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT p.*, cu.login_name AS created_by_name, au.login_name AS approved_by_name,
                                       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(y.amount) FROM subcon_payments y WHERE y.progress_id = p.id AND y.status = 'Posted'), 0) AS paid_amount
                                  FROM subcon_progress p LEFT JOIN public.m_user_system cu ON cu.id = p.created_by LEFT JOIN public.m_user_system au ON au.id = p.approved_by
                                 WHERE p.contract_id = :id ORDER BY p.id");
            $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $progress = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($progress as &$p) {
                $p['id'] = (int)$p['id'];
                foreach (['gross_amount', 'ppn_amount', 'pph_amount', 'retention_amount', 'dp_recovery', 'net_payable', 'cum_pct', 'paid_amount'] as $k) $p[$k] = (float)$p[$k];
                $p['qty_lines'] = 0; $p['insp_status'] = null;
            }
            unset($p);
            $inspections = [];
            if ($hasQty && count($progress)) {
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT q.progress_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM subcon_progress_qty_items q JOIN subcon_progress p ON p.id = q.progress_id WHERE p.contract_id = :c GROUP BY q.progress_id");
                $st->execute([':c' => $id]);
                $qn = []; foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) $qn[(int)$r['progress_id']] = (int)$r['n'];
