<?php
/**
 * subcon.progressCRD.php
 * [FINAL 2026-11-13] 100% compatible dengan struktur database aktual:
 * - subcon_inspections (inspection_no, progress_id, status: DRAFT/APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED)
 * - subcon_inspection_items (progress_qty_item_id, qty_inspected, qty_passed, qty_rejected, qty_rework, result)
 * - subcon_progress_qty_items (progress_id, contract_task_id, work_item_id, qty_claimed, unit_price_snapshot)
 * - spk_work_items (spk_id, project_task_id, work_code, description, unit, contract_qty, unit_price, material_supply)
 *
 * Aturan: No Inspection, No Payment. Trigger DB sudah memvalidasi qty.
 */
require_once '../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once '../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login ulang.']);
    exit;
}

$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';
$db = new crud();
$userId = (int)$_SESSION['user_id'];

// [SECURITY PATCH] Otorisasi operasi per task. FormAccess (menu access) saja
// TIDAK cukup -- setiap aksi dicek levelnya: list/read=1, simpan draft=2,
// ubah item/approve=3. (Pola sama dengan modul subkon lainnya.)
$scRequiredAccess = array(
    'list_inspections'     => 1,
    'load_inspection'      => 1,
    'save_progress_draft'  => 2,
    'update_inspection_items' => 3,
    'approve_inspection'   => 3,
);
if (isset($scRequiredAccess[$task]) && (int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < $scRequiredAccess[$task]) {
    http_response_code(403);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Hak akses tidak mencukupi untuk operasi inspeksi ini.']);
    exit;
}

try {
    switch ($task) {
        case 'list_inspections':
            $spk_id = (int)($_GET['spk_id'] ?? 0);
            $progress_id = (int)($_GET['progress_id'] ?? 0);
            $status = $_GET['status'] ?? '';
            
            $where = []; $params = [];
            if ($spk_id > 0) { $where[] = "sp.spk_id = :spk_id"; $params[':spk_id'] = $spk_id; }
            if ($progress_id > 0) { $where[] = "si.progress_id = :progress_id"; $params[':progress_id'] = $progress_id; }
            if ($status !== '') { $where[] = "si.status = :status"; $params[':status'] = $status; }
            $where_sql = !empty($where) ? 'WHERE ' . implode(' AND ', $where) : '';
            
            $st = $db->prepare("
                SELECT si.*, sp.spk_id, sp.progress_no, sp.progress_date,
                       sc.contract_no, s.subcon_name
                FROM subcon_inspections si
                JOIN subcon_progress sp ON sp.id = si.progress_id
                JOIN subcon_contracts sc ON sc.id = sp.contract_id
                JOIN subcontractors s ON s.id = sc.subcontractor_id
                {$where_sql}
                ORDER BY si.inspection_date DESC, si.id DESC
            ");
            $st->execute($params);
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
            break;

        case 'load_inspection':
            $inspection_id = (int)($_GET['id'] ?? 0);
            if ($inspection_id <= 0) { echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID tidak valid.']); break; }
            
            $hdr = $db->query("
                SELECT si.*, sp.spk_id, sp.progress_no, sp.progress_date,
                       sc.contract_no, sc.contract_value, s.subcon_name
                FROM subcon_inspections si
                JOIN subcon_progress sp ON sp.id = si.progress_id
                JOIN subcon_contracts sc ON sc.id = sp.contract_id
                JOIN subcontractors s ON s.id = sc.subcontractor_id
                WHERE si.id = {$inspection_id}
            ")->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            
            $dtl = $db->query("
                SELECT sii.*, 
                       spqi.qty_claimed, spqi.unit_price_snapshot, spqi.amount_claimed,
                       swi.work_code, swi.description as work_description, swi.unit,
                       swi.contract_qty as work_contract_qty
                FROM subcon_inspection_items sii
                JOIN subcon_progress_qty_items spqi ON spqi.id = sii.progress_qty_item_id
                JOIN spk_work_items swi ON swi.id = spqi.work_item_id
                WHERE sii.inspection_id = {$inspection_id}
                ORDER BY sii.id ASC
            ")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => ['header' => $hdr, 'items' => $dtl]]);
            break;

        case 'save_progress_draft':
            $progress_id = (int)($_POST['progress_id'] ?? 0);
            $inspection_date = $_POST['inspection_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
            $items = json_decode($_POST['items'] ?? '[]', true);

            if ($progress_id <= 0 || empty($items)) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Progress ID dan item wajib diisi.']);
                break;
            }

            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $inspection_no = 'INS-' . date('Ymd') . '-' . str_pad((string)mt_rand(1, 9999), 4, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
                
                $stmt = $db->prepare("
                    INSERT INTO subcon_inspections 
                    (inspection_no, progress_id, inspection_date, status, created_by, created_at)
                    VALUES (:no, :pid, :date, 'DRAFT', :uid, NOW())
                    RETURNING id
                ");
                $stmt->execute([':no' => $inspection_no, ':pid' => $progress_id, ':date' => $inspection_date, ':uid' => $userId]);
                $inspection_id = (int)$stmt->fetchColumn();

                $stmt_item = $db->prepare("
                    INSERT INTO subcon_inspection_items 
                    (inspection_id, progress_qty_item_id, qty_inspected, qty_passed, qty_rejected, qty_rework, result)
                    VALUES (:iid, :pqii, :qi, 0, 0, 0, 'PENDING')
                ");

                foreach ($items as $item) {
                    $pqii = (int)($item['progress_qty_item_id'] ?? 0);
                    $qi = (float)($item['qty_inspected'] ?? 0);
                    if ($pqii > 0 && $qi > 0) {
                        $stmt_item->execute([':iid' => $inspection_id, ':pqii' => $pqii, ':qi' => $qi]);
                    }
                }

                $db->commit();
                echo json_encode([
                    'success' => true, 
                    'inspection_id' => $inspection_id,
                    'inspection_no' => $inspection_no,
                    'message' => 'Draft inspeksi berhasil dibuat.'
                ]);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        case 'update_inspection_items':
            $inspection_id = (int)($_POST['inspection_id'] ?? 0);
            $items = json_decode($_POST['items'] ?? '[]', true);
            
            if ($inspection_id <= 0 || empty($items)) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Data tidak valid.']);
                break;
            }
            
            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT status FROM subcon_inspections WHERE id = :id");
            $st->execute([':id' => $inspection_id]);
            if ($st->fetchColumn() !== 'DRAFT') {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Hanya inspeksi DRAFT yang bisa diubah.']);
                break;
            }
            
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $stmt_upd = $db->prepare("
                    UPDATE subcon_inspection_items 
                    SET qty_passed = :qp, qty_rejected = :qr, qty_rework = :qw,
                        result = :res, notes = :notes
                    WHERE id = :id AND inspection_id = :iid
                ");
                
                foreach ($items as $item) {
                    $qp = (float)($item['qty_passed'] ?? 0);
                    $qr = (float)($item['qty_rejected'] ?? 0);
                    $qw = (float)($item['qty_rework'] ?? 0);
                    
                    $result = 'PENDING';
                    if ($qp > 0 && $qr == 0 && $qw == 0) $result = 'PASS';
                    elseif ($qp > 0 && ($qr > 0 || $qw > 0)) $result = 'PARTIAL';
                    elseif ($qr > 0) $result = 'REJECT';
                    elseif ($qw > 0) $result = 'REWORK';
                    
                    $stmt_upd->execute([
                        ':qp' => $qp, ':qr' => $qr, ':qw' => $qw,
                        ':res' => $result, ':notes' => $item['notes'] ?? '',
                        ':id' => (int)$item['id'], ':iid' => $inspection_id
                    ]);
                }
                
                $db->commit();
                echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Item inspeksi diperbarui.']);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        case 'approve_inspection':
            $inspection_id = (int)($_POST['inspection_id'] ?? 0);
            $status = $_POST['status'] ?? '';
            
            if ($inspection_id <= 0 || !in_array($status, ['APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED'])) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Data tidak valid.']);
                break;
            }
            
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT status FROM subcon_inspections WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $st->execute([':id' => $inspection_id]);
                if ($st->fetchColumn() !== 'DRAFT') {
                    throw new Exception('Hanya inspeksi DRAFT yang bisa di-approve.');
                }
                
                if ($status === 'APPROVED') {
                    $stmt = $db->prepare("
                        UPDATE subcon_inspections 
                        SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_by = :uid, approved_at = NOW()
                        WHERE id = :id
                    ");
                    $stmt->execute([':uid' => $userId, ':id' => $inspection_id]);
                } else {
                    $reason = trim($_POST['cancel_reason'] ?? '');
                    if ($reason === '') throw new Exception('Alasan penolakan wajib diisi.');
                    $stmt = $db->prepare("
                        UPDATE subcon_inspections 
                        SET status = :st, cancelled_by = :uid, cancelled_at = NOW(), cancel_reason = :r
                        WHERE id = :id
                    ");
                    $stmt->execute([':st' => $status, ':uid' => $userId, ':r' => $reason, ':id' => $inspection_id]);
                }
                
                $db->commit();
                echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Inspeksi {$status}."]);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        default:
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
    }
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[subcon.progressCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
}

/**
 * ppn_backfillCRD.php  --  SKRIP SEKALI PAKAI (hapus dari server setelah selesai)

 * Memperbaiki tagihan termin (project_invoices) lama yang tersimpan TANPA PPN sehingga Laporan PPN kosong.

 *   dpp = amount / (1 + tarif/100) ; ppn = amount - dpp ; amount (total tagihan) TIDAK berubah
 *   -> alokasi pembayaran, sisa tagihan, dan piutang tidak bergeser.
 *   Tarif = projects.ppn_rate. Proyek bertarif 0 dilewati.
 * Yang diubah per tagihan (dalam satu transaksi, gagal = batal semua):
 *   1. project_invoices : dpp_amount, ppn_rate, ppn_amount
 *   2. jurnal penagihan : reverse jurnal lama (reference_type 'project_invoice'), posting ulang
 *                         PROJECT_INVOICE (DPP) + PROJECT_INVOICE_PPN (PPN), tanggal = tgl invoice
 *   3. projects.ppn_inclusive = true untuk proyek yang tertagih (agar Master Proyek konsisten dengan Opsi A)
 * Yang dilewati: tagihan yang sudah punya PPN (ppn_amount > 0) atau proyek bertarif 0.
 *
 * Task : preview (GET/POST, hanya baca)  |  run (POST, wajib confirm=YA)
 * Param: project_id (opsional, 0 = semua proyek yang memenuhi syarat)
 * Respons JSON standar {success, message, data, totalCount}.

const BF_JOURNAL_REF = 'project_invoice';          // sama dengan project_paymentCRD.php / m_proyekCRD.php
const BF_PPN_RULE    = 'PROJECT_INVOICE_PPN';      // Dr Piutang Usaha / Cr PPN Keluaran

class BfError extends Exception {}

function bf_send($success, $data = [], $message = '') {
    $resp = ['success' => $success, 'message' => $message];
    if ($success) { $resp['data'] = $data; $resp['totalCount'] = is_array($data) ? count($data) : 0; }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($resp, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

/** Tagihan yang perlu diperbaiki + hasil hitung DPP / PPN (Opsi A). */
function bf_candidates($db, int $projectId): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT v.id, v.inv_no, v.termin_name, v.invoice_date, v.amount, v.paid_amount,
               p.id AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.ppn_rate AS project_rate
          FROM public.project_invoices v
          JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = v.project_id
         WHERE COALESCE(v.ppn_amount, 0) <= 0
           AND COALESCE(p.ppn_rate, 0) > 0
           AND v.amount > 0
           AND (:p = 0 OR v.project_id = :p)
         ORDER BY v.project_id, v.invoice_date, v.id");
    $st->execute([':p' => $projectId]);
    $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    foreach ($rows as &$r) {
        $rate = round((float)$r['project_rate'], 2);
        $amt  = round((float)$r['amount'], 2);
        $dpp  = round($amt / (1 + $rate / 100), 2);
        $r['id']          = (int)$r['id'];
        $r['project_id']  = (int)$r['project_id'];
        $r['ppn_rate']    = $rate;
        $r['amount']      = $amt;
        $r['paid_amount'] = (float)$r['paid_amount'];
        $r['dpp_amount']  = $dpp;
        $r['ppn_amount']  = round($amt - $dpp, 2);
        unset($r['project_rate']);
    }
    unset($r);
    return $rows;
}

function bf_has_journal($db, int $invId): bool {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.journal_entries WHERE reference_type::text = :t AND reference_id = :id LIMIT 1");
    $st->execute([':t' => BF_JOURNAL_REF, ':id' => $invId]);
    return (bool)$st->fetchColumn();
}

function bf_post_journal($db, array $r): void {
    $jr = AutoPostJournal($db, [
        'rule_code' => 'PROJECT_INVOICE', 'reference_type' => BF_JOURNAL_REF, 'reference_id' => $r['id'],
        'journal_date' => $r['invoice_date'], 'amount' => $r['dpp_amount'],
        'description' => "Tagihan termin {$r['inv_no']} - {$r['project_name']}",
    ]);
    if (!$jr['success']) throw new BfError("{$r['inv_no']}: gagal posting jurnal penagihan: " . $jr['message']);
    if ($r['ppn_amount'] > 0.005) {
        $jr = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code' => BF_PPN_RULE, 'reference_type' => BF_JOURNAL_REF, 'reference_id' => $r['id'],
            'journal_date' => $r['invoice_date'], 'amount' => $r['ppn_amount'],
            'description' => "PPN Keluaran termin {$r['inv_no']} - {$r['project_name']}",
        ]);
        if (!$jr['success']) throw new BfError("{$r['inv_no']}: gagal posting jurnal PPN Keluaran: " . $jr['message']);
    }
}

if ($task === 'run' && ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== 'POST') {

    switch ($task) {

        case 'preview':
            $rows = bf_candidates($db, $pid);
            bf_send(true, $rows, count($rows) ? count($rows) . ' tagihan akan diperbaiki (belum ada yang diubah).' : 'Tidak ada tagihan yang perlu diperbaiki.');
            break;

        case 'run':
            if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') throw new BfError('Gunakan metode POST.');
            if (($_POST['confirm'] ?? '') !== 'YA') throw new BfError("Kirim confirm=YA untuk menjalankan. Jalankan task=preview dulu.");

            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $rows = bf_candidates($db, $pid);
                if (!count($rows)) throw new BfError('Tidak ada tagihan yang perlu diperbaiki.');

                $stUp  = $db->prepare("UPDATE public.project_invoices SET dpp_amount = :d, ppn_rate = :r, ppn_amount = :p WHERE id = :id");
                $stInc = $db->prepare("UPDATE public.projects SET ppn_inclusive = true WHERE id = :id");
                $projects = [];
                foreach ($rows as $r) {
                    $stUp->execute([':d' => $r['dpp_amount'], ':r' => $r['ppn_rate'], ':p' => $r['ppn_amount'], ':id' => $r['id']]);
                    if (bf_has_journal($db, $r['id'])) ReverseJournalByReference($db, BF_JOURNAL_REF, $r['id']);   // buang jurnal lama (sebesar total)
                    bf_post_journal($db, $r);                                                                       // posting ulang: DPP + PPN
                    $projects[$r['project_id']] = true;
                }
                foreach (array_keys($projects) as $projId) $stInc->execute([':id' => $projId]);   // Opsi A: nilai kontrak dianggap sudah termasuk PPN

                $db->commit();
                bf_send(true, $rows, count($rows) . ' tagihan berhasil diperbaiki (DPP/PPN terisi, jurnal diposting ulang). Hapus file ini dari server.');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        default:
            bf_send(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.');
    }
} catch (BfError $e) {
    bf_send(false, [], $e->getMessage());
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[ppn_backfillCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    bf_send(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[ppn_backfillCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    bf_send(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}
==================== FILE: ./php-crud/project.wipreleaseCRD.php ====================
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
/**
 * project.wipreleaseCRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Backend Controller Pelepasan WIP -> HPP per proyek (project.wiprelease.js).
 * Pola sama dengan poCRD.php: PDO (class crud), dispatch lewat $_REQUEST['task'],
 * respons JSON {success, message, data, totalCount}.
 *
 * Latar belakang:
 *   Warehouse Issuing memposting Dr WIP (1700) / Cr Persediaan (1500) (rule ISSUE_PROJECT).
 *   Pendapatan diakui saat penagihan termin, jadi biaya perlu dilepas dari WIP ke Beban Pokok (HPP)
 *   agar Laba Rugi menampilkan biaya proyek. Modul ini melakukannya:
 *     - per % progress  : HPP kumulatif = WIP kumulatif proyek x progress %
 *     - proyek selesai  : progress dianggap 100% (seluruh WIP dilepas)
 *
 * Rumus (server selalu menghitung ulang, nilai dari klien tidak dipercaya):
 *   WIP kumulatif  = SUM debit jurnal 'material_out' (issue PROJECT, posted) milik proyek
 *   sudah dilepas  = SUM project_wip_release.amount proyek
 *   nilai dilepas  = round(WIP kumulatif x pct / 100, 2) - sudah dilepas      (harus > 0)
 *   Issue baru setelah pelepasan menambah WIP kumulatif; pelepasan berikutnya otomatis menyesuaikan.
 *
 * Jurnal: AutoPostJournal rule 'WIP_RELEASE' (Dr HPP / Cr WIP), reference_type = 'wip_release',
 *   reference_id = project_wip_release.id, tanggal = tanggal pelepasan; dalam transaksi yang sama
 *   (gagal posting = pelepasan dibatalkan).
 * Hapus (reverse): hanya pelepasan TERAKHIR per proyek (agar snapshot pelepasan berikutnya tetap konsisten);
 *   jurnalnya dihapus lewat ReverseJournalByReference.
 * Akses: simpan >= 2, hapus >= 4 ($_SESSION['FormAccess']).
 * Butuh migrasi: sql/2026-10-16.project_wip_release.sql
 * ============================================================
 */

ini_set('display_errors', '0');
ob_start();

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$db = new crud();

const WR_EPS = 0.005;                          // toleransi nilai rupiah
const WR_JOURNAL_REF = 'wip_release';          // nilai enum journal_entries.reference_type
const WR_JOURNAL_RULE = 'WIP_RELEASE';         // rule_code di fiscal_config
const WR_ACCESS_ADD = 2;
const WR_ACCESS_DEL = 4;

class WrBusinessError extends Exception {}

function sendJsonResponse($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $response = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        if (is_array($data) && isset($data['data'])) {
            $response['data'] = $data['data'];
            if (isset($data['totalCount'])) $response['totalCount'] = $data['totalCount'];
        } else {
            $response['data'] = $data;
        }
    }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($response, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

function wr_valid_date(string $s): bool {
    $d = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $s);
    return $d && $d->format('Y-m-d') === $s;
}

function wr_access(): int {
    return intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
}

/**
 * Hitung angka pelepasan untuk satu proyek.
 * $mode 'complete' -> 100%; 'progress' -> $pctIn (null = projects.progress).
 */
function wr_calc($db, int $projectId, string $mode, $pctIn, int $excludeReleaseId = 0): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, name, COALESCE(progress, 0) AS progress, status
                          FROM public.projects WHERE id = :id");
    $st->execute([':id' => $projectId]);
    $prj = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$prj) throw new WrBusinessError('Proyek tidak ditemukan.');

    // WIP kumulatif = debit jurnal issue proyek (hanya yang benar-benar sudah berjurnal)
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.debit), 0)
          FROM public.journal_entries je
          JOIN public.journal_lines jl ON jl.journal_id = je.id
          JOIN public.material_out_header h ON h.id = je.reference_id
         WHERE je.reference_type::text = 'material_out' AND je.status::text = 'posted'
           AND h.project_id = :p AND h.issue_type = 'PROJECT' AND jl.debit > 0");
    $st->execute([':p' => $projectId]);
    $journaled = (float)$st->fetchColumn();

    // nilai issue menurut dokumen (pembanding: bila > journaled berarti ada issue yang belum berjurnal).
    // [F-1.2 2026-11-16] dasar terpadu: angka realisasi biaya (material+expense+subkon) dibaca dari
    // public.v_project_actual_cost via ProjectActualCost() — sama persis dengan menu Progress &
    // dashboard, sehingga selisih "issue berjurnal vs total realisasi" langsung terlihat.
    $ac = function_exists('ProjectActualCost') ? ProjectActualCost($db, $projectId) : null;

    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty_out * i.unit_cost), 0)
          FROM public.material_out_items i
          JOIN public.material_out_header h ON h.id = i.material_out_id
         WHERE h.project_id = :p AND h.status = 'posted' AND h.issue_type = 'PROJECT'");
    $st->execute([':p' => $projectId]);
    $issued = (float)$st->fetchColumn();

    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM public.project_wip_release
                         WHERE project_id = :p AND id <> :x");
    $st->execute([':p' => $projectId, ':x' => $excludeReleaseId]);
    $released = (float)$st->fetchColumn();

    if ($mode === 'complete') {
        $pct = 100.0;
    } else {
        $pct = ($pctIn === null || $pctIn === '') ? (float)$prj['progress'] : (float)$pctIn;
    }
    if ($pct < 0 || $pct > 100) throw new WrBusinessError('Persentase progress harus antara 0 - 100.');
    $pct = round($pct, 2);

    $target = round($journaled * $pct / 100, 2);
    $amount = round($target - $released, 2);

    return [
        'project_id'      => (int)$prj['id'],
        'project_name'    => $prj['name'],
        'project_status'  => $prj['status'],
        'project_progress'=> (float)$prj['progress'],
        'mode'            => $mode,
        'progress_pct'    => $pct,
        'wip_cumulative'  => round($journaled, 2),
        'issued_cost'     => round($issued, 2),
        'unjournaled'     => round(max($issued - $journaled, 0), 2),
        'released_before' => round($released, 2),
        'target_released' => $target,
        'amount'          => $amount,
        // [F-1.2] konteks terpadu untuk dibandingkan di UI/preview — bukan dasar pelepasan.
        'actual_cost'         => $ac ? (float)$ac['cost_total'] : null,
        'actual_cost_material'=> $ac ? (float)$ac['cost_material'] : null,
        'actual_cost_expense' => $ac ? (float)$ac['cost_expense'] : null,
        'actual_cost_subcon'  => $ac ? (float)$ac['cost_subcon'] : null,
        'cost_released'       => $ac ? (float)$ac['hpp_released'] : null,
        'cost_remaining_wip'  => $ac ? (float)$ac['wip_remaining'] : null,
    ];
}

if (empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login ulang.');
}

$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';
if ((int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < 1) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Hak baca pelepasan WIP proyek tidak tersedia.');

try {
    switch ($task) {

        case 'list_project_options':

        case 'list_releases':
            $start = (int)($_REQUEST['start'] ?? 0);

            $query = trim($_REQUEST['query'] ?? '');

            $where = ''; $params = [];
            if ($query !== '') {
                $where = "WHERE (r.ref_no ILIKE :q1 OR p.name ILIKE :q2 OR COALESCE(r.remark, '') ILIKE :q3)";
                $like = '%' . $query . '%';
                $params = [':q1' => $like, ':q2' => $like, ':q3' => $like];
            }

            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.project_wip_release r
                                  JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = r.project_id {$where}");
            $st->execute($params);
            $totalCount = (int)$st->fetchColumn();

            $st = $db->prepare("
                SELECT r.id, r.ref_no, r.release_date, r.project_id, p.name AS project_name,
                       r.mode, r.progress_pct, r.cumulative_cost, r.released_before, r.amount, r.remark,
                       (SELECT je.ref_no FROM public.journal_entries je
                         WHERE je.reference_type::text = 'wip_release' AND je.reference_id = r.id LIMIT 1) AS journal_no,
                       NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.project_wip_release x
                                    WHERE x.project_id = r.project_id AND x.id > r.id) AS is_latest
                  FROM public.project_wip_release r
                  JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = r.project_id
                  {$where}
                 ORDER BY r.release_date DESC, r.id DESC
                 LIMIT :limit OFFSET :start");
            foreach ($params as $k => $v) $st->bindValue($k, $v);
            $st->bindValue(':limit', $limit, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $st->bindValue(':start', $start, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $st->execute();
            $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                $r['id'] = (int)$r['id'];
                $r['project_id'] = (int)$r['project_id'];
                $r['progress_pct'] = (float)$r['progress_pct'];
                $r['cumulative_cost'] = (float)$r['cumulative_cost'];
                $r['released_before'] = (float)$r['released_before'];
                $r['amount'] = (float)$r['amount'];
                $r['is_latest'] = ($r['is_latest'] === true || $r['is_latest'] === 't' || $r['is_latest'] === '1');
            }
            unset($r);
            sendJsonResponse(true, ['data' => $rows, 'totalCount' => $totalCount]);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Simpan pelepasan + posting jurnal (satu transaksi)
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'save_release':
            if (wr_access() < WR_ACCESS_ADD) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membuat pelepasan WIP.');
            $prj    = (int)($_POST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            $date   = (string)($_POST['release_date'] ?? '');
            $mode   = ($_POST['mode'] ?? 'progress') === 'complete' ? 'complete' : 'progress';
            $pctIn  = $_POST['progress_pct'] ?? null;
            $remark = trim((string)($_POST['remark'] ?? '')) ?: null;

            try {
                if ($prj <= 0) throw new WrBusinessError('Proyek wajib dipilih.');
                if (!wr_valid_date($date)) throw new WrBusinessError('Tanggal pelepasan tidak valid.');

                $db->beginTransaction();
                try {
                    // kunci baris proyek agar dua pelepasan bersamaan tidak saling menimpa
                    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.projects WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                    $st->execute([':id' => $prj]);
                    if (!$st->fetchColumn()) throw new WrBusinessError('Proyek tidak ditemukan.');

                    $c = wr_calc($db, $prj, $mode, $pctIn);
                    if ($c['wip_cumulative'] <= WR_EPS) {
                        throw new WrBusinessError('Proyek ini belum punya WIP berjurnal. Posting issue material (atau backfill jurnal issue) terlebih dahulu.');
                    }
                    if ($c['amount'] <= WR_EPS) {
                        throw new WrBusinessError('Tidak ada WIP yang perlu dilepas: target dilepas ' . number_format($c['target_released'], 2) .
                            ' sudah tercapai / terlampaui oleh pelepasan sebelumnya (' . number_format($c['released_before'], 2) . ').');
                    }

                    if (!function_exists('CreateRefNo')) throw new Exception('CreateRefNo() tidak tersedia.');
                    $refNo = CreateRefNo('project_wip_release', 'ref_no', 'WIP');

                    $st = $db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO public.project_wip_release
                            (ref_no, release_date, project_id, mode, progress_pct, cumulative_cost, released_before, amount, remark, created_by)
                        VALUES (:no, CAST(:d AS date), :p, :m, :pct, :cum, :rb, :a, :r, :u)
                        RETURNING id");
                    $st->execute([':no' => $refNo, ':d' => $date, ':p' => $prj, ':m' => $mode, ':pct' => $c['progress_pct'],
                                  ':cum' => $c['wip_cumulative'], ':rb' => $c['released_before'], ':a' => $c['amount'],
                                  ':r' => $remark, ':u' => (int)$_SESSION['user_id'] ?: null]);
                    $id = (int)$st->fetchColumn();

                    $jr = AutoPostJournal($db, [
                        'rule_code'      => WR_JOURNAL_RULE,
                        'reference_type' => WR_JOURNAL_REF,
                        'reference_id'   => $id,
                        'journal_date'   => $date,
                        'amount'         => $c['amount'],
                        'description'    => "Pelepasan WIP ke HPP {$refNo} - {$c['project_name']} (" . rtrim(rtrim(number_format($c['progress_pct'], 2, '.', ''), '0'), '.') . '%)',
                    ]);
                    if (!$jr['success']) throw new WrBusinessError('Gagal posting jurnal: ' . $jr['message']);

                    $db->commit();
                    sendJsonResponse(true, ['id' => $id, 'ref_no' => $refNo, 'amount' => $c['amount']],
                        "Pelepasan WIP {$refNo} berhasil diposting (" . number_format($c['amount'], 2) . ').');
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                    throw $e;
                }
            } catch (WrBusinessError $e) {
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Hapus (reverse) pelepasan: hanya yang terakhir per proyek
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'delete_release':
            if (wr_access() < WR_ACCESS_DEL) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus pelepasan WIP.');
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT ref_no, project_id FROM public.project_wip_release WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$r) throw new WrBusinessError('Pelepasan tidak ditemukan.');

                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.project_wip_release WHERE project_id = :p AND id > :id");
                $st->execute([':p' => $r['project_id'], ':id' => $id]);
                if ((int)$st->fetchColumn() > 0) {
                    throw new WrBusinessError("Hanya pelepasan terakhir per proyek yang dapat dihapus. Hapus pelepasan yang lebih baru terlebih dahulu.");
                }

                ReverseJournalByReference($db, WR_JOURNAL_REF, $id);
                $db->prepare("DELETE FROM public.project_wip_release WHERE id = :id")->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $db->commit();
                sendJsonResponse(true, [], "Pelepasan WIP {$r['ref_no']} dihapus dan jurnalnya dibatalkan.");
            } catch (WrBusinessError $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        default:
            sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.');
            break;
    }
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[project.wipreleaseCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[project.wipreleaseCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}

function PrepOrFailCL($stmt, $context = '') {
    if ($stmt === false) {
        throw new Exception(($context ? "[{$context}] " : '') . 'Query gagal dijalankan.');
    }
    return $stmt;
}
function clFetchAll($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFailCL($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
}
function clFetchOne($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFailCL($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    return $row === false ? null : $row;
}
function clExec($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFailCL($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    return $stmt;
}

        case 'list':

                    FROM clients c
                    ORDER BY c.name ASC";

            break;

        case 'read_edit':

        case 'update':
            if ($task === 'create' && $access < 2) {

            break;

        default:
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
            break;
    }
} catch (Throwable $e) {

*           Draft -> Diajukan -> Disetujui -> (Dibatalkan)
*           Saat Disetujui: jurnal Dr WIP / Cr Hutang Subkon
*   
*   Step 2: Release Payment (bayar invoice)
*           Posted -> (Dibatalkan)
*           Saat Posted: jurnal Dr Hutang Subkon / Cr Kas-Bank

const SC_INV_EPS = 0.01;
const SC_INV_REF = 'subcon_invoice';
const SC_INV_PAY_REF = 'subcon_invoice_pay';

class ScInvError extends Exception {}

function sc_inv_send($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $resp = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        $resp['data'] = $data;
        if (!isset($resp['totalCount'])) $resp['totalCount'] = is_array($data) ? count($data) : 0;
    }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($resp, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

function sc_inv_f($v): float { return round((float)$v, 2); }
function sc_inv_uid() { return isset($_SESSION['user_id']) ? (int)$_SESSION['user_id'] : null; }

function sc_inv_has_journal($db, string $ref, int $id): bool {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries WHERE reference_type::text = :t AND reference_id = :id LIMIT 1");
    $st->execute([':t' => $ref, ':id' => $id]);
    return (bool)$st->fetchColumn();
}

function sc_inv_post($db, string $rule, string $ref, int $id, string $date, float $amount, string $desc, ?int $creditAccountId = null): void {
    if ($amount <= 0.004) return;
    $p = ['rule_code' => $rule, 'reference_type' => $ref, 'reference_id' => $id, 'journal_date' => $date, 'amount' => $amount, 'description' => $desc];
    if ($creditAccountId) $p['credit_account_id'] = $creditAccountId;
    $r = AutoPostJournal($db, $p);
    if (!$r['success']) throw new ScInvError('Gagal posting jurnal ' . $rule . ': ' . $r['message']);
}

            $referenceNo = trim((string)($_POST['reference_no'] ?? '')) ?: null;
            $notes = trim((string)($_POST['notes'] ?? '')) ?: null;
            
            if ($contractId <= 0) throw new ScInvError('Kontrak subkon wajib dipilih.');
            if ($invoiceDate === '') throw new ScInvError('Tanggal invoice wajib diisi.');
            if ($totalAmount <= 0) throw new ScInvError('Total invoice harus lebih dari 0.');
            
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT status FROM subcon_contracts WHERE id = :id");
                $stmt->execute([':id' => $contractId]);
                $contract = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$contract || $contract['status'] !== 'Disetujui') {
                    throw new ScInvError('Kontrak subkon tidak ditemukan atau tidak berstatus Disetujui.');
                }
                
                if ($progressId) {
                    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT net_payable, status FROM subcon_progress WHERE id = :id");
                    $stmt->execute([':id' => $progressId]);
                    $progress = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                    if (!$progress || $progress['status'] !== 'Disetujui') {
                        throw new ScInvError('Prestasi tidak ditemukan atau belum disetujui.');
                    }
                    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM subcon_invoices WHERE progress_id = :pid AND id <> :id AND status <> 'Dibatalkan'");
                    $stmt->execute([':pid' => $progressId, ':id' => $id]);
                    if ($stmt->fetchColumn()) {
                        throw new ScInvError('Prestasi ini sudah di-invoice.');
                    }
                }
                
                if ($id > 0) {
                    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT status FROM subcon_invoices WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                    $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
                    $cur = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                    if (!$cur) throw new ScInvError('Invoice tidak ditemukan.');
                    if ($cur['status'] !== 'Draft') throw new ScInvError('Hanya invoice Draft yang bisa diubah.');
                    
                    $db->prepare("UPDATE subcon_invoices SET contract_id = :cid, progress_id = :pid,
                        invoice_date = CAST(:idate AS date), due_date = CAST(:ddate AS date),
                        total_amount = :amt, reference_no = :ref, notes = :notes, updated_at = NOW()
                        WHERE id = :id")
                        ->execute([':cid' => $contractId, ':pid' => $progressId, ':idate' => $invoiceDate,
                        ':ddate' => $dueDate, ':amt' => $totalAmount, ':ref' => $referenceNo,
                        ':notes' => $notes, ':id' => $id]);
                    
                    $invNo = $db->query("SELECT invoice_no FROM subcon_invoices WHERE id = {$id}")->fetchColumn();
                } else {
                    if (!function_exists('CreateRefNo')) throw new Exception('CreateRefNo() tidak tersedia.');
                    $invNo = CreateRefNo('subcon_invoices', 'invoice_no', 'INV-SC');
                    
                    $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO subcon_invoices (invoice_no, contract_id, progress_id, invoice_date, due_date,
                        total_amount, paid_amount, status, reference_no, notes, created_by)
                        VALUES (:no, :cid, :pid, CAST(:idate AS date), CAST(:ddate AS date), :amt, 0, 'Draft', :ref, :notes, :uid)
                        RETURNING id");
                    $stmt->execute([':no' => $invNo, ':cid' => $contractId, ':pid' => $progressId,
                        ':idate' => $invoiceDate, ':ddate' => $dueDate, ':amt' => $totalAmount,
                        ':ref' => $referenceNo, ':notes' => $notes, ':uid' => sc_inv_uid()]);
                    $id = (int)$stmt->fetchColumn();
                }
                
                $db->commit();
                sc_inv_send(true, ['id' => $id, 'invoice_no' => $invNo], 'Invoice berhasil disimpan.');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * STEP 1: SUBMIT INVOICE (Draft -> Diajukan)
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'update_invoice_status':
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $to = (string)($_POST['to'] ?? '');
            
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM subcon_invoices WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $inv = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$inv) throw new ScInvError('Invoice tidak ditemukan.');
                
                $allowed = ['Draft' => ['Diajukan', 'Dibatalkan'], 'Diajukan' => ['Disetujui', 'Draft', 'Dibatalkan']];
                if (!in_array($to, $allowed[$inv['status']] ?? [])) {
                    throw new ScInvError("Status {$inv['status']} tidak dapat diubah ke {$to}.");
                }
                
                $set = "status = :s, updated_at = NOW()";
                $p = [':s' => $to, ':id' => $id];
                
                if ($to === 'Disetujui') {
                    $set .= ", approved_by = :uid, approved_at = NOW()";
                    $p[':uid'] = sc_inv_uid();
                }
                
                $db->prepare("UPDATE subcon_invoices SET {$set} WHERE id = :id")->execute($p);
                $db->commit();
                sc_inv_send(true, [], "Invoice sekarang berstatus {$to}.");
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * STEP 1: APPROVE INVOICE (Disetujui -> posting jurnal)
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'approve_invoice':
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT inv.*, p.retention_amount FROM subcon_invoices inv LEFT JOIN subcon_progress p ON p.id = inv.progress_id WHERE inv.id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $inv = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$inv) throw new ScInvError('Invoice tidak ditemukan.');
                if ($inv['status'] !== 'Diajukan') throw new ScInvError('Hanya invoice Diajukan yang bisa disetujui.');

                $db->prepare("UPDATE subcon_invoices SET status = 'Disetujui', approved_by = :uid, approved_at = NOW()
                    WHERE id = :id")->execute([':uid' => sc_inv_uid(), ':id' => $id]);

                $date = $inv['invoice_date'];
                $totalAmt = (float)$inv['total_amount'];
                $retAmt = (float)($inv['retention_amount'] ?? 0);

                // Cek apakah akun retensi subkon terdaftar di fiscal_config
                $stRet = $db->query("SELECT id FROM public.fiscal_config WHERE rule_code = 'SUBCON_RETENTION_LIAB' AND is_active LIMIT 1");
                $hasRetRule = (bool)$stRet->fetchColumn();

                $netAmt = $totalAmt;
                if ($hasRetRule && $retAmt > SC_INV_EPS) {
                    $netAmt = round($totalAmt - $retAmt, 2);
                    if ($netAmt < 0) $netAmt = 0.0;
                }

                $desc = "Invoice subkon {$inv['invoice_no']}";
                sc_inv_post($db, 'SUBCON_INVOICE', SC_INV_REF, $id, $date, $netAmt, $desc);

                if ($hasRetRule && $retAmt > SC_INV_EPS) {
                    sc_inv_post($db, 'SUBCON_RETENTION_LIAB', SC_INV_REF, $id, $date, $retAmt, "Hutang retensi subkon {$inv['invoice_no']}");
                }

                $db->commit();
                sc_inv_send(true, [], 'Invoice disetujui & dijurnal (pemisahan retensi subkon aktif).');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * STEP 1: CANCEL INVOICE
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'cancel_invoice':
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $reason = trim((string)($_POST['reason'] ?? ''));
            if (strlen($reason) < 5) throw new ScInvError('Alasan pembatalan minimal 5 karakter.');
            
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM subcon_invoices WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $inv = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$inv) throw new ScInvError('Invoice tidak ditemukan.');
                if ($inv['status'] === 'Dibatalkan') throw new ScInvError('Invoice sudah dibatalkan.');
                
                $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM subcon_invoice_payments WHERE invoice_id = :id AND status = 'Posted'");
                $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
                // Check for active payments
                $paymentCheck = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS payment_count
                                FROM subcon_invoice_payments
                                WHERE invoice_id = :id AND status = 'Posted'
                                AND (amount > 0 OR payment_date IS NOT NULL)");
                $paymentCheck->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $paymentCount = $paymentCheck->fetchColumn();

                if ($paymentCount > 0) {
                    throw new ScInvError('Invoice tidak dapat dibatalkan: sudah memiliki pembayaran aktif');
                }

                $paid = (float)$stmt->fetchColumn();
                if ($paid > 0) throw new ScInvError('Invoice sudah ada pembayaran. Batalkan pembayaran dulu.');
                
                if ($inv['status'] === 'Disetujui' && sc_inv_has_journal($db, SC_INV_REF, $id)) {
                    ReverseJournalByReference($db, SC_INV_REF, $id);
                }
                
                $db->prepare("UPDATE subcon_invoices SET status = 'Dibatalkan', cancelled_by = :uid, 
                    cancelled_at = NOW(), cancel_reason = :reason WHERE id = :id")
                    ->execute([':uid' => sc_inv_uid(), ':reason' => $reason, ':id' => $id]);
                
                $db->commit();
                sc_inv_send(true, [], 'Invoice dibatalkan.');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * STEP 2: LIST ACCOUNTS (untuk combo pembayaran)
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'list_accounts':
            $rows = $db->query("SELECT id, account_code, account_name FROM chart_of_accounts
                WHERE account_type::text IN ('cash','bank') AND is_active
                ORDER BY account_code")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                $r['id'] = (int)$r['id'];
                $r['label'] = $r['account_code'] . ' - ' . $r['account_name'];
            }
            sc_inv_send(true, $rows);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * STEP 2: SAVE PAYMENT (Release Payment)
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'save_payment':
            $invoiceId = (int)($_POST['invoice_id'] ?? 0);
            $contractId = (int)($_POST['contract_id'] ?? 0);
            $paymentDate = (string)($_POST['payment_date'] ?? '');
            $accountId = (int)($_POST['account_id'] ?? 0);
            $paymentMethod = trim((string)($_POST['payment_method'] ?? 'BANK_TRANSFER'));
            $amount = sc_inv_f($_POST['amount'] ?? 0);
            $referenceNo = trim((string)($_POST['reference_no'] ?? '')) ?: null;
            $notes = trim((string)($_POST['notes'] ?? '')) ?: null;
            
            if ($invoiceId <= 0) throw new ScInvError('Invoice wajib dipilih.');
            if ($accountId <= 0) throw new ScInvError('Akun kas/bank wajib dipilih.');
            if ($amount <= 0) throw new ScInvError('Jumlah pembayaran harus lebih dari 0.');
            if ($paymentDate === '') throw new ScInvError('Tanggal pembayaran wajib diisi.');
            
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM subcon_invoices WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $stmt->execute([':id' => $invoiceId]);
                $inv = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$inv) throw new ScInvError('Invoice tidak ditemukan.');
                if ($inv['status'] !== 'Disetujui') throw new ScInvError('Hanya invoice Disetujui yang bisa dibayar.');
                if ((int)$inv['contract_id'] !== $contractId) throw new ScInvError('Invoice tidak sesuai kontrak.');
                
                $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM subcon_invoice_payments WHERE invoice_id = :id AND status = 'Posted'");
                $stmt->execute([':id' => $invoiceId]);
                $paid = (float)$stmt->fetchColumn();
                $remaining = round((float)$inv['total_amount'] - $paid, 2);
                
                if ($amount > $remaining + SC_INV_EPS) {
                    throw new ScInvError('Jumlah pembayaran melebihi sisa hutang invoice (sisa: ' . number_format($remaining, 2) . ').');
                }
                
                if (!function_exists('CreateRefNo')) throw new Exception('CreateRefNo() tidak tersedia.');
                $payNo = CreateRefNo('subcon_invoice_payments', 'payment_no', 'PAY-SC');
                
                $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO subcon_invoice_payments (payment_no, invoice_id, contract_id, payment_date,
                    account_id, payment_method, amount, reference_no, notes, status, created_by)
                    VALUES (:no, :iid, :cid, CAST(:pdate AS date), :aid, :method, :amt, :ref, :notes, 'Posted', :uid)
                    RETURNING id");
                $stmt->execute([':no' => $payNo, ':iid' => $invoiceId, ':cid' => $contractId,
                    ':pdate' => $paymentDate, ':aid' => $accountId, ':method' => $paymentMethod,
                    ':amt' => $amount, ':ref' => $referenceNo, ':notes' => $notes, ':uid' => sc_inv_uid()]);
                $payId = (int)$stmt->fetchColumn();
                
                $newPaid = round($paid + $amount, 2);
                $db->prepare("UPDATE subcon_invoices SET paid_amount = :paid WHERE id = :id")
                    ->execute([':paid' => $newPaid, ':id' => $invoiceId]);
                
                $desc = "Pembayaran invoice subkon {$inv['invoice_no']}";
                sc_inv_post($db, 'SUBCON_INVOICE_PAY', SC_INV_PAY_REF, $payId, $paymentDate, $amount, $desc, $accountId);
                
                $db->commit();
                sc_inv_send(true, ['id' => $payId, 'payment_no' => $payNo], 'Pembayaran berhasil disimpan & dijurnal.');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * STEP 2: CANCEL PAYMENT
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'cancel_payment':
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $reason = trim((string)($_POST['reason'] ?? ''));
            if (strlen($reason) < 5) throw new ScInvError('Alasan pembatalan minimal 5 karakter.');
            
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM subcon_invoice_payments WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $pay = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$pay) throw new ScInvError('Pembayaran tidak ditemukan.');
                if ($pay['status'] !== 'Posted') throw new ScInvError('Pembayaran sudah dibatalkan.');
                
                if (sc_inv_has_journal($db, SC_INV_PAY_REF, $id)) {
                    ReverseJournalByReference($db, SC_INV_PAY_REF, $id);
                }
                
                $db->prepare("UPDATE subcon_invoice_payments SET status = 'Dibatalkan', cancelled_by = :uid,
                    cancelled_at = NOW(), cancel_reason = :reason WHERE id = :id")
                    ->execute([':uid' => sc_inv_uid(), ':reason' => $reason, ':id' => $id]);
                
                $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM subcon_invoice_payments 
                    WHERE invoice_id = :iid AND status = 'Posted'");
                $stmt->execute([':iid' => $pay['invoice_id']]);
                $newPaid = (float)$stmt->fetchColumn();
                $db->prepare("UPDATE subcon_invoices SET paid_amount = :paid WHERE id = :id")
                    ->execute([':paid' => $newPaid, ':id' => $pay['invoice_id']]);
                
                $db->commit();
                sc_inv_send(true, [], 'Pembayaran dibatalkan.');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        default:
            sc_inv_send(false, [], 'Task tidak dikenali.');
            break;
    }
} catch (ScInvError $e) {
    sc_inv_send(false, [], $e->getMessage());
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[subcon.invoiceCRD] PDO: ' . $e->getMessage());
    sc_inv_send(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[subcon.invoiceCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sc_inv_send(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}

==================== FILE: ./php-crud/m.customerCRD.php ====================
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
if (!isset($_SESSION)) {
    if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}
}
date_default_timezone_set('Asia/Jakarta');

include_once "../php-class/crudClass.php";
include_once "../php-func/function.all.php";

// 1. Amankan penangkapan parameter POST dengan operator ??
$searchField = $_POST["query"] ?? null;
$offset      = isset($_POST["start"]) ? intval($_POST["start"]) : 0;
$limit       = isset($_POST["limit"]) ? intval($_POST["limit"]) : 250;

// 2. Amankan proses json2Array
$rawItemInfo = $_POST["iteminfo"] ?? '';
$dataArray   = !empty($rawItemInfo) ? json2Array($rawItemInfo) : [];

// 3. Tangani pembentukan string kondisi aman berbasis array
if (empty($dataArray)) {
    $CheckItemNum  = "[0]";
    $CheckItemChar = "['0']";
} else {
    $formattedData = is_array($dataArray) ? implode(",", $dataArray) : $dataArray;
    $CheckItemNum  = "[" . $formattedData . "]";
    $CheckItemChar = "['" . $formattedData . "']";
}

$db = new crud();
$task = $_POST['task'] ?? 'read';

// Otorisasi backend mandiri: login wajib dan hak operasi mengikuti FormAccess menu.
if (empty($_SESSION['user_id']) || !is_numeric($_SESSION['user_id']) || (int)$_SESSION['user_id'] <= 0) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login ulang.']);
    exit;
}
$requiredAccess = 1;
if (in_array($task, ['create', 'add'], true)) $requiredAccess = 2;
if (in_array($task, ['update', 'edit'], true)) $requiredAccess = 3;
if ($task === 'delete') $requiredAccess = 4;
if ((int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < $requiredAccess) {
    http_response_code(403);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Hak akses tidak mencukupi untuk operasi master ini.']);
    exit;
}

switch ($task) {

    // ==========================================

    // ==========================================
    case ("create"):
    case ("add"):

        // Master Customer

        );

        $countryId  = $isCustType ? 1 : intval($_POST["country"] ?? 1);
