                "npwp_no"        => checksinglequote($_POST["npwp"] ?? ''),
                "active"         => 'true',
                "customer_id"    => "currval('m_customer_id_seq'::regclass)",
                "address_office" => !empty($_POST["ass_addr_off"]) ? checksinglequote($_POST["ass_addr_off"]) : null
            );
            $queryC .= insertQ($table, $data) . ";";

            // Alamat NPWP
            $table = "m_address";
            $data = array(
                "npwp_id"    => "currval('customer_npwp_id_seq'::regclass)",
                "active"     => 'true',
                "street"     => checksinglequote($_POST["street"] ?? ''),
                "block"      => checksinglequote($_POST["block"] ?? ''),
                "street_no"  => checksinglequote($_POST["street_no"] ?? ''),
                "rt"         => checksinglequote($_POST["rt"] ?? ''),
                "rw"         => checksinglequote($_POST["rw"] ?? ''),
                "village_id" => (empty($_POST["village"]) || $_POST["village"] == 0) ? null : intval($_POST["village"]),
                "country_id" => 1
            );
            $queryC .= insertQ($table, $data) . ";";
        }

        // Limit Kredit
        $limitCurrency = intval($_POST["limit_currency"] ?? 0);
        $limitAmount   = floatval(str_replace(",", "", $_POST["limit_amount"] ?? 0));
        if ($limitCurrency > 0 && $limitAmount > 0) {
            $table = "customer_credit_limit";
            $data = array(
                "customer_id"  => "currval('m_customer_id_seq'::regclass)",
                "limit_amount" => $limitAmount,
                "currency_id"  => $limitCurrency,
                "from_date"    => "now()",
                "to_date"      => null
            );
            $queryC .= insertQ($table, $data) . ";";
        }

        // Periode Pembayaran
        $paymentPeriod = floatval(str_replace(",", "", $_POST["payment_period"] ?? 0));
        if ($paymentPeriod > 0) {
            $table = "customer_payment_period";
            $data = array(
                "customer_id" => "currval('m_customer_id_seq'::regclass)",
                "period"      => $paymentPeriod,
                "from_date"   => "now()",
                "to_date"     => null
            );
            $queryC .= insertQ($table, $data) . ";";
        }

        // Kontak Kantor (Email, Mobile, Phone, Fax)
        $contactsConfig = [
            "office_email"  => 1,
            "office_mobile" => 2,
            "office_phone"  => 3,
            "office_fax"    => 4
        ];

        foreach ($contactsConfig as $postKey => $contactType) {
            if (!empty($_POST[$postKey])) {
                $table = "m_contact_no";
                $data = array(
                    "customer_id"       => "currval('m_customer_id_seq'::regclass)",
                    "supplier_id"       => null,
                    "contact_person_id" => null,
                    "contact_type"      => $contactType,
                    "contact_no"        => checksinglequote($_POST[$postKey])
                );
                $queryC .= insertQ($table, $data) . ";";
            }
        }

        // Array Kontak Person Tambahan
        $rawContacts  = $_POST["arrContact"] ?? '[]';
        $dataContacts = !empty($rawContacts) ? json_decode($rawContacts) : [];

        if (is_array($dataContacts)) {
            foreach ($dataContacts as $contact) {
                if (!empty($contact->name)) {
                    $table = "m_contact_person";
                    $data = array(
                        "customer_id" => "currval('m_customer_id_seq'::regclass)",
                        "supplier_id" => null,
                        "name"        => checksinglequote($contact->name ?? ''),
                        "position"    => checksinglequote($contact->position ?? ''),
                        "remark"      => checksinglequote($contact->remark ?? '')
                    );
                    $queryC .= insertQ($table, $data) . ";";

                    if (!empty($contact->address)) {
                        $table = "m_address";
                        $data = array(
                            "contact_person_id" => "currval('m_contact_person_id_seq'::regclass)",
                            "active"            => 'true',
                            "address"           => checksinglequote($contact->address)
                        );
                        $queryC .= insertQ($table, $data) . ";";
                    }

                    $subContactsMap = [
                        "email"  => 1,
                        "mobile" => 2,
                        "phone"  => 3
                    ];

                    foreach ($subContactsMap as $sKey => $sVal) {
                        if (!empty($contact->$sKey)) {
                            $table = "m_contact_no";
                            $data = array(
                                "contact_type"      => $sVal,
                                "contact_person_id" => "currval('m_contact_person_id_seq'::regclass)",
                                "contact_no"        => checksinglequote($contact->$sKey)
                            );
                            $queryC .= insertQ($table, $data) . ";";
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $db->cmdQ($queryC);
        echo $db->getResult();
    break;

    // ==========================================
    // 2. READ (Daftar Customer)
    // ==========================================
    case ("read"):
        $queryParam = $_POST["query"] ?? '';
        $sResult    = searchData($queryParam, array("c.name", "c.init", "a.address"), $limit);
        $searchSQL  = is_array($sResult["searchSQL"]) ? '' : strval($sResult["searchSQL"]);

        $fields = "
            c.id, cn.id country, c.init, c.name, coalesce(c.remark,'') remark,
            replace(coalesce(a.address,''),'\n','<br>') address, n.npwp_no npwp,
            anp.street, anp.block, anp.street_no, anp.rt, anp.rw, anp.village_id, anp.address npwp_addr, anp.country_id,
            l.limit_amount, l.currency_id, cr.init || '' || to_char(l.limit_amount, '999,999,999,999.99') cr_limit,
            cnt.contact_name,
            case when lower(cn.name)='indonesia' then 1 else 2 end cst_type
        ";

        $table = "
            m_customer c
            left join m_address a on a.customer_id=c.id and a.active is true
            left join m_country cn on cn.id=a.country_id
            left join customer_npwp n on n.customer_id=c.id and n.active is true
            left join m_address anp on anp.npwp_id=n.id and anp.active is true
            left join customer_credit_limit l on l.customer_id=c.id and l.to_date is null
            left join m_currency cr on cr.id=l.currency_id
            left join (
                select customer_id, array_to_string(array_agg(name || ' (' || position || ')'), '<br>') contact_name
                from m_contact_person
                where customer_id > 0
                group by customer_id
            ) cnt on coalesce(cnt.customer_id, 0) = coalesce(c.id, 0)
        ";

        $where = "c.active is true " . $searchSQL;
        $order = "c.name ASC";

        $db->select($table, $fields, $where, $order, $limit, $offset);
        echo $db->getResult();
    break;

    // ==========================================
    // 3. READ EDIT (Ambil Data Detail Customer)
    // ==========================================
    case ("readedit"):
    case ("read_edit"):
        $idCustomer = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

        $fields = "
            c.id, cn.id country, c.init, c.name, coalesce(c.remark,'') remark, a.id address_id, a.address,
            n.id npwp_id, n.npwp_no npwp, n.address_office as_addr, anp.id npwp_address_id,
            anp.street, anp.block, anp.street_no, anp.rt, anp.rw, anp.address npwp_addr, anp.country_id,
            anp.village_id village, nv.district, nv.city, nv.province, nv.postalcode postal_code,
            l.id customer_credit_limit_id, l.limit_amount, l.currency_id limit_currency,
            p.id payment_period_id, p.period payment_period,
            cnt.office_email_id, cnt.office_email, cnt.office_mobile_id, cnt.office_mobile,
            cnt.office_phone_id, cnt.office_phone, cnt.office_fax_id, cnt.office_fax,
            case when lower(cn.name)='indonesia' then 1 else 2 end cst_type
        ";

        $table = "
            m_customer c
            left join m_address a on a.customer_id=c.id and a.active is true
            left join m_country cn on cn.id=a.country_id
            left join customer_npwp n on n.customer_id=c.id and n.active is true
            left join m_address anp on anp.npwp_id=n.id and anp.active is true
            left join customer_credit_limit l on l.customer_id=c.id and l.to_date is null
            left join customer_payment_period p on p.customer_id=c.id and p.to_date is null
            left join m_currency cr on cr.id=l.currency_id
            left join (
                select customer_id,
                max(case when contact_type = 1 then id end) as office_email_id,
                max(case when contact_type = 1 then contact_no end) as office_email,
                max(case when contact_type = 2 then id end) as office_mobile_id,
                max(case when contact_type = 2 then contact_no end) as office_mobile,
                max(case when contact_type = 3 then id end) as office_phone_id,
                max(case when contact_type = 3 then contact_no end) as office_phone,
                max(case when contact_type = 4 then id end) as office_fax_id,
                max(case when contact_type = 4 then contact_no end) as office_fax
                from m_contact_no
                where customer_id > 0
                group by customer_id
            ) cnt on coalesce(cnt.customer_id, 0) = coalesce(c.id, 0)
            left join (
                select v.id village, v.postalcode, d.id district, c.id city, p.id province
                from m_village v
                left join m_district d on d.id=v.district_id
                left join m_city c on c.id=d.city_id
                left join m_province p on p.id=c.province_id
            ) nv on nv.village = anp.village_id
        ";

        $where = "c.id = " . $idCustomer;

        $db->select($table, $fields, $where);
        echo $db->getResult();
    break;

    // ==========================================
    // 4. WILAYAH & LOOKUP (Country, Prov, City, etc)
    // ==========================================
    case ("readcountry"):
        $db->select("m_country", "id, name", "1=1", "name ASC");
        echo $db->getResult();
    break;

    case ("readprov"):
        $countryId = intval($_POST['country_id'] ?? 0);
        $db->select("m_province", "id, name", "country_id = " . $countryId, "name ASC");
        echo $db->getResult();
    break;

    case ("readcity"):
        $provinceId = intval($_POST['province_id'] ?? 0);
        $db->select("m_city", "id, name", "province_id = " . $provinceId, "name ASC");
        echo $db->getResult();
    break;

    case ("readdistrict"):
        $cityId = intval($_POST['city_id'] ?? 0);
        $db->select("m_district", "id, name", "city_id = " . $cityId, "name ASC");
        echo $db->getResult();
    break;

    case ("readvillage"):
        $districtId = intval($_POST['district_id'] ?? 0);
        $db->select("m_village", "id, name, postalcode", "district_id = " . $districtId, "name ASC");
        echo $db->getResult();
    break;

    case ('readcontact'):
        $customerId = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $fields = "
            p.id cont_id, p.customer_id, p.name, p.position, coalesce(p.remark,'') remark, a.id cont_address_id, a.address,
            cnt.cont_email_id, cnt.email, cnt.cont_mobile_id, cnt.mobile, cnt.cont_phone_id, cnt.phone, cdt.contact
        ";
        $table = "
            m_contact_person p
            left join m_address a on a.contact_person_id = p.id and a.active is true
            left join (
                select contact_person_id,
                    max(case when contact_type = 1 then id end) as cont_email_id,
                    max(case when contact_type = 1 then contact_no end) as email,
                    max(case when contact_type = 2 then id end) as cont_mobile_id,
                    max(case when contact_type = 2 then contact_no end) as mobile,
                    max(case when contact_type = 3 then id end) as cont_phone_id,
                    max(case when contact_type = 3 then contact_no end) as phone
                from m_contact_no
                where contact_person_id > 0
                group by contact_person_id
            ) cnt on coalesce(cnt.contact_person_id, 0) = coalesce(p.id, 0)
            left join (
                select contact_person_id, array_to_string(array_agg(
                    case
                        when contact_type=1 then 'Email'
                        when contact_type=2 then 'Mobile'
                        when contact_type=3 then 'Phone'
                        when contact_type=4 then 'Fax'
                    end
                    || ' : ' || contact_no), '<br>') contact
                from m_contact_no
                where contact_person_id > 0
                group by contact_person_id
            ) cdt on coalesce(cdt.contact_person_id, 0) = coalesce(p.id, 0)
        ";
        $where = "p.customer_id = " . $customerId;
        $order = "p.name ASC";

        $db->select($table, $fields, $where, $order);
        echo $db->getResult();
    break;

    // ==========================================
    // 5. HISTORY DATA LOG
    // ==========================================
    case ('HistoryData'):
        $txId   = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $fields = "
            tx_id, date, count,
            case amend_name
                when 'init' then '[EDIT] - Init'
                when 'name' then '[EDIT] - Name'
                when 'description' then '[EDIT] - Description'
                when 'remark' then '[EDIT] - Remark'
                else amend_name
            end ::character varying(200) AS amend_name,
            before_amendment, after_amendment, user_name, user_time
        ";
        $where   = "tx_id::int = " . $txId . " and table_name = 'm_customer'";
        $orderBy = "count desc";

        $db->select('history', "view_single_table_log", $fields, $where, $orderBy);
        echo $db->getResult();
    break;

    // ==========================================
    // 6. UPDATE (Edit Customer)
    // ==========================================
    case ('update'):
    case ('edit'):
        $queryC = '';
        $customerId = intval($_POST["id"] ?? 0);
        $rawContacts = $_POST["arrContact"] ?? '[]';
        $dataContacts = !empty($rawContacts) ? json_decode($rawContacts) : [];

        if ($customerId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(["success" => "false", "status" => "Error", "message" => "ID Customer tidak valid."]);
            break;
        }

        // Cek kontak person lama yang perlu dihapus
        $checkDb = new crud();
        $checkDb->select("m_contact_person", "id, address_id", "customer_id = " . $customerId, "id ASC");
        $resCheckJSON = $checkDb->getResult();
        $resCheckArr  = json_decode($resCheckJSON, true);
        $dataCheck    = $resCheckArr["data"] ?? [];

        foreach ($dataCheck as $rowOld) {
            $dataFound = false;
            $cId    = $rowOld['id'];
            $addrId = $rowOld['address_id'] ?? 0;

            if (is_array($dataContacts)) {
                foreach ($dataContacts as $contact) {
                    if (isset($contact->cont_id) && $contact->cont_id == $cId) {
                        $dataFound = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!$dataFound) {
                if ($addrId > 0) {
                    $queryC .= deleteQ("m_address", "id = " . intval($addrId)) . ";";
                }
                $queryC .= deleteQ("m_contact_no", "contact_person_id = " . intval($cId)) . ";";
                $queryC .= deleteQ("m_contact_person", "id = " . intval($cId)) . ";";
            }
        }

        // Update Master Customer
        $table = "m_customer";
        $data = array(
            "name"   => checksinglequote($_POST["name"] ?? ''),
            "init"   => checksinglequote($_POST["init"] ?? ''),
            "remark" => checksinglequote($_POST["remark"] ?? '')
        );
        $where = "id = " . $customerId;
        $queryC .= updateQ($table, $data, $where) . ";";

        // Update Alamat Customer
        $addressId  = intval($_POST["address_id"] ?? 0);
        $newAddress = checksinglequote($_POST["address"] ?? '');
        $custType   = $_POST["cust_type"] ?? false;
        $isCustType = ($custType === true || $custType === 'true' || $custType === '1');
        $countryId  = $isCustType ? 1 : intval($_POST["country"] ?? 1);

        if ($addressId > 0) {
            $queryC .= updateQ("m_address", array(
                "address"    => $newAddress,
                "country_id" => $countryId
            ), "id = " . $addressId) . ";";
        } else if (!empty($newAddress)) {
            $queryC .= insertQ("m_address", array(
                "customer_id" => $customerId,
                "active"      => 'true',
                "address"     => $newAddress,
                "country_id"  => $countryId
            )) . ";";
        }

        // Update NPWP jika WNI
        if ($isCustType) {
            $npwpId  = intval($_POST["npwp_id"] ?? 0);
            $npwpNo  = checksinglequote($_POST["npwp"] ?? '');
            $asOffice = !empty($_POST["ass_addr_off"]) ? checksinglequote($_POST["ass_addr_off"]) : null;

            if ($npwpId > 0) {
                $queryC .= updateQ("customer_npwp", array(
                    "npwp_no"        => $npwpNo,
                    "address_office" => $asOffice
                ), "id = " . $npwpId) . ";";

                $npwpAddrId = intval($_POST["npwp_address_id"] ?? 0);
                if ($npwpAddrId > 0) {
                    $queryC .= updateQ("m_address", array(
                        "street"     => checksinglequote($_POST["street"] ?? ''),
                        "block"      => checksinglequote($_POST["block"] ?? ''),
                        "street_no"  => checksinglequote($_POST["street_no"] ?? ''),
                        "rt"         => checksinglequote($_POST["rt"] ?? ''),
                        "rw"         => checksinglequote($_POST["rw"] ?? ''),
                        "village_id" => (empty($_POST["village"]) || $_POST["village"] == 0) ? null : intval($_POST["village"])
                    ), "id = " . $npwpAddrId) . ";";
                }
            } else if (!empty($npwpNo)) {
                $queryC .= insertQ("customer_npwp", array(
                    "npwp_no"        => $npwpNo,
                    "active"         => 'true',
                    "customer_id"    => $customerId,
                    "address_office" => $asOffice
                )) . ";";

                $queryC .= insertQ("m_address", array(
                    "npwp_id"    => "currval('customer_npwp_id_seq'::regclass)",
                    "active"     => 'true',
                    "street"     => checksinglequote($_POST["street"] ?? ''),
                    "block"      => checksinglequote($_POST["block"] ?? ''),
                    "street_no"  => checksinglequote($_POST["street_no"] ?? ''),
                    "rt"         => checksinglequote($_POST["rt"] ?? ''),
                    "rw"         => checksinglequote($_POST["rw"] ?? ''),
                    "village_id" => (empty($_POST["village"]) || $_POST["village"] == 0) ? null : intval($_POST["village"]),
                    "country_id" => 1
                )) . ";";
            }
        }

        // Limit Kredit
        $limitCurrency = intval($_POST["limit_currency"] ?? 0);
        $limitAmount   = floatval(str_replace(",", "", $_POST["limit_amount"] ?? 0));
        $creditLimitId = intval($_POST["customer_credit_limit_id"] ?? 0);

        if ($limitCurrency > 0 && $limitAmount > 0) {
            if ($creditLimitId > 0) {
                $queryC .= updateQ("customer_credit_limit", array(
                    "limit_amount" => $limitAmount,
                    "currency_id"  => $limitCurrency
                ), "id = " . $creditLimitId) . ";";
            } else {
                $queryC .= insertQ("customer_credit_limit", array(
                    "customer_id"  => $customerId,
                    "limit_amount" => $limitAmount,
                    "currency_id"  => $limitCurrency,
                    "from_date"    => "now()",
                    "to_date"      => null
                )) . ";";
            }
        }

        // Periode Pembayaran
        $paymentPeriod   = floatval(str_replace(",", "", $_POST["payment_period"] ?? 0));
        $paymentPeriodId = intval($_POST["payment_period_id"] ?? 0);

        if ($paymentPeriod > 0) {
            if ($paymentPeriodId > 0) {
                $queryC .= updateQ("customer_payment_period", array("period" => $paymentPeriod), "id = " . $paymentPeriodId) . ";";
            } else {
                $queryC .= insertQ("customer_payment_period", array(
                    "customer_id" => $customerId,
                    "period"      => $paymentPeriod,
                    "from_date"   => "now()",
                    "to_date"     => null
                )) . ";";
            }
        }

        // Kontak Utama
        $contactsConfig = [
            "office_email"  => ["id" => "office_email_id", "type" => 1],
            "office_mobile" => ["id" => "office_mobile_id", "type" => 2],
            "office_phone"  => ["id" => "office_phone_id", "type" => 3],
            "office_fax"    => ["id" => "office_fax_id", "type" => 4]
        ];

        foreach ($contactsConfig as $postKey => $cfg) {
            if (!empty($_POST[$postKey])) {
                $contactNoId = intval($_POST[$cfg["id"]] ?? 0);
                if ($contactNoId > 0) {
                    $queryC .= updateQ("m_contact_no", array("contact_no" => checksinglequote($_POST[$postKey])), "id = " . $contactNoId) . ";";
                } else {
                    $queryC .= insertQ("m_contact_no", array(
                        "customer_id"  => $customerId,
                        "contact_type" => $cfg["type"],
                        "contact_no"   => checksinglequote($_POST[$postKey])
                    )) . ";";
                }
            }
        }

        // Save Kontak Person Tambahan
        if (is_array($dataContacts)) {
            foreach ($dataContacts as $contact) {
                $contId = intval($contact->cont_id ?? 0);
                if ($contId > 0) {
                    $queryC .= updateQ("m_contact_person", array(
                        "name"     => checksinglequote($contact->name ?? ''),
                        "position" => checksinglequote($contact->position ?? ''),
                        "remark"   => checksinglequote($contact->remark ?? '')
                    ), "id = " . $contId) . ";";

                    if (!empty($contact->address)) {
                        $contAddrId = intval($contact->cont_address_id ?? 0);
                        if ($contAddrId > 0) {
                            $queryC .= updateQ("m_address", array("address" => checksinglequote($contact->address)), "id = " . $contAddrId) . ";";
                        } else {
                            $queryC .= insertQ("m_address", array(
                                "contact_person_id" => $contId,
                                "active"            => 'true',
                                "address"           => checksinglequote($contact->address)
                            )) . ";";
                        }
                    }

                    $subContacts = [
                        "email"  => ["id" => "cont_email_id", "type" => 1],
                        "mobile" => ["id" => "cont_mobile_id", "type" => 2],
                        "phone"  => ["id" => "cont_phone_id", "type" => 3]
                    ];

                    foreach ($subContacts as $sKey => $sCfg) {
                        if (!empty($contact->$sKey)) {
                            $subId = intval($contact->{$sCfg["id"]} ?? 0);
                            if ($subId > 0) {
                                $queryC .= updateQ("m_contact_no", array("contact_no" => checksinglequote($contact->$sKey)), "id = " . $subId) . ";";
                            } else {
                                $queryC .= insertQ("m_contact_no", array(
                                    "contact_person_id" => $contId,
                                    "contact_type"      => $sCfg["type"],
                                    "contact_no"        => checksinglequote($contact->$sKey)
                                )) . ";";
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    $queryC .= insertQ("m_contact_person", array(
                        "customer_id" => $customerId,
                        "name"        => checksinglequote($contact->name ?? ''),
                        "position"    => checksinglequote($contact->position ?? ''),
                        "remark"      => checksinglequote($contact->remark ?? '')
                    )) . ";";

                    if (!empty($contact->address)) {
                        $queryC .= insertQ("m_address", array(
                            "contact_person_id" => "currval('m_contact_person_id_seq'::regclass)",
                            "active"            => 'true',
                            "address"           => checksinglequote($contact->address)
                        )) . ";";
                    }

                    if (!empty($contact->email)) {
                        $queryC .= insertQ("m_contact_no", array(
                            "contact_type"      => 1,
                            "contact_person_id" => "currval('m_contact_person_id_seq'::regclass)",
                            "contact_no"        => checksinglequote($contact->email)
                        )) . ";";
                    }
                    if (!empty($contact->mobile)) {
                        $queryC .= insertQ("m_contact_no", array(
                            "contact_type"      => 2,
                            "contact_person_id" => "currval('m_contact_person_id_seq'::regclass)",
                            "contact_no"        => checksinglequote($contact->mobile)
                        )) . ";";
                    }
                    if (!empty($contact->phone)) {
                        $queryC .= insertQ("m_contact_no", array(
                            "contact_type"      => 3,
                            "contact_person_id" => "currval('m_contact_person_id_seq'::regclass)",
                            "contact_no"        => checksinglequote($contact->phone)
                        )) . ";";
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $db->cmdQ($queryC);
        echo $db->getResult();
    break;

    // ==========================================
    // 7. DELETE (Soft Delete Customer)
    // ==========================================
    case ('delete'):
        $deleteId = intval($_POST["id"] ?? 0);

        if ($deleteId > 0) {
            $table  = "m_customer";
            $data   = array("active" => 'false');
            $where  = "id = " . $deleteId;

            $queryC = updateQ($table, $data, $where) . ";";
            $db->cmdQ($queryC);
            echo $db->getResult();
        } else {
            echo json_encode([
                "success" => "false",
                "status"  => "Error",
                "message" => "ID Customer tidak valid untuk proses penghapusan."
            ]);
        }
    break;

    default:
        echo json_encode([
            "success" => "false",
            "status"  => "Error",
            "message" => "Task atau perintah tidak dikenali oleh sistem."
        ]);
    break;
}

==================== FILE: ./php-crud/year.closingCRD.php ====================
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
/**
 * year.closingCRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Backend Tutup Buku Tahunan (jurnal penutup) -- year.closing.js.
 * Pola sama dengan poCRD.php / project.wipreleaseCRD.php: PDO (class crud), dispatch lewat $_REQUEST['task'],
 * respons JSON {success, message, data, totalCount}.
 *
 * Konsep:
 *   Akhir tahun, saldo akun Pendapatan & Beban tahun itu "dinolkan" dan selisihnya (laba/rugi) dipindah ke akun ekuitas
 *   Laba Ditahan (default 3200). Dibuat SATU jurnal (reference_type 'closing_entry', reference_id = tahun buku),
 *   tanggal 31 Desember, status posted:
 *     - tiap akun pendapatan/beban bersaldo : Dr (pendapatan, saldo kredit) / Cr (beban, saldo debit) sebesar saldonya
 *     - akun Laba Ditahan                    : Cr bila laba, Dr bila rugi
 *   Saldo tahun dihitung dari jurnal posted/reversed bertanggal 1 Jan - 31 Des tahun itu, KECUALI jurnal 'closing_entry'.
 *   [PILIH AKUN] Klien mengirim account_ids (JSON) = akun pendapatan/beban yang ikut ditutup (checklist; default semua).
 *   Hanya akun terpilih yang dinolkan; laba/rugi yang dipindah ke Laba Ditahan = selisih akun terpilih saja.
 *   Akun yang tidak dipilih tetap bersaldo (tidak ikut ditutup). Tanpa account_ids = semua akun.
 *
 * Aturan:
 *   1. Satu tahun hanya bisa ditutup sekali (tabel year_closing, fiscal_year unik).
 *   2. Tahun harus ditutup berurutan: semua tahun sebelumnya yang punya jurnal harus sudah ditutup.
 *   3. Periode akuntansi yang memuat 31 Desember harus ada & masih terbuka saat jurnal dibuat.
 *   4. Tahun yang belum berakhir hanya boleh ditutup dengan konfirmasi (force=1), untuk uji coba.
 *   5. Opsi lock_periods: setelah jurnal dibuat, semua periode tahun itu dikunci (is_closed = true);
 *      id yang dikunci disimpan agar bisa dibuka kembali.
 *   6. Buka kembali (hapus penutupan): hanya tahun yang PALING AKHIR ditutup; periode yang tadi dikunci dibuka lagi
 *      dan jurnal penutupnya dihapus (ReverseJournalByReference).
 *   Laporan Laba Rugi (layar & cetak) mengabaikan jurnal 'closing_entry'; Neraca & Trial Balance memasukkannya.
 * Akses: tutup / buka kembali >= 3 ($_SESSION['FormAccess']).
 * Butuh migrasi: sql/2026-10-18.year_closing_and_recon.sql
 * ============================================================
 */

ini_set('display_errors', '0');
ob_start();

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$db = new crud();

const YC_EPS = 0.005;
const YC_REF = 'closing_entry';     // nilai enum journal_entries.reference_type
const YC_ACCESS = 3;
const YC_ACCESS_REOPEN = 4;

class YcBusinessError extends Exception {}

function sendJsonResponse($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $response = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        if (is_array($data) && isset($data['data'])) {
            $response['data'] = $data['data'];
            if (isset($data['totalCount'])) $response['totalCount'] = $data['totalCount'];
        } else {
            $response['data'] = $data;
        }
    }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($response, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

function yc_access(): int { return intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0); }
function yc_bool($v): bool { return ($v === true || $v === 't' || $v === '1' || $v === 1); }

/** Tahun yang punya jurnal (selain closing_entry), urut naik. */
function yc_journal_years($db): array {
    $st = $db->query("SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM journal_date)::int AS y
                        FROM public.journal_entries
                       WHERE status::text IN ('posted', 'reversed') AND reference_type::text <> 'closing_entry'
                       ORDER BY y");
    return array_map('intval', $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN));
}

/** Peta tahun -> nomor jurnal penutup untuk tahun yang sudah ditutup. */
function yc_closed_map($db): array {
    $map = [];
    foreach ($db->query("SELECT fiscal_year, journal_no FROM public.year_closing")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) {
        $map[(int)$r['fiscal_year']] = $r['journal_no'];
    }
    return $map;
}

/** Cek syarat penutupan. Mengembalikan ['blockers'=>[], 'warnings'=>[], 'closing_date'=>, 'period'=>, 'not_ended'=>bool, 'periods'=>[]]. */
function yc_state($db, int $year): array {
    $blockers = []; $warnings = [];
    $closingDate = sprintf('%04d-12-31', $year);
    $yearStart = sprintf('%04d-01-01', $year);
    $closed = yc_closed_map($db);

    if (isset($closed[$year])) {
        $blockers[] = "Tahun {$year} sudah ditutup (jurnal " . ($closed[$year] ?: '-') . ').';
    }
    foreach (yc_journal_years($db) as $y) {
        if ($y < $year && !isset($closed[$y])) $blockers[] = "Tutup buku tahun {$y} terlebih dahulu (penutupan harus berurutan).";
    }

    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, period_name, is_closed FROM public.accounting_periods
                         WHERE CAST(:d AS date) BETWEEN start_date AND end_date ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1");
    $st->execute([':d' => $closingDate]);
    $period = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$period) {
        $blockers[] = "Tidak ada periode akuntansi yang memuat {$closingDate}. Buat periodenya dulu di menu Fiscal Period.";
    } elseif (yc_bool($period['is_closed'])) {
        $blockers[] = "Periode {$period['period_name']} (memuat {$closingDate}) sudah ditutup. Buka kembali periodenya dulu agar jurnal penutup bisa dibuat.";
    }

    $notEnded = ($closingDate > date('Y-m-d'));
    if ($notEnded) $warnings[] = "Tahun {$year} belum berakhir (hari ini " . date('Y-m-d') . '). Penutupan sebelum akhir tahun hanya untuk uji coba.';

    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, period_name, is_closed FROM public.accounting_periods
                         WHERE start_date >= CAST(:s AS date) AND end_date <= CAST(:e AS date) ORDER BY start_date");
    $st->execute([':s' => $yearStart, ':e' => $closingDate]);
    $periods = [];
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $p) {
        $periods[] = ['id' => (int)$p['id'], 'period_name' => $p['period_name'], 'is_closed' => yc_bool($p['is_closed'])];
    }

    return ['blockers' => $blockers, 'warnings' => $warnings, 'closing_date' => $closingDate,
            'period' => $period ?: null, 'not_ended' => $notEnded, 'periods' => $periods];
}

/** Hitung baris jurnal penutup untuk satu tahun. */
function yc_calc($db, int $year): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type::text AS account_type,
               COALESCE(SUM(l.credit - l.debit), 0) AS net_credit
          FROM public.chart_of_accounts c
          JOIN public.journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
          JOIN public.journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
               AND j.status::text IN ('posted', 'reversed')
               AND j.reference_type::text <> 'closing_entry'
               AND j.journal_date BETWEEN CAST(:s AS date) AND CAST(:e AS date)
         WHERE c.account_type::text IN ('revenue', 'expense')
         GROUP BY c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type
         ORDER BY c.account_code ASC");
    $st->execute([':s' => sprintf('%04d-01-01', $year), ':e' => sprintf('%04d-12-31', $year)]);

    $revenue = []; $expense = []; $lines = [];
    $revTotal = 0.0; $expTotal = 0.0; $net = 0.0;
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) {
        $nc = round((float)$r['net_credit'], 2);
        if (abs($nc) < YC_EPS) continue;
        $isRev = ($r['account_type'] === 'revenue');
        $balance = $isRev ? $nc : -$nc;                     // saldo menurut sifat akun (pendapatan = kredit, beban = debit)
        $debit  = $nc > 0 ? $nc : 0.0;                      // menolkan akun: saldo kredit -> didebit, saldo debit -> dikredit
        $credit = $nc < 0 ? -$nc : 0.0;
        $item = ['account_id' => (int)$r['id'], 'account_code' => $r['account_code'], 'account_name' => $r['account_name'],
                 'type' => $isRev ? 'revenue' : 'expense', 'balance' => $balance, 'debit' => $debit, 'credit' => $credit];
        if ($isRev) { $revenue[] = $item; $revTotal += $balance; } else { $expense[] = $item; $expTotal += $balance; }
        $lines[] = $item;
        $net += $nc;                                         // laba = jumlah (kredit - debit) seluruh akun pendapatan & beban
    }
    return ['revenue' => $revenue, 'expense' => $expense, 'lines' => $lines,
            'revenue_total' => round($revTotal, 2), 'expense_total' => round($expTotal, 2), 'net_income' => round($net, 2)];
}

/**
 * [PILIH AKUN] Saring hasil yc_calc ke akun terpilih saja dan hitung ulang total.
 * Id yang tidak ada di hasil hitung (bukan akun pendapatan/beban bersaldo tahun itu) ditolak.
 */
function yc_filter(array $calc, array $ids): array {
    $known = [];
    foreach ($calc['lines'] as $ln) { $known[$ln['account_id']] = true; }
    $set = [];
    foreach ($ids as $id) {
        $id = (int)$id;
        if (!isset($known[$id])) throw new YcBusinessError('Akun terpilih tidak valid / tidak bersaldo pada tahun ini (ID ' . $id . ').');
        $set[$id] = true;
    }
    $revenue = []; $expense = []; $lines = []; $rt = 0.0; $et = 0.0; $net = 0.0;
    foreach ($calc['lines'] as $ln) {
        if (!isset($set[$ln['account_id']])) continue;
        $lines[] = $ln;
        if ($ln['type'] === 'revenue') { $revenue[] = $ln; $rt += $ln['balance']; } else { $expense[] = $ln; $et += $ln['balance']; }
        $net += $ln['debit'] - $ln['credit'];
    }
    return ['revenue' => $revenue, 'expense' => $expense, 'lines' => $lines,
            'revenue_total' => round($rt, 2), 'expense_total' => round($et, 2), 'net_income' => round($net, 2),
            'selected_count' => count($lines), 'total_count' => count($calc['lines'])];
}

function yc_retained($db, int $id): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, account_code, account_name, account_type::text AS account_type, is_active
                          FROM public.chart_of_accounts WHERE id = :id");
    $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
    $a = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$a) throw new YcBusinessError('Akun Laba Ditahan tidak ditemukan.');
    if ($a['account_type'] !== 'equity') throw new YcBusinessError('Akun penampung laba harus bertipe ekuitas (equity).');
    if (!yc_bool($a['is_active'])) throw new YcBusinessError('Akun penampung laba tidak aktif.');
    return $a;
}

if (empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login ulang.');
}

$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';
if ((int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < 1) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Hak baca tutup buku tahunan tidak tersedia.');
if (in_array($task, ['save_closing', 'delete_closing'], true) && ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== 'POST') {
    http_response_code(405);
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Metode harus POST untuk proses tutup / buka kembali buku.');
}

try {
    switch ($task) {

        /* Combo tahun: tahun yang punya jurnal + status penutupan */
        case 'list_years':
            $closed = yc_closed_map($db);
            $years = yc_journal_years($db);
            foreach (array_keys($closed) as $y) { if (!in_array($y, $years, true)) $years[] = $y; }
            sort($years);
            $rows = [];
            foreach ($years as $y) {
                $rows[] = ['year' => $y, 'closed' => isset($closed[$y]),
                           'label' => $y . (isset($closed[$y]) ? ' (sudah ditutup)' : '')];
            }
            sendJsonResponse(true, array_reverse($rows));
            break;

        /* Combo akun ekuitas penampung laba; 3200 = default */
        case 'list_accounts':
            $rows = $db->query("SELECT id, account_code, account_name FROM public.chart_of_accounts
                                 WHERE account_type::text = 'equity' AND is_active = true ORDER BY account_code")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            $out = [];
            foreach ($rows as $r) {
                $out[] = ['id' => (int)$r['id'], 'label' => $r['account_code'] . ' - ' . $r['account_name'],
                          'is_default' => ($r['account_code'] === '3200')];
            }
            sendJsonResponse(true, $out);
            break;

        /* Pratinjau jurnal penutup */
        case 'preview':
            $year = (int)($_REQUEST['year'] ?? 0);
            $accId = (int)($_REQUEST['retained_account_id'] ?? 0);
            try {
                if ($year < 2000 || $year > 2100) throw new YcBusinessError('Tahun buku tidak valid.');
                $state = yc_state($db, $year);
                $calc = yc_calc($db, $year);
                $ra = null;
                if ($accId > 0) { $ra = yc_retained($db, $accId); }
                else { $state['blockers'][] = 'Pilih akun Laba Ditahan.'; }
                if (!count($calc['lines'])) $state['blockers'][] = "Tidak ada saldo pendapatan / beban pada tahun {$year}.";
                sendJsonResponse(true, [
                    'year' => $year, 'closing_date' => $state['closing_date'],
                    'revenue' => $calc['revenue'], 'expense' => $calc['expense'],
                    'revenue_total' => $calc['revenue_total'], 'expense_total' => $calc['expense_total'], 'net_income' => $calc['net_income'],
                    'retained_account' => $ra ? ($ra['account_code'] . ' - ' . $ra['account_name']) : null,
                    'blockers' => $state['blockers'], 'warnings' => $state['warnings'], 'not_ended' => $state['not_ended'],
                    'periods' => $state['periods'],
                ]);
            } catch (YcBusinessError $e) {
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            }
            break;

        /* Daftar penutupan (grid utama) */
        case 'list_closings':
            $st = $db->query("
                SELECT yc.id, yc.fiscal_year, yc.closing_date, yc.journal_no, yc.revenue_total, yc.expense_total, yc.net_income,
                       yc.locked_periods, yc.remark, a.account_code || ' - ' || a.account_name AS retained_account,
                       NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.year_closing x WHERE x.fiscal_year > yc.fiscal_year) AS is_latest
                  FROM public.year_closing yc
                  LEFT JOIN public.chart_of_accounts a ON a.id = yc.retained_account_id
                 ORDER BY yc.fiscal_year DESC");
            $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                $r['id'] = (int)$r['id'];
                $r['fiscal_year'] = (int)$r['fiscal_year'];
                $r['revenue_total'] = (float)$r['revenue_total'];
                $r['expense_total'] = (float)$r['expense_total'];
                $r['net_income'] = (float)$r['net_income'];
                $r['locked_count'] = strlen(trim((string)$r['locked_periods'])) ? count(explode(',', $r['locked_periods'])) : 0;
                $r['is_latest'] = yc_bool($r['is_latest']);
            }
            unset($r);
            sendJsonResponse(true, ['data' => $rows, 'totalCount' => count($rows)]);
            break;

        /* Proses tutup buku: satu transaksi (jurnal + catatan + kunci periode) */
        case 'save_closing':
            if (yc_access() < YC_ACCESS) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk tutup buku.');
            $year = (int)($_POST['year'] ?? 0);
            $accId = (int)($_POST['retained_account_id'] ?? 0);
            $lock = ((int)($_POST['lock_periods'] ?? 0) === 1);
            $force = ((int)($_POST['force'] ?? 0) === 1);
            $remark = trim((string)($_POST['remark'] ?? '')) ?: null;
            $selIds = null;      // [PILIH AKUN] null = semua akun; array = hanya akun terpilih
            if (isset($_POST['account_ids'])) {
                $selIds = json_decode((string)$_POST['account_ids'], true);
                if (!is_array($selIds)) $selIds = [];
            }

            try {
                if ($year < 2000 || $year > 2100) throw new YcBusinessError('Tahun buku tidak valid.');
                if ($selIds !== null && !count($selIds)) throw new YcBusinessError('Pilih minimal satu akun yang akan ditutup.');
                $db->beginTransaction();
                try {
                    $db->query("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(7002)");     // cegah dua proses tutup buku bersamaan

                    $state = yc_state($db, $year);
                    if (count($state['blockers'])) throw new YcBusinessError(implode(' ', $state['blockers']));
                    if ($state['not_ended'] && !$force) throw new YcBusinessError("Tahun {$year} belum berakhir. Konfirmasi diperlukan untuk menutup lebih awal.");
                    $ra = yc_retained($db, $accId);
                    $calc = yc_calc($db, $year);
                    if (!count($calc['lines'])) throw new YcBusinessError("Tidak ada saldo pendapatan / beban pada tahun {$year}.");
                    $calc = yc_filter($calc, $selIds === null ? array_column($calc['lines'], 'account_id') : $selIds);    // [PILIH AKUN]
                    if (!count($calc['lines'])) throw new YcBusinessError('Pilih minimal satu akun yang akan ditutup.');

                    $net = $calc['net_income'];
                    $desc = "Jurnal penutup tahun {$year} - " . ($net >= 0 ? 'laba' : 'rugi') . ' bersih ' . number_format(abs($net), 2, '.', ',') .
                            ($calc['selected_count'] < $calc['total_count'] ? " [{$calc['selected_count']} dari {$calc['total_count']} akun]" : '');

                    $refNo = function_exists('JournalNextRefNo') ? JournalNextRefNo($db) : CreateRefNo('journal_entries', 'ref_no', 'JV');
                    $st = $db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO public.journal_entries
                            (ref_no, journal_date, period_id, reference_type, reference_id, description, status, posted_by, posted_at)
                        VALUES (:no, CAST(:d AS date), :p, 'closing_entry', :rid, :desc, 'posted', :u, now())
                        RETURNING id");
                    $st->execute([':no' => $refNo, ':d' => $state['closing_date'], ':p' => (int)$state['period']['id'],
                                  ':rid' => $year, ':desc' => $desc, ':u' => (int)$_SESSION['user_id'] ?: null]);
                    $jid = (int)$st->fetchColumn();

                    $stL = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO public.journal_lines (journal_id, account_id, debit, credit, description)
                                         VALUES (:j, :a, :d, :c, :t)");
                    $sumD = 0.0; $sumC = 0.0;
                    foreach ($calc['lines'] as $ln) {
                        $stL->execute([':j' => $jid, ':a' => $ln['account_id'], ':d' => $ln['debit'], ':c' => $ln['credit'],
                                       ':t' => "Penutupan {$ln['account_code']} tahun {$year}"]);
                        $sumD += $ln['debit']; $sumC += $ln['credit'];
                    }
                    // baris Laba Ditahan: kredit bila laba, debit bila rugi
                    $reD = $net < 0 ? -$net : 0.0; $reC = $net > 0 ? $net : 0.0;
                    $stL->execute([':j' => $jid, ':a' => (int)$ra['id'], ':d' => $reD, ':c' => $reC,
                                   ':t' => "Laba (rugi) tahun {$year} ke {$ra['account_code']}"]);
                    $sumD += $reD; $sumC += $reC;
                    if (abs($sumD - $sumC) > YC_EPS) throw new Exception('Jurnal penutup tidak seimbang (' . $sumD . ' vs ' . $sumC . ').');

                    // kunci periode tahun ini (bila dipilih) -- simpan id agar bisa dibuka kembali
                    $locked = [];
                    if ($lock) {
                        foreach ($state['periods'] as $p) {
                            if (!$p['is_closed']) { $locked[] = (int)$p['id']; }
                        }
                        // periode Desember (dipakai jurnal ini) masih terbuka saat dicek -> ikut dikunci
                        $stU = $db->prepare("UPDATE public.accounting_periods SET is_closed = true WHERE id = :id");
                        foreach ($locked as $pid) { $stU->execute([':id' => $pid]); }
                    }

                    $st = $db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO public.year_closing
                            (fiscal_year, closing_date, journal_id, journal_no, revenue_total, expense_total, net_income,
                             retained_account_id, locked_periods, remark, created_by)
                        VALUES (:y, CAST(:d AS date), :j, :no, :rt, :et, :ni, :ra, :lp, :r, :u)");
                    $st->execute([':y' => $year, ':d' => $state['closing_date'], ':j' => $jid, ':no' => $refNo,
                                  ':rt' => $calc['revenue_total'], ':et' => $calc['expense_total'], ':ni' => $net,
                                  ':ra' => (int)$ra['id'], ':lp' => implode(',', $locked), ':r' => $remark,
                                  ':u' => (int)$_SESSION['user_id'] ?: null]);

                    $db->commit();
                    sendJsonResponse(true, ['year' => $year, 'journal_no' => $refNo, 'net_income' => $net],
                        "Tutup buku tahun {$year} berhasil. Jurnal {$refNo}, " . ($net >= 0 ? 'laba' : 'rugi') . ' bersih ' .
                        number_format(abs($net), 2) . ($lock ? ', ' . count($locked) . ' periode dikunci.' : '.'));
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                    throw $e;
                }
            } catch (YcBusinessError $e) {
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            }
            break;

        /* Buka kembali: hapus penutupan TERAKHIR, buka kunci periode, hapus jurnal penutup */
        case 'delete_closing':
            if (yc_access() < YC_ACCESS_REOPEN) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk membuka kembali tutup buku.');
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $db->query("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(7002)");
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT fiscal_year, journal_no, locked_periods FROM public.year_closing WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$r) throw new YcBusinessError('Data penutupan tidak ditemukan.');
                $year = (int)$r['fiscal_year'];

                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.year_closing WHERE fiscal_year > :y");
                $st->execute([':y' => $year]);
                if ((int)$st->fetchColumn() > 0) {
                    throw new YcBusinessError("Hanya penutupan tahun terakhir yang dapat dibuka kembali. Buka kembali tahun yang lebih baru terlebih dahulu.");
                }

                // buka kunci periode yang dikunci oleh penutupan ini (supaya jurnal penutup di periode Desember bisa dihapus)
                $ids = array_filter(array_map('intval', explode(',', (string)$r['locked_periods'])));
                $stU = $db->prepare("UPDATE public.accounting_periods SET is_closed = false WHERE id = :id");
                foreach ($ids as $pid) { $stU->execute([':id' => $pid]); }

                ReverseJournalByReference($db, YC_REF, $year);
                $db->prepare("DELETE FROM public.year_closing WHERE id = :id")->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $db->commit();
                sendJsonResponse(true, [], "Tutup buku tahun {$year} dibuka kembali; jurnal {$r['journal_no']} dihapus dan " . count($ids) . ' periode dibuka.');
            } catch (YcBusinessError $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        default:
            sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.');
            break;
    }
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[year.closingCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[year.closingCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}

function SaveBinLocation($db, $id, $post) {
    $warehouseId = intval($post['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);
    $code        = trim($post['code'] ?? '');
    $name        = trim($post['name'] ?? '');
    $zone        = trim($post['zone'] ?? '');
    $rack        = trim($post['rack'] ?? '');
    $level       = trim($post['level'] ?? '');
    $active      = isset($post['active']) && ($post['active'] === '1' || $post['active'] === 'true' || $post['active'] === true);

    if ($warehouseId <= 0) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gudang wajib dipilih.']);
        return;
    }
    if ($code === '') {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Kode Bin Location wajib diisi.']);
        return;
    }

    $sqlDup = "SELECT id FROM bin_locations WHERE warehouse_id = :warehouse_id AND code = :code";
    $paramsDup = ['warehouse_id' => $warehouseId, 'code' => $code];
    if ($id) {
        $sqlDup .= " AND id != :id";
        $paramsDup['id'] = $id;
    }
    $stmtDup = $db->prepare($sqlDup);
    $stmtDup->execute($paramsDup);
    if ($stmtDup->fetch()) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => "Kode '{$code}' sudah ada di gudang ini."]);
        return;
    }

    $data = [
        'warehouse_id' => $warehouseId,
        'code'         => $code,
        'name'         => $name !== '' ? $name : null,
        'zone'         => $zone !== '' ? $zone : null,
        'rack'         => $rack !== '' ? $rack : null,
        'level'        => $level !== '' ? $level : null,
        'active'       => $active ? 'true' : 'false'
    ];

    if ($id === null) {
        DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('bin_locations', $data), 'insert bin_locations');
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Bin Location '{$code}' berhasil ditambahkan."]);
    } else {
        DbOrFail($db, $db->update('bin_locations', $data, "id = {$id}"), 'update bin_locations');
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Bin Location '{$code}' berhasil diperbarui."]);
    }
}
exit;

 * purchase.planningCRD.php

function PgOrFail($result, $context = '') {
    if ($result === false) {
        $err = pg_last_error();
        // [SECURITY PATCH] jangan sampai pesan database bocor ke frontend;
        // log detail ke server saja, lempar pesan umum yang aman.
        error_log('purchase.planningCRD PgOrFail [' . $context . ']: ' . $err);
        throw new Exception(($context ? "[{$context}] " : '') . 'Terjadi kesalahan pada database. Silakan hubungi administrator.');
    }
    return $result;
}

// Qty yang sudah di-PO-kan per baris RAB (PO Dibatalkan tidak dihitung).
// Dipakai di dua task supaya hitungannya selalu konsisten.
const PLAN_PO_SUM = "
    SELECT poi.budget_item_id, SUM(poi.qty) AS qty_ordered
      FROM po_items poi
      JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id = poi.po_id
     WHERE po.status <> 'Dibatalkan' AND poi.budget_item_id IS NOT NULL
     GROUP BY poi.budget_item_id
";

try {
    // [INVENTORY] helper stok butuh koneksi PDO crudClass (GetProjectStockMap).
    $db = new crud();

    switch ($task) {

        // ==========================================================
        // LIST PROJECTS -- Grid Utama (Proyek + Ringkasan Sisa Beli)
        // ==========================================================
        case 'list_projects':
            $searchQuery = trim($_REQUEST['query'] ?? '');
            $searchWhere = '';
            $searchParams = [];
            if ($searchQuery !== '') {
                $searchWhere = " WHERE p.name ILIKE $1";
                $searchParams[] = '%' . $searchQuery . '%';
            }

            $sql = "SELECT p.id, p.name,
                           COALESCE(agg.total_rab_count, 0) AS total_rab_count,
                           COALESCE(agg.material_count, 0) AS material_count,
                           COALESCE(agg.total_remaining_value, 0) AS total_remaining_value
                    FROM public.projects p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT bi.project_id,
                               COUNT(*) AS total_rab_count,
                               COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (bi.qty_plan - COALESCE(po_sum.qty_ordered, 0)) > 0.0001) AS material_count,
                               SUM(GREATEST(bi.qty_plan - COALESCE(po_sum.qty_ordered, 0), 0) * COALESCE(bi.unit_price_plan, 0)) AS total_remaining_value
                          FROM public.budget_items bi
                          JOIN public.materials m ON m.id = bi.material_id
                          LEFT JOIN (" . PLAN_PO_SUM . ") po_sum ON po_sum.budget_item_id = bi.id
                         WHERE bi.category = 'Material' AND COALESCE(bi.qty_plan, 0) > 0
                         GROUP BY bi.project_id
                    ) agg ON agg.project_id = p.id
                    {$searchWhere}
                    ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC";
            $result = PgOrFail(pg_query_params($sql, $searchParams), 'list_projects');
            $rows = pg_fetch_all($result) ?: [];
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $rows, 'totalCount' => count($rows)]);
            break;

        // ==========================================================
        // LOAD PLANNING -- Detail Sisa Beli per Material utk 1 Proyek
        // ==========================================================
        case 'load_planning':
            $projectId = (int)($_REQUEST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($projectId <= 0) throw new Exception('Proyek belum dipilih');

            $sql = "SELECT bi.id AS rab_material_id, bi.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(bi.unit, ''), m.unit, '') AS unit,
                           bi.qty_plan AS budget_qty,
                           COALESCE(bi.unit_price_plan, 0) AS unit_price,
                           COALESCE(po_sum.qty_ordered, 0) AS qty_ordered,
                           GREATEST(bi.qty_plan - COALESCE(po_sum.qty_ordered, 0), 0) AS qty_remaining,
                           (GREATEST(bi.qty_plan - COALESCE(po_sum.qty_ordered, 0), 0) * COALESCE(bi.unit_price_plan, 0)) AS remaining_value,
                           0 AS qty_on_hand,
                           GREATEST(bi.qty_plan - COALESCE(po_sum.qty_ordered, 0), 0) AS qty_to_buy,
                           COALESCE(bi.material_source, 'COMPANY') AS material_source
                      FROM public.budget_items bi
                      JOIN public.materials m ON m.id = bi.material_id
                      LEFT JOIN (" . PLAN_PO_SUM . ") po_sum ON po_sum.budget_item_id = bi.id
                     WHERE bi.project_id = $1 AND bi.category = 'Material' AND COALESCE(bi.qty_plan, 0) > 0
                     ORDER BY m.material_name";
            $result = PgOrFail(pg_query_params($sql, [$projectId]), 'load_planning');
            $rows = pg_fetch_all($result) ?: [];

            // [INVENTORY] kaya tiap baris dg saldo stok yang dapat dipakai proyek ini.
            // Baris RAB ganda utk material sama dijumlahkan stoknya sekali saja per material.
            // [CLIENT-SUPPLIED F-4.1] material_source='CLIENT_SUPPLIED' (titipan klien) TIDAK DIBELI:
            // qty_to_buy wajib 0 (skip total, bukan GREATEST(...)) -- barang datangnya dari klien.
            $stockMap = GetProjectStockMap($db, $projectId);
            $seenMat  = [];
            foreach ($rows as &$row) {
                $mid = (int)$row['material_id'];
                $onHand = $stockMap[$mid] ?? 0.0;
                $row['qty_on_hand'] = $onHand;
                $row['material_source'] = strtoupper(trim((string)($row['material_source'] ?: 'COMPANY')));
                if ($row['material_source'] === 'CLIENT_SUPPLIED') {
                    $row['qty_to_buy'] = 0.0;
                    continue;
                }
                // material sama muncul di >1 baris RAB: stok hanya boleh dipakai sekali
                if (isset($seenMat[$mid])) {
                    $row['qty_on_hand'] = 0.0;
                    $row['qty_to_buy']  = (float)$row['qty_remaining'];
                } else {
                    $seenMat[$mid] = true;
                    $row['qty_to_buy'] = max((float)$row['qty_remaining'] - $onHand, 0.0);
                }
            }
            unset($row);
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $rows]);
            break;

        // ==========================================================
        // CHECK INVENTORY -- validasi rencana beli sebelum PO dibuat.
        // Input: project_id + items[] (rab_material_id, material_id, qty).
        // Output per baris: sisa kuota RAB, stok tersedia, kekurangan
        // (qty_to_buy). Stok dipakai bersama antarbaris RAB material sama.
        // ==========================================================
        case 'check_inventory':
            $projectId = (int)($_REQUEST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($projectId <= 0) throw new Exception('Proyek belum dipilih.');

            $rawItems = $_REQUEST['items'] ?? $_POST['items'] ?? '[]';
            $items = is_string($rawItems) ? json_decode($rawItems, true) : $rawItems;
            if (!is_array($items) || !$items) throw new Exception('Tidak ada material yang diperiksa.');

            $stockMap = GetProjectStockMap($db, $projectId);

            // Sisa kuota RAB per budget_item_id (PO Dibatalkan tidak dihitung)
            $poSum = [];
            $rs = PgOrFail(pg_query_params("
                SELECT poi.budget_item_id, SUM(poi.qty) AS qty_ordered
                  FROM po_items poi
                  JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id = poi.po_id
                 WHERE po.status <> 'Dibatalkan' AND poi.budget_item_id IS NOT NULL
                 GROUP BY poi.budget_item_id", []), 'check_inventory:po_sum');
            foreach (pg_fetch_all($rs) ?: [] as $r) {
                $poSum[(int)$r['budget_item_id']] = (float)$r['qty_ordered'];
            }

            $rabById = [];
            $rs2 = PgOrFail(pg_query_params("
                SELECT bi.id, bi.material_id, bi.qty_plan, COALESCE(bi.tolerance_pct, 0) AS tol,
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(bi.unit, ''), m.unit, '') AS unit, m.material_name,
                       COALESCE(bi.material_source, 'COMPANY') AS material_source
                  FROM public.budget_items bi
                  JOIN public.materials m ON m.id = bi.material_id
                 WHERE bi.project_id = $1 AND bi.category = 'Material' AND COALESCE(bi.qty_plan, 0) > 0", [$projectId]), 'check_inventory:rab');
            foreach (pg_fetch_all($rs2) ?: [] as $r) {
                $rabById[(int)$r['id']] = $r;
            }

            $usedStock = [];   // material_id => stok yang sudah diklaim baris sebelumnya
            $data = [];
            foreach ($items as $n => $it) {
                $no   = 'Baris ' . ($n + 1);
                $bid  = (int)($it['rab_material_id'] ?? $it['budget_item_id'] ?? 0);
                $mid  = (int)($it['material_id'] ?? 0);
                $qty  = round((float)($it['qty'] ?? 0), 4);
                if ($bid <= 0 || $mid <= 0 || $qty <= 0) {
                    $data[] = ['line' => $no, 'rab_material_id' => $bid, 'material_id' => $mid, 'qty' => $qty,
                               'ok' => false, 'message' => $no . ': material dan qty (> 0) wajib diisi.'];
                    continue;
                }
                $bi = $rabById[$bid] ?? null;
                if (!$bi || (int)$bi['material_id'] !== $mid) {
                    $data[] = ['line' => $no, 'rab_material_id' => $bid, 'material_id' => $mid, 'qty' => $qty,
                               'ok' => false, 'message' => $no . ': material tidak ada di RAB proyek ini.'];
                    continue;
                }
                $remaining = max((float)$bi['qty_plan'] - ($poSum[$bid] ?? 0.0), 0.0);
                $quota     = (float)$bi['qty_plan'] * (1 + (float)$bi['tol'] / 100) - ($poSum[$bid] ?? 0.0);
                $onHand    = $stockMap[$mid] ?? 0.0;
                $claimed   = $usedStock[$mid] ?? 0.0;
                $free      = max($onHand - $claimed, 0.0);        // stok belum diklaim baris lain
                $covered   = min($qty, $free);
                $src       = strtoupper(trim((string)($bi['material_source'] ?: 'COMPANY')));
                // [CLIENT-SUPPLIED F-4.1] titipan klien tidak dibeli -> qty_to_buy wajib 0 (skip,
                // bukan GREATEST); stok gudang tetap boleh dipakai untuk cover kebutuhan proyek.
                $toBuy     = ($src === 'CLIENT_SUPPLIED') ? 0.0 : max($qty - $free, 0.0);
                $usedStock[$mid] = $claimed + $covered;

                $msgs = [];
                $err = false;
                if ($qty > $quota + 0.0001) {
                    $msgs[] = 'qty rencana ' . $qty . ' ' . $bi['unit'] . ' melebihi sisa kuota RAB ' . max($quota, 0.0) . ' ' . $bi['unit'];
                    $err = true;
                }
                if ($toBuy > 0.0001) {
                    // bukan error: stok tidak mencukupi -> sisa kebutuhan harus dibeli
                    $msgs[] = 'stok tersedia ' . $free . ' ' . $bi['unit'] . ', perlu beli ' . $toBuy . ' ' . $bi['unit'];
                } elseif ($src === 'CLIENT_SUPPLIED') {
                    $msgs[] = 'material titipan klien (CLIENT_SUPPLIED): tidak dibeli, qty_to_buy = 0';
                }
                $data[] = [
                    'line' => $no, 'rab_material_id' => $bid, 'material_id' => $mid,
                    'material_name' => $bi['material_name'] ?? '', 'unit' => $bi['unit'],
                    'material_source' => $src,
                    'qty' => $qty, 'qty_remaining' => $remaining, 'quota_remaining' => max($quota, 0.0),
                    'qty_on_hand' => $onHand, 'qty_covered' => $covered, 'qty_to_buy' => $toBuy,
                    'ok' => !$err,
                    'message' => $msgs ? $no . ': ' . implode('; ', $msgs) . '.' : 'OK'
                ];
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'project_id' => $projectId, 'data' => $data]);
            break;

        default:
            throw new Exception('Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task));
    }
} catch (Exception $e) {
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
/*
  Document      : Profit & Loss (Rugi Laba) - CRUD & Report Handler

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;

$task   = $_POST['task'] ?? $_REQUEST['task'] ?? 'read_profit_loss';

if ($access < 1) { http_response_code(403); echo json_encode(['success'=>false,'message'=>'Hak baca Laba Rugi tidak tersedia.']); exit; }
if (in_array($task, ['create', 'update', 'delete'], true) && ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== 'POST') {
    http_response_code(405);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Metode harus POST untuk perubahan master akun.']);
    exit;

$db     = new crud();

switch ($task) {

    case 'read_periods':
        $sql = "SELECT id, period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods ORDER BY start_date DESC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    case 'read_profit_loss':
        $periodId = intval($_POST['period_id'] ?? $_REQUEST['period_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($periodId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode akuntansi wajib dipilih.']);
            exit;
        }

        $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtP->execute(['id' => $periodId]);
        $period = $stmtP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$period) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode tidak ditemukan.']);
            exit;
        }

        // [YTD] Awal tahun berjalan = 1 Januari tahun akhir periode (bila periode mulai sebelum itu, pakai awal periode)
        $ytdStart = date('Y', strtotime($period['end_date'])) . '-01-01';
        if ($period['start_date'] < $ytdStart) { $ytdStart = $period['start_date']; }

        $sql = "
            SELECT c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type,
                   -- [YTD] amount = mutasi DALAM periode; amount_cum = tahun berjalan (YTD): 1 Jan tahun periode s/d akhir periode
                   COALESCE(SUM(
                       CASE WHEN j.id IS NOT NULL AND j.journal_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date THEN
                           CASE WHEN c.account_type = 'revenue' THEN l.credit - l.debit
                                WHEN c.account_type = 'expense' THEN l.debit - l.credit
                                ELSE 0 END
                       ELSE 0 END
                   ), 0) AS amount,
                   COALESCE(SUM(
                       CASE WHEN j.id IS NOT NULL THEN
                           CASE WHEN c.account_type = 'revenue' THEN l.credit - l.debit
                                WHEN c.account_type = 'expense' THEN l.debit - l.credit
                                ELSE 0 END
                       ELSE 0 END
                   ), 0) AS amount_cum
            FROM chart_of_accounts c
            LEFT JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
            LEFT JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
                AND j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')
                AND j.journal_date BETWEEN :ytd_start AND :cum_end
                AND j.reference_type::text <> 'closing_entry'      -- [CLOSING] jurnal penutup tahunan tidak ikut dihitung di Laba Rugi (supaya tahun yang ditutup tetap menampilkan pendapatan & beban)
            WHERE c.is_active = true
              AND c.account_type IN ('revenue', 'expense')
            GROUP BY c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type
            ORDER BY c.account_code ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([
            'start_date' => $period['start_date'],
            'end_date'   => $period['end_date'],
            'ytd_start'  => $ytdStart,               // [YTD]
            'cum_end'    => $period['end_date']      // [YTD] nama parameter dibedakan (PDO pgsql tidak mengizinkan nama yang sama dipakai dua kali)
        ]);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $revenues = [];
        $expenses = [];
        $totalRevenue = 0;
        $totalExpense = 0;
        $totalRevenueCum = 0;      // [CUM]
        $totalExpenseCum = 0;      // [CUM]

        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $amount = floatval($r['amount']);
            $amountCum = floatval($r['amount_cum']);      // [CUM]
            $item = [
                'id'           => $r['id'],
                'account_code' => $r['account_code'],
                'account_name' => $r['account_name'],
                'amount'       => $amount,
                'amount_cum'   => $amountCum               // [CUM]
            ];

            if ($r['account_type'] === 'revenue') {
                $revenues[] = $item;
                $totalRevenue += $amount;
                $totalRevenueCum += $amountCum;            // [CUM]
            } else if ($r['account_type'] === 'expense') {
                $expenses[] = $item;
                $totalExpense += $amount;
                $totalExpenseCum += $amountCum;            // [CUM]
            }
        }

        $netProfitLoss = $totalRevenue - $totalExpense;

        echo json_encode([
            'success'        => true,
            'period_name'    => $period['period_name'],
            'start_date'     => $period['start_date'],
            'end_date'       => $period['end_date'],
            'ytd_start'      => $ytdStart,      // [YTD]
            'revenues'       => $revenues,
            'expenses'       => $expenses,
            'total_revenue'  => $totalRevenue,
            'total_expense'  => $totalExpense,
            'net_profit_loss'=> $netProfitLoss,
            // [CUM] total kumulatif s/d akhir periode
            'total_revenue_cum'   => $totalRevenueCum,
            'total_expense_cum'   => $totalExpenseCum,
            'net_profit_loss_cum' => $totalRevenueCum - $totalExpenseCum
        ]);
        break;

    case 'create':
        if ($access < 2) { echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']); exit; }
        $code = trim($_POST['account_code'] ?? '');
        $name = trim($_POST['account_name'] ?? '');
        $type = trim($_POST['account_type'] ?? '');
        if (empty($code) || empty($name) || !in_array($type, ['revenue', 'expense'])) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Data tidak lengkap.']); exit;
        }
        $db->insert('chart_of_accounts', ['account_code' => $code, 'account_name' => $name, 'account_type' => $type, 'is_active' => true]);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Akun berhasil ditambahkan.']);
        break;

    case 'update':
        if ($access < 3) { echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']); exit; }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $code = trim($_POST['account_code'] ?? '');
        $name = trim($_POST['account_name'] ?? '');
        if ($id <= 0 || empty($code) || empty($name)) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Data tidak valid.']); exit;
        }
        $db->update('chart_of_accounts', ['account_code' => $code, 'account_name' => $name], "id = {$id}");
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Akun berhasil diperbarui.']);
        break;

    case 'delete':
        if ($access < 4) { echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']); exit; }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) { echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID tidak valid.']); exit; }
        $db->update('chart_of_accounts', ['is_active' => false], "id = {$id}");
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Akun dinonaktifkan.']);
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
}

// Helper error handling PostgreSQL
function PgOrFail($result, $context = '') {
    if ($result === false) {
        $err = pg_last_error();
        // [SECURITY PATCH] jangan sampai pesan database bocor ke frontend;
        // log detail ke server saja, lempar pesan umum yang aman.
        error_log('m.materialsCRD PgOrFail [' . $context . ']: ' . $err);
        throw new Exception(($context ? "[{$context}] " : '') . 'Terjadi kesalahan pada database. Silakan hubungi administrator.');
    }
    return $result;
}

try {
    switch ($task) {

        case 'list':
            $search = trim($_REQUEST['query'] ?? '');
            $where  = '1=1';

                $where .= " AND (material_code ILIKE $1 OR material_name ILIKE $1)";
                $params[] = '%' . $search . '%';

                    FROM materials
                    WHERE {$where}
                    ORDER BY material_name ASC";

            $rows = pg_fetch_all($result) ?: [];

            }

            break;

        // 3. CREATE -- Insert Material Baru
        // ==========================================================
        case 'create':
            $code  = trim($_POST['material_code'] ?? '');

                ), 'insert materials');
