header('Content-Type: application/json');

$db = new crud();

const TI_EPS = 0.01;                          // toleransi nilai rupiah
const TI_JOURNAL_REF = 'project_invoice';     // nilai enum journal_entries.reference_type
const TI_PPN_RULE = 'PROJECT_INVOICE_PPN';    // fiscal_config: Dr Piutang Usaha / Cr PPN Keluaran
const TI_REL_DRAFT = 'draft';                 // [RELEASE-LAYER] belum diterbitkan ke client
const TI_REL_RELEASED = 'released';           // [RELEASE-LAYER] dokumen tagihan sudah diterbitkan

class TiError extends Exception {}

function ti_send($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $resp = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        $resp['data'] = $data;
        if (!isset($resp['totalCount'])) $resp['totalCount'] = is_array($data) ? count($data) : 0;
    }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($resp, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

function ti_valid_date(string $s): bool {
    $d = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $s);
    return $d && $d->format('Y-m-d') === $s;
}

/** [RELEASE-LAYER] Baca catatan penerbitan dari POST: opsional, string, maks 200 karakter, sudah di-trim. */
function ti_read_release_note(): string {
    $raw = trim((string)($_POST['release_note'] ?? ''));
    if ($raw === '') return '';
    if (function_exists('mb_strlen') && mb_strlen($raw, 'UTF-8') > 200) {
        throw new TiError('Catatan penerbitan terlalu panjang (maksimal 200 karakter).');
    } elseif (!function_exists('mb_strlen') && strlen($raw) > 200) {
        throw new TiError('Catatan penerbitan terlalu panjang (maksimal 200 karakter).');
    }
    return $raw;
}

function ti_has_journal($db, int $invId): bool {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.journal_entries WHERE reference_type::text = :t AND reference_id = :id LIMIT 1");
    $st->execute([':t' => TI_JOURNAL_REF, ':id' => $invId]);
    return (bool)$st->fetchColumn();
}

/** Jurnal penagihan: DPP ke pendapatan + PPN ke PPN Keluaran (bila ada) + Retensi (bila diatur di fiscal_config). */
function ti_post_journal($db, int $invId, string $invNo, string $date, float $dpp, float $ppn, string $projectName, float $retentionAmount = 0.0): void {
    // Cek apakah akun retensi khusus terdaftar di fiscal_config
    $stRet = $db->query("SELECT id FROM public.fiscal_config WHERE rule_code = 'PROJECT_RETENTION' AND is_active LIMIT 1");
    $hasRetentionRule = (bool)$stRet->fetchColumn();

    $netDpp = $dpp;
    if ($hasRetentionRule && $retentionAmount > TI_EPS) {
        $netDpp = round($dpp - $retentionAmount, 2);
        if ($netDpp < 0) $netDpp = 0.0;
    }

    $jr = AutoPostJournal($db, [
        'rule_code' => 'PROJECT_INVOICE', 'reference_type' => TI_JOURNAL_REF, 'reference_id' => $invId,
        'journal_date' => $date, 'amount' => $netDpp, 'description' => "Tagihan termin {$invNo} - {$projectName}",
    ]);
    if (!$jr['success']) throw new TiError('Gagal posting jurnal penagihan: ' . $jr['message']);

    if ($hasRetentionRule && $retentionAmount > TI_EPS) {
        $jrRet = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code' => 'PROJECT_RETENTION', 'reference_type' => TI_JOURNAL_REF, 'reference_id' => $invId,
            'journal_date' => $date, 'amount' => $retentionAmount, 'description' => "Retensi ditahan termin {$invNo} - {$projectName}",
        ]);
        if (!$jrRet['success']) throw new TiError('Gagal posting jurnal retensi proyek: ' . $jrRet['message']);
    }

    if ($ppn > TI_EPS) {
        $jr = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code' => TI_PPN_RULE, 'reference_type' => TI_JOURNAL_REF, 'reference_id' => $invId,
            'journal_date' => $date, 'amount' => $ppn, 'description' => "PPN Keluaran termin {$invNo} - {$projectName}",
        ]);
        if (!$jr['success']) throw new TiError('Gagal posting jurnal PPN Keluaran: ' . $jr['message']);
    }
}

/** Invoice sudah punya pembayaran? */
function ti_has_payment($db, int $invId, float $paid): bool {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.project_payment_items WHERE invoice_id = :id");
    $st->execute([':id' => $invId]);
    return $paid > TI_EPS || (int)$st->fetchColumn() > 0;
}

/**
 * [RELEASE-LAYER 2026-11-15] Cek periode akuntansi terbuka untuk tanggal jurnal penagihan.
 * Dijalankan SEBELUM mutasi release (dalam transaksi yang sama) supaya gagal cek = release batal whole,
 * bukan invoice released tapi jurnal gagal posting (inkonsisten). is_closed bertipe boolean.
 */
function ti_ensure_period_open($db, string $journalDate, string $invNo): void {
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT id, is_closed
          FROM public.accounting_periods
         WHERE CAST(:jdate AS date) BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
         LIMIT 1");
    $st->execute([':jdate' => $journalDate]);
    $period = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$period) {
        throw new TiError("Tidak ada periode akuntansi yang mencakup tanggal {$journalDate} (invoice {$invNo}). Buat periode-nya dulu di menu Fiscal Period.");
    }
    if ((bool)$period['is_closed']) {
        throw new TiError("Periode akuntansi untuk tanggal {$journalDate} sudah ditutup. Invoice {$invNo} tidak dapat diterbitkan.");
    }
}

/** Cek no. faktur pajak keluaran unik antar invoice. */
function ti_check_faktur_unique($db, $fpNo, int $exclId): void {
    if ($fpNo === null || $fpNo === '') return;
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT inv_no FROM public.project_invoices WHERE faktur_pajak_no = :n AND id <> :id LIMIT 1");
    $st->execute([':n' => $fpNo, ':id' => $exclId]);
    $dup = $st->fetchColumn();
    if ($dup) throw new TiError("No. faktur pajak {$fpNo} sudah dipakai invoice {$dup}.");
}

/** [RELEASE-LAYER] Nomor dokumen tagihan berikutnya (format TAG-yymm-00001, seperti CreateRefNo tapi dalam transaksi PDO berjalan). */
function ti_next_release_no($db): string {
    $db->query("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(987654321)");          // kunci supaya tidak ada nomor ganda saat release bersamaan
    $ym = date('ym');
    $prefix = 'TAG-' . $ym . '-';
    // [FIX-REFNO] substring(x from '.....$') adalah potongan regex POSIX 5 karakter TERAKHIR, bukan 5 digit seri:
    // seri < 5 digit (mis. TAG-2611-1) menghasilkan potongan '611-1' -> CAST integer error / MAX salah ->
    // nomor berikutnya bisa 0 atau ganda. Pakai RIGHT() + filter regex ^TAG-yymm-[0-9]{5}$ (pola JournalNextRefNo)
    // supaya hanya nomor seri format valid yang dihitung.
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(release_no, 5) AS integer)), 0) + 1
          FROM public.project_invoices
         WHERE release_no IS NOT NULL
           AND release_no ~ :pat");
    $st->execute([':pat' => '^' . $prefix . '[0-9]{5}$']);
    return $prefix . str_pad((string)(int)$st->fetchColumn(), 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
}

/**
 * [RELEASE-LAYER] Terbitkan satu invoice: draft -> released (+ nomor TAG, tanggal, user, catatan) + posting jurnal bila belum ada.
 * HARUS dipanggil di dalam transaksi PDO yang sudah dibuka. Melempar TiError bila tidak memenuhi syarat.
 * Catatan penerbitan (release_note) opsional, maks 200 karakter; nilai kosong -> ''.
 */
function ti_release_one($db, int $id, string $relDate, int $userId, string $relNote = ''): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, inv_no, project_id, paid_amount, release_status, invoice_date FROM public.project_invoices WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
    $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
    $inv = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$inv) throw new TiError('Invoice tidak ditemukan.');
    if ((string)$inv['release_status'] !== TI_REL_DRAFT) {
        throw new TiError("Invoice {$inv['inv_no']} sudah diterbitkan (status: {$inv['release_status']}).");
    }
    if (ti_has_payment($db, $id, (float)$inv['paid_amount'])) {
        throw new TiError("Invoice {$inv['inv_no']} sudah memiliki pembayaran, tidak dapat diterbitkan ulang.");
    }
    // [RELEASE-LAYER 2026-11-15] periode akuntansi tanggal terbit & tanggal invoice (dasar tanggal jurnal) wajib terbuka.
    // invoice_date NULL/'' (data tidak lazim) -> cukup tanggal terbit; jangan sampai CAST('' AS date) error.
    ti_ensure_period_open($db, $relDate, $inv['inv_no']);
    $invDate = isset($inv['invoice_date']) ? trim((string)$inv['invoice_date']) : '';
    if ($invDate !== '') { ti_ensure_period_open($db, $invDate, $inv['inv_no']); }
    $relNo = ti_next_release_no($db);
    $st = $db->prepare("
        UPDATE public.project_invoices
           SET release_status = :s, release_no = :n, release_date = CAST(:d AS date), released_by = :u, release_note = :note
         WHERE id = :id");
    $st->execute([':s' => TI_REL_RELEASED, ':n' => $relNo, ':d' => $relDate, ':u' => $userId, ':note' => $relNote, ':id' => $id]);

    // Jurnal penagihan: invoice lama (pra migrasi) mungkin sudah punya jurnal -> jangan posting ganda.
    if (!ti_has_journal($db, $id)) {
        $st = $db->prepare("
            SELECT v.dpp_amount, v.ppn_amount, v.amount, v.invoice_date, p.name AS project_name
              FROM public.project_invoices v JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = v.project_id
             WHERE v.id = :id");
        $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
        $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $dpp = (float)$r['dpp_amount'] > 0 ? (float)$r['dpp_amount'] : (float)$r['amount'];
        ti_post_journal($db, $id, $inv['inv_no'], (string)$r['invoice_date'], $dpp, (float)$r['ppn_amount'], (string)$r['project_name']);
    }
    return ['inv_no' => $inv['inv_no'], 'release_no' => $relNo];
}

if (empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    ti_send(false, [], 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login ulang.');
}

$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';

$invoiceAccess = (int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
$invoiceRequired = 1;
if ($task === 'save_invoice') $invoiceRequired = 2;
// [RELEASE-LAYER] penerbitan & pembatalan release = level ubah (3); hapus tetap level 4.
if (in_array($task, ['update_faktur_pajak', 'release_invoice', 'release_invoices', 'unrelease_invoice'], true)) $invoiceRequired = 3;
if ($task === 'delete_invoice') $invoiceRequired = 4;
if ($invoiceAccess < $invoiceRequired) {
    http_response_code(403);
    ti_send(false, [], 'Hak akses tidak mencukupi untuk operasi invoice proyek ini.');
}
if (in_array($task, ['save_invoice', 'update_faktur_pajak', 'delete_invoice', 'release_invoice', 'release_invoices', 'unrelease_invoice'], true)
    && ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== 'POST') {
    http_response_code(405);
    ti_send(false, [], 'Metode harus POST untuk perubahan invoice proyek.');
}

try {
    switch ($task) {

        case 'list_clients':
            $rows = $db->query("SELECT id, name FROM public.clients ORDER BY name ASC")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) $r['id'] = (int)$r['id'];
            unset($r);
            ti_send(true, $rows);
            break;

        // Proyek + nilai kontrak + total DPP yang sudah ditagih (untuk kontrol sisa kontrak di form)
        case 'list_projects':
            $rows = $db->query("
                SELECT p.id, p.name, p.client_id, COALESCE(p.contract_value, 0) AS contract_value,
                       COALESCE(b.dpp, 0) AS billed_dpp
                  FROM public.projects p
                  LEFT JOIN (SELECT project_id, SUM(CASE WHEN dpp_amount > 0 THEN dpp_amount ELSE amount END) AS dpp
                               FROM public.project_invoices GROUP BY project_id) b ON b.project_id = p.id
                 ORDER BY p.name ASC")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                $r['id'] = (int)$r['id'];
                $r['client_id'] = $r['client_id'] !== null ? (int)$r['client_id'] : 0;
                $r['contract_value'] = (float)$r['contract_value'];
                $r['billed_dpp'] = (float)$r['billed_dpp'];
            }
            unset($r);
            ti_send(true, $rows);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Daftar invoice + ringkasan (grid utama)
         * Filter: query, client_id, project_id, status (unpaid|partial|paid|open|overdue),
         *         doc_status (draft|released) [RELEASE-LAYER], date_from, date_to
         * Ringkasan HANYA menghitung invoice RELEASED (tagihan resmi ke client);
         * nilai DRAFT dilaporkan terpisah (draft_count / draft_value) untuk keperluan monitoring.
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'list_invoices':
            $start = max((int)($_REQUEST['start'] ?? 0), 0);
            $limit = min(max((int)($_REQUEST['limit'] ?? 250), 1), 1000);
            $query = trim((string)($_REQUEST['query'] ?? ''));
            $cli   = (int)($_REQUEST['client_id'] ?? 0);
            $prj   = (int)($_REQUEST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            $stat  = (string)($_REQUEST['status'] ?? '');
            $doc   = (string)($_REQUEST['doc_status'] ?? '');               // [RELEASE-LAYER]
            $dFrom = (string)($_REQUEST['date_from'] ?? '');
            $dTo   = (string)($_REQUEST['date_to'] ?? '');

            $where = []; $params = [];
            if ($query !== '') {
                $where[] = "(x.inv_no ILIKE :q OR x.project_name ILIKE :q OR x.client_name ILIKE :q OR x.termin_name ILIKE :q OR x.faktur_pajak_no ILIKE :q OR x.release_no ILIKE :q)";
                $params[':q'] = '%' . $query . '%';
            }
            if ($cli > 0) { $where[] = "x.client_id = :cli"; $params[':cli'] = $cli; }
            if ($prj > 0) { $where[] = "x.project_id = :prj"; $params[':prj'] = $prj; }
            if ($dFrom !== '' && ti_valid_date($dFrom)) { $where[] = "x.invoice_date >= CAST(:df AS date)"; $params[':df'] = $dFrom; }
            if ($dTo !== '' && ti_valid_date($dTo))     { $where[] = "x.invoice_date <= CAST(:dt AS date)"; $params[':dt'] = $dTo; }
            switch ($stat) {
                case 'unpaid':  $where[] = "x.paid_amount <= 0.005"; break;
                case 'partial': $where[] = "x.paid_amount > 0.005 AND x.amount - x.paid_amount > 0.005"; break;
                case 'paid':    $where[] = "x.amount - x.paid_amount <= 0.005"; break;
                case 'open':    $where[] = "x.amount - x.paid_amount > 0.005"; break;
                case 'overdue': $where[] = "x.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND x.amount - x.paid_amount > 0.005"; break;
            }
            switch ($doc) {                                                   // [RELEASE-LAYER]
                case 'draft':    $where[] = "x.release_status = 'draft'"; break;
                case 'released': $where[] = "x.release_status = 'released'"; break;
            }
            $w = count($where) ? 'WHERE ' . implode(' AND ', $where) : '';

            $base = "
                SELECT v.id, v.inv_no, v.invoice_date, v.due_date, v.termin_name, v.percentage, v.amount, v.paid_amount,
                       v.dpp_amount, v.ppn_rate, v.ppn_amount, v.faktur_pajak_no, v.faktur_pajak_date, v.remark,
                       v.release_status, v.release_no, v.release_date, v.released_by, v.release_note,
                       e.employee_name AS released_by_name,
                       p.id AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, cl.id AS client_id, cl.name AS client_name,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.project_id ORDER BY v.invoice_date, v.id) AS termin_no
                  FROM public.project_invoices v
                  JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = v.project_id
                  LEFT JOIN public.clients cl ON cl.id = p.client_id
                  LEFT JOIN public.m_user_system u ON u.id = v.released_by        -- [RELEASE-LAYER]
                  LEFT JOIN public.m_employee e ON e.id = u.employee_id";

            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ({$base}) x {$w}");
            $st->execute($params);
            $total = (int)$st->fetchColumn();

            // Ringkasan (mengikuti filter): rilis resmi = hanya yang RELEASED; draft dilaporkan terpisah. [RELEASE-LAYER]
            $st = $db->prepare("
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN x.release_status = 'released' THEN x.amount END), 0) AS invoiced,
                       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN x.release_status = 'released' THEN x.paid_amount END), 0) AS paid,
                       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN x.release_status = 'released' THEN GREATEST(x.amount - x.paid_amount, 0) END), 0) AS outstanding,
                       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN x.release_status = 'released' AND x.due_date < CURRENT_DATE
                                              AND x.amount - x.paid_amount > 0.005
                                         THEN x.amount - x.paid_amount END), 0) AS overdue,
                       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN x.release_status = 'released' AND x.due_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + 30
                                              AND x.amount - x.paid_amount > 0.005
                                         THEN x.amount - x.paid_amount END), 0) AS due_30,
                       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN x.release_status = 'released' AND x.due_date IS NULL
                                         AND x.amount - x.paid_amount > 0.005
                                         THEN x.amount - x.paid_amount END), 0) AS no_due,
                       COUNT(CASE WHEN x.release_status = 'draft' THEN 1 END) AS draft_count,
                       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN x.release_status = 'draft' THEN x.amount END), 0) AS draft_value
                  FROM ({$base}) x {$w}");
            $st->execute($params);
            $sum = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($sum as $k => $v) $sum[$k] = round((float)$v, 2);
            $sum['draft_count'] = (int)$sum['draft_count'];

            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT x.*, (CURRENT_DATE - x.due_date) AS days_overdue
                                  FROM ({$base}) x {$w}
                                 ORDER BY x.invoice_date DESC, x.id DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :start");
            foreach ($params as $k => $v) $st->bindValue($k, $v);
            $st->bindValue(':limit', $limit, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $st->bindValue(':start', $start, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $st->execute();
            $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                foreach (['id', 'project_id', 'client_id', 'termin_no', 'released_by'] as $f) $r[$f] = $r[$f] !== null ? (int)$r[$f] : 0;
                foreach (['percentage', 'amount', 'paid_amount', 'dpp_amount', 'ppn_rate', 'ppn_amount'] as $f) $r[$f] = $r[$f] !== null ? (float)$r[$f] : 0.0;
                $r['remaining'] = round($r['amount'] - $r['paid_amount'], 2);
                $r['status'] = ($r['remaining'] <= 0.005) ? 'Lunas' : ($r['paid_amount'] > 0.005 ? 'Sebagian' : 'Belum Bayar');
                $r['is_overdue'] = ($r['remaining'] > 0.005 && $r['due_date'] !== null && (int)$r['days_overdue'] > 0);
                $r['days_overdue'] = $r['is_overdue'] ? (int)$r['days_overdue'] : 0;
            }
            unset($r);
            ti_send(true, $rows, '', ['totalCount' => $total, 'summary' => $sum]);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Detail satu invoice + pembayaran yang dialokasikan ke invoice ini
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'load_invoice':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $st = $db->prepare("
                SELECT v.id, v.inv_no, v.invoice_date, v.due_date, v.termin_name, v.percentage, v.amount, v.paid_amount,
                       v.dpp_amount, v.ppn_rate, v.ppn_amount, v.faktur_pajak_no, v.faktur_pajak_date, v.remark,
                       v.release_status, v.release_no, v.release_date, v.released_by, v.release_note,
                       e.employee_name AS released_by_name,
                       p.id AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, COALESCE(p.contract_value, 0) AS contract_value,
                       cl.id AS client_id, cl.name AS client_name
                  FROM public.project_invoices v
                  JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = v.project_id
                  LEFT JOIN public.clients cl ON cl.id = p.client_id
                  LEFT JOIN public.m_user_system u ON u.id = v.released_by        -- [RELEASE-LAYER]
                  LEFT JOIN public.m_employee e ON e.id = u.employee_id
                 WHERE v.id = :id");
            $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $h = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$h) ti_send(false, [], 'Invoice tidak ditemukan.');
            foreach (['id', 'project_id', 'client_id', 'released_by'] as $f) $h[$f] = $h[$f] !== null ? (int)$h[$f] : 0;
            foreach (['percentage', 'amount', 'paid_amount', 'dpp_amount', 'ppn_rate', 'ppn_amount', 'contract_value'] as $f) $h[$f] = $h[$f] !== null ? (float)$h[$f] : 0.0;
            $h['remaining'] = round($h['amount'] - $h['paid_amount'], 2);
            $h['editable'] = ((string)$h['release_status'] === TI_REL_DRAFT) && !ti_has_payment($db, $id, $h['paid_amount']);  // [RELEASE-LAYER]

            $st = $db->prepare("
                SELECT pp.payment_no, pp.payment_date, pp.payment_method, i.amount_paid
                  FROM public.project_payment_items i
                  JOIN public.project_payments pp ON pp.id = i.payment_id
                 WHERE i.invoice_id = :id ORDER BY pp.payment_date, pp.id");
            $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $pays = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($pays as &$p) $p['amount_paid'] = (float)$p['amount_paid'];
            unset($p);
            ti_send(true, ['header' => $h, 'payments' => $pays]);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Simpan / ubah invoice (selalu sebagai DRAFT; jurnal penagihan belum posting)
         * Ubah hanya bila masih DRAFT dan belum ada pembayaran.
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'save_invoice':
            $id      = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            // Aksi ini melayani penerbitan dan perubahan invoice; perubahan memerlukan level 3.
            if ($id > 0 && $invoiceAccess < 3) {
                http_response_code(403);
                ti_send(false, [], 'Hak ubah invoice proyek tidak tersedia.');
            }
            $prj     = (int)($_POST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            $cliChk  = (int)($_POST['client_id'] ?? 0);
            $name    = trim((string)($_POST['termin_name'] ?? ''));
            $date    = (string)($_POST['invoice_date'] ?? '');
            $due     = trim((string)($_POST['due_date'] ?? ''));
            $pct     = ($_POST['percentage'] ?? '') !== '' ? round((float)$_POST['percentage'], 2) : null;
            $amt     = round((float)($_POST['amount'] ?? 0), 2);               // DPP (tanpa PPN)
            $ppnRate = round((float)($_POST['ppn_rate'] ?? 0), 2);             // 0 = tanpa PPN
            $fpNo    = trim((string)($_POST['faktur_pajak_no'] ?? '')) ?: null;
            $fpDate  = trim((string)($_POST['faktur_pajak_date'] ?? ''));
            $remark  = trim((string)($_POST['remark'] ?? '')) ?: null;

            try {
                if ($prj <= 0) throw new TiError('Proyek wajib dipilih.');
                if ($name === '') throw new TiError('Nama termin wajib diisi.');
                if (!ti_valid_date($date)) throw new TiError('Tanggal invoice tidak valid.');
                if ($due !== '' && !ti_valid_date($due)) throw new TiError('Tanggal jatuh tempo tidak valid.');
                if ($due !== '' && $due < $date) throw new TiError('Jatuh tempo tidak boleh lebih awal dari tanggal invoice.');
                if ($pct !== null && ($pct < 0 || $pct > 100)) throw new TiError('Persentase harus antara 0 - 100.');
                if ($ppnRate < 0 || $ppnRate > 100) throw new TiError('Tarif PPN harus antara 0 - 100%.');
                if ($fpDate !== '' && !ti_valid_date($fpDate)) throw new TiError('Tanggal faktur pajak tidak valid.');
                if ($fpNo === null && $fpDate !== '') throw new TiError('Isi no. faktur pajak, atau kosongkan tanggalnya.');

                $db->beginTransaction();
                try {
                    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(contract_value, 0) AS cv, client_id, name FROM public.projects WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                    $st->execute([':id' => $prj]);
                    $prjRow = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                    if (!$prjRow) throw new TiError('Proyek tidak ditemukan.');
                    if ($cliChk > 0 && (int)$prjRow['client_id'] !== $cliChk) throw new TiError('Proyek tidak termasuk client yang dipilih.');
                    $contract = (float)$prjRow['cv'];

                    $inv = null;
                    if ($id > 0) {
                        $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, inv_no, project_id, paid_amount, release_status FROM public.project_invoices WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                        $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
                        $inv = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                        if (!$inv) throw new TiError('Invoice tidak ditemukan.');
                        if ((int)$inv['project_id'] !== $prj) throw new TiError('Proyek invoice tidak dapat diganti. Hapus lalu terbitkan ulang bila salah proyek.');
                        if ((string)$inv['release_status'] !== TI_REL_DRAFT) {    // [RELEASE-LAYER] yang sudah diterbitkan tidak boleh diubah
                            throw new TiError("Invoice {$inv['inv_no']} sudah diterbitkan ({$inv['release_status']}); batalkan release dulu untuk mengubah.");
                        }
                        if (ti_has_payment($db, $id, (float)$inv['paid_amount'])) {
                            throw new TiError("Invoice {$inv['inv_no']} sudah memiliki pembayaran, tidak dapat diubah.");
                        }
                    }

                    if ($amt <= 0 && $pct !== null && $contract > 0) $amt = round($contract * $pct / 100, 2);
                    if ($amt <= 0) throw new TiError('Nilai invoice (DPP) harus lebih dari 0.');

                    // kontrol nilai kontrak: total DPP invoice lain + invoice ini <= contract_value
                    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN dpp_amount > 0 THEN dpp_amount ELSE amount END), 0)
                                          FROM public.project_invoices WHERE project_id = :p AND id <> :x");
                    $st->execute([':p' => $prj, ':x' => $id]);
                    $existing = (float)$st->fetchColumn();
                    if ($contract > 0 && $existing + $amt > $contract + TI_EPS) {
                        throw new TiError('Total tagihan DPP (' . number_format($existing + $amt, 2) . ') melebihi nilai kontrak (' . number_format($contract, 2) . ').');
                    }
                    ti_check_faktur_unique($db, $fpNo, $id);

                    // Validate total invoice amount against project contract
                    $contract = $db->prepare("SELECT contract_amount FROM projects WHERE id = :project_id");
                    $contract->execute([':project_id' => $projectId]);
                    $contractAmount = $contract->fetchColumn();

                    $existingInvoices = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_invoiced
                                        FROM project_invoices
                                        WHERE project_id = :project_id AND status = 'posted' AND id != :id");
                    $existingInvoices->execute([':project_id' => $projectId, ':id' => $id]);
                    $totalInvoiced = $existingInvoices->fetchColumn();

                    $ppnAmt = ($ppnRate > 0) ? round($amt * $ppnRate / 100, 2) : 0.0;
                    $total = round($amt + $ppnAmt, 2);

                    if (($totalInvoiced + $total) > $contractAmount) {
                        throw new Exception("Total akumulasi termin invoice (" . number_format($totalInvoiced + $total, 2) . ") melebihi nilai kontrak proyek (" . number_format($contractAmount, 2) . ")");
                    }

                    if ($id > 0) {
                        // [RELEASE-LAYER] invoice lama (pra migrasi) bisa sudah punya jurnal saat masih draft -> reverse saja;
                        // jurnal penagihan yang benar diposting ulang saat release.
                        if (ti_has_journal($db, $id)) ReverseJournalByReference($db, TI_JOURNAL_REF, $id);
                        $st = $db->prepare("
                            UPDATE public.project_invoices
                               SET termin_name = :n, invoice_date = CAST(:d AS date), due_date = CAST(NULLIF(:due, '') AS date),
                                   percentage = :pct, amount = :a, dpp_amount = :dpp, ppn_rate = :pr, ppn_amount = :ppn,
                                   faktur_pajak_no = :fn, faktur_pajak_date = CAST(NULLIF(:fd, '') AS date), remark = :rm
                             WHERE id = :id");
                        $st->execute([':n' => $name, ':d' => $date, ':due' => $due, ':pct' => $pct, ':a' => $total, ':dpp' => $amt, ':pr' => $ppnRate,
                                      ':ppn' => $ppnAmt, ':fn' => $fpNo, ':fd' => $fpDate, ':rm' => $remark, ':id' => $id]);
                        $invNo = $inv['inv_no'];
                        $newId = $id;
                    } else {
                        if (!function_exists('CreateRefNo')) throw new Exception('CreateRefNo() tidak tersedia.');
                        $invNo = CreateRefNo('project_invoices', 'inv_no', 'INV');
                        $st = $db->prepare("
                            INSERT INTO public.project_invoices
                                (inv_no, project_id, termin_name, invoice_date, due_date, percentage, amount, paid_amount,
                                 dpp_amount, ppn_rate, ppn_amount, faktur_pajak_no, faktur_pajak_date, remark, release_status)
                            VALUES (:no, :p, :n, CAST(:d AS date), CAST(NULLIF(:due, '') AS date), :pct, :a, 0,
                                    :dpp, :pr, :ppn, :fn, CAST(NULLIF(:fd, '') AS date), :rm, :rs)
                            RETURNING id");
                        $st->execute([':no' => $invNo, ':p' => $prj, ':n' => $name, ':d' => $date, ':due' => $due, ':pct' => $pct, ':a' => $total,
                                      ':dpp' => $amt, ':pr' => $ppnRate, ':ppn' => $ppnAmt, ':fn' => $fpNo, ':fd' => $fpDate, ':rm' => $remark,
                                      ':rs' => TI_REL_DRAFT]);                               // [RELEASE-LAYER] invoice baru = DRAFT
                        $newId = (int)$st->fetchColumn();
                    }
                    // [RELEASE-LAYER] jurnal penagihan TIDAK diposting di sini; diposting saat RELEASE (lihat release_invoice).
                    $db->commit();
                    ti_send(true, ['id' => $newId, 'inv_no' => $invNo],
                        "Invoice {$invNo} " . ($id > 0 ? 'diperbarui' : 'disimpan sebagai DRAFT') . "." .
                        ($id > 0 ? '' : ' Terbitkan (Release) agar menjadi tagihan resmi ke client.'));
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                    throw $e;
                }
            } catch (TiError $e) {
                ti_send(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * [RELEASE-LAYER] Terbitkan invoice ke client: draft -> released (+ nomor TAG) + posting jurnal.
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'release_invoice':
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $relDate = trim((string)($_POST['release_date'] ?? ''));
            try {
                if ($id <= 0) throw new TiError('Invoice wajib dipilih.');
                if ($relDate !== '' && !ti_valid_date($relDate)) throw new TiError('Tanggal terbit tidak valid.');
                if ($relDate === '') $relDate = date('Y-m-d');
                $relNote = ti_read_release_note();                          // [RELEASE-LAYER] catatan penerbitan (opsional)
                $db->beginTransaction();
                try {
                    $out = ti_release_one($db, $id, $relDate, (int)($_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0), $relNote);
                    $db->commit();
                    ti_send(true, ['id' => $id, 'inv_no' => $out['inv_no'], 'release_no' => $out['release_no']],
                        "Dokumen tagihan {$out['release_no']} untuk invoice {$out['inv_no']} diterbitkan. Invoice kini muncul di Pembayaran Termin.");
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                    throw $e;
                }
            } catch (TiError $e) {
                ti_send(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            }
            break;

        // [RELEASE-LAYER] Release banyak sekaligus (bulk) sesuai filter: ids = JSON array maupun CSV.
        case 'release_invoices':
            $rawIds = $_POST['ids'] ?? '';
            if (is_string($rawIds)) {
                $dec = json_decode($rawIds, true);
                $ids = is_array($dec) ? $dec : array_map('trim', explode(',', $rawIds));
            } else {
                $ids = (array)$rawIds;
            }
            $ids = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map('intval', $ids), function ($v) { return $v > 0; })));
            try {
                if (!count($ids)) throw new TiError('Tidak ada invoice yang dipilih untuk diterbitkan.');
                $relDate = trim((string)($_POST['release_date'] ?? ''));
                if ($relDate !== '' && !ti_valid_date($relDate)) throw new TiError('Tanggal terbit tidak valid.');
                if ($relDate === '') $relDate = date('Y-m-d');
                $relNote = ti_read_release_note();                          // [RELEASE-LAYER] catatan per-invoice (opsional)
                $db->beginTransaction();
                try {
                    $released = [];
                    foreach ($ids as $oneId) {
                        $out = ti_release_one($db, $oneId, $relDate, (int)($_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0), $relNote);
                        $released[] = $out['inv_no'];
                    }
                    $db->commit();
                    ti_send(true, ['released' => count($released), 'invoices' => $released],
                        count($released) . ' tagihan berhasil diterbitkan (' . implode(', ', $released) . ').');
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                    throw $e;
                }
            } catch (TiError $e) {
                ti_send(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * [RELEASE-LAYER] Batalkan penerbitan: released -> draft (jurnal penagihan dibatalkan).
         * Hanya bila belum ada pembayaran.
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'unrelease_invoice':
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                if ($id <= 0) throw new TiError('Invoice wajib dipilih.');
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, inv_no, paid_amount, release_status FROM public.project_invoices WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $inv = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$inv) throw new TiError('Invoice tidak ditemukan.');
                if ((string)$inv['release_status'] !== TI_REL_RELEASED) {
                    throw new TiError("Invoice {$inv['inv_no']} belum diterbitkan (status: {$inv['release_status']}).");
                }
                if (ti_has_payment($db, $id, (float)$inv['paid_amount'])) {
                    throw new TiError("Invoice {$inv['inv_no']} sudah memiliki pembayaran, penerbitannya tidak dapat dibatalkan.");
                }
                if (ti_has_journal($db, $id)) ReverseJournalByReference($db, TI_JOURNAL_REF, $id);
                $st = $db->prepare("
                    UPDATE public.project_invoices
                       SET release_status = :s, release_no = NULL, release_date = NULL, released_by = NULL, release_note = ''
                     WHERE id = :id");
                $st->execute([':s' => TI_REL_DRAFT, ':id' => $id]);
                $db->commit();
                ti_send(true, [], "Penerbitan invoice {$inv['inv_no']} dibatalkan; kembali ke DRAFT.");
            } catch (TiError $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                ti_send(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Hapus invoice (hanya DRAFT & belum ada pembayaran) - jurnal penagihannya ikut di-reverse
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'delete_invoice':
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT inv_no, paid_amount, release_status FROM public.project_invoices WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $inv = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$inv) throw new TiError('Invoice tidak ditemukan.');
                if ((string)$inv['release_status'] !== TI_REL_DRAFT) {   // [RELEASE-LAYER] dokumen yang sudah diterbitkan tidak boleh dihapus
                    throw new TiError("Invoice {$inv['inv_no']} sudah diterbitkan; batalkan release dulu sebelum menghapus.");
                }
                if (ti_has_payment($db, $id, (float)$inv['paid_amount'])) {
                    throw new TiError("Invoice {$inv['inv_no']} sudah memiliki pembayaran, tidak dapat dihapus.");
                }
                if (ti_has_journal($db, $id)) ReverseJournalByReference($db, TI_JOURNAL_REF, $id);
                $db->prepare("DELETE FROM public.project_invoices WHERE id = :id")->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $db->commit();
                ti_send(true, [], "Invoice {$inv['inv_no']} dihapus.");
            } catch (TiError $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                ti_send(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Isi / ubah faktur pajak keluaran (boleh walau sudah ada pembayaran)
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'update_faktur_pajak':
            $id     = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $fpNo   = trim((string)($_POST['faktur_pajak_no'] ?? ''));
            $fpDate = trim((string)($_POST['faktur_pajak_date'] ?? ''));
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                if ($fpDate !== '' && !ti_valid_date($fpDate)) throw new TiError('Tanggal faktur pajak tidak valid.');
                if (strlen($fpNo) > 30) throw new TiError('No. faktur pajak maksimal 30 karakter.');
                if ($fpNo === '' && $fpDate !== '') throw new TiError('Isi no. faktur pajak, atau kosongkan tanggalnya.');
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT inv_no, ppn_amount FROM public.project_invoices WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $inv = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$inv) throw new TiError('Invoice tidak ditemukan.');
                if ((float)$inv['ppn_amount'] <= TI_EPS) throw new TiError("Invoice {$inv['inv_no']} tidak memuat PPN, tidak ada faktur pajak.");
                ti_check_faktur_unique($db, $fpNo, $id);
                $st = $db->prepare("UPDATE public.project_invoices
                                       SET faktur_pajak_no = NULLIF(:n, ''), faktur_pajak_date = CAST(NULLIF(:d, '') AS date) WHERE id = :id");
                $st->execute([':n' => $fpNo, ':d' => $fpDate, ':id' => $id]);
                $db->commit();
                ti_send(true, [], $fpNo === '' ? "Faktur pajak invoice {$inv['inv_no']} dikosongkan." : "Faktur pajak invoice {$inv['inv_no']} tersimpan.");
            } catch (TiError $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                ti_send(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        default:
            ti_send(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.');
            break;
    }
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[projectinvoiceCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    ti_send(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[projectinvoiceCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    ti_send(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}

function mpJson(array $payload) {
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($payload, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

function PrepOrFailMP($stmt, $context = '') {
    if ($stmt === false) {
        throw new Exception(($context ? "[{$context}] " : '') . 'Query gagal dijalankan.');
    }
    return $stmt;
}
function mpFetchAll($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFailMP($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
}
function mpFetchOne($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFailMP($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    return $row === false ? null : $row;
}
function mpExec($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFailMP($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    return $stmt;
}


/* ============================================================
 * [AUTO-INV][NEW] Penerbitan tagihan (invoice) otomatis berdasarkan breakdown task AI
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Aturan:
 *  - 4 slot: Down Payment, Termin 1, Termin 2, Pelunasan Proyek = 30-20-20-30 dari Nilai Kontrak
 *    (DP mengikuti projects.dp_min_pct bila diisi; sisanya dibagi proporsional 20:20:30).
 *  - Tgl invoice = tgl mulai task pemicu - 7 hari ; Jatuh tempo = tgl mulai task pemicu - 1 hari.
 *  - DP dipicu task pertama; Termin 1-3 dipicu task yang dipilih AI (fallback: titik 25% / 50% / 75% durasi kerja).
 *  - Analisis data tagihan & pembayaran: belum ada tagihan -> mulai dari DP; sudah ada n tagihan -> lanjut slot ke n+1.
 *  - Slot terakhir menyerap sisa agar total tagihan = Nilai Kontrak (tidak ada selisih pembulatan).
 *  - Tagihan otomatis yang belum dibayar ikut disesuaikan tanggalnya bila task di-breakdown ulang.
 *  - [PPN] Nilai slot = DPP dari Nilai Kontrak (bila ppn_inclusive, DPP = kontrak / (1 + tarif)); PPN Keluaran = DPP x projects.ppn_rate;
 *    amount = DPP + PPN, sama dengan project_invoiceCRD.php.
 *  - [JURNAL] Tiap tagihan diposting lewat AutoPostJournal (PROJECT_INVOICE + PROJECT_INVOICE_PPN) dalam transaksi yang sama; gagal posting = batal semua.
 *    Sinkron tanggal tagihan otomatis = reverse jurnal lama lalu posting ulang di tanggal baru.
 * Butuh migrasi: sql/2026-10-28.project_invoices_auto.sql
 * ============================================================ */
const MP_INV_LEAD_DAYS    = 7;                                    /* tgl invoice = mulai task - 7 hari */
const MP_INV_REST_WEIGHTS = [20, 20, 30];                         /* bobot Termin 1..3 (DP dihitung terpisah) */
const MP_INV_NAMES        = ['Down Payment', 'Termin 1', 'Termin 2', 'Pelunasan Proyek'];

const MP_JOURNAL_REF = 'project_invoice';          /* sama dengan project_invoiceCRD.php (TI_JOURNAL_REF) */
const MP_PPN_RULE    = 'PROJECT_INVOICE_PPN';      /* Dr Piutang Usaha / Cr PPN Keluaran */

function mpBool($v) { return $v === true || $v === 't' || $v === '1' || $v === 1; }

/* [AUTO-INV][REFACTOR] panggilan Gemini dipakai bersama oleh breakdown task & analisis tagihan */
function mpCallGemini($prompt, $timeout = 20) {
    $apiKey = getenv('GOOGLE_API_KEY');
    $candidateModels = ['gemini-3.6-flash','gemini-3.5-flash-lite'];
    $response = null; $httpCode = 0; $lastErrorMsg = '';

    foreach ($candidateModels as $model) {
        $apiUrl = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{$model}:generateContent";
        for ($attempt = 1; $attempt <= 2; $attempt++) {
            $ch = curl_init($apiUrl);
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST, "POST");
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, json_encode([
                'contents' => [['parts' => [['text' => $prompt]]]],
                'generationConfig' => ['responseMimeType' => 'application/json', 'maxOutputTokens' => 16384]   /* [AI-BOQ] BoQ + expense panjang */
            ]));
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ['Content-Type: application/json', 'x-goog-api-key: ' . $apiKey]);
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, $timeout);

            $response = curl_exec($ch);
            $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
            curl_close($ch);

            if ($httpCode === 200) break 2;
            $lastErrorMsg = "Model {$model} (HTTP {$httpCode}): " . $response;
            if ($httpCode === 503 || $httpCode === 429) sleep(1); else break;
        }
    }
    if ($httpCode !== 200) {
        throw new Exception("Gagal terhubung ke Gemini API: {$lastErrorMsg}");
    }
    $apiResult = json_decode($response, true);
    $raw = $apiResult['candidates'][0]['content']['parts'][0]['text'] ?? '';
    return trim(str_replace(['```json', '```'], '', $raw));
}

/* [JURNAL] jurnal penagihan: DPP -> pendapatan, PPN -> PPN Keluaran (sama dengan ti_post_journal) */
function mpPostInvoiceJournal($db, $invId, $invNo, $date, $dpp, $ppn, $projectName) {
    $jr = AutoPostJournal($db, [
        'rule_code' => 'PROJECT_INVOICE', 'reference_type' => MP_JOURNAL_REF, 'reference_id' => $invId,
        'journal_date' => $date, 'amount' => $dpp, 'description' => "Tagihan termin {$invNo} - {$projectName}",
    ]);
    if (!$jr['success']) throw new Exception('Gagal posting jurnal penagihan: ' . $jr['message']);
    if ($ppn > 0.01) {
        $jr = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code' => MP_PPN_RULE, 'reference_type' => MP_JOURNAL_REF, 'reference_id' => $invId,
            'journal_date' => $date, 'amount' => $ppn, 'description' => "PPN Keluaran termin {$invNo} - {$projectName}",
        ]);
        if (!$jr['success']) throw new Exception('Gagal posting jurnal PPN Keluaran: ' . $jr['message']);
    }
}
function mpHasJournal($db, $invId) {
    return (bool)mpFetchOne($db, "SELECT 1 AS x FROM public.journal_entries WHERE reference_type::text = :t AND reference_id = :id LIMIT 1",
                            ['t' => MP_JOURNAL_REF, 'id' => $invId], 'cek jurnal');
}

/* Persentase per slot: DP = dp_min_pct (default 30), sisanya proporsional 20:20:30 -> default 30-20-20-30 */
function mpSlotPcts($dpPct) {
    $dp   = ($dpPct > 0 && $dpPct < 100) ? (float)$dpPct : 30.0;
    $rest = 100 - $dp;
    $sw   = array_sum(MP_INV_REST_WEIGHTS);
    $p    = [$dp];
    foreach (MP_INV_REST_WEIGHTS as $w) $p[] = round($rest * $w / $sw, 2);
    return $p;
}

/* Titik pemicu default (index task): DP = task 1; Termin 1-3 = task pertama yang dimulai setelah 25% / 50% / 75% total durasi */
function mpDefaultAnchors(array $tasks) {
    $n = count($tasks); $cumBefore = []; $cum = 0;
    foreach ($tasks as $i => $t) {
        $d = max(1, (int)floor((strtotime($t['end_date']) - strtotime($t['start_date'])) / 86400) + 1);
        $cumBefore[$i] = $cum; $cum += $d;
    }
    $idx = [0];
    foreach ([0.25, 0.50, 0.75] as $target) {
        $prev = end($idx); $pick = $n - 1;
        for ($i = $prev + 1; $i < $n; $i++) {
            if ($cum > 0 && $cumBefore[$i] / $cum >= $target - 1e-9) { $pick = $i; break; }
        }
        $idx[] = $pick;
    }
    return $idx;
}

/* Nomor invoice berurutan dari satu nomor awal (CreateRefNo membaca data ter-commit, jadi tidak aman dipanggil berulang dalam 1 transaksi) */
function mpRefPlus($ref, $n) {
    if ($n === 0) return $ref;
    if (preg_match('/^(.*?)(\d+)$/', $ref, $m)) {
        return $m[1] . str_pad((string)((int)$m[2] + $n), strlen($m[2]), '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
    }
    return $ref . '-' . $n;
}

function mpMinusDays($ymd, $days) { return date('Y-m-d', strtotime($ymd . " -{$days} days")); }

/* Analisis data proyek + tagihan + pembayaran klien -> rencana tagihan (belum menyimpan apa pun) */
function mpBuildInvoicePlan($db, $projectId, $useAi = true) {
    $proj = mpFetchOne($db, "SELECT id, name, client_id, contract_value, dp_min_pct, ppn_rate, ppn_inclusive FROM projects WHERE id = :id", ['id' => $projectId], 'plan_proj');
    if (!$proj) throw new Exception('Proyek tidak ditemukan.');
    $cv = round((float)$proj['contract_value'], 2);
    if ($cv <= 0) throw new Exception('Nilai Kontrak (Plafon) proyek belum diisi, tagihan tidak dapat dihitung.');

    /* [PPN] basis DPP: nilai kontrak sudah termasuk PPN -> DPP = kontrak / (1 + tarif) */
    $ppnRate = round((float)$proj['ppn_rate'], 2);
    $base    = (mpBool($proj['ppn_inclusive']) && $ppnRate > 0) ? round($cv / (1 + $ppnRate / 100), 2) : $cv;

    $tasks = mpFetchAll($db, "SELECT id, task_name, start_date, end_date FROM public.project_tasks WHERE project_id = :p ORDER BY start_date ASC, id ASC", ['p' => $projectId], 'plan_tasks');
    if (!count($tasks)) throw new Exception('Breakdown task proyek belum ada. Jalankan ANALISIS & BAGI TASK (AI) terlebih dahulu.');

    $existing = mpFetchAll($db,
        "SELECT id, inv_no, termin_name, invoice_date, due_date, amount, CASE WHEN dpp_amount > 0 THEN dpp_amount ELSE amount END AS dpp,
                paid_amount, task_id, COALESCE(auto_generated, false) AS auto_generated
           FROM project_invoices WHERE project_id = :p ORDER BY invoice_date ASC, id ASC", ['p' => $projectId], 'plan_existing');
    $k = count($existing);
    $invoiced = 0.0; $invoicedDpp = 0.0; $paid = 0.0;
    foreach ($existing as $e) { $invoiced += (float)$e['amount']; $invoicedDpp += (float)$e['dpp']; $paid += (float)$e['paid_amount']; }

    /* riwayat pembayaran klien (seluruh proyek klien yang sama) sebagai bahan analisis AI */
    $cli = ['inv_count' => 0, 'invoiced' => 0, 'paid' => 0];
    if ($proj['client_id']) {
        $cli = mpFetchOne($db,
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS inv_count, COALESCE(SUM(i.amount),0) AS invoiced, COALESCE(SUM(i.paid_amount),0) AS paid
               FROM project_invoices i JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id WHERE p.client_id = :c",
            ['c' => (int)$proj['client_id']], 'plan_client') ?: $cli;
    }

    /* slot yang bisa disinkronkan = tagihan otomatis yang belum ada pembayaran */
    $syncable = [];
    for ($j = 0; $j < min($k, 4); $j++) {
        if (mpBool($existing[$j]['auto_generated']) && (float)$existing[$j]['paid_amount'] <= 0) $syncable[] = $j;
    }

    $rows = []; $analysis = ''; $aiUsed = false;
    $pcts = mpSlotPcts((float)$proj['dp_min_pct']);

    if ($k < 4 || count($syncable)) {
        /* --- titik pemicu: default deterministik, lalu coba disempurnakan AI --- */
        $anchors = mpDefaultAnchors($tasks);
        $n = count($tasks);
        if ($useAi && $n >= 4) {
            try {
                $tl = [];
                foreach ($tasks as $t) $tl[] = ['task_id' => (int)$t['id'], 'task_name' => $t['task_name'], 'start_date' => $t['start_date'], 'end_date' => $t['end_date']];
                $prompt = "Anda adalah Project Controller konstruksi. Tentukan task pemicu penerbitan tagihan termin ke klien.\n" .
                    "Data proyek: nama={$proj['name']}; nilai kontrak={$cv}; sudah ditagih={$invoiced}; sudah dibayar={$paid}; jumlah tagihan existing={$k}.\n" .
                    "Riwayat klien (semua proyek): jumlah tagihan={$cli['inv_count']}; total ditagih={$cli['invoiced']}; total dibayar={$cli['paid']}.\n" .
                    "Skema penagihan: Down Payment " . $pcts[0] . "% (dipicu task pertama), Termin 1 " . $pcts[1] . "%, Termin 2 " . $pcts[2] . "%, Pelunasan Proyek " . $pcts[3] . "%.\n" .
                    "Daftar task (urut tanggal mulai): " . json_encode($tl, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) . "\n" .
                    "Aturan: pilih 3 task BERBEDA dan berurutan (sesuai urutan tanggal mulai), bukan task pertama, sebagai pemicu Termin 1, 2, 3. " .
                    "Tagihan terbit sebelum task tersebut dimulai, jadi pilih task yang awal tahap kerjanya selaras dengan akumulasi persentase tagihan. " .
                    "Jika klien punya riwayat bayar lambat/outstanding besar, jelaskan itu di analysis.\n" .
                    "Jawab JSON MURNI: {\"termin1_task_id\":int,\"termin2_task_id\":int,\"termin3_task_id\":int,\"analysis\":\"2-3 kalimat Bahasa Indonesia\"}";
                $ai = json_decode(mpCallGemini($prompt), true);
                if (is_array($ai)) {
                    $byId = [];
                    foreach ($tasks as $i => $t) $byId[(int)$t['id']] = $i;
                    $ids = [(int)($ai['termin1_task_id'] ?? 0), (int)($ai['termin2_task_id'] ?? 0), (int)($ai['termin3_task_id'] ?? 0)];
                    $ok = true; $prev = 0; $cand = [0];
                    foreach ($ids as $tid) {
                        if (!isset($byId[$tid]) || $byId[$tid] <= $prev) { $ok = false; break; }   /* wajib ada, berbeda, berurutan, bukan task pertama */
                        $prev = $byId[$tid]; $cand[] = $prev;
                    }
                    if ($ok) { $anchors = $cand; $aiUsed = true; }
                    $analysis = trim((string)($ai['analysis'] ?? ''));
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                error_log('[m.proyekCRD][auto_invoice AI] ' . $e->getMessage());   /* AI gagal -> tetap jalan dengan titik default */
            }
        }
        if ($analysis === '') {
            $analysis = "Tagihan sudah {$k} dari 4 termin; ditagih " . number_format($invoiced, 2) . ", dibayar " . number_format($paid, 2) .
                        " dari nilai kontrak " . number_format($cv, 2) . ". Titik penagihan dihitung dari porsi durasi task.";
        }

        /* --- susun baris per slot --- */
        $remaining = round($base - $invoicedDpp, 2);     /* [PPN] sisa dihitung atas DPP */
        for ($j = 0; $j < 4; $j++) {
            $t = $tasks[min($anchors[$j], $n - 1)];
            $invDate = mpMinusDays($t['start_date'], MP_INV_LEAD_DAYS);        /* [FIX] persis mulai task - 7 hari (tanpa dibatasi hari ini) */
            $dueDate = mpMinusDays($t['start_date'], 1);                       /* jatuh tempo = mulai task - 1 hari */
            $row = ['slot' => $j, 'termin_name' => MP_INV_NAMES[$j], 'pct' => $pcts[$j], 'task_id' => (int)$t['id'],
                    'task_name' => $t['task_name'], 'task_start' => $t['start_date'],
                    'invoice_date' => $invDate, 'due_date' => $dueDate];
            if ($j < $k) {
                $e = $existing[$j];
                $row['termin_name'] = $e['termin_name']; $row['inv_no'] = $e['inv_no']; $row['invoice_id'] = (int)$e['id'];
                $row['amount'] = (float)$e['amount']; $row['dpp'] = (float)$e['dpp']; $row['pct'] = $base > 0 ? round($row['dpp'] / $base * 100, 2) : 0;
                $same = in_array($j, $syncable, true)
                    ? ((string)$e['invoice_date'] === $invDate && (string)$e['due_date'] === $dueDate && (int)$e['task_id'] === (int)$t['id']) : true;
                $row['action'] = (in_array($j, $syncable, true) && !$same) ? 'sync' : 'exists';
                if ($row['action'] === 'exists') { $row['invoice_date'] = $e['invoice_date']; $row['due_date'] = $e['due_date']; }
            } else {
                $planned = round($base * $pcts[$j] / 100, 2);
                $amt = ($j === 3) ? $remaining : min($planned, $remaining);   /* slot terakhir menyerap sisa */
                if ($amt <= 0) { $row['amount'] = 0; $row['dpp'] = 0; $row['ppn'] = 0; $row['action'] = 'skip'; }
                else {
                    $amt = round($amt, 2); $ppnAmt = ($ppnRate > 0) ? round($amt * $ppnRate / 100, 2) : 0.0;     /* [PPN] */
                    $row['dpp'] = $amt; $row['ppn'] = $ppnAmt; $row['amount'] = round($amt + $ppnAmt, 2);       /* amount = total tagihan */
                    $row['pct'] = round($amt / $base * 100, 2); $row['action'] = 'new'; $remaining = round($remaining - $amt, 2);
                }
            }
            $rows[] = $row;
        }
    } else {
        $analysis = 'Seluruh 4 termin sudah terbit untuk proyek ini.';
        foreach ($existing as $j => $e) {
            $rows[] = ['slot' => $j, 'termin_name' => $e['termin_name'], 'inv_no' => $e['inv_no'], 'invoice_id' => (int)$e['id'],
                       'amount' => (float)$e['amount'], 'dpp' => (float)$e['dpp'], 'pct' => round((float)$e['dpp'] / $base * 100, 2), 'invoice_date' => $e['invoice_date'],
                       'due_date' => $e['due_date'], 'task_id' => $e['task_id'], 'task_name' => '', 'task_start' => '', 'action' => 'exists'];
        }
    }

    $cnt = ['new' => 0, 'sync' => 0];
    foreach ($rows as $r) { if (isset($cnt[$r['action']])) $cnt[$r['action']]++; }
    return ['project' => $proj, 'k' => $k, 'rows' => $rows, 'analysis' => $analysis, 'ai_used' => $aiUsed,
            'new_count' => $cnt['new'], 'sync_count' => $cnt['sync'],
            'ppn_rate' => $ppnRate, 'summary' => ['contract_value' => $cv, 'dpp_base' => $base, 'invoiced' => round($invoiced, 2), 'paid' => round($paid, 2),
                          'client_invoiced' => (float)$cli['invoiced'], 'client_paid' => (float)$cli['paid']]];
}

/* Simpan rencana: INSERT tagihan baru + jurnal, dan sinkron tanggal tagihan otomatis yang belum dibayar (satu transaksi) */
function mpApplyInvoicePlan($db, array $plan) {
    $pid = (int)$plan['project']['id'];
    $db->beginTransaction();
    try {
        mpExec($db, "SELECT id FROM projects WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE", ['id' => $pid], 'lock proyek');      /* cegah klik ganda / proses paralel */
        $cnt = (int)mpFetchOne($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM project_invoices WHERE project_id = :p", ['p' => $pid], 'recount')['n'];
        if ($cnt !== (int)$plan['k']) throw new Exception('Data tagihan proyek berubah saat diproses, silakan ulangi.');
        $pName = (string)$plan['project']['name'];

        $firstRef = null; $seq = 0; $made = 0; $synced = 0;
        foreach ($plan['rows'] as $r) {
            if ($r['action'] === 'new') {
                if ($firstRef === null) {
                    if (!function_exists('CreateRefNo')) throw new Exception('CreateRefNo() tidak tersedia.');
                    $firstRef = CreateRefNo('project_invoices', 'inv_no', 'INV');
                }
                $invNo  = mpRefPlus($firstRef, $seq++);
                $remark = "Tagihan otomatis {$r['termin_name']} ({$r['pct']}%): terbit " . MP_INV_LEAD_DAYS .
                          " hari sebelum task '{$r['task_name']}' dimulai ({$r['task_start']}).";
                /* [PPN] kolom sama dengan project_invoiceCRD.php: amount = DPP + PPN */
                $newId = (int)mpFetchOne($db,
                    "INSERT INTO project_invoices
                        (inv_no, project_id, termin_name, invoice_date, due_date, percentage, amount, paid_amount,
                         dpp_amount, ppn_rate, ppn_amount, remark, task_id, auto_generated, ai_note)
                     VALUES (:no, :p, :tn, CAST(:idt AS date), CAST(:ddt AS date), :pct, :amt, 0,
                             :dpp, :pr, :ppn, :rm, :tid, 't', :ai)
                     RETURNING id",
                    ['no' => $invNo, 'p' => $pid, 'tn' => $r['termin_name'], 'idt' => $r['invoice_date'], 'ddt' => $r['due_date'],
                     'pct' => $r['pct'], 'amt' => $r['amount'], 'dpp' => $r['dpp'], 'pr' => $plan['ppn_rate'], 'ppn' => $r['ppn'],
                     'rm' => $remark, 'tid' => $r['task_id'], 'ai' => $plan['analysis']],
                    'insert invoice otomatis')['id'];
                /* [RELEASE-LAYER] jurnal penagihan TIDAK diposting di sini (tagihan otomatis = DRAFT); */
                /* diposting saat release dari menu Tagihan ke Klien (project.invoiceCRD.php). */
                /* mpPostInvoiceJournal($db, $newId, $invNo, $r['invoice_date'], (float)$r['dpp'], (float)$r['ppn'], $pName); */
                $made++;
            } elseif ($r['action'] === 'sync') {
                $cur = mpFetchOne($db,
                    "SELECT inv_no, paid_amount, dpp_amount, ppn_amount, amount, release_status FROM project_invoices
                      WHERE id = :id AND auto_generated = true FOR UPDATE", ['id' => $r['invoice_id']], 'lock invoice sync');   /* [RELEASE-LAYER] */
                if (!$cur || (float)$cur['paid_amount'] > 0) continue;
                $pay = mpFetchOne($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.project_payment_items WHERE invoice_id = :id", ['id' => $r['invoice_id']], 'cek bayar');
                if ((int)$pay['n'] > 0) continue;                                   /* sudah ada alokasi pembayaran -> jangan diubah */
                mpExec($db,
                    "UPDATE project_invoices SET invoice_date = CAST(:idt AS date), due_date = CAST(:ddt AS date), task_id = :tid, ai_note = :ai
                      WHERE id = :id",
                    ['idt' => $r['invoice_date'], 'ddt' => $r['due_date'], 'tid' => $r['task_id'], 'ai' => $plan['analysis'], 'id' => $r['invoice_id']],
                    'sync invoice otomatis');
                /* [JURNAL] tanggal berubah -> reverse jurnal lama, posting ulang di tanggal baru (sama dengan edit invoice manual). */
                /* [RELEASE-LAYER] hanya untuk yang sudah diterbitkan; DRAFT belum punya jurnal. */
                if ((string)$cur['release_status'] === 'released') {
                    if (mpHasJournal($db, (int)$r['invoice_id'])) ReverseJournalByReference($db, MP_JOURNAL_REF, (int)$r['invoice_id']);
                    $dpp = (float)$cur['dpp_amount'] > 0 ? (float)$cur['dpp_amount'] : (float)$cur['amount'];
                    mpPostInvoiceJournal($db, (int)$r['invoice_id'], $cur['inv_no'], $r['invoice_date'], $dpp, (float)$cur['ppn_amount'], $pName);
                }
                $synced++;
            }
        }
        $db->commit();
        return ['made' => $made, 'synced' => $synced];
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
        throw $e;
    }
}

/* ============================================================
 * [AI-BOQ] Helper analisis proyek -> BoQ (task + material + EXPENSE + harga min/max) -> master material -> RAB
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 *  - AI memecah proyek menjadi paket pekerjaan (task). Tiap task berisi:
 *      materials : bahan (nama, spesifikasi, satuan, qty, harga MIN dan MAX)
 *      expenses  : biaya non-material (kategori RAB: Upah, Peralatan, Transport, Konsumsi, Lain-lain; master = expense_master) - wajib bila task tanpa material
 *  - Harga MIN dan MAX milik MASTER (materials.estimated_price_min/estimated_price; expense_master.default_price_min/default_price).
 *    Harga satuan RAB = MAX (budget_items.unit_price_plan); di modul RAB user boleh mengubahnya selama masih di antara min-max master.
 *  - Saat SIMPAN (satu transaksi): material baru dibuat di master -> semua material & expense masuk RAB (budget_items)
 *    -> task + alokasi (project_tasks, task_materials) disimpan. Total RAB tidak boleh melebihi nilai kontrak (plafon).
 *  - Butuh migrasi: sql/2026-11-06.budget_items_price_range.sql
 * ============================================================ */
const MP_EPS = 0.00005;
const MP_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES = ['Upah', 'Peralatan', 'Transport', 'Konsumsi', 'Lain-lain'];   /* [AI-BOQ] = RAB_CATEGORIES (rabCRD.php) selain Material */
/* [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-5.3] normalisasi CASE-INSENSITIVE; kategori kosong/tak dikenal -> Exception */
/* (dulu demote diam-diam ke 'Lain-lain'). Daftar kini sama dengan CHECK DB budget_items_category_check. */
function mpExpCategory($c) {
    $c = trim((string)$c);
    $lc = strtolower($c);
    foreach (MP_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES as $valid) {
        if (strtolower($valid) === $lc) { return $valid; }
    }
    throw new Exception('Kategori biaya RAB tidak valid: "' . $c . '". Kategori yang diterima: ' . implode(', ', MP_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES) . '.');
}

function mpNorm($s) {                                   /* kunci pencocokan nama */
    $s = strtolower(trim((string)$s));
    return trim(preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/', ' ', $s));
}
function mpNum($v) {                                    /* angka dari AI / klien (toleran terhadap string) */
    if (is_numeric($v)) return (float)$v;
    return (float)preg_replace('/[^0-9.\-]/', '', str_replace(',', '', (string)$v));
}
function mpIdr($v) { return number_format((float)$v, 0, ',', '.'); }

/* Normalisasi pasangan harga: tidak negatif, min <= max, salah satu kosong -> samakan */
function mpNormPrice($pMin, $pMax) {
    $pMin = max(0, round((float)$pMin, 2)); $pMax = max(0, round((float)$pMax, 2));
    if ($pMax <= 0 && $pMin > 0) $pMax = $pMin;
    if ($pMin > $pMax) { $t = $pMin; $pMin = $pMax; $pMax = $t; }
    if ($pMin <= 0) $pMin = $pMax;
    return [$pMin, $pMax];
}

/* Kolom harga min master (materials.estimated_price_min, expense_master.default_price_min) sudah dimigrasi? Bila belum, halaman tetap terbaca; hanya SIMPAN yang ditolak. */
function mpHasPriceRange($db) {
    static $has = null;
    if ($has === null) {
        $r = mpFetchOne($db, "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = ANY (current_schemas(false)) AND table_name = 'materials' AND column_name = 'estimated_price_min')
                                   + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = ANY (current_schemas(false)) AND table_name = 'expense_master' AND column_name = 'default_price_min') AS n", [], 'has_price_range');
        $has = ((int)$r['n'] === 2);
    }
    return $has;
}

/* Peta RAB proyek: material (category Material) & expense (MP_EXPENSE_CATEGORY) + master material (untuk cocokkan nama) */
/* [AI-BOQ] Task lama yang AMAN diganti saat analisis ulang: status 'Belum Mulai' dan tidak punya tagihan yang sudah dibayar */
function mpTaskReplaceInfo($db, $projectId) {
    $rows = mpFetchAll($db, "SELECT t.id, t.status, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.paid_amount) FROM project_invoices i WHERE i.task_id = t.id), 0) AS paid
                               FROM public.project_tasks t WHERE t.project_id = :p", ['p' => $projectId], 'task_replace_info');
    $ids = [];
    foreach ($rows as $r) { if ($r['status'] === 'Belum Mulai' && (float)$r['paid'] <= 0) $ids[] = (int)$r['id']; }
    return ['total' => count($rows), 'replaceable_ids' => $ids];
}
function mpMode($v) { return ((string)$v === 'append') ? 'append' : 'replace'; }   /* [DEDUP] tidak dipakai lagi (simpan selalu cek 'hampir sama'); dibiarkan agar pemanggil lama aman */

/* ============================================================
 * [DEDUP][NEW] Cek 'HAMPIR SAMA' sebelum simpan (task, material, biaya)
 *  - nama dinormalisasi (huruf kecil, tanpa tanda baca, tanpa kata umum: pekerjaan/pemasangan/dan/...), token diurutkan
 *  - angka (dimensi / mutu: 300, K350, 50) HARUS sama persis -> 'Baja WF 200' tidak digabung dengan 'Baja WF 300'
 *  - skor = max(Dice token, similar_text) ; item (material/biaya) >= MP_SIM_ITEM, task >= MP_SIM_TASK
 *  - mirip dengan data lama -> data lama DITIMPA/dipakai ulang ; tidak ada yang mirip -> simpan baru
 * ============================================================ */
const MP_SIM_ITEM = 0.85;     /* ambang kemiripan material / biaya (0-1) */
const MP_SIM_TASK = 0.75;     /* ambang kemiripan nama task (kalimat lebih longgar) */
function mpTokens($s) {
    static $cache = [];
    $k = (string)$s;
    if (isset($cache[$k])) return $cache[$k];
    $stop = ['pekerjaan' => 1, 'pemasangan' => 1, 'pasang' => 1, 'pengadaan' => 1, 'dan' => 1, 'untuk' => 1, 'yang' => 1, 'dengan' => 1, 'dgn' => 1, 'material' => 1, 'bahan' => 1];
    $t = [];
    foreach (explode(' ', mpNorm($k)) as $w) { if ($w !== '' && !isset($stop[$w])) $t[$w] = true; }
    $t = array_keys($t); sort($t);
    return $cache[$k] = $t;
}
function mpSimilarity($a, $b) {
    $ta = mpTokens($a); $tb = mpTokens($b);
    if (!$ta || !$tb) return (mpNorm($a) !== '' && mpNorm($a) === mpNorm($b)) ? 1.0 : 0.0;
    preg_match_all('/\d+/', implode(' ', $ta), $ma);
    preg_match_all('/\d+/', implode(' ', $tb), $mb);
    $na = $ma[0]; $nb = $mb[0]; sort($na); sort($nb);
    if ($na !== $nb) return 0.0;                                  /* angka berbeda = barang / mutu berbeda */
    $dice = 2 * count(array_intersect($ta, $tb)) / (count($ta) + count($tb));
    similar_text(implode(' ', $ta), implode(' ', $tb), $pct);     /* toleran salah ketik */
    return max($dice, $pct / 100);
}
/* Cari baris paling mirip pada peta ctx (nilai: array baris); $field = kolom nama pada baris */
function mpFuzzy($name, array $map, $field, $th = MP_SIM_ITEM) {
    $best = null; $bs = 0.0;
    foreach ($map as $row) {
        $sc = mpSimilarity($name, isset($row[$field]) ? $row[$field] : '');
        if ($sc >= $th && $sc > $bs) { $bs = $sc; $best = $row; }
    }
    return $best;
}
/* Nama baris baru yang hampir sama dalam SATU rencana disatukan (agar tidak membuat 2 material / biaya baru yang kembar) */
function mpCanonName(array &$seen, $kind, $name) {
    if (!isset($seen[$kind])) $seen[$kind] = [];
    foreach ($seen[$kind] as $n) { if (mpSimilarity($name, $n) >= MP_SIM_ITEM) return $n; }
    $seen[$kind][] = $name;
    return $name;
}
/* Pasangkan task hasil analisis (indeks => ['id','name']) dengan task lama proyek yang namanya hampir sama (satu-satu) */
function mpMatchTasks($db, $projectId, array $planTasks) {
    $existing = mpFetchAll($db, "SELECT id, task_name FROM public.project_tasks WHERE project_id = :p ORDER BY id", ['p' => $projectId], 'match_tasks');
    $pairs = [];
    foreach (array_values($planTasks) as $i => $t) {
        $nm = trim((string)(isset($t['task_name']) ? $t['task_name'] : ''));
        if ($nm === '') continue;
        foreach ($existing as $e) {
            $sc = mpSimilarity($nm, $e['task_name']);
            if ($sc >= MP_SIM_TASK) $pairs[] = ['s' => $sc, 'i' => $i, 'id' => (int)$e['id'], 'n' => $e['task_name']];
        }
    }
    usort($pairs, function ($a, $b) { return $b['s'] <=> $a['s']; });
    $out = []; $usedId = [];
    foreach ($pairs as $pr) {
        if (isset($out[$pr['i']]) || isset($usedId[$pr['id']])) continue;
        $out[$pr['i']] = ['id' => $pr['id'], 'name' => $pr['n'], 'score' => round($pr['s'], 2)];
        $usedId[$pr['id']] = true;
    }
    return $out;
}
function mpMatchIds(array $m) { $ids = []; foreach ($m as $x) $ids[] = (int)$x['id']; return $ids; }
/* ============================================================
 * [EDIT-SAVED][NEW] Edit task / material yang SUDAH TERSIMPAN tanpa analisis ulang AI.
 * Aturan hapus: penghapusan DITOLAK (seluruh simpan dibatalkan) bila data sudah dipakai
 *   - alokasi (task_materials)  : dipakai SPK
 *   - task                      : dipakai SPK / kontrak subkon / tagihannya sudah ada pembayaran
 *   - item RAB (yatim, tak lagi dialokasikan ke task mana pun) : dipakai PO / SPK / kontrak subkon / sudah di-issue dari gudang
 * Pengecekan tabel opsional memakai to_regclass agar tidak error bila tabel belum ada di database.
 * ============================================================ */
function mpTableExists($db, $t) {
    static $c = [];
    if (!isset($c[$t])) {
        $r = mpFetchOne($db, "SELECT to_regclass(:t) AS x", ['t' => 'public.' . $t], 'tbl_exists');
        $c[$t] = is_array($r) && !empty($r['x']);
    }
    return $c[$t];
}
function mpCount($db, $sql, array $params, $tag) {
    $r = mpFetchOne($db, $sql, $params, $tag);
    return is_array($r) ? (int)$r['n'] : 0;
}
/* Alasan alokasi (task_materials.id) tidak boleh dilepas; '' = boleh */
function mpAllocLock($db, $tmId, $taskId, $bid) {
    if (mpTableExists($db, 'spk_task_materials') &&
        mpCount($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.spk_task_materials WHERE task_material_id = :id", ['id' => $tmId], 'lk_spk_mat') > 0) return 'sudah dipakai SPK';
    if (mpTableExists($db, 'task_expenses') && mpTableExists($db, 'spk_task_expenses') &&
        mpCount($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.spk_task_expenses s JOIN public.task_expenses te ON te.id = s.task_expense_id
                       WHERE te.task_id = :t AND te.budget_item_id = :b", ['t' => $taskId, 'b' => $bid], 'lk_spk_exp') > 0) return 'sudah dipakai SPK (biaya)';
    return '';
}
/* Alasan item RAB tidak boleh dihapus; '' = boleh */
function mpItemBlock($db, $projectId, $bid) {
    $r = mpFetchOne($db, "SELECT po.po_number FROM public.po_items i JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON po.id = i.po_id
                           WHERE i.budget_item_id = :b ORDER BY po.id LIMIT 1", ['b' => $bid], 'lk_po');
    if (is_array($r) && !empty($r['po_number'])) return 'sudah dipakai PO ' . $r['po_number'];
    if (mpTableExists($db, 'spk_work_items') &&
        mpCount($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.spk_work_items WHERE budget_item_id = :b", ['b' => $bid], 'lk_swi') > 0) return 'sudah dipakai SPK';
    if (mpTableExists($db, 'subcon_contracts') &&
        mpCount($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.subcon_contracts WHERE budget_item_id = :b", ['b' => $bid], 'lk_subcon') > 0) return 'sudah dipakai kontrak subkon';
    if (mpTableExists($db, 'task_expenses') &&
        mpCount($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.task_expenses WHERE budget_item_id = :b", ['b' => $bid], 'lk_texp') > 0) return 'sudah dialokasikan sebagai biaya task';
    if (mpTableExists($db, 'material_out_items') && mpTableExists($db, 'material_out_header')) {
        $bi = mpFetchOne($db, "SELECT material_id FROM public.budget_items WHERE id = :b", ['b' => $bid], 'lk_bi');
        $mid = (is_array($bi) && $bi['material_id'] !== null) ? (int)$bi['material_id'] : 0;
        if ($mid > 0 && mpCount($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.material_out_items i JOIN public.material_out_header h ON h.id = i.material_out_id
                                       WHERE h.project_id = :p AND i.material_id = :m AND h.status = 'posted'", ['p' => $projectId, 'm' => $mid], 'lk_issue') > 0) {
            return 'sudah di-issue dari gudang';
        }
    }
    return '';
}
/* Alasan task tidak boleh dihapus; '' = boleh */
function mpTaskBlock($db, $taskId) {
    if (mpTableExists($db, 'spk_tasks') &&
        mpCount($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.spk_tasks WHERE task_id = :t", ['t' => $taskId], 'lk_spk_task') > 0) return 'sudah dipakai SPK';
    if (mpTableExists($db, 'spk_work_items') &&
        mpCount($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.spk_work_items WHERE project_task_id = :t", ['t' => $taskId], 'lk_swi_task') > 0) return 'sudah dipakai SPK';
    if (mpTableExists($db, 'subcon_contract_tasks') &&
        mpCount($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.subcon_contract_tasks WHERE task_id = :t", ['t' => $taskId], 'lk_subcon_task') > 0) return 'sudah dipakai kontrak subkon';
    if (mpCount($db, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.project_invoices WHERE task_id = :t AND COALESCE(paid_amount,0) > 0", ['t' => $taskId], 'lk_inv_paid') > 0) return 'tagihannya sudah ada pembayaran';
    return '';
}
function mpItemName($db, $bid) {
    $r = mpFetchOne($db, "SELECT item_name FROM public.budget_items WHERE id = :b", ['b' => $bid], 'item_name');
    return is_array($r) ? (string)$r['item_name'] : ('#' . $bid);
}
/* [FORM-LIVE][NEW] Nilai yang sedang diisi di FORM proyek (belum disimpan) menimpa data proyek di database */
/* untuk analisis AI, hitung ulang, cek plafon dan simpan rencana -> user tidak perlu Simpan proyek dulu / keluar-masuk form. */
function mpApplyFormOverrides(array $proj) {
    $r = $_REQUEST;
    if (isset($r['ovr_name']) && trim((string)$r['ovr_name']) !== '') $proj['name'] = trim((string)$r['ovr_name']);
    if (array_key_exists('ovr_project_scope', $r)) $proj['project_scope'] = trim((string)$r['ovr_project_scope']);
    if (isset($r['ovr_status']) && in_array((string)$r['ovr_status'], ['Belum Mulai', 'Berjalan', 'Tertunda', 'Selesai'], true)) $proj['status'] = (string)$r['ovr_status'];
    foreach (['ovr_start_date' => 'start_date', 'ovr_end_date' => 'end_date'] as $rk => $col) {
        if (!empty($r[$rk])) {
            $d = DateTime::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', (string)$r[$rk]);
            if ($d && $d->format('Y-m-d') === (string)$r[$rk]) $proj[$col] = (string)$r[$rk];
        }
    }
    foreach (['ovr_budget' => 'budget', 'ovr_contract_value' => 'contract_value'] as $rk => $col) {
        if (isset($r[$rk]) && trim((string)$r[$rk]) !== '') $proj[$col] = (float)str_replace(',', '', (string)$r[$rk]);
    }
    return $proj;
}
/* id task yang dimuat saat jendela edit dibuka (dikirim balik oleh UI) */
function mpLoadedIds() {
    $ids = [];
    $raw = json_decode((string)($_REQUEST['loaded_ids'] ?? '[]'), true);
    foreach ((is_array($raw) ? $raw : []) as $x) { if ((int)$x > 0) $ids[(int)$x] = true; }
    return array_keys($ids);
}

/* Ringkasan untuk UI: daftar task yang akan menimpa task lama */
function mpMatchInfo(array $m, array $planTasks) {
    $pt = array_values($planTasks); $rows = [];
    foreach ($m as $i => $x) $rows[] = ['index' => $i, 'task_name' => (string)($pt[$i]['task_name'] ?? ''), 'match_task_id' => $x['id'], 'match_task_name' => $x['name'], 'score' => $x['score']];
    return ['task_matches' => $rows, 'overwrite_task_count' => count($m), 'new_task_count' => max(0, count($pt) - count($m))];
}

/* $ignoreTaskIds: task yang akan diganti -> alokasinya tidak dihitung (agar analisis ulang tidak menggandakan qty RAB) */
function mpLoadMaterialContext($db, $projectId, array $ignoreTaskIds = []) {
    $ign = $ignoreTaskIds ? ' AND tm.task_id NOT IN (' . implode(',', array_map('intval', $ignoreTaskIds)) . ')' : '';
    $has = mpHasPriceRange($db);
    $mnSel = $has ? "CASE WHEN COALESCE(bi.category,'Material') = 'Material' THEN m.estimated_price_min ELSE em.default_price_min END" : 'NULL';
    $mxSel = "CASE WHEN COALESCE(bi.category,'Material') = 'Material' THEN m.estimated_price ELSE em.default_price END";
    $rows = mpFetchAll($db, "
        SELECT bi.id AS budget_item_id, bi.material_id, bi.expense_id, COALESCE(bi.category,'Material') AS category,
               COALESCE(m.material_name, bi.item_name) AS material_name,
               COALESCE(NULLIF(bi.unit,''), m.unit, '') AS unit,
               COALESCE(bi.qty_plan,0) AS qty_plan,
               COALESCE(bi.unit_price_plan,0) AS unit_price_plan,
               COALESCE({$mnSel}, 0) AS master_min, COALESCE({$mxSel}, 0) AS master_max,       -- rentang harga dari MASTER (mata uang dasar)
               COALESCE((SELECT SUM(tm.qty_budget) FROM public.task_materials tm WHERE tm.budget_item_id = bi.id{$ign}),0) AS qty_allocated
          FROM public.budget_items bi
          LEFT JOIN public.materials m ON m.id = bi.material_id
          LEFT JOIN expense_master em ON em.id = bi.expense_id
         WHERE bi.project_id = :pid
