            /* [PPN][NEW] pengaturan penagihan: tarif PPN, nilai kontrak termasuk PPN, retensi, DP minimum. */
            /* Tidak dikirim (UI lama) -> null: saat update nilai lama dipertahankan, saat tambah memakai default kolom. */
            $numOrNull = function ($k) { return (isset($_REQUEST[$k]) && $_REQUEST[$k] !== '') ? (float)str_replace(',', '', $_REQUEST[$k]) : null; };
            $ppn_rate      = $numOrNull('ppn_rate');
            $retention_pct = $numOrNull('retention_pct');
            $dp_min_pct    = $numOrNull('dp_min_pct');
            $ppn_inclusive = isset($_REQUEST['ppn_inclusive']) && $_REQUEST['ppn_inclusive'] !== ''
                             ? (in_array((string)$_REQUEST['ppn_inclusive'], ['1', 'true', 't'], true) ? 't' : 'f') : null;   /* boolean PDO pgsql: 't' / 'f' */
            foreach (['Tarif PPN' => $ppn_rate, 'Retensi' => $retention_pct, 'DP Minimum' => $dp_min_pct] as $lbl => $v) {
                if ($v !== null && ($v < 0 || $v > 100)) throw new Exception("{$lbl} harus antara 0 - 100%.");
            }

            $budget_raw     = $_REQUEST['budget'] ?? '';
            $cv_raw         = $_REQUEST['contract_value'] ?? '';
            
            $budget         = ($budget_raw !== '') ? (float)str_replace(',', '', $budget_raw) : null;
            $contract_value = ($cv_raw !== '') ? (float)str_replace(',', '', $cv_raw) : null;
            $progress       = (isset($_REQUEST['progress']) && $_REQUEST['progress'] !== '') ? (int)$_REQUEST['progress'] : null;

            if ($name === '') throw new Exception('Nama Proyek wajib diisi.');
            if (!in_array($status, ['Belum Mulai', 'Berjalan', 'Tertunda', 'Selesai'], true)) {
                throw new Exception('Status proyek tidak valid.');
            }
            if ($progress !== null && ($progress < 0 || $progress > 100)) throw new Exception('Progress harus antara 0-100.');
            /* [F-1.1 2026-11-16] Progress hanya boleh BERUBAH oleh admin (FormAccess >= 4); non-admin harus */
            /* lewat modul Project Progress (klaim -> verifikasi). Nilai yang TIDAK berubah tetap boleh dikirim */
            /* (UI lama mengirim ulang nilai yang sama); yang ditolak hanyalah nilai yang menyimpang dari DB. */
            if ($progress !== null && $access < 4 && $task === 'update' && $id > 0) {
                $curProg = mpFetchOne($db, "SELECT COALESCE(progress, 0) AS progress FROM projects WHERE id = :id",
                    ['id' => $id], 'cek progress proyek');
                if ($curProg !== null && (int)$curProg['progress'] !== $progress) {
                    throw new Exception('Set progress manual hanya untuk admin (akses 4). Gunakan modul Project Progress untuk klaim & verifikasi progress.');
                }
            }
            if ($progress !== null && $progress > 0 && $task === 'create' && $access < 4) {
                /* Proyek baru non-admin selalu mulai dari 0%; progress diisi lewat klaim terverifikasi. */
                $progress = 0;
            }
            if ($end_date && $start_date && $end_date < $start_date) {
                throw new Exception('Tanggal Selesai tidak boleh sebelum Tanggal Mulai.');
            }

            if ($task === 'create') {
                $newId = (int)mpFetchOne($db,
                    "INSERT INTO projects
                        (name, client_id, pic_id, location_id, start_date, end_date, budget, contract_value, progress, status, notes, project_scope,
                         ppn_rate, ppn_inclusive, retention_pct, dp_min_pct, created_at, updated_at)
                     VALUES (:name, :cid, :pid, :lid, :sd, :ed, :budget, :cv, :progress, :status, :notes, :scope,
                         COALESCE(CAST(:ppn AS numeric), 0), COALESCE(CAST(:ppninc AS boolean), false), COALESCE(CAST(:ret AS numeric), 0), COALESCE(CAST(:dpmin AS numeric), 30), NOW(), NOW())
                     RETURNING id",
                    ['name' => $name, 'cid' => $client_id, 'pid' => $pic_id, 'lid' => $location_id,
                     'sd' => $start_date, 'ed' => $end_date,
                     'budget' => $budget ?? 0, 'cv' => $contract_value ?? 0,
                     'progress' => $progress ?? 0, 'status' => $status, 'notes' => $notes, 'scope' => $project_scope,
                     'ppn' => $ppn_rate, 'ppninc' => $ppn_inclusive, 'ret' => $retention_pct, 'dpmin' => $dp_min_pct],
                    'insert projects')['id'];
                mpJson(['success' => true, 'id' => $newId, 'message' => "Proyek '{$name}' berhasil ditambahkan."]);
            } else {
                if (!$id) throw new Exception('ID proyek tidak valid.');
                mpExec($db,
                    "UPDATE projects SET
                        name = :name, client_id = :cid, pic_id = :pid, location_id = :lid,
                        start_date = :sd, end_date = :ed,
                        budget = COALESCE(CAST(:budget AS numeric), budget),
                        contract_value = COALESCE(CAST(:cv AS numeric), contract_value),
                        progress = COALESCE(CAST(:progress AS smallint), progress),
                        status = :status, notes = :notes, project_scope = :scope,
                        ppn_rate = COALESCE(CAST(:ppn AS numeric), ppn_rate),
                        ppn_inclusive = COALESCE(CAST(:ppninc AS boolean), ppn_inclusive),
                        retention_pct = COALESCE(CAST(:ret AS numeric), retention_pct),
                        dp_min_pct = COALESCE(CAST(:dpmin AS numeric), dp_min_pct),
                        updated_at = NOW()
                     WHERE id = :id",
                    ['name' => $name, 'cid' => $client_id, 'pid' => $pic_id, 'lid' => $location_id,
                     'sd' => $start_date, 'ed' => $end_date,
                     'budget' => $budget, 'cv' => $contract_value, 'progress' => $progress,
                     'status' => $status, 'notes' => $notes, 'scope' => $project_scope, 'id' => $id,
                     'ppn' => $ppn_rate, 'ppninc' => $ppn_inclusive, 'ret' => $retention_pct, 'dpmin' => $dp_min_pct],
                    'update projects');
                mpJson(['success' => true, 'message' => "Proyek '{$name}' berhasil diperbarui."]);
            }
            break;

        case 'delete':
            if ($access < 4) {
                mpJson(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus proyek.']);
            }
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            if (!$id) throw new Exception('ID proyek tidak valid.');

            $refs = mpFetchOne($db,
                "SELECT
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders WHERE project_id = :id1) AS po_count,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_invoices WHERE project_id = :id2) AS termin_count,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_out_header WHERE project_id = :id3) AS mout_count",
                ['id1' => $id, 'id2' => $id, 'id3' => $id], 'cek referensi proyek');
            $refCount = (int)$refs['po_count'] + (int)$refs['termin_count'] + (int)$refs['mout_count'];
            if ($refCount > 0) {
                throw new Exception("Proyek ini tidak bisa dihapus karena sudah punya transaksi terkait.");
            }

            mpExec($db, "DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = :id", ['id' => $id], 'delete projects');
            mpJson(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Proyek berhasil dihapus.']);
            break;

        default:
            mpJson(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
            break;
    }
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[m.proyekCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    mpJson(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage() !== '' ? $e->getMessage() : 'Terjadi kesalahan pada server.']);
}

 * projectprogressCRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Backend Project Progress (halaman mobile project.progress.m.js).
 * Pola sama dengan poCRD.php: PDO (class crud), dispatch lewat $_REQUEST['task'],
 * respons JSON {success, message, data, totalCount}.
 *
 * Task: list_projects | list_progress | save_progress | photo
 *
 * Aturan:
 *  1. Progress dicatat PER PROYEK (persen 0-100) + catatan + foto (maks 5) + GPS (opsional).
 *  2. IDEMPOTEN: client_uuid dibuat di HP. Kiriman ulang dengan uuid sama tidak membuat data ganda
 *     (penting untuk antrean offline / sinyal putus di tengah upload).
 *  3. projects.progress otomatis = persen entri terbaru (berdasarkan progress_date, id).
 *  4. Foto disimpan di luar web root bila memungkinkan (../uploads/progress), nama file acak,
 *     diverifikasi MIME asli (finfo), dan hanya disajikan lewat task=photo (wajib login).
 * Butuh migrasi: sql/2026-10-13.project_progress.sql
 * ============================================================
 */

ini_set('display_errors', '0');
ob_start();

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$db = new crud();

const PRG_ACCESS_ADD = 2;                 // level akses minimal untuk menyimpan progress (samakan dengan PO)
const PRG_MAX_PHOTOS = 5;                 // [BARU] maks foto per entri
const PRG_MAX_BYTES  = 5 * 1024 * 1024;   // [BARU] maks 5 MB per foto (klien sudah mengompres)
const PRG_ALLOWED    = ['image/jpeg' => 'jpg', 'image/png' => 'png', 'image/webp' => 'webp'];

class PrgBusinessError extends Exception {}

function sendJsonResponse($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $response = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        if (is_array($data) && isset($data['data'])) {
            $response['data'] = $data['data'];
            if (isset($data['totalCount'])) $response['totalCount'] = $data['totalCount'];
        } else {
            $response['data'] = $data;
        }
    }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode($response, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

function prg_upload_dir(): string {
    $dir = __DIR__ . '/../uploads/progress';
    if (!is_dir($dir)) { @mkdir($dir, 0750, true); }
    return $dir;
}

/** Normalisasi $_FILES['photos'] (multi) menjadi array flat. */
function prg_files(): array {
    $out = [];
    if (empty($_FILES['photos'])) return $out;
    $f = $_FILES['photos'];
    if (!is_array($f['name'])) {
        $f = ['name' => [$f['name']], 'tmp_name' => [$f['tmp_name']], 'error' => [$f['error']], 'size' => [$f['size']]];
    }
    foreach ($f['name'] as $i => $n) {
        if ($f['error'][$i] === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) continue;
        $out[] = ['tmp' => $f['tmp_name'][$i], 'error' => $f['error'][$i], 'size' => (int)$f['size'][$i]];
    }
    return $out;
}

if (empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    http_response_code(401);                       // klien mobile: 401 = antrean offline TETAP disimpan, minta login ulang
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login ulang.');
}

$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';
if ((int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < 1) { http_response_code(403); sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Anda tidak memiliki hak baca progres proyek.'); }


try {
    switch ($task) {

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Daftar proyek untuk dipilih (kartu di HP)
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'list_projects':
            $rows = $db->query("
                SELECT p.id, p.name, p.status, COALESCE(p.progress, 0) AS progress, p.location
                  FROM public.projects p
                 ORDER BY (p.status = 'Berjalan') DESC, p.name ASC")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) { $r['id'] = (int)$r['id']; $r['progress'] = (int)$r['progress']; }
            sendJsonResponse(true, ['data' => $rows, 'totalCount' => count($rows)]);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Riwayat progress satu proyek (terbaru dulu) + id foto
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'list_progress':
            $prj = (int)($_REQUEST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($prj <= 0) throw new PrgBusinessError('Proyek tidak valid.');
            $st = $db->prepare("
                SELECT pp.id, pp.progress_date, pp.percent, pp.notes, pp.latitude, pp.longitude,

                          FROM public.project_progress_photos ph WHERE ph.progress_id = pp.id) AS photos
                  FROM public.project_progress pp
                  LEFT JOIN public.m_user_system u ON u.id = pp.created_by
                 WHERE pp.project_id = :p
                 ORDER BY pp.progress_date DESC, pp.id DESC
                 LIMIT 50");
            $st->execute([':p' => $prj]);
            $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                $r['id'] = (int)$r['id'];
                $r['percent'] = (float)$r['percent'];
                $r['photos'] = json_decode($r['photos'], true) ?: [];
            }
            sendJsonResponse(true, ['data' => $rows, 'totalCount' => count($rows)]);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Simpan progress (multipart: field + photos[]). Idempoten via client_uuid.
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'save_progress':
            if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') throw new PrgBusinessError('Metode harus POST.');
            $access = (int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
            if ($access < PRG_ACCESS_ADD) throw new PrgBusinessError('Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mencatat progress.');

            $prj   = (int)($_POST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            $pct   = round((float)($_POST['percent'] ?? -1), 2);
            $date  = (string)($_POST['progress_date'] ?? '');
            $notes = trim((string)($_POST['notes'] ?? '')) ?: null;
            $uuid  = strtolower(trim((string)($_POST['client_uuid'] ?? '')));
            $lat   = ($_POST['latitude']  ?? '') !== '' ? round((float)$_POST['latitude'], 6)  : null;
            $lng   = ($_POST['longitude'] ?? '') !== '' ? round((float)$_POST['longitude'], 6) : null;
            $userId = (int)$_SESSION['user_id'];

            $written = [];     // file yang sudah ditulis ke disk (dihapus bila transaksi gagal)
            try {
                if ($prj <= 0) throw new PrgBusinessError('Proyek wajib dipilih.');
                if ($pct < 0 || $pct > 100) throw new PrgBusinessError('Persentase progress harus 0 - 100.');

                try {

                    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM public.project_progress WHERE client_uuid = :u");
                    $st->execute([':u' => $uuid]);
                    $dup = $st->fetchColumn();
                    if ($dup) {
                        $db->rollBack();
                        sendJsonResponse(true, ['id' => (int)$dup, 'duplicate' => true], 'Laporan sudah tersimpan sebelumnya.');
                    }

                        if ($acMobile !== null && $acMobile['cost_material'] <= 0) {

                        }

                            (project_id, progress_date, percent, notes, latitude, longitude, client_uuid, created_by)
                        VALUES (:p, CAST(:d AS date), :pc, :n, :la, :lo, :u, :by)

                    $st->execute([':p' => $prj, ':d' => $date, ':pc' => $pct, ':n' => $notes,

                                          VALUES (:g, :f, :s)");
                    foreach ($files as $i => $f) {

                        if ($f['size'] <= 0 || $f['size'] > PRG_MAX_BYTES) throw new PrgBusinessError("{$no}: ukuran harus di bawah 5 MB.");
                        if (!is_uploaded_file($f['tmp'])) throw new PrgBusinessError("{$no}: file tidak valid.");

                        if (!move_uploaded_file($f['tmp'], $dir . '/' . $name)) throw new Exception("{$no}: gagal menyimpan file.");
                        $written[] = $dir . '/' . $name;
                        $stPh->execute([':g' => $progId, ':f' => $name, ':s' => $f['size']]);
                    }

                    // projects.progress = persen entri terbaru (tanggal lalu / backdate tidak menimpa yang lebih baru)
                    $db->prepare("
                        UPDATE public.projects
                           SET progress = (SELECT ROUND(percent)::smallint FROM public.project_progress
                                            WHERE project_id = :p ORDER BY progress_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1),
                               updated_at = NOW()
                         WHERE id = :p")->execute([':p' => $prj]);

                    $db->commit();
                    sendJsonResponse(true, ['id' => $progId], 'Progress berhasil disimpan.');
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                    foreach ($written as $w) { @unlink($w); }
                    throw $e;
                }
            } catch (PrgBusinessError $e) {
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Sajikan foto (hanya untuk user login) - folder upload tidak diakses langsung
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'photo':
            $pid = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT file_name FROM public.project_progress_photos WHERE id = :id");
            $st->execute([':id' => $pid]);
            $fn = $st->fetchColumn();
            $path = $fn ? prg_upload_dir() . '/' . basename($fn) : '';
            if (!$fn || !is_file($path)) {
                http_response_code(404);
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Foto tidak ditemukan.');
            }
            $mime = (new finfo(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE))->file($path);
            if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
            header('Content-Type: ' . $mime);
            header('Content-Length: ' . filesize($path));
            header('Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400');
            readfile($path);
            exit;

        default:
            sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.');
            break;
    }
} catch (PrgBusinessError $e) {
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[projectprogressCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[projectprogressCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}

==================== FILE: ./php-crud/material.leftoverCRD.php ====================
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
/**
 * material.leftoverCRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Backend "Material Left Over" = RETUR SISA MATERIAL PROYEK ke gudang.  Front end: js/material.leftover.js,
 * views/material.leftover.php.
 *
 * Konsep : material yang sudah di-issue ke proyek (masuk WIP) tetapi tidak terpakai (sisa / left over) dikembalikan ke gudang:
 *          stok bertambah kembali dan WIP proyek berkurang, sehingga biaya proyek (dan HPP saat Pelepasan WIP) tidak terlalu besar.
 * Aturan :
 *  1. Qty retur sisa per material <= qty terissue bersih proyek = SUM(issue posted tipe PROJECT) - SUM(retur sisa posted).
 *  2. Nilai retur = biaya rata-rata issue bersih proyek untuk material itu (nilai issue bersih / qty issue bersih), sehingga
 *     WIP proyek berkurang tepat sebesar nilai yang dulu dibebankan. Stok masuk (stock_movements IN, reference_type
 *     'MATERIAL_LEFTOVER') dengan biaya tersebut -> membentuk layer FIFO baru di gudang tujuan.
 *  3. Jurnal (satu transaksi dengan stok): aturan fiscal_config WH_LEFTOVER = Dr 1500 Persediaan Bahan Baku / Cr 1700 WIP Proyek,
 *     reference_type 'material_leftover'. Gagal posting = seluruh transaksi dibatalkan.
 *  4. Reverse hanya bila stok hasil retur belum terpakai (stok gudang >= qty retur); jurnal & stok ikut dibatalkan.
 *  5. Tidak mengubah kuota RAB di Warehouse Issuing (retur sisa tidak mengurangi 'sudah di-issue').
 * Task   : lookup_projects | lookup_warehouses | lookup_materials | list | detail | position | save | reverse
 * Migrasi: sql/2026-10-27.material_leftover.sql dan sql/2026-10-27.leftover_journal_enum.sql
 * ============================================================
 */
ini_set('display_errors', '0');
ob_start();

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$db = new crud();

const LO_EPS = 0.00005;                       // toleransi qty
const LO_JOURNAL_REF = 'material_leftover';   // nilai enum journal_entries.reference_type
const LO_JOURNAL_RULE = 'WH_LEFTOVER';        // fiscal_config: Dr Persediaan Bahan Baku / Cr WIP Proyek
const LO_STOCK_REF = 'MATERIAL_LEFTOVER';     // stock_movements.reference_type

class LoError extends Exception {}

function lo_send($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $resp = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        $resp['data'] = $data;
        if (!isset($resp['totalCount'])) $resp['totalCount'] = is_array($data) ? count($data) : 0;
    }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($resp, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

function lo_valid_date(string $s): bool {
    $d = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $s);
    return $d && $d->format('Y-m-d') === $s;
}

/** Qty & nilai issue bersih proyek untuk satu material (issue PROJECT posted - retur sisa posted). */
function lo_net($db, int $projectId, int $materialId): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty_out), 0) AS q, COALESCE(SUM(i.qty_out * i.unit_cost), 0) AS a
          FROM public.material_out_items i JOIN public.material_out_header h ON h.id = i.material_out_id
         WHERE h.project_id = :p AND i.material_id = :m AND h.status = 'posted' AND h.issue_type = 'PROJECT'");
    $st->execute([':p' => $projectId, ':m' => $materialId]);
    $iss = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty), 0) AS q, COALESCE(SUM(i.qty * i.unit_cost), 0) AS a
          FROM public.material_leftover_items i JOIN public.material_leftover_header h ON h.id = i.header_id
         WHERE h.project_id = :p AND i.material_id = :m AND h.status = 'posted'");
    $st->execute([':p' => $projectId, ':m' => $materialId]);
    $lo = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    $q = round((float)$iss['q'] - (float)$lo['q'], 4);
    $a = round((float)$iss['a'] - (float)$lo['a'], 2);
    return ['qty' => max($q, 0), 'amount' => max($a, 0), 'avg_cost' => ($q > LO_EPS) ? round(max($a, 0) / $q, 4) : 0.0];
}

function lo_onhand($db, int $materialId, int $warehouseId): float {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'IN' THEN qty ELSE -qty END), 0)
                          FROM public.stock_movements WHERE item_id = :m AND warehouse_id = :w");
    $st->execute([':m' => $materialId, ':w' => $warehouseId]);
    return round((float)$st->fetchColumn(), 4);
}

                                 WHERE i.header_id = :id ORDER BY i.id");
            $st->execute([':id' => $id]);

            foreach ($rows as &$r) { $r['qty'] = (float)$r['qty']; $r['unit_cost'] = (float)$r['unit_cost']; $r['amount'] = round((float)$r['amount'], 2); }
            unset($r);
            lo_send(true, $rows);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Posisi material per proyek: issue, retur sisa, bersih (terpakai) vs RAB
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'position':
            $pid = (int)($_REQUEST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            $q   = trim((string)($_REQUEST['query'] ?? ''));
            $where = ["h.status = 'posted'", "h.issue_type = 'PROJECT'"]; $params = [];
            if ($pid > 0) { $where[] = "h.project_id = :pid"; $params[':pid'] = $pid; }

                SELECT k.project_id, p.name AS project_name, k.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit,
                       COALESCE(rab.q, 0) AS rab_qty, k.issued_qty, k.issued_amt,
                       COALESCE(lo.q, 0) AS lo_qty, COALESCE(lo.a, 0) AS lo_amt
                  FROM (SELECT h.project_id, i.material_id, SUM(i.qty_out) AS issued_qty, SUM(i.qty_out * i.unit_cost) AS issued_amt
                          FROM public.material_out_items i JOIN public.material_out_header h ON h.id = i.material_out_id

            $st->execute($params);
            $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                $r['project_id'] = (int)$r['project_id']; $r['material_id'] = (int)$r['material_id'];
                foreach (['rab_qty', 'issued_qty', 'issued_amt', 'lo_qty', 'lo_amt'] as $f) $r[$f] = (float)$r[$f];
                $r['net_qty'] = round($r['issued_qty'] - $r['lo_qty'], 4);
                $r['net_amt'] = round($r['issued_amt'] - $r['lo_amt'], 2);
                $r['used_pct'] = $r['rab_qty'] > 0 ? round($r['net_qty'] / $r['rab_qty'] * 100, 1) : null;     // terpakai bersih vs RAB
            }
            unset($r);
            lo_send(true, $rows);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Simpan & posting retur sisa (stok masuk + jurnal, satu transaksi)
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'save':
            $projectId = (int)($_POST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            $whId      = (int)($_POST['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);
            $date      = (string)($_POST['doc_date'] ?? '');
            $remark    = trim((string)($_POST['remark'] ?? '')) ?: null;
            $details   = json_decode($_POST['details'] ?? '[]', true);
            try {
                if ($projectId < 1) throw new LoError('Proyek wajib dipilih.');
                if ($whId < 1) throw new LoError('Gudang tujuan wajib dipilih.');
                if (!lo_valid_date($date)) throw new LoError('Tanggal tidak valid.');
                if (!is_array($details) || !count($details)) throw new LoError('Tambahkan minimal satu material.');

                $lines = [];                                                  // gabung baris ganda per material
                foreach ($details as $d) {
                    $mid = (int)($d['material_id'] ?? 0);
                    $qty = round((float)($d['qty'] ?? 0), 4);
                    if ($mid < 1) throw new LoError('Material pada detail tidak valid.');
                    if ($qty <= 0) throw new LoError('Qty retur sisa harus lebih besar dari 0.');
                    if (!isset($lines[$mid])) $lines[$mid] = ['qty' => 0.0, 'notes' => ''];
                    $lines[$mid]['qty'] = round($lines[$mid]['qty'] + $qty, 4);
                    if (!empty($d['notes'])) $lines[$mid]['notes'] = trim((string)$d['notes']);
                }

                $db->beginTransaction();
                try {
                    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, name FROM public.projects WHERE id = :id");
                    $st->execute([':id' => $projectId]);
                    $prj = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                    if (!$prj) throw new LoError('Proyek tidak ditemukan.');
                    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, active FROM public.warehouses WHERE id = :id");
                    $st->execute([':id' => $whId]);
                    $wh = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                    if (!$wh || !in_array($wh['active'], [true, 't', 'true', 1, '1'], true)) throw new LoError('Gudang tidak ditemukan / tidak aktif.');

                    if (!function_exists('CreateRefNo')) throw new Exception('CreateRefNo() tidak tersedia.');
                    $refNo = CreateRefNo('material_leftover_header', 'ref_no', 'MLO');
                    $st = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO public.material_leftover_header (ref_no, project_id, warehouse_id, doc_date, status, remark, created_by)
                                        VALUES (:r, :p, :w, CAST(:d AS date), 'posted', :rm, :u) RETURNING id");
                    $st->execute([':r' => $refNo, ':p' => $projectId, ':w' => $whId, ':d' => $date, ':rm' => $remark, ':u' => $userId]);
                    $hdrId = (int)$st->fetchColumn();

                    $totalAmt = 0.0;
                    $stItem = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO public.material_leftover_items (header_id, material_id, qty, unit_cost, notes)
                                            VALUES (:h, :m, :q, :c, :n)");
                    $stMov = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO public.stock_movements
                                (movement_date, item_id, grade_id, warehouse_id, movement_type, qty, unit_cost, reference_type, reference_id, reference_no, remark, created_by)
                                VALUES (CAST(:d AS date), :m, NULL, :w, 'IN', :q, :c, :rt, :rid, :rn, :rm, :u)");
                    foreach ($lines as $mid => $ln) {
                        $db->prepare("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(CAST(:a AS integer), CAST(:b AS integer))")->execute([':a' => $projectId, ':b' => $mid]);   // serialkan qty bersih proyek+material
                        $st = $db->prepare("SELECT material_name FROM public.materials WHERE id = :id");
                        $st->execute([':id' => $mid]);
                        $name = $st->fetchColumn();
                        if (!$name) throw new LoError("Material ID {$mid} tidak ditemukan.");

                        $net = lo_net($db, $projectId, $mid);
                        if ($net['qty'] <= LO_EPS) throw new LoError("{$name}: tidak ada qty issue bersih untuk proyek ini (belum pernah di-issue / sudah diretur seluruhnya).");
                        if ($ln['qty'] > $net['qty'] + LO_EPS) {
                            throw new LoError("{$name}: qty retur sisa (" . rtrim(rtrim(number_format($ln['qty'], 4, '.', ''), '0'), '.') .
                                ") melebihi qty issue bersih proyek (" . rtrim(rtrim(number_format($net['qty'], 4, '.', ''), '0'), '.') . ").");
                        }
                        $cost = $net['avg_cost'];                                           // biaya rata-rata issue bersih proyek
                        $stItem->execute([':h' => $hdrId, ':m' => $mid, ':q' => $ln['qty'], ':c' => $cost, ':n' => $ln['notes'] !== '' ? $ln['notes'] : null]);
                        $stMov->execute([':d' => $date, ':m' => $mid, ':w' => $whId, ':q' => $ln['qty'], ':c' => $cost, ':rt' => LO_STOCK_REF,
                                         ':rid' => $hdrId, ':rn' => $refNo, ':rm' => 'Retur sisa material proyek ' . $prj['name'], ':u' => $userId]);
                        $totalAmt += round($ln['qty'] * $cost, 2);
                    }
                    $totalAmt = round($totalAmt, 2);
                    if ($totalAmt > 0.004) {
                        $jr = AutoPostJournal($db, [
                            'rule_code' => LO_JOURNAL_RULE, 'reference_type' => LO_JOURNAL_REF, 'reference_id' => $hdrId,
                            'journal_date' => $date, 'amount' => $totalAmt, 'description' => "Retur sisa material {$refNo} - {$prj['name']}",
                        ]);
                        if (!$jr['success']) throw new LoError('Gagal posting jurnal: ' . $jr['message']);
                    }
                    $db->commit();
                    lo_send(true, ['id' => $hdrId, 'ref_no' => $refNo], "Retur sisa material diposting. No: {$refNo} (nilai " . number_format($totalAmt, 2) . ').');
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                    throw $e;
                }
            } catch (LoError $e) {
                lo_send(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Reverse: hanya bila stok hasil retur belum terpakai
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'reverse':
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, ref_no, status, warehouse_id FROM public.material_leftover_header WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $h = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$h) throw new LoError('Dokumen tidak ditemukan.');
                if ($h['status'] !== 'posted') throw new LoError('Hanya dokumen berstatus posted yang dapat di-reverse.');
                $whId = (int)$h['warehouse_id'];

                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT i.material_id, i.qty, m.material_name FROM public.material_leftover_items i
                                      JOIN public.materials m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.header_id = :id");
                $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
                foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $it) {
                    $db->prepare("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(CAST(:a AS integer), CAST(:b AS integer))")->execute([':a' => (int)$it['material_id'], ':b' => $whId]);
                    $onhand = lo_onhand($db, (int)$it['material_id'], $whId);
                    if ($onhand + LO_EPS < (float)$it['qty']) {
                        throw new LoError("Tidak dapat di-reverse: stok {$it['material_name']} di gudang (" . rtrim(rtrim(number_format($onhand, 4, '.', ''), '0'), '.') .
                            ") kurang dari qty retur (" . rtrim(rtrim(number_format((float)$it['qty'], 4, '.', ''), '0'), '.') . "); stok sudah terpakai.");
                    }
                }
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.journal_entries WHERE reference_type::text = :t AND reference_id = :id LIMIT 1");
                $st->execute([':t' => LO_JOURNAL_REF, ':id' => $id]);
                if ($st->fetchColumn()) ReverseJournalByReference($db, LO_JOURNAL_REF, $id);
                $db->prepare("DELETE FROM public.stock_movements WHERE reference_type = :t AND reference_id = :id")->execute([':t' => LO_STOCK_REF, ':id' => $id]);
                $db->prepare("UPDATE public.material_leftover_header SET status = 'reversed', reversed_at = NOW(), reversed_by = :u WHERE id = :id")
                   ->execute([':u' => $userId, ':id' => $id]);
                $db->commit();
                lo_send(true, [], "Dokumen {$h['ref_no']} di-reverse; stok dan jurnal dibatalkan.");
            } catch (LoError $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                lo_send(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        default:
            lo_send(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.');
            break;
    }
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[material.leftoverCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    lo_send(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[material.leftoverCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    lo_send(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}
==================== FILE: ./php-crud/warehouse.issuingCRD.php ====================
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
/**
 * warehouse.issuingCRD.php — Warehouse Issuing (material out ke proyek)
 *
 * Aturan issue per material:
 *   1. Material harus sudah di-RCV di gudang (stok W/H > 0).
 *   2. qty issue <= stok di W/H.
 *   3. Total issue proyek (posted) + qty ini <= RAB qty_plan x (1 + 5%).
 *      Bila melewati qty RAB tapi masih dalam +5% -> is_overbudget = true (allowance terpakai).
 *   4. [UPGRADE PROGRESS-GATED BUDGET] Total kumulatif actual cost tidak boleh melebihi plafon
 *      anggaran berjalan berdasarkan progress fisik proyek di lapangan (projects.progress) + 5% toleransi.
 *   Nilai issue = FIFO dari layer RCV (stock_movements IN).
 *
 * [CLIENT-SUPPLIED 2026-11-15 F-4.1] FIFO mengeluarkan layer termurah dulu, sehingga layer Rp 0
 * titipan klien keluar lebih dulu dan HPP proyek = Rp 0 secara otomatis (tanpa perubahan alokasi).
 * Guard eksplisit di IssSave(): bila issueValue == 0 (material CLIENT_SUPPLIED), jurnal ISSUE_PROJECT
 * DI-SKIP (bukan error) agar WIP tidak tercemar jurnal Rp 0.
 */

if ($stockAccess < $stockRequired) {
    http_response_code(403);

    }

function IssRabInfo($projectId, $materialId) {
    $rab = WhRow("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_plan),0) AS q FROM budget_items
                  WHERE project_id=$1 AND material_id=$2", array((int)$projectId, (int)$materialId));
    $iss = WhRow("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty_out),0) AS q
                  FROM material_out_items i JOIN material_out_header h ON h.id=i.material_out_id
                  WHERE h.project_id=$1 AND i.material_id=$2 AND h.status='posted'
                    AND h.issue_type='PROJECT'", 
                 array((int)$projectId, (int)$materialId));
    return array('rab_qty' => round((float)$rab['q'], 4), 'issued' => round((float)$iss['q'], 4));
}

/**
 * [NEW PROGRESS-GATED VALIDATION] Validasi pengeluaran material terhadap progress fisik proyek.
 * [F-1.2 2026-11-16] Biaya terpakai dihitung dari rumusan terpadu v_project_actual_cost:
 *   material (posted/reversed-null/PROJECT) + expenses (status bukan void/cancelled) + subkon tersertifikasi.
 *   Plafon = budget terpadu (projects.budget x kurs, atau SUM(budget_items) bila budget kosong) x progress% x (1 + 5%).
 *   Bila view belum dimigrasi (F-1.2 SQL), jatuh kembali ke perilaku lama: budget header + material saja.
 */
function validateMaterialOutAgainstProgress($projectId, $newMaterialCost) {
    $proj = WhRow("SELECT budget, COALESCE(progress, 0) AS progress,
                          COALESCE(NULLIF(budget * COALESCE(NULLIF(budget_exch_rate, 0), 1), 0),
                                   (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.qty_plan*b.unit_price_plan), 0) FROM budget_items b WHERE b.project_id = $1), 0) AS budget_base
                   FROM public.projects WHERE id = $1", array((int)$projectId));
    if (!$proj) {
        throw new WhException('Proyek tidak ditemukan.');
    }

    $totalBudget = floatval($proj['budget_base']);
    $currentProgress = intval($proj['progress']);
    $tolerancePct = 5.0;

    if ($totalBudget <= 0) {
        return;
    }

    $allowedBudgetLimit = ($totalBudget * ($currentProgress / 100.0)) * (1 + ($tolerancePct / 100.0));

    // [F-1.2] Realisasi biaya = material + expense + subkon (satu rumus, dibaca dari view terpadu).
    $costRow = WhRow("SELECT COALESCE(cost_total, 0) AS total_spent
                      FROM public.v_project_actual_cost
                      WHERE project_id = $1", array((int)$projectId));
    if ($costRow) {
        $currentSpent = floatval($costRow['total_spent']);
    } else {
        // Fallback lama (view belum dimigrasi): material posted saja.
        $spentData = WhRow("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty_out * i.unit_cost), 0) AS total_spent
                            FROM material_out_header h
                            JOIN material_out_items i ON i.material_out_id = h.id
                            WHERE h.project_id = $1 AND h.status = 'posted' AND h.reversed_at IS NULL AND h.issue_type = 'PROJECT'",
                           array((int)$projectId));
        $currentSpent = floatval($spentData['total_spent']);
    }
    $projectedSpent = $currentSpent + $newMaterialCost;

    if ($projectedSpent > $allowedBudgetLimit) {
        // [F-1.1 BUGFIX 2026-11-16] format string sebelumnya memakai placeholder yang di-escape (%%d%%/%%s)
        // sehingga pesan dilog tidak pernah memuat angka (selalu tercetak literal "%d%" / "%s").
        throw new WhException(sprintf(
            "TRANSAKSI DITOLAK: Pemakaian anggaran melampaui batas progress fisik saat ini! Progress fisik: %d%%. Plafon diizinkan: Rp %s. Total pengajuan: Rp %s.",
            $currentProgress,
            number_format($allowedBudgetLimit, 2, ',', '.'),
            number_format($projectedSpent, 2, ',', '.')
        ));
    }
}

function IssNextSjNo($date) {
    $ts = strtotime($date);
    $prefix = 'SJ-' . date('ym', $ts ? $ts : time()) . '-';
    WhRow('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext($1)) AS l', array('material_out_sj_no'));
    $r = WhRow('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(delivery_note_no, 5) AS integer)), 0) AS n
                FROM material_out_header WHERE delivery_note_no ~ $1', array('^' . $prefix . '[0-9]{5}$'));
    return $prefix . str_pad((string)((int)$r['n'] + 1), 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
}

function IssList() {
    list($start, $limit) = WhPage();
    $q = WhReq('query');
    $params = array();
    $where = '1=1';
    if ($q !== '') {
        $params[] = '%' . $q . '%';
        $where .= ' AND (h.ref_no ILIKE $1 OR p.name ILIKE $1 OR h.received_by_mandor ILIKE $1 OR rt.ref_no ILIKE $1
                   OR h.delivery_note_no ILIKE $1 OR h.delivery_receiver ILIKE $1)';
    }
    $c = WhRow("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM material_out_header h
                JOIN projects p ON p.id=h.project_id
                LEFT JOIN supplier_return_hdr rt ON rt.material_out_id=h.id
                WHERE $where", $params);

    $params[] = $limit;  $pl = '$' . count($params);
    $params[] = $start;  $ps = '$' . count($params);
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT h.id, h.ref_no, h.project_id, p.name AS project_name,
                           h.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, h.issue_date,
                           h.received_by_mandor, h.status, h.remark, h.issue_type,
                           h.prepared_at, h.delivery_date, h.delivery_note_no, h.delivery_receiver, h.delivery_proof,
                           rt.ref_no AS return_ref_no, rt.status AS return_status,
                           rt.sent_date, rt.carrier, rs.name AS return_supplier_name,
                           COALESCE(t.total_amount,0) AS total_amount,
                           COALESCE(t.line_count,0)   AS line_count,
                           COALESCE(t.has_over,false) AS has_overbudget
                    FROM material_out_header h
                    JOIN projects   p ON p.id=h.project_id
                    JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=h.warehouse_id
                    LEFT JOIN supplier_return_hdr rt ON rt.material_out_id=h.id
                    LEFT JOIN m_suppliers rs ON rs.id=rt.supplier_id
                    LEFT JOIN (SELECT material_out_id, SUM(qty_out*unit_cost) AS total_amount,
                                      COUNT(*) AS line_count, BOOL_OR(is_overbudget) AS has_over
                               FROM material_out_items GROUP BY material_out_id) t ON t.material_out_id=h.id
                    WHERE $where
                    ORDER BY h.issue_date DESC, h.id DESC
                    LIMIT $pl OFFSET $ps", $params);
    foreach ($rows as &$r) { $r['has_overbudget'] = WhBool($r['has_overbudget']); }
    unset($r);
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => (int)$c['n'], 'data' => $rows));
}

function IssDetail() {
    $id = (int)WhReq('id');
    if ($id < 1) { throw new WhException('ID dokumen tidak valid.'); }
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT i.id, i.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit,
                           i.qty_out, i.unit_cost, (i.qty_out*i.unit_cost) AS amount,
                           i.is_overbudget, i.overbudget_reason, i.notes
                    FROM material_out_items i JOIN materials m ON m.id=i.material_id
                    WHERE i.material_out_id=$1 ORDER BY i.id", array($id));
    foreach ($rows as &$r) { $r['is_overbudget'] = WhBool($r['is_overbudget']); }
    unset($r);
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($rows), 'data' => $rows));
}

function IssLookupProjects() {
    $q = WhReq('query');
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT id, name FROM projects WHERE name ILIKE $1 ORDER BY name LIMIT 100",
                   array('%' . $q . '%'));
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($rows), 'data' => $rows));
}

function IssLookupWarehouses() {
    $pid = (int)WhReq('project_id');
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT w.id, w.code,
                           (w.name || ' (' || oh.item_count || ' material)') AS name
                    FROM warehouses w
                    JOIN (SELECT warehouse_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count
                          FROM (SELECT warehouse_id, item_id
                                FROM stock_movements
                                GROUP BY warehouse_id, item_id
                                HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='IN' THEN qty ELSE -qty END) > 0) x
                          GROUP BY warehouse_id) oh ON oh.warehouse_id = w.id
                    WHERE w.active = true
                    ORDER BY (w.project_id = $1) DESC NULLS LAST, w.name", array($pid));
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($rows), 'data' => $rows));
}

function IssLookupMaterials() {
    $pid = (int)WhReq('project_id');
    $wid = (int)WhReq('warehouse_id');
    $q   = WhReq('query');
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit,
                           oh.onhand,
                           COALESCE(rab.rab_qty,0) AS rab_qty,
                           COALESCE(iss.issued,0)  AS issued
                    FROM materials m
                    JOIN (SELECT item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='IN' THEN qty ELSE -qty END) AS onhand
                          FROM stock_movements WHERE warehouse_id=$2 GROUP BY item_id) oh ON oh.item_id=m.id
                    LEFT JOIN (SELECT material_id, SUM(qty_plan) AS rab_qty FROM budget_items
                               WHERE project_id=$1 AND material_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY material_id) rab
                           ON rab.material_id=m.id
                    LEFT JOIN (SELECT i.material_id, SUM(i.qty_out) AS issued
                               FROM material_out_items i JOIN material_out_header h ON h.id=i.material_out_id
                               WHERE h.project_id=$1 AND h.status='posted' AND h.issue_type='PROJECT'
                               GROUP BY i.material_id) iss
                           ON iss.material_id=m.id
                    WHERE oh.onhand > 0 AND (m.material_name ILIKE $3 OR m.material_code ILIKE $3)
                    ORDER BY m.material_name LIMIT 50",
                   array($pid, $wid, '%' . $q . '%'));
    foreach ($rows as &$r) {
        $rab = (float)$r['rab_qty'];
        $limit = round($rab * (1 + ISSUE_ALLOWANCE_PCT / 100), 4);
        $remain = max(0, round($limit - (float)$r['issued'], 4));
        $r['limit_qty'] = $limit;                                   
        $r['max_issue'] = ($rab > 0) ? min((float)$r['onhand'], $remain) : 0;   
    }
    unset($r);
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($rows), 'data' => $rows));
}

function IssSave() {
    WhRequirePost();
    $projectId = (int)WhPost('project_id');
    $whId      = (int)WhPost('warehouse_id');
    $date      = WhDate(WhPost('issue_date'), 'Tanggal issue');
    $mandor    = WhPost('received_by_mandor');
    $remark    = WhPost('remark');
    $details   = WhDetails();
    $userId    = WhUserId();

    if ($projectId < 1) { throw new WhException('Proyek wajib dipilih.'); }
    if ($whId < 1)      { throw new WhException('Gudang wajib dipilih.'); }

    $wh = WhRow('SELECT id, project_id, active FROM warehouses WHERE id=$1', array($whId));
    if (!$wh || !WhBool($wh['active'])) { throw new WhException('Gudang tidak ditemukan / tidak aktif.'); }

    $lines = array();
    foreach ($details as $d) {
        $mid = isset($d['material_id']) ? (int)$d['material_id'] : 0;
        $qty = isset($d['qty_out']) ? WhNum($d['qty_out']) : 0;
        if ($mid < 1) { throw new WhException('Material pada detail tidak valid.'); }
        if ($qty <= 0) { throw new WhException('Qty issue harus lebih besar dari 0.'); }
        if (!isset($lines[$mid])) { $lines[$mid] = array('qty' => 0, 'notes' => ''); }
        $lines[$mid]['qty'] = round($lines[$mid]['qty'] + $qty, 4);
        if (!empty($d['notes'])) { $lines[$mid]['notes'] = trim($d['notes']); }
    }

    WhQ('BEGIN');
    
    $estimatedTotalValue = 0.0;
    foreach ($lines as $mid => $ln) {
        $qty = $ln['qty'];
        $lyEst = WhFifoAllocate($mid, $whId, $qty);
        foreach ($lyEst as $ly) {
            $estimatedTotalValue += ($ly['qty'] * $ly['unit_cost']);
        }
    }

    validateMaterialOutAgainstProgress($projectId, $estimatedTotalValue);

    $refNo = CreateRefNo('material_out_header', 'ref_no', 'GI');
    $h = WhRow("INSERT INTO material_out_header
                    (ref_no, project_id, warehouse_id, issue_date, issued_by, received_by_mandor, status, remark)
                VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,'posted',$7) RETURNING id",
               array($refNo, $projectId, $whId, $date, $userId, $mandor, $remark));
    $hdrId = (int)$h['id'];
    $issueValue = 0.0;                              

    foreach ($lines as $mid => $ln) {
        $qty = $ln['qty'];
        WhLock($mid, $whId);          
        WhLock($mid, 0);              
        $mat = WhRow('SELECT material_name FROM materials WHERE id=$1', array($mid));
        if (!$mat) { throw new WhException('Material ID ' . $mid . ' tidak ditemukan.'); }
        $name = $mat['material_name'];

        $onhand = WhOnHand($mid, $whId);
        if ($onhand <= 0) { throw new WhException("Material {$name} belum di-RCV / stok di gudang kosong."); }
        if ($qty > $onhand + 0.00005) {
            throw new WhException("Qty issue {$name} (" . WhFmt($qty) . ") melebihi stok di gudang (" . WhFmt($onhand) . ").");
        }
        
        $info = IssRabInfo($projectId, $mid);
        if ($info['rab_qty'] <= 0) { throw new WhException("Material {$name} tidak ada di RAB proyek ini."); }
        $limit = round($info['rab_qty'] * (1 + ISSUE_ALLOWANCE_PCT / 100), 4);
        $after = round($info['issued'] + $qty, 4);
        if ($after > $limit + 0.00005) {
            throw new WhException("Issue {$name} melebihi batas RAB +" . ISSUE_ALLOWANCE_PCT . "% (RAB " .
                WhFmt($info['rab_qty']) . ", batas " . WhFmt($limit) . ", sudah di-issue " . WhFmt($info['issued']) . ").");
        }
        $over   = ($after > $info['rab_qty'] + 0.00005);
        $reason = $over ? ('Allowance +' . ISSUE_ALLOWANCE_PCT . '% dari RAB') : null;

        $layers = WhFifoAllocate($mid, $whId, $qty);
        foreach ($layers as $ly) {
            WhQ("INSERT INTO material_out_items
                    (material_out_id, material_id, qty_out, unit_cost, is_overbudget, overbudget_reason, notes)
                 VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7)",
                array($hdrId, $mid, $ly['qty'], round($ly['unit_cost'], 2), $over ? 't' : 'f', $reason, $ln['notes']));
            WhPostMovement($date, $mid, $whId, 'OUT', $ly['qty'], $ly['unit_cost'],
                           ISSUE_REF_TYPE, $hdrId, $refNo, 'Issue ke proyek', $userId);
            $issueValue += $ly['qty'] * $ly['unit_cost'];
        }
    }

    // [CLIENT-SUPPLIED 2026-11-15 F-4.1] jurnal ISSUE_PROJECT hanya untuk nilai > 0.
    // Titipan klien keluar dari FIFO layer Rp 0 -> issueValue = 0 -> jurnal DI-SKIP (bukan error),
    // sehingga WIP tidak tercemar jurnal Rp 0. (JrnPost sudah diam-diam null bila amount <= 0;
    // guard ini membuat perilaku itu eksplisit + terukur.)
    if ($issueValue > 0) {
        JrnPost('ISSUE_PROJECT', JRN_REF_ISSUE, $hdrId, $date, $issueValue,
                'Issue material ke proyek - ' . $refNo, $userId);
    }
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    WhOk('Issuing berhasil diposting. No: ' . $refNo, array('id' => $hdrId, 'ref_no' => $refNo, 'issue_value' => round($issueValue, 2)));
}

function IssReverse() {
    WhRequirePost();
    $id = (int)WhPost('id');
    if ($id < 1) { throw new WhException('ID dokumen tidak valid.'); }
    WhQ('BEGIN');
    $h = WhRow('SELECT id, status, issue_type FROM material_out_header WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE', array($id));
    if (!$h) { throw new WhException('Dokumen tidak ditemukan.'); }
    if ($h['status'] !== 'posted') { throw new WhException('Hanya dokumen berstatus posted yang dapat di-reverse.'); }
    if ($h['issue_type'] !== 'PROJECT') { throw new WhException('Dokumen ini adalah issue Retur Supplier. Gunakan Batal Kirim di modul Retur Supplier.'); }
    WhQ("UPDATE material_out_header SET status='reversed', reversed_at=now(), reversed_by=$2 WHERE id=$1",
        array($id, WhUserId()));
    JrnReverseByRef(JRN_REF_ISSUE, $id, date('Y-m-d'), WhUserId(), 'Reverse issue');
    WhDeleteMovementsByRef(ISSUE_REF_TYPE, $id);   
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    WhOk('Dokumen issuing berhasil di-reverse.');
}

function IssPrepare() {
    WhRequirePost();
    $id = (int)WhPost('id');
    if ($id < 1) { throw new WhException('ID dokumen tidak valid.'); }
    WhQ('BEGIN');
    $h = WhRow('SELECT id, status, issue_type FROM material_out_header WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE', array($id));
    if (!$h) { throw new WhException('Dokumen tidak ditemukan.'); }
    if ($h['issue_type'] !== ISSUE_TYPE_RETURN) { throw new WhException('Siap Kirim hanya untuk issue Retur Supplier.'); }
    if ($h['status'] !== 'pending') { throw new WhException('Hanya dokumen berstatus pending yang dapat ditandai Siap Kirim.'); }
    $sjNo = IssNextSjNo(date('Y-m-d'));       
    WhQ("UPDATE material_out_header SET status='prepared', prepared_at=now(), prepared_by=$2, delivery_note_no=$3 WHERE id=$1",
        array($id, WhUserId(), $sjNo));
    WhQ("UPDATE supplier_return_hdr SET status='Disiapkan', updated_at=now() WHERE material_out_id=$1 AND status='Diperintahkan'",
        array($id));
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    WhOk('Barang ditandai sudah disiapkan (Siap Kirim). No. Surat Jalan: ' . $sjNo . '. Menunggu konfirmasi pengiriman.', array('delivery_note_no' => $sjNo));   
}

function IssDeliver() {
    WhRequirePost();
    $id       = (int)WhPost('id');
    $date     = WhDate(WhPost('delivery_date'), 'Tanggal kirim');
    $carrier  = trim(WhPost('carrier'));
    $receiver = trim(WhPost('receiver'));
    $proof    = trim(WhPost('delivery_proof'));
    $userId   = WhUserId();
    if ($id < 1) { throw new WhException('ID dokumen tidak valid.'); }
    if ($carrier === '')  { throw new WhException('Kurir / kendaraan pengiriman wajib diisi.'); }
    if ($receiver === '') { throw new WhException('Nama penerima wajib diisi.'); }
    
    $proofs = array();
    foreach (preg_split('/\r\n|\r|\n/', $proof) as $u) {
        $u = trim($u);
        if ($u === '') { continue; }
        if (!preg_match('#^(https?://|/)#i', $u)) { throw new WhException('Bukti harus berupa file yang diunggah atau link http(s).'); }
        $proofs[] = $u;
    }
    if (count($proofs) > 5) { throw new WhException('Bukti maksimal 5 file.'); }
    $proof = implode("\n", $proofs);

    WhQ('BEGIN');
    $h = WhRow('SELECT id, ref_no, status, issue_type, warehouse_id, delivery_note_no FROM material_out_header WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE', array($id));
    if (!$h) { throw new WhException('Dokumen tidak ditemukan.'); }
    if ($h['issue_type'] !== ISSUE_TYPE_RETURN) { throw new WhException('Konfirmasi dikirim hanya untuk issue Retur Supplier.'); }
    if ($h['status'] === 'pending') { throw new WhException('Tandai Siap Kirim terlebih dahulu sebelum konfirmasi dikirim.'); }
    if ($h['status'] !== 'prepared') { throw new WhException('Hanya dokumen berstatus prepared yang dapat dikonfirmasi dikirim.'); }
    $rt = WhRow('SELECT id, ref_no FROM supplier_return_hdr WHERE material_out_id=$1 FOR UPDATE', array($id));
    if (!$rt) { throw new WhException('Dokumen retur asal tidak ditemukan.'); }
    $whId  = (int)$h['warehouse_id'];
    $refNo = $h['ref_no'];
    
    $sjNo = trim((string)$h['delivery_note_no']);
    if ($sjNo === '') { $sjNo = IssNextSjNo($date); }
    $dtl = WhRows('SELECT id, material_id, qty_claim, defect_type FROM supplier_return_dtl WHERE return_hdr_id=$1 ORDER BY material_id, id',
                  array((int)$rt['id']));
    if (!count($dtl)) { throw new WhException('Retur belum memiliki item.'); }

    WhQ('DELETE FROM material_out_items WHERE material_out_id=$1', array($id));   
    $value = 0.0;
    foreach ($dtl as $d) {
        $mid = (int)$d['material_id'];
        $qty = round((float)$d['qty_claim'], 4);
        WhLock($mid, $whId);
        $m = WhRow('SELECT material_name FROM materials WHERE id=$1', array($mid));
        $onhand = WhOnHand($mid, $whId);
        if ($qty > $onhand + 0.00005) {
            throw new WhException('Stok ' . $m['material_name'] . ' di gudang (' . WhFmt($onhand) .
                ') tidak cukup untuk dikirim (' . WhFmt($qty) . ').');
        }
        $tot = 0.0;
        foreach (WhFifoAllocate($mid, $whId, $qty) as $ly) {
            WhQ("INSERT INTO material_out_items (material_out_id, material_id, qty_out, unit_cost, is_overbudget, notes)
                 VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'f',$5)",
                array($id, $mid, $ly['qty'], round($ly['unit_cost'], 2), 'Retur cacat: ' . $d['defect_type']));
            WhPostMovement($date, $mid, $whId, 'OUT', $ly['qty'], $ly['unit_cost'], ISSUE_REF_TYPE, $id, $refNo,
                           'Retur supplier ' . $rt['ref_no'], $userId);
            $tot += $ly['qty'] * $ly['unit_cost'];
        }
        WhQ('UPDATE supplier_return_dtl SET unit_cost=$2 WHERE id=$1', array((int)$d['id'], round($tot / $qty, 4)));
        $value += $tot;
    }
    
    JrnPost('RETURN_SUPPLIER', JRN_REF_RETURN, (int)$rt['id'], $date, $value, 'Retur supplier ' . $rt['ref_no'], $userId);

    WhQ("UPDATE material_out_header SET status='posted', issue_date=$2, received_by_mandor=$3, delivery_date=$2,
                delivery_note_no=$4, delivery_receiver=$5, delivery_proof=$6 WHERE id=$1",
        array($id, $date, $carrier, $sjNo, $receiver, $proof !== '' ? $proof : null));      
    WhQ("UPDATE supplier_return_hdr SET status='Dikirim', sent_date=$2, carrier=$3, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1",
        array((int)$rt['id'], $date, $carrier));
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    WhOk('Pengiriman dikonfirmasi. No. Surat Jalan: ' . $sjNo . '. Stok keluar dari gudang dan retur ' . $rt['ref_no'] . ' berstatus Dikirim.', array('delivery_note_no' => $sjNo));   
}

function IssUploadProof() {
    WhRequirePost();
    WhUserId();                                              
    if (empty($_FILES['file']) || $_FILES['file']['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
        $code = isset($_FILES['file']['error']) ? (int)$_FILES['file']['error'] : -1;
        throw new WhException('File gagal diunggah (kode ' . $code . '). Cek batas upload_max_filesize / post_max_size di php.ini.');
    }
    $f = $_FILES['file'];
    if ($f['size'] > 5 * 1024 * 1024) { throw new WhException('Ukuran file maksimal 5 MB.'); }
    $allowed = array('jpg' => 'image/jpeg', 'jpeg' => 'image/jpeg', 'png' => 'image/png',
                     'webp' => 'image/webp', 'gif' => 'image/gif', 'pdf' => 'application/pdf');
    $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($f['name'], PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
    if (!isset($allowed[$ext])) { throw new WhException('Tipe file tidak diizinkan. Gunakan JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF atau PDF.'); }
    if (function_exists('finfo_open')) {                     
        $fi = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
        $mime = finfo_file($fi, $f['tmp_name']);
        finfo_close($fi);
        if ($mime !== $allowed[$ext]) { throw new WhException('Isi file tidak sesuai dengan ekstensinya.'); }
    }
    $dir = dirname(__DIR__) . '/uploads/delivery';
    if (!is_dir($dir) && !@mkdir($dir, 0755, true)) {
        throw new WhException('Folder uploads/delivery tidak bisa dibuat. Buat manual dan beri izin tulis untuk user web server.');
    }
    $ht = $dir . '/.htaccess';                               
    if (!file_exists($ht)) {
        @file_put_contents($ht, "<FilesMatch \"\\.(php|phtml|phar|pl|cgi)$\">\n    Require all denied\n</FilesMatch>\n");   // [FIX-HTACCESS] tanda kutip penutup pola FilesMatch sebelumnya hilang ($\>)
    }
    $name = 'dlv_' . date('Ymd_His') . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4)) . '.' . $ext;
    if (!move_uploaded_file($f['tmp_name'], $dir . '/' . $name)) {
        throw new WhException('Gagal menyimpan file. Cek izin tulis folder uploads/delivery.');
    }
    WhJson(array('success' => true, 'url' => '/rab-project/uploads/delivery/' . $name, 'name' => $name));
}

// [BACKFILL-RETUR][NEW] Backfill sekali jalan: jurnal retur supplier (Dr GRN Clearing / Cr Persediaan, rule RETURN_SUPPLIER)
// untuk retur yang sudah dikirim (issue posted) tetapi belum punya jurnal -- yaitu retur yang dikirim sebelum fitur jurnal ada.
// Idempotent (retur yang sudah berjurnal dilewati). Satu transaksi: gagal satu (mis. periode ditutup) = batal semua.
// Tanggal jurnal = tanggal kirim (delivery_date, bila kosong issue_date).
function IssBackfillReturnJournal() {
    // Backfill mengubah jurnal: wajib POST agar tidak dapat dipicu melalui tautan / prefetch browser.
    WhRequirePost();
    $userId = WhUserId();
    if (intval(isset($_SESSION['FormAccess']) ? $_SESSION['FormAccess'] : 0) < 3) { throw new WhException('Akses ditolak.'); }
    WhQ('BEGIN');
    $rows = WhRows("SELECT r.id, r.ref_no, COALESCE(mo.delivery_date, mo.issue_date, r.sent_date) AS jdate,
                           COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.qty_out*i.unit_cost) FROM material_out_items i WHERE i.material_out_id=mo.id),0) AS total
                    FROM supplier_return_hdr r
                    JOIN material_out_header mo ON mo.id=r.material_out_id AND mo.status='posted'
                    WHERE r.status IN ('Dikirim','Diganti','Kredit')
                      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries je
                                       WHERE je.reference_type::text=$1 AND je.reference_id=r.id)
                    ORDER BY jdate ASC, r.id ASC", array(JRN_REF_RETURN));
    $done = array(); $skipped = array();
    foreach ($rows as $r) {
        $jid = JrnPost('RETURN_SUPPLIER', JRN_REF_RETURN, (int)$r['id'], $r['jdate'], $r['total'],
                       'Retur supplier ' . $r['ref_no'], $userId);
        if ($jid) { $done[] = $r['ref_no']; } else { $skipped[] = $r['ref_no']; }     // nilai 0 -> tidak dijurnal
    }
    WhQ('COMMIT');
    $msg = count($done) . ' jurnal retur diposting' . (count($done) ? ': ' . implode(', ', $done) : '.');
    if (count($skipped)) { $msg .= ' | dilewati (nilai 0): ' . implode(', ', $skipped); }
    WhOk($msg, array('posted' => $done, 'skipped' => $skipped));
}

                  - Saldo berjalan dihitung PER AKUN pakai window function

                    (0 kalau periode tidak difilter).

    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;

if ((int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < 1) { http_response_code(403); echo json_encode(['success'=>false,'message'=>'Hak baca buku besar tidak tersedia.']); exit; }

    // ==============================================================

        $sql = "SELECT id, account_code, account_name, account_type
                FROM chart_of_accounts
                WHERE is_active = true
                ORDER BY account_code ASC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_periods':
        $sql = "SELECT id, period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods ORDER BY start_date DESC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // Laporan utama -- filter account_id & period_id keduanya OPSIONAL
    case 'read_ledger':
        $accountId = intval($_POST['account_id'] ?? 0);
        $periodId  = intval($_POST['period_id'] ?? 0);

        $startDate = null;
        $endDate   = null;
        $periodName = 'Semua Periode';

        if ($periodId > 0) {
            $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtP->execute(['id' => $periodId]);
            $period = $stmtP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$period) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode tidak ditemukan.']);
                exit;
            }
            $startDate  = $period['start_date'];
            $endDate    = $period['end_date'];
            $periodName = $period['period_name'];
        }

        $accountLabel = 'Semua Akun';
        if ($accountId > 0) {
            $stmtAcc = $db->prepare("SELECT account_code, account_name FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtAcc->execute(['id' => $accountId]);
            $acc = $stmtAcc->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$acc) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akun tidak ditemukan.']);
                exit;
            }
            $accountLabel = $acc['account_code'] . ' - ' . $acc['account_name'];
        }

        // Bangun kondisi WHERE secara dinamis
        $conds  = ["j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')"];
        $params = [];
        if ($accountId > 0) {
            $conds[] = "l.account_id = :acc";
            $params['acc'] = $accountId;
        }
        if ($startDate !== null) {
            $conds[] = "j.journal_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date";
            $params['start_date'] = $startDate;
            $params['end_date']   = $endDate;
        }
        $where = implode(' AND ', $conds);

        // Saldo awal per akun -- hanya relevan kalau periode difilter.
        // Kalau tidak difilter, seluruh histori sudah masuk ke query utama,
        // jadi saldo awal = 0 (tidak ada "sebelum" yang perlu diakumulasi).
        $openingSubquery = "0";
        if ($startDate !== null) {
            $openingCond = "l2.account_id = l.account_id AND j2.status IN ('posted','reversed') AND j2.journal_date < :ob_start_date";
            if ($accountId > 0) {
                $openingCond .= " AND l2.account_id = :ob_acc";
            }
            $openingSubquery = "(
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c2.account_type IN ('asset','bank','cash','expense') THEN l2.debit - l2.credit ELSE l2.credit - l2.debit END), 0)
                FROM journal_lines l2
                JOIN journal_entries j2 ON j2.id = l2.journal_id
                JOIN chart_of_accounts c2 ON c2.id = l2.account_id
                WHERE {$openingCond}
            )";
            $params['ob_start_date'] = $startDate;
            if ($accountId > 0) $params['ob_acc'] = $accountId;
        }

        $sql = "
            SELECT j.journal_date, j.ref_no, l.description AS line_desc, j.description AS header_desc,
                   l.debit, l.credit, l.account_id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type,
                   {$openingSubquery} AS opening_balance,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN c.account_type IN ('asset','bank','cash','expense') THEN l.debit - l.credit ELSE l.credit - l.debit END)
                     OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY j.journal_date, j.id, l.id
                           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_in_range
            FROM journal_lines l
            JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
            JOIN chart_of_accounts c ON c.id = l.account_id
            WHERE {$where}
            ORDER BY c.account_code ASC, j.journal_date ASC, j.id ASC, l.id ASC
        ";

        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $data = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $data[] = [
                'account_id'      => $r['account_id'],
                'account_code'    => $r['account_code'],
                'account_name'    => $r['account_name'],
                'account_label'   => $r['account_code'] . ' - ' . $r['account_name'],
                'journal_date'    => $r['journal_date'],
                'ref_no'      => $r['ref_no'],
                'description'     => $r['line_desc'] ?: $r['header_desc'],
                'debit'           => floatval($r['debit']),
                'credit'          => floatval($r['credit']),
                'balance'         => floatval($r['opening_balance']) + floatval($r['cum_in_range'])
            ];
        }

        echo json_encode([
            'success'      => true,
            'account_label'=> $accountLabel,
            'period_name'  => $periodName,
            'totalCount'   => count($data),
            'data'         => $data
        ]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task)]);
}

/**
 * ap.agingCRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Backend Laporan Kartu Hutang & Aging AP per supplier (read-only).
 * Front end: js/ap.aging.js, views/ap.aging.php. Menu: m_form_name seq 6039.
 *
 * Sumber data: view v_ap_card / v_ap_aging (sql/2026-11-17.ar_ap_aging_card.sql)
 *   - AP : invoice purchase_invoice_hdr (status bukan void/cancel/reverse); aging = invoice_date vs CURRENT_DATE.
 *   - Sisa AP = total_amount - GREATEST(paid_amount, total alokasi supplier_payment_items).
 *
 * Task : list_suppliers | list_cards | list_details | export_csv
 * Param: year, month (1-12) untuk kartu; supplier_id (0=semua) untuk detail;
 *        date_from/date_to (YYYY-MM-DD) untuk aging; query (cari).
 * Respons JSON standar {success, message, data, totalCount}; list_cards menambah 'totals'.
 * ============================================================
 */
ini_set('display_errors', '0');
ob_start();

require_once '../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once '../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$db = new crud();
if (empty($_SESSION['user_id']) || !is_numeric($_SESSION['user_id']) || (int)$_SESSION['user_id'] <= 0) {
    http_response_code(401);
    rpt_send(false, [], 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login ulang.');
}
if ((int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < 1) {
    http_response_code(403);
