        $table  = "m_user_system";
        $data   = array(
            "login_name"  => checksinglequote($_POST["login_name"] ?? ''),
            "employee_id" => $employeeId,
            "password"    => $hashedPassword,
            "active"      => ($_POST["u_active"] === 'true' || $_POST["active"] === 'true') ? 'true' : 'false',
            "role_id"     => $roleId > 0 ? $roleId : null
        );
        $queryC .= insertQ($table, $data) . ";";

        $table = "m_user_login_status";
        $data  = array("user_id" => "currval('m_user_system_id_seq'::regclass)");
        $queryC .= insertQ($table, $data) . ";";

        $formAccessPayload = $_POST['form_access'] ?? $_POST['arrForm'] ?? null;
        $applyRole = intval($_POST['apply_role'] ?? 0);

        if ($applyRole === 1 && $roleId > 0) {
            // Copy permissions from role
            $tableD = "m_user_access_menu";
            $queryC .= "INSERT INTO {$tableD} (user_id, form_id, access_level)
                        SELECT currval('m_user_system_id_seq'::regclass), form_id, access_level
                        FROM m_role_access_menu
                        WHERE role_id = {$roleId} AND access_level > 0;";
        } else if (!empty($formAccessPayload)) {
            $cleanJson = stripslashes($formAccessPayload);
            $dataForm  = json_decode($cleanJson, true);

            if (is_array($dataForm) && count($dataForm) > 0) {
                foreach ($dataForm as $row) {
                    $formId    = intval($row['form_id'] ?? 0);
                    $accessLvl = intval($row['access_level'] ?? 1);
                    if ($accessLvl < 0 || $accessLvl > 4) {
                        http_response_code(400);
                        echo json_encode(["success" => false, "status" => "Error", "message" => "Tingkat hak akses harus 0 sampai 4."]);
                        exit;
                    }

                    if ($formId > 0 && $accessLvl > 0) {
                        $tableD = "m_user_access_menu";
                        $dataD  = array(
                            "user_id"      => "currval('m_user_system_id_seq'::regclass)",
                            "form_id"      => $formId,
                            "access_level" => $accessLvl
                        );
                        $queryC .= insertQ($tableD, $dataD) . ";";
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();
            $db->cmdQ($queryC);
            $db->commit();
            echo $db->getResult();
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
            echo json_encode(["success" => false, "status" => "Error", "message" => "Gagal menyimpan data user: " . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // ==========================================
    // 6. UPDATE (Simpan Header User & Detail Hak Akses)
    // ==========================================
    case ('update'):
    case ('edit'):
        $queryC = '';
        $userId = intval($_POST['user_id'] ?? $_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $employeeId = intval($_POST["employee_id"] ?? $_POST["name"] ?? 0);
        $roleId = intval($_POST["role_id"] ?? 0);

        if ($userId > 0) {
            if ($employeeId <= 0) {
                $checkStmt = $db->prepare("SELECT employee_id FROM m_user_system WHERE id = :id");
                $checkStmt->execute(['id' => $userId]);
                $existRow = $checkStmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if ($existRow && !empty($existRow['employee_id'])) {
                    $employeeId = intval($existRow['employee_id']);
                }
            }

            if ($employeeId <= 0) {
                echo json_encode([
                    "success" => "false",
                    "status"  => "Error",
                    "message" => "Gagal Simpan: ID Karyawan tidak terdeteksi (Foreign Key Violation)."
                ]);
                exit;
            }

            $table = "m_user_system";
            $data  = array(
                "login_name"  => checksinglequote($_POST["login_name"] ?? ''),
                "employee_id" => $employeeId,
                "active"      => ($_POST["u_active"] === 'true' || $_POST["u_active"] === true || $_POST["active"] === 'true') ? 'true' : 'false',
                "role_id"     => $roleId > 0 ? $roleId : null
            );

            if (!empty($_POST["password"])) {
                $data["password"] = password_hash(trim($_POST["password"]), PASSWORD_DEFAULT, ['cost' => 12]);
            }

            $where = "id = " . $userId;
            $queryC .= updateQ($table, $data, $where) . ";";

            $formAccessPayload = $_POST['form_access'] ?? $_POST['arrForm'] ?? null;
            $applyRole = intval($_POST['apply_role'] ?? 0);

            if ($applyRole === 1 && $roleId > 0) {
                // Clear and Copy permissions from role
                $queryC .= "DELETE FROM m_user_access_menu WHERE user_id = {$userId};";
                $queryC .= "INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level)
                            SELECT {$userId}, form_id, access_level
                            FROM m_role_access_menu
                            WHERE role_id = {$roleId} AND access_level > 0;";
            } else if (!empty($formAccessPayload)) {
                $cleanJson = stripslashes($formAccessPayload);
                $dataForm  = json_decode($cleanJson, true);

                if (is_array($dataForm) && count($dataForm) > 0) {
                    $keepAccessIds = array();

                    foreach ($dataForm as $row) {
                        $accessId  = intval($row['id'] ?? 0);
                        $formId    = intval($row['form_id'] ?? 0);
                        $accessLvl = intval($row['access_level'] ?? 1);
                        if ($accessLvl < 0 || $accessLvl > 4) {
                            http_response_code(400);
                            echo json_encode(["success" => false, "status" => "Error", "message" => "Tingkat hak akses harus 0 sampai 4."]);
                            exit;
                        }

                        if ($accessId > 0) {
                            // Never allow an access-row ID belonging to another user to be edited.
                            $ownerCheck = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM m_user_access_menu WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :uid");
                            $ownerCheck->execute(['id' => $accessId, 'uid' => $userId]);
                            if (!$ownerCheck->fetchColumn()) {
                                http_response_code(403);
                                echo json_encode(["success" => false, "status" => "Error", "message" => "Baris hak akses tidak dimiliki oleh user yang sedang diubah."]);
                                exit;
                            }
                            $keepAccessIds[] = $accessId;
                            $tableD = "m_user_access_menu";
                            $dataD  = array("access_level" => $accessLvl);
                            $whereD = "id = " . $accessId;
                            $queryC .= updateQ($tableD, $dataD, $whereD) . ";";
                        } else if ($formId > 0) {
                            $insStmt = $db->prepare(
                                "INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level) VALUES (:uid, :fid, :lvl) RETURNING id"
                            );
                            $insStmt->execute([
                                'uid' => $userId,
                                'fid' => $formId,
                                'lvl' => $accessLvl
                            ]);
                            $newAccessId = $insStmt->fetchColumn();
                            if ($newAccessId) {
                                $keepAccessIds[] = intval($newAccessId);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (!empty($keepAccessIds)) {
                        $idsString = implode(',', $keepAccessIds);
                        $queryC .= "DELETE FROM m_user_access_menu WHERE user_id = " . $userId . " AND id NOT IN (" . $idsString . ");";
                    }
                }
            }

            $db->cmdQ($queryC);
            echo $db->getResult();
        } else {
            echo json_encode([
                "success" => "false",
                "status"  => "Error",
                "message" => "ID User tidak valid untuk proses update."
            ]);
        }
        break;

    // ==========================================
    // 8. APPLY ROLE (Sama seperti sync tapi dari sisi User System)
    // ==========================================
    case ('apply_role'):
        $userId = intval($_POST['user_id'] ?? 0);
        $roleId = intval($_POST['role_id'] ?? 0);

        if ($userId <= 0 || $roleId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "ID User dan ID Role harus valid."]);
            exit;
        }

        $queryC = "DELETE FROM m_user_access_menu WHERE user_id = {$userId};";
        $queryC .= "INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level)
                    SELECT {$userId}, form_id, access_level
                    FROM m_role_access_menu
                    WHERE role_id = {$roleId} AND access_level > 0;";

        $db->cmdQ($queryC);
        echo $db->getResult();
        break;

    // ==========================================
    // 7. DELETE (Hapus User System)
    // ==========================================
    case ('delete'):
        $deleteId = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

        if ($deleteId > 0) {
            $table  = "m_user_system";
            $data   = array("active" => 'false');
            $where  = "id = " . $deleteId;
            $queryC = updateQ($table, $data, $where) . ";";

            $db->cmdQ($queryC);
            echo $db->getResult();
        } else {
            echo json_encode([
                "success" => "false", 
                "status"  => "Error", 
                "message" => "ID User tidak valid untuk proses penghapusan."
            ]);
        }
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode([
            "success" => "false", 
            "status"  => "Error", 
            "message" => "Perintah task '" . htmlspecialchars($task) . "' tidak valid."
        ]);
        break;
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
/**
 * settingsCRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Backend Pengaturan Sistem (settings.js). Pola sama dengan rabCRD.php:
 * PDO (class crud), dispatch lewat $_REQUEST['task'], respons JSON {success, message, data}.
 *
 * Data:
 *  - company_profile  (1 baris): nama, alamat, kontak, NPWP, 2 logo (dokumen & aplikasi), pelengkap dokumen.
 *  - finance_settings (1 baris): mata uang dasar (pembukuan) + mata uang laporan keuangan final,
 *                                jenis kurs default, dasar kurs laba rugi, awal tahun fiskal, desimal.
 *
 * Task      : load_settings, save_company, save_document, save_finance,
 *             upload_logo, delete_logo, logo (GET, mengalirkan gambar)
 *
 * Aturan:
 *  - Semua task butuh login; task tulis butuh hak akses form >= SET_ACCESS_WRITE.
 *  - Logo: hanya PNG / JPEG / WEBP (isi file diperiksa, bukan hanya ekstensi), maks 1 MB, maks 4000 px.
 *    SVG sengaja ditolak (bisa memuat script).
 *  - Mata uang dasar terkunci begitu sudah ada transaksi (jurnal, stok, PO, pembayaran, invoice proyek).
 *    Mata uang laporan boleh diganti kapan saja (hanya cara penyajian laporan).
 *
 * Butuh: sql/2026-10-01.settings.sql
 * ============================================================
 */

ini_set('display_errors', '0');
ob_start();

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

const SET_ACCESS_WRITE = 3;
const SET_MAX_LOGO     = 1048576;          // 1 MB
const SET_MAX_PIXEL    = 4000;
const SET_RATE_TYPES   = ['KMK', 'BI', 'MANUAL'];
const SET_RATE_BASIS   = ['TRANSACTION', 'AVERAGE', 'PERIOD_END'];
const SET_LOGO_COLS    = ['document' => 'logo_document', 'app' => 'logo_app'];     // whitelist nama kolom
const SET_LOGO_MIMES   = ['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'];

$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';
if ($task !== 'logo') {
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
}

$db = new crud();

class SetBusinessError extends Exception {}

function sendJsonResponse($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $response = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        $response['data'] = $data;
    }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($response, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

function set_bool($v): bool {
    return $v === true || $v === 't' || $v === '1' || $v === 1;
}

function set_require_write(): void {
    if (intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < SET_ACCESS_WRITE) {
        sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengubah pengaturan.');
    }
}

function set_text($key, int $max, bool $required = false, string $label = ''): ?string {
    $v = trim((string)($_POST[$key] ?? ''));
    if ($required && $v === '') throw new SetBusinessError(($label ?: $key) . ' wajib diisi.');
    if (mb_strlen($v) > $max) throw new SetBusinessError(($label ?: $key) . " maksimal {$max} karakter.");
    return $v === '' ? null : $v;
}

/** Alasan mata uang dasar tidak boleh diganti (null = masih boleh). */
function set_base_lock_reason($db): ?string {
    $checks = [
        'journal_entries'    => 'jurnal',
        'stock_movements'    => 'pergerakan stok',
        'purchase_orders'    => 'PO',
        'supplier_payments'  => 'pembayaran supplier',
        'project_invoices'   => 'invoice proyek',
    ];
    foreach ($checks as $table => $label) {
        $reg = $db->query("SELECT to_regclass('public.{$table}')")->fetchColumn();
        if (!$reg) continue;
        if ((int)$db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.{$table}")->fetchColumn() > 0) {
            return "Sudah ada transaksi ({$label}).";
        }
    }
    return null;
}

function set_currency_exists($db, int $id): bool {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.m_currency WHERE id = :id");
    $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
    return (bool)$st->fetchColumn();
}

if (empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    if ($task === 'logo') { if (ob_get_length()) ob_clean(); exit; }
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login ulang.');
}
$userId = (int)$_SESSION['user_id'];
if (in_array($task, ['save_company', 'save_document', 'save_finance', 'upload_logo', 'delete_logo'], true)
    && ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== 'POST') {
    http_response_code(405);
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Metode harus POST untuk perubahan pengaturan sistem.');
}

try {
    switch ($task) {

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Muat semua pengaturan
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'load_settings':
            $company = $db->query("
                SELECT company_name, legal_name, address, city, province, postal_code, country,
                       phone, email, website, tax_id, doc_footer, doc_signer_name, doc_signer_title,
                       (logo_document IS NOT NULL) AS has_logo_document,
                       (logo_app IS NOT NULL)      AS has_logo_app,
                       COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM logo_document_updated_at)::bigint, 0) AS logo_document_v,
                       COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM logo_app_updated_at)::bigint, 0)      AS logo_app_v
                  FROM public.company_profile WHERE id = 1")->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
            if ($company) {
                $company['has_logo_document'] = set_bool($company['has_logo_document']);
                $company['has_logo_app']      = set_bool($company['has_logo_app']);
                $company['logo_document_v']   = (int)$company['logo_document_v'];
                $company['logo_app_v']        = (int)$company['logo_app_v'];
            }

            $finance = $db->query("SELECT base_currency_id, report_currency_id, default_rate_type, rate_basis_pl,
                                          fiscal_year_start_month, amount_decimals
                                     FROM public.finance_settings WHERE id = 1")->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: null;
            if ($finance) {
                $finance['base_currency_id']        = (int)$finance['base_currency_id'];
                $finance['report_currency_id']      = (int)$finance['report_currency_id'];
                $finance['fiscal_year_start_month'] = (int)$finance['fiscal_year_start_month'];
                $finance['amount_decimals']         = (int)$finance['amount_decimals'];
            }

            $currencies = $db->query("SELECT id, init, name FROM public.m_currency ORDER BY init ASC")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($currencies as &$c) $c['id'] = (int)$c['id'];

            sendJsonResponse(true, [
                'company'          => $company,
                'finance'          => $finance,
                'currencies'       => $currencies,
                'base_lock_reason' => set_base_lock_reason($db),
            ]);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Simpan profil perusahaan
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'save_company':
            set_require_write();
            try {
                $name  = set_text('company_name', 150, true, 'Nama perusahaan');
                $legal = set_text('legal_name', 200);
                $addr  = set_text('address', 1000);
                $city  = set_text('city', 100);
                $prov  = set_text('province', 100);
                $post  = set_text('postal_code', 20);
                $ctry  = set_text('country', 100);
                $phone = set_text('phone', 50);
                $email = set_text('email', 150);
                $web   = set_text('website', 150);
                $tax   = set_text('tax_id', 50);
                if ($email !== null && !filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
                    throw new SetBusinessError('Format email tidak valid.');
                }
            } catch (SetBusinessError $e) {
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            }

            $st = $db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO public.company_profile
                    (id, company_name, legal_name, address, city, province, postal_code, country,
                     phone, email, website, tax_id, updated_by)
                VALUES (1, :name, :legal, :addr, :city, :prov, :post, :ctry, :phone, :email, :web, :tax, :uid)
                ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
                    company_name = EXCLUDED.company_name, legal_name = EXCLUDED.legal_name,
                    address = EXCLUDED.address, city = EXCLUDED.city, province = EXCLUDED.province,
                    postal_code = EXCLUDED.postal_code, country = EXCLUDED.country,
                    phone = EXCLUDED.phone, email = EXCLUDED.email, website = EXCLUDED.website,
                    tax_id = EXCLUDED.tax_id, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by");
            $st->execute([':name' => $name, ':legal' => $legal, ':addr' => $addr, ':city' => $city, ':prov' => $prov,
                          ':post' => $post, ':ctry' => $ctry, ':phone' => $phone, ':email' => $email,
                          ':web' => $web, ':tax' => $tax, ':uid' => $userId]);
            sendJsonResponse(true, [], 'Profil perusahaan disimpan.');
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Simpan pelengkap dokumen (footer + penandatangan)
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'save_document':
            set_require_write();
            try {
                $footer = set_text('doc_footer', 1000);
                $sname  = set_text('doc_signer_name', 150);
                $stitle = set_text('doc_signer_title', 100);
            } catch (SetBusinessError $e) {
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            }
            $st = $db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO public.company_profile (id, doc_footer, doc_signer_name, doc_signer_title, updated_by)
                VALUES (1, :f, :n, :t, :uid)
                ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
                    doc_footer = EXCLUDED.doc_footer, doc_signer_name = EXCLUDED.doc_signer_name,
                    doc_signer_title = EXCLUDED.doc_signer_title, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by");
            $st->execute([':f' => $footer, ':n' => $sname, ':t' => $stitle, ':uid' => $userId]);
            sendJsonResponse(true, [], 'Pengaturan dokumen disimpan.');
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Simpan pengaturan keuangan
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'save_finance':
            set_require_write();
            $base   = (int)($_POST['base_currency_id'] ?? 0);
            $report = (int)($_POST['report_currency_id'] ?? 0);
            $rtype  = (string)($_POST['default_rate_type'] ?? '');
            $basis  = (string)($_POST['rate_basis_pl'] ?? '');
            $month  = (int)($_POST['fiscal_year_start_month'] ?? 0);
            $dec    = (int)($_POST['amount_decimals'] ?? -1);

            try {
                if (!$base || !set_currency_exists($db, $base))     throw new SetBusinessError('Mata uang dasar wajib dipilih.');
                if (!$report || !set_currency_exists($db, $report)) throw new SetBusinessError('Mata uang laporan keuangan wajib dipilih.');
                if (!in_array($rtype, SET_RATE_TYPES, true))        throw new SetBusinessError('Jenis kurs tidak valid.');
                if (!in_array($basis, SET_RATE_BASIS, true))        throw new SetBusinessError('Dasar kurs laba rugi tidak valid.');
                if ($month < 1 || $month > 12)                      throw new SetBusinessError('Bulan awal tahun fiskal harus 1-12.');
                if ($dec < 0 || $dec > 4)                           throw new SetBusinessError('Jumlah desimal harus 0-4.');

                $cur = $db->query("SELECT base_currency_id FROM public.finance_settings WHERE id = 1")->fetchColumn();
                if ($cur !== false && (int)$cur !== $base) {
                    $lock = set_base_lock_reason($db);
                    if ($lock !== null) {
                        throw new SetBusinessError('Mata uang dasar tidak dapat diubah. ' . $lock);
                    }
                }
            } catch (SetBusinessError $e) {
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            }

            $st = $db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO public.finance_settings
                    (id, base_currency_id, report_currency_id, default_rate_type, rate_basis_pl,
                     fiscal_year_start_month, amount_decimals, updated_by)
                VALUES (1, :b, :r, :t, :p, :m, :d, :uid)
                ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
                    base_currency_id = EXCLUDED.base_currency_id, report_currency_id = EXCLUDED.report_currency_id,
                    default_rate_type = EXCLUDED.default_rate_type, rate_basis_pl = EXCLUDED.rate_basis_pl,
                    fiscal_year_start_month = EXCLUDED.fiscal_year_start_month,
                    amount_decimals = EXCLUDED.amount_decimals, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by");
            $st->execute([':b' => $base, ':r' => $report, ':t' => $rtype, ':p' => $basis,
                          ':m' => $month, ':d' => $dec, ':uid' => $userId]);
            sendJsonResponse(true, [], 'Pengaturan keuangan disimpan.');
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Upload logo (multipart: type = document|app, file)
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'upload_logo':
            set_require_write();
            $type = (string)($_POST['type'] ?? '');
            if (!isset(SET_LOGO_COLS[$type])) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Jenis logo tidak dikenal.');
            $col = SET_LOGO_COLS[$type];

            $f = $_FILES['file'] ?? null;
            if (!$f || $f['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                $msg = ($f && in_array($f['error'], [UPLOAD_ERR_INI_SIZE, UPLOAD_ERR_FORM_SIZE], true))
                    ? 'Ukuran file melebihi batas server.' : 'File logo belum dipilih atau gagal diunggah.';
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], $msg);
            }
            if ($f['size'] > SET_MAX_LOGO) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Ukuran logo maksimal 1 MB.');
            if (!is_uploaded_file($f['tmp_name'])) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Berkas tidak valid.');

            $mime = (new finfo(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE))->file($f['tmp_name']);
            if (!in_array($mime, SET_LOGO_MIMES, true)) {
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Format logo harus PNG, JPEG, atau WEBP.');
            }
            $info = @getimagesize($f['tmp_name']);
            if (!$info) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'File bukan gambar yang valid.');
            if ($info[0] > SET_MAX_PIXEL || $info[1] > SET_MAX_PIXEL) {
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Dimensi logo maksimal ' . SET_MAX_PIXEL . ' x ' . SET_MAX_PIXEL . ' piksel.');
            }

            $db->exec("INSERT INTO public.company_profile (id) VALUES (1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING");
            $fp = fopen($f['tmp_name'], 'rb');
            $st = $db->prepare("UPDATE public.company_profile
                                   SET {$col} = :img, {$col}_mime = :mime, {$col}_updated_at = NOW(),
                                       updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = :uid
                                 WHERE id = 1");
            $st->bindParam(':img', $fp, PDO::PARAM_LOB);
            $st->bindValue(':mime', $mime);
            $st->bindValue(':uid', $userId, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $st->execute();
            fclose($fp);
            sendJsonResponse(true, [], 'Logo berhasil diunggah.');
            break;

        case 'delete_logo':
            set_require_write();
            $type = (string)($_POST['type'] ?? '');
            if (!isset(SET_LOGO_COLS[$type])) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Jenis logo tidak dikenal.');
            $col = SET_LOGO_COLS[$type];
            $db->prepare("UPDATE public.company_profile
                             SET {$col} = NULL, {$col}_mime = NULL, {$col}_updated_at = NOW(),
                                 updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = :uid WHERE id = 1")
               ->execute([':uid' => $userId]);
            sendJsonResponse(true, [], 'Logo dihapus.');
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Alirkan gambar logo (GET ?task=logo&type=document|app&v=...)
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'logo':
            $type = (string)($_GET['type'] ?? '');
            if (!isset(SET_LOGO_COLS[$type])) { http_response_code(404); if (ob_get_length()) ob_clean(); exit; }
            $col = SET_LOGO_COLS[$type];

            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT {$col}, {$col}_mime FROM public.company_profile WHERE id = 1");
            $st->execute();
            $st->bindColumn(1, $img, PDO::PARAM_LOB);
            $st->bindColumn(2, $mime);
            if (!$st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_BOUND) || $img === null) {
                http_response_code(404);
                if (ob_get_length()) ob_clean();
                exit;
            }
            $bin = is_resource($img) ? stream_get_contents($img) : $img;
            if (is_string($bin) && strncmp($bin, '\\x', 2) === 0) {           // bytea format hex (jaga-jaga)
                $bin = hex2bin(substr($bin, 2));
            }
            if (!in_array($mime, SET_LOGO_MIMES, true) || $bin === '' || $bin === false) {
                http_response_code(404);
                if (ob_get_length()) ob_clean();
                exit;
            }
            if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
            header('Content-Type: ' . $mime);
            header('Content-Length: ' . strlen($bin));
            header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
            header('Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400');
            echo $bin;
            exit;

        default:
            sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.');
            break;
    }
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[settingsCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    if ($task === 'logo') { http_response_code(500); if (ob_get_length()) ob_clean(); exit; }
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[settingsCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    if ($task === 'logo') { http_response_code(500); if (ob_get_length()) ob_clean(); exit; }
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}

// [FIX] helper respons tunggal: bersihkan buffer lalu kirim JSON
function fp_json(array $payload, int $httpCode = 200) {
    if ($httpCode !== 200) { http_response_code($httpCode); }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($payload, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

// [FIX 2] normalisasi tanggal ke Y-m-d. Field tanggal UI menampilkan '01 Oct 26' (d M y),
// jadi terima beberapa format; kembalikan null bila tidak ada yang cocok.
function fp_normalize_date($str) {
    $str = trim((string)$str);
    if ($str === '') { return null; }
    foreach (['Y-m-d', 'd M y', 'd M Y', 'd/m/Y', 'd-m-Y'] as $fmt) {
        $dt = DateTime::createFromFormat('!' . $fmt, $str);
        $err = DateTime::getLastErrors();
        if ($dt && (!$err || ($err['warning_count'] == 0 && $err['error_count'] == 0))) {
            return $dt->format('Y-m-d');
        }
    }
    return null;
}

            }
            $retainedEarningsId = $reAccount['id'];

            // 3. Saldo Pendapatan & Beban khusus periode ini
            $sqlIS = "
                SELECT c.id, c.account_type,
                       COALESCE(SUM(

                if ($r['account_type'] === 'revenue') {

                } else {

                }
            }

            $netIncome    = $revenueTotal - $expenseTotal;

            if (!empty($closingLines)) {

                if ($netIncome >= 0) {
                    $closingLines[] = ['account_id' => $retainedEarningsId, 'debit' => 0, 'credit' => $netIncome];
                } else {
                    $closingLines[] = ['account_id' => $retainedEarningsId, 'debit' => abs($netIncome), 'credit' => 0];
                }

                $sumCredit = array_sum(array_column($closingLines, 'credit'));
                if (abs($sumDebit - $sumCredit) > 0.01) {

                    $stmtJe = $db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO journal_entries

                            (:ref, CAST(:jd AS date), :pid, :rt, 0, :descr, 'posted', :uid, NOW())
                        RETURNING id");
                    $stmtJe->execute([

                        ':jd'    => $period['end_date'],
                        ':pid'   => $id,
                        ':rt'    => 'closing_entry',      // pastikan nilai ini ada di enum reference_type
                        ':descr' => 'Jurnal Penutup - ' . $period['period_name'],
                        ':uid'   => $_SESSION['user_id'],
                    ]);
                    $closingJournalId = (int)$stmtJe->fetchColumn();
                    if ($closingJournalId <= 0) { throw new Exception('Gagal membuat header jurnal penutup.'); }

                    $stmtJl = $db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO journal_lines (journal_id, account_id, debit, credit, description)
                        VALUES (:jid, :acc, :d, :c, :descr)");
                    foreach ($closingLines as $l) {
                        $stmtJl->execute([
                            ':jid'   => $closingJournalId,
                            ':acc'   => $l['account_id'],
                            ':d'     => round($l['debit'], 2),
                            ':c'     => round($l['credit'], 2),
                            ':descr' => 'Tutup buku ' . $period['period_name'],
                        ]);
                    }
                }

                // 4. Kunci periode  [FIX] literal true
                $stmtLock = $db->prepare("UPDATE accounting_periods SET is_closed = true WHERE id = :id");
                $stmtLock->execute([':id' => $id]);

                $db->commit();
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                throw $e;     // ditangkap catch global -> JSON error
            }

            $msg = $closingRefNo
                ? "Periode berhasil ditutup. Jurnal penutup: {$closingRefNo} (Laba/Rugi periode: " . number_format($netIncome, 2, ',', '.') . ")"
                : "Periode berhasil ditutup. Tidak ada aktivitas Pendapatan/Beban di periode ini, jurnal penutup tidak diperlukan.";
            fp_json(['success' => true, 'message' => $msg]);
            break;

        // ==============================================================
        case 'reopen':
            $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
            if ($access < 4) {
                fp_json(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Hanya akses tertinggi yang boleh membuka kembali periode.']);
            }
            $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

            $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM journal_entries WHERE period_id = :id AND reference_type = 'closing_entry' AND status = 'posted'");
            $stmtChk->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $hasClosing = intval($stmtChk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['cnt']) > 0;

            // [FIX] literal false (sebelumnya $db->update(... false) -> '' -> error 22P02)
            $stmtOpen = $db->prepare("UPDATE accounting_periods SET is_closed = false WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtOpen->execute([':id' => $id]);

            $msg = 'Periode berhasil dibuka kembali.';
            if ($hasClosing) {
                $msg .= ' PERHATIAN: periode ini punya jurnal penutup yang sudah posting -- kalau mau input jurnal baru lagi di periode ini, reverse dulu jurnal penutupnya lewat menu Journal Entry supaya tidak double-hitung Laba Ditahan saat tutup buku berikutnya.';
            }
            fp_json(['success' => true, 'message' => $msg]);
            break;

        // ==============================================================
        case 'delete':
            $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
            if ($access < 4) {
                fp_json(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            }
            $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

            $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT is_closed FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtChk->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $row = $stmtChk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$row) {
                fp_json(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Periode tidak ditemukan.']);
            }
            if ($row['is_closed']) {
                fp_json(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Periode yang sudah ditutup tidak boleh dihapus.']);
            }

            // [FIX] prepared statement (sebelumnya interpolasi string)
            $stmtDel = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtDel->execute([':id' => $id]);
            fp_json(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Periode berhasil dihapus.']);
            break;

        // ==============================================================
        default:
            fp_json(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task)]);
    }

} catch (PDOException $e) {
    // [FIX] error DB -> log + JSON (tidak lagi fatal error HTML)
    error_log('[m.fiscalperiodCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    fp_json(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[m.fiscalperiodCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    fp_json(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
}

<?php

    http_response_code(405);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Metode harus POST untuk perubahan invoice.']);
    exit;

                   i.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name,
                   i.proyekoice_date, i.due_date, i.total_amount, i.paid_amount, i.status
            FROM proyekoices i
            LEFT JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = i.so_id
            LEFT JOIN m_customer c ON c.id = i.customer_id

        $stmt = $db->query($sql);

    // ==============================================================

        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => 0, 'data' => []]);

        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        break;

    // Combo Sales Order (untuk field so_id, wajib diisi)

            SELECT so.id, so.ref_no, so.tx_date, mc.name AS legacy_customer_name
            FROM sales_order so 
            LEFT JOIN m_customer mc ON mc.id = so.customer_id
            WHERE (so.active = true or so.active IS null) 
                and so.id NOT IN (
            	    SELECT distinct i.so_id FROM proyekoice_items t 
            	    left join proyekoices i on i.id=t.proyekoice_id
            	    WHERE t.so_item_id IS NOT NULL

        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // Item dari Sales Order terpilih yang BELUM pernah dipakai di proyekoice
    // manapun (so_item_id belum muncul di proyekoice_items manapun).
    case 'read_so_items':
        $soId = intval($_POST['so_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($soId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => []]);
            exit;
        }
        $sql = "
      SELECT soi.id AS so_item_id, soi.qty_unit as qty, 
       case
                when soi.disc_percent is true then (coalesce(soi.unit_price,0) - (coalesce(soi.unit_price,0) * (coalesce(soi.disc,0) / 100)))
                else (coalesce(soi.unit_price,0) - coalesce(soi.disc,0))
            end::numeric(14,2) as unit_price,
        case
                when soi.disc_percent is true then (coalesce(soi.unit_price,0) - (coalesce(soi.unit_price,0) * (coalesce(soi.disc,0) / 100))) * coalesce(soi.qty_unit,0)
                else (coalesce(soi.unit_price,0) - coalesce(soi.disc,0)) * soi.qty_unit
            end::numeric(14,2) as subtotal,
       i.name AS product_name
            FROM sales_order_item soi
            LEFT JOIN items i  ON i.id = soi.item_id
            WHERE soi.order_id= :so_id
              AND soi.id NOT IN (
                  SELECT so_item_id FROM proyekoice_items WHERE so_item_id IS NOT NULL
              )
            ORDER BY soi.id asc
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['so_id' => $soId]);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        // Fallback deskripsi: pakai nama produk kalau kolom description kosong
        foreach ($data as &$d) {
            if (empty($d['description'])) $d['description'] = $d['product_name'];
        }
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // Combo Customer (untuk pilih manual kalau perlu override)
    case 'read_customer':
        $sql = "SELECT id, name FROM m_customer WHERE active = true ORDER BY name ASC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'create':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 2) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        saveInvoice($db, null, $_POST);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'update':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID proyekoice tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }
        $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT status FROM proyekoices WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtChk->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $existing = $stmtChk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($existing && $existing['status'] !== 'draft') {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Hanya proyekoice berstatus Draft yang boleh diedit.']);
            exit;
        }
        saveInvoice($db, $id, $_POST);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // Finalize -- dipanggil otomatis oleh JS saat tombol Print diklik.
    // Ubah status draft -> final, DAN generate jurnal otomatis (Tahap 6).
    case 'finalize':
        // Finalisasi mengunci invoice Draft dan memicu posting jurnal otomatis; wajib hak ubah (level 3).
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID invoice tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        // Status invoice dan jurnal harus berubah bersama-sama; bila posting gagal, transaksi di-rollback.
        $db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $stmtInv = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM proyekoices WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
            $stmtInv->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $proyekoice = $stmtInv->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$proyekoice) {
                throw new Exception('Invoice tidak ditemukan.');
            }

            // Kalau sudah final sebelumnya, tidak perlu proses ulang (hindari jurnal dobel).
            if ($proyekoice['status'] === 'final') {
                $db->commit();
                echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Invoice sudah final.', 'already_final' => true]);
                break;
            }

            $stmtUpd = $db->prepare("UPDATE proyekoices SET status = 'final' WHERE id = :id AND status = 'draft'");
            $stmtUpd->execute(['id' => $id]);
            if ($stmtUpd->rowCount() === 0) {
                throw new Exception('Gagal finalisasi -- status invoice sudah berubah, silakan reload.');
            }

            // ---- Auto-posting jurnal ----
            $jr = AutoPostJournal($db, [
                'rule_code'      => 'SLSCREDIT',
                'reference_type' => 'sales_proyekoice',
                'reference_id'   => $id,
                'journal_date'   => $proyekoice['proyekoice_date'],
                'amount'         => $proyekoice['total_amount'],
                'description'    => 'Invoice ' . $proyekoice['proyekoice_no']
            ]);
            if (!$jr['success']) {
                throw new Exception('Jurnal otomatis gagal dibuat: ' . $jr['message']);
            }

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Invoice berhasil difinalisasi. ' . $jr['message']]);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                $db->rollBack();
            }
            error_log('[invoiceCRD][finalize] ' . $e->getMessage());
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'delete':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 4) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

        $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT status FROM proyekoices WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtChk->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $row = $stmtChk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($row && $row['status'] !== 'draft') {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Hanya proyekoice berstatus Draft yang boleh dihapus.']);
            exit;
        }

        $db->query("DELETE FROM proyekoice_items WHERE proyekoice_id = {$id}");
        $db->query("DELETE FROM proyekoices WHERE id = {$id}");
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Invoice berhasil dihapus.']);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task)]);
}

function saveInvoice($db, $id, $post) {
    $soId       = intval($post['so_id'] ?? 0);
    $customerId = intval($post['customer_id'] ?? 0);
    $proyekDate    = trim($post['proyekoice_date'] ?? '');
    $dueDate    = trim($post['due_date'] ?? '') ?: null;
    $itemsJson  = $post['arrItems'] ?? '[]';
    $items      = json_decode($itemsJson, true);

    if ($soId <= 0) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Sales Order wajib dipilih.']);
        return;
    }
    if ($customerId <= 0) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Customer wajib dipilih.']);
        return;
    }
    if (empty($proyekDate)) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Tanggal proyekoice wajib diisi.']);
        return;
    }
    if (!is_array($items) || count($items) < 1) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Invoice minimal harus punya 1 item.']);
        return;
    }

    $validItems = [];
    $totalAmount = 0;
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $desc = trim($it['description'] ?? '');
        $qty = Str2N($it['qty'] ?? 0);
        $price = Str2N($it['unit_price'] ?? 0);
        $soItemId = !empty($it['so_item_id']) ? intval($it['so_item_id']) : null;
        if (empty($desc) || $qty <= 0) continue;
        $subtotal = $qty * $price;
        $totalAmount += $subtotal;
        $validItems[] = ['description' => $desc, 'qty' => $qty, 'unit_price' => $price, 'subtotal' => $subtotal, 'so_item_id' => $soItemId];
    }
    if (count($validItems) < 1) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Tidak ada item valid (deskripsi & qty wajib diisi).']);
        return;
    }

    $headerData = [
        'so_id'        => $soId,
        'customer_id'  => $customerId,
        'proyekoice_date' => $proyekDate,
        'due_date'     => $dueDate,
        'total_amount' => $totalAmount
    ];

    if ($id === null) {
        $proyekoiceNo = CreateRefNo('proyekoices', 'proyekoice_no', 'INV');
        $headerData['proyekoice_no']  = $proyekoiceNo;
        $headerData['paid_amount'] = 0;
        $headerData['status']      = 'draft';
        $headerData['created_by']  = $_SESSION['user_id'];

        $db->insert('proyekoices', $headerData);

        $stmtId = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM proyekoices WHERE proyekoice_no = :no");
        $stmtId->execute(['no' => $proyekoiceNo]);
        $newId = $stmtId->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['id'] ?? null;

        if ($newId) insertItems($db, $newId, $validItems);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Invoice {$proyekoiceNo} berhasil disimpan."]);
    } else {
        $db->update('proyekoices', $headerData, "id = {$id}");
        $db->query("DELETE FROM proyekoice_items WHERE proyekoice_id = {$id}");
        insertItems($db, $id, $validItems);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Invoice berhasil diperbarui.']);
    }
}

function insertItems($db, $proyekoiceId, $items) {
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $db->insert('proyekoice_items', [
            'proyekoice_id'  => $proyekoiceId,
            'so_item_id'  => $it['so_item_id'] ?? null,
            'description' => $it['description'],
            'qty'         => $it['qty'],
            'unit_price'  => $it['unit_price'],
            'subtotal'    => $it['subtotal']
        ]);
    }
}
==================== FILE: ./php-crud/trialbalanceCRD.php ====================
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
/*
  Document      : Trial Balance - Report Handler
  Called from   : js/m.trialbalance.js
  Note          : - Laporan read-only.
                  - Saldo dihitung sebagai akumulasi SEMUA transaksi posted/
                    reversed sampai dengan tanggal akhir periode terpilih
                    (bukan cuma mutasi dalam periode itu saja -- trial balance
                    adalah saldo KUMULATIF per titik waktu tertentu).
                  - Saldo ditampilkan di kolom Debit kalau positif untuk akun
                    normal-debit (asset/expense), sebaliknya di kolom Kredit.
                    Kalau saldo "terbalik" (kontra), tetap ditampilkan di
                    kolom lawan supaya total tetap balance secara matematis.
                  - [FIX-BANKCASH] Akun bank & cash diperlakukan debit-normal
                    (konsisten dengan Neraca).
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once   '../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once   '../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;
}

$task = $_POST['task'] ?? $_REQUEST['task'] ?? 'read_trial_balance';
if ((int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < 1) { http_response_code(403); echo json_encode(['success'=>false,'message'=>'Hak baca neraca saldo tidak tersedia.']); exit; }
$db   = new crud();

switch ($task) {

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_periods':
        $sql = "SELECT id, period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods ORDER BY start_date DESC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_trial_balance':
        $periodId = intval($_POST['period_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($periodId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode wajib dipilih.']);
            exit;
        }

        $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT period_name, end_date FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtP->execute(['id' => $periodId]);
        $period = $stmtP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$period) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode tidak ditemukan.']);
            exit;
        }
        $asOfDate = $period['end_date'];

        $sql = "
            SELECT c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type,
                   COALESCE(SUM(
                       CASE WHEN c.account_type IN ('asset','bank','cash','expense') THEN l.debit - l.credit
                            ELSE l.credit - l.debit END
                   ), 0) AS balance
            FROM chart_of_accounts c
            LEFT JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
            LEFT JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
                AND j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')
                AND j.journal_date <= :as_of_date
            WHERE c.is_active = true
            GROUP BY c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type
            ORDER BY c.account_code ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['as_of_date' => $asOfDate]);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $data = [];
        $totalDebit = 0;
        $totalCredit = 0;
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $isDebitNormal = in_array($r['account_type'], ['asset', 'bank', 'cash', 'expense']);   // [FIX-BANKCASH] bank & cash = debit-normal
            $balance = floatval($r['balance']);

            $debitCol = 0;
            $creditCol = 0;
            if ($isDebitNormal) {
                if ($balance >= 0) { $debitCol = $balance; } else { $creditCol = abs($balance); }
            } else {
                if ($balance >= 0) { $creditCol = $balance; } else { $debitCol = abs($balance); }
            }

            $totalDebit += $debitCol;
            $totalCredit += $creditCol;

            $data[] = [
                'account_code' => $r['account_code'],
                'account_name' => $r['account_name'],
                'account_type' => $r['account_type'],
                'debit'        => $debitCol,
                'credit'       => $creditCol
            ];
        }

        echo json_encode([
            'success'      => true,
            'period_name'  => $period['period_name'],
            'as_of_date'   => $asOfDate,
            'total_debit'  => $totalDebit,
            'total_credit' => $totalCredit,
            'is_balance'   => abs($totalDebit - $totalCredit) < 0.01,
            'totalCount'   => count($data),
            'data'         => $data
        ]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task)]);
}

==================== FILE: ./php-crud/ppn.reportCRD.php ====================
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
/**
 * ppn.reportCRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Backend Laporan PPN bulanan per proyek (PPN Keluaran vs PPN Masukan).  [PPN - TAHAP 3]
 * Front end: js/ppn.report.js, views/ppn.report.php. Menu: m_form_name seq 6037 (grup acct report).
 *
 * Sumber data:
 *  - PPN Keluaran : project_invoices (termin) dengan ppn_amount > 0; proyek = project_invoices.project_id.
 *  - PPN Masukan  : purchase_invoice_hdr dengan ppn_amount > 0; proyek diambil dari PO tiap GRN yang di-match
 *                   (purchase_invoice_dtl -> grn_hdr -> purchase_orders). Invoice yang mencakup lebih dari satu
 *                   proyek dialokasikan proporsional terhadap matched_amount; sisa pembulatan masuk ke baris terbesar
 *                   sehingga total alokasi = PPN invoice.
 *  - Masa pajak   : bulan dari tanggal faktur pajak; bila belum diisi memakai tanggal invoice.
 *
 * Task : list_projects | list_summary | list_keluaran | list_masukan | export_csv
 * Param: year, month (1-12), project_id (0 = semua), query (cari), type (export_csv: summary|keluaran|masukan)
 * Respons JSON standar {success, message, data, totalCount}; list_summary menambah 'totals'.
 * ============================================================
 */
ini_set('display_errors', '0');
ob_start();

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$db = new crud();if (empty($_SESSION['user_id']) || !is_numeric($_SESSION['user_id']) || (int)$_SESSION['user_id'] <= 0) { http_response_code(401); rpt_send(false, [], 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login ulang.'); }
if ((int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < 1) { http_response_code(403); rpt_send(false, [], 'Hak baca laporan PPN tidak tersedia.'); }



class RptError extends Exception {}

function rpt_send($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $resp = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        $resp['data'] = $data;
        $resp['totalCount'] = is_array($data) ? count($data) : 0;
    }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($resp, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

/** Rentang periode: [awal bulan, awal bulan berikutnya) dalam format YYYY-MM-DD. */
function rpt_period(): array {
    $y = (int)($_REQUEST['year'] ?? date('Y'));
    $m = (int)($_REQUEST['month'] ?? date('n'));
    if ($y < 2000 || $y > 2100 || $m < 1 || $m > 12) throw new RptError('Periode tidak valid.');
    $from = sprintf('%04d-%02d-01', $y, $m);
    $to   = date('Y-m-d', strtotime($from . ' +1 month'));
    return [$from, $to, $y, $m];
}

function rpt_f($v): float { return round((float)$v, 2); }

/** Baris PPN Keluaran (termin proyek) pada periode. */
function rpt_keluaran($db, string $from, string $to): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT v.id, COALESCE(v.faktur_pajak_date, v.invoice_date) AS tax_date, v.invoice_date, v.inv_no, v.termin_name,
               v.faktur_pajak_no, v.faktur_pajak_date, v.dpp_amount, v.ppn_rate, v.ppn_amount, v.amount AS total_amount,
               p.id AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, c.name AS counterparty
          FROM public.project_invoices v
          JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = v.project_id
          LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON c.id = p.client_id
         WHERE v.release_status = 'released'                                    -- [RELEASE-LAYER] hanya tagihan resmi
           AND v.ppn_amount > 0
           AND COALESCE(v.faktur_pajak_date, v.invoice_date) >= CAST(:f AS date)
           AND COALESCE(v.faktur_pajak_date, v.invoice_date) <  CAST(:t AS date)
         ORDER BY tax_date, v.id");
    $st->execute([':f' => $from, ':t' => $to]);
    $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    foreach ($rows as &$r) {
        $r['id'] = (int)$r['id'];
        $r['project_id'] = (int)$r['project_id'];
        $r['dpp_amount'] = rpt_f($r['dpp_amount']);
        $r['ppn_rate'] = (float)$r['ppn_rate'];
        $r['ppn_amount'] = rpt_f($r['ppn_amount']);
        $r['total_amount'] = rpt_f($r['total_amount']);
    }
    unset($r);
    return $rows;
}

/** Baris PPN Masukan (invoice supplier) pada periode, sudah dialokasikan per proyek. */
function rpt_masukan($db, string $from, string $to): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT h.id, COALESCE(h.faktur_pajak_date, h.invoice_date) AS tax_date, h.invoice_date, h.inv_no,
               h.supplier_invoice_no, h.faktur_pajak_no, h.faktur_pajak_date,
               h.dpp_amount, h.ppn_rate, h.ppn_amount, h.total_amount,
               s.name AS counterparty, s.npwp_no,
               COALESCE(po.project_id, 0) AS project_id, COALESCE(p.name, '(Tanpa proyek)') AS project_name,
               SUM(d.matched_amount) AS dpp_proj
          FROM public.purchase_invoice_hdr h
          LEFT JOIN public.m_suppliers s ON s.id = h.supplier_id
          LEFT JOIN public.purchase_invoice_dtl d ON d.invoice_hdr_id = h.id
          LEFT JOIN public.grn_hdr g ON g.id = d.grn_hdr_id
          LEFT JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON po.id = g.po_id
          LEFT JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = po.project_id
         WHERE h.ppn_amount > 0
           AND LOWER(h.status) NOT IN ('cancelled','canceled','dibatalkan','void','reversed')
           AND COALESCE(h.faktur_pajak_date, h.invoice_date) >= CAST(:f AS date)
           AND COALESCE(h.faktur_pajak_date, h.invoice_date) <  CAST(:t AS date)
         GROUP BY h.id, s.name, s.npwp_no, po.project_id, p.name
         ORDER BY tax_date, h.id, project_name");
    $st->execute([':f' => $from, ':t' => $to]);
    $raw = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    // kelompokkan per invoice lalu alokasikan PPN per proyek (proporsional matched_amount)
    $byInv = [];
    foreach ($raw as $r) $byInv[(int)$r['id']][] = $r;

    $out = [];
    foreach ($byInv as $lines) {
        $ppn = rpt_f($lines[0]['ppn_amount']);
        $dppInv = rpt_f($lines[0]['dpp_amount']);
        $sum = 0.0;
        foreach ($lines as $l) $sum += (float)$l['dpp_proj'];
        $alloc = [];
        $allocSum = 0.0; $maxIdx = 0; $maxVal = -1.0;
        foreach ($lines as $i => $l) {
            $dppP = ($sum > 0) ? rpt_f($l['dpp_proj']) : $dppInv;     // invoice tanpa detail -> seluruh nilai ke satu baris
            $ppnP = ($sum > 0) ? round($ppn * (float)$l['dpp_proj'] / $sum, 2) : $ppn;
            $alloc[$i] = [$dppP, $ppnP];
            $allocSum += $ppnP;
            if ($dppP > $maxVal) { $maxVal = $dppP; $maxIdx = $i; }
        }
        $alloc[$maxIdx][1] = round($alloc[$maxIdx][1] + ($ppn - $allocSum), 2);      // sisa pembulatan ke baris terbesar
        foreach ($lines as $i => $l) {
            $out[] = [
                'id' => (int)$l['id'], 'tax_date' => $l['tax_date'], 'invoice_date' => $l['invoice_date'],
                'inv_no' => $l['inv_no'], 'supplier_invoice_no' => $l['supplier_invoice_no'],
                'faktur_pajak_no' => $l['faktur_pajak_no'], 'faktur_pajak_date' => $l['faktur_pajak_date'],
                'counterparty' => $l['counterparty'], 'npwp_no' => $l['npwp_no'],
                'project_id' => (int)$l['project_id'], 'project_name' => $l['project_name'],
                'ppn_rate' => (float)$l['ppn_rate'],
                'dpp_amount' => $alloc[$i][0], 'ppn_amount' => $alloc[$i][1],
                'total_amount' => round($alloc[$i][0] + $alloc[$i][1], 2),
            ];
        }
    }
    return $out;
}

/** Filter proyek + kata kunci (dilakukan setelah alokasi agar alokasi per invoice tetap utuh). */
function rpt_filter(array $rows): array {
    $pid = (int)($_REQUEST['project_id'] ?? 0);
    $q = trim((string)($_REQUEST['query'] ?? ''));
    if ($pid <= 0 && $q === '') return $rows;
    $res = [];
    foreach ($rows as $r) {
        if ($pid > 0 && (int)$r['project_id'] !== $pid) continue;
        if ($q !== '') {
            $hay = strtolower(implode(' ', [$r['inv_no'] ?? '', $r['project_name'] ?? '', $r['counterparty'] ?? '',
                                            $r['faktur_pajak_no'] ?? '', $r['supplier_invoice_no'] ?? '', $r['termin_name'] ?? '']));
            if (strpos($hay, strtolower($q)) === false) continue;
        }
        $res[] = $r;
    }
    return $res;
}

/** Ringkasan per proyek + total (kurang / lebih bayar = Keluaran - Masukan). */
function rpt_summary(array $kel, array $mas): array {
    $map = [];
    $touch = function ($r) use (&$map) {
        $k = (int)$r['project_id'];
        if (!isset($map[$k])) $map[$k] = ['project_id' => $k, 'project_name' => $r['project_name'],
            'keluaran_dpp' => 0.0, 'keluaran_ppn' => 0.0, 'masukan_dpp' => 0.0, 'masukan_ppn' => 0.0];
        return $k;
    };
    foreach ($kel as $r) { $k = $touch($r); $map[$k]['keluaran_dpp'] += $r['dpp_amount']; $map[$k]['keluaran_ppn'] += $r['ppn_amount']; }
    foreach ($mas as $r) { $k = $touch($r); $map[$k]['masukan_dpp']  += $r['dpp_amount']; $map[$k]['masukan_ppn']  += $r['ppn_amount']; }

    $tot = ['keluaran_dpp' => 0.0, 'keluaran_ppn' => 0.0, 'masukan_dpp' => 0.0, 'masukan_ppn' => 0.0];
    $rows = [];
    foreach ($map as $r) {
        foreach (['keluaran_dpp', 'keluaran_ppn', 'masukan_dpp', 'masukan_ppn'] as $f) { $r[$f] = round($r[$f], 2); $tot[$f] += $r[$f]; }
        $r['net_ppn'] = round($r['keluaran_ppn'] - $r['masukan_ppn'], 2);
        $rows[] = $r;
    }
    usort($rows, function ($a, $b) { return strcmp((string)$a['project_name'], (string)$b['project_name']); });
    foreach ($tot as $f => $v) $tot[$f] = round($v, 2);
    $tot['net_ppn'] = round($tot['keluaran_ppn'] - $tot['masukan_ppn'], 2);    // > 0 kurang bayar, < 0 lebih bayar
    return [$rows, $tot];
}

function rpt_csv_out(string $filename, array $head, array $rows): void {
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    header('Content-Type: text/csv; charset=utf-8');
    header('Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="' . $filename . '"');
    echo "\xEF\xBB\xBF" . "sep=;\r\n";                                   // BOM + petunjuk pemisah agar Excel (locale apa pun) membuka rapi
    $fh = fopen('php://output', 'w');
    fputcsv($fh, $head, ';');
    foreach ($rows as $r) fputcsv($fh, $r, ';');
    fclose($fh);
    exit;
}

$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';

        case 'list_projects':

            foreach ($rows as &$r) $r['id'] = (int)$r['id'];

            array_unshift($rows, ['id' => 0, 'name' => '(Semua proyek)']);
            rpt_send(true, $rows);
            break;

            list($rows, $tot) = rpt_summary(rpt_filter(rpt_keluaran($db, $from, $to)), rpt_filter(rpt_masukan($db, $from, $to)));
            rpt_send(true, $rows, '', ['totals' => $tot]);

        case 'list_keluaran':

        case 'list_masukan':
            list($from, $to) = rpt_period();
            rpt_send(true, rpt_filter(rpt_masukan($db, $from, $to)));
            break;

        case 'export_csv':
            list($from, $to, $y, $m) = rpt_period();
            $type = (string)($_REQUEST['type'] ?? 'summary');
            $stamp = sprintf('%04d-%02d', $y, $m);
            if ($type === 'keluaran') {
                $rows = rpt_filter(rpt_keluaran($db, $from, $to));
                $out = [];

                                                $r['faktur_pajak_no'], $r['dpp_amount'], $r['ppn_rate'], $r['ppn_amount'], $r['total_amount']];
                rpt_csv_out("ppn-keluaran-{$stamp}.csv",
                    ['Tgl Pajak', 'No Invoice', 'Proyek', 'Customer', 'Termin', 'No Faktur Pajak', 'DPP', 'Tarif %', 'PPN', 'Total'], $out);
            } elseif ($type === 'masukan') {
                $rows = rpt_filter(rpt_masukan($db, $from, $to));
                $out = [];
                foreach ($rows as $r) $out[] = [$r['tax_date'], $r['inv_no'], $r['supplier_invoice_no'], $r['project_name'], $r['counterparty'],
                                                $r['npwp_no'], $r['faktur_pajak_no'], $r['dpp_amount'], $r['ppn_rate'], $r['ppn_amount'], $r['total_amount']];
                rpt_csv_out("ppn-masukan-{$stamp}.csv",
                    ['Tgl Pajak', 'No Invoice', 'Invoice Supplier', 'Proyek', 'Supplier', 'NPWP', 'No Faktur Pajak', 'DPP', 'Tarif %', 'PPN', 'Total'], $out);
            } else {
                list($rows, $tot) = rpt_summary(rpt_filter(rpt_keluaran($db, $from, $to)), rpt_filter(rpt_masukan($db, $from, $to)));
                $out = [];
                foreach ($rows as $r) $out[] = [$r['project_name'], $r['keluaran_dpp'], $r['keluaran_ppn'], $r['masukan_dpp'], $r['masukan_ppn'], $r['net_ppn']];
                $out[] = ['TOTAL', $tot['keluaran_dpp'], $tot['keluaran_ppn'], $tot['masukan_dpp'], $tot['masukan_ppn'], $tot['net_ppn']];
                rpt_csv_out("ppn-ringkasan-{$stamp}.csv",
                    ['Proyek', 'DPP Keluaran', 'PPN Keluaran', 'DPP Masukan', 'PPN Masukan', 'PPN Kurang(+)/Lebih(-) Bayar'], $out);
            }
            break;

        default:
            rpt_send(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.');
            break;
    }
} catch (RptError $e) {
    rpt_send(false, [], $e->getMessage());
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[ppn.reportCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    rpt_send(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[ppn.reportCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    rpt_send(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}
==================== FILE: ./php-crud/whrcvCRD_err.php ====================
<?php
/**
 * whrcvCRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Backend Controller untuk WH Receiving (Penerimaan Fisik Gudang)
 * Mengontrol alur penerimaan barang berdasarkan GRN, pencatatan
 * ke stock_movements, serta integrasi Auto Journal.
 *
 * PERBAIKAN (dari versi sebelumnya):
 * - [FIX UTAMA] Versi lama memakai DUA KONEKSI/TRANSAKSI SEKALIGUS: pg_query
 *   native (BEGIN/COMMIT) untuk header+detail, dan $db PDO (beginTransaction/
 *   commit) untuk PostStockMovement()/AutoPostJournal(). Kalau salah satu sisi
 *   gagal commit SETELAH sisi lain sudah berhasil, hasilnya header WH Rcv
 *   tersimpan "posted" tapi detail/stok/jurnalnya hilang -- persis gejala
 *   "total nilai 0.00, tidak ada item detail" yang muncul di produksi.
 *   Sekarang SEMUA query (termasuk yang tadinya pg_query_params) memakai satu
 *   koneksi PDO ($db) yang sama, satu transaksi tunggal.
 * - m_bin_location -> bin_locations (perbaikan sebelumnya, dipertahankan).
 * - Validasi "total qty diterima harus lebih dari 0" sekarang dicek SEBELUM
 *   ada INSERT apa pun (dari total qty, bukan dari qty*unit_cost) -- supaya
 *   item dengan unit_cost=0 (data GRN yang belum diisi harga) tetap valid
 *   tersimpan, tidak keliru dianggap "tidak ada yang diterima".
 * ============================================================
 */

function PrepOrFail($stmt, $context = '') {
    if ($stmt === false) {
        throw new Exception(($context ? "[{$context}] " : '') . 'Query gagal dijalankan.');
    }
    return $stmt;
}

/** SELECT dan fetchAll dalam satu langkah. */
function fetchAll($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFail($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
}

/** SELECT dan fetch satu baris. */
function fetchOne($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFail($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    return $row === false ? null : $row;
}

/** INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE biasa (tanpa perlu baris kembalian). */
function execSql($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFail($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    return $stmt;
}

                        GROUP BY d.grn_dtl_id

                    WHERE g.status IN ('open','partial')
                    GROUP BY g.id, g.ref_no, g.grn_date, g.status, s.name
                    HAVING SUM(gd.qty_received) - COALESCE(SUM(wd.qty_wh_sum), 0) > 0.0001

                    FROM grn_dtl gd

                    }

                    $cost = (float)($it['unit_cost'] ?? 0);
                    $total_amount += ($qty * $cost);
                    $grade_id = !empty($it['grade_id']) ? $it['grade_id'] : $chk['grade_id'];

                            'grade_id' => $grade_id, 'remark' => $it['remark'] ?? null

                        'movement_date'  => $received_date,

                    'reference_id'   => $wh_receiving_hdr_id,

            } catch (Throwable $e) {

            }
            break;

        case 'reverse':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);

            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $hdr = fetchOne($db,
                    "SELECT * FROM wh_receiving_hdr WHERE id = :id AND status = 'posted' FOR UPDATE",

                $db->commit();

            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        default:
            throw new Exception('Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task));
    }
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage() !== '' ? $e->getMessage() : 'Terjadi kesalahan pada server.']);
}

         Butuh migrasi: sql/2026-10-26.ppn_invoice.sql
   [JURNAL 2026-10-29] Invoice supplier kini dijurnal (keputusan: aktifkan sebelum pembayaran supplier pertama, agar Hutang Usaha
         terbentuk dan GRN Clearing ter-offset; tanpa ini pembayaran supplier membuat Hutang Usaha bersaldo debit):
         - rule PUR_INVOICE          : Dr 2600 GRN Clearing   / Cr 2100 Hutang Usaha  sebesar DPP
         - rule PURCHASE_INVOICE_PPN : Dr 2400 PPN Masukan    / Cr 2100 Hutang Usaha  sebesar PPN (hanya bila PPN > 0)
         - reference_type 'purchase_invoice', tanggal jurnal = tanggal invoice; edit = reverse + posting ulang; hapus = reverse.
         - create / update / delete dipindah ke PDO (class crud) dalam SATU transaksi bersama jurnal (AutoPostJournal butuh PDO,
           sedangkan koneksi pg_* tidak bisa berbagi transaksi). Task read tetap memakai pg_*.
         - delete ditolak bila invoice sudah ada pembayaran supplier.
         - task baru 'backfill_journal' (preview / run) untuk memposting jurnal invoice lama yang belum dijurnal.
         (Enum reference_type di database ini SUDAH memuat 'purchase_invoice' -> sql/2026-10-29.purchase_invoice_journal.sql tidak perlu dijalankan.)
   [PPN MENGIKUTI PO 2026-10-29] DPP / PPN invoice ditentukan dari PO tiap GRN yang di-match, BUKAN dari tarif yang diketik user:
         - Nilai GRN (grn_dtl.unit_cost) sudah berbasis DPP untuk semua mode PO (GRN menolak harga PO inklusif PPN; default = harga / (1+tarif)).
           Jadi matched_amount = DPP. PO EXCL / INCL (tarif > 0): PPN = DPP x tarif PO ; PO NONE: PPN 0 ; total hutang = DPP + PPN
           (untuk PO INCL total = nilai PO yang inklusif PPN, sesuai 'tagihan dibayar sesuai PO').
         - Input 'PPN sesuai faktur' dari klien tetap boleh sebagai koreksi, dalam toleransi PI_PPN_TOLERANCE.
         - ppn_rate header = tarif tunggal bila seragam; bila campur diisi tarif efektif (PPN / DPP). Hanya informasi.
         - Satu invoice hanya boleh satu mata uang; jurnal diposting dalam mata uang dasar (nilai x kurs GRN).
   [NILAI BERSIH SETELAH RETUR 2026-10-29] Sisa yang bisa di-invoice = nilai GRN - retur supplier berstatus Dikirim / Kredit
         (Diganti tidak mengurangi: barang pengganti memenuhi GRN) - yang sudah di-match invoice lain. Invoice yang sudah ada tetap boleh
         disimpan ulang pada nilai lamanya; retur setelah invoice diselesaikan lewat nota kredit retur (bukan mengubah invoice).
         Retur dihitung dari supplier_return_dtl.qty_claim x unit_cost (mata uang dasar) / kurs GRN -> mata uang PO.
   [BARU 2026-10-08]
         - task 'read_invoice_print': data Tanda Terima Invoice (read-only, tidak mengubah data).
         - create: kolom created_by ikut diisi dari sesi (kolom sudah ada di tabel, sebelumnya kosong)
           supaya nama penerima tampil di cetakan. */
