// [FIX] Helper supaya pesan error TIDAK PERNAH kosong ke frontend.
function pgErrorOrFallback($fallback = 'Terjadi kesalahan pada database.') {
    $err = pg_last_error();
    return $err !== '' ? $err : $fallback;
}

// [PPN] ---------------------------------------------------------------
const PI_PPN_TOLERANCE   = 100.00;                    // selisih maks (Rp) antara PPN input (faktur) dan hitungan DPP x tarif
const PI_JOURNAL_REF     = 'purchase_invoice';        // [JURNAL] reference_type jurnal invoice supplier

/** [PPN] Hitung PPN dari DPP menurut mode & tarif PO. EXCL / INCL (tarif > 0) -> DPP x tarif ; NONE -> 0. */
function PiPpnFromDpp($dpp, $mode, $rate) {
    $mode = strtoupper((string)$mode);
    $rate = (float)$rate;
    if (($mode === 'EXCL' || $mode === 'INCL') && $rate > 0) return round($dpp * $rate / 100, 2);
    return 0.0;
}

/**
 * [PPN][RETUR] Info satu GRN untuk validasi & hitung invoice: supplier, mata uang & kurs GRN, mode/tarif PPN PO,
 * nilai GRN, nilai retur (Dikirim / Kredit) dalam mata uang PO, dan total yang sudah di-match di invoice LAIN.
 * [GAP #7] Juga memeriksa approval_status GRN - hanya APPROVED yang valid untuk invoice.
 */
function PiGrnInfo($db, $grnId, $excludeInvoiceId) {
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT g.id, g.ref_no, g.approval_status, COALESCE(g.supplier_id, po.supplier_id) AS supplier_id,
               UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(cur.init, ''))) AS currency_code,
               COALESCE(NULLIF(g.exch_rate, 0), 1) AS exch_rate,
               COALESCE(po.ppn_mode, 'NONE') AS ppn_mode, COALESCE(po.ppn_rate, 0) AS ppn_rate,
               (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.qty_received * d.unit_cost), 0) FROM grn_dtl d WHERE d.grn_hdr_id = g.id) AS grn_total,
               (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sd.qty_claim * sd.unit_cost), 0)
                  FROM supplier_return_hdr sh
                  JOIN supplier_return_dtl sd ON sd.return_hdr_id = sh.id
                  JOIN wh_receiving_hdr r ON r.id = sh.wh_receiving_hdr_id
                 WHERE r.grn_hdr_id = g.id AND sh.status IN ('Dikirim', 'Kredit')) AS returned_base,
               (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.matched_amount), 0) FROM purchase_invoice_dtl m
                 WHERE m.grn_hdr_id = g.id AND m.invoice_hdr_id <> :ex) AS matched_other
          FROM grn_hdr g
          LEFT JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id = g.po_id
          LEFT JOIN m_currency cur ON cur.id = g.currency_id
         WHERE g.id = :id");
    $st->execute([':id' => $grnId, ':ex' => (int)$excludeInvoiceId]);
    $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$r) return null;
    // [GAP #7] Check approval status
    if (($r['approval_status'] ?? 'PENDING') !== 'APPROVED') {
        throw new Exception('GRN ' . $r['ref_no'] . ' belum disetujui (status approval: ' . ($r['approval_status'] ?? 'PENDING') . '). Hanya GRN dengan status APPROVED yang dapat di-match ke invoice.');
    }
    $r['exch_rate']     = (float)$r['exch_rate'];
    $r['ppn_rate']      = (float)$r['ppn_rate'];
    $r['grn_total']     = (float)$r['grn_total'];
    $r['returned']      = round((float)$r['returned_base'] / ($r['exch_rate'] > 0 ? $r['exch_rate'] : 1), 2);   // dalam mata uang PO
    $r['matched_other'] = (float)$r['matched_other'];
    return $r;
}

/** [JURNAL] pastikan enum reference_type sudah memuat 'purchase_invoice' (bila kolom berupa enum). */
function PiAssertJournalRefType($db) {
    $st = $db->query("SELECT t.typtype, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_enum e WHERE e.enumtypid = t.oid AND e.enumlabel = '" . PI_JOURNAL_REF . "') AS has_label
                        FROM pg_attribute a
                        JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid
                        JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = a.atttypid
                       WHERE c.relname = 'journal_entries' AND a.attname = 'reference_type' AND NOT a.attisdropped
                       LIMIT 1");
    $r = $st ? $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) : false;
    if ($r && $r['typtype'] === 'e' && !in_array($r['has_label'], [true, 't', '1', 1], true)) {
        throw new Exception("Tipe jurnal 'purchase_invoice' belum terdaftar di database. Jalankan sql/2026-10-29.purchase_invoice_journal.sql terlebih dahulu.");
    }
}

function PiHasJournal($db, $invoiceId) {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries WHERE reference_type::text = :t AND reference_id = :id LIMIT 1");
    $st->execute([':t' => PI_JOURNAL_REF, ':id' => $invoiceId]);
    return (bool)$st->fetchColumn();
}

/** [JURNAL] posting jurnal invoice supplier: DPP (GRN Clearing -> Hutang) + PPN Masukan (-> Hutang) + PPh (Hutang Usaha -> Hutang PPh). Panggil di dalam transaksi. */
function PiPostJournal($db, $invoiceId, $invNo, $supplierInvNo, $invDate, $dpp, $ppn, $pph = 0.0) {
    $desc = 'Invoice supplier ' . $invNo . ($supplierInvNo !== '' ? ' (' . $supplierInvNo . ')' : '');
    if ($dpp > 0.005) {
        $r = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code' => 'PUR_INVOICE', 'reference_type' => PI_JOURNAL_REF, 'reference_id' => $invoiceId,
            'journal_date' => $invDate, 'amount' => $dpp, 'description' => $desc,
        ]);
        if (!$r['success']) throw new Exception('Gagal posting jurnal invoice: ' . $r['message']);
    }
    if ($ppn > 0.005) {
        $r = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code' => 'PURCHASE_INVOICE_PPN', 'reference_type' => PI_JOURNAL_REF, 'reference_id' => $invoiceId,
            'journal_date' => $invDate, 'amount' => $ppn, 'description' => 'PPN Masukan ' . $desc,
        ]);
        if (!$r['success']) throw new Exception('Gagal posting jurnal PPN Masukan: ' . $r['message']);
    }
    if ($pph > 0.005) {
        $r = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code' => 'PPH_SUPPLIER', 'reference_type' => PI_JOURNAL_REF, 'reference_id' => $invoiceId,
            'journal_date' => $invDate, 'amount' => $pph, 'description' => 'Pemotongan PPh ' . $desc,
        ]);
        if (!$r['success']) throw new Exception('Gagal posting jurnal PPh Supplier: ' . $r['message']);
    }
}

        case 'read_available_grn':
            // [BARU] Daftar GRN (grn_hdr) yang bisa dipilih untuk di-match ke invoice.
            // Difilter berdasarkan supplier yang sama dengan invoice, status masih
            // open/partial. Agregasi qty/harga dari grn_dtl (lihat catatan di
            // read_invoice_detail soal grn_hdr_id mengarah ke level dokumen).
            // [GAP #7] Hanya GRN dengan approval_status = 'APPROVED' yang bisa di-match ke invoice
            $supplier_id = isset($_REQUEST['supplier_id']) ? intval($_REQUEST['supplier_id']) : 0;

            // [PPN][RETUR] + mode/tarif PPN PO, mata uang & kurs GRN, nilai retur; sisa = nilai GRN - retur - sudah di-match
            $sql = "SELECT h.id AS grn_hdr_id, h.ref_no AS grn_ref_no, h.grn_date, h.supplier_id,
                           h.approval_status,  -- [GAP #7] GRN Approval Gate
                           string_agg(DISTINCT gd.item_name, ', ') AS item_name,
                           SUM(gd.qty_received) AS qty_received,
                           CASE WHEN SUM(gd.qty_received) > 0
                                THEN SUM(gd.qty_received * gd.unit_cost) / SUM(gd.qty_received)
                                ELSE 0 END AS unit_cost,
                           SUM(gd.qty_received * gd.unit_cost) AS grn_total,
                           COALESCE(im.already_matched, 0) AS already_matched,
                           ROUND(COALESCE(rt.returned_base, 0) / COALESCE(NULLIF(h.exch_rate, 0), 1), 2) AS returned_value,
                           SUM(gd.qty_received * gd.unit_cost) - COALESCE(im.already_matched, 0)
                             - ROUND(COALESCE(rt.returned_base, 0) / COALESCE(NULLIF(h.exch_rate, 0), 1), 2) AS remaining,
                           COALESCE(po.ppn_mode, 'NONE') AS ppn_mode, COALESCE(po.ppn_rate, 0) AS ppn_rate,
                           UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(cur.init, ''))) AS currency_code
                    FROM grn_hdr h
                    JOIN grn_dtl gd ON gd.grn_hdr_id = h.id
                    LEFT JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id = h.po_id
                    LEFT JOIN m_currency cur ON cur.id = h.currency_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT grn_hdr_id, SUM(matched_amount) AS already_matched
                        FROM purchase_invoice_dtl
                        GROUP BY grn_hdr_id
                    ) im ON im.grn_hdr_id = h.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT r.grn_hdr_id, SUM(sd.qty_claim * sd.unit_cost) AS returned_base
                          FROM supplier_return_hdr sh
                          JOIN supplier_return_dtl sd ON sd.return_hdr_id = sh.id
                          JOIN wh_receiving_hdr r ON r.id = sh.wh_receiving_hdr_id
                         WHERE sh.status IN ('Dikirim', 'Kredit')
                         GROUP BY r.grn_hdr_id
                    ) rt ON rt.grn_hdr_id = h.id
                    WHERE COALESCE(LOWER(h.status), '') NOT IN ('cancelled','canceled','dibatalkan','void','reversed')
                      AND h.approval_status = 'APPROVED'  -- [GAP #7] Hanya GRN yang sudah disetujui
                      AND ($1 = 0 OR h.supplier_id = $1)
                    GROUP BY h.id, h.ref_no, h.grn_date, h.supplier_id, h.exch_rate, h.approval_status, im.already_matched, rt.returned_base,
                             po.ppn_mode, po.ppn_rate, cur.init
                    -- Invoicing partial dibolehkan: GRN tetap muncul selama masih ada sisa nilai (setelah retur) yang belum di-match.
                    HAVING SUM(gd.qty_received * gd.unit_cost) - COALESCE(im.already_matched, 0)
                           - ROUND(COALESCE(rt.returned_base, 0) / COALESCE(NULLIF(h.exch_rate, 0), 1), 2) > 0.004
                    ORDER BY h.grn_date DESC";

                $row['returned_value'] = floatval($row['returned_value']);   // [RETUR]
                $row['ppn_rate'] = floatval($row['ppn_rate']);               // [PPN]

            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
            break;

        case 'read_invoice_detail':
            $invoice_id = isset($_REQUEST['invoice_id']) ? intval($_REQUEST['invoice_id']) : 0;

            // [FIX] Kolom sebelumnya (d.invoice_id, d.grn_dtl_id) tidak ada
            // di tabel purchase_invoice_dtl -> query selalu gagal.
            // grn_hdr_id mengarah ke grn_hdr (dokumen), jadi di-JOIN +
            // GROUP BY ke grn_dtl untuk tetap dapat qty/harga/nama item.
            $sql = "SELECT d.id, d.invoice_hdr_id, d.grn_hdr_id, d.matched_amount, d.remark,
                           h.ref_no AS grn_ref_no,
                           COALESCE(po.ppn_mode, 'NONE') AS ppn_mode, COALESCE(po.ppn_rate, 0) AS ppn_rate,   -- [PPN] mode & tarif PO
                           string_agg(DISTINCT gd.item_name, ', ') AS item_name,
                           SUM(gd.qty_received) AS qty_received,
                           CASE WHEN SUM(gd.qty_received) > 0
                                THEN SUM(gd.qty_received * gd.unit_cost) / SUM(gd.qty_received)
                                ELSE 0 END AS unit_cost,
                           SUM(gd.qty_received * gd.unit_cost) AS grn_total
                    FROM purchase_invoice_dtl d
                    JOIN grn_hdr h ON h.id = d.grn_hdr_id
                    LEFT JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id = h.po_id
                    LEFT JOIN grn_dtl gd ON gd.grn_hdr_id = h.id

        case 'read_invoice_print':

            $sqlH = "SELECT h.id, h.inv_no, h.supplier_invoice_no, h.invoice_date, h.created_at, h.status,

            $resH = pg_query_params($sqlH, [$invoice_id]);

            $hdr = pg_fetch_assoc($resH);
            if (!$hdr) throw new Exception('Invoice tidak ditemukan.');
            $hdr['total_amount'] = floatval($hdr['total_amount']);
            $hdr['dpp_amount'] = floatval($hdr['dpp_amount']);     // [PPN]

                     FROM purchase_invoice_dtl d
                     JOIN grn_hdr g ON g.id = d.grn_hdr_id
                     LEFT JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.id = g.po_id
                     LEFT JOIN m_currency cur ON cur.id = g.currency_id
                     WHERE d.invoice_hdr_id = $1
                     ORDER BY d.id";
            $resD = pg_query_params($sqlD, [$invoice_id]);
            if (!$resD) throw new Exception(pgErrorOrFallback('Gagal memuat rincian invoice.'));
            $items = [];
            while ($row = pg_fetch_assoc($resD)) {
                $row['matched_amount'] = floatval($row['matched_amount']);
                $items[] = $row;
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => ['header' => $hdr, 'items' => $items]]);
            break;

        case 'create':
        case 'update':
            // [JURNAL] seluruh penulisan memakai PDO dalam satu transaksi (header + detail + total + jurnal)
            $id = isset($_POST['id']) ? intval($_POST['id']) : 0;
            // [FIX] inv_no adalah No. Ref Dokumen yang di-generate sistem, bukan input user -> $_POST['inv_no'] diabaikan.
            $supplier_invoice_no = isset($_POST['supplier_invoice_no']) ? $_POST['supplier_invoice_no'] : '';
            $invoice_date = isset($_POST['invoice_date']) ? $_POST['invoice_date'] : date('Y-m-d');
            $supplier_id = isset($_POST['supplier_id']) ? intval($_POST['supplier_id']) : 0;
            $remark = isset($_POST['remark']) ? $_POST['remark'] : '';
            // [PPN] tarif & mode PPN diambil dari PO tiap GRN (input ppn_rate dari klien diabaikan);
            //       ppn_amount kosong = hitung otomatis, terisi = koreksi sesuai faktur (dalam toleransi)
            $ppn_amount_in = (isset($_POST['ppn_amount']) && $_POST['ppn_amount'] !== '') ? round(floatval($_POST['ppn_amount']), 2) : null;
            $fp_no      = isset($_POST['faktur_pajak_no']) ? trim($_POST['faktur_pajak_no']) : '';
            $fp_date    = isset($_POST['faktur_pajak_date']) ? trim($_POST['faktur_pajak_date']) : '';
            if ($fp_date !== '' && !preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', $fp_date)) throw new Exception('Tanggal faktur pajak tidak valid (YYYY-MM-DD).');
            if (!preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', $invoice_date)) throw new Exception('Tanggal invoice tidak valid (YYYY-MM-DD).');
            if ($supplier_id <= 0) throw new Exception('Supplier wajib dipilih.');

            $invoice_details = isset($_POST['invoice_details']) ? json_decode($_POST['invoice_details'], true) : [];
            if (!is_array($invoice_details) || !count($invoice_details)) throw new Exception('Minimal satu GRN harus di-match ke invoice.');

            $db = new crud();
            $db->beginTransaction();
            PiAssertJournalRefType($db);
            $prevMatched = [];                                    // [RETUR] diisi pada update

                // No. Ref Dokumen PINV-YYMM-NNNNN: nomor terakhir bulan ini + 1 (aman setelah ada invoice yang dihapus)
                $prefix = 'PINV-' . date('ym') . '-';
                $db->query("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(7201)");
$stSeq = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(inv_no, 5) AS integer)), 0) + 1
                                         FROM purchase_invoice_hdr WHERE inv_no LIKE :p AND inv_no ~ '-[0-9]{5}$'");
                $stSeq->execute([':p' => $prefix . '%']);
                $inv_no = $prefix . str_pad((string)$stSeq->fetchColumn(), 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);

                $created_by = isset($_SESSION['user_id']) ? intval($_SESSION['user_id']) : null;
                $stHdr = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO purchase_invoice_hdr (inv_no, supplier_invoice_no, invoice_date, supplier_id, remark, status, created_by)
                                       VALUES (:no, :sno, CAST(:d AS date), :sup, :rm, 'posted', :cb) RETURNING id");
                $stHdr->execute([':no' => $inv_no, ':sno' => $supplier_invoice_no, ':d' => $invoice_date, ':sup' => $supplier_id, ':rm' => $remark, ':cb' => $created_by]);
                $invoice_id = (int)$stHdr->fetchColumn();
            } else {
                $invoice_id = $id;
                $stCur = $db->prepare("SELECT inv_no FROM purchase_invoice_hdr WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $stCur->execute([':id' => $invoice_id]);
                $inv_no = $stCur->fetchColumn();
                if ($inv_no === false) throw new Exception('Invoice tidak ditemukan.');

                // [RETUR] nilai matched lama per GRN (sebelum dihapus) -> boleh dipertahankan walau retur datang setelah invoice
                $stPrev = $db->prepare("SELECT grn_hdr_id, SUM(matched_amount) AS m FROM purchase_invoice_dtl WHERE invoice_hdr_id = :id GROUP BY grn_hdr_id");
                $stPrev->execute([':id' => $invoice_id]);
                foreach ($stPrev->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $pv) $prevMatched[(int)$pv['grn_hdr_id']] = (float)$pv['m'];

                // [FIX] inv_no sengaja tidak ikut di SET -> No. Ref Dokumen immutable setelah dibuat.
                $stUp = $db->prepare("UPDATE purchase_invoice_hdr SET supplier_invoice_no = :sno, invoice_date = CAST(:d AS date), supplier_id = :sup, remark = :rm WHERE id = :id");
                $stUp->execute([':sno' => $supplier_invoice_no, ':d' => $invoice_date, ':sup' => $supplier_id, ':rm' => $remark, ':id' => $invoice_id]);
                $db->prepare("DELETE FROM purchase_invoice_dtl WHERE invoice_hdr_id = :id")->execute([':id' => $invoice_id]);
            }

            // [PPN][RETUR] validasi tiap GRN terhadap supplier, mata uang, nilai bersih setelah retur; kelompokkan per mode/tarif PO
            $total_amount_header = 0;
            $groups = [];                  // key "MODE|rate" => subtotal DPP (mata uang PO)
            $dppBase = 0.0;                // DPP dalam mata uang dasar (untuk jurnal)
            $curCode = null;
            $seenGrn = [];
            $stDtl = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO purchase_invoice_dtl (invoice_hdr_id, grn_hdr_id, matched_amount) VALUES (:h, :g, :m)");
            foreach ($invoice_details as $item) {
                $grn_hdr_id = intval(isset($item['grn_hdr_id']) ? $item['grn_hdr_id'] : (isset($item['grn_dtl_id']) ? $item['grn_dtl_id'] : 0));
                $matched_amount = round(floatval($item['matched_amount']), 2);
                if ($grn_hdr_id <= 0) throw new Exception('GRN pada rincian invoice tidak valid.');
                if ($matched_amount <= 0) throw new Exception('Nominal matched harus lebih besar dari 0.');
                if (isset($seenGrn[$grn_hdr_id])) throw new Exception('GRN yang sama tidak boleh muncul dua kali dalam satu invoice.');
                $seenGrn[$grn_hdr_id] = true;

                $gi = PiGrnInfo($db, $grn_hdr_id, $invoice_id);
                if (!$gi) throw new Exception('GRN pada rincian invoice tidak ditemukan.');
                if ($gi['supplier_id'] !== null && (int)$gi['supplier_id'] !== $supplier_id) {
                    throw new Exception('GRN ' . $gi['ref_no'] . ' bukan milik supplier yang dipilih.');
                }
                if ($curCode === null) $curCode = $gi['currency_code'];
                elseif ($curCode !== $gi['currency_code']) throw new Exception('Satu invoice hanya boleh satu mata uang (' . $curCode . ' dan ' . $gi['currency_code'] . ' tercampur).');

                // batas: tidak boleh melebihi nilai GRN - invoice lain; penambahan di atas nilai lama dibatasi nilai bersih setelah retur
                $grossCap = round($gi['grn_total'] - $gi['matched_other'], 2);
                $netCap   = round($gi['grn_total'] - $gi['returned'] - $gi['matched_other'], 2);
                $prev     = isset($prevMatched[$grn_hdr_id]) ? $prevMatched[$grn_hdr_id] : 0.0;
                $allowed  = min($grossCap, max($netCap, $prev));
                if ($matched_amount > $allowed + 0.005) {
                    throw new Exception('GRN ' . $gi['ref_no'] . ': nominal matched (' . number_format($matched_amount, 2) . ') melebihi sisa yang boleh di-invoice (' .
                        number_format(max($allowed, 0), 2) . ($gi['returned'] > 0 ? ', sudah dikurangi retur ' . number_format($gi['returned'], 2) : '') . ').');
                }

                $total_amount_header += $matched_amount;
                $key = strtoupper($gi['ppn_mode']) . '|' . $gi['ppn_rate'];
                $groups[$key] = (isset($groups[$key]) ? $groups[$key] : 0.0) + $matched_amount;
                $dppBase += round($matched_amount * $gi['exch_rate'], 2);
                $stDtl->execute([':h' => $invoice_id, ':g' => $grn_hdr_id, ':m' => $matched_amount]);
            }

            // [PPN] DPP = jumlah matched ; PPN = hitungan per kelompok mode/tarif PO (pembulatan di level kelompok)
            $dpp = round($total_amount_header, 2);
            $ppn_calc = 0.0; $rates = [];
            foreach ($groups as $key => $sub) {
                list($gm, $gr) = explode('|', $key);
                $p = PiPpnFromDpp(round($sub, 2), $gm, (float)$gr);
                if ($p > 0) { $ppn_calc += $p; $rates[(string)(float)$gr] = true; }
            }
            $ppn_calc = round($ppn_calc, 2);
            if ($ppn_calc > 0 && $ppn_amount_in !== null) {
                if (abs($ppn_amount_in - $ppn_calc) > PI_PPN_TOLERANCE) {
                    throw new Exception('PPN yang diinput (' . number_format($ppn_amount_in, 2) . ') berbeda dari hitungan menurut PO (' .
                        number_format($ppn_calc, 2) . ') lebih dari toleransi ' . number_format(PI_PPN_TOLERANCE, 2) . '. Kosongkan kolom PPN untuk hitung otomatis.');
                }
                $ppn_amount_final = $ppn_amount_in;
            } else {
                $ppn_amount_final = $ppn_calc;       // PO tanpa PPN -> PPN 0, input klien diabaikan
            }
            $total_with_ppn = round($dpp + $ppn_amount_final, 2);
            // tarif header: seragam -> tarif itu; campur -> tarif efektif (informasi)
            if (!count($rates)) $ppn_rate = 0.0;
            elseif (count($rates) === 1) $ppn_rate = (float)array_keys($rates)[0];
            else $ppn_rate = ($dpp > 0) ? round($ppn_amount_final / $dpp * 100, 2) : 0.0;
            // nilai jurnal dalam mata uang dasar: DPP x kurs GRN; PPN proporsional terhadap DPP
            $ppnBase = ($dpp > 0) ? round($ppn_amount_final * ($dppBase / $dpp), 2) : 0.0;

            // [PPN] PPh supplier
            $pph_rate = isset($_POST['pph_rate']) ? round(floatval($_POST['pph_rate']), 2) : 0.0;
            $pph_amount = isset($_POST['pph_amount']) ? round(floatval($_POST['pph_amount']), 2) : 0.0;

            // [PPN] no. faktur pajak unik per supplier
            if ($fp_no !== '') {
                $stFp = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM purchase_invoice_hdr WHERE supplier_id = :s AND faktur_pajak_no = :f AND id <> :id LIMIT 1");
                $stFp->execute([':s' => $supplier_id, ':f' => $fp_no, ':id' => $invoice_id]);
                if ($stFp->fetchColumn()) throw new Exception('No. faktur pajak ' . $fp_no . ' sudah dipakai invoice lain dari supplier ini.');
            }
            // [PPN] total baru tidak boleh lebih kecil dari yang sudah dibayar
            $stPaid = $db->prepare("SELECT paid_amount FROM purchase_invoice_hdr WHERE id = :id");
            $stPaid->execute([':id' => $invoice_id]);
            $paidNow = floatval($stPaid->fetchColumn());
            if ($paidNow > $total_with_ppn + 0.005) {
                throw new Exception('Total invoice (' . number_format($total_with_ppn, 2) . ') lebih kecil dari yang sudah dibayar (' . number_format($paidNow, 2) . ').');
            }

            $stTot = $db->prepare("UPDATE purchase_invoice_hdr
                                      SET total_amount = :t, dpp_amount = :dpp, ppn_rate = :pr, ppn_amount = :pa,
                                          pph_rate = :pthr, pph_amount = :ptha,
                                          faktur_pajak_no = :fn, faktur_pajak_date = CAST(:fd AS date)
                                    WHERE id = :id");
            $stTot->execute([':t' => $total_with_ppn, ':dpp' => $dpp, ':pr' => $ppn_rate, ':pa' => $ppn_amount_final,
                             ':pthr' => $pph_rate, ':ptha' => $pph_amount,
                             ':fn' => $fp_no !== '' ? $fp_no : null, ':fd' => $fp_date !== '' ? $fp_date : null, ':id' => $invoice_id]);

            // [JURNAL] edit: buang jurnal lama lalu posting ulang sesuai nilai terbaru
            if (PiHasJournal($db, $invoice_id)) ReverseJournalByReference($db, PI_JOURNAL_REF, $invoice_id);
            PiPostJournal($db, $invoice_id, $inv_no, $supplier_invoice_no, $invoice_date, $dppBase, $ppnBase, $pph_amount);   // mata uang dasar

            $db->commit();

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Data purchase invoice berhasil disimpan.']);
            break;

        case 'delete':
            $id = isset($_POST['id']) ? intval($_POST['id']) : 0;
            if ($id <= 0) throw new Exception('ID invoice tidak valid.');
            $db = new crud();
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $stLk = $db->prepare("SELECT inv_no, paid_amount FROM purchase_invoice_hdr WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
            $stLk->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $rowLk = $stLk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$rowLk) throw new Exception('Invoice tidak ditemukan.');
            $stPay = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM supplier_payment_items WHERE invoice_id = :id LIMIT 1");
            $stPay->execute([':id' => $id]);
            if (floatval($rowLk['paid_amount']) > 0.005 || $stPay->fetchColumn()) {
                throw new Exception('Invoice ' . $rowLk['inv_no'] . ' sudah ada pembayaran supplier, tidak dapat dihapus. Hapus pembayarannya terlebih dahulu.');
            }

            if (PiHasJournal($db, $id)) ReverseJournalByReference($db, PI_JOURNAL_REF, $id);   // [JURNAL] jurnal ikut dibatalkan
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM purchase_invoice_dtl WHERE invoice_hdr_id = :id")->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM purchase_invoice_hdr WHERE id = :id")->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Data berhasil dihapus.']);
            break;

        // [JURNAL] Backfill sekali pakai: posting jurnal untuk invoice lama yang belum dijurnal.
        //   task=backfill_journal            -> preview (hanya baca)
        //   task=backfill_journal&confirm=YA -> jalankan (POST)
        case 'backfill_journal':
            $db = new crud();
            $stList = $db->query("SELECT h.id, h.inv_no, h.supplier_invoice_no, h.invoice_date, h.dpp_amount, h.ppn_amount, h.total_amount
                                    FROM purchase_invoice_hdr h
                                   WHERE LOWER(h.status) NOT IN ('cancelled','canceled','dibatalkan','void','reversed')
                                     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries j WHERE j.reference_type::text = '" . PI_JOURNAL_REF . "' AND j.reference_id = h.id)
                                   ORDER BY h.id");
            $todo = $stList->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            $run = (isset($_POST['confirm']) && $_POST['confirm'] === 'YA' && $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST');
            if ($run && count($todo)) {
                $db->beginTransaction();
                PiAssertJournalRefType($db);
                foreach ($todo as $r) {
                    $dppTxn = round(floatval($r['dpp_amount']), 2);
$ppnTxn = round(floatval($r['ppn_amount']), 2);
$dppBase = round(floatval($r['dpp_base']), 2);
$ppnBase = ($dppTxn > 0) ? round($ppnTxn * ($dppBase / $dppTxn), 2) : 0.0;
PiPostJournal($db, (int)$r['id'], $r['inv_no'], (string)$r['supplier_invoice_no'], $r['invoice_date'], $dppBase, $ppnBase);
                }
                $db->commit();
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($todo), 'data' => $todo,
                              'message' => $run ? count($todo) . ' invoice berhasil dijurnal.'
                                                : count($todo) . ' invoice belum dijurnal (preview, belum ada yang diubah). Kirim POST task=backfill_journal&confirm=YA untuk menjalankan.']);
            break;

        default:
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
            break;
    }
} catch (Exception $e) {
    if (isset($db) && is_object($db) && method_exists($db, 'inTransaction') && $db->inTransaction()) {      // [JURNAL] transaksi PDO
        $db->rollBack();
    }
    if (function_exists('pg_query')) {
        @pg_query("ROLLBACK");
    }
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/php-func/app.url.php';
/**
 * project.progressCRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Backend Progress Proyek (level proyek) -- project.progress.js
 * Pola sama dengan poCRD.php: PDO (class crud), dispatch lewat $_REQUEST['task'], respons JSON {success, message, data}.
 *
 * Tujuan: progress proyek (projects.progress) TIDAK lagi bisa diketik bebas. Alurnya:
 *   lapangan mengajukan klaim (persen + bukti) -> orang LAIN memverifikasi / menolak -> baru projects.progress berubah.
 *
 * Pembanding otomatis (Earned Value sederhana, semua dalam mata uang dasar):
 *   Nilai hasil  = Budget (x kurs anggaran) x progress terverifikasi
 *   Biaya aktual = pemakaian material (issue PROJECT, posted) + biaya non-material (financial_expenses)
 *   Indeks biaya = Nilai hasil / Biaya aktual   (< PROG_CPI_YELLOW kuning, < PROG_CPI_RED merah)
 *
 * Aturan:
 *  1. Lapor progress   : akses >= PROG_ACCESS_REPORT; proyek harus berstatus Berjalan / Tertunda.
 *  2. Klaim            : persen harus LEBIH BESAR dari progress terverifikasi, maks 100; bukti wajib (PROG_REQUIRE_EVIDENCE);
 *                        hanya satu klaim yang boleh menunggu verifikasi per proyek.
 *  3. Verifikasi/tolak : akses >= PROG_ACCESS_VERIFY; pemverifikasi tidak boleh pelapor sendiri (PROG_ALLOW_SELF_VERIFY = false);
 *                        tolak wajib catatan; setujui saat indeks biaya MERAH wajib catatan. Saat disetujui, posisi
 *                        budget / biaya / indeks disimpan sebagai jejak audit (snap_*).
 *  4. Batal            : pelapor (atau akses verifikasi) dapat membatalkan klaim yang masih Diajukan.
 *  5. Bukti          : boleh berupa file unggahan (foto / PDF, maks 5 file x 5 MB -> /rab-project/uploads/progress/) dan/atau teks (no. BAP).
 *                      Beberapa bukti disimpan satu per baris di evidence_ref (butuh kolom text: sql/2026-10-13.progress_evidence.sql).
 *  Butuh sql/2026-10-12.project_progress.sql.
 * ============================================================
 */

ini_set('display_errors', '0');
ob_start();

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$db = new crud();

const PROG_ACCESS_REPORT    = 2;
const PROG_ACCESS_VERIFY    = 3;
const PROG_CPI_YELLOW       = 0.90;     // indeks biaya di bawah ini -> KUNING
const PROG_CPI_RED          = 0.80;     // indeks biaya di bawah ini -> MERAH
const PROG_REQUIRE_EVIDENCE = true;     // bukti (no. foto / BAP / link) wajib pada klaim
const PROG_ALLOW_SELF_VERIFY = false;   // false = pelapor tidak boleh memverifikasi klaimnya sendiri
const PROG_COST_LAG_WARN    = 25;       // progress mendahului realisasi biaya >= gap ini -> PERINGATAN (lunak, tidak memblokir)

class ProgBusinessError extends Exception {}

function sendJsonResponse($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $response = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        if (is_array($data) && isset($data['data'])) {
            $response['data'] = $data['data'];
            if (isset($data['totalCount'])) $response['totalCount'] = $data['totalCount'];
        } else {
            $response['data'] = $data;
        }
    }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($response, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

function prog_fmt($n): string { return number_format((float)$n, 2, ',', '.'); }

function prog_text($s, int $len): string {
    $s = trim((string)$s);
    if (function_exists('mb_substr')) return mb_substr($s, 0, $len, 'UTF-8');
    $chars = preg_split('//u', $s, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
    return $chars === false ? substr($s, 0, $len) : implode('', array_slice($chars, 0, $len));
}

function prog_need_access(int $min, string $what) {
    if (intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < $min) {
        throw new ProgBusinessError("Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk {$what}.");
    }
}

/** Status indikator dari indeks biaya. */
function prog_status(float $budgetBase, float $actual, ?float $cpi): string {
    if ($budgetBase <= 0) return 'NO BUDGET';
    if ($actual <= 0 || $cpi === null) return '-';
    if ($cpi < PROG_CPI_RED) return 'MERAH';
    if ($cpi < PROG_CPI_YELLOW) return 'KUNING';
    return 'OK';
}

/**
 * Metrik per proyek (satu proyek bila $projectId > 0). $progressOverride = hitung seolah-olah progress sebesar itu
 * (dipakai saat verifikasi untuk menghitung indeks pada progress yang diklaim).
 * [F-1.2 2026-11-16] Realisasi biaya TIDAK dihitung ulang di sini: satu rumus = view public.v_project_actual_cost
 * (via ProjectActualCost() di function.all.php). cost_actual = material + expense + prestasi subkon tersertifikasi.
 */
function prog_metrics($db, int $projectId = 0, string $query = '', ?int $progressOverride = null): array {
    $where = []; $params = [];
    if ($projectId > 0) { $where[] = 'p.id = :id'; $params[':id'] = $projectId; }
    if ($query !== '') { $where[] = 'p.name ILIKE :q'; $params[':q'] = '%' . $query . '%'; }
    $w = $where ? 'WHERE ' . implode(' AND ', $where) : '';
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT p.id, p.name, p.status, COALESCE(p.progress, 0) AS progress,
               COALESCE(p.contract_value, 0) AS contract_value,
               COALESCE(pend.n, 0) AS pending_count
          FROM projects p
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM project_progress_log WHERE status = 'Diajukan' GROUP BY project_id) pend ON pend.project_id = p.id
          {$w}
         ORDER BY p.id DESC");
    $st->execute($params);
    $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    foreach ($rows as &$r) {
        $pid = (int)$r['id'];
        $r['id'] = $pid;
        $ov = $progressOverride !== null ? (float)$progressOverride : null;
        $ac = ProjectActualCost($db, $pid, $ov);                     // [F-1.2] satu rumus terpadu
        $curProgress = (int)($progressOverride !== null ? $progressOverride : (int)$r['progress']);
        $r['progress'] = $curProgress;
        $r['pending_count'] = (int)$r['pending_count'];
        if ($ac === null) {
            // fallback defensif bila view belum dimigrasi: angka 0 + status NO BUDGET, jangan gagalkan daftar proyek
            $bb = 0.0; $cm = 0.0; $co = 0.0; $cs = 0.0; $actual = 0.0; $ev = 0.0; $cpi = null;
        } else {
            $bb = $ac['budget_base'];
            $cm = $ac['cost_material'];
            $co = $ac['cost_expense'];
            $cs = $ac['cost_subcon'];
            $actual = $ac['cost_total'];
            $ev = $ac['earned_value'];
            $cpi = $ac['cpi'];
        }
        $r['budget_base'] = round($bb, 2); $r['contract_value'] = (float)$r['contract_value'];
        $r['cost_material'] = round($cm, 2); $r['cost_other'] = round($co, 2); $r['cost_subcon'] = round($cs, 2);
        $r['cost_actual'] = round($actual, 2);
        $r['earned_value'] = round($ev, 2);
        $r['cost_pct'] = $bb > 0 ? round($actual / $bb * 100, 2) : null;
        $r['cpi'] = $cpi;
        $r['cpi_status'] = prog_status($bb, $actual, $cpi);
    }
    return $rows;
}

if (empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login ulang.');
}
$userId = (int)$_SESSION['user_id'];
$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';
if ((int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < 1) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Hak baca progres proyek tidak tersedia.');
if (in_array($task, ['upload_evidence', 'submit_claim', 'verify', 'cancel_claim'], true)
    && ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== 'POST') {
    http_response_code(405);
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Metode harus POST untuk perubahan progres proyek.');
}

try {
    switch ($task) {

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Daftar proyek + indikator progress vs biaya
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'list_projects':
            $rows = prog_metrics($db, 0, trim((string)($_REQUEST['query'] ?? '')));
            sendJsonResponse(true, ['data' => $rows, 'totalCount' => count($rows)], '',
                             ['thresholds' => ['yellow' => PROG_CPI_YELLOW, 'red' => PROG_CPI_RED]]);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Riwayat klaim satu proyek
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'list_log':
            $pid = (int)($_REQUEST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($pid <= 0) throw new ProgBusinessError('Proyek tidak valid.');
            $st = $db->prepare("
                SELECT l.id, l.project_id, l.report_date, l.percent_claimed, l.prev_percent, l.reported_by,
                       COALESCE(er.employee_name, ur.login_name) AS reporter_name,
                       l.evidence_ref, l.note, l.status, l.verified_by,
                       COALESCE(ev.employee_name, uv.login_name) AS verifier_name,
                       l.verified_at, l.verify_note, l.snap_cost_base, l.snap_cpi, l.created_at
                  FROM project_progress_log l
                  LEFT JOIN m_user_system ur ON ur.id = l.reported_by
                  LEFT JOIN m_employee er ON er.id = ur.employee_id
                  LEFT JOIN m_user_system uv ON uv.id = l.verified_by
                  LEFT JOIN m_employee ev ON ev.id = uv.employee_id
                 WHERE l.project_id = :p
                 ORDER BY l.report_date DESC, l.id DESC");
            $st->execute([':p' => $pid]);
            $rows = $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                $r['id'] = (int)$r['id'];
                $r['percent_claimed'] = (int)$r['percent_claimed'];
                $r['prev_percent'] = (int)$r['prev_percent'];
                $r['reported_by'] = $r['reported_by'] !== null ? (int)$r['reported_by'] : null;
                $r['snap_cost_base'] = $r['snap_cost_base'] !== null ? (float)$r['snap_cost_base'] : null;
                $r['snap_cpi'] = $r['snap_cpi'] !== null ? (float)$r['snap_cpi'] : null;
            }
            sendJsonResponse(true, $rows, '', ['user_id' => $userId, 'allow_self_verify' => PROG_ALLOW_SELF_VERIFY]);      // [CHANGED] + flag untuk tampilan tombol
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * [NEW] Unggah bukti progress (foto / PDF, maks 5 MB) -> /rab-project/uploads/progress/, kembalikan URL.
         *       Pola sama dengan upload bukti pengiriman di warehouse.issuingCRD.php.
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'upload_evidence':
            prog_need_access(PROG_ACCESS_REPORT, 'mengunggah bukti progress');
            if (empty($_FILES['file']) || $_FILES['file']['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                $code = isset($_FILES['file']['error']) ? (int)$_FILES['file']['error'] : -1;
                throw new ProgBusinessError('File gagal diunggah (kode ' . $code . '). Cek batas upload_max_filesize / post_max_size di php.ini.');
            }
            $f = $_FILES['file'];
            if ($f['size'] > 5 * 1024 * 1024) throw new ProgBusinessError('Ukuran file maksimal 5 MB.');
            $allowed = ['jpg' => 'image/jpeg', 'jpeg' => 'image/jpeg', 'png' => 'image/png',
                        'webp' => 'image/webp', 'gif' => 'image/gif', 'pdf' => 'application/pdf'];
            $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($f['name'], PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
            if (!isset($allowed[$ext])) throw new ProgBusinessError('Tipe file tidak diizinkan. Gunakan JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF atau PDF.');
            if (function_exists('finfo_open')) {                 // cek isi file, bukan hanya ekstensi
                $fi = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
                $mime = finfo_file($fi, $f['tmp_name']);
                finfo_close($fi);
                if ($mime !== $allowed[$ext]) throw new ProgBusinessError('Isi file tidak sesuai dengan ekstensinya.');
            }
            $dir = dirname(__DIR__) . '/uploads/progress';
            if (!is_dir($dir) && !@mkdir($dir, 0755, true)) {
                throw new ProgBusinessError('Folder uploads/progress tidak bisa dibuat. Buat manual dan beri izin tulis untuk user web server.');
            }
            $ht = $dir . '/.htaccess';                           // larang eksekusi script di folder upload
            if (!file_exists($ht)) {
                @file_put_contents($ht, "<FilesMatch \"\\.(php|phtml|phar|pl|cgi)$\">\n    Require all denied\n</FilesMatch>\n");
            }
            $name = 'prg_' . date('Ymd_His') . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4)) . '.' . $ext;
            if (!move_uploaded_file($f['tmp_name'], $dir . '/' . $name)) {
                throw new ProgBusinessError('Gagal menyimpan file. Cek izin tulis folder uploads/progress.');
            }
            /*$destination = $dir . '/' . $name;

            $moveResult = move_uploaded_file($f['tmp_name'], $destination);

            if (!$moveResult) {
                $lastError = error_get_last();

                error_log('PROGRESS UPLOAD DIAGNOSTIC: ' . json_encode([

                    'last_error' => $lastError

            }*/

            sendJsonResponse(true, ['url' => rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') . '/uploads/progress/' . rawurlencode($name), 'name' => $name]);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Ajukan klaim progress
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'submit_claim':
            prog_need_access(PROG_ACCESS_REPORT, 'melaporkan progress');
            $pid  = (int)($_POST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            $date = (string)($_POST['report_date'] ?? '');
            $pct  = (int)round((float)($_POST['percent_claimed'] ?? -1));
            $note = prog_text($_POST['note'] ?? '', 1000);
            $evid = prog_text($_POST['evidence_ref'] ?? '', 2000);      // [CHANGED] banyak bukti (URL + teks), satu per baris

            $d = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $date);
            if (!$d || $d->format('Y-m-d') !== $date) throw new ProgBusinessError('Tanggal laporan tidak valid.');
            if ($date > date('Y-m-d')) throw new ProgBusinessError('Tanggal laporan tidak boleh di masa depan.');
            if ($pct < 0 || $pct > 100) throw new ProgBusinessError('Persen progress harus antara 0 - 100.');
            if (PROG_REQUIRE_EVIDENCE && $evid === '') throw new ProgBusinessError('Bukti (no. foto / BAP / link) wajib diisi.');

            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT name, status, COALESCE(progress, 0) AS progress FROM projects WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $st->execute([':id' => $pid]);
                $pj = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$pj) throw new ProgBusinessError('Proyek tidak ditemukan.');
                if (!in_array($pj['status'], ['Berjalan', 'Tertunda'], true)) {
                    throw new ProgBusinessError("Progress hanya bisa dilaporkan untuk proyek berstatus Berjalan / Tertunda (status sekarang: {$pj['status']}).");
                }
                $cur = (int)$pj['progress'];
                if ($pct <= $cur) {
                    throw new ProgBusinessError("Klaim {$pct}% harus lebih besar dari progress terverifikasi saat ini ({$cur}%).");
                }
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM project_progress_log WHERE project_id = :p AND status = 'Diajukan'");
                $st->execute([':p' => $pid]);
                if ($st->fetchColumn()) throw new ProgBusinessError('Masih ada klaim progress yang menunggu verifikasi. Verifikasi / batalkan dulu.');

                // [F-1.1 2026-11-16] Kontrol klaim vs realisasi biaya (satu rumus: v_project_actual_cost).
                $warn = [];
                $ac = ProjectActualCost($db, $pid);
                if ($ac !== null) {
                    // Hard-block: klaim 100% tanpa satu pun material terpakai (temuan audit A1).
                    if ($pct >= 100 && $ac['cost_material'] <= 0) {
                        throw new ProgBusinessError(
                            'Klaim 100% DITOLAK: belum ada realisasi pemakaian material (issue material Rp 0) untuk proyek ini. ' .
                            'Catat issue material di modul Warehouse Issuing terlebih dahulu, atau ajukan klaim di bawah 100%.');
                    }
                    $usagePct = $ac['budget_base'] > 0 ? $ac['cost_total'] / $ac['budget_base'] * 100 : null;
                    if ($usagePct !== null && $pct - $usagePct >= PROG_COST_LAG_WARN) {
                        $warn[] = 'PERHATIAN: klaim ' . $pct . '% melampaui realisasi biaya ' . round($usagePct, 1) . '% (gap +' .
                            round($pct - $usagePct) . '). Pastikan bukti lapangan lengkap; verifikator wajib mengisi catatan.';
                    }
                }

                $st = $db->prepare("
                    INSERT INTO project_progress_log (project_id, report_date, percent_claimed, prev_percent, reported_by, note, evidence_ref, status)
                    VALUES (:p, CAST(:d AS date), :pct, :prev, :u, :n, :e, 'Diajukan') RETURNING id");
                $st->execute([':p' => $pid, ':d' => $date, ':pct' => $pct, ':prev' => $cur, ':u' => $userId,
                              ':n' => $note !== '' ? $note : null, ':e' => $evid !== '' ? $evid : null]);
                $id = (int)$st->fetchColumn();
                $db->commit();
                $msg = "Klaim progress {$pct}% untuk {$pj['name']} diajukan, menunggu verifikasi.";
                if (!empty($warn)) { $msg .= ' ' . implode(' ', $warn); }
                sendJsonResponse(true, ['id' => $id, 'warning' => $warn ? implode(' ', $warn) : null], $msg);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Verifikasi / tolak klaim
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'verify':
            prog_need_access(PROG_ACCESS_VERIFY, 'memverifikasi progress');
            $id       = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $decision = (string)($_POST['decision'] ?? '');
            $vnote    = prog_text($_POST['verify_note'] ?? '', 1000);
            if (!in_array($decision, ['Diverifikasi', 'Ditolak'], true)) throw new ProgBusinessError('Keputusan tidak valid.');

            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM project_progress_log WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $cl = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$cl) throw new ProgBusinessError('Klaim tidak ditemukan.');
                if ($cl['status'] !== 'Diajukan') throw new ProgBusinessError("Klaim ini sudah berstatus {$cl['status']}.");
                if (!PROG_ALLOW_SELF_VERIFY && (int)$cl['reported_by'] === $userId) {
                    throw new ProgBusinessError('Klaim tidak boleh diverifikasi oleh pelapornya sendiri. Minta PM / QS lain memverifikasi.');
                }
                $pid = (int)$cl['project_id'];
                $pct = (int)$cl['percent_claimed'];

                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT name, COALESCE(progress, 0) AS progress FROM projects WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $st->execute([':id' => $pid]);
                $pj = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$pj) throw new ProgBusinessError('Proyek tidak ditemukan.');

                if ($decision === 'Ditolak') {
                    if ($vnote === '') throw new ProgBusinessError('Alasan penolakan wajib diisi.');
                    $st = $db->prepare("UPDATE project_progress_log SET status = 'Ditolak', verified_by = :u, verified_at = NOW(), verify_note = :n WHERE id = :id");
                    $st->execute([':u' => $userId, ':n' => $vnote, ':id' => $id]);
                    $db->commit();
                    sendJsonResponse(true, [], "Klaim {$pct}% ditolak.");
                }

                // Setujui: hitung posisi biaya pada progress yang diklaim, simpan sebagai jejak audit
                if ($pct <= (int)$pj['progress']) {
                    throw new ProgBusinessError("Klaim {$pct}% tidak lebih besar dari progress terverifikasi sekarang ({$pj['progress']}%). Tolak atau batalkan klaim ini.");
                }
                // [F-1.1 2026-11-16] Hard-block yang sama seperti submit_claim, ditegakkan ulang saat verifikasi:
                // bila antara pengajuan dan verifikasi belum ada issue material, klaim 100% tetap ditolak (audit A1).
                $acV = ProjectActualCost($db, $pid);
                if ($acV !== null && $pct >= 100 && $acV['cost_material'] <= 0) {
                    throw new ProgBusinessError(
                        'Klaim 100% DITOLAK: belum ada realisasi pemakaian material (issue material Rp 0) untuk proyek ini. ' .
                        'Catat issue material di modul Warehouse Issuing terlebih dahulu.');
                }
                $m = prog_metrics($db, $pid, '', $pct)[0] ?? null;
                if (!$m) throw new ProgBusinessError('Data proyek tidak ditemukan.');
                if ($m['cpi'] !== null && $m['cpi'] < PROG_CPI_RED && $vnote === '') {
                    throw new ProgBusinessError('Indeks biaya pada progress ' . $pct . '% adalah ' . number_format($m['cpi'], 2, ',', '.') .
                        ' (di bawah ' . number_format(PROG_CPI_RED, 2, ',', '.') . '): biaya terpakai ' . prog_fmt($m['cost_actual']) .
                        ' jauh melebihi nilai pekerjaan ' . prog_fmt($m['earned_value']) . '. Isi catatan verifikasi bila tetap disetujui.');
                }
                $st = $db->prepare("
                    UPDATE project_progress_log
                       SET status = 'Diverifikasi', verified_by = :u, verified_at = NOW(), verify_note = :n,
                           snap_budget_base = :sb, snap_cost_base = :sc, snap_cpi = :cpi
                     WHERE id = :id");
                $st->execute([':u' => $userId, ':n' => $vnote !== '' ? $vnote : null, ':sb' => $m['budget_base'],
                              ':sc' => $m['cost_actual'], ':cpi' => $m['cpi'], ':id' => $id]);
                $st = $db->prepare("UPDATE projects SET progress = :p WHERE id = :id");      // satu-satunya jalur yang mengubah progress
                $st->execute([':p' => $pct, ':id' => $pid]);
                $db->commit();
                sendJsonResponse(true, [], "Progress {$pj['name']} terverifikasi {$pct}%." .
                    ($m['cpi'] !== null ? ' Indeks biaya ' . number_format($m['cpi'], 2, ',', '.') . ' (' . $m['cpi_status'] . ').' : ''));
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Batalkan klaim yang masih Diajukan
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'cancel_claim':
            prog_need_access(PROG_ACCESS_REPORT, 'membatalkan klaim progress');
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT status, reported_by, percent_claimed FROM project_progress_log WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $cl = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$cl) throw new ProgBusinessError('Klaim tidak ditemukan.');
                if ($cl['status'] !== 'Diajukan') throw new ProgBusinessError("Klaim berstatus {$cl['status']} tidak dapat dibatalkan.");
                if ((int)$cl['reported_by'] !== $userId && intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < PROG_ACCESS_VERIFY) {
                    throw new ProgBusinessError('Hanya pelapor (atau pemverifikasi) yang dapat membatalkan klaim ini.');
                }
                $st = $db->prepare("UPDATE project_progress_log SET status = 'Dibatalkan', verified_by = :u, verified_at = NOW() WHERE id = :id");
                $st->execute([':u' => $userId, ':id' => $id]);
                $db->commit();
                sendJsonResponse(true, [], 'Klaim ' . (int)$cl['percent_claimed'] . '% dibatalkan.');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        default:
            sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.');
            break;
    }
} catch (ProgBusinessError $e) {
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[project.progressCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[project.progressCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}

Document      : m.expensesCRD.php
Description   : Backend CRUD Master Expense (sama pola dengan m.materialsCRD.php)

function exp_require_access($minimum, $message) {
    $current = (int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
    if ($current < $minimum) {
        exp_send(false, [], $message);
    }
}

$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';

function exp_send($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $response = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        if (is_array($data) && isset($data['data'])) {
            $response['data'] = $data['data'];
            if (isset($data['totalCount'])) $response['totalCount'] = $data['totalCount'];
        } else {
            $response['data'] = $data;
        }
    }
    echo json_encode($response, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

try {
    switch ($task) {
        /* --------------------------------------------------------------
         * LIST - Grid utama

        case 'list':

            $limit = (int)($_REQUEST['limit'] ?? 250);
            $query = trim($_REQUEST['query'] ?? '');

            $where = '';
            $params = [];
            if ($query !== '') {
                $where = "WHERE (expense_code ILIKE :q OR expense_name ILIKE :q OR category ILIKE :q)";
                $params[':q'] = '%' . $query . '%';
            }

            $stmtCount = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expense_master {$where}");
            $stmtCount->execute($params);
            $totalCount = (int)$stmtCount->fetchColumn();

            $stmt = $db->prepare("
                SELECT id, expense_code, expense_name, category, unit, default_price, active,
                       created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at
                FROM expense_master
                {$where}
                ORDER BY category, expense_name
                LIMIT :limit OFFSET :start
            ");
            foreach ($params as $k => $v) $stmt->bindValue($k, $v);
            $stmt->bindValue(':limit', $limit, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $stmt->bindValue(':start', $start, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $stmt->execute();

            $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                $r['id'] = (int)$r['id'];
                $r['default_price'] = (float)$r['default_price'];
                $r['active'] = ($r['active'] === true || $r['active'] === 't' || $r['active'] === '1');
                $r['created_by'] = $r['created_by'] ? (int)$r['created_by'] : null;
                $r['updated_by'] = $r['updated_by'] ? (int)$r['updated_by'] : null;
            }
            unset($r);

            exp_send(true, ['data' => $rows, 'totalCount' => $totalCount]);
            break;

         * READ_EDIT - Load data untuk form edit
         * -------------------------------------------------------------- */

            $row['id'] = (int)$row['id'];

                : 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menambah Master Expense.');
            $code = trim((string)($_POST['expense_code'] ?? ''));
            $name = trim((string)($_POST['expense_name'] ?? ''));

            $rawActive = $_POST['is_active'] ?? 'false';
            $active = in_array((string)$rawActive, ['true', '1', 't', 'on'], true);

            // Validasi
            if ($code === '') exp_send(false, [], 'Kode Expense wajib diisi.');
            if (strlen($code) > 30) exp_send(false, [], 'Kode Expense maksimal 30 karakter.');
            if ($name === '') exp_send(false, [], 'Nama Expense wajib diisi.');
            if (strlen($name) > 150) exp_send(false, [], 'Nama Expense maksimal 150 karakter.');
            if ($category === '') exp_send(false, [], 'Kategori wajib dipilih.');
            if ($unit === '') exp_send(false, [], 'Satuan wajib diisi.');
            if ($price < 0) exp_send(false, [], 'Harga Satuan tidak boleh negatif.');

            // Cek duplikasi kode (kecuali saat edit record yang sama)
            $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM expense_master WHERE expense_code = :code AND id <> :id");
            $stmtChk->execute([':code' => $code, ':id' => $id]);
            if ($stmtChk->fetchColumn()) {
                exp_send(false, [], 'Kode Expense "' . $code . '" sudah digunakan.');
            }

            $userId = (int)($_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0);

            if ($id > 0) {
                // UPDATE
                $stmt = $db->prepare("
                    UPDATE expense_master
                    SET expense_code = :code,
                        expense_name = :name,
                        category = :category,
                        unit = :unit,
                        default_price = :price,
                        active = :active,
                        updated_by = :uid,
                        updated_at = NOW()
                    WHERE id = :id
                ");
                $stmt->execute([
                    ':code' => $code, ':name' => $name, ':category' => $category,
                    ':unit' => $unit, ':price' => $price, ':active' => $active ? 't' : 'f',
                    ':uid' => $userId, ':id' => $id
                ]);
                exp_send(true, ['id' => $id, 'expense_code' => $code], 'Expense berhasil diupdate.');
            } else {
                // CREATE
                $stmt = $db->prepare("
                    INSERT INTO expense_master
                    (expense_code, expense_name, category, unit, default_price, active, created_by)
                    VALUES (:code, :name, :category, :unit, :price, :active, :uid)
                    RETURNING id
                ");
                $stmt->execute([
                    ':code' => $code, ':name' => $name, ':category' => $category,
                    ':unit' => $unit, ':price' => $price, ':active' => $active ? 't' : 'f',
                    ':uid' => $userId
                ]);
                $newId = (int)$stmt->fetchColumn();
                exp_send(true, ['id' => $newId, 'expense_code' => $code], 'Expense baru berhasil disimpan.');
            }
            break;

        /* --------------------------------------------------------------
         * DELETE - Soft delete (set active = false)
         * -------------------------------------------------------------- */
        case 'delete':
            exp_require_access(4, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menonaktifkan Master Expense.');
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            if ($id <= 0) exp_send(false, [], 'ID expense tidak valid.');

            $userId = (int)($_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0);

            $stmt = $db->prepare("

                WHERE id = :id
            ");
            $stmt->execute([':uid' => $userId, ':id' => $id]);

            exp_send(true, [], 'Expense berhasil dinonaktifkan.');
            break;

        /* --------------------------------------------------------------
         * LIST_OPTIONS - Untuk combo di RAB / modul lain
         * -------------------------------------------------------------- */
        case 'list_options':

                {$where}
                ORDER BY category, expense_name
            ");
            $stmt->execute($params);
            $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

                $r['default_price'] = (float)$r['default_price'];
                $r['label'] = $r['expense_name'] . ' (' . $r['unit'] . ')';
            }
            unset($r);
            exp_send(true, $rows);
            break;

        default:
            exp_send(false, [], 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task));
    }
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[m.expensesCRD] PDO: ' . $e->getMessage());
    exp_send(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {

    exp_send(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
/**
 * purchase.returnCRD.php — Retur Pembelian (Retur Supplier) untuk material cacat / rusak
 *
 * [CHANGED] Entry retur kini BERBASIS DOKUMEN W/H RCV:
 *   pilih satu RCV -> supplier, gudang, proyek (via GRN -> PO) dan PO terisi otomatis;
 *   daftar item = item pada RCV tsb; qty retur dibatasi:
 *      min( qty RCV - sudah diretur dari RCV ini,  stok gudang - klaim retur lain berstatus Diajukan )
 *   Gudang TIDAK lagi difilter berdasarkan warehouses.project_id (gudang utama dipakai bersama).
 *
 * Alur   : Diajukan --(Perintahkan W/H)--> Diperintahkan --(W/H: Siap Kirim)--> Disiapkan
 *          --(W/H: Konfirmasi Dikirim)--> Dikirim --(Selesaikan)--> Diganti | Kredit
 *          Diajukan --(Batalkan)--> Dibatalkan ; Diperintahkan/Disiapkan --(Batalkan Perintah)--> Diajukan
 *          Dikirim --(Batal Kirim)--> Diajukan (issue di-reverse, stok & jurnal dibalik)
 * [CHANGED 2026-10-11] 'Kirim' dipecah: Pembelian hanya MEMERINTAHKAN issue (dokumen issue status 'pending',
 *          stok belum keluar). Siap Kirim + Konfirmasi Dikirim dilakukan GUDANG di Warehouse Issuing
 *          (warehouse.issuingCRD.php: prepare / deliver) -> di situlah stok keluar FIFO + jurnal dibuat.
 * Order  : membuat dokumen ISSUE W/H (material_out_header.issue_type = 'SUPPLIER_RETURN'),
 *          stok keluar FIFO lewat stock_movements (reference_type 'MATERIAL_OUT', sama dengan Warehouse Issuing)
 *          sehingga tampil di Stock Card. Issue retur TIDAK menghitung kuota RAB +5%.
 * [NEW 2026-10-11] Jurnal otomatis (posted): Konfirmasi Dikirim di W/H -> Dr 2600 GRN Clearing / Cr 1500 Persediaan; Batal Kirim -> jurnal pembalik;
 *                  Selesaikan 'Kredit' -> Dr 2100 Hutang Usaha / Cr 2600. 'Ganti Barang' tanpa jurnal (RCV pengganti sudah menjurnal).
 *                  Mapping akun di fiscal_config (RETURN_SUPPLIER, RETURN_CREDIT_NOTE). Helper: php-func/journal.stock.php
 * Action : list | detail | lookup_rcv | rcv_items | save | order | cancel_order | unsend | resolve | cancel | upload_evidence
 * Butuh  : sql/2026-10-09.issue_return_fix.sql + sql/2026-10-09b.return_from_rcv.sql
 */
