/** Info mata uang untuk tampilan: dari snapshot GRN bila $grn_id > 0, selain itu dari PO. */
function GrnCurrencyInfo($po_id, $grn_id) {
    if ($grn_id > 0) {
        $res = pg_query_params("SELECT UPPER(TRIM(c.init)) AS code, COALESCE(NULLIF(g.exch_rate,0),1) AS exch_rate
                                  FROM grn_hdr g LEFT JOIN m_currency c ON c.id = g.currency_id WHERE g.id = $1", [$grn_id]);
    } else {
        $res = pg_query_params("SELECT UPPER(TRIM(c.init)) AS code, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.exch_rate,0),1) AS exch_rate
                                  FROM purchase_orders p LEFT JOIN m_currency c ON c.id = p.currency_id WHERE p.id = $1", [$po_id]);
    }
    PgOrFail($res, 'Gagal load mata uang');
    $row = pg_fetch_assoc($res) ?: [];
    $base = GrnBaseCode();
    return ['code' => $row['code'] ?: $base, 'base_code' => $base, 'exch_rate' => (float)($row['exch_rate'] ?? 1)];
}

function GetPoDtlTolerance($po_dtl_id, $po_qty, $exclude_grn_hdr_id = 0) {
    // Total Qty yang sudah diterima GRN lain untuk item PO ini
    $sql = "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_received),0) AS received_other
            FROM grn_dtl 
            WHERE po_item_id = $1 AND grn_hdr_id <> $2
              AND grn_hdr_id IN (SELECT id FROM grn_hdr WHERE COALESCE(LOWER(status),'') NOT IN ('cancelled','canceled','dibatalkan','void','reversed'))";
    $res = pg_query_params($sql, [$po_dtl_id, (int)$exclude_grn_hdr_id]);
    PgOrFail($res, 'Gagal cek akumulasi qty GRN');
    $row = pg_fetch_assoc($res);
    $receivedOther = (float)($row['received_other'] ?? 0);

    $stTol = pg_query_params("SELECT COALESCE(b.tolerance_pct,0) AS tol FROM po_items pi LEFT JOIN budget_items b ON b.id = pi.budget_item_id WHERE pi.id = $1", [$po_dtl_id]);
    PgOrFail($stTol, 'Gagal cek toleransi RAB');
    $tolPct = (float)(pg_fetch_assoc($stTol)['tol'] ?? 0);
    $qtyMaxAllowed = round($po_qty * (1 + $tolPct / 100), 4);
    $qtyReceivableMax = max(0, $qtyMaxAllowed - $receivedOther);

    return [
        'others_qty'         => $receivedOther,
        'qty_max_allowed'    => $qtyMaxAllowed,
        'qty_receivable_max' => $qtyReceivableMax
    ];
}

try {
    switch ($task) {

        case 'list_po_open':
            // HANYA MENGAMBIL PO YANG MEMILIKI SISA QTY BELUM DI-GRN
            $sql = "SELECT p.id, p.po_number AS ref_no, p.po_date AS tx_date, 
                           p.supplier_id, 
                           COALESCE(sup.id, p.supplier_id) AS legacy_supplier_id, 
                           sup.name AS supplier_name,
                           p.currency_id, UPPER(TRIM(cur.init)) AS currency_code,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(p.exch_rate,0),1) AS exch_rate,
                           p.ppn_mode, p.ppn_rate              -- [PPN]
                    FROM purchase_orders p
                    LEFT JOIN m_suppliers sup ON sup.id = p.supplier_id
                    LEFT JOIN m_currency cur ON cur.id = p.currency_id
                    JOIN po_items pd ON pd.po_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT po_item_id, SUM(qty_received) AS total_rcv
                        FROM grn_dtl
                        GROUP BY po_item_id
                    ) g ON g.po_item_id = pd.id
                    WHERE p.status IN ('" . implode("','", GRN_PO_STATUS_LIST) . "')
                    GROUP BY p.id, p.po_number, p.po_date, p.supplier_id, sup.id, sup.name, p.currency_id, cur.init, p.exch_rate, p.ppn_mode, p.ppn_rate
                    HAVING SUM(pd.qty) - COALESCE(SUM(g.total_rcv), 0) > 0.0001
                    ORDER BY p.po_date DESC";
            $result = pg_query_params($sql, []);
            PgOrFail($result, 'Gagal load daftar PO');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => pg_fetch_all($result) ?: []]);
            break;

        case 'read_po_items':
            $po_id  = (int)($_REQUEST['po_id'] ?? 0);
            $grn_id = (int)($_REQUEST['grn_id'] ?? 0);

            $sql = "SELECT pd.id AS po_dtl_id, pd.material_id AS item_id, pd.description AS item_name, 
                           pd.qty AS qty_ordered, pd.unit_price,
                           po.ppn_mode, po.ppn_rate                -- [PPN]
                    FROM po_items pd
                    JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id = pd.po_id
                    WHERE pd.po_id = $1
                    ORDER BY pd.id";
            $result = pg_query_params($sql, [$po_id]);
            PgOrFail($result, 'Gagal load detail PO');
            $rows = pg_fetch_all($result) ?: [];

            $data = [];
            foreach ($rows as $r) {
                $poQty = (float)$r['qty_ordered'];
                $tol   = GetPoDtlTolerance($r['po_dtl_id'], $poQty, $grn_id);

                // Cek apakah item ini milik GRN yang sedang diedit
                $ownResult = pg_query_params(
                    "SELECT qty_received, unit_cost FROM grn_dtl WHERE po_item_id = $1 AND grn_hdr_id = $2",
                    [$r['po_dtl_id'], $grn_id]
                );
                PgOrFail($ownResult, 'Gagal cek baris grn_dtl existing');
                $own = pg_fetch_assoc($ownResult);

                // Hitung sisa murni PO (PO_Qty - Received_Others)
                $sisaQtyPure = max(0, $poQty - $tol['others_qty']);

                // Sisa maksimal yang diizinkan (Toleransi 10%)
                $sisaQtyBolehditerima = $tol['qty_receivable_max'];

                // Jika Sisa Qty Murni <= 0 dan bukan dalam mode Edit item terkait, skip (jangan tampilkan)
                if ($sisaQtyPure <= 0.0001 && !$own) {
                    continue;
                }

                // [PPN] PO mode Include: harga PO sudah termasuk PPN -> default biaya GRN = DPP (harga / (1 + tarif))
                $ppnMode  = strtoupper((string)$r['ppn_mode']);
                $ppnRate  = (float)$r['ppn_rate'];
                $dppPrice = ($ppnMode === 'INCL' && $ppnRate > 0) ? round((float)$r['unit_price'] / (1 + $ppnRate / 100), 4) : (float)$r['unit_price'];

                $data[] = [
                    'po_dtl_id'             => $r['po_dtl_id'],
                    'item_id'               => $r['item_id'],
                    'item_name'             => $r['item_name'],
                    'qty_ordered'           => $poQty,
                    'unit_price'            => (float)$r['unit_price'],
                    'qty_received'          => $tol['others_qty'],
                    'sisa_qty_po'           => $sisaQtyPure,
                    'qty_max_allowed'       => $tol['qty_max_allowed'],
                    'qty_receivable_max'    => $sisaQtyBolehditerima,
                    'qty_received_this_grn' => $own ? (float)$own['qty_received'] : $sisaQtyPure,
                    'unit_cost_this_grn'    => $own ? (float)$own['unit_cost'] : $dppPrice,       // [PPN] default = DPP
                    'unit_price_dpp'        => $dppPrice,                                          // [PPN]
                    'ppn_mode'              => $ppnMode,                                           // [PPN]
                    'ppn_rate'              => $ppnRate                                            // [PPN]
                ];
            }

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data,
                              'currency' => GrnCurrencyInfo($po_id, $grn_id)]);
            break;

        case 'read':
            // [CHG] tambah g.vehicle_plate_no, g.driver_name untuk kolom grid & panel detail
            // [GAP #7] tambah approval_status untuk GRN Approval Gate
            $sql = "SELECT g.id, g.ref_no, g.grn_date, g.status, g.remark,
                           g.vehicle_plate_no, g.driver_name, g.supplier_do_no,      -- [NEW] No. DO Supplier
                           g.approval_status, g.approved_by, g.approved_at, g.approved_note,  -- [GAP #7] GRN Approval
                           p.po_number AS po_ref_no, g.po_id, s.id AS supplier_id, s.name AS supplier_name,
                           (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_received),0) FROM grn_dtl d WHERE d.grn_hdr_id = g.id) AS total_qty,
                           (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_received * unit_cost),0) FROM grn_dtl d WHERE d.grn_hdr_id = g.id) AS total_amount,
                           (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_received * unit_cost_base),0) FROM grn_dtl d WHERE d.grn_hdr_id = g.id) AS total_base,
                           UPPER(TRIM(cur.init)) AS currency_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(g.exch_rate,0),1) AS exch_rate
                    FROM grn_hdr g
                    LEFT JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.id = g.po_id
                    LEFT JOIN m_suppliers s ON s.id = g.supplier_id
                    LEFT JOIN m_currency cur ON cur.id = g.currency_id
                    ORDER BY g.grn_date DESC, g.id DESC";
            $result = pg_query_params($sql, []);
            PgOrFail($result, 'Gagal load daftar GRN');
            $all = pg_fetch_all($result) ?: [];
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($all), 'data' => $all]);
            break;

        case 'read_grn_items':
            $grn_id = (int)($_REQUEST['grn_id'] ?? 0);
            $sql = "SELECT item_name, qty_received AS qty, unit_cost AS unit_price, unit_cost_base
                    FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = $1 ORDER BY id";
            $result = pg_query_params($sql, [$grn_id]);
            PgOrFail($result, 'Gagal load item GRN');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => pg_fetch_all($result) ?: [],
                              'currency' => GrnCurrencyInfo(0, $grn_id)]);
            break;

        case 'read_edit':
            // SELECT * -> kolom vehicle_plate_no & driver_name otomatis ikut terisi ke form (name field sama)
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $hdrResult = pg_query_params("SELECT * FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($hdrResult, 'Gagal load GRN');
            $hdr = pg_fetch_assoc($hdrResult);
            if (!$hdr) throw new Exception('Data tidak ditemukan');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $hdr]);
            break;

        case 'read_grn_print':
            // [NEW] Data Tanda Terima GRN. Sengaja TANPA harga (dokumen untuk driver/supplier).
            $grn_id = (int)($_REQUEST['grn_id'] ?? 0);
            if (!$grn_id) throw new Exception('GRN tidak valid');

            $hRes = pg_query_params(
                "SELECT g.id, g.ref_no, g.grn_date, g.status, g.remark,
                        g.vehicle_plate_no, g.driver_name, g.supplier_do_no,      -- [NEW]
                        p.po_number AS po_ref_no, p.po_date AS po_date,
                        pr.name AS project_name,
                        s.name AS supplier_name,
                        COALESCE(e.employee_name, u.login_name) AS created_by_name
                   FROM grn_hdr g
                   LEFT JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.id = g.po_id
                   LEFT JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = p.project_id
                   LEFT JOIN m_suppliers s ON s.id = g.supplier_id
                   LEFT JOIN m_user_system u ON u.id = g.created_by
                   LEFT JOIN m_employee e ON e.id = u.employee_id
                  WHERE g.id = $1",
                [$grn_id]
            );
            PgOrFail($hRes, 'Gagal load header cetak GRN');
            $hdr = pg_fetch_assoc($hRes);
            if (!$hdr) throw new Exception('GRN tidak ditemukan');

            // qty_cum = akumulasi diterima untuk baris PO tsb s/d GRN ini (GRN dengan id <= id ini)
            $dRes = pg_query_params(
                "SELECT d.id, d.item_name, m.material_code,
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(pi.unit,''), '') AS unit,
                        COALESCE(pi.qty, 0) AS qty_po,
                        d.qty_received AS qty,
                        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(x.qty_received),0) FROM grn_dtl x
                          WHERE x.po_item_id = d.po_item_id AND x.grn_hdr_id <= d.grn_hdr_id) AS qty_cum,
                        d.remark
                   FROM grn_dtl d
                   LEFT JOIN po_items pi ON pi.id = d.po_item_id
                   LEFT JOIN materials m ON m.id = d.item_id
                  WHERE d.grn_hdr_id = $1
                  ORDER BY d.id",
                [$grn_id]
            );
            PgOrFail($dRes, 'Gagal load item cetak GRN');

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => ['header' => $hdr, 'items' => pg_fetch_all($dRes) ?: []]]);
            break;

        case 'create':
            $po_id       = (int)($_REQUEST['po_id'] ?? 0);
            $supplier_id = (int)($_REQUEST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
            $grn_date    = $_REQUEST['grn_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
            $remark      = $_REQUEST['remark'] ?? null;
            $arrItems    = json_decode($_REQUEST['arrItems'] ?? '[]', true);
            $created_by  = $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null;
            // [NEW] plat no kendaraan & nama driver (dinormalisasi / divalidasi)
            $veh         = GrnCleanVehicle($_REQUEST['vehicle_plate_no'] ?? '', $_REQUEST['driver_name'] ?? '');
            $doNo        = GrnCleanDo($_REQUEST['supplier_do_no'] ?? '');      // [NEW] No. DO Supplier

            if (!$po_id) throw new Exception('PO belum dipilih');

            if (!$supplier_id) {
                $supRes = pg_query_params("SELECT supplier_id FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = $1", [$po_id]);
                if ($supRes && $supRow = pg_fetch_assoc($supRes)) {
                    $supplier_id = (int)$supRow['supplier_id'];
                }
            }

            if (!$supplier_id) throw new Exception('Supplier tidak ditemukan dari PO');
            if (empty($arrItems)) throw new Exception('Minimal 1 item harus diisi qty diterima');

            // PO harus berstatus Disetujui; mata uang & kurs PO dibekukan di GRN
            $poRes = pg_query_params("SELECT status, currency_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(exch_rate,0),1) AS exch_rate
                                        FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = $1", [$po_id]);
            PgOrFail($poRes, 'Gagal cek PO');
            $poRow = pg_fetch_assoc($poRes);
            if (!$poRow) throw new Exception('PO tidak ditemukan');
            if (!in_array($poRow['status'], GRN_PO_STATUS_LIST, true)) {
                throw new Exception('GRN hanya dapat dibuat dari PO berstatus ' . implode('/', GRN_PO_STATUS_LIST) .
                                    ' (status PO saat ini: ' . $poRow['status'] . ').');
            }
            $po_currency = $poRow['currency_id'] !== null ? (int)$poRow['currency_id'] : null;
            $po_rate     = (float)$poRow['exch_rate'];

            pg_query('BEGIN');
            SetPgAppUser();
            $ref_no = CreateRefNo('grn_hdr', 'ref_no', 'GRN');

            // [GAP #7] GRN baru selalu status approval PENDING, status GRN tetap 'open' (draft)
            // [CHG] INSERT + vehicle_plate_no ($9), driver_name ($10), approval_status ($12)
            $hdrResult = pg_query_params(
                "INSERT INTO grn_hdr (ref_no, grn_date, po_id, supplier_id, status, remark, created_by, created_at, currency_id, exch_rate,
                                      vehicle_plate_no, driver_name, supplier_do_no, approval_status)
                 VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'open',$5,$6,NOW(),$7,$8,$9,$10,$11,'PENDING') RETURNING id",
                [$ref_no, $grn_date, $po_id, $supplier_id, $remark, $created_by, $po_currency, $po_rate,
                 $veh['plate'], $veh['driver'], $doNo]
            );
            PgOrFail($hdrResult, 'Gagal insert grn_hdr');
            $grn_hdr_id = pg_fetch_result($hdrResult, 0, 'id');

            InsertGrnItems($grn_hdr_id, $arrItems, 0, $po_rate);

            pg_query('COMMIT');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "GRN {$ref_no} berhasil disimpan (status approval: PENDING).", 'id' => $grn_hdr_id, 'ref_no' => $ref_no, 'approval_status' => 'PENDING']);
            break;

        case 'update':
            $id          = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $po_id       = (int)($_REQUEST['po_id'] ?? 0);
            $supplier_id = (int)($_REQUEST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
            $grn_date    = $_REQUEST['grn_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
            $remark      = $_REQUEST['remark'] ?? null;
            $arrItems    = json_decode($_REQUEST['arrItems'] ?? '[]', true);
            // [NEW] plat no kendaraan & nama driver
            $veh         = GrnCleanVehicle($_REQUEST['vehicle_plate_no'] ?? '', $_REQUEST['driver_name'] ?? '');
            $doNo        = GrnCleanDo($_REQUEST['supplier_do_no'] ?? '');      // [NEW] No. DO Supplier

            if (!$id) throw new Exception('GRN tidak valid');

            if (!$supplier_id && $po_id) {
                $supRes = pg_query_params("SELECT supplier_id FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = $1", [$po_id]);
                if ($supRes && $supRow = pg_fetch_assoc($supRes)) {
                    $supplier_id = (int)$supRow['supplier_id'];
                }
            }

            if (!$supplier_id) throw new Exception('Supplier belum dipilih');
            if (empty($arrItems)) throw new Exception('Minimal 1 item harus diisi qty diterima');

            // [GAP #7] Check approval status - cannot edit APPROVED GRN
            $hdrCheck = pg_query_params("SELECT approval_status FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($hdrCheck, 'Gagal cek approval status GRN');
            $hdrRow = pg_fetch_assoc($hdrCheck);
            if ($hdrRow && $hdrRow['approval_status'] === GRN_APPROVED_STATUS) {
                throw new Exception('GRN sudah disetujui (APPROVED), tidak dapat diedit. Batalkan approval terlebih dahulu jika perlu perubahan.');
            }

            $hRes = pg_query_params("SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(exch_rate,0),1) AS exch_rate FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($hRes, 'Gagal load kurs GRN');
            $hRow = pg_fetch_assoc($hRes);
            if (!$hRow) throw new Exception('GRN tidak ditemukan');
            $grn_rate = (float)$hRow['exch_rate'];                       // kurs snapshot GRN tidak berubah saat edit

            pg_query('BEGIN');
            SetPgAppUser();

            GuardNoWhReceiving($id, 'diedit');

            $delResult = pg_query_params("DELETE FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($delResult, 'Gagal hapus baris lama grn_dtl');

            // [CHG] UPDATE + vehicle_plate_no ($5), driver_name ($6); id jadi $7
            $upd = pg_query_params(
                "UPDATE grn_hdr SET supplier_id = $1, grn_date = $2, remark = $3,
                        vehicle_plate_no = $4, driver_name = $5, supplier_do_no = $6
                  WHERE id = $7",      // [CHG] + supplier_do_no ($6); id jadi $7
                [$supplier_id, $grn_date, $remark, $veh['plate'], $veh['driver'], $doNo, $id]
            );
            PgOrFail($upd, 'Gagal update grn_hdr');

            InsertGrnItems($id, $arrItems, $id, $grn_rate);

            pg_query('COMMIT');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'GRN berhasil diupdate.', 'id' => $id]);
            break;

        // [GAP #7] GRN Approval Gate - Approve GRN
        case 'approve_grn':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $note = $_REQUEST['note'] ?? '';
            $approved_by = $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null;

            if (!$id) throw new Exception('GRN tidak valid');

            $hdrRes = pg_query_params("SELECT approval_status, ref_no FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($hdrRes, 'Gagal load GRN');
            $hdr = pg_fetch_assoc($hdrRes);
            if (!$hdr) throw new Exception('GRN tidak ditemukan');
            if ($hdr['approval_status'] === GRN_APPROVED_STATUS) {
                throw new Exception('GRN sudah disetujui sebelumnya.');
            }
            if ($hdr['approval_status'] === GRN_REJECTED_STATUS) {
                throw new Exception('GRN sudah ditolak, tidak dapat disetujui.');
            }

            pg_query('BEGIN');
            SetPgAppUser();

            $upd = pg_query_params(
                "UPDATE grn_hdr SET approval_status = $1, approved_by = $2, approved_at = NOW(), approved_note = $3
                 WHERE id = $4",
                [GRN_APPROVED_STATUS, $approved_by, $note, $id]
            );
            PgOrFail($upd, 'Gagal approve GRN');

            pg_query('COMMIT');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "GRN {$hdr['ref_no']} berhasil disetujui (APPROVED).", 'approval_status' => GRN_APPROVED_STATUS]);
            break;

        // [GAP #7] GRN Approval Gate - Reject GRN
        case 'reject_grn':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $note = $_REQUEST['note'] ?? '';
            $approved_by = $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null;

            if (!$id) throw new Exception('GRN tidak valid');

            $hdrRes = pg_query_params("SELECT approval_status, ref_no FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($hdrRes, 'Gagal load GRN');
            $hdr = pg_fetch_assoc($hdrRes);
            if (!$hdr) throw new Exception('GRN tidak ditemukan');
            if ($hdr['approval_status'] === GRN_REJECTED_STATUS) {
                throw new Exception('GRN sudah ditolak sebelumnya.');
            }
            if ($hdr['approval_status'] === GRN_APPROVED_STATUS) {
                throw new Exception('GRN sudah disetujui, tidak dapat ditolak. Batalkan approval terlebih dahulu jika perlu perubahan.');
            }

            pg_query('BEGIN');
            SetPgAppUser();

            $upd = pg_query_params(
                "UPDATE grn_hdr SET approval_status = $1, approved_by = $2, approved_at = NOW(), approved_note = $3
                 WHERE id = $4",
                [GRN_REJECTED_STATUS, $approved_by, $note, $id]
            );
            PgOrFail($upd, 'Gagal reject GRN');

            pg_query('COMMIT');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "GRN {$hdr['ref_no']} berhasil ditolak (REJECTED).", 'approval_status' => GRN_REJECTED_STATUS]);
            break;

        // [GAP #7] GRN Approval Gate - Unapprove GRN (back to PENDING)
        case 'unapprove_grn':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);

            if (!$id) throw new Exception('GRN tidak valid');

            $hdrRes = pg_query_params("SELECT approval_status, ref_no FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($hdrRes, 'Gagal load GRN');
            $hdr = pg_fetch_assoc($hdrRes);
            if (!$hdr) throw new Exception('GRN tidak ditemukan');
            if ($hdr['approval_status'] !== GRN_APPROVED_STATUS) {
                throw new Exception('GRN belum disetujui, tidak perlu dibatalkan approval-nya.');
            }

            // Check if GRN has WH Receiving - cannot unapprove if already received
            $whCheck = pg_query_params(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wh_receiving_hdr WHERE grn_hdr_id = $1 AND status = 'posted'",
                [$id]
            );
            PgOrFail($whCheck, 'Gagal cek WH Receiving');
            $whCount = (int)pg_fetch_result($whCheck, 0, 0);
            if ($whCount > 0) {
                throw new Exception('GRN sudah memiliki WH Receiving, tidak dapat membatalkan approval. Reverse WH Receiving terlebih dahulu.');
            }

            // Check if GRN has Purchase Invoice matched - cannot unapprove if already invoiced
            $piCheck = pg_query_params(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_invoice_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = $1",
                [$id]
            );
            PgOrFail($piCheck, 'Gagal cek Purchase Invoice');
            $piCount = (int)pg_fetch_result($piCheck, 0, 0);
            if ($piCount > 0) {
                throw new Exception('GRN sudah di-match ke Purchase Invoice, tidak dapat membatalkan approval. Hapus invoice terlebih dahulu.');
            }

            pg_query('BEGIN');
            SetPgAppUser();

            $upd = pg_query_params(
                "UPDATE grn_hdr SET approval_status = $1, approved_by = NULL, approved_at = NULL, approved_note = NULL
                 WHERE id = $2",
                [GRN_PENDING_STATUS, $id]
            );
            PgOrFail($upd, 'Gagal unapprove GRN');

            pg_query('COMMIT');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Approval GRN {$hdr['ref_no']} dibatalkan (kembali ke PENDING).", 'approval_status' => GRN_PENDING_STATUS]);
            break;

        case 'delete':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            if (!$id) throw new Exception('GRN tidak valid');

            pg_query('BEGIN');
            SetPgAppUser();

            GuardNoWhReceiving($id, 'dihapus');

            $delDtl = pg_query_params("DELETE FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($delDtl, 'Gagal hapus grn_dtl');

            $delHdr = pg_query_params("DELETE FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($delHdr, 'Gagal hapus grn_hdr');

            pg_query('COMMIT');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'GRN berhasil dihapus.']);
            break;

        default:
            throw new Exception('Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task));
    }
} catch (Exception $e) {
    @pg_query('ROLLBACK');
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
}

/**
 * [NEW] Normalisasi & validasi Plat No. Kendaraan + Nama Driver.
 *  - Plat: huruf besar, spasi ganda dirapikan, hanya huruf/angka/spasi/strip, maks 20 karakter.
 *  - Driver: spasi dirapikan, maks 100 karakter.
 *  - Kosong disimpan NULL, kecuali GRN_REQUIRE_VEHICLE = true (maka wajib diisi).
 * @return array ['plate' => string|null, 'driver' => string|null]
 */
function GrnCleanVehicle($plate, $driver) {
    $plate  = strtoupper(trim(preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', (string)$plate)));
    $driver = trim(preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', (string)$driver));

    if (GRN_REQUIRE_VEHICLE) {
        if ($plate === '')  throw new Exception('Plat No. Kendaraan wajib diisi.');
        if ($driver === '') throw new Exception('Nama Driver wajib diisi.');
    }
    if ($plate !== '') {
        if (strlen($plate) > 20) throw new Exception('Plat No. Kendaraan maksimal 20 karakter.');
        if (!preg_match('/^[A-Z0-9 \-]+$/', $plate)) throw new Exception('Plat No. Kendaraan hanya boleh huruf, angka, spasi, dan strip (-).');
    }
    // [FIX 2026-10-09] mb_strlen() tidak tersedia (ekstensi mbstring belum terpasang di server) -> Fatal error.
    // Pakai mb_strlen hanya bila ada; fallback ke hitung karakter UTF-8 via preg_match_all('/./u').
    $drvLen = function_exists('mb_strlen') ? mb_strlen($driver, 'UTF-8') : preg_match_all('/./us', $driver);
    if ($driver !== '' && $drvLen > 100) throw new Exception('Nama Driver maksimal 100 karakter.');

    return ['plate' => ($plate === '' ? null : $plate), 'driver' => ($driver === '' ? null : $driver)];
}

/**
 * [NEW] Normalisasi & validasi No. DO Supplier (nomor surat jalan dari supplier).
 *  - Spasi dirapikan, maks 100 karakter. Kosong disimpan NULL, kecuali GRN_REQUIRE_DO = true (wajib diisi).
 */
function GrnCleanDo($do) {
    $do = trim(preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', (string)$do));
    if ($do === '') {
        if (GRN_REQUIRE_DO) throw new Exception('No. DO Supplier wajib diisi.');
        return null;
    }
    $len = function_exists('mb_strlen') ? mb_strlen($do, 'UTF-8') : preg_match_all('/./us', $do);
    if ($len > 100) throw new Exception('No. DO Supplier maksimal 100 karakter.');
    return $do;
}

function InsertGrnItems($grn_hdr_id, $arrItems, $exclude_grn_hdr_id, $rate = 1.0) {
    $any_line = false;

    foreach ($arrItems as $it) {
        $qty = (float)($it['qty_received'] ?? 0);
        if ($qty <= 0) continue;

        $poResult = pg_query_params("SELECT pi.qty AS po_qty, pi.unit_price, po.ppn_mode, po.ppn_rate,
                                            COALESCE(bi.material_source, 'COMPANY') AS material_source
                                       FROM po_items pi JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id = pi.po_id
                                            LEFT JOIN public.budget_items bi ON bi.id = pi.budget_item_id
                                      WHERE pi.id = $1", [$it['po_dtl_id']]);        // [CHG][PPN] + harga & mode PPN PO
        PgOrFail($poResult, 'Gagal cek qty PO');
        $poRow = pg_fetch_assoc($poResult);
        if (!$poRow) throw new Exception('Baris PO tidak ditemukan (po_dtl_id=' . $it['po_dtl_id'] . ')');

        // [PPN] PO mode Include: unit_cost GRN harus DPP; tolak bila sama dengan harga PO yang sudah termasuk PPN
        if (strtoupper((string)$poRow['ppn_mode']) === 'INCL' && (float)$poRow['ppn_rate'] > 0) {
            $gross = (float)$poRow['unit_price'];
            $dpp   = round($gross / (1 + (float)$poRow['ppn_rate'] / 100), 4);
            if (abs($gross - $dpp) > 0.005 && abs((float)($it['unit_cost'] ?? 0) - $gross) < 0.005) {
                throw new Exception("Harga PO {$it['item_name']} sudah termasuk PPN (" . (float)$poRow['ppn_rate'] .
                                    "%). Biaya per unit GRN harus DPP: " . $dpp . ".");
            }
        }

        // [CLIENT-SUPPLIED 2026-11-15 F-4.1] barang titipan klien: biaya per unit DIPAKSA 0 server-side
        // (harga beli Rp 0), meski user mengirim unit_cost > 0. Nilai yang masuk ledger/jurnal tetap 0.
        $isClientSupplied = strtoupper(trim((string)$poRow['material_source'])) === 'CLIENT_SUPPLIED';
        $unitCost         = $isClientSupplied ? 0.0 : (float)($it['unit_cost'] ?? 0);

        $tol = GetPoDtlTolerance($it['po_dtl_id'], (float)$poRow['po_qty'], $exclude_grn_hdr_id);
        if ($qty > $tol['qty_receivable_max'] + 0.0001) {
            throw new Exception("Qty GRN untuk {$it['item_name']} ({$qty}) melebihi batas toleransi +10% PO (sisa maksimal: " . round($tol['qty_receivable_max'], 4) . ")");
        }

        $dtlResult = pg_query_params(
            "INSERT INTO grn_dtl (grn_hdr_id, po_item_id, item_id, item_name, qty_received, unit_cost, unit_cost_base, remark)
             VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8)",
            [
                $grn_hdr_id, $it['po_dtl_id'], $it['item_id'], $it['item_name'],
                $qty, $unitCost, round($unitCost * $rate, 4), $it['remark'] ?? null
            ]
        );
        PgOrFail($dtlResult, 'Gagal insert grn_dtl');

        $any_line = true;
    }

    if (!$any_line) {
        throw new Exception('Tidak ada baris dengan qty > 0');
    }
}

function GuardNoWhReceiving($grn_hdr_id, $actionLabel) {
    $chkResult = pg_query_params(
        "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.qty_received),0) AS total_wh
         FROM wh_receiving_dtl d
         JOIN wh_receiving_hdr h ON h.id = d.wh_receiving_hdr_id AND h.status = 'posted'
         JOIN grn_dtl gd ON gd.id = d.grn_dtl_id
         WHERE gd.grn_hdr_id = $1",
        [$grn_hdr_id]
    );
    PgOrFail($chkResult, 'Gagal cek qty yang sudah di-WH Rcv');
    $chk = pg_fetch_assoc($chkResult);
    if ((float)$chk['total_wh'] > 0) {
        throw new Exception("GRN tidak bisa {$actionLabel} -- sudah ada WH Rcv terkait. Reverse WH Rcv-nya dulu.");
    }
}

function taxExchangeRequireAccess($minimum, $message)
{
    $currentAccess = (int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);

    if ($currentAccess < $minimum) {
        http_response_code(403);
        echo json_encode([
            'success' => false,
            'message' => $message
        ]);
        exit;
    }

$task   = $_POST['task'] ?? $_GET['task'] ?? 'read';
if (in_array($task, ['fetch_now', 'sync', 'delete'], true)
    && strtoupper($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET') !== 'POST') {
    http_response_code(405);
    header('Allow: GET, POST');
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Sinkronisasi dan penghapusan wajib menggunakan POST.']);

$limit  = intval($_POST['limit'] ?? $_REQUEST['limit'] ?? 250);

switch ($task) {

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. READ HEADER GRID (Daftar Periode KMK)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read':
        try {
            $stmtCount = $pdo->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tax_exchange_rate_hdr");
            $totalCount = $stmtCount->fetchColumn();

            $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
                SELECT id, kmk_no, start_date, end_date, file_url, remark, created_at
                FROM tax_exchange_rate_hdr
                ORDER BY start_date DESC, id DESC
                LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
            ");

            $stmt->bindValue(':offset', $start, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $stmt->execute();
            $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            echo json_encode([
                'success' => true,
                'totalRecord' => $totalCount,
                'data' => $data
            ]);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. READ DETAIL GRID (Rincian Kurs per Mata Uang)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_detail':
        try {
            $hdrId = intval($_POST['hdr_id'] ?? $_REQUEST['hdr_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($hdrId <= 0) {
                // Default ke header terbaru jika tidak spesifik
                $hdrId = $pdo->query("SELECT id FROM tax_exchange_rate_hdr ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1")->fetchColumn();
            }

            if (!$hdrId) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => []]);
                exit;
            }

            $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
                SELECT 
                    d.id, d.hdr_id, d.currency_id, d.currency_code, d.currency_name, 
                    d.unit_multiplier, d.rate AS rate_kmk, d.rate_per_unit AS rate_effective,
                    d.prev_rate, d.change_amount, d.change_direction
                FROM tax_exchange_rate_dtl d
                WHERE d.hdr_id = :hdr_id
                ORDER BY d.currency_code ASC
            ");
            $stmt->execute(['hdr_id' => $hdrId]);
            $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            echo json_encode([
                'success' => true,
                'hdr_id' => $hdrId,
                'data' => $data
            ]);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. FETCH NOW (Tarik Otomatis dari Kemenkeu)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'fetch_now':
    case 'sync':
        taxExchangeRequireAccess(
            3,
            'Anda tidak memiliki hak untuk memperbarui Kurs Pajak.'
        );

            if ($res['success']) {
                echo json_encode([

                ]);
            } else {
                echo json_encode([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => $res['message']
                ]);
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => "Error sync: " . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. DELETE RECORD
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'delete':
        taxExchangeRequireAccess(
            4,
            'Anda tidak memiliki hak untuk menghapus Kurs Pajak.'
        );
        try {
            if ($id <= 0) {

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
        break;
}

==================== FILE: ./php-crud/rabCRD.php ====================
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
/**
* rabCRD.php - CLEAN VERSION (Simplicity is Power)
* ============================================================
* Backend Controller untuk RAB Proyek (Material + Expense Master)
* 
* Fitur:
* - Multi-kategori: Material, Upah, Peralatan, Transport, Konsumsi, Lain-lain
* - Material: track by qty (qty_plan vs qty_out)
* - Expense: track by amount (budget only, actual via jurnal terpisah)
* - Expense Master: CRUD daftar jenis expense (seperti Master Material)
* - Budget control terintegrasi (satu plafon Nilai Kontrak)
* - Multi-currency support
* - Plafon & cadangan (addendum)
* - [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-4.1] Sumber material per baris RAB: COMPANY (dibeli perusahaan, default) /
*   CLIENT_SUPPLIED (titipan klien). Disimpan di budget_items.material_source (migrasi
*   sql/2026-11-15_patch_gelombang2_client_supplied.sql). CLIENT_SUPPLIED -> qty_to_buy 0 di
*   planning/PO, harga beli Rp 0 di GRN/WH Rcv, jurnal rupiah di-skip, fisik tetap tercatat.
* 
* File related: rab.js, m.expenses.js
* Migration: sql/expense_master.sql
* ============================================================
*/
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/fx.func.php';

const RAB_REQUIRE_CONTRACT = true;
const RAB_EPS_VAL = 0.01;
const RAB_EPS_QTY = 0.00005;
const RAB_CATEGORIES = ['Material', 'Upah', 'Peralatan', 'Transport', 'Konsumsi', 'Lain-lain'];

// [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-4.1] Sumber material per baris RAB (budget_items.material_source, migrasi
// sql/2026-11-15_patch_gelombang2_client_supplied.sql): COMPANY = dibeli perusahaan (default, perilaku
// lama); CLIENT_SUPPLIED = titipan klien -> qty_to_buy wajib 0 di planning/PO, harga beli 0, fisik
// tetap tercatat di stock_movements tanpa jurnal rupiah. Hanya berlaku untuk kategori 'Material'.
const RAB_MATERIAL_SOURCES = ['COMPANY', 'CLIENT_SUPPLIED'];

function rabNormSource($src) {
    $s = strtoupper(trim((string)$src));
    if ($s === '' || $s === null) { return 'COMPANY'; }
    if (!in_array($s, RAB_MATERIAL_SOURCES, true)) {
        throw new RabBusinessError('Sumber material tidak valid: "' . $s . '". Yang diterima: ' . implode(', ', RAB_MATERIAL_SOURCES) . '.');
    }
    return $s;
}

// [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-5.3] Normalisasi kategori RAB CASE-INSENSITIVE dengan validasi KETAT:
// category kosong di luar daftar -> RabBusinessError (dulu demote diam-diam ke 'Lain-lain', lalu baris
// material ber-material_id dibuang tanpa peringatan -- audit F-5.3). Daftar ini kini sama persis dengan
// CHECK DB budget_items_category_check (sql/2026-11-15_patch_gelombang1_readiness_rab.sql).
function rabNormCategory($cat) {
    $c = trim((string)$cat);
    $lc = strtolower($c);
    foreach (RAB_CATEGORIES as $valid) {
        if (strtolower($valid) === $lc) { return $valid; }
    }
    throw new RabBusinessError('Kategori RAB tidak valid: "' . $c . '". Kategori yang diterima: ' . implode(', ', RAB_CATEGORIES) . '.');
}

class RabBusinessError extends Exception {}

function mb_strlen_safe($str, $len) {
    $str = (string)$str;
    if (function_exists('mb_substr')) return mb_substr($str, 0, $len, 'UTF-8');
    $chars = preg_split('//u', $str, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
    return $chars === false ? substr($str, 0, $len) : implode('', array_slice($chars, 0, $len));
}

function rab_fmt($n): string { return number_format((float)$n, 2, ',', '.'); }

// [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-5.2] Alasan budget_item tidak boleh dihapus dari RAB; '' = boleh.
// Replika mpItemBlock() (m.proyekCRD.php) karena rabCRD.php tidak menyertakan file itu (m.proyekCRD menjalankan
// controller top-level). Cakupan sama: PO, SPK, kontrak subkon, biaya task, issue gudang -- siap dipakai PO/SPK/issue.
function rabItemBlock($db, int $projectId, int $bid): string {
    $bid = (int)$bid;
    if ($bid <= 0) { return ''; }
    $one = function (string $sql, array $p) use ($db) {
        $st = $db->prepare($sql); $st->execute($p);
        return (int)$st->fetchColumn() > 0;
    };
    $r = $db->prepare("SELECT po.po_number FROM po_items i JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id = i.po_id
                       WHERE i.budget_item_id = :b ORDER BY po.id LIMIT 1");
    $r->execute([':b' => $bid]);
    $po = $r->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if ($po && !empty($po['po_number'])) { return 'sudah dipakai PO ' . $po['po_number']; }
    if ($db->query("SELECT to_regclass('public.spk_work_items')")->fetchColumn() &&
        $one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM spk_work_items WHERE budget_item_id = :b", [':b' => $bid])) { return 'sudah dipakai SPK'; }
    if ($db->query("SELECT to_regclass('public.subcon_contracts')")->fetchColumn() &&
        $one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM subcon_contracts WHERE budget_item_id = :b", [':b' => $bid])) { return 'sudah dipakai kontrak subkon'; }
    if ($db->query("SELECT to_regclass('public.task_expenses')")->fetchColumn() &&
        $one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM task_expenses WHERE budget_item_id = :b", [':b' => $bid])) { return 'sudah dialokasikan sebagai biaya task'; }
    if ($db->query("SELECT to_regclass('public.material_out_items')")->fetchColumn() && $db->query("SELECT to_regclass('public.material_out_header')")->fetchColumn()) {
        $bi = $db->prepare("SELECT material_id FROM budget_items WHERE id = :b");
        $bi->execute([':b' => $bid]);
        $row = $bi->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $mid = (is_array($row) && $row['material_id'] !== null) ? (int)$row['material_id'] : 0;
        if ($mid > 0 && $one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM material_out_items i JOIN material_out_header h ON h.id = i.material_out_id
                              WHERE h.project_id = :p AND i.material_id = :m AND h.status = 'posted'", [':p' => $projectId, ':m' => $mid])) {
            return 'sudah di-issue dari gudang';
        }
    }
    return '';
}

// [AI-BOQ] Rentang harga MILIK MASTER (mata uang dasar): materials.estimated_price_min .. estimated_price (max),
// expense_master.default_price_min .. default_price (max). Harga satuan RAB default = max; user boleh mengubahnya di RAB
// selama masih di dalam rentang master. Rentang hanya berlaku bila master punya min > 0 dan max >= min.
// Butuh migrasi sql/2026-11-06.budget_items_price_range.sql; belum migrasi -> tanpa batas (perilaku lama).
function rab_has_master_range($db): bool {
    static $has = null;
    if ($has === null) {
        $st = $db->query("SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = ANY (current_schemas(false)) AND table_name = 'materials' AND column_name = 'estimated_price_min')
                               + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = ANY (current_schemas(false)) AND table_name = 'expense_master' AND column_name = 'default_price_min')");
        $has = ((int)$st->fetchColumn() === 2);
    }
    return $has;
}
function rab_master_limits($db, string $type, int $id): ?array {
    static $cache = [];
    $k = $type . $id;
    if (array_key_exists($k, $cache)) return $cache[$k];
    $cache[$k] = null;
    if ($id <= 0 || !rab_has_master_range($db)) return null;
    if ($type === 'M') $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(estimated_price_min,0) AS mn, COALESCE(estimated_price,0) AS mx, material_name AS nm FROM public.materials WHERE id = :id");
    else               $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(default_price_min,0) AS mn, COALESCE(default_price,0) AS mx, expense_name AS nm FROM expense_master WHERE id = :id");
    $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
    $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if ($r && (float)$r['mn'] > 0 && (float)$r['mx'] >= (float)$r['mn']) {
        $cache[$k] = ['min' => (float)$r['mn'], 'max' => (float)$r['mx'], 'name' => $r['nm']];
    }
    return $cache[$k];
}

function sendJsonResponse($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $response = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        if (is_array($data) && isset($data['data'])) {
            $response['data'] = $data['data'];
            if (isset($data['totalCount'])) $response['totalCount'] = $data['totalCount'];
        } else {
            $response['data'] = $data;
        }
    }
    echo json_encode($response, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

function rab_currency_lock_reason($db, int $projectId): ?string {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.po_items poi JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON po.id = poi.po_id WHERE po.project_id = :p AND po.status <> 'Dibatalkan' LIMIT 1");
    $st->execute([':p' => $projectId]);
    if ($st->fetchColumn()) return 'Proyek ini sudah memiliki PO.';
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.material_out_header WHERE project_id = :p AND status = 'posted' LIMIT 1");
    $st->execute([':p' => $projectId]);
    if ($st->fetchColumn()) return 'Proyek ini sudah memiliki pemakaian material.';
    return null;
}

const RAB_USAGE_CTE = "
WITH usage AS (
    SELECT moh.project_id, moi.material_id,
    SUM(moi.qty_out) AS qty_out,
    SUM(moi.qty_out * moi.unit_cost) AS actual_cost
    FROM material_out_items moi
    JOIN material_out_header moh ON moh.id = moi.material_out_id AND moh.status = 'posted'
    GROUP BY moh.project_id, moi.material_id
)
";

            COALESCE(agg.total_actual_cost, 0) / COALESCE(NULLIF(p.budget_exch_rate, 0), 1) AS total_actual_cost,
            COALESCE(exp_agg.expense_budget, 0) AS expense_budget,
            CASE COALESCE(agg.status_rank, 0)
                WHEN 3 THEN 'OVERBUDGET'
                WHEN 2 THEN 'WARNING'

                ELSE 'NO BUDGET'
            END AS rab_status
            FROM public.projects p
            LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON c.id = p.client_id
            LEFT JOIN public.m_currency cur ON cur.id = p.budget_currency_id
            LEFT JOIN (

            FROM public.budget_items bi

            $rabBase = round($rabCur * $rate, 2);
            $plafon = [

                'project_status' => $proj['project_status'],

                'reserve_used' => $budgetCur > 0 ? max($rabBase - $budgetBase, 0) : 0,
                'reserve_remaining' => $contract > 0 ? max($contract - max($budgetBase, $rabBase), 0) : 0,

        /* ============================================================

        case 'save_rab':
            $projectId = (int)($_POST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            $items = json_decode($_POST['items'] ?? '[]', true);
            if ($projectId <= 0) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'ID Proyek tidak valid.');
            if (!is_array($items)) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Format data item RAB tidak valid.');
            
            $stmtCur = $db->prepare("SELECT budget_currency_id FROM public.projects WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtCur->execute([':id' => $projectId]);

            if ($storedCur === false) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Proyek tidak ditemukan.');

            $baseCur = fx_base_currency($db);

            if ($currencyId <= 0) $currencyId = $storedCur ?: (int)$baseCur['id'];

            if ($baseCur['id'] !== null && $currencyId === $baseCur['id']) $exchRate = 1.0;
            if ($exchRate <= 0) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Kurs harus lebih besar dari 0.');

            $rd = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $rateDate);
            if (!$rd || $rd->format('Y-m-d') !== $rateDate) $rateDate = date('Y-m-d');

                $lock = rab_currency_lock_reason($db, $projectId);

            }
            
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $stP = $db->prepare("SELECT status, COALESCE(budget, 0) AS budget, COALESCE(contract_value, 0) AS contract_value FROM public.projects WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $stP->execute([':id' => $projectId]);
                $pj = $stP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                $contract = (float)$pj['contract_value'];
                $budgetCur = (float)$pj['budget'];
                $running = ($pj['status'] !== 'Belum Mulai');
                
                // Load existing items (for comparison)
                $stOld = $db->prepare("SELECT id, material_id, expense_id, category, qty_plan, unit_price_plan FROM public.budget_items WHERE project_id = :p");
                $stOld->execute([':p' => $projectId]);
                $old = [];
                foreach ($stOld->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $o) {
                    $key = ($o['category'] === 'Material' && $o['material_id']) ? 'M' . $o['material_id'] : 'E' . $o['category'] . '_' . ($o['expense_id'] ?: $o['id']);
                    $old[$key] = ['id' => (int)$o['id'], 'qty' => (float)$o['qty_plan'], 'price' => (float)$o['unit_price_plan'], 'category' => $o['category']];
                }
                
                $totalCur = 0.0; $flags = [];
                foreach ($items as $item) {
                    $cat = rabNormCategory($item['category'] ?? '');   // [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-5.3] case-insensitive + validasi ketat
                    $mid = (int)($item['material_id'] ?? 0);
                    $eid = (int)($item['expense_id'] ?? 0);
                    $q = (float)($item['budget_qty'] ?? 0);
                    $pr = (float)($item['unit_price'] ?? 0);
                    // [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-4.1] normalisasi & validasi sumber material (hanya untuk Material)
                    $src = rabNormSource($cat === 'Material' ? ($item['material_source'] ?? '') : '');
                    if ($cat === 'Material' && ($mid <= 0 || $q <= 0)) continue;
                    if ($cat !== 'Material' && ($eid <= 0 || $q <= 0)) continue;
                    $val = round($q * $pr, 2);
                    $totalCur += $val;
                    $key = ($cat === 'Material' && $mid > 0) ? 'M' . $mid : 'E' . $cat . '_' . $eid;
                    $oldVal = isset($old[$key]) ? round($old[$key]['qty'] * $old[$key]['price'], 2) : 0.0;
                    $flags[$key] = !isset($old[$key]) || $q > $old[$key]['qty'] + RAB_EPS_QTY || $val > $oldVal + RAB_EPS_VAL;
                    // [AI-BOQ] harga satuan harus di dalam rentang min-max MASTER (diperiksa hanya untuk item baru / harga yang diubah,
                    // sehingga data lama yang sudah di luar rentang tidak memblokir simpan). Perbandingan dalam mata uang dasar.
                    if (!isset($old[$key]) || abs($pr - $old[$key]['price']) > 0.005) {
                        $lim = ($cat === 'Material') ? rab_master_limits($db, 'M', $mid) : rab_master_limits($db, 'E', $eid);
                        if ($lim) {
                            $pBase = $pr * $exchRate;
                            if ($pBase < $lim['min'] * 0.9999 - 0.5 || $pBase > $lim['max'] * 1.0001 + 0.5) {
                                throw new RabBusinessError('Harga satuan ' . $lim['name'] . ' (' . rab_fmt($pBase) . ') di luar batas master: min ' . rab_fmt($lim['min']) .
                                                           ' - max ' . rab_fmt($lim['max']) . '. Ubah harga atau perbarui rentang harga di master terlebih dahulu.');
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                $totalBase = round($totalCur * $exchRate, 2);
                $budgetBase = round($budgetCur * $exchRate, 2);
                
                if ($contract <= 0 && RAB_REQUIRE_CONTRACT) {
                    throw new RabBusinessError('Nilai Kontrak (plafon) proyek belum diisi.');
                }
                if ($contract > 0) {
                    if ($budgetBase > $contract + RAB_EPS_VAL) {
                        throw new RabBusinessError('Budget proyek (setara ' . rab_fmt($budgetBase) . ') melebihi Nilai Kontrak (' . rab_fmt($contract) . ').');
                    }
                    if ($totalBase > $contract + RAB_EPS_VAL) {
                        throw new RabBusinessError('Total RAB setara ' . rab_fmt($totalBase) . ' melebihi Nilai Kontrak (' . rab_fmt($contract) . ').');
                    }
                }
                if (!$running && $budgetCur > 0 && $totalBase > $budgetBase + RAB_EPS_VAL) {
                    throw new RabBusinessError('Total RAB melebihi Budget proyek. Cadangan baru bisa dipakai setelah proyek Berjalan.');
                }
                
                $usesReserve = $running && $budgetCur > 0 && $totalBase > $budgetBase + RAB_EPS_VAL;
                $userId = (int)($_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0);
                $addInfo = [];
                foreach ($items as $item) {
                    $cat = rabNormCategory($item['category'] ?? '');   // [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-5.3] case-insensitive + validasi ketat
                    $mid = (int)($item['material_id'] ?? 0);
                    $eid = (int)($item['expense_id'] ?? 0);
                    $q = (float)($item['budget_qty'] ?? 0);
                    // [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-4.1] sumber material (validasi ulang, sama dg loop di atas)
                    $src = rabNormSource($cat === 'Material' ? ($item['material_source'] ?? '') : '');
                    if ($cat === 'Material' && $mid <= 0) continue;
                    if ($cat !== 'Material' && ($eid <= 0 || $q <= 0)) continue;
                    $reason = trim((string)($item['addendum_reason'] ?? ''));
                    $key = ($cat === 'Material' && $mid > 0) ? 'M' . $mid : 'E' . $cat . '_' . $eid;
                    $isAdd = $usesReserve && !empty($flags[$key]);
                    if ($isAdd && $reason === '') {
                        throw new RabBusinessError('Penambahan RAB yang memakai cadangan wajib diisi alasannya.');
                    }
                    $addInfo[$key] = ['flag' => $isAdd ? 1 : 0, 'reason' => $isAdd ? mb_strlen_safe($reason, 500) : '', 'category' => $cat];
                }
                
                $stmtProj = $db->prepare("UPDATE public.projects SET budget_currency_id = :c, budget_exch_rate = :r, budget_rate_date = CAST(:d AS date) WHERE id = :id");
                $stmtProj->execute([':c' => $currencyId, ':r' => $exchRate, ':d' => $rateDate, ':id' => $projectId]);
                
                $activeKeys = [];
                
                foreach ($items as $item) {
                    $cat = rabNormCategory($item['category'] ?? '');   // [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-5.3] case-insensitive + validasi ketat
                    $materialId = (int)($item['material_id'] ?? 0);
                    $expenseId = (int)($item['expense_id'] ?? 0);
                    $itemName = trim((string)($item['item_name'] ?? ''));
                    $budgetQty = (float)($item['budget_qty'] ?? 0);
                    $unitPrice = (float)($item['unit_price'] ?? 0);
                    $tolerance = (float)($item['tolerance_pct'] ?? 0);
                    $unitName = trim((string)($item['unit'] ?? 'Unit'));
                    // [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-4.1] sumber material (validasi ulang, sama dg loop di atas)
                    $src = rabNormSource($cat === 'Material' ? ($item['material_source'] ?? '') : '');

                    if ($cat === 'Material' && $materialId <= 0) continue;
                    if ($cat !== 'Material' && ($expenseId <= 0 || $budgetQty <= 0)) continue;
                    
                    $key = ($cat === 'Material' && $materialId > 0) ? 'M' . $materialId : 'E' . $cat . '_' . $expenseId;
                    $activeKeys[] = $key;
                    
                    if ($cat === 'Material') {
                        // UPSERT untuk Material
                        // [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-4.1] material_source ikut tersimpan (COMPANY / CLIENT_SUPPLIED)
                        $stmtUpsert = $db->prepare("
                            INSERT INTO public.budget_items (project_id, material_id, category, item_name, unit, qty_plan, unit_price_plan, tolerance_pct, created_at, is_addendum, addendum_reason, addendum_by, addendum_at, material_source)
                            SELECT :project_id, :material_id, 'Material', m.material_name, COALESCE(m.unit, :unit_name), :budget_qty, :unit_price, :tolerance_pct, NOW(),
                            (CAST(:is_add AS integer) = 1), NULLIF(:reason, ''), CAST(NULLIF(:by, '') AS integer), CASE WHEN CAST(:is_add AS integer) = 1 THEN NOW() END,
                            :material_source
                            FROM public.materials m WHERE m.id = :material_id
                            ON CONFLICT (project_id, material_id) WHERE category = 'Material' AND material_id IS NOT NULL
                            DO UPDATE SET qty_plan = EXCLUDED.qty_plan, unit_price_plan = EXCLUDED.unit_price_plan, tolerance_pct = EXCLUDED.tolerance_pct,
                            item_name = EXCLUDED.item_name, unit = EXCLUDED.unit,
                            material_source = EXCLUDED.material_source,
                            is_addendum = (budget_items.is_addendum OR EXCLUDED.is_addendum),
                            addendum_reason = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.is_addendum THEN EXCLUDED.addendum_reason ELSE budget_items.addendum_reason END,
                            addendum_by = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.is_addendum THEN EXCLUDED.addendum_by ELSE budget_items.addendum_by END,
                            addendum_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.is_addendum THEN EXCLUDED.addendum_at ELSE budget_items.addendum_at END
                        ");
                        $stmtUpsert->execute([
                            ':project_id' => $projectId, ':material_id' => $materialId, ':unit_name' => $unitName,
                            ':budget_qty' => $budgetQty, ':unit_price' => $unitPrice, ':tolerance_pct' => $tolerance,
                            ':is_add' => $addInfo[$key]['flag'] ?? 0, ':reason' => $addInfo[$key]['reason'] ?? '',
                            ':by' => $userId > 0 ? (string)$userId : '',
                            ':material_source' => $src
                        ]);
                    } else {
                        // Non-Material: ambil nama dari expense_master
                        $stExp = $db->prepare("SELECT expense_name, unit FROM expense_master WHERE id = :id AND active = true");
                        $stExp->execute([':id' => $expenseId]);
                        $expRow = $stExp->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                        if (!$expRow) throw new RabBusinessError("Expense ID {$expenseId} tidak ditemukan atau tidak aktif.");
                        $finalItemName = $itemName ?: $expRow['expense_name'];
                        $finalUnit = $unitName !== 'Unit' ? $unitName : $expRow['unit'];
                        
                        // Cek apakah sudah ada (berdasarkan project_id + category + expense_id)
                        $stChk = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM budget_items WHERE project_id = :p AND category = :cat AND expense_id = :eid");
                        $stChk->execute([':p' => $projectId, ':cat' => $cat, ':eid' => $expenseId]);
                        $existingId = $stChk->fetchColumn();
                        
                        if ($existingId) {
                            // [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-4.1] material_source tetap COMPANY untuk non-Material (kolom NOT NULL)
                            $db->prepare("UPDATE budget_items SET item_name = :name, unit = :unit, qty_plan = :qty, unit_price_plan = :price, tolerance_pct = :tol, material_source = 'COMPANY', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = :id")
                                ->execute([':name' => $finalItemName, ':unit' => $finalUnit, ':qty' => $budgetQty, ':price' => $unitPrice, ':tol' => $tolerance, ':id' => $existingId]);
                        } else {
                            $db->prepare("INSERT INTO budget_items (project_id, material_id, expense_id, category, item_name, unit, qty_plan, unit_price_plan, tolerance_pct, created_at, material_source)
                                VALUES (:p, NULL, :eid, :cat, :name, :unit, :qty, :price, :tol, NOW(), 'COMPANY')")
                                ->execute([':p' => $projectId, ':eid' => $expenseId, ':cat' => $cat, ':name' => $finalItemName, ':unit' => $finalUnit, ':qty' => $budgetQty, ':price' => $unitPrice, ':tol' => $tolerance]);
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Delete items yang tidak ada di grid
                // [PATCH 2026-11-15 F-5.2] JANGAN hapus diam-diam budget_item lama yang sudah dipakai
                // PO/SPK/kontrak subkon/task expense/issue gudang. mpItemBlock() dulu hanya dipanggil di
                // m.proyekCRD edit; save_rab punya celah yang sama (audit F-5.2).
                $blockedByItem = [];
                foreach ($old as $oKey => $oRow) {
                    if (in_array($oKey, $activeKeys, true)) continue;      // masih di grid -> bukan dihapus
                    $why = rabItemBlock($db, $projectId, (int)$oRow['id']);
                    if ($why !== '') { $blockedByItem[] = '"' . $oKey . '" (id ' . $oRow['id'] . '): ' . $why; }
                }
                if ($blockedByItem) {
                    throw new RabBusinessError('Item RAB tidak dapat dihapus karena sudah dipakai transaksi lain: ' . implode('; ', $blockedByItem) . '. Hapus dulu rujukannya atau pertahankan item tersebut di grid.');
                }

                if ($activeKeys) {
                    $materialIds = []; $expenseIds = [];
                    foreach ($activeKeys as $k) {
                        if (strpos($k, 'M') === 0) {
                            $materialIds[] = (int)substr($k, 1);
                        } else {
                            $parts = explode('_', substr($k, 1), 2);
                            if (count($parts) === 2) {
                                $expenseIds[] = (int)$parts[1];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Delete Material yang tidak ada
                    if ($materialIds) {
                        $ph = [];
                        $params = [':project_id' => $projectId];
                        foreach ($materialIds as $i => $mid) { $ph[] = ":m{$i}"; $params[":m{$i}"] = $mid; }
                        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM public.budget_items WHERE project_id = :project_id AND category = 'Material' AND material_id NOT IN (" . implode(',', $ph) . ")")
                            ->execute($params);
                    } else {
                        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM public.budget_items WHERE project_id = :project_id AND category = 'Material'")
                            ->execute([':project_id' => $projectId]);
                    }
                    
                    // Delete Non-Material yang tidak ada
                    if ($expenseIds) {
                        $ph2 = [];
                        $params2 = [':project_id' => $projectId];
                        foreach ($expenseIds as $i => $eid) { $ph2[] = ":e{$i}"; $params2[":e{$i}"] = $eid; }
                        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM public.budget_items WHERE project_id = :project_id AND category <> 'Material' AND expense_id NOT IN (" . implode(',', $ph2) . ")")
                            ->execute($params2);
                    } else {
                        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM public.budget_items WHERE project_id = :project_id AND category <> 'Material'")
                            ->execute([':project_id' => $projectId]);
                    }
                } else {
                    $db->prepare("DELETE FROM public.budget_items WHERE project_id = :project_id")->execute([':project_id' => $projectId]);
                }
                
                $db->commit();
                $msg = 'RAB berhasil disimpan.';
                if ($usesReserve) $msg .= ' Cadangan terpakai ' . rab_fmt($totalBase - $budgetBase) . ' dari ' . rab_fmt(max($contract - $budgetBase, 0)) . '.';
                sendJsonResponse(true, [], $msg);
            } catch (RabBusinessError $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Gagal menyimpan RAB: ' . $e->getMessage());
            }
            break;

        default:
            sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal: ' . htmlspecialchars($task));
            break;
    }
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/user.valid.php';
/*
  Document      : Journal Entry - CRUD Handler
  Called from   : js/journal.entry.js
  Note          : - Jurnal manual pakai reference_type = 'manual_entry',
                    reference_id = 0 (tidak terkait dokumen sumber lain).
                  - Jurnal hanya boleh dibuat/diedit selagi status = 'draft'
                    dan periode masih Open.
                  - 'Batalkan posting' dilakukan lewat REVERSE: membuat jurnal
                    baru dengan baris debit/kredit dibalik, lalu status jurnal
                    asal diubah jadi 'reversed'. Ini menjaga jejak audit,
                    bukan menghapus/mengubah data historis.
                  - Total debit/kredit dihitung on-the-fly dari journal_lines,
                    tidak disimpan terpisah di header (sesuai struktur asli).
                  - Periode akuntansi pakai tabel accounting_periods.
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;
}

if ((int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < 1) { http_response_code(403); echo json_encode(['success'=>false,'message'=>'Hak baca jurnal tidak tersedia.']); exit; }

    http_response_code(405);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Metode harus POST untuk perubahan jurnal.']);
    exit;

        $limit = $srch['limit'] ?? 250;

            SELECT j.id, j.ref_no, j.journal_date, j.period_id, p.period_name,
                   j.description, j.status,
                   COALESCE((SELECT SUM(debit)  FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id = j.id), 0) AS total_debit,
                   COALESCE((SELECT SUM(credit) FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id = j.id), 0) AS total_credit
            FROM journal_entries j
            LEFT JOIN accounting_periods p ON p.id = j.period_id
            
            ORDER BY j.journal_date DESC, j.id DESC
            LIMIT " . intval($limit);

        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $stmt->execute(['id' => $id]);

        echo json_encode(['success' => (bool)$row, 'data' => $row ?: new stdClass()]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_lines':
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => 0, 'data' => []]);
            exit;
        }

            SELECT l.id AS line_id, l.account_id, c.account_code, c.account_name,

            FROM journal_lines l
            LEFT JOIN chart_of_accounts c ON c.id = l.account_id
            WHERE l.journal_id = :id
            ORDER BY l.id ASC
        ");
        $stmt->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'create':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 2) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        saveJournal($db, null, $_POST);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'update':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID jurnal tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT status FROM journal_entries WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtChk->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $existing = $stmtChk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($existing && $existing['status'] !== 'draft') {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Hanya jurnal berstatus Draft yang boleh diedit.']);
            exit;
        }

        saveJournal($db, $id, $_POST);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
     case 'post':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $userId = $_SESSION['user_id'];
 
        $stmtUpd = $db->prepare("
            UPDATE journal_entries
            SET status = 'posted', posted_by = :uid, posted_at = now()
            WHERE id = :id AND status = 'draft'
        ");
        $stmtUpd->execute(['uid' => $userId, 'id' => $id]);
 
        if ($stmtUpd->rowCount() === 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal posting -- data tidak ditemukan atau status sudah bukan Draft (mungkin sudah di-post/reload halaman lain).']);
            exit;
        }
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Jurnal berhasil di-post.']);
        break;


    
    // ==============================================================
    case 'reverse':
        $access = (int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 4) {
            http_response_code(403);
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Hanya akses tertinggi yang boleh reverse jurnal.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) throw new Exception('ID jurnal tidak valid.');

        $db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            // Lock source journal so concurrent requests cannot create duplicate reversals.
            $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM journal_entries WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
            $stmtChk->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $original = $stmtChk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$original || $original['status'] !== 'posted') {
                throw new Exception('Hanya jurnal berstatus Posted yang bisa di-reverse.');
            }

            $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT is_closed FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
            $stmtP->execute([':id' => $original['period_id']]);
            $period = $stmtP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$period || $period['is_closed']) {
                throw new Exception('Periode jurnal asal tidak ditemukan atau sudah ditutup; reverse tidak diizinkan.');
            }

            $reverseNo = CreateRefNo('journal_entries', 'ref_no', 'JE');
            $stmtNew = $db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO journal_entries
                    (ref_no, journal_date, period_id, reference_type, reference_id,
                     description, status, posted_by, posted_at)
                VALUES
                    (:no, CURRENT_DATE, :period, 'manual_entry', 0,
                     :description, 'posted', :uid, NOW())
                RETURNING id
            ");
            $stmtNew->execute([
                ':no' => $reverseNo,
                ':period' => (int)$original['period_id'],
                ':description' => 'Reversal dari ' . $original['ref_no']
                    . (empty($original['description']) ? '' : ' - ' . $original['description']),
                ':uid' => (int)$_SESSION['user_id']
            ]);
            $newId = (int)$stmtNew->fetchColumn();
            if ($newId <= 0) throw new Exception('Gagal membuat jurnal reversal.');

            $stmtLines = $db->prepare("SELECT account_id, debit, credit, description FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id = :id");
            $stmtLines->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $origLines = $stmtLines->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$origLines) throw new Exception('Jurnal asal tidak memiliki detail; reversal dibatalkan.');

            $insertLine = $db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO journal_lines (journal_id, account_id, debit, credit, description)
                VALUES (:journal_id, :account_id, :debit, :credit, :description)
            ");
            foreach ($origLines as $line) {
                $insertLine->execute([
                    ':journal_id' => $newId,
                    ':account_id' => $line['account_id'],
                    ':debit' => $line['credit'],
                    ':credit' => $line['debit'],
                    ':description' => $line['description']
                ]);
            }

            $markOriginal = $db->prepare("UPDATE journal_entries SET status = 'reversed' WHERE id = :id AND status = 'posted'");
            $markOriginal->execute([':id' => $id]);
            if ($markOriginal->rowCount() !== 1) throw new Exception('Status jurnal asal berubah; reversal dibatalkan.');

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Jurnal berhasil di-reverse. Jurnal koreksi: {$reverseNo}"]);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
            throw $e;
        }
        break;

    case 'delete':
        $access = (int)($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 4) {
            http_response_code(403);
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) throw new Exception('ID jurnal tidak valid.');

        $db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT status FROM journal_entries WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
            $stmtChk->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $row = $stmtChk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$row) throw new Exception('Jurnal tidak ditemukan.');
            if ($row['status'] !== 'draft') {
                throw new Exception('Hanya jurnal berstatus Draft yang boleh dihapus.');
            }

            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id = :id")->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $deleteHeader = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM journal_entries WHERE id = :id AND status = 'draft'");
            $deleteHeader->execute([':id' => $id]);
            if ($deleteHeader->rowCount() !== 1) throw new Exception('Jurnal gagal dihapus; status mungkin telah berubah.');

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Jurnal berhasil dihapus.']);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
            throw $e;
        }
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task)]);
}

function saveJournal($db, $id, $post) {
    $journalDate = trim($post['journal_date'] ?? '');
    $periodId    = intval($post['period_id'] ?? 0);
    $desc        = $post['description'] ?? null;
    $linesJson   = $post['arrLines'] ?? '[]';
    $lines       = json_decode($linesJson, true);

    if (empty($journalDate)) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Tanggal jurnal wajib diisi.']);
        return;
    }
    if ($periodId <= 0) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode akuntansi wajib dipilih.']);
        return;
    }

    $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT is_closed FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
    $stmtP->execute(['id' => $periodId]);
    $period = $stmtP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$period) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode akuntansi tidak ditemukan.']);
        return;
    }
    if ($period['is_closed']) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode ini sudah ditutup, tidak bisa menambah jurnal.']);
        return;
    }

    if (!is_array($lines) || count($lines) < 2) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Jurnal minimal harus punya 2 baris (debit & kredit).']);
        return;
    }

    $totalDebit = 0;
    $totalCredit = 0;
    $validLines = [];
    foreach ($lines as $l) {
        $accId  = intval($l['account_id'] ?? 0);
        $debit  = Str2N($l['debit'] ?? 0);
        $credit = Str2N($l['credit'] ?? 0);
        if ($accId <= 0) continue;
        if ($debit == 0 && $credit == 0) continue;
        if ($debit > 0 && $credit > 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Satu baris tidak boleh diisi debit dan kredit sekaligus.']);
            return;
        }
        $totalDebit  += $debit;
        $totalCredit += $credit;
        $validLines[] = ['account_id' => $accId, 'debit' => $debit, 'credit' => $credit, 'description' => $l['description'] ?? null];
    }

    if (count($validLines) < 2) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Jurnal minimal harus punya 2 baris valid (ada akun & nominal).']);
        return;
    }

    if (abs($totalDebit - $totalCredit) > 0.01) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => "Jurnal tidak balance! Total Debit: {$totalDebit}, Total Kredit: {$totalCredit}"]);
        return;
    }

    $headerData = [
        'journal_date' => $journalDate,
        'period_id'    => $periodId,
        'description'  => $desc
    ];

    if ($id === null) {
        $journalNo = CreateRefNo('journal_entries', 'ref_no', 'JE');
        $headerData['ref_no']     = $journalNo;
        $headerData['reference_type'] = 'manual_entry';
        $headerData['reference_id']   = 0;
        $headerData['status']         = 'draft';

        $db->insert('journal_entries', $headerData);

        $stmtId = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM journal_entries WHERE ref_no = :no");
        $stmtId->execute(['no' => $journalNo]);
        $newId = $stmtId->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['id'] ?? null;

        if ($newId) {
            insertLines($db, $newId, $validLines);
        }
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Jurnal {$journalNo} berhasil disimpan."]);
    } else {
        $db->update('journal_entries', $headerData, "id = {$id}");
        $db->query("DELETE FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id = {$id}");
        insertLines($db, $id, $validLines);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Jurnal berhasil diperbarui.']);
    }
}

function insertLines($db, $journalId, $lines) {
    foreach ($lines as $l) {
        $db->insert('journal_lines', [
            'journal_id'  => $journalId,
            'account_id'  => $l['account_id'],
            'debit'       => $l['debit'],
            'credit'      => $l['credit'],
            'description' => $l['description']
        ]);
    }
}
