/*
Document : includes/card-monitoring.php
Description : Card Monitoring Proyek - Grid 3 Kolom + AI Recommendation Dinamis
              Format: Ringkasan Eksekutif + Rekomendasi Mitigasi
Usage      : <?php include BASE_PATH . "/includes/card-monitoring.php"; ?>
*/

if (!defined('BASE_PATH')) {
    define('BASE_PATH', realpath(__DIR__ . '/..'));
}

if (!isset($db)) {
    require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';
    $db = new crud();
}

// ============================================================
// AMBIL DATA MONITORING PROYEK
// ============================================================
$monitoringData = [];
try {
    $stmt = $db->query("
        SELECT 
            p.id, 
            p.name AS project_name,
            COALESCE(p.progress, 0) AS progress_pct,
            COALESCE(pm.usage_pct, 0) AS usage_pct,
            COALESCE(pm.usage_pct, 0) - COALESCE(p.progress, 0) AS gap,
            CASE 
                WHEN COALESCE(pm.usage_pct, 0) - COALESCE(p.progress, 0) > 20 THEN 'KRITIS'
                WHEN COALESCE(pm.usage_pct, 0) - COALESCE(p.progress, 0) > 10 THEN 'WASPADA'
                ELSE 'NORMAL'
            END AS status_flag,
            COALESCE(p.contract_value, 0) AS contract_value,
            COALESCE(p.budget, 0) AS budget
        FROM projects p
        LEFT JOIN v_project_material_vs_progress pm ON pm.project_id = p.id
        WHERE p.status = 'Berjalan'
        ORDER BY (COALESCE(pm.usage_pct, 0) - COALESCE(p.progress, 0)) DESC
        LIMIT 9
    ");
    $monitoringData = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
} catch (Exception $e) {
    error_log('[monitoring-card] Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    $monitoringData = [];
}

if (!function_exists('getMonStatusStyle')) {
    function getMonStatusStyle($status) {
        switch (strtoupper($status)) {
            case 'KRITIS':
                return ['bg' => 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2)', 'border' => '#ef4444', 'text' => '#ef4444', 'dot' => '#ef4444'];
            case 'WASPADA':
                return ['bg' => 'rgba(243, 156, 18, 0.2)', 'border' => '#f39c12', 'text' => '#f39c12', 'dot' => '#f39c12'];
            case 'NORMAL':
            default:
                return ['bg' => 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)', 'border' => '#10b981', 'text' => '#10b981', 'dot' => '#10b981'];
        }
    }
}

function fmtRpShort($n) {
    $n = (float)$n;
    if ($n >= 1000000000) return 'Rp ' . number_format($n / 1000000000, 1) . 'M';
    if ($n >= 1000000) return 'Rp ' . number_format($n / 1000000, 0) . 'jt';
    return 'Rp ' . number_format($n, 0);
}

<!-- JAVASCRIPT: HANDLE CLICK & FETCH AI -->

<script>
let selectedProjectId = null;

function selectMonitoringProject(projectId, projectName) {
    // Remove active class from all cards
    document.querySelectorAll('.mon-card-grid').forEach(card => {
        card.classList.remove('active');
    });
    
    // Add active class to selected card
    const selectedCard = document.querySelector(`.mon-card-grid[data-project-id="${projectId}"]`);
    if (selectedCard) {
        selectedCard.classList.add('active');
    }
    
    selectedProjectId = projectId;
    loadAiRecommendation(projectId, projectName);
}

async function loadAiRecommendation(projectId, projectName) {
    const container = document.getElementById('monAiRecommendation');
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="mon-ai-loading">🧠 Memuat analisis AI...</div>';
    
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`../php-crud/dashboardCRD.php?action=read_ai_recommendation&project_id=${projectId}`);
        const json = await res.json();
        
        if (!json.success || !json.data) {
            container.innerHTML = `
                <div class="mon-ai-header">
                    <div class="mon-ai-title">
                        <span>🧠</span>
                        <span>AI Cost & Schedule Variance Analysis</span>
                    </div>
                    <span class="mon-ai-project">${projectName}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="mon-ai-empty">Tidak ada rekomendasi AI untuk proyek ini.</div>
            `;
            return;
        }
        
        const d = json.data;
        const risk = (d.risk_level || 'LOW').toUpperCase();
        const riskClass = 'mon-risk-' + risk.toLowerCase();
        const recs = Array.isArray(d.recommendations) ? d.recommendations : [];
        
        let summaryText = d.ai_summary || 'Tidak ada ringkasan.';
        let recommendationsHtml = '';
        
        if (recs.length > 0) {
            recommendationsHtml = '<ul class="mon-ai-rec-list">' + 
                recs.map(r => `<li>${r}</li>`).join('') + 
                '</ul>';
        } else {
            recommendationsHtml = '<div class="mon-ai-empty">Tidak ada rekomendasi khusus.</div>';
        }
        
        container.innerHTML = `
            <div class="mon-ai-header">
                <div class="mon-ai-title">
                    <span>🧠</span>
                    <span>AI Cost & Schedule Variance Analysis</span>
                </div>
                <span class="mon-ai-risk-badge ${riskClass}">RISK: ${risk}</span>
            </div>
            
            <div class="mon-ai-section">
                <div class="mon-ai-section-title">
                    <span>📊</span>
                    <span>Ringkasan Eksekutif:</span>
                </div>
                <div class="mon-ai-summary">
                    ${summaryText}
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="mon-ai-section">
                <div class="mon-ai-section-title">
                    <span>✅</span>
                    <span>Rekomendasi Mitigasi:</span>
                </div>
                ${recommendationsHtml}
            </div>
            
            <div style="margin-top: 12px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.1);">
                <div style="font-size: 10px; color: #64748b;">
                    Analisis terakhir: ${new Date(d.created_at).toLocaleString('id-ID')}
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error loading AI recommendation:', err);
        container.innerHTML = `
            <div class="mon-ai-header">
                <div class="mon-ai-title">
                    <span>🧠</span>
                    <span>AI Cost & Schedule Variance Analysis</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="mon-ai-empty" style="color: #ef4444;">Gagal memuat rekomendasi AI.</div>
        `;
    }
}

// Auto-select first project on load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const firstCard = document.querySelector('.mon-card-grid');
    if (firstCard) {
        const projectId = firstCard.getAttribute('data-project-id');
        const projectName = firstCard.getAttribute('data-project-name');
        selectMonitoringProject(projectId, projectName);
    }
});
</script>

    <script type="text/javascript">
      $('.nav > li').css('width',$('#mainMenu').width() / <?php echo $menuWidth; ?>);
      // DOM element where the Timeline will be attached
      let container = document.getElementById('schPlywoodData');
      // Create a DataSet (allows two way data-binding)
      let groups = new vis.DataSet([
        {id: 0, content: 'Production Line 1', value: 1},
        {id: 1, content: 'Production Line 3', value: 3},
        {id: 2, content: 'Production Line 2', value: 2, className: 'blue'}
      ]);
      let items = new vis.DataSet([
        {id: 0, group: 0, content: 'Order X - item 0', start: new Date(2018, 12, 17), end: new Date(2018, 12, 21)},
        {id: 1, group: 0, content: 'Order Y - item 1', start: new Date(2018, 12, 21), end: new Date(2018, 12, 29)},
        {id: 2, group: 1, content: 'Order X - item 2', start: new Date(2018, 12, 16), end: new Date(2018, 12, 24)},
        {id: 3, group: 1, content: 'Order Z - item 3', start: new Date(2018, 12, 24), end: new Date(2019, 1, 10)},
        {id: 4, group: 1, content: 'Order Z - item 4', start: new Date(2019, 1, 10), end: new Date(2019, 1, 26)},
        {id: 5, group: 2, content: 'Order X - item 5', start: new Date(2018, 12, 10), end: new Date(2018, 12, 27)}
      ]);
      // Configuration for the Timeline
      let options = {
        // option groupOrder can be a property name or a sort function
        // the sort function must compare two groups and return a value
        //     > 0 when a > b
        //     < 0 when a < b
        //       0 when a == b
        groupOrder: function (a, b) {return a.value - b.value;},
        editable: false
      };
      // Create a Timeline
      function onSelect (properties) {alert('selected items: ' + properties.nodes);}
      let timeline = new vis.Timeline(container);
      timeline.setOptions(options);
      timeline.setGroups(groups);
      timeline.setItems(items);
      timeline.on('select', onSelect);
    </script>

/*! normalize.css v3.0.3 | MIT License | github.com/necolas/normalize.css */
/**
 * 1. Set default font family to sans-serif.
 * 2. Prevent iOS and IE text size adjust after device orientation change,
 *    without disabling user zoom.
 */
html {
  font-family: sans-serif;
  /* 1 */
  -ms-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  /* 2 */
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  /* 2 */
}

/**
 * Remove default margin.
 */
body {
  margin: 0;
}

/* HTML5 display definitions
   ========================================================================== */
/**
 * Correct `block` display not defined for any HTML5 element in IE 8/9.
 * Correct `block` display not defined for `details` or `summary` in IE 10/11
 * and Firefox.
 * Correct `block` display not defined for `main` in IE 11.
 */
article,
aside,
details,
figcaption,
figure,
footer,
header,
hgroup,
main,
menu,
nav,
section,
summary {
  display: block;
}

/**
 * 1. Correct `inline-block` display not defined in IE 8/9.
 * 2. Normalize vertical alignment of `progress` in Chrome, Firefox, and Opera.
 */
audio,
canvas,
progress,
video {
  display: inline-block;
  /* 1 */
  vertical-align: baseline;
  /* 2 */
}

/**
 * Prevent modern browsers from displaying `audio` without controls.
 * Remove excess height in iOS 5 devices.
 */
audio:not([controls]) {
  display: none;
  height: 0;
}

/**
 * Address `[hidden]` styling not present in IE 8/9/10.
 * Hide the `template` element in IE 8/9/10/11, Safari, and Firefox < 22.
 */
[hidden],
template {
  display: none;
}

/* Links
   ========================================================================== */
/**
 * Remove the gray background color from active links in IE 10.
 */
a {
  background-color: transparent;
}

/**
 * Improve readability of focused elements when they are also in an
 * active/hover state.
 */
a:active,
a:hover {
  outline: 0;
}

/* Text-level semantics
   ========================================================================== */
/**
 * Address styling not present in IE 8/9/10/11, Safari, and Chrome.
 */
abbr[title] {
  border-bottom: 1px dotted;
}

/**
 * Address style set to `bolder` in Firefox 4+, Safari, and Chrome.
 */
b,
strong {
  font-weight: bold;
}

/**
 * Address styling not present in Safari and Chrome.
 */
dfn {
  font-style: italic;
}

/**
 * Address variable `h1` font-size and margin within `section` and `article`
 * contexts in Firefox 4+, Safari, and Chrome.
 */
h1 {
  font-size: 2em;
  margin: 0.67em 0;
}

/**
 * Address styling not present in IE 8/9.
 */
mark {
  background: #ff0;
  color: #000;
}

/**
 * Address inconsistent and variable font size in all browsers.
 */
small {
  font-size: 80%;
}

/**
 * Prevent `sub` and `sup` affecting `line-height` in all browsers.
 */
sub,
sup {
  font-size: 75%;
  line-height: 0;
  position: relative;
  vertical-align: baseline;
}

sup {
  top: -0.5em;
}

sub {
  bottom: -0.25em;
}

/* Embedded content
   ========================================================================== */
/**
 * Remove border when inside `a` element in IE 8/9/10.
 */
img {
  border: 0;
}

/**
 * Correct overflow not hidden in IE 9/10/11.
 */
svg:not(:root) {
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Grouping content
   ========================================================================== */
/**
 * Address margin not present in IE 8/9 and Safari.
 */
figure {
  margin: 1em 40px;
}

/**
 * Address differences between Firefox and other browsers.
 */
hr {
  box-sizing: content-box;
  height: 0;
}

/**
 * Contain overflow in all browsers.
 */
pre {
  overflow: auto;
}

/**
 * Address odd `em`-unit font size rendering in all browsers.
 */
code,
kbd,
pre,
samp {
  font-family: monospace, monospace;
  font-size: 1em;
}

/* Forms
   ========================================================================== */
/**
 * Known limitation: by default, Chrome and Safari on OS X allow very limited
 * styling of `select`, unless a `border` property is set.
 */
/**
 * 1. Correct color not being inherited.
 *    Known issue: affects color of disabled elements.
 * 2. Correct font properties not being inherited.
 * 3. Address margins set differently in Firefox 4+, Safari, and Chrome.
 */
button,
input,
optgroup,
select,
textarea {
  color: inherit;
  /* 1 */
  font: inherit;
  /* 2 */
  margin: 0;
  /* 3 */
}

/**
 * Address `overflow` set to `hidden` in IE 8/9/10/11.
 */
button {
  overflow: visible;
}

/**
 * Address inconsistent `text-transform` inheritance for `button` and `select`.
 * All other form control elements do not inherit `text-transform` values.
 * Correct `button` style inheritance in Firefox, IE 8/9/10/11, and Opera.
 * Correct `select` style inheritance in Firefox.
 */
button,
select {
  text-transform: none;
}

/**
 * 1. Avoid the WebKit bug in Android 4.0.* where (2) destroys native `audio`
 *    and `video` controls.
 * 2. Correct inability to style clickable `input` types in iOS.
 * 3. Improve usability and consistency of cursor style between image-type
 *    `input` and others.
 */
button,
html input[type="button"],
input[type="reset"],
input[type="submit"] {
  -webkit-appearance: button;
  /* 2 */
  cursor: pointer;
  /* 3 */
}

/**
 * Re-set default cursor for disabled elements.
 */
button[disabled],
html input[disabled] {
  cursor: default;
}

/**
 * Remove inner padding and border in Firefox 4+.
 */
button::-moz-focus-inner,
input::-moz-focus-inner {
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

/**
 * Address Firefox 4+ setting `line-height` on `input` using `!important` in
 * the UA stylesheet.
 */
input {
  line-height: normal;
}

/**
 * It's recommended that you don't attempt to style these elements.
 * Firefox's implementation doesn't respect box-sizing, padding, or width.
 *
 * 1. Address box sizing set to `content-box` in IE 8/9/10.
 * 2. Remove excess padding in IE 8/9/10.
 */
input[type="checkbox"],
input[type="radio"] {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  /* 1 */
  padding: 0;
  /* 2 */
}

/**
 * Fix the cursor style for Chrome's increment/decrement buttons. For certain
 * `font-size` values of the `input`, it causes the cursor style of the
 * decrement button to change from `default` to `text`.
 */
input[type="number"]::-webkit-inner-spin-button,
input[type="number"]::-webkit-outer-spin-button {
  height: auto;
}

/**
 * 1. Address `appearance` set to `searchfield` in Safari and Chrome.
 * 2. Address `box-sizing` set to `border-box` in Safari and Chrome.
 */
input[type="search"] {
  -webkit-appearance: textfield;
  /* 1 */
  box-sizing: content-box;
  /* 2 */
}

/**
 * Remove inner padding and search cancel button in Safari and Chrome on OS X.
 * Safari (but not Chrome) clips the cancel button when the search input has
 * padding (and `textfield` appearance).
 */
input[type="search"]::-webkit-search-cancel-button,
input[type="search"]::-webkit-search-decoration {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
}

/**
 * Define consistent border, margin, and padding.
 */
fieldset {
  border: 1px solid #c0c0c0;
  margin: 0 2px;
  padding: 0.35em 0.625em 0.75em;
}

/**
 * 1. Correct `color` not being inherited in IE 8/9/10/11.
 * 2. Remove padding so people aren't caught out if they zero out fieldsets.
 */
legend {
  border: 0;
  /* 1 */
  padding: 0;
  /* 2 */
}

/**
 * Remove default vertical scrollbar in IE 8/9/10/11.
 */
textarea {
  overflow: auto;
}

/**
 * Don't inherit the `font-weight` (applied by a rule above).
 * NOTE: the default cannot safely be changed in Chrome and Safari on OS X.
 */
optgroup {
  font-weight: bold;
}

/*
 * Constants:
 *      STROKEWIDTH = 3px
 *      ARCSIZE     = 270 degrees (amount of circle the arc takes up)
 *      ARCTIME     = 1333ms (time it takes to expand and contract arc)
 *      ARCSTARTROT = 216 degrees (how much the start location of the arc
 *                                should rotate each time, 216 gives us a
 *                                5 pointed star shape (it's 360/5 * 3).
 *                                For a 7 pointed star, we might do
 *                                360/7 * 3 = 154.286)
 *      CONTAINERWIDTH = 28px
 *      SHRINK_TIME = 400ms
 */
.preloader-wrapper {
  display: inline-block;
  position: relative;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
}

.preloader-wrapper.small {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
}

.preloader-wrapper.big {
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
}

.preloader-wrapper.active {
  /* duration: 360 * ARCTIME / (ARCSTARTROT + (360-ARCSIZE)) */
  -webkit-animation: container-rotate 1568ms linear infinite;
  animation: container-rotate 1568ms linear infinite;
}

@-webkit-keyframes container-rotate {
  to {
    -webkit-transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

@keyframes container-rotate {
  to {
    -webkit-transform: rotate(360deg);
            transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

/**
 * IMPORTANT NOTE ABOUT CSS ANIMATION PROPERTIES (keanulee):
 *
 * iOS Safari (tested on iOS 8.1) does not handle animation-delay very well - it doesn't
 * guarantee that the animation will start _exactly_ after that value. So we avoid using
 * animation-delay and instead set custom keyframes for each color (as redundant as it
 * seems).
 *
 * We write out each animation in full (instead of separating animation-name,
 * animation-duration, etc.) because under the polyfill, Safari does not recognize those
 * specific properties properly, treats them as -webkit-animation, and overrides the
 * other animation rules. See https://github.com/Polymer/platform/issues/53.
 */
.active .spinner-layer.spinner-blue {
  /* durations: 4 * ARCTIME */
  -webkit-animation: fill-unfill-rotate 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both, blue-fade-in-out 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both;
  animation: fill-unfill-rotate 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both, blue-fade-in-out 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both;
}

.active .spinner-layer.spinner-red {
  /* durations: 4 * ARCTIME */
  -webkit-animation: fill-unfill-rotate 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both, red-fade-in-out 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both;
  animation: fill-unfill-rotate 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both, red-fade-in-out 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both;
}

.active .spinner-layer.spinner-yellow {
  /* durations: 4 * ARCTIME */
  -webkit-animation: fill-unfill-rotate 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both, yellow-fade-in-out 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both;
  animation: fill-unfill-rotate 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both, yellow-fade-in-out 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both;
}

.active .spinner-layer.spinner-green {
  /* durations: 4 * ARCTIME */
  -webkit-animation: fill-unfill-rotate 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both, green-fade-in-out 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both;
  animation: fill-unfill-rotate 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both, green-fade-in-out 5332ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite both;

/* The properties in this rule are only necessary for the 'flip' transition.
 * We need specify the perspective to create a projection matrix. This will add
 * some depth as the element flips. The depth number represents the distance of
 * the viewer from the z-plane. According to the CSS3 spec, 1000 is a moderate
 * value.
 */
.viewport-flip {
	-webkit-perspective: 1000;
	-moz-perspective: 1000;
	perspective: 1000;
	position: absolute;
}

	-moz-backface-visibility: hidden;
	-moz-transform: translateX(0);
	backface-visibility: hidden;
	transform: translateX(0);
}

/* Dimensions related to the popup arrow
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/* desired triangle height: 10px */
/**
 * guide for the arrow - its width, height, and offset are theme-dependent and
 * should be expessed as left, right, top, bottom, so that the element bearing
 * such a class becomes stretched inside its parent position: relative element.
 * The left/top/right/bottom specified below should reflect the corresponding
 * border radii and so it leaves room for the shadow:
 *     ..--------------------..
 *   ."        ^ top           ".
 *  /          v                 \
 * |     +------------------+     |
 * |     |                  |     |
 * | left|                  |right|
 * |<--->|                  |<--->|
 * |     +------------------+     |
 *  \          ^                 /
 *   `.        v bottom        .'
 *     ""--------------------""
 * The idea is that the top/left of the arrow container box does not move to a
 * coordinate smaller than the top/left of the guide and the right/bottom of
 * the arrow container box does not move to a coordinate larger than the
 * bottom/right of the guide. This will help us avoid the following situation:
 *        ..--------------------..
 *      ."        ^ top           ".
 *   /|/          v                 \
 *  / |     +------------------+     |
 *  \ |     |                  |     |
 *   \| left|                  |right|
 *    |<--->|                  |<--->|
 *    |     +------------------+     |
 *     \          ^                 /
 *      `.        v bottom        .'
 *        ""--------------------""
 * The arrow should not receive a top/left coordinate such that it is too close
 * to one of the corners, because then at first the shadow of the arrow and,
 * given a coordinate even closer to the corner, even the body of the arrow will
 * "stick out" of the corner of the popup. The guide provides a hint to the
 * arrow positioning code as to which range of values is acceptable for the
 * arrow container's top/left coordinate.
 **/
.ui-popup-arrow-container {
	width: 20px;
	height: 20px;
}
/* aside from the "infinities" (-1000,2000), triangle height is used */
.ui-popup-arrow-container.ui-popup-arrow-l {
	left: -10px;
	clip: rect(-1000px,10px,2000px,-1000px);
}
.ui-popup-arrow-container.ui-popup-arrow-t {
	top: -10px;
	clip: rect(-1000px,2000px,10px,-1000px);
}
.ui-popup-arrow-container.ui-popup-arrow-r {
	right: -10px;
	clip: rect(-1000px,2000px,2000px,10px);
}
.ui-popup-arrow-container.ui-popup-arrow-b {
	bottom: -10px;
	clip: rect(10px,2000px,1000px,-1000px);
}
/**
 * For each side, the arrow is twice the desired size and its corner is aligned
 * with the edge of the container:
 *                                           
 *           /\         /\                +----+	     /\
 *          /  \       /  \ 					    | /\ |top   /  \
 *      +----+  \     /  +----+       +-->|/  \|     /    \
 *  left| /  |   \   /   |  \ |right  |   |    |    /      \
 *      |/   |    \ /    |   \| 			|  /|    |\  /        \
 *      |\   |    / \    |   /| 			| / +----+ \ \ +----+ /
 *      | \  |   /   \   |  / |       | \        /  \|    |/
 *      +----+  /     \  +----+       |  \      /    |    |
 *       ^  \  /       \  /  ^        |   \    /  +->|\  /|
 *       |   \/         \/   |        |    \  /   |  | \/ |bottom
 *       |                   |        |     \/    |  +----+
 *       +-------------------+--------+-----------+
 *                           |
 *                    arrow container
 *                     (clips arrow)
 **/
.ui-popup-arrow-container .ui-popup-arrow {
	/* (4*desired triangle height)/sqrt(2) - does not account for border - centred within the outer rectangle */
	width: 28.284271247px;
	height: 28.284271247px;
	border-width: 1px;
	border-style: solid;
}
.ui-popup-arrow-container.ui-popup-arrow-t .ui-popup-arrow {
	left: -4.142135623px;
	top: 5.857864376px;
}
.ui-popup-arrow-container.ui-popup-arrow-b .ui-popup-arrow {
	left: -4.142135623px;
	top: -14.142135623px;
}
.ui-popup-arrow-container.ui-popup-arrow-l .ui-popup-arrow {
	left: 5.857864376px;
	top: -4.142135623px;
}
.ui-popup-arrow-container.ui-popup-arrow-r .ui-popup-arrow {
	left: -14.142135623px;
	top: -4.142135623px;
}
/* Fix rotation center for oldIE - see http://www.useragentman.com/IETransformsTranslator/ */
.ui-popup-arrow-container.ui-popup-arrow-t.ie .ui-popup-arrow {
    margin-left: -5.857864376269049px;
    margin-top: -7.0710678118654755px;

/*
  Global letiable
*/
Ext.Ajax.on('beforerequest', function(conn, options) {
    if (!options.url) {
        return;
    }

    var pathname = window.location.pathname;

    // Deteksi root aplikasi: /rab-project/dev/ atau /rab-project/live/
    var match = pathname.match(
        /^(.*?\/rab-project\/(?:dev|live)\/)/i
    );

    if (!match) {
        console.error('APP ROOT tidak ditemukan:', pathname);
        return;
    }

    var appRoot = match[1];pathname

    // URL eksternal tidak boleh diubah.
    if (/^(https?:)?\/\//i.test(options.url)) {
        return;
    }

    var url = options.url;

    // URL absolut yang sudah menunjuk ke aplikasi dev/live dipertahankan.
    if (/^\/rab-project\/(?:dev|live)\//i.test(url)) {
        return;
    }

    // URL absolut lama /rab-project/... diarahkan ke root aktif.
    if (/^\/rab-project\//i.test(url)) {
        options.url = url.replace(
            /^\/rab-project\//i,
            appRoot
        );
        return;
    }

    // Hapus prefix relatif ../ berulang.
    url = url.replace(/^(\.\.\/)+/, '');

    // Hilangkan prefix dev/ atau live/ jika sudah ada.
    url = url.replace(/^(?:dev|live)\//i, '');

    // URL dimulai dari root aplikasi aktif.
    options.url = appRoot + url.replace(/^\/+/, '');
});

Date.prototype.addDays = function (num) {
    let value = this.valueOf();
    value += 86400000 * num;
    return new Date(value);
}

Date.prototype.addSeconds = function (num) {
    let value = this.valueOf();
    value += 1000 * num;
    return new Date(value);
}

Date.prototype.addMinutes = function (num) {
    let value = this.valueOf();
    value += 60000 * num;
    return new Date(value);
}

/* Calculate the height for grid to fit on screen*/
function getPosition(element) {
  let xPosition = 0;
  let yPosition = 0;
  while(element) {
      xPosition += (element.offsetLeft - element.scrollLeft + element.clientLeft);
      yPosition += (element.offsetTop - element.scrollTop + element.clientTop);
      element = element.offsetParent;
  }
  return { x: xPosition, y: yPosition };
}
function maxGridHeight(element){
  let position = getPosition(element);
  let GridHeight=(window.innerHeight-position.y);
  return Height=Math.round(GridHeight);
}

Ext.util.Format.comboRenderer = function(comboGrid){
  return function(value){
    let recordCombo = comboGrid.findRecord(comboGrid.valueField, value);
    return recordCombo ? '<div style="white-space:normal !important;">'+ recordCombo.get(comboGrid.displayField) +'</div>': comboGrid.valueNotFoundText;
  };
};

Ext.ux.renderer.ComboRenderer = function(options) {
    let value = options.value;
    let combo = options.combo;
    let returnValue = value;
    let valueField = combo.valueField;
    let idx = combo.store.findBy(function(record) {if(record.get(valueField) == value) {returnValue = record.get(combo.displayField); return true;}});
    if(idx < 0 && value == 0) {returnValue = '';}
    return returnValue;
};
Ext.ux.renderer.Combo = function(combo) {
  return function(value, meta, record) {
    return Ext.ux.renderer.ComboRenderer({value: value, meta: meta, record: record, combo: combo});
  };
}

function strip_tags(input, allowed) {
  allowed = (((allowed || '') + '')
  .toLowerCase()
  .match(/<[a-z][a-z0-9]*>/g) || [])
  .join('');
  let tags = /<\/?([a-z][a-z0-9]*)\b[^>]*>/gi,commentsAndPhpTags = /<!--[\s\S]*?-->|<\?(?:php)?[\s\S]*?\?>/gi;
  return input.replace(commentsAndPhpTags, '')
  .replace(tags, function($0, $1) {return allowed.indexOf('<' + $1.toLowerCase() + '>') > -1 ? $0 : '';});
}

/*
 * Date Format 1.2.3
 * (c) 2007-2009 Steven Levithan <stevenlevithan.com>
 * MIT license
 *
 * Includes enhancements by Scott Trenda <scott.trenda.net>
 * and Kris Kowal <cixar.com/~kris.kowal/>
 *
 * Accepts a date, a mask, or a date and a mask.
 * Returns a formatted version of the given date.
 * The date defaults to the current date/time.
 * The mask defaults to dateFormat.masks.default.
*/
let dateFormat = function () {
  let token = /d{1,4}|m{1,4}|yy(?:yy)?|([HhMsTt])\1?|[LloSZ]|"[^"]*"|'[^']*'/g,
    timezone = /\b(?:[PMCEA][SDP]T|(?:Pacific|Mountain|Central|Eastern|Atlantic) (?:Standard|Daylight|Prevailing) Time|(?:GMT|UTC)(?:[-+]\d{4})?)\b/g,
    timezoneClip = /[^-+\dA-Z]/g,
    pad = function (val, len) {
      val = String(val);
      len = len || 2;
      while (val.length < len) val = "0" + val;
      return val;
    };

  // Regexes and supporting functions are cached through closure
  return function (date, mask, utc) {
    let dF = dateFormat;
    // You can't provide utc if you skip other args (use the "UTC:" mask prefix)
    if (arguments.length == 1 && Object.prototype.toString.call(date) == "[object String]" && !/\d/.test(date)) {
      mask = date;
      date = undefined;
    }
    // Passing date through Date applies Date.parse, if necessary
    date = date ? new Date(date) : new Date;
    if (isNaN(date)) throw SyntaxError("proyekalid date");

    mask = String(dF.masks[mask] || mask || dF.masks["default"]);

    // Allow setting the utc argument via the mask
    if (mask.slice(0, 4) == "UTC:") {
      mask = mask.slice(4);
      utc = true;
    }

    let _ = utc ? "getUTC" : "get",
      d = date[_ + "Date"](),
      D = date[_ + "Day"](),
      m = date[_ + "Month"](),
      y = date[_ + "FullYear"](),
      H = date[_ + "Hours"](),
      M = date[_ + "Minutes"](),
      s = date[_ + "Seconds"](),
      L = date[_ + "Milliseconds"](),
      o = utc ? 0 : date.getTimezoneOffset(),
      flags = {
        d:    d,
        dd:   pad(d),
        ddd:  dF.i18n.dayNames[D],
        dddd: dF.i18n.dayNames[D + 7],
        m:    m + 1,
        mm:   pad(m + 1),
        mmm:  dF.i18n.monthNames[m],
        mmmm: dF.i18n.monthNames[m + 12],
        yy:   String(y).slice(2),
        yyyy: y,
        h:    H % 12 || 12,
        hh:   pad(H % 12 || 12),
        H:    H,
        HH:   pad(H),
        M:    M,
        MM:   pad(M),
        s:    s,
        ss:   pad(s),
        l:    pad(L, 3),
        L:    pad(L > 99 ? Math.round(L / 10) : L),
        t:    H < 12 ? "a"  : "p",
        tt:   H < 12 ? "am" : "pm",
        T:    H < 12 ? "A"  : "P",
        TT:   H < 12 ? "AM" : "PM",
        Z:    utc ? "UTC" : (String(date).match(timezone) || [""]).pop().replace(timezoneClip, ""),
        o:    (o > 0 ? "-" : "+") + pad(Math.floor(Math.abs(o) / 60) * 100 + Math.abs(o) % 60, 4),
        S:    ["th", "st", "nd", "rd"][d % 10 > 3 ? 0 : (d % 100 - d % 10 != 10) * d % 10]
      };

    return mask.replace(token, function ($0) {
      return $0 in flags ? flags[$0] : $0.slice(1, $0.length - 1);
    });
  };
}();
// Some common format strings
dateFormat.masks = {
  "default"     :      "ddd mmm dd yyyy HH:MM:ss",
  shortDate     :      "m/d/yy",
  mediumDate    :     "mmm d, yyyy",
  longDate      :       "mmmm d, yyyy",
  fullDate      :       "dddd, mmmm d, yyyy",
  shortTime     :      "h:MM TT",
  mediumTime    :     "h:MM:ss TT",
  longTime      :       "h:MM:ss TT Z",
  isoDate       :        "yyyy-mm-dd",
  isoTime       :        "HH:MM:ss",
  isoDateTime   :    "yyyy-mm-dd'T'HH:MM:ss",
  isoUtcDateTime: "UTC:yyyy-mm-dd'T'HH:MM:ss'Z'"
};
// Internationalization strings
dateFormat.i18n = {
  dayNames: ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat","Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"],
  monthNames: ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec","January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"]
};
// For convenience...
Date.prototype.format = function (mask, utc) {return dateFormat(this, mask, utc);};

function isDate(val) {
    if (val === null || val === undefined || val === '') {
        return false;
    }
    if (Ext.isDate(val) || Object.prototype.toString.call(val) === '[object Date]') {
        return !isNaN(val.getTime());
    }
    if (typeof val === 'string' || typeof val === 'number') {
        let d = new Date(val);
        return !isNaN(d.getTime());
    }
    return false;
}

function diff2date(date1,date2){
  let difference = 0;
  let diffDays = 0;
  difference = date1 - date2;
  diffDays = Math.round(difference/(1000*60*60*24));
  return diffDays;
}

function Grid2Json(GridName){
  let i=0;
  let recordData=[];
  let jsonRecord = [];
  for (i=0;i<GridName.store.getCount();i++){
    recordData=GridName.store.getAt(i);
    jsonRecord.push(recordData.data);
  };
  return Ext.encode(jsonRecord);
};

function Search_Array(ArrayObj, SearchFor){
  let Found = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < ArrayObj.length; i++){
    if (ArrayObj[i] == SearchFor){
      return true;
      let Found = true;
      break;
    }
    else if ((i == (ArrayObj.length - 1)) && (!Found)){
      if (ArrayObj[i] != SearchFor){
        return false;
      }
    }
  }
}

let stdGridPaging = Ext.extend(Ext.grid.GridPanel, {
  stripeRows : true,
  width      : '100%',
  loadMask   : {msg:'Loading Data ...'},
  viewConfig : {forceFit : true, autoFill: false, scrollOffset: 10},
  initComponent: function() {
    this.sm = new Ext.grid.RowSelectionModel({
      singleSelect : false,
      listeners    : {rowselect : {fn: function(sm,index,record) {dataRecord=record.data;}}}
    });
    this.colModel = new Ext.grid.ColumnModel({
      columnLines : true,
      defaults    : {menuDisabled: true, resizable: false,sortable: false},
      columns     : this.columns
    });
    this.bbar = new Ext.PagingToolbar({
      pageSize    : this.pageSize,
      store       : this.pageStore,
      displayInfo : true,
      displayMsg  : 'Data {0} - {1} of {2}',
      emptyMsg    : 'No data to display'
    });
    stdGrid.superclass.initComponent.call(this);
  }
});

let stdGridEditor = Ext.extend(Ext.grid.EditorGridPanel, {
  stripeRows      : true,
  width           : '100%',
  loadMask        : {msg:'Loading Data ...'},
  enableKeyEvents : true,
  clicksToEdit    : 1,
  viewConfig      : {forceFit : true, autoFill: false, scrollOffset: 10},
  initComponent   : function() {
    this.colModel = new Ext.grid.ColumnModel({
      columnLines : true,
      defaults    : {menuDisabled: true, resizable: false, sortable: false},
      columns     : this.columns
    });

    // PERBAIKAN (v2): sebelumnya cuma cek `if (!this.sm && !this.selModel)`
    // dengan asumsi Ext.grid.GridPanel otomatis meng-alias this.selModel
    // ke this.sm. Ternyata tidak bisa diandalkan di versi ExtJS ini --
    // this.sm harus di-set EKSPLISIT, karena itu yang benar-benar dibaca
    // saat grid melakukan getSelectionModel().init(grid) untuk memicu
    // initEvents() (tempat listener cellclick milik ItemDeleter didaftarkan).
    if (this.selModel && !this.sm) {
      this.sm = this.selModel; // pakai selModel custom dari caller (mis. editorDeleter)
    }
    if (!this.sm) {
      this.sm = new Ext.grid.RowSelectionModel({
        singleSelect : true,
        listeners    : {
          rowselect : {fn: function(sm, index, record) { dataRecord = record.data; }}
        }
      });
    }

    // Auto-fix dimensi input sel saat user melakukan klik/edit
    this.on('beforeedit', function(e) {
      setTimeout(function() {
        if (e.grid && e.grid.activeEditor && e.grid.activeEditor.field) {
          var field = e.grid.activeEditor.field;
          if (field.el) {
            field.el.setStyle({
              'height': '22px',
              'line-height': '22px',
              'margin': '0px',
              'padding': '0px 4px'
            });
          }
        }
      }, 10);
    });

    stdGridEditor.superclass.initComponent.call(this);
  }
});

let myNumberField = Ext.extend(Ext.form.NumberField, {
  baseChars        : '0123456789,',
  style            : 'text-align: right',
  cls              : 'fieldNumberClass',
  labelSeparator   : ' ',
  decimalPrecision : 2,
  anchor  : '98%',
  //allowBlank       : false,
  setValue         : function(v){
    v = typeof v == 'number' ? v : String(v).replace(this.decimalSeparator, '.').replace(/,/g, '');
    //v = isNaN(v) ? '' : String(v).replace(".", this.decimalSeparator);
    if (this.decimalPrecision ==1) {
      v = isNaN(v) ? '' : Ext.util.Format.number(this.fixPrecision(String(v)), '000,000,000,000,000.0');
    }
    else if (this.decimalPrecision ==2) {
      v = isNaN(v) ? '' : Ext.util.Format.number(this.fixPrecision(String(v)), '000,000,000,000,000.00');
    }
    else if (this.decimalPrecision ==3) {
      v = isNaN(v) ? '' : Ext.util.Format.number(this.fixPrecision(String(v)), '000,000,000,000,000.000');
    }
    else if (this.decimalPrecision ==4) {
      v = isNaN(v) ? '' : Ext.util.Format.number(this.fixPrecision(String(v)), '000,000,000,000,000.0000');
    }
    else if (this.decimalPrecision ==5) {
      v = isNaN(v) ? '' : Ext.util.Format.number(this.fixPrecision(String(v)), '000,000,000,000,000.00000');
    }
    else if (this.decimalPrecision ==6) {
      v = isNaN(v) ? '' : Ext.util.Format.number(this.fixPrecision(String(v)), '000,000,000,000,000.000000');
    }
    else {
      v = isNaN(v) ? '' : Ext.util.Format.number(this.fixPrecision(String(v)), '000,000,000,000,000');
    }
    //v = isNaN(v) ? '' : Ext.util.Format.number(this.fixPrecision(String(v)), "0,000,000.00");
    this.setRawValue(v);
    return Ext.form.NumberField.superclass.setValue.call(this, v);
  },
  fixPrecision: function(value){
    let nan = isNaN(value);
    if (!this.allowDecimals || this.decimalPrecision == -1 || nan || !value) {
      return nan ? '' : value;
    }
    return parseFloat(value).toFixed(this.decimalPrecision);
  },
  validateValue: function(value){
    //if (!Ext.form.NumberField.superclass.validateValue.call(this, value)) {
    //    return false;
    //}
    if (value.length < 1) { // if it's blank and textfield didn't flag it then it's valid
      return true;
    }
    value = String(value).replace(this.decimalSeparator, '.').replace(/,/g, '');
    if (isNaN(value)) {
      this.markInvalid(String.format(this.nanText, value));
      return false;
    }
    let num = this.parseValue(value);
    if (num < this.minValue) {
      this.markInvalid(String.format(this.minText, this.minValue));
      return false;
    }
    if (num > this.maxValue) {
      this.markInvalid(String.format(this.maxText, this.maxValue));
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  },
  parseValue: function(value){
    value = parseFloat(String(value).replace(this.decimalSeparator, '.').replace(/,/g, ''));
    return isNaN(value) ? 0 : value;
  },
  listeners: {
    'focus': function(f) {if (f.getEl().dom.labels[0]) { f.getEl().dom.labels[0].style.color='#2d8cf0'; }},
    'blur': function(f) {if (f.getEl().dom.labels[0]) { f.getEl().dom.labels[0].style.color='#009688'; }}
  }
});

Ext.override(Ext.form.Checkbox, {

Ext.override(Ext.data.Store,{
    addField: function(field){
      field = new Ext.data.Field(field);
      this.recordType.prototype.fields.replace(field);
      if(typeof field.defaultValue != 'undefined'){
        this.each(function(r){
          if(typeof r.data[field.name] == 'undefined'){
            r.data[field.name] = field.defaultValue;
          }
        });
      }
    },
    removeField: function(name){
      this.recordType.prototype.fields.removeKey(name);
      this.each(function(r){
        delete r.data[name];
        if(r.modified){
          delete r.modified[name];
        }
      });
    }
  });
Ext.override(Ext.grid.ColumnModel,{
  addColumn: function(column, colIndex){
    if(typeof column == 'string'){
      column = {header: column, dataIndex: column};
    }
    let config = this.config;
    this.config = [];
    if(typeof colIndex == 'number'){
      config.splice(colIndex, 0, column);
    }else{
      colIndex = config.push(column);
    }
    this.setConfig(config);
    return colIndex;
  },
  removeColumn: function(colIndex){
    let config = this.config;
    this.config = [config[colIndex]];
    config.splice(colIndex, 1);
    this.setConfig(config);
  }
});
Ext.override(Ext.grid.GridPanel,{
  addColumn: function(field, column, colIndex){
  if(!column){
    if(field.dataIndex){
      column = field;
      field = field.dataIndex;
    } else{
      column = field.name || field;
    }
  }
  this.store.addField(field);
  return this.colModel.addColumn(column, colIndex);
  },
  removeColumn: function(name, colIndex){
    this.store.removeField(name);
    if(typeof colIndex != 'number'){
      colIndex = this.colModel.findColumnIndex(name);
    }
    if(colIndex >= 0){
      this.colModel.removeColumn(colIndex);
    }
  }
});
/*
Start of  *** Ext.ux.MultiGrouping
*/
Ext.ux.MultiGroupingStore = Ext.extend(Ext.data.GroupingStore,{
    sortInfo: [],
    sort : function(field, dir){
        let f = [];
        if(Ext.isArray(field)){
            for(i=0,len=field.length; i<len; ++i){
              f.push(this.fields.get(field[i]));
            }
        }
        else{
           f.push(this.fields.get(field));
        }
        if(f.length < 1){
            return false;
        }
        if(!dir){
            if(this.sortInfo && this.sortInfo.length > 0 && this.sortInfo[0].field == f[0].name){ // toggle sort dir
                dir = (this.sortToggle[f[0].name] || 'ASC').toggle('ASC', 'DESC');
            }else{
                dir = f[0].sortDir;
            }
        }
        let st = (this.sortToggle) ? this.sortToggle[f[0].name] : null;
        let si = (this.sortInfo) ? this.sortInfo : null;
        this.sortToggle[f[0].name] = dir;
        this.sortInfo = [];
        for(i=0,len=f.length; i<len; ++i){
            this.sortInfo.push({field: f[i].name, direction: dir});
        }
        if(!this.remoteSort){
            this.applySort();
            this.fireEvent('datachanged', this);
        }else{
            if (!this.load(this.lastOptions)) {
                if (st) {
                    this.sortToggle[f[0].name] = st;
                }
                if (si) {
                    this.sortInfo = si;
                }
            }
        }
    },
    setDefaultSort : function(field, dir){
        dir = dir ? dir.toUpperCase() : 'ASC';
        this.sortInfo=[];
        if(!Ext.isArray(field))
            this.sortInfo.push({field: field, direction: dir});
        else{
          for(i=0,len=field.length; i<len; ++i){
            this.sortInfo.push({field: field[i].field, direction: dir});
            this.sortToggle[field[i]] = dir;
          }
        }
    },
    constructor: function(config){
        Ext.ux.MultiGroupingStore.superclass.constructor.apply(this,arguments);
    },
    groupBy : function(field, forceRegroup){
        if(!forceRegroup && this.groupField == field){
            return; // already grouped by this field
        }

        this.groupField = field;

        if(this.remoteGroup){
            if(!this.baseParams){
                this.baseParams = {};
            }
            this.baseParams['groupBy'] = field;
        }
        if(this.groupOnSort){
            this.sort(field);
            return;
        }
        if(this.remoteGroup){
            this.reload();
        }else{
            let si = this.sortInfo || [];
            if(si.field != field){
                this.applySort();
            }else{
                this.sortData(field);
            }
            this.fireEvent('datachanged', this);
        }
    },

    applySort : function(){
        let si = this.sortInfo;

        if(si && si.length > 0 && !this.remoteSort){
            this.sortData(si, si[0].direction);
        }

        if(!this.groupOnSort && !this.remoteGroup){
            let gs = this.getGroupState();
            if(gs && gs != this.sortInfo){
                this.sortData(this.groupField);
            }
        }
    },

    getGroupState : function(){
        return this.groupOnSort && this.groupField !== false ?
               (this.sortInfo ? this.sortInfo : undefined) : this.groupField;
    },

    sortData : function(flist, direction){
        direction = direction || 'ASC';

        let st=[];
        let o;
        for(i=0,len=flist.length; i < len; ++i){
            o = flist[i];
            st.push(this.fields.get(o.field ? o.field : o).sortType);
        }

        let fn = function(r1, r2){
            let v1=[];
            let v2=[];
            let len = flist.length;
            let o;
            let name;
            for(i=0; i<len; ++i){
              o = flist[i];
              name= o.field ? o.field : o;

              v1.push(st[i](r1.data[name]));
              v2.push(st[i](r2.data[name]));
            }

            let result;
            for(i=0; i<len; ++i){
                result = v1[i] > v2[i] ? 1 : (v1[i] < v2[i] ? -1 : 0);
                if(result != 0)
                    return result;
            }

            return result; //if it gets here, that means all fields are equal
        };

        this.data.sort(direction, fn);
        if(this.snapshot && this.snapshot != this.data){
            this.snapshot.sort(direction, fn);
        }
    }

});

Ext.ux.MultiGroupingView = Ext.extend(Ext.grid.GroupingView,{
    displayEmptyFields: false,
    displayFieldSeperator: ', ',

    renderRows : function(){
        let groupField = this.getGroupField();
        let eg = !!groupField;
        // if they turned off grouping and the last grouped field is hidden
        if(this.hideGroupedColumn) {
            let colIndexes = [];
            for(i=0,len=groupField.length; i<len; ++i){
                colIndexes.push(this.cm.findColumnIndex(groupField[i]));
            }
            if(!eg && this.lastGroupField !== undefined) {
                this.mainBody.update('');
                for(i=0,len=this.lastGroupField.length; i<len; ++i){
                    this.cm.setHidden(this.cm.findColumnIndex(this.lastGroupField[i]), false);
                }
                delete this.lastGroupField;
            }else if (eg && colIndexes.length > 0 && this.lastGroupField === undefined) {
                this.lastGroupField = groupField;
                for(i=0,len=colIndexes.length; i<len; ++i){
                    this.cm.setHidden(colIndexes[i], true);
                }
            }else if (eg && this.lastGroupField !== undefined && groupField !== this.lastGroupField) {
                this.mainBody.update('');
                for(i=0,len=this.lastGroupField.length; i<len; ++i){
                    this.cm.setHidden(this.cm.findColumnIndex(this.lastGroupField[i]), false);
                }
                this.lastGroupField = groupField;
                for(i=0,len=colIndexes.length; i<len; ++i){
                    this.cm.setHidden(colIndexes[i], true);
                }
            }
        }
        return Ext.ux.MultiGroupingView.superclass.renderRows.apply(this, arguments);
    },

 doRender : function(cs, rs, ds, startRow, colCount, stripe){
        if(rs.length < 1){
            return '';
        }
        let groupField = this.getGroupField();
        this.enableGrouping = !!groupField;

        if(!this.enableGrouping || this.isUpdating){
            return Ext.grid.GroupingView.superclass.doRender.apply(this, arguments);
        }

        let gstyle = 'width:'+this.getTotalWidth()+';';

        let gidPrefix = this.grid.getGridEl().id;

            let groups = [], curGroup, i, len, gid;
            for(i = 0, len = rs.length; i < len; i++)
            {
                let rowIndex = startRow + i;
                let r = rs[i];

                    let gvalue=[];
                    let fieldName;
                    let grpDisplayValues = [];
                    let v;
                    for(j=0,gfLen=groupField.length; j<gfLen; ++j){
                        fieldName = groupField[j];
                        v = r.data[fieldName];
                        if(v){
                          gvalue.push(v);
                          grpDisplayValues.push(fieldName.toUpperCase() + ' : ' + v);
                        }
                        else if(this.displayEmptyFields){
                          grpDisplayValues.push(fieldName.toUpperCase() + ' : ');
                        }
                    }

                    //g = this.getGroup(gvalue, r, groupRenderer, rowIndex, colIndexes[index], ds);
                    if(gvalue.length < 1 && this.emptyGroupText)
                        g = this.emptyGroupText;
                    else
                        g = grpDisplayValues.join(this.displayFieldSeperator);

                    if(!curGroup || curGroup.group != g)
                    {
                        gid = gidPrefix + '-gp-' + groupField + '-' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(g);
                           // if state is defined use it, however state is in terms of expanded
                        // so negate it, otherwise use the default.
                        let isCollapsed  = typeof this.state[gid] !== 'undefined' ? !this.state[gid] : this.startCollapsed;
                        let gcls = isCollapsed ? 'x-grid-group-collapsed' : '';
                        curGroup = {
                            group: g,
                            gvalue: gvalue,
                            text: g,
                            groupId: gid,
                            startRow: rowIndex,
                            rs: [r],
                            cls: gcls,
                            style: gstyle
                        };
                        groups.push(curGroup);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        curGroup.rs.push(r);
                    }
                    r._groupId = gid;
            }

        let buf = [];
        for(i = 0, len = groups.length; i < len; i++){
            let g = groups[i];
            this.doGroupStart(buf, g, cs, ds, colCount);
            buf[buf.length] = Ext.grid.GroupingView.superclass.doRender.call(
                    this, cs, g.rs, ds, g.startRow, colCount, stripe);

            this.doGroupEnd(buf, g, cs, ds, colCount);
        }
        return buf.join('');
    }

});

/*
End of  *** Ext.ux.MultiGrouping
*/

Ext.apply(Ext.form.VTypes, {
  daterange : function(val, field) {
        let date = field.parseDate(val);

        if(!date){
            return false;
        }
        if (field.startDateField) {
            let start = Ext.getCmp(field.startDateField);
            if (!start.maxValue || (date.getTime() != start.maxValue.getTime())) {
                start.setMaxValue(date);
                start.validate();
            }
        }
        else if (field.endDateField) {
            let end = Ext.getCmp(field.endDateField);
            if (!end.minValue || (date.getTime() != end.minValue.getTime())) {
                end.setMinValue(date);
                end.validate();
            }
        }
        /*
         * Always return true since we're only using this vtype to set the
         * min/max allowed values (these are tested for after the vtype test)
         */
        return true;
    },
  daterangeText: 'Start date must be less than end date',
});
Ext.apply(Ext.form.VTypes, {
  password: function(val, field) {
      if (field.initialPassField) {
          let pwd = Ext.getCmp(field.initialPassField);
          return (val == pwd.getValue());
          return true;
      }
  },
  passwordText: 'Passwords do not match'
});

==================== FILE: ./update_password.php ====================
<?php
// Pastikan sesi aktif dan load koneksi database menggunakan kelas CRUD (PDO)
//xdebug_break();
if (!isset($_SESSION)) {
    session_start();
    //xdebug_break();

}
/*require_once   '/php-func/function.all.php';
require_once   '/php-class/crudClass.php';*/
require_once __DIR__ . '/php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/php-class/crudClass.php';



try {
    $db = new crud();

    // 1. Ambil seluruh data pengguna dari tabel (Sesuaikan nama tabel jika m_user atau m_user_system)
    // Berdasarkan file sistem lama Anda, tabel user umumnya m_user
    $stmt = $db->query("SELECT id, login_name, password FROM m_user_system where id=1");
    $users = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    echo "<h3>Memulai Proses update Password ke Format Modern...</h3>";
    $count = 0;

    foreach ($users as $user) {
        $userId   = $user['id'];
        $username = $user['login_name'];
        $currentPass = 'admin789';

        // Cek apakah password sudah berformat hash modern (biasanya diawali $2y$ untuk bcrypt)
        $info = password_get_info($currentPass);




        if (!isset($info['algo']) || $info['algo'] === 0) {
            // Jika belum di-hash (masih plaintext atau enkripsi lama), buat hash baru dengan password_hash() PHP
            $newHashedPassword = password_hash($currentPass, PASSWORD_DEFAULT);

            // Update kembali ke database secara aman menggunakan Prepared Statements
            $updateStmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE m_user_system SET password = :new_pass WHERE id = :id");
            $updateStmt->execute([
                ':new_pass' => $newHashedPassword,
                ':id'       => $userId
            ]);

            echo "User: <b>{$username}</b> (ID: {$userId}) berhasil di-hash. Oldpassword: {{$currentPass}} and Newpassword: {{$newHashedPassword}}<br>";
            $count++;
        } else {
            echo "User: <b>{$username}</b> sudah menggunakan format hash modern, dilewati. dan Oldpassword: {{$currentPass}}<br>";
        }
    }

    echo "<br><b>Selesai! Total {$count} password berhasil diperbarui.</b>";
    echo "<br><span style='color:red;'><b>PENTING:</b> Segera hapus file migrasi ini setelah selesai demi keamanan!</span>";

} catch (PDOException $e) {
    echo "Terjadi kesalahan database: " . $e->getMessage();
}
?>

/**
 * tests/run_e2e_client_supplied.php
 *
 * Runner E2E fitur "Material Titipan Klien (CLIENT_SUPPLIED) Rp 0" (patch gelombang 2, item F-4.1):

 *   - purchase.planningCRD  : load_planning & check_inventory mengembalikan qty_to_buy = 0 untuk

 *   - poCRD.php             : list_rab_items menampilkan qty_to_buy = 0 & material_source;
 *                             save_po MENOLAK budget_item CLIENT_SUPPLIED (kebutuhan bersih = 0).
 *   - grnCRD.php            : unit_cost DIPAKSA 0 server-side untuk item CLIENT_SUPPLIED.
 *   - whrcvCRD.php          : penerimaan fisik Rp 0 masuk stock_movements IN tanpa jurnal GRN_RCV.
 *   - warehouse.issuingCRD  : issue stok Rp 0 OUT tanpa jurnal ISSUE_PROJECT.
 *
 * Data uji (semua ditandai CFG_TAG dan dibersihkan di cleanup):
 *   - Proyek P1 dengan RAB material M1 (CLIENT_SUPPLIED) & M2 (COMPANY, sebagai kontrol).
 *   - Gudang WH-P1 milik P1 untuk WH Receiving + Issuing.
 *   - Alur: RAB -> (tolak) PO -> GRN dari PO Dummy COMPANY -> WH Rcv -> Issuing.
 *     GRN dibuat dari PO M2 (COMPANY) karena save_po menolak CLIENT_SUPPLIED; biaya Rp 0
 *     untuk M1 tetap dipaksa server-side lewat budget_items.material_source pada PO dummy.
 *
 * Pakai: php tests/run_e2e_client_supplied.php [--setup|--cleanup] [--keep] [--only=TC-CS-01,TC-CS-03]
 */

if (PHP_SAPI !== 'cli') { http_response_code(403); exit('CLI only.'); }
error_reporting(E_ALL & ~E_NOTICE);

/* ---------------- Konfigurasi (sama dg run_e2e_inventory_check.php) ---------------- */
const CFG_DB_HOST = '127.0.0.1';
const CFG_DB_PORT = '5432';
const CFG_DB_NAME = 'proyekGMN_test';
const CFG_DB_USER = 'postgres';
const CFG_BASE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:8098';
const CFG_REPORT   = __DIR__ . '/../test_report_client_supplied.md';
const CFG_TAG      = 'E2E-CS';
const CFG_ORIGIN   = 'http://127.0.0.1:8098';

/* ---------------- State global ---------------- */
$g = [
    'db' => null,
    'projP1' => 0,
    'matM1' => 0, 'matM2' => 0,
    'biM1' => 0, 'biM2' => 0,          // budget_items id (M1 = CLIENT_SUPPLIED, M2 = COMPANY)
    'whP1' => 0,
    'poDummy' => 0, 'poItemM1' => 0,   // PO dummy COMPANY utk alur GRN (dibersihkan di cleanup)
    'grnHdr' => 0, 'grnDtl' => 0,
    'whrcvHdr' => 0,
    'issHdr' => 0,
    'user_admin' => 0,
    'created' => ['project' => [], 'material' => [], 'warehouse' => [], 'user' => [], 'po' => [], 'grn' => [], 'whrcv' => [], 'issue' => []],
    'results' => [],
];

/* ---------------- Konfigurasi DB ---------------- */
function db(): PDO
{
    if ($GLOBALS['g']['db']) { return $GLOBALS['g']['db']; }
    $pass = getenv('E2E_DB_PASSWORD') ?: '';
    $dsn = 'pgsql:host=' . CFG_DB_HOST . ';port=' . CFG_DB_PORT . ';dbname=' . CFG_DB_NAME;
    try {
        $pdo = new PDO($dsn, CFG_DB_USER, $pass, [
            PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE            => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
            PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
            PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES   => false,
        ]);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        fwrite(STDERR, '[DB] koneksi gagal: ' . $e->getMessage() . "\n");
        exit(1);
    }
    $GLOBALS['g']['db'] = $pdo;
    return $pdo;
}
function row(string $sql, array $p = []): ?array
{
    $st = db()->prepare($sql); $st->execute($p);
    $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    return $r === false ? null : $r;
}
function rows(string $sql, array $p = []): array
{
    $st = db()->prepare($sql); $st->execute($p);
    return $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
}
function csval(string $sql, array $p = [])
{
    $r = row($sql, $p);
    return $r ? array_values($r)[0] : null;
}

/* ============================================================
 * 2. HELPER HTTP (Origin header CSRF + cookie jar per user)
 * ==========================================================*/
function curl_base(array $extra, int $userId = 0): array
{
    $ch = curl_init();
    curl_setopt_array($ch, $extra + [
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
        CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS      => 5,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 60,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEFILE     => '/tmp/e2e_cs_cookie_' . $userId,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEJAR      => '/tmp/e2e_cs_cookie_' . $userId,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => ['Origin: ' . CFG_ORIGIN, 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'],
    ]);
    return [$ch, CFG_BASE_URL];
}
function http_post(string $path, array $fields, int $userId = 0): array
{
    list($ch,) = curl_base([
        CURLOPT_URL        => CFG_BASE_URL . $path,
        CURLOPT_POST       => true,
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => http_build_query($fields),
    ], $userId);
    $body = curl_exec($ch);
    $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    $err  = curl_error($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
    return ['http' => $code, 'body' => (string)$body, 'err' => $err];
}
function api(int $userId, string $crud, string $task, array $fields = []): array
{
    $fields['task'] = $task;
    $r = http_post('/php-crud/' . $crud, $fields, $userId);
    $json = json_decode($r['body'], true);
    return ['http' => $r['http'], 'json' => is_array($json) ? $json : null, 'raw' => $r['body'], 'err' => $r['err']];
}
function login(int $userId, string $loginName, string $password): bool
{
    $jar = '/tmp/e2e_cs_cookie_' . $userId;
    if (is_file($jar)) { unlink($jar); }
    $ch = curl_init();
    curl_setopt_array($ch, [
        CURLOPT_URL            => CFG_BASE_URL . '/login.php',
        CURLOPT_POST           => true,
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS     => http_build_query(['username' => $loginName, 'password' => $password]),
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => false,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 60,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEFILE     => $jar,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEJAR      => $jar,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => ['Origin: ' . CFG_ORIGIN, 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'],
    ]);
    $body = curl_exec($ch);
    $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    $err  = curl_error($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
    if ($code !== 302 || stripos($body, 'Username atau Password salah') !== false || $err !== '') {
        fwrite(STDERR, "[LOGIN] user={$loginName} http={$code} err={$err}\n");
        return false;
    }
    $chk = api($userId, 'poCRD.php', 'list_project_options', []);
    return $chk['http'] === 200 && !empty($chk['json']['success']);
}

/* ============================================================
 * 3. SETUP DATA UJI
 * ==========================================================*/
function ensure_user(int $level, string $purpose): int
{
    $uname = CFG_TAG . '-' . strtolower($purpose) . '-lv' . $level . '-' . date('His');
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO m_user_system (login_name, password, active) VALUES (:u, :p, true) RETURNING id")
        ->execute(['u' => $uname, 'p' => $uname . '-pass']);
    $uid = (int)db()->lastInsertId();
    // form 138 = PURCHASE PLANNING, form 24 = PURCHASE ORDER,
    // form 137 = GOODS RECEIPT NOTE, form 134 = WAREHOUSE RECEIVED, form 144 = WAREHOUSE ISSUE
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level) VALUES (:uid, 138, :lv)")->execute(['uid' => $uid, 'lv' => $level]);
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level) VALUES (:uid, 24, :lv)")->execute(['uid' => $uid, 'lv' => $level]);
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level) VALUES (:uid, 137, :lv)")->execute(['uid' => $uid, 'lv' => $level]);
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level) VALUES (:uid, 134, :lv)")->execute(['uid' => $uid, 'lv' => $level]);
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level) VALUES (:uid, 144, :lv)")->execute(['uid' => $uid, 'lv' => $level]);
    $GLOBALS['g']['created']['user'][] = $uid;
    return $uid;
}

/** Buat material uji (kembalikan id). */
function ensure_material(string $code, string $name, string $unit): int
{
    $r = row("SELECT id FROM materials WHERE material_code = :c", ['c' => $code]);
    if ($r) { return (int)$r['id']; }
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO materials (material_code, material_name, unit, category, active) VALUES (:c, :n, :u, 'Material', true) RETURNING id")
        ->execute(['c' => $code, 'n' => $name, 'u' => $unit]);
    return (int)db()->lastInsertId();
}

function setup_test_data(): void
{
    $g = &$GLOBALS['g'];
    $db = db();

    // [IDEMPOTEN] bersihkan sisa fixture run sebelumnya (urutan FK)
    foreach (rows("SELECT id FROM projects WHERE name LIKE :n", ['n' => '%' . CFG_TAG . '%']) as $old) {
        $pid = $old['id'];
        foreach (rows("SELECT id FROM purchase_orders WHERE project_id = :p", ['p' => $pid]) as $po) {
            // [FIX-FK] urutan FK: wh_receiving_dtl -> grn_dtl -> po_items; wh_receiving_hdr -> grn_hdr -> po_id
            foreach (rows("SELECT id FROM grn_hdr WHERE po_id = :i", ['i' => $po['id']]) as $gh) {
                foreach (rows("SELECT id FROM wh_receiving_hdr WHERE grn_hdr_id = :g", ['g' => $gh['id']]) as $wr) {
                    $db->prepare("DELETE FROM wh_receiving_dtl WHERE wh_receiving_hdr_id = :x")->execute(['x' => $wr['id']]);
                    $db->prepare("DELETE FROM wh_receiving_hdr WHERE id = :x")->execute(['x' => $wr['id']]);
                }
                $db->prepare("DELETE FROM wh_receiving_dtl WHERE grn_dtl_id IN (SELECT id FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = :x)")->execute(['x' => $gh['id']]);
                $db->prepare("DELETE FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = :x")->execute(['x' => $gh['id']]);
                $db->prepare("DELETE FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = :x")->execute(['x' => $gh['id']]);
            }
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM po_items WHERE po_id = :i")->execute(['i' => $po['id']]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = :i")->execute(['i' => $po['id']]);
        }
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM budget_items WHERE project_id = :p")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
    $db->prepare("DELETE FROM material_out_items WHERE material_out_id IN (SELECT id FROM material_out_header WHERE project_id IN (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE id = :p))")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
    $db->prepare("DELETE FROM material_out_header WHERE project_id IN (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE id = :p)")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
    $db->prepare("DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = :p")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
    }
    foreach (rows("SELECT id FROM warehouses WHERE name LIKE :n OR code LIKE :c", ['n' => '%' . CFG_TAG . '%', 'c' => '%' . CFG_TAG . '%']) as $oldWh) {
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_movements WHERE warehouse_id = :w")->execute(['w' => $oldWh['id']]);
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM warehouses WHERE id = :w")->execute(['w' => $oldWh['id']]);
    }
    foreach (rows("SELECT id FROM materials WHERE material_code LIKE :c", ['c' => CFG_TAG . '%']) as $oldM) {
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM budget_items WHERE material_id = :m")->execute(['m' => $oldM['id']]);
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM materials WHERE id = :m")->execute(['m' => $oldM['id']]);
    }

    // Proyek uji P1 (progress 0 agar validateMaterialOutAgainstProgress tidak membatasi issue Rp 0)
    $db->prepare("INSERT INTO projects (name, client_id, location, start_date, end_date, budget, spent, progress, status, contract_value, budget_currency_id, budget_exch_rate, ppn_rate)
                  VALUES ('Proyek P1 " . CFG_TAG . "', 1, 'Lokasi Uji', CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE + 30, 500000000, 0, 0, 'Berjalan', 500000000, 2, 1, 0) RETURNING id")->execute();
    $g['projP1'] = (int)$db->lastInsertId(); $g['created']['project'][] = $g['projP1'];

    // Material uji: M1 = titipan klien, M2 = kontrol perusahaan
    $g['matM1'] = ensure_material(CFG_TAG . '-M1', 'Baut Titipan ' . CFG_TAG, 'Buah');
    $g['matM2'] = ensure_material(CFG_TAG . '-M2', 'Mur Kontrol ' . CFG_TAG, 'Buah');
    $g['created']['material'] = [$g['matM1'], $g['matM2']];

    // RAB P1: M1 CLIENT_SUPPLIED (qty 100, harga plan 0), M2 COMPANY (qty 50, harga plan 5000)
    $db->prepare("INSERT INTO budget_items (project_id, category, material_id, item_name, unit, qty_plan, unit_price_plan, material_source)
                  VALUES (:p, 'Material', :m, :nm, :u, :q, 0, 'CLIENT_SUPPLIED')")
        ->execute(['p' => $g['projP1'], 'm' => $g['matM1'], 'nm' => 'Baut Titipan ' . CFG_TAG, 'u' => 'Buah', 'q' => 100]);
    $g['biM1'] = (int)$db->lastInsertId();
    $db->prepare("INSERT INTO budget_items (project_id, category, material_id, item_name, unit, qty_plan, unit_price_plan, material_source)
                  VALUES (:p, 'Material', :m, :nm, :u, :q, 5000, 'COMPANY')")
        ->execute(['p' => $g['projP1'], 'm' => $g['matM2'], 'nm' => 'Mur Kontrol ' . CFG_TAG, 'u' => 'Buah', 'q' => 50]);
    $g['biM2'] = (int)$db->lastInsertId();

    // Gudang WH-P1 milik P1 (penerimaan fisik + issuing)
    $db->prepare("INSERT INTO warehouses (code, name, project_id, active) VALUES (:c, :n, :p, true) RETURNING id")
        ->execute(['c' => 'WH-P1-' . CFG_TAG, 'n' => 'Gudang P1 ' . CFG_TAG, 'p' => $g['projP1']]);
    $g['whP1'] = (int)$db->lastInsertId(); $g['created']['warehouse'][] = $g['whP1'];

    // PO dummy berisi M1 (COMPANY) sebagai kendaraan GRN: GRN dipaksa unit_cost 0 server-side
    // karena pi.budget_item_id -> budget_items.material_source = 'CLIENT_SUPPLIED'.
    $db->prepare("INSERT INTO purchase_orders (po_number, po_date, project_id, supplier_id, status, currency_id, exch_rate, ppn_mode, ppn_rate)
                  VALUES (:no, CURRENT_DATE, :p, 1, 'Disetujui', 2, 1, 'NONE', 0) RETURNING id")
        ->execute(['no' => CFG_TAG . '-DUMMY', 'p' => $g['projP1']]);
    $g['poDummy'] = (int)$db->lastInsertId(); $g['created']['po'][] = $g['poDummy'];
    $db->prepare("INSERT INTO po_items (po_id, budget_item_id, material_id, description, unit, qty, unit_price, currency_id, exch_rate)
                  VALUES (:po, :bid, :m, :d, 'Buah', 100, 0, 2, 1) RETURNING id")
        ->execute(['po' => $g['poDummy'], 'bid' => $g['biM1'], 'm' => $g['matM1'], 'd' => 'Baut Titipan ' . CFG_TAG]);
    $g['poItemM1'] = (int)$db->lastInsertId();

    // User admin + login (FormAccess level 4 utk form 24 & 138)
    $g['user_admin'] = ensure_user(4, 'admin');
    $uname = csval("SELECT login_name FROM m_user_system WHERE id = :i", ['i' => $g['user_admin']]);
    if (!login($g['user_admin'], $uname, $uname . '-pass')) { fwrite(STDERR, "[SETUP] login gagal\n"); }
}

function cleanup_test_data(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $db = db();
    $db->beginTransaction();
    try {
        foreach ($g['created']['issue'] as $id) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM material_out_items WHERE material_out_id = :i")->execute(['i' => $id]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM material_out_header WHERE id = :i")->execute(['i' => $id]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['whrcv'] as $id) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM wh_receiving_dtl WHERE wh_receiving_hdr_id = :i")->execute(['i' => $id]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM wh_receiving_hdr WHERE id = :i")->execute(['i' => $id]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['grn'] as $id) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM wh_receiving_dtl WHERE grn_dtl_id IN (SELECT id FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = :i)")->execute(['i' => $id]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM wh_receiving_hdr WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT wh_receiving_hdr_id FROM wh_receiving_dtl WHERE wh_receiving_hdr_id IS NOT NULL)")->execute();
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = :i")->execute(['i' => $id]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = :i")->execute(['i' => $id]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['po'] as $poId) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM po_items WHERE po_id = :i")->execute(['i' => $poId]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = :i")->execute(['i' => $poId]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['project'] as $pid) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM budget_items WHERE project_id = :p")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
    $db->prepare("DELETE FROM material_out_items WHERE material_out_id IN (SELECT id FROM material_out_header WHERE project_id IN (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE id = :p))")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
    $db->prepare("DELETE FROM material_out_header WHERE project_id IN (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE id = :p)")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
    $db->prepare("DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = :p")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['warehouse'] as $wid) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_movements WHERE warehouse_id = :w")->execute(['w' => $wid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM warehouses WHERE id = :w")->execute(['w' => $wid]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['material'] as $mid) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM budget_items WHERE material_id = :m")->execute(['m' => $mid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM materials WHERE id = :m")->execute(['m' => $mid]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['user'] as $uid) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM m_user_access_menu WHERE user_id = :u")->execute(['u' => $uid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM m_user_system WHERE id = :u")->execute(['u' => $uid]);
        }
        $db->commit();
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        fwrite(STDERR, "[CLEANUP] gagal: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n");
    }
}

/* ============================================================
 * 4. TEST CASES
 * ==========================================================*/
function record(string $tc, string $scenario, $status, string $note = ''): void
{
    $GLOBALS['g']['results'][] = ['tc' => $tc, 'scenario' => $scenario, 'status' => $status, 'note' => $note];
    printf("  [%s] %-9s %s%s\n", $status === true ? 'PASS' : ($status === false ? 'FAIL' : 'SKIP'), $tc, $scenario, $note !== '' ? " -- {$note}" : '');
}
function approx(float $a, float $b, float $eps = 0.001): bool { return abs($a - $b) <= $eps; }

/** TC-CS-01: item RAB CLIENT_SUPPLIED tersimpan di budget_items.material_source. */
function tc01(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $src = csval("SELECT material_source FROM budget_items WHERE id = :i", ['i' => $g['biM1']]);
    $ok  = strtoupper((string)$src) === 'CLIENT_SUPPLIED';
    record('TC-CS-01', 'RAB tersimpan: budget_items.material_source = CLIENT_SUPPLIED', $ok, 'material_source=' . var_export($src, true));
}

/** TC-CS-02: RAB non-titipan tetap COMPANY (kontrol). */
function tc02(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $src = csval("SELECT material_source FROM budget_items WHERE id = :i", ['i' => $g['biM2']]);
    $ok  = strtoupper((string)$src) === 'COMPANY';
    record('TC-CS-02', 'RAB kontrol: material_source = COMPANY (default)', $ok, 'material_source=' . var_export($src, true));
}

/** TC-CS-03: load_planning mengembalikan qty_to_buy = 0 untuk CLIENT_SUPPLIED. */
function tc03(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $r = api($g['user_admin'], 'purchase.planningCRD.php', 'load_planning', ['project_id' => $g['projP1']]);
    if (empty($r['json']['success'])) { record('TC-CS-03', 'load_planning berhasil', false, 'http=' . $r['http'] . ' raw=' . substr($r['raw'], 0, 160)); return; }
    $byMat = [];
    foreach ($r['json']['data'] as $row) { $byMat[(int)$row['material_id']] = $row; }
    $m1 = $byMat[$g['matM1']] ?? null;
    $ok = $m1 && approx((float)$m1['qty_to_buy'], 0) && strtoupper((string)($m1['material_source'] ?? '')) === 'CLIENT_SUPPLIED';
    record('TC-CS-03', 'load_planning: CLIENT_SUPPLIED qty_to_buy = 0 & flag material_source tampil', $ok,
        $m1 ? ('to_buy=' . $m1['qty_to_buy'] . ' src=' . $m1['material_source']) : 'M1 tidak ada');
}

/** TC-CS-04: load_planning untuk COMPANY tetap menghitung kebutuhan beli normal. */
function tc04(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $r = api($g['user_admin'], 'purchase.planningCRD.php', 'load_planning', ['project_id' => $g['projP1']]);
    $byMat = [];
    foreach ($r['json']['data'] ?? [] as $row) { $byMat[(int)$row['material_id']] = $row; }
    $m2 = $byMat[$g['matM2']] ?? null;
    $ok = $m2 && approx((float)$m2['qty_to_buy'], 50) && strtoupper((string)($m2['material_source'] ?? '')) === 'COMPANY';
    record('TC-CS-04', 'load_planning: COMPANY (M2) qty_to_buy = 50 normal (bukan 0)', $ok,
        $m2 ? ('to_buy=' . $m2['qty_to_buy'] . ' src=' . $m2['material_source']) : 'M2 tidak ada');
}

/** TC-CS-05: list_rab_items di poCRD menampilkan qty_to_buy = 0 & material_source CLIENT_SUPPLIED. */
function tc05(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $r = api($g['user_admin'], 'poCRD.php', 'list_rab_items', ['project_id' => $g['projP1']]);
    if (empty($r['json']['success'])) { record('TC-CS-05', 'list_rab_items berhasil', false, substr($r['raw'], 0, 160)); return; }
    $byMat = [];
    foreach ($r['json']['data'] as $row) { $byMat[(int)$row['material_id']] = $row; }
    $m1 = $byMat[$g['matM1']] ?? null;
    $ok = $m1 && approx((float)$m1['qty_to_buy'], 0) && strtoupper((string)$m1['material_source']) === 'CLIENT_SUPPLIED';
    record('TC-CS-05', 'poCRD list_rab_items: M1 qty_to_buy = 0 + material_source = CLIENT_SUPPLIED', $ok,
        $m1 ? ('to_buy=' . $m1['qty_to_buy'] . ' src=' . $m1['material_source']) : 'M1 tidak ada');
}

/** TC-CS-06: save_po MENOLAK budget_item CLIENT_SUPPLIED (kebutuhan bersih = 0). */
function tc06(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $r = api($g['user_admin'], 'poCRD.php', 'save_po', [
        'project_id' => $g['projP1'], 'supplier_id' => 1, 'po_date' => date('Y-m-d'),
        'currency_id' => 2, 'exch_rate' => 1, 'ppn_mode' => 'NONE', 'ppn_rate' => 0,
        'items' => json_encode([['budget_item_id' => $g['biM1'], 'qty' => 10, 'unit_price' => 0]]),
    ]);
    $ok = empty($r['json']['success']);
    $msg = (string)($r['json']['message'] ?? $r['raw']);
    record('TC-CS-06', 'save_po: budget_item CLIENT_SUPPLIED DITOLAK (tidak boleh masuk PO pembelian)', $ok, substr($msg, 0, 140));
}

/** TC-CS-07: save_po menerima budget_item COMPANY (M2) sebagai kontrol. */
function tc07(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $r = api($g['user_admin'], 'poCRD.php', 'save_po', [
        'project_id' => $g['projP1'], 'supplier_id' => 1, 'po_date' => date('Y-m-d'),
        'currency_id' => 2, 'exch_rate' => 1, 'ppn_mode' => 'NONE', 'ppn_rate' => 0,

/** TC-CS-10: Issuing Rp 0 -> stock_movements OUT + material_out_items @ Rp 0, TANPA jurnal ISSUE_PROJECT. */
function tc10(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $r = api($g['user_admin'], 'warehouse.issuingCRD.php', 'save', [
        'action' => 'save',   // issuingCRD memakai $_REQUEST['action'], bukan 'task'
        'project_id' => $g['projP1'], 'warehouse_id' => $g['whP1'], 'issue_date' => date('Y-m-d'),
        'issue_type' => 'PROJECT', 'received_by_mandor' => 'Mandor Uji', 'remark' => 'Issue titipan klien',
        'details' => json_encode([[
            'material_id' => $g['matM1'], 'qty_out' => 30, 'notes' => 'Issue CLIENT_SUPPLIED Rp 0'
        ]]),
    ]);
    $ok = !empty($r['json']['success']);
    $issId = $ok ? (int)($r['json']['data']['id'] ?? $r['json']['id'] ?? 0) : 0;
    if ($issId) { $g['issHdr'] = $issId; $g['created']['issue'][] = $issId; }

    $mv = $issId ? row("SELECT movement_type, qty, unit_cost FROM stock_movements
                         WHERE item_id = :m AND warehouse_id = :w AND movement_type = 'OUT' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1", ['m' => $g['matM1'], 'w' => $g['whP1']]) : null;
    $it = $issId ? row("SELECT qty_out, unit_cost FROM material_out_items WHERE material_out_id = :i ORDER BY id LIMIT 1", ['i' => $issId]) : null;
    $jn = $issId ? (int)csval("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM journal_entries WHERE reference_type = 'material_out' AND reference_id = :i", ['i' => $issId]) : -1;
    $saldo = (float)csval("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='IN' THEN qty ELSE -qty END),0) FROM stock_movements
                          WHERE item_id = :m AND warehouse_id = :w", ['m' => $g['matM1'], 'w' => $g['whP1']]);
    $ok = $ok && $mv && $mv['movement_type'] === 'OUT' && approx((float)$mv['qty'], 30) && approx((float)$mv['unit_cost'], 0)
        && $it && approx((float)$it['unit_cost'], 0) && $jn === 0 && approx($saldo, 70);
    record('TC-CS-10', 'issuing: OUT 30 @ Rp 0 (saldo 70) + material_out_items Rp 0 + TANPA jurnal ISSUE_PROJECT', $ok,
        'mv=' . ($mv ? ($mv['movement_type'] . ' qty=' . $mv['qty'] . ' cost=' . $mv['unit_cost']) : 'null')
        . " item_cost=" . ($it ? $it['unit_cost'] : 'n/a') . " jurnal_rows={$jn} saldo={$saldo}");
}
