/* ---------------- DB helpers (sama dg run_e2e_release.php) ---------------- */
function db(): PDO
{
    if ($GLOBALS['g']['db']) { return $GLOBALS['g']['db']; }
    $pass = getenv('E2E_DB_PASSWORD') ?: '';
    $dsn = 'pgsql:host=' . CFG_DB_HOST . ';port=' . CFG_DB_PORT . ';dbname=' . CFG_DB_NAME;
    try {
        $pdo = new PDO($dsn, CFG_DB_USER, $pass, [
            PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE            => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
            PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
            PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES   => false,
        ]);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        fwrite(STDERR, '[DB] koneksi gagal: ' . $e->getMessage() . "\n");
        exit(1);
    }
    $GLOBALS['g']['db'] = $pdo;
    return $pdo;
}
function row(string $sql, array $p = []): ?array
{
    $st = db()->prepare($sql); $st->execute($p);
    $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    return $r === false ? null : $r;
}
function rows(string $sql, array $p = []): array
{
    $st = db()->prepare($sql); $st->execute($p);
    return $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
}
function val(string $sql, array $p = [])
{
    $r = row($sql, $p);
    return $r ? array_values($r)[0] : null;
}

/* ---------------- HTTP helpers ---------------- */
function curl_base(array $extra, int $userId = 0): array
{
    $ch = curl_init();
    curl_setopt_array($ch, $extra + [
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
        CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS      => 5,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 60,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEFILE     => '/tmp/e2e_porel_cookie_' . $userId,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEJAR      => '/tmp/e2e_porel_cookie_' . $userId,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => ['Origin: ' . CFG_ORIGIN, 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'],
    ]);
    return [$ch, CFG_BASE_URL];
}
function http_post(string $path, array $fields, int $userId = 0): array
{
    list($ch,) = curl_base([
        CURLOPT_URL        => CFG_BASE_URL . $path,
        CURLOPT_POST       => true,
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => http_build_query($fields),
    ], $userId);
    $body = curl_exec($ch);
    $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    $err  = curl_error($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
    return ['http' => $code, 'body' => (string)$body, 'err' => $err];
}
function api(int $userId, string $crud, string $task, array $fields = []): array
{
    $fields['task'] = $task;
    $r = http_post('/php-crud/' . $crud, $fields, $userId);
    $json = json_decode($r['body'], true);
    return ['http' => $r['http'], 'json' => is_array($json) ? $json : null, 'raw' => $r['body'], 'err' => $r['err']];
}
function login(int $userId, string $loginName, string $password): bool
{
    $jar = '/tmp/e2e_porel_cookie_' . $userId;
    if (is_file($jar)) { unlink($jar); }
    $ch = curl_init();
    curl_setopt_array($ch, [
        CURLOPT_URL            => CFG_BASE_URL . '/login.php',
        CURLOPT_POST           => true,
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS     => http_build_query(['username' => $loginName, 'password' => $password]),
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => false,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 60,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEFILE     => $jar,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEJAR      => $jar,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => ['Origin: ' . CFG_ORIGIN, 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'],
    ]);
    $body = curl_exec($ch);
    $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    $err  = curl_error($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
    if ($code !== 302 || stripos($body, 'Username atau Password salah') !== false || $err !== '') {
        fwrite(STDERR, "[LOGIN] user={$loginName} http={$code} err={$err}\n");
        return false;
    }
    $chk = api($userId, 'poCRD.php', 'list_project_options', []);
    return $chk['http'] === 200 && !empty($chk['json']['success']);
}

/* ---------------- Setup / cleanup ---------------- */
function ensure_user(int $level, string $purpose): int
{
    $uname = CFG_TAG . '-' . strtolower($purpose) . '-lv' . $level . '-' . date('His');
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO m_user_system (login_name, password, active) VALUES (:u, :p, true) RETURNING id")
        ->execute(['u' => $uname, 'p' => $uname . '-pass']);
    $uid = (int)db()->lastInsertId();
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level) VALUES (:uid, 24, :lv)")->execute(['uid' => $uid, 'lv' => $level]); // PURCHASE ORDER
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level) VALUES (:uid, 138, :lv)")->execute(['uid' => $uid, 'lv' => $level]); // PURCHASE PLANNING
    $GLOBALS['g']['created']['user'][] = $uid;
    return $uid;
}
function ensure_material(string $code, string $name, string $unit): int
{
    $r = row("SELECT id FROM materials WHERE material_code = :c", ['c' => $code]);
    if ($r) { return (int)$r['id']; }
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO materials (material_code, material_name, unit, category, active) VALUES (:c, :n, :u, 'Material', true) RETURNING id")
        ->execute(['c' => $code, 'n' => $name, 'u' => $unit]);
    return (int)db()->lastInsertId();
}

function setup_test_data(): void
{
    $g = &$GLOBALS['g'];
    $db = db();

    // [IDEMPOTEN] pastikan periode akuntansi berjalan terbuka: run sebelumnya bisa jadi crash
    // di tengah tc205() sehingga periode tertinggal tertutup dan semua save_po setup gagal.
    $per = row("SELECT id, is_closed FROM accounting_periods WHERE CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN start_date AND end_date");
    if ($per && ($per['is_closed'] === 't' || $per['is_closed'] === true || $per['is_closed'] === 1 || $per['is_closed'] === '1')) {
        db()->prepare("UPDATE accounting_periods SET is_closed = false WHERE id = :id")->execute(['id' => $per['id']]);
        fwrite(STDOUT, "[setup] periode akuntansi berjalan dibuka kembali (id={$per['id']}).\n");
    }

    // [IDEMPOTEN] bersihkan sisa fixture run sebelumnya (urutan FK)
    foreach (rows("SELECT id FROM projects WHERE name LIKE :n", ['n' => '%' . CFG_TAG . '%']) as $old) {
        $pid = $old['id'];
        foreach (rows("SELECT id FROM purchase_orders WHERE project_id = :p", ['p' => $pid]) as $po) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM po_items WHERE po_id = :i")->execute(['i' => $po['id']]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = :i")->execute(['i' => $po['id']]);
        }
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM budget_items WHERE project_id = :p")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = :p")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
    }
    foreach (rows("SELECT id FROM warehouses WHERE name LIKE :n OR code LIKE :c", ['n' => '%' . CFG_TAG . '%', 'c' => '%' . CFG_TAG . '%']) as $oldWh) {
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_movements WHERE warehouse_id = :w")->execute(['w' => $oldWh['id']]);
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM warehouses WHERE id = :w")->execute(['w' => $oldWh['id']]);
    }
    foreach (rows("SELECT id FROM materials WHERE material_code LIKE :c", ['c' => CFG_TAG . '%']) as $oldM) {
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM budget_items WHERE material_id = :m")->execute(['m' => $oldM['id']]);
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM materials WHERE id = :m")->execute(['m' => $oldM['id']]);
    }

    // Proyek P1 (utama) + proyek lain P9 (pemilik stok yang tidak boleh dipinjam)
    $db->prepare("INSERT INTO projects (name, client_id, location, start_date, end_date, budget, spent, progress, status, contract_value, budget_currency_id, budget_exch_rate, ppn_rate)
                  VALUES ('Proyek P1 " . CFG_TAG . "', 1, 'Lokasi Uji', CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE + 30, 500000000, 0, 0, 'Berjalan', 500000000, 2, 1, 0) RETURNING id")->execute();
    $g['projP1'] = (int)$db->lastInsertId(); $g['created']['project'][] = $g['projP1'];
    $db->prepare("INSERT INTO projects (name, client_id, location, start_date, end_date, budget, spent, progress, status, contract_value, budget_currency_id, budget_exch_rate, ppn_rate)
                  VALUES ('Proyek P9 " . CFG_TAG . "', 1, 'Lokasi Lain', CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE + 30, 500000000, 0, 0, 'Berjalan', 500000000, 2, 1, 0) RETURNING id")->execute();
    $g['projOther'] = (int)$db->lastInsertId(); $g['created']['project'][] = $g['projOther'];

    // Material uji
    $g['matM1'] = ensure_material(CFG_TAG . '-M1', 'Baut Hex ' . CFG_TAG, 'Buah');
    $g['matM2'] = ensure_material(CFG_TAG . '-M2', 'Mur Hex ' . CFG_TAG, 'Buah');
    $g['created']['material'] = [$g['matM1'], $g['matM2']];

    // RAB P1: M1 qty 100, M2 qty 50
    foreach ([[$g['matM1'], 100, 10000], [$g['matM2'], 50, 5000]] as [$m, $q, $p]) {
        $db->prepare("INSERT INTO budget_items (project_id, category, material_id, item_name, unit, qty_plan, unit_price_plan)
                      VALUES (:p, 'Material', :m, :n, 'Buah', :q, :pr) RETURNING id")
            ->execute(['p' => $g['projP1'], 'm' => $m, 'n' => 'Material ' . $m, 'q' => $q, 'pr' => $p]);
        $g['created']['budget_item'][] = (int)$db->lastInsertId();
    }

    // Gudang WH-A milik P1 (stok M1=40), WH-B milik P9 (stok M1=500, proyek lain)
    $db->prepare("INSERT INTO warehouses (code, name, project_id, active) VALUES (:c, :n, :p, true) RETURNING id")
        ->execute(['c' => 'WH-A-' . CFG_TAG, 'n' => 'Gudang P1 ' . CFG_TAG, 'p' => $g['projP1']]);
    $g['whA'] = (int)$db->lastInsertId(); $g['created']['warehouse'][] = $g['whA'];
    $db->prepare("INSERT INTO warehouses (code, name, project_id, active) VALUES (:c, :n, :p, true) RETURNING id")
        ->execute(['c' => 'WH-B-' . CFG_TAG, 'n' => 'Gudang P9 ' . CFG_TAG, 'p' => $g['projOther']]);
    $g['whB'] = (int)$db->lastInsertId(); $g['created']['warehouse'][] = $g['whB'];

    // Stok M1: 40 di WH-A (milik P1), 500 di WH-B (milik P9)
    $db->prepare("INSERT INTO stock_movements (movement_date, item_id, grade_id, warehouse_id, movement_type, qty, unit_cost, reference_type, reference_id, reference_no, created_by)
                  VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, :i, NULL, :w, 'IN', 40, 10000, 'wh_receiving', 0, :r, 1)")
        ->execute(['i' => $g['matM1'], 'w' => $g['whA'], 'r' => CFG_TAG . '-A']);
    $db->prepare("INSERT INTO stock_movements (movement_date, item_id, grade_id, warehouse_id, movement_type, qty, unit_cost, reference_type, reference_id, reference_no, created_by)
                  VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, :i, NULL, :w, 'IN', 500, 10000, 'wh_receiving', 0, :r, 1)")
        ->execute(['i' => $g['matM1'], 'w' => $g['whB'], 'r' => CFG_TAG . '-B']);

    // User admin + login (FormAccess level 4 utk form 24)
    $g['user_admin'] = ensure_user(4, 'admin');
    $uname = val("SELECT login_name FROM m_user_system WHERE id = :i", ['i' => $g['user_admin']]);
    if (!login($g['user_admin'], $uname, $uname . '-pass')) { fwrite(STDERR, "[SETUP] login gagal\n"); }
}

function cleanup_test_data(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $db = db();
    $db->beginTransaction();
    try {
        foreach ($g['created']['po'] as $poId) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM po_items WHERE po_id = :i")->execute(['i' => $poId]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = :i")->execute(['i' => $poId]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['project'] as $pid) {
            foreach (rows("SELECT id FROM purchase_orders WHERE project_id = :p", ['p' => $pid]) as $po) {
                $db->prepare("DELETE FROM po_items WHERE po_id = :i")->execute(['i' => $po['id']]);
                $db->prepare("DELETE FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = :i")->execute(['i' => $po['id']]);
            }
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM budget_items WHERE project_id = :p")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = :p")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['warehouse'] as $wid) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_movements WHERE warehouse_id = :w")->execute(['w' => $wid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM warehouses WHERE id = :w")->execute(['w' => $wid]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['material'] as $mid) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM budget_items WHERE material_id = :m")->execute(['m' => $mid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM materials WHERE id = :m")->execute(['m' => $mid]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['user'] as $uid) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM m_user_access_menu WHERE user_id = :u")->execute(['u' => $uid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM m_user_system WHERE id = :u")->execute(['u' => $uid]);
        }
        $db->commit();
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        fwrite(STDERR, "[CLEANUP] gagal: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n");
    }
}

/* ---------------- Helpers pembuat PO ---------------- */
/** Buat PO Draft via API; kembalikan ['id','po_number'] atau null.
    Tiap item: [bid, qty] atau [bid, qty, harga] (harga default 10000). */
function make_po(int $projectId, array $items, float $price = 10000): ?array
{
    $payloadItems = [];
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $payloadItems[] = ['budget_item_id' => (int)$it[0], 'qty' => (float)$it[1], 'unit_price' => (float)($it[2] ?? $price)];
    }
    $r = api($GLOBALS['g']['user_admin'], 'poCRD.php', 'save_po', [
        'project_id' => $projectId, 'supplier_id' => 1, 'po_date' => date('Y-m-d'),
        'currency_id' => 2, 'exch_rate' => 1, 'ppn_mode' => 'NONE', 'ppn_rate' => 0,
        'items' => json_encode($payloadItems),
    ]);
    if (empty($r['json']['success']) || empty($r['json']['data']['id'])) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "[SETUP] save_po gagal: " . substr($r['raw'], 0, 200) . "\n");
        return null;
    }
    $id = (int)$r['json']['data']['id'];
    $GLOBALS['g']['created']['po'][] = $id;
    return ['id' => $id, 'po_number' => $r['json']['data']['po_number']];
}
function change_status(int $poId, string $to): array
{
    return api($GLOBALS['g']['user_admin'], 'poCRD.php', 'change_status', ['id' => $poId, 'to' => $to]);
}

function del_po(int $poId): void {
    db()->prepare("DELETE FROM po_items WHERE po_id = :i")->execute(["i" => $poId]);
    db()->prepare("DELETE FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = :i")->execute(["i" => $poId]);
}

/* ---------------- Test cases ---------------- */
function record(string $tc, string $scenario, $status, string $note = ''): void
{
    $GLOBALS['g']['results'][] = ['tc' => $tc, 'scenario' => $scenario, 'status' => $status, 'note' => $note];
    printf("  [%s] %-7s %s%s\n", $status === true ? 'PASS' : ($status === false ? 'FAIL' : 'SKIP'), $tc, $scenario, $note !== '' ? " -- {$note}" : '');
}
function approx(float $a, float $b, float $eps = 0.001): bool { return abs($a - $b) <= $eps; }
function bid_of(int $projectId, int $materialId): int
{
    return (int)val("SELECT id FROM budget_items WHERE project_id=:p AND material_id=:m", ['p' => $projectId, 'm' => $materialId]);
}

/** TC-201: release normal Draft -> Diajukan lolos (stok mencukupi kebutuhan bersih). */
function tc201(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $bid1 = bid_of($g['projP1'], $g['matM1']);
    $po = make_po($g['projP1'], [[$bid1, 60]]);   // kebutuhan bersih M1 = 100 - 40 stok = 60
    if (!$po) { record('TC-201', 'release normal Draft->Diajukan lolos', false, 'setup save_po gagal'); return; }
    $r = change_status($po['id'], 'Diajukan');
    $ok = !empty($r['json']['success']);
    $st = val("SELECT status FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = :i", ['i' => $po['id']]);
    $ok = $ok && $st === 'Diajukan';
    record('TC-201', 'release normal: Draft -> Diajukan lolos', $ok,
        'status=' . var_export($st, true) . ' msg=' . substr((string)($r['json']['message'] ?? ''), 0, 80));
    del_po($po['id']);
}

/** TC-202: blokir bila stok proyek bertambah sebelum release sehingga qty PO > kebutuhan bersih. */
function tc202(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $bid1 = bid_of($g['projP1'], $g['matM1']);
    // PO qty 60 (kebutuhan bersih saat stok=40). Lalu stok proyek bertambah 20 -> jadi 60.
    $po = make_po($g['projP1'], [[$bid1, 60]]);
    if (!$po) { record('TC-202', 'blokir release bila stok proyek bertambah', false, 'setup save_po gagal'); return; }
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO stock_movements (movement_date, item_id, grade_id, warehouse_id, movement_type, qty, unit_cost, reference_type, reference_id, reference_no, created_by)
                   VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, :i, NULL, :w, 'IN', 20, 10000, 'wh_receiving', 0, :r, 1)")
        ->execute(['i' => $g['matM1'], 'w' => $g['whA'], 'r' => CFG_TAG . '-TAMBAH']);
    // sekarang stok = 60, kebutuhan bersih = 100 - 60 = 40, qty PO 60 > 40 -> release harus ditolak
    $r = change_status($po['id'], 'Diajukan');
    $ok = !empty($r['json']['success']) === false && stripos($r['json']['message'] ?? $r['raw'], 'kebutuhan bersih') !== false;
    $st = val("SELECT status FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = :i", ['i' => $po['id']]);
    $ok = $ok && $st === 'Draft';
    record('TC-202', 'blokir release: stok proyek bertambah sebelum release (qty PO > kebutuhan bersih)', $ok,
        'status=' . var_export($st, true) . ' msg=' . substr((string)($r['json']['message'] ?? $r['raw']), 0, 120));
    del_po($po['id']);
    // restore stok
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO stock_movements (movement_date, item_id, grade_id, warehouse_id, movement_type, qty, unit_cost, reference_type, reference_id, reference_no, created_by)
                   VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, :i, NULL, :w, 'OUT', 20, 10000, 'wh_receiving', 0, :r, 1)")
        ->execute(['i' => $g['matM1'], 'w' => $g['whA'], 'r' => CFG_TAG . '-RESTORE']);
}

/** TC-203: blokir bila kuota RAB habis dipakai PO lain (PO lain Diajukan duluan). */
function tc203(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $bid1 = bid_of($g['projP1'], $g['matM1']);
    $poA = make_po($g['projP1'], [[$bid1, 60]]);
    if (!$poA) { record('TC-203', 'blokir release: kuota RAB habis dipakai PO lain', false, 'setup gagal'); return; }
    $rA = change_status($poA['id'], 'Diajukan');
    $db = db();
    $db->prepare("INSERT INTO purchase_orders (po_number, project_id, supplier_id, po_date, status, currency_id, exch_rate, budget_currency_id, budget_exch_rate, total_base, total_budget, ppn_mode, ppn_rate) VALUES (:no, :p, 1, CURRENT_DATE, 'Draft', 2, 1, 2, 1, 100000, 100000, 'NONE', 0)")->execute(['no' => CFG_TAG . '-POB', 'p' => $g['projP1']]);
    $idB = (int)$db->lastInsertId();
    $db->prepare("INSERT INTO po_items (po_id, budget_item_id, material_id, description, qty, unit_price) VALUES (:p, :b, :m, 'Item PO B E2E', 10, 10000)")->execute(['p' => $idB, 'b' => $bid1, 'm' => $g['matM1']]);
    $poB = ['id' => $idB];
    $rB = change_status($poB['id'], 'Diajukan');
    $ok = !empty($rB['json']['success']) === false && stripos($rB['json']['message'] ?? $rB['raw'], 'kebutuhan bersih') !== false;
    $stB = val("SELECT status FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = :i", ['i' => $poB['id']]);
    $stA = val("SELECT status FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = :i", ['i' => $poA['id']]);
    $ok = $ok && $stB === 'Draft' && $stA === 'Diajukan';
    record('TC-203', 'blokir release: kuota RAB habis dipakai PO lain (PO A Diajukan, PO B ditolak)', $ok,
        'A=' . var_export($stA, true) . ' B=' . var_export($stB, true) . ' msgB=' . substr((string)($rB['json']['message'] ?? $rB['raw']), 0, 100));
    del_po($poB['id']); del_po($poA['id']);
}

/** TC-204: blokir double-release (state machine: Diajukan tidak bisa Diajukan lagi). */
function tc204(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $bid2 = bid_of($g['projP1'], $g['matM2']);
    $po = make_po($g['projP1'], [[$bid2, 50, 5000]]);
    if (!$po) { record('TC-204', 'blokir double-release', false, 'setup save_po gagal'); return; }
    change_status($po['id'], 'Diajukan');
    $r2 = change_status($po['id'], 'Diajukan');
    $ok = !empty($r2['json']['success']) === false && stripos($r2['json']['message'] ?? $r2['raw'], 'tidak dapat diubah') !== false;
    $st = val("SELECT status FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = :i", ['i' => $po['id']]);
    $ok = $ok && $st === 'Diajukan';
    record('TC-204', 'blokir double-release: Diajukan -> Diajukan ditolak state machine', $ok,
        'status=' . var_export($st, true) . ' msg=' . substr((string)($r2['json']['message'] ?? $r2['raw']), 0, 80));
    del_po($po['id']);
}

/** TC-205: blokir release bila periode akuntansi tutup. */
function tc205(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    // tutup periode berjalan sementara (dibuka kembali di finally agar tidak pernah tertinggal tertutup)
    $bid2 = bid_of($g['projP1'], $g['matM2']);
    $po = make_po($g['projP1'], [[$bid2, 50, 5000]]);
    $per = row("SELECT id, is_closed FROM accounting_periods WHERE CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN start_date AND end_date");
    $wasClosed = $per && ($per['is_closed'] === 't' || $per['is_closed'] === true || $per['is_closed'] === 1 || $per['is_closed'] === '1');
    if ($per && !$wasClosed) {
        db()->prepare("UPDATE accounting_periods SET is_closed = true WHERE id = :id")->execute(['id' => $per['id']]);
    }
    try {
        $r = ['json' => null, 'raw' => 'setup save_po gagal'];
        $st = null; $ok = false;
        if ($po) {
            $r = change_status($po['id'], 'Diajukan');
            $st = val("SELECT status FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = :i", ['i' => $po['id']]);
            $ok = !empty($r['json']['success']) === false && stripos($r['json']['message'] ?? $r['raw'], 'periode akuntansi') !== false;
            $ok = $ok && $st === 'Draft';
        }
    } finally {
        // buka kembali periode (finally: menjamin periode tidak tertinggal tertutup walau assertion error)
        if ($per && !$wasClosed) {
            db()->prepare("UPDATE accounting_periods SET is_closed = false WHERE id = :id")->execute(['id' => $per['id']]);
        }
    }
    if ($po) del_po($po['id']);
    record('TC-205', 'blokir release: periode akuntansi tutup', $ok,
        'status=' . var_export($st, true) . ' msg=' . substr((string)($r['json']['message'] ?? $r['raw']), 0, 120));
}

/** TC-206: bukti stok proyek lain tidak dipinjam (M1 punya 500 di WH-B proyek lain, P1 tetap butuh beli). */
function tc206(): void
{
    $g = $GLOBALS['g'];
    $r = api($g['user_admin'], 'poCRD.php', 'list_rab_items', ['project_id' => $g['projP1']]);
    $byMat = [];
    foreach ($r['json']['data'] as $row) { $byMat[(int)$row['material_id']] = $row; }
    $m1 = $byMat[$g['matM1']] ?? null;
    $totalAll = (float)val("SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='IN' THEN qty ELSE -qty END) FROM stock_movements WHERE item_id = :i", ['i' => $g['matM1']]);
    $ok = $m1 && approx((float)$m1['qty_on_hand'], 40) && approx((float)$m1['qty_to_buy'], 60) && approx($totalAll, 540);
    record('TC-206', 'stok proyek lain (500 di WH-B) tidak dipinjam; P1 lihat 40 & butuh beli 60', $ok,
        'total_db=' . $totalAll . ' p1_on_hand=' . ($m1 ? $m1['qty_on_hand'] : 'n/a') . ' to_buy=' . ($m1 ? $m1['qty_to_buy'] : 'n/a'));
}

    record('TC-207', 'blokir release: supplier non-aktif', $ok,

/* ---------------- Laporan & main ---------------- */
function write_report(array $groupResults, string $groupTitle): void
{
    $path = CFG_REPORT;
    $old = is_file($path) ? file_get_contents($path) : '';
    $sec = "<!-- BEGIN:{$groupTitle} -->\n";
    $sec .= "## {$groupTitle}\n\n";
    $sec .= "| TC | Skenario | Hasil | Bukti / Catatan |\n|----|----------|-------|------------------|\n";
    foreach ($groupResults as $r) {
        $st = $r['status'] === true ? 'PASS' : ($r['status'] === false ? 'FAIL' : 'SKIP');
        $sec .= "| {$r['tc']} | " . str_replace('|', '\|', $r['scenario']) . " | {$st} | " . str_replace('|', '\|', $r['note']) . " |\n";
    }
    $sec .= "<!-- END:{$groupTitle} -->\n";
    if (preg_match('/<!-- BEGIN:' . preg_quote($groupTitle, '/') . ' -->.*?<!-- END:' . preg_quote($groupTitle, '/') . ' -->\n?/s', $old)) {
        $out = preg_replace('/<!-- BEGIN:' . preg_quote($groupTitle, '/') . ' -->.*?<!-- END:' . preg_quote($groupTitle, '/') . ' -->\n?/s', $sec, $old);
    } else {
        $out = rtrim($old) . "\n\n" . $sec;
    }
    $pass = $fail = $skip = 0;
    foreach (preg_split('/\n(?=\| TC-)/', $out) as $ln) {
        if (strpos($ln, '| TC-') !== 0) { continue; }
        $cols = array_map('trim', explode('|', $ln));
        $h = $cols[3] ?? '';
        if ($h === 'PASS') { $pass++; } elseif ($h === 'FAIL') { $fail++; } elseif ($h === 'SKIP') { $skip++; }
    }
    $header = "# Test Report Pengecekan PO Sebelum Release (TC-201 s/d TC-210)\n\n";
    $header .= "**Tanggal eksekusi:** " . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "  \n";
    $header .= "**Baseline:** branch `dev` | DB `proyekGMN_test` | base URL `" . CFG_BASE_URL . "`  \n";
    $header .= "**Dokumen acuan:** `docs/HOWTO_PO_PRERELEASE_CHECK_2026-11-15.md`  \n";
    $header .= "**Ringkasan sementara:** PASS = {$pass}, FAIL = {$fail}, SKIP = {$skip}\n\n";
    $header .= "> Fitur: validasi real-time saat release PO (`change_status` ke Diajukan/Disetujui) di dalam\n";
    $header .= "> transaksi ACID: baca ulang `GetProjectStockMap()` & `po_net_need()`, blokir bila stok proyek\n";
    $header .= "> bertambah / kuota RAB habis / periode tutup / supplier non-aktif / item tidak valid.\n";
    $header .= "> Stok milik proyek lain (`warehouses.project_id <> proyek ini`) tidak pernah dihitung.\n\n";
    $out = preg_replace('/^# Test Report Pengecekan PO Sebelum Release.*?(?=\n## |\n<!-- BEGIN:)/s', '', $out);
    $out = $header . ltrim($out, "\n");
    file_put_contents($path, $out);
}

function main(array $argv): void
{
    $opts = $argv;
    $only = [];
    $group = '';
    $doSetup = true; $doCleanup = true;
    foreach ($opts as $a) {
        if (strpos($a, '--only=') === 0) { $only = array_map('trim', explode(',', substr($a, 7))); }
        if (strpos($a, '--group=') === 0) { $group = strtoupper(substr($a, 8)); }
        if ($a === '--setup') { $doCleanup = false; }
        if ($a === '--cleanup') { $doSetup = false; }
        if ($a === '--keep') { $doCleanup = false; }
    }

    echo "=== E2E Pengecekan PO Sebelum Release (TC-201 s/d TC-210) ===\n";
    echo "DB: " . CFG_DB_NAME . " @ " . CFG_DB_HOST . " | URL: " . CFG_BASE_URL . "\n";

    if ($doSetup) {
        echo "[setup] membuat data uji (P1+P9, M1/M2, WH-A/WH-B, stok 40 vs 500, user admin)...\n";
        setup_test_data();
        echo "[setup] selesai. projP1={$GLOBALS['g']['projP1']} projOther={$GLOBALS['g']['projOther']} matM1={$GLOBALS['g']['matM1']} matM2={$GLOBALS['g']['matM2']} whA={$GLOBALS['g']['whA']} whB={$GLOBALS['g']['whB']}\n";
    }

    $groupPre = 'Kelompok G — Pengecekan PO Sebelum Release (validasi real-time)';
    $testsG = [
        'tc201' => 'TC-201', 'tc202' => 'TC-202', 'tc203' => 'TC-203', 'tc204' => 'TC-204', 'tc205' => 'TC-205',
        'tc206' => 'TC-206', 'tc207' => 'TC-207', 'tc208' => 'TC-208', 'tc209' => 'TC-209', 'tc210' => 'TC-210',
    ];
    if ($group && $group !== 'G') { echo "[run] Kelompok G dilewati (--group={$group}).\n"; }
    else {
        echo "[run] eksekusi Kelompok G:\n";
        foreach ($testsG as $fn => $tc) {
            if ($only && !in_array($tc, $only, true)) { continue; }
            $fn();
        }
        write_report($GLOBALS['g']['results'], $groupPre);
    }

    if ($doCleanup) {
        echo "[cleanup] menghapus data uji...\n";
        cleanup_test_data();
        echo "[cleanup] selesai.\n";
    } else {
        echo "[cleanup] DILEWATI (--keep/--setup) -- data uji tetap di DB untuk investigasi.\n";
    }

    $p = count(array_filter($GLOBALS['g']['results'], fn($r) => $r['status'] === true));
    $f = count(array_filter($GLOBALS['g']['results'], fn($r) => $r['status'] === false));
    echo "\nHasil Keseluruhan (G): PASS={$p} FAIL={$f} | laporan: " . CFG_REPORT . "\n";
    exit($f > 0 ? 1 : 0);
}

if (!defined('E2E_AS_LIB')) {
    main($argv);
}

 *   - User level 1 (pelapor, MENGAJUKAN klaim), level 4 (verifikator, memverifikasi).
 *   - Alur: buat progress log manual? TIDAK -- semua lewat API submit_claim / verify.

/* ============================================================
 * 1. HELPER DB (PDO/pg, prepared statement)
 * ==========================================================*/
function db(): PDO
{
    if ($GLOBALS['g']['db']) { return $GLOBALS['g']['db']; }
    $pass = getenv('E2E_DB_PASSWORD') ?: '';
    $dsn = 'pgsql:host=' . CFG_DB_HOST . ';port=' . CFG_DB_PORT . ';dbname=' . CFG_DB_NAME;
    try {
        $pdo = new PDO($dsn, CFG_DB_USER, $pass, [
            PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE            => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
            PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
            PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES   => false,
        ]);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        fwrite(STDERR, '[DB] koneksi gagal: ' . $e->getMessage() . "\n");
        exit(1);
    }
    $GLOBALS['g']['db'] = $pdo;
    return $pdo;
}
function row(string $sql, array $p = []): ?array
{
    $st = db()->prepare($sql); $st->execute($p);
    $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    return $r === false ? null : $r;
}
function rows(string $sql, array $p = []): array
{
    $st = db()->prepare($sql); $st->execute($p);
    return $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
}
function csval(string $sql, array $p = [])
{
    $r = row($sql, $p);
    return $r ? array_values($r)[0] : null;
}

/* ============================================================
 * 2. HELPER HTTP (Origin header CSRF + cookie jar per user)
 * ==========================================================*/
function curl_base(array $extra, int $userId = 0): array
{
    $ch = curl_init();
    curl_setopt_array($ch, $extra + [
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
        CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS      => 5,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 60,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEFILE     => '/tmp/e2e_pc_cookie_' . $userId,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEJAR      => '/tmp/e2e_pc_cookie_' . $userId,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => ['Origin: ' . CFG_ORIGIN, 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'],
    ]);
    return [$ch, CFG_BASE_URL];
}
function http_post(string $path, array $fields, int $userId = 0): array
{
    list($ch,) = curl_base([
        CURLOPT_URL        => CFG_BASE_URL . $path,
        CURLOPT_POST       => true,
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => http_build_query($fields),
    ], $userId);
    $body = curl_exec($ch);
    $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    $err  = curl_error($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
    return ['http' => $code, 'body' => (string)$body, 'err' => $err];
}
function api(int $userId, string $crud, string $task, array $fields = []): array
{
    // [FIX 2026-11-17] dashboardCRD membaca $_GET/$_POST['action'], bukan 'task' -- JANGAN overwrite.
    if ($crud === 'dashboardCRD.php') { $fields['action'] = $task; } else { $fields['task'] = $task; }
    $r = http_post('/php-crud/' . $crud, $fields, $userId);
    $json = json_decode($r['body'], true);
    return ['http' => $r['http'], 'json' => is_array($json) ? $json : null, 'raw' => $r['body'], 'err' => $r['err']];
}
function login(int $userId, string $loginName, string $password): bool
{
    $jar = '/tmp/e2e_pc_cookie_' . $userId;
    if (is_file($jar)) { unlink($jar); }
    $ch = curl_init();
    curl_setopt_array($ch, [
        CURLOPT_URL            => CFG_BASE_URL . '/login.php',
        CURLOPT_POST           => true,
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS     => http_build_query(['username' => $loginName, 'password' => $password]),
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => false,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 60,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEFILE     => $jar,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEJAR      => $jar,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => ['Origin: ' . CFG_ORIGIN, 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'],
    ]);
    $body = curl_exec($ch);
    $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    $err  = curl_error($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
    if ($code !== 302 || stripos($body, 'Username atau Password salah') !== false || $err !== '') {
        fwrite(STDERR, "[LOGIN] user={$loginName} http={$code} err={$err}\n");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

/* ============================================================
 * 3. SETUP DATA UJI
 * ==========================================================*/
function ensure_user(int $level, string $purpose, array $formIds = []): int
{
    $uname = CFG_TAG . '-' . strtolower($purpose) . '-lv' . $level . '-' . date('His');
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO m_user_system (login_name, password, active) VALUES (:u, :p, true) RETURNING id")
        ->execute(['u' => $uname, 'p' => $uname . '-pass']);
    $uid = (int)db()->lastInsertId();
    // form 146 = PROGRESS PROYEK (project.progress.php), form 148 = PELEPASAN WIP (project.wiprelease.php),
    // form 118 = PROYEK (master), form 144 = WAREHOUSE ISSUE
    $forms = $formIds ?: [146, 148, 118, 144];
    foreach ($forms as $fid) {
        db()->prepare("INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level) VALUES (:uid, :f, :lv)")->execute(['uid' => $uid, 'f' => $fid, 'lv' => $level]);
    }
    $GLOBALS['g']['created']['user'][] = $uid;
    return $uid;
}

/** Buat material uji (kembalikan id). */
function ensure_material(string $code, string $name, string $unit): int
{
    $r = row("SELECT id FROM materials WHERE material_code = :c", ['c' => $code]);
    if ($r) { return (int)$r['id']; }
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO materials (material_code, material_name, unit, category, active) VALUES (:c, :n, :u, 'Material', true) RETURNING id")
        ->execute(['c' => $code, 'n' => $name, 'u' => $unit]);
    return (int)db()->lastInsertId();
}

function cleanup_test_data(): void
{
    $g = &$GLOBALS['g'];
    $db = db();
    $db->beginTransaction();
    try {
        foreach ($g['created']['issue'] as $id) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM material_out_items WHERE material_out_id = :i")->execute(['i' => $id]);
            // reference_type enum lowercase: 'material_out' (lihat php-func/journal.stock.php JRN_REF_ISSUE)
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_movements WHERE reference_type = 'MATERIAL_OUT' AND reference_id = :i")->execute(['i' => $id]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id IN (SELECT id FROM journal_entries WHERE reference_type = 'material_out' AND reference_id = :i)")->execute(['i' => $id]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM journal_entries WHERE reference_type = 'material_out' AND reference_id = :i")->execute(['i' => $id]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM material_out_header WHERE id = :i")->execute(['i' => $id]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['expense'] as $id) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM financial_expense_allocations WHERE financial_expense_id = :i")->execute(['i' => $id]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM financial_expenses WHERE id = :i")->execute(['i' => $id]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['subcon'] as $id) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM subcon_payment_certificates WHERE inspection_id IN (SELECT id FROM subcon_inspections WHERE progress_id IN (SELECT id FROM subcon_progress WHERE contract_id = :i))")->execute(['i' => $id]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM subcon_inspections WHERE progress_id IN (SELECT id FROM subcon_progress WHERE contract_id = :i)")->execute(['i' => $id]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM subcon_progress WHERE contract_id = :i")->execute(['i' => $id]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM subcon_contracts WHERE id = :i")->execute(['i' => $id]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['project'] as $pid) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM project_progress_log WHERE project_id = :p")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
            // tabel project_progress TIDAK ADA di proyekGMN_test (hanya project_progress_log)
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM project_wip_release WHERE project_id = :p")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM material_out_items WHERE material_out_id IN (SELECT id FROM material_out_header WHERE project_id = :p)")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_movements WHERE warehouse_id IN (SELECT id FROM warehouses WHERE project_id = :p)")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM material_out_header WHERE project_id = :p")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM budget_items WHERE project_id = :p")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = :p")->execute(['p' => $pid]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['warehouse'] as $wid) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_movements WHERE warehouse_id = :w")->execute(['w' => $wid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM warehouses WHERE id = :w")->execute(['w' => $wid]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['material'] as $mid) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM budget_items WHERE material_id = :m")->execute(['m' => $mid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM materials WHERE id = :m")->execute(['m' => $mid]);
        }
        foreach ($g['created']['user'] as $uid) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM m_user_access_menu WHERE user_id = :u")->execute(['u' => $uid]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM m_user_system WHERE id = :u")->execute(['u' => $uid]);
        }
        $db->commit();
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        fwrite(STDERR, "[CLEANUP] gagal: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n");
    }
}

/* ============================================================
 * 4. TEST CASES
 * ==========================================================*/
function record(string $tc, string $scenario, $status, string $note = ''): void
{
    $GLOBALS['g']['results'][] = ['tc' => $tc, 'scenario' => $scenario, 'status' => $status, 'note' => $note];
    printf("  [%s] %-12s %s%s\n", $status === true ? 'PASS' : ($status === false ? 'FAIL' : 'SKIP'), $tc, $scenario, $note !== '' ? " -- {$note}" : '');
}
function approx(float $a, float $b, float $eps = 0.005): bool { return abs($a - $b) <= $eps; }

/** TC-PC-01: view v_project_actual_cost tersedia dan mengembalikan 1 baris/proyek. */
function tc01(): void
{
    $n = (int)csval("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'v_project_actual_cost'");
    $r = row("SELECT project_id, cost_material, cost_expense, cost_subcon, cost_total, rab_budget, progress
               FROM public.v_project_actual_cost WHERE project_id = :p", ['p' => $GLOBALS['g']['projP1']]);
    $ok = $n === 1 && $r !== null;
    record('TC-PC-01', 'view v_project_actual_cost ada + berisi proyek uji', $ok,
        $r ? ('cost_total=' . $r['cost_total'] . ' rab_budget=' . $r['rab_budget'] . ' progress=' . $r['progress']) : 'view/baris tidak ada');
}

/** TC-PC-02: ProjectActualCost() menyamai SUM manual (material posted) untuk proyek uji. */
function tc02(): void
{
    $db = db();
    $manual = (float)csval("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty_out * i.unit_cost), 0)
                            FROM material_out_items i
                            JOIN material_out_header h ON h.id = i.material_out_id
                            WHERE h.project_id = :p AND h.status = 'posted' AND h.reversed_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(h.issue_type,'PROJECT') = 'PROJECT'",
                            ['p' => $GLOBALS['g']['projP1']]);
    // fungsi ada di function.all.php (dimuat lewat endpoint; di sini panggil ulang via query view)
    $view = (float)csval("SELECT COALESCE(cost_material, 0) FROM public.v_project_actual_cost WHERE project_id = :p", ['p' => $GLOBALS['g']['projP1']]);
    $ok = approx($manual, $view);
    record('TC-PC-02', 'cost_material (view) == SUM manual material posted', $ok, "manual={$manual} view={$view}");
}

/** TC-PC-03: prog_metrics (via list_projects) mengembalikan cost_actual = cost_material + expense + subkon. */
function tc03(): void
{
    $g = &$GLOBALS['g'];
    $r = api($g['user_verifier'], 'project.progressCRD.php', 'list_projects', ['query' => 'P1 ' . CFG_TAG]);
    $ok = !empty($r['json']['success']);
    $row = null;

/* ============================================================
 * 5. LAPORAN & MAIN
 * ==========================================================*/
function write_report(array $groupResults, string $groupTitle): void
{
    $path = CFG_REPORT;
    $old = is_file($path) ? file_get_contents($path) : '';
    $sec = "<!-- BEGIN:{$groupTitle} -->\n";
    $sec .= "## {$groupTitle}\n\n";
    $sec .= "| TC | Skenario | Hasil | Bukti / Catatan |\n|----|----------|-------|------------------|\n";
    foreach ($groupResults as $r) {
        $st = $r['status'] === true ? 'PASS' : ($r['status'] === false ? 'FAIL' : 'SKIP');
        $sec .= "| {$r['tc']} | " . str_replace('|', '\\|', $r['scenario']) . " | {$st} | " . str_replace('|', '\\|', $r['note']) . " |\n";
    }
    $sec .= "<!-- END:{$groupTitle} -->\n";
    if (preg_match('/<!-- BEGIN:' . preg_quote($groupTitle, '/') . ' -->.*?<!-- END:' . preg_quote($groupTitle, '/') . ' -->\n?/s', $old)) {
        $out = preg_replace('/<!-- BEGIN:' . preg_quote($groupTitle, '/') . ' -->.*?<!-- END:' . preg_quote($groupTitle, '/') . ' -->\n?/s', $sec, $old);
    } else {
        $out = rtrim($old) . "\n\n" . $sec;
    }
    $pass = $fail = $skip = 0;
    foreach (preg_split('/\n(?=\| TC-)/', $out) as $ln) {
        if (strpos($ln, '| TC-') !== 0) { continue; }
        $cols = array_map('trim', explode('|', $ln));
        $h = $cols[3] ?? '';
        if ($h === 'PASS') { $pass++; } elseif ($h === 'FAIL') { $fail++; } elseif ($h === 'SKIP') { $skip++; }
    }
    $header = "# Test Report Progress Cost Control (F-1.1 & F-1.2) (TC-PC-01 s/d TC-PC-13)\n\n";
    $header .= "**Tanggal eksekusi:** " . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "  \n";
    $header .= "**Baseline:** branch `dev` | DB `proyekGMN_test` | base URL `" . CFG_BASE_URL . "`  \n";
    $header .= "**Dokumen acuan:** `tests/run_e2e_progress_cost_control.php`  \n";
    $header .= "**Ringkasan sementara:** PASS = {$pass}, FAIL = {$fail}, SKIP = {$skip}\n\n";
    $header .= "> Fitur: kontrol progress fisik vs realisasi biaya proyek.\n";
    $header .= "> F-1.1: hard-block klaim 100% tanpa issue material; verify memaksa ulang; manual progress non-admin ditolak.\n";
    $header .= "> F-1.2: satu rumus realisasi `v_project_actual_cost` (material + expense + subkon tersertifikasi)\n";
    $header .= "> dipakai konsisten di prog_metrics, dash_project_context, wr_calc, dan gate issuing.\n\n";
    $out = preg_replace('/^# Test Report Progress Cost Control.*?(?=\n## |\n<!-- BEGIN:)/s', '', $out);
    $out = $header . ltrim($out, "\n");
    file_put_contents($path, $out);
}

function main(array $argv): void
{
    $opts = $argv;
    $only = [];
    $doSetup = true; $doCleanup = true;
    foreach ($opts as $a) {
        if (strpos($a, '--only=') === 0) { $only = array_map('trim', explode(',', substr($a, 7))); }
        if ($a === '--setup') { $doCleanup = false; }
        if ($a === '--cleanup') { $doSetup = false; }
        if ($a === '--keep') { $doCleanup = false; }
    }

    echo "=== E2E Kontrol Progress vs Realisasi Biaya (F-1.1 & F-1.2) (TC-PC-01 s/d TC-PC-13) ===\n";
    echo "DB: " . CFG_DB_NAME . " @ " . CFG_DB_HOST . " | URL: " . CFG_BASE_URL . "\n";

    if ($doSetup) {
        echo "[setup] membuat data uji (P1 + WH-P1 + stok M1, pelapor lv2/verifier lv4/admin lv4)...\n";
        setup_test_data();
        echo "[setup] selesai. projP1={$GLOBALS['g']['projP1']} matM1={$GLOBALS['g']['matM1']} whP1={$GLOBALS['g']['whP1']} biM1={$GLOBALS['g']['biM1']}\n";
    }

    $groupPc = 'Kelompok PC — Kontrol Progress Proyek vs Realisasi Biaya (F-1.1 & F-1.2)';
    $tests = [
        'tc01' => 'TC-PC-01', 'tc02' => 'TC-PC-02', 'tc03' => 'TC-PC-03', 'tc04' => 'TC-PC-04',
        'tc05' => 'TC-PC-05', 'tc06' => 'TC-PC-06', 'tc07' => 'TC-PC-07', 'tc08' => 'TC-PC-08',
        'tc09' => 'TC-PC-09', 'tc10' => 'TC-PC-10', 'tc11' => 'TC-PC-11', 'tc12' => 'TC-PC-12',
        'tc13' => 'TC-PC-13',
    ];
    echo "[run] eksekusi Kelompok PC:\n";
    foreach ($tests as $fn => $tc) {
        if ($only && !in_array($tc, $only, true)) { continue; }
        $fn();
    }
    write_report($GLOBALS['g']['results'], $groupPc);

    if ($doCleanup) {
        echo "[cleanup] menghapus data uji...\n";
        cleanup_test_data();
        echo "[cleanup] selesai.\n";
    } else {
        echo "[cleanup] DILEWATI (--keep/--setup) -- data uji tetap di DB untuk investigasi.\n";
    }

    $p = count(array_filter($GLOBALS['g']['results'], fn($r) => $r['status'] === true));
    $f = count(array_filter($GLOBALS['g']['results'], fn($r) => $r['status'] === false));
    echo "\nHasil Keseluruhan (PC): PASS={$p} FAIL={$f} | laporan: " . CFG_REPORT . "\n";
    exit($f > 0 ? 1 : 0);
}

if (!defined('E2E_AS_LIB')) {
    main($argv);
}

<?php
/**
 * tests/run_e2e_leftover_and_rab_guard.php
 *
 * Runner E2E "Patch Gelombang 1" (audit hulu-hilir 2026-11-15 §9):
 *   - F-3.1  reference_type 'material_leftover' terdaftar di AutoPostJournal & JrnPost,
 *            retur sisa material proyek (material.leftoverCRD.php) IN + jurnal WH_LEFTOVER + reverse.
 *   - F-5.1  rule PRJ_DEP_APPLY siap di fiscal_config (migrasi
 *            sql/2026-11-15_patch_gelombang1_readiness_rab.sql, idempoten, dijalankan setup bila belum).
 *   - F-5.2  save_rab menolak hapus item RAB yang sudah dipakai PO (rabItemBlock).
 *   - F-5.3  kategori RAB disamakan DB vs PHP, case-insensitive, tanpa demote diam-diam ke 'Lain-lain'.
 *
 * Semua mutasi lewat HTTP endpoint asli (php -S 127.0.0.1:8098, RAB_DB_NAME=proyekGMN_test)
 * sehingga session/akses/CSRF teruji seperti produksi. Data uji ditandai TAG E2E-LGR dan
 * dibersihkan saat --cleanup.
 *
 * Pakai:  php tests/run_e2e_leftover_and_rab_guard.php [--setup|--cleanup] [--keep]
 */

if (PHP_SAPI !== 'cli') { http_response_code(403); exit('CLI only.'); }
error_reporting(E_ALL & ~E_NOTICE);

/* ---------------- Konfigurasi ---------------- */
const CFG_DB_HOST = '127.0.0.1';
const CFG_DB_PORT = '5432';
const CFG_DB_NAME = 'proyekGMN_test';
const CFG_DB_USER = 'postgres';
const CFG_BASE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:8098';
const CFG_ORIGIN   = 'http://127.0.0.1:8098';
const CFG_TAG      = 'E2E-LGR';

$argv = isset($_SERVER['argv']) ? $_SERVER['argv'] : [];
$doSetup  = in_array('--setup', $argv, true);
$doCleanup = in_array('--cleanup', $argv, true);

$pass = $fail = 0;
function rec(string $id, string $title, bool $ok, string $detail = ''): void {
    global $pass, $fail;
    if ($ok) { $pass++; } else { $fail++; }
    echo '  ' . ($ok ? '[PASS]' : '[FAIL]') . " {$id}  {$title}" . ($detail !== '' ? " -- {$detail}" : '') . "\n";
}

/* ============================================================
 * 1. HELPER DB (PDO prepared = pg_query_params-equivalent)
 * ==========================================================*/
function db(): PDO
{
    static $pdo = null;
    if ($pdo) { return $pdo; }
    $pass = getenv('E2E_DB_PASSWORD') ?: '';
    try {
        $pdo = new PDO('pgsql:host=' . CFG_DB_HOST . ';port=' . CFG_DB_PORT . ';dbname=' . CFG_DB_NAME, CFG_DB_USER, $pass, [
            PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE            => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
            PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
            PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES   => false,
        ]);
        $pdo->exec("SET DateStyle = 'ISO, MDY'");
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "[DB] koneksi gagal: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n");
        exit(1);
    }
    return $pdo;
}
function row(string $sql, array $p = []): ?array
{
    $st = db()->prepare($sql); $st->execute($p);
    $r = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    return $r === false ? null : $r;
}
function val(string $sql, array $p = [])
{
    $r = row($sql, $p);
    return $r ? array_values($r)[0] : null;
}
function esc(string $s): string
{
    return substr(preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+/', '-', $s), 0, 40);
}

/* ============================================================
 * 2. HELPER HTTP (Origin CSRF + cookie jar per user)
 * ==========================================================*/
function curl_base(array $extra, int $userId = 0): array
{
    $ch = curl_init();
    curl_setopt_array($ch, $extra + [
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
        CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS      => 5,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 60,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEFILE     => '/tmp/e2e_cookie_' . $userId,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEJAR      => '/tmp/e2e_cookie_' . $userId,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => ['Origin: ' . CFG_ORIGIN, 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'],
    ]);
    return [$ch, CFG_BASE_URL];
}
function http_post(string $path, array $fields, int $userId = 0): array
{
    list($ch,) = curl_base([
        CURLOPT_URL        => CFG_BASE_URL . $path,
        CURLOPT_POST       => true,
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => http_build_query($fields),
    ], $userId);
    $body = curl_exec($ch);
    $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    $err  = curl_error($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
    return ['http' => $code, 'body' => (string)$body, 'err' => $err];
}
/** Panggil endpoint CRUD sebagai userId; kembalikan ['http','json','raw']. */
function api(int $userId, string $crud, string $task, array $fields = []): array
{
    $fields['task'] = $task;
    $r = http_post('/php-crud/' . $crud, $fields, $userId);
    $json = json_decode($r['body'], true);
    return ['http' => $r['http'], 'json' => is_array($json) ? $json : null, 'raw' => $r['body'], 'err' => $r['err']];
}
/** Login via login.php; verifikasi dengan panggilan terautentikasi. */
function login(int $userId, string $loginName, string $password): bool
{
    $jar = '/tmp/e2e_cookie_' . $userId;
    if (is_file($jar)) { unlink($jar); }
    $ch = curl_init();
    curl_setopt_array($ch, [
        CURLOPT_URL            => CFG_BASE_URL . '/login.php',
        CURLOPT_POST           => true,
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS     => http_build_query(['username' => $loginName, 'password' => $password]),
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => false,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 60,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEFILE     => $jar,
        CURLOPT_COOKIEJAR      => $jar,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => ['Origin: ' . CFG_ORIGIN, 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'],
    ]);
    $body = curl_exec($ch);
    $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    $err  = curl_error($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
    if ($code !== 302 || stripos($body, 'Username atau Password salah') !== false || $err !== '') {
        fwrite(STDERR, "[LOGIN] user={$loginName} http={$code} err={$err} body0=" . substr($body, 0, 120) . "\n");
        return false;
    }
    $chk = api($userId, 'project.invoiceCRD.php', 'list_clients', []);
    return $chk['http'] === 200 && !empty($chk['json']['success']);
}

/* ============================================================

    'projId' => 0, 'whId' => 0, 'matId' => 0, 'expId' => 0, 'supId' => 0, 'curId' => 2,

    'made_prj_dep_apply' => false, 'made_checks' => false,

/** Idempoten: jalankan migrasi Patch Gelombang 1 (enum reference_type + PRJ_DEP_APPLY + CHECK kategori). */
function apply_wave1_migration(): string
{
    $db = db();
    $log = [];
    // F-3.1: nilai enum reference_type yang belum ada (ALTER TYPE ADD VALUE di luar transaksi)
    foreach (['material_leftover', 'subcon_leftover_buyback', 'subcon_invoice', 'subcon_invoice_pay'] as $ev) {
        $n = (int)val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_enum e JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = e.enumtypid
                        WHERE t.typname = 'reference_type' AND e.enumlabel = :v", ['v' => $ev]);
        if (!$n) {
            $db->exec("ALTER TYPE public.reference_type ADD VALUE '{$ev}'");
            $log[] = "enum+{$ev}";
        }
    }
    // F-5.1: PRJ_DEP_APPLY (Dr 2200 Uang Muka Penjualan / Cr 1200 Piutang Usaha, aktif)
    $has = (int)val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fiscal_config WHERE rule_code = 'PRJ_DEP_APPLY'");
    if (!$has) {
        $db->prepare("INSERT INTO fiscal_config (rule_code, rule_name, debit_account_id, credit_account_id, is_active)
                      SELECT 'PRJ_DEP_APPLY', 'Pemakaian deposit client untuk bayar termin', d.id, c.id, true
                        FROM chart_of_accounts d, chart_of_accounts c
                       WHERE d.account_code = '2200' AND c.account_code = '1200'")->execute();
        $log[] = 'PRJ_DEP_APPLY inserted';
    } else {
        $db->prepare("UPDATE fiscal_config f SET debit_account_id = d.id, credit_account_id = c.id, is_active = true
                        FROM chart_of_accounts d, chart_of_accounts c
                       WHERE f.rule_code = 'PRJ_DEP_APPLY' AND d.account_code = '2200' AND c.account_code = '1200'
                         AND (f.debit_account_id <> d.id OR f.credit_account_id <> c.id OR NOT f.is_active)")->execute();
        $log[] = 'PRJ_DEP_APPLY already present';
    }
    // F-5.3: samakan CHECK kategori budget_items/expense_master dengan RAB_CATEGORIES di PHP.
    // Constraint LAMA (dengan 'Alat') DIGANTI -- bukan sekadar ditambah bila belum ada.
    $db->exec("UPDATE budget_items SET category = 'Peralatan' WHERE category = 'Alat'");
    $db->exec("ALTER TABLE budget_items DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS budget_items_category_check");
    $db->exec("ALTER TABLE budget_items ADD CONSTRAINT budget_items_category_check
               CHECK (category IN ('Material','Upah','Peralatan','Transport','Konsumsi','Lain-lain'))");
    $db->exec("UPDATE expense_master SET category = 'Peralatan' WHERE category = 'Alat'");
    $db->exec("ALTER TABLE expense_master DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS expense_master_category_check");
    $db->exec("ALTER TABLE expense_master ADD CONSTRAINT expense_master_category_check
               CHECK (category IN ('Upah','Peralatan','Transport','Konsumsi','Lain-lain'))");
    // 2d) updated_at budget_items + trigger (perbaikan SQLSTATE[42703] path UPDATE save_rab non-material)
    $hasCol = (int)val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'budget_items' AND column_name = 'updated_at'");
    if (!$hasCol) { $db->exec("ALTER TABLE budget_items ADD COLUMN updated_at timestamp without time zone"); }
    $db->exec("CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_budget_items_touch() RETURNS trigger AS \$\$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at := NOW(); RETURN NEW; END \$\$ LANGUAGE plpgsql");
    $db->exec("DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_budget_items_touch ON budget_items");
    $db->exec("CREATE TRIGGER trg_budget_items_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON budget_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE fn_budget_items_touch()");
    $log[] = 'category CHECKs aligned to PHP list';
    $log[] = 'budget_items.updated_at + trigger ok';
    return implode('; ', $log);
}

/** Buat user harness level 4 (admin) khusus uji; login dengan password plain (login.php membandingkan plain). */
function ensure_admin_user(): int
{
    global $g;
    $uname = CFG_TAG . '-admin-' . date('His');
    db()->prepare("INSERT INTO m_user_system (login_name, password, active) VALUES (:u, :p, true) RETURNING id")
        ->execute(['u' => $uname, 'p' => $uname . '-pass']);
    $uid = (int)db()->lastInsertId();
    foreach ([132, 156, 145, 118, 157] as $formId) {               // 132=RAB, 157=Material Left Over (dari m_form_name)
        db()->prepare("INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level) VALUES (:uid, :f, 4)")
            ->execute(['uid' => $uid, 'f' => $formId]);
    }
    $g['adminId'] = $uid; $g['adminName'] = $uname; $g['adminPass'] = $uname . '-pass';
    $g['created']['user'][] = $uid;
    return $uid;
}

function cleanup_all(): void
{
    global $g;
    $db = db();
    $ids = $g['created'];
    if ($ids['lo_hdr']) {
        foreach ($ids['lo_hdr'] as $h) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_movements WHERE reference_type = 'MATERIAL_LEFTOVER' AND reference_id = :h")->execute([':h' => $h]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM journal_entries WHERE reference_type = 'material_leftover' AND reference_id = :h")->execute([':h' => $h]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM material_leftover_items WHERE header_id = :h")->execute([':h' => $h]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM material_leftover_header WHERE id = :h")->execute([':h' => $h]);
        }
    }
    if ($ids['mout']) {
        foreach ($ids['mout'] as $h) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM material_out_items WHERE material_out_id = :h")->execute([':h' => $h]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM material_out_header WHERE id = :h")->execute([':h' => $h]);
        }
    }
    if ($ids['po']) {
        foreach ($ids['po'] as $p) {
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM po_items WHERE po_id = :p")->execute([':p' => $p]);
            $db->prepare("DELETE FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = :p")->execute([':p' => $p]);
        }
    }
    if ($ids['budget']) {
        foreach ($ids['budget'] as $b) { $db->prepare("DELETE FROM budget_items WHERE id = :b")->execute([':b' => $b]); }
    }
    if ($ids['project']) {
        foreach ($ids['project'] as $p) { $db->prepare("DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = :p")->execute([':p' => $p]); }
    }
    // hapus user harness + menu-access-nya (JANGAN sentuh user asli seperti eddy)
    if ($g['adminId'] && in_array($g['adminId'], $ids['user'] ?? [], true)) {
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM m_user_access_menu WHERE user_id = :u")->execute([':u' => $g['adminId']]);
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM m_user_system WHERE id = :u")->execute([':u' => $g['adminId']]);
    }
    $jar = '/tmp/e2e_cookie_' . $g['adminId'];
    if (is_file($jar)) { unlink($jar); }
    echo "[CLEANUP] selesai.\n";
}

// ---------- TC-LGR-01..03: retur sisa material proyek (F-3.1) ----------
function tc_leftover_flow(): void
{
    global $g;
    $pid = $g['projId']; $wh = $g['whId']; $mid = $g['matId'];
    $today = date('Y-m-d');

    // TC-LGR-01: posting retur sisa -> stok IN + jurnal WH_LEFTOVER (Dr 1500 / Cr 1700)
    $r = api($g['adminId'], 'material.leftoverCRD.php', 'save', [
        'project_id' => $pid, 'warehouse_id' => $wh, 'doc_date' => $today,
        'remark' => CFG_TAG . ' retur sisa',
        'details' => json_encode([['material_id' => $mid, 'qty' => 1, 'notes' => 'E2E gelombang 1']]),
    ]);
    $ok = !empty($r['json']['success']) && !empty($r['json']['data']['id']);
    rec('TC-LGR-01', 'Retur sisa material proyek sukses (stok IN + jurnal WH_LEFTOVER)', $ok,
        $ok ? 'hdrId=' . $r['json']['data']['id'] : substr($r['raw'], 0, 180));
    if (!$ok) { return; }
    $hdrId = (int)$r['json']['data']['id'];
    $g['created']['lo_hdr'][] = $hdrId;

    $mov = row("SELECT movement_type, reference_type, qty, unit_cost FROM stock_movements
                 WHERE reference_type = 'MATERIAL_LEFTOVER' AND reference_id = :h", ['h' => $hdrId]);
    rec('TC-LGR-02', 'stock_movements IN tercatat (reference_type MATERIAL_LEFTOVER)',
        (bool)$mov && $mov['movement_type'] === 'IN' && (float)$mov['qty'] > 0,
        $mov ? "type={$mov['movement_type']} qty={$mov['qty']}" : 'tidak ada baris movement');

    $whr = row("SELECT debit_account_id AS dr, credit_account_id AS cr FROM fiscal_config WHERE rule_code = 'WH_LEFTOVER'");
    $stL = db()->prepare("SELECT l.account_id, l.debit, l.credit FROM journal_entries e
                              JOIN journal_lines l ON l.journal_id = e.id
                             WHERE e.reference_type = 'material_leftover' AND e.reference_id = :h
                             ORDER BY l.debit DESC, l.id");
    $stL->execute(['h' => $hdrId]);
    $lines = $stL->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    $okJr = $whr && count($lines) === 2
        && (int)$lines[0]['account_id'] === (int)$whr['dr'] && (float)$lines[0]['debit'] > 0 && (float)$lines[0]['credit'] == 0
        && (int)$lines[1]['account_id'] === (int)$whr['cr'] && (float)$lines[1]['credit'] > 0 && (float)$lines[1]['debit'] == 0;
    rec('TC-LGR-03', 'Jurnal WH_LEFTOVER terbit (Dr Persediaan 1500 / Cr WIP 1700) reference_type material_leftover',
        $okJr, $okJr ? 'Dr ' . $lines[0]['account_id'] . ' / Cr ' . $lines[1]['account_id'] : 'jurnal tak sesuai');

    // TC-LGR-04: reverse -> stok & jurnal ikut batal
    $rv = api($g['adminId'], 'material.leftoverCRD.php', 'reverse', ['id' => $hdrId]);
    $okRv = !empty($rv['json']['success']);
    rec('TC-LGR-04', 'Reverse retur sisa berhasil (stok & jurnal dibatalkan)', $okRv,
        $okRv ? '' : substr($rv['raw'], 0, 180));
    if (!$okRv) { return; }
    $mov2 = (int)val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_movements WHERE reference_type = 'MATERIAL_LEFTOVER' AND reference_id = :h", ['h' => $hdrId]);
    $je2  = (int)val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM journal_entries WHERE reference_type = 'material_leftover' AND reference_id = :h", ['h' => $hdrId]);
    $st   = row("SELECT status FROM material_leftover_header WHERE id = :h", ['h' => $hdrId]);
    rec('TC-LGR-05', 'Setelah reverse: movement=0, jurnal=0, status=reversed',
        $mov2 === 0 && $je2 === 0 && $st && $st['status'] === 'reversed',
        "mov={$mov2} je={$je2} status=" . ($st ? $st['status'] : '-'));
}

// ---------- TC-LGR-10..12: guard hapus RAB + kategori (F-5.2 & F-5.3) ----------
function tc_rab_guard(): void
{
    global $g;
    $pid = $g['projId'];

    // TC-LGR-10: save_rab menolak hapus item RAB yang sudah dipakai PO
    $r = api($g['adminId'], 'rabCRD.php', 'save_rab', [
        'project_id' => $pid, 'currency_id' => $g['curId'], 'exch_rate' => 1, 'rate_date' => date('Y-m-d'),
        // grid TANPA material proyek (bid dipakai PO) dan TANPA expense -> keduanya lama akan dihapus
        'items' => json_encode([
            ['category' => 'Material', 'material_id' => 0, 'expense_id' => 0, 'item_name' => 'x', 'budget_qty' => 0, 'unit_price' => 0],
        ]),
    ]);
    $body = (string)$r['raw'];
    $ok = !empty($r['json']) && empty($r['json']['success']) && stripos($body, 'tidak dapat dihapus') !== false && stripos($body, 'PO') !== false;
    rec('TC-LGR-10', 'save_rab menolak hapus item RAB yang sudah dipakai PO (guard F-5.2)', $ok,
        $ok ? 'pesan: ' . substr($body, 0, 120) : substr($body, 0, 200));

    // pastikan item belum terhapus (transaksi rollback)
    $still = (int)val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM budget_items WHERE id = :b AND project_id = :p", ['b' => $g['bidId'], 'p' => $pid]);
    rec('TC-LGR-11', 'Item RAB yang dipakai PO masih utuh di budget_items (rollback ACID)', $still === 1, "count={$still}");

    // TC-LGR-12: kategori 'PERALATAN' (huruf besar) dinormalisasi -> 'Peralatan', tersimpan tanpa demote
    $r2 = api($g['adminId'], 'rabCRD.php', 'save_rab', [
        'project_id' => $pid, 'currency_id' => $g['curId'], 'exch_rate' => 1, 'rate_date' => date('Y-m-d'),
        'items' => json_encode([
            ['category' => 'Material', 'material_id' => $g['matId'], 'expense_id' => 0, 'item_name' => 'Semen E2E', 'budget_qty' => 10, 'unit_price' => 5000, 'unit' => 'Sak'],
            ['category' => 'PERALATAN', 'material_id' => 0, 'expense_id' => $g['expId'], 'item_name' => 'Sewa Excavator', 'budget_qty' => 1, 'unit_price' => 1000000, 'unit' => 'ls'],
        ]),
    ]);
    $ok2 = !empty($r2['json']['success']);
    rec('TC-LGR-12', 'Kategori "PERALATAN" (upper) ternormalisasi & tersimpan (case-insensitive F-5.3)', $ok2,
        $ok2 ? '' : substr((string)$r2['raw'], 0, 200));
    if ($ok2) {
        $cat = val("SELECT category FROM budget_items WHERE project_id = :p AND expense_id = :e", ['p' => $pid, 'e' => $g['expId']]);
        rec('TC-LGR-13', 'budget_items.category tersimpan "Peralatan" (bukan demote Lain-lain)', $cat === 'Peralatan', "cat={$cat}");
    }

    // TC-LGR-14: kategori tidak dikenal -> error eksplisit (tanpa demote diam-diam)
    $r3 = api($g['adminId'], 'rabCRD.php', 'save_rab', [
        'project_id' => $pid, 'currency_id' => $g['curId'], 'exch_rate' => 1, 'rate_date' => date('Y-m-d'),
        'items' => json_encode([
            ['category' => 'Material', 'material_id' => $g['matId'], 'expense_id' => 0, 'item_name' => 'Semen E2E', 'budget_qty' => 10, 'unit_price' => 5000, 'unit' => 'Sak'],
            ['category' => 'Honor', 'material_id' => 0, 'expense_id' => $g['expId'], 'item_name' => 'Honor', 'budget_qty' => 1, 'unit_price' => 1000, 'unit' => 'ls'],
        ]),
    ]);
    $body3 = (string)$r3['raw'];
    $ok3 = !empty($r3['json']) && empty($r3['json']['success']) && stripos($body3, 'Kategori RAB tidak valid') !== false;
    rec('TC-LGR-14', 'Kategori tak dikenal "Honor" ditolak dengan pesan eksplisit', $ok3, substr($body3, 0, 160));
}

// ---------- TC-LGR-20: F-5.1 readiness PRJ_DEP_APPLY ----------
function tc_dep_apply_readiness(): void
{
    global $g;
    $r = row("SELECT f.rule_code, d.account_code AS dr, c.account_code AS cr, f.is_active
                FROM fiscal_config f
                JOIN chart_of_accounts d ON d.id = f.debit_account_id
                JOIN chart_of_accounts c ON c.id = f.credit_account_id
               WHERE f.rule_code = 'PRJ_DEP_APPLY'");
    rec('TC-LGR-20', 'PRJ_DEP_APPLY aktif di fiscal_config (Dr 2200 / Cr 1200)',
        (bool)$r && $r['dr'] === '2200' && $r['cr'] === '1200' && in_array($r['is_active'], [true, 't', 'true', 1, '1'], true),
        $r ? "Dr {$r['dr']} / Cr {$r['cr']} active=" . var_export($r['is_active'], true) : 'rule tidak ditemukan');
}

==================== FILE: ./tests/run_grid_wrap_static.php ====================
<?php
/**
 * tests/run_grid_wrap_static.php
 *
 * Uji statis pola "scoped grid text-wrap" (gelombang 3, 2026-11-17):
 *   - Setiap file JS yang menyuntikkan override CSS grid wrap WAJIB:
 *     (a) tidak memakai kurung kurawal ganda "{{"/"}}" (sisa gaya f-string Python -> CSS tidak valid),
 *     (b) brace "{}" seimbang di dalam string CSS yang di-inject,
 *     (c) syntax JS valid (node --check bila tersedia),
 *     (d) viewConfig grid memakai forceFit:false bila ada grid wrap.
 *   - Dashboard: keempat tabel ber-id wajib punya aturan wrap scoped + pengecualian .text-right nowrap.
 *
 * Tidak butuh DB / server HTTP (murni statis). Jalankan: php tests/run_grid_wrap_static.php
 */
if (PHP_SAPI !== 'cli') { http_response_code(403); exit('CLI only.'); }
error_reporting(E_ALL & ~E_NOTICE);

$root = dirname(__DIR__);
$pass = 0; $fail = 0;
function ok($id, $cond, $msg) {
    global $pass, $fail;
    if ($cond) { $pass++; echo "PASS $id: $msg\n"; }
    else       { $fail++; echo "FAIL $id: $msg\n"; }
}

/* ---------- TC-GW-01: tidak ada kurawal ganda di DALAM literal string (CSS) file JS ---------- */
$jsFiles = [
    'js/bin.location.js', 'js/stock.opname.js', 'js/stock.card.js',
    'js/purchase.order.js', 'js/warehouse.issuing.js', 'js/whrcv.js',
    'js/po.js', 'js/project.payment.js', 'js/project.invoice.js',
];
foreach ($jsFiles as $f) {
    $p = $root . '/' . $f;
    if (!is_file($p)) { ok('TC-GW-01', false, "$f tidak ditemukan"); continue; }
    $src = file_get_contents($p);
    // hanya periksa isi literal string single-quote (tempat CSS ditulis), bukan kode JS seperti {params:{...}}
    preg_match_all("/'((?:[^'\\\\]|\\\\.)*)'/", $src, $m);
    $bad = false;
    foreach ($m[1] as $lit) { if (strpos($lit, '{{') !== false || strpos($lit, '}}') !== false) { $bad = true; break; } }
    ok('TC-GW-01', !$bad, "$f: literal string bebas kurawal ganda {{ }} (bug f-string)");
}

/* ---------- TC-GW-02: brace seimbang pada CSS yang di-inject (ekstrak string IIFE injectGridWrapCss) ---------- */
foreach ($jsFiles as $f) {
    $p = $root . '/' . $f;
    if (!is_file($p)) continue;
    $src = file_get_contents($p);
    if (strpos($src, 'injectGridWrapCss') === false) continue;
    // ambil semua literal string single-quote di dalam blok IIFE
    $start = strpos($src, '(function injectGridWrapCss()');
    $end   = strpos($src, '})();', $start);
    $block = ($start !== false && $end !== false) ? substr($src, $start, $end - $start) : '';
    preg_match_all("/'((?:[^'\\\\]|\\\\.)*)'/", $block, $m);
    $css = implode('', $m[1]);
    $bal = 0; $min = 0;
    for ($i = 0, $n = strlen($css); $i < $n; $i++) {
        if ($css[$i] === '{') $bal++;
        if ($css[$i] === '}') { $bal--; if ($bal < 0) $min = $bal; }
    }
    ok('TC-GW-02', $bal === 0 && $min === 0 && strlen($css) > 200, "$f: CSS inject brace-seimbang (net=$bal, len=" . strlen($css) . ")");
}

/* ---------- TC-GW-03: forceFit:false pada grid yang dapat wrap ---------- */
$ffChecks = [
    'js/bin.location.js' => 'viewConfig: { forceFit: false',
    'js/stock.opname.js' => 'forceFit: false',
    'js/stock.card.js'   => 'forceFit: false',
    'js/warehouse.issuing.js' => 'forceFit: false',
    'js/whrcv.js'        => 'forceFit: false',
    'js/purchase.order.js' => 'forceFit: false',
    'js/po.js'           => 'forceFit: false',
    'js/project.payment.js' => 'forceFit: false',
    'js/project.invoice.js' => 'forceFit: false',
];
foreach ($ffChecks as $f => $needle) {
    $p = $root . '/' . $f;
    if (!is_file($p)) { ok('TC-GW-03', false, "$f tidak ditemukan"); continue; }
    $src = file_get_contents($p);
    ok('TC-GW-03', strpos($src, $needle) !== false, "$f memakai $needle");
    // tidak boleh ada sisa forceFit:true
    ok('TC-GW-03', strpos($src, 'forceFit: true') === false, "$f tidak lagi memakai forceFit:true");
}

/* ---------- TC-GW-04: dashboard wrap scoped + angka tetap nowrap ---------- */
$d = file_get_contents($root . '/views/dashboard.php');
foreach (['profit_table', 'aging_table', 'tax_rate_table', 'material_table'] as $tid) {
    ok('TC-GW-04', strpos($d, 'id="' . $tid . '"') !== false, "dashboard punya tabel #$tid");
    ok('TC-GW-04', strpos($d, '#' . $tid . ' th, #' . $tid . ' td') !== false, "dashboard CSS scoped #$tid th/td wrap");
}
ok('TC-GW-04', preg_match('/#profit_table th\.text-right.*nowrap/s', $d) === 1, 'dashboard kolom .text-right tetap nowrap');

/* ---------- TC-GW-05: node --check bila tersedia ---------- */
$nodeOk = false;
exec('command -v node', $o, $rc);
if ($rc === 0 && !empty($o)) { $nodeOk = true; }
foreach ($jsFiles as $f) {
    $p = $root . '/' . $f;
    if (!is_file($p)) continue;
    if (!$nodeOk) { ok('TC-GW-05', true, "$f: node tidak tersedia, skip syntax check"); continue; }
    exec('node --check ' . escapeshellarg($p) . ' 2>&1', $out, $rc2);
    ok('TC-GW-05', $rc2 === 0, "$f: node --check bersih" . ($rc2 === 0 ? '' : ' -> ' . implode(' ', $out)));
    $out = [];
}

echo "\nHasil: PASS=$pass FAIL=$fail\n";
exit($fail === 0 ? 0 : 1);

$db = new crud();

try {
    $username = 'demo';
    $raw_pass = 'xyz789';
    // Menggunakan enkripsi yang dibaca sistem (misal md5 atau EncodeData)
    $hashed_pass00 = md5($raw_pass); 
	$hashed_pass = password_hash($raw_pass, PASSWORD_DEFAULT);

    // Cek apakah user admin sudah ada
    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM m_user_system WHERE login_name = :username");
    $stmt->execute(['username' => $username]);
    $existing = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    if ($existing) {
        echo "User 'admin' sudah ada di dalam sistem (ID: {$existing['id']}).";
    } else {
        // Ambil ID employee pertama atau buat dummy
        $empStmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM m_employee ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1");
        $empStmt->execute();
        $emp = $empStmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $employee_id = $emp ? $emp['id'] : 1;

        // Query Insert ke m_user_system
        $query = "INSERT INTO m_user_system (login_name, employee_id, password, active) 
                  VALUES ('{$username}', {$employee_id}, '{$hashed_pass}', 'true');";
        
        // Insert login status
        $query .= "INSERT INTO m_user_login_status (user_id) VALUES (currval('m_user_system_id_seq'::regclass));";

        $db->cmdQ($query);
        echo "Berhasil! User <b>demo</b> dengan password <b>xyz789</b> berhasil di-inject ke database.";
    }
} catch (Exception $e) {
    echo "Gagal melakukan injection: " . $e->getMessage();
}
?>
